Manipulate the information - Use Orwell’s upgraded toolset and the information you have uncovered to create your own version of the truth. Then use that to gain influence and control over the situation.

End the threat - Expose the truth. Destroy the lives and influence of those who seek to bring harm to the government and diplomatic relations with neighboring countries. Put an end to the civil unrest threatening to destroy the Nation.
70010000109946.intro: Big Brother has arrived - and it’s you again.
70010000109946.name: Orwell: Ignorance is Strength

70010000109961.description:
Jump into a world of fast, physics-filled action where every kick sends enemies flying. Kick It to Stickman is a fun and chaotic fighting game that’s easy to pick up and impossible to stop playing. Use simple controls to dodge attacks, land powerful hits, and chain together crazy combos as you battle your way through waves of stickman enemies.

Explore different levels, face challenging opponents, and unlock new abilities to boost your fighting skills. With smooth animations, ragdoll physics, and satisfying impact effects, every encounter feels intense and entertaining.

Features:

• Action-packed stickman combat with physics-based movement
• Simple one-touch controls perfect for quick sessions
• Multiple levels filled with enemies to defeat
• Unlockable skills and power-ups
• Fun ragdoll effects and smooth animations
• Suitable for all ages

Kick, dodge, and fight your way to victory — become the ultimate stickman champion!
70010000109961.intro:
Fast fights
Wild physics
Endless fun
70010000109961.name: Kick It to Stickman

70010000109982.description:
Welcome to the Paldea region, a sprawling land of vast open spaces dotted with lakes, towering peaks, wastelands and perilous mountain ranges.

Experience your adventure the way you want as you freely go back and forth between three grand stories and challenge Gyms in the order you desire!

Share the joy of discovery as you and up to three friends adventure together in the same space! Cheer each other on as you battle wild Pokémon and show off the Pokémon that walk along with you.
70010000109982.intro: Welcome to the open world of Pokémon!
70010000109982.name: Pokémon Scarlet

70010000109989.description:
An urban redevelopment plan is underway in Lumiose City! The goal: to turn it into a place Pokémon and people can truly share. Shortly after arriving, you’ll choose from one of these partner Pokémon to accompany you on your journey – Chikorita, Tepig or Totodile.

Together, you can explore the streets of this vast city or visit Wild Zones – habitats where you’ll encounter wild Pokémon. To catch them, aim carefully and throw a Poké Ball or take them on with the help of the Pokémon on your team.
70010000109989.intro: An ambitious new adventure set within Lumiose City is coming in 2025.
70010000109989.name: Pokémon Legends: Z-A

70010000109990.description:
An urban redevelopment plan is underway in Lumiose City! The goal: to turn it into a place Pokémon and people can truly share. Shortly after arriving, you’ll choose from one of these partner Pokémon to accompany you on your journey – Chikorita, Tepig or Totodile.

Together, you can explore the streets of this vast city or visit Wild Zones – habitats where you’ll encounter wild Pokémon. To catch them, aim carefully and throw a Poké Ball or take them on with the help of the Pokémon on your team.
70010000109990.intro: Explore Lumiose City on Nintendo Switch 2
70010000109990.name: Pokémon Legends: Z-A – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000110001.description:
A masterpiece of historical simulation "ROMANCE OF THE THREE KINGDOMS 8" is revived after 20 years.
This version includes an improved "All Officers Play" feature, which allows players to play as any officer in the world of the Three Kingdoms.
The game is also packed with additional elements that bring the officers to life, such as "Destiny" which can dramatically change the course of events and "Tales" which offer a variety of stories to choose from.
Combining 2D and 3D technologies, the game features both new and nostalgic visual effects, as well as many new officer graphics created specifically for this title.
Enjoy the greatest military drama in the Three Kingdoms series, with the largest number of officers and scenarios!
70010000110001.name: ROMANCE OF THE THREE KINGDOMS 8 REMAKE

70010000110006.description:
You’re grounded again — this time under lock and key. Your parents have turned the house into a fortress: your mom stalks the second floor, your dad guards the first, and every attempt to slip out could end in humiliating punishments. But in SCHOOLBOY SIM, every locked door hides a puzzle, every patrol can be outsmarted, and freedom is always just one clever step away.

The game drops you straight into a cinematic storyline: your mom storms in, hands down your punishment, and locks you inside. From that moment, your mission begins — find the codes, beat the patrols, and escape before the night is over.

Features:
• Outsmart your parents and learn their patrol patterns.
• Solve puzzles that unlock doors, codes, and secret paths.
• Use stealth and timing to sneak past danger.
• Piece together clues leading to your ultimate escape.

No handholding — only hints. Every move is a risk, every success a step closer to freedom. SCHOOLBOY SIM turns a simple punishment into a tense, cinematic escape adventure.
70010000110006.intro: In a house turned prison, every creak is a risk — and every smart move brings you closer to freedom.
70010000110006.name: SCHOOLBOY SIM

70010000110020.description:
Step into a world of romance where every message matters. Chat with charming anime girls, discover their hobbies, dreams, and personalities, and see where your conversations lead. Build meaningful relationships, make choices, and find out who could become your special someone.

Features:
- Real-time texting: Message multiple girls through your phone and experience unique responses from each one. Pay attention to their personalities to strengthen your bond.
- Choice-driven dialogues: Your decisions shape your relationships. Be careful with your choices — trust is key, and every decision influences how the story unfolds.
- Romantic dates: Turn successful conversations into dates. Every outing is a chance to get closer and learn more about her personality.
- Photo sharing: As connections grow, girls will share personal photos, revealing more about their interests and character. Each girl has her own collection of images.

Every message counts, every choice matters, and every moment brings you closer to finding your perfect match. Are you ready to start your romantic journey?
70010000110020.intro: Adventure, romance, and unforgettable moments in every chat.
70010000110020.name: Anime Love Chat Girls

70010000110027.description:
Take control of advanced cleaning equipment and travel through diverse locations, restoring shine to objects of all shapes and sizes. Explore three large areas, each filled with unique items waiting to be brought back to life. Choose the right tools, switch between washer nozzles, and enjoy the deeply satisfying process of transforming dirty surfaces into spotless perfection.

Features:
1. Three Large Locations: Explore three big areas, each with multiple zones and objects to clean, from benches to larger structures.
2. Variety of Equipment: Use a professional washer with interchangeable nozzles and special detergent options for tough dirt.
3. Detailed Object Cleaning: See dirt, rust, and grime disappear in real time, revealing clean surfaces.
4. Bonus Missions: Complete short, time-limited challenges for extra fun and variety.
5. Relaxing Atmosphere: Enjoy soothing water sounds, smooth cleaning, and visually satisfying results for a calming experience.

Step into the world of ultimate cleanliness, master your tools, and experience the simple joy of turning grime into sparkle. Every swipe, spray, and scrub brings satisfaction—proving that even the smallest tasks can be truly rewarding.
70010000110027.intro: Scrub, wash, and power through every messy challenge.
70010000110027.name: Wash Cleaner Simulator
70010000110027.publisher: Lu Ming trading as Shane Game

70010000110033.description:
Step onto the course and enjoy a colorful 3D mini golf adventure packed with creative holes, clever obstacles, and competitive fun for everyone.

Minigolf Family Party delivers fast-paced arcade sports gameplay that is easy to learn and exciting to master. Aim carefully, control your power, and sink the perfect putt as you navigate ramps, moving platforms, narrow bridges, loops, and tricky angles. Every course rewards precision, timing, and smart strategy.

Play solo to sharpen your skills and beat your personal best, or gather friends and family for local matches full of laughter and friendly competition. Take turns, challenge each other, and see who can finish with the lowest score.

Explore vibrant themed environments with dynamic obstacles that keep every round fresh and unpredictable. Master bank shots, use the terrain to your advantage, and discover clever shortcuts to gain the edge.

With smooth controls and quick rounds, Minigolf Family Party is perfect for short play sessions, party nights, and weekend tournaments. It is a family-friendly sports experience designed for players of all ages.

Features:
• Fun and accessible 3D mini golf gameplay
• Creative courses filled with exciting obstacles
• Skill-based mechanics with precise shot control
• Local party mode
• Colorful environments and smooth performance
• Replayable challenges for endless family fun

Line up your shot, plan your angle, and bring the whole family together for the ultimate mini golf party.
70010000110033.intro:
Family-friendly golf party game
Tricky holes and fun obstacles
Local match action
70010000110033.name: Minigolf Family Party

70010000110044.description:
Feel the thrill of high-speed motorcycle racing in Moto Championship 26, a fast and exciting superbike experience. Race through challenging tracks, lean into sharp corners, and push your bike to the limit as you compete for the championship title.

Choose your bike, perfect your racing lines, and battle skilled AI opponents who fight for every position. Smooth controls and responsive handling make every race intense and accessible for both new players and experienced riders.

Features:
• Fast and dynamic motorcycle races
• Multiple tracks with unique layouts and challenges
• Smooth, precise bike handling
• Competitive AI racers
• Unlock new bikes and aim for the 2026 championship

Start your engine, hit the track, and rise to the top in Moto Championship 26!
70010000110044.intro:
Moto Racing at Full Speed
Dynamic Tracks & Challenges
Race to the Top in 2026
70010000110044.name: Moto Championship 26

70010000110053.description:
Inspired by the adventure and imagination that we love from classic science-fiction, No Man's Sky presents you with a galaxy to explore, filled with unique planets and lifeforms, and constant danger and action.

In No Man's Sky, every star is the light of a distant sun, each orbited by planets filled with life, and you can go to any of them you choose. Fly smoothly from deep space to planetary surfaces, with no loading screens, and no limits. In this infinite procedurally generated universe, you'll discover places and creatures that no other players have seen before - and perhaps never will again.

Embark on an epic voyage
At the centre of the galaxy lies a irresistible pulse which draws you on a journey towards it to learn the true nature of the cosmos. But, facing hostile creatures and fierce pirates, you'll know that death comes at a cost, and survival will be down to the choices you make over how you upgrade your ship, your weapon and suit.

Find your own destiny
Your voyage through No Man's Sky is up to you. Will you be a fighter, preying on the weak and taking their riches, or taking out pirates for their bounties? Power is yours if you upgrade your ship for speed and weaponry.

Or a trader? Find rich resources on forgotten worlds and exploit them for the highest prices. Invest in more cargo space and you'll reap huge rewards.

Or perhaps an explorer? Go beyond the known frontier and discover places and things that no one has ever seen before. Upgrade your engines to jump ever farther, and strengthen your suit for survival in toxic environments that would kill the unwary.

Share your journey
The galaxy is a living, breathing place. Trade convoys travel between stars, factions vie for territory, pirates hunt the unwary, and the police are ever watching. Every other player lives in the same galaxy, and you can choose to share your discoveries with them on a map that spans known space. Perhaps you will see the results of their actions as well as your own...
70010000110053.intro: No Man's Sky is a game about exploration and survival in an infinite procedurally generated universe.
70010000110053.name: No Man's Sky

70010000110064.description:
Poetic Trio is a themed set of three games. A game about rain (Pluviophile), a game about snow (Chionophile), and a game about wind (Loverowind). All in one. The core aspect of each game is the atmosphere. It is recommended for those who mostly seek to experience the mood.


Pluviophile is a short experience about the mood of rain in the woods. It is a slow-paced pure walking simulator; you only walk, slowly, in the wilderness away from civilization. A beautiful poem from Julius Cawein accompanies your short journey; and the original music score that is composed by Pınar Karabaş.

*

Chionophile is a short experience about the mood of winter in the woods. It is a slow-paced pure walking simulator; you only walk, slowly, in the wilderness away from civilization. A beautiful poem from Archibald Lampman accompanies your short journey; and the original music score that is composed by Pınar Karabaş.

The game has 2 chapters. While the first one is a little linear, the second one (which is more expansive) takes place in a large open area. There are paths for the player to follow to reduce confusion about where to go. But you are free to roam away from the path and discover.

*

Loverowind is a short experience about the wind of spring. Similar to Pluviophile, you collect flowers, and use them on the altars to reveal a poem. But this time you move much faster, unless the circles of light roaming in the world don't catch you.
70010000110064.intro: A game about rain, a game about snow, and a game about wind. All in one.
70010000110064.name: Poetic Trio

70010000110084.description:
Fight off the employee's infection and get the highest score! In order to get the highest score, cover more space on the immune system field than the opponent.

CURE MODE

Cure 20 infected immune system fields using the Cell Disc vaccine and unlock secret quotes from sick employees!

VS MODE

Battle a friend playing as either Cell Disc or Poison and decide if the infected corporate slave should live or die!

XX

About Bernard Cinemas

In 2004 a local movie theater went out of business leaving their employees without a job. Not too long from it's closure a former employee named Bernard Jays decided to open his own movie theater a year later, and called it Bernard Cinemas. It was an absolute success! Since 2005 Bernard Cinemas became known for it's support of independent films and freshly made popcorn butter! Unfortunately during the early years of prosperity, thousands of employees who made the butter on a daily basis were infected and exposed to it's "Poison".

Infected employees over time reported having fever, god complex, yellow skin, and yellow blood. Many have died due to complications of the Poison, but Bernard Cinemas never lost it's reputation or financial support. The hundreds of deaths did not put a dent in the company's operations. Film companies continued to flock, the wealthy continued to donate, politicians continued to protect, and the unfortunate continued to apply.

Eventually, in 2018 when Bernard Cinemas gained a certain billion dollar threshold, corporate finally took exertion and decided to act by creating a vaccine called "Cell Disc" to combat the Poison. Since then every new generation of infected employees are required to take Cell Disc. Those who were able to survive the one-hour curing process were gifted with overtime and of course free movies! As of today, the Cell Disc vaccine has retained many hard working employees from possible death, giving them a newfound purpose to live and serve Bernard Cinemas forever!

XX
70010000110084.intro: A simple strategy board game featuring 20 different immune systems!
70010000110084.name: Extra Extra Poison NS

70010000110116.description:
Mini Airways is a real-time management game with an air traffic control theme.
You will play as a busy air traffic controller in the game: directing planes to take off and land, clearing air traffic, upgrading airspace ...... And most of all, don't let them crash!

Real-TimeATC
Fast-paced, real-time ATC gameplay: Manage airspace, clear planes for takeoff and landing, and avoid near misses! In addition to the normal arrangement of takeoffs and landings, you also need to face the challenges of mountains, no-fly zones, and peak landing hours, so please concentrate!

Upgrade Your Airspace
Every time you finish one day's management, you will be able to pick an upgrade for your airspace and airport: auto holding, accelerating turns, increasing airspace, waypoints ...... upgrade and customize airports to keep flights running more smoothly.

Distinctive Global Maps
As you increase your flight management records, you will gradually unlock a total of 19 airspace maps based on real-world airports—from Beijing Capital, Shanghai Hongqiao, Chengdu Shuangliu in China to Vancouver, New York in North America, and then to London, Amsterdam in Europe... Showcase your air traffic control skills across various global airports!

Surprise Random Events
The game triggers random events under certain specific maps and conditions, featuring classic moments in aviation history: the miracle landing on the Hudson River, Air Force One crossing, emergency incidents, high-priority flights, etc.

Three Selectable Modes
The game offers three modes: Classic, Hardcore, and Sandbox.
In Hardcore mode, the airspace simulates real ATC operations without the ability to pause within the session;
In Sandbox mode, players have full control over waypoints, props, and landing intensity, allowing you to design their own waypoints and test the maximum flight density they can handle.

Custom Maps&Mods
The game supports creating custom maps and mods. Players can import map assets, freely configure runways, restricted areas, and other terrains for gameplay. For those with more demanding needs in aviation management, they can create MODs for altitude, wind speed, etc., enhancing the strategic depth of the game.

Play with your mates
Each airport can accommodate up to 4 people online. You can work with your friends to jointly manage the same airspace to reduce the impact of mistakes and challenge higher scores!
70010000110116.intro: Mini Airways is a real-time management game where you play the role of an air traffic controller. Clear your aircraft to takeoff & land, direct them to the destination.
70010000110116.name: Mini Airways

70010000110122.description:
Welcome to The World’s Game in EA SPORTS FC™ 27.

Step into The Grounds‡‡, a social football playground where the streets meet the stadium. From Kickabouts and 1v1s to teaming up with friends in Clubs, connect with renowned football mentors, improve your abilities, and express yourself on and off the pitch.
Feel greater control in every game mode with more fluid, true-to-life gameplay, featuring dynamic corners, enhanced attacking awareness, player-focused defending tailored for competitive play, and more community-driven innovations.
Sign your next star in Manager Career through a rebuilt Transfer Market with realistic player values and active club bidding. Master new negotiation tactics, including performance and buy-back clauses, as Dynamic OVRs reflect player form, morale, and fitness across every club.
Immortalise your dream club in Football Ultimate Team™ with the brand-new FUT Gallery. Curate your favourite Player Items to grow your Gallery Level, earn rewards, and build your Club’s identity throughout the new football season.
Experience unrivalled authenticity in EA SPORTS FC™ 27, with match data from the world’s top leagues powering 21,000+ licensed players.

‡‡The Grounds mode, including Clubs, only available on Nintendo Switch™ 2 version.

This game includes optional in-game purchases of virtual currency that can be used to acquire virtual in-game items, including a random selection of virtual in-game items.
70010000110122.name: EA SPORTS FC™ 27

70010000110137.description:
Have you always dreamed of finding a great group for tabletop RPGs?
This time, you can dive headfirst into thrilling adventures!

EmyLiveShow: Demons & Mistresses Tale is the continuation of Dragon & Mistresses Tale — now featuring a fully customizable protagonist!
Meet Amy, Nia, Uma, and Six in person, get to know them better, and of course, play through an exciting fantasy story about saving the world… that might just turn into a wild party!

EmyLiveShow: Demons & Mistresses Tale is a visual novel styled after a tabletop RPG, complete with dice roll mechanics.

Create your own protagonist.
You can choose gender and appearance at the start, but that’s not all — your choices and opinions will shape the hero’s personality and how others treat them.

Follow two parallel story levels.
While untangling the main plot, don’t forget those sitting at the table with you! Playing along with one of them might be the best way to win her favor…

Test your luck.
Dice rolls determine the outcome of your actions — but even failure moves the story forward. Sometimes a setback can be more exciting than success!

Discover the continuation of Dragon & Mistresses Tale — or start fresh.
The story is told from the perspective of a new player joining the group, so no prior knowledge is required — but returning fans will enjoy many subtle references!
70010000110137.intro: Fantasy battle of EmyLiveShow vtubers — fight or fall to temptation!
70010000110137.name: EmyLiveShow: Demons and Mistresses Tale

70010000110147.description:
Maestro is an easy-to-learn hard-to-master rhythm game that turns you into an orchestra conductor. With precise Joy-Con™ motion controls, every gesture matters. You don’t just play the music: you conduct it.

Explore a curated repertoire spanning movies and gaming soundtracks, classical and jazz music bringing together the most iconic works in music History. Conduct scores from Star Wars, Game of Thrones, The Lord of the Rings, Harry Potter, and Attack on Titan and the timeless masterpieces of Beethoven, Mozart, Wagner, Vivaldi, and Duke Ellington.

Step into the Parisian artistic society and discover music, culture and gastronomy where real orchestra conducting meets griping rhythm gameplay. Set the tempo, cue the instruments, guide the crescendos, and lead every performance in real time.

Are you ready to become a true Maestro?
70010000110147.intro: Grab your Joy-Con™ and throw real Maestro moves!
70010000110147.name: Maestro

70010000110156.description:
In 1936, Nazi influence has spread, along with rumours of secret excavations, mysterious artefacts, and gruesome occult rituals... Assemble a bold team of adventurers and journey through the desert-wilderness. Outwit foes in strategic squad combat and locate ancient treasures before they fall into the wrong hands!

• DYNAMIC ADVENTURES - Discover 5 different campaigns of varying difficulty, each attempt generating a new web of events...

• TOUGH CHOICES - Encounter hand-crafted story events. Search the well? Save the villagers? It's up to you!

• DECISIVE CONFLICTS - Use cover and positioning in exciting turn-based squad combat. Learn to make the best use of your team's abilities and equipment in order to defeat the enemy!

• BUILD YOUR TEAM OF ADVENTURERS - Each of Pathway’s 16 unlockable characters has their own set of skills and quirks which can impact combat and story encounters.

• HIDDEN TREASURES - Trade-in your high-value loot in order to upgrade your team's arsenal with increasingly rare weapons and armour.

• RECOVER & REPLAY - Experiment with different team combinations until your foes have been vanquished!
70010000110156.intro: A rip-roaring adventure into the unknown...
70010000110156.name: Pathway

70010000110164.description:
Clothing Store Simulator

Build and manage your own fashion boutique and discover the exciting world of retail!
In Clothing Store Simulator, you’ll oversee every aspect of running a successful clothing shop, from designing attractive displays to helping customers find their perfect style, all within a vibrant 3D setting.

Choose new clothing lines, arrange your store layout, and keep shelves and racks organized to create a welcoming shopping experience. Assist visitors at checkout, maintain customer satisfaction, and grow your reputation as a top fashion destination. As profits increase, expand your store space, upgrade interiors, and unlock fresh collections to keep up with the latest trends.

Whether you enjoy business management games or prefer a calm and creative experience, Clothing Store Simulator offers relaxing gameplay that lets you build the fashion store you’ve always imagined.

Features:

• Realistic 3D supermarket environment
• Stock shelves, scan items, and serve customers
• Manage inventory and balance your profits
• Upgrade your store and unlock new products
• Enjoy casual, relaxing gameplay suitable for all players

Are you ready to open your boutique and become the top fashion manager in town?
Your clothing store journey begins now!
70010000110164.intro:
Manage your own clothing store.
Arrange displays and help your customers.
Expand your store as your business grows!
70010000110164.name: Clothing Store Simulator

70010000110170.description:
Truck Simulator Europe

Start your journey as a professional truck driver and explore the vast road networks of Europe! In European TRUCK Simulator, you will transport cargo between cities, complete delivery contracts, and experience the life of a long-distance trucker in a detailed 3D world.

Take control of powerful trucks, plan your routes, and drive across highways, countryside roads, and busy urban areas. Complete transport missions, deliver cargo safely, and earn rewards to improve your trucking career. Manage your deliveries carefully, maintain efficiency, and build your reputation as a reliable driver.

As you progress, unlock new trucks, upgrade your vehicles, and expand your fleet to take on bigger and more profitable jobs. Improve your trucks’ performance and customize them to match your driving style.

Whether you enjoy simulation games or relaxing driving experiences, European TRUCK Simulator offers immersive gameplay where you can travel across Europe and build your own trucking success story.

Features:

• Drive powerful trucks across European roads
• Deliver cargo and complete transport missions
• Earn rewards and upgrade your trucks
• Unlock new vehicles and expand your fleet
• Change between day and night driving
• Experience different weather conditions, including rain
• Enjoy a relaxing and immersive driving experience

Are you ready to start your trucking career and conquer the roads of Europe?
70010000110170.intro:
Drive powerful trucks across Europe.
Deliver cargo and complete transport jobs.
Upgrade your trucks and expand your fleet.
70010000110170.name: European TRUCK Simulator

70010000110176.description:
Build and manage your own electronics store!

Stock the shelves with the latest gadgets, electronics, and accessories. Set prices, organize your products, serve customers, and keep your store running smoothly.

Expand your business as you earn profits. Unlock new products, upgrade your store, increase your inventory, and create the perfect shopping experience for your customers.

Every decision matters as your small electronics shop grows into a successful retail business.

Features:
• Manage your own electronics store
• Stock and organize a variety of products
• Set prices and maximize your profits
• Serve customers and manage daily operations
• Unlock new electronics and accessories
• Upgrade and expand your store
• Grow your business into an electronics retail empire

Start small, make smart decisions, and become the ultimate electronics store tycoon!
70010000110176.intro: Build your electronics empire! Stock the latest gadgets, serve customers, set prices, upgrade your store, and become the ultimate electronics retail tycoon.
70010000110176.name: Supermarket Electronic

70010000110182.description:
Jump into explosive tank battles in Tank Battle Arena Combat! Take control of powerful war machines and fight your way through action-packed missions filled with enemy tanks, obstacles, and intense firefights.

Drive across dynamic battlefields, aim carefully, and unleash devastating attacks to destroy opponents and complete challenging objectives. Upgrade your tank, improve your combat performance, and adapt your strategy to overcome increasingly difficult encounters.

Easy to learn and fun to master, the game delivers fast-paced action with simple controls and satisfying physics-based combat. Every battle rewards skillful movement, precise shooting, and smart positioning.

Prepare for nonstop tank warfare and prove your dominance on the battlefield!

Features:
Action-packed tank combat
Multiple challenging missions
Upgradeable tanks and combat abilities
Simple controls with dynamic gameplay
Explosive battles and satisfying destruction
70010000110182.intro:
Drive powerful tanks into battle.
Destroy enemies and conquer missions.
Fast, explosive tank action awaits!
70010000110182.name: Tank Battle Arena Combat

70010000110201.description:
Inspired by the adventure and imagination that we love from classic science-fiction, No Man's Sky presents you with a galaxy to explore, filled with unique planets and lifeforms, and constant danger and action.

In No Man's Sky, every star is the light of a distant sun, each orbited by planets filled with life, and you can go to any of them you choose. Fly smoothly from deep space to planetary surfaces, with no loading screens, and no limits. In this infinite procedurally generated universe, you'll discover places and creatures that no other players have seen before - and perhaps never will again.

Now including...
Play with all major updates since launch: Foundation, Pathfinder, Atlas Rises, NEXT, The Abyss, Visions, the 2.0 BEYOND update, Synthesis, Living Ship, Exo Mech, Desolation and the 3.0 update, ORIGINS, Next Generation, Companions, Expeditions, Prisms, Frontiers, Sentinel, Outlaws, Endurance, Waypoint (4.0),  Fractal, Interceptor, Echoes, Omega, Orbital, Worlds Part I (5.0), Worlds Part II and Relics.

An epic voyage to the centre of a shared universe awaits, allowing you to explore, trade, fight and survive alone or with friends.

Embark on an epic voyage
At the centre of the galaxy lies a irresistible pulse which draws you on a journey towards it to learn the true nature of the cosmos. But, facing hostile creatures and fierce pirates, you'll know that death comes at a cost, and survival will be down to the choices you make over how you upgrade your ship, your weapon and suit.

Find your own destiny
Your voyage through No Man's Sky is up to you. Will you be a fighter, preying on the weak and taking their riches, or taking out pirates for their bounties? Power is yours if you upgrade your ship for speed and weaponry.

Or a trader? Find rich resources on forgotten worlds and exploit them for the highest prices. Invest in more cargo space and you'll reap huge rewards.

Or perhaps an explorer? Go beyond the known frontier and discover places and things that no one has ever seen before. Upgrade your engines to jump ever farther, and strengthen your suit for survival in toxic environments that would kill the unwary.

Share your journey
The galaxy is a living, breathing place. Trade convoys travel between stars, factions vie for territory, pirates hunt the unwary, and the police are ever watching. Every other player lives in the same galaxy, and you can choose to share your discoveries with them on a map that spans known space. Perhaps you will see the results of their actions as well as your own...
70010000110201.intro: No Man's Sky is a game about exploration and survival in an infinite procedurally generated universe.
70010000110201.name: No Man's Sky Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000110223.description: The story of YinYang Street takes place in a border town in the 1980s. Our protagonist Li Minglai is involved in an important operation. He runs into a series of strange things and finds his beloved wife missing when he comes home. Where used to be warm and sweet is now full of mysteries, which lead to a place called YinYang Street. Is this a coincidence or a conspiracy? Li Minglai has no time to think about it. All he could do is rush to YinYang Street and explore the bottomless abyss...
70010000110223.intro: Step into the fabled YinYang Street
70010000110223.name: YinYang Street Ultimate Edition

70010000110227.description:
Set in Fódlan, a land governed by three powers, Fire Emblem Warriors: Three Hopes takes the world and characters of Fire Emblem: Three Houses and spins a new tale.

Enjoy fights that fuse action and tactics. Directly control characters and mow down hordes of enemies in intense Warriors action, while giving orders to allies. Think tactically as you decide where to advance, based on the state of the battlefield. Between battles, interact with charming characters from Fire Emblem: Three Houses.

What awaits in this as-yet unseen story? Will it be hope…or despair?

The game will be available in English, French, German, Spanish and Italian, with English and Japanese voiceover.


(Download version bonus) Owl Perch
An owl will now periodically appear in front of your personal quarters in camp. If you talk to the owl, you can get an Owl Feather as a gift. You can use an Owl Feather to gain support points with an ally.
70010000110227.name: Fire Emblem Warriors: Three Hopes

70010000110234.description:
Step into the shoes of a professional freerunner and conquer urban landscapes like never before! In Parkour Simulator 2026, master jumps, flips, wall-runs, and vaults as you navigate rooftops, alleys, and obstacles with precision and style.

Train your skills, perform daring stunts, and unlock new abilities as you tackle increasingly challenging courses. Whether racing against the clock or exploring the city at your own pace, every move counts in your quest to become the ultimate parkour master.

Key Features:
	•	Realistic Movement – Experience fluid, dynamic parkour mechanics.
	•	Challenging Courses – Test your skills across rooftops, alleys, and urban environments.
	•	Stunt System – Perform flips, wall-runs, vaults, and combos with precision.
	•	Progression & Upgrades – Unlock new abilities and improve your freerunner’s skills.
	•	Freestyle & Exploration – Freely explore the city or compete in timed challenges.

Can you master the city and become the ultimate parkour legend?
70010000110234.intro: Jump, flip, and run across rooftops to become the ultimate parkour master.
70010000110234.name: Parkour Simulator 2026
70010000110234.publisher: Lu Ming trading as Shane Game

70010000110242.description:
Re-experience the critically acclaimed, genre-defining game that started it all. Beautifully remastered, return to Lordran in stunning detail. DARK SOULS: REMASTERED includes the main game plus the Artorias of the Abyss DLC.

Deep and Dark Universe
Delve into an epic dark fantasy universe stricken by decline and the Curse. Explore its intricate world design - full of hidden passages, dungeons and secrets - and uncover its deeply rooted lore.

Each End is a New Beginning
Each playthrough surprises you with new challenges and unexpected facets of the game. Don’t bet on completing the game only once.

The Way of the Multiplayer
Whatever your motivations are to play online – collaboration or confrontation, support or betrayal – you’ll find your true home among the nine covenants. Which allegiance will you choose?
70010000110242.name: DARK SOULS™ Remastered

70010000110243.description:
■Digital Deluxe Edition: Contents
・The Hundred Line -Last Defense Academy-
・Digital Art Book
・Digital Soundtrack

◆15 Students Against an Army of Invaders
When Takumi Sumino wakes up in a strange school surrounded by otherworldly fire, all he wants is to go home. But his self-appointed "Commanding Officer," Sirei, has other ideas.
Takumi and the other students are tasked with defending the school from grotesque monsters known as School Invaders for the next 100 days, with the fate of humanity itself on the line.
What is Last Defense Academy? Who are the School Invaders? And what is the truth behind this war?

◆Adventure Game Meets SRPG
Takumi's choices will affect how the story progresses, leading to a multitude of possible endings.
Alternate between story and battle sequences for a fusion of strategy, intrigue, and excitement!
70010000110243.intro:
The curtain rises on 100 days of Extreme Despair...
Kazutaka Kodaka and Kotaro Uchikoshi join forces for the first time to deliver the ULTIMATE adventure game!
70010000110243.name: The Hundred Line -Last Defense Academy- Digital Deluxe Edition

70010000110252.description:
Explore the grim world inspired by Cthulhu Mythos and collect memory fragments to uncover the secret society. Experience the gritty atmosphere through your multiple runs, upgrade your cards to shape unique strategies and most importantly - try not to lose your sanity.

Features:
▪ One threat, four answers - four playable heroes (including The Abomination), each with their own unique deck of battle cards and fighting style,
▪ Shape your destiny - various inventory items, battle allies, powerful relic collections and upgrades to make your run more thrilling,
▪ Madness repeats itself - enjoy high replayability with different seeds that will let you master the game,
▪ Truth lies beneath - encounter strange events, uncover dark secrets and recover lost memories,
▪ Expand the insanity - this edition includes “The Rift of Sanity” DLC, featuring a brand new character, allies, items and an additional game act.

Additional languages:
- Hungarian (HU/MAGYAR),
- Turkish (TUR/TÜRKÇE),
- Ukrainian (UA/УКРАЇНСЬКА).
70010000110252.intro: Menace from the Deep is a roguelike deckbuilder, set in myth-soaked 1920s USA, where cults and eldritch horrors lurk beneath the surface.
70010000110252.name: Menace from the Deep: Complete Edition

70010000110258.description:
Diver, Catch & Cook Simulator lets you explore the ocean’s depths by day and run a sushi restaurant by night. Hunt fish and strange marine creatures using harpoons, weapons, and underwater tools, then turn your catch into delicious dishes to earn profits and upgrade your gear. Manage oxygen, face unknown threats, and dive deeper to discover rare species and hidden zones.

Key Features
- Day & Night Gameplay Loop: Dive for fish by day, run a sushi restaurant by night
- Harpoon Combat & Fishing: Use harpoons to catch fish and creatures — with hook for automatic loot or without hook for manual collection
- Deep-Sea Exploration: Discover new depths, biomes, and dangerous creatures
- Crafting & Upgrades: Improve suits, weapons, and underwater scooters
- Progression-Based Discovery: Unlock new fish, creatures, and challenges as you dive deeper

Take a deep breath, dive in, and master the balance between survival, exploration, and culinary success.
70010000110258.intro: Balance survival, exploration, and culinary mastery in every dive.
70010000110258.name: Diver, Catch & Cook Simulator

70010000110259.description:
Fairy Tail: Dungeons is a deck-building roguelike where you combine magic cards and outwit your enemies to win battles.
Players control Fairy Tail characters with diverse abilities and skills, exploring dungeons within a limited number of steps. Using decks built to suit their strategy, they defeat enemies that attack them, aiming to reach the deepest part of the dungeon.

Features an All-new Story
One day, Natsu and Happy discover a mysterious door has suddenly appeared below the guild. Inside, they find a strange, expansive dungeon that saps all intruders of their powers. With no means to defend themselves, the two seem doomed until an Exceed called Labi comes to their aid. Once they hear about Labi's missing friend, Natsu and Happy decide to head for the deepest depths themselves.

Labyrinth (Solo Dungeon)
Use the cards in your deck to attack, defend, cast magic, and more. Power up your deck further with cards won in battle or found in treasure chests. Use cards in a specific order to activate Magic Chains for punishing amounts of damage.

Explore the solo dungeon and unlock powerful skills before your lantern goes out. If you're lucky, you might even run into fellow guild members who can join up with you!

Even if you fall in battle, the points you earn exploring will unlock amulets which will aid in future runs through the dungeon. Don't let defeat stop you. Try and try again!

Characters
Players can control a whopping 10 characters.
Each character has their own fighting style and fortes.
Natsu, a balanced all-rounder.
Lucy, who calls on her unique celestial spirits to wreak havoc on the battlefield.
Gray, who uses diverse molding magic to gain tactical advantage, and many more!
Discover how to use each effectively and earn the upper hand in battle.

Labyrinth Depths (Team Dungeon)
Form a team with 3 characters you've trained in the solo dungeon, and dive deep into the depths. Find tomes inside to power up your team's stats. Don't miss out on the final boss—an original character illustrated by Fairy Tail creator Hiro Mashima himself!

Music
Features a soundtrack produced by Secret of Mana composer Hiroki Kikuta. The world of Fairy Tail comes alive through Celtic-inspired sounds that add a vibrant backdrop to the battles and story scenes.
70010000110259.intro: Another tale of Fairy Tail, who fought for their comrades' wishes...
70010000110259.name: FAIRY TAIL: DUNGEONS

70010000110265.description:
Experience the real challenge of managing and driving your own bus in this realistic simulator. In Bus Simulator, you can purchase different buses, upgrade them across three categories, and explore the city through missions or free-ride mode. Each level has a clear goal: reach the marked point on the mini-map and complete the route safely.

Key Features:
- Build your own bus fleet and customize it with powerful upgrades
- Take on level-based missions with clear goals and increasing challenges
- Enjoy Free Ride mode and explore the city at your own pace
- Manage fuel, fatigue, and vehicle condition to keep your routes running smoothly
- Drive carefully to avoid penalties and costly repairs
- Experience realistic bus handling designed to test your skills on every trip

Take the driver’s seat and prove your skills on every route. From careful city driving to managing your bus fleet, every trip is a test of strategy, precision, and timing. Are you ready to become a true bus driving pro?
70010000110265.intro: Every route, every passenger, every stop — shape your career as a city bus driver.
70010000110265.name: City Bus Simulator

70010000110277.description: Winner of more than 200 Game of the Year awards, The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim, the open-world masterpiece where you can be anyone and do anything, now allows you to go anywhere – at home or on the go. Skyrim® brings to life a complete virtual world for you to explore any way you choose,  including all-new features like motion controls, plus outfits and gear from compatible The Legend of Zelda™ amiibo. Take down enemies with the Master Sword, protect yourself with the Hylian Shield or look heroic in the Champion’s Tunic. The legendary freedom of choice and adventure of Skyrim is realized like never before. Dragons, long lost to the passages of the Elder Scrolls, have returned and the future of Skyrim hangs in the balance. As Dragonborn, the prophesized hero born with the power of The Voice, you are the only one who can stand amongst them.
70010000110277.name: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim

70010000110283.description:
Welcome to Cosmic Coop, a cozy farming and creature-collecting game where you discover adorable Critterlings, grow crops, and decorate your perfect little world.

Tend your farm, discover new Critterlings, and craft decorations inspired by the creatures you raise. Each Critterling has its own personality and unique item drops, letting you design your farm in creative ways.

Unlock new decorations, collect resources, place homes, and create the perfect balance to keep your Critterlings happy.

Whether you’re farming, decorating, upgrading your home, or just watching your Critterlings roam the farm, every day on your farm is a chance to build something new.

With its simple controls, colorful art, and relaxing gameplay, Cosmic Coop is the perfect cozy escape for players of all ages.
70010000110283.intro: Raise adorable Critterlings, craft unique items, and create your dream farm.
70010000110283.name: Cosmic Coop

70010000110289.description:
"Neopets™: The Mega Mini Games Collection is a lovingly remastered collection of 26 fan-favourite mini-games from the golden age of Neopets! From collecting Doughnutfruits in Hasee Bounce, launching Kass in Kass Basher, or chasing Neggs in Meerca Chase, the magic of Neopets is back!

And introducing an all-new adventure: Starlight Symphony, starring Nyx in a dazzling musical quest through the stars!

26 Classic Games, Remastered
Enjoy a curated library of Neopia’s most beloved web games, now optimised for controllers, widescreen displays, and silky-smooth 60 FPS gameplay.

Play Your Way
Choose from Arcade, Challenge, or Endless mode

Unlockable Goodies
Earn trophies, stickers, and Pet-themed rewards as you play and master each game

From the Haunted Woods to Faerieland, each and every pixel, song, and piece of art has been restored with care, welcoming back returning fans and inviting new ones into the whimsical world of Neopia.

Reconnect/Connect With Your Inner Neopian
Whether you're returning to Neopia or discovering it for the first time, this collection is your ticket to the colourful, quirky universe that inspired a generation.

So dust off your Slorg Blaster, grab your favorite pet, and get ready, you’ve got a world to explore!"
70010000110289.intro: Journey back to Neopia with 26 classic games, brought back to life for new and returning fans!
70010000110289.name: Neopets - Mega Mini Games Collection - The Neopian Arcade Odyssey

70010000110292.description:
School’s out, but 11-year-old Milano’s mom needs to go to the hospital and Milano is sent to spend the summer with her uncle. There’s one small problem – her uncle is away on vacation! Left on her own, Milano decides to make the most of her situation by taking up a variety of part-time jobs in town. Over the next 40 days, Milano goes all in – delivering pizzas, nursing sick patients, milking flying cows, and more – to make this summer unforgettable. And maybe she can spruce up her uncle’s place and have some fun while she’s at it.

Previously only available in Japan, this charming classic delivers cute Japanese nostalgia to worldwide audiences for the first time!

◆Milano Meets the World
Full English text and voiceovers bring Milano’s pixel-art adventures to a whole new audience. Fans can rest assured that the original Japanese is also available, complete with all-new English subtitles.

◆Make Your Home Away from Home
Rest and relaxation are important for work-life balance. Milano can style the house with new furniture and decor instead of going into work, and at night she can enjoy quiet time inside with her uncle’s cat, stargazing from her bedroom, and making use of items purchased with her hard-earned wages.

◆It’s Not Work if You Love to Do It
Help Milano earn money in eight unique mini games, including curing diseases as a nurse, catching falling fruits in an orchard, and more. Enrich Milano’s skill, mood, and energy in the evenings to unlock more odd jobs and higher difficulty levels. The tougher the challenge, the bigger the payday!

◆Nostalgic Gameplay, Modern Conveniences
The charm and gameplay of the original release are intact, but improved load times, save states, and a rewind feature help update this classic title for modern audiences.
70010000110292.intro: For the first time outside Japan, help Milano take on an exciting summer of part-time jobs and cozy home life.
70010000110292.name: Milano's Odd Job Collection

70010000110296.description:
Welcome to "Cats Ritual"
a captivating indie adventure where you must navigate a decaying city to gather 30 elusive cats and save an eccentric NPC from the clutches of ancient cat spirits. As you explore the hidden corners of this forsaken urban landscape—alleys, abandoned lots, and shadowy rooftops—you'll uncover the secrets behind the Eternal Ritual, a sacred dance that keeps the malevolent cat spirits at bay.

Key Features:
- Exploration: Roam through diverse locations such as derelict buildings, shadowy alleys, and forgotten parks, each hiding its own mysteries and dangers.

- Collection: Find and collect 30 unique cats, each with their own personality and story, essential for completing the ritual.

- Puzzle-Solving: Overcome clever puzzles and challenges that stand between you and the cats, testing your wit and agility.

- Character Interactions: Meet a variety of peculiar characters, from the agitated NPC to other city dwellers, who may aid or obstruct your quest.

"Cats Ritual" blends exploration, collection, and narrative depth into a unique gaming experience. With its whimsical yet thrilling tone, the game offers a journey into a city forgotten by time, where every meow could be your salvation—or your doom. Will you succeed in your quest and restore balance to the city, or will you fall victim to the eternal regret?
70010000110296.intro: Lights out - cats out! Catch them before it's too late!
70010000110296.name: Cats Ritual

70010000110302.description:
Clockwork Rabbit is a relaxing single-player isometric puzzle game set in a steampunk world inhabited by adorable bunnies.

Meet Tessa, a young mechanic working in a textile factory in Clockwork Town, where every room hides a new challenge.

The game blends time manipulation, action planning, helper robot programming, and creative puzzle solving. With no time limits, you can play at your own pace and enjoy a calm, laid-back experience.

Key features:
A calm and thoughtful puzzle experience
Single-player adventure with narrative background
Isometric perspective
Time manipulation mechanics
No violence, no ads, no microtransactions
Stylized visuals and a unique atmosphere
Suitable for both experienced and new players
Crafted with passion by an independent team

Jump into the rabbit hole with Tessa and try to catch that bunny!
70010000110302.intro: Tessa works as a mechanic in a textile factory. A puzzle game with hand-crafted puzzles based on manipulating time. A cute story about sweet bunnies.
70010000110302.name: Clockwork Rabbit

70010000110303.description:
Deadly Premonition 2: A Blessing in Disguise for Nintendo Switch is a sequel that takes place in present-day Boston. However, through unique storytelling, venture back in time to Le Carré and uncover the mysteries buried within the once peaceful town.

Serving as both a sequel and prequel to the original Deadly Premonition, follow Agents Davis and Jones as they begin a new investigation into the Le Carré serial murders. Through the memories of a former FBI agent, go back in time to Le Carré and step into the role of Special Agent York to begin unraveling the mystery.

• Return as FBI Special Agent York and experience a brand-new murder mystery!

• Both a prequel and a sequel: A historic investigation to uncover the murder mystery in Le Carré

• An open-world adventure: Travel around the town of Le Carré by foot or skateboard

• Mini-games: Bowling, Bayou Ride, Skateboard Challenge, and more

• Customisation: Customise your character and upgrade your skateboard for improved speed and landing more difficult tricks
70010000110303.intro: Return as FBI Special Agent York and experience a brand-new murder mystery in Deadly Premonition 2 for Nintendo Switch!
70010000110303.name: Deadly Premonition 2: A Blessing In Disguise

70010000110310.description:
In No More Heroes 3, the otaku assassin Travis Touchdown wields his beloved Beam Katana against a host of baddies brimming with attitude in the hopes of rising to the top of the Galactic Superhero Rankings.

・ Hack and slash your heart out!

Whip together cutthroat combos with the Beam Katana! The action feels even more extreme when you use a Joy-Con to play.

・ Ranking fights are even more chaotic!

Take on the series's classic ranking fights on a galactic level and see what out-of-this-world boss fights are waiting for Travis! Each rank features a host of heinous outer-space superheroes for you to slice and dice.

・ Explore the open world of Santa Destroy!

Return to the series's familiar setting - now with four new locations! Rev up Travis's motorbike, Demzamtiger, to explore the various areas of Santa Destroy and take on missions oozing with slick charm. While you're at it, you can also save up the cash you'll need to challenge Ranking Battles!

Bonus:
You can change Travis's T-shirt to a special bonus design called "CAT (overseas ver)".

This software may contain product placement and advertising.
70010000110310.intro:
The curtain's up on Travis Touchdown's latest adventure.
Help him rise through the ranks of the Galactic Superhero Rankings!
70010000110310.name: No More Heroes 3

70010000110313.description:
Join Mickey & Friends on a quest to explore the mysterious island of Month and recover three mystical books to save the world from disaster!

Play as Mickey & Friends
Choose your favorite character and unlock special abilities as you perform high-flying platforming feats, solve fun puzzles, and take on epic boss battles.

Reveal the mysteries of Disney Illusion Island
Run, swim, swing, and jump your way through a beautiful yet mysterious island and discover rich biomes, intriguing characters, and hidden secrets.

Fun with friends in 4-player co-op
Play solo or grab up to three friends to save the island of Monoth in 4-player couch co-op. Team up with friends and utilize unique skills such as Rope Drop, Leap Frog, and a heart gifting Hug.

Be a part of an authentic Mickey cartoon
Experience a brand-new Mickey & Friends adventure with hand-drawn animation, an orchestrated original score and authentic voice talents.
70010000110313.intro: Join Mickey & Friends on a quest to explore the mysterious island of Month and recover three mystical books to save the world from disaster!
70010000110313.name: Disney Illusion Island

70010000110330.description:
The legendary gaming console – the Death Drive Mark 2… Travis Touchdown wanders into the game world and embarks on a rampage of epic proportions in Travis Strikes Again: No More Heroes for Nintendo Switch. Inside, there’s an action game, racing, puzzles…A total of seven different game titles! With his Beam Katana in hand, he vows to exterminate every last Bug he finds.

Pass a Joy-Con controller to a friend for co-op multiplayer – and partner up with the one and only Badman! Did we mention the Adventure Mode, which tells a new story?
70010000110330.name: Travis Strikes Again: No More Heroes

70010000110333.description:
*This is a Nintendo Switch™ version product.
*There is also a Nintendo Switch™ 2 version of this game. Please select the version you require carefully.

[Product Summary]
Set on the continent of Orsterra, OCTOPATH TRAVELER 0 is a tale of revenge and restoration that centres around the divine rings.

Embark on an adventure of your own creation.

Enjoy familiar features such as the series' HD-2D graphics, a fusion of retro pixel art and 3DCG; the player's ability to roleplay using Path Actions of their choice; and the Break and Boost system that can turn the tide of battle. Additionally, brand-new features such as character creation and town building allow you to create your own character and restore your hometown.

[Key Features]
1. You are the protagonist of the story. Choose your appearance, voice, motions, and favorite dish with the new character creation feature!

2. Restore your hometown through town building. Invite companions and allies to live in a town of your creation!

3. Engage in exhilarating and strategic command battles. Choose from over 30 allies to form a party comprised of up to eight characters!

4. Use Path Actions to invite people to your town, engage in battle, and obtain items. Where you go and what you do is entirely up to you.

5. Equip action skills with the new skill system. These skills can be learned by allies and passed on to others.

*The OCTOPATH TRAVELER 0 Digital Deluxe Edition, which combines the OCTOPATH TRAVELER 0 base game and paid additional content at a lower price, is also available.
*Please see the official website for details of the bonuses for each edition.
70010000110333.intro: Start from Zero in a Tale of Restoration and Retribution
70010000110333.name: OCTOPATH TRAVELER 0

70010000110342.description:
Magin: The Rat Project Stories takes place in a dark fantasy world, where magic – or essence, as it is called – is directly tied to the desires and fears of its inhabitants.

Shape the fate of Elester, a Magin and veteran hitman in an underworld syndicate, as well as young Tolen, who is about to realize that he too can use the essence to his advantage.

Step into a mature, magical world standing on the edge of an industrial revolution and utter chaos.

Overcome obstacles, play your cards wisely, and find your destiny in this immersive, story-driven adventure.

Adventure Game
- Explore atmospheric and mysterious locations by investigating the environment, and interacting with items.
- Battle horrific creatures and meet numerous complex characters - potential allies or foes.

The Essence Mechanic
- Manage your essence by utilizing emotions, both in combat and during exploration.
- The emotional state of your character influences the story and various gameplay mechanics.

Branching Storyline
- Immerse yourself in a cold and harsh fantasy world where medieval culture is confronted with the invention of industrial, magic-powered machines, and the forces that seek to control them.
- Follow the main characters on their journey of lost and redeemed hope and decide its outcome based on your choices.

Card System Mechanics
- Manage and upgrade your deck as the story progresses.
- Gain special cards from story choices and defeated enemies.
- Craft unique double-sided, emotion-infused essence cards fitting your strategy.
70010000110342.intro: Magin is an exciting combination of a narrative-driven adventure game with a deck-building card battler.
70010000110342.name: Magin: The Rat Project Stories

70010000110343.description:
Embark on a harrowing journey into the heart of darkness with Escape From Pripyat, a narrative-driven shooter that plunges you into a realm where fear and survival intertwine. You assume the role of a fearless investigative reporter, part of a specialized unit dispatched to document the unfolding horrors within the desolate ruins of Pripyat. However, your mission takes a sinister turn when your helicopter is brutally attacked by an enigmatic creature, leaving you as the sole survivor amidst the eerie aftermath.
In this relentless struggle for survival, you must navigate treacherous environments, battling grotesque mutants and hostile adversaries while unearthing the chilling secrets buried within Chernobyl's shadowy depths. Armed with your wits, firearms, and an array of melee weapons, you'll delve into abandoned buildings and hazardous territories, scavenging for crucial supplies and piecing together the fragmented truth.

Game Features:
	•	Immersive Horror Atmosphere: Prepare to be immersed in a chilling atmosphere enriched with unsettling sounds, nerve-wracking jump scares, and haunting soundtracks that amplify the tension.
	•	Dynamic Gameplay Mechanics: Master the art of interaction with the environment, from scavenging essential resources to manipulating environmental elements for tactical advantage.
	•	Survival Essentials: Manage hunger, thirst, and inventory meticulously as you navigate a realistic day-night cycle that dynamically influences gameplay.
	•	Narrative Depth: Engage with a compelling storyline driven by your quest to survive, uncover the mysteries of Chernobyl, and confront the horrors that lurk in its darkest corners.
	•	Combat Mastery: Enhance your combat prowess through precision aiming, strategic melee combat, and unexpected encounters that test your reflexes and resourcefulness.

Escape From Pripyat challenges you to confront your deepest fears, to unravel the enigma of Chernobyl's haunting legacy, and to emerge victorious from the abyss. Are you prepared to face the unknown, reporter? Your odyssey into darkness begins now.
70010000110343.intro: Survive the silent ruins where danger lurks in every shadow.
70010000110343.name: Chernobyl: Escape from Pripyat

70010000110357.description:
Tiny Garden lets you cultivate a pocket-sized garden inside a magical toy passed down through generations. Grow a variety of plants, trade them for unique furniture, and customize your garden in this calming mix of farming, puzzle-solving, and strategy. With no scores or time limits, it’s all about relaxing, experimenting, and letting your creativity bloom!

EVERYTHING IS A TOY IN TINY GARDEN!

Tiny Garden is a soothing, stress-free mix of farming, puzzles, and discovery - all inside a charming toy. Grow a variety of plants, from colourful vegetables to whimsical flowers, each with its own unique mechanics waiting to be uncovered. As your garden flourishes, trade your harvests for fun, toy furniture, and design your very own magical space.

A TOY WITH HISTORY

Before you got your hands on Tiny Garden, others have played with this toy. Through letters, you'll uncover a heartfelt story that reminds us that objects aren’t just things - they hold the traces of lives lived and stories shared. Each new discovery offers more than just a piece of furniture or a plant - it’s a glimpse into a deeper connection.

RELAX, DISCOVER, CREATE

Tiny Garden invites you to turn the crank, make things happen, and enjoy a wholesome but thoughtful experience. Each turn should be carefully considered - each decision and each new plant can reveal hidden surprises or unlock the next step in your garden’s evolution. There are no wrong choices here - just a relaxing journey where you can unwind, explore, and create without pressure.
70010000110357.intro: Tiny Garden lets you grow a pocket-sized garden inside a magical toy passed down through generations.
70010000110357.name: Tiny Garden

70010000110363.description:
In the floating world of beauty and illusion, love is the most dangerous secret of all.
You arrive as a stranger… but soon, one glance, one whispered word, changes everything.

Each geisha hides a story  of duty, desire, and dreams long buried beneath layers of silk and silence.
As you grow closer, your choices will shape a fragile bond that could either blossom into forbidden love… or fade like cherry petals in the wind.

Will you be the one to free her heart… or let her disappear into the shadows of tradition?

How far would you go for love that was never meant to be?


Game Features:

● Romance among the blossoms: Fall for captivating geishas, each with her own past, secrets, and emotions waiting to unfold.

● Your choices decide her fate: Comfort her, challenge her, or confess your feelings. Every decision changes your shared destiny.

● A poetic journey through the floating world: Immerse yourself in an atmosphere of beauty, melancholy, and passion.

● Multiple endings: Discover the bittersweet paths of love, freedom, and sacrifice.

● A visual novel of emotion and elegance: Where every word, glance, and gesture can change the course of a heart.


Will you risk everything to love a geisha who can never be yours?
70010000110363.intro: A geisha’s heart longs for freedom… will you be the one to set it free?
70010000110363.name: Geisha's Heart: Romance Among the Cherry Blossoms

70010000110369.description:
In the age of steel and cherry blossoms, love is a forbidden blade.
You arrive as an outsider… but soon, a single glance, a moment of trust, changes everything.

Each samurai carries a story of duty, pride, and a heart trapped between loyalty and desire.
As your bond deepens, every choice you make draws you closer to a love that defies both fate and tradition.

Will you pierce the armor around his heart… or watch him vanish into the path of duty?

How far would you go for a love that could destroy everything?


Game Features:

● Romance among the blossoms: Fall for noble samurais, each with his own past, scars, and secret longing for connection.

● Your choices decide his fate: Encourage his courage, challenge his loyalty, or confess your forbidden love. Every decision shapes your destiny together.

● A poetic journey through honor and passion: Experience the tension between duty, emotion, and the beauty of fleeting love.

● Multiple endings: Discover the paths of devotion, sacrifice, and redemption.

● A visual novel of emotion and elegance: Where every word, look, and silence could change the course of two hearts.


Will you risk everything to love a samurai bound by duty?
70010000110369.intro: A samurai’s heart hides behind honor… will you be the one to make it surrender?
70010000110369.name: Samurai Shoguns Heart: Romance Among the Cherry Blossoms

70010000110375.description:
Welcome to a farm where nothing is normal.

One minute, you’re feeding the animals…
The next, you’re in a turn-based battle against a chicken with ninja kicks.

Defeat her, capture her, and —WHAT?!—

She transforms into a cute anime girl who wants to go on a date?!

In Farm Love Legend, every animal hides a secret human form.

Every battle could unlock a new romance.

And every girl you meet has her own wild personality inspired by her animal nature:

• A shy lamb girl who just wants a hug…
• A proud fox girl who loves teasing you…
• A strong cow warrior with a heart of gold…

Your choices decide who will be your ultimate farm waifu.
Just don’t let the other girls find out.


GAME FEATURES:

♥ CAPTURE & TRANSFORM: Battle animals like in a monster game… then date them as cute anime girls.

♥ TURN-BASED COMBAT: Strategy meets seduction.

♥ ROMANCE & VISUAL NOVEL CHOICES: Build bonds, go on dates, unlock secret memories.

♥ FARM LIFE + WAIFU LIFE: Upgrade your farm AND your relationships.

♥ MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Which animal girl will become your legend?


It’s weird.
It’s funny.
It’s sexy in a “WAIT WHAT?!” way.

Are you ready to fall in love with your farm?
70010000110375.intro:
Capture. Transform. Date.
Wait… you turned a cow into a waifu?!
70010000110375.name: Farm Love Legend: Transform your Animals into Anime Girls

70010000110383.description:
Welcome to a farm where nothing makes sense.

One minute, you’re feeding the animals…

The next, you’re in a turn-based battle against a chicken throwing ninja kicks at your face.

You win, you capture him and—WHAT?!—
He transforms into a handsome anime boy asking you out?!

In Farm Love Legend, every farm animal hides a secret human form.

Every battle could unlock a brand-new romance.
And every boy’s personality is wild in his own way:

• A shy lamb boy who melts at every hug…
• A flirty fox boy who loves teasing you…
• A strong bull warrior with a tender heart…

Your choices decide who becomes your ultimate farm husbando.
(And yeah… try not to make the others jealous)


GAME FEATURES:

♥ CAPTURE & TRANSFORM: Battle animals like in a monster game… then date them as charming anime boys

♥ TURN-BASED COMBAT: Strategy + seduction = chaos

♥ ROMANCE & VISUAL NOVEL CHOICES: Chat, bond, unlock moments you’ll never forget

♥ FARM LIFE + LOVE LIFE: Upgrade your home and deepen your relationships

♥ MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Who will be the one waiting for you at the barn?


It’s ridiculous.
It’s hilarious.
It’s sexy in a “WAIT WHAT?!” way.

Are you ready to fall in love with your farm?
70010000110383.intro:
Capture. Transform. Date.
Wait… you turned a bull into a husbando?!
70010000110383.name: Farm Love Legend: Transform your Animals into Anime Boys

70010000110419.description:
Get ready to roll, jump, and think your way through a series of stunning 3D mazes!
Amazing Maze redefines the classic “roll-a-ball” experience with creative twists, parkour-inspired moves, and physics-based puzzles that challenge both your reflexes and your mind.

Collect the yellow cubes, find the exit, and master each maze with creativity and precision. Every challenge offers multiple paths and clever ways to escape — sometimes, thinking outside the box is the only way out!

Transform your sphere to gain special abilities like speed boost, jump, or wall climb. You’ll need to master when and how to use them to reach the goal in style. And yes — you can wall run and wall jump with a sphere!

With colorful visuals, satisfying physics, and countless ways to overcome obstacles, Amazing Maze is the perfect blend of logic, creativity, and arcade fun for all ages!
70010000110419.intro: Roll, jump, climb, and outsmart every maze in a colorful 3D world full of physics and surprises for all ages!
70010000110419.name: Amazing Maze

70010000110444.description:
A carefree new life is just beyond the horizon! Step off the plane and onto your very own deserted island where new friends, discoveries and opportunities are waiting for you.

New ways to play
The Nintendo Switch 2 Edition of Animal Crossing: New Horizons uses the unique features of the console to offer even more ways to enjoy your island paradise!

Your island, clearer than ever
With the enhanced 4K resolution of the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition, you’ll be able to see your island and its residents even clearer than before!

Get creative with mouse controls
Use the intuitive mouse controls of the Joy-Con 2 controller to redecorate your home, organise your furniture, create Custom Designs and even draw posts for the bulletin board.

New item: Megaphone
Purchase the Megaphone from Nook's Cranny, then use it to find your island friends by calling out their names. The built-in microphone of Nintendo Switch 2 will help find where they are, even if they’re far away from you!

Play with more friends at once!
In the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition, up to 12 players can play together on one island online or up to eight players via local wireless play.

With GameChat, you’ll be able to talk to your friends while playing with them. And by connecting a compatible USB-C camera, such as the Nintendo Switch 2 camera (sold separately), they’ll be able to see your expressions as you play!
70010000110444.intro: Welcome to the Deserted Island Getaway Package!
70010000110444.name: Animal Crossing: New Horizons – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000110459.description:
Immerse yourself in the chilling tale of the Chen Family Village, where a mother searching for her missing daughter accidentally stumbles into a haunted place filled with mysterious cults. Guide Jia Jun Lee as she searches a village and pieces together fragile clues to her loved one’s whereabouts, carefully hiding her movements as supernatural threats close in from all sides.

Incantation is a first-person horror-themed adventure game adapted from the live action film of the same name. Beyond the palpable madness and fear in the village, there's a sinister force that drives one to despair. What happens when one crosses the forbidden line of this evil deity?

Perform rituals, solve puzzles, collect documents and hunt for key items to access new areas of the village, all in hopes of finding your missing daughter and escaping alive!

• Explore a remote village that harbors evil secrets and worships malicious spirits!
• Search for clues to your missing daughter’s whereabouts while evading your pursuers.
• Unravel an eerie ritual and discover its deep secrets!
• Solve environmental puzzles and collect key items to gain access to new areas.
• Enjoy an immersive cinematic experience inspired by Taiwanese culture and traditions!
70010000110459.intro: Brave the darkness of a haunted village in hopes of finding a lost loved one!
70010000110459.name: Incantation

70010000110472.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 30 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.
70010000110472.intro: Meet over 30 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000110472.name: Kawaii Girls: Vegas Romance

70010000110502.description:
Storm Chasing Sim 2025 - Tornado Hunter puts you in the heart of extreme weather action. Take control of powerful storm-chasing vehicles and track down the most intense and dangerous tornadoes across vast, dynamic landscapes. Feel the adrenaline as you navigate through unpredictable weather patterns, battling wind, rain, and debris in your pursuit of the perfect storm.

Features:
-Realistic storm physics: Experience authentic tornado behavior, wind forces, and weather changes that challenge your driving and strategy.
-Dynamic open world: Explore sprawling plains, rural towns, and storm-prone areas as you hunt for severe weather events.
-Advanced storm tracking tools: Use radar, weather sensors, and live updates to locate and intercept tornadoes before they strike.
-Vehicle customization and upgrades: Equip your chase vehicle with the latest tech, reinforced armor, and performance enhancements to survive harsh conditions.
-Challenging missions and free roam: Take on intense timed chases or roam freely to capture incredible storm footage and collect data.

Prepare to brave the fury of nature, chase the chaos, and become the ultimate tornado hunter. Are you ready to face the storm?
70010000110502.intro: Drive into danger, uncover the secrets of the storm.
70010000110502.name: Storm Chasing Sim 2025 - Tornado Hunter

70010000110508.description:
Welcome to the Ultimate Parkour Game!

Welcome to Parkour Labs, a vaporwave-inspired parkour game.
Surf the waves of nostalgia and retro aesthetics, sliding down ramps and performing smooth turns.
Explore colorful and surreal landscapes inspired by the culture, music, and art of the 80s and 90s.
Collect glitch effects and artifacts to unlock new levels and secrets.
Experience the synthwave atmosphere in this unique and original game that challenges your movement skills and precision.
70010000110508.intro: Think you're a parkour master? Prove it!
70010000110508.name: Parkour Labs

70010000110515.description:
When your best friend falls into trouble, it’s up to you to embark on a daring journey through the Land of Letters.

In A Difficult Game About Letters, you take control of a character who can transform into any letter of the alphabet. Each letter's shape provides unique abilities, which you’ll need to solve puzzles, navigate obstacles, and complete challenging platforming levels.

Here’s what you can do in the game:

*Transform Into Letters: Instantly switch between 26 different letters to adapt to obstacles. Each letter's shape can help you in unique ways.
*Jump Across Platforms: Use letters like J or V to jump higher or leap across wide gaps.
* Hook and Grab: Turn into L or T to hook onto ledges, edges, or moving platforms.
* Roll and Squeeze: Transform into round letters like O or C to roll through tight spaces or under obstacles.
* Brace and Balance: Use sturdy letters like X or H to block moving walls, balance on narrow platforms
70010000110515.intro: Transform into letters to overcome platforming challenges and save your friend from evil King in this crayon-style adventure!
70010000110515.name: Difficult Game About Letters

70010000110527.description:
"BOMB JACK TWIN" is an action game released by NMK(Original work by KOEI TECMO GAMES)  in 1993.
The popular "BOMB JACK" is back, cuter and tougher than ever! Two-player simultaneous play is also possible!
Dodge enemy attacks and collect all the bombs on the stage. Prioritize grabbing the lit bombs for a chance at a high score!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.

At the time, the game was sold and distributed through NMK (current copyright successor: HAMSTER Corporation), which is why the in-game copyright notice displays NMK. However, the copyright of the game itself belongs to KOEI TECMO GAMES.
70010000110527.intro: Even the toughest challenge can be overcome by two players!
70010000110527.name: Arcade Archives BOMB JACK TWIN

70010000110533.description:
Pokémon Café Mix just got a makeover and is ready to re-open! Now it's bustling with Pokémon!
The cute vibe is just the same, but we've really powered up the thrills and fun that you'll get from catching and training Pokémon and completing puzzles!

You’re the owner of a café that Pokémon visit.
With your Pokémon staff, complete puzzles to prepare drinks and dishes, and treat your Pokémon customers to a wonderful time at the café!

■Make your Pokémon into café staff!
All the café's clientele are Pokémon!
If you make friends with Pokémon by presenting them with yummy dishes, they'll join your staff. Then you'll be able to develop brand-new dishes with your Pokémon chums! And when they get wind of your delicious new dishes, even more new Pokémon will flock to your establishment to check them out!
Recruit lots of Pokémon to your café crew and make your café a fun place to be.

■Solve cooking puzzles with your Pokémon helpers!
Each of your Pokémon assistants will have their own special skills to bring to bear on the cooking puzzles. With new specialty gimmicks, the thrills you get from the puzzles will get a whole new boost!
Train up your Pokémon staff and aim for a three-star establishment!
70010000110533.intro:
Blend, link, and clear!
Enjoy fun culinary puzzles with Pokémon!
70010000110533.name: Pokémon Café ReMix

70010000110555.description:
Build your own classic car dealership and become a successful retro car trader! Search for hidden bargains, buy old vehicles, repair and restore them, then sell them for profit. Upgrade your garage, expand your showroom, and grow your business from a small workshop into a thriving dealership.
Discover unique vintage cars, improve their condition, customize their appearance, and negotiate the best deals. Manage your finances wisely, unlock new opportunities, and prove you have what it takes to become the ultimate retro car dealer.

Features:
* Buy and sell classic and vintage cars.
* Restore, repair, and customize vehicles.
* Expand your garage and dealership.
* Earn profits through smart negotiations.
* Upgrade tools and unlock new content.
