* Enjoy satisfying business simulation gameplay.
* Build your reputation as the best retro car dealer.


Build the ultimate retro car empire, collect iconic vehicles, and prove your business skills in the world of classic automobiles.
70010000110555.intro:
Become a Car Dealer.
Trade Classic Cars.
Build Your Dealership.
70010000110555.name: Car Dealer Simulator: Retro Car for Sale

70010000110560.description:
Step into the boots of the ultimate marksman in Sniper Warrior Elite, the most realistic modern warfare sniping experience yet. As a highly skilled assassin, you’ll take on dangerous missions across vast, open-ended maps that demand more than just a steady aim—they demand tactical genius, patience, and precision.

Features:
• Immersive Campaign: Dive into a gripping single-player story, where every shot counts and every decision matters.
• Massive Open Maps: Explore sprawling, detailed environments designed to test your strategic planning and adaptability.
• Customizable Arsenal: Choose your weapons carefully, upgrade and modify them to fit your style, and manage your inventory by purchasing ammo and new gear to stay prepared for every mission.
• Unmatched Realism: Feel the thrill of long-distance sniping with lifelike ballistics, weather effects, and weapon mechanics.
• Tactical Gameplay: Use stealth and cunning to infiltrate enemy lines, eliminating high-value targets with deadly accuracy.

Whether you’re silently stalking through dense forests, navigating war-torn cities, or holding your breath for that impossible shot, Sniper Warrior Elite offers an unparalleled sniping experience. Are you ready to prove yourself as the ultimate assassin? The mission begins now.
70010000110560.intro: Precision, patience, and deadly accuracy in every shot.
70010000110560.name: SNIPER WARRIOR ELITE

70010000110561.description:
BALL x PIT is a fast-paced fantasy roguelite where heroes must find the balls to plunge deeper into a seemingly bottomless pit of monsters. Develop arcane ammunition and resources in pursuit of treasure, recruiting additional heroes to aid you in your perilous quest.

Ballbylon has fallen. After a meteoric and completely unexpected event annihilated the great city, all that remains is an ominous, yawning pit. Treasure hunters from far and wide flock to the city’s tomb to seek their fortune, plumbing the depths in search of Ballbylon’s scattered riches. Few return.

The pit plays host to armies of barbaric creatures, hellbent on ending your quest before it even begins. Armed with a growing arsenal of magic-infused projectiles, batter your way through multiple levels of increasingly challenging obstacles to claim the ultimate prizes and rebuild New Ballbylon.

Fuse Your Balls
The Ball Fusion system encourages explosive experimentation with over 60 randomized balls to equip and combine during your journey. Discover overpowered combinations and unexpected synergies from hundreds of possible outcomes.

Build New Ballbylon
Expand New Ballbylon with over 70 unique buildings that provide gameplay bonuses and unlock further power-ups, new characters, and more! As your community grows, task homebound heroes with automated tasks to keep the resources coming while you dive deeper into the pit.

Discover New Realms
Face legions of diverse enemies within the pit, battling through barren deserts, frozen caverns, savage forests and more. Each region offers its own unique set of hazards on top of hordes of increasingly challenging foes and mighty, screen-filling bosses.

Recruit Fellow Hunters
As you explore the pit you’ll encounter fellow treasure hunters eager to add their skills to your expedition. Each character has unique, upgradable mechanics that totally change the way you play the game. Experimentation and adaptation are crucial to the success of New Ballbylon!
70010000110561.intro: A brick-breaking, ball-fusing, base-building survival roguelite.
70010000110561.name: BALL x PIT

70010000110567.description:
Get ready to slide into an enchanted swamp full of magical puzzles!
In Toad Slide, a Sokoban-inspired 2D pixel-art puzzle, you control a mystical toad who must move runic stone blocks and place them onto magic circles to restore balance to the swamp.

With 30 carefully crafted levels, 15 by day and 15 by night, the game blends clear logic, smooth gameplay, and gradually increasing challenges that invite you to think precisely and act strategically.

How to play:

Grid movement: Slide the toad in four directions and plan each move carefully.

Mystic tongue: Pull blocks with your tongue if the path is clear — but be careful, one mistake and you’re stuck!

Swallow and spit: The toad can swallow a block and then spit it, making it slide until it hits a wall, another block, or the correct circle.

Quick retry system: Undo or restart instantly — every attempt is a new chance to master the puzzle.

Blocks glow softly when placed correctly, helping you stay focused on the perfect solution.

Explore the Magical Swamp, a world divided between the gentle light of day and the mysterious calm of night. Master the power of the guardian toad and prove you’re the true puzzle master of the swamp!
70010000110567.name: Toad Slide

70010000110573.description:
Looney Test is the ultimate quiz for anyone who’s ever wondered, “Am I a little weird… or completely off the rails?” Dive into 12 ridiculous multiple-choice questions that will test your silliness, challenge your inner clown, and reveal just how delightfully looney you truly are. Play solo for a personal dose of absurdity or take turns with friends to see who’s the biggest goofball in the group!
Each answer secretly adds to your Looney Score, leading up to your grand reveal: the Looney Certificate! Will you be crowned a Mildly Goofy Goldfish or a Totally Bonkers Banana? There’s only one way to find out. Quick, wacky, and full of laughs, Looney Test turns every game night into a giggle-fest of pure nonsense and unfiltered fun
70010000110573.name: Looney Test

70010000110586.description:
Back to the Dawn is a story-rich RPG set in a high-security prison ruled by factions and buried secrets. Investigate two conspiracies from the inside, gather evidence, and outsmart a system designed to silence you. Make friends (or foes) with fellow inmates and with their help, break out of prison.

■A Hardboiled Story Straight Out of the Movies
In a city of animals torn apart by corruption, play as a wrongfully convicted journalist or an undercover investigator forced into a brutal prison system. With allies working from the outside, gather evidence, follow every lead without leaving a trace, and fight to save yourself—and the city.

■A Fully-Fledged RPG Packed with Content
Choose between two protagonists — Thomas, a reporter caught in a web of lies, or Bob, an undercover agent sent deep into the prison system. Each storyline delivers over 20 hours of engrossing mystery, where your every choice matters. Navigate a prison ruled by three powerful gangs, interact with 47 uniquely crafted inmates, and uncover layers of intrigue through dozens of memorable NPCs. With over 100 handcrafted quests, multiple escape routes—each with its own risks and rewards—several possible endings, and more than 500,000 words of gripping narrative, Back to the Dawn delivers a deeply replayable RPG unlike anything you've experienced.

■Uncover the Prison’s Hidden Conspiracies
Thomas the Fox is a journalist caught up in a dark conspiracy and who got thrown into a maximum-security prison for not playing ball. Working with your attorney friend on the outside, you must collect evidence to save yourself and the city from grave danger! Bob the Panther is an undercover agent who has never failed on any of his missions, but he is growing exhausted of this line of work and wants out. But a personal tragedy drags him back for one last job in prison. Experience a hardboiled tale of betrayal, vengeance, and truth!

■A Deeply Immersive Virtual Experience
This is an enormous prison with lots to do and many places to explore, but make sure you follow the rules, or at least try not to get caught! You’ll encounter all kinds of challenges as you explore your new environment. But will you be a model prisoner and just try to keep your head down, or will you leave a trail of chaos and destruction in your wake? It’s all up to you.

■A Colorful Cast
Meet a colorful cast of inmates in your prison, each with an interesting story to tell. You can either make them your friends or fight, bully and rob them into submission. Will you be part of a gang or a cunning lone wolf? Pick a side!

■Open Character Growth System
Are you a tough guy who lets his fists do the talking, a thief who hides in the shadows, or perhaps a smooth talker who manipulates the scene? Develop your skills, craft tools to suit your style, and climb your way from “new fish” to “top dog.”

■Plan Your Prison Escape
In a place built to break you, your sharpest weapon is your creativity and cunning. Every inch of Boulderton Prison might hold the key to your escape, from your prison cell to the infirmary, to the sewers and even the rooftops. Can you break free?
70010000110586.intro: Dive into a gripping CRPG packed with intrigue, chaos, and nonstop action!
70010000110586.name: Back to the Dawn

70010000110587.description: Unwind with puzzles in Pokémon Friends! Solve sets of three randomly selected puzzles to help untangle your mind – then place the yarn you obtain into the Plush-O-Matic, a special machine that creates in-game Pokémon plush! As you try to make them all, you can track your crafted plush in the catalogue. You can also mark your calendar with a stamp each day you play.
70010000110587.intro: Cosy up with a variety of bite-sized puzzles – and collect virtual Pokémon plush!
70010000110587.name: Pokémon Friends

70010000110589.description:
Become a Pokémon photographer in New Pokémon Snap on Nintendo Switch!

Inspired by the classic Nintendo 64 game, embark on a safari through the scorching deserts and dense jungles of the Lental region, taking photos of wild Pokémon thriving in nature.

Capture a majestic Wailord breaching the clear tropical waters, or photograph a mischievous Aipom swinging from branch to branch. Have your camera at the ready for great snap opportunities before the Pokémon are gone in a flash.
70010000110589.intro: Embark on a photographic Pokémon adventure!
70010000110589.name: New Pokémon Snap

70010000110590.description:
Pokémon: Let's Go, Pikachu! and Pokémon: Let's Go, Eevee! bring the experience of a classic Pokémon RPG to Nintendo Switch with gameplay that is easily approachable for newcomers to the series, but is also deep enough to keep veteran Trainers on their toes.

These games also have two-player simultaneous play, so you can take the journey with a friend! And there’s a deep connection between Pokémon: Let's Go, Pikachu! and Pokémon: Let's Go, Eevee! and Pokémon GO, so fans of the hit mobile game will find even more to enjoy.
70010000110590.intro: An exciting new Pokémon RPG for Nintendo Switch!
70010000110590.name: Pokémon: Let's Go, Pikachu!

70010000110591.description:
Pokémon: Let's Go, Pikachu! and Pokémon: Let's Go, Eevee! bring the experience of a classic Pokémon RPG to Nintendo Switch with gameplay that is easily approachable for newcomers to the series, but is also deep enough to keep veteran Trainers on their toes.

These games also have two-player simultaneous play, so you can take the journey with a friend! And there’s a deep connection between Pokémon: Let's Go, Pikachu! and Pokémon: Let's Go, Eevee! and Pokémon GO, so fans of the hit mobile game will find even more to enjoy.
70010000110591.intro: An exciting new Pokémon RPG for Nintendo Switch!
70010000110591.name: Pokémon: Let's Go, Eevee!

70010000110594.description: Get ready to explore a beautiful, reimagined world in Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Rescue Team DX – a remake of the original Nintendo DS and Game Boy Advance titles. Build your rescue team from the likes of Pikachu, Eevee and Charmander and complete missions to save Pokémon in the ever-changing mystery dungeon!
70010000110594.intro: What would you do if you woke up one morning…and you were a Pokémon?!
70010000110594.name: Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Rescue Team DX

70010000110652.description:
Welcome to a world where desire, destiny, and strategy collide.

In Arcana, the legendary Tarot cards are no longer symbols.
They are seductive, powerful women, each one representing a different Arcana with her own personality, intentions, and hidden motives.

Talk to them.
Go on dates to unlock new abilities.
Gain their trust… or provoke their ambition.

But connection is only the beginning.

When conflict begins, conversations give way to strategic, roguelite-inspired card battles, where each run challenges you to adapt, plan, and evolve your approach.

Build your deck using the Arcana you’ve bonded with and face enemy armies in encounters where every card matters.

Your choices shape more than relationships.
They define how your Arcana fight, how they evolve, and which powers they are willing to unleash for you.

This is not a traditional visual novel.
This is a fusion of narrative intimacy and tactical card combat.


Features:

● ARCANA AS CHARACTERS:
The Tarot comes to life as powerful, seductive women, each with unique abilities, personalities, and motivations.

● NARRATIVE PROGRESSION & DATES:
Talk to the Arcana, go on dates, and unlock new skills that directly affect combat.

● STRATEGIC ROGUELITE CARD COMBAT:
Every run is different. Adapt your deck, manage risk, and refine your strategy as challenges escalate.

● DECK BUILDING & SYNERGY:
Create powerful combinations using the Arcana you’ve bonded with and shape your own playstyle.

● ARMY BASED ENCOUNTERS:
Face increasingly dangerous enemy forces in tactical card battles where positioning and timing matter.

● CHOICE DRIVEN EVOLUTION:
Your decisions influence how the Arcana grow, fight, and what powers they are willing to reveal.


Some Arcana seek control.
Others crave devotion.
All of them have a price.

Will you master the cards…
or let them master you?
70010000110652.intro:
Seductive Arcana.
Strategic cards.
Power is won by choice.
70010000110652.name: The Arcana: Dark Tarot & Queens of Madness

70010000110663.description:
Welcome to a world where power, destiny, and strategy collide.

In "The Arcana: Dark Tarot & Kings of Madness", the legendary Tarot cards are no longer symbols.
They are dangerous, charismatic men, each embodying a different Arcana, driven by ambition, dominance, and hidden intent.

Talk to them.
Go on dates to unlock new abilities.
Earn their loyalty… or challenge their authority.

But connection is only the beginning.

When conflict begins, conversations give way to strategic, roguelite-inspired card battles, where every run challenges you to adapt, plan, and assert control.

Build your deck using the Arcana you’ve bonded with and face enemy armies in encounters where every card shapes the outcome.

Your choices shape more than relationships.
They define how your Arcana fight, how they evolve, and which powers they are willing to place in your hands.

This is not a traditional visual novel.
This is a fusion of narrative tension and tactical card combat.

Some Arcana seek domination.
Others demand loyalty.
All of them have a price.


Features:

● ARCANA AS CHARACTERS:
The Tarot comes to life as powerful male Arcana, each with distinct abilities, personalities, and ambitions.

● NARRATIVE PROGRESSION & DATES:
Talk to the Arcana, go on dates, and unlock new skills that directly affect combat.

● STRATEGIC ROGUELITE CARD COMBAT:
Every run is different. Adapt your deck, manage risk, and refine your strategy as challenges escalate.

● DECK BUILDING & SYNERGY:
Create powerful combinations using the Arcana you’ve bonded with and define your own playstyle.

● ARMY BASED ENCOUNTERS:
Face increasingly dangerous enemy forces in tactical card battles where positioning and timing matter.

● CHOICE DRIVEN EVOLUTION:
Your decisions influence how the Arcana grow, fight, and which powers they are willing to place at your disposal.


Will you command the cards…
or lose yourself to their madness?
70010000110663.intro:
Dark Arcana.
Strategic cards.
Power bends to your will.
70010000110663.name: The Arcana: Dark Tarot & Kings of Madness

70010000110669.description:
Bring the world around you to life with the power of color in Colorbound, a vibrant palette-platformer. Join Anku on a heartfelt journey to reunite his late grandfather’s band by using color to shape the world around you. As you journey, you’ll solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and help a family of musicians come together one last time.

A Farewell Tour For Your Grandfather
Anku’s grandfather was a beloved musician to his people, but his band has long since scattered/  Now, with only memories and a special gift, Anku must journey across diverse landscapes to find the missing musicians, reignite their passions, and give his grandfather the farewell he deserves. Along the way, you’ll use color to brighten the canvas, turning obstacles into opportunities, and puzzles into music!

Change Colors to Change The World
In Colorbound, you will collect colors onto your palette which can be used to overcome logic and light platforming puzzles. From lush forests to forgotten cities, Colorbound’s overworld offers a variety of mind-bending puzzles that span a variety of locations and aesthetics.

Finding Balance
Not all colors behave the same way. Some may be lighter, allowing objects to float away once painted, while other colors are heavier and may drop down. Using this to your advantage can help Anku cross the treacherous terrain to reach his destination.

Rooted in Culture
Colorbound draws inspiration from the Aymara culture of the Andes, blending traditional music and art styles with an indie-gem-inspired puzzle platformer experience. Informed by Panpipe Studio’s Chilean culture and heritage, Colorbound celebrates the rich culture of South America while delivering a universal story of love, loss, and the power of art.
70010000110669.intro: In Colorbound, color is more than just hue.
70010000110669.name: Colorbound

70010000110674.description:
Moorhuhn Winter Edition – Let the Feathers Fly!

A Blizzard of Fun Awaits!
Join the iconic crazy chicken in a hilarious arcade shooting adventure set in a whimsical winter wonderland. Whether you're a longtime fan or a first-time hunter, the addictive gameplay will have you hooked in no time.

Shoot, Score, Repeat!
Your mission is simple: rack up as many points as you can in 90 seconds by shooting the zany chickens that pop up all over the screen. It’s the perfect pick-up-and-play experience — great for quick gaming sessions on the go or cozy evenings at home.

Secrets Beneath the Snow
The snowy landscape isn’t just for show! Blast away at quirky objects to uncover hidden bonuses, trigger laugh-out-loud chain reactions, and solve playful puzzles. With intuitive controls, anyone can jump in and start hunting.

Nostalgia Meets New High Scores
Whether you're reliving the classic chaos or discovering the joy of Moorhuhn for the first time, this winter edition delivers pure, lighthearted fun that keeps you coming back for more.

Highlights:
● FRANTIC WINTER HUNTING – Dive into 90-second rounds of shoot-em-up madness in a charming winter world. Simple to play, tough to master!
● SECRETS & PUZZLES GALORE – Explore the interactive landscape to uncover hidden targets, trigger comical reactions, and boost your score.
● CLIMB THE LEADERBOARDS – Compete with friends and players worldwide to become the ultimate chicken hunter!

Ready, aim, snow! Jump into the winter madness today!

Moorhuhn speaks English, Brazilian Portuguese, Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional), Czech, Dutch, European Portuguese, French, German, Hungarian, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Russian, Spanish, Swedish, Turkish, and Ukrainian.
70010000110674.intro: The legendary chicken hunt returns with a snowy twist! Dive into 90 seconds of fast-paced fun, secrets, and laughs. Perfect for players of all ages! Enjoy
70010000110674.name: Moorhuhn Winter Edition

70010000110704.description:
PULMO is the second part in a trilogy about the human journey. Our project explores human behavior in a society where everyone will find their own meanings. Your goal is to change the environment around you to influence people's behavior by solving spatial puzzles. The crowd in the game acts according to its own rules, sometimes helping, sometimes interfering, but always reacting to your actions.

Take control of the fate of a lone wanderer, challenging the silent crowds in a series of mysterious trials. There is no rush here, no victory or defeat - just a quiet dialog between you and the game. Follow this short but meaningful journey, absorbing every moment like the last ray of sunset.

Features:
- Unique art style combining 3D graphics and minimalistic hand-drawn style.
- High-quality music and audio accompaniment for full immersion in what is happening.
- Unsimilar puzzles with different complexity.
- Cutscenes and levels with deep narrative.
- Each cutscene has been worked out to the last detail.

«No matter how large the crowd around you may be, you will be left alone in the last moment. No matter how rich you may be, you will be a beggar in the end. No matter how dazzling your luck may seem, its wings will turn to dust. No matter how much joy you sow on your way, the harvest will be bitter.»
70010000110704.intro: PULMO is a casual puzzle game where you control a lone character in a world full of faceless crowds.
70010000110704.name: PULMO

70010000110718.description:
Welcome to Tumblecube Island, where everything’s a cube – even the Pokémon! Set out on expeditions to achieve your goal of finding the precious loot that lies hidden all over the island.

Choose three Pokémon for your team, then go on expeditions in all sorts of stages! Your Pokémon will progress through a stage on their own - all you have to do is pick what moves you want them to use and when.

You can improve the moves and stats of your Pokémon by making them hold special stones, called Power Stones, which you'll obtain during your journey.
Each stage can be challenged as many times as you'd like, so you can test out different teams to your heart's content!

This game can be downloaded and played for free. All available downloadable content can be purchased on Nintendo eShop.
70010000110718.intro: An all-new action RPG featuring blocky Pokémon!
70010000110718.name: Pokémon™ Quest

70010000110747.description:
From cute arcade novelties to innovative text-based thrillers and acclaimed fourth wall-breaking stories, Simogo Legacy Collection is an eclectic celebration of Simogo's past, featuring faithful renditions of seven games released on mobile platforms between 2010 and 2015.

• Kosmo Spin
• Bumpy Road
• Beat Sneak Bandit
• Year Walk (+ Year Walk Companion)
• DEVICE 6
• The Sailor’s Dream
• SPL-T

Additionally, Simogo Legacy Collection features bonus content with thoughtfully curated curios from Simogo's wide-ranging history.

• Year Walk Bedtime Stories for Awful Children – E-book
• The Lighthouse Painting – Audio drama Podcast
• Music – Tracks from Simogo’s history, including previously unreleased tracks
• Images – Illustrations from Simogo’s archive
• Year Walk Prototype – Playable prototype
• Bumpy Road Prototype – Playable prototype
• Rollovski Prototype – Playable prototype
• The Sensational December Machine – Playable short story

Requires understanding of written and spoken English to be fully enjoyed.
70010000110747.name: Simogo Legacy Collection

70010000110775.description:
OUT NOW – PLAY TODAY
New foundations set the stage for you to define your footballing destiny. Made with Unity, FM26 Touch brings you closer to the action.
MATCH DAY DRAMA
Powered by the Unity graphics engine, matchdays feel more dramatic than ever thanks to volumetric animations from real football matches and improved on-pitch detail.
TOTAL FOOTBALL, TOTAL CONTROL
Delivering smoother navigation, an upgraded UI enables smooth, intuitive navigation through your wider game world, from squad building to match preparation.
PREMIER LEAGUE. FULLY LICENSED
Compete for glory in the Premier League, now vividly brought to life with official kits, club logos, broadcast graphics and player images.
YOUR MANAGER, YOUR WAY
Express more of your personality, style and backstory in every career with a revamped manager creation experience.
ADVANCED TACTICAL INNOVATION
Make your mark on the pitch with distinct in and out-of-possession formations and level up your gameplans with new and redefined player roles.
TRANSFORMATIVE TRANSFER TOOLS
Harness new recruitment tools, powered by football’s transfer marketplace TransferRoom, to smartly shape your title-winning squads.
INTRODUCING: WOMEN’S FOOTBALL
Break new ground as women’s football seamlessly joins FM in one footballing world with 14 playable leagues across 11 nations, including elite competitions like the WSL and NWSL.
In FM26 Touch, football belongs to you and your vision. Change the Game.
70010000110775.intro: Step into the dugout and experience the future of football management on Nintendo Switch™.
70010000110775.name: Football Manager 26 Touch

70010000110779.description:
Set sail for a world built for curiosity in Gecko Gods; a serene puzzle-adventure platformer where you explore a forgotten archipelago through the eyes of a tiny, but mighty, gecko.

Climb across sunlit ruins, weave through lush caves, and uncover the remnants of an ancient civilisation, all at your own pace. With no wrong turns, every ledge, crevice and hidden path invites discovery. Glide between islands on your small wooden boat, each stop offering new puzzles to solve, insects to snack on and secrets to uncover.

Key Features:

Explore Freely - Scale walls, ceilings and cliffs with the gecko’s effortless agility.

A Gecko-sized Journey - Experience a world designed for curiosity and gentle adventure, where movement itself is part of the joy.

Solve Ancient Puzzles - Delve into ruins and temples filled with intuitive, environmental challenges.

Sail Between Islands - Drift across tranquil seas to discover unique landscapes, each with its own atmosphere and hidden life.

With its relaxing atmosphere and intuitive blend of exploration and platforming, Gecko Gods invites you to see the world from a different perspective.
70010000110779.intro: Climb walls, solve ancient puzzles and uncover a lost civilisation in a world full of hidden paths, quiet secrets and natural wonder.
70010000110779.name: Gecko Gods

70010000110785.description:
On a rainy night, Yuto, a freelance illustrator, encounters a mysterious girl named Milk with cat ears in a back alley. After taking in the non-human girl, Yuto’s once-quiet daily life becomes lively and warm. Milk's pure and innocent reactions to modern civilization gently heal Yuto's heart. As they spend time together, the two gradually form a bond as if they were a true family.
This is a heartwarming visual novel about the gentle connections that transcend species and background.
Includes Japanese voice acting.
70010000110785.intro: A cat-eared girl quietly changed my world.
70010000110785.name: Nekomimi Days ~365 Days with You~

70010000110791.description:
That winter, I met a girl with silver hair.
As the seasons quietly changed, two closed-off hearts began to connect through a single “story.”
Each time the snow fell, the world was wrapped in silence, and unspoken feelings quietly piled up.
In a quiet corner of the academy begins a gentle yet heartrending tale that weaves the soul—of solitude, hope, and rebirth.
Just like snow softly covering everything, this story may quietly settle in someone’s heart as well.
Your words might be able to change someone’s future.
Includes Japanese voice acting.
70010000110791.intro: Beyond the falling snow awaits the miracle of meeting you.
70010000110791.name: Whispers of Winter Blossom

70010000110808.description:
Roll and push the adorable hololive members—your precious “treasures”—all the way to the goal!

How to Play:
Simply roll or toss your “treasures” (hololive talents) to move forward!
Combine matching treasures to evolve them into new ones!
Keep merging and rolling to reach the top!

Multiplayer:
Play online with up to 4 players and cooperate to reach the goal!
You can also compete in local 2-player races to clear the same stage as fast as possible.

Stages:
Includes 36 stages featuring a variety of themes, including Secret Society holoX and hololive DEV_IS!
Race to the summit against players from around the world!

Play with Your Favorite Treasures:
Earn stars in stages to swap out the treasures registered in your “Treasure Collection.”
Complete your collection and climb with your favorite hololive member!

Unlock Playable Characters:
Collect coins to unlock mascot characters and use them as playable avatars.
Gather coins efficiently and exchange them for your favorites!

Special Bonus — “Kumarine”:
Play this game on a console that has hololive Treasure Mountain MegaPack (Nintendo Switch™) save data to unlock the exclusive character “Kumarine”!
70010000110808.intro:
Push your Oshi to the top!
A must-play for hololive fans!
A fun and easy 3D action game — just keep pushing!
70010000110808.name: hololive GoroGoro Mountain DX

70010000110814.description:
Get ready to ignite your engines in Formula Uno Racing — a thrilling single-player experience that captures the intensity of professional Formula Car racing.

Race across a global lineup of high-speed circuits that evolve with the time of day. Tackle sharp turns under the morning sun, chase victory through glowing dusk, and dominate the track beneath dazzling night lights.

Progress through your racing career by unlocking new circuits and earning cash rewards to purchase faster, more powerful cars. Every victory brings you closer to mastering the ultimate racing machine.


Features:
-Authentic Formula Car physics and responsive controls
-Dynamic time-of-day environments: sunny, dawn, and night
-Career progression with unlockable circuits and new car purchases
-Deep vehicle tuning and setup options

Formula Uno Racing — One driver. One dream. Endless speed.
70010000110814.intro: One Race. One Goal. No limits.
70010000110814.name: Formula Uno Racing

70010000110817.description:
Vine Card is a deck-building strategic game with roguelike elements. Choose from a roster of quirky heroes with even quirkier skills, plan your route around the game board,
grab the goodies and defeat the baddies Navigate your hero around a game board of limited grids, one step at a time.

Sounds boring? Well, throw in a deck of 200+ unique cards, and watch the chemical reactions happen. 8 playable characters with wildly different styles/skills further increase the fun.

It all starts from this fictitious empire on a fictitious planet. The Tang Empire is facing a pivotal moment and from there, things start to go wild. Follow our heroes from the Tang Empire to the Far West, then the mysterious Skyland descending from the, duh, sky!
Embark on a journey that is natural, semi-natural, supernatural, meta-natural, and unnatural at the same time! Blend Wuxia and science fiction and fantasy and mythology together and it just works.

Take elements from Chinese mythology, Norse mythology, Celtic mythology, Arthurian mythology, Cthulhu mythology (yeah, we've got that covered, too), add modern pop culture, sprinkle a liberal dose of actual history, serve while hot.

Gatling guns vs swords vs crossbows vs pretty much anything you can think of.
Who said cowboys can't do Chinese kungfu, eh? Leave common sense behind, dude. It's holding you down.

The game comes with 30+ handcrafted "legend site" stages, from the mysterious Sanxingdui to the isle of Avalon to the glorious Valhalla. Take a break from the busy combat and solve these special challenges instead!
70010000110817.intro: VineCard is a card strategy game that combines war chess and light rogue-like elements.
70010000110817.name: Vinecard

70010000110819.description:
Firefighting Rescue Simulator puts you in the heart of real emergency action. As a heroic firefighter, your mission is to respond fast, rescue civilians, and battle intense fires across a city on the brink. Every call is a new test of courage, skill, and speed.

Choose from six unique characters, each ready to take on danger. Complete missions to unlock powerful fire trucks and gain access to three expanding cities, each with its own challenges. The more missions you pass, the more your firefighting arsenal grows.

Drive through urban streets with precision, rescue victims and hand them off to paramedics, and use advanced tools to extinguish raging fires. Be warned—night missions are harder, and every second counts.

Key Features:
• Realistic fire truck driving in detailed city environments
• Use multiple tools to fight fires and control danger
• Choose from 6 playable firefighter characters
• 3 cities to unlock through mission progress
• Dynamic rescue scenarios with mission-based structure
• Time-based gameplay—act fast, save lives
• Day/night cycle that affects mission difficulty
• Rescue and evacuate people to paramedics on scene

Gear up, race the clock, and become the hero your city needs. Are you ready to face the flames?
70010000110819.intro: Answer every emergency call and show what a true firefighter can do.
70010000110819.name: Firefighting Rescue Simulator

70010000110835.description:
Dive into a world of stunning, realistic puzzles that captivate your eyes and mind. Piece by piece, reveal breathtaking images of beautiful women — each completed puzzle unlocks a new masterpiece, keeping you motivated to discover what’s next.

Smooth and intuitive touch controls make gameplay effortless and deeply satisfying — you’ll feel like you’re truly shaping every picture with your own hands. Gentle, soothing music sets the perfect mood, helping you unwind while your curiosity pulls you to complete the next challenge.

Relax, enjoy, and let yourself get lost in the details.

Features:
• Addictive, easy-to-play puzzle mechanics.
• Gorgeous, realistic artwork of women.
• Satisfying touch interaction — every move feels natural.
• Unlock new, even more stunning images as you progress.
• Perfect balance of challenge and relaxation.
• Soothing soundtrack that enhances your focus and mood.
• Admire each completed image in full detail.
70010000110835.intro: Every piece brings you closer to perfection!
70010000110835.name: Hentai Gallery: Hidden Charms

70010000110841.description:
Complete captivating puzzles featuring realistic images of beautiful women. With each completed image, you'll unlock new images, and the gradually increasing difficulty will make completing the puzzle an engaging challenge. Intuitive touch controls create the feeling of actually touching every piece.

Soft and relaxing music helps you immerse yourself in the atmosphere, and after completing the puzzle, you can carefully examine the image and admire every detail.

Features:

• Convenient one-handed play.
• Realistic images of women.
• Full immersion thanks to touch controls.
• Gradual increase in level difficulty.
• Atmospheric soundtrack.
• Examine the picture after completing it.
70010000110841.name: Hentai Gallery: Lovely Angels

70010000110851.description:
In Tune My Car: Tuning Studio & Mechanic Simulator 2026, every bolt you tighten and every upgrade you install takes you one step closer to becoming the ultimate master of automotive customization. Start your journey with a modest budget from your first story missions, build your collection one car at a time, and transform stock machines into high-performance masterpieces.

From aggressive body kits and thunderous V8 engines to precision-tuned suspensions and flawless custom paint jobs, every choice you make directly shapes your car’s style, handling, and raw power. Work hands-on in your fully equipped garage, switch freely between first-person and third-person views, and take your creations to the test track to feel the difference under your fingertips.

Key Features:
	•	Story-Driven Career – Complete missions to unlock new cars, upgrades, and opportunities.
	•	Full Vehicle Customization – Modify body parts, swap engines, fine-tune suspensions, and repaint with total freedom.
	•	Performance That Matters – Every upgrade changes acceleration, top speed, handling, and nitro performance.
	•	Free Tuning Mode – Experiment with any unlocked vehicle without mission constraints.
	•	Immersive Garage – Interact with every tool, part, and station in first or third person.
	•	Test & Perfect – Push your builds to the limit on a dedicated track before taking them to the streets.

Your garage. Your vision. Your legend.
70010000110851.intro: Are you ready to create the car of your dreams?
70010000110851.name: Tune My Car - Tuning Studio & Mechanic Simulator 2026

70010000110871.description: Enter a world where creativity and physics collide. Use your imagination to draw lines that come to life, guiding a small ball through clever routes and obstacles into its target. Every stroke interacts with realistic physics, turning simple drawings into intricate mechanisms and satisfying solutions. Set within a sleek science lab, a scientist observes and sketches behind a glass screen, and it’s his pen you command. Each level offers a fresh puzzle that blends simplicity with challenge, inviting you to experiment, test, and refine your designs in a playful 3D environment that rewards both logic and creativity.
70010000110871.name: Vector Lab

70010000110903.description:
Get ready to jump, dash, and glide with Quick Whiskers, a pixel-art platformer where every move counts! Take control of a nimble cat and venture through 30 challenging levels across two unique biomes: the peaceful park and the bustling city. Your mission is simple but full of action: collect food cans and reach a cozy bed to rest.

With mechanics easy to learn but hard to master, each stage rewards skill, quick thinking, and precision. Jump, dash, use springs and balloons to avoid spikes, saws, and falling platforms. Some challenges hide extra cans in tricky spots. Will you risk it to get them?

What to expect in each level
Agile movement: Walk, jump, and dash precisely to navigate the environment.
Interactive elements: Springs and balloons propel your cat to reach inaccessible areas.
Challenging obstacles: Spikes, saws, and unstable platforms test your reflexes.
Exploration and reward: Collect food cans to earn extra points and complete levels in style.

Each level starts with your cat on the left, expanding to the right, with clear and intuitive obstacles and items. The progression is rewarding, giving casual players and fans of high-mobility platformers fun and challenge.

With adorable visuals, fast pace, and fluid gameplay, Quick Whiskers is the perfect playground for anyone who loves cats, speed, and precision challenges. Are you ready to show who rules the rooftops and parks of the city?
70010000110903.name: Quick Whiskers

70010000110904.description:
Step into the fast lane with Speed Legacy: Ultimate Drive, where adrenaline, precision, and speed define your every move. Take on a variety of high-octane missions — from intense drag races and precision drifting to daring escapes from relentless pursuers. Every route is a challenge, every second counts, and every turn could be the difference between victory and defeat.
Push your skills to the limit as you race against time, master every maneuver, and prove you have what it takes to become the ultimate driver. Can you handle the thrill, the chaos, and the ultimate rush of the streets?
70010000110904.name: Speed Legacy: Ultimate Drive

70010000110917.description:
Get ready for a heartwarming hexagonal puzzle adventure where clever thinking meets cozy charm. Guide the adorable Chippys, little squirrels with big personalities, as they collect every shiny acorn and make their way safely home.
Across 30 hand-crafted levels and three seasonal worlds: Spring, Summer and Autumn, you’ll twist, swap and align tiles to form perfect paths through nature’s maze.
Each move matters. Rotate or move tiles to connect acorns to the burrow, then watch your fluffy friends scurry along the path you built. It’s all about planning, precision and a touch of playful creativity.
As you advance, new tile types and tricky layouts appear, turning every stage into a fresh and rewarding puzzle.
Features:
• 30 handcrafted levels filled with charm and challenge
• Three cozy seasonal biomes: Spring, Summer and Autumn
• Rotate and move tiles to connect paths and gather all the acorns
• A clever hint system to keep you thinking without frustration
• A shuffle option for endless replayability
Relax, think and enjoy the company of your squirrelly friends. The Chippys are waiting for your help to find every last nut.
70010000110917.name: Hexa Chippy

70010000110923.description:
Get ready for an ocean full of puzzles and charm. Guide a lovable whale through 30 handcrafted stages where strategy meets relaxation. Push the turtles onto the buoys and help restore harmony to the sea in this adorable adventure of logic and calm.
Explore three peaceful worlds, the Caribbean Sea, Coral Reef and Deep Sea, each filled with cozy pixel art and soothing ocean vibes. Every move brings you closer to mastering the art of gentle thinking, as you plan routes, reposition turtles and find the perfect solution at your own pace.
Features:
• 30 handcrafted puzzles full of cute and clever design
• Three cozy ocean worlds: Caribbean Sea, Coral Reef and Deep Sea
• Push turtles onto buoys and reorganize them to solve each stage
• A relaxing atmosphere with charming art and soothing sea ambience
Take a deep breath, plan your moves and make waves of happiness with your ocean friends.
70010000110923.name: The Cute Whale

70010000110940.description:
Explore ancient palace ruins, set up your garden, cook Indian food, run errands for quirky characters, and learn about your history by making art.

Features:
Vibrant hand-painted watercolour graphics.
Indian Cooking and tea shop management.
A relaxing play style with an open-world exploration and questing.
Over 25 regionally & culturally diverse cast of characters to interact.
A feel-good story of achievement despite social marginalization.
15th century Indian royal palace exploration.
70010000110940.intro: A rural adventure set in fictional 90s India. A heartfelt story of ambition, struggle, and friendship.
70010000110940.name: The Palace on the Hill

70010000110951.description:
Move through 3D space to find hints, solve mysteries and escape from the room.
Anyone can play to the end because you can see hints and answers.

Also, a card search game has been added as a bonus.
Rankings that compete with people all over the world for the time they find
There is also a communication match that starts all at once and competes for ranking.
70010000110951.intro:
Explore 3D space and escape
You can also play a game to find cards as a bonus
70010000110951.name: Escape game & Card search game R01M

70010000110952.description:
Speed through dimensions in the ultimate showdown!
Sonic has traveled to all kinds of worlds over the years.
However, when the Travel Rings bring him to the multiverse, a brand-new adventure, unpredictable races, and wild competitions await!

▼Race with or against players from around the globe
Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds lets you race offline or against competitors from around the world—including players on other platforms! In World Match, you can face off against up to 11 other players! For some team-based fun with unique challenges, give Friend Match a try. If you're looking to prove who's the fastest, hit up Time Trial! Master each mode and take your rightful place on the podium!

▼Craft a machine tailor-made to your preferences
Gadgets are an exciting new feature with the power to change the outcome of any race! Fitting your vehicle with different gadgets grants you all kinds of abilities that change your playstyle options. With over 70 gadgets to choose from, craft your own tailor-made machine! Every part of your vehicle is yours to customize, from the colors and decals to even the texture!
Create your dream ride!

▼Expect the unexpected as each course changes with every lap
During the second lap, the Travel Ring will warp you to another world. Put the pedal to the metal in 24 main courses and 15 CrossWorlds.

▼The biggest playable roster in the series to date
23 iconic Sonic characters have fueled up and are ready for action! Pick your favorite character and accelerate to the finish line.

▼Get a leg up on the competition with an assortment of items
Use items to gain abilities like transforming into a monster truck that can crush your competition!
70010000110952.intro:
No two races are alike in Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds!
Buckle up for high-octane, unpredictable racing fun.
70010000110952.name: Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds

70010000110955.description:
As Elias returns to the coastal town that once sheltered him, he’s pulled into a slow winter of connection, memory and quiet decisions. Take the role of this young man and guide the choices he makes, surrounded by the warmth of townspeople young and old, often holding conversations in a bookstore over shared coffee.

Winterlight is a contemplative visual novel adventure about coming home, facing grief and learning to accept the ordinary over means of personal escape. Enjoy an adventure in a branching narrative with meaningful choices, one filled with emotional maturity and beautiful illustrations. Take things at your own pace as you explore all possible outcomes for Elias.

• Immerse yourself in an adventure spanning 32,000 words!
• Engage in emotionally mature themes and real-world issues.
• Guide the narrative by making key decisions for Elias!
• Enjoy beautifully illustrated character portraits and backdrops.
• Discover multiple endings as you seek truth and lasting peace!
70010000110955.intro: Explore a heartfelt and thought-provoking tale of bittersweet homecoming!
70010000110955.name: Winterlight - Where silence says it all

70010000110979.description:
After School .LIVE -Mirror of Twilight- is a visual novel game starring Cyber Girl Siro, Chieri Kakyoin, and Iori Yamato, the Vtubers from .LIVE production.
It's a story with a mix of horror and school comedy, where the player is the president of the Manga Research Club. Together with three club members, escape the strange, otherworldly after school building.

Your choices shape how the story unfolds, leading to multiple endings.
Break free from the endlessly repeating, never ending after school!


◆Synopsis
“The age of horror is here!”
You and three girls in the Manga Research Club.
After school, you discover a strange shrine inside the building, and in a moment of carelessness you shatter the mirror enshrined there.

In an instant--
the world freezes beneath an eerie sunset.
Shadows shaped like you and the girls begin to wander the corridors of the sealed after school.

“Th■ ag■ o■ ho■■or i■ h■r■!”

One by one, members of the club are attacked by the shadows.
Can you escape this never ending after school?


◆Characters
・Mashiro Momose (CV: Cyber Girl Siro)
Your childhood friend.
She lives next door and comes by every morning to wake you up.
Many says she always looks cheerful and carefree, and it seems they're right, since she doesn't have much worries.
True to her soothing voice, she is laid back and tends to agree with just about anything.
Oddly enough, she happens to be an excellent student straight A's.

・Sakura Otoin (CV: Chieri Kakyoin)
A kouhai in the same Manga Research club. Many calls her Cherry.
She has a soft, airy vibe that puts everyone at ease.
Her special skill is being cute.
She is usually bubbly and acts sweet, but when in panic her tone can suddenly turn rough.
She is basically the straight man of the group.

・Inori Amano (CV: Iori Yamato)
A kouhai in the same Manga Research club.
A natural born oddball who thinks everything is fine as long as everyone is having fun.
A curious free spirit who dislikes conflict.
She has the youngest child energy, and is usually the one getting teased and called out.


○Novel Game Brand "Rabbitfoot”
A novel game brand that delivers novel games casting active YouTubers and VTubers as game characters.
As well as using their names and nicknames, you can enjoy the different sides of your faves and feel a close connection through the novel game that you cannot experience in the usual streaming or video uploads.
70010000110979.intro: A visual novel starring the Vtubers from .LIVE production with a a mix of horror and school comedy.
70010000110979.name: After School .LIVE -Mirror of Twilight-

70010000111015.description: An atmospheric management RPG about life on the open road. Pick up hitchhikers, work odd jobs, customize and repair your car, and map your route across the country. Use upgrades, skills and items to overcome challenges. And remember to take it easy. You’re young. You have time.
70010000111015.name: Keep Driving

70010000111045.description:
What if this dream never ended? What if we could dream it together?

Reverie in the Moonlight is an action game where, with the help of your stuffed animals, you try to defend yourself from the monsters attacking you night after night.

Nightly Visits

Little Tete’s nights are restless. His dreams are full of horrible monsters attacking him. But then, one night, he meets Luna, and she teaches him how to use his plushies to defend himself.

Cute but Strong

When faced with a monster, Tete can only do one thing: run away. His plushies, however, can actually fight and defeat monsters. Different animals play different roles, with some focusing on short-range attacks, some on long-range shots, and some on supporting their allies. There are 40 types to choose from, so find your favorites and help them protect Tete from the monsters.

Collect and Strategize

After the monsters’ attack is over, you can shop with the gold you found. You can get new plushies and even buy special items that can make you stronger. Some of them will also give you new weaknesses, so it’s up to you to strategize and prepare for the next attack in the best way possible. There are more than 100 items in the game... Will you be able to collect them all?

Change Clothes to Change Strategies

So, you’ve played the game’s story to the end. Well done. But this is just the start!

You can change Tete’s clothes, choosing from more than 20 costumes. Each one makes him stronger in some ways and weaker in others. If you want to help Tete defeat his nightmares, you’ll have to find the right plushies and items to go with each costume!
70010000111045.intro: In Reverie in the Moonlight, scary monsters are chasing you, and you can’t fight them...but your plushies can. Can your adorable friends protect you from these nightm
70010000111045.name: Reverie in the Moonlight

70010000111046.description:
Step into a world where love, temptation, and fate collide.

A mysterious demon appears before you with a chilling challenge: win the heart of your university professor… or be dragged into the depths of hell.

As your conversations grow more intimate, your every word shapes your destiny.

Will you follow the demon’s wicked game, or defy him and choose your own path?

Your choices matter... and every ending reveals a different truth about desire, freedom, and the price of love.


Features:

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Every path leads to a different fate. And a different version of you.

● CHOICE & CONSEQUENCE: What you say changes everything, even who survives.

● SUPERNATURAL ROMANCE: A love story twisted by temptation, mystery, and desire.

● ATMOSPHERIC EXPERIENCE: Stunning art and haunting music that draw you into the dark.


It’s seductive.
It’s dangerous.
It’s your soul on the line.

Are you ready to play her game?
70010000111046.intro:
What if the price of love… was your soul?
Make your choice… before it’s made for you.
70010000111046.name: Anime School Love: Her Teacher's Secret Lesson

70010000111088.description:
Step into the dark halls of the royal castle with the fearless Red Cape Knight, summoned by the King after dangerous creatures seize his home. Armed with his sword and the magic of his enchanted red cape, the knight must face deadly traps and fierce enemies to reclaim the castle.

With the power to double jump using his cape, dash past danger, and strike with precision, the Red Cape Knight delivers a thrilling platforming experience filled with danger at every corner.

Features:

- Precision platforming entirely set inside the castle
- Deadly traps and hidden dangers
- Double jump with the enchanted cape
- Fast and fluid Dash ability
- Sword combat against dangerous creatures
- Beautiful Pixel Art style
- Immersive and intense soundtrack
70010000111088.intro: The knight must face deadly traps and fierce enemies to reclaim the castle
70010000111088.name: Red Cape Knight

70010000111089.description:
Immerse yourself in the depths of the Spirit World, fractured into 4 realms and scarred with 13 distinct regions. Confront over 30 enemy types and harness the potential of more than 160 cards, forging unique archetypes and a multitude of powerful combinations. A dark journey awaits you, spanning 25+ hours of gameplay, with numerous enthralling side quests and grim boss battles.

Master Your Deck-Building Skills
Craft over 160 cards and fashion synergistic decks that focus on poison, strength, sacrifice, retaliation, backstabbing, blocking, movement, and more. Discover shamanic totems with unique effects to enhance your deck. Each new element allows you to tailor your tactical style as you prepare for your next deadly encounter.

Engage in Grid-Based Combat
Face a host of restless spirits - Skulldogs, Crackle Bursts, Woeful Seashrooms and more - in grid-based battles where each move is crucial. Test your wit by fighting unique enemy types, powerful bosses, and mini-bosses, all while taking into account environmental hazards and boons. Grow stronger, adapt your deck, and choose your battles as you explore a vast world filled with dangerous challenges.

Journey to the spirit realm
In forgotten lands shrouded by myth, Ro - a hunter from a small tribe - is overcome by grief following the death of her beloved son. Guided by voices from another world, she transcends into the realm of spirits, in hopes of bringing him back. Meet strange spirits and help them with quests and challenges that affect your deck – although not all of them may have your best interests at heart. Discover a mysterious world of forgotten lore, where darkness whispers secrets and invites you to unearth buried memories.
70010000111089.intro: Master the grid, defy death. Enter a grim Spirit Realm in this open-world deck builder.
70010000111089.name: Death Howl

70010000111136.description:
Morkull Ascend to the Gods is a 2D action video game focused on boss battles, once again taking control of the charismatic God of Death: Morkull.

Set in the original world of Morkull Ragast's Rage, locked up and aware that he is in a new video game, you must help him escape so that he can carry out his evil plans for the world and rule by subjecting everyone to his will (yes, including you).

You will feel the power and bear the weight of being the God of Death and Darkness. A select series of battles against other henchmen, minions, and Gods that make up the Olympus of the Kingdom of Midaldus await you.

But don't worry, don't tremble. You won't be alone. You'll have Morkull (or rather, he'll have you), who has a wide range of combos, skills, and charms that you can unlock, equip, and build to your liking before each battle.

Although you'll also die a good handful of times.

Morkull is back!

This means that his charisma, character, and personality, along with his breaking of the fourth wall, will create a lighthearted atmosphere at all times (you're going to need it), loaded with bad jokes, references, and memes that are very present in pop culture.

It's like having a friend playing alongside you.

Like its predecessor, Morkull Ascend to the Gods is completely hand-drawn and animated, with great care and frame by frame. In this way, thanks to traditional animation, the characters' movements are very natural and full of life.

Distinguished by a stylized character and a wide color palette, this time, outside of Ragast, you will be able to see and discover other environments that belong to the Kingdom of Midaldus.

Morkull is back! So get back in trouble with him and join his ranks by supporting his Machiavellian cause.
70010000111136.intro: Get in trouble with Morkull again!
70010000111136.name: Morkull Ascend to the Gods

70010000111142.description:
Skinwalker is a horror adventure escape game that takes place in a frozen wilderness where every second counts. Trapped alone in a dark, merciless forest, your only lifeline is the fire that keeps you warm against the bitter cold. However, the freezing night isn't your only enemy. A terrifying creature known as the Skinwalker lurks nearby, hiding among the wildlife and waiting for you to let your guard down.

To survive, you’ll need to scavenge for resources and think quickly in high-pressure situations. You'll need to collect sticks to feed your fire, search for wooden planks to cross crumbling bridges, and uncover hidden tools, such as shovels and keys, that could mean the difference between life and death. Each step away from the fire is a gamble as the icy air closes in and the Skinwalker waits in the shadows, ready to attack.

The forest is full of danger at every turn, testing your wits, instincts, and courage. Manage your time, keep your fire alive, and stay one step ahead of the horror stalking you. Survival is possible, but only if you can outlast the cold and the creature that wears many faces.

This is not for the faint of heart. In Skinwalker, fear is as cold as the forest itself.
70010000111142.intro: Survival burns brightest in the dark.
70010000111142.name: Skinwalker

70010000111143.description:
Welcome to the co-op shooter where the end of the world has never looked so...tasty! The end of days is near, with the city infested by ravenous, greasy food creatures, bringing total chaos and destruction. Our last hope lies with a band of skilful, trigger-happy cooks who are determined not to end up as the main course.


Features:
★Choose your fighter: Choose from different food-themed heroes, each with their own special ability. Find the one that fits your style best.
★Fight crazy food monsters: Battle wild enemies like cheeseburger beasts that shoot cheese and cupcake creatures with sharp claws.
★Play with a Friend (Local Co-op): Team up in 2-player local co-op mode. Work together to survive the monsters and double the fun.
★Upgrades & Perks: Improve your abilities to move faster, take less damage, or block attacks. Mix and match perks to suit how you want to play.
★Use Wacky Food Weapons: Blast enemies with a mustard shotgun, fire forks with a crossbow, or zap them with a microwave laser. Weapons are weird and powerful.
★Fast-Paced Roguelite Action: Enjoy action-packed gameplay with challenging fights and random elements that make every session different.
70010000111143.intro: Last Supper: A Top-Down Bullet Buffet
70010000111143.name: Nom Nom Apocalypse

70010000111152.description:
SCP: CONTROL ERROR is a short, first-person psychological horror game set in 1985

You are Barry Gittings - a man who volunteered for a classified experiment inside the Vortex Complex, a remote underground facility established during the Cold War.

You don’t know what’s behind the next door.
You don’t know who’s watching.
You only know the doors opened, the voice welcomed you, and the test began.

Explore sealed research chambers. Solve strange cognitive trials. Read internal reports and documents left behind by those who came before - or maybe didn’t leave at all.

No jump scares. No gunfights. Just you, the test, and something you can’t quite see.
70010000111152.intro: SCP: CONTROL ERROR is a short psychological horror game where you take part in a live experiment inside a restricted underground facility. The test begins. You're observed.
70010000111152.name: SCP: Control Error

70010000111158.description:
I was just hoping for a quiet school life...
But then I got targeted by a cheerful and mysterious beauty!
She leads the eccentric club known as the “Happy Life Research Society” and is a legendary figure at school—Rina Shinonome.
Beautiful, smart, athletic... yet her personality is so outrageous, it’s overwhelming!?
After being called “the chosen one,” I was dragged into the club against my will.
Day after day, I found myself caught up in her whirlwind pace.
But behind her constant smile... she seems to be hiding a secret no one knows—?
Includes Japanese voice acting.
70010000111158.intro: Perfect girl × Mad rule = No turning back from school life!?
70010000111158.name: Rina-sama☆Musou ~The Chosen One and the Reign of Madness~

70010000111164.description:
Once every five years, a special chime echoes through the school in this town.
Luna, a transfer student and an art-loving girl, laughs it off as "nonsense"—but she holds a hidden past.
Without realizing it’s a reunion, she meets the protagonist, "me", again.
Their bond, and the secret of her parents’ work hidden behind the chime, begin to resurface.
A sound heard only once every five years ties the two together once more.
Includes Japanese voice acting.
70010000111164.intro: A chime heard once in five years. A past that never left.
70010000111164.name: For Luna the Bell Tolls

70010000111166.description:
This story revolves around the frog-hopping tactical battler Frogtime. Collect, buy and trade frogs and use them to build an unbeatable roster.

Embark on a quest to defeat the local bully, and get sidetracked – play music, infiltrate a beehive (disguised as a bee), and maybe get in a sled race with a vampire.

Fully voice acted by us and our friends but also features a number of surprising special guests.

Grab your toadbag, count those cocoduds, and explore a gently absurd world where everything is resolved with frog battles.

Features:
- a bear in a frog onesie
- a giant skeleton man
- a normal sized skeleton man
- at least 12 heartfelt moments about the importance of community and what it means to have self-worth
- you can put hats on the frogs :3
70010000111166.intro: Bonnie Bear Saves Frogtime is a frog-obsessed comedy adventure featuring tactical frog battles, bizarre quests, and the mother of all frogs: the motherfrogger.
70010000111166.name: Bonnie Bear Saves Frogtime

70010000111174.description:
Dispatch is a superhero workplace comedy set in modern day Los Angeles, and featuring an all-star cast including Aaron Paul, Laura Bailey, and Jeffrey Wright.

Note: Some mature content from Dispatch's original version has been modified.

You play as Robert Robertson, AKA Mecha Man, whose mech-suit is destroyed in a battle against his nemesis, forcing him to take a job at a superhero dispatch center: not as a hero, but a dispatcher.

As their dispatcher, you take charge of a team of ex-supervillains given a shot at redemption. Manage and level up your roster, all while navigating office relationships and romances, and rebuilding your suit for a shot at revenge!

> Shape the Story

In Dispatch, every decision you make influences the unfolding narrative. From banter in the breakroom to life-or-death situations in the field, your choices affect your relationships with the heroes, their allegiances, and the path your own story takes.

>  Deploy Your Heroes

Use the strategy map to review ongoing emergencies and deploy the right (or wrong) heroes to deal with them. Balance the risks and rewards as you make tactical decisions, knowing that each choice can have lasting consequences for your team and the city.

> Manage Your Roster

Managing heroes sometimes goes beyond their powers. Each hero comes with quirks, flaws, and baggage you’ll need to navigate to keep the team together. Upgrade their skills and unlock abilities to boost their effectiveness in the field.

Blending narrative, strategy, and humor, Dispatch explores what it means to be a hero, whether you're wearing a cape or behind a desk.

Featuring an all-star cast from every corner of entertainment:

Aaron Paul (Breaking Bad, Westworld, Black Mirror)
Laura Bailey (The Legend of Vox Machina)
Erin Yvette
MoistCr1TiKaL (Charles White)
Jacksepticeye (Sonic Prime, River City Girls 1 & 2, Bendy and the Ink Machine)
Travis Willingham (The Legend of Vox Machina, Critical Role)
Alanah Pearce (V/H/S Beyond)
Lance Cantstopolis (Karate, Dancing, Actor)
Joel Haver (Filmmaker, Actor, YouTuber)
THOT SQUAD (Musician: Pound Cake, Hoes Depressed)
Yung Gravy (Musician: Betty (Get Money), oops!)
Matthew Mercer (Critical Role)
and Jeffrey Wright (American Fiction, The Batman, Casino Royale)
70010000111174.intro: Choices matter in this superhero comedy where you manage a team of misfits.
70010000111174.name: Dispatch

70010000111175.description:
In an alternate reality you'd find Stratogun in your nearest arcade, consuming all of your hard-earned pocket change. Stratogun is a modern interpretation of the arcade classics of the 80's. It's easy to pick up, but very difficult to master. Shoot your way through of swarms of enemies, unlock weapons ships & perks to increase your chances of survival.

At its core Stratogun is an ultra-fast space shooter with tight controls. The game also includes progression as after each run your score is converted to experience points which in turn unlock new gear. Every unlocked item will increase your chances of survival, but in the end it will all boil down to your skills and reaction time. The Red Orbit is ruthless, and only the toughest space pilots will survive the increasingly difficult waves of blood-thirsty enemies.The visuals of Stratogun draw influence from the arcade classics. Wireframe aesthetics are combined with a kick-ass soundtrack ensuring that this would indeed be something you'd find in an arcade, if those establishments would still be a thing.
Key Features:
• Uncompromised arcade gameplay & difficulty
• Modern, yet arcade-faithful audiovisuals
• Progression & unlockable gear
70010000111175.intro: Stratogun is a modern interpretation of the arcade classics of the 80's.
70010000111175.name: Stratogun

70010000111181.description:
Your brains’ll be pouring out too with the soaring difficulty of this “gusher” puzzle game.
That’s what Vaccine Case’s all about.

The key to everything is the order you open the partitions holding back the vaccines.
Eliminate each stage’s virus cells with vaccines of matching colors by trial & error.

Rules:
• The object is to open the partitions, and let out the vaccine to eradicate the virus cells of the same color.
• However, when you eliminate even one cell, the vaccine will turn clear and no longer work.
• When you make a mistake, you can go back step by step with the UNDO button on the lower left (at most ten times).
• You cannot open partitions between vaccines of different colors.
• As the game progresses purple and orange viruses will also appear. Mix the vaccines to make the appropriate colors with the mixer.

Over 200 stages of abundant designs and tricks.
70010000111181.intro: Store, mix, and pour the vaccine out to eradicate the virus.
70010000111181.name: Vaccine Case

70010000111182.description: Experience everything you love about Pokémon battles all in one place – in Pokémon Champions for Nintendo Switch. This battle-focused game features familiar mechanics such as Pokémon types, Abilities, and moves, allowing new and experienced Trainers alike to experiment with rich and varied strategies.
70010000111182.intro: It’s time to become a champion
70010000111182.name: Pokémon Champions

70010000111191.description:
A Sweet Love Story with a Cat-Eared Client.


◆Synopsis
"Serena. My name is Serena Hanazono...!"

A cat-eared client is seeking the services of your handyman business.
She introduces herself as Serena Hanazono, and she would like you to help her find a lost necklace.
Movie theatres, cafes, parks, amusement parks......

Together, the two of you search each possible location, but somehow it feels like a fun date......

From a simple client and handyman relationship, your bond gradually deepens.
Will you be able to find Serena's lost item?

And what will become of your relationship...?

Experience a sweet, intimate love story with Serena Hanazono.


◆Characters
・Serena Hanazono（VA: Serena Hanazono）
She visits your handyman service to recover her lost necklace.

A clumsy yet charming girl who sometimes forgets the search and enjoys the moment.
But there seems to be an important reason why she came to you specifically......


○Novel Game Brand "Rabbitfoot”
A novel game brand that delivers novel games casting active YouTubers and VTubers as game characters.
As well as using their names and nicknames, you can enjoy the different sides of your faves and feel a close connection through the novel game that you cannot experience in the usual streaming or video uploads.
70010000111191.intro: A short story visual novel with ASMR, starring the cat VTuber Serena Hanazono.
70010000111191.name: Serena Hanazono’s Lost Item ～Sweet Memory～

70010000111202.description:
Do you have a sharp eye? We challenge you to test it! Find 10 differences between two similar images. But beware, they change every time you attempt it!

- changing differences to find (we didn't really count all the combinations, sorry!)
- cute hand-drawn monsters
- hints
70010000111202.intro: Ready to test your detective skills? Find the differences between two similar monster-themed scenes!
70010000111202.name: There's No Differences: Monsters

70010000111208.description:
This game is a monorail simulation game set in Hwagae Mountain, a representative natural landmark in Korea.
Players become a monorail driver, taking in the breathtaking scenery of Hwagae Mountain and experiencing the unique experience of operating a monorail through beautiful natural and cultural heritage sites.

This is the first title to utilize actual filmed sections of the Hwagae Mountain monorail!

Key Features

• Realistic Monorail Driving Experience

Uses high-quality footage of actual Hwagae Mountain monorail sections.

Experience driving a monorail through diverse landscapes and terrain.

Two play modes: section-by-section driving mode and view mode.

• Control System

Just like driving a real monorail, precise control is required, including acceleration, deceleration, and stopping.

Compared to regular railways, the game features numerous uphill and downhill sections and significant impacts, requiring appropriate acceleration and deceleration control.

Ensuring on-time operation and stopping locations are crucial challenges, providing players with a truly engaging experience.

Supports Mascon for Nintendo Switch™ controllers from Zuiki.

• Realistic Scenery and Atmosphere

Pass through the Hwagaesan Monorail section and admire the surrounding mountains, nature, and tourist attractions through footage shot on the actual monorail.

Enjoy the natural beauty of Korea through high-definition footage that realistically recreates the breathtaking scenery as you ride.

Recommended for:

• Gamers who enjoy monorails and natural scenery
• Players who want to experience Korea's famous attractions and travels through games
• Users who prefer realistic simulations that emphasize nature and scenery

This game offers a unique opportunity to experience Hwagaesan and its surrounding natural landscapes by monorail.
It's a truly unforgettable experience for lovers of Korean nature and monorails!
70010000111208.intro: This simulation game lets you operate a train directly, based on footage of actual trains in motion! Simply operate the up/down accelerator and brake levers to experience beautiful scenery.
70010000111208.name: Korean Monorail Panorama Line Hwagaesan

70010000111223.description:
It’s the year 197X…

A mysterious force calling itself the Cosmic Demon Empire suddenly launched an assault on Earth, commanding an army of colossal beast-shaped war machines known as the Space Beasts. Meanwhile, at a certain top-secret Space Robot Laboratory somewhere in the Far East, preparations had been made “just in case something like this ever happened”. Thus, the newly developed transforming and combining combat robot GEPPY-X was deployed into action.

Never before released outside of Japan, 70’s-Style Robot Anime GEPPY-X will now be available to play worldwide!

A love letter to Japanese mecha anime from the 70’s, this fast-paced 2D side-scrolling shooter has undergone a transformation of its own. Battle the Cosmic Demon Empire with quality of life improvements such as faster load times, rewind, save states, and more!

Experience GEPPY-X with subtitles in eight new languages and full restoration of the 8,000 hand-drawn frames from the original Betacam master tapes. The original release squeezed the animation into four discs at 320x240 resolution and only 15fps. For this new release, each “episode” has had its opening theme, previews, commercials, and end credits re-digitized and restored to its original 24fps.

Features
- Never suffer from a mistake or miss a commercial with the ability to rewind
- Save and reload at any point with Save States
- Trophies/Achievements
- Fully restored Betacam tapes re-digitized to 24fps with optional upscaling (optional setting will follow shortly after launch)
- Original Japanese voice overs including iconic voices from classic 90’s anime such as Akira Kamiya, Shō Hayami, Shūichi Ikeda, Ichirō Nagai, Gorō Naya, and more
- Original soundtrack including legendary anime theme artists Isao Sasaki, Akira Kushida, and Hironobu Kageyama
- Localized subtitles (available in English, Japanese, French, Spanish, Italian, German, Korean, Traditional Chinese, and Simplified Chinese)
- Transform between three combat forms in real time, mastering balance, speed, and power
Rapid Fire Option : Relax your hands and fire your main and sub weapons by holding botton instead of button mashing!
- CRT filters - Relive the retro experience with several filter options, including CRT curvature
- Digital Gameplay Manual
- 6 Unlockable Extra Modes including:
    Boss Rush
    Alternate Timelines
    Experimental Episode Variants
70010000111223.intro:
70s-Style Super Robot Anime Returns.
Transforming Mechs × Arcade 2D Shooter Action.
A Cult Classic Reborn in HD — Now Worldwide.
70010000111223.name: 70s-style Robot Anime Geppy-X

70010000111229.description:
STREAMER SIMULATOR 2026 invites you into a dynamic world of digital content creation, where every stream tells a story and every follower brings you closer to internet fame. Step into the shoes of an aspiring streamer and feel the thrill, pressure, and unpredictability of building your online career from scratch.

This is more than a lifestyle game — it’s a full streamer simulation, where timing, creativity, and strategy shape your path to stardom.

Features:
-Realistic content creation:
Master live streaming, audience interaction, and editing with tools simulating real streaming platforms.
-Dynamic social trends:
Adapt to viewer interests, viral moments, trolls, and sponsorships in a changing online ecosystem.
-Life and time management:
Balance streaming with sleep, meals, side jobs, bills, and manage stress and burnout.
-Customization and modding:
Personalize your setup, overlays, outfits, and create or download custom events and content.

Will you shine in the spotlight — or vanish in the algorithm?
70010000111229.intro: Go live, get noticed, and captivate viewers worldwide.
70010000111229.name: STREAMER SIMULATOR 2026

70010000111238.description:
"BOMB BEE" is a brick breaker released by NAMCO LIMITED (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1979.
The biggest feature of this sequel to GEE BEE, as its title suggests, is the bomb!
Find the hidden bombs in the playfield, set off explosions, and aim for a high score! Like its predecessor, this title also supports mouse control. Let's BOMB BEE with simple controls!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.
70010000111238.intro: The second in the BEE series! New charm for the block-breaker genre!
70010000111238.name: Arcade Archives BOMB BEE

70010000111247.description:
Kingdom's Return is an action RPG where you'll adventure to restore your fallen kingdom. Collect materials in 2D side-scrolling adventure stages, then use them in the strategy part to rebuild your kingdom and power up your characters!

*Story
In a world of swords, magic, and fairies, you are a lone adventurer who suddenly becomes tasked to revive the ruined kingdom of Almacia along with the Fairy of Time, Chronos.
Through adventure (action) and revival (strategy), restore the kingdom to its former glory!

*Action and Strategy
Kingdom's Return combines action with strategy for an addictive hybrid experience!
In adventure stages, you'll collect items for construction in the strategy part, all while levelling up your kingdom and characters.
You can approach each side in balance, or concentrate primarily on just one and still clear the game.

*The build of your dreams!
As you fill the land with buildings, the characters you take on adventures will also grow stronger.
Build the kingdom of your dreams and strengthen your allies!

*The playable cast is brimming with personality!
Start your adventure by choosing from "Imperial", "Wizard", "Alchemist", and "Zipangu".
Each has unique stats, skills and attacks, so choose the one that fits your action style!
You can change characters while in your kingdom, so you'll always have a variety of styles to choose from!

*Adventure in an idyllic fantasy world!
In Kingdom's Return, you'll build your cozy fantasy kingdom and bravely adventure into dungeons.
Get quests from villagers, build up your lands, and play around with powerful bosses!
This is your kingdom to rebuild how you want!
70010000111247.intro: A kingdom-rebuilding adventure filled with action and strategy!
70010000111247.name: Kingdom's Return: Time-Eating Fruit and the Ancient Monster

70010000111252.description:
Welcome to Nature Escapes 5, where the peaceful world of hidden objects awaits.
With 24 new levels, each one is a quiet corner of nature where you can take your time and enjoy the simple act of finding hidden objects.
It’s a casual game designed for those moments when you just want to relax and unwind.

Find yourself in 20+ cozy, nature-inspired levels.

- Uncover over 70+ hidden object scenes and engaging minigames.
- Learn fascinating facts about a diverse array of plants.
- Relax with soothing, gentle music throughout your journey.
- Create and personalize your own peaceful garden retreat.

As you explore, you’ll discover objects nestled in beautiful, serene settings.
Whether it's a tranquil forest or a blooming garden, each level offers a calm, unhurried experience.
