And if you enjoy a bit of creativity, there's plenty of opportunity to expand your garden with new plants and decorations, making it a little retreat that reflects the world you explore.
70010000111252.intro: Nature Escapes makes a return with exciting surprises for both old and new players!
70010000111252.name: Nature Escapes 5 Collector's Edition

70010000111254.description:
Welcome to Disney Speedstorm!

Disney Speedstorm is the ultimate hero-based combat-racing game, set on high-speed circuits inspired by Disney and Pixar worlds. It’s a thrilling arcade racing experience where players will need to master each Character’s unique Skills on the racetrack and claim victory.

DISNEY & PIXAR GO FULL BATTLE RACING
An incredible cast of characters, including Sulley, Beast, Mickey Mouse, Mulan, Baloo, Captain Jack Sparrow, and more, are suited and revving up for racing combat. Upgrade each Racer’s stats and make the most of their unique Skills that can impact the outcome of a single race and dramatically change the way you play the game!

ARCADE RACING REDEFINED
Anyone can pick up and play Disney Speedstorm, but mastering skills and techniques like timing your nitro boosts, precisely drifting around corners, and adapting to dynamic track environments are crucial to dominating each race.

RACING TOGETHER HAS NEVER BEEN EASIER
Pick your Racer and speed through action-packed tracks solo, or challenge friends in local and online multiplayer modes. You can even face off with players from around the globe to become an online legend.

DISNEY- & PIXAR-INSPIRED RACETRACKS
Start your engine in environments inspired by some of your favourite Disney and Pixar films. From the docks of Pirates of the Caribbean’s Kraken Port to the wilds of The Jungle Book’s Jungle Ruins or the Scare Floor from Monsters, Inc., you can experience these worlds from a fresh, exciting perspective geared specifically for racing!

CUSTOMISE TO YOUR OWN STYLE
Choose your favorite Racer’s suit, a flashy kart livery, and show off stylish wheels and wings -- all of this and more is possible with the extensive customisation features in the game!

NEW CONTENT RACING YOUR WAY
The action never slows down thanks to fresh seasonal content always around the corner. New Disney and Pixar Racers will be added regularly, bringing special skills for you to master (or overcome), and unique tracks will be created often, to pump fresh strategy into the mix. Support Crew characters, environments, customisation options, and collectibles will also drop in regularly, so there’s always more to experience.
70010000111254.intro: Drift into the ultimate hero-based combat racing game, set on high-speed circuits inspired by Disney and Pixar worlds.
70010000111254.name: Disney Speedstorm

70010000111260.description: 12 enchanting beauties will delight you in an exciting puzzle game. An angel and a succubus, a cat girl, a fox, and many others are waiting for you!
70010000111260.intro: 12 enchanting beauties will delight you in an exciting puzzle game.
70010000111260.name: Hentai Uni 5

70010000111274.description: A castaway stuck on a deserted island scrounges for the last bits of food he can find. On the edge of death, he wakes up one night and realizes that a fully stocked, fully functional fast food restaurant has appeared on his tiny island paradise. Shocked and confused at the sight, he wanders into the nightmare that is Manny's, a restaurant with employees who act as if nothing is out of the ordinary, one bloodthirsty patron, and a mysterious manager who calls out from the bowels of the restaurant itself. Will this castaway get his last meal, or will he become the meal?
70010000111274.intro: this stranded soul will have to work for his meal...and for his life!
70010000111274.name: Manny’s

70010000111280.description:
The ultimate brand-new 8-bit shmup "Changeable Guardian ESTIQUE," born in the 21st century, has arrived!

What is "Changeable Guardian ESTIQUE"?
A faithful port of "Changeable Guardian ESTIQUE," meticulously crafted to capture a truly nostalgic 8-bit feel.

It features both the Japanese and North American versions, each offering a distinct storyline. You can also explore and enjoy printed materials and various visual artworks in the Gallery Mode.

Simple yet deep game system
This title is a side-scrolling shmup consisting of 6 stages based on cities around the world.
The super-variable mech "ESTIQUE" can transform at any time between "Fighter Form", which has a smaller vertical hitbox, and "Robot Form", which nullifies terrain damage and excels in health recovery. The key to clearing the game lies in how you switch between these two forms and two types of equipment depending on the situation. Furthermore, the scoring system driven by the special attack "Super Weapon", activated by mashing the shot button, adds depth to the gameplay.
With a game design focused on playability—such as a time-based regenerating life system and the removal of power-ups—a strategic shooting experience awaits everyone, from beginners to experts.
70010000111280.intro: "Changeable Guardian ESTIQUE" is the ultimate, completely new 8-bit shmup created in the 21st century.
70010000111280.name: Changeable Guardian ESTIQUE

70010000111286.description:
"They mean everything to me. Please, make them whole again."

You are a mechanic for androids who has received a request from a new client.
The client is a doctor named Miomaru and his personal android, an old, near-failing model named Harima.
As per your client's request, you begin repairing Harima. You connect the cords, trade out parts, and bring life back to the functions that had broken down. It was supposed to be a simple mechanical repair.
However, the more you deepen your bonds with Harima and Miomaru, the more you start to realize something.
You're not just repairing an android anymore. You're connecting the cords that spark their memories; ones that they'd tried to forget.
Once your job is finished, you will be forced to confront shocking truths and hear their heartrending pleas.


Gameplay

Android Repairs
Look inside Harima's body to find the parts that need to be fixed through a variety of mini-games. These repairs will be the key to learning about your clients' past.

Conversation
Talk with your clients, Miomaru and Harima, to gain their trust and get to the true crux of their story. Your choices will change how they respond.

World-buildingWhile in your car, you can listen to the radio and gain more insights into the world and its culture. Try out several channels to gain even more insight into the game's world.
70010000111286.intro: A puzzle adventure where you repair androids to uncover the secrets of the past.
70010000111286.name: Save My Scrap

70010000111305.description:
Judero is an action/ adventure game inspired by the rich folk history of the Scottish Borders. You play as Judero, a Celt who can establish a rapport with the nature around him. Travel with Judero through a handcrafted landscape as he discovers there is an evil at work manipulating the unguarded.

Strike and dodge your way through a myriad of foes culminating in exciting and unique boss challenges.

Take on the form of lesser creatures to greatly expand your abilities. Use these enchanted minions in combat and to solve puzzles.

Discover the world of Judero through branching dialogues and pithy, aphoristic NPCs.

Through your adventures you will encounter a number of diverse Mini Games with differing mechanics and visual styles. Mini games also vary the pace of the game and allow us to explore other narrative tangents.

There are many secrets and discoveries to find as you roam through the world of Judero. From collectables and pick-ups to whole optional story-lines and more.

Judero is made from handcrafted objects and bespoke figurines, animated in the stop-motion tradition. For us, this art style invokes something nostalgic; in part comical but perhaps a little bit creepy too. These real life elements are then rendered into a 3D world to evoke a unique visual style. Using this style we can bring in digital techniques like real-time lighting, shaders and post-processing effects. Cutscenes will be made using traditional stop-motion animation techniques with greater fidelity to give a more cinematic quality.

The music in Judero is an homage to traditional British folk music such as those documented by Francis James Child. Many of these songs are hundreds of years old and it has been an honour researching and learning them. We are keeping instrumentation acoustic and mostly authentic to the originals (mostly) but with contemporary arrangements and harmonies.
70010000111305.intro: Judero is a handmade action/ adventure game inspired by the rich folk history of the Scottish Borders. You play as Judero, a Celt who can establish a rapport with the nature around him.
70010000111305.name: Judero

70010000111321.description:
Upon signing up to a perfectly normal battle of the bands contest for a bit of fun, Faye, Ian and Briff are cursed with an unusual power and find themselves sealed to a horrible fate. Surely there's a way to get out of it, there has to be! Even if it means... *shudder* working together.

Gameplay features:
- 15-20 hours of game time
- Kick down every single door you come across
- 100+ skills, 50+ accessories and 9 classes to customize the band with, each with their own special outfit
- Outfit choices are reflected in ALL dialogue portraits and cutscenes
- Excessive amounts of hand-drawn frame-by-frame animation
- Inventive battle system that combines real-time and turn-based gameplay
- Rich soundtrack spanning a wide variety of genres
- Highly praised writing and humour
- Memorable dungeons - From traversing the hair of a giant tree lady to crowdsurfing through an entire arena
- Item system that says GOOD RIDDANCE to tedious inventory management
- 120+ unique NPCs, all with their own dialogue portraits
- Late game dating segment with 12+ endings
- You can actually use status effects on bosses!
- Singing fish are an integral part of the story
- NEW! Easy mode
- NEW! Bonus area with brutally difficult challenges

This product supports the following languages: English
70010000111321.intro: Melt a face, slap a bass or kiss a drum in this RPG about three idiot musicians. Praised for its refreshing take on the JRPG genre.
70010000111321.name: Deathbulge: Battle of the Bands

70010000111327.description:
Brave Rounds is a fast-paced, close range-heavy vertical scrolling shoot 'em up with the beauty and ruthless precision of 00s arcade classics. Shoot them up by yourself or co-op together with a friend!

Master the art of getting closer and beat the heck out of them!

Play as one of three playable characters accompanied with their Options. Shoot the wide shot, focus shot, deploy the bombs, or unleash their special!

You don't have to fight alone; get a friend and play together in Two Player where they control the Options directly! Or control both characters at once with just one controller with Dual Control!

Brave Rounds tells a touching story of inter-generational relationships and the lengths people take to accomplish their goals. Set in the occult and sci-fi-laden modern era of 20XX, Brave Rounds explores the worth in fighting for what you believe in.

Features:
- Arcade Mode, the game's main mode of high-intensity five stages action. Fight the mid-bosses, bosses, and watch out for the dynamic difficulty: Rank! Are you worthy enough to face the True Last Boss...?
- Stage Practice, for your practicing convenience. Whenever you get stuck at Arcade Mode, visit the Stage Practice.
- Story Mode, telling a different story from Arcade Mode, is where you tackle 41 bite-sized stages. Complete the challenges, get the stars, upgrade your strength. Explore the world of Brave Rounds and the motivations behind the characters in lively and animated Visual Novel-style cutscenes!
- Score Attack. Get the high score in the Score Attack-exclusive stage within the 3 minutes time limit! Dare to put the gas on the pedal and raise the rank to its limit?
- Inspired by 00s video games and animes, Brave Rounds features smooth, hi-res hand-drawn art and animations. Colorful and expressive! Watching their movements is key to success.
- Enjoy the soundtrack of various genres by Dicky Teja Pratama, Jasson Prestiliano and Scowsh!
- Screen scaling options including TATE / Vertical mode, rebindable controls, and replays!
70010000111327.intro: Shoot, punch and get closer through bullets and enemies in this close range-heavy arcade bullet hell shoot 'em up!
70010000111327.name: Brave Rounds

70010000111335.description:
This is a box-pushing puzzle escape game set in a collapsing room. You’ll need to count your moves precisely, dodge bottomless pits and traps, use all kinds of mechanisms in the room, and push crates to solve puzzles—escape before the walls crush you into a puddle!

The amount of content is insane! Over 300+ escape-room levels, 5 large themed chapters, plus tons of exhibits packed with dark-humor jokes.

Watch the timing of the walls closing in each turn, plan your steps with precision, avoid traps, make smart use of the stage’s interactive mechanics, push boxes to open the exit, and get out before the walls turn you into mince!

All kinds of fun gadgets await inside: signal panels, polymers, portals... and many more tricky, high-difficulty puzzles for you to crack! Bring it on!

You can freely explore the level-select hub. Clear the main challenges to earn compute points and unlock later chapters—but the tough puzzles hidden in the corners are the real test. And when you need a break from solving puzzles, you can also explore virtual exhibits and hunt for hidden levels—there are loads of Easter eggs waiting to be found.
70010000111335.name: Shrink Rooms

70010000111336.description:
An ominous brotherhood of religious fanatics perform experiments on humans in their top-secret scientific complex. An ancient prison hidden deep in the Swiss mountains houses hundreds of test subjects whose bodies are mutilated in an effort to produce a new biological species of superhuman.

You are one of them, but unlike other test subjects, your body is immune to mutagens. For you, it's not poison anymore, rather a source of power that makes your body nearly indestructible.

Steal the weapon and obliterate them.

Break into the depths of the secret complex, unravel the secret of the millennial brotherhood's ancient technology and harness the power of mutagen to annihilate all those who stand in your way.

A timeless classic, with a fresh presentation.

You will feel right at home when exploring complex one-story levels in search of first aid kits, ammo and key cards, while fighting hordes of enemies in action-packed firefights. An old school shooter's classic weapons, upgrades, and well-hidden secrets will complete the experience.

Enemies are powerful. But not immortal.

There are more than 20 types of enemies in the game, and each knows how to kill you in a variety of ways. Among them are ordinary soldiers, cyborgs with power armor, flamethrowers, and huge walking mechs.

Fear not! There are brutal means to fight them all! A total of 9 types of weapons representing the most advanced engineering fashion of the brotherhood. You'll have plenty of obliteration methods at your disposal - not only a shotgun that can make a juicy "bang", but also a laser rifle that can fire infinitely, a flamethrower, and a rocket launcher. There is also...a " Butterfly ", a weapon so secret that not even the Brotherhood knows why it's called like that.

Danger lurks around every corner.

Crowds of fanatics aren't the only obstacles you need to overcome on your journey; traps and environmental elements also pose a grave threat. Watch out, since just 1 wrong step is all it takes for the laser barrier to slice you into 8 pieces.

This journey will be long. Challenging. And exciting.

You will face 24 huge and complex levels across 6 acts. Escape the prison by sneaking through a secret laboratory, sand dunes, and an ancient castle that holds thousands of years of Brotherhood history.

No one is with you. All you have is yourself. Your shotgun. Hordes of enemies. Animal rage and the desire to kill.

Destroy Them All!
70010000111336.intro: They are billions. You are alone.
70010000111336.name: Brotherhood

70010000111348.description:
Dive into a world of stunning, realistic puzzles that captivate your eyes and mind. Piece by piece, reveal breathtaking images of beautiful women — each completed puzzle unlocks a new masterpiece, keeping you motivated to discover what’s next.

Smooth and intuitive touch controls make gameplay effortless and deeply satisfying — you’ll feel like you’re truly shaping every picture with your own hands. Gentle, soothing music sets the perfect mood, helping you unwind while your curiosity pulls you to complete the next challenge.

Relax, enjoy, and let yourself get lost in the details.

Features:
• Addictive, easy-to-play puzzle mechanics.
• Gorgeous, realistic artwork of women.
• Satisfying touch interaction — every move feels natural.
• Unlock new, even more stunning images as you progress.
• Perfect balance of challenge and relaxation.
• Soothing soundtrack that enhances your focus and mood.
• Admire each completed image in full detail.
70010000111348.intro: Every piece brings you closer to perfection!
70010000111348.name: Pure Hentai: Dreams

70010000111368.description: This is a logical observation game where you have to match identical cats! Search, spot them in the crowd, and pair them up! Test your observation skills!
70010000111368.intro: Can you find two identical cats?
70010000111368.name: Spot the Cat

70010000111377.description:
Dive into a world of stunning, realistic puzzles that captivate your eyes and mind. Piece by piece, reveal breathtaking images of beautiful women — each completed puzzle unlocks a new masterpiece, keeping you motivated to discover what’s next.

Smooth and intuitive touch controls make gameplay effortless and deeply satisfying — you’ll feel like you’re truly shaping every picture with your own hands. Gentle, soothing music sets the perfect mood, helping you unwind while your curiosity pulls you to complete the next challenge.

Relax, enjoy, and let yourself get lost in the details.

Features:
• Addictive, easy-to-play puzzle mechanics.
• Gorgeous, realistic artwork of women.
• Satisfying touch interaction — every move feels natural.
• Unlock new, even more stunning images as you progress.
• Perfect balance of challenge and relaxation.
• Soothing soundtrack that enhances your focus and mood.
• Admire each completed image in full detail.
70010000111377.intro: Every piece brings you closer to perfection!
70010000111377.name: Hentai Balls 3D: Heavy Attraction

70010000111387.description:
Cast n Chill's a laid-back fishin’ game for folks who’d rather wet a line than break a sweat. Whether yer driftin’ on a lazy lake, pokin’ 'round a winding river, or droppin’ lines in salty blue water, this here’s a game where you set the pace.

Upgrade Yer Gear.
Start with the basics, catch whatever bites, sell your haul, and put those coins toward better rods, reels, and upgrades. Before ya know it, you’ll be wranglin’ rare species that’d make any angler green with envy.

Explore New Waters.
Find yer favourite fishin’ hole or keep wanderin’. There’s 16 peaceful spots to discover, each with its own critters swimmin’ 'round, just waitin’ to bite.

Pick Your Pace.
In Active Mode, you’re in the thick of it - castin’, reelin’, and keepin’ busy like a loon at nesting time.

Switch to Passive Mode if you’d rather let the game do the work while you’re off choppin’ wood.

Collect 'Em All.
There’s 50 fish to discover - some you’ll recognize, some you’ll squint at and go “what in the heck is that?” From scrappy little sunfish to big ol’ deepwater beasts, they’re all in the logbook waitin’ for your name.

Legendary Catches
There’s 16 fish out there that still get folks jabberin’ at ol' Rusty's bait shop like they saw Bigfoot ride a moose. Land one, and you'll be part o' the legend.

Boat Buddies
Grab your rod and call a buddy, Cast 'n Chill now has co-op! Whether you’re lookin’ to kick back and fish side-by-side or stir up a bit of friendly competition, it’s all better with company.

Trusty Companion
Nothin’ beats a day on the lake with a four-legged friend. They might not know a spinnerbait from a spoon, but they’ll help you spot a fish - if only 'cause they’re hopin’ for a bite themselves.
70010000111387.intro: Catch rare fish, upgrade your gear and reel in legendary catches - all with your loyal companion by your side.
70010000111387.name: Cast n Chill

70010000111414.description:
The natural order has been disrupted, and it’s up to you to set things straight again! Travel to the forest, volcano and winter biomes as a brainteasing top-down adventure ensues.

Tiny Biomes is a relaxing yet challenging tile-rotation puzzle game where you must guide the flow of water, snow or lava to bring life back to the biomes, each consisting of 50 unique levels of gradually increasing complexity and challenge.

As you progress deeper into these biomes, you will encounter more tiles and branching paths. Each level offers up three stars. The fewer moves you use, the more stars you earn!

• Guide the flow of water, snow and lava to restore life to each biome!
• Rotate landscape tiles in engaging, relaxing puzzle gameplay.
• Enjoy colorful aesthetics and HD graphics!
• Master 150 unique stages across forest, volcano and winter biomes.
• Replay levels to use fewer moves and earn more stars!
70010000111414.intro: Restore life to the troubled lands in tile-based brainteaser style!
70010000111414.name: Tiny Biomes

70010000111417.description:
Balance the weight of the GIGASWORD, battling between brain and brawn in this action-puzzle metroidvania where the might of the sword will determine all. As tensions rise in Thoenhart, a city plagued by famine and disease, the humans within set their hopes on a final solution: invade the ancient tower Nestrium, slay the Nocturne, and take the God Crystal, Gnosis, for themselves.

Said to grant prosperity to those who wield it, Gnosis has been long sought after by humanity for generations. However, upon raiding its resting place, the disturbance of this ancient power awakens an evil capable of destroying the very fabric of reality . Can Ezra reach the top of the Nestrium in time to stop this cataclysm, or will humanity’s ignorance lead the world to its doom?
Balance the Weight - The sword may be perfect for combat but you’ll find slaying isn’t its only use. Unlock doors, weigh down pressure plates, and push blocks as you ground your blade, traversing by foot, relieving yourself momentarily, the weight of the blade.
Olden Secrets - With cataclysm at the doorstep, unearth the twisting forgotten halls of the Nestrium. Hidden secrets lurk behind every nook, cranny, and hole in the wall, with only you to discover the wealth that lies within.
Curb Demonic Ruination - Hack, slash, and dodge through ruthless demons, corrupted bosses, and bloodlusting fiends landing the killing blow, sending them back to the underworld.
Adapt, Innovate, Evolve - As you’re forced through nefarious traps, deathly drops, and seemingly invincible foes, discover new abilities to aid in your journey such as Thunder Bolts, Crawling Sparks, Grappling Hooks, and much more.
For Famine and Family - Humans are on death's front door and they curse the heavens, looking to the Nestrium for their salvation. The God Crystal, Gnosis, safeguarded by the Nocturne is a chance at prosperity. It’s up to Ezra to keep the balance… and bring peace to all!
70010000111417.intro: Can he restore the world's coherency before it's too late?
70010000111417.name: GIGASWORD

70010000111426.description:
Tales of Berseria returns with enhanced playability and quality-of-life enhancements!

Engage in the ultimate quest for self-discovery, remastered for the first time. The sacred kingdom awaits the arrival of its savior, and a lone woman named Velvet is marked by traumatic deceit. Join Velvet on her journey for vengeance, along with her cast of eccentric companions, as they sail through the archipelago which comprises the kingdom of Midgand.

• A Tale of Emotion Versus Reason
Let emotions guide your destiny, or maintain order with the power of reason. Witness the eternal struggle between the head and the heart as Velvet is challenged to stand by her convictions while the world around her compresses into a system of order.

• An Exhilarating Combat System
Freely choose Artes to suit your playstyle and perform a variety of combos. Collect enemy Souls to unleash a barrage of attacks for a thrilling battle experience.

• A Modern, High-Quality Retelling
Useful features like destination markers and the ability to disable enemy encounters make traversing the islands of Midgand all the more enticing. Visit the famous Grade Shop from the game's opening. Get a smooth play experience only found in this remaster!

• Access DLC from the First Iteration
This version features several DLC from the original 2016 version. A treasure trove of content awaits you, such as outfits for your characters from the previous Tales Of games along with useful equipment for your travels.
70010000111426.name: Tales of Berseria Remastered

70010000111445.description:
The beloved classic returns in a remastered edition, featuring improved visuals and enhanced atmospheric presentation.

◆STORY
In Mitono, a remote mountain village with only a handful of households, every child must undergo a mysterious ritual known as Warawa-Tomurai. Sixth-graders Yuuma and Honoka take part in the ceremony just before the village begins to disperse.

Yuuma’s family soon moves to the city, while Honoka remains behind due to unforeseen circumstances. Separated, the two begin to uncover the secrets behind the ritual.

Within the sanctum where something inhuman resides, the children are drawn in—toward a painful fate.

◆REMASTERED FEATURES
- Some background images have been replaced with new assets, giving the game a distinctly different visual impression from the original.
- The user interface has been redesigned for improved readability and usability.
- New text dialogues sounds enhance immersion in the story.
- Save slot count has been expanded to 21, allowing for more flexible play.
- Multi-language support opens the experience to a wider global audience.
70010000111445.intro:
They buried the dolls for us that night.
But the story didn’t end with the soil.
70010000111445.name: Our Burial Dolls Remastered

70010000111459.description:
This is a deck-building roguelike game. Combine and upgrade over 100 carefully designed spells to forge the ultimate magical power.

More than 50 unique enemies appear across a wide variety of stages. Choose your own battle strategy and cast powerful spells at just the right moment to fend off endless waves of foes!

Encounter unexpected events, decide between risky or safer paths, face different enemies, pick different cards, and discover powerful relics!
70010000111459.intro: Build your deck and unleash the most powerful spells.
70010000111459.name: Legendary Spell

70010000111462.description:
A legendary arcade game developed by Dimps in 2005. This fighting game gained popularity for its smooth visuals powered by S.M.A as well as the high level of strategy driven by its 2-gauges system. And with the addition of new current-gen features it's even easier to play.

- Battle Mechanics Polished to a Shine by a Legendary Studio Known for Fighters:
The first original fighting game from Dimps, known for being involved in a number of other fighting games. It has continued to attract fighting game fans since its release in 2005 with mechanics that use 2 gauges--one for offense and one for defense--and slick 2D visuals powered by S.M.A. (Smooth Model Animation).

- New Features for Console Provide a Modern Gameplay Experience:
The console version contains new features such as an Online Versus Mode--a first for the series. It uses Rollback Netcode, which corrects lag between players, making for a streamlined experience online. And with 16:9 wide-screen support, AI and a training mode, you can fully enjoy this game in the comfort of your own home.

- Main Game Modes:
・Arcade
・Survival
・Time Attack
・Local Multiplay
・Online Multiplay with rollback netcode
・Training
・Gallery
Added features: Spectator mode, rematch, match recording, combat range and match time settings, assist mode, new character colors, button assignment for Boost Dive, and an updated training mode including character-specific gauge and enemy attack/dodge/ground recovery settings, as well as adjustments to enemy auto recovery timing.

- The Story:
It is the end of the 20th century... A large-scale natural disaster struck the eastern area of a nation. It wiped out the financial sector and resulted in a staggering loss of life.

At the dawn of the 21st century, the conglomerate PROBE-NEXUS, commonly known as Probe, began reconstruction efforts in that eastern area. Colossal capital and cutting-edge technology was poured into rebuilding it. Skyscrapers that put the old high-rises to shame along with the world's biggest shopping mall and recreational facilities. This was the dazzling birth of a symbol for the new century. It was christened Zone Prime.

And now, in an undeveloped sector of its western block, there was an area known as the slums...
70010000111462.name: The Rumble Fish 2

70010000111464.description:
The city belongs to the night, but it doesn’t forgive mistakes.

You are a vampire on the run, hiding among streets, dark alleys, and forgotten places where danger and desire walk side by side.

Every night brings new choices, new encounters, and new risks.

In Vampire Girls Love Story: Date or Die, time is always moving forward. Days pass. Hunters get closer. And the girls you meet are drawn to something they can’t quite explain.

Some are intrigued by your presence.
Others sense the danger beneath it.
All of them can change your fate.

This is a narrative visual novel where romance and survival are tightly connected. Exploring the city unlocks locations, abilities, and story paths, while conversations and decisions determine who trusts you, who helps you, and who gets close enough to matter.

But attraction alone won’t keep you alive.

Vampire hunters patrol the streets, forcing you to escape, confront threats, and grow stronger. Learning new skills, choosing when to fight or flee, and deciding how to spend each night can mean the difference between freedom… or the end.

Some relationships offer safety.
Others grant power.
And a few may cost more than you’re willing to lose.

Balance desire, strategy, and survival in a story where every choice carries weight.


Features

● ROMANCE & SURVIVAL VISUAL NOVEL: A story that blends dating, danger, and supernatural tension.

● TIME PROGRESSION SYSTEM: Days advance as you explore, shaping events, encounters, and threats.

● CHOICE DRIVEN GAMEPLAY: Decisions affect relationships, abilities, and how the city reacts to you.

● VAMPIRE HUNTERS & ESCAPES: Avoid pursuit, face danger, and fight to stay alive.

● MULTIPLE ROUTES & ENDINGS: Different romances, powers, and outcomes based on how you play.


Date wisely.
Survive the night.
Play now!
70010000111464.intro:
Hunt the night.
Win their hearts.
Survive until dawn.
70010000111464.name: Vampire Girls Love Story: Date or Die

70010000111470.description:
Help Zealot find her lost brother, Solitude, in the vibrant but chaotic 'Other Dimension' where riches are abundant and dangers aplenty!
 Combine bullet powers found on the field to create unique bullet types. Dash to avoid attacks but also to crash enemies or deflect bullets.
Fight through randomised levels, challenge large bullet hell-like bosses and collect Red Eye Orbs to spend between attempts to permanently upgrade your abilities to help tip the tide and assist you in beating the game.
70010000111470.intro: This game rolls roguelite and run and gunner into a tight experience with 1-4 couch co-op.
70010000111470.name: Blitz Smash Ultimate

70010000111480.description:
A mesmerizing, intertwined, decaying world awaits.

Awaken MIO, a nimble robot with extraordinary abilities, and unravel the mysteries of the Vessel, an enormous technological ark overgrown with lush vegetation and machines gone rogue.

Nobody knows why the Pearls, The Vessel's AI caretakers, have ceased functioning. Forgotten by all, the Vessel faces imminent shutdown. Dive into its depths to revive its lost memories, as you unravel your true past and destiny, in this mesmerizing metroidvania.

Will you rise to the challenge and save the Vessel from destruction? Will you dare to seek and wake its memories?

•Explore a captivating universe, full of wonder and artistic curiosities. Interact with the Vessel’s environments to learn more about its past and memories.

•Earn game-changer abilities to help MIO progress through this twisted and interconnected space. Climb walls like a spider or float through the air with your Glide power. Master precision, rhythm, and timing to find the perfect flow!

•Face off a diverse array of over 30 enemy units and 15 formidable guardian bosses. Use your arsenal of powers to adapt to every encounter. Evade foes using your Hook, unleash orbs as powerful projectiles, and even create decoy clones to strike from unexpected angles. It’s always your choice!

•Enhance and customize MIO abilities by scavenging components. Spice up your fighting skills with many Modifiers and transform MIO into a formidable force tailored to your playstyle.
70010000111480.intro: Revive the Memories of the Vessel
70010000111480.name: MIO: Memories in Orbit

70010000111486.description:
Every victory draws attention.
In this pride filled paradise, confidence is part of the game.

Furry Pride Paradise: Love & Fun invites you into a world that celebrates expression, personality, and playful attraction.

Through short, engaging minigames, each success unlocks new images, comments, and reactions that reflect the unique attitude of the furry boys around you.

This is a place where pride is visible in every smile, every reaction, and every bold comment.

Some furry boys stand out with fearless confidence.
Others reveal themselves slowly, watching how you play before opening up.
A few enjoy reacting to your choices, turning every win into a shared moment.

As you progress, the furry boys respond directly to your performance: teasing, commenting, and encouraging you to keep going. Your skill, focus, and curiosity shape what you see and who steps closer.

Win minigames, unlock scenes, and discover personalities that shine through confidence, attitude, and unapologetic charm.

Each victory adds a new layer to the experience, making every session feel expressive, rewarding, and full of character.

Fun, bold, and proudly expressive.


Features:

● PRIDEFUL FURRY BOYS: A diverse cast of furry boys that celebrate confidence, self expression, and playful charm.

● MINIGAMES WITH PERSONALITY: Clear challenges to unlock comments, reactions, and new interactions.

● UNLOCKABLE SCENES: Discover images and moments tied to your progress and performance.

● MULTIPLE FAVORITES: Different playstyles bring different furry boys into the spotlight.

● HIGH REPLAY VALUE: New reactions and outcomes encourage you to return again and again.


Are you ready to play and discover your favorite furry boy?
70010000111486.intro:
Colorful furry boys, playful challenges, and reactions full of personality.
Who will you unlock first in this pride filled paradise?
70010000111486.name: Furry Pride Paradise Love & Fun

70010000111492.description:
Welcome to a colorful world where charming furry girls turn every moment into playful fun.

Furry Girls Paradise mixes casual minigames with a light visual novel experience.

Each stage unlocks new images, cute reactions, and comments that reveal each girl’s unique personality.

Some are shy, some are confident, some are naturally flirty, and all of them express themselves with surprising comments as you play.

Your performance decides what you get to see and how each encounter progresses.

Win minigames, unlock scenes, and enjoy the reactions only these furry girls can give.


Features:

♥ CUTE & PLAYFUL GIRLS: Meet furry girls inspired by sweetness, charm, and colorful personalities.

♥ MINIGAMES & DIALOGUE: Alternate between quick challenges and fun conversations.

♥ UNLOCK SCENES: Discover new images and reactions with every success.

♥ MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Your progress shapes who becomes your favorite.

♥ HIGH REPLAY VALUE: Different outcomes and reactions every time you play.


Fun, charming, a little mischievous.
Are you ready to play?
70010000111492.intro:
Cute furry girls, playful challenges, and unexpected reactions.
Ready to discover who’s waiting behind each victory?
70010000111492.name: Furry Girls Paradise: Love & Fun

70010000111501.description:
In Fly for Fly, you control a cheeky little fly that turns a peaceful classroom into total chaos. Your only goal is to make every student lose their patience and survive long enough to see it happen.

Fly over desks and land on notebooks. Dodge furious swats as you push each student’s nerves to the limit. The more you annoy them, the higher their anger meter climbs. But be careful, one well-timed smack could end your buzzing career in an instant!

It’s a simple, hilarious action game where timing and movement are everything. Weave through pencils and papers, outsmart angry hands, and laugh at the chaos you create!

Can you stay in the air long enough to drive everyone crazy?
70010000111501.intro: Be the buzz that no one can ignore!
70010000111501.name: Fly for Fly

70010000111509.description:
Saddle up and ride back into the Wild West with the gunslinging ex-Marshal, James Anderson, and face off against the good, the bad, and the even worse this side of the Mississippi as you work to uncover a twisted plot of greed and corruption. With your trusty six-shooting .45 Revolver, Scoped .44 Rifle, 10-Gauge Shotgun, and good ol' Sawed-Off 12-Gauge Shotgun, you'll be packin' plenty of firepower to take out all manner of outlaw varmints.

Outlaws + A Handful of Missions features high-resolution, uncompressed cutscenes and updated visuals for weapons, characters, and enemies, all fully recreated from archived art and stylized to match the original look with full color palettes. Outlaws + A Handful of Missions also offers Cross-Play Multiplayer with game modes including Deathmatch, Team Play, Capture the Flag, and Kill The Fool With The Chicken!

It's Payback Time.

Outlaws + A Handful of Missions Remastered Key Features:
- Engaging first-person ground combat featuring five weapon types.
- Optimized controller support.
- A Vault filled with a treasure trove of behind-the-scenes gold nuggets.
- Quality of Life improvements
70010000111509.intro: The Most Dangerous Man is the One with Nothing Left to Lose.
70010000111509.name: Outlaws + Handful of Missions: Remaster

70010000111510.description:
FIGHT FOR YOUR FREEDOM
In the future, even death can’t free you. If a criminal dies while serving their sentence, they are reconstructed to return to their suffering. And you’re serving a 1300-year sentence. The only way to shorten this sentence? Win on “The Last Ticket.” The rules are simple: there is a shuttle on the roof of the prison, and if you can fight your way through hordes of other inmates and reach it in time, you will be given your freedom.

NO COMPROMISES
KIBORG is a hybrid of old-school beat’em ups, shooters, and rogue-likes. The fights are fast, brutal, and deadly. Sever limbs, squash heads, and tear cybernetic cores apart from living foes. There are dozens of enemy types with unique abilities and tactics, and they are mixed and matched to create hundreds of challenging encounters. If you’re here for blood and gore, you’ve come to the right place.

IMMENSE BUILD VARIETY
Replace your body parts with an array of cybernetic implants, enabling a wide variety of playstyles. Experiment with hundreds of power-enhancing augmentations and apply dozens of mutations to create deadly synergies. Wield a variety of melee weapons and firearms of all types. Use combos and special attacks to devastate your foes. Unleash millions of possible combinations and countless potential viable builds to destroy those standing between you and freedom.
70010000111510.intro: KIBORG is a relentless rogue-lite beat’em up where you enhance your body with new cybernetic implants each run
70010000111510.name: KIBORG

70010000111511.description:
Dispatch is a superhero workplace comedy set in modern day Los Angeles featuring an all-star cast including Aaron Paul, Laura Bailey, and Jeffrey Wright.

Note: Some mature content from Dispatch's original version has been modified.

You play as Robert Robertson, AKA Mecha Man, whose mech-suit is destroyed in a battle against his nemesis, forcing him to take a job at a superhero dispatch center: not as a hero, but a dispatcher.

As their dispatcher, you take charge of a team of ex-supervillains given a shot at redemption. Manage and level up your roster, all while navigating office relationships and romances, and rebuilding your suit for a shot at revenge!

> Shape the Story

In Dispatch, every decision you make influences the unfolding narrative. From banter in the breakroom to life-or-death situations in the field, your choices affect your relationships with the heroes, their allegiances, and the path your own story takes.

>  Deploy Your Heroes

Use the strategy map to review ongoing emergencies and deploy the right (or wrong) heroes to deal with them. Balance the risks and rewards as you make tactical decisions, knowing that each choice can have lasting consequences for your team and the city.

> Manage Your Roster

Managing heroes sometimes goes beyond their powers. Each hero comes with quirks, flaws, and baggage you’ll need to navigate to keep the team together. Upgrade their skills and unlock abilities to boost their effectiveness in the field.

Blending narrative, strategy, and humor, Dispatch explores what it means to be a hero, whether you're wearing a cape or behind a desk.

Featuring an all-star cast from every corner of entertainment:

Aaron Paul (Breaking Bad, Westworld, Black Mirror)
Laura Bailey (The Legend of Vox Machina)
Erin Yvette
MoistCr1TiKaL (Charles White)
Jacksepticeye (Sonic Prime, River City Girls 1 & 2, Bendy and the Ink Machine)
Travis Willingham (The Legend of Vox Machina, Critical Role)
Alanah Pearce (V/H/S Beyond)
Lance Cantstopolis (Karate, Dancing, Actor)
Joel Haver (Filmmaker, Actor, YouTuber)
THOT SQUAD (Musician: Pound Cake, Hoes Depressed)
Yung Gravy (Musician: Betty (Get Money), oops!)
Matthew Mercer (Critical Role)
and Jeffrey Wright (American Fiction, The Batman, Casino Royale)
70010000111511.intro: Choices matter in this superhero comedy where you manage a team of misfits.
70010000111511.name: Dispatch Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000111517.description:
"TOUCHDOWN FEVER" is a sports game released by SNK in 1987.
Tap the buttons to push forward—simple controls make it easy to enjoy the flow of American football.
With over a hundred formations selected automatically, even beginners unfamiliar with detailed tactics can relax and enjoy the game.

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.
70010000111517.intro: Rotate the joystick! Tap the Run button! Touchdown!
70010000111517.name: Arcade Archives TOUCHDOWN FEVER

70010000111526.description:
"Um, please be the new manager of the cafe!”
 Fuwa Fuwa Cafe—a maid cafe tucked away in a quiet part of Nipponbashi, and where a wonderful encounter is about to take place...
 You, the protagonist, quit your job at an extremely toxic workplace and find yourself at a run-down maid cafe, where a cute maid named Shiro works.
 At first, you only agree to become the new manager because it conveniently met all your urgent needs, but soon the colorful maids Miyu, Favna, and Honoka join in. And as you spend time with them and meet the people of Electric Street, both you and the cafe will gradually liven up once more.

 Maid Cafe on Electric Street is a game set in Nipponbashi, the heart of Osaka’s otaku culture. This is a story-focused adventure game where you enjoy daily life at Fuwa Fuwa Cafe. Make yourself a cup of coffee, relax, and immerse yourself in a heartwarming story.

 ■4 Cute, Memorable Heroines
Enjoy voice-acted conversations with the four maids, all with distinct personalities.
 ♥Shiro (VA: Ikumi Hasegawa)
 A maid who loves Fuwa Fuwa Cafe. A huge otaku for anime and video games, she talks really fast when she’s gushing about the things she loves, and often splurges on merch without thinking whenever she visits an anime shop. A little clumsy, but works hard every day to become the cute maid she’s always wanted to be.

 ♥Miyu (VA: Ayasa Itou)
 A game otaku and gyaru with a big appetite. Loves both eating and cooking, and apparently really enjoys serving her cooking to customers at Fuwa Fuwa Cafe. Is actually Shiro's friend on the online game Magic Angel, so they knew each other before actually meeting in real life.

 ♥Favna (VA: Sayumi Suzushiro)
 A mysterious girl dressed in gothic Lolita fashion. Speaks in riddles and demands the protagonist become her familiar. She sometimes accidentally drops the edgy act when she's taken by surprise though, so maybe she's just got a serious case of chuunibyou...?

 ♥Honoka (VA: Yui Ishikawa)
 A girl with a Kansaiben dialect who works as a shrine maiden at her family shrine. Practically in charge of the shrine, she is reliable and very good at handling money! Is actually a doujin author...?

 ■The Daily Life with the Four Maids of Fuwa Fuwa Cafe
 As the manager of Fuwa Fuwa, you’ll live in Nipponbashi, Osaka and spend time with your favorite maid... or maids. Go shopping, watch a movie, go for karaoke, buy a present for a special someone... What you choose to do, and with whom, will affect the ending of the story.

 ■Make Fuwa Fuwa Cafe Famous!
As the manager, it's your job to run the cafe. Improve the maids' work skills, optimize their roles, and drive up profits. The money you earn can be spent on shopping, food, capsule toys and more!

 ■The Stunning Sights of Nipponbashi
 Visit stores you can find in the real Nipponbashi, such as Surugaya, Sofmap, Dragon Star, Super Potato, and Karaoke Rainbow, among the many others we've collaborated with.
 Go shopping by yourself or go on dates with the maids and enjoy life in otaku heaven. But don't stay out too late; you still have a cafe to run!


 ■Collectable Capsule Toys
 In this game, you can try to collect your favorite capsule toy series and experience that unique gacha thrill of not knowing what you're getting. Keep cranking those machines until you've collected them all!

 Other than capsule toys, there's more merch for you to collect, like video games, books, and figures. You can also decorate your room and watch as your collections reach completion!
70010000111526.intro:
Fuwa Fuwa, a maid cafe on its last legs.
By a twist of fate, you've become the boss.
Now turn things around with four adorable maids!
70010000111526.name: Maid Cafe on Electric Street

70010000111527.description:
One day, an unexplained error occurs, and suddenly games all over the world become unplayable!
Three game-loving girls—Akari, Sumire, and Hikaru—are joined by a mysterious girl named Nayuta and Blackcat. Together, they set out to investigate the mysterious cause!
Through their game consoles, Akari and the others dive into the world of games to resolve the strange phenomena happening inside!

▼ Strategic Turn-Based Battles
Assemble characters called “Bullet” into your deck and defeat enemies.
Equip a “Cart” with unique effects to your Bullets to expand your deck-building options infinitely.

▼ Character Selection
As you progress through the story, you can play as the three protagonists: Akari, Hikaru, and Sumire.
Each character has unique traits, requiring different playstyles that match their personalities.

▼ Over 160 Unique Bullets
Collect more than 160 original Bullets, each featuring custom illustrations and voice acting.
Bullets can be obtained during missions, so keep challenging yourself to collect them all!

▼ Seven Distinctive Missions
Take on seven missions inspired by classic retro games, including romance games, rhythm games, and shooting games.
The route choices on each mission map play a key role in successfully completing the mission.
70010000111527.intro: A one-of-a-kind deck-building, turn-based roguelike strategy packed with adorable characters!
70010000111527.name: Super Bullet Break

70010000111540.description:
hololive members transform into adorable treasures!
Stack the 3D hololive members without letting them overflow to create your very own mountain in this must-play 3D puzzle game for hololive fans!


How to Play
Just toss the treasures and stack them on the island!
Combine identical treasures to transform them into larger ones!
The game ends when a treasure falls off the island!

Create bigger treasures and make consecutive combinations to boost your score through chain reactions!
And when you create the largest treasure, something amazing happens…!?


Treasure Exchange
The treasures that appear in the game can be swapped with other members!
Customize to your liking and create your own unique mountain of favorite members!


Rankings
Compete with players from around the world and test your skills.
Aim for the high score and keep challenging yourself!


New Features for the Nintendo Switch™ Version
This version includes all three DLC packs previously released for the PC version!
By completing newly added in-game missions, you can unlock a total of four commentators and music tracks by talents!

Additionally, a new BGM customization feature has been added!
Combine your favorite BGM with your favorite commentator to create your very own Treasure Mountain and enjoy the game even more!
70010000111540.intro: Stack the Love of Captain Marine!
70010000111540.name: hololive Treasure Mountain MegaPack

70010000111541.description:
Step into a world where love, temptation, and fate collide.

A mysterious demon appears before you with a chilling challenge:
win the heart of your university professor… or be dragged into the depths of hell.

As your conversations grow more intimate, every word pulls you closer to him... and to the darkness that follows.

Will you surrender to the demon’s wicked game, or defy him and carve your own destiny?

Your choices matter... and every ending reveals a different truth about desire, freedom, and the price of love.


Features:

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Every path leads to a different fate...  and a different version of you.

● CHOICE & CONSEQUENCE: What you say changes everything, even who survives.

● SUPERNATURAL ROMANCE: A forbidden love story twisted by temptation, mystery, and male desire.

● ATMOSPHERIC EXPERIENCE: Beautiful art and haunting music that pull you deeper into the dark.


It’s seductive.
It’s dangerous.
It’s your soul on the line.

Are you ready to play his game?
70010000111541.intro:
What if the price of love… was your soul?
Make your choice… before it’s made for you.
70010000111541.name: Anime School Love: His Teacher Secret Lesson

70010000111557.description:
A thousand years ago, the divine created the world and six eggs. The beings born from them, called Spirit Beasts, were entrusted with prosperity but eventually rebelled. Enraged, the divine sealed them away and vanished, leaving behind humanity, the Divine Sword, and the Seed of Hope. Now, fate stirs once more as a new hero rises...

Experience a nostalgic pixel-art RPG packed with classic turn-based battles, a board game-style growth system, and a wide range of customizable jobs. Collect items, unlock powerful Wonder Skills, and raise a Spirit Beast companion that evolves with the story. Spin the roulette, grow stronger, and uncover the truth behind the sealed legends!
70010000111557.intro: Master the board game with Spirit Beasts in a pixel-art fantasy RPG!
70010000111557.name: Dragon Spira

70010000111558.description:
You are the president of a railroad company.
Lay tracks, run trains, and experience building your very own city!

The theme of this work is “tourism.”
Develop tourist routes from distant cities and aim to create a bustling tourist city filled with people."
Providing realistic business management simulations of financing, investing, and more, as well as a wide variety of customizable options for all your vehicles, A-Train: All Aboard Tourism is packed full of features for you to explore.
"But don't be overwhelmed—players old and new alike will be able to jump right into the series thanks to the fun and practical tutorials provided in the early stages.
So why not hop aboard the A-Train with your trusted team of advisors, and start crafting a bright future for your town?

【A Story to Save a Troubled Town】
Featuring 11 scenarios set in towns burdened by various circumstances—like “a town saddled with massive debt after opening a bullet train line” or “a town run by a railway company owning a perpetually loss-making baseball team”!
Every town holds hidden charm, especially tourist destinations lacking developed transportation networks, offering ample room for growth. It's where the president's skills truly shine—deciding which tracks to lay and what kind of towns to build.

【Aim to Become an A-Train Creator】
Featuring a “Construction” mode where you can freely shape terrain and place buildings without worrying about funds. Create anything from your ideal tourist attraction to real-world cities within the world of ‘A-Train’.
Vehicle plans in the scenario can be shared online! Of course, you can also download and play those created by other players.
Enjoy planning your trip with the same accessibility for everyone and the same boundless depth.

※This product is a bundle containing the main game “A-Train: All Aboard! Tourism” and the additional content “Nintendo Switch 2 Edition upgrade pack.” If you already own “A-Train: All Aboard! Tourism,” please purchase only the additional content.
70010000111558.intro: A bustling city plan just for you
70010000111558.name: A-Train: All Aboard! Tourism Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000111559.description:
Let's make pizza on the Nintendo Switch™!
Make lots of slices and fill orders one after another!
Keep your slice stock full and serve orders, but don't let anything burn!

Share Joy-Con™, and up to 4 players can join in the fun!
Bake masterfully and aim for the ultimate high score!

《Rules》
Make pizzas to order and serve them to your customers!
To earn the most points, prepare perfect pizzas and don't let them burn!
Bake as many pizzas as you can within the time limit!

《How to Play》
1. Place pizza dough on the counter!
2. Roll out the dough and add toppings!
3. Bake the pizza in the oven!
4. When the pizza is done, cut it and stock the slices!
5. Pick 4 slices to box, then serve them to the customer!

[Score Attack]
Earn a high spot on the global leaderboards!
Make pizzas quickly and accurately, fulfill more and more orders, and aim for a new record!

[Battle]
Compete with up to 4 players!
Be faster and more precise than your opponents to win!
70010000111559.intro:
Roll the dough and add toppings to order!
Serve your customers delicious, fresh-baked pizza!
70010000111559.name: Bake it! Pizza Master

70010000111566.description:
Embark on the craziest journey of your life in It Takes Two, a genre-bending platform adventure created purely for co-op. Invite a friend to join for free with Friend’s Pass* and work together across a huge variety of gleefully disruptive gameplay challenges.

Master unique and connected character abilities in every new level. Help each other through unexpected obstacles and laugh-out-loud moments. Embrace the heartfelt story of a fractured relationship.

It Takes Two is developed by Hazelight, the industry-leader of cooperative play.

KEY FEATURES:
PURE CO-OP PERFECTION – Invite a friend to join for free with Friend’s Pass

GLEEFULLY DISRUPTIVE GAMEPLAY – From rampaging vacuum cleaners to suave love gurus – with It Takes Two, you never know what you’re up against next.

A UNIVERSAL TALE OF RELATIONSHIPS – Discover a touching and heartfelt story you’ll treasure – together!
70010000111566.name: It Takes Two

70010000111569.description:
The BEYBLADE ACTION game that faithfully recreates the world of BEYBLADE X arrives with three powerful evolutions! Witness EVOBATTLE, EVOSTORY, and EVOCUSTOMIZE!

■ Evolution 1: EVOBATTLE
Your strategy changes dramatically depending on your Bey type. Attack Type specializes in offense, Stamina Type absorbs the opponent’s stamina, Defense Type activates shields for solid protection, and Balance Type boosts attack power through combos! Experience thrilling high-speed Battles that demand skill and precision! Challenge Bladers around the world in online matches!

■ Evolution 2: EVOSTORY
New allies await—compete, grow, and chase your dreams together in the ultimate BEY BATTLE ROYALE (BBR)!

■ Evolution 3: EVOCUSTOMIZE
Customization reaches new heights! Collect materials to coat your Beys in your favorite colors, enhance your favorite parts, and choose X Skills to create the perfect Beys for your Battle style!
70010000111569.intro: Experience the EVOLUTION of Xtreme Battle!
70010000111569.name: BEYBLADE X EVOBATTLE

70010000111570.description:
Take the reins of your own construction company and transform a small contracting gig into an industry-leading empire. In Construction Sim: City and Road Builder, every job is a stepping stone — from hauling materials and clearing sites to assembling massive bridges, paving roads, and even installing wind turbines.

Master the art of construction with a deep set of mechanics:
- Dynamic Contract System – Tackle jobs of varying complexity, from simple one-star deliveries to multi-stage mega projects.
- Company Progression – Upgrade your business to unlock advanced contracts, features, and bigger challenges.
- Specialized Machinery – Purchase, maintain, and operate a full fleet of equipment, from excavators and cranes to dump trucks and compactors.
- Realistic Operations – Experience authentic physics for loading, leveling, compacting, and transporting.
- Equipment Management – Match the right machines to each job, and keep them in shape with a detailed repair system.

With clean, realistic visuals and an atmosphere that captures the everyday grind of the construction world, Construction Sim: City and Road Builder delivers the satisfying journey from rookie contractor to industry titan.
70010000111570.intro: Master machines and build a thriving construction empire.
70010000111570.name: Construction Sim: City and Road Builder

70010000111590.description:
After a record-breaking nap spanning several millennia, Kent finds himself in the year 10,000 with nothing but a stick and a dry sense of humor. Tired, hungry, and still employed, he will need to explore the unknown to craft the machines that will turn his broken space module into a self-sufficient base of operations. Prepare to craft to survive and automate to thrive.

EXPLORE, SCAN, CATALOGUE
Discover the wonders and the oddities of a vast, ever-changing world filled to the brim with fascinating flora, fauna, and climate events. Classify every animal, plant, and mineral in order to help you survive the passing seasons. Knowledge is your greatest weapon. But don’t try to use knowledge against certain animals, you WILL get eaten.

CRAFT IT TO THE LIMIT
Use every material at your disposal to build your base. Start small by turning bone and wood into coal, machine scraps into sheets of metal, and slowly but surely grow your base into a full-blown resource-generating machine that can rival any factory in the world.

SURVIVE... OR NOT! YOU'LL BE CLONED ANYWAYS
Even though Kent will be revived endlessly, that doesn’t change the fact that dying is a major drag. To not bite the dust constantly, you’ll need to gather and hunt for food, find new recipes, and polish your cooking skills. Building your own farms and vivariums is your ticket to a steady source of nourishment.

BUILD THE HOMEBASE OF YOUR DREAMS
Expand your home base and create an automated system to allow you to streamline and optimize your productions while you are off exploring.

TRAVERSE EXOTIC LOCALES IN STYLE
From vibrant jungles to desolate ruins, traverse post-apocalyptic Earth with your hoverboard, hang glider, grappling hook and more. It is up to you to maneuver with equal parts adventure and efficiency.
70010000111590.intro: Kickstart Humanity after a 7,000 year Slumber
70010000111590.name: Kentum

70010000111602.description:
In Delivery of Us, you guide a clever carrier pigeon on a mission to deliver every letter across the city’s rooftops. Plan each route carefully, because every move counts. Once the counter hits zero, the delivery fails.

This relaxing logic and movement-based puzzle game combines smooth mechanics, strategic planning, and calm visuals. Each level challenges you to find the most efficient path to every mailbox while avoiding walls, hazards, and obstacles along the way.

Discover different rooftop settings, from cozy neighborhoods to corporate towers, and enjoy the peaceful yet clever atmosphere as you test your reasoning skills.

Features

Solve handcrafted puzzles with limited moves

Plan precise routes across creative rooftop layouts

Deliver every letter before time runs out

Enjoy a relaxing experience with charming visuals and intuitive controls

For players who love clever puzzles, logical challenges, and the simple joy of delivering smiles one letter at a time
70010000111602.intro: Take flight into a charming puzzle adventure!
70010000111602.name: Delivery of Us

70010000111603.description:
"Jump into the New Year" is a jump action game where you stay airborne by stepping on objects within the stage to welcome the New Year!
Land before the year ends, and you'll be swallowed into another world—so be careful!
Keep flying for about 3 seconds (or even over 30 seconds in some cases) and aim for a “Nice~” New Year!

■Story
The protagonist, “Botti” is asked by a mysterious being called “Kamisama” in a dream to save the world.
Apparently, people have been oversleeping New Year's Eve lately and getting swallowed into another world...
Join Botti to defeat the root cause of this otherworldly trouble, the “Last Boss” and save the world!

■Stages
Towns, ruins, underwater, even space!?
Step on various objects in all sorts of locations and let's ring in the New Year!
Boss battle stages against the “Last Boss” and its minions, plus extra-challenging Hard Stages await!

■Replay Value
Earn scores based on objects stepped on or jumps performed.
Accumulate scores to unlock mini-games!
Plus, an encyclopedia recording stepped objects and 100 achievements to collect.
Play through every corner of the “Jump into the New Year” world!
70010000111603.intro:
Jump into the New Year!
But if you don't keep jumping for three seconds straight, you'll get swallowed up by another world!?
70010000111603.name: Jump into the New Year

70010000111633.description:
Enjoy your stay in the worst place on Earth.

I Hate This Place is an isometric craft-based survival horror game set in a cursed land filled with reality-bending nightmares and terrifying creatures that thrive in the dark. You’ll need to scavenge, build, sneak, and fight if you want to make it out alive.

Classic Craft-Based Survival Horror

Scavenge every corner of Rutherford Ranch to stay alive. From haunted forests, a derelict town, to infested bunkers. Explore a world teeming with danger as you gather vital resources, craft essential gear, upgrade your campsite, and rebuild outposts to have somewhere to hide.

Day Prepares You. Night Hunts You

A dynamic day-night cycle that changes the world. Use daylight wisely to explore, scavenge supplies, craft what you need, and prepare for what’s coming. When night falls, the real nightmares come out to play. More enemies appear, stronger and more aggressive than before. The landscape becomes harder to navigate with just your flashlight. Sometimes your best hope is to find shelter and hunker down till morning.

Deadly Silence Goes A Long Way

Stealth and combat go hand-in-hand here as many of the twisted creatures in Rutherford Ranch hunt and stalk you by sound alone. Brute force will often just land you in an early grave. Use sound to your advantage, luring creatures away from your path or cleverly leading them straight into deadly traps you laid.

80’s Vibes Meets Comic Book Flair

Inspired by the award-nominated comic book series created by Kyle Starks and Artyom Topilin, I Hate This Place comes to life with bold colors, a punchy retro comic book style, and a heavy dose of '80s flair. A unique blend of horror, dark humor, and just the right touch of camp and gore where unsettling dread meets stylized charm.
70010000111633.intro: Isometric craft-based survival horror with 80’s vibes and comic book flair
70010000111633.name: I Hate This Place

70010000111641.description:
Easy Delivery Co. is a relaxing driving game, with definitely no secrets. You’ve been hired as a delivery driver in a once-lively scenic mountain town now plagued with inhospitable weather. Make deliveries and uncover the story of the town’s not-at-all mysterious residents, all while earning well below minimum wage.

Features:
Earn a "living" by delivering packages with your kei truck

Take in the atmospheric scenery or blitz through (road safety not required)

Buy drastically overpriced gas and get to know the locals

Simple controls and retro graphics

Listen to cool beats while driving

Nothing strange going on, no lore, nothing at all, we promise
70010000111641.intro: Earn a "living" by delivering packages with your kei truck.
70010000111641.name: Easy Delivery Co.

70010000111642.description:
Heavy Duty isn’t just about driving. It’s about controlling the toughest machines on Earth and leading a crew through high-stakes missions. Pick your cargo carefully, balance every load, and be ready to drop, crack, break, and try again until the job gets done.

From rocky mountain roads to stormy seas and towering construction sites, each challenge will test your driving skills and your ability to move your team forward. Will you be the one to deliver the cargo, and smash through any obstacle in your way?

Features:
• Master bulldozers, cranes, trucks, ships, and more. Each machine operates differently and gives you new ways to dominate the job.
• Transport heavy loads across dangerous terrain. Mud, water, storms, and heights push your vehicles to the limit.
• Progress through a wide range of levels that grow tougher and more complex as you advance.
• Enjoy cozy yet challenging environments designed for long, satisfying play sessions.

Prepare for action, engage the engines, and prove you’re ready to lead the ultimate heavy-duty crew.
70010000111642.intro: Master the Machines. Get the Job Done.
70010000111642.name: Heavy Duty

70010000111654.description:
Your veterinary adventure begins at the wildlife park! Help injured and sick animals such as horses, deer, ducks, donkeys, goats, rabbits, and many more.

With a great deal of empathy, you examine symptoms, make diagnoses, and treat over 30 different diseases. Each animal has individual needs and is waiting for your expert help.

Use modern instruments, accompany your patients' recovery step by step, and experience a varied everyday life in the animal park.

Intuitive controls, realistic treatments, and lovingly animated animals make this game a highlight for young animal lovers.

Sophia's Animal Clinic - Mission Wildlife Park combines fun gameplay with educational insights into the world of veterinary medicine - a real experience for anyone who loves animals!

• Explore the extensive wildlife park and find injured or sick animals.
• Use veterinary tools for diagnosis and treatment.
• Earn the trust of the animals – with patience, empathy, and care.
• 10 different animal species, including ibex, wild boar, fox, deer, and many more.
• Learn exciting facts about the animal species.
• Learn about 30 diseases and different treatments.
70010000111654.intro: Sophia's Animal Clinic - where love for animals becomes an adventure!
70010000111654.name: Sophia's Animal Clinic - Mission Wildlife Park

70010000111678.description:
Build and manage your own supermarket and gas station. Stock shelves, refill fuel pumps, serve customers, and grow your business into a thriving roadside destination.

Upgrade your store, unlock new products, hire employees, and improve your services to increase profits. Can you create the ultimate supermarket and gas station empire?

Features:
Manage a supermarket and gas station
Restock products and refill fuel pumps
Upgrade and expand your business
Hire staff and improve efficiency
Unlock new products and equipment
Build your business empire
70010000111678.intro:
Stock shelves. Fuel cars.
Serve customers and earn profits.
Become the ultimate business owner!
70010000111678.name: Supermarket Gas Station Simulator

70010000111684.description:
Enter the world of ULTIMATE BATTLE KINGDOM, a fast-paced 3D action battler where warriors clash for glory, power, and control of the realm. Step into epic arenas filled with danger, strategy, and nonstop combat as you fight to prove yourself as the true ruler of the kingdom.

Choose your champion, master powerful attacks, and outplay your enemies using skill, timing, and smart positioning. Every battle is a test of reflexes and tactics, whether you're facing fierce AI opponents or challenging friends in local multiplayer showdowns.

Unlock new fighters, upgrade abilities, and explore dynamic battlefields inspired by medieval fantasy worlds. From towering castles to open battlegrounds, each arena offers unique paths, hazards, and opportunities for victory.

Only the strongest will rise. Only one will rule.
70010000111684.intro:
Forge Your Legend
Conquer the Arena
Rule the Kingdom
70010000111684.name: ULTIMATE BATTLE KINGDOM

70010000111690.description:
AU REVOIR - 2071

In a future where immortality is a privilege of the wealthy, Au Revoir Ltd. dominates the market with synthetic brains capable of storing human consciousness. Sentinels are tasked with locating these minds and carrying out the recovery and transfer process into new bodies.

Explore interactive environments, collect documents and clues, solve unique puzzles, and make decisions that influence the course of the story. Use your car to navigate different areas and interact with characters who hide more than they reveal.

ENGAGING NARRATIVE

Experience a rich and complex story where the narrative unfolds with depth, filled with twists and moral dilemmas that challenge your view of the world and of the protagonist.

IMMERSIVE SETTING

Explore a carefully crafted futuristic world with detailed environments and striking visual design. The neon-noir atmosphere blends vibrant colors with a dense mood, creating a deeply immersive cyberpunk setting.

DEEP CHARACTERS

Interact with a variety of characters, each with their own personality, motivations, and hidden secrets. Conversations reveal crucial details and open up different paths, adding weight to every encounter and multiple ways to interpret what’s truly happening.

INVESTIGATIVE CHALLENGES

Face puzzles that require logic, observation, and attention to detail. Gather clues, connect information, and solve narrative-driven challenges. Each solved mystery brings you closer to the truth — or to new questions to uncover.

Prepare for an unforgettable journey in Au Revoir, where every decision can alter the fate of the world.
70010000111690.intro: The year is 2071. As Tristan, you have to uncover secrets and solve puzzles to recover human consciousnesses in this neon-noir world with a low poly aesthetic inspired by the 90s.
70010000111690.name: Au Revoir

70010000111720.description:
Handed the keys to a rundown ranch, it’s up to you to restore your family’s legacy and become an equestrian legend! With the help of a host of colorful characters, you’ll raise charming foals, manage your dream stable of horses, and bring the ranch back to its former glory.

Ride your way — take the reins to feel the thrill and thunder on the racecourse, hone your jumping skills on the Cross Country course, explore the ranch with your horses, and so much more.

RACE AND RIDE TO VICTORY
• Feel all the excitement of the racecourse with realistic, motion-captured animations and dynamic race commentary.
• Race in story mode or online multiplayer in locations inspired by famous race tracks from around the globe.
• Put your jumping skills to the test in Cross Country.

ENJOY THE EQUESTRIAN LIFESTYLE
• Relax and explore gorgeous open locations with your horses, from the ranch to the scenic Swiss Alps.
• Capture stunning images of your horses with the feature-packed Photo Mode.
• Earn and manage resources to upgrade your homestead.

BREED YOUR DREAM HORSES
• Breed adorable foals with unique coats and patterns.
• Craft a legendary lineage with the in-depth genetic breeding system.
• Design your perfect horse with the Horse Creator.
70010000111720.intro: Take the reins and become an equestrian legend!
70010000111720.name: Rival Stars Horse Racing

70010000111741.description:
The exciting battle to stay up late returns!
Enjoy the simple yet satisfying thrills of pulling an all-nighter!
With a Joy-Con™ controller for each player, up to six players can join in the fun!
Time your moves carefully and rack up points without getting caught!

[Time Attack]
Compete for the fastest clear time and earn a top spot on the leaderboards!
Read the movements of the patrolling characters and find the right time to play!

[Battle]
Compete against friends or CPU-controlled opponents for the highest score!
Be bold and take risks to rack up the most points and win the game!
70010000111741.intro:
It's time for another sneaky all-nighter!
Play to your heart's content in all-new situations—just don't get caught!
70010000111741.name: Sneaky All-Nighter 2

70010000111767.description:
Pursuit puts you behind the wheel in a fast-paced, driving adventure where escape is the goal.
Every delivery is a race against time, the police, and the city itself — a city that never forgives mistakes. With no room for error, you must rely on skill, quick reflexes, and sharp instincts to stay ahead of those chasing you.
Each pursuit becomes more intense, pushing your driving to the limit. You’ll weave through tight corners, accelerate through narrow paths, and outmaneuver unpredictable obstacles that test your focus and timing. Every second counts as you're constantly challenged to make split-second decisions that determine whether you break free or get caught.
Whether it's threading through chaos or mastering high-speed turns, your ability to stay cool under pressure is the key.
Pursuit offers a relentless drive toward freedom—where every chase tells a story, and every escape is earned.
70010000111767.intro: No brakes. No mercy. Just escape.
70010000111767.name: Pursuit

70010000111768.description:
*This is the Nintendo Switch™ version.
There is also a Nintendo Switch™ 2 version of this game. Please select the version you require carefully.

"There's more to the world than this island... And we're going to prove it!"

Set sail on an adventure spanning past and present in DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined!

As a bright-eyed young fisherman's son, you've lived your entire life on the peaceful island of Estard. Your journey begins with a simple question: is there more to the world than this small island kingdom?

On a quest for answers, you and your childhood friends discover the Shrine of Mysteries and are swept back in time. There, you uncover the shocking truth that entire lands have been sealed away by a malevolent force.

The fate of the world now rests in your hands.

DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined brings a timeless classic to life in a whole new way with charming diorama visuals, updated gameplay mechanics, and a streamlined story,.

For seasoned adventurers, rediscover a tale of plucky companions that is brimming with joy and heartbreak. For fledgling heroes new to the series, this is a great place to begin your DRAGON QUEST journey.

■A Diorama Brought to Life
DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined blends a beautiful diorama art style with Akira Toriyama's iconic character designs to make every encounter feel vibrant, heartfelt, and full of adventure. From lush forests and bustling towns to ancient ruins and whimsical monsters, every environment is bursting with color and personality.

■Travel through History to Restore the Present
Scattered stone fragments unlock portals to long-lost eras with their own challenges to solve. Restore the islands, solve mysteries, and make allies in the past to breathe life back into the present.

■A Beloved Tale with a Streamlined Narrative
DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined is told through a series of vignettes with an overarching narrative. The main story has also been streamlined to make the journey more accessible to all players.

■Classic Combat, Improved!
The battle system in DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined has undergone significant changes. Turn the tides of battle with new vocational perks. Each vocation has its own unique ability, from all-out attacks to those that support your allies. Battle speed adjustments and an auto-battle feature are also available. Battles can progress without interruptions between each turn, depending on the tactics selected for the protagonist and allies. While on the field, players can pre-emptively strike monsters and instantly defeat them If the monster is weaker than the party.

■Moonlight and Level Up Two Vocations at the Same Time!
Customize your playstyle with the new Moonlighting mechanic. Having two vocations assigned at once provides access to the skills, magic spells, and unique perks from both.
70010000111768.intro: Unravel the mysteries of the past in DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined
70010000111768.name: DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined

70010000111774.description: Relax while assembling beautiful pictures. The images of the heroines, classes, and races are inspired by a popular RPG.
70010000111774.intro: In our game, you will find very simple puzzles and pleasant music!
70010000111774.name: Anime: Fantasy Uni

70010000111775.description:
The multi-million selling Burnout™ franchise races onto Nintendo Switch for the first time ever.

Make action your middle name as you rule the open streets of Paradise City, in Burnout™ Paradise Remastered.  Test the limits of skill and endurance as you push the boundaries of speed itself.  Hurtle through hectic downtown avenues to wild mountain roads.  Smash through traffic, wreck your opponents, and use the open city to find shortcuts.  Leave your friends in the dust and define your route to victory – or crash out in spectacular and devastating effect.
