Packed with 8 pieces of extra content, with 130+ vehicles, new areas to explore such as Big Surf Island, and hundreds of online challenges, embrace high-octane stunts and wanton destruction in one of the greatest arcade racers.  Fully optimized for the Nintendo Switch in 60 FPS, including pinch-and-pull map control for ease of navigation.  Burnout Paradise Remastered is the ultimate driving playground to play with friends or on-the-go.

KEY FEATURES
- THE ULTIMATE DRIVING PLAYGROUND
Throw out that driver’s handbook and blaze your own path to victory, leaving a trail of speed and destruction across the streets.  Send your car launching, spinning, and smashing through traffic.  Leave a very expensive trail of wreckage in your rearview.  Race hard and crash harder, wrecking your friends online, or joining forces in hundreds of online challenges

- THE DEFINITIVE BURNOUT PARADISE EXPERIENCE
Burnout Paradise Remastered delivers the complete original game and 8 main DLC packs, including Big Surf Island, Burnout Bikes, and the Cops and Robbers pack.  With new locations, challenges, and 130+ vehicles to explore, from hot rods to vintage classics – ready to race and ready to wreck!

- FULL-THROTTLE GRAPHICS
Experience high-octane races and cinematic crashes in glorious 60 FPS.  Fully optimized for the Nintendo Switch, Burnout Paradise Remastered delivers high resolution textures and a range of technical enhancements for greater visual fidelity and ease-of-play, including pinch-and-pull map control
70010000111775.name: Burnout™ Paradise Remastered

70010000111783.description:
high-speed races, solo or with friends!
Share the excitement with friends and family playing split-screen multiplayer.
Hop in a formula car and race on unique tracks from around the world. With its multiple difficulty settings and accessibility options such as assist mode and gyroscopic controls, 4PGP can be enjoyed by everyone from beginners to experts.

From beginners to experts, fun for everyone!
・Singleplayer: Championship, Quick Race, and Time Attack
・Split-screen multiplayer with up to four players
・19 unique cars based on real formula cars
・14 different circuits from around the world that can also be played in reverse.
・Four difficulty levels: ROOKIE, NOVICE, VETERAN, and EXPERT
・Gyroscopic controls and Assist mode for beginners
・Learn how to play with an extensive tutorial mode!
・60FPS in TV, Handheld, and Tabletop Mode
70010000111783.intro: Arcade fun, anywhere and with anyone!
70010000111783.name: 4PGP

70010000111802.description:
Players will dodge and weave through intense bullet patterns, unleashing a barrage of firepower upon hordes of unique and challenging enemies.

Choose your hero - from the teleporting trickster to the laser-wielding warrior! Each character boasts a distinct playstyle with unique shots and melee attacks.

Brace yourself for epic encounters with mid and end-stage bosses, each demanding a different strategy to defeat.

Upgrade your arsenal and gain valuable tips between levels at each of the world’s in-game shops.

Finish every stage and discover a treasure trove of hidden secrets.
70010000111802.intro: Blast your way through a cosmic gauntlet of epic boss battles, addictive scoring, and hidden secrets in a thrilling arcade-style adventure through fantasy, sci-fi, and alien-themed worlds.
70010000111802.name: ZPF

70010000111830.description:
Finally, when you are top artist, play at a largest music festival in your country. Create your own live music using musical instruments, hire other musicians to make a band. Become a worldwide known musician.

Game Features:
11 musical instruments to play on, on some you play music note by note, sound by sound, by clicking on string of guitar/piano key/ bashing drum sticks on drums or your hands on jambe, Musical Instruments have both prerecorded ready 5-10 chords of songs for you to play that you trigger by moving hand or clicking on piano keys or classic mode note by note where you play on instrument by clicking on string/piano key note by note triggering abcdefg major/minor and make your own song.
Guitar, Thrombone, Piano, Jambe, Violin, Harphe, Ukulele, Chimes, Drums, DJ Set
Each event lasts 5 minutes and then you come back to city map
You make your own live music playing on musical instruments using drum sticks, hand etc. note by note, sound by sound.
10 different locations unlocked based on followers: Rave Party, Luna Club, JazzManClub, ExtraPub, Press, Hiring Agency for musicians, Concert Hall, Street Singing, Music Publisher
Create your own band by hiring other musicians
Gain followers to unlock other locations, events, musicians
Followers gain is calculated based on audience fun during event
When you gain enough followers you become a worldwide-known musician, and you will see what happens then
Meet with publisher and get to top of band charts on contest with other bands
See progress of local music industry, with you in it in local press release
70010000111830.intro: Make your career as a musician. Start as a street singer, become a Dj in a local pub in your town, and when you gather enough followers organize concert at a local hall.
70010000111830.name: Musician Simulator

70010000111845.description:
Find Difference is a fun and relaxing puzzle game where every scene hides carefully crafted changes. Look closely, think fast and discover every difference before time runs out!

Features:
• Enjoy dozens of beautifully illustrated levels
• Spot the differences between two pictures
• Relax with simple and intuitive controls
• Unlock new scenes as you progress
• Suitable for all ages — perfect for quick play sessions

Challenge your eyes sharpen your focus and see how many differences you can find!

Are you ready to spot them all?
70010000111845.intro:
Two pictures
One challenge
Can you find it?
70010000111845.name: Find Difference

70010000111851.description:
Stunt Car Extreme Simulator throws you behind the wheel of powerful vehicles and challenges you to conquer extreme tracks filled with steep climbs, dangerous drops, and tricky obstacles. Test your driving skills with realistic physics as you balance your car, control your speed, and perform daring stunts to reach the finish line.

Race against the clock to earn stars and rewards, then use them to unlock and upgrade a variety of vehicles — from rugged off-road trucks to high-performance stunt cars. Each level offers unique environments and increasingly difficult challenges that keep the gameplay fresh and exciting.

Choose your preferred control style and master every turn, jump, and climb as you push your limits across wild landscapes and adrenaline-packed courses.

Stunt Car Extreme Simulator is the perfect game for players who love thrilling races, extreme stunts, and the freedom to drive their own way.
70010000111851.intro:
Drive the Limits
Defy Gravity
Conquer Every Track
70010000111851.name: Stunt Car Extreme Simulator

70010000111863.description:
Explore detailed scenes and test your observation skills in this relaxing hidden object adventure.
Search every corner, zoom in to spot tiny clues, and discover cleverly hidden items across colorful environments. From cozy interiors to lively outdoor locations, each level offers a new scavenger hunt challenge.
Perfect for fans of puzzle games and brain teasers, this search-and-find experience starts easy and becomes more challenging as you progress.

• Beautiful, detailed scenes
• Smooth and intuitive controls
• Increasing difficulty
• Fun for all ages

Sharpen your focus. Train your brain.
Can you find them all?
70010000111863.intro:
Search. Spot. Discover.
Explore beautiful scenes and find hidden objects.
Train your brain and master every scavenger hunt.
70010000111863.name: SCAVENGER HUNT Find Hidden Objects

70010000111869.description:
A hardcore tactical extraction shooter where survival is everything.

Enter a dangerous warzone inspired by intense extraction-based FPS gameplay. In Escape From DUCKNESS, every raid is high risk and high reward. Fight armed enemies, secure valuable loot, and extract before you lose it all.

This is not an arcade shooter. This is tactical survival.

Plan your loadout carefully. Choose the right weapons, armor, and equipment for each mission. Every bullet matters. Every sound can reveal your position. Smart movement, positioning, and timing are the keys to survival.

Key Features

• Hardcore extraction shooter gameplay
• Tactical FPS combat with realistic gunplay
• High-risk raids with permanent loot loss
• Weapon customization and strategic loadouts
• Intense PvE firefights
• Immersive survival mechanics
• Loot, extract, upgrade, repeat

Explore hostile maps filled with ambush points, hidden gear, and unpredictable threats. Engage in close-quarters battles or long-range tactical encounters. Adapt your strategy every raid.

If you die, you lose your gear.
If you extract, you grow stronger.

Designed for players who enjoy realistic shooters, survival combat, and high-tension gameplay, Escape From DUCKNESS delivers adrenaline-filled missions where every decision counts.

Gear up. Enter the raid. Secure the loot. Escape alive.
70010000111869.intro:
Strategic combat meets chaotic feathered warfare.
Build your loadout, adapt your tactics, dominate the raid.
Escape the DUCKNESS before it consumes you.
70010000111869.name: Escape From DUCKNESS

70010000111875.description:
Build your dream farm and manage your very own supermarket in Farming Supermarket Simulator — a relaxing and immersive experience where you control every step of the journey from soil to shelf.

Start by growing a variety of fresh crops on your farm. Plant seeds, water your fields, harvest produce, and expand your agricultural operations as you improve your efficiency and unlock new products. Careful planning and smart time management will help you create a steady flow of goods ready for sale.

Once harvested, transport your products to your supermarket and take full control of store operations. Stock shelves, organize displays, set prices, and keep customers happy with clean aisles and well-managed inventory. The better you run your store, the more customers you attract.

Balance farming and retail management as you reinvest profits into upgrading equipment, expanding farmland, and improving your supermarket layout. Optimize your workflow, reduce waste, and make strategic decisions to keep both your farm and store running smoothly.

With satisfying progression, accessible controls, and a calming gameplay loop, Farming Supermarket Simulator offers a complete farm-to-market simulation designed for players who enjoy management, organization, and steady growth.

Features:
• Grow and harvest a variety of crops
• Manage your own fully functional supermarket
• Stock shelves and organize product displays
• Set prices and monitor sales performance
• Upgrade your farm and store equipment
• Expand your land and retail space
• Relaxing gameplay with rewarding progression

Plant, harvest, stock, and sell — experience the full cycle of running a farming supermarket, all in one engaging simulator.
70010000111875.intro:
Grow it. Stock it. Sell it.
Experience the full journey from farm to supermarket.
A relaxing and realistic farming supermarket simulator.
70010000111875.name: Farming Supermarket Simulator

70010000111881.description:
Moto Racer Highway Traffic

Start your engine and hit the highway in Moto Racer Highway Traffic, a thrilling motorcycle racing experience where speed, precision, and reflexes are the key to victory.

Ride powerful motorbikes through busy highways packed with traffic. Dodge cars and trucks, perform daring overtakes, and push your bike to extreme speeds as you race through detailed environments. The faster and closer you pass other vehicles, the higher your score will climb.

Take on exciting missions, unlock new bikes, and upgrade your ride to become the ultimate highway racer. Each motorcycle has unique handling and performance, giving you new ways to master the road and improve your skills.

Experience the sensation of high-speed riding with immersive visuals, dynamic day and night environments, and smooth arcade-style controls that keep the action fast and fun. The game challenges players to weave through traffic and complete objectives while maintaining top speed on endless highways.

Whether you're chasing high scores, completing missions, or simply enjoying the thrill of riding through traffic, Moto Racer Highway Traffic delivers nonstop motorcycle racing excitement.

Features

High-speed motorcycle racing through busy highway traffic
Multiple motorbikes to unlock and upgrade
Challenging missions and progression system
Dynamic environments with different times of day
Fast arcade gameplay with smooth controls
Score bonuses for risky overtakes and high speeds

Jump on your bike, test your reflexes, and prove you have what it takes to dominate the highway.
70010000111881.intro:
Hit the highway and race through traffic.
Avoid vehicles and upgrade your motorcycles.
Test your reflexes and become the best highway rider.
70010000111881.name: Moto Racer Highway Traffic

70010000111884.description:
The black dragon [Guernian], who once faced down the gods, has fallen.
From the rift he fled before his death, an unholy energy has spread across the world, and life is undergoing a bizarre mutation. People call it Corruption and live their days in fear, but few know its trustworthy source and full extent.

You are an immortal warrior, a so-called Successor, chosen by the God of Light [Lu], the God of Fire [Ashuran], and the God of Water [Harnia]. Arriving in Cliffshire, a town of light, Successors must head to a burial ground where demons are said to be manifesting and follow clues to cleanse the distorted world.

Dragon is Dead delivers 2D platformer action requiring precise dodging and pattern-breaking. Each area is a vertically and horizontally intertwined, multi-layered structure that regenerates in a rogue-lite fashion with different terrain, monster placement, and loot composition on each run. When you die, you lose your gold and temporary buffs, but your gear and runes are permanently preserved and become the basis for the next cycle. Defeating bosses yields rune stones that can be used to craft or awaken legendary gear, and artifacts found during exploration can bring both powerful blessings and dangerous curses depending on the combination, providing new tactical tension each time.

Make your way to the Citadel – the closer you get, the more you’ll come face-to-face with a secret that has brought the world to its knees.

Features:

•	Tight, immersive platforming and combat
•	Stunning visuals to draw you into the world
•	Each run brings new challenges as you gain strength
•	Extensive customization and character options for exciting builds
•	Conquer the Corruption to unravel the story
70010000111884.intro: Amid spreading Corruption, the immortal Successor walks a fated path.
70010000111884.name: Dragon Is Dead

70010000111885.description:
The Mega Man Star Force series, which expanded into an anime, is back in the Mega Man Star Force Legacy Collection! This collection includes seven games and additional features like a gallery of illustrations and music! Online play is also supported!

The following titles are included in the collection:

Mega Man Star Force Pegasus
Mega Man Star Force Leo
Mega Man Star Force Dragon
Mega Man Star Force 2 Zerker x Ninja
Mega Man Star Force 2 Zerker x Saurian
Mega Man Star Force 3 Black Ace
Mega Man Star Force 3 Red Joker

It is the year 220X, and the world has seen rapid advancements in Wave technology. Our protagonist, 11-year-old Geo Stelar, refuses to go to school as he mourns the disappearance of his astronaut father.
One night, Geo is at the observatory gazing at stars as he usually does. Suddenly, his Transer picks up a signal from space and he is hit with a powerful electric shock!
When he finally comes to, an alien with an electromagnetic wave body called Omega-Xis is standing over him...

Note: The toy link features found in the original versions are not supported.
70010000111885.intro: The Star Force games make a stellar comeback in a new Legacy Collection!
70010000111885.name: Mega Man Star Force Legacy Collection

70010000111897.description:
Direction Quad is a 2D action-adventure presented in top-down pixel art style. Take the role of young Quad as he hops through the swamp in any diagonal direction, collecting coins and bugs along the way. The objective is to get Quad from his starting lily pad to the finish line of each stage without colliding with the terrain or any treacherous traps.

As you advance, the mazelike levels get more complex! Use bumpers to ricochet along the best lines, hit switches to open new paths and keep Quad from kicking the bucket! Replay stages as many times as it takes, but beware, there is greater danger lurking in the swamp than even the Wize Toad may realize!

• Master a gauntlet of unique stages.
• Take the role of a young frog and hop in top-down puzzle action.
• Avoid traps and enemies as you race for the finish line.
• Retry levels as many times as it takes.
• Enjoy retro pixel art aesthetics and old-school challenge.
70010000111897.intro: Hop your way through the dangerous swamps as you face the trials of your master the Wise Toad!
70010000111897.name: Direction Quad

70010000111903.description:
Are you ready for a brick breaker with a twist? In Hextreme Void, you can’t lose! Instead of lives or game overs, the challenge comes from progression and optimization in order to complete all levels within a certain time limit. Each playthrough takes you through one of five distinct Voids, with 50 levels per Void. Stages are presented in high-def 2D style with hexagonal bricks arranged in increasingly complex patterns. Your ball moves automatically, but it’s up to you to decide how released powerups are used.

As you advance, you’ll earn experience and choose between various buffs that can enhance ball stats, increase your time limit, multiply coin output and more! Every run feels unique thanks to random upgrade paths and temporary powerups that appear. During runs, collect coins to unlock permanent upgrades, letting you grow stronger and tackle harder Voids with new strategies the more you play!

• Battle across the Void by optimizing the movement of your automated ball!
• Choose from a huge variety of upgrades during gameplay to clear the field faster.
• Master 250 stages across 5 uniquely themed worlds!
• Collect coins to spend on permanent upgrades.
• Enjoy colorful HD presentation and practically limitless replay value!
70010000111903.intro: Strategically power up to clear the field as efficiently as possible in a brick breaker about quick thinking!
70010000111903.name: Hextreme Void

70010000111904.description:
As an adventurer party based in the capital city of Isigwere, take on a wide range of quests—from small requests by townsfolk, like dealing with goblins, to the queen’s grand command to defeat the dragon that awakened in the underground ruins. Can you stop the world’s destruction and rise as the legendary hero?

- A dungeon crawler RPG where you grow stronger while exploring 15 dungeons.
- Choose 4 members from 21 classes such as Fighter and Ranger to form your party.
- Accept quests, hunt for treasure, and power up through auto battles.
- Make use of new equipment and skills to gain the upper hand in battle.
- Take on increasingly powerful foes and bosses in replayable runs.
70010000111904.intro: Explore dungeons, grow stronger, and slay the dragon to become a hero!
70010000111904.name: Dragon Ruins II

70010000111908.description:
With a varied selection of full-body aerobic, anaerobic, and stretching exercises, this title lets players have fun with genuine workouts at home.

■ Genuine Exercise With Mickey
Players will receive support from Mickey as the instructor in this title, as well as from his assistant Hexie, a robot created to make exercise fun.
The controls are simple, with players holding the Joy-Con™ in both hands and moving in time with Mickey, making the exercises approachable for all audiences.
Exercises in this title break down into three types: Rhythmic, Power, and Relaxation. The selection lets players choose from a variety of options that suit their objectives and how they feel each day.

・Rhythmic Exercises
Aiming to improve overall endurance, there are aerobic exercises that incorporate rhythmic movements like dance or boxing. These exercises are fun and make you want to move instinctively, making them great for light workouts or stress relief.

・Power Exercises
These exercises focus on muscle training for specific parts of the body, forming a selection for building up muscle and basal metabolism through anaerobic workouts. There are five distinct movements for each body part to train, forming approachable workouts that include brief breaks. These are the perfect choices for those who want to work out in limited time periods.

・Relaxation Exercises
These yoga-style exercises relax and align the body while incorporating core workouts. These include flexibility stretches with slow full-body movement and balanced stretches where players hold static poses, making them ideal for post-workout cooldowns and a change of pace. These workouts are easy to incorporate into open time over the average day.

■ Two Modes: Daily and Free
In Daily mode, Hexie the assistant checks the player's condition using a selection process to suggest the ideal routine, combining aerobic, anaerobic, and relaxation exercises.
Free mode lets players select anything they want. This title also features programs that combine Rhythmic, Power, and Relaxation stages, making them flexible fits to player moods.

■ Supporting Players to Continue Exercising
This title will also include popular support functions from the Fitness Boxing series, such as the post-exercise stamp feature and a management system that keeps records of daily workouts.
You can check reports with estimated calories burned. There is also be a strong selection of collectibles, such as special medals earned from consecutive days of play and signed messages from Mickey.
This title will provide a fitness experience with a unique setting that makes exercise more fun the longer players continue.
70010000111908.intro: Start an all-in-one exercise routine with Mickey Mouse!
70010000111908.name: Disney Miraness Fitness

70010000111934.description:
Take the wheel and ride on this nostalgic rally trip out to the desert. Pick your driving crew and manage your vehicle and resources, as you encounter challenges on the road. No stress though, just keep your engine running and your eyes on the road.

• Manage crew and resources: From selecting your team members to managing your vehicle's resources – every decision impacts your journey. Carefully allocate your food, fuel, and spare parts to sustain your team and maintain your vehicle.

• Stuff happens on the road: Bad weather, wild animals, bandits. Event encounters can either propel you forward or set you back – choose your course of action wisely!

• A classic feel: Drive into the beautifully crafted, retro-inspired world. It’s a pixel-perfect combo of retro visuals and modern gameplay.

• Race and race again: With multiple strategies and pilot combos to explore, and the unpredictable nature of the event system – every run will be a unique adventure.

See ya at the races!
70010000111934.name: Desert Race Adventures

70010000111941.description:
Dinosaur Survival Simulator - Prehistoric RPG places you in the heart of an ancient world ruled by colossal beasts and the struggle to survive. Live the life of legendary dinosaurs—from swift predators to towering giants—on a journey of transformation, danger, and adaptation. Explore hostile habitats, face unpredictable challenges, and grow stronger to endure the unforgiving prehistoric era.

Key Features:
-Captivating evolutionary progression: Experience the life paths of multiple dinosaur species, each with unique behaviors and survival traits.
-Diverse and dangerous environments: Traverse contrasting regions—forests, dry plains, waterfalls, and volcanic zones—each with its own natural challenges.
-Growth and customization: Upgrade your dinosaur’s essential abilities and adapt to overcome the brutal wilderness.
-Varied challenges: Complete missions focused on hunting, survival, and territorial dominance, constantly testing your instincts.

Step into a world where nature makes the rules and only the adapted endure.
Prove you have what it takes to become the most feared dinosaur of the prehistoric age.
70010000111941.intro: Survive the dangers of the prehistoric era and rise through evolution.
70010000111941.name: Dinosaur Survival Simulator - Prehistoric RPG

70010000111970.description:
Move through 3D space to find hints, solve mysteries and escape from the room.
Anyone can play to the end because you can see hints and answers.
70010000111970.name: Escape game R00M02

70010000111976.description:
Welcome to the daily life of the most caring — yet incredibly busy — mom! In this game, you take on the role of a mother who tries to manage it all: caring for her family, keeping the house cozy, and still finding a little time for herself.

Each day is filled with countless tasks, but a mom’s life isn’t only about responsibilities — she can also dedicate time to her hobbies to relax and recharge. Everything depends on how well you plan your day and whether you can complete everything on time.

Features:
- Life as a mom: Step into the shoes of a woman who carries the responsibility of her home, her family, and even her pet. Every day brings new challenges and surprises.
- Two children with different needs: Look after your school-aged child, help him get ready for class, and take care of the baby to make sure he’s always happy and comfortable.
- Household chores: Cleaning, laundry, and cooking — familiar but essential tasks that require attention and speed. The faster you complete them, the more time you’ll have for other activities.
- Pet care: Your little dog needs affection, playtime, and care — otherwise, it will become sad and lonely.
- Time for yourself: Even with a packed schedule, mom can make time for her hobby — helping her rest and maintain a balance between family duties and personal life.
- Balance & time management: The main challenge is to stay on top of everything, managing your energy and time so no one in the family feels left behind.

Are you ready to take on the challenge and create the perfect daily balance?
70010000111976.intro: Conquer chaos, unlock upgrades, and rule the family empire.
70010000111976.name: Mom Life Simulator

70010000111982.description:
In Just a Little Purr_suit, guide a clever kitten in a turn-based strategy puzzle with 65 handcrafted levels. Use cards to decide every move: advance, launch the kitten with cannons, bounce on trampolines, cross mysterious portals, and even create new platforms to overcome challenges.

With no time limit, every move is a chance to find creative solutions. Explore environments full of tricks, use boosters and totems to your advantage, and discover the best path to the bird to finally scare it away.

A fun, colorful, and addictive adventure for the whole family!
70010000111982.intro: The birds won’t stop making noise… it’s time to scare them away!
70010000111982.name: Just a Little Purr Suit

70010000111995.description:
Retro Motel Simulator invites you on a nostalgic journey to the golden age of roadside America. Step into the sizzling 1960s and build your own dream motel — a place where pastel walls, chrome furniture, and glowing neon signs tell stories of freedom, style, and ambition.

Start small on a dusty desert highway and work your way up to a five-star retro paradise. Repaint faded walls, decorate rooms with authentic mid-century charm, and make every guest feel at home under the warm buzz of neon lights. From hands-on cleaning and maintenance to full creative control over décor and pricing, every decision shapes your success.

Wander freely in first-person through vintage halls, listen to the hum of jukebox tunes, and watch your guests unwind, dance, and live out their 60s dreams. Feel every brushstroke, sweep, and hammer strike through immersive controller feedback that brings your motel to life.

Key Features:
• Authentic 1960s Atmosphere: Experience the warmth, charm, and style of mid-century America with stunning period décor and lighting.
• Creative Freedom: Design and personalize every room — choose colors, furniture, and decorations to craft the perfect vintage vibe.
• Guest Management: Rent out rooms, set prices, and keep your guests satisfied to boost reputation and profits.
• Hands-On Gameplay: Clean, repair, and maintain your motel to keep ratings high and customers coming back.
• Dynamic Progression: Expand your property, unlock new design options, and turn your roadside stop into a legendary landmark.
• Live 60s Orchestra: Watch your guests dance the night away to live performances of classic tunes.
• Immersive Feedback: Feel every action — from sweeping floors to tuning lamps — with realistic vibration responses.

Welcome to the era where hospitality met style — your Retro Motel is open for business.
70010000111995.intro: Every room tells a story — craft your perfect retro vibe.
70010000111995.name: Retro Motel Simulator

70010000111998.description:
Presenting The Last Ninja Collection + Bonus Games (International Karate, IK+ and Bangkok Knights). Known for its innovative gameplay, memorable graphics, atmospheric music and blockbusting reviews, our Last Ninja series captivated gamers the world over and set a new standard for action-adventure games. This collection brings together the entire Last Ninja series of C64 versions along with Amiga and Spectrum versions, where available, for the first time. These games pushed the boundaries of what was possible with the technology of the time and now they are available to play on Nintendo Switch™.

The Last Ninja (C64)
Navigate through beautifully hand-crafted environments, solve puzzles and engage in combat with a variety of enemies. The Last Ninja was not only a global commercial success but also a critical one, earning numerous awards, including ‘Game of the Year,’ ‘Best 8-Bit Graphics,’ and ‘Best Music Soundtrack’. The series sold over 23 million copies, cementing its place as one of the most influential and best-selling titles of the 8-bit computer gaming era.

Last Ninja 2 (C64, Spectrum and Amiga)
A landmark title in action-adventure gaming, the Last Ninja 2 featured atmospheric, isometric environments. Its detailed graphics, immersive soundtracks, and challenging gameplay captivated both players and critics, earning multiple awards, including Game of the Year, as well as accolades for its outstanding graphics and sound. It became the most successful entry in the Last Ninja trilogy.

Last Ninja 3 (C64 and Amiga)
Holds a special place in retro video game history, not only for its innovative gameplay and stunning visuals of its time, but also for being the first computer game to receive a perfect 100% review score.

Ninja Remix (C64 and Amiga)
A special edition that enhances the original experience with new soundtracks, updated graphics and gameplay tweaks.

International Karate (Spectrum and C64)
This classic fighting game set the standard for martial arts games in the 1980s. It was also the first European-developed game to receive a CES Showcase Innovations Award at the 1986 Chicago event and won many other awards.

IK+ (C64, Spectrum and Amiga)
A multi-award-winning retro classic that built on the success of its predecessor, IK+ introduced improved graphics and gameplay, with AI that continues to impress even today. The game also featured an innovative and exciting three-player mode, which added a new dimension to the fighting genre. Widely regarded as the ultimate fighting game of the 1980s, IK+ has earned its place in gaming history as a timeless masterpiece that continues to be celebrated by retro gaming enthusiasts.

Bangkok Knights (C64 and Amiga)
A classic System 3 retro game celebrating the art of Muay Thai boxing. Bangkok Knights was the first fighting game to feature large, distinct different characters, and according to some interviews with Capcom’s developers, it inspired the very first Street Fighter game.

Introduction
The 1980s and '90s were a pioneering time for video games and System 3, set up in 1982 by Mark Cale. The original developers were pioneers, experimenting with new technologies and game-play mechanics that would lay the groundworks for today's video game industry.

The Importance of Video Game Preservation
We have always been dedicated to pushing the boundaries of video game development. However, as we look back on our journey, we recognize the critical importance of preserving these creations for future generations to maintain the cultural and historical significance of an entire medium. Developers, too, can benefit from looking back at older games to draw inspiration and understand the technological and creative processes that went into their creation.

System 3’s Legacy
System 3 is proud to have contributed some of the most iconic and influential games in the industry, particularly on the C64 and Amiga platforms.
70010000111998.intro: A tribute to the golden era of retro gaming: 7 cult titles (across 15 formats) united in one collection. Relive gaming history with C64, Amiga, and Spectrum versions lovingly preserved.
70010000111998.name: The Last Ninja Collection + Bonus Games

70010000112030.description:
There’s only one shape that’s perfect, eternal, and completely unbothered: the halo.

FEATURES
• Tackle 300+ handcrafted levels and 51 bonus challenges across 6 difficulties
• Immerse yourself in 90+ minutes of electronic and techno music
• Share controls with friends for co-op chaos
• Discover secret endings and hidden surprises
• Full touch screen support

MUSIC BY
• Damiano Baldoni
• Rik4k
• Zane Little
70010000112030.intro: Hypno Halo is a minimalist score attack game.
70010000112030.name: Hypno Halo

70010000112040.description:
Homicipher, the language-deciphering x exploration adventure game in which you try to escape by deciphering the words of horror men, is coming!

■Synopsis
The protagonist, having wandered into the Otherworld, must learn the words of the horror men who dwell there while searching for a way to escape...

■Nintendo Switch™ Version Features
◎New illustrations added!
Includes several newly-drawn event CG's by Yatsunagi.
◎Fully-Realized System
Optimized with intuitive controls for text input and point-and-click, ensuring a smooth and comfortable gameplay experience.
◎Supported Languages: Japanese, English, Traditional and Simplified Chinese
70010000112040.intro:
Decipher the words of the horror men and aim for escape
Decipher words ・Escape from horror ・ADV
70010000112040.name: Homicipher

70010000112041.description:
Astral Ascent is a 2D platformer rogue-lite game set in a modern fantasy world. As one of 4 Heroes with very different personalities, you must escape from the Garden, an astral prison guarded by 12 powerful and vicious bosses, the Zodiacs.

CREATE YOUR OWN PLAYSTYLE

Unlock dozens of unique spells for your 4 distinct characters. Optimize your own build or try out new ones to take down 12 powerful bosses. Get stronger with time to match up with your foes. Each run will test your skills and your reactivity.

TWELVE ALMIGHTY BOSSES TO FACE

The Zodiacs are 12 experienced guardians dispatched over 4 gorgeous worlds. They’ll bring to the battlefield unique attacks, abilities, and patterns, backstories to uncover, and reasons to be fighting you. Get yourself warned!

FOUR PLAYABLE CHARACTERS

Unique characters. Unique weapons. Unique ways to play.

Ayla: The sole survivor of her guild of assassins, she uses her twin daggers to eliminate her enemies before they can react. Her speed and proficiency are unmatched.

Kiran: This orphan learned life the hard way. He uses his strength to deliver attacks powerful enough to create shockwaves. Brutal.

Calie: This talented sculptor wants her freedom back. She will use her magical gemstones to pierce enemy defenses and shred them to bits. She is unforgiving.

Octave: Trained by a powerful witch, this young fighter summons ethereal guns to attack his foes. When needed, he can conjure bigger weapons as well. Lethal in all cases.

A STORY THAT OPENS UP, ONE PIECE AT A TIME

Astral Ascent is a rogue-lite infused with narration. Replayability is part of our story which will be unraveled piece by piece. As you get stronger, you will discover more about the characters, their motivations, and the secrets of the world they’re trapped in.

LOCAL CO-OP

The weight of destiny is too heavy to carry by yourself? Don’t worry and bring a friend to play in our two-player co-op mode. Fight and crush your enemies together in local co-op!

A VAST, COLORFUL FANTASY WORLD WAITING TO BE EXPLORED

Dash across gigantic landscapes. Explore original and hand-crafted areas. Discover the world created by our artists, with a gorgeous art and frame-by-frame animation.
70010000112041.intro: Choose one of four heroes and explore the Garden, an astral prison guarded by 12 powerful mystical bosses: the Zodiacs.
70010000112041.name: Astral Ascent

70010000112064.description:
Released on March 2, 1990 as the only official home-console game of its kind, this legendary title returns 35 years later—now launching worldwide simultaneously with all the excitement of its original debut.
This game is more than just a remake—it’s a fusion of nostalgia and newness. With multi-language localization, both long-time fans and new players can enjoy the experience without a language barrier.

Relive the excitement and emotional moments once more.

New Features
Multi-language support for fans worldwide:
Supported languages: Japanese, English, French (including the Nicky Larson version), German, Italian, Spanish, Korean, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese

Story
My name is Ryo Saeba, also known as City Hunter. In this line of work, I'm a well-known professional "sweeper."
I take on all kinds of jobs, from protecting beautiful women to assassinations. In other words, I'm a cleaner who gets rid of the scum of the city. That means I live a life constantly on the edge. My partner, Kaori, is the younger sister of my deceased best friend, but she never brings in any decent jobs.

So, what kind of work is waiting for me today?
70010000112064.intro: After 35 years, the only official game is now being revived.
70010000112064.name: City Hunter

70010000112075.description:
After a brutal wolf attack, the protagonist regains consciousness alone in a snow-covered mountain and forest wilderness. There is nothing around him but cold wind, deep snow, and signs of wild animals. Injured, exhausted, and almost without equipment, he must face a world where winter itself is the main enemy.
To survive, he must hunt, search for food, gather resources, and find shelter. Without fire, there is no warmth. Without proper clothing, the night cannot be endured. Every step through the snow drains precious strength.
At the same time, the search for a missing friend drives the story forward. While exploring the mountainous and forest landscape, players discover scattered notes that reveal clues and unlock new crafting recipes. These discoveries gradually expand survival possibilities and move the narrative ahead.
It is a journey through cold, isolation, and constant decision-making.

Key Features:
	•	Harsh Winter Survival — cold, hunger, and exhaustion directly affect the character’s condition.
	•	Hunting and Food Gathering — track and hunt animals to survive.
	•	Crafting System — create tools, weapons, clothing, campfires, and drying racks.
	•	Recipe Unlocking Through Notes — discover new crafting options by finding scattered notes.
	•	Story-Driven Progression — advance the narrative while surviving in the wilderness.
	•	Snowy Mountain and Forest World — inhabited by wolves, bears, rabbits, deer, and boars.
	•	Dynamic Weather — changing conditions enhance atmosphere and survival challenge.


Frost Survival – Winter is a steady struggle for survival in a cold and unforgiving environment. Every resource matters, every discovery strengthens you, and every step through the snow brings you closer to endurance — or failure.
70010000112075.intro: Every hunt, every build, and every step matters in the frozen wild.
70010000112075.name: Frost Survival - Winter

70010000112085.description:
You’ve just inherited a small supermarket and a modest amount of cash.
Now it’s up to you to turn it into a thriving business empire. Manage operations, expand strategically, and earn your first million — and make your family proud.

Features:
• Explore & Learn: Walk around your store, order new stock, organize shelves, set prices, and operate cashier machines and terminals to handle payments.
• Customer Satisfaction: Serve customers quickly to earn likes and boost your store’s reputation. Poor service leads to negative reviews and lower ratings.
• Expand Your Store: Purchase nearby spaces to grow your supermarket. Larger stores mean higher utility costs such as electricity, water, and waste disposal.
• Diversify Your Product Catalogue: Unlock new product categories, from dairy to household supplies, by acquiring licenses and attracting different types of shoppers.
• Smart Pricing Strategy: Optimize prices to maximize profits.
• Recycle for Rewards: Collect and recycle empty boxes to earn bonus cash — and help the planet.
• Global Competition: Climb the worldwide leaderboard and become the ultimate Supermart Tycoon.
• Stay Energized: Boost your energy each morning by eating well. Negative customer feedback affects your morale and energy levels.

Sell smart. Grow fast. Keep customers happy.
The road to becoming the world’s top Supermart entrepreneur starts here.

NOTE :
This game is suitable for players of all ages. Game has NO references to alcohol, cigarettes, tobacco, or related imagery.
All content is appropriate for children and promotes a safe, family-friendly play environment.


How to play ?
1. Order Stocks : Order new stock from your in-game computer. Unpack deliveries and place products neatly on shelves, in fridges, and freezers.
2. Open for business : Open your shop each morning. Customers will visit to buy what they need. Run marketing promotions to attract more visitors. At the end of the day, close the shop to review your earnings summary.
3. Work as the cashier—scan items, process card payments, and make sure every customer leaves happy with their shopping and checkout experience.
4. Pricing : Set and adjust prices to find the best balance between customer satisfaction and profit margins.
5. Planning : Earn profits, reinvest wisely, and expand your store. Upgrade interiors, enlarge your space, and obtain distributor licenses to unlock a wider range of products. Keep adapting to changing retail trends.
6. Personalise : Make your shop your own—customize floors, paint walls, and choose a name that defines your business.
70010000112085.intro: Supermart simulation. Buy, sell, and build your business empire!
70010000112085.name: Supermart Tycoon

70010000112129.description:
"QUESTER" is a brick breaker released by NAMCO LIMITED (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1987.
Your goal is to safely return to Earth by piloting the spacecraft and defeating the mysterious space organisms（blocks） that obstruct your path.
The ball can split into multiple pieces if it continues to bounce off the walls. Use various power-up items to your advantage and aim to clear all 33 rounds!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.
70010000112129.intro: Emergency Order! Annihilate all the Breeders!
70010000112129.name: Arcade Archives QUESTER

70010000112151.description:
Pack your bags and get your treats ready—it’s time to visit Cozy Town!

In the cute Cats Visiting series, you are invited to wander through six intricately detailed, hand-drawn towns bustling with life and hidden secrets. From busy market squares to quiet cobblestone alleys and rooftop gardens, the locals are missing one thing: their cats!

There are over 400 cats hiding in plain sight, waiting to be found. Some are sleeping on awnings, some are peeking out of windows, and others are blending perfectly into the scenery.

Take a break from the stress of daily life. There are no timers, no scores, and no pressure—just you, the beautiful art, and a whole lot of cats.

Key Features:
     6 Beautiful Illustrations: Explore distinct, charming townscapes filled with personality and detail.
     The Ultimate Scavenger Hunt: Search high and low to spot over 400 hidden cats.
     Relaxing Atmosphere: Enjoy a soothing, Zen-like experience suitable for all ages.
     Zoom & Pan: Inspect every corner, chimney, and bush to find the trickiest hiders.
70010000112151.intro: Explore charming streets and find hundreds of feline friends in this purr-fectly relaxing hidden object adventure.
70010000112151.name: Cats Visiting Cozy Town

70010000112158.description:
Welcome to a first-person horror experience focused on tension, stealth, and environmental storytelling. You play as a lone survivor trapped in a massive underground metro system haunted by a mysterious ghost train.

There are no weapons. Your main tools are silence, awareness, and the environment itself.

- Exploration: Navigate abandoned stations, dark tunnels, and derelict utility rooms in search of a way out.

- Stealth Survival: Make too much noise, and the ghost train will find you. Hide, and listen carefully to survive.

- Traps & Scare Points: Some areas offer light and supplies. Others are bait for terrifying ambushes.

- Interactive Items: Use tools to unlock new paths, solve simple environmental puzzles, or distract threats.

- Dynamic Threat: The ghost train isn’t bound to a single track — it roams. It hears. It hunts.

 It’s a horror game where survival comes from being quiet, thinking fast, and paying attention to every sound in the darkness.
70010000112158.intro: Silence is your only weapon — keep quiet, keep alive.
70010000112158.name: PLATFORM 0

70010000112164.description:
Step into the warm world of Cute Bonfire, a charming pixel-art puzzle game set inside a fireplace. Take control of a little fire spirit that moves tile by tile, pushing charcoal pieces to light up the bonfires. With 30 levels of gradually increasing difficulty, delightful visuals, and a cozy, relaxing atmosphere, Cute Bonfire is perfect for casual players who love the satisfaction of solving puzzles.

Guide your fire spirit across the grid, pushing charcoals in the right order to ignite all the bonfires. Each level is a mini challenge of observation, planning, and clever moves, with undo and restart options to help you experiment without pressure. Stones and wooden obstacles block your path, adding to the strategic depth, while the gentle pixel-art style and warm ambiance make every session comforting and enjoyable.

Whether you’re a puzzle lover or just looking for a cozy, bite-sized challenge, Cute Bonfire invites you to light up every hearth and enjoy a spark of satisfaction.
70010000112164.name: Cute Bonfire

70010000112201.description:
This game is a monorail simulation game set in Soi Mountain, a representative natural landmark in Korea.
Players become a monorail driver, taking in the breathtaking scenery of Soi Mountain and experiencing the unique experience of operating a monorail through beautiful natural and cultural heritage sites.

This is the first title to utilize actual filmed sections of the Hwagae Mountain monorail!

Key Features

• Realistic Monorail Driving Experience

Uses high-quality footage of actual Soi Mountain monorail sections.

Experience driving a monorail through diverse landscapes and terrain.

Two play modes: section-by-section driving mode and view mode.

• Control System

Just like driving a real monorail, precise control is required, including acceleration, deceleration, and stopping.

Compared to regular railways, the game features numerous uphill and downhill sections and significant impacts, requiring appropriate acceleration and deceleration control.

Ensuring on-time operation and stopping locations are crucial challenges, providing players with a truly engaging experience.

Supports Mascon for Nintendo Switch™ controllers from Zuiki.

• Realistic Scenery and Atmosphere

Pass through the Soisan Monorail section and admire the surrounding mountains, nature, and tourist attractions through footage shot on the actual monorail.

Enjoy the natural beauty of Korea through high-definition footage that realistically recreates the breathtaking scenery as you ride.

Recommended for:

• Gamers who enjoy monorails and natural scenery
• Players who want to experience Korea's famous attractions and travels through games
• Users who prefer realistic simulations that emphasize nature and scenery

This game offers a unique opportunity to experience Hwagaesan and its surrounding natural landscapes by monorail.
It's a truly unforgettable experience for lovers of Korean nature and monorails!
70010000112201.intro: This simulation game lets you operate a train directly, based on footage of actual trains in motion!
70010000112201.name: Korean Monorail Panorama Line Soisan

70010000112217.description:
DigDigDrill is a mining, ore-collecting, and drill-customization simulation game where you carve out the underground world step-by-step at your own pace.

Dig, collect, and grow stronger. This is the definitive edition of "steady progress" mining that you won't be able to put down!
Use the resources you gather to create your very own original drill.
Let's dig deep into a cozy world with no enemies and no time limits!

<<< DigDigDrill Features >>>
- Mindless fun with mining and treasure hunting
- Block-puzzle style forging to enhance your drill just the way you like it
- Equipment with various special effects for efficient digging
- Extra stages appear after clearing the game for even more fun!

◆ Steady Digging
Dig through the earth and collect ores and treasure chests. Your goal: Floor 999!
Once your bag is full, head back to the surface to drop off your haul.

◆ Puzzle x Forging
Craft new drills using the ores you've collected.
If you fit the ores into the blueprints just right, you might create the ultimate drill.

◆ Choose Your Gear
If you're lucky, your drill will gain special effects. Combine them wisely to boost your efficiency!
- Specialize in movement speed to transport resources to the surface quickly
- Power up your bombs to blast through large areas at once
The choice is yours!

◆ End-Game Content
High-difficulty stages await you after the main clear.
The treasures you'll find there are just as powerful!

<<< Recommended for people who: >>>
- Want to lose themselves in satisfying "grind" tasks
- Love grinning at a massive collection of items
- Enjoy theory-crafting builds in hack-and-slash games
- Are looking for a relaxing game to unwind
70010000112217.intro:
Dig, Build, and Grow Stronger
Relaxing ground mining and ore collection
Aim for B999 and beyond with your custom drill!
70010000112217.name: DigDigDrill

70010000112218.description:
The 1983 classic multi-room platformer Montezuma’s Revenge returns in 2.5D glory, and now Pedro’s adventure is bigger than ever with 100 tricky rooms to explore! For its 40th anniversary, what was once an unfinished game is now resurrected to match the full vision of creator Robert Jaeger. This time you can choose between male and female explorers, Pedro or his sister Rosita, to delve deep into the dangerous ruins and hunt for treasures untold!

Montezuma’s Revenge: The 40th Anniversary Edition is remade from the ground up with vibrant 3D visuals while preserving the 1983 original’s 2D gameplay style. Run, jump and climb your way through tricky chambers to collect valuable artifacts, avoid perilous traps and fiendish enemies, find keys to progress and survive a final showdown to escape with your riches… and your life!

• Choose between adventurous male and female protagonists!
• Explore 100 tricky chambers filled with traps, treasures and roving baddies.
• Collect valuable artifacts as you solve the ruins’ many mysteries!
• Enjoy retro aesthetics reimagined in vibrant 2.5D style.
• Relive a timeless video game classic in its most complete form ever!
70010000112218.intro: Experience a timeless classic adventure now fully evolved and complete for the first time!
70010000112218.name: Montezuma's Revenge - The 40th Anniversary Edition

70010000112230.description:
Perennial Dusk -Kinsenka- is a visual novel presented by Yukito Urushibara (Planning & Story) and Saine (Character Design & Art).

Sai suffers from a persistent numbness in his heart and lives only to protect his little sister... That is, until a fateful meeting with a girl named Matsuri. In a twilight world where the dead and the living mingle, a group of boys and girls face the imminent threat of beings known as Maledicts. Growing little by little, they experience the bittersweetness of life and the warmth of human connection.

■About This Game
・Unpredictable twists, written by Yukito Urushibara, will keep you on the edge of your seat like a mystery thriller!
・An intricate story with themes exploring life and dead—highly recommended for visual novel fans!
・Charming characters drawn by Saine!
・The theme song by Mao Uesugi and beautiful background music by Fuminori Matsumoto & Hitoshi Fujima (Elements Garden) perfectly complement the story!
・No branching paths—enjoy it even in Auto Play!
・Includes a chapter selection feature so you can start from your favorite scenes!
・Full HD support for gorgeous graphics!

■Main Characters
Matsuri (CV: Manaka Iwami)
A girl born into the Benio Family, a powerful family of Maledict Exorcists, who is tightly bound by her family's curse. Due to an incident in the past, causing her to close off her heart, she doesn't speak and barely shows any emotion. She is a Curse Bearer with the ability to give Maledicts form and use their powers freely.

Nobody (CV: Manaka Iwami)
Another personality that dwells inside Matsuri's heart who takes over when she is asleep. She can be incredibly selfish, and her words, actions, and strong attitude cause her to come across as a haughty, ill-mannered girl.

■Story
"The human heart is but a vessel for pain."

That's what someone once whispered—a voice laced with loneliness, whispering directly into the soul. It's an indescribable sadness, a love just beginning to bloom. It becomes an invisible pain that pierces the heart. And that's what makes up life: a cyclical series of highs and lows.

Tachibana Sai was born without the ability to feel pain in his heart. He spends his days eliminating any seeds of malice that sneak up on his sister, the one person he treasures, without drawing attention to himself.

Sick of the never-ending monotony he lives through, he chances upon a meeting with Benio Matsuri, a young girl whose aloof demeanor resembles that of a beautifully crafted doll.

For the first time in his life, he encounters a heart-piercing sensation—that of falling in love.

On the edge between day and night, in a twilight world where the dead and living mingle, stands an apartment building called Maison sans Nom, which is home to a group of boys and girls.

A ruthless boy who knows no pain in his heart.
A lonely girl without any friends.
A friendly girl who struggles to make connections.
A prickly, ambitious girl who is keen to be of help.
A boy who loves his own cute self above anything else.
A mess of a woman who tries to solve everything through brute force.
And a boy with a tender heart who knows no pain in his body.

This ill-assorted group of residents, hands stained with blood from battling the Maledicts, shall encounter the hearts they never knew and begin nurturing their souls.

The human heart is but a vessel for pain.

To protect this pain akin to love... To gently break the world apart, piece by piece... Even if it means abandoning humanity. That's why the heart is but a vessel for pain.

For life blazes brilliantly, while the heart goes around in an endless cycle.
70010000112230.intro: A visual novel about how the human heart endures relentless violence and limitless cruelty.
70010000112230.name: Perennial Dusk -Kinsenka-

70010000112236.description:
■Unique Controls
Explore the unique and challenging "Rotation Control Mode" where your character spins as you rotate the stick.

The game starts with a standard control method, making it easy for anyone to enjoy. When you're ready, dive into the challenge of mastering the unique "Rotation Control Mode," where your character spins as you rotate the stick.

■Unique World
There is no time to worry about why macho is in space or why he does side rolls.

All you need to understand is that he is in space and must return to Earth.

■Simple Rules
The only way is up! All you need is the physical strength to keep rolling and the determination to never give up.

■Various Areas
As you progress, the environment changes, demanding different strategies. To survive in space, you must adapt to the situation.

■Great Music
The music changes with each area and will make you feel excited. Enjoy the carefully curated soundtrack.
70010000112236.intro: Rolling Macho: Tumbling to Earth is a rolling action game where you roll and squat your way back to Earth after being stranded in space.
70010000112236.name: Rolling Macho: Tumbling to Earth

70010000112237.description:
Hiroshi has to go on a business trip to Kyushu, so now the entire Nohara family has decided to stay with an childhood friend of Misae's in Asso, Kumamoto.
But when they arrive at Kumamoto Station on their way to Asso, they meet a strange man who offers them an even stranger camera on the condition that they'll act as his witnesses...

With his new camera in hand, Shinnosuke can enjoy his summer vacation in the beautiful Asso fields and mountains to the fullest. The scenery is even crawling with creatures that he would never find in Kasukabe. And there are townspeople to help and new friends to make.
That said...don't these kids look an awful lot like the ones he knows from home?

One cool summer night, Shinnosuke witnesses a giant creature outlined against the light of a full moon. Next to the creature is a strange man with a wide smile.
It's the same weird man who gave him the camera at the station...
And he calls himself the Professor Akuno. Following this encounter more and more strange things start to happen around Asso...
70010000112237.intro: Kazu Ayabe, director of the My Summer Vacation game series, presents a brand new adventure!
70010000112237.name: Shin chan: Me and the Professor on Summer Vacation -The Endless Seven-Day Journey-

70010000112244.description:
Hiroshi is suddenly given an job assignment near his hometown in Akita.
So the Nohara family make their way to a small village near Hiroshi’s parents’ home and rent out a traditional Japanese farmhouse.
Nestled in this tranquil rural landscape, they begin their carefree and quiet life in the countryside.

Ginnosuke, Shinnosuke’s grandfather, bestows the mysteries of country playtime by teaching Shinnosuke how to catch bugs and fish.
A highlight of every evening is when the family gathers around the sunken hearth to savor delicious Akita dishes.
In the village, Shinnosuke talks with farmers and makes new friends.
Every day, he’s enjoying life to the fullest until…

Shinnosuke Follows After a Soot-covered Shiro

One morning, Shiro shows up at the house covered in soot.
As a confused Shinnosuke looks on, Shiro suddenly dashes away…!
Shinnosuke chases after Shiro until, stopped before him, he notices a mysterious train he’s never seen before.
Shinnosuke follows after Shiro and accidentally boards this train.

Welcome to Coal Town

The mysterious train stops in a lively and prosperous town that seems to have been frozen in time since the Showa era.
In this town called Coal Town, there are energetic working-class people going about their day.
After meeting a mysterious young girl, Shinnosuke becomes friends with these people.
And so begins Shinnosuke’s newest adventure…!

Life in Akita

Fish
Akita's rivers are rich with a diverse range of fish, from common catches to rare species that are hard to find.
There are also crawfish in irrigation channels…! Experiment with different times of day and locations to catch the fish you want.
Add any fish you find to your nature book collection!

Catch Bugs
There are all kinds of bugs living in the groves and forest. As night falls, fireflies emerge, creating a magical scene.
You may even find some bugs that only live in this village!
Add any bugs you catch to your nature book collection!

Pick Wild Vegetables
You can forage for wild vegetables along the village roads and in the mountains.
Use the vegetables you find for your errands!
Of course, you can add them to your nature collection too.

Grow Vegetables
Your grandma in Akita will teach you how to grow vegetables.
Grow more vegetables to get more new seeds.
You can also use the deliciously fresh vegetables as ingredients in local dishes!

Life in Coal Town

Inventions
There’s a gorgeous young lady inventor in Coal Town!
Work with this young lady to create amazing inventions with the help of her strange machine that creates inventions.
Use different items found around town to create inventions.

Menu Creation at the Diner
The people of Coal Town love hanging out at the diner.
Help the owner of the diner come up with new menu items while she serves up the food.
Shinnosuke can catch fish or find other ingredients for new menu items!

Trolly Race
This entertainment facility is popular with the people of Coal Town. You can even race against other people in town.
Win a race, and you’ll even receive rare items.

More and more courses!
Explore a collection of unique tracks, from courses with exhilarating jumps to courses designed for thrilling battles.
Get stronger and challenge more racers.

A variety of trollies!
Choose from a variety of trollies, like stable beginner trollies or to faster trollies for more advanced racers. Choose the trolly that suits your racing style.
You may even find some peculiar trollies with special skills…!

Amazing custom parts!
Choose from a large collection of items to upgrade your trolly with melee parts that can distract your opponents, parts to help you hit corners smoothly, or parts to boost your speed.
Create your very own trolly with custom parts!
70010000112244.intro: Shin chan starts a mysterious daily routine, traveling between two worlds: the Village in Akita and Coal Town.
70010000112244.name: Shin chan: Shiro and the Coal Town

70010000112250.description:
"Öoo" is a charming yet mysterious exploration puzzle platformer where you discover creative ways to use bombs!

A Variety of Solutions Using Bombs!

Discover unique ways to use bombs!

Uncover hidden paths with clever bomb usage!

Traverse the map to find hidden routes!

Features
・A dense experience that can be enjoyed in just 2–3 hours
・A cute yet oddly mysterious world
・Diverse puzzle solutions that change depending on how you use bombs
・No text — enjoy the game without language barriers
・So cute that even people who dislike bugs can enjoy it comfortably.
70010000112250.name: Öoo

70010000112251.description: SEDAP! is a co-op cooking-combat adventure that combines the chaos of a collaborative kitchen and the wonders of adventuring into an unexplored world. Embark on an exciting culinary journey, whip up delectable delicacies, and serve your way through a fantastical reimagination of Southeast Asia!
70010000112251.intro:
Embark on a culinary adventure on a mysterious
and legendary island!
70010000112251.name: SEDAP! A Culinary Adventure

70010000112252.description:
After awakening to find herself trapped in a mysterious dream world, Lily is forced to face her past traumas and experiences. Harnessing a unique ability to swap, rotate, and move the environment around her, Lily progresses through the various worlds in a journey of navigating grief and finding herself.

Features:
Accompanied by her flying turtle friend, take on the challenges of the mysterious dream worlds together

Swap, rotate, and move the environment around you to solve puzzles to progress through the world

Immerse yourself in the stunning, hand-drawn visuals that span various, visually distinct worlds

While exploring the worlds of As I Began to Dream, you are accompanied by peaceful, almost melancholy music.
70010000112252.intro: As I Began to Dream is a journey about a girl and her turtle, trapped in her dream world, dealing with past trauma. She controls this world uniquely to navigate her grief.
70010000112252.name: As I Began to Dream

70010000112262.description:
Enjoy an easy and fun game that anyone can play while admiring adorable characters!
Now introducing the Fantasy Version Vol.2 with increased difficulty!
Includes 15 exciting stages!

Compare the two illustrations and find the differences!
Tap either side to answer.
If you can't find the differences, try zooming in!
Still stuck? Use the magnifying glass for a helpful hint!
Perfect for killing time during short breaks!

＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝
At Age, we support video creators who stream our games.
No permission is required for gameplay streaming.
70010000112262.intro: A spot-the-difference game featuring lots of cute girls!
70010000112262.name: Lovely Spot the Difference Fantasy Edition

70010000112268.description:
By merging three matching tiles, you’ll gradually transform a humble settlement into a thriving metropolis—growing your world from adorable beginnings to awe-inspiring skylines.
With no timers or pressure, you’re free to build, relax, and shape your town at your own pace.

Game features:
- Merge and Evolve Gameplay: Connect three identical tiles to unlock new buildings and expand your city step by step.
- Customizable Themes: Personalize your town with unique looks, including festive options like Halloween and Christmas.
- Night Mode: Switch to a glowing nighttime view and watch your city sparkle under the stars.
- Stress-Free Play: No countdowns, no rush—just calm, creative building at your own rhythm.
- Atmospheric Vibes: Enjoy lo-fi music and low-poly art that create a relaxing, minimalist atmosphere.
- Casual Yet Strategic: Easy to pick up, but with enough depth to keep you planning your next clever merge.
- Family-Friendly Fun: Accessible for all ages, blending puzzle-solving with city-building charm.

Why You’ll Love It
Teeny Tiny Town combines the simplicity of a match-three puzzle with the satisfaction of city-building strategy.
Whether you’re chasing the perfect layout, experimenting with different themes, or just unwinding with its cozy soundtrack, this game offers a relaxing yet rewarding experience.
70010000112268.intro: Step into Teeny Tiny Town, a cozy and colorful city-building puzzle where every move counts.
70010000112268.name: Teeny Tiny Town

70010000112274.description:
Venture into this dungeon crawler with roguelike elements, where you'll face bloodthirsty skeletons and other creatures. Reach the top of the tower and uncover the mysteries hidden within.

In this adventure, you will follow the story of Dorian, an adventurer who has spent years tracking down a powerful sorcerer. However, when he finally finds him, he discovers that the situation is far worse than he expected.

Game features
----------------
- A dungeon-crawling adventure where you must clear each floor before advancing. After every floor, you can choose between opening a chest with improved equipment or moving on to the next floor, where loot chances are better but enemies are stronger.

-Simple mechanics! Jump back into the game whenever you want, with no steep learning curve.

- Define your own playstyle! Choose from different weapon types and talents. Feel free to carve your own path.

- Forge your own custom equipment! If the gear you find during your journey isn't enough, create your ideal equipment with the stats you need.

- A unique style! More friendly and suitable for all audiences. Perfect for newcomers to the genre and refreshing for veteran players.

- An unexpected story waiting to be uncovered as you explore the dungeons.

- Various bosses and powerful enemies that will appear as you progress.
70010000112274.intro: Fight your way to the top of the tower and stop the sorcerer who controls it to free the unfortunate souls who arrived there and are now trapped.
70010000112274.name: Doors & Loot

70010000112296.description:
Horticular is a relaxing garden-builder that begins with mysterious gnomes summoning you. Their wish? For you to breathe new life into a long-lost garden, abandoned by its previous caretaker.

Enter a magical world where you build up and expand a lush garden at your own pace. In your journey, you attract adorable animals to inhabit every corner; uncover helpful upgrades; and assist quirky characters for rewards and story development—all while juggling decay and fending off corruption sent by your nemesis!

Creative Freedom:
Build and expand the garden of your dreams with hundreds of unlockable surface types and items. You set the pace and what to do next, whether it be developing a new vegetable area, progressing a lucrative story arch, or just sitting back and admiring your creation.

Animal Ecosystem:
Create and preserve animal habitats to attract adorable creatures. Each species has its own requirements to fulfill before they pay you a visit, so you have to plan ahead if you want them all. Should you not take proper care of your inhabitants, they may leave you in pursuit of better luck elsewhere!

Immersive World:
Immerse yourself in your personal garden diorama, complete with a day-night cycle and weather effects. But while a rainy and lantern-lit evening may be cozy, it is not just for show! You will find that darkness attracts unsavory characters, some animals prefer specific weather conditions, and lightning strikes loom under stormy skies.

Maintaining Magic:
Nurture your garden with magic. Over time, you will have to deal with unhappy animals, garden decay, and corrupted agents sent by your nemesis. But with a combination of helpful gnomes and your own magical gloves, you are sure to keep an everblooming environment.

Garden Upgrades:
Choose how your gardening journey develops by upgrading abilities and investing in new items. Since you make the decision, every playthrough is personal. But worry not; no choice locks you out of content, and you are able to collect everything!

Pen Pals:
Encounter multiple quirky characters writing you letters throughout the story. Each individual has their own specialty, and they frequently give you tasks to carry out in exchange for a reward. What you decide to pursue is completely up to you, and there is always something waiting to be done.
70010000112296.intro: Horticular is a relaxing garden builder where you grow plants, design habitats and attract a wide range of wildlife.
70010000112296.name: Horticular

70010000112302.description:
All main characters are Vtubers!!
Pixel art side-scrolling comical fantasy magical action sent by Vtuber magical girl Kohaku!!
The magical girl goes on a journey in search of magical things scattered all over the place!
Believe in your magical power and run around the mysterious world from the magical gate!

This game is an orthodox side-scrolling 2D action game.
You can experience various worlds from the beginning with the stage selection type.
Run through various stages and successfully defeat the boss, and the ability is yours.
The difficulty level depends on the abilities you have acquired, so it's up to you to decide which stage to start!

After clearing all the stages, more !?
See for yourself the future! !!
70010000112302.intro:
All main characters are Vtubers!!
Pixel art side-scrolling comical fantasy magical action sent by Vtuber magical girl!!
70010000112302.name: Magical Magic World

70010000112308.description:
Cast n Chill's a laid-back fishin’ game for folks who’d rather wet a line than break a sweat. Whether yer driftin’ on a lazy lake, pokin’ 'round a winding river, or droppin’ lines in salty blue water, this here’s a game where you set the pace.

Upgrade Yer Gear.
Start with the basics, catch whatever bites, sell your haul, and put those coins toward better rods, reels, and upgrades. Before ya know it, you’ll be wranglin’ rare species that’d make any angler green with envy.

Explore New Waters.
Find yer favourite fishin’ hole or keep wanderin’. There’s 16 peaceful spots to discover, each with its own critters swimmin’ 'round, just waitin’ to bite.

Pick Your Pace.
In Active Mode, you’re in the thick of it - castin’, reelin’, and keepin’ busy like a loon at nesting time.

Switch to Passive Mode if you’d rather let the game do the work while you’re off choppin’ wood.

Collect 'Em All.
There’s 50 fish to discover - some you’ll recognize, some you’ll squint at and go “what in the heck is that?” From scrappy little sunfish to big ol’ deepwater beasts, they’re all in the logbook waitin’ for your name.

Legendary Catches
There’s 16 fish out there that still get folks jabberin’ at ol' Rusty's bait shop like they saw Bigfoot ride a moose. Land one, and you'll be part o' the legend.

Boat Buddies
Grab your rod and call a buddy, Cast 'n Chill now has co-op! Whether you’re lookin’ to kick back and fish side-by-side or stir up a bit of friendly competition, it’s all better with company.

Trusty Companion
Nothin’ beats a day on the lake with a four-legged friend. They might not know a spinnerbait from a spoon, but they’ll help you spot a fish - if only 'cause they’re hopin’ for a bite themselves.
70010000112308.intro: Catch rare fish, upgrade your gear and reel in legendary catches - all with your loyal companion by your side.
70010000112308.name: Cast n Chill - Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition

70010000112309.description:
Embrace mind-blowing moments as you’re pulled deep into the many worlds of Split Fiction, a boundary-pushing co-op action adventure from the studio behind 2021 Game of the Year Winner, It Takes Two. Mio and Zoe are contrasting writers – one writes sci-fi and the other writes fantasy – who become trapped in their own stories after being hooked up to a machine designed to steal their creative ideas. They’ll have to rely on each other to break free with their memories in-tact, working together to master a variety of abilities and overcome diverse challenges while jumping between sci-fi and fantasy worlds in this unexpected tale of friendship.

This split-screen adventure is tailored for two. Experience co-op gameplay where you’ll have to coordinate your actions and timing as well as work together to overcome challenges. Invite a partner to join you for free, for cross-platform play, with the Friend's Pass*.

One minute you’re taming adorable dragons and the next you’re fighting as cyber ninjas, escaping terrifying trolls, or dodging hover cars thrown by a robotic parking attendant. It’s weird, it’s wild, and it’s designed to be shared.
70010000112309.intro: Experience a mind-blowing co-op adventure in Split Fiction
70010000112309.name: Split Fiction

70010000112326.description:
Leap into a world of calm precision and clever rhythm in this 2D platformer where every jump changes everything. You play as a brave ninja bunny in training, mastering the art of movement where each leap toggles platforms, spikes, and saws on or off. Timing isn’t just important, it’s everything.
With smooth controls, double jumps, and wall jumps, you’ll flow through 30 handcrafted levels that blend platforming and puzzle-solving in a uniquely relaxing way. Each stage is short, focused, and satisfying, perfect for players who enjoy smart challenges or love hunting for achievements.
Plan your jumps, find your rhythm, and reach the torii gate to prove you’ve earned your black belt.
Features
• 30 handcrafted stages filled with clever platform puzzles
• Jump to toggle platforms, spikes, and saws on or off
• Double jump and wall jump mechanics for flexible movement
• A calm and readable challenge perfect for casual players
• Checkpoints and instant retries for frustration-free fun
Train your mind and reflexes as you turn every jump into a perfect act of ninja mastery. The path to the torii awaits, one hop at a time.
70010000112326.intro: Hop, Toggle, and Train Like a True Ninja!
70010000112326.name: Bunninjutsu

70010000112349.description:
Cabernet is a 2D narrative RPG set in a 19th century Eastern European inspired world, with a modern twist. Guide Liza, a young vampire struggling with her morality and the supernatural world she has been pulled into. Will you retain your humanity or descend further into the horror you have become? Prepare to explore a hidden world of political intrigue, class conflict, and decadent corruption.

Use the moonlit sky to plan your next feast and explore. Mingle among vampiric society and the humans who feed them. Uncover who can aid your new kin and whose only purpose is to be drained.

Vampirism isn't just an unholy transformation of your body-- it also threatens to transform your mind. Will you choose to indulge your empathetic humanity or embrace your newfound nihilism?

But to lure your next meal somewhere safe and secluded, you'll need to understand who they are and what they desire. A kind-hearted, alcoholic coachman? A fraying newlywed couple? A greedy, yet charming charlatan? Their lives are yours to aid or unravel.

Art, literature, history, science, these are the skills you'll require to succeed. Your knowledge will be your greatest weapon in a world where the cunning drain the brutal of life.
70010000112349.intro: Cabernet is a 2D narrative RPG set in a 19th century Eastern European inspired world, with a modern twist. Guide Liza, a young vampire in her new unlife among the
70010000112349.name: Cabernet

70010000112350.description:
DRAGON BALL: Sparking! ZERO takes the legendary gameplay of the Budokai Tenkaichi series and raises it to whole new levels. Become a super warrior and experience the earth-shaking, limit-breaking power of Dragon Ball battles!

THE BIGGEST ROSTER IN HISTORY
Unleash the strength of over 180 fighters from Dragon Ball Z, Dragon Ball Super, Dragon Ball GT, and selected Dragon Ball movies, all in the base game! Each character comes with their own signature abilities, transformations, and techniques.

Make the destructive power of the strongest fighters ever to appear in Dragon Ball yours!

BREATHTAKING 3D FIGHTS
Engage in heart-pounding, high-speed 3D battles that stay true to the anime and video game series, with breathtaking visuals and authentic combat moves like beam clashes, rush attacks, movements too quick for the eyes to see, and planet-razing ultimate attacks.

RIVALS MAKE YOU STRONGER
Challenge players online to test your skills, enjoy local multiplayer with up to six players on a single console, or connect multiple consoles for wireless play. Experience intense battles and become a Super Warrior with immersive motion controls using the Joy-Con™ controllers.

BLAZE A NEW PATH
