Conquer the action-packed battles from the beloved original story, or discover and unlock new encounters for your favorite Z-Fighters and more. Relive your favorite moments from the series through cutscenes you can experience from the perspectives of eight characters!

CREATE, PLAY, AND SHARE
Recreate your favorite battles from throughout the Dragon Ball story, or set up your dream story battle with your favorite characters! Share your creations with other fans and experience the battles brought to life by imaginations around the world.

*In addition to this edition, Deluxe Edition and Ultimate Edition are also available. Please be careful not to purchase the same content twice.
70010000112350.name: DRAGON BALL: Sparking! ZERO

70010000112354.description:
From cute arcade novelties to innovative text-based thrillers and acclaimed fourth wall-breaking stories, Simogo Legacy Collection is an eclectic celebration of Simogo's past, featuring faithful renditions of seven games released on mobile platforms between 2010 and 2015.

• Kosmo Spin
• Bumpy Road
• Beat Sneak Bandit
• Year Walk (+ Year Walk Companion)
• DEVICE 6
• The Sailor’s Dream
• SPL-T

Additionally, Simogo Legacy Collection features bonus content with thoughtfully curated curios from Simogo's wide-ranging history.

• Year Walk Bedtime Stories for Awful Children – E-book
• The Lighthouse Painting – Audio drama Podcast
• Music – Tracks from Simogo’s history, including previously unreleased tracks
• Images – Illustrations from Simogo’s archive
• Year Walk Prototype – Playable prototype
• Bumpy Road Prototype – Playable prototype
• Rollovski Prototype – Playable prototype
• The Sensational December Machine – Playable short story

Requires understanding of written and spoken English to be fully enjoyed.
70010000112354.name: Simogo Legacy Collection - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000112357.description:
Inti Creates brings you speedy and stylish 2D action the likes of which you've never seen before! Experience the apeX of 2D action with Luminous Avenger iX!

● Fast-paced, stylish 2D action eXplodes onto the scene!

The hero, Copen, can dash into enemies to lock-on onto them so his shots never miss their mark. Put your ingenuity to the test, and you can use his "Bullit Dash" to fly through stages without touching the ground! You have many tools at your disposal, so make find a style that works for you and conquer each stage with style.

● Acquire EX Weapons from bosses for eXtreme firepower!

Each and every boss has a unique superpower called a "Septima" that powers their special abilities. When Copen defeats a boss, his partner robot Lola copies those Septimas and gives him access to a new arsenal of weapons. Each boss has a weakness to one of these EX Weapons, so make good use of them!

● Utilize a wide variety of abilities that allow players of all skill levels to eXcel!

When Copen reaches 0 HP, there's a chance his partner Lola will revive him in a powered up state—perfect for anyone who wants a second chance! Blitz through stages with style and precision to rack up Kudos points! Rack up over 1000 Kudos and Lola will transform and sing for you, so shoot for the stars and go for a high score! High scores also unlock flashy score result screens that you can share on social media!

● Experience the story of people surviving in a world where they are on the brink of eXtermination!

The hero Copen swears to protect a group of children surviving in the ruins of society, hiding in the shadows from the watchful eyes of all-powerful Sumeragi Institute. To make matters worse, the threat of Sumeragi's elite soldiers, The Falcons, looms large. Meet a huge cast of colorful characters that shine through in this dark tale.

Voice Cast
Copen:  Yuma Uchida, Lola: Mayu Mineda
Kohaku: Yumiri Hanamori
Kyota: Nozomi Chikamura, Jin: Ryosuke Sakamaki, Maria: Maria Naganawa
Blade: Yui Ishikawa
Rebellio: Ryota Yoshizaki, Stella: Ryoko Shiraishi, Crimm: Suguru Narisawa
Isola: Miku Ito, Bakto: Atsushi Tanaka, Dystnine: Yuichiro Umehara
70010000112357.intro: Get ready for the apeX of 2D action!
70010000112357.name: Gunvolt Chronicles: Luminous Avenger iX

70010000112380.description:
Story
In the near future, a sudden proliferation of plants has left much of human civilization drowning in greenery. Yuuto is a boy living in a city that's now largely reclaimed by nature. One day, a girl named Kanade appears on his doorstep.
The two had been exchanging letters after she found one of his carrier pigeons.
"I have to sing the greatest love song and save the world in my mother's place.
So, Yuuto-san... Would you please fall in love with me?"
Warmly watched over by those around them, the two tentatively begin their exploration of love. What neither of them realize is that a spark of affection has already budded between them...
Fall in love, make music, and save the world.
This is the tale of a wondrous future where the encounter between a boy and girl brings a miracle to the world.
70010000112380.intro: "I have to sing the greatest love song and save the world."
70010000112380.name: KANADE

70010000112388.description:
Step into a chaotic battlefield where survival is everything — and the fiercest foes are armed… cats! In this wild shooter, you face off against cunning, weapon-wielding felines across a dynamic map. Every encounter is unpredictable, every corner could hide a new adversary, and only the sharpest aim and quickest reflexes will keep you alive.
Outsmart, outgun, and outlast these armed cats to claim victory and become the ultimate champion of the arena. Are you ready to take on the purr-fect challenge?
70010000112388.intro: Cats are armed. You are warned!
70010000112388.name: Blablublas Battle Royale Shooter

70010000112393.description:
Play the odds in Lost in Random™, a gothic fairytale-inspired action adventure where every citizen’s fate is determined by the roll of a dice.

Ruled by a wicked Queen, the kingdom of Random is divided into six shadowy realms where life is dictated by a cursed black dice. In this story, from the award-winning Swedish game studio Zoink and penned by Eisner Award-winning Adventure Time and Marvel Comics The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl author Ryan North, you’ll join Even, a penniless girl who’s down on her luck, in a dark quest to save her beloved sister. With her companion Dicey, a small and strange living dice, Even must learn to embrace the chaos of Random, uncovering an age-old tale with a modern message.

Walk Random’s mysterious cobbled streets, meet its unpredictable residents, and take on courageous quests. Engage in fearsome battles with a unique blend of tactical combat, card collection, and explosive dice gameplay. It’s time to adapt or perish, as you battle inside giant board game arenas that change with every dice throw! Learn how to tip the odds in your favor, and dive into a dark wonderland where only the brave survive.

Play the odds. Win the game.
70010000112393.intro: Enter a gothic world where your fate depends on a dice roll.
70010000112393.name: Lost in Random™

70010000112419.description:
Two years after waking from her coma, Laura believes she’s free from nightmares. But the Sandman, who once held her soul captive, is back for revenge. A relaxing trip to a snowy mountain resort turns tragic when Tim falls from a cliff and slips into a coma.

Bound by her vow not to use her Power for personal gain, Laura can’t save him herself. Desperate, she turns to an old friend (the player) and enters Tim’s subconscious, now under the Sandman’s dark influence.

Explore haunting dreamscapes, solve intriguing puzzles, and face the shadows before the Sandman claims his next heir.

• A modern blend of point-and-click adventure and hidden object gameplay
• Explore over 40 exciting locations and experience a thrilling sequel
• Solve a variety of hidden object scenes and mini-games
• 2 game modes (normal and advanced)
• Includes bonus chapter
70010000112419.intro: A nightmare comes true – save Laura’s husband from the Sandman!
70010000112419.name: Dreamscapes - Nightmare’s Heir

70010000112425.description:
Heroes Battle Awakening is a top-down tower defense tactics game that puts you in command of cyclops knights, minotaurs, skull-topped guard towers and more as you fend off invaders.

Collect coins on the battlefield to pay for new units and deploy them strategically along the 5-lane grid. Some of your units will do ranged damage, others will focus on melee as the enemy closes in and certain units will specialize in producing more gold to deploy defenses faster.

Take down waves successfully and progress through 4 uniquely-themed chapters, each with 10 levels to master. But watch out! As combat heats up, you’ll face hordes of skeleton soldiers, orcs, flying sorcerers and even greater menaces! Can you keep the kingdom safe?

• Enjoy colorful and casual tower defense gameplay!
• Strategically deploy a variety of unit types.
• Command your own unique monsters.
• Battle across 4 story chapters, each with 10 levels.
• Collect coins during battle to purchase new units!
70010000112425.intro: Fight monsters with monsters as you command legions against waves of invaders in tower defense style!
70010000112425.name: Heroes Battle Awakening

70010000112433.description:
You open your eyes to complete darkness, trapped in a basement with no way out. Every door is locked, and the silence is broken only by distant, haunting sounds. As you search the area, you discover hidden passwords that might be your only chance to escape.

But you’re not alone. A mysterious masked enemy stalks the shadows, hunting you with relentless intent. With only a flashlight and a weapon, you must uncover the truth, stay one step ahead, and survive the nightmare.

Key Features
- Dark exploration: uncover clues and passwords to unlock doors
- Horror atmosphere: chilling sounds and tense visuals
- Relentless enemy: avoid the masked stalker
- First-person immersion: feel the fear up close
- Flashlight & weapon: light your path and defend yourself

Can you escape, or will you become the next victim?
70010000112433.intro: You wake up in darkness and every door hides a nightmare.
70010000112433.name: I'm not a Human: Horror

70010000112449.description:
Help Xi navigate a five-day time loop and figure out what happened to her memories in a vast hand-drawn world.

Together with her companion, Ouro, travel through a true metroidvania world where time changes the terrain in subtle ways. Escape the loop through exploration and battle. Change Xi’s fate and learn the truth of the Dragon Loop!

• Turn Bosses into Summonable Spirits

Defeat a wide range of interesting bosses to get exclusive summonable spirits. Destroy your foes with powerful Explosive Spirits, or summon Persistent Spirit companions to follow you around. Upgrade and evolve both types to enhance their combat power!

• Multipurpose Metroidvania Powers

Find rare Pearls to summon powerful tools that help you traverse the world. Spiky pufferfish, magnetic boxes, a vacuuming whale spirit… and more. Each has multiple uses in both combat and traversing the world, unlocking many ways to play!

• Fast-Paced Exciting Battles

Combine Xi’s strength with Ouro’s agility in fast-paced combat. Play well, manage your X-Rating, and boost your speed and combat power even further in this fast-paced combat system with no contact damage.

• Branches in Time

In Dragon Loop, time is a limited resource. Use your five days wisely and plan your routes through an easily-navigable Time Map. Explore and open up new worldlines to see how things play out differently.But don’t worry: this isn’t a roguelike; you never start from scratch.
70010000112449.intro: Escape The Time Loop In This Open-World Metroidvania
70010000112449.name: Dragon Loop

70010000112467.description:
Midnight Swamp is a dark point-and-click adventure where you will dive into a world of eerie fairy tales. Play as a tourist who must find a way out of a mysterious swamp, where every corner hides a riddle.

A mysterious laugh echoed from the lake on that restless summer night. One careless step outside the tent — and you find yourself dragged into a dark world of shifting swamps, inhabited by strange creatures and filled with hidden secrets.

Soon, a talking Cat convinces you to enter the inhospitable castle rising above the swamp, while the Witch from the gingerbread house teaches you the basics of potion brewing. Will you have the courage to uncover the mystery of this place?

Features:
- A variety of puzzles, potion crafting, and location exploration
- A dark swamp hiding a sinister secret
- Many strange inhabitants for you to meet
- Hand-drawn graphics
70010000112467.intro: A dark point-and-click adventure where you will dive into a world of eerie fairy tales
70010000112467.name: Midnight Swamp

70010000112499.description:
Explore the beautiful yet dangerous and twisted land of Bramble in your endeavour to rescue your sister. Traverse a wondrous landscape and survive deadly encounters with Bramble's many hideous creatures.

Bramble The Mountain King takes you on a gripping and unsettling journey through stunning environments. Take on the role of Olle, a young boy setting off to rescue his sister, kidnapped by a dreaded troll.

Not everything in Bramble is exactly how it seems - in this strange land with creatures big and small, you must be careful when to approach and when to hide. Many hungry and spiteful beasts lurk in these forests and caves. Watch your step....

Call upon the Spark of Courage, an enchanted fragment granting the gifts you need to endure the pitfalls and trials in your path. Defeat the horrid creatures you encounter in different and unique ways. Be warned, courage without kindness can take you down a dark path.

Key Features
• Adventure as Olle, a brave boy who sets off to rescue his sister.
• A beautiful yet dangerous world to explore.
• Encounter twisted, mythical creatures from Nordic folklore for epic-scale boss battles.
• Tense, heart-pounding moments with hi-end visuals to match.
70010000112499.intro: Bramble The Mountain King is a grim adventure set in a world inspired by dark, Nordic fables.
70010000112499.name: Bramble: The Mountain King

70010000112500.description:
Old Pete, “The Dock Yard”, is being demolished. He’s the first of his group of friends to go. It was unexpected and everyone is a bit worried.

Being made of bricks and mortar doesn’t mean you don’t have your own things to worry about.

This ragtag group of friends were there, right from the start, when it really became a city. With them they brought the titans of the industry, hundreds of jobs, and hundreds more houses. But the Linen Mill’s not been getting many textile orders come through this year, the Warehouse lost another contract from the neighbouring city and the Old Bank’s having money troubles.

Something’s not quite right. Change is coming. What if they’re next?

Fortunately, you, The Halfway Hotel, are at hand to step in and reassure everyone that things will be ok. But what starts off as small odd jobs ends up unravelling into more problems, as history moves faster than you can keep up with.

Buildings Have Feelings Too! is an exciting new city management game about buildings and the city they inhabit.

Imagine a city where buildings can walk and talk to one another. Each one has its own aspirations, hopes and fears. Most of the time they are just trying to get along with each other and make it through the day. Grow your city into a bustling metropolitan centre with an array of shops, offices, entertainment facilities and amenities, to help your buildings thrive; or risk them being demolished forever.

Features:
• Discover and equip a wide range of businesses from the Victorian era right through to the modern day.
• Befriend a range of Buildings, each with their own aspirations, hopes and fears, as they come to grips with the changing world around them.
• Customise and rearrange your city’s layout by moving buildings and find the perfect combination for your city to grow.
• Expand across multiple neighbourhoods of your city, discovering new landmark characters and districts.
70010000112500.intro: An exciting new city-management/puzzle game about buildings and the city they inhabit.
70010000112500.name: Buildings Have Feelings Too!

70010000112501.description:
Two rules: Don’t miss a delivery and don’t ask what’s in the package.

Your name is Rania. This is your first night working for Cloudpunk, the semi-legal delivery company based in the sprawling city of Nivalis. You go everywhere, from the Marrow below to the spires that pierce the grey clouds high above before scraping the edge of the troposphere. No delivery job is too dangerous, and no one is faster than a Cloudpunk driver.

In this story-based exploration game, you will meet a diverse range of characters including androids, AI and unscrupulous humans at every level of society. Everyone has a story, and in the course of one night in Nivalis, everything will change.

Features:
• Explore an immense vertical cyberpunk city with your hover car and on foot
• Unravel mysteries in a world of corporate conspiracy, hackers and rogue AI through the eyes of Rania
• Meet a diverse range of characters and immerse yourself in their everyday lives
• Your decisions will have a lasting impact on the inhabitants of Nivalis
• Discover hidden places and items unlocking additional stories
70010000112501.intro: A neon-noir story in a rain-drenched cyberpunk metropolis. It’s your first night on the job working for the Cloudpunk delivery service.
70010000112501.name: Cloudpunk

70010000112506.description:
Download Friend's Pass* to play Split Fiction with a friend for free on any platform! Try the early stages of the game in couch co-op or online cross-platform with another owner of the Friends Pass. If a friend owns the full game, you can join them for the entire adventure for free.

HERE'S HOW IT WORKS:
1. Own Split Fiction
2. Friend Downloads Friend’s Pass on chosen platform
3. Send invite to a friend
4. Play the entire game together!

One minute you’re taming adorable dragons and the next you’re fighting as cyber ninjas, escaping terrifying trolls, or dodging hover cars thrown by a robotic parking attendant. Split Fiction is weird, wild and designed to be shared. Grab a friend and get ready to overcome any obstacle thrown your way.

Embrace a mind-blow co-op action adventure from the studio behind 2021 Game of the Year Winner, It Takes Two. Mio and Zoe are contrasting writers – one writes sci-fi and the other writes fantasy – who become trapped in their own stories after being hooked up to a machine designed to steal their creative ideas. They’ll have to rely on each other to break free with their memories in-tact, working together to master a variety of abilities and overcome diverse challenges while jumping between sci-fi and fantasy worlds in this unexpected story of friendship.
70010000112506.intro: Experience a mind-blowing co-op adventure in Split Fiction
70010000112506.name: Split Fiction - Friend's Pass

70010000112519.description:
The Knights of the Cross is an RPG card game adapted from The Knights of the Cross by Nobel Prize-winning author Henryk Sienkiewicz. You will play as the knight Zbyszko and embark on a medieval adventure. Recruit companions, build your deck, and help the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth battle the Teutonic Order in the epic Battle of Grunwald.

【Recruit Allies, Join the Fight】
Recruit over 30 unique companions, each with their own storyline. Completing their storyline unlock exclusive items.
Each character is equipped with dynamic portraits and stunning ultimate abilities and effects, offering a rich visual experience.

【Unique Synergy, Build Your Strategy】
The innovative Teambuilding Combo System: The cards you play will dictate your allies' actions in the turn.
Combine cards and relics with your teammates' abilities to create powerful combat strategies like burn, bleed, poison, and more—offering fresh experiences on each playthrough.
Bosses come with their own special mechanics, such as cleansing their debuffs or limiting card types. Adapt your deck and tactics to break through tough encounters and feel the thrill of victory.

【Engaging Story, Immersive World】
A branching main story with multiple endings, allowing you to change the fate of the original characters.
Over a hundred side quests and random events that immerse you in medieval festivals, folk traditions, and daily life.
70010000112519.intro:
Build Your Deck. Lead Your Allies.
Face the Teutonic Knights. Rewrite the Ending.
70010000112519.name: The Knights of the Cross

70010000112535.description:
Step into the underground world of Osaka’s legendary highway racers in Kanjozoku Game: Car Racing & Highway
Driving Simulator REMASTER. Inspired by the iconic 90s street scene, this remastered experience puts you behind the wheel of authentic JDM machines, where speed, precision, and reputation define everything.

Take over the Kanjo loop at night, weave through dense traffic, and prove your dominance in high-speed battles. Every run is a test of skill—push your limits, outdrive your rivals, and rise through the underground ranks to become the most feared racer on the highway.

Build your ultimate car with deep and detailed customization. From performance tuning to visual styling, every upgrade shapes how your machine handles and how it stands out on the streets.

Key Features:
 ● Authentic 90s Osaka highway racing atmosphere with intense night driving and traffic challenges
 ● Wide selection of classic JDM cars with full tuning options: engine upgrades, swaps, suspension, and performance setups
 ● Extensive customization system including body parts, wheels, stance tuning, and custom liveries
 ● Multiple gameplay modes and activities: time-based challenges, traffic dodging, drifting, and competitive racing
 ● Dynamic world with car meets, hotspots, and high-speed police chases
 ● Progression system that rewards skillful driving, risk-taking, and race performance

Push beyond limits, own the highway, and become a true Kanjo legend.
70010000112535.intro: Master the neon streets and prove your skill against the fastest legends.
70010000112535.name: Kanjozoku Game: Car Racing & Highway Driving Simulator REMASTER

70010000112536.description:
The surface has been claimed by an Impact Winter but beneath the ice and earth, mankind hibernates. As a young apprentice mechanic, you wake up in the dark. The Power Plant is offline. The Water Treatment Plant seems to be too. The Cryo Colony is in danger!

What begins as a simple trip to fetch your mentor’s wrench sets off a winding journey through the caverns below to a vast Snowcean above to rescue friends, foes, and strangers alike.

Along the way, you'll find and master eight unassuming tools, each opening new paths for exploration. Starting with just the Crank Lantern to light your first steps into the dark and the Wrench Sword to swing at what you find lurking in it, you'll be bounding, drilling, gliding, stomping, and dashing your way across the world of the Ratcheteer by the time you reach the end.
70010000112536.intro: Explore the depths and brave a frozen Snowcean in this lo-fi action-adventure!
70010000112536.name: Ratcheteer DX

70010000112579.description:
Collect pieces of the plump and adorable “Buyowan” pups and complete the puzzle!
There are 15 stages in total.
As you clear each stage, the difficulty increases!
Stages 1–10: 30 pieces
Stages 11–15: 50 pieces
The final stage is a tough one with no background watermark!
Take your time and examine each piece to complete the puzzle!
When the puzzle is completed, you can hear the cute voice of “Buyowan”!
Clear all puzzles and complete your gallery ♪
=====================
At AGE, we support game streamers!
No permission is required for streaming this game.
70010000112579.intro: A puzzle game featuring slightly chubby doggies is here!
70010000112579.name: Puffy Dog Puzzle

70010000112586.description:
Party battle game "SUPER BOMBERMAN" is now available as a collection featuring a total of 8 titles with 13 versions across JP, EUR and USA, including the long-awaited localised versions of the unreleased SUPER BOMBERMAN 4 and 5!
Including Boss Rush mode to time attack against all the bosses in each title, support functions, libraries and more!

【Included Titles】

① SUPER BOMBERMAN [Japanese Version / US Version / European Version]
Mr. Karat, the evil power-hungry tyrant, and scientist Dr.Mukk! Defeat the robot army they command and thwart their ambitions!

② SUPER BOMBERMAN 2 [Japanese Version / US Version / European Version]
Our Bomberman has been captured by the sudden appearance of the vicious Bomber Quintet. For the sake of Earth's peace and his own destiny, he must confront them!

③ SUPER BOMBERMAN 3 [Japanese Version / European Version]
The evil Professor Bugler has revived the vicious Five Dastardly Bombers, once defeated by Bomberman, and has begun his march towards cosmic conquest.

④ SUPER BOMBERMAN 4 [Japanese Version (English localised version available)]
Bomberman has been transported to different eras by the Four Bomber Kings. What is their purpose? And what is the mysterious entity lurking in the shadows?

⑤ SUPER BOMBERMAN 5 [Japanese Version (English localised version available)]
A mysterious man calling himself the Emperor of another world, ‘Terrorin’. He has freed eight ‘Vicious Bombers’ from prison and begun an invasion with them as his subordinates.

⑥ Bomberman [Japanese Version]
The commemorative work that laid the foundation for the series. Conquer all 50 stages!

⑦ Bomberman II [Japanese Version]
The sequel to Bomberman. The work that implemented versus play.

⑧ Panic Bomber W [Japanese Version (English localization available)]
A competitive puzzle game up to 4 players.
Attack your opponents with special effects triggered by chain reactions and Big Bombs that appear when you fill the meter!

【Support Features, Helpful Functions and New Modes】

‘Boss Rush’
A challenge mode where you battle bosses from each game consecutively in a time attack!
*Panic Bomber W does not feature a boss rush.

‘Save/Load Anytime’
Save or load your game at any point during gameplay

‘Rewind Function’
A handy feature allowing you to rewind and retry at any point

‘Screen Filtering Function’
Adjust resolution or apply screen filters to play with your preferred visual settings

‘BOMB Radio’
Listen to original soundtracks from each title. You can also create your own playlists

‘Gallery’
Browse art works and development materials. Over 200 items in total!
70010000112586.intro: Hit party battle game series ‘SUPER BOMBERMAN’ now available as a collection!
70010000112586.name: SUPER BOMBERMAN COLLECTION

70010000112594.description:
*This title supports 4-8 players only and does not function with fewer participants. To play, each player must also use an internet‑connected smartphone, tablet, or PC.

A STORM IS COMING

Forest of Deceit is a social deduction game for 4 to 8 players. You are part of a group lost in a dark, treacherous forest that seems to go on forever and ever. You can’t find any escape, and there’s a storm brewing on the horizon - a storm so massive that you all will surely perish if you can’t build a solid shelter before it arrives. Every day you explore the forest to gather resources with which to build your shelter. But the forest itself is cursed, slowly driving people into a traitorous madness; it’s surely already got a hold on some of your friends’ minds… or maybe even yours. If you don’t figure out who’s sabotaging the efforts to build a shelter, you all are going to be swept away. On the other hand, if you happen to be the Traitor and they find you, you could get kicked out of the group - for good.


A FOREST OF LIES AND BETRAYAL

From the minds of Ghost Camp and Thomas Mackinnon comes Forest of Deceit, a back-stabbing experience about trying to survive a storm and betraying your friends. With a beautiful hand-drawn art style and a focus on casual play and social interaction, this party game is perfect for all kinds - from teenagers to grandpas, hardcore players to someone who’s never played a game in their life.

Each day, gathering parties are assigned to go deep into the forest for resources. Innocents will try to gather useful resources whereas Traitors will try to hinder the group’s advances with bad resources and try to get other players lost in the accursed woods. When the results of the day’s gathering are revealed, the group can discuss what happened - and after a few days there will even be a daily vote to expel suspected Traitors from the group. If the Innocents can build the shelter in time, they win! If not… it’s a victory for treachery.

Focusing on casual play and social interaction, Forest of Deceit is fun for all kinds of players - from a family experience to group meetings; from non-gamers to hardcore players!


FEATURES

- Gather resources to build a shelter against the upcoming storm. If you are a Traitor, you will try to get other people lost in the forest, and hinder the group’s efforts by collecting bad resources.

- Discuss what happened, and eventually start voting suspect Traitors out. If the Traitors can prevent the Innocents building a shelter in time, they win.

- Create your own house rules: An endlessly replayable party game, with fully customisable game options.

- Use your own phones, tablets, or computers for each player to play right from their very own web browser.

NOTE: No generative AI was used in the making of this game or its associated assets.
70010000112594.intro: Find the Traitors in this social deduction game for 4-8 players.
70010000112594.name: Forest of Deceit

70010000112608.description:
Animal Coloring Books for Kids & Toddlers – Dinosaurs. The perfect fun game for your kid.

The game can be played directly on the device’s touchscreen using a finger. Children simply tap, paint, and get creative!

Kids start by choosing a dinosaur line-art image and then enter the canvas area, where they can color the picture and freely paint in the background. The line-art can also be disabled, allowing children to draw on a blank canvas.

A wide selection of colors, brushes, and fill tool is available. The size of each drawing tool can be adjusted, and all buttons and tools can be hidden so only the drawing area remains visible.

It’s the perfect creative experience for young children to improve hand-eye coordination, explore colors, and enjoy a fun artistic journey with friendly dinosaurs.
70010000112608.intro: Lovingly designed coloring book full of child-friendly dinosaur illustrations
70010000112608.name: Animal Coloring Books for Kids & Toddlers - Dinosaurs

70010000112617.description:
Stranded by the sea. Surrounded by danger. Driven to survive.

After a violent storm destroys your ship, you wake up alone on a remote tropical island. With nothing but the wreckage around you and the ocean full of unknown threats, survival becomes your only goal. Every resource matters. Every dive is a risk. And escape is not guaranteed.

In Island Survival 2026: Craft, Build, Grow, you must explore both the island and the depths below the water. Search beaches, jungles, reefs, and sunken ships to gather materials, craft essential tools, and slowly build everything you need to stay alive. Hunger, thirst, storms, and predators constantly test your endurance, while limited oxygen turns underwater exploration into a race against time.

To escape the island, you must construct a boat piece by piece — hull, sail, and rudder. But the final blueprint lies hidden deep inside a sunken ship, guarded by sharks and dangerous currents. Only by crafting better equipment, managing resources wisely, and pushing further into the unknown can you claim your way home.
Survival is not about speed. It’s about preparation, courage, and learning from the world around you.

Key Features
- Island survival gameplay with crafting and resource management
- Underwater exploration with oxygen limits and environmental threats
- Boat construction as the main progression goal
- Dynamic survival systems: hunger, thirst, storms, and hazards
- Semi-open world with beaches, jungles, reefs, and shipwrecks
- Story elements revealed through exploration

Survive the island.
Build your escape.
Leave the ocean behind.
70010000112617.intro: Survive the island. Build your way home.
70010000112617.name: Island Survival 2026: Craft, Build, Grow

70010000112634.description:
Embark on an epic adventure in Aarik And The Ruined Kingdom, a relaxing and family-friendly perspective puzzle game that blends heart warming storytelling with mind-bending challenges.

Join Aarik as he journeys through enchanted castles, mystical forests, vast deserts, eerie swamps, and frozen tundra, all while solving intricate puzzles to reunite his family. Harness the power of your father’s magical crown, equipped with four enchanted gemstones, to reshape the world around you.

Fix crumbling bridges, mend broken paths, make new allies, and even reverse time itself! Dive into a world full of unique levels and devious puzzles in this captivating quest to find Aarik’s mother and restore hope to a broken land.
70010000112634.intro: Use the King's magic crown to solve perspective puzzles and fix a broken kingdom.
70010000112634.name: Aarik And The Ruined Kingdom

70010000112644.description:
Explore Bluey’s World of Play!

Join everyone's favorite blue heeler with a new story by the show's creator in Bluey's Quest for The Gold Pen.

When Dad snatches the Gold Pen Bluey needs to finish her drawing, Bluey and her family are swept into a world of fun and adventure. Explore charming, hand-drawn worlds, uncover hidden treasures, and solve playful puzzles as you help bring the Gold Pen home.

Written by Joe Brumm, this original story features fully-animated cutscenes and exploration-focused gameplay, designed to be enjoyed by fans of all ages.

Key Features:

An Original Bluey Story. Written by Bluey creator, Joe Brumm, this adventure captures the warmth, humor, and heart of the beloved series.

A World Drawn from Play. Explore nine charming, hand-drawn worlds — from golden beaches and snowy mountains to the iconic Australian Outback and beyond.

Wild Rides & Playful Exploration. Travel by boat, bike, jetpack, and glider on a fun-filled quest.

Fun Challenges & Playful Puzzles. Help Bluey and Bingoose outwit pesky cane toads, sleepy council workers, and naughty bin chickens by finding clues, solving puzzles, and uncovering hidden treasures.

Fully-Animated Story Moments. Expressive cutscenes bring Bluey’s world and adventures to life.

An Experience for the Whole Family. Easy-to-learn controls make this adventure fun to watch, share, and take turns playing.
70010000112644.intro: Join Bluey in a heartfelt, story-driven adventure. Explore hand-drawn worlds and enjoy an original family-friendly story written by Bluey creator, Joe Brumm.
70010000112644.name: Bluey's Quest For The Gold Pen

70010000112652.description:
At sonic speeds, Aureole - Wings of Hope takes platforming to the literal skies! Join Ramila and Ryleth on their crusade to reclaim their home from demonic forces in this unique physics-based side-scrolling game.

Turn into the fastest halo ever! Join Ramila and Ryleth on their high-speed crusade to reclaim their home from demonic forces in this unique physics-based platformer. Master precision movement as you dash, bounce, and soar through levels designed to push you to supersonic speeds with smooth and responsive controls.

Ages after the demons were banished, a new threat looms over the Heaven Kingdom. The demonic army has returned, stronger than ever, led by the self-proclaimed Demon King Lazel, who seeks to conquer the angels’ domain once and for all.

Features:
-Explore vibrant biomes, each expanding gameplay and mechanics.
-Easy to learn, fun to master.
-Upbeat soundtrack to fuel your speed.
-Climb global leaderboards and surpass your limits.
-Discover hidden collectibles.

[Voice Cast] Yomichi Yuki/ Sugiura Nayuta / Masaki Yukiya / Tsuda Takuma / Ota Atsuko / Ota Mitsutoshi
*Japanese voice
70010000112652.intro: Speed merges with precision in this celestial adventure!
70010000112652.name: Aureole - Wings of Hope

70010000112664.description:
Long ago, when the world was engulfed in black mist, the surviving humans escaped to the Ark.

There's only one way to restore the world:
seek out the hidden Time Shades and activate the Clock Tower.
The Clock Tower will surely restore the world to a time of peace.

Awakening in the Twisted Land beneath the Ark,
Lucy finds she has no memories other than the words "Activate the Clock Tower"...

She joins forces with her companions and sets out in search of the Time Shades.

Blending RPG and card game elements

Recruit up to 4 companions and build the strongest party based on their skills and abilities. The skills of Lucy, the protagonist, and her companions are available as cards. Your choices determine what skills they learn!

Defeat is nothing to fear

Unlike traditional RPGs, everything resets when your party gets defeated, and new companions and skills become available. Perfect your strategy with each iteration.
70010000112664.intro: Chrono Ark, the deck-building roguelike RPG. Recruit companions with distinct personalities, build a party that maximizes skill synergies, and save the Twisted World!
70010000112664.name: Chrono Ark Deluxe Edition

70010000112672.description:
Do you have a sharp eye? We challenge you to test it! Find 20 differences between two similar images. But beware, they change every time you attempt it!



- 10 levels with changing differences to find (we didn't really count all the combinations, sorry!)
- cute holiday-themed items
- hints
70010000112672.intro: Can you find the differences between the two festive images?
70010000112672.name: There's No Differences: Santa

70010000112714.description:
Brawl your way through the streets and mall in the View Askewniverse as Jay and Silent Bob where you unleash a dizzying array of irreverent combos, special moves, collect and summon assists, in this over-the-top beat ‘em up. You’ll need to harness every ounce of smoke-fueled creativity to get past the throngs of hockey-stick wielding teenage thugs, dookie demons, hipsters with babies, old grumpy danglers and massive, movie-inspired boss battles. 

Jay and Silent Bob: Chronic Blunt Punch combines incredible stylized, hand drawn animation, character design, and over the top combat and badass catchphrases in a side-scrolling, tag-team, beat-’em-up. Our heroes embark on an epic adventure from their humble, suburban New Jersey Quick Stop to an unearthed mystical mall that has unleashed an evil hold on the city.

No matter if you play solo and tag swap between characters or with your hetero lifemate in couch co-op, you’ll be performing special moves and outrageous combos. 

Developed with the full blessing, enthusiasm and voice-acting quips from Jason Mewes and Kevin Smith themselves, Chronic Blunt Punch gives players the ultimate, profound, and profane Jay and Silent Bob experience.

Features

- Hand-Drawn Art and Animation: Incredibly detailed, expressive and highly inspired hand-drawn animations.

- Insane combos: Bust out a cornucopia of irreverent special moves and combos that link together to create explosive finishers.

- Super Moves: Build up your super meter to launch video game inspired super attacks or save up your super meter and transform Jay and Silent Bob into Bluntman and Chronic to freeze time and deliver a devastating attack.

- Local Co-Op: Play solo or with your hetero lifemate with two-player couch co-op. Tag you’re it, snackpack.

- Cameo-palooza: During your journey, interact with cameo characters from the Viewaskewniverse and call them in to help you during intense moments.
70010000112714.intro: Play solo or with your hetero lifemate in this hand drawn, arcade style, side-scrolling beat-em-up blessed by Jay and Silent Bob themselves.
70010000112714.name: Jay and Silent Bob: Chronic Blunt Punch

70010000112721.description:
Enjoy the relaxing puzzle of Habitat Shapes by organizing spaces for three animal families – mammals, birds, and reptiles – using Fence/Wall pieces to keep them separated. Watch out: different families cannot touch, and any attempt triggers a funny “fight cloud,” sending the last piece back to the conveyor.

With 30 levels split between the structured Urban Zoo and the organic Safari Sanctuary, Habitat Shapes offers short, accessible, and reversible challenges. Pick, rotate, and place pieces on the grid, experiment with undo and restart, and find the perfect layout of space and barriers. Each move brings small victories and satisfying moments without time pressure, letting you enjoy a flawlessly organized zoo.

Perfect for fans of spatial organization, subtle visual humor, and puzzles that reward smart experimentation.
70010000112721.name: Habitat Shapes

70010000112736.description: Step into the next generation of management simulation. In Hotel Simulator 2026, you don't just run the business—you save it. Clean up neglected properties, manage staff, satisfy guests, and turn a dirty parking lot into a 5-star empire.
70010000112736.intro: Hotel Simulator 2026: Clean up the Past, Build Your Future.
70010000112736.name: Hotel Simulator 2026

70010000112745.description:
Amane, Tia, and Lill lived peacefully with their father, Kalius, until his sudden disappearance shattered their lives. Ten years later, a chance meeting with a magus named Rett pulls Amane and Tia into a dangerous journey. In a world where magi are feared and persecuted, standing up for Rett makes Amane a fugitive. As they flee from the law, the siblings search for answers and the truth behind their father’s fate.

Fortuna Magus features strategic turn-based battles built around revelations and TP (Technical Points). Learn new spells and tandem attacks by meeting combat conditions, manage TP to unleash devastating special skills, and strengthen characters through element levels using magestones. Deep customization and rewarding progression await long after the story ends.
70010000112745.intro: A fantasy RPG where magic is forbidden and destiny begins to move
70010000112745.name: Fortuna Magus

70010000112763.description:
Enjoy a variety of wintry party games with simple controls!
From snowball fights to battles on the ice, there's winter fun for everyone!
Up to six players can join the fun with one Joy-Con™ per person!
Whether you're partying with family and friends or playing solo, there's a mode for every mood!

[Free Mode]
Pick a game and play!
Practice on your own or face off against friends!

[Party Mode]
Play a series of games to determine the champion!
Win or lose, the fun never stops!

[Online Mode]
Battle it out on snowy stages with players from around the world!
Hop into a Quick Match for fast and thrilling fun!
70010000112763.intro:
Slide around, throw snowballs, and aim to be champion!
Play solo or together—the winter party begins!
70010000112763.name: Slide! Throw! Snow Party

70010000112793.description:
The most entertaining and challenging Clutter yet with over 1800 puzzles to keep you playing for days and days.
So many new Clutter variations mixed in with old favorites for a Quest you'll never forget.
The newest variation you won't want to miss are the Petal Puzzles
And just like regular Clutter levels, they are highly  addicting too.
In addition, there are Sliders, Square Jigsaws and Box Quotes.
And wait until you see the Flowers used as Stackers.
You've never seen Clutter this challenging.
New Mah Jong Modes that let you play Mah Jong your way.
And Favorites allow you to collect the puzzles you want to play again and again.

x1 - New Object Sets and Many New Gameplay Modes
x2 - Over 1800 levels including a very challenging 100 level Main Quest
x3 - Extra easy No-Motion Old-School area
x4 - All new Petal Puzzles that you won't believe
x5 - New Mah Jong Modes that make Mah Jong even more fun
x6 - Hundreds of picture puzzles and 200 new Box Quotes puzzles
x7 - Randomly generated levels mean endless replayability
x8 - Another Great Soundtrack with a Cinematic Feel
70010000112793.intro: Clutter surprizes again and again with amazing new variations!
70010000112793.name: Clutter 17 Flower Power Collector's Edition

70010000112818.description:
Experience fast-paced highway action in Highway Traffic Pro, a thrilling car-driving game where your reflexes and skill determine how far you can go. Steer through busy lanes, avoid collisions, and race against intense traffic as speeds climb and challenges increase.

Choose from multiple cars, each offering unique handling and performance. Collect coins, complete missions, and unlock upgrades to improve acceleration, braking, and top speed. Dynamic weather, different times of day, and varying traffic patterns keep every drive fresh and exciting.

Whether you prefer quick runs or long endurance drives, Highway Traffic Pro delivers smooth controls, vibrant visuals, and nonstop road action. Test your skills, set new high scores, and prove you're the ultimate highway driver.

Features:
Exciting highway racing with increasing difficulty
Multiple cars to unlock and upgrade
Smooth and responsive driving controls
Dynamic traffic, weather, and time-of-day changes
Missions, rewards, and endless gameplay challenges
High score system and progression-based unlocks
70010000112818.intro:
Highway Traffic Racing
Fast Car Driving
Extreme Road Challenge
70010000112818.name: Highway Traffic Pro

70010000112831.description:
"LABYRINTH RUNNER" is a shooting game released by KONAMI in 1988.
You set off on a journey towards the castle where the evil Devil awaits, in order to rescue the kidnapped Princess Papaya.
Be wary of the various traps along the way, and use three types of projectiles to defeat enemies appearing from all directions as you advance!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.
70010000112831.intro: Pit your wits against the Devil!!
70010000112831.name: Arcade Archives LABYRINTH RUNNER

70010000112850.description:
Celebrating the 20th anniversary of the Kiseki series, a story-driven RPG that began in 2004, the landmark first installment, The Legend of Heroes: Sora no Kiseki FC (First Chapter), is receiving a full remake!

The Liberl Kingdom, the setting of the adventure, is brought to life in stunning 3D, with refined designs for all characters, including the vibrant Estelle and Joshua.

Enjoy seamless transitions between two battle modes: field action and command battles. The remake also features dynamic presentations of each character's special abilities (Crafts) and elemental magic (Arts), delivering exhilarating and stress-free combat.
While retaining the picturesque charm of the Liberl Kingdom, the game offers various quests and extensive side content, allowing players to immerse themselves in the journey through the kingdom from a fresh perspective.

Estelle and Joshua embark on a journey across the Liberl Kingdom, spurred by the mysterious disappearance of their father, Cassius.

Meet new allies, experience heartfelt farewells, and uncover the fate that awaits the two at the end of their journey...
70010000112850.name: Sora no Kiseki the 1st

70010000112869.description:
Do you like platforming, exploration, and plumbing...? Uh, I mean... play-dough?! Well, we may not have pipes, but we can give you 64 reasons to join Crosak’s daring adventures.

1.	Become a real caveman jumping and clubbing your way through a multi-gravity universe made of sticky play-dough: six open worlds full of secrets plus three special worlds with everything a galaxy could wish for.

2.	Invite your favorite second player to have fun with Crosak and his friend Ena! Enjoy the full adventure in one- or two-player mode, switching whenever you like.

3.	Face crazy “Jurassic-inspired” enemies — from giant carnivorous plants to karate dinosaurs or our take on the missing link (the Kobi).

4.	Experiment with various power-ups to overcome the twisted planets’ challenges: anti-gravity feathers, rock-helmet, or flaming club, to name a few.

64.	And let’s not forget the main mission! Rescue the 60 cavemen from Routine Village captured by the fearsome warlock Double G. 60 objectives with all kinds of missions: races, pterodactyl flights, mini-games, free falls, T-Rex rides, powerful boss fights, and much more.

Don’t overthink it — give your world a spin with Crosak!
70010000112869.intro: Turn your world around and join Crosak on his Jurassic adventure in a multi-gravity playdough universe.
70010000112869.name: Crosak

70010000112882.description:
Return to the dark world of Nosgoth as you take control of both the vampire Kain and his betrayed lieutenant Raziel, two powerful entities bound by the conflict between free will and fate.

Armed with legendary blades and supernatural abilities, battle through towering gothic spaces filled with enemies, puzzles, and long-buried secrets – where no victory comes without a cost.

Experience a timeless dark fantasy reborn for a new generation

Legacy of Kain: Defiance Remastered has been updated with new HD graphics, refined controls, and a modernized game camera with the ability to toggle between the HD and original presentation any time. This new edition also boasts a photo mode, alternate character skins, a comprehensive lore reader, and unreleased content and 'lost levels' from the original game.

Dual Protagonist
Play as both Kain and Raziel, each with distinct abilities, combat styles, and perspectives that shape how the story unfolds.

Dark Fantasy and Rewarding Puzzles
Explore ruined cities, ancient temples, and towering strongholds filled with environmental puzzles, challenging enemies, and horrible secrets.

Faithfully Remastered for Modern Play
Updated HD visuals, refined controls, and a modernized camera, with the option to switch between modern and classic presentation at any time.

Character Skins
Earn alternate skins for both Kain and Raziel inspired by the Legacy of Kain canon.

This remaster includes fully localized UI and subtitles for all supported languages but some bonus and archival materials including the Encyclopedia, Lost Levels introductions, Arcane Tomes, and archival Comics are in English only.
70010000112882.intro: Armed with legendary blades and supernatural abilities, explore the dark world of Nosgoth.
70010000112882.name: Legacy of Kain: Defiance Remastered

70010000112920.description:
Who is Here? is a psychological horror game where the player is trapped in an abandoned hospital. The protagonist must survive 8 long and terrifying days, exploring corridors, wards, and hidden rooms to uncover the presence of strange anomalies.

Each day, the player must search the entire location and carefully observe the environment. Sometimes the walls seem to breathe, a shadow flashes by the window, or whispers echo from an empty ward. But sometimes… everything looks normal.

At the end of each day, the player must make a choice:

Green Sphere — if no anomaly was detected that day.

Red Sphere — if an anomaly was present.

The choice determines the outcome:

A correct decision advances the player to the next day.

A wrong decision resets all progress, and the cycle begins from Day 1.
70010000112920.intro: Nothing happened. Or did it? Keep attention.
70010000112920.name: Who is Here?

70010000112966.description:
In a place in Albuquerque, New Mexico, USA, a strange accident occurred on October 27, 1986. Everything was recorded on a VHS tape.

Enter the eerie world of Backrooms Level X, a first-person horror game that immerses you in an endless labyrinth of desolate and surreal spaces. After a freak accident, you find yourself trapped in the Backrooms, a place where logic and reality vanish.  Explore endless corridors of yellow carpet, empty rooms and areas of flickering light as you try to find a way out. But beware: you are not alone. Mysterious entities lurk in the shadows, and every sound may be the last you hear.

Features:

Immersive Exploration: Navigate an immersive environment made with unique level design. Discover hidden secrets and an immersive narrative that will draw you into the story.

Atmospheric Horror: Immerse yourself in an oppressive atmosphere with immersive sound effects and haunting graphics that will keep you on the edge of your seat.

Challenges and Puzzles: Solve riddles and face challenges that will test your wits as you try to escape from the Backrooms.

Varied Environments: Backrooms Level X consists of more than 15 levels to explore. Discover the intricacies of the story and enemies, keeping each game a fresh and exciting experience.

Defiant Bosses: Get out unscathed from huge final enemies. Throughout the exploration, we will encounter gigantic bosses that we will have to defeat with our wits.

Do you have what it takes to survive in the Backrooms? The only way out is to face your fears and discover the truth behind this terrifying place. Download Backrooms Level X and begin your journey into the unknown!
70010000112966.intro: Enter the disturbing world of Backrooms Level X, a first-person narrative survival horror game that immerses you in an endless labyrinth of desolate and liminal spaces.
70010000112966.name: Backrooms Level X

70010000112967.description:
[Game Overview]
A roguelite action game set in the BLAZBLUE universe, featuring striking 2D visuals, stylish, fast-paced combat, and precise, responsive controls.
Command a line-up of unique characters from the renowned BLAZBLUE franchise and dive into an unparalleled action experience.

[Story]
At a mysterious domain, known as “the Lab”,a group of elite researchers race to save a collapsing word; however, despite their efforts to date, Dr. Mercurius, head of the laboratory, still warns the world’s downfall is near.
In a last-ditch effort, the urgent *Research of Possibility* initiative seeks to collect *Shards of Possibility*—a special fragment of the world that could forestall the seemingly inevitable destruction.
These shards lie within the *Sea of Possibility*, a realm between worlds, beyond the bounds of reality.
Our protagonist, *Ace*, is the only being capable of diving into this sea.
Guided by the elite researchers at *the Lab*, Ace descends again and again in pursuit of salvation—until strange visions take hold and his body begins to change.
As Ace continues to dive, countless memories flood his mind, and the truth behind the collapsing world—and the research itself—begins to surface....

“……The Power of Azure.”
70010000112967.name: BlazBlue Entropy Effect X

70010000112970.description:
Move through 3D space to find hints, solve mysteries and escape from the room.
Anyone can play to the end because you can see hints and answers.
70010000112970.name: Escape game R00M03

70010000112971.description: Play with 4-15 players online or via local WiFi as you attempt to prepare your spaceship for departure, but beware as one or more random players among the Crew are Impostors bent on killing everyone!
70010000112971.intro: An online and local party game of teamwork and betrayal for 4-15 players...in space!
70010000112971.name: Among Us

70010000112972.description:
<Features>
1. Roguelike gameplay, with a different map with each playthrough.
2. Various guns can be picked up in the base. Make use of their features and plan your strategy.
3. There is no reloading or refilling ammunition. Even if you don't have a gun, you can utilize a beam knife for close quarter combat.
4. Unlike twin-stick shooters, your weapon automatically aims at the enemy when within range.
5. You're invincible while dashing. Use this to dodge enemy bullets.
6. Acquire random gear to upgrade the protagonist.
7. Save up money to buy guns and gear at the store.
8. Once you fight a boss, you can unlock a practice mode for them.
9. There are unlockable elements that can be carried over in easy and normal game modes.
10. In expert mode, there are no carry over elements at all. Use only your skills as a player to break your enemies.
70010000112972.intro: A 2.5D top-down, roguelike shooter set in a base that has been taken over by a revolt of robots.
70010000112972.name: Gunner-chan!

70010000112978.description:
A classic horror inspired by the original survival games of the 90s, EBOLA VILLAGE — is a modern take on a first-person adventure where the main character Maria investigates the mysterious events that took place in Russia. Maria is sitting in her apartment watching her favorite series, the transmission is interrupted, and a live broadcast about a biological threat begins. Maria goes to the village to visit her mother and her ex-husband Ruslan...and terrible things start to happen there...
You have to understand the intricate history, and find out what happened, and who is involved in this.

The well-developed setting of the game will completely immerse you in the atmosphere of the Russian village.
70010000112978.intro: A classic 90s survival horror game with an emphasis on atmosphere
70010000112978.name: EBOLA VILLAGE

70010000112994.description:
Road Champions is a high-octane racing game where style meets speed. Tame the roads of the countryside, master the art of turbo boosting, and dominate a world built for speed and glory.
These modern champion riders charge through diverse tracks – be it dusty desert roads, ramshackle junkyards, or winding country lanes. Beat your opponents, compete in time trials, and participate in champion tournaments in single-player – or challenge a friend for a cutthroat couch multiplayer race!
Enjoy arcade car racing action with 16 upgradeable and customizable vehicles on 12 different racing tracks.
It is time to hit the gas!
Features
•	16 cars – Collect, upgrade, and customize your vehicles.
•	12 racing tracks – Rush through different environments.
•	A variety of boosts – Get an edge over your opponents!
•	Choose your difficulty – Set your AI opponents’ skill to Easy, Medium, or Hard for a customizable challenge.
•	3 driver modes – Change your view to third-person, first-person, or close-up mode: what fits your racing style?
Game Modes
•	Tournament mode – Play multiple rounds against the same opponents. Collect points each round in Race, Elimination, or Time Trial modes.
•	Quick Race mode – Play a simple round on a chosen track against AI opponents.
•	Time Trial challenge – Beat set track times or your own best time.
•	Hotseat – Play against your friends for a round of split-screen multiplayer.
Earn your place among the Road Champions, where every race is a fight for glory and every second counts!
70010000112994.intro: Full throttle racing: no brakes, no mercy.
70010000112994.name: Road Champions

70010000113000.description:
Night Swarm is a vampire-themed roguelite RPG bullet hell where you play as a fearsome young vampire lord rising to power. Gather loyal allies, unleash devastating abilities, and fight back against the relentless werewolf hordes that threaten to consume the night.

BUILD YOUR SWARM. TEAR THROUGH THE PACK.
Ancient powers of the dark stand behind you, each offering unique, cursed blessings to aid your ascent.
Uncover why these shadowy forces have chosen to support you, unravel the truth behind the age-old war between vampires and werewolves, and delve into the haunted pasts of your companions as you push deeper into the cursed lands.
The night is yours—and you are hungry.

GROW STRONG — AND MAKE OTHERS STRONGER
Let your legend travel faster than your shadow, becoming a beacon of hope for those still resisting in the dark.
They await a new Vampire Lord—a leader worthy of the night. That leader is you.
Rally them to your side. Show them how to fight. And remind the world that the true terror of the night... is you.

YOU HAVE WORK TO DO TONIGHT
Aid friendly creatures, uncover hidden treasures, restore the natural order, and bring balance back to the night.
Sometimes you'll help your allies. Sometimes—even your enemies. Because to truly reclaim the night, it's not enough to defeat your foes; you must also ensure your friends rise with you.
By guiding others to victory, you earn their trust—and their aid in your fight against ancient evils. The night is a delicate web of power, and only those who understand its balance can hope to survive it.
70010000113000.intro: Vampiric roguelite RPG where you rise and battle werewolf hordes.
70010000113000.name: Night Swarm

70010000113009.description:
Put yourself in the paws of the world’s cheekiest feline and turn Granny's peaceful home into your own chaotic playground! In Angry Cat, you’ll sneak, scratch, and smash your way through a fully interactive 3D house filled with secrets, surprises, and, most importantly, breakable items.

Cause mischief everywhere: knock over vases, scratch furniture, steal snacks, and outsmart Granny before she catches you. Each prank earns you laughs, chaos points, and hilarious reactions from your not-so-patient human.

Customize your cat with different skins and outfits. Unlock new rooms and discover hidden shortcuts as you claw your way from the living room to the attic and beyond! With smooth first-person controls and funny animations, every level is a new chance to sharpen your claws and stir up trouble, all while Granny is hot on your tail.

Do you have what it takes to be the ultimate prankster cat? Get ready to break the rules, dodge Granny’s wrath, and cause the funniest mayhem ever!
70010000113009.name: Angry Cat

70010000113025.description:
Step into the aromatic world of Barista Life Simulator 2026 and live the dream of running your own coffee shop! Feel the buzz of your café, the warmth of fresh coffee, and the excitement of serving happy customers. Every cup you craft tells a story, and every decision shapes the success of your business.

Welcome guests, prepare exquisite drinks, and manage your café down to the smallest detail. Master recipes from creamy lattes to bold americanos, expand your space, upgrade equipment, and decorate your shop to create a cozy, inviting atmosphere.

Key Features:
• Realistic Coffee Recipes: Craft americanos, cappuccinos, lattes, and more with precise steps.
• Café Customization: Upgrade furniture, equipment, and licenses to grow your business.
• Stock & Inventory: Keep shelves filled with snacks, croissants, juices, and water.
• Manage Staff: Hire helpers to handle cleaning, stocking, and warehouse tasks.
• Financial Strategy: Balance budgets, take loans if needed, and expand wisely.

Every day brings new challenges, new customers, and new opportunities. Can you become the ultimate barista and build the café of your dreams? Start brewing, serve perfection, and watch your café come to life!
70010000113025.intro: Build your café, delight your customers, grow your empire.
70010000113025.name: Barista Life Simulator 2026

70010000113027.description:
INTO THE ABYSS
The most dangerous criminals are convicted and sent to Kletka. Your sentence is to descend into the depths of the Gigastructure while maintaining a living and hungry elevator. Never forget to feed it if you don't want to end up being eaten alive. Kletka is omnivorous, be ready to feed it both fuel and flesh.

GIGASTRUCTURE
The Gigastructure is an endlessly expanding building. Traps and anomalies fill the corridors. Any stop you make could be your last.

SAMOSBOR
Samosbor is a mysterious anomaly that kills anything in its path. This terrifying phenomenon is feared by all inhabitants as no one has ever survived it. When you hear the siren, it's time to drop everything and run to the elevator as fast as you can. Kletka is the only thing that can protect you from this anomaly.

TOGETHER
Form a team of up to six people and descend in the elevator. Friends tend to survive when they work together, but friends also make for good fuel.
70010000113027.intro: KLETKA is a co-op (up to 6 players) horror game about going down in an elevator that is trying to eat you.
70010000113027.name: KLETKA

70010000113033.description:
The action is faster, the stakes are higher, and the possibilities are endless in this cybermyth roguelike. With explosive run 'n' gun gameplay, diverse combat styles, and unlimited item synergies, Neon Abyss 2 delivers a dramatic, thrill-packed experience every time you enter.

NEW 4 PLAYER CO-OP!
Team Work makes the Dream Work!
Neon Abyss 2 introduces exhilarating online 4-player co-op, allowing you and up to three friends to dive into the roguelike chaos together. Band together to multiply each of your unique synergies and combos, creating powerful forces of destruction. Coordinate your builds and conquer the Abyss as a team, even exploring different
rooms within the same map to maximize efficiency and uncover hidden secrets and treasures.

UNIMAGINABLE WEAPONRY
A Revolutionary Weapon System
What's your combat style? Smash enemies up close with a bat or saber, unleash attacks with deadly plants, or command fierce dragon-like creatures to fight for you—the choice is yours! With limitless options and an inventive arsenal, every run lets you experiment with unique, wild ways to conquer the Abyss.

UNLIMTED  ITEM SYNERGIES
Even More Monstrous!
Random item drops in the Abyss grant you powers that combine in surprising and powerful ways. Stack as many as you can to create wild, unstoppable synergies that make every run feel unique. Show the Abyss who’s really in charge—there’s no limit to how many items you can wield!

HATCH THEM ALL!
Hatchmon! I choose you!
Your favourite Abyss companions, now in even brighter colours! Hatch and collect these cute creatures, then evolve them into powerful and unique allies to spice up your runs. With a wide variety of Hatchmon to discover, each run brings new possibilities!

THE POWER OF FAITH
Turn the Tides!
Introducing the all-new Faith System, designed to turn the tides when the Abyss gets tough. How will you wield this power? Spend it in a shop stocked with powerful items, recruit more Hatchmon to fight by your side, or... risk it all in a game of chance? Either way, we have faith in you!

...AND MORE!
Discover as You Explore
Uncover a host of new features and surprises in this dynamic second instalment. From new enemies and powerful gods, to updated loot and hidden secrets, there’s always something fresh to discover. The Abyss awaits—dive deeper and uncover secrets you may not face alone!
70010000113033.intro: Dive deeper into the chaotic, beautifully pixelated Abyss with Neon Abyss 2!
70010000113033.name: Neon Abyss 2

70010000113050.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 30 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.
70010000113050.intro: Meet over 30 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000113050.name: Sugoi Girls: Victoria Vogue

70010000113051.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 30 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.
70010000113051.intro: Meet over 30 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000113051.name: Anime Girls: College Love

70010000113052.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 30 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.
70010000113052.intro: Meet over 30 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000113052.name: Anime Girls: Tokyo Christmas

70010000113073.description:
Trash Goblin is a wholesome and cosy shopkeeping game where you uncover and clean trinkets for sale! Customise them by upcycling and more to meet the eccentric requests of your endless colourful, customers. Spend your savings to upgrade your shop, buy new and better tools, and customise your space! There is no pressure, no risk, no right way to play - it is not a simulator - it's just good vibes and nice customers to serve.

DISCOVER PECULIAR TRINKETS
Unearth knick-knacks of all kinds by chipping away at the dirt and cruft they're embedded inside, wrestling with different types of dirt that yield in different ways.

RESTORE FORGOTTEN CURIOS TO GLORY
Scrub all these strange items up nice and clean with your sponge to get them ready for sale!

UPCYLE INTO IMAGINATIVE NEW FORMS!
Customise these curios by combining Trinkets together, turning them into strange and wonderful new items!

SELL TO A PARADE OF COLOURFUL CUSTOMERS
A wide range of intriguing, odd and charming customers will frequent your store, some with interesting stories to tell, others after a particular object, some just browsing...

UPGRADE YOUR WORKSHOP
Spend your savings to expand your tool set, and unlock more space to work in. Buy a display mat to tempt customers with specific wares, or a soak tub to clean up overnight, an honesty box for getting rid of unwanted trinkets, and more!

TREAT YOURSELF
Customise your space, decorate your shelves however you like, get some nice plants, change up the wallpaper and bedclothes; make it your own!

MAXIMUM CHILL, ZERO PRESSURE
There's a gentle limit to how much you can do in a given day but customers will return, you can potter as much as you like, and there are no fail states.

FEATURES:
• Hundreds of Trinkets and Accessories with 1000s of combinations and variations to find, clean, upcycle, sell and collect.
• Multiple Tools to buy, upgrade and use across 3 Trinket-care minigames.
• Make life easier with the Coffee Pot, Soak Tub, and other handy gadgets.
• Expand your shop with shelves, storage, and more.
• 4 distinct locations to visit and sell in.
• Customise your shop with cosmetics covering bedclothes, wallpapers, and more.
• 40 unique NPC characters to get to know and sell to.
• 120+ Quests to complete.
• 20+ hours of story content.
• Endless randomised customers.
• Endless gameplay.
70010000113073.name: Trash Goblin

70010000113085.description:
Play as Makoto Hayakawa, a college student spending her summer behind the counter of a small-town convenience store, in a colorful world inspired by early 1990s Japan.

Your days are shaped by simple, tactile actions. You stock shelves, tidy displays, and prepare the store for customers, not to optimize numbers, but to settle into a comforting rhythm. Between tasks, you explore the store and its surroundings, notice tiny details, and connect with regulars whose lives gently intertwine with yours.

Through branching conversations and meaningful choices, your interactions shape relationships and reveal intimate stories of a close-knit neighborhood.

Key Features
A Cozy, Routine-Driven Store Experience

Engage in light storekeeping activities like stocking items, organizing shelves, and ordering goods. These moments create a calming flow that supports exploration and storytelling rather than complex management.

Narrative Focused Interactions
Experience branching dialogue and meaningful choices as you learn about the lives, routines, and secrets of your customers.

Nostalgic Early 1990s Atmosphere
Immerse yourself in a Japan-inspired setting with soft visuals, warm lighting, and lovingly crafted details that evoke comfort and familiarity.

Toy Capsule Surprises
Collect and discover charming capsule toys from the store’s gachapon machine. Each capsule holds a small surprise, adding moments of delight and curiosity to your daily routine and inviting you to uncover every little treasure inside.

Soothing ASMR Inspired Soundscape
Enjoy a peaceful ASMR-like soundscape filled with subtle everyday sounds that enhance relaxation and presence.

This product is released for the Nintendo Switch. It can also be played on Nintendo Switch 2. However, please note that a separate product, inKONBINI: One Store. Many Stories, is available exclusively for Nintendo Switch 2.

Save data and Additional Contents are not compatible between the two versions. Please be careful to avoid duplicate or mistaken purchases.

Nintendo Switch 2 Edition and Upgrade Pack are not available for this product.
70010000113085.intro: inKONBINI: One Store. Many Stories is a cozy, narrative-driven slice-of-life game with light simulation elements, centered on human connection and everyday moments.
70010000113085.name: inKONBINI: One Store. Many Stories

70010000113086.description:
System Shock is the fully fledged remake of the ground breaking original from 1994, combining cult gameplay with all-new HD visuals, updated controls, an overhauled interface and all-new sounds & music; it even has the original voice actor of SHODAN, one of gaming’s most iconic villains. Witness the rebirth of one of the greatest and most influential games ever created.

A first-person fight to the death in the depths of space!

SHE IS SELF-AWARE AND AWARE OF YOU
Meet SHODAN: The psychotic AI has taken control of Citadel Station and turned the crew into an army of cyborgs and mutants; She now plans to do the same to Earth. You must explore and battle your way through the depths of a space station gone to hell. Stop SHODAN and avert humanity’s destruction.

HER TERMINATION IS OUR SALVATION

This product is released for the Nintendo Switch. It can also be played on Nintendo Switch 2. However, please note that a separate product, System Shock, is available exclusively for Nintendo Switch 2.

Save data and Additional Contents are not compatible between the two versions. Please be careful to avoid duplicate or mistaken purchases.

Nintendo Switch 2 Edition and Upgrade Pack are not available for this product.
70010000113086.intro: A first-person fight to the death in the depths of space!
70010000113086.name: System Shock

70010000113098.description: A challenging and heartfelt precision-platformer. Use powers of Astral Projection to complete a dangerous coming-of-age pilgrimage. Master tight controls, overcome challenges, and let your spirit guide you to the journey's end.
70010000113098.name: TetherGeist

70010000113104.description:
The world has fallen silent once again. The streets are empty, the lights have faded - and what remains now belongs to something else.

Play as a courageous stray cat on a mission to rescue lost kittens, bring food to those in need, and help other strays survive in a city overtaken by new dangers. Swarm-like insects creep through the alleys, while dangerous dogs patrol the ruins of factories and streets. To survive, you’ll have to rely on stealth, speed, and the support of other strays who still believe in hope.

IN LITTLE STRAYS 2, TEAMWORK MATTERS.
Join a friend in full two-player co-op, explore ruined neighborhoods, solve puzzles, and protect each other from lurking threats.

From flooded sewers to forgotten laboratories, every area hides secrets - and every cat you rescue brings the city one step closer to life again.

Features
• Play together! - Team up with a friend in full co-op mode, share supplies, solve puzzles, and survive together.
• Explore a ruined city overtaken by insects and guarded by dogs - find safe paths and uncover hidden routes.
• Seven story-driven levels, each with unique quests and secret areas to discover.
• Find food, rescue kittens, and help other strays survive in a silent world.
• Cinematic visuals and an ambient soundtrack that evolves with your journey.

The world may be overrun… but courage still meows in the dark.
70010000113104.intro: Even in a city swallowed by silence, a brave stray cat can spark hope - one tiny pawstep at a time.
70010000113104.name: Little Strays 2

70010000113110.description:
When federal agents threaten his family, former outlaw John Marston is forced to hunt down the gang of criminals he once called friends. Experience Marston’s journey across the sprawling expanses of the American West and Mexico as he fights to bury his blood-stained past in the critically acclaimed predecessor to the 2018 blockbuster, Red Dead Redemption 2. Also included is Undead Nightmare, the iconic horror story that transforms the world of Red Dead Redemption into an apocalyptic fight for survival against a zombie horde.

Featuring the complete single-player experiences of both games, Red Dead Redemption also includes bonus content from the Game of the Year Edition and more.*

Outlaws to the End

*Red Dead Redemption features the single-player experiences from both Red Dead Redemption and Undead Nightmare, plus bonus content from the Game of the Year Edition and more. Red Dead Redemption does not feature multiplayer content.
70010000113110.intro: Experience the epic western adventures that defined a generation
70010000113110.name: Red Dead Redemption

70010000113111.description:
This product entitles you to download the digital Nintendo Switch™ 2 version of this game.

When federal agents threaten his family, former outlaw John Marston is forced to hunt down the gang of criminals he once called friends. Experience Marston’s journey across the sprawling expanses of the American West and Mexico as he fights to bury his blood-stained past in the critically acclaimed predecessor to the 2018 blockbuster, Red Dead Redemption 2.

Also included is Undead Nightmare, the iconic horror story that transforms the world of Red Dead Redemption into an apocalyptic fight for survival against a zombie horde.

Featuring the complete single-player experiences of both games, Red Dead Redemption also includes bonus content from the Game of the Year Edition and more.*

Outlaws to the End

*Red Dead Redemption does not feature multiplayer content.
70010000113111.intro: Experience the epic Western adventures that defined a generation
70010000113111.name: Red Dead Redemption: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000113160.description:
*If you play the Nintendo Switch 2™ version on a Nintendo Switch™ console, its features and performance will match the Nintendo Switch™ version.

Speed through dimensions in the ultimate showdown!
Sonic has traveled to all kinds of worlds over the years.
However, when the Travel Rings bring him to the multiverse, a brand-new adventure, unpredictable races, and wild competitions await!

▼Race with or against players from around the globe
Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds lets you race offline or against competitors from around the world—including players on other platforms! In World Match, you can face off against up to 11 other players! For some team-based fun with unique challenges, give Friend Match a try. If you're looking to prove who's the fastest, hit up Time Trial! Master each mode and take your rightful place on the podium!

▼Craft a machine tailor-made to your preferences
Gadgets are an exciting new feature with the power to change the outcome of any race! Fitting your vehicle with different gadgets grants you all kinds of abilities that change your playstyle options. With over 70 gadgets to choose from, craft your own tailor-made machine! Every part of your vehicle is yours to customize, from the colors and decals to even the texture!
Create your dream ride!

▼Expect the unexpected as each course changes with every lap
During the second lap, the Travel Ring will warp you to another world. Put the pedal to the metal in 24 main courses and 15 CrossWorlds.

▼The biggest playable roster in the series to date
23 iconic Sonic characters have fueled up and are ready for action! Pick your favorite character and accelerate to the finish line.
