▼Get a leg up on the competition with an assortment of items
Use items to gain abilities like transforming into a monster truck that can crush your competition!
70010000113160.intro:
No two races are alike in Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds!
Buckle up for high-octane, unpredictable racing fun.
70010000113160.name: Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds - Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition

70010000113161.description:
Tribute Games and Dotemu are teaming up again, in collaboration with Marvel Games, to craft an original, fresh beat 'em up. Featuring dynamic combat combos and dazzling pixel art, this planet-hopping adventure stands as a love letter to the Marvel Universe.

“THE COSMOS MUST FALL SO THAT I MIGHT LIVE!!”
So swears Annihilus, the living death that walks!

After an unprecedented attack is launched across the galaxy, all life hangs in the balance.

From New York City to the depths of the Negative Zone, the future of the Universe will be fought for across the stars in MARVEL Cosmic Invasion!


●15 PLAYABLE SUPER HEROES
Spider-Man, Wolverine, She-Hulk, Captain America, Phoenix, Black Panther, Storm and Iron Man, some of the most powerful earth-born Marvel Super Heroes, are ready to face the threat.

But they won't be alone! Galactic Super Heroes Rocket Raccoon, Beta Ray Bill, Venom, Cosmic Ghost Rider, Nova, Phyla-Vell and the Silver Surfer enter the battle as well to complete the relentless line-up.

All will join forces in a star-spanning brawling adventure against the deadly Annihilation Wave.

●MASTER THE COSMIC SWAP TAG-TEAM SYSTEM
With the Cosmic Swap tag-team system, choose two Super Heroes for each level and switch between them instantly. Create unique combos and powerful special attacks. Each character’s abilities encourage creative team-ups and a more tactical approach to the action.

●AMAZING RETRO ART DIRECTION
MARVEL Cosmic Invasion is a tribute to one of Marvel’s most iconic eras, with stunning full-color pixel art designs.

●INTUITIVE, FUN MULTIPLAYER FOR EVERYONE
Whether you're teaming up with friends or family, MARVEL Cosmic Invasion has you covered with local/online play and a drop-in/drop-out adaptive system.

A cosmic battle awaits!
70010000113161.intro: A cosmic battle awaits in this Marvel frenetic action beat ‘em up!
70010000113161.name: MARVEL Cosmic Invasion

70010000113167.description:
"This game reeks of being a total disaster... I must patrol it!"
A visual novel starring VTuber "Nekomoto Pato"!
Team up with Nekomoto Pato and take on a bizarre, glitchy game!


・Synopsis
"Why is my game being released...?"

After hitting it off at university, you and Nekomoto Pato stumble upon a bizarre game at a shady back alley shop.
When you start playing, you relive everything from your first meeting to now.

Could it be that what happens in this game is actually happening in real life...?

Sudden absurd twists and relentless microtransaction traps.
Can the two of you survive and conquer this mysterious, chaotic game!?


・Characters
Nekomoto Pato (VA: Nekomoto Pato)
Also known as the Glitch-Game Patrol Cat, with the siren on her head being her true self.
A suspicious character who claimed the best spot at the university (self-proclaimed). She bonds with the protagonist as a fellow gaming enthusiast.


○Novel Game Brand "Rabbitfoot”
A novel game brand that delivers novel games casting active YouTubers and VTubers as game characters.
As well as using their names and nicknames, you can enjoy the different sides of your faves and feel a close connection through the novel game that you cannot experience in the usual streaming or video uploads.
70010000113167.intro: Starring VTuber "Nekomoto Pato"! An adventure conquering a mysterious reality-linked glitchy game!
70010000113167.name: PATONEKO QUEST Ⅱ

70010000113188.description:
Wake Up, Lia! is a narrative-driven 2D precision platformer set within nightmares shaped by bullying. As Lia, you will have to overcome deadly traps across 20 handcrafted stages to recover lost memories and fragments of your identity.

Embark on a heartfelt journey of trauma, resilience and rebirth, blending emotional storytelling with challenging gameplay and an atmospheric soundtrack! Play solo or team up with a friend in local co-op!

• Guide a young heroine through 20 nightmarish stages.
• Run and leap with precision as you avoid deadly traps and pitfalls.
• Choose from multiple difficulties for your desired challenge.
• Recover memories to help Lia overcome emotional challenges.
• Play solo or team up with a friend in local co-op.
70010000113188.intro: Help Lia overcome her nightmares in a side-scrolling adventure across emotionally themed stages!
70010000113188.name: Wake Up, Lia!

70010000113198.description:
You’re an indebted angler, trapped in a vicious cycle of borrowing and desperation. One dark, endless night at sea you haul up something unnatural: a talking fish named Cagliuso. It promises you riches — but its bargains come with terrifying strings.
In LOAN SHARK, the nets you cast bring more than fish. They pull you toward sacrifice, secrets, and a deadline you may never meet. The “loan shark” isn’t just metaphoric — something is stalking the waters, your time is running out, and every deal you strike pushes you deeper into the unknown."
• Short, intense experience – Designed for a compact but unforgettable playthrough.
• Underwater eye-cam mechanic – Watch the lure in submerged view, anticipate the bite, then pull fast while the depths watch you.
• Fish & gut mechanic – After you reel them in, you must gut the fish yourself… carefully. Mistakes may cut you.
• Surreal dialogues & meaningful choices – Meet Cagliuso and barter with a one-eyed talking fish. Every choice alters your path.
• Time pressure & looming threat – The loan shark is coming. The clock ticks. Something hides in the darkness.
• Atmospheric horror & creeping dread – The deep sea becomes your adversary; the familiar becomes monstrous.
70010000113198.intro: A desperate fisherman makes a deadly deal with a talking fish that trades riches for pieces of his soul.
70010000113198.name: Loan Shark

70010000113199.description:
【About the Game】
Ys Memoire: The Oath in Felghana, one of the standout action RPG titles in the "Ys" series, has been upgraded with an HD remaster and all-new features!

・New Visuals: Easily switch between the original and updated graphics.
・HD Remaster and Enhanced Sound: Experience upgraded sound with three different settings.
・Voiced Protagonist: New voiceover added for Adol, with event scenes fully voiced.
・High-Speed Mode: Includes features to assist beginners.
70010000113199.intro:
A deeper action RPG:
Ys Memoire: The Oath in Felghana arrives on Nintendo Switch™!
70010000113199.name: Ys Memoire: The Oath in Felghana

70010000113225.description:
Cat Girl Survivor is a survivor-style action game where you fight endless waves of enemies alongside adorable cat girl characters.

◆ Game Features
- 7 unique cat girl characters with distinct personalities
- Over 40 combination skills for infinite strategic possibilities
- Endless character growth up to level 1000
- Equipment system to freely upgrade your favorite weapons
- Easy and comfortable gameplay with auto-attack system
- Roguelike elements for fresh fun every playthrough
- Diverse stages and boss battles

◆ How to Play
Characters automatically attack nearby enemies. Players only need to focus on movement and skill selection. Level up to acquire new skills and combine them to unleash powerful combination skills!

◆ Combination Skill System
When you acquire specific skills together, they evolve into even more powerful combination skills. Discover over 40 combinations and create your own ultimate build.

◆ Infinite Growth System
You can level up each character to level 1000, and freely enhance your favorite weapons through the equipment system. Experience characters that become stronger over time.

◆ Endless Challenge, Infinite Dungeon
Addictively engaging gameplay that's hard to stop once you start! Each playthrough features different skill combinations, allowing you to try new strategies. Challenge yourself against increasingly powerful enemies, aim for higher floors, and enjoy the thrill of endless growth. Experience the exhilarating gameplay that makes you say "just one more run"!

Defeat the hordes of enemies and complete your ultimate cat girl!
70010000113225.intro:
Survivor-style action with 7 cat girls!
Over 40 combination skills and infinite growth up to level 1000!
70010000113225.name: Cat Girl Survivor

70010000113239.description:
Get ready to unleash your inner champion in Scorpion Champions: Island Warfare, an exhilarating fast-paced shooter that will have you blasting your way through diverse island environments. From sun-drenched beaches to frozen tundras, you’ll face relentless hordes of enemies, strategically choose your path, and collect powerful loot to become an unstoppable force.

Features:
- Island Hopping: Blast through diverse islands, each with unique landscapes to conquer!
- Non-stop Action: Unleash a torrent of firepower on relentless enemies in fast-paced battles.
- Strategize to Dominate: Every choice matters - make tactical decisions to dominate the battlefield.
- Fresh Runs, Every Time: Dynamic challenges ensure endlessly surprising and engaging gameplay.
- Forge Your Legend: Complete missions to unlock powerful upgrades and customize your champion’s look.
- Flawless Control: Experience smooth movement and sharp combat mechanics for effortless domination.
- Endless Challenge: Test your limits with infinitely loopable runs. How far can you conquer?

Step onto the battlefield, adapt to every challenge, and prove your strength across the islands. Only the bold endure — rise, conquer, and become a legend!
70010000113239.intro: Conquer every island. Destroy every enemy. Become unstoppable.
70010000113239.name: Scorpion Champions: Island Warfare

70010000113245.description:
Crystal Vale: Dino Escape is a fast-paced adventure platformer set in a beautiful but dangerous dinosaur world. Trapped in a mysterious crystal valley, you must outrun prehistoric predators, explore vibrant environments, and collect powerful crystals to survive.

Run, jump, swim, dash, and parachute your way through four unique maps filled with hazards, hidden paths, and relentless dinosaurs that will stop at nothing to catch you. Every crystal you collect brings you closer to escaping the valley, but danger lurks around every corner.

With fluid movement, colorful environments, and thrilling chase gameplay, Crystal Vale: Dino Escape delivers an exciting experience for players who love action, exploration, and fast reflexes.

Can you escape the valley before the dinosaurs catch you?
70010000113245.name: Crystal Vale: Dino Escape

70010000113257.description:
Challenge the streets in Street Combat Fighting, a fast-paced 3D brawler that brings classic street fighting action to a modern, low-poly world.

Punch, kick, and combo your way through a variety of opponents on different stages, ranging from warehouses and offices to underground gyms. Master your timing, unlock new abilities, and work your way up from rookie to champion in Career Mode. Or, jump straight into Arcade Mode for quick, intense battles.

Features:
• Dynamic 3D low-poly visuals with unique environments
• Two exciting modes: Career and Arcade
• Unlockable abilities and power-ups
• Easy-to-learn, skill-based combat system
• AI battles with increasing difficulty

Are you ready to become the ultimate street champion?
70010000113257.intro: Fight Your Way to the Top!
70010000113257.name: Street Combat Fighting

70010000113262.description:
This world has an "end"...
We have been taught this for as long as anyone can remember.
Even the limitless stretching seas has a distinct end, beyond which one cannot go.
That’s why many scholars say, "This world is flat." A pretty common perception of the world. ...I wonder if it's really true.
No, I’m sure it's wrong. There are still a lot of unknowns in the world. What are these images we see within the Star Fragments?
I strongly believe that the world is much bigger than that. Yes. The world must be much, much bigger...
70010000113262.intro:
An adventure through the stars arrives on Nintendo Switch™!
Rubble from the heavens is falling unto our island...
70010000113262.name: Nayuta No Kiseki: Ad Astra

70010000113269.description:
New warplanes once revolutionized warfare — and the gripping aerial battles of the Second World War have now also found their way onto Nintendo Switch™. Step into the boots of Admiral Lucas Stark (US Navy) and coordinate the defense of Pearl Harbor and the liberation of the Pacific Ocean — or win honor and glory for the Japanese empire as Admiral Hideaki Hashimoto (Imperial Japanese Army).

In the arcade flight simulation Air Conflicts: Pacific Carriers, you will relive the Pacific War in historical battles and original planes that are accurate down to the last detail. Experience the vast scale of a conflict that shaped the history of warfare on the open seas and in the skies.

Features:
- Play two campaigns revolving around historically significant aircraft carriers — either for the US Navy or the Imperial Japanese Army.

- Step into the cockpits of 18 famous airplane types, such as the Japanese A6M "Zero" and the Aichi D3 "Val", or the American F4F "Wildcat" or F4U "Corsair".

- Experience the most famous battles of the Pacific War and fly missions located in Midway, Pearl Harbor, and Wake Island.

- Put your flying abilities to the test in 4 different online multiplayer modes, including aerial and aircraft carrier battles.
70010000113269.intro: True heroes know no bounds! Experience top combat action in this brand new arcade flight sim and become immersed in the exploits of famous aircraft carriers.
70010000113269.name: Air Conflicts: Pacific Carriers

70010000113274.description:
Amongst the best beat’em up series ever created, jammin’ ‘90s beats and over the top street beating, the iconic series Bare Knuckle comes back with a masterful tribute to and revitalization of the classic action fans adore.

The all-time classic Bare Knuckle, also known as Streets of Rage, is a beat ‘em up series known for this timeless gameplay and electronic dance influenced music. Bare Knuckle IV builds upon the classic trilogy’s gameplay with new mechanics, beautiful hand-drawn visuals and a God tier soundtrack.

Team up with iconic and brand-new characters

Bare Knuckle IV got its iconic characters back: Axel, Blaze, and Adam teaming up with new brother and sister in arms Floyd Iraia and Cherry Hunter. With some brand-new moves and kickass tracks to take a listen, our heroes are ready to dish out beatdowns to a fledgling group of ill-advised criminals in full force.

Nostalgia strikes again

One of your dreams is coming true. In addition to the 5 new characters, unlock and play your favorite pixelated characters from the previous Bare Knuckle games such as Axel, Adam, Blaze, Skate, Max and many more with their own retro SFX, in gorgeous HD hand-drawn urban environments. And for the full nostalgic experience, you will also be able to play with the music of the previous Bare Knuckle games!

Outstanding Hand-Drawn Visuals

Bare Knuckle IV will be the first entry to the core series in 25 years, standing as Axel, Adam or Blaze’s glorious return to serving up side-scrolling beatdowns. With lush hand-drawn animations, new combat abilities, and fresh tracks from an amazing team of composers, Bare Knuckle IV will be a masterful tribute to and revitalization of the classic action fans adore.

Epic line-up of legendary games composers

The Bare Knuckle series is known for its electronic dance influenced music around the world.

Led by Olivier Derivière the soundtrack of Bare Knuckle IV will be composed by not only an all-star ensemble of Japanese memorable musical architects in the video game history but also by 4 Western rising stars:

● Yūzō Koshiro
● Motohiro Kawashima
● Yoko Shimomura
● Harumi Fujita
● Keiji Yamagishi
● Scattle
● Das Mörtal
● XL Middleton
● Groundislava

Features

● The comeback of the legendary Bare Knuckle series.
● Beautiful graphics fully hand-drawn and animated
● Clean up Wood Oak City by yourself or with another friend online !
● Team up to 6 people offline to take the city back for the very first time!
● Classic gameplay enhanced with brand-new mechanics.
● Soundtrack by a wide all-star line up of world-class musicians.
● Braised chicken everywhere.
● A dozen former Bare Knuckle characters unlockable and playable in their original pixel versions.
● Play with the music of the previous Bare Knuckle games.
● 12 unique stages.
70010000113274.intro: The iconic series Bare Knuckle comes back with a masterful tribute to and revitalization of the classic action fans adore.
70010000113274.name: Bare Knuckle IV

70010000113293.description:
■ Featured Titles
《WATER SKI》
Speed across the ocean waves with grace.

《FIELD DAY》
Take on challenges like the ball-toss and the 120m relay!

《TYPHOON GAL》
Challenge every dojo in your path!

《ARKANOID》(Compatible with USB Mouse)
The definitive edition of the legendary block-breaker!

《BONZE ADVENTURE》
King enma’ s madness, Hell’ s chaos.
Venerable monks set out on a journey!

《KURI KINTON》
In a post-apocalyptic era,
a martial threat strikes America. Fight for peace!

《SYVALION》(Compatible with USB Mouse)
A story that changes drastically with every playthrough.

《DON DOKO DON》
Carpenters Bob & Jim are aiming for the castle
above the clouds!

《CAMELTRY》(Compatible with USB Mouse)
Rotate the screen to guide the ball to the goal.

《THE NINJA KIDS》
Devil worshippers attack town of puppets.
Four ninja puppets, restore peace!

■ Key Features
・Save State Function
・Display Settings
・Button Configuration
70010000113293.intro:
Nostalgic arcade action, sports,
and paddle classics return!
10 curated Taito classics from the 80s and 90s!
70010000113293.name: Taito Milestones 4

70010000113304.description:
The story takes place in sprawling Balduq, also known as Prison City, located in the Gllia-Erdlingen region, northeast of Esterior. Here, a new adventure exploring the mysteries of the prison, alongside monsters (also known as monstrum) with various unique abilities, is about to unfold…

In addition to the hallmarks of the Ys series, such as an array of skill attacks, fast-paced action and thrilling boss battles, the game also introduces a number of new elements that are closely linked to Ys IX, such as the ability to explore the field in all directions via monstrum special abilities!

In addition, the Nintendo Switch™ version of the game includes bonus items, such as exclusive costumes and attachments, that were originally released on other consoles. Explore the Prison City in your own unique style!
70010000113304.intro: Ys IX, the high-speed action RPG known for its exhilarating battles and adventure powered by special abilities, is now available on Nintendo Switch™!
70010000113304.name: Ys IX -Monstrum NOX-

70010000113308.description:
A TIMELESS CLASSIC RETURNS
R-Type Delta is one of the finest shoot ‘em ups ever and took the gaming world by storm upon its release in 1998. Now, 27 years later, history repeats itself with R-Type Delta: HD Boosted. With its tight level design, three selectable ships, powerful Delta Weapons, and the brilliant Force mechanic, this new edition proves that gaming classics of this caliber are truly timeless. If you played R-Type Delta back in the day, this is the perfect opportunity to return to its dark science fiction action. If you've never experienced this essential piece of gaming history before, now is the time.

SHARPER THAN EVER
R-Type Delta: HD Boosted features high-resolution graphics that hone the polygonal edges of this masterpiece until they’re sharp enough to cut glass. You simply haven’t experienced R-Type Delta until you've played it in high definition. This version of the game also comes equipped with a new Practice Mode for those of you who want to polish your skills until they are as sharp as the resolution itself!

NEW MUSIC BY HÜLSBECK, ISHIDA AND THE USP SOUND TEAM
The atmospheric music has always been a highlight of R-Type Delta. The HD Boosted version also includes brand-new, optional tracks composed by Masahiko Ishida (R-Type II, Image Fight), the USP sound team (who wrote the music for the original 1998 version), and – last but by no means least – Chris Hülsbeck. Hülsbeck is, of course, one of the true icons of video game music, This new R-Type Delta: HD Boosted soundtrack is truly out of this world!

ENVIRONMENTAL STORYTELLING
What has always made R-Type Delta so fantastic is its dark, eerie atmosphere. Shoot-'em-ups are not typically known for storytelling, but R-Type Delta: HD Boosted excels with its simple, minimalist environmental storytelling, characteristic of the late ’90s. It’s a narrative that is as fascinating as it is unsettling, as adrenaline-pumping as it is deeply disturbing. And all this without a single word being spoken.

THE MEANING OF DELTA
The name “Delta” carries several meanings. Firstly, the Greek letter delta resembles a triangle, which coincidentally has as many sides as there are playable ships in the game. It is also the fourth letter of the Greek alphabet, and R-Type Delta is the fourth game in the R-Type series. Additionally, the delta triangle is the simplest type of polygon, which is fitting since R-Type Delta was the first game in the series to use three-dimensional polygon graphics instead of two-dimensional sprites.

STORY
The year is 2163, and the badly damaged R9 Arrowhead fighter has just returned to Earth after its mission to destroy the Bydo Empire. The vessel is rescued by the battle-cruiser Croque-Monsieur and transported to an orbital space station. One year later, astronomers in Central Asia observe mysterious objects falling from the sky, and moments later, control is lost over the orbiting annihilation platform Moritz-G. This high-tech machine, capable of destroying the entire planet, descends over a city and levels it to the ground. Although its planet-destroying weapons have not yet been activated, its advanced defense systems make Moritz-G virtually impossible to approach. A desperate military operation is launched, and the prototype ship R9aII Delta is deployed to resolve the situation. Thus begins the epic battle that is R-Type Delta!
70010000113308.intro: The legendary shoot-'em-up returns; remastered, reloaded, and razor-sharp.
70010000113308.name: R-Type Delta: HD Boosted

70010000113313.description:
Includes 22 great levels. Over 35 million units sold across all formats!
Explore a world where puzzles are gigantic, and the challenges even bigger! Human has shrunk!

Navigating a tranquil garden represents a near insurmountable problem for our tiny Human in the latest FREE level Miniature.

Clamber on a titanic toy firetruck, drive a model car to the max, operate a menacingly massive vacuum cleaner and blow up the biggest balloon you've ever seen!

Play solo or call your friends; seven pals by your side in co-op maximises the silliness of an outsized adventure.

Human: Fall Flat is a hilarious, light-hearted physics platformer set in a world of floating dreamscapes.

Each dream level provides a new environment to navigate, from mansions, castles and Aztec adventures to snowy mountains, eerie nightscapes and industrial locations. Multiple routes through each level, and perfectly playful puzzles ensure exploration and ingenuity are rewarded.

More Humans, More Mayhem
Need a hand getting that boulder on to a catapult, or need someone to break that wall? Online multiplayer for up to 8 players transforms the way Human: Fall Flat is played.

A Vibrant Community
Streamers and YouTubers flock to Human: Fall Flat for its unique, hilarious gameplay. Fans have watched these videos more than 3 Billion times!

A Blank Canvas
Your Human is yours to customise. With outfits from builder to chef, skydiver, miner, astronaut and ninja. Choose your head, upper and lower body and get creative with the colours!

Free Great Content
Since launch more than four brand new levels have launched free of charge with even more on the horizon. What could the next dreamscape have in store?
70010000113313.intro: Human Fall Flat is a hilarious, light-hearted platformer set in floating dreamscapes that can be played solo or with up to 8 players online.
70010000113313.name: Human: Fall Flat

70010000113318.description:
The most successful racing game of Eden Games studio is back on Nintendo Switch™
With the pedal to the metal, race along more than 1800 miles of races!
On the mountainside, through a nature park, in the middle of the desert or along the coast, defend your position over the course of more than 250 races, including championships, missions and challenges.

As you progress through the races, admire the growing collection of cars in your personal garage. Gear.Club Unlimited 2 has more than 50 licensed cars from the world’s most famous manufacturers, such as the Porsche 718 Boxster, 918 Spyder, 911 GT2RS, Dodge Viper, Lotus 3-Eleven or McLaren 720s.

Personalize them and make them unique! You can change their appearance with the paint and bodywork, or change their driving performance with engine tuning.

You would be nothing, however, without your Club! Create and manage it with your friends, recruit the best drivers and take on rival clubs from all over the world, reach the top of the podium and enjoy exclusive content reserved for the best players.

No more borders. Drive with freedom!

Features:

• A huge playing area that includes more than 250 races, located in four rich and diverse environments.
• Players begin with 51 famous racing cars made by some of the finest manufacturers in the world, including Porsche, Lotus, McLaren, Koenigsegg and Bugatti.
• In the story mode, save the family team from bankruptcy by taking on charismatic riders of all nationalities.
• Players can create and manage their Club and recruit the best drivers that cross their path. They are free to challenge rival clubs from around the world to see their crew’s name appear at the top of the leaderboard.
• Players can manage and personalize their garage, as well as their racing cars, which can be visually customized and performance-tuned!
• Play alone or with friends: the game features a local multiplayer mode with a four-way split screen.
70010000113318.intro: With the pedal to the metal, race along more than 3,000 kilometers of tracks that await you!
70010000113318.name: Gear.Club Unlimited 2

70010000113341.description:
Get behind the sirens and feel the rush of justice in Police Chase Simulator: Highway Racers Pursuit — an adrenaline-fueled experience where every pursuit tests your nerve, reflexes, and sense of duty.
Join an elite police unit tasked with taking down reckless drivers, smugglers, and high-speed fugitives across sprawling highways and dangerous city streets. Engage in cinematic chases, execute tactical maneuvers, and show criminals that no one outruns the law.

Key Features:
	•	Dynamic High-Speed Pursuits: Chase offenders through urban chaos, scenic highways, and treacherous mountain passes. Each pursuit offers new challenges and strategies.
	•	Authentic Police Gear: Ram suspects, set up spike traps, trigger sirens, and unleash nitro bursts to dominate the chase.
	•	Stunning Realism: Experience lifelike graphics, detailed patrol cars, and atmospheric environments that capture the tension of real police work.
	•	Mission Variety: From spontaneous pursuits to planned sting operations, every mission brings unique goals and escalating intensity.
	•	Intuitive Controls: Simple yet precise controls let you stay focused on the chase and react in split seconds.

Police Chase Simulator: Highway Racers Pursuit isn’t just about speed — it’s about justice on wheels.
Step into the driver’s seat, hit the lights, and prove that no outlaw escapes the long arm of the law.
70010000113341.intro: When chaos hits the highway, you answer with speed.
70010000113341.name: Police Chase Simulator: Highway Racers Pursuit

70010000113344.description:
Tired of feeling trapped at home, Moka, a spoiled cat, decides to run away and seek adventure. His journey takes an unexpected turn when the kennelman threatens the streets. Moka needs to learn how to survive, and appreciate what he left behind, before he's going to lose his best friend and everything he had.

FEATURES

· Explore a beautiful hand drawn watercolor world.
· Feel the magic of the animated movie classics.
· Discover the power of friendship.
· Live an emotional journey.
· Be a cat..

DO YOU WANT TO KNOW IF THIS GAME IS FOR YOU?

· Did you ever want to experience life as a cat?
· Are you into handmade animated movie classics?
· Do you like to engage in emotional stories?
· Do you like short games (around 2-3 hours of game play)?
· Are you ready for intuitive manageable challenges?

Yay, awesome! Because our game offers all of that, and much more.
70010000113344.intro: Stars in the Trash brings the magic of animated movie classics into a narrative-driven platformer that combines action, exploration and puzzles.
70010000113344.name: Stars In The Trash

70010000113361.description:
Join the all-night investigation at an abandoned building where reports of paranormal activity have never stopped. As a member of a ghost-hunting team, explore empty rooms and dark corridors while monitoring supernatural phenomena.
Use professional detection equipment to track strange fluctuations, record unexplained sounds, and document sightings. As the night progresses, activity intensifies and the building’s hidden past begins to surface.

Key Features:
	•	Explore a large abandoned location filled with dark rooms and hidden areas
	•	Use ghost-hunting gadgets to detect and record paranormal activity
	•	Investigate dynamic supernatural events that escalate throughout the night
	•	Find clues and environmental details that reveal the building’s history
	•	Solve puzzles and uncover the mystery behind the haunting
	•	Immersive atmosphere focused on tension and suspense


The night is long, and the building is never truly silent. Every sound could be a sign, every shadow a warning. Stay focused, trust your equipment, and uncover the truth before it’s too late.
Will you leave with evidence… or become part of the legend?
70010000113361.intro: Darkness doesn’t arrive suddenly — it builds slowly.
70010000113361.name: Dark Fall: Ghost Vigil

70010000113386.description:
Survive an insane army of enemies with a squad of elemental creatures! Recruit new members for your team by defeating the bosses that cross your path, and combine their traits to unlock powerful effects! Unity not only brings strength, it also creates new abilities!

MEET THE SHARDS

Over 20 Shards can join your squad! Experiment and discover which ones will become your favorites!

FORM AN ELEMENTAL SQUAD

Choose Shards of Fire, Electric, Water, Nature, and Crystal! Your squad, your rules! Build the team of your dreams to survive the crisis devastating the world of Mellunia!

COMBINE TRAITS

Each Shard has three distinct traits capable of unlocking powerful abilities and effects! Having more than one creature with the desired trait in your team will increase your squad’s power level!

OVERCOME CHALLENGES

Unique events and powerful bosses will appear to test your squad’s skills! Overcome these challenges to earn special rewards for your survival!
70010000113386.intro: Form a squad of elemental creatures, face fierce hordes, and use shard synergies and relics to turn the winds in your favor! Survive and save your lands!
70010000113386.name: Shard Squad

70010000113394.description:
The sprawling Nezu-Me space station has been overrun with devious, mutated mice! Roll around the rails in a unique blend of platform game and 2D shooter. Blast enemies, dodge threats, destroy the Nezu-Me core and get all the stranded cats back home!

Super Scram Kitty is a complete re-imagining of 'Scram Kitty and his Buddy on Rails', with all new controls, remixed stages, updated enemy behaviours, and new visual effects.
70010000113394.intro: Stop the evil Nezu-Me corporation's plan for eternal domination!
70010000113394.name: Super Scram Kitty

70010000113400.description:
A gentle, laid-back life begins in a village surrounded by nature.
Cast your line into rivers, lakes, and the open sea, and enjoy fishing whenever the mood strikes.
Spend peaceful days getting to know the village's charming residents and soaking in a calming, heartwarming atmosphere.

Before long, massive King Fish lurking in the waters will reveal themselves.
Beyond them awaits a legendary creature spoken of only in tales.
Sharpen your skills, upgrade your gear, and challenge the Legendary King!

[Easy-to-Learn Fishing Controls]
Fishing is simple and intuitive!
Tilt the stick to line it up with the gauge, then hold down the button!
Reel in your catch before it gets away!

[Over 120 Types of Creatures to Discover!]
Fill out your collection, aim for record-breaking sizes, and enjoy plenty of challenges.
Explore different locations and strive for 100% completion!

[Collect Fishing Gear]
Use the money you earn to buy new equipment.
Gather fishing rods and lures to take on even bigger fish!

[Interact with the Villagers]
Chatting with villagers may earn you helpful fishing tips.
Sometimes, you'll be invited to partake in fun minigames like catching runaway chickens or racing along the beach, all for special rewards!

[Customize Your Home]
Place purchased furniture in your house and make it your own.
Decorate with your favorite items, display your caught fish in a tank, and create a room that's uniquely yours.

[Online Rankings]
Take on the Score Attack Challenge at the local fishing hole!
See how many fish you can catch within the time limit and test your skills.
Check rankings based on your total catches and aim for the top spot.
Fish your way to No. 1!
70010000113400.intro:
Relax and unwind.
Enjoy a slow life all your own, spent fishing at your own pace.
70010000113400.name: Peaceful Fishing Story

70010000113418.description:
A legendary arcade game developed by Dimps in 2005. This fighting game gained popularity for its smooth visuals powered by S.M.A as well as the high level of strategy driven by its 2-gauges system. And with the addition of new current-gen features it's even easier to play.

- Battle Mechanics Polished to a Shine by a Legendary Studio Known for Fighters:
The first original fighting game from Dimps, known for being involved in a number of other fighting games. It has continued to attract fighting game fans since its release in 2005 with mechanics that use 2 gauges--one for offense and one for defense--and slick 2D visuals powered by S.M.A. (Smooth Model Animation).

- New Features for Console Provide a Modern Gameplay Experience:
The console version contains new features such as an Online Versus Mode--a first for the series. It uses Rollback Netcode, which corrects lag between players, making for a streamlined experience online. And with 16:9 wide-screen support, AI and a training mode, you can fully enjoy this game in the comfort of your own home.

- Main Game Modes:
・Arcade
・Survival
・Time Attack
・Local Multiplay
・Online Multiplay with rollback netcode
・Training
・Gallery
Added features: Spectator mode, rematch, match recording, combat range and match time settings, assist mode, new character colors, button assignment for Boost Dive, and an updated training mode including character-specific gauge and enemy attack/dodge/ground recovery settings, as well as adjustments to enemy auto recovery timing.

- The Story:
It is the end of the 20th century... A large-scale natural disaster struck the eastern area of a nation. It wiped out the financial sector and resulted in a staggering loss of life.

At the dawn of the 21st century, the conglomerate PROBE-NEXUS, commonly known as Probe, began reconstruction efforts in that eastern area. Colossal capital and cutting-edge technology was poured into rebuilding it. Skyscrapers that put the old high-rises to shame along with the world's biggest shopping mall and recreational facilities. This was the dazzling birth of a symbol for the new century. It was christened Zone Prime.

And now, in an undeveloped sector of its western block, there was an area known as the slums...
70010000113418.intro:
The Fight for Survival
The legendary fighting game has returned sporting new features!
70010000113418.name: The Rumble Fish 2 - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000113437.description:
DUNGEON RAZE is an intense power-trip where you don't crawl through the dungeon, you blast through it. Become a destruction magic-wielding witch and reduce every wall and defense system to dust.

Demolish Everything in Sight
Not even the walls of the dungeon can stop you. Tear through the map to hunt down gold, power-ups, and rescue allies. Your firepower vaporizes the dungeon as you go

Experience Instant Hyper-Inflation
Forget grinding for gradual stat upgrades and go for explosive growth. Power scaling that defies logic is achievable within minutes. Watch your projectiles multiply, and your damage skyrocket until even the toughest walls satisfyingly crumble in a single shot.

Lead a Mobile Fortress
No one razes alone. Smash through the rubble to rescue imprisoned adventurers and add their firepower to your own. As your squad grows and your inflation peaks, the screen fills with a chaotic storm of magic and munitions that no defense can withstand.

Push Your Destructive Limits
Find out just how much devastation you can unleash:
- Eternal Dungeon: No limits, no end. See how far your "hyper-inflated" firepower can go in a procedurally generated maze of infinite destruction.
- Speed Raze: How fast can you raze the core? A time-based mode where every second counts.
- Hard Dungeon: High-difficulty stages filled with tougher walls and enemies, designed to challenge your ultimate power. Encounter special allies and powerful, unknown foes.
70010000113437.intro:
Demolish walls to grow stronger!
A high-octane, magic destruction shooter.
70010000113437.name: DUNGEON RAZE

70010000113449.description:
Dive into a thrilling and epic adventure, where every action pulses to the heady rhythm of an intense soundtrack. Master fluid, acrobatic, and responsive combat, paired with challenging parkour. Death after death, forge your own playstyle – through exploration and encounters, perhaps you'll find a way to right your wrongs and save the Persian kingdom envisioned by Evil Empire.

REWRITE FATE. SAVE PERSIA. DIE TRYING.
Shape the legend of a Prince spared by death, whose fatal mistake doomed his people. Try your best to right your wrongs: each failure is a new chance to explore different paths, discover secrets, meet new characters, and use the knowledge gained from past attempts to change your people's fate and prove yourself as the true Prince of Persia.

MASTER A FAST AND ACROBATIC STYLE
As the Prince of Persia, agility is your greatest weapon. Dodge traps, wall-run, chain acrobatic combos, and strike with precision. Every movement is an opportunity, and every battle will reward skill and style.

FIGHT YOUR OWN WAY
Discover, unlock, and master over 100 unique weapons and medallions. Adapt, upgrade, and customize your build with each run, crafting deadly combinations that fit your playstyle.

ONE MORE TRULY UNIQUE RUN
No run is ever the same. Dive back into this ever-evolving adventure, where narration, metaprogression, difficulty modifiers, random events, and procedurally generated levels will always leave you craving just one more unique run.
70010000113449.intro: REWRITE FATE. SAVE PERSIA. DIE TRYING.
70010000113449.name: The Rogue Prince of Persia™

70010000113454.description:
Party battle game "SUPER BOMBERMAN" is now available as a collection featuring a total of 8 titles with 13 versions across JP, EUR and USA, including the long-awaited localised versions of the unreleased SUPER BOMBERMAN 4 and 5!
Including Boss Rush mode to time attack against all the bosses in each title, support functions, libraries and more!

【Included Titles】

① SUPER BOMBERMAN [Japanese Version / US Version / European Version]
Mr. Karat, the evil power-hungry tyrant, and scientist Dr.Mukk! Defeat the robot army they command and thwart their ambitions!

② SUPER BOMBERMAN 2 [Japanese Version / US Version / European Version]
Our Bomberman has been captured by the sudden appearance of the vicious Bomber Quintet. For the sake of Earth's peace and his own destiny, he must confront them!

③ SUPER BOMBERMAN 3 [Japanese Version / European Version]
The evil Professor Bugler has revived the vicious Five Dastardly Bombers, once defeated by Bomberman, and has begun his march towards cosmic conquest.

④ SUPER BOMBERMAN 4 [Japanese Version (English localised version available)]
Bomberman has been transported to different eras by the Four Bomber Kings. What is their purpose? And what is the mysterious entity lurking in the shadows?

⑤ SUPER BOMBERMAN 5 [Japanese Version (English localised version available)]
A mysterious man calling himself the Emperor of another world, ‘Terrorin’. He has freed eight ‘Vicious Bombers’ from prison and begun an invasion with them as his subordinates.

⑥ Bomberman [Japanese Version]
The commemorative work that laid the foundation for the series. Conquer all 50 stages!

⑦ Bomberman II [Japanese Version]
The sequel to Bomberman. The work that implemented versus play.

⑧ Panic Bomber W [Japanese Version (English localization available)]
A competitive puzzle game up to 4 players.
Attack your opponents with special effects triggered by chain reactions and Big Bombs that appear when you fill the meter!

【Support Features, Helpful Functions and New Modes】

‘Boss Rush’
A challenge mode where you battle bosses from each game consecutively in a time attack!
*Panic Bomber W does not feature a boss rush.

‘Save/Load Anytime’
Save or load your game at any point during gameplay

‘Rewind Function’
A handy feature allowing you to rewind and retry at any point

‘Screen Filtering Function’
Adjust resolution or apply screen filters to play with your preferred visual settings

‘BOMB Radio’
Listen to original soundtracks from each title. You can also create your own playlists

‘Gallery’
Browse art works and development materials. Over 200 items in total!
70010000113454.intro: Hit party battle game series ‘SUPER BOMBERMAN’ now available as a collection!
70010000113454.name: SUPER BOMBERMAN COLLECTION - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000113461.description:
The objective is to collect the crystals located on the stage by utilizing jumps and dashes.
The stage is a 3D space with height, width, and depth. There is gravity, and the player controls their character by moving forward, backward, left, and right, and jumping to move vertically, aiming for the crystals.

Features
• Collect the crystal to clear the stage!
• 30 stages in total!
• Difficulty levels can be selected; Normal mode is relatively easy to clear, while Hard mode is extremely difficult.
• Collect coins to make crystals appear!
• Up to 4 players can play in split-screen mode!
• Use items to power up your abilities!
• Defeat enemies!
• There is a sword as a weapon!
• Use dodge actions to move around!

Multiplayer
• Cooperate with everyone to collect coins!
• Cooperate with everyone to defeat enemies!
• Be the first to get the crystal!
70010000113461.intro:
Get the crystals!!
Play in split-screen multiplayer with 1-4 players!
30 stages! Normal and Hard difficulty!
70010000113461.name: CRYZON part2

70010000113480.description:
Brace yourself for a wild ride where music meets mayhem! Look Mum No Computer takes you to the quirky, pixel-art universe of Soldersworth, as you join Sam and his Synthesizer sidekick, Kosmo, in this twin-stick shooter action-RPG to battle rogue household items and fix them from the inside — one electrifying beat at a time!

Key Features
Interactive Music Creation: Craft and upgrade unique modules that not only serve as powerful weapons but also form the instruments of the game’s evolving soundtrack.  Customize your playstyle and compose your own electronic music as you battle rogue machines
DIY Crafting System: Collect items and craft new modules inspired by creator Look Mum No Computer’s iconic designs, including the flamethrower module — a fiery nod to their infamous flamethrower organ.
 Quirky Worlds to Explore: Warp into the strange and vibrant pixel-art landscapes inside machines, teeming with bizarre creatures, challenging quests, and epic boss fights.
Dynamic Combat:  Take on swarms of enemies using twin-stick controls, balancing your energy to fuel both your arsenal and your electrifying music.
For Music Lovers and Gamers Alike: Whether you're a fan of retro games, electronic music, or Look Mum No Computer's inventive DIY spirit, this game offers something you’ll love.

The Adventure Awaits
Travel through the world of Soldersworth’s rogue devices, meet unforgettable characters, and unravel the musical chaos inside. Will you repair the machines, conquer the bosses, and restore harmony—or lose the beat forever?
70010000113480.intro: Fix the chaos, drop the beat – electrifying action meets DIY music mayhem!
70010000113480.name: Look Mum No Computer

70010000113492.description:
Challenge a friend to a tennis match where you can play as SpongeBob, Aang, and all your Nickelodeon favorites in fast-paced, local split-screen action!

All-Star Nickelodeon Characters: Pick your star player from among 15 iconic Nickelodeon characters from SpongeBob SquarePants, Avatar: The Last Airbender, Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles and more!

Play It Your Style: Choose from over 500 outfits and accessories to customize your Nickelodeon character your way, and show off your personality on the tennis court. Turn the tide of the match with powerful ultimate abilities that are unique to every character!

Play Solo or Local 1v1: Challenge a friend or family member to a 1v1 couch co-op split-screen tennis match, or play in Story Mode at your own speed!

Instant Fun for Everyone: You don't need to be a pro to have fun! Start playing instantly with easy-to-learn controls, accessible for the entire family.

Multiple Ways to Play: From classic matches to fun mini-games, there's something for everyone. Embark on a narrated Story Mode, dive into Mini-Games for extra fun, or rise to the top in Tournament Mode to claim your victory!
70010000113492.intro: Hit the tennis court for some fast-paced arcade action as your favorite Nickelodeon all-star! Customize SpongeBob, then enjoy accessible couch co-op matches' fun for all ages!
70010000113492.name: Nickelodeon Extreme Tennis: Next!

70010000113504.description:
Last Battalion Defense blends intense arcade shooter action with deep strategy and tower-defense mechanics. Command humanity’s final defensive line across 3 unique maps as you battle through 5 escalating waves of soldiers, armored vehicles, and military convoys. Manage powerful weapon systems and upgrade your defenses between waves to survive the onslaught.

Strategic Arsenal Management

Your success depends on mastering four specialized military weapon systems, each serving a distinct tactical purpose:

Artillery: Shreds infantry with rapid, suppressive fire.

Cannon: Delivers devastating area damage, wiping out troops and breaking armored vehicles.

Mortar: Provides explosive bombardments to halt enemy advances.

Patriot Missile System: A dominant all-purpose weapon capable of eliminating any threat with overwhelming force.

Each weapon offers unique strengths, letting you create the perfect defensive setup for every battlefield.

Dynamic Shop & Upgrade System

Between enemy waves, head to the Armory to manage your battlefield economy. Spend your earned coins to:

Purchase new weapon turrets

Repair damaged defenses

Upgrade your firepower

Unlock additional fortified positions

Every decision matters—expand your coverage, reinforce your strongholds, or save resources for later waves.

Tactical Depth & Adaptation

When the pressure becomes overwhelming, call in devastating air support to clear enemy forces and regain control.
As waves grow stronger, faster, and more coordinated, you must constantly adapt—balancing repairs, upgrades, expansion, and ability usage to endure the escalating assault.
70010000113504.intro:
Command your arsenal!
Defend the realm.
Your battalion is humanity's last hope.
70010000113504.name: Last Battalion Defense

70010000113510.description:
Grab your towels because the chillest capybara in gaming is ready for a soak! In Capy Spa, you help Pipa, a relaxation-loving capybara, push herb buckets into hot springs to prepare the perfect bath.

With 30 carefully crafted levels, two charming biomes (Savanna River and Forest Onsen), and a soothing soundtrack that blends with the rising steam, every stage invites calm and thoughtful moves.

No enemies, no timer, no rush. The focus is on smart movement, experimenting, undoing, and trying again until you find the perfect sequence. Sometimes, pools start already filled, and you’ll need to reorganize everything with patience and logic.

It feels like solving a puzzle while watching steam dance and leaves drift by. Each completed level brings that quiet satisfaction of seeing Pipa’s spa finally ready to relax.

Capy Spa is the kind of puzzle that makes you smile in peace, turning simple bucket-pushing into a zen and delightful experience.
70010000113510.intro: Capy Spa: The Most Relaxing Bath in the Savanna
70010000113510.name: Capy Spa

70010000113521.description:
Meet Ian, an 11-year-old dreamer whose imagination brings his room to life. Minima invites you to experience an interactive story told through light, sound, and discovery.

Explore a world of childhood memories, gaze through Ian’s telescope, peek into his glowing tent, and discover the simple magic hidden in everyday things. Its warm colors and handcrafted design take you on a peaceful, nostalgic journey through a child’s eyes.

Features:
• A heartfelt, story-driven experience told entirely through atmosphere and discovery.
• Handcrafted minimalist visuals that capture childhood nostalgia.
• A calming soundtrack that invites reflection and warmth.
• Explore, observe, and relive moments of imagination and light.

Minima is not just a game, it’s a quiet memory brought to life.
70010000113521.intro: A tiny world filled with big memories.
70010000113521.name: Minima

70010000113527.description:
Cute Astro is a cozy, pixel-art puzzle where you play a rockstar mouse pushing tasty cheese cubes across musical score boards. Each board has score holes that must be filled with cheese to complete the riff and open the way forward. The challenge is all about careful planning, avoiding deadlocks, and pushing in the right order.
With 30 handcrafted levels, two themed stages, instant Undo and Restart, and a playful concert atmosphere, it’s perfect for casual players and logic-puzzle fans who enjoy relaxing, brain-teasing challenges.
Across 30 levels in two biomes, the crisp Purple Stage and the warm Orange Stage, the player enters a compact grid filled with obstacles, cheese cubes, and score holes. A level ends only when every hole is filled. There is no timer and every action can be reversed through Undo or Restart, keeping the focus on planning, iteration, and discovery.
Moment-to-moment the loop is simple and satisfying: observe, plan a route, move tile by tile, push cheese into place, adjust with Undo or Restart, fill every hole, and enjoy the musical sting that celebrates your victory.
70010000113527.intro: A Puzzle Show on the Star Stage
70010000113527.name: Cute Astro

70010000113534.description:
The Club is Yours in EA SPORTS FC™ 26.

Experience The World’s Game like never before in EA SPORTS FC™ 26. The latest update introduces a brand-new international tournament mode featuring 48 national teams, alongside new authentic stadiums to play in. Take on international-themed Manager Live Challenges, and step into Player Career with new international ICONs and Heroes.
Play your way with an overhauled gameplay experience shaped by community feedback, Manager Live Challenges that deliver fresh scenarios throughout the season, and new Archetypes inspired by greats of the game.

Put your dream squad to the test in Football Ultimate Team™ with new Live Events and Tournament modes, as well as a refreshed Rivals and Champs experience.
Experience The World’s Game like never before in EA SPORTS FC™ 26, with match data from the world’s top leagues powering 20,000+ authentic players.

This game includes optional in-game purchases of virtual currency that can be used to acquire virtual in-game items, including a random selection of virtual in-game items.

This game was released for Nintendo Switch. It is also playable on Nintendo Switch 2, but there is a separate "EA SPORTS FC™ 26" that is only playable on Nintendo Switch 2. Save data or additional content from the two games are not compatible. Be careful not to make duplicate purchases or purchase incorrect content.
70010000113534.name: EA SPORTS FC™ 26

70010000113541.description:
Get ready to flap your wings and fire up your brain, because the hummingbird is about to turn the garden into a festival of logic. Hummingbird Garden is a charming pixel-art puzzle where you push little pollen nuggets through tight pathways until each flower blooms in a colorful display. It is the perfect mix of calm thinking, strategy, and a touch of natural magic.

You study the garden, choose the best route, avoid getting stuck, and decide the right order to deliver each pollen nugget. There is no rush. Every move can be undone with Undo or tried again with Restart, letting you experiment freely until you find the most elegant solution. It is a game made for thinking peacefully and enjoying every small discovery.

With 30 handcrafted levels divided into two biomes, the gardens offer varied terrain, natural obstacles, and many satisfying moments when flowers light up to celebrate your success. Each level feels like a small pollination mission, and completing one gives that delightful sense of making the world a little more beautiful.
70010000113541.intro: A Garden Full of Blooming Puzzles
70010000113541.name: Hummingbird Garden

70010000113549.description:
Get ready to fluff your brain and relax your heart, because this little sheep in a top hat is about to turn puzzle-solving into the cutest ritual of calm you’ve ever seen. Magic Sheep is a charming, slow-paced puzzle adventure where you push wooden barrels across peaceful gardens until each one rests perfectly on a marble pedestal. No pressure, no timer, only soft music, gentle thinking, and plenty of “oh, that was clever” moments.

Each level is a tiny diorama built with love. You study the layout, plan a clean path, slide through narrow passages, avoid blocking yourself, and decide the perfect order to move each barrel. If something goes wrong, no worries at all. Undo takes you back one step, Restart lets you rethink the whole puzzle, and the atmosphere stays quiet and comforting from start to finish.

Across 30 handcrafted stages set between two biomes, the bright Summer and the cozy Autumn, you’ll enjoy warm colors, relaxing scenery, and puzzles that grow more satisfying as you progress. Finishing a level fills the screen with a cheerful little jingle, rewarding your clever route and inviting you to the next peaceful challenge.

Magic Sheep is perfect for players who love cozy visuals, gentle strategy, and the joy of solving puzzles at their own pace, all in the company of the happiest sheep in a top hat.
70010000113549.intro: A Cozy Puzzle of Barrels and Marble Charms
70010000113549.name: Magic Sheep

70010000113556.description:
Welcome to Meowgic Mix, an adorable pixel art puzzle where a floating cat on a living book must mix potions and deliver them to the correct cauldrons. There are 30 stages inside a magical academy, with challenges that require strategy, logic, and a good dose of feline cleverness.

Observe the classroom where each cauldron awaits its perfect potion. Push bottles, plan your route, and avoid getting stuck while solving each enchanted mini-puzzle. And if something goes wrong, no worries — undo or restart is always just a paw away.

Meowgic Mix combines charming pixel visuals, relaxing music, and mechanics made for players who love calm puzzles, cute animals, and a touch of fantasy. Get ready for a cozy, clever, purr-magical experience where every completed level is a tiny victory in feline alchemy.
70010000113556.name: Meowgic Mix

70010000113562.description:
SpotCat vs The Cheddar Mafia In The Americas is a thrilling "Find-the-Difference" game with a hidden object twist.

The notorious Cheddar Mafia is spreading chaos across the Americas, and only SpotCat can stop them. Explore vibrant, hand-drawn scenes from different countries, spot the subtle differences, and stay sharp — mafia rats can appear when you least expect it.

Your mission? Find all 25 mafia rats, solve every scene, and bring justice to the continent!

Perfect for players who love visual challenges, lighthearted mystery, and clever surprises.

Join the hunt. Save the Americas. Spot every difference!
70010000113562.intro: Spot every difference. Stop the Cheddar Mafia. Save the Americas!
70010000113562.name: SpotCat vs The Cheddar Mafia In The Americas

70010000113583.description:
Pogui is just a little dog who wants to take a nap, but crazy stuff keeps happening around him! Guide the lovable pug through dreamlike worlds and help him get to bed. Pogui is a side-scrolling precision platformer presented in retro pixel art style. Run, jump and dash your way through colorful but hazardous levels!

Keep the pup moving as quickly as possible by watching your stamina meter! You’ll have to navigate worlds of toys, sweets, sunny beaches and more, each stage bringing new and wondrous mechanics that can help or hinder you. Watch Pogui don different outfits like a chef’s hat or space suit along the way, further maximizing his cuteness.

• Run, jump and dash with precision.
• Take control of an adorable canine protagonist.
• Collect golden bones to protect Pogui!
• Traverse an overworld map as you progress between levels.
• Enjoy cute and colorful aesthetics in retro pixel art style!
70010000113583.intro: Safely guide a lovable pup through crazy platforming stages so he can get back to his naptime!
70010000113583.name: Pogui

70010000113589.description:
What's left of humanity are minds trapped in circuits.
You are awaken as ReSetna, a warrior on a mission to rescue last human remnants.
Explore seven hostile zones, face seven brutal bosses and evolve through a unique upgrade system.
Uncover horrifying truth and decide if the future is worth saving.

Awaken as ReSetna, you begin in Polis, a dark, ruined world once inhabited by humans.
As you progress, you uncover unknown dimensions, new elements and entire worlds made of data and circuits.

Every zone is a warzone. Every machine is your enemy.

-	Master intense, precision combat with parry mechanics and weapon-switching
-	Your loyal drone companion IXA will be an essential aid
-	Customize your abilities using a unique chip-based upgrade system
-	Explore a fractured world, filled with secrets, danger and a dark history
-	Uncover the final secret and decide if the future is still worth saving
-	Explore a Rich, Post-Apocalyptic World: From the haunting remnants of Polis_13 to the toxic expanses of Acidia, journey through distinct, dystopian zones, each filled with secrets, unique challenges, and lore, inviting deep exploration and discovery.
-	Rich Narrative and Lore: Piece together clues to discover the complicated history of this enigmatic world. Each zone holds keys to the past and hints of the future, through environmental storytelling and cryptic communications.
-	Fast-Paced Combat: Engage with a wide array of enemies in each zone. Each will challenge you to adapt your strategy and refine your combat skills. Tactical thinking is key to mastering ReSetna's arsenal and overcoming adversaries.
-	Dynamic Companion – IXA: IXA, your loyal drone companion, will be an essential aid, providing healing in critical moments and hacking enemies.
-	Epic Boss Battles: The ultimate test of your skills! Each formidable boss is an epic, intense showdown requiring a sound strategy to beat. Their unique abilities will require you stay on your toes, exploit their weaknesses, and leverage upgrades to survive.
-	Upgrade Your Abilities: A customizable chip-upgrade system lets you customize ReSetna to suit your playstyle. Whether enhancing her combat techniques or her abilities to manipulate her environment, your choices affect her evolution and how you overcome obstacles.
-	7 Demanding Districts: Every environment presents a challenging terrain demanding keen observation and platforming abilities. You'll encounter mechanisms and hazards, as well as opportunities to uncover hidden rooms and secret passages that offer unique rewards and deeper insight into the world's history.
70010000113589.intro: A warrior on a mission to rescue last human remnants.
70010000113589.name: ReSetna

70010000113595.description:
Sun Wukong, Zhu Bajie, Sha Wujing, and Tang Sanzang!
All of the main characters are Kunio!!
A wild, exhilarating comedy action adventure where they all set out for Tianzhu.

1. A roguelike action game where you grow stronger with each run!
Obtain Secret Skills from gods who randomly appear as you progress through the stages to boost your abilities and stats!
With a whopping 80 different Secret Skills available, discover your ultimate build and mow down the swarms of enemies!

2. Master 3 distinct fighting styles!
You'll start with only the speed-focused Sun Wukong, but as you progress through the story, you'll unlock the power-focused Zhu Bajie and the long-range Sha Wujing!
Freely choose between the three Kunios and utilize their unique traits to conquer each stage!

3. Familiar faces from the River City series join the fray!
Series regulars make their appearances one after another as characters from Journey to the West!
Sometimes they will aid Kunio's crew on their journey, while other times they will stand in your way as bosses...
Don't miss the hilarious banter that unfolds throughout the story!
70010000113595.intro: River City's First Roguelike Built for Solo Play
70010000113595.name: River City Saga: Journey to the West

70010000113601.description:
Multi-ending daughter-raising simulation game: Volcano Princess

In a volcanic kingdom where smithing, magic, and alchemy flourish,
you play as a father and guide your daughter as she grows up.

Each and every choice you make will influence your daughter's growth and lead the story to different endings.

Featuring over 50 unique endings, the game offers a wide variety of outcomes based on your future career path and the bonds you forge with the people who matter most.

With its multiplatform release, this version also includes full Japanese voice support, newly written story content, new event illustrations, and a brand-new exploration map.

[Official Website]
https://volcano-princess.com

[Notes]
"Volcano Princess Prologue" is a demo version.
Data played in "Volcano Princess Prologue" cannot be carried over to the full release. Thank you for your understanding.
70010000113601.name: Volcano Princess

70010000113607.description:
Step into Junkyard Garage Simulator, where every rusted wreck tells a story and every repair brings a forgotten legend back to life. Take control of your own fully equipped garage and immerse yourself in the art of car restoration. From scrapyards to showrooms, every vehicle is a challenge waiting to be mastered.

Game Features:
 • Inspect & Diagnose Every Detail: Rotate the camera freely, examine vehicles from every angle, and use tools to identify missing or damaged components before starting repairs.
 • Repair, Restore, or Scrap: Fix engines, brakes, and suspension, restore worn parts through interactive mini-games, or scrap components for partial value.
 • Customization & Tuning: Modify body panels, improve performance, and apply visual upgrades to increase vehicle value.
 • Test Drives & Quality Checks: Take restored cars on a test track to evaluate handling and ensure everything works properly.
 • Explore & Discover Hidden Stories: Search scrapyards and abandoned locations to find rare vehicles, hidden items, and mysterious traces.

Become a master restorer, revive automotive history, and turn rusted relics into priceless masterpieces. Every car you save is more than a restoration — it’s a story brought back to life.
70010000113607.intro: Become a master restorer and turn scrap into treasures.
70010000113607.name: Junkyard Garage Simulator

70010000113608.description:
■■ About the Game ■■

Heroic Songs: the Remix! is an Idol × City-Building Simulation Game where you help develop a land known as the Void while guiding the main heroine, Akari Sunohara, on her journey to become an idol. Build roads and facilities, attract new residents, and transform this desolate world into a vibrant Fanctuary worthy of the spotlight!

● A Diverse Lineup of Buildings
With over 50 unique buildings, you'll have plenty of ways to shape your city!
- Basic Facilities such as houses to attract Fans, and roads to connect your buildings
- Production Facilities, placed around resource tiles and visited by Fans to gather materials
- Processing Facilities, which convert one type of resource into another as a result of Fan visits
- Recreational Facilities, where resources are spent to generate Likes, a key progression resource
You can also earn Likes through Tours, or the rhythm-based Concerts described below.

● Idol Stages
By constructing personal stages, idols will perform for their Fans by singing and dancing in town! Idols with stages become available for Concerts and Tours, and will boost the surrounding buildings whenever they’re present.

As idols gain experience from performances, their levels rise—enhancing those building effects even further! You can also assign skill points to customize how their influence spreads across your city. ;)

● Concerts
Concerts are short, 30-second rhythm games. Keep in time with the music to hit the target score and clear the stage! Successful Concerts will unlock new story content, boost idol and Fan experiences, and provide rewards. Some idols will also unlock alternate stage outfits as you progress through the game.

● A Wild Yet Heartfelt Story Unfolds!
Progress through successful concerts, construction projects, and city development to unlock new chapters in the story.
Follow Akari Sunohara—an ordinary girl with a love for idols—as she discovers her true calling. Dive deeper into each of the five main heroines in dedicated Character Stories, and experience each idol’s unique charm!

■ Characters ■
● Protagonist (You)
You’re the one who was transported to the Void alongside Akari. As the central figure in this world, your role is to support Akari and the other idols on their journey.

● Akari Sunohara / voiced by: Seika Hirose
An ordinary girl with an extraordinary love for idols. She possesses the innate potential to become one herself, and must step into the spotlight to find a way home.
At first, she struggles with doubt and frustration, but grows through her encounters with veteran idols and her fans in the fantasy worlds.

● Ruri Tsukuyomi / voiced by: Risae Matsuda
The Ultimate Idol, reigning at the top with an overwhelming presence and voice. Her legacy echoes throughout the various fantasy worlds Akari explores.

● Lynalelle Singulant / voiced by: Hitomi Sekine
The idol of Seven Falls, a fantasy-themed world. She’s a king, an idol, and a passionate idol superfan all in one!

● Haru / voiced by Yuka Amemiya
The idol of Discordia, a sci-fi-themed world. She’s a trusted senior to Akari, but seems to be hiding some complicated circumstances.

● Kaguya / voiced by Risae Matsuda
The idol of Karan Ashihara, a world with a traditional Japanese aesthetic. As the wild and fearsome Behemoth of Befoulment, she stands in Akari’s path as a powerful rival.
70010000113608.intro:
Build a Sanctuary for Idols Across Fantasy Worlds!
A City-Building × Idol Simulation Game
70010000113608.name: Heroic Songs: the Remix!

70010000113615.description:
Do you have a sharp eye? We challenge you to test it! Find 10 differences between two similar images. But beware, they change every time you attempt it!

- 9 levels with changing differences to find (we didn't really count all the combinations, sorry!)
- cute hand-drawn cakes and sweets
- hints
70010000113615.intro: Ready to test your detective skills? Find the differences between two similar sweet scenes!
70010000113615.name: There's No Differences: Cake

70010000113634.description:
The game "Leo and Tig," based on the animated series of the same name, takes you on an adventure with the show's charming characters: Leo the Amur leopard, Tig the playful tiger, Mila the weasel, Yara the agile lynx, Kuba the cheerful pig, Martik the squirrel, Kino the eaglet, and Willy the brave bunny.

Each character has their own unique abilities that help them overcome any challenge! The game features seven stunningly beautiful locations, where a story about friendship, mutual assistance, and caring for nature unfolds.

Leo and Tig: Taiga is a captivating arcade game featuring your favorite characters.

A unique world set in the taiga, where players can complete engaging quests and solve challenging puzzles. Unlock the unique abilities of the animal characters and let them explore beautiful places that hold many secrets.
70010000113634.intro: A bundle of two games about the exciting adventures of Leo and Tig.
70010000113634.name: Leo And Tig

70010000113641.description:
The next episode of Tsubasa’s riveting adventure is here! Enjoy the thrill of spectacular soccer actions with 110 playable characters and new sensational super moves. Challenge a friend in the field or support Tsubasa on his Journey, the ball is yours.

• New and Improved Gameplay
Action on the field has been enhanced with powerful new super moves that intensify every action, from passing to blocking. The updated system adds more strategy, especially in goalkeeper versus shooter duels featuring spectacular super shots and blocks from the original series characters.

• A Soccer World That is Bigger Than Before!
Featuring 22 national teams, over 110 playable characters, and more than 150 cutscenes highlighting moves on the pitch! Previously unseen teams from the manga and original teams and characters clash in glorious, meticulous animation. The excitement of these once-in-a-lifetime moments has never been higher!

• Experience the New Storylines based on the World Youth Arc supervised by Yoichi Takahashi
Pick up where the first game left off and follow Tsubasa as he takes on formidable new rivals in the thrilling story based on the World Youth arc.
Discover expanded storylines overseen by the original creator, Yoichi Takahashi, and witness powerhouse nations clash as they chase international glory.
Step onto the pitch in the NEW STARS ROUTE, create your own custom player, join the Japanese national team, and fight alongside Tsubasa on the road to world victory.

• Powerful and Inspiring Music
Tadayoshi Makino (SpinSolfa), praised for his moving BGM tracks from the previous title, brings over 100 energized tracks to this iteration. Dare to compete with this exhilarating compilation of melodies perfectly suited to the high-octane action of Captain Tsubasa, the king of sports of anime, as Tsubasa and his teammates give their all on the pitch for the ultimate victory.
70010000113641.name: CAPTAIN TSUBASA 2: WORLD FIGHTERS

70010000113662.description:
NATO forces are now engaged in high-intensity conflict against their historic enemies.

As a pilot in NATO's unified command, you will fly the best Western fighter planes (Rafale, F18, F22, F35) and lead a squadron of allied aircraft (Typhoon, Mirage, etc.).

Together, you will have to neutralize enemy fighters as well as targets on land and at sea, in a variety of weather conditions.

Thanks to the advanced realism of its physics engine and high-definition graphics, you will experience all the sensations of a modern Western fighter pilot.
70010000113662.intro: Fight as a fighter pilot in current conflicts.
70010000113662.name: Top Gun Global War

70010000113667.description: Inspired by the gritty atmosphere and taut suspense of 80s slasher films, Christmas Mutilator™ is a gripping, stealth-driven horror experience set in the chilly seclusion of a lonely, snow-covered cabin. You take on the role of Amelia, a loving mother and wife who has traveled to the remote cabin to celebrate Christmas with her husband, Adam, and kids. But when a murderous maniac starts stalking the cabin, your vacation plans take a terrible turn.
70010000113667.name: Christmas Mutilator

70010000113673.description:
Cooking Cat-astrophe is a cozy yet fast-paced cooking game starring an adorable cat chef trying to survive the chaos of ever-changing kitchens. Prepare burgers, soups, and salads, assemble each order with precision, and keep your workspace spotless while juggling multiple tasks at once.

As you progress, the kitchen layouts shift and reposition themselves, forcing you to adapt on the fly and rethink your strategy. Learn new recipes, sharpen your timing, and tackle increasingly challenging stages where speed, accuracy, and quick decision-making are the keys to success.

Unlock skill upgrades to enhance your cat chef’s abilities and collect unique skins to customize your hero. With simple controls, a warm cartoony atmosphere, and a charming feline protagonist, Cooking Cat-astrophe delivers light, fun, and engaging culinary challenges for players of all skill levels.
70010000113673.name: Cooking Cat-Astrophe

70010000113675.description:
ABOUT THIS GAME

Unleash the mayhem in Pritto Prisoner, the cute and chaotic 4v2 asymmetrical party game where animal inmates lay poopie traps, spray peepee, and use special skills to outwit robot guards.

Inside a notorious island prison, the world’s cutest criminals, including a gangster rabbit, an influencer cat, and even a penguin chef, are locked in maximum security under 24/7 robot surveillance.

Will you scramble to freedom as a poopie-dropping prisoner, or hunt them down as a custom-built robot warden? Choose your side and jump into unpredictable escapes, chaotic chases, and laugh-out-loud clashes where no two matches ever play out the same!


ANIMAL TEAM

・Complete funny and unique objectives around the prison to open the escape gates.

・Eat bread and drink water to fuel your potty powers: poopie and peepee.

・Poopie: dropping your load in toilets powers you up and brings you one step closer to freedom!

・Peepee: unleash your bladder on robots and cameras to short-circuit them, giving your team a chance to escape.


・Whether you’re slicing through robots as a lion sword master or dropping explosive decoy art as an elephant fraudster, every animal packs unique skills and passives that unlock outrageous new playstyles!

・Captured animals go to the Nap Room, where counting sheep can bring them back. Get tucked in too many times and it’s Deep Sleep for good!


ROBOT TEAM

・Build your robot from mix-and-match parts, combining upper and lower bodies with gadgets and boosts that let you capture in your own way.

・Uppers: shape your offense with weapons like the Stun Gun for shocking captures or the Lasso for long-range takedowns.

・Lowers: change the way you move with options like legs, wheels, or tank treads to chase down escapees.

・Equip gadgets and boosts like the Magic Hand to trap animals, the Wormhole to slip through walls, the Motion Sensor to track their moves, and the Shield to block enemy peepee.

・Collect poopie left behind during the match to unlock stronger upgrades and supercharge your robot.

・Coordinate with your robot partner to turn every escape attempt into a chaotic back-and-forth of counters, traps, and mayhem.


KEY FEATURES

・Asymmetrical 4v2 multiplayer with animals on the run and robots on the hunt

・Quick 10-minute matches perfect for party play

・A hilarious yet strategic peepee-and-poopie gameplay loop

・Kanahei’s adorable art style and TeddyLoid’s energetic soundtrack

・Cross-platform play

・Single-player campaign to uncover the secrets of Prison Island

・Complete Pritto Challenges to earn Pritto Coins and unlock decorations

・Customize your animals and robots with a variety of fun decorations

・Host private matches with your friends using custom settings
70010000113675.intro: Escape or capture in this cute and chaotic 4v2 action party game! Play as mischievous animal prisoners using peepee, poopie, and special skills to escape.
70010000113675.name: PRITTO PRISONER

70010000113681.description:
Collect the pieces of cute maid girls and complete the puzzles!

There are 15 stages in total.
As you clear each stage, the difficulty increases!

Stages 1–10: 30 pieces
Stages 11–15: 50 pieces

The final stage is a challenging one with no background watermark!
Take your time, examine each piece closely, and complete the puzzle!

When you complete a puzzle, high-resolution maid girls will be added to your gallery♪

=====================
At “AGE,” we support video creators who stream or record gameplay.
No permission is required for game commentary or streaming.
70010000113681.intro: A puzzle game featuring many adorable maid girls has arrived!
70010000113681.name: Maid Girls

70010000113690.description:
BALL x PIT is a fast-paced fantasy roguelite where heroes must find the balls to plunge deeper into a seemingly bottomless pit of monsters. Develop arcane ammunition and resources in pursuit of treasure, recruiting additional heroes to aid you in your perilous quest.

Ballbylon has fallen. After a meteoric and completely unexpected event annihilated the great city, all that remains is an ominous, yawning pit. Treasure hunters from far and wide flock to the city’s tomb to seek their fortune, plumbing the depths in search of Ballbylon’s scattered riches. Few return.

The pit plays host to armies of barbaric creatures, hellbent on ending your quest before it even begins. Armed with a growing arsenal of magic-infused projectiles, batter your way through multiple levels of increasingly challenging obstacles to claim the ultimate prizes and rebuild New Ballbylon.

Fuse Your Balls
The Ball Fusion system encourages explosive experimentation with over 60 randomized balls to equip and combine during your journey. Discover overpowered combinations and unexpected synergies from hundreds of possible outcomes.

Build New Ballbylon
Expand New Ballbylon with over 70 unique buildings that provide gameplay bonuses and unlock further power-ups, new characters, and more! As your community grows, task homebound heroes with automated tasks to keep the resources coming while you dive deeper into the pit.

Discover New Realms
Face legions of diverse enemies within the pit, battling through barren deserts, frozen caverns, savage forests and more. Each region offers its own unique set of hazards on top of hordes of increasingly challenging foes and mighty, screen-filling bosses.

Recruit Fellow Hunters
As you explore the pit you’ll encounter fellow treasure hunters eager to add their skills to your expedition. Each character has unique, upgradable mechanics that totally change the way you play the game. Experimentation and adaptation are crucial to the success of New Ballbylon!
