70010000113690.intro: A brick-breaking, ball-fusing, base-building survival roguelite.
70010000113690.name: BALL x PIT – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000113696.description:
Konpaku Youmu sets out to prove herself to Saigyouji Yuyuko, mistress of Hakugyokurou. Make use of her three skills and challenge the veteran incident resolver and shrine maiden, Hakurei Reimu. An exhilarating 3D bullet hell action game set in Gensokyo, the world of Touhou Project!

This game is a Touhou Project fangame.

●About This Game

Konpaku Youmu works as the gardener, security, and swordsmanship instructor for Saigyouji Yuyuko, mistress of Hakugyokurou.

One day, upon Youmu scolding her mistress for slacking off in her training, Yuyuko told her "with your lack of skill, there won't be any training."
Yuyuko then challenged her to prove herself by defeating the shrine maiden who'd resolved Gensokyo's incidents time and time again:
She was to go and defeat Hakurei Reimu.

Youmu wasn't happy with this, but showing awareness of her inexperience, she accepted her mistress's conditions and set off for Gensokyo.
Will she be able to overcome the dangers awaiting her, defeat Reimu, and prove her skills to Yuyuko?

●Gameplay

・Use Three Skills to Clear Stages and Beat Bosses!
Youmu has three skills that each have their own strong points – movement, area damage, and range, as well as high-damage Spell Card. They'll come in handy when clearing stages if used well!

For example, your dash skill can help extend your jump range as well as do damage, and your ranged skill can defeat troublesome foes waiting on the other side of gaps.

・Each Skill Has its Own Button!
Previously, you toggle between between Youmu's three skills as you fought, but the skill controls have been updated to be more intuitive.

・Farm Combos to Turn the Tides
Continuing to hit enemies will raise your combo counter, granting bonuses to your score and skill recharge rate.

The latter bonus lets you use your skills much more often, making battles much easier.

・Difficulty Options
Play on Easy, Hard, or Normal; whichever suits your skill level.

・Music
Touhou: Blossom Blade features Touhou arranges from Shoichiro Sakamoto, AKA Sound Sepher, to make stages feel even more alive.

・Other Changes
Balance changes
More breakable objects
HUD additions
No more fall penalty
Graphics optimized for modern hardware
Added English localization

Please enjoy the newly refined and more accessible Touhou: Blossom Blade on Nintendo Switch™!
70010000113696.intro:
Touhou: Blossom Blade, the origin title of doujin circle Ankake Spa, returns in a remastered edition!
Set off on a journey through Gensokyo with Youmu.
70010000113696.name: Touhou: Blossom Blade

70010000113700.description:
Get ready to grab your shovel and dig the most epic holes on the world’s most exotic beaches! In Hole Digging Beach - Simulator, every grain of sand matters, and every hole could hide a treasure, a surprise, or just pure fun. Relax in this lighthearted simulator where the sun, the waves, and the sand become your personal playground.

Key Features:
• Detailed tropical beaches – Explore diverse locations, from deserted islands to lively tourist shores, each with its own secrets and breathtaking scenery.
• Customizable tools – Collect, unlock, and upgrade shovels, pickaxes, and other tools—each with unique benefits and distinct visual styles.
• Hidden treasures and mysteries – Uncover rare items, lost relics, or clues to greater mysteries as you dig deeper into the sand.
• Character customization – Create your perfect beach avatar with fun outfits, silly hats, and accessories that make you stand out in the sun.

Whether you’re hunting for buried treasure or just aiming to dig the perfectly round hole, Hole Digging Beach - Simulator is the perfect place where the sun never sets on the fun!
70010000113700.intro: Dig, explore, and discover the secrets buried beneath exotic beaches.
70010000113700.name: Hole Digging Beach Simulator

70010000113762.description:
Night. Silence. Every creak could give you away. One wrong step — and the alarm will go off.
In Crime Thief Simulator you play as a professional thief for whom time is the greatest enemy. Break into houses, search for valuable items, and decide what’s worth the risk.

Every second counts: the longer you stay inside, the higher the chance of being caught.
Keep an eye on the timer, listen for sounds, avoid lights and surveillance cameras. Plan your escape route in advance — when time runs out, there may be no way back.

Use tools to pick locks and disable security. Each mission tests your patience, reflexes, and instincts.
Will you be able to strip the house down to the last coin and get out before the timer ends?
70010000113762.name: Crime Thief Simulator

70010000113767.description:
Love is in the air. And so is Solitaire!
Enter the enchanting world of Jewel Match as you fall head over heels for this charming new Solitaire adventure.
Discover and rebuild 5 gorgeous scenes as you follow each passionate couple across the land.
Play 200 levels, plus 50 bonus mahjong levels to unlock! Dozens of game play variations add to the classic Solitaire, such as obstacles, power-ups, frozen cards, and more!
Search every last level for gems and coins that you can use to purchase new upgrades for each scene, plus aim for the elusive “Perfect” in each level.
Bring your sweetheart and a deck of cards, because all is fair in love and solitaire.

Features:
- 200 lovely Solitaire levels.
- 5 beautiful scenes to build.
- 50 replayable bonus mahjong levels!
- Choose between several delightful card designs.
- Tons of game play variations and power-ups.
70010000113767.intro: Bring your sweetheart along in this lovely Solitaire adventure!
70010000113767.name: Jewel Match Solitaire L'Amour

70010000113773.description:
Spy Guy is an amazing detective who searches for hidden objects in various locations and cities around the world. This time, he has been tasked with traveling to Europe to find hidden objects in European capitals and cities.
Spy Guy Europe, with a new hint system and three game modes, is a great choice for anyone who loves searching for hidden objects and solving puzzles.
70010000113773.intro: Spy Guy sets out to conquer Europe in a brand new detective game!
70010000113773.name: Spy Guy Europe

70010000113779.description:
You know all the rules and possible combinations, so just enjoy new levels and new obstacles! This bowling is still not the classical one.

Knock down everithing with just one shot. It's challenging and fun!

Try the newest levels — you will be surprised at how strange they are!

Check out the new fun game from the NOSTRA.GAMES team.

New even more strange levels to discover!
70010000113779.intro: Play bowling in this puzzle way. Use your mind first!
70010000113779.name: Pin Strike 3

70010000113787.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 30 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.
70010000113787.intro: Meet over 30 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000113787.name: Yabai Girls: Heavenly Homemaker

70010000113808.description:
Let's make kushikatsu on the Nintendo Switch™!
Fry the ingredients without burning them, then add sauce on top!
With a Joy-Con™ for each player, up to 4 players can join in the fun!
Reach for the ultimate high score!

《Rules》
Make kushikatsu to order!
Fry the ingredients and add sauce for the finishing touch!
Keep cooking until time runs out!

《How to Play》
1. Add the ingredients to the oil and start cooking!

2. Once they're ready, take them out of the oil!

3. Choose 3 kushikatsu that have dried, then select a sauce! Choose from Worcester sauce, miso, and tartar sauce!

4. When you're done, serve the kushikatsu to the customer! The closer they match the order, the more points you get!

[Score Attack]
Cook up as many kushikatsu as possible and aim for the top spot on the leaderboards!

[Battle]
Compete with others and test your kushikatsu-making skills!
70010000113808.intro:
Get ready for a delicious kushikatsu-making challenge!
Make tons of kushikatsu and watch your food cart prosper!
70010000113808.name: Make it! Kushikatsu

70010000113818.description:
The hotel looks peaceful at first.
Sunlit corridors, quiet lounges, and guests who seem perfectly composed.

But attention lingers in subtle ways.
A glance held for a second too long.
A conversation that shifts without warning.
Men whose confidence feels practiced… and intentional.

In Sugar Daddy Crush: Hidden Hotel Love Story, you step into an adult narrative focused on attraction, restraint, and emotional timing.

Your stay becomes a series of encounters shaped by dialogue, perception, and the choices you make in each moment.

These are men who value control, image, and experience. Getting closer isn’t about bold gestures, but about understanding when to speak, when to wait, and when silence says more than words.

Every response affects how relationships unfold. What feels casual may open unexpected paths, while a single misstep can quietly close a connection before it begins.

Trust builds gradually through shared moments, unspoken interest, and the sense of being noticed.

As the days pass, motivations surface, boundaries shift, and the hotel reveals more than its elegant exterior suggests. Not every path leads to romance, and not every story ends the same.

This is a visual novel driven by atmosphere, character presence, and the tension between curiosity and restraint.


Features:

● ADULT STORY DRIVEN VISUAL NOVEL: A narrative experience focused on mature relationships, subtle attraction, and emotional tension.

● CHOICE BASED DIALOGUE: Every response influences trust, distance, and how each connection evolves.

● MULTIPLE ROUTES & ENDINGS: Different paths lead to distinct outcomes shaped by your decisions.

● CHARACTER FOCUSED ENCOUNTERS: Each guest brings his own presence, pace, and boundaries to the story.

● ATMOSPHERIC HOTEL SETTING: A refined vacation backdrop where quiet moments carry meaning.

● ANIME VISUAL NOVEL: Expressive character art designed to highlight mood and emotion.


Choose carefully who you let close.
Play now!
70010000113818.intro:
Elegant men.
Hidden intentions.
A love story you control.
70010000113818.name: Sugar Daddy Crush: Hidden Hotel Love Story

70010000113824.description:
Time To Usher In a Life As Ellie the Little Apprentice Witch!
• Step into the shoes of Ellie, an apprentice witch dispatched from Lucerine Ortu—a land of witches—and experience her journey of self development!
• Explore brand-new areas, craft potions and help the villagers. A heartwarming and cozy adventure awaits you here.
• Fish, gather, decorate your house, and interact with cats! We have all kinds of activities that will make every day an unforgettable experience.

Activities and Explorations as a Witch
• Navigate forests, caves, cliffs and lakes on your broom to meet adorable life forms and complete your Encyclopedia.
• Gather materials to craft problem-solving potions, discover hidden treasures and unlock new paths.

Stories of the Village and Its Inhabitants
• Work as an apprentice witch. Help out at the village and solve problems for the villagers.
• Make friends with the villagers as you restore the village. By establishing bonds, you can unlock their stories and even learn about their secrets.

Collections and Home Decoration
• Gather recipes and materials to craft furniture, which will give your living space a personal touch.
• Collect and customize brooms to add extra enjoyment to your explorations.

Laid-back Moments
• Spend your peaceful free time fishing and chatting. Interact with cats to deepen your cross-species friendships.
• Create your exclusive story in this magical yet ever so relatable world!
70010000113824.intro: Begin a cozy apprentice witch life in the woods with Ellie.
70010000113824.name: Little Witch in the Woods

70010000113831.description:
Last stop of the line. All passengers must exit

In The Last Train, a first-person psychological horror game, routine turns into nightmare when you fall asleep on the subway. Upon waking, you discover you've reached the end of the line, an abandoned station shrouded in darkness. But you're not alone; something else waits in the shadows, watching you and following your every move.

Explore the gloomy corridors and hidden corners of the last station as you try to find a way back to safety. Every sound, every movement, could be a sign that what's hunting you is closer than you think. You'll need to keep your calm, solve puzzles, and find clues that reveal the dark secrets hidden within this abandoned station. Will you escape before the entity catches you?

Features

- First-person horror with touches of humor
- 4 endings to unlock
- Interact with and run from popular characters
- Discover secrets that reveal a larger story
- Intense experience in a mysterious station

Prepare for a one-way journey into fear. The last station awaits you… and not everyone makes it back.
70010000113831.intro: First-person horror game where a mysterious entity chases you
70010000113831.name: THE LAST TRAIN: Baquedano

70010000113832.description:
From the moment you arrive, attention feels natural.

The hotel is elegant and relaxed, but the atmosphere carries something more. Certain women notice you immediately. Their interest isn’t rushed, it’s assured. Smiles come easily. Conversations feel effortless. And when they speak, it’s clear they know exactly what they want.

In Mom Crush: Hidden Hotel Love Story, you step into a narrative built around confidence, attraction, and being desired. This isn’t about chasing attention, it’s about responding to it.

These women are experienced, self-assured, and direct in their own way. They enjoy testing chemistry, guiding conversations, and deciding when to move closer. Your role is to recognize the moment, match their energy, and choose how far each connection goes.

This visual novel focuses on chemistry, presence, and the appeal of being wanted, all within a refined, relaxed hotel setting.

Let them make the first move.
Decide how the story ends.


Features

● ADULT ROMANCE VISUAL NOVEL: A story centered on attraction, confidence, and mature relationships.

● CONFIDENCE DRIVEN CHOICES: Your responses influence desire, chemistry, and how women react to you.

● MULTIPLE ROUTES & ENDINGS: Each relationship follows a distinct path based on your decisions.

● CHARACTER LED ROMANCE: Women with strong presence, personality, and intention.

● ELEGANT HOTEL SETTING: A luxurious vacation backdrop that enhances mood and connection.

● ANIME VISUAL NOVEL STYLE: Stylish character art that emphasizes expression and chemistry.


Choose carefully who you let close.
Play now!
70010000113832.intro:
Confident women.
Undeniable attraction.
A story where you’re chosen.
70010000113832.name: Mom Crush: Hidden Hotel Love Story

70010000113887.description:
The long-running Hakuoki otome visual novel series enters a new era! Hakuoki SSL ~Sweet School Life~ puts a modern spin on the Edo period romance of the main series, instead casting heroine Chizuru and the handsome warriors of the Shinsengumi as students and teachers living in modern Japan. School life antics ensue as these beloved characters hold a school festival, stress over midterms, get into watergun fights and more!

Experience a fun slice-of-life story through unlockable event scenes, engaging dialogue and beautifully illustrated character portraits, all localized in English for the first time. Explore unique endings with each character and enjoy mini-games that make this standalone entry extra special!

• Take the role of Chizuru as she’s surrounded by familiar faces in a new modern setting!
• Engage in fun mini-games with the handsome warriors of the Shinsengumi.
• Make key choices and discover unique endings with each possible love interest!
• Enjoy voiceovers in Japanese and newly localized text in English.
• Navigate scenarios with ease using a variety of UI controls and preferences!
70010000113887.intro: Reunite with familiar faces in a light-hearted modern setting filled with fun and fluffy romance!
70010000113887.name: Hakuoki SSL ~Sweet School Life~

70010000113910.description:
Grab your backpack and climb on in, it’s time to hit the road!  We’ve got cakes to bake, clothes to make, as folks prepare for the Whizz Bang Fair!

As fresh-faced Guild Rookies, you and your best friend Bubba will travel through picturesque landscapes in your reliable old caravan, helping communities along the way. Craft a variety of handmade items—from hearty meals to stylish outfits—then set up your market stall and share goodies with the local townsfolk.
Meet an eclectic mix of characters, each with their own stories and needs. Cultivate connections across Harvestvale and uphold the mission of the Guild—help those in need and spread kindness!

Express Yourself
In Cozy Caravan, you can be whoever you want to be. Create your own adorable character from dozens of animal species and even more colour variations.
Curate countless outfit combinations, making your character feel like the coziest version of you.
Axolotls
Badgers
Beavers
Bunnies
Capybaras
Dogs
Foxes
Frogs
Parrots
Raccoons
And many more!

Life on the Road
Your caravan is your home, transportation, kitchen, and more. Customise your ride and journey how you like—help hitchhikers, collect crafting resources, and explore the nooks and crannies of Harvestvale and beyond. Keep an eye out, you never know where you might find someone who could use a lift!

Spread Happiness
In Harvestvale, happiness grows from even the smallest interaction.
Spreading happiness is the goal of every Guild Rookie. Happiness brings growth, enabling you to upgrade your caravan, learn new crafting recipes, and more! If you’re looking for ways to help, there’s always someone in need.

Share The Fun
Take a break and say “hoyo!” to the local townsfolk and join in on fun activities! Test your stone-skipping skills by the water, or drop a fishing line in a nearby pond. Build connections with local townsfolk by joining games of Hide & Seek or Hopscotch. You can even help cafes with their lunchtime rush!

Fair Game!
The annual Whizz Bang Fair is just around the corner, but it’s all gone awry! Help folks along the way as they try to get things ready for the big day!
70010000113910.intro: Head out on a gentle journey in your reliable old caravan, crafting hearty meals, running market stalls and sharing goodies with local townsfolk.
70010000113910.name: Cozy Caravan

70010000113912.description:
Story:
1981, Somewhere in Europe.

Eighteen-year-old Noah is haunted by the memory of his mother abandoning him as a child.
He lives with his father Leonard, a failed writer obsessed with collecting items related to “Dictator X.”
Noah wishes he would stop, but Leonard refuses to give up his strange obsession, even as they struggle financially.

One day, an auction invitation arrives, addressed to Leonard. Ignoring Noah’s protests, Leonard sets off for the old castle where the auction is to be held, promising to tell Noah everything once he returns.
But Leonard never comes home. With no way to contact him, Noah heads to the castle himself, determined to bring him home—only to witness something shocking.
Trapped inside the castle with the other guests, Noah decided to accept the Auctioneer's invitation, and take part in the auction himself.

Characters:
Noah Crawford (VA. Kengo Kawanishi)
Leonard Crawford (VA. Rikiya Koyama)
Edgar Schultz (VA. Daisuke Namikawa)
Christoph Treheim von Berg (VA. Nobunaga Shimazaki)
Otto Klein (VA. Shunsuke Takeuchi)
Karla Becker (VA. Maaya Uchida)
Lorraine Klopp (VA. Yui Ishikawa)
Hell (VA. Akira Ishida)
Auctioneer (VA. Show Hayami)

ame features:
- Explore freely within an old castle rendered in 3D
- Use reasoning and deduction to solve clues via the Word Cloud System
- Use memories to expose the truth via each Auction

In the exploration phase, you will search rooms and floors, and talk to other participants, revealing trauma and lies that will lead you to the truth each one keeps hidden.

Information you learn here will be stored in your Word Cloud, and can then be used to solve mysteries during each auction!

But in this place, the auction exhibits aren't bid on with money, but with memories.
Auction participants try to win their bids by offering their own memories, using a memory reconstruction device known as EPO.
But memories burdened by secrets or trauma can change completely, becoming distorted and incorrect.
If the participants offer incomplete memories, their auction bids will fail.

Noah must become their supporter, fixing each target's memory to ensure they are correct.
If the auction is a success, the truth will be revealed—unleashing the dramatic story behind each ill-fated auction exhibit.


Story / Script: Rika Suzuki
Character Design: KOHSKE
Music: Yuko Komiyama, Tsukasa Masuko
Director / Producer: Shinsuke Umeda (IzanagiGames)


* This game is a story about young people learning about the past, and striving to protect a peaceful future. Although memories related to past wars feature in this game, it does not in any way, seek to glorify or promote the crimes of war.
70010000113912.intro:
The Auction of Dark Memories Begins Now.
What truths await beyond a bid made with your life?
70010000113912.name: Dark Auction

70010000113926.description:
In the heart of uncharted lands, a bustling colony emerges.
The Governor’s arrival looms. The fate of Popper Lands Colony rests in your capable hands.
As a seasoned settler, your expertise is vital to its success.

Here’s what awaits you:
1 - 110 Popping Levels: Dive into a captivating journey across 110 colorful and challenging levels. Match bubbles, strategize, and watch your village flourish.
2 - Exciting Power-Ups: Unleash magical abilities and boost your progress. These power-ups will keep you on your toes.
3 - Explore gorgeous locations: Embark on an adventure through a myriad of stunning locations.
4 - Witness Your Village Grow: Start from scratch and witness your humble settlement evolve into a bustling hub of activity

The Popper Lands Colony awaits your touch.
Gather your wits, pop those bubbles, and build a legacy that echoes through generations.
The Governor’s arrival draws near, will you rise to the challenge?
70010000113926.intro: A new colony is appearing in popper lands!
70010000113926.name: Popper Lands Colony

70010000113957.description:
Drone Delivery Express: City Simulator is a relaxing drone delivery game set in a realistic modern city. Your main mission is simple: take off, fly across the streets and rooftops, and deliver different packages safely and on time.

Choose from multiple drones and enjoy smooth, satisfying gameplay that’s easy to learn and fun to master. Each level introduces new delivery routes and fresh challenges, while the atmosphere constantly changes thanks to dynamic time and weather—bright daytime flights, beautiful sunsets, and rainy nights.

Fly with precision, plan your path, and enjoy a calm simulation experience made for players who want to unwind.
70010000113957.name: Drone Delivery Express: City Simulator

70010000113970.description:
The bedlam is back, and now it’s online too. Grab and swing through all-new weird and wonderful worlds with up to four players in online and local co-op and versus play.

Take your partners by the hand (or head) and swing your ungainly chain from platform to pillar and beyond. Let go at the wrong moment and meet your splattery end, but a solid grip and pro swinging will take you over the finish line in sweet harmony!

Online Pandemonium
Adding to the game’s couch co-op roots, Heave Ho 2 takes the chaos online for the first time. Get a grip on faraway friends, then drop them into the void from a safe distance!

Wild Worlds
Launch yourself and your friends through eight themed worlds of fiendish fun, from weightless space and kitchen chaos, to medieval mayhem, ninja nonsense, and much more.

Push, Pull, Shoot, Squeeze
Pop guns, drones, space ships, ski lifts, keys, and ketchup are just a few of the items you’ll play with on your swinging travels. And lasers. Of course lasers.

Fight Among Friends
Take revenge on your underperforming co-op teammates in versus mode through a series of frantic challenges, cunningly designed to start a completely different argument every time!

*This product is released for the Nintendo Switch. It can also be played on Nintendo Switch 2. However, please note that a separate product, "Heave Ho 2",
is available exclusively for Nintendo Switch 2.
*Save data and Additional Contents are not compatible between the two versions. Please be careful to avoid duplicate or mistaken purchases.
*Nintendo Switch 2 Edition and Upgrade Pack are not available for this product.
*This game does not support single-player mode.
70010000113970.intro: Get a grip, it’s Heave Ho 2! The insane 2-4 player party game sequel takes the couch co-op mayhem online for the first time. Grab what you can and swing to win!
70010000113970.name: Heave Ho 2

70010000114001.description:
HEROES IN A HALF SHELL

Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Shredder’s Revenge features groundbreaking gameplay rooted in timeless classic brawling mechanics, brought to you by the beat ’em up experts at Dotemu and Tribute Games. Bash your way through gorgeous pixel art environments and slay tons of hellacious enemies with your favorite Turtle, each with his own skills and moves - making each run unique! Choose a fighter, use radical combos to defeat your opponents and experience intense combats loaded with breathtaking action and outrageous ninja abilities. Stay sharp as you face off against Shredder and his faithful Foot Clan alone, or grab your best buds and play with up to four players simultaneously!

TURTLE BOYS DON’T CUT KRANG NO SLACK

With Bebop and Rocksteady assaulting Channel 6 and stealing super gnarly devices to support Krang and Shredder’s latest twisted plan, Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Shredder’s Revenge sees the Turtles battling across a righteous range of timeless TMNT locations. From Manhattan and Coney Island, to city rooftops and dank sewers, help the fearsome foursome trounce Foot Soldiers, Triceraton Warriors, and Rock Troops all the way to Dimension X!

TURTLE POWER!!

Enjoy stunning full-color pixel art graphics and a vintage TMNT vibe that will rock you straight back to the awesome 80s. Every character, vehicle, weapon, item, and background is directly inspired by the 1987 TV show, making you feel like you hopped into the television -- with a dope mix of killer humor and action-packed adventures!

FEATURES:

● Gnarly game design takes you back to the ’80s

● Beautiful full-color pixel art graphics

● Old-school gameplay enhanced with super-fresh mechanics

● Up to six players simultaneously

● Play with iconic TMNT characters and vehicles in diverse gameplay options

● Radical new story mode
70010000114001.intro: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Shredder’s Revenge reunites Leonardo, Michelangelo, Donatello, and Raphael as they kick shell in a beautifully realized beat ’em up.
70010000114001.name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Shredder's Revenge

70010000114005.description:
*This is the Nintendo Switch™ version. There is also a Nintendo Switch™ 2 version of this game. Please select the version you require carefully.

Romancing SaGa 3, the acclaimed JRPG first released in Japan in 1995, returns in a full 3D remake. Whether you're a longtime SaGa fan or a newcomer, this reimagining offers a fresh take on a classic adventure.

■Story
Every 300 years, Morastrum, the Star of Death, rises, dooming all born beneath it except the mysterious Child of Destiny. Nearly twenty years after its last appearance, an insurrection in Loanne uncovers a far greater threat: the Four Sinistrals seek to reopen the gates to the Abyss. Eight heroes bound by fate must unite to save the world.

■Characters
Choose from eight protagonists, each with a unique story, and recruit over twenty allies to your party

■Graphics
Inspired by the original pixel art and Tomomi Kobayashi's illustrations, the remake features character designs by Yoshiro Ambe and fully realized 3D environments.

■Freeform Scenario System
Your choices shape the adventure, from the stories you pursue to the order in which you challenge the Sinistrals, creating a unique experience every playthrough.

■Battle and Character Power Systems
Classic SaGa features such as Glimmer and Formation return alongside a new timeline-based battle system and United Attacks for deeper tactical combat.

■Difficulty
Choose from Casual, Normal, or Classic difficulty to tailor the challenge to your playstyle.

■Music and Voices
Original composer Kenji Ito supervised newly arranged music, with players able to switch between original and arranged tracks.
70010000114005.intro: Choose from eight heroes in this turn-based RPG.
70010000114005.name: Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United

70010000114051.description:
After accidentally falling into the mystical world of spirits, you find yourself in a difficult situation: to find your way home, you will have to work in a local restaurant.

- Dishes from myths and legends
- Mysterious yokai patrons
- Magical restaurant makeover
- The way of the masterful waiter

Master the art of keeping your tray balanced: every mistake can cost you a tip. Learn to manage your time so you can promptly serve all your guests and prevent them from leaving because of long waiting time.
Immerse yourself in the mysterious atmosphere of Japan: serve unusual orders to yokai and learn all the secrets of local cuisine. Serve dishes that even mysterious spirits can enjoy. Today’s menu includes onigiri, sushi and ramen, and fortune cookies for dessert!
Develop your waiter skills to earn more tips and invest them in upgrades, and don’t forget to pay the rent.
Are you ready to make your way as a waiter in the mysterious world of Japanese spirits? Keep your balance, solve puzzles and find your way home!
70010000114051.intro: The Way of the Tray is a waiter simulator with action puzzle elements in a Japanese spirit world setting.
70010000114051.name: The Way of the Tray

70010000114062.description:
"Rave Racer" is a racing game released by NAMCO LIMITED (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1995.
With dynamic presentation and more exhilarating drift control, this title evolved in every way, becoming a hit that soared past the high expectations set for the third installment in the RIDGE RACER series. The diverse soundtrack further pumps up the race, igniting a frenzy that truly lives up to its name—RAVE!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.
70010000114062.name: Arcade Archives Rave Racer

70010000114081.description:
Catch the cutest bugs, train them and win the Summer Beetle Battles Championship in this tiny bug collection game! Upgrade your equipment to find rarer, stronger and shinier little friends.

Kabuto Park is a cute and short bug collection game. Spend a month as Hana, a little girl on summer vacation. Catch the best bugs and level them up, choose your team carefully and fight other kids to become the Summer Beetle Battles champion.

Expect 2 to 4 hours of serene bug catching, exciting little battles and summer vibes.

Catch cute bugs
Beetles! Butterflies! Bees! Dragonflies! And many more! Discover more than 40 cool bug species that live in Kabuto Park and try to catch them by timing your net swings right.

Move your Joy-Con™ to catch bugs! You can swing your Joy-Con just like an insect collecting net!

Win the tiniest sumo fights
Choose your team depending on their stats, abilities or look and show other kids who the best beetle battler is!

Each bug you select for your team will add cards to your deck that you'll be able to use during the little fights. Try to push your opponents out of the ring.

Your rhino beetle is not strong enough? Feed it candies to level it up and you'll have better luck winning the next fight!

Buy cool stuff
Better boots or a better net will surely make you the best bug catcher! Lucky for you, the local store has everything you need to get access to new areas with new bugs, make rare bugs appear more often or make capture easier.

Features
What Kabuto Park offers:

A short creature collector: With 2 to 4 hours of playtime, this game is a perfect snack for an afternoon or a few sessions here and there. I like to keep my game short, to the point and respectful of players' time.
Simple game mechanics: A relaxing capture mini game, little bug battles with a simple deck building gameplay, a light upgrade system and a leveling system to upgrade your favorite critters.
A cozy mood: Summer vibes, childlike wonder, cute art and lovely music!
The cutest bugs: Bugs from all around the world are here and ready to become your friend. You can even pet them in your terrarium!

What Kabuto Park does NOT offer:

No Exploration or moving around in the world.
No big adventure with quests and a long plot.
No multiplayer of any kind. No PVP, no trading.
No spiders. That one is for you arachnophobes.
70010000114081.name: Kabuto Park

70010000114090.description:
The night you cross paths with her, everything changes.
A demon succubus, feared in stories, hunted in legends, appears before you with eyes that hide something no myth ever mentioned: doubt.

She was created to take emotions, not to feel them.
But something inside her is breaking… or awakening.

Succubus Heart: Demon Love Redemption is a narrative driven visual novel where every choice shapes the life of a demon who has never known freedom.
You are not her target.
You become her turning point.

Meet succubi with pasts carved in temptation, duty, rebellion, and loss.
Learn the truth behind their power, their hunger, and the chains that bind them to the world of demons.

You decide whether they remain creatures of desire...
or discover something they were never meant to feel.


Features:

● UNIQUE CHARACTERS: Meet anime succubi/incubi with personalities shaped by sin, fear, or longing.

● IMPACTFUL CHOICES: Your decisions influence whether they rise, fall, or defy their destiny.

● EXCLUSIVE SCENES: Unlock moments that reveal their past, their nature, and the humanity hidden within.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Salvation, corruption, escape, or eternal hunger.

● HIGH REPLAY VALUE: Explore branching narrative routes with completely different outcomes.


She was born to claim souls.
Will you be the one to change hers?
70010000114090.intro:
A demon succubus born from desire.
A fate shaped by your choices.
Will you break her curse… or fall under it?
70010000114090.name: Succubus Hearts: Demon Love Redemption

70010000114098.description:
You feel him before you see him.
A presence heavy enough to silence the air around you.

The demon incubus who appears in your path does not flirt.
He challenges.
He studies.
He waits for the moment you look away… and judges you for it.

"Incubus Heart: Demon Love Redemption" is a narrative visual novel where you unravel the truth behind men shaped not by desire, but by power, pride, and centuries of unspoken regret.

Each incubus hides a wound carved by betrayal, duty, or temptation gone wrong.
They do not ask for your help.
They reveal only what you earn.

Your choices define how far they let you in,
and how much of their darkness you’re willing to take on.


Features:

● LAYERED CHARACTERS: Anime incubi with personalities shaped by control, pride, intelligence, or silent inner wounds.

● DECISIVE CHOICES: Decisions that shift the balance between dominance, trust, and destiny.

● EXCLUSIVE SCENES: Unlock moments that reveal fragments of their power, their past, and what they hide beneath the surface.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Rebellion, redemption, shared fate, or complete collapse.

● HIGH REPLAY VALUE: Explore deeply branching routes with dramatic and unique outcomes.


He walks the line between temptation and danger.
Do you dare walk beside him?
70010000114098.intro:
A demon incubus born from desire.
A fate shaped by your choices.
Will you break his curse… or fall under it?
70010000114098.name: Incubus Hearts: Demon Love Redemption

70010000114104.description:
Some people look at a smile, or a pair of eyes, to understand someone.
Here, everything begins lower: in the softness of a step, the confidence of a pose, or the way a heel touches the ground before a glance is exchanged.

Anime Feet Girls: The Charm Finder Quest mixes lighthearted story moments with short minigames.
As you progress, you’ll unlock exclusive scenes, discover reactions, and get closer to the subtle details that define each girl.

● A shy cutie who hides her face but not her steps.
● A self-made businesswoman who walks with purpose, every movement controlled and intentional.
● A rebel who challenges you without saying a word, lifting her foot just enough to test your attention.

You will learn who they are not by what they say… but by how they move.
Each challenge you clear reveals more: curves, angles, posture, balance.
The closer you get, the more their charm unfolds.


Features:

● Distinct personalities: Meet girls inspired by sweetness, ambition, and playful confidence.

● Minigames: Alternate between quick reflex challenges and light dialogue choices.

● Unlock exclusive scenes, close-up perspectives, and hidden reactions.

● Multiple endings: Your style of play determines who opens up to you.

● High replay value: Different choices reveal new sides of every girl.


Their charms are subtle, their steps unforgettable.
Do you dare to play?
70010000114104.intro:
Step into a world where every step reveals a new charm.
Can you win the trust of the anime girls hidden behind their graceful silhouettes?
70010000114104.name: Anime Feet Girls: The Charm Finder Quest

70010000114110.description:
Minesweeper Classic brings the legendary puzzle back to life with crisp visuals, smooth controls, and the timeless gameplay millions grew up with. Tap into pure logic as you uncover tiles, dodge hidden mines, and chase that perfect clear.

Take on five difficulty levels - from easy warm-ups to expert boards that will test your skills to the limit. Whether you're reliving a classic or discovering it for the first time, every round delivers quick, satisfying, and endlessly replayable fun.

Rediscover a true classic - simple to learn, rewarding to master, and impossible to put down.
70010000114110.name: Minesweeper Classic

70010000114116.description:
You enter a space where confidence begins from the ground up.
The men you meet don’t need speeches or flirting.

Their presence is defined by how they stand, how they move, and the quiet tension of every step they take.

In Anime Feet Boys: The Charm Finder Quest, each encounter mixes light narrative with short skill challenges.

Your performance unlocks exclusive scenes and angles that highlight balance, posture, and the moments where their movements slow down just long enough for you to notice.

● A laid-back athlete who stretches before every challenge, toes brushing the floor with calm precision.
● A model who enjoys making you watch, lifting his heel just enough to break your focus.
● A quiet prodigy whose still stance feels like a trap: you can’t tell if he’s inviting you to look… or daring you to try.

You cannot impress them with words.
You earn their attention by reading their rhythm:
the curve of an arch, the weight shift before a step, the pressure of skin against the ground.

Each victory unlocks more angles, reactions, subtle movements that reveal a side of them most people never see.


Features:

● Strong personalities: Meet anime boys inspired by discipline, elegance, and confident posture.

● Minigames: Switch between reflex challenges and light choices to progress.

● Unlock exclusive scenes that focus on movement, stance, and close-up details.

● Multiple endings: Your timing and performance determine who opens up to you.

● High replay value: Different reactions and scenes await players who pay attention.


They don’t chase you.
They make you watch.
Are you bold enough to play?
70010000114116.intro:
Not everyone reveals their charm through their eyes.
Some do it with the way their bare feet meet the floor.
70010000114116.name: Anime Feet Boys: The Charm Finder Quest

70010000114121.description:
Step into a world where raw magic shapes destiny. You begin as a novice mage, armed with only the most basic spells. With every battle, every conquered foe, and every new land explored, your power grows. Unlock unique abilities, master devastating spells, and carve your path toward the ultimate goal—claiming the throne as the greatest sorcerer of all time.

The realm is torn apart by ancient wars between rival schools of magic. Ambition drives every mage to prove their supremacy, while mystical beasts guard forgotten secrets. To rise above them all, you must challenge enemy sorcerers, defeat legendary monsters, and claim artifacts of untold power.

Key Features:
• Dynamic Combat – Face diverse enemies with distinct fighting styles, from close-range brawlers to ranged spellcasters.
• Evolving Magic System – Unlock and upgrade spells like teleportation, health regeneration, protective shields, freezing blasts, and homing attacks.
• Skill Trees – Shape your own playstyle by investing in offensive or defensive abilities, mixing active and passive powers.
• Exploration & Treasure – Hunt for hidden chests across mystical maps, each guarded by enemies ready to test your strength.
• Consumables & Enhancements – Purchase spell-infused potions for temporary boosts in health, damage, and more.
• Epic Boss Battles – Defeat mighty foes to earn legendary artifacts and unlock new levels of difficulty.

Forge your legacy, outcast the competition, and ascend as the unrivaled master of the Mage Battle Arena!
70010000114121.intro: Build your mage, evolve your spells, and define your legend.
70010000114121.name: Mage Battle Arena

70010000114149.description:
The recipes to the secret potions that maintain peace and harmony throughout the land are contained within the Book of the Druids.
The book was stolen and four ancient druids set off toward the Dark Castle to seek the valuable tome and restore peace to the land.
Assist them in their quest by matching three or more Symbols of Power to fill up their magic reserves and unleash their enchantments.
They are counting on you to return what is rightfully theirs and stop evil from possessing this ultimate power!

- Four special power-ups.
- Two gameplay modes.
- More than 110 arduous levels.
70010000114149.intro: Find secret magic in Book of the Druids.
70010000114149.name: Druids: Battle of Magic

70010000114154.description:
Megabonk Smash is a fast-paced pixel roguelike action game where you battle endless waves of enemies, collect glowing crystals, upgrade your abilities, and face brutal bosses in an isolated arena of chaos. You awaken on a forgotten pixel island, surrounded by monsters born from crystal insanity. Every second counts — crush enemies, evolve your powers, and survive until the boss appears. Win, or restart the nightmare.

Features:
- Intense Arena Combat – Slash, blast, and burn through hordes using melee, ranged, and fireball attacks.
- Progression and Upgrades – Level up, collect experience crystals, and unlock random skills and perks each run.
- Adaptive Enemies & Boss Fights – Smart foes hunt you down, and powerful bosses test your survival instincts.
- Interactive Pixel World – Explore a handcrafted arena with destructible objects, secrets, and dynamic lighting.
- Retro Aesthetics & Sound – Enjoy classic pixel art visuals, cinematic effects, and immersive sound design.

You are a mysterious warrior trapped on a cursed pixel island — a realm consumed by crystal madness. Each wave pushes you closer to the edge. Gather shards, evolve your strength, and defeat the ancient boss to escape alive. Survive. Evolve. Smash everything.
70010000114154.intro: Smash, survive, evolve — fight through endless waves of chaos.
70010000114154.name: Megabonk Smash

70010000114155.description:
Step into a place where nothing feels quite right — a silent, twisting space that seems to breathe on its own. Every corner hides a whisper, every shadow watches, and something follows your every move.

This is a horror experience built on tension, mystery, and the uneasy feeling that you're never truly alone. The walls feel too close, the silence too loud, and the presence behind you far too real.

Your only goal is simple, yet terrifying: keep moving, stay sharp, and don’t let fear slow you down. Because in this place… hesitation is dangerous.

Run fast. Think fast.
And whatever you do — don’t look back.
70010000114155.name: Run from BLABLUBLAS horror

70010000114174.description:
Combining the speed of an arcade racer with the brawling of a fighting game, this cult classic made its mark with its originality and its own dose of chaos and personality.
Race on tracks filled with obstacles and crazy settings (from Mount Rushmore to Transylvania), use special moves to knock out your rivals, and explore modes that go far beyond traditional racing.
Get ready to laugh, crash, accelerate, and fight for every corner.
Street Racer Collection is pure arcade fun, straight from the past to your screen.
–
4 game modes
Practice: train before competing for real.
Head-to-Head: race against a single opponent on a track of your choice.
Championship: create your own competitions by combining tracks and difficulty levels.
Rumble Mode: knock your opponents out of the arena!
Soccer Mode: play soccer... with race cars! (not available in the MS-DOS version)
–
What you'll find
4 games in 1: the collection includes the classical 16-bit and 8-bit versions versions of the game.
Up to 27 unique tracks full of shortcuts, traps, and challenges
8 cartoon characters with crazy vehicles and special attacks
Varied racing options: from a quick lap to 80-lap marathons!
–
Why play Street Racer Collection?
A true cult classic, remembered to this day for its creativity and boldness
Unique and pioneering mix of kart racing + combat
Guaranteed fun in both solo and local multiplayer modes
A piece of video game history, preserved in its original form and experience
Get ready to laugh, crash, accelerate, and fight for every corner.
Street Racer Collection is pure arcade fun, straight from the past to your screen.
70010000114174.intro: A classic that mixes racing and fighting, for up to 4 players!
70010000114174.name: Street Racer Collection

70010000114186.description:
Collect lucky coins through festive New Year's games.
Bring in the most good fortune, and you'll be crowned Master of the New Year!

With a Joy-Con™ controller for each player, up to six players can join in the fun!

[Sugoroku Mode]
Collect coins and aim for victory!
The board is filled with festive New Year's events and special ema plaques that can change your fate!
There's always a chance for a last-minute comeback!

[Minigame Mode]
Enjoy a variety of New Year's-themed minigames!
Play 10 different games, including Fukuwarai and Mochi Pounding!

[Online Mode]
Compete in sugoroku and minigames with players from around the world!
Test your luck for the New Year and see how you fare!

<Skin Edit>
Freely customize your Character Piece used in Sugoroku Mode!
Create original pieces in festive New Year's attire!
70010000114186.intro:
Try your luck and test your wits in this adventure of fortune!
Good luck abounds in Sugoroku New Year's Party!
70010000114186.name: Sugoroku New Year's Party

70010000114192.description:
This rhythm game features a unique four-zone layout that divides the screen into four areas.
Notes flow from the edges toward the center—hit them at the right moment to keep the rhythm going.
Play using controller buttons or touchscreen controls and choose the style that feels most comfortable.
With only single notes and simultaneous inputs, the rules are easy to learn, but precise timing is the key to mastering the game.

The story takes place in a digital world.
Strange incidents begin to occur in a social rhythm game—avatars are stolen, and mysterious entities continue to multiply.
The narrative unfolds through chat screens, gradually revealing the truth through conversations between characters.
Beyond the chat, the story moves quietly—but steadily—forward.

Compete in online rankings and aim for a perfect score of 1,000,000 points.
A simple yet challenging rhythm experience that rewards focus and precision.
70010000114192.intro:
Four-Zone Rhythm Game!
Feel the beat with simple controls!
70010000114192.name: Bug!Ban!Break!

70010000114198.description: Firework is a Chinese horror puzzle game. The story takes place in a remote mountain village. An accidental fire at a funeral forces the police to re-investigate a closed case of the massacre. Lin Lixun, rookie police, participates in the re-investigation by chance. As the investigation goes deeper, the past of the victims gradually emerges. However, the case becomes more bewildering.
70010000114198.intro: Firework is a Chinese horror puzzle game.
70010000114198.name: Firework

70010000114199.description:
An exciting new style of action adventure fusing shooting action with exploration.

■A new take on shooting action and in-depth exploration
Experience a new type of action adventure, featuring a fusion between exploration within an expansive world and highly technical twin-stick shooting. At your home base, power up the demon king Damon and make purchases. During the exploration phase, defeat enemies to complete each area. The story progresses as you alternate between the two phases.

■Strategic battles with a vast arsenal of weapons and gimmicks
The battle mechanics include both close-ranged attacks with handguns as well as long-ranged attacks with machine guns and more.
You can find more powerful weapons as you explore.
During the boss battles awaiting within each stage, a strategic approach making use of the area gimmicks will prove crucial.

■Customization and Outfit Changes
Damon grows throughout the adventure, learning to master various weapons and skills. You can customize your set of skills to match your play style. You can even choose from a variety of outfit options to change Damon's appearance.

■Journey together with two player co-op
Take control of Damon's canine companion to help him in combat in various ways, such as collecting items.
*Only available via local (offline) play
70010000114199.intro: An unlikely pair, an unforgettable journey
70010000114199.name: DAMON and BABY

70010000114210.description:
【STORY】
Can the past rewrite the future?

The Meiji era, a turbulent age.
A series of murders shook Kyoto.
Mysterious patterns drawn in the victim's blood.
The case went unsolved, casting a long shadow over history.

A hundred years later in Kyoto, Detective Daiki Katsuki was investigating a brutal murder case.
The case bore a striking resemblance to the one that had shaken Meiji-era Kyoto.
The key to the investigation lay in the immersive AR experience ‘Echoes of Kyoto.’
The developer was the brilliant young engineer Quinn Rio.
The two entered the recreated Kyoto of 100 years ago to solve the case.

‘Echoes of Kyoto’
Through state-of-the-art AR contact lenses,
this augmented reality experience transports people into a breathtaking recreation of the Kyoto of 100 years ago.
The reconstructed city captivated many people with its nostalgia.
However, as the truth behind the incident draws near, ‘Echoes of Kyoto’ begins to transcend mere history.
The boundary between recreation and reality begins to blur, and a question emerges—

Is this the work of a copycat killer?
Or is the past truly invading the future?

A future held hostage by the past.
A past bound to the future.

When past and future intersect, the world begins to tremble.


【POINT】
◆ AR × Time-Travel Mystery
Experience a multi-layered story that shifts between the present and the Meiji era—faithfully recreated in AR Kyoto.

◆ Two Timelines, Two Detective Duos
Two eras. Two pairs of investigators. One truth that connects them across time.

◆ Beauty and Shadows of Kyoto
A unique visual and sound experience that blends traditional elegance with cutting-edge technology.


【CAST】
Daiki Katsuki（CV.Yohei Azakami）
Rio Quinn（CV.Yuuki Temma）
Masayoshi Nagahama（CV.Ryotaro Okiayu）
Saki（CV.Yoko Hikasa）
Hikari（CV.Hikaru Tono）
Dee（CV.Shuta Morishima）
Galaxy（CV.Yuzuki Watase）
Togawa（CV.Wataru Urata）
Suburi-Chan（CV.Haruna Fukushima）
70010000114210.intro: A new visual novel game co-created by Cherrymochi!
70010000114210.name: DUSK INDEX: GION

70010000114228.description:
Throw heavy punches, chain quick combos, block high and low, dodge at the right moment, and punish your opponent with powerful counters in intense, easy-to-read matches.

Jump into local couch PvP for fun, competitive showdowns with friends, or step into a story-driven campaign where you build your boxer’s career from fight to fight. Unlock perks that can dramatically change your playstyle, customize your fighter, and compete across a variety of arenas.

With simple-to-learn mechanics, strong visual feedback, and plenty of room for mastery, Casual Sports: Boxing delivers exciting, satisfying fights whether you’re chasing victory solo or battling it out on the couch.

Key Features
- Fast-paced arcade boxing combat focused on timing, stamina management, and smart risk-taking
- Local couch PvP for competitive matches with friends
- Story-driven campaign mode where you build your boxer’s career fight by fight
- Game-changing perks that let you shape your playstyle and approach each match differently
- Multiple playable boxers to unlock, learn, and master
- Fighter customization to create a boxer that feels like your own
- Multiple arenas that bring variety and atmosphere to every fight
70010000114228.intro: Casual Sports: Boxing is a fast-paced arcade boxing game where timing, stamina, and smart risks decide every fight.
70010000114228.name: Casual Sport Series: Boxing

70010000114242.description:
Is there anyone around you that suffers from depression? Do you really understand depression? This game allows you to enter a world of people who suffer from depression and understand how to deal with people with depression properly.

"Room of Depression" is an adventure game that focuses on the atmosphere and experience of depression.

Players experience Moon's daily life. Her encounters may be as ordinary as any passer-by but her world is very different from others. The big and small events in life affect her differently because she suffers from depression.

Depression is a common mental illness around the world, especially in developed cities. The mission of this work is to not only explain depression, but to let players have a taste of depression themselves through the game experience.
70010000114242.intro: "Same encounter, different world." Moon is a young woman who lives an ordinary city life as an office worker.
70010000114242.name: Room of Depression

70010000114249.description:
Race higher, faster, and through more daring paths than ever before in the next evolution of the series.

Experience high-speed racing and precision platforming with improved graphics, richer lighting, with curved and winding tracks that bring every course to life in a fresh, dynamic way.

Speed across towering metal frameworks and futuristic structures suspended high above the world, navigating slopes, spirals, bends, and sudden drops that demand both control and courage.

Unlock new vehicles, race against the clock, and push for the perfect run across a set of challenging courses that grow increasingly complex.
70010000114249.name: High Cars 3

70010000114255.description:
Team up or go solo, unleash powerful upgrades, and conquer unique modes like Paint, Minefield, and Invisibility as you clear every foe and push to the next level.

This is a fast-paced couch co-op action game for 1 to 4 players, built for old-school living room fun. Play solo or with friends, clear enemy-packed stages, and experiment with wild power-ups and game modes that keep every match fresh.

Battle through 30 different stages, each filled with enemies to wipe out before you can advance. Treasure chests scattered around the arena grant new abilities—boost your speed, increase your power, or even slip straight through walls to outsmart your opponents.

Whether you are teaming up or going head-to-head, the special modes change how you play:

• Paint Mode – Shoot paint, teleport around the map or hide in plain sight to ambush your opponents
• Minefield Mode – Drop deadly mines and turn the arena into a trap-filled maze
• Invisibility Mode – Vanish from sight and rely on your instincts to survive and strike first
• Single-Player Mode – Take on mission-based challenges tailored for solo play

Perfect for quick sessions or long game nights, this offline multiplayer brawler keeps everyone shouting, laughing, and begging for “one more round.”

Feature List
• Couch co-op for 1–4 players – Play solo or with friends on the same screen.
• Offline multiplayer & single-player – No online required; just plug in and play.
• 4 unique game modes – Paint, Minefield, Invisibility, and mission-based Single-Player.
• 30 handcrafted stages – Battle through a wide variety of levels and layouts.
• Powerful pick-ups – Open treasure chests for speed boosts, power upgrades, and wall-passing abilities
70010000114255.intro: Grab your friends, hit the couch, and blast through 30 chaotic stages in this local co-op battle game for 1–4 players.
70010000114255.name: Blastoids

70010000114261.description:
Step into the chaotic world of Ultra Bonk Survivors, where every swing, spell, and explosion decides your fate!

Choose your hero, dive into monster-filled arenas, and unleash devastating attacks in this fast-paced survivor-style action roguelite designed for quick, addictive sessions of pure fun.

Game features:
- Bonk, Slash, and Survive!
- Face endless waves of goblins, skeletons, and demons in vibrant fantasy arenas that crumble and glow with magical energy.
- Every run is a fight to last just a little longer—and bonk a little harder.
- Unlock Heroes & Legends
- Begin your adventure with humble warriors and unlock mighty heroes as you progress, including the legendary Lion Knight, masters of sword and shield.
- Each character brings unique stats and attack styles to discover.
- Grow Stronger Every Run
- Collect glowing orbs, relics, and mystical books that grant random power-ups. Experiment with different builds and create unstoppable synergies.
- Explore and Interact
- Find shrines, treasure chests, and mysterious power-ups scattered across the battlefield.

Will you risk everything to open a chest in the middle of a horde?
One More Bonk...
Fast-paced, endlessly replayable, and dangerously addictive. Every defeat brings you closer to your next unlock and new surprises.

Check out this fun new game from the NOSTRA.GAMES team.

Ultra Bonk Survivors is your ticket to the ultimate fantasy survival experience.

Choose your hero, charge into the temple ruins, and see how long you can survive the bonkocalypse.
70010000114261.intro: Epic fantasy survival – bonk your way to Glory!
70010000114261.name: Ultra Bonk Survivors

70010000114270.description:
[Overview]
Shizuku and Akane...two pilots bound by rivalry and friendship battle to save their world from malevolent cosmic forces!

Multi-directional boomerang style melee attacks, flamethrowers, burst lasers...a plethora of different weapons are at your disposal to combine and match as you customize your ship, battle waves of enemies and bosses though a variety of game modes including Local Co-Op Duo Play Mode and Boost Mode which allow you to alter game rules, engage in cooperative play or take on high-score challenges!

[Gameplay]
Control the super advanced Revolgear space fighters Pheasant or Dove, and use your precise movement skills, strategic weapon usage and combat prowess to earn extra lives and maximize your score!

Use the Bit Shoot attack for a boomerang style melee attack, the burst system for a powerful energy beam attack and tons of other different weapons and load-outs you unlock as you play!

[Features]
- Seven stages with 4 difficulty levels to choose from.
- Two main game modes that include 6 different possible endings.
- Over 2,000 different equipment combinations. Builds can be customized to suit each player preferences.
- Mission mode with 30 different challenges that test your skills with various weapons and techniques.
- Unlock shop where you can obtain custom weapons and gear using in-game currency.
- Diverse Stage Designs: From menacing mechs to mystical dragons, anything goes!
- Two Main Characters with Voice Acting. Enjoy various dialogues that change from situation to situation.
- Local Co-Op! Co-op with Algorithmic AI partner available in certain game modes too.
- Includes the bizarre mystery bonus game "God of Cats"!
- In-game Achievements.
70010000114270.intro: Fast-paced shmup action, tons of loadout combos, and local co-op!
70010000114270.name: Revolgear Zero

70010000114276.description:
Gas Ratio brings back the nostalgia of classic top-down arcade racers with a chaotic twist. In this game, speed isn't the only thing that matters—survival does. Drift through pixel-art tracks, dodge obstacles, and make split-second decisions.

The "Risk & Reward" System Forget standard power-ups. In Gas Ratio, every mystery box is a gamble. Crack one open and you might get a Jump ability to clear gaps or a full Repair. But beware: you might also trigger No Nitro, Low Gravity, or other debuffs that turn your race upside down!

Key Features:
Retro Arcade Vibes: Classic top-down racing with charming pixel art graphics.
Chaos Mechanics: Dynamic mystery boxes that dispense both helpful buffs and challenging debuffs.
Local Multiplayer: Grab a friend and race head-to-head in classic Split-Screen mode.
Solo Challenge: Hone your skills against competitive AI bots.
Diverse Tracks: Master 3 unique maps, each with its own twists and turns.
Garage Variety: Choose from a variety of distinct car types to suit your style.
70010000114276.intro: Are you ready to test your driving skills and your luck?
70010000114276.name: Gas Ratio

70010000114278.description:
Upin & Ipin Universe is a vibrant open-world adventure that brings the charm of tropical Southeast Asian village life to players worldwide.

Inspired by the beloved Upin & Ipin animated series, it invites players to explore the lively Kampung Durian Runtuh. A living, breathing world filled with authentic sights, sounds, and traditions, crafted by Malaysians for the world.

From bustling markets to quiet rice fields, it captures the essence of kampung (village) life, fireflies at dusk, swaying coconut palms, and the aroma of home-cooked meals. Play as Upin and Ipin on a heartfelt journey, uncovering local legends, helping their community, and immersing themselves in Malaysia’s rich culture, rooted in the heart of Southeast Asia.
70010000114278.intro: Crafted by Malaysians, for the world.
70010000114278.name: Upin & Ipin Universe

70010000114284.description:
Lariat the witch will make your wish will come true if you win a game of trivia, but if you lose, something dark will happen instead. How many lives will your ignorance ruin?

Majotori is a narratrivia, an original little game that combines an interactive narrative with a quiz game.

Features:

- 25+ characters
- 50+ branching storylines
- 1000+ engaging questions for the modern geek
- 4 question categories (video games, cinema, animation, miscellaneous) with customizable frequency of appearance
- A character dying a horrible death because you don't watch enough anime
70010000114284.intro: How many lives will your ignorance ruin? Majotori is a narratrivia, an original little game that combines an interactive narrative with a quiz game.
70010000114284.name: Majotori

70010000114290.description:
Golfing Over It with Alva Majo is a discouraging game about climbing a surreal mountain with a golf ball.
Experience the challenge of climbing an unyielding mountain without infuriating controls being part of that challenge.

Bennett Foddy has played this game and granted it his blessing.

Features:

- Golf your way up to the top.
- Listen as Alva explains why he made such a cruel game.
- Fall all the way back to the bottom.
- And if you manage to get to the top?
- Will that make you feel good?
- Will you feel that it's all been worth it?
- I think you will.
70010000114290.intro: Experience the challenge of climbing an unyielding mountain without infuriating controls being part of that challenge.
70010000114290.name: Golfing Over It with Alva Majo

70010000114303.description:
Seafrog is an action-platformer mashed with the movement of lite-skateboarding. Grind, kick-flip and find the flow with a rocket-powered wrench that moves smoother than a buttered beluga!

A SEA-SLICK PLATFORMER
String together combos by using a simple auto-trick system, landing grinds on enemies and rusty pipes to fuel up your rocket-wrench! Use the fuel to boost through enemies, fly straight up walls, and stick to ceilings in order to complete over 120 handcrafted challenges!

EXPLORE RUN DOWN SHIPS
Battle vengeful Viking ghosts aboard the Sea Dragon. Dig in for an unsavory meal aboard the Chunky Chacken, where you’ll discover a man-eating chicken outbreak. Finally, get ready for some monkey business at The Sweater Factory, an abandoned workshop run by an unexpected crew of apes causing all the ruckus. Each chapter holds a Master Gear, guarded by an ultimate boss.

MASTER GEAR, HO!
Battle the legendary Skraken, Metal Beak the Momma Chacken, and... Gerald. Face these colorful 'n crusty foes to retrieve the Master Gears and repair your cannon. Blast yourself to a stranded seaplane to escape the seahole, a mysterious sinking hole in the ocean… before ye end up in Davy Jones' Locker!
70010000114303.intro: Hop aboard Seafrog’s rocket-powered wrench and slide, grind, and trick your way through a one-of-a-kind 2.5D action-puzzle-platformer!
70010000114303.name: Seafrog

70010000114325.description:
A Dark Fantasy of Maids
Shizuka, a maid of purgatory, fights to bring salvation to lost souls. Entrusted with a special mission from the Sanctuary’s Overseer, she crosses the portal into a Purgatory overrun by Fiends. Yet as her journey unfolds, Shizuka begins to realize that the salvation she believed in—and the truth of this world—is far more twisted than she ever imagined...

Features
Experience deep, satisfying combat through a diverse fighting style that blends swords, firearms, and secret techniques with precise controls.

Enjoy rich action that combines exploration and a wide array of skills, including dodging, guarding, parrying, surprise attacks, and chain-based moves.

Face over 20 powerful bosses. Make full use of the items and secret techniques you've acquired to approach each battle with strategic precision.

Enjoy quests and hidden boss encounters. Discover the unfolding stories of maids—whether allies or rivals.

A finely crafted skill board system awaits you. Develop your character to match your unique playstyle.
70010000114325.intro: The latest title from the HunterX development studio, Maid of Salvation is an action RPG that features fast-paced and versatile combat.
70010000114325.name: Maid of Salvation

70010000114332.description:
Make video games history!
Start in a tiny office in 1976, program pixelated dreams on clunky computers, and experience up close how audacious ideas become legendary blockbusters. Form visionary teams, survive flops and risk everything for the next big hit; the future of the industry is in your hands. Are you up to the task?

• Build your studio – from a modest space to a state-of-the-art office complex with server farms and motion-capture studios
• Recruit the best brains in the industry – hire brilliant developers, experienced producers, and talented designers
• Revolutionize the market – design the next-gen console that will change the gaming world forever
• Set new standards – develop groundbreaking titles that will be talked about for decades to come
• Become an industry giant – sell licenses, buy studios and dominate the global gaming market
70010000114332.intro: From a studio in the garage to a gaming empire
70010000114332.name: Mad Games Tycoon 2

70010000114338.description:
Dive into Tile Jong, a beautifully designed tile-matching game that blends relaxation with strategy! Solve engaging puzzles by selecting and matching sets of three identical tiles. Each level brings new challenges with increasingly intricate layouts that will test your concentration and problem-solving skills.

Key Features:
- Engaging Tile-Matching Gameplay – Tap, match, and clear tiles to progress through a variety of levels.
- Vibrant & Relaxing Visuals – Enjoy a colorful, soothing atmosphere with smooth animations.
- 4 Unique Power-Ups – Need help? Use hints, reshuffles, undos, and extra slots to overcome tricky levels!
- Journey Through Beautiful Landscapes – Unlock new levels as you explore serene backgrounds.
- Easy to Learn, Challenging to Master – Start with simple puzzles and gradually take on more complex challenges.

Can you clear all the levels and become a Tile Jong master? Download now and test your skills!
70010000114338.name: Tile Jong

70010000114344.description:
Drop Pop is an addictive and relaxing game that is easy to play and hard to stop. Drop colorful balls, connect the same ones, and watch them turn into bigger balls. Every move feels satisfying and rewarding.

Enjoy smooth and calming gameplay with no pressure, no timers, and no stress. Play at your own pace - relax for a few minutes or spend hours having fun and improving your skills.

Think you can do better? In Drop Pop, you can beat high scores and challenge records set by other players. Plan your moves, aim for bigger merges, and climb higher on the leaderboard.
70010000114344.name: Drop Pop

70010000114351.description:
The world of the Wall awaits. Wall World 2 builds on the mining rogue-lite experience with expanded mechanics, new challenges, and deeper gameplay. Explore procedurally generated mines full of new discoveries and dangers. Extract valuable resources, harness lost technologies, and upgrade your robospider and exosuit to survive against hordes of raging monsters. Venture through incredible biomes and uncover the secrets entombed in the depths of the Wall.

DELVE INTO THE MYSTERIES OF THE WALL
Venture deep into the World Wall in your robospider. The mysterious Hole holds both deadly threats and long-lost answers. Risk everything to find out what lies on the other side of the unseen depths.

BATTLE ON ALL FRONTS
Monsters lurk everywhere — not only on the surface of the Wall, but also within its mines. Arm yourself with an arsenal of powerful weapons and abilities to fight off any threat that stands between you and the truth.

ADAPT TO A LIVING WORLD
The endless Wall is ever-changing. Its depths contain not only resources and technologies, but also anomalies that can help or hinder your journey. Navigate incredible biomes, overcome obstacles and discover new wonders as you carve your path deeper inside.

UPGRADE AND CUSTOMIZE
Customize your robospider between expeditions and meet new characters in the sphere city. You'll have plenty of options to upgrade and enhance the equipment of both your exosuit and your mobile battle station. Each of them brings you one step closer to conquering the Wall.
70010000114351.intro: The adventure in the mysterious world of the Wall continues!
70010000114351.name: Wall World 2

70010000114352.description:
Hunt the Night is a retro-style action-RPG that blends fast, skillful combat with dark fantasy lore. Play as Vesper, a member of the Stalkers, and traverse the ruined world of Medhram on a mission to save humanity from a deadly cycle of annihilation. Endure nightmarish overworlds, slash through horrific dungeons, face brutal bosses, and wield an arsenal of powers in a relentless struggle against the Night itself.

In the 9th Age, humanity is trapped in a vicious cycle on the verge of extinction. The day is ruled by humans, while the Night brings annihilation by horrid creatures. A group of humans called ‘The Stalkers’ once wielded power to hold back the horrors, but their sacrifice only delayed the inevitable.

Now, as the Night starts devouring every single glint of light, Vesper, a Stalker by right and daughter of a traitor, will travel a dying land trying to save the last embers of humanity. She hunts in a race against destiny, as the shadows lengthen both in the world and in her mind.

ENGAGE IN FAST-PACED DYNAMIC COMBAT
Dash through enemies while you unleash your combos, use your weapons or destroy them with your dark powers. You can switch between melee and ranged attack in quick succession: slashing enemies with your sword and then dashing away to use your ranged weapons, avoiding enemy attacks.

FACE INTENSE CHALLENGING BOSSES
Endure the ultimate challenge as you fight the ancient horrors of the Night that have been annihilating humanity over and over in intense boss battles. Learn their weak points, attack patterns and survive through the different combat phases as the battle gets more challenging and extreme.

UPGRADE AND CUSTOMIZE VESPER'S BUILD
Create your own build that will adapt not only to your preferred gameplay but also to particular bosses. Customize the upgrades of your arsenal and use the equipment that best suits your gameplay: Critical Damage, Life Steal, Poison, Close Combat, Firepower and more. Collect Sanguine vials, Crow Feathers, Moonstones and Noctilium to increase your stats and get ready to face the Night.

DISCOVER THE DARK WORLD OF MEDHRAM
Explore Medhram in a combination of action-adventure and dark fantasy lore. Survive huge dungeons full of traps, enemies, puzzles and challenges. Discover all kinds of locations, from ancient cathedrals and libraries of knowledge to lost kingdoms and devastated floating cities.

COMPLETE 'HUNTS' AS A MEMBER OF THE STALKERS
Accept a hunt at ‘Crow’s Nest’ and track down the dark beast, find where it hides and hunt the most powerful creatures of the Night. After every completed hunt you will get rewards that will increase your health and dark energy bar.

FIND SECONDARY CHARACTERS AND DISCOVER THEIR STORIES
Meet new characters and discover their tragic past and stories in a world that is on the brink of the abyss.

PLAY TO ADAPTED AND IMMERSIVE MUSIC
Immersive and adapted music to every moment, boss and location, with the collaboration of Hiroki Kikuta.
70010000114352.intro: Darkness never rests, and neither will you.
70010000114352.name: Hunt the Night

70010000114353.description:
It's time to shake it on center stage in this vibrant rhythm action game. Amigo and his friends are back in Samba de Amigo: Party Central!
Pick up your maracas and groove to 40 hit songs from the world's most popular genres, with even more arriving as post-launch DLC!

Groove with your friends and family with different party modes!
Feeling confident in your skills? Complete the StreamiGo! challenges to help Amigo rise to fame.
Strut that style by customizing your character with unique costumes and accessories.
Take the party to a global level: hit the floor with 12 Amigos and up to 8 of your friends online in World Party Mode.
Show the world what you've got by competing on the online leaderboards.
70010000114353.intro: Get up and shake it with Amigo and friends! It's time for an all- new Samba de Amigo: a music rhythm game that allows you to party around the world!
70010000114353.name: Samba de Amigo: Party Central

70010000114362.description:
Your mission is to assist the fairies in locating hidden fragments of various magical items scattered across the Melleryn Kingdom.
As you advance, you'll explore diverse locations featuring three unique modes: fragmented, matching pairs, and all of a kind.
Throughout the game, you'll also encounter jigsaw, swap puzzles, and a hangman word game with stunning enchanted images!

Key Game Features:

- 3 Game Modes to choose from!
- Shard puzzles and Rotate Puzzles!
- Hangman word game with performance log!
- Integrated walkthrough for shards!
70010000114362.intro: A magical hidden object game set in the Melleryn Kingdom, featuring diverse modes and puzzles!
70010000114362.name: Enchantment 2 Sun's Tear Collector's Edition

70010000114368.description:
BRIO World - Railway is a cozy and creative sandbox experience where you can build your very own train city. Using an easy-to-use building system, you’ll lay tracks, place scenery, and design detailed railway systems that come to life before your eyes. Whether you're a longtime train fan or just looking for a peaceful game to unwind with, this is your perfect escape.

Bring your imagination to life with over 250 beautifully crafted pieces - including tracks, trees, bridges, buildings, animals, and more. All pieces are designed with the classic BRIO wooden toy aesthetic, highlighting the warmth and charm of handcrafted playsets.

Meet the charming characters who live in your world and help them with fun little tasks. Complete missions to level up and unlock new parts and features as you go.

Drive your trains or cars in an immersive first-person view and see your creations from a whole new perspective, or simply sit back and watch your trains drive along the tracks you’ve laid down. It’s your world - explore it however you like.

BRIO World - Railway is designed to be a gentle, no-stress experience that welcomes everyone. Whether you want to build for hours, play short creative sessions, or just enjoy watching your trains go by, it’s the perfect way to slow down and enjoy a moment of calm.
70010000114368.intro: Build your dream railway using BRIOs classic wooden-style parts. Lay tracks, place stations and figures, create unique train sets, and explore a charming world filled with fun missions to co
70010000114368.name: BRIO World - Railway

70010000114369.description:
Your crew plundered a forgotten Mayan temple-and paid the ultimate price. Cursed by ancient gods, you and your ship are bound to the Pirate Grotto, doomed to rise again after every fall. Rival captains, empowered by stolen idols, now rule the seas. To break the curse, you must hunt them down, reclaim the relics, and face the truth that binds your entire crew. Sail across dangerous sea charts, from storm-lashed coasts to haunted wreck zones. Engage rival ships in ferocious naval battles, then clash steel and pistol on deck in brutal duels. Each defeat drags you back to the grotto, but every return pushes you closer to lifting the curse that chains your souls.

Key Features:
	•	Epic Story Campaign: Follow the tale of your cursed crew, bound to the Pirate Grotto and haunted by Mayan relics.
	•	Naval & On-Foot Combat – Battle rival ships in real-time sea clashes, then take the fight to the decks with swords, daggers, and pistols.
	•	Progression & Customization: Enhance your ship, expand your arsenal, and equip rare gear to refine your playstyle.
	•	Unique Sea Charts: Every map brings distinct challenges and environments, from whirlpools to skull-shaped cliffs.
