	•	Souls-like Challenge: Death is not the end. Each defeat returns you to the grotto, forging resilience and driving you closer to your final victory.
	•	Varied Enemy Encounters: Face everything from nimble raiders to heavily armed warships, each demanding different tactics.

In Pirate Simulator – Corsair Skull & Sails, every voyage tests your strength. Every defeat sharpens your resolve. Only by facing the sea’s deadliest captains can you break the curse and set your crew free.
70010000114369.intro: Every battle at sea brings you closer to freedom… or doom.
70010000114369.name: Pirate Simulator - Corsair Skull & Sails

70010000114378.description:
FIND YOUR PATH IN RUMBRAL

You wake up in a dark, mysterious forest with no memory of who you are or why you're there. Move through a world filled with abandoned structures and puzzles, perhaps left behind by others. Survivors? Explorers? Discover strange magenta liquids that reveal secrets of the past… and maybe of yourself. But be careful: you might not be alone in this desolate place.

TRAVEL BETWEEN REALITIES

Throughout your journey in Rumbral, you'll come across strange magenta puddles that allow you to travel to another reality. Shift between these parallel worlds to influence both and find your way forward.

SOLVE MYSTERIOUS PUZZLES

The path won’t always be easy: you’ll need to solve different obstacles that stand in your way to keep moving on.

DISCOVER HIDDEN COLLECTIBLES

Along the way, you'll find special collectible items, some more hidden than others. Gathering them will help you uncover the story of this broken world.
70010000114378.intro: Every step reveals a secret. Every shadow a threat. Welcome to Rumbral
70010000114378.name: Rumbral

70010000114382.description:
The Murder Hotel is an interactive Murder Mystery Adventure with a huge twist: A scissors wielding demon is the murderer and you have to blame one of the human guests, forging a plausible theory how they could have done it.

A demon may be the perpetrator but you can only explain each murder by human methods. Are you up to the challenge?

Find out why the murders are happening and how to put an end to them.

Featuring 14 human guests and a handful of demons, all with their own backstories and dark secrets.

Find clues in the form of paper words and form your own sentences to interrogate suspects

There's multiple ways and theories to win a trial. Can you find them all?
70010000114382.intro: Interrogate suspects, search for clues, & uncover a dastardly plot, as you solve a string of mystifying murders to help reluctant detective Ilmarinen escape the foreboding Fafnir Hotel
70010000114382.name: The Murder Hotel

70010000114388.description:
Launch dice across enchanted battlefields where realistic physics meets ancient magic. Matching dice fuse into a more powerful one that seeks its equals, triggering devastating chain combos.

Plan each throw carefully - every dice placement can trigger massive combos that wipe out entire enemy waves or set up tactical future plays. Master both precise aiming and strategic prediction to unleash the full power of mystical dice fusion.

Pick from 8 unique classes, each with special dice and magical abilities. Every class offers multiple heroes with different starting combinations, ensuring each adventure feels completely different. With endless replayability for each unique hero classes. Level up, complete quests, and unlock rewards.

Spread deadly poison through enemy ranks as a Rogue, unleash lightning storms as a Mage, or absorb massive damage as a heavily armoured Warrior. Each class opens up entirely new tactical approaches and synergies.

Every location culminates in challenging battles against bosses, each with unique abilities that will test your strategy.

Some bosses summon additional minions, others manipulate the dice field, and the most dangerous can completely change combat rules. Adapt your dice collection and tactics to overcome each distinct threat.

Craft a powerful combination of dice, relics, and runes that work together to define your playstyle.

Collect magical dice through combat victories and shop purchases, discover game-changing relics that provide permanent enhancements, and gather tactical runes for battlefield manipulation. Visit ancient altars where you can risk your dice for upgrades, or play it safe and build your arsenal gradually. The synergy between your dice attacks, relic bonuses, and rune abilities creates devastating combinations and endless strategic possibilities.
70010000114388.intro: Tactical deckbuilding in bite-sized sessions. Launch dice to create magical chain reactions. Choose from distinct hero classes with unique abilities.
70010000114388.name: Rune Dice

70010000114423.description:
Wanderstop is a narrative-centric cozy game about change and tea. Playing as a fallen fighter named Alta, you’ll manage a tea shop within a magical forest and tend to the customers who pass through. But Alta does not want to be here. And if she gets her way, the tea shop will be nothing but a brief and painful memory.


Wanderstop is a tea shop management ritual. Grow and harvest the ingredients needed for tea, and then mix them together in an unusual tea-making contraption. Along the way, speak with the many travelers who pass through the shop, learn their stories and make tea that’s just right for them.

In your downtime, you might tidy up around the clearing, decorate the shop in your style, or just sit on a bench with a cup of tea and listen to your own thoughts. Maybe doing nothing at all is okay. The shop demands patience, it rejects those who have come only in the pursuit of growth unchecked.

And that’s why Alta can’t be here. It’s why she’ll never make it. This isn’t who she is. No, she’s a fighter! Why would anyone insist on turning the world’s greatest championship warrior into a docile shopkeeper?! With everything she’s capable of?? No no no, she won’t, she won’t do it... she can’t…
70010000114423.intro: A narrative-centric cozy game about change and tea
70010000114423.name: Wanderstop

70010000114452.description:
Temari Trials: Dojo’s Test is a logic-focused puzzle game with charming pixel art where you guide a clever fox pushing temaris toward locked chests. Every hit removes a lock, and when a chest is fully unlocked, the level is cleared. Temaris can also push each other, allowing creative setups and surprising solutions for players who enjoy Japanese aesthetics and clever problem-solving.

The game features 30 handcrafted single-player stages with challenges that evolve based on how many hits each chest requires and how temaris can be positioned to reach them. You control a fox exploring levels filled with temaris and chests that range from 1 to 3 locks. Your goal is to plan the order and direction of every push while considering obstacles and placement.

You begin each stage by observing your options. Then you act, watch the result and use undo or restart if needed. When all locks are broken by hitting the chests with the correct temaris, the fox clears the mission and advances to the next challenge.
70010000114452.name: Temari Trials: Dojo's Test

70010000114492.description:
Get ready for a brand-new puzzle battle experience that blends speed and strategy, now on Nintendo Switch™!

One wrong move can turn the tables, but a flash of inspiration can change everything!
Enjoy intense, edge-of-your-seat matches where the outcome isn't decided until the very end!

Customize the game to your liking with detailed settings such as stage size, music, time limits, and player colors!

With a Joy-Con™ controller for each player, you can challenge a friend to a serious one-on-one showdown!

《Rules》
Take turns placing blocks and connect lines vertically or horizontally!
When a line is completed, all blocks on that line disappear!
Earn points based on the number of your opponent's blocks removed!
The first player to reach the target score wins!

[Challenge Mode]
Battle against the CPU under special rules!
Each victory increases the difficulty, putting your thinking skills and speed to the test.
Push your limits and see how far you can go!

[Battle Mode]
Face off in intense one-on-one matches against the CPU or friends!
Adjust the settings and enjoy battles tailored to your preferences!

[Online Mode]
Compete in real-time against players from around the world!
Jump into Quick Matches that affect your rating, or enjoy casual Room Matches!
Test your strategy against skilled competitors nationwide!
70010000114492.intro:
Stylish visuals, music, and effects bring this game to life!
A simple yet strategic competitive puzzle battle!
70010000114492.name: BLOCLASH

70010000114493.description: This is a game where you combine two small fruits to make them larger and create big watermelons.
70010000114493.intro: To prevent the fruits from overflowing from the box,  collide the same kind of fruit. As you collide fruits, their types change. Let's create big watermelons!
70010000114493.name: Suika Game

70010000114494.description:
Drop the fruits freely from any direction as "Poppy" flies 360° around the planet. Make fruits of the same type collide to make them "evolve" and aim to create watermelons for a high score!
 Make a lot of fruits "evolve" to enter the new "Super Evolution Time" mode! Special background music, dramatic effects, and a bonus score bring the excitement to a peak!
The "Suika Game Planet" has evolved in many ways, including with a customization function that allows you to freely decorate the game screen (skin), and a collection function that allows you to collect stickers for completing missions and use them to create your original name tag. Try playing it now!

This product is released for the Nintendo Switch™ . It can also be played on Nintendo Switch™  2. However, please note that a separate product, "Suika Game Planet", is available exclusively for Nintendo Switch™  2. Save data and Additional Contents are not compatible between the two versions. Please be careful to avoid duplicate or mistaken purchases. Nintendo Switch™  2 Edition and Upgrade Pack are not available for this product.
70010000114494.intro:
A new Suika Game is here from a new setting in space!
Turn, target, and aim for the watermelon!
70010000114494.name: Suika Game Planet

70010000114538.description:
Dive into a world of stunning, realistic puzzles that captivate your eyes and mind. Piece by piece, reveal breathtaking images of beautiful women — each completed puzzle unlocks a new masterpiece, keeping you motivated to discover what’s next.

Smooth and intuitive touch controls make gameplay effortless and deeply satisfying — you’ll feel like you’re truly shaping every picture with your own hands. Gentle, soothing music sets the perfect mood, helping you unwind while your curiosity pulls you to complete the next challenge.

Relax, enjoy, and let yourself get lost in the details.

Features:
• Addictive, easy-to-play puzzle mechanics.
• Gorgeous, realistic artwork of women.
• Satisfying touch interaction — every move feels natural.
• Unlock new, even more stunning images as you progress.
• Perfect balance of challenge and relaxation.
• Soothing soundtrack that enhances your focus and mood.
• Admire each completed image in full detail.
70010000114538.intro: Every piece brings you closer to perfection!
70010000114538.name: Double Trouble: Sexy Logic

70010000114578.description:
You are trapped in a crumbling, post-apocalyptic bunker, and your only goal is survival. Navigate dark corridors, smash obstacles with your trusty hammer, and find hidden paths as you search for an exit. Each level increases the difficulty with destructible doors, furniture, and secret rooms that test your wit, timing, and strategy.

Explore carefully. Glowing objects hint at upgrades, tools, and shortcuts. As you progress, unlock new abilities that give you the power to tackle bigger barriers and uncover more of the bunker’s secrets.

From the Bunker delivers a thrilling survival experience to test your skills with tense puzzle-solving, interactive environments, and a constant sense of danger. Can you escape before time runs out?
70010000114578.name: From the Bunker

70010000114584.description:
Soccer is a third person football game where you control and see each player individually, making every action feel direct, personal, and more intense than classic top down or broadcast style football games. You are always close to the action, watching your player run, defend, and attack in real time, which makes every match feel dynamic and exciting.

Thanks to a ball physics system based on the game engine, every pass, shot, bounce, and deflection feels natural and unpredictable, creating immersive gameplay where no two situations play out exactly the same. Even with its humorous and cartoon like visual style, where players have oversized big heads, the game still delivers a fun and satisfying football experience that rewards timing, positioning, and smart play.

The game includes several difficulty modes, starting with Training to learn the controls and understand the basics, then moving on to Easy, Medium, Hard, and finally Champions for players who want the highest level of challenge and competitive gameplay. Each difficulty increases the speed, precision, and overall intensity of the matches, pushing you to improve your skills and decision making.
70010000114584.intro: Non-stop action from kickoff to final whistle.
70010000114584.name: Soccer

70010000114596.description:
A Short & Whisker-Twitching Adventure!
Step into the paws of a curious cat in this choice-driven, storybook-style game!
Explore, interact, and make decisions that shape your journey, whether that means making friends, causing mischief, or discovering something unexpected.

What’s in the Box?
- Be a Cat - Nap, explore, knock things over, and do what cats do best!
- Make Choices - Your decisions shape the story, leading to different outcomes.
- Meet Quirky Characters - Befriend (or bother) a cast of charming animal NPCs.

It’s a short and delightful game, perfect for a cozy playthrough in a single sitting. Where will your paws take you?
70010000114596.intro: Welcome to a whimsical animal adventure in which your choices shape the story and the world reacts to your actions!
70010000114596.name: Pawsky

70010000114600.description:
In this game, you'll build a cozy island together with Sumikko.
Collect materials, fulfill Sumikko's requests, create various items, and decorate the island to make it popular!
The more the island becomes popular and developed, the more features are unlocked, like expanding areas and attracting other Sumikko to the island, so let's work together with Sumikko and create a wonderful island!

■Fulfill Sumikko's request and make them happy!
Sumikko will make all sorts of "requests".
Fulfill them to raise Sumikko's "Joy Meter"!
These requests are time-sensitive, so don't forget to fulfill them.

■Gather materials with Sumikko!
Shirokuma, Penguin?, Tonkatsu, Neko and Tokage will gather the materials you need to build the island.
When the player helps gather too, the amount of materials obtained increases!

■Island-Building Fun!
Use coins and the materials you gathered with Sumikko to create items you can place on the island.
The Place items that you made can be freely placed within the layout area!

■Create an island that matches the seasons!
On the island, there are four seasons. Not only does the scenery change, but you can also buy season-limited items at the shop, and enjoy lots of different seasonal events!
To make your island match the current season, you'll need to raise "Season Points" that show how close you are to matching the season.
Get more Season Points by placing items with the same Season Points as the island's current season!

■Enjoy Sumikko's cute moments!
Sumikko will freely play or unwind using the items you place on the island to pass the time!
70010000114600.intro: Enjoy creating a cozy island that matches the seasons with the Sumikko!
70010000114600.name: Sumikkogurashi Create a Wonderful Sumikko Island!

70010000114601.description:
Play as Yuma Ilvern and stop the Empire from exploiting the power of the ancient dragons, including the soul of the Shining Dragon within you. With the help of your friends, realize your destiny, save Astoria, and unleash the strength you’ve always had locked away.

In the original game, previously released only in Japan, Imperial Princess Excella was an unplayable character, but in the new “Refrain Mode” in Shining Resonance Refrain, both she and Dragonslayer Jinas can be added as party members for a new experience – just be sure to save this for your second playthrough to avoid any spoilers!

Dragons were long thought to be extinct, and because Yuma holds the ability to transform into the Shining Dragon, he was taken as a captive of the Empire. With the help of the Dragoneers, Sonia, princess of Astoria, pleads with Yuma to aid them in their fight to save their land from the Empire’s dominion. Typically timid, will Yuma find the courage to realize the strength he has within him?
70010000114601.intro: Liberate the dragon that resides within you!
70010000114601.name: Shining Resonance Refrain

70010000114609.description:
Includes the full game, bonus currency, and curated vehicles to start your racing journey.

AUTHENTIC RACING EXPERIENCE
Experience realistic physics and handling with authentic licensed vehicles and real-world tracks. Master technical circuits where precision and skill determine victory.

LICENSED VEHICLES & TRACKS
Race genuine licensed cars with accurate performance characteristics. Challenge yourself on faithfully recreated tracks that demand perfect racing lines and expert car control.

DEEP CUSTOMIZATION
Fine-tune suspension, differential, tire pressure, and gear ratios to match your driving style. Every adjustment affects handling and performance on track.

ONLINE MULTIPLAYER
Compete against players worldwide in real-time races. Test your skills in time attack leaderboards and ranked events.

CONTENTS
- Full game access
- Bonus currency for vehicle purchases
- Curated vehicle selection to begin racing immediately

Master the art of racing simulation where physics, precision, and skill matter most.
70010000114609.intro: Get the full game with bonus currency and select vehicles. Race licensed cars on real tracks with realistic physics. Tune your car and compete.
70010000114609.name: Assoluto Racing

70010000114613.description:
NemoSphere is the easy-play shooter

Left and right operation and shoot

Shoot to the sphere coming from the left and right

The ejected block is speedy

The key point is timing

Leave your best time
70010000114613.name: NemoSphere

70010000114628.description:
A Planet of Mine Mastermine Edition is a cozy 4X game with mass strategy !
Choose your winning gang, mastermine resources, and build your base and tools to boost your technology and conquer space ! Unless your neighbors don’t see it that way... Trade, peace or clash : your planet, your choice !

Tuesday Quest invites you to discover A Planet of Mine in this MASTERMINE EDITION, featuring:

・ LOADS OF NEW CONTENT AND MISSIONS,
・ A WAY MORE ROBUST GAME ENGINE,
・ A REVAMPED AND ERGONOMIC UI,
・ MORE DETAILED VFX,
・ NEW MUSIC AND FAR MORE SOUNDS,
・ IMPROVED AI ENGINE,
・ AND ANIMAL PRODUCE (YES, YOU READ THAT RIGHT).

Choose among 20 different factions ranging from space pirate chickens to nuclear scientist elephants! Establish a colony in a randomly generated star system. Manage the collection and production of your resources and advance your technology by unlocking new buildings and science. Trade with other factions or go to war for system-wide domination! Plan your strategy wisely and stay focused: you may encounter surprising stuff...

CREATE YOUR OWN GAME
The Mastermine Edition offers you the ability to create your own universe. You can personalize the sun’s type, the number of planets and factions, the distance of your first planet to the sun, and the global size of your world. You can also add rules like a specific game mode, or a limited number of cycles. So much power is in your hands!

REPRODUCE AND SHARE YOUR GAME
With great power comes great responsibility, so now that you can control the universe, it means that you can create the best strategy challenges! And the best part is that now, you can share any game with your friends. Each generated star system has a unique seed that allows it to be identically recreated on another profile. So, you can simply share the Game ID with anyone and play the exact same game. Dare to defy your friends with completely ridiculous or very complex systems, and explore infinite game strategies together!
70010000114628.intro: A cozy&cute strategy game set in space with animals !
70010000114628.name: A Planet of Mine MasterMine Edition

70010000114629.description:
high-speed races, solo or with friends!
Share the excitement with friends and family playing split-screen multiplayer.
Hop in a formula car and race on unique tracks from around the world. With its multiple difficulty settings and accessibility options such as assist mode and gyroscopic controls, 4PGP can be enjoyed by everyone from beginners to experts.

From beginners to experts, fun for everyone!
・Singleplayer: Championship, Quick Race, and Time Attack
・Split-screen multiplayer with up to four players
・19 unique cars based on real formula cars
・14 different circuits from around the world that can also be played in reverse.
・Four difficulty levels: ROOKIE, NOVICE, VETERAN, and EXPERT
・Gyroscopic controls and Assist mode for beginners
・Learn how to play with an extensive tutorial mode!
・60FPS in TV, Handheld, and Tabletop Mode
70010000114629.intro: Arcade fun, anywhere and with anyone!
70010000114629.name: 4PGP - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000114635.description:
Screw Master is a fun and engaging puzzle game where players must strategically remove screws to dismantle intricate wooden structures. Each level presents a new challenge requiring logical thinking and precise actions. With 50 levels of increasing difficulty, can you master the art of unscrewing?

Gameplay Features:
- Challenging Puzzle Mechanics - Unscrew, remove planks, and clear the board!
- Realistic Physics - Every screw holds the structure together, so plan your moves wisely.
- Strategic Thinking - Remove screws in the right order to prevent getting stuck.
- Time-Based Challenges - Beat the clock to complete levels efficiently!

Power-Ups to Help You!
- Hammer - Instantly removes a plank, clearing the way.
- Drill - Adds an extra hole to free trapped pieces.
- Screwdriver - Removes a screw completely, bypassing any restrictions.
- Freeze - Stops time, giving you more time to think and solve the puzzle.

Use these tools wisely to tackle tougher puzzles and progress through levels!

Levels & Progression
- 50 unique levels, each introducing new mechanics and increasing complexity.
-  Unlock power-ups as you advance to help with more intricate puzzles.
- Dismantle creative wooden structures, testing your logic and precision.

Why You’ll Love Screw Master!
- Addictive and relaxing gameplay
- Satisfying visuals and realistic sound effects
- Simple controls but deep strategy

Are you ready to become the Screw Master? Start unscrewing now and see if you can clear all 50 levels!
70010000114635.intro: Are you good with a screwdriver?
70010000114635.name: Screw Master

70010000114637.description: HeadHunters is a chaotic platform fighter for up to 4 players, online or on the couch. Blast, bash, and body-swap your way through explosive arenas in fast-paced, no-rules mayhem. It’s all about dodging, blasting, and making your mates scream “no way!”. Heads will definitely roll!
70010000114637.intro: It’s all about dodging, blasting, and making your mates scream “no way!”. Heads will definitely roll!
70010000114637.name: HeadHunters

70010000114638.description:
Gradiently 2 - casual color puzzle game for everyone.
Reorder tiles in a way they will form perfect gradient.

• 500 beautiful hand-tuned gradient puzzles
• Infinite random mode
• Minimal art style
• Full touch screen support
• Relaxing lofi soundtrack
70010000114638.intro: Beautiful relaxing puzzles, 500+ gradients will challenge your color perception!
70010000114638.name: Gradiently 2

70010000114644.description:
This high-energy hyper-casual runner expands the original experience with faster movement, smoother visuals, and a new wave of dynamic obstacles. Players charge through the tracks while growing a trailing line of followers, multiply your numbers through colour-coded gates, and avoid hazards designed to tear your chain apart. The bigger your trail, the more power you carry into the explosive end-of-run finale.
At the finish, your entire squad is loaded into a cannon and fired toward a series of rotating targets. Each successful hit racks up points, with tighter targets offering larger rewards. Every run showers players with coins that can be saved up to unlock an expanding wardrobe of hats, letting you customise your crew with playful flair.
Build the longest trail you can, survive the gauntlet, and blast your team toward ever higher scores in a continuously evolving, endlessly repeatable sprint.
70010000114644.intro: Grow your line. Shoot for glory.
70010000114644.name: Long Run 2

70010000114666.description:
PAC-MAN WORLD 2 has been modernized, enhanced, and upgraded! The fan favorite returns as PAC-MAN WORLD 2 Re-PAC!

The Ghosts snuck into PAC-Village and stole the Golden Fruit, unwittingly freeing the all-powerful ghost king, Spooky! PAC-MAN must venture across PAC-LAND to reclaim the Golden Fruit and put a stop to the dastardly Spooky!

A World of Fun
Run, chomp, butt-bounce, and more to meet PAC-LAND's challenge and charm! From B-Doing Tree Tops to ice skating in Snowy Mountain, and taking aim from the PAC-Marine deep in the Ocean. Rev roll in Paradise Meadows, Flutter jump over lava in the Volcano, and PAC-Dot attack through Ghost Island!  PAC-MAN is ready for action!

Remade for all PAC Players!
With modern graphics, expanded levels and PAC-Village, quality of life improvements, and voice acting - it's the fan favorite remade from scratch with the original recipe. But Re-PAC means more: new actions for PAC-MAN, updated boss battles, characters, collectables, customizations, even a 2-player mode!

In PAC-MAN WORLD 2 Re-PAC, Adventure is back on the menu!
70010000114666.intro: Adventure is back on the menu in PAC-MAN WORLD 2 Re-PAC!
70010000114666.name: PAC-MAN WORLD 2 Re-PAC

70010000114683.description:
Each place is uniquely styled, offering a warm atmosphere and dozens of hidden items to find.
Show off your skills in mini-games. A variety of puzzles and challenges will help you unlock new levels and discover even more places to search for hidden objects.
Customize your interior and create your perfect room!
Decorate it with beautiful items and add a personal touch by purchasing new décor and furniture to create your unique cozy space.

- Relaxing gameplay designed for fans of hidden object games.
- Engaging challenges that improve observation skills.
- Explore cozy places: Sit by the pool, grill barbecue in the backyard, or discover charming cottages in nature.
70010000114683.intro: Immerse yourself in a cozy atmosphere of hidden object searches and puzzle-solving fun!
70010000114683.name: Sweet Home: Look and Find 4 Collector's Edition

70010000114684.description:
BANG! BANG! BANDITS is an all new, original shooting game. It adopts simple rules and controls while maintaining the tension and exhilaration of the classic genre of gun shooting games. This means that it can be enjoyed by a wide range of people, from children to adults. It features colorful, adorable characters and an easy-to-understand world.

■Intuitive controls that require zero explanation! Anyone can play immediately!
Simple controls: just hold the Joy-Con™ in one hand as a handgun and aim and shoot at the enemies on the screen!!
Automatically move around the field, aim and shoot at all the enemies that appear, and collect lots and lots of coins!
There is no bullet limit, so you can fire as much as you want!
There's nothing to it, just shoot away!

■12 types of stages x 2 leagues, for a lot of fun to be had!
The Normal League, where the battles take place, has 12 stages with different characteristics, including jungles, urban areas, ruins, and caves.
Once you've conquered all the stages in the Normal League, you can challenge the Wild League, which is the most difficult mode available!

■Unique enemy characters run amok all over the screen!
Defeat the Goomin that attack you one after another, and defeat the evil boss waiting at the end of the stage!

■Enjoy 2 different ways to play: Challenge Mode and Battle Mode!
Start with low-class stages in Challenge Mode and then conquer the most difficult stages.
You can play alone or in a team of 2 to 4 people! If each player has a Joy-Con, you can enjoy competitive play, such as single battles (individual battles) where 2-4 players compete for the highest score, or team battles where 2 teams of 2 players compete for the highest score!
70010000114684.intro:
Bang bang away! It feels great!
A new party-style shooting game that can be enjoyed by both children and adults is now available!
70010000114684.name: BANG! BANG! BANDITS

70010000114698.description:
Play as Maude, a graffiti artist compelled to tag up the walls of a nightclub at every possible opportunity. As you move your way past bouncers and club goers you come to discover there’s more to Club Soko than meets the eye.

Game Features:
- Over 100+ handcrafted puzzles
- An undo system to work through past mistakes
- 6 chapters each with their own music
- 13 unlockable cameo characters to discover from other true indie devs, artists, and indie games!
- 11 different kinds of puzzle pieces
- 2 types of secret rooms to find
- A chill music mode
- A puke toggle!
- The first puzzle game in the world with a circle pit!
70010000114698.intro: Navigate your way deep into an underground nightclub and discover secrets hidden in its depths.
70010000114698.name: Club Soko

70010000114704.description:
All aboard! Get ready for a colorful, brain-teasing puzzle experience where your goal is simple but oh-so-addictive: arrange all passengers to fit perfectly on their matching buses. Sounds easy? Think again!

In this fun and relaxing puzzle game, you’ll face increasingly tricky challenges as you sort passengers by color and seat them correctly before the buses depart. Each level brings new patterns, tighter spaces, and more passengers to organize — testing your logic, speed, and strategic thinking.

Game Features:

Unique Puzzle Mechanics: Drag and arrange passengers so they fit into their designated bus seats. Every move counts!

Dozens of Fun Levels: Start simple and progress to more complex puzzles with multiple buses and limited space.

Colorful and Relaxing Visuals: A bright, cheerful design to keep your mind sharp and your mood lifted.

Earn Coins and Unlock Challenges: Complete levels perfectly to earn rewards and unlock new puzzles.

Brain-Training Gameplay: Sharpen your problem-solving skills while having endless fun.

Quick, Pick-up-and-Play Sessions: Perfect for short breaks or long puzzle-solving marathons.

Can you keep up with the rush and seat every passenger before the buses leave? Test your organizational skills, plan your moves carefully, and become the ultimate bus puzzle master!

Hop in, line up your passengers, and let the puzzle journey begin!
70010000114704.intro: Arrange passengers perfectly and master the ultimate bus puzzle challenge!
70010000114704.name: Bus Stop Shuffle

70010000114713.description:
A small town in the far north goes about its life: preparing for the Festival of the New Star, decorating streets, celebrating. The festival is inseparable from a cycle that repeats month after month. And Sonya stands at its center.

She's part of a story she's still trying to understand. A kind girl with a sharp mind and countless questions, she searches for answers among snow and lights.

Sonya helps friends, makes new ones, explores hidden corners, fights spirits, and solves puzzles. She acts, hoping her actions will lead to understanding.

Game Features:
- An isometric adventure with detailed pixel art that brings a cozy, living world to life
- Combat against spirits and bosses that tests your reflexes and wit
- Puzzles and challenges for those who love to explore
- Memorable characters with their own stories: talk, help, and build friendships
- A soulful soundtrack that warms the heart and stays with you

The cycle continues.
70010000114713.intro: Explore a northern town with Sonya, solving puzzles and fighting spirits.
70010000114713.name: ChildStory

70010000114723.description:
Make mountains of trash disappear in seconds, and enjoy the satisfying feeling of turning messy spaces into organized and clean environments. This is a short, stress-free cozy game to unwind with, and spark some joy.

Vacuum, brush, mop, spray – there are many ways to make a place sparkling clean. As a new Cleaning Gig Worker, you will take on variety of requests - declutter a hoarded-up apartment, spiffy up old haunted mansion while avoiding ghosts, or solve puzzles in an ancient temple and find (and clean) the treasure room. Who knows, some of these might even seem familiar ;)

As you play, you will grow your prestige and earn cash, letting you upgrade your tools and purchase new outfits. Don't fret, the game is very low-pressure, and you can always revisit levels with improved tools to get better scores.

Most importantly, bring many derelict locations back to life, with your trusty broom and vacuum! 

----
Note: if you played our previous games like "Rain on Your Parade" or "Just Crow Things", a heads up that this one is a bit less puzzle-y and less challenging. It's more about simply relaxing for an evening or two!
70010000114723.intro: Turn huge messes into sparkling spaces! Feel the satisfaction of cleaning with your super-powered tools. A short and simple game about the joy of tidying up!
70010000114723.name: Cleaning Up!

70010000114760.description:
In the world of Valkyria Chronicles, the year is 1935 E.C., and the continent of Europa has been plunged into the Second Europan War between the Autocratic East Europan Imperial Alliance -- also known as The Empire -- and the Atlantic Federation over the precious resource Ragnite. The Empire is sweeping through the continent like an unchecked wildfire and has its eyes set on the rich Ragnite deposits of the Principality of Gallia. Although peaceful Gallia remains neutral in the conflict, its citizens will need to defend home and country against the inevitable invasion. Follow Lieutenant Welkin Gunther and the vaunted Squad 7 of the Gallian Militia as they take on the seemingly insurmountable forces of the Empire.

Valkyria Chronicles features:
• “CANVAS” Graphics Engine
• “BLiTZ” tactical battle system
• Memorable storyline
• All previously released DLC included
70010000114760.name: Valkyria Chronicles

70010000114761.description:
A Continent Engulfed in the Bitter Flames of War!

Valkyria Chronicles 4 takes place in the same timeframe as the original Valkyria Chronicles, but focuses on Squad E of the Federation. Commander Claude Wallace and his childhood friends set out to fight for freedom in this desperate war, but bone-chilling blizzards, waves of imperial soldiers, and the godlike powers of the Valkyria stand between them and victory.

The return of the BLiTZ Battle System and the CANVAS Graphic Engine!

The Next Generation of the BLiTZ Battle System - The part overhead turn-based strategy, part RPG, and part real-time 3rd person shooter the “BLiTZ” battle system storms onto the battlefield. Fight the imperial threat with more units on bigger maps than ever before. An explosive new unit called the Grenadier and numerous options for both offensive and defensive battle support make their debut in Valkyria Chronicles 4.

A Lush Watercolor World -  The series’ signature hand-drawn visual style is back! Inspired by watercolor compositions, the CANVAS Graphics Engine blends visual elements of reality and imagination to create an expressive world filled with colorful emotions. Watch the journey of Squad E unfold like an interactive painting.
70010000114761.name: Valkyria Chronicles 4

70010000114781.description:
Lines 98 Classic is a legendary puzzle game familiar to many since childhood. Connect balls of the same color into lines horizontally, vertically, or diagonally to clear the board and earn as many points as possible.

With simple rules and intuitive controls, the game is easy to pick up but offers deep strategic depth. A relaxing pace combined with an endless mental challenge makes Lines 98 Classic perfect for both quick casual sessions and long, thoughtful playthroughs as you aim to beat your high score.
70010000114781.intro: Lines 98 Classic — Plan your moves. Build perfect lines.
70010000114781.name: Lines 98 Classic

70010000114787.description:
Collect pieces of the adorable “Doji-nyan” cats and complete the puzzle!
There are 15 stages in total.
As you clear each stage, the difficulty increases!
Stages 1–10: 30 pieces
Stages 11–15: 50 pieces
The final stage is a tough one with no background watermark!
Take your time and examine each piece to complete the puzzle!
Clear all puzzles and complete your gallery ♪
=====================
At AGE, we support game streamers!
No permission is required for streaming this game.
70010000114787.intro: A puzzle game featuring slightly clumsy and cute cats is here!
70010000114787.name: Funny Cats Puzzle

70010000114790.description:
【What is Makaism: Frenzy of the Netherworld?】
A brand-new 3D action RPG where you can unleash flashy, overpowered attacks with simple controls! Build up your characters with absurdly inflated stats, deal billions of points of damage, and revel in the sheer satisfaction of crushing your enemies with overwhelming force.

【STORY】
Welcome to the vast world of the Netherrealm: a chaotic land ruled by countless demons.
In one such realm, the “Transcendent Netherworld,” a battle-hardened mercenary named N.A. is summoned by the demon lord Ticiel and given a shocking mission:
“Someone ate my pudding from the fridge!”
“Wait... your what, now?”
The Primordial Pudding of Dawn, a legendary dessert created by Ticiel’s late father, the previous Transcendent Overlord, was stolen by a treacherous subordinate—and now N.A. must get it back!
Thus begins the battle to reclaim the Primordial Pudding, waged by a lonely mercenary and an inexperienced demon lord!

【Seven Weapons, Endless Playstyles!】
N.A. can equip seven types of weapons: Fist, Sword, Spear, Axe, Bow, Gun, and Staff, each with unique ranges and attack styles. For example: the Sword offers balanced, easy-to-use techniques, the Bow allows long-range and multi-target attacks at the cost of power, and the Staff unlocks the use of magic. By mastering and switching between multiple weapons, you can dramatically expand your combat possibilities!

【Crush Your Foes with... Extreme Character Growth?!】
Even action game newbies will be kicking butt in no time!
Characters can level up to Lv. 9999, and using Reincarnation, you can reset to Lv. 1 while keeping bonus stats to grow even stronger. Enhance your power further through systems like Evilities, which grant passive boosts, and Character World, where you can strengthen your stats from within.
And that’s not all—the game includes Item World, Innocents, and many other customization systems that fans of Nippon Ichi Software will instantly recognize!
70010000114790.intro: An exhilarating RPG that takes demonic action to a whole new level!
70010000114790.name: Makaism: Frenzy of the Netherworld

70010000114800.description: ‘We. The Refugees: Ticket to Europe’ is a socially engaged, text-based RPG about a journalist looking for his big break by uncovering the plights of refugees travelling from Africa to Europe. It is a story inspired by true events.
70010000114800.name: We. The Refugees: Ticket to Europe

70010000114801.description:
Hop into the cabs of North Western Railway’s classic steam team to enjoy nostalgic stories and all-new narratives right from the drivers’ seats. Explore the Wonders of Sodor – fun and magic await!

• Join Thomas, Diesel, Gordon, Percy, and Emily for railway adventures in their home, the Island of Sodor.

• Explore iconic landmarks across Sodor, such as the Tidmouth Sheds, Knapford station, and the famous Windmills.

• Play a total of 8 stories all narrated by the legendary Mark Moraghan.

• Get involved by driving Thomas on his branch line, or even ride as a passenger!

Thomas & Friends™: Wonders of Sodor is powered by Train Sim World, combining the unparalleled detail and realism of Unreal Engine and Simugraph with accessible controls to create a nostalgic experience that all Thomas & Friends™ fans can enjoy.
70010000114801.intro: Join Thomas and his friends on a special journey across Sodor!
70010000114801.name: Thomas & Friends™: Wonders of Sodor

70010000114812.description:
Saborus is a thrilling horror adventure in which you guide a brave chicken through a deadly slaughterhouse where everything wants to kill you! You, as the chicken, will solve puzzles and face the relentless pursuit of the Saborus slaughterhouse workers.

Make your way through the sinister surroundings of a creepy slaughterhouse, full of suspense and surprises! Can you survive?

Saborus promises an immersive and spine-chilling horror game experience, inviting you to confront the depths within the confines of a sinister slaughterhouse. Will you be able to navigate the haunting horrors and get out of the slaughterhouse for good?
70010000114812.intro: Hide, peck, and survive in a slaughterhouse!
70010000114812.name: Saborus

70010000114819.description:
Hunters Music World is a rhythm game.
Press the buttons in time with the music!

It features theme songs from Mysterious Adventure of Michael,
The Legend of the Dragonflame High School,
as well as tracks from a wide variety of genres—
rock, punk, enka, Halloween songs, and more!

Aim for a Perfect Clear on every song!
70010000114819.intro: A rhythm game packed with over 40 tracks from HUNTERS!
70010000114819.name: HUNTERS Music World

70010000114828.description:
THE ULTIMATE BREAKOUT BEGINS!
You’ve got a report card full of low grades, angry parents, and a strict punishment: you are grounded. But your friends are waiting outside, and you aren't about to let a locked door stop the fun.

Schoolboy Escape: Runaway is a first-person stealth puzzle game where your only goal is freedom. Use your wits to navigate through the house, dodge your patrolling parents, and find the way out.

GAMEPLAY FEATURES.
STEALTH IS KEY: Tiptoe across quiet hallways and avoid making noise. If your parents hear you running, you’re busted!

MASTER OF DISGUISE: Mom checking in on you? trick her by quickly placing a math book on your desk to pretend you’re studying hard.

SOLVE THE PUZZLE: The front door isn't the only obstacle. Search drawers, cupboards, and shelves to find hidden keys, spare parts, and codes to crack the safe in your parents' bedroom.

EXPAND YOUR ESCAPE: The adventure doesn't stop at the front door. Face new challenges in the school, the village, and beyond as you sneak past watchmen and obstacles.

DO YOU HAVE WHAT IT TAKES?
Every move counts. Watch your surroundings, hide in closets when necessary, and collect every tool you can find. Can you escape the house before your parents catch you?

Plan your route. Fool your parents. Run away!
70010000114828.intro: Bad grades? Grounded? Not for long! Outsmart your parents, solve puzzles, and sneak out to join your friends in this stealth adventure.
70010000114828.name: Schoolboy Escape: Runaway

70010000114832.description:
Command An Army Of Ghosts
Summon and control a legion of ghosts, banshees, gremlins, and more, each with unique abilities. Your ghoulish goons are more terrifying (and entertaining) than ever.

Strategy Meets Supernatural
Blend tactics, adventure, and resource management in a seamless gameplay loop set within a richly built paranormal world.

Solve Mysteries, Unleash Horror
Every haunting is a puzzle. Use spectral strategy and powers to uncover secrets, manipulate mortals, and complete objectives.

Rediscover the Fear
Ghost Master: Resurrection invites you to master the art of fear in a beautifully reimagined supernatural playground. The dead have risen... and they're under your control.
70010000114832.intro: Terror Reimagined for a New Generation
70010000114832.name: Ghost Master: Resurrection

70010000114833.description:
The year is 12,012. Multiquadrillionaire monopoly "GSSAI CO." has been in power of the universe for centuries after a world-ending bioweapon was unleashed onto the masses. And now? The solar system has been destroyed by unknown celestial forces. A weapons development program run by the Earth subsidiary of "GSSAI CO." is fast progressing. And the world's denizens are disappearing.

That is until one man screws up a game of pool.

HERO OF THE STARS AND THE SKY
● Use your tongue to lick enemies and objects as you make your way through open metroidvania-like areas, whilst collecting "Planet Bits" to help fix the solar system!

WELCOME TO RUBATO WORLD
● 5 compact, densely packed areas ranging from a huge sprawling bakery to the world's most poorly planned city. Uncover secrets and shortcuts in every corner of the world.

IF I COULD ONLY LOVE
● A strange, funny plot with a deep focus on humour and character writing. It gets silly. It gets serious. Really concerningly serious. Uh. Is the guy who made this game okay..?

BUT FIRST, LOVE YOURSELF
● To save the world, you must save yourself first. Find yourself again.

©2026 dconn. Published by Headcannon. Developed by dconn. All rights reserved.
70010000114833.intro: RUBATO, an experimental, 2D physics-based take on the collect-a-thon genre!
70010000114833.name: RUBATO

70010000114838.description:
The city after dark is never neutral.

Shadows stretch longer than they should, streets feel watched, and certain encounters carry an intensity that can’t be ignored.

As a vampire on the run, every night pulls you deeper into a world where danger and attraction exist side by side.

In Vampire Boys Love Story: Date or Die, time moves relentlessly forward. Days pass. Hunters close in. And the boys you meet seem drawn to you: sometimes with curiosity, sometimes with caution, and sometimes with something far more dangerous.

These encounters aren’t simple.
Interest builds slowly.
Trust is never guaranteed.
And desire often comes with unspoken conditions.

This narrative visual novel blends romance with survival, placing equal weight on conversation, perception, and choice.

But connection has a cost.

Vampire hunters patrol the night, forcing you to escape, fight, or disappear when necessary.

Some relationships offer protection.
Others awaken power.
And a few may pull you toward a fate you can’t outrun.

Trust carefully.
Choose who you let close.
The night remembers every mistake.


Features:

● ROMANCE & SURVIVAL VISUAL NOVEL: A narrative experience where attraction and danger evolve together.

● TIME PROGRESSION SYSTEM: Days advance naturally, increasing tension and shaping events.

● CHOICE BASED DIALOGUE: Your words affect trust, desire, and who stands beside you.

● VAMPIRE HUNTERS & CONFRONTATIONS: Escape pursuit, face threats, and fight to stay alive.

● MULTIPLE ROUTES & ENDINGS: Relationships, abilities, and outcomes change with every decision.

● ANIME VISUAL STYLE: Expressive character art and moody city environments.


Choose your connections.
Survive the pursuit.
Play now!
70010000114838.intro:
Embrace the night.
Feel the tension.
Survive what follows.
70010000114838.name: Vampire Boys Love Story: Date or Die

70010000114865.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 30 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.
70010000114865.intro: Meet over 30 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000114865.name: Anime Girls: Cheerful Cosplay

70010000114869.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 30 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.
70010000114869.intro: Meet over 30 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000114869.name: Anime Girls: Shanghai Romance

70010000114873.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 30 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.
70010000114873.intro: Meet over 30 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000114873.name: Anime Girls: Sakura Love

70010000114915.description:
MAMIYA - A Shared Illusion of the World's End - is a dark mystery visual novel made by the indie developer Kenkou Land.
Containing all three parts of the story, it lets you experience a world of characters guided by fate towards various conclusions.

●synopsis
Tokyo, during the year in which the world was prophesied to end.

As we clung to reality, too spineless to throw our lives away together, we met MAMIYA.

At a friend's funeral, the entire crowd was weeping and mourning, while we thought to ourselves that the death of a single person had no meaningful impact on the world at large.
We slept, woke up, and went through the same daily grind as ever. At least, that's how it was supposed to be.

Then MAMIYA appeared...

Before we even knew it, the mysterious child named MAMIYA had wormed their way into our daily lives. They slowly, but surely, became something of an emotional support. They'd brought us down a new path.

A path that would surely lead us to our deaths...

●Added Content
・Additional illustrations for the story!
・The long-awaited full voice acting!
As a voice actor, we have hired Soyogi-Soyogi !
・The Nintendo Switch™ version also contains an original minigame to win "what-if" stories!
70010000114915.intro: It doesn't matter if my love goes unnoticed—I am always on your side.
70010000114915.name: MAMIYA - A Shared Illusion of the World's End -

70010000114921.description:
A new frontier in live-action suspense games, combining a multi-perspective visual novel where you switch between characters, high-quality live-action cinematics, and immersive 360° camera direction.

Story
Thirteen years ago, six girls mysteriously disappeared in Akihabara — a series of unsolved cases known as "The Akiba Vanishing".

At the annual Tokyo Game Expo, Daiki Shinjo (played by Hiromitsu Kitayama), once hailed as a "genius creator," boldly announces the development of a new game inspired by this very incident: AKIBA LOST.
But soon thereafter, the strange disappearances begin again.

The cast of the game includes his sister Aoi Shinjo, who works at a maid cafe, underground idol Kokone Nagato, food writer Moe Kurosu, shrine maiden Chihiro Jimbo, cosplayer Wakana Yusa, and game streamer Yukimi Kurahashi — each a colorful icon of Akihabara’s vibrant subculture.

The story they were supposed to perform soon begins to bleed into reality.
It all starts with a threatening phone call — and the sudden disappearance of Aoi.

"Stop developing the game now. Or else...the tragedy will repeat again."

Can Shinjo finish developing the game? Can he protect everyone? Who is behind it all? And what really happened 13 years ago?
The choices determining how the story ends are now in your hands.


Game features:
Multiple Protagonists – Character Switching System
Freely switch between characters to experience the same timeline from multiple perspectives.
A single choice made by one character may change another’s fate.

Choose-Your-Own-Adventure System
The story branches according to your decisions.
A single choice can ripple across characters — and alter the ending.

360° View – Immersive Camera System
Step into each character’s point of view.
Look around freely through their eyes for a deeply immersive, cinematic experience.

FREEZE & ACTIVATE
Unlock frozen story paths through other characters.
When one story reaches a dead end, another character's story may hold the key to moving forward.

Buddy Characters
Meet colorful partner characters who accompany you throughout the story.

Cast:
Hiromitsu Kitayama / Game Creator: Daiki Shinjo
Sayuri Matsumura / Maid: Aoi Shinjo
Momoko Tanabe / Game Streamer: Yukimi Kurahashi
Misato Ugaki / Food Writer: Moe Kurosu
Yui Oguri (AKB48) / Underground Idol: Kokone Nagato
Azusa Ohara / Shrine Maiden: Chihiro Jimbo
MINA (East Of Eden) / Cosplayer: Wakana Yusa

This product is released for the Nintendo Switch™. It can also be played on Nintendo Switch™ 2. However, please note that a separate product, "AKIBA LOST", is available exclusively for Nintendo Switch 2.
Save data and Additional Contents are not compatible between the two versions. Please be careful to avoid duplicate or mistaken purchases.
Nintendo Switch 2 Edition and Upgrade Pack are not available for this product.
70010000114921.intro: A live-action multi-perspective suspense game of fate and choice in Akihabara
70010000114921.name: AKIBA LOST

70010000114937.description:
Turn numbers into works of art!
Choose from over 120 designs, color in each section, and marvel as vibrant images appear before your very eyes. Whether animals, landscapes or artistic designs, experience the perfect escape as you paint.

• Draw intuitively with your finger – control all your actions directly via the touchscreen, with no additional devices required

• Suitable for any talent level – a range of difficulty levels are available from the first brushstroke to the finished masterpiece

• Personalize your work – experiment with 8 color palettes and 8 unique painting styles to produce wildly different results

• Smart drawing aids – highlight fields, show/hide numbers, or automatically jump to the next area

• Flexible painting – you can start a picture, take a break and then resume painting whenever you feel like it

• Admire your gallery – use time-lapse mode to look back at how your artworks were created
70010000114937.name: CreArt – Painting by Numbers

70010000114938.description:
The tyrant Lassic rules the cosmos, and it is up to you to defeat his evil reign. Witness the revival of this defining RPG in SEGA AGES Phantasy Star.

Take advantage of the new dungeon map display and the acclaimed “Ages Mode” as you traverse tricky dungeon mazes and battle ferocious 8-bit beasts. Phantasy Star has claimed its place as a pioneer RPG and its retro-spirit is sure to find a home in the hearts of old and new fans alike.
70010000114938.intro: The classic galactical adventure arrives on Nintendo Switch™!
70010000114938.name: SEGA AGES Phantasy Star

70010000114939.description:
Over three decades since its humble beginnings, Alex Kidd is back to smash rocks, collect items, and play Rock, Paper, Scissors with evil henchmen! The beloved boy martial artist must traverse the kingdom of Radaxian to face off against evil villain Janken the Great. Does he have what it takes to save the kingdom, or will all be lost to evil?

Featuring a new ranking system, AGES mode rewind option, two Time-Attack challenge modes, and more!
70010000114939.intro: A classic arcade platformer returns in SEGA AGES Alex Kidd for Nintendo Switch™.
70010000114939.name: SEGA AGES Alex Kidd in Miracle World

70010000114940.description:
It's 2348 and the Gain Ground battle-simulation supercomputer has gone rogue, trapping people inside with rampaging robots! It's up to you to rescue them.

Choose between twenty playable characters, each with their unique abilities and skill sets. Do you have what it takes to escape?
70010000114940.intro: The classic arcade game returns on SEGA AGES for Nintendo Switch™.
70010000114940.name: SEGA AGES Gain Ground

70010000114941.description:
The arcade platform action RPG stars a now-teenage Tom-Tom, also known as Wonder Boy. Having previously saved Wonder Land from clutches of the evil king, the hero is called upon again when the evil MEKA dragon invades. It's up to Wonder Boy to defeat all the monsters in the now-called "Monster Land." Fight monsters, purchase magical weapons, and traverse the realm today!

Take advantage of these new features:
-	Challenge Mode: Two time attack challenges and one score attack challenge
-	Rankings: Record your high scores from Arcade and Challenge Modes
-	Replays: Capture and re-watch gameplay in Arcade or Challenge Modes
-	Power Up New Game: Enables you to restart a New Game with the gear you accumulated in your previous run
70010000114941.intro: Sequel to the original Wonder Boy, Wonder Boy: Monster Land returns in SEGA AGES for Nintendo Switch™ !
70010000114941.name: SEGA AGES Wonder Boy: Monster Land

70010000114951.description:
SEGA AGES Sonic The Hedgehog includes Mega Play, previously only available in the Sonic the Hedgehog arcade game. Familiar stages will feel new again as you race against time to the finish line. It's a thrilling challenge for seasoned Sonic fans!

With features such as Drop Dash from Sonic Mania, Ring Keep Mode, and stage select, Sonic is a fun and accessible game for all players!
70010000114951.intro: Experience the definitive Sonic The Hedgehog experience on Nintendo Switch™!
70010000114951.name: SEGA AGES Sonic The Hedgehog

70010000114955.description:
Take part in the new adventurous TV show! We designed unique puzzles and locations special for you. Prove yourself worthy of the love of the audience!

“Artifact Seekers” is an adventure game in the genre of Hidden Objects, with plenty of mini-games and puzzles, unforgettable characters and complicated quests.

Have you ever dreamed of fame and glory? Your time has come! Try your hand at living under the spotlight in the brand new TV show — Artifact Seekers. The whole season of adventures is ready to impress you.
Explore carefully designed locations, talk to the helpers, and solve challenging puzzles. Earn as many stars as possible using your intelligence, and reach the quest goals showing perseverance. The viewers of the show will love it!

- Think outside the box, show ingenuity, and the victory is in your pocket!
- Explore whole worlds with each new episode, carefully collecting local curiosities.
- Enjoy stunning locations and beautiful soundtracks
- Solve dozens of puzzles and test yourself in exciting mini-games
70010000114955.name: Artifact Seekers

70010000114961.description:
Forgotten lands and ancient magic give rise to a dangerous journey against the oppressive rule of witches.

“Legendary Tales V. Price of Power” is an adventure game in the Hidden Objects genre, with plenty of mini-games and puzzles, unforgettable characters, and complicated quests.

In a world ruled by witches, survival is hard and hope is rare. Whispers of forgotten myths and powers suggest that change may still be possible. From hidden catacombs to long-abandoned cities, this journey unfolds across ruins of lost civilizations and through encounters with dangerous foes. Along the way, unlikely allies appear, old secrets resurface, and the fragile dream of freedom grows stronger. The journey is filled with uncertainty, but each discovery hints that the world’s fate may yet be rewritten. Thus, a story of magic, struggle, the search for safety, and the creation of a new future takes shape.

- Gather old friends to overcome hardships together
- Travel through incredible places no one ever believed existed
- Solve puzzles and play mini-games to put your wits to the test
- Examine locations carefully and find every collectible
- Join the battle for freedom alongside your favorite characters
70010000114961.intro: With every adventure, hope for a safer world grows.
70010000114961.name: Legendary Tales V. Price of Power

70010000114978.description:
Light the right path in Lantern Push, a charming puzzle game where you control a red panda pushing paper lanterns onto Magical Ember Seals scattered across the ground. When a lantern reaches a seal, magic happens: it lights up, floats gently, and marks another step toward the perfect solution.

With 30 handcrafted levels divided between the Bamboo Garden at dawn and the Riverbank during the lantern festival, each challenge invites you to think calmly, test ideas, and reorganize routes until everything clicks into place. There is no rush, no enemies, and no penalties. Making mistakes is part of the process, and Undo and Restart are always at hand so you can experiment without fear.

Lantern Push is ideal for players who love relaxing puzzles, cozy visuals, and that delightful “now it works” feeling. Push, light, adjust, and discover the pleasure of illuminating the perfect path, one lantern at a time.
70010000114978.name: Lantern Push

70010000114984.description:
5 on 5 Pro Basketball born from the golden era of sports games. This spiritual successor to the 8-bit ballers bridges the gap between retro and today’s simulation games.

* Side-scrolling, sweaty arcade action
* Simplified 3-button gameplay
* Decades of rosters with 175 teams
* 1000 players with individualized attributes
* Seamless play calling
* Sensational cut scenes
* 1-Player Story Mode unlocks secret teams
* Scream-inducing local multiplayer
* Retro vibes galore
* No virtual currency. No pay-to-win. No micro transactions. Ever.

Side-scrolling, arcade action is paired with on-the-fly strategy. 3 button gameplay is easy to pick up, but it is the dynamic play-calling that elevates this title beyond just long bombs and acrobatics.

Attribute-rich players make up a vast set of rosters. Dig through decades of teams to find your favorite All-Stars and even unlock the "Legends" in an immersive story mode.
70010000114984.name: Basketball Classics

70010000114990.description:
In Cloudberry Kingdom, the beloved platformer returns, now available on modern consoles. Dive into a world where every jump, jetpack boost, and wheelie roll feels fresh yet comfortingly familiar.
Meet Bob, the courageous hero of Cloudberry Kingdom. When King Kobbler threatens to throw the kingdom into chaos, Bob steps up to protect his home. With the princess in danger and the future of the realm at stake, Bob sets out on a daring adventure to restore peace.

Key Features:
Experience endless platforming challenges with procedurally generated levels that ensure each run feels unique.
Follow Bob’s journey in Story Mode as he confronts King Kobbler and overcomes tough platforming challenges.
Create your own levels and challenge friends to conquer your designs in Free Play Mode.
Test your skills in a range of mini-games and time trials built to push your platforming abilities in Arcade Mode.
Team up with friends in cooperative play or compete in exciting multiplayer challenges.
Personalise Bob with a variety of costumes and accessories.

Cloudberry Kingdom delivers the energetic platforming action fans love, now enhanced with improved resolution for a modern gameplay experience. Get ready to leap back into the adventure and save Cloudberry Kingdom!
70010000114990.name: Cloudberry Kingdom

70010000114996.description:
Get ready for ground-smashing fun and leafy adventures! In Beetle Shock, you control a strong beetle capable of breaking cracked logs with a powerful ground pound. Each level is a small forest mission: find the yellow fruit, open the door, and reach the insect house hidden inside a tree trunk.

Across 30 levels split between day and night biomes, you jump across platforms, use bouncy mushrooms and cannon plants to launch yourself through the scenery, and explore every corner in search of collectible fireflies, perfect for completionists. It’s a light, colorful platformer made for players who enjoy accessible action with a touch of exploration.

The path isn’t always safe: clover-shaped saws, dangerous spikes, and tricky platforms will test your reflexes. Luckily, sunflowers act as checkpoints, saving your progress and getting you back into the action quickly without losing collectibles. Difficulty increases smoothly, introducing new challenges without breaking the fun flow.

Beetle Shock is ideal for fans of classic platformers, nature lovers, and players who enjoy collecting everything along the way. A charming adventure full of personality, where every jump, every ground pound, and every firefly collected adds to the fun.
70010000114996.intro: Shell Shock in the Insect Kingdom
70010000114996.name: Beetle Shock

70010000115002.description:
Get ready for an underground adventure full of charm and strategy! In Mole Cart Mining, you guide a determined little mole riding a mine cart while rotating tracks on a hexagonal grid to create the perfect route. The goal is simple and satisfying: collect every mineral and reach the exit in style.

Each level is a tiny puzzle filled with classic pieces like straights, curves, and junctions, plus the game’s chaotic star, the rotating conveyor, which spins automatically when the cart crosses it. It changes everything mid-route and demands smart planning that mixes order, timing, and a bit of underground boldness.

With 30 handcrafted levels split between the Iron Mines and Diamond Mines, the game offers short, clean, relaxing challenges with clear objectives. Every solution brings that genuine “aha!” moment when everything clicks into place.

Mole Cart Mining is perfect for fans of clever puzzles, smart routes, and that satisfying feeling of watching the mole slide along exactly the path you planned. No frustration here, just good ideas, good tracks, and plenty of mining fun.
70010000115002.intro: Clever Tracks in the Little Mole Mines
70010000115002.name: Mole Cart Mining

70010000115023.description:
Explore cozy country clubs, parks, picturesque canyons and family holidays, enjoying every moment.
In this part of the series, you will find even more new places where you can test your skills in searching for objects and solving puzzles!

The collector's edition includes:
- 12 additional levels with unique hidden object scenes and mini-games.
- 8 exclusive mini-games from the previous installments.
- Souvenir Shop – collect unique trophies for achievements.

Leave the hustle and bustle of the city behind and embark on an exciting journey full of discoveries and vivid emotions.
70010000115023.intro: Picturesque locations are waiting for you, filled with an atmosphere of relaxation.
70010000115023.name: Amazing Weekend 4 Search and Relax Collector's Edition

70010000115064.description:
This is an incredible journey offering a variety of hidden object search modes and a wide selection of exciting mini-games.
Treat yourself to a unique journey through 30 amazing and unforgettable places.
You will be able to visit azure beaches, to conquer deserts, to immerse yourself in the beauty of forests, and to enjoy holidays in a variety of places on our planet.
The game will give you the opportunity to use your skills and knowledge to complete mini-games and find all the hidden objects.

The collector's edition includes:
- 10 additional locations
- 10 additional mini-games, as well as 12 puzzles for real fans
- Souvenir shop
70010000115064.name: Around the World 4: Family Tour Collector's Edition

70010000115070.description:
Take control of a rocket and navigate through challenging courses where precise control is essential.
Use thrust and rotation to carefully maneuver through tight spaces and reach the finish line.

Every mistake leads to an explosion and instant restart, pushing you to master inertia and improve your control.
Levels are designed for short, intense attempts and constant refinement of your best times.

Perfect for players who enjoy fair challenges, time attacks, and skill-based gameplay.
70010000115070.name: Rocket Time Trials: Galactic Highway

70010000115076.description:
Plan Santa’s route and solve 40 festive logic puzzles in this cozy holiday adventure.
Before each level begins, place directional tiles to map out how Santa will move. Once the route is set, watch him follow your plan—collecting every gift on the way and delivering them to the waiting child. With limited tiles available, every decision matters, turning each stage into a fun little brain teaser.

The puzzles start simple but become more challenging as you progress, pushing you to think ahead, find efficient paths, and make the most of your available moves. No timers, no pressure—just thoughtful planning and satisfying solutions.

Perfect for players of all ages, this charming puzzle game offers 40 handcrafted levels filled with holiday spirit and relaxing gameplay. Help Santa find the right path, gather all the gifts, and bring joy to every child!
70010000115076.intro: Collect gifts, and plan the perfect path.
70010000115076.name: Ho Ho & Move

70010000115102.description:
"Arcade Archives MEGA ZONE" is a shooting game released by KONAMI in 1984.
Pilot your tank and head for the enemy base with the goal of destroying the core hidden in its deepest depths.
By collecting items, two tanks can combine to power up. Gain the strength you need to prepare for the battle against an unknown enemy!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.
70010000115102.intro: MEGA ZONE! FURTHER INTO UNKNOWN CRISIS...
70010000115102.name: Arcade Archives MEGA ZONE

70010000115103.description:
The legendary SEIBU KAIHATSU arcade game Raiden Fighters returns, revived from the depths of time.

Choose between the Japanese version and a hardcore International version!

Enjoy convenient features like rapid-fire button configuration, Practice Mode, and a restart function.

Great for both first-time players and those returning to 2D shooting games after a long break!

The remix soundtrack includes all stage and boss music from Raiden Fighters.

Enjoy the music on the sound player, and assign music to each stage just as you like with a mode.

Customize the experience to your liking and discover a new world of Raiden Fighters!

Participating Artist: SOSHI HOSOI

Check out the wallpaper customization, an authentic arcade-style CRT filter, and Vertical Screen Mode (monitor rotation) that deliver a vivid sense of presence that goes beyond the arcade experience.

Play the reborn Raiden Fighters in its bold new form to your heart's content!

■ Contents (Choose between the Japanese/International Version)

RAIDEN FIGHTERS

※ This product contains and offers selected titles from the RAIDEN FIGHTERS REMIX COLLECTION at a reduced price. Please be careful to avoid duplicate purchases.
70010000115103.intro: The score-driven classic that thrilled shooters everywhere, Raiden Fighters, returns with modern features and remix music!
70010000115103.name: RAIDEN FIGHTERS REMIX

70010000115116.description:
A management simulation in which you take an old, run-down castle and turn it into a dastardly demon stronghold! Recruit unique monsters as your minions and vanquish adventurers who dare to enter your realm!

Install gargoyles, ritual altars, and other devilish decor to boost your castle's mystique and attract more monsters your way. Gift them food and other items to help them grow, and garner their support to fend off pesky adventurers.

You can also send your monster minions out to explore nearby dungeons and towns. They'll bring you back items and other loot, and maybe even some new allies!

As you progress, you can also start merging monsters together to make new ones.

And don't forget traps—essential equipment for proper castle defense! Develop a range of traps like sleep-inducing gas and heavy washbowls to thwart any who cross the threshold of your demonic haven! By placing and combining traps in imaginative ways, you can make your fortress of fiendishness virtually impregnable!

Fend off attacks from mighty adventurers and keep your minions sweet to become the biggest and baddest demon overlord of all time!
70010000115116.intro: Demon Castle Building Dungeon Management Simulation
70010000115116.name: Demon Castle Story

70010000115117.description:
The legendary SEIBU KAIHATSU arcade game Raiden Fighters JET returns, revived from the depths of time.

Choose between the Japanese version and a hardcore International version!

Enjoy convenient features like rapid-fire button configuration, Practice Mode, and a restart function. Great for both first-time players and those returning to 2D shooting games after a long break!

The remix soundtrack includes all stage and boss music from Raiden Fighters JET.

Enjoy the music on the sound player, and assign music to each stage just as you like with a mode.

Customize the experience to your liking and discover a new world of Raiden Fighters JET!
Participating Artists: YUKI ARAI/SOSHI HOSOI

Check out the wallpaper customization, an authentic arcade-style CRT filter, and Vertical Screen Mode (monitor rotation) that deliver a vivid sense of presence that goes beyond the arcade experience.

Play the reborn Raiden Fighters JET in its bold new form to your heart's content!

■ Contents (Choose between the Japanese/International Version)
RAIDEN FIGHTERS JET

※ This product contains and offers selected titles from the RAIDEN FIGHTERS REMIX COLLECTION at a reduced price. Please be careful to avoid duplicate purchases.
70010000115117.intro: The score-driven classic that thrilled shooters everywhere, Raiden Fighters JET, returns with modern features and remix music!
70010000115117.name: RAIDEN FIGHTERS JET REMIX

70010000115118.description:
The legendary SEIBU KAIHATSU arcade game Raiden Fighters 2 returns, revived from the depths of time.

Choose between the Japanese version and a hardcore International version!

Enjoy convenient features like rapid-fire button configuration, Practice Mode, and a restart function.

Great for both first-time players and those returning to 2D shooting games after a long break!

The remix soundtrack includes all stage and boss music from Raiden Fighters 2.

Enjoy the music on the sound player, and assign music to each stage just as you like with a mode.

Customize the experience to your liking and discover a new world of Raiden Fighters 2!
Participating Artist: KAZUHIRO TSURUKUBO

Check out the wallpaper customization, an authentic arcade-style CRT filter, and Vertical Screen Mode (monitor rotation) that deliver a vivid sense of presence that goes beyond the arcade experience.

Play the reborn Raiden Fighters 2 in its bold new form to your heart's content!

■ Contents (Choose between the Japanese/International Version)
RAIDEN FIGHTERS 2

※ This product contains and offers selected titles from the RAIDEN FIGHTERS REMIX COLLECTION at a reduced price. Please be careful to avoid duplicate purchases.
70010000115118.intro: The score-driven classic that thrilled shooters everywhere, Raiden Fighters 2, returns with modern features and remix music!
70010000115118.name: RAIDEN FIGHTERS 2 REMIX

70010000115127.description:
■ MotionRec is a "recording puzzle action" game.

Use the ability to record your own movements and play them back elsewhere to explore a world of devastation.

You can record the trajectory of your movements, from walking to jumping. Use stage gimmicks to create and record more complex movements to traverse the world.

■ Record your movements and play them back in another location!

This will let you reach places too high to jump up to, or even access spots where there's nothing to stand on.

Make good use of the MotionRec ability to unravel the mysteries behind this devastated world ruled by machines!
70010000115127.intro: Use stage gimmicks to create and record more complex movements to traverse the world.
70010000115127.name: MotionRec

70010000115128.description:
The extreme tension of infiltrating without being detected.
Metal Gear series, the pinnacle of “stealth action” where you avoid combat and complete missions while hiding.

The game take place 10 years after METAL GEAR SOLID 3: Snake Eater.
Amidst the swirling conspiracies behind the East-West Cold War, Snake confronts them while leading a private military force.
This is the story of how one soldier, “Snake”, becomes “Big Boss”.

【STORY】
THE ILLUSION OF PEACE FALTERS

In 1964, after saving the world from all-out nuclear war, Naked Snake, a true hero, receives the name Big Boss, but he disappears shortly after the naming ceremony.

Ten years later, Big Boss is running an independent military unit in Columbia, when he is visited by two individuals from Costa Rica, a country without a military.

In a post-Cuban Missile Crisis world, and in a Central America essential to maintaining the power balance between East and West, Costa Rica has been miraculously able to maintain peace.
However, a mysterious armed group has been seen acting suspiciously throughout the region.

They request Big Boss to investigate and eliminate the armed group.
Though he hesitates to accept the request because the tape they brought contained the voice of The Boss, who was supposed to be dead.

【System】
This title offers not only thrilling solo infiltration missions but also co-op with “SENYU” via online connections, and competitive multiplayer for up to six players.

The offshore facility Mother Base supports your missions.

It houses staff living quarters, development labs for mission weapons and gear, storage for captured large-scale weapons, and more. Expanding your staff allows Mother Base to grow and develop, incorporating simulation elements.

----------
The Screenplay Book containing in-game text from Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker and the Master Book detailing the story and characters are also included within the game.

[Game]
Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker (HD Collection version)
*Online play is available for up to 6 players.

[Digital Contents]
Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker Screenplay Book
Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker Master Book
*Accessible via the in-game Start Menu.

----------
【METAL GEAR SOLID: MASTER COLLECTION Vol.1 Save Data Bonus】
If you have save data from titles included in METAL GEAR SOLID MASTER COLLECTION Vol.1, you can receive in-game items usable in the game as a bonus.

・Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker (HD Collection version) Bonus: Uniform:GOLD

*Bonus content can be obtained by playing this game respectively.
*This requires that save data for titles included in METAL GEAR SOLID: MASTER COLLECTION Vol.1, created using the same account, be present on the console used to play this game.
*Playing this game first, then starting to play titles included in METAL GEAR SOLID: MASTER COLLECTION Vol.1, still qualifies you for this bonus.
70010000115128.name: METAL GEAR SOLID: Peace Walker - Master Collection Version

70010000115134.description:
Buy your own dream home — Choose the house that fits your heart and finally make that dream come true.
Get your own car — Add style and freedom to your new lifestyle!
Decorate four beautiful rooms — Personalize your kitchen, living room, bedroom, and garden with hundreds of charming furniture and decor pieces.

Explore warm and inviting locations: front porches, green backyards, homey interiors, and peaceful nature spots. Each scene is filled with dozens of well-hidden items waiting to be found.

Mini-Games and Relaxing Puzzles
