Take a break and enjoy thoughtful, relaxing mini-games that sharpen your focus and unlock new locations and features.

Collector’s Edition Includes:
- 8 all-new hidden object scenes
- 8 relaxing mini-games
- 8 bonus levels from previous Sweet Home games
70010000115134.intro: Step into a cozy world of hidden object fun, heartwarming stories, and the joy of creating your perfect home.
70010000115134.name: Sweet Home: Look and Find 5 Collector's Edition

70010000115140.description: Place directional tiles on the ground and choose to solve puzzles the easy or hard way—it's up to you! Watch as the cow follows your path to reach its tasty hay in this fun, kid-friendly game!
70010000115140.intro: Guide the hungry cow to its goal!
70010000115140.name: Moo & Move: Extra Grazing Grounds

70010000115154.description:
Easy to learn, tough to master! Jump straight into fast-paced puzzle action with features fit for both friendly rivalries and competitive tournaments in Puyo Puyo Champions. Challenge your friends and family in local multiplayer or compete against players from around the world through online matchmaking. Built for all ages, this classic puzzle game comes with a surprisingly competitive edge.

- Craft strategic chains and drop devastating attacks with your favorite characters from over 25 years of Puyo Puyo history.
- Competitive multiplayer modes feature fan favorite rulesets from Puyo Puyo 2 and Puyo Puyo Fever.
- Hop online to battle in Puyo Puyo League matches or play casually via Free Play.
- Run your own local tournaments with up to 8 players for the ultimate bragging rights!
70010000115154.intro:
Will you be the next Puyo Puyo Champion?
Fun, fast-paced, competitive puzzle action!
70010000115154.name: Puyo Puyo Champions

70010000115155.description:
Japan’s beloved puzzle game series Puyo Puyo and the world-renowned Tetris® game franchise have teamed up again to deliver even more Puyo-popping and Tetrimino-clearing fun in Puyo Puyo Tetris 2. Playing is easy: match 4 or more same-colored Puyos or complete a line of blocks to clear them from your board and dump Garbage into your opponent’s game. But keep an eye on what’s coming your way too.

Play traditional Puyo Puyo and Tetris…or mix them together to level up your game. Offline or online, you’ll have loads of modes that let you play the way you want from single-player Adventure to couch-competition Versus to ranked Online matches, and more.

• Brand-new Skill Battle introduces character-based skills that can quickly turn the tables on a match, plus item cards to power up your team
• Vibrant characters and an all-new story adventure add dimension to addictive arcade puzzle play
• Improved Online mode offers competition in game-specific leagues and Free Play for up to 4
• Challenge modes including endless Tetris and Puyo Puyo add still more variety to solo and online play
70010000115155.intro: Two Puzzle Legends Reunite for the Ultimate Crossover
70010000115155.name: Puyo Puyo™ Tetris® 2

70010000115156.description:
BANG! BANG! BANDITS, the party-style gun shooting game that the whole family can enjoy, is now available as the Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition!

Set in a bright and pop world with simple controls anyone can master, this title has been further powered up by the performance of the Nintendo Switch 2.

With new support for GameShare, you can now easily play together not only with those nearby but also with people far away. Furthermore, the visuals have evolved to be even more beautiful and vivid! Enjoy an even more thrilling gameplay experience on a high-impact screen with silky-smooth motion.

■Intuitive controls that require zero explanation! Anyone can play immediately!
Simple controls: just hold the Joy-Con™ in one hand as a handgun and aim and shoot at the enemies on the screen!!
Automatically move around the field, aim and shoot at all the enemies that appear, and collect lots and lots of coins!
There is no bullet limit, so you can fire as much as you want!
There's nothing to it, just shoot away!

■12 types of stages x 2 leagues, for a lot of fun to be had!
The Normal League, where the battles take place, has 12 stages with different characteristics, including jungles, urban areas, ruins, and caves.
Once you've conquered all the stages in the Normal League, you can challenge the Wild League, which is the most difficult mode available!

■Unique enemy characters run amok all over the screen!
Defeat the Goomin that attack you one after another, and defeat the evil boss waiting at the end of the stage!

■Enjoy 2 different ways to play: Challenge Mode and Battle Mode!
Start with low-class stages in Challenge Mode and then conquer the most difficult stages.
You can play alone or in a team of 2 to 4 people! If each player has a Joy-Con, you can enjoy competitive play, such as single battles (individual battles) where 2-4 players compete for the highest score, or team battles where 2 teams of 2 players compete for the highest score!
70010000115156.intro:
Bang bang away! It feels great!
A new party-style shooting game that can be enjoyed by both children and adults is now available!
70010000115156.name: BANG! BANG! BANDITS Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000115162.description:
The BEYBLADE ACTION game that faithfully recreates the world of BEYBLADE X arrives with three powerful evolutions! Witness EVOBATTLE, EVOSTORY, and EVOCUSTOMIZE!

■ Evolution 1: EVOBATTLE
Your strategy changes dramatically depending on your Bey type. Attack Type specializes in offense, Stamina Type absorbs the opponent’s stamina, Defense Type activates shields for solid protection, and Balance Type boosts attack power through combos! Experience thrilling high-speed Battles that demand skill and precision! Challenge Bladers around the world in online matches!

■ Evolution 2: EVOSTORY
New allies await—compete, grow, and chase your dreams together in the ultimate BEY BATTLE ROYALE (BBR)!

■ Evolution 3: EVOCUSTOMIZE
Customization reaches new heights! Collect materials to coat your Beys in your favorite colors, enhance your favorite parts, and choose X Skills to create the perfect Beys for your Battle style!
70010000115162.intro: Experience the EVOLUTION of Xtreme Battle!
70010000115162.name: BEYBLADE X EVOBATTLE Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000115168.description:
Choose what kind of farmer you want to be! Operate realistic tractors, harvesters, field sprayers, and other machines. Start logging with heavy forestry equipment, or tend to adorable farm animals like cows, sheep, chickens, goats, and their offspring.

• Tons of possibilities on two new maps
• 15 different field crops, plus trees
• 120+ authentic, GPS-enabled machines
• Farm challenges that keep you on your toes
• Production chains, logistics, and more

Operate more than 120 authentic machines by Case IH, CLAAS, DEUTZ-FAHR, Fendt, John Deere, KRONE, Massey Ferguson, New Holland, Valtra & many other acclaimed manufacturers from around the world.

There’s a lot more to do after plowing, removing weeds, harvesting crops, or collecting eggs from chicken coops: Produce valuable goods made from your harvest to expand your flourishing business with new factories and production chains!

Don’t worry, there is always time to relax and walk around your vast arable land while visuals change through the atmospheric seasons. New and improved in-game tutorials show you the ways of the farm if you’re new to country life.
70010000115168.intro: Rise to the Challenge of Farming!
70010000115168.name: Farming Simulator 26: Nintendo Switch™ Edition

70010000115173.description:
Deathground Simulator drops you into a brutal, prehistoric world where survival means outsmarting deadly predators. Stranded in a hostile jungle, you must use limited resources, craft tools, and rely on your wits to escape. The jungle is filled with ancient creatures that will hunt you down—outsmart them or become their prey.

As you explore abandoned outposts, you’ll uncover dark secrets and hear cryptic radio messages. But who can you trust?

Survival Features:
• Deadly Pursuit: Outsmart intelligent predators that relentlessly hunt you. Every move could be your last.
• Dangerous Territories: Explore eerie ruins, dense forests, and hidden places filled with danger and dark secrets.
• Craft to Survive: Collect resources, craft tools, and set traps to defend yourself against the threats that lurk.
• Adaptive Threats: Study predator behaviors and adjust your tactics as the danger evolves.
• Unravel the Mystery: Piece together cryptic radio signals and uncover the horrifying truth of the island’s past.
• Tension at Every Step: The jungle is always watching. Every sound, every shadow, could lead to your demise.

In Deathground Simulator, surviving isn’t just about escaping—it’s about uncovering the terrifying truth hidden in the heart of the wilderness.
70010000115173.intro: Fight, hide, or outsmart—only one will survive the Deathground.
70010000115173.name: Deathground Simulator

70010000115213.description:
"ADVENTURE CANOE" is an action game released by TAITO in 1982.
Your goal is to paddle your canoe down the river and venture deep into the uncharted backcountry. Watch out for driftwood floating downstream and the fierce river currents.
Rumor has it that terrifying crocodiles and outlaws inhabit these waters... Reach the finish line safely and prove your courage!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.
70010000115213.intro: Brave canoeist, challenge the unknown rapids!
70010000115213.name: Arcade Archives ADVENTURE CANOE

70010000115262.description:
Kitchen Wars is a fast-paced party game with 1-8 players that plunges players into the chaos of a restaurant, where they must engage in strategic fights and theft while serving their customers.

Use weapons, steal chairs, throw items, level up to unlock boosters, and have a blast! Deliver meals quickly to keep customers happy and satisfied. Enhance your kitchen and unlock powerful boosters.

Disrupt your rivals with strategic attacks and sabotage. Reduce your competitor’s seating capacity by swiping their chairs. Upgrade Your Restaurant: Earn money from happy clients to invest in your kitchen and secure victory.

Whether you're focused on improving your restaurant or causing chaos for your opponents, Kitchen Wars offers a blend of strategy, combat, and humor for an entertaining and competitive experience.
70010000115262.intro:
Serve your clients
Get upgrades and items
Attack the opposing restaurants
70010000115262.name: Kitchen Wars

70010000115274.description:
One explosion. Too many lies.
When a car bomb shakes 1950s San Viento, detective Javier Cruz must investigate the truth — while the city fights to bury it.
In Noire Police Detective: Gangster Drama Simulator, follow leads through neon-lit streets, motels, bars, warehouses, and ruined landmarks — and decide how far you’re willing to go to uncover the truth.
Use Detective Vision to reveal hidden clues, combine evidence in your case journal, and unlock new objectives or dialogue options. Stay quiet when danger is close: hide in shadows, distract guards, slip through back routes, and take down enemies silently. When stealth fails, you’ll rely on limited combat — close-quarters strikes and a six-shot revolver, where every bullet matters.
The case isn’t just about evidence — it’s about choices. Bribe a witness, destroy a document, protect a suspect, or expose the people in power. Your decisions shape relationships with key characters — a corrupt sheriff, a dangerous femme fatale, and an idealistic journalist — and lead to three possible endings: justice, corruption, or survival.

Key Features:
	•	Noir detective story set in a tense 1950s border city
	•	Detective Vision to uncover hidden clues and secrets
	•	Stealth gameplay: shadows, distractions, silent takedowns
	•	Environmental puzzles: safes, panels, locked routes, coded messages
	•	Moral choices that affect characters, missions, and the final outcome
	•	Semi-open locations with collectibles and optional areas

Truth has a price in San Viento. Will you expose the system — or become part of it?
70010000115274.intro: Uncover the lie behind the crime.
70010000115274.name: Noire Police Detective: Gangster Drama Simulator

70010000115286.description:
*This title does not support single player play.

Astro Party EX is a chaotic local multiplayer space brawler. Blast enemy ships, run over pilots, and laugh while you do it. The twist? Ships can only turn right. (whaaaaa?)

• Up to 4 players
• Two-button controls
• Fully destructible arenas
• Stylish pixel art & music
70010000115286.name: Astro Party EX

70010000115297.description:
Dive into a faster, brighter, and even more satisfying blast of hyper-casual action. Take on endless waves each packed with three quick challenges that test your aim, timing, and reactions.

Your goal is simple: knock every green block into oblivion. Smash through glass panels, dodge shifting obstacles, and send pieces flying with clean, physics-driven precision.
With its vibrant visuals, smooth effects, and bold geometric style, this experience turns every shot into a burst of colour and motion. Conquer waves to earn gems, then unlock a variety of stylish new ball designs to personalise your play.
70010000115297.intro: Fire the shot. Watch it fall
70010000115297.name: Smash Out 2

70010000115316.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 30 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.
70010000115316.intro: Meet over 30 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000115316.name: Sugoi Girls: Pretty Party

70010000115320.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 30 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.
70010000115320.intro: Meet over 30 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000115320.name: Sugoi Girls: Dental Darling

70010000115324.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 30 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.
70010000115324.intro: Meet over 30 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000115324.name: Sugoi Girls: Clover Crush

70010000115333.description:
Fetch Quest Remastered is a visual novel that expands on the hit Fetch Quest with more content, upgraded graphics, and unlockable perks with different story branches.

Flora, a budding adventurer, takes on a job retrieving stolen items for a suspicious bartender. To retrieve the item, she must infiltrate a notorious gang of bandits in the guise of a new recruit.

Fortunately, she has the help of two other adventurers...

…Unfortunately, they are completely useless without her!

According to the narrator, who has a strangely loud voice, if everyone had created their characters in advance, things would have gone more smoothly...

Join the role-playing adventures of Flora and her (unprepared) companions Connor and Todd, helping them complete the quests planned by their resourceful Dungeon Master.

Features:
● Discover multiple endings by making in-game choices
● Enjoy remastered games with HD graphics and illustrations
● Choose from two love interests according to your heart
● Unlock additional content by selection
● New true ending leading to sequel
● Approximately 2 hours of reading time
● 1 internet meme
70010000115333.intro: Did you bring your character sheet this time? We can’t start the game if you don’t know who your character is… anyway, we have an item to retrieve—do you accept this quest?
70010000115333.name: Fetch Quest Remastered

70010000115337.description:
Find the thief of the magical ring!

The castle is in an uproar: The king's magical ring has been stolen! Only you can talk to the speaking animals – they saw the thief. Follow their clues, make clever deductions and unmask the culprit before the time runs out. Can you save the kingdom?

• Talk to the animals and gather information
• Search the castle and discover magical items
• Make clever deductions – every clue counts!
• Play with up to 4 detectives – whether they're real friends or smart AI teammates
• Every game is a new adventure – plenty of thrills right to the end!
70010000115337.intro: Reveal the secrets of the speaking animals and find the thief!
70010000115337.name: Whoowasit?

70010000115343.description:
Welcome to Loaders Inc, where speed, precision, and style determine your success in the ultimate moving and decorating challenge. Your mission? Clear out old homes, load every last item into the truck, and transform new houses into dream spaces, all before time runs out!

Every second counts as you race against the clock to collect furniture, boxes, and decorations. Upgrade your crew, boost their speed and stamina, and increase your time limit with each attempt. The faster and smarter you work, the more your moving business will thrive.

Once the loading is done, it's time for you to get creative. Arrange and decorate carefully to impress your customers, earn top satisfaction scores, and watch as you grow from a small startup into a decorating powerhouse.

Loaders Inc is fast, fun, and endlessly replayable. It blends time management, strategy, and design into one satisfying experience that proves hard work can be this enjoyable.
70010000115343.intro: Box by Box, Build Your Business
70010000115343.name: Loaders, Inc.

70010000115350.description:
ABOUT THIS GAME

Unleash the mayhem in Pritto Prisoner, the cute and chaotic 4v2 asymmetrical party game where animal inmates lay poopie traps, spray peepee, and use special skills to outwit robot guards.

Inside a notorious island prison, the world’s cutest criminals, including a gangster rabbit, an influencer cat, and even a penguin chef, are locked in maximum security under 24/7 robot surveillance.

Will you scramble to freedom as a poopie-dropping prisoner, or hunt them down as a custom-built robot warden? Choose your side and jump into unpredictable escapes, chaotic chases, and laugh-out-loud clashes where no two matches ever play out the same!


ANIMAL TEAM

・Complete funny and unique objectives around the prison to open the escape gates.

・Eat bread and drink water to fuel your potty powers: poopie and peepee.

・Poopie: dropping your load in toilets powers you up and brings you one step closer to freedom!

・Peepee: unleash your bladder on robots and cameras to short-circuit them, giving your team a chance to escape.


・Whether you’re slicing through robots as a lion sword master or dropping explosive decoy art as an elephant fraudster, every animal packs unique skills and passives that unlock outrageous new playstyles!

・Captured animals go to the Nap Room, where counting sheep can bring them back. Get tucked in too many times and it’s Deep Sleep for good!


ROBOT TEAM

・Build your robot from mix-and-match parts, combining upper and lower bodies with gadgets and boosts that let you capture in your own way.

・Uppers: shape your offense with weapons like the Stun Gun for shocking captures or the Lasso for long-range takedowns.

・Lowers: change the way you move with options like legs, wheels, or tank treads to chase down escapees.

・Equip gadgets and boosts like the Magic Hand to trap animals, the Wormhole to slip through walls, the Motion Sensor to track their moves, and the Shield to block enemy peepee.

・Collect poopie left behind during the match to unlock stronger upgrades and supercharge your robot.

・Coordinate with your robot partner to turn every escape attempt into a chaotic back-and-forth of counters, traps, and mayhem.


KEY FEATURES

・Asymmetrical 4v2 multiplayer with animals on the run and robots on the hunt

・Quick 10-minute matches perfect for party play

・A hilarious yet strategic peepee-and-poopie gameplay loop

・Kanahei’s adorable art style and TeddyLoid’s energetic soundtrack

・Cross-platform play

・Single-player campaign to uncover the secrets of Prison Island

・Complete Pritto Challenges to earn Pritto Coins and unlock decorations

・Customize your animals and robots with a variety of fun decorations

・Host private matches with your friends using custom settings
70010000115350.intro: Escape or capture in this cute and chaotic 4v2 action party game! Play as mischievous animal prisoners using peepee, poopie, and special skills to escape.
70010000115350.name: PRITTO PRISONER - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000115383.description:
After a strange incident, the Phantom Thieves wander into a bizarre realm where its citizens are living under tyrannical oppression. Surrounded by a military group named Legionnaires, they find themselves in grave danger until a mysterious revolutionary named Erina rescues them and offers an enticing deal in exchange for their help. What truth lies behind Erina and the deal she offers to the Phantom Thieves?

Persona 5 Tactica features an all-new story, the return of fan-favorite characters, and brand-new allies and foes. Join the group as they lead an emotional revolution in this thrilling combat adventure!

An Emotional Revolution
Lead an uprising of the heart in a brand-new storyline that takes place in Persona’s iconic universe.

Build Your Dream Squad
Assemble a team of beloved heroes to fight oppressive armies in thrilling turn-based combat.

Dynamic Combat
Overthrow your enemies with powerful Personas, an assortment of weapons, and wipe them out with style!
70010000115383.intro: Ignite your heart— An emotional uprising begins!
70010000115383.name: Persona 5 Tactica

70010000115384.description:
Join the Phantom Thieves and strike back against the corruption overtaking cities across Japan. A summer vacation with close friends takes a sudden turn as a distorted reality emerges; reveal the truth and redeem the hearts of those imprisoned at the center of the crisis!

•	Jump into the stylish world of Persona in an all-new story
•	Dynamically control your team during explosive combat
•	Battle across Japan in an epic road trip
70010000115384.name: Persona® 5 Strikers

70010000115392.description:
Jump, Mouse, Jump! is a fast-paced vertical platformer where your only goal is to climb as high as you possibly can!

Play as a fearless little mouse, hop between platforms, snag tasty cheese along the way, and dodge hungry cats determined to stop your ascent.

Simple to learn but tough to master - every jump counts, every platform matters, and one wrong move can send you all the way down. The higher you climb, the bigger your score and the greater the thrill!

Think you’ve got the reflexes to reach new heights?
70010000115392.intro: Free cheese is only found in mousetraps - but who are we to resist?
70010000115392.name: Jump, Mouse, Jump!

70010000115406.description:
Honor or vengeance — walk the path of the ronin.

Step into the role of Takashi Hayato, a samurai turned ronin after the murder of his lord. Set in feudal Japan during the Sengoku era, the game follows a journey of revenge, honor, and difficult choices.
Master skill-based katana combat with light and heavy attacks, blocks, parries, counterattacks, and executions. Use stealth to strike from the shadows or face enemies head-on in intense duels. Archery supports combat, offering tactical options in battle.

Progress through story-driven levels set in villages, temples, mountain paths, and enemy strongholds. Your actions shape the Honor Karma System — follow the Path of Honor to gain survivability, or the Path of Blood to embrace raw power. Karma influences gameplay bonuses and determines the final ending.

Key Features

- Skill-based katana combat with light, heavy, parry, counter, and execution mechanics
- Stealth gameplay with detection, silent kills, and risk-reward encounters
- Archery support for tactical combat and positioning
- Atmospheric levels inspired by feudal Japan
- Cinematic boss duels that test timing, focus, and resolve
- A branching Honor Karma system that shapes gameplay and story outcomes

Your journey ends where honor, revenge, and destiny collide.
Only your choices will decide whether Takashi becomes a legendary warrior, a ruthless survivor, or a ronin lost to history.
70010000115406.intro: Fight with honor. Decide your fate.
70010000115406.name: Samurai Simulator: Kensei Warrior

70010000115412.description:
Had enough of endless meetings and paperwork? It’s time to shake things up!

Step into the shoes of a tired office worker who decides that today… things are going to change.
Turn routine into mayhem as you dash through lively office spaces, overcome obstacles, and face the ultimate challenge — the boss!

Key Features:

*A Playful Office Uprising*
Transform boring routine into lighthearted chaos.

*Action with a Twist of Strategy*
Overcome fun challenges using both timing and clever thinking.

*Creative Interactive Environments*
Navigate dynamic office spaces filled with surprises.

*Fast-Paced, Accessible Gameplay*
Easy to jump into, satisfying to master.

*A Relatable Antihero*
Because everyone has dreamed of skipping just one more meeting.

Swap stress for action as everyday workplace objects become tools of playful chaos.
Smash, dodge, and outsmart your way through creative levels where quick thinking is just as important as quick reflexes.
70010000115412.intro: Challenge the office routine! Turn an ordinary workday into a playful office uprising — outsmart obstacles, stir up fun chaos, and face the best boss!
70010000115412.name: Office Brawl - Room Smash

70010000115423.description:
Catch the wave of tranquility in Crabwave, a relaxing puzzle where a stylish crab surfs across islands, bringing life wherever he goes. Connect water streams, plan the perfect route, and plant coconuts to transform beaches, reefs, and mangroves into vibrant paradises.

No timers, no pressure, no rush. Here, thinking calmly is part of the fun. Build your route, press Play, and watch the crab glide smoothly over the waves, executing your plan with charm and flow. Made a mistake? Restart, rearrange, and try again. Each level is an invitation to experiment, adjust, and smile when everything finally clicks.

Crabwave is perfect for players looking for smart puzzles, a zen atmosphere, and that satisfying feeling of solving challenges at their own pace. Relax, think, surf, and let the tide carry you.
70010000115423.name: Crabwave

70010000115430.description:
Embark on a tranquil journey to uncharted waters in Collector’s Cove, a farming adventure set on the high seas! There are no enemies in this world: it’s just you, your animal friend, and an ocean full of secrets and surprises.

Grow a flourishing floating farm. Cultivate rare crops and reel in elusive fish. Discover new islands and climate zones, each with its own collection of unique local flora. Fill in your Collector’s Compendium. Craft items and personalize your ship, transforming it into your own home. Learn how to gather enough rare crops and fish; you might even rise to the ultimate rank: Named-Collector!

Best of all, you don’t journey alone. Your animal friend will come along for the ride! Strengthen your bond, customize her with accessories, unlock new interactions, and grow together as you venture onwards!

Features:

Farm: Cultivate your own farm on the deck of a ship, surrounded by the open sea!

 Discover: Sail across uncharted waters and forage on unseen islands!

Collect: Find rare crops and fish on your quest to fill in every page of the Collector’s Compendium!

Befriend: Forge a bond and customize your trusty animal friend who can lend a fin whenever needed!

Personalize: Craft useful items from foraged materials and transform your boat into your own home!
70010000115430.intro: Collector’s Cove is a cozy farming adventure on the high seas. Sail with your animal friend to uncharted waters, cultivate your floating farm, and discover new islands, crops and fish.
70010000115430.name: Collector's Cove

70010000115450.description:
Centipede Gun is a creature-building roguelite, where you create unusual beings by combining different shapes, modules, and... weapons!?
Try out insane combinations and try to break the game with the craziest creations! Each combination offers new possibilities to defeat enemies in increasingly challenging battles. After each round, use the money you earn to buy different units in the store and further strengthen your centipede of destruction. But be careful — as you evolve, enemies also become stronger, testing the limits of your creativity and strategy.

Assemble strange and powerful centipedes whose weapons automatically attack when enemies approach. Use special modules to add extra effects to your attacks and combine modules of the same type to evolve them, unlocking secret abilities as you reach new levels of power. Survive if you can and find out how far your centipede can go!
70010000115450.name: Centipede Gun

70010000115464.description:
[Pa!nt, a magical world where doodles come to life]

An ordinary notebook becomes the stage for a special adventure with your touch. Become the owner of 'Moony,' a small, cute octopus friend born from a drawing, and explore a puzzle world full of color and imagination!

■ Change the color and the answer appears! Strategic color puzzle

Moony can pass through the same color as itself, but cannot pass through different colors.

Use the surrounding water buckets to change Moony's color and feel the thrilling sensation of paving the way through blocked paths.

■ 60 rich stages and special gimmicks

60 diverse stages await your challenge.

More than 4 special devices that move Moony or change its color add depth to the puzzle.

■ Healing time to decorate your own notebook

As you clear stages, the monotonous home screen transforms into a splendid one!

Dress Moony in cute outfits with items acquired during gameplay to express your own personality.

■ The joy beyond limits

When you need a different challenge, try 'Black and White Mode,' which relies solely on silhouette and senses!
70010000115464.intro:
Changing colors opens the way!
Enjoy 60 colorful puzzles with the adorable Muni.
Clear stages and freely decorate your own notebook world!
70010000115464.name: Pa!nt

70010000115470.description:
Step into the Colosseum chained to your friends. Chained Beasts is a co-op gladiator roguelike for 1-4 players, combining brutal combat with teamwork and slapstick moments. Can you gather your friends, crush your enemies, win the crowd and gain your freedom?

Gladiatorial Combat
Slash and hack your enemies in this brutal gladiator roguelike or use the environment against them. Hurl an urn at your foes or hurl your foes at an urn. Charge them into a wall of spikes or a pit of snakes. Throw your weapons to take down enemies from a distance but be sure you have another at hand or you might find yourself in trouble.

Chained to Your Friends
Don’t struggle alone, gather four ferocious friends and you’ll be chained together in cruel and creative ways. If you can’t coordinate you’ll end up tangled around a pillar or worse but synchronize your efforts and you can trip your enemies and turn the tables.

Battle Brutal Bosses
As your fame rises you will battle brutal bosses, heroes of the arena, armed to the teeth with every advantage at their disposal. The deck will be stacked against you but victory will bring you one step closer to Rome and a chance at freedom or revenge.

Survive Ghastly Wounds
Each day in the arena leaves you with new wounds to add to your misery. Struggle on with a painful limp, try to get by with a missing left eye or flail madly at hallucinations only you can see. There are potions to relieve your pain but the side effects can leave you with worse afflictions, perhaps surgery is the answer…

Struggle Forges Character
Do not lose hope, experience in the arena can also forge you into a brutal fighter. Learn powerful skills to overcome your foes. Win the crowd and they will always have your back. Save up money and buy equipment and weapons that can turn the tide in battle. Unlock new characters with powerful abilities. Each run will require that you take a different path.
70010000115470.intro: Chained Beasts is a 1-4 player co-op gladiator roguelike. Fight chaotic battles chained to your friends. Use your chains or the arena to beat up foes in creative ways and survive the day.
70010000115470.name: Chained Beasts

70010000115471.description: Two puzzle game juggernauts collide as Tetris®, one of the largest-selling and recognized brands in gaming history, and Puyo Puyo™ from SEGA have combined to create a fun-to-play, fast-paced, competitive party game like no other!  The game offers tons of gameplay styles – from single-player Adventure and Challenge modes to ferocious competition with up-to-four player Arcade modes, for tons of Tetris/Puyo variety.
70010000115471.intro: Puyos and Tetriminos Collide in a Frantic Four-Player Puzzle Mashup!
70010000115471.name: Puyo Puyo™Tetris®

70010000115472.description:
"SPACE INVADERS" is a shooting game released by TAITO in 1978.
The origin of the masterpiece that once captivated all of Japan has finally arrived on Arcade Archives!
This title includes both the black-and-white and color versions, and the sound has been reproduced to the limit of how it sounded back then.
Experience the timeless legend once again!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.
70010000115472.name: Arcade Archives SPACE INVADERS

70010000115480.description:
Command your fleet and dominate the seas in Modern Naval Warfare: Sea Combat. Step into the role of a naval commander and engage in high-intensity maritime battles where modern technology, tactical planning, and firepower determine victory. Control advanced warships, deploy devastating weapons systems, and outsmart enemy fleets across strategic ocean zones.

Upgrade and customize your vessels with cutting-edge armaments, enhance your fleet’s capabilities, and execute precise combat maneuvers. Navigate vast and dangerous waters, adapt to evolving threats, and prove your dominance in modern naval warfare.

Main Features:
- Command modern warships, from missile destroyers to powerful aircraft carriers
- Experience tactical, technology-driven naval combat
- Upgrade weapons systems, defenses, and fleet performance
- Battle across dynamic sea environments and strategic combat zones

Every decision matters on the open sea — from strategic positioning to the moment you give the order to fire. Will you secure naval supremacy, or will your fleet be lost to the depths?
70010000115480.intro: Will your strategy survive the storm of modern naval warfare?
70010000115480.name: Modern Naval Warfare: Sea Combat

70010000115482.description:
Three legendary arcade titles from SEIBU KAIHATSU's Raiden Fighters series return, revived from the depths of time.

Choose between the Japanese version and a hardcore International version!

Enjoy convenient features like rapid-fire button configuration, Practice Mode, and a restart function.

Great for both first-time players and those returning to 2D shooting games after a long break!

The remix soundtrack includes 30 tracks drawn from the stage and boss music from each title.

Enjoy the music on the sound player, and assign music to each stage just as you like with a mode.

Customize the experience to your liking and discover a new world of Raiden Fighters!

Participating Artists: SOSHI HOSOI/KAZUHIRO TSURUKUBO/YUKI ARAI

Check out the wallpaper customization, an authentic arcade-style CRT filter, and Vertical Screen Mode (monitor rotation) that deliver a vivid sense of presence that goes beyond the arcade experience.

Play the reborn Raiden Fighters in its bold new form to your heart's content!

■ Contents (Choose between the Japanese/International Version)
RAIDEN FIGHTERS
RAIDEN FIGHTERS 2
RAIDEN FIGHTERS JET
70010000115482.intro: Three score-driven classics from the Raiden Fighters series return alongside modern features and remix music!
70010000115482.name: RAIDEN FIGHTERS REMIX COLLECTION

70010000115517.description:
Meet charming girls who dream of completing their collection of the cutest panties! Your task is to help them find the missing pairs by matching threes in cozy puzzles. Instead of the usual fruits or candies, you'll find elegant panties in a variety of colors, styles, and textures. Match three of them, solve increasingly challenging puzzles, and gradually unlock all the images of beautiful girls.
With each completed round, you gain access to new fragments, and then to full portraits that you can not only store but also creatively decorate. In the gallery, you can move, zoom, and choose the perfect angle, combining unlocked images with different backgrounds to create your own unique composition. All this is accompanied by gentle, relaxing music, turning the game into a meditative ritual of beauty and attention.

Features:
• Cute images of girls.
• Collect panties in different colors and styles.
• A variety of backgrounds to personalize your favorite images.
• Interactive gallery.
• Useful bonuses and boosters.
• Relaxing music that creates an atmosphere of comfort and intimacy.
• Gradually increasing puzzle difficulty.
70010000115517.name: Panty Match Girls

70010000115524.description:
Escape from Tarkan throws you into an isolated city shattered by conflict and abandoned by the world. Law has collapsed, rival factions fight for control, and danger lurks around every corner.

Move through ruined streets, collapsed buildings, and hazardous industrial zones in search of weapons, equipment, and vital supplies. Enemies are ruthless and unpredictable, forcing constant adaptation and split-second decisions. Advanced visual effects and immersive sound design heighten the oppressive atmosphere, turning Tarkan into a living urban nightmare.

Key Features:
- Vast Urban Environment: A large, open city filled with abandoned locations, alternative routes, and hidden threats.
- Weapons and Equipment: Discover and use essential gear scattered throughout the city.
- Rival Factions: Face intelligent enemies battling for dominance in a lawless zone.
- Tense, Realistic Atmosphere: Visual and audio design that amplifies every moment of danger.

Will you escape Tarkan, or will the city claim you? Every step could be your last.
70010000115524.intro: Ruthless enemies, ruined streets, and one chance to escape.
70010000115524.name: Escape from Tarkan

70010000115532.description:
Get ready for intergalactic barking and clever strategy in Collie Call: The Future Is Calling. Here, you control a robotic dog in outer space on a very unusual mission: organize floating sheep into air-bubble pastures before chaos takes over the galaxy.

Each stage is a smart puzzle where every push matters. Teleporters flash, buttons activate futuristic gates, and every move can mean the difference between a perfect solution or a sheep stuck in the wrong corner of the universe. Plan carefully, test routes, use undo without fear, and refine your strategy until everything clicks into place.

With 30 levels full of progressive challenges, charming sci-fi visuals, and accessible mechanics, Collie Call blends logic, cuteness, and technology into an engaging experience. It is the perfect puzzle for players who enjoy thinking calmly, experimenting with creative solutions, and celebrating that satisfying feeling of getting everything just right.

The future is calling. And it needs a good dog.
70010000115532.intro: Collie Call: Sheep Mission in Space
70010000115532.name: Collie Call: The Future Is Calling

70010000115549.description:
Game Description

“Looking for someone to run the boarding house once again!”

The FMV dating simulation [Five Hearts Under One Roof] returns with Season 2!
Step into the shoes of Yuman once again and run a love-filled boarding house alongside six charming heroines.

Season 2 brings back fan favorites Mal-sook, Gran, and Min-jung,
now joined by three new tenants, each with their own unique charm.

Experience heart-fluttering new stories and see how much the girls have grown.

In the end… who will stay by your side?


Character Introduction
Mal-sook Go / First Tenant / Childhood Friend of 20 Years
"From today on, he’s under my control!"

Perfect chemistry, unspoken understanding—Mal-sook is Yuman’s one and only friend.
In the 21 years they’ve known each other, there was nothing they didn’t share.
At least, until a few months ago.

Now, Mal-sook has a secret she can’t bring herself to tell Yuman.

Gran Dong / Second Tenant / Workplace Supervisor
"When we’re not at work, don’t call me 'Manager.' Use my name."

Even calling her a workaholic wouldn’t cut it. Gran is completely obsessed with her job.
To her, anything outside of work isn’t worth her time or thoughts.
But there's one exception: Yuman.

Watching him has become her unexpected source of enjoyment.

Yu-na Jeong / Third Tenant / Wealthy Heiress
"I came to take responsibility for you, Yuman. I always keep my word."

The youngest daughter of a powerful and successful conglomerate family.
She seems carefree, full of energy, and always ready to have fun—like she doesn’t have a worry in the world.
But at home, she’s seen as the clumsy, useless one.

And that “useless one” ends up causing real trouble.

Min-jung Park / Fourth Tenant / First Love
"I had nowhere else to go but here."

Once an unknown idol struggling for attention, Min-jung is now a national sweetheart.
Just when her career seemed to be at its peak, radiant and busier than ever,
another scandal threatens to bring her crashing down.

Right now, Yuman is the only person she can rely on.

Yoo-jung Yang / Last Tenant / Quiet Wallflower
"You're the first person who’s ever really seen me."

Yoo-jung does nothing but work—unless she’s eating or sleeping.
Because of bullying she went through in school, she finds it hard to face people.
She keeps putting off college, too, afraid of dealing with others.

But then, someone like Yuman comes into her life—a once-in-a-lifetime chance.

Gyu-ri Bang / Soon-to-Be Tenant (?) / Sweet Nurse
"Yuman, you’re a patient right now. A patient!"

With her warm personality and adorable looks, Gyu-ri is like an idol to the hospital patients.
Despite the demanding nature of her job, she gives her all with a strong sense of duty.
But one particular patient starts to feel... different.

Lately, Yuman keeps crossing her mind—not as a patient, but as a man.


Out of these six unique heroines, who will you fall in love with?

Or… will it be someone else entirely?
70010000115549.intro:
“Looking for someone to run the boarding house once again!”
The FMV dating simulation [Five Hearts Under One Roof] returns with Season 2!
70010000115549.name: Five Hearts Under One Roof 2

70010000115559.description:
Even in death, Kugayama Shiori takes her own life.
Maybe her next will finally be her last.
But no matter how many times she dies, her soul refuses to leave this world.

Maybe the answer lies in her lost memories.
Maybe there's a lingering attachment she's forgotten.

Other than her name, she remembers nothing.
Who was she?
Why did she die?

Together with you—the only living person who can still speak to her—
Shiori begins her search for her memories, and for the truth behind her death.
70010000115559.intro: Don't be shy, watch me die!
70010000115559.name: Kugayama Shiori's Death Diary

70010000115571.description:
Get ready for new friends, new challenges and lots of surprises in this expanded version of Super Mario Bros. Wonder for Nintendo Switch 2!

Every course contains its very own Wonder Flower – collect one, and anything can happen. From moving pipes to tilting terrain, singing Piranha Plants to stampeding Bulrushes, skydiving to space walks, you never know what’ll happen next. You might even transform into something totally new!

Lots of multiplayer fun awaits in this area of Bellabel Park! Visit the Local Multiplayer Plaza for enjoy 17 different co-operative and competitive attractions, where up to four people can play together – even via GameShare!

Alternatively, you can head to the Game Room Plaza and play with friends and family either online or via local wireless. Six different attractions await here, allowing up to 12 players to work together or compete for first place!
70010000115571.name: Super Mario Bros. Wonder – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Meetup in Bellabel Park

70010000115593.description:
The house is no longer peaceful — because you’re inside. In Evil Cat Simulator vs Granny, you become a mischievous and slightly evil cat determined to turn Granny’s quiet home into your personal playground. Explore every room, outsmart Granny, and unleash adorable chaos with no rules holding you back. Whether you prefer sneaky pranks or full-scale destruction, the house now belongs to you.

Features:
• Free exploration of Granny’s house, including hidden spots and high places
• Dozens of interactive objects to push, break, scratch, and knock over
• Stealth elements: hide under beds, behind doors, and escape when spotted
• Dynamic encounters with Granny throughout the house
• Multiple playstyles: relax, explore, prank, or create total disorder
• Light-hearted atmosphere mixed with playful rivalry

Evil Cat Simulator vs Granny is a fun and chaotic cat life adventure where freedom and instinct come first. Sneak, jump, scratch, and outsmart Granny as you transform her home into the ultimate feline playground. The world is in your paws — and mischief is only the beginning.
70010000115593.intro: Sneak through every room, outsmart Granny, and unleash true feline mischief.
70010000115593.name: Evil Cat Simulator vs Granny

70010000115605.description:
Collect puzzles with photorealistic images of girls in spectacular outfits, enjoy convenient touch controls and feel the process at your fingertips.

Relaxing music creates the right mood, and gradually increasing difficulty turns each level into an exciting challenge. After assembly, you can carefully examine each image and appreciate all the details.

Features:

• Photorealistic images.

• Gradually increasing difficulty.

• Relaxing music.

70010000115605.name: Hentai Balls 3D: Perfect Motion

70010000115612.description:
DAVE THE DIVER is a casual, single-player adventure RPG featuring deep-sea exploration and fishing during the day and sushi restaurant management at night. Join Dave and his quirky friends as they seek to uncover the secrets of the mysterious Blue Hole.

■ An adventure, RPG, management hybrid
Explore and unravel the mysteries in the depths of the Blue Hole by day and run a successful exotic sushi restaurant by night.
It’s easy to get hooked on the satisfying gameplay loop!

■Casual combat and gathering gameplay with rogue-like elements
Dive into the ever-changing Blue Hole and use a harpoon and other weapons to catch fish and various creatures.
Upgrade and forge equipment with collected resources and sushi restaurant profits to prepare for the dangers that lurk in the unknown.
Running out of oxygen means leaving collected items and fish behind!

■ Eccentric characters with a lighthearted narrative
Quirky but lovable characters and a story full of in-jokes, spoofs, and other humorous scenes provide an approachable and enjoyable gameplay experience.

■ A beautiful sea environment with attractive 2D/3D Art
A combination of pixel and 3D graphics provides a stunning art style that showcases breathtaking underwater scenery.
This oceanic adventure is set in the real marine environment of a Blue Hole filled with over 200 kinds of sea creatures.

■ Ample additional content to complement the main gameplay loop
Minigames, side quests, and multiple storylines provide many hours of entertainment and varied gameplay.
70010000115612.intro:
Dive by day! Serve by night!
The best diving, harpooning, action-adventuring, and sushi restaurant managing experience you'll ever have.
70010000115612.name: DAVE THE DIVER

70010000115629.description:
Enter the frontline in Counter Force, an action-packed tactical shooter where precision, leadership, and quick thinking decide every mission. As the commander of an elite counter-terror unit, you’ll face dangerous enemies, rescue civilians, and restore order in high-risk operations across hostile locations. Every move matters when failure is not an option.

Game Features:
- Elite Task Unit – Control a skilled strike team built for combat and special operations.
- Smart Tactical Play – Plan attacks, choose routes, and react to changing threats.
- Fast-Paced Gunfights – Engage enemies with realistic weapons and intense shooting action.
- Mission-Based Progression – Complete critical objectives to unlock new challenges and gear.
- Dynamic Battle Zones – Fight through urban areas, secured compounds, and danger-filled environments.
- High-Risk Operations – Stay alert as enemy reinforcements and unexpected events keep missions unpredictable.

The battlefield is waiting. Take command, execute with precision, and prove you have what it takes to lead Counter Force.
70010000115629.intro: Lead your team, fight with honor, and rise as a hero.
70010000115629.name: Counter Force

70010000115636.description:
Barrel down an endless, obstacle-packed lane as a bowling ball, scooping up ragdoll humans who cling on for dear life.
Dodge crushing hazards, spinning traps, and brutal obstacles designed to strip away your hard-earned human pile. The pace and pressure ramp up relentlessly, demanding sharp reactions and control.
At the end of each run, fire your collected humans like living projectiles, blasting them toward towering skittles. Take down as many as you can — especially the King Pin, the most valuable target on the lane.
70010000115636.name: Human Bowling: King Pin

70010000115665.description:
When Moomintroll unexpectedly wakes up early from his winter hibernation, he finds himself completely alone for the first time, in a world he barely recognizes. The familiar landscape of Moominvalley is now cloaked in the frosty veil of the Lady of the Cold. Initially seeking someone to care for him and longing to banish winter, young Moomintroll reluctantly embarks on a journey into the unknown, learning to forge new friendships and help those in greater need than himself.

- Wander through the beautiful landscape inspired by Nordic nature, exploring Moominvalley and the nearby forests and mountains.
- Meet many of Moomintroll’s old and new friends, and help them out by solving quests and puzzles.
- Re-imagine Tove Jansson’s Moominland Midwinter. A trove of nostalgia for fans of Moomin, and an approachable starting point for those experiencing this wonderful world for the first time.
70010000115665.intro: Experience a heartwarming new adventure inspired by the beloved Moomin stories by Tove Jansson.
70010000115665.name: Moomintroll: Winter's Warmth

70010000115724.description:
ENDLESS CYCLES, CEASELESS REBIRTH
Step into the shifting, treacherous realms as Red, the swordsman bound by her destiny. Wield the power of the Fox whilst confronting monstrous enemies and brutal bosses. Death is not the end; it's just a chance to redefine your destiny through cycles of death and rebirth. Take up your weapon and let your quest to escape the ever-changing realm of ink begin.

FIERCE BATTLES WITH INFINITE CREATIVITY
Experience infinite creativity. Dive into thrilling, fast-paced combat and invent a style that is uniquely yours.
- Mix and match dozens of different forms, weapons, and enhancements.
- With over 40 distinctive Ink Gems, every single run is a new opportunity.
- Unlock vast possibilities and enhance playstyles with over 200 artefacts
- Think you’ve mastered the realm? Prove it. Push your skill to the absolute limit in the Trial Valleys and earn high scores in the brutal Endless Challenge mode.

YOUR INK PET FIGHTS BY YOUR SIDE
Adorable yet deadly. Meet Momo: Your fiercely loyal companion. This mysterious Ink Pet fights tooth and claw alongside you every step of the way.
But the real magic happens when you combine Ink Gems: witness instant, explosive transformations! Experience the unique changes with over 15 unique, striking forms, each one granting access to utterly unique move sets. Which combination will become your favourite?

EXPLORE NEW REALMS
An Eastern fantasy world, painted in ink. Journey deep into stunning, diverse realms, from the vibrant, verdant forests to the hallowed, reverent ruins of the Mausoleum. Each environment is a breathtaking blend of classical Chinese ink-wash art and rich, vibrant colour palettes.
Draw your sword and venture into the unknown. Battle the enigmatic Realm Guardians to glimpse beyond the veil into their mysterious pasts. And prepare to face over 20 unique creatures, steeped in distinctive Chinese folklore and backstory, including the cunning Fox Demon, the elegant Peony Fairy and the elusive Mirror Sprite.
70010000115724.intro:
Ink binds fate.
Break the cycle.
Become the anomaly.
70010000115724.name: Realm of Ink

70010000115732.description:
There’s a mystery hidden behind this peaceful village, unknown to its inhabitants, who carry on with their daily lives.

Kejora features hand-drawn art and animation, environmental platformer puzzles, and party-based inspired gameplay with 2 supporting characters with unique skills to help Kejora in her exploration and journey.

Key Features:

◆Beautiful visuals: Immerse yourself in the story, accompanied by stunning, hand-drawn landscapes, characters, and animation.

◆Party-based inspired gameplay: Kejora is accompanied by her two friends on her journey, each with their own unique abilities to help Kejora overcome obstacles and puzzles.

◆Puzzle platformer adventure: Explore various hand-drawn environments, and with the help of Kejora and her friends, discover items that can help you, solve puzzles, and defeat enemies.
70010000115732.intro: When Kejora realizes that her village has been reliving the same day over, she and her friends seek out to try and uncover the origin of the mysterious time loop cursed on her village.
70010000115732.name: KEJORA

70010000115742.description:
Hollow Knight is a classically styled 2D action adventure across a vast interconnected world. Explore twisting caverns, ancient cities and deadly wastes; battle tainted creatures and befriend bizarre bugs; and solve ancient mysteries at the kingdom's heart.

Includes free content packs! All new quests, boss battles and secrets!
• Hidden Dreams: Mighty new foes emerge! New Boss fights. New Upgrades. New Music.
• The Grimm Troupe: Light the Nightmare Lantern. Summon the Troupe. New Major Quest. New Boss Fights. New Charms. New Enemies. New Friends.
• Lifeblood: New mapping tools. New Boss fight. Upgraded Bosses. New Music. Hidden Extras!
• Godmaster: Take your place amongst the Gods. New Characters and Quests. New Boss Fights. Hidden Surprises!

Game Features
• Classic side-scrolling action, with all the modern trimmings.
• Forge your own path! The world of Hallownest is expansive and open. Choose which paths you take, which enemies you face and find your own way forward.
• Evolve with powerful new skills and abilities! Gain spells, strength and speed. Leap to new heights on ethereal wings. Dash forward in a blazing flash. Blast foes with fiery Soul!
• Equip Charms! Ancient relics that offer bizarre new powers and abilities. Choose your favourites and make your journey unique!
• An enormous cast of cute and creepy characters all brought to life with traditional 2D frame-by-frame animation.
• Over 140 enemies! 30 epic bosses! Face ferocious beasts and vanquish ancient knights on your quest through the kingdom.
• Chart your journey with extensive mapping tools. Buy compasses, quills, maps and pins to enhance your understanding of Hollow Knight’s many twisting landscapes.
• A haunting, intimate score accompanies the player on their journey, composed by Christopher Larkin.
70010000115742.intro: Forge your own path in Hollow Knight! An epic action adventure through a vast, ruined kingdom of insects and heroes.
70010000115742.name: Hollow Knight
