70010000115803.description:
From the hero and enemies to the blocks, BGM, and sound effects—
everything in this game is made from the developer (me): live-action images and real voice.
A sanity-questioning 2D action platformer has arrived.

[WARNING] The claimed clear rate is 0.000000000000000001%.
We take no responsibility for any regret after purchase.

■ "All-Me" materials, in full madness
The player, attacking enemies, and even the platforms are all live-action images of the developer.
Jump sounds, damage sounds, and the BGM are also made entirely from the developer's "voice."
Enjoy the deranged artwork that shaves away your sanity the longer you play.

■ Unreasonably "ultra-high difficulty"
Gotcha traps, nasty enemy placements, and strict control precision.
It follows the classic die-and-learn style of old-school "die games."
Even the developer struggles to clear it—can you endure it?

■ Friendship-destroying "2-player co-op"
Supports local 2-player co-op by sharing a controller.
But it's not normal co-op.
If either player makes a mistake: instant game over—collective responsibility.
Shove each other off tiny platforms, fall, blame your partner… pure chaos.

Now—don't give up. Overcome "me."
70010000115803.intro:
Dev-made live-action everything
Brutal die-and-retry (0.00…1% clear)
2-player co-op: one mistake = game over for both
70010000115803.name: All Me Action Game

70010000115814.description:
You awaken on a strange island ruled by the enigmatic Lord Ambermaze. He has frozen time, turning the island into a trap where no one ages or dies, and bizarre creatures roam — twisted results of his magical experiments. Don’t be surprised if you encounter carnivorous plums, exploding pumpkins, or mutant wasps along the way!

THE GREAT GARDEN BATTLE
The entire island is one sprawling maze teeming with odd and dangerous creatures: stink-spiders, acidic slimes, fire moths, chomping hives — and that’s just the beginning.
But you’re not defenseless. Armed with a magical sword, a sturdy bow, a reliable shield, and most importantly — courage — your hero is ready to outwit and defeat every threat.
You’ll also need agility and sharp wits. Beyond the toothy and spiky monsters, the island is filled with traps and obstacles: bottomless pits, thorny bushes, spike traps, and more. You’ll have to use your brain to get past them.

FISHING AND OTHER ACTIVITIES
Even the boldest adventurer needs a break. Luckily, Lord Ambermaze is packed with mini-games and side activities.
Try your luck at shell games and hunt for treasure (just hope you pick the right chest — or risk singed eyebrows). Go fishing and you might catch a golden fish… or a golden coin… or a bomb. Depends on your luck.
Move ancient boulders in classic sokoban puzzles and try not to throw out your back. Solve color-matching puzzles, sliding tile challenges, and escape from rooms as dark as the belly of a mutant plum.

NEW FRIENDS AND ISLAND MYSTERIES
There’s more than just enemies on the island — you can find friends too. Meet charming ladies, each with her own backstory and personality. Give gifts and build a relationship with one (or all!) of them. After all, every hero deserves a loyal companion, right?

And it’s not just the ladies — the island is full of eccentric characters with stories to tell. Who is the stone golem and how did he end up like that? Why does the fisherman have so many clones, and what are they all trying to catch?
Play Lord Ambermaze and uncover every secret the island hides!
70010000115814.intro: Lord Ambermaze is a charming adventure where the world moves only when you do. Battle quirky foes, solve puzzles, and save your little sister by uncovering the dark lord’s secret.
70010000115814.name: Lord Ambermaze

70010000115828.description: It is a skill based game that tests your dexterity. All of the cubes movement is based on physics. You rotate the world by rotating the console. Game takes in account built in gyroscope and accelerometer of console to calculate rotation. There are many levels and obstacles, so every level is unique and challenging.
70010000115828.intro: Shake and rotate your console to guide cubes into portals while navigating challenging obstacles! 30 ready-to-play levels offer hours of fun and challenging gameplay!
70010000115828.name: Shake Cubes

70010000115837.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 30 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.
70010000115837.intro: Meet over 30 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000115837.name: Yabai Girls: Ballet Beauty

70010000115841.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 30 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.
70010000115841.intro: Meet over 30 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000115841.name: Yabai Girls: Valentine Babe

70010000115845.description: Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 30 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.
70010000115845.intro: Meet over 30 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!
70010000115845.name: Yabai Girls: Fairy Love

70010000115880.description:
Laysara: Summit Kingdom is a challenging city builder which tasks you with creating a new home for your people forced out of the lowlands. During a campaign or sandbox playthrough, you will establish multiple towns, each on a unique mountain with its own traits. All your towns co-exist in symbiosis, creating a trading network, which you can then adjust to your needs by revisiting already developed settlements. The Kingdom of Laysara has to be rebuilt!

BUILD ON A MOUNTAIN
Each mountain comes with a new set of challenges. Mounts differ in shapes, vegetation zone layouts, resource availability and weather conditions. Sometimes you will have plenty of room for farming in green lowlands, sometimes you will need to rely on breeding and extracting valuable minerals from regions dangerously close to peak glaciers. If you find yourself in dire need of a certain resource, you can always try to establish a trading route with another town.

DEAL WITH AVALANCHES
One of the ever-present dangers you will have to deal with are mighty avalanches. You can’t stop them, but you can take precautions and be prepared. Afforest the key areas to create natural barriers, build artificial ones to redirect rushing masses of snow, or trigger the avalanche early, while it’s still manageable. Create a deliberate and reliable strategy and you might even be able to use the power of snow to your advantage; fail to do so and find your city buried and devastated!

CRAFT A TRANSPORT NETWORK
So, transporting goods is easy, right? Well, not if your destination lies on the other side of the mountain, a few hundred meters higher, behind cliffs, ridges, canyons and rivers. You will need to create a vast, complex transport network consisting of roads, bridges and shafts to ensure reliable delivery chains. As demand for resources will grow alongside the town’s population, always look for opportunities to optimise your transportation network, be it by building paved roads, using more advanced lifting constructions, or aiding your carriers with glamorous yaks.

RAISE A SUMMIT TEMPLE
If you manage to endure all mountain dangers, build a network of efficient production chains and satisfy all needs of your people, there is only one more thing to be done: conquering the mountain peak! To succeed in this great endeavour you’ll need to reach the summit and establish safe routes for your carriers to bring in enormous amounts of building resources, but beware! Weather at this height is as deadly as ever. The final effect is well worth the effort though, as raising the summit temple is an act of total triumph of human courage (and your logistics skills!) over the elements.

Final note: the game is a pure city building experience solely focused on the economy, resource management and surviving despite the inhospitable environment. Therefore, the game doesn’t feature combat or any other military aspects.
70010000115880.intro: Build and expand your very own settlements in high mountains!
70010000115880.name: Laysara: Summit Kingdom

70010000115903.description:
You find yourself trapped in the endless maze of the Backrooms — but you’re not alone. Somewhere in the humming corridors, something strange waddles in the dark. A duck…

What begins as a simple search for an exit quickly turns into a survival chase. Sometimes you hear soft footsteps… sometimes a quiet squeak right behind you.
The deeper you go, the weirder it gets: distorted rooms, looping hallways, impossible spaces, and the unsettling presence of the duck that always seems one step closer.

Stay alert, navigate the shifting rooms, and outsmart the creature hunting you.
Run when you must. Hide when you can.
And whatever you do, don’t look back when you hear the squeak.
70010000115903.intro: Don't follow the squeak — it follows you.
70010000115903.name: Backrooms: Duck Escape

70010000115914.description:
You awaken in a flooded maze.
Water clings to every step making escape feel hopeless from the start.
With each turn, instinct takes control.
Movement is no longer a choice — it’s survival.
There’s no time to hesitate, nowhere to hide, and with no certainty about what awaits beyond the next corner.
One rule defines everything now:
Keep running. Never turn back.
And above all — never let the Duck reach you.
70010000115914.intro: Run fast… the Duck is already around here.
70010000115914.name: Run from Duck

70010000115940.description:
Control the flow of time to solve subtle platform puzzles in this update of the indie classic "Braid," featuring refreshed artwork and seriously in-depth creator commentary.  Travel from a city house through a series of interconnected worlds where time behaves strangely, searching for an elusive Princess. Along the way you'll explore memories and regrets that still haunt you. This Anniversary Edition remaster of the award-winning platformer contains fully repainted high-resolution graphics, new sound effects and extensive audio commentary.

MANIPULATE TIME TO MOVE FORWARD
Rewind, pause and use the strange properties of time in each world to run and jump through beautifully painted environments. Avoid hazards, unlock doors and collect jigsaw puzzle pieces to assemble. If you get hung up on a particular puzzle, feel free to move on and return later.

A FRESH COAT OF PAINT
This is the game you remember, with all the original challenges and the same haunting, evocative score — but repainted pixel by pixel so that each carefully rendered world comes to life in high resolution. New visual details, animated brushstroke effects and revamped sounds add to the immersive experience.

GO (DEEP) BEHIND THE SCENES
Explore the most extensive developer commentary ever put into a game, with over 12 hours of recorded insight and conversation from developer Jonathan Blow, artist David Hellman and more members of the "Braid" creative team. Navigate it by visiting a new in-game world, which also contains new puzzles and redesigns of classic puzzles.  - Created by Thekla, Inc.
70010000115940.intro: Control the flow of time to solve puzzles in this new version of the indie classic, featuring fully repainted artwork, a new world of puzzles, and seriously in-depth commentary.
70010000115940.name: Braid, Anniversary Edition

70010000115946.description:
Sudoku is a simple and clear number-puzzle game.
The goal is easy to understand: fill the grid so each row, column, and 3×3 box contains the numbers 1 to 9 with no repeats. No math required, just logic.

Playing Sudoku helps improve focus, memory, and problem-solving skills in a calm and enjoyable way. It’s a quick mental exercise that keeps the brain active and sharp.

This version includes a wide variety of color themes, allowing you to play in the style that feels most comfortable for your eyes.

Easy to learn, relaxing to play, and beneficial for your cognitive health.
70010000115946.name: Sudoku

70010000115955.description:
Within these walls, your fate rests in the hands of luck. Overpowered 2 - Crux of Fate is a survival shooter where you’ll have to surround yourself with the most powerful weapons you can find in order to fend off relentless waves of enemy monsters! But as you will soon discover, in this arena your luck increases with each failed attempt, and your determination will ultimately be rewarded!

Enter a dark arena where everything is out to kill you. The action ensues in top-down retro pixel art style where you control a lone human combatant, strategically navigating in every direction and around columns to keep incoming enemy hordes at a safe distance, but still within striking range. Start by selecting a single weapon, then pick up experience drops to level up and improve gear or choose additional armaments. Collect hearts to recover health, gain temporary speed boosts and more! How long can you hang on?

• Run from enemy hordes while keeping them within range of your selected weaponry!
• Pick up experience boosts from fallen foes and level up on the fly.
• Add new weapons to your growing arsenal, each with unique attacks and effects!
• Focus on strategic movement while your weapons automatically strike nearby enemy monsters.
• Survive 20 menacing waves and escape the arena.
• Increase your luck with each failed attempt, gradually creeping towards your goal with determination!
70010000115955.intro: Press your luck to its absolute limits as you fight for survival in a deadly monster arena!
70010000115955.name: Overpowered 2 - Crux of Fate

70010000115970.description:
Run a convenience store solo in this frantic action game!
Dash around the store handling tasks while customers keep pouring in!
Feel the exhilaration of handling one task after another!

Rush around during peak busy hours!
Time is limited, so think fast and prioritize as you move around the store!
Complete every task, and you just might become a true solo shift master!

[The Work Never Ends!]
Operate the cash register, restock shelves, cook with the fryer, clean, and collect items.
Work efficiently to stay on top of it all!

[Decision-Making is Key!]
Good planning and prioritization make all the difference!
Assess the situation before you act!

[A Different Store Every Stage]
Each stage features a different store layout!
Adapt your strategy to match!

[Score Attack]
Earn stars based on your performance!
Work at maximum efficiency and aim for a perfect 3-star rating!

[2-Player Mode]
Play co-op as a worker and support robot team!
Split up tasks and work together strategically!
70010000115970.intro:
From cash register to fryer—you've got to manage it all!
Take on waves of customers all by yourself!
70010000115970.name: Solo Shift!

70010000115976.description:
Offroad Rally Racing is a fast-paced console racing game where you drive powerful rally cars across clearly marked tracks in different weather conditions, including sunny, rainy, and night races. Each track offers a unique challenge, forcing you to adapt your driving to changing visibility and road grip.

Win races to earn cash, which you can use to unlock and purchase new rally cars. Every victory brings you closer to building a stronger garage and taking on tougher tracks.

With easy-to-learn controls and exciting offroad action, Offroad Rally Racing delivers simple, fun racing focused on skill, speed, and progression.
70010000115976.intro: Rally through sun, rain, and night.
70010000115976.name: Offroad Rally Racing

70010000115998.description:
Command your warriors and stop the orcs and villains from raiding your stronghold. With 100 action-packed levels, 11 unique defensive forces, 3 powerful abilities, and an engaging power-up system, your castle stands ready for the ultimate battle!

Key Features:

Dynamic Battle Mechanics: Engage in strategic, turn-based combat with immersive gameplay.
11 Unique Defenders: Command a variety of fictional warriors, monsters, and magical units.
Castle Customization: Decorate your fortress with flags, elements, 2 castle skins, and 3 unique weapons.
100 Exciting Levels: Progress through a full campaign of increasingly challenging stages.
Achievements & Rewards: Unlock achievements and spin the fortune wheel for powerful bonuses.
Avatar Personalization: Customize your player name and avatar for a unique experience.
Powerful Abilities: Equip 3 distinct abilities per hero and master 4 special powers for combat dominance.
70010000115998.intro: Defend your castle across 100 thrilling levels! Command unique warriors, use powerful abilities, and stop the orcs.
70010000115998.name: Knight Castle Defender

70010000116017.description:
Only Tung Tung Sahur UP is a chaotic climbing game where your only real enemy is gravity… and your own confidence.

Jump on random objects, weird platforms and totally questionable constructions while trying to reach the very top. Sounds easy? One bad jump — and you’re back down.

This is not a calm journey.
This is a loud addictive climb full of fails, laughs and unexpected moments.

No mercy.
Only Tung Tung.
70010000116017.intro: Up, up, and never give up!
70010000116017.name: Only Tung Tung Sahur UP

70010000116018.description:
SOMA is a horror and science fiction video game from Frictional Games. It is a haunting story about identity, consciousness and what it means to be human.

The radio doesn't work, food is scarce and machines have begun to believe they are people. The submerged PATHOS-II facility has suffered terrible isolation and difficult decisions will have to be made. What to do? What makes sense? What is left to fight for?

Enter the world of SOMA and confront the horrors submerged in the depths of the ocean. Rummage through locked terminals and secret documents to uncover the truth behind the chaos. Search for the last inhabitants and take part in the events that will ultimately shape the fate of the station. But beware, danger lurks around every corner: corrupt humans, twisted creatures, mad robots and even an inscrutable and omnipresent A.I..
You'll need to figure out how to deal with each one. Just remember there's no turning back, either you defeat your enemies or get ready to run.
70010000116018.intro: A masterpiece of psychological horror. Fight to survive in a hostile world that will make you question your own existence.
70010000116018.name: SOMA

70010000116030.description:
Welcome to a place where reality breaks and memes take control.
BOMBARDINO CROCODILO vs TUNG TUNG SAHUR is a chaotic meme game where you play as BOMBARDINO CROCODILO and try to survive in a world full of absurd danger.
Your goal is simple — keep dodging and stay alive while TUNG TUNG SAHUR suddenly appears ahead, turning every moment into a test of reflexes and nerve.
A strange world.
Only BOMBARDINO CROCODILO can escape the chaos.
Nothing here plays fair — especially Tung.
70010000116030.intro: Dodge the meme. Survive the chaos!
70010000116030.name: BOMBARDINO CROCODILO vs TUNG TUNG SAHUR

70010000116037.description:
Love food truck cooking games? Get ready to unleash your inner chef with Food Truck Chef! Join Emily on a global culinary journey, preparing mouthwatering recipes from tacos and sushi to pizza and beyond!

Food Truck Chef is an exciting, fast-paced cooking and management game where your culinary dreams come to life on wheels! Start with a humble food truck where you'll prepare meals, satisfy customers, and work your way up to transform it into the ultimate foodie hotspot!

Master the kitchen
Upgrade your food truck, serve hungry customers, and become a top chef! Time management is key as you cook, serve, and manage your way to success.

Explore the world
Discover 19+ exciting locations, each with unique dishes to master. From the bustling food streets of Asia to the vibrant flavors of Mexico, there's always a new kitchen challenge to tackle.

Key features
• Endless fun: Hundreds of levels, dishes, and upgrades to keep you entertained.
• Addictive gameplay: Easy to learn, with fast-paced cooking game mechanics.
• Colorful visuals: Enjoy lively, engaging art that brings each food truck scene to life.
70010000116037.intro: Manage and build your Food Truck! Cook global dishes, upgrade your kitchen, and serve hungry customers in this fast-paced cooking game
70010000116037.name: Food Truck Chef - Full Course Edition

70010000116043.description:
Fix & Flip Dream House is interior renovation and design simulator. Step into the shoes of a professional decorator: purchase old properties, clear out the clutter, and transform them into stylish, modern living spaces. Your goal is to completely reinvent the interior by selecting finishing materials, furniture from an extensive catalog. Painting walls, laying floors, and arranging furniture — every decision you make directly impacts the final value of the home.

Key features:

- Full Renovation Cycle: Buy abandoned properties, demolish old partitions, and completely transform the look of the premises.

- Interior Design and Finishing: A vast catalog of materials and furniture allows you to paint walls, hang wallpaper, and arrange elements to your taste.

- A Jack of All Trades: Use and upgrade arsenal of tools to speed up your workflow.
70010000116043.name: Fix & Flip Dream House

70010000116048.description:
Agatha Hastings came to Silver Peaks for a peaceful getaway, but instead, she walked into a nightmare.
When Victor Marchand, a wealthy businessman, is found dead in his room, panic spreads through the secluded ski resort.
A brutal snowstorm has buried all roads under deep drifts of snow, sealing the guests inside.
No one can leave. No one can arrive. And the killer is among them.

Search through 140 immersive clutter puzzles, hunting for hidden objects in chaotic scenes.
For the most patient and observant players, 20 additional puzzle challenges await, testing your wit and attention to detail.
But be warned—every clue you uncover brings you closer to the truth… and closer to the danger lurking in the shadows.

In Mirrors of Deception: The Silver Peaks Secret, nothing is as it seems.
Can you solve the mystery before the killer strikes again... or will you be next?
70010000116048.intro: Step into a world of mystery and deception as you unravel the truth behind Marchand’s murder.
70010000116048.name: Mirrors Of Deception: The Silver Peaks Secret

70010000116054.description:
Duck Battle Royale is a chaotic battle royale where the fiercest competitors are ducks. Enter a world full of quirky quacks, encounters, and unpredictable chaos.
Every match is a test of timing, strategy, and sheer luck as you face off against feathered foes. Expect the unexpected, embrace the silliness, and dive into a wildly entertaining showdown.
Will you outsmart your opponents and rise to the top?
The battlefield waits — and only one will claim victory.
70010000116054.name: Duck Battle Royale

70010000116071.description:
Step into the arena of Minos Trials, a 2D puzzle-platformer where brute strength and sharp thinking go hand in hand. Control Minos, a not-so-patient minotaur who solves problems with punches, pushing blocks, filling pits, activating pressure plates, and crushing nosy adventurers who insist on stealing his treasure.

Across 30 fast-paced stages set in elegant gardens and bubbling lava chambers, your goal is always clear: grab the chest, find the key, and open the Stairway Door. Use springs and geysers to reach impossible places, create clever shortcuts, and craft efficient solutions that deliver that satisfying “solved in one go” feeling.

With clean readability, instant restart, and smart challenges without punishment, Minos Trials is perfect for players who love sharp puzzles, optimized routes, and the joy of mastering each level with style. Think fast, hit hard, and prove that no one enters Minos’ labyrinth without permission.
70010000116071.name: Minos Trials

70010000116083.description:
Get ready for a relaxing and charming puzzle where every move matters and every solution brings that satisfying sense of accomplishment. You take control of a dedicated farmer pig on a mission to organize carrots and radishes into their correct planting spots.

Inspired by classic logic games, it transforms simplicity into a clever challenge. Push, test paths, undo mistakes when needed, and discover the best way to organize each scenario without pressure or time limits.

Explore two delightful environments, the Farm and the Greenhouse, each with unique obstacles that require planning and strategy. With 30 carefully designed levels, the game offers short and satisfying challenges, perfect for players who enjoy calm thinking and creative problem solving.

Plan each move, refine your strategy, and enjoy the moment when everything falls perfectly into place.
70010000116083.name: Piggy's Farm

70010000116089.description:
Get your brain ready and sharpen your curiosity in Do You Really Know?, a charming quiz game where every correct answer is a step toward the top of the Owls’ Tower of Knowledge. It starts easy, but don’t be fooled. The higher you climb, the tougher the questions become.

With each streak of correct answers, you advance through the tower’s floors and earn points to exchange for helpful power-ups. They give you that extra push when challenges get tricky and can make all the difference at critical moments. Made a mistake? No problem. You return to the preparation area, take a breath, and try again, now a little wiser.

With cute visuals, a relaxed atmosphere, and questions that test general knowledge without pressure, Do You Really Know? is perfect for players who enjoy smart quizzes, quick sessions, and the satisfying feeling of learning while playing.
70010000116089.intro: Do You Really Know? Climb the Tower of Knowledge
70010000116089.name: Do You Really Know?

70010000116090.description:
Could you escape from The Lab?

The Lab is an Escape Room where you have to make your way through intelligence and lateral thinking. You will solve a huge amount of puzzles while you discover an interesting story and move around a facility full of sci-fi equipment. Search for clues, find objects and secrets and keep a cool head, because only then you will be able to get out alive from The Lab.

Features
- Dozens of puzzles that will challenge your mind
- Large complex with different themed rooms
- A story that will keep you hooked
- From escape room lovers to escape room lovers
70010000116090.intro: Walk through a futuristic complex while solving puzzles and discover how you got there. What are these mysterious creatures? Why everything looks abandoned?
70010000116090.name: The Lab - Escape Room

70010000116100.description:
Manage an Adventure Park
 Build all kinds of facilities, such as weapon shops, general stores, and tailor shops, then assign the right Pupus to run them. The harder the heroes “adventure” in your park, the more resources you earn, allowing you to keep expanding your very own adventure park.

Raise the Pupu Clan
 As your park continues to grow, you’ll need more reliable workers. Breed new Pupus through the Spring of Life, build homes for them, and make cookies and cakes to keep them fed—yes, they absolutely love sweets! Of course, you’ll also need to take care of their little moods from time to time.

Unlock Facilities and Blueprints
 From basic shops to special NPCs like bards, merchants, and bounty hunters, keep unlocking blueprints to expand what your park can do. As construction goes on, you may even stumble upon the surprising story hidden behind this adventure park.

Post Adventure Commissions
 Post all kinds of tasks on the commission board to attract different types of heroes. Design your tasks wisely to maximize park revenue and obtain key resources such as rare items and hero essence, which can be used to upgrade and expand your park.
70010000116100.intro: Run a fantasy theme park where heroes get to play adventurer!
70010000116100.name: PUPU's Adventure Park

70010000116125.description:
"PLUMP POP" is an action game released by TAITO in 1987.
The protagonists are a family of PLUMP ANIMALS. The parents control a trampoline to launch their child into the air and defeat enemies above.
With two-player simultaneous play, it’s a fun experience where two families work together to clear the stages!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.
70010000116125.intro: Let's all work together as a family!
70010000116125.name: Arcade Archives PLUMP POP

70010000116139.description:
Embark on an unforgettable adventure with LumenTale: Memories of Trey, a captivating Monster Collector RPG set in a beautiful and enchanting world.
Discover an emotional tale of self-discovery, adventure through captivating regions each as unique as their people. Join Trey as he navigates his way through a land full of mystical creatures to reveal the mystery behind his lost memories.

STORY
Long ago, in the golden era of Talea, the Emperor kept the lands peaceful, and the people prospered. After passing away without naming a successor between his twin sons, a civil war raged between the North, Logos and the South, Mythos - fighting for who would take control of the throne. The townsfolk lived in fear from the atrocities being carried out in the conflict. In a bid to stop the destruction, a part of the empire’s military became Talea’s dedicated protectors.
From the everlasting darkness of war, these people were the beacon of light that brought people hope. The Lumen were born, and as guardians in their provinces, they ensure the safety of the residents of Talea, both the people and the Animon.

Since ancient times, people have long studied the Animon. Not much is known of their nature to this day. They’re made of Anivis, an energy that flows through the whole world, and they possess the ability to affect emotions and interact with the very soul of every living being. Catch the Animon and become inseparable partners as you harness their elemental powers and battle alongside each other with your Holoken.

Catching Animon
Test your skills with the Holoken and catch Animon in the field to recruit them to your party or initiate an incredible and exciting battle against them to prove your mettle! Every Animon can perform their own abilities and skills, and victory is achieved through using the best strategy with your team. There are around 140 known species with 13 elemental types, which are categorized with attributes depending on the emotion they're able to evoke in people.

Battles
Engage in thrilling 1v1 duels or team up for epic 4v4 showdowns with your party in battle. Level up your Animons and outsmart your opponents by using the best strategy to win.  Each Animon has strengths and weaknesses for you to uncover, so use them to your advantage.

Trading
With up to 3 different ways to trade your Animon, you can effortlessly  complete your collection and build the perfect battle team. Connect to the Animon Trade Station to seek the Animon you need, trade directly with friends, or the community.

Cook and craft
While on your adventure, be sure to take a rest at the Fountain, where you’ll be able to craft useful items and cook delicious food! If you’re feeling adventurous, you’ll be able to experiment with ingredients to help nurture your Animon.

The Anispace
The Anispace is a place that exists and doesn’t exist at the same time. A space detached from the world as we know it. Here is where you’ll find your Animon after you capture them and where you’ll be able to train your Animon for battle. Customise their space when they’re not in your battle party and create stronger bonds with them!
70010000116139.intro: Join Trey on an adventure to regain his lost memories and uncover the lost secrets in the land of Talea!
70010000116139.name: LumenTale: Memories of Trey

70010000116146.description:
Take control of a small stray kitten and begin an adventure through a vast abandoned factory filled with hidden pathways, towering structures, and forgotten corners. What appears to be an empty industrial complex soon reveals itself as a giant playground where curiosity and agility are the keys to progress.

Explore rooftops, containers, warehouses, offices, and maintenance areas as you search for food and collectible figurines scattered throughout the environment. Climb, jump, and navigate challenging obstacles while uncovering secrets hidden across twenty unique levels. Every area offers new discoveries and rewards for those willing to venture off the beaten path.

Features:
• Explore a large factory filled with secrets, hidden paths, and unique locations
• Run, jump, and climb across industrial structures and platforming challenges
• Collect food and rare figurines throughout twenty exciting levels
• Use your meow and bring extra personality to your adventure
• Unlock new fur colors and customize the appearance of your kitten
• Discover hidden collectibles, shortcuts, and rewards as you explore

Can you uncover every secret hidden within the factory and complete the journey of a tiny stray cat?
70010000116146.intro: Jump, climb, and explore a world full of hidden surprises.
70010000116146.name: TINNY STRAYS

70010000116151.description:
Agatha Hastings thought she was leaving the chaos behind when she accepted an invitation to the Thompson estate.
But the moment she stepped through the door, that illusion shattered, she'd walked right into a murder investigation.

Behind every polite conversation lurked suspicion. Inheritance, old grudges, secrets kept for generations—none of it added up. And Agatha couldn't ignore the feeling that someone was lying.

As she digs deeper into the family's tangled history, it becomes clear that Charles Thompson didn't die by chance.
The truth is buried in cluttered rooms and overlooked details, in strained glances and half-spoken words.
Across 140 immersive clutter levels and 20 bonus puzzle challenges, every hidden object you uncover pulls you further into a mystery that refuses to stay hidden.
Solving the case will take patience, sharp eyes, and a willingness to question everything—and everyone.

- Unravel a chilling murder mystery in the Thompson mansion!
- 140 thrilling "clutter" puzzles to challenge your mind!
- Exclusive bonus: 20 extra puzzles for keen detectives!
- Enjoy relaxing sounds and music masterpieces!
- Every clue brings you closer to the truth... or danger!
70010000116151.intro: Another murder mystery investigated by Agatha Hastings!
70010000116151.name: Mirrors Of Deception: The Poisoned Legacy

70010000116165.description:
Oh no! That sneaky Grabbo has stolen all of Mister Chickums' precious eggs! This misdeed cannot remain unpunished: Get out there and help the poor chick to regain his rightful property and give the culprit a well-deserved spanking!

And if you ever get stuck, invite your best friend to play the role of Fritz, Mister Chickums' BFF, to assist you in the hunt for the lost eggs!

CLASSIC ARCADE ACTION!
Go! Go! Mister Chickums is a fun, classic single-screen platformer, inspired by arcade hits of the 80s. The game can be played either in single player mode, or in local couch co-op with 2 players simultaneously.

SO MUCH TO DO, SO LITTLE TIME!
Jump and run through 100 lovingly designed screens and collect the stolen eggs before the clock runs out. Collect countless bonus items and take advantage of a variety of secret bonus mechanics to ensure you always have enough extra lives up your sleeve. Finish off the numerous enemies with their very own challenges and tactics and then kick the evil Grabbo's bottom to save the day!

QUITE SOME FEATURES FOR SUCH A SMALL CHICK!
- Hours of fun in solo or two-player couch coop mode
- 100 challenging levels, each with a unique design
- A large variety of different enemies with unique behaviours
- Countless secret bonus mechanics
- Vibration feedback support
…and an amazing original soundtrack by Zane Little!
70010000116165.name: Go! Go! Mister Chickums

70010000116171.description:
The objective is to collect the crystals located on the stage by utilizing jumps and dashes.
The stage is a 3D space with height, width, and depth. There is gravity, and the player controls their character by moving forward, backward, left, and right, and jumping to move vertically, aiming for the crystals.

Features
• Collect the crystal to clear the stage!
• 30 stages in total!
• Difficulty levels can be selected; Normal mode is relatively easy to clear, while Hard mode is extremely difficult.
• Collect coins to make crystals appear!
• Up to 4 players can play in split-screen mode!
• Use items to power up your abilities!
• Defeat enemies!
• There is a sword as a weapon!
• Use dodge actions to move around!
• Defend with a shield.

Multiplayer
• Cooperate with everyone to collect coins!
• Cooperate with everyone to defeat enemies!
• Be the first to get the crystal!
70010000116171.intro:
Get the crystals!!
Play in split-screen multiplayer with 1-4 players!
30 stages! Normal and Hard difficulty!
70010000116171.name: CRYZON part3

70010000116181.description:
Cards Lie is a single-player social deduction experience inspired by timeless games of bluff and betrayal — reimagined in a gothic, Burton-esque world. Each card represents a villager or a demon. Flip, listen, and judge who tells the truth… or who’s leading you straight to hell.

Features

• • 75 beautifully hand made illustrated cards — villagers, demons, and mysterious clues.


• • Procedural scenarios — no two rituals are the same.

• • Lies that evolve — demons adapt their deceit every round.

• • Stylized art direction — gothic charm and medieval engravings.

• • Atmospheric soundtrack — haunting choirs and dark ambient tones.

• • Easy to learn, hard to master — uncover patterns, analyze logic, and trust your instincts.



Gameplay Loop

1. → Gather your village.

2. → Flip a card and reveal a phrase — truth or lie.

3. → Use logic and intuition to eliminate the demons.

4. → One mistake… and the village falls to darkness.

“Not every smile is innocent.”

Will you see through the lies?
70010000116181.intro: Unmask the demons. Trust no one. You’ve gathered the entire village for a midnight ritual. Among them hide creatures of pure evil — demons disguised as villagers.
70010000116181.name: Cards lie

70010000116185.description:
Command the last ship against relentless waves of zombies in a mystical world. Build turrets, lead your crew, upgrade the ship, explore, gather resources and discover powerful artifacts.

The Horde
Fight the zombie hordes filled with the mundane, the abnormal, and the dangerous. The longer you survive, the stronger and more numerous the zombies become. But the loot and artifacts also become stronger and more numerous.

Turrets!
Loot resources to construct various powerful turrets. Choose your upgrade path, combine turret effects and create your own zombie death machine.

Build your Ship
Plow your way through a sea of zombies by equipping and upgrading ship parts and turrets. Collect and unlock powerful upgrades that drastically alter the way you survive.

Command your crew
Manage, rescue, and hire crew members with unique skills and abilities. Every role is important for the survival of the ship and assigning the right crew member with the right talents is key to survival.

Discover the world
Keep each run fresh and exciting by exploring mysterious ruins and discovering powerful artifacts and loot. Combine their effects and the more artifacts you find, the more combinations and strategies become open to you.
70010000116185.intro: Build turrets, lead your crew, and upgrade the ship while gathering loot in this exciting "Tower Defense-on-wheels zombie survival roguelite" game.
70010000116185.name: Zombie Rollerz: The Last Ship

70010000116186.description:
A heroine who has lost everything faces tragedy and discovers her way of life in a magical and suspense-filled Otome game.

[Main Cast]
Olivier Paquet (CV: Okitsu Kazuyuki)
Emmanuel de Beaumont (CV: Umehara Yuuichirou)
Melodie (CV: Suzuki Tatsuhisa)
Ismail (CV: Yamoto Souma)

[Story]
It is an era shrouded in darkness — the world sealed off, and a deadly plague ravaging the land. A peaceful village is ruthlessly attacked by a knightly order, leaving your home in ruins and your family slain.

Saved by a mysterious figure, you are led to a magical city floating upon the sea. There, the stranger proclaims you to be the Moon Witch, destined to guide the people toward prosperity. But amidst your newfound safety and status, turmoil begins to brew. Friends turn on one another, alliances falter, and blades begin to clash.

You wish to end this tragedy. To take root in this land and live on. Who will you trust...? Who will you choose to face the end with?
70010000116186.name: Volontés

70010000116199.description:
"COMBAT SCHOOL" is an action game released by KONAMI in 1987.
Join a prestigious military academy as a cadet and tackle brutal training like shooting and combat under a terrifying instructor.
Only those who survive these trials to claim the glory of graduation can face the next battle as a hero. Well, can you make it to the end?!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.
70010000116199.name: Arcade Archives COMBAT SCHOOL

70010000116216.description:
"FINAL LAP" is a racing game released by NAMCO LIMITED (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1987.
1987 marked the dawn of the F1 boom in Japan. Set against the backdrop of that era, this title portrays the raw power of racing machines and the stoic world of professional competition.
Experience nail-biting, high-speed battles set on the legendary circuit as it was back then. Push yourself to the absolute limit where every tenth of a second counts—and give it everything you've got!

Note: This title is for single-player only. References to "通信機能搭載(Multi-Player Linkage)" shown during the game are included as a visual element to faithfully recreate the atmosphere of the original arcade version.

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.
70010000116216.intro: Bet everything on the final lap!
70010000116216.name: Arcade Archives FINAL LAP

70010000116218.description:
The world has been rewritten, and the very name of "Hero" erased from memory. Once, three brave warriors defeated the Demon King and brought peace to the land—but now their deeds are lost to time. Lunette, the only one who remembers the true history, sets out on a journey to restore it by summoning the forgotten souls of heroes and reclaiming the light once stolen from the world.

Experience a full-fledged fantasy JRPG filled with classic turn-based battles, dungeon exploration, and strategic party building. Form teams of up to five heroes, combining unique traits and skills to create powerful synergies. Strengthen your allies through training, gear up at shops, and master the art of command battles where every move counts. With features like high-speed combat, dungeon escape spells, and smooth progression, enjoy an adventure that blends nostalgic JRPG charm with modern convenience.
70010000116218.intro: Restore the lost history in a summoning fantasy RPG!
70010000116218.name: Hero Seekers

70010000116239.description:
East Prussia, 1944. Behind concrete, barbed wire and heavily armed security rings lies one of the most dangerous places of the Second World War: the Wolf’s Lair – the sealed-off power centre of the Nazi leadership.

As an elite soldier, you fight through heavily guarded facilities, defensive positions and bunkers. Every advance is brutal, direct and fast-paced. Short, hard firefights await you, where every explosion blasts open a path and every hit brings you closer to the key figures of the dictatorship – up to the final showdown with Hitler himself.

• Experience compact missions with intense firefights and uncompromising action.
• Use a deadly arsenal of weapons, explosives, vehicles and mounted guns.
• Target high-ranking officers and generals – all the way to Hitler.
• Immerse yourself in the era with historical uniforms, flags and symbols.
• Storm the Wolf’s Lair – precisely reconstructed using original plans and current satellite data.
70010000116239.intro: Strike at the heart of the Nazi regime
70010000116239.name: Wolfsschanze – Operation Götterdämmerung

70010000116245.description:
A Seaplane, a Storm, and a Missing Uncle 

Take to the skies in your trusty seaplane on a heartfelt adventure across the tropical Limbo archipelago. After receiving a distress call from Uncle Lou, you arrive only to find the islands in disarray and Lou nowhere to be found. Collect resources, help rebuild a community, and unravel the mystery of your uncle’s disappearance. 

Collect, Craft, Restore 

Harness the vacuum power of the Swirler! — a glorious multi-tool — to collect everything from scrap and native plants to materials dropped by Limbo’s unique wildlife. Use your finds to repair buildings, craft goods, and help the communities thrive again. 

Claim your slice of paradise at Lou’s Lagoon. Build your dream beach hut, add your personal touch, and let the island rhythm take over.

Meet the islanders of Limbo 

Discover the archipelago’s vibrant islands, each with their own spirited communities, hidden treasures, and unique problems to solve. Get a warm welcome from the Charneys in Tangle Bloom—the archipelago's liveliest town—then head to Gleam Reef to watch the Vooi move to the music of the tides. Lastly, visit Boulderia, home to the grumpy, sugar-crystal-mining Gorplins! 

Key Features: 

- Explore the Limbo archipelago, home to vibrant communities and ancient secrets. 

- Pilot your very own seaplane, master ring challenges, and enjoy the freedom of open skies. 

- Upgrade your gadgets to expand your adventures. Scoop, build, glide and fish! 

- Personalize your seaplane with vibrant skins and custom configurations. 

- Full character customization. Make your avatar uniquely yours, from hairstyle to outfits and accessories. 

- Build your island base, decorate it, and make Lou’s Lagoon feel like home. 

- A mystery to unravel. Piece together clues, follow Lou’s trail, and uncover the truth behind his disappearance!  

Whether you’re hot on the trail to solving the mystery of Uncle Lou or just kicking back and enjoying island life, Lou’s Lagoon is your ticket to an exciting adventure.  

Ready for takeoff?
70010000116245.name: Lou's Lagoon

70010000116278.description:
Step into the life of a self-proclaimed detective. Along with your quirky assistant Olivina, take on a seemingly ordinary case, until you unravel its hidden twists and turns that pull you through a thrilling, unique story.

Unique investigation gameplay that challenges players to be observant

Game Features:

• Diverse cast of characters
• Smooth 2D animation that breathes life into the characters
• Stylized, hand-drawn CG for players to unlock and collect
70010000116278.intro: Embark on a thrilling detective visual novel with your quirky assistant, Olivina, featuring unique investigations and a diverse cast of characters.
70010000116278.name: Memory Rewind

70010000116281.description:
This is a story about a group of girls in a world that exists in limbo between life and death. Embark on a dramatic real-time tactical adventure.

In this world, opposites intertwine— cuteness and grotesqueness, hope and despair, life and death.

Those who yearn for death, yet cannot bring themselves to it, arrive at the Interworld suspended between life and death.

This is the story of Mitsu Mao, a girl clinging to life who gets lost in this Interworld, and those she meets there who have desired death.

The game consists of an adventure part, where you explore the Interworld, and a real-time tactical part, where you strategically defeat the monsters blocking Mao's path with her allies.
Embark on a dramatic real-time tactical adventure.
70010000116281.intro:
Why Do People Want to Die?
Why Don't People Want to Die?
70010000116281.name: GiLGuL

70010000116282.description:
This physics-based puzzler turns everyday frustration into cathartic destruction as you throw, smash, and flip tables through levels inspired by modern life. Your adventure begins with a bad day at work, when your boss demands you work overtime on your birthday, and escalates into a heroic journey to become the President of the most powerful nation on Earth: Antarctica.

Wreck the world to unlock dozens of costumes and new playable levels. Make coffee as a barista, survive teaching a class of high school students, and prove your throwing mastery in ridiculous boss battles where you can tussle with a college professor. Each imaginative level encourages experimentation, creative destruction to rack up points, all alongside a cast of quirky characters.

Want to crank the chaos even higher? Build your own fully destructible stages with the in-game level editor. Turn real-life frustrations into unhinged playgrounds of destruction! Then share your masterpieces online for other players to play.

Features:
● Flip tables, throw objects, and enjoy the consequences.
● Unlock costumes to create your own custom flipper.
● Battle memorable bosses that are both silly and epic.
● Chase high scores across a huge variety of stages.
● Solve optional objectives to unlock bonus levels.
● Explore retro-cool visuals and knock out over 200 characters.
● Build fully destructible levels with the in-game editor.
● Share your creations online and play levels made by other players.
● Did we mention smashing things?
70010000116282.intro: Flip tables, smash stress, and unleash chaos in absurd physics fun.
70010000116282.name: Table Flip Simulator

70010000116292.description:
DAVE THE DIVER is a casual, single-player adventure RPG featuring deep-sea exploration and fishing during the day and sushi restaurant management at night. Join Dave and his quirky friends as they seek to uncover the secrets of the mysterious Blue Hole.

■ An adventure, RPG, management hybrid
Explore and unravel the mysteries in the depths of the Blue Hole by day and run a successful exotic sushi restaurant by night.
It’s easy to get hooked on the satisfying gameplay loop!

■Casual combat and gathering gameplay with rogue-like elements
Dive into the ever-changing Blue Hole and use a harpoon and other weapons to catch fish and various creatures.
Upgrade and forge equipment with collected resources and sushi restaurant profits to prepare for the dangers that lurk in the unknown.
Running out of oxygen means leaving collected items and fish behind!

■ Eccentric characters with a lighthearted narrative
Quirky but lovable characters and a story full of in-jokes, spoofs, and other humorous scenes provide an approachable and enjoyable gameplay experience.

■ A beautiful sea environment with attractive 2D/3D Art
A combination of pixel and 3D graphics provides a stunning art style that showcases breathtaking underwater scenery.
This oceanic adventure is set in the real marine environment of a Blue Hole filled with over 200 kinds of sea creatures.

■ Ample additional content to complement the main gameplay loop
Minigames, side quests, and multiple storylines provide many hours of entertainment and varied gameplay.
70010000116292.intro:
Dive by day! Serve by night!
The best diving, harpooning, action-adventuring, and sushi restaurant managing experience you'll ever have.
70010000116292.name: DAVE THE DIVER Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000116294.description:
"Greyhill Incident is a story-driven Survival-Horror game that takes place during the early 90s. As Ryan Baker, equipped with a baseball bat and a few bullets in his trusty revolver, the story takes you across the atmospheric neighbourhood of Greyhill, which is invaded by UFOs & Grey Aliens.

EXPERIENCE A CLASSIC ALIEN INVASION STORY
The recent increase paranormal activities over the last few days have convinced the scared and now paranoid residents of Greyhill, that the Aliens are amongst them.
They trust no one. The small neighbourhood of Greyhill is afraid to speak up and fearing being sent to the psychiatric ward, they avoid calling the police.
Alone, they prepare by boarding up their windows and start a neighbourhood watch.

GET ACROSS THE NEIGHBOURHOOD
Ryan Baker attempts cross the neighbourhood of Greyhill to save a neighbour who is in serious trouble. Find useful items, solve puzzles and you meet other humans as you fight to survive the invasion and guide Ryan through the Neighbourhood.

INESTIGATE AND UNCOVER THE TRUTH
Sneak through the open areas of Greyhill.  Investigate houses & barns and search for ammo while you work up your way through the village and uncover the Alien Conspiracy.

BEWARE OF THE GREYS
""They"" are a constant threat as they try to abduct people from the village village, take samples of everything, and experiment, and probe people.
Sneak, Run or fight to get through Greyhill and beware of ""The Greys""."
Includes new content and an alternative ending specifically for the Nintendo Switch™ version.
"
Found Footage Mode – Play the whole game through a ‘Found Footage’ view
Digital extras including Bob's Tin Foil Hat Manual, Conspiracy Advertisement, Newspaper and Wallpaper
Original Soundtrack – Main Theme and This is Our World"
70010000116294.name: Greyhill Incident Re-probed Edition

70010000116315.description:
Collect puzzles with photorealistic images of girls in spectacular outfits, enjoy convenient touch controls and feel the process at your fingertips.

Relaxing music creates the right mood, and gradually increasing difficulty turns each level into an exciting challenge. After assembly, you can carefully examine each image and appreciate all the details.

Features:

• Photorealistic images.

• Realistic assembly process.

• Gradually increasing difficulty.

• Relaxing music.

• Detailed image viewing.
70010000116315.name: Hentai Balls 3D: Sexy Girls

70010000116321.description:
Collect puzzles with photorealistic images of girls in spectacular outfits, enjoy convenient touch controls and feel the process at your fingertips.

Relaxing music creates the right mood, and gradually increasing difficulty turns each level into an exciting challenge. After assembly, you can carefully examine each image and appreciate all the details.

Features:

• Photorealistic images.

• Relaxing music.

• Detailed image viewing.
70010000116321.name: Hentai Demon's Lullaby

70010000116327.description:
Collect puzzles with photorealistic images of girls in spectacular outfits, enjoy convenient touch controls and feel the process at your fingertips.

Relaxing music creates the right mood, and gradually increasing difficulty turns each level into an exciting challenge. After assembly, you can carefully examine each image and appreciate all the details.

Features:

• Photorealistic images.

• Realistic assembly process.

• Gradually increasing difficulty.

• Relaxing music.

• Detailed image viewing.
70010000116327.name: Hentai Succubus Serenade

70010000116342.description:
Collect pieces of beautiful and adorable elves to complete the puzzle!
There are 15 stages in total.
As you clear each stage, the difficulty increases!
Stages 1–10: 30 pieces
Stages 11–15: 50 pieces
The final stage is a tough one with no background watermark!
Take your time and examine each piece to complete the puzzle!
Once completed, high-resolution elves will be added to your gallery ♪
=====================
We support game streamers!
No permission is required to stream this game.
70010000116342.intro: A puzzle game featuring many cute and mysterious elf girls is here!
70010000116342.name: Elf Girls

70010000116355.description:
* Download the Nintendo Switch™ version and get a Battlegrounds Costume you can use in-game!

G'Day! Grab your tools, gather resources, and build your town while hanging out with friends and enjoying the charm of Dinkum.

■ A Survival Life Sim with Endless Possibilities
Plant crops, raise animals, and build your dream farm, or roam the island catching fish and bugs at your own pace.
With changing seasons and weather affecting how your crops grow, every day brings a new challenge. Slip on your flip-flops to hunt for rare fish, bugs, or ores. Every moment becomes a special adventure.

■ Explore and Survive the Wild
From red deserts and lush forests to hidden mines, Dinkum is full of wild places to explore. Hunt wild animals, gather resources, and learn how to survive in the great outdoors.
The creatures might look cute, but don't let your guard down! You'll need tools, weapons, and a solid strategy to make it out in one piece. Will you go head-to-head, or set traps and play it smart? The choice is yours.

■ Build Your Town Your Way
What starts as a simple campfire and a sleeping bag can grow into a thriving town with shops, fountains, flower beds, and windmills.
Craft furniture and decorations to personalize your home, reshape the island to design your ideal town layout, and customize your character's look from head to toe. Invite friends over to show off your one-of-a-kind creation!

■ The Joy of Growing Together
Sell your harvest and foraged goods to earn Dinks, and reinvest them to help your town flourish.
As your town grows, new shops will open, visitors will stop by—and some might even decide to stay for good. Celebrate with festivals and build a vibrant, lively town, whether you're playing solo or with friends.
70010000116355.name: Dinkum

70010000116399.description:
Solitaire Crime Stories is an exciting solitaire-investigation game where you take on the roles of journalist Lana Whitt and sheriff's assistant Bill Maite to investigate crimes in the sunny little town of Springdale.
Meet with the town’s people and hear some harrowing stories that will keep you on the edge of your seat!
Complete fun Solitaire challenges, investigate crimes, and make the criminals come clean!

- Colorful and intuitive solitaire challenges
- Finish compelling quests
- Solve hundreds of solitaire levels
- Crack the case and catch the killer
70010000116399.intro: Put your detective skills to the test in a thrilling solitaire mystery!
70010000116399.name: Solitaire Crime Stories Chapter 1

70010000116430.description:
They say the path to immortality is paved with hardship. But in your case, this hardship happened to take the form of seven dangerously beautiful women.

You are Lin Fan, the chosen one of the Crane Illusion Sect. Born with a Pure Yang Lineage, you are destined to ascend to the heavens. However, no matter how hard you train, fate sends yet another challenge in your way...temptations in the shape of an unreliable master, a strict senior sister, or a saintess who seems far more interested in testing your heart rather than your skills.

Can you survive the thousand tribulations of love, jealousy, and thunder? Or will your heart fall just before your heavenly ascension?

A Cinematic Live-Action FMV Experience

Stunning xianxia-inspired effects bring a mythic Chinese fantasy world to life. Feel the spark of every lightning strike!

A First-Person Immortal Ascension Adventure

Step into the robes of Lin Fan and experience the world through his eyes. Every glance, every touch, and every whispered word can shake your Dao heart.

Multiple Paths, Infinite Outcomes

Will you walk the merciless path of the true immortal, or lose yourself in mortal passion? Every choice leads to a different fate: enlightenment, downfall, or something in between.

Train, Duel, and Survive Heavenly Tribulation

Quick-time trials, emotional duels, and comedic chaos await. Survive your master's "training," dodge objects thrown at you, and protect your Divine Essence… at all costs.

Survival Tips for Aspiring Immortals
Never believe your master... especially when she says, "This time, I won’t deceive you."

Senior sisters strike fast... but jealousy strikes faster.

Your Divine Essence is both a blessing and a curse... manage it wisely.

Key Highlights
Immersive live-action FMV experience

Chinese myth-inspired fantasy setting

Multiple endings and branching choices

Humor, romance, and supernatural chaos

Thunder, temptation, and transcendence
70010000116430.name: God bless, or Goddess

70010000116450.description:
Step into a warm, flour-dusted world where pan dulce takes center stage. Merge adorable conchas, cuernitos, and more to discover delicious new treats in this whimsical puzzle game. With a dash of strategy and a sprinkle of tradition, PancitoMerge blends the joy of classic falling block games with the vibrant spirit of a neighborhood panadería.

Great for cozy breaks or chasing a high-score, no baking skills required!

The goal is simple: merge matching breads to create higher-level ones, aiming for the highest score possible while unlocking every type of bread in a single run. But be careful, the game ends if the breads stack up to the top of the bag!

A Tasty Twist: Every 5 drops, a customer arrives with a specific bread request. Fulfill their order by clicking/tapping on the requested bread in the bag.

PancitoMerge is a love letter to Mexican culture and the joy of pan dulce. From colorful conchas to buttery cuernitos, each bread is inspired by real treats found in local bakeries, celebrating the warmth, tradition, and creativity of Mexican baking.
70010000116450.intro: Drop, stack, and merge colorful pan dulce into bigger, tastier treats in this cozy game! Enjoy our charming visuals and simple gameplay!
70010000116450.name: PancitoMerge

70010000116460.description:
Welcome to 1 CatLine, a brainteasing precision platformer where you must guide a daring and adventurous heroine through single-screen challenges, with 50 unique levels spanning a variety of colorful pixel art biomes.

Run and leap through increasingly complex stages, freezing time and shifting perspectives to maneuver your cat friend around the environment to push crates, activate switches or create improvised platforms using its long furry body! Are you clever enough to clear all the challenges?

• Traverse increasingly complex platforming stages.
• Use your feline companion to form improvised platforms and push objects.
• Freeze time mid-air and maneuver your cat buddy to avoid pitfalls.
• Activate switches in the correct order to toggle barriers.
• Enjoy 50 levels of brainteasing retro goodness.
70010000116460.intro: Master puzzling stages with the help of your 2D feline companion!
70010000116460.name: 1 CatLine

70010000116466.description:
Are you clever enough to clear the streets? Avenue Escape is a puzzle game that challenges you to direct traffic jams and safely move cars through busy cityscapes! Each of Avenue Escape’s 50 levels features a bustling scene packed with cars, pedestrians and traffic lights. It’s up to you to figure out the perfect sequence to move every vehicle to its destination.

Think ahead, time your moves carefully and avoid accidents as you navigate tricky intersections and unpredictable crosswalks. Try to clear each stage in the fewest lives possible, but don’t worry too much, as levels can be tried as many times as it takes.

• Engage in top-town puzzle gameplay across 50 unique levels!
• Safely direct vehicles to their destinations.
• Think ahead and strategically choose the correct sequence.
• Clear levels using as few “lives” as possible.
• Enjoy casual gameplay and cute graphics.
70010000116466.intro: Bring order to the urban chaos as you solve traffic jams in brainteasing puzzle action!
70010000116466.name: Avenue Escape

70010000116472.description:
CyberBlocker Complete Edition is a brick-breaking action puzzler with shoot’em up elements. Maneuver twin ships to ricochet an orb into enemy blocks and clear the battlefield while dodging incoming fire and collecting power-up capsules.

Aim for higher scores as ball speed increases. Keep it in play, combine your reflective ships for an even wider shield and face off against massive bosses across 5 unique stages. Enjoy unlimited replay value and push your skills further in Challenge Mode!

• Effectively control 2 ships at once.
• Break blocks while evading enemy fire and collecting power-ups.
• Strategically combine ships on-the-fly to increase shield size.
• Keep the orb in play as it ricochets around the stage.
• Enjoy old-school arcade gameplay or push your skills in Challenge Mode.
70010000116472.intro: Engage in classic arcade style brick-breaking action with a shoot’em up twist!
70010000116472.name: CyberBlocker Complete Edition

70010000116478.description:
Find the hidden kitties around the apartment! Secret Paws - Cozy Apartments is an isometric hidden object game themed around cats and colorful little rooms. Explore unique, adorably decorated cube-shaped bedrooms, kitchens, living rooms, bathrooms and more as you search for dozens of cleverly obscured felines lying around each stage.

By finding all the cats in an apartment, you’ll clear the stage and unlock the next. Secret Paws - Cozy Apartments is calm, casual and therapeutic with a soothing soundtrack to match, making it the perfect “anytime” experience!

• Find the cats hidden in colorful isometric apartments!
• Unlock new rooms of gradually increasing complexity.
• Rotate the apartment rooms to change your viewpoint and avoid obstructions!
• Click on cleverly placed felines to reduce the cat counter to zero.
70010000116478.intro: Solve feline-themed hidden object challenges in cute cube-shaped isometric apartments!
70010000116478.name: Secret Paws - Cozy Apartments

70010000116484.description:
Shockwave Triggers is a vertical scrolling shoot’em up where you’ll choose between 2 pilots – the fast and versatile Amira, whose crystal-sensitive sister has been kidnapped, and the slower but more powerful Turbo B, a mechanic determined to take down the supreme leader of the WW army!

Enjoy anime-style cutscenes and a pumping soundtrack as you blast through 6 unique stages of bullet hell mayhem. Collect crystals from destroyed enemies, initiate shockwaves to cancel incoming projectiles into gems, deploy super attacks and upgrade your ship with character-specific armaments!

Use the shop system to earn new features or buy extra credits, choose from multiple difficulties to suit your playstyle, fill your gallery with unlockable art and use the jukebox feature to enjoy the game’s original soundtrack. Team up for local co-op play, dare to challenge Boss Rush mode and test your skills against online leaderboards!

• Blast off for vertical scrolling shoot’em up action across a post-apocalyptic wasteland!
• Gather crystals to trigger powerful shockwaves and cancel enemy projectiles.
• Choose from 2 pilots, each with unique strengths and weaknesses!
• Enjoy bullet hell gameplay and anime-style cutscenes set to a pumping original soundtrack.
• Use the in-game shop system to unlock new features or gain extra credits.
• Adjust difficulty, challenge Boss Rush mode, team up for local co-op and more!
70010000116484.intro: Collect the crystals and reclaim your future as you survive bullet hell mayhem in a post-apocalyptic world!
70010000116484.name: Shockwave Triggers

70010000116498.description:
In the aftermath of the ruined world left behind by World War III, humanity has been pushed to its final limits. With crops gone and animals extinct, survival depends on the government's most feared mandate: the Sustainable Meat Act. Every family must make a "contribution". No exceptions.

Take on the role of Marco, a father trying to protect what remains of his life. What starts as a quiet visit with family gradually turns into a nightmare of suspicion, memory loss, and unspeakable horrors lurking in the darkness. In this first-person, VHS-style experience, every hallway, every whisper, and every flicker of light pulls you deeper into a reality you’re not sure you can trust.

Key features:
• Psychological Horror: Navigate a crumbling world where truth, guilt, and imagination converge.
• Disturbing Atmosphere: An ordinary home becomes the setting for the unimaginable.
• First-Person Immersion: Explore, interact, and uncover the truth through tense, claustrophobic gameplay.
• Choices and Consequences: Your decisions will shape Marco’s fate and determine the cost of your "contribution".

Every contribution has a cost. Are you ready to pay it?
70010000116498.intro: A psychological horror tale born from desperation.
70010000116498.name: TROX

70010000116526.description:
GooNECT√2 is a two-player co-op action-adventure game, and sequel to the Japan exclusive Goonect.

Set off on a spirited journey through a vibrant 3D world where two players must hold hands the entire time to reach the end! Grab a buddy for a classic couch co-op experience or become besties with an online partner to navigate unlimited, randomly-generated stages across eight difficulty levels.

Put stretchy, rubber-like arms to the test while completing platforming challenges and dodging obstacles that could tear the pair apart. Once players let go of each other’s hands, it’s game over! Overcome towering wooden blocks, giant basketballs, and powerful wind gusts by pulling, launching, or even using each other as a stepping stone.

Reach the goal while perfectly in sync with a friend, or choose to control both characters at once for a solo excursion offline. Aim for a high Bestie Level at the end of each stage, which is calculated based on clear time, number of restarts, and number of hearts collected.

Its predecessor, Goonect, was very popular in Japan, and we hope more people will come to enjoy the thrills of sharing one fate with their gaming partner. GooNECT√2 adds lots of new features to further evolve the game, while maintaining its focus on fun and friendship building.
70010000116526.intro: Hold Hands, Reach the End with the Power of Friendship in GooNECT√2!
70010000116526.name: GooNECT√2

70010000116576.description:
Welcome to a private spa where relaxation isn’t the only thing in the air.

In Spa Massage Girls: Love & Relax, you’ll enjoy soothing massage minigames while getting to know a group of charming girls through lighthearted, flirty conversations. Every interaction brings you closer to unlocking new scenes, reactions, and special moments.

Balance calm hands with smart choices as you learn what each girl enjoys, how she responds to your moves, and when to push… or slow things down.

Relax, connect, and let the atmosphere do the rest.


FEATURES:

● Minigames in the spa: Simple, satisfying gameplay focused on timing, precision, and relaxation.

● Interactive conversations: Choose your answers and discover how each girl reacts to your style.

● Unlockable images and moments: Progress through each route to reveal exclusive content.

● Different personalities: From sweet and shy to confident and teasing, every girl feels unique.

● Multiple outcomes: Your performance and decisions shape each experience.


Can you find the perfect balance between relaxation and romance?

Step into the spa and enjoy the experience at your own pace.
Are you ready?
70010000116576.intro:
Gentle touches.
Playful flirting.
Pure relaxation.
70010000116576.name: Spa Massage Girls: Love & Relax

70010000116582.description:
Welcome to an exclusive spa where relaxation comes with chemistry.

In Spa Massage Boys: Love & Relax, you’ll meet confident, charming guys ready to unwind with you. Enjoy satisfying massage-themed minigames while building attraction through playful conversations and bold choices.

Each guy has his own vibe, from confident and teasing to calm and mysterious. Learn what makes them relax, discover their reactions, and unlock special moments as you progress.

Keep your focus, read the mood, and let the connection grow.


FEATURES:

● Massage-based minigames focused on timing and precision.

● Flirty, choice-driven conversations.

● Unlockable images and exclusive scenes.

● Different personalities and story routes.

● Multiple endings depending on your performance and decisions.


Can you handle the heat behind closed doors?

Step into the spa, take a deep breath… and see where the tension leads.

Are you ready?
70010000116582.intro:
Strong hands.
Playful tension.
Total relaxation.
70010000116582.name: Spa Massage Boys: Love & Relax

70010000116594.description:
Unleash your creativity in Super Sticker Studio, the ultimate casual sticker editor and design game for kids, families, and sticker fans! The perfect sticker book game for kids & toddlers: Drag, drop and customize cute stickers to create magical scenes—from festive Christmas wonderlands with Santa, elves and reindeer to cozy farm animals, construction vehicles, dinosaurs & Jurassic World, knights & castles, space adventures, plants & flowers, Halloween, ocean & beach, sunny farm adventures with animals and tractors. Ideal for personalized digital greeting cards, birthday surprises or holiday wishes for friends and family.
Whether child in fantasy worlds or adult with nostalgia: Layer stickers, add speech bubbles and text for funny comics, experiment with special effect stickers.

Key Features:
+ Endless sticker customization: Theme categories (Christmas, Farm, Construction, Dinosaurs, Knights & Castles, Space, Plants & Flowers, Halloween, Ocean & Beach, Special Effects etc.) with hundreds of vibrant motifs
+ Drag & drop into your scene, then resize, rotate, flip, reorder layers – pro control
+ Creative tools for all ages: Mirror horizontally/vertically, spin clockwise/counter-clockwise, stack elements for depth – turn drag & drop into art
+ Surprise loved ones with custom Christmas, Halloween, birthday cards or comic strips with talking characters
+ Pure imagination: Build comics with speech bubbles, explore fantasy realms or design cozy farmyards
+ No rules – just relaxing fun
+ Great content for fantasy and creativity: Many sticker packs with holidays, animals, dinosaurs, space, knights, construction, Halloween, ocean and surprises

Join the sticker revolution: Create, share and spread joy in Super Sticker Studio – every scene tells a story! Ideal for kids, toddlers and fans of relaxing creative and family games. Boosts creativity and imagination. The perfect kids and toddlers and sticker fan game.
70010000116594.intro: Unleash your creativity in Super Sticker Studio, the ultimate casual sticker creator and design simulation game for kids, families, and sticker enthusiasts!
70010000116594.name: Super Sticker Studio - Creative Sticker Book Game for Kids

70010000116600.description:
In Slide Viking: Treasure’s Path, you step into a charming Viking village filled with clever puzzles and personality. Controlling a fearless Viking, your mission is to push axes onto treasure chests, marking each one before claiming the hidden riches.

With 30 levels of increasing difficulty, the game blends logic and strategy across compact boards full of pixel art details. Every move matters, as the Viking moves tile by tile, requiring careful planning to position the axes correctly without getting trapped in dead ends.

Between wooden tables that act as walls and simple yet deep mechanics, Slide Viking delivers the kind of challenge that invites you to think, test, undo, and try again until the perfect solution appears. If you enjoy Viking themes, classic puzzles, and the satisfaction of seeing everything fall into place, this treasure hunt is for you.
70010000116600.name: Slide Viking: Treasure's Path

70010000116606.description:
Bubble Shot delivers classic bubble-popping fun! Aim carefully, match colors, chain pops, and wipe out clusters of bubbles.

Simple rules, smooth mechanics, and gradually increasing difficulty make it perfect for short sessions and relaxing gameplay.
70010000116606.name: Bubble Shot

70010000116612.description:
When her husband was taken by the gods, Alys refused to accept their verdict. With sword in hand, she embarked on a quest to take his soul back, throwing down the gauntlet to the goddess of death, Morrigan. Neither the legions of godly servants nor the gods themselves will stop her wrath.

Welcome to SoulQuest, a hack-and-slash tale of one woman's undying love and boundless grief. Carve through endless hordes of enemies and rip out their very souls. Battle the fates using a deep freeform combat system. Fight the Celtic gods - will you win and complete Alys' quest?

Features:
- Epic story of love conquering death, set in a fantasy world drawing on the rich legacy of Celtic myths and Arthurian legends.
- Deep combat system combining a broad variety of attacks, magic abilities, and ultimates, designed to be easy to understand and with plenty of ways to master it as you challenge Morrigan, the goddess of death!
- Non-stop action against hordes of foes, from fodder to cleave apart, to elite foes requiring quick thinking to defeat, and challenging bosses with plenty of aces up their sleeves.
- Plenty of secrets to discover across the vast levels, using Alys' ability to use vertical surfaces for sliding and jumping off. Then turn these skills on the enemy to outmaneuver and outfox them!
- Challenges await veteran players, putting your skills to the test with the highest difficulty levels leaving no room for error!
70010000116612.intro: Carve your path through hordes of enemies, defying the gods to seize the power of Morrigan, Goddess of Death, and retrieve the soul of your beloved! SoulQuest combine
70010000116612.name: SoulQuest

70010000116616.description:
Ready to become a Border Police Officer? Step into the world of Black Border 2 and experience the intense pressure of national security. As a Customs Officer, your duty is to protect the nation from illegal smuggling and Check the Papers, Please!

Inspect passports, scrutinize documents, and use advanced tools to make life-or-death decisions in this gripping police simulator game.

Take on the duty of a Border Patrol Agent and protect your nation's borders. Your role is crucial and you Must Check every Papers, Please:

Document Inspection: Meticulously check passports, permits, and papers to approve or reject entrants.

Advanced Tools: Utilize X-ray scanners to reveal hidden items and weigh stations to check vehicle legitimacy.

Canine Unit: Deploy your loyal service dog to sniff out concealed contraband and uncover secrets.

Strategic Decisions: Every choice you make impacts the safety of your country.
70010000116616.intro: Black Border 2 is an intense border patrol simulator where you inspect documents and use special tools to detect forgeries and stop smugglers.
70010000116616.name: Black Border 2

70010000116632.description:
A desperate plea from Lady Margaret tells of the sudden disappearance of her beloved dog, Lulu.
