At first, it seems like a simple matter of a missing pet.
But as Casey arrives at the imposing mansion, it becomes clear this is no ordinary investigation.
Lulu’s past is shrouded in shadows, and Lady Margaret may not be telling the whole truth.

Search for clues in lavish yet haunting locations — from candlelit halls and dusty libraries to forgotten gardens and crypts cloaked in mystery.
Featuring beautiful artwork, atmospheric music, and a twisted storyline,
Dark Town Secrets: Lost Lulu delivers the timeless charm of classic hidden object gameplay alongside a variety of challenging puzzles that will test both logic and attentiveness.

Will you be able to save Lulu — and the other dogs — before it’s too late?
Or will the secrets of Dark Town remain forever buried?

The Collector’s Edition includes:
- An exclusive additional storyline!
- Extra levels to play and mysteries to solve!
- New characters to meet!
70010000116632.intro: When a mysterious letter lands on the desk of private detective Casey Monroe, a strange case begins to unfold.
70010000116632.name: Dark Town Secrets: Lost Lulu Collector's Edition

70010000116646.description:
Unrailed 2: Back on Track brings chaotic local and online multiplayer track-building action to the next level – band together with friends to collaborate and build your track across new procedurally generated worlds - WHILST the train is running! So think fast, with more freedom than ever before, and conquer new obstacles in your way - before your trains becomes… a trainwreck!

CHOOSE YOUR TRACK
Now featuring a story spread across new environments, on branching paths for you to choose, so no two runs will feel the same. In these biomes you’ll now be able encounter new points of interests, side quests, daunting bosses and as well as other random encounters, so adapt quickly on your feet! New unlockable cosmetics also let you add your personal touch to your characters’ story.

YOUR JOURNEY GETS BETTER AND BETTER
Every excursion your crew undertakes feels increasingly meaningful, with new rewards and permanent upgrades granting you character with gameplay-modifying abilities, as well as new train engines, wagons and extensions to unlock, giving you the tools to build a multitude of train configurations to play and experiment with. Each locomotive loss is an opportunity to rebuild and get… back on track!

CREATE, SHARE AND PLAY WITH THE COMMUNITY
The all-new Terrain Conductor mode allows you unleash your imagination to create your very own custom maps and share these with the Unrailed community – with highlights being featured by the developers. Or if creating isn’t your thing, browse the limitless creations other players have built, so the frantic fun never ends!

CO-OPERATE TO COMPETE
Fulfill your burning competitive urge – manically duke it out in against another team in the new 8-player Vs Mode. Test your team’s prowess in online leaderboards with action replays and see who can achieve the highest scores.
70010000116646.intro: Unrailed is back on track with more co-op railroad construction chaos than ever!
70010000116646.name: Unrailed 2: Back on Track

70010000116648.description:
Evelius’s Tower awaits you, adventurers. Do you have what it takes to make it out alive?

DECEPTIVELY CHALLENGING
Lucky Tower Ultimate is an absurd adventure that will bamboozle you in its difficulty, while enchanting you with its absurdly funny charm. Be prepared to perish at the hands of the uncompromising Tower's traps and monsters countless times before you can even think about escaping to the local village - and only then can progression be earned.

IMPROVISE, LEARN, DIE
Embark on a quest with the delightfully narcissistic knight, Von Wanst, as he finds himself zapped into the perplexing Tower with no armor, weapons, or clear path to escape. Seek aid (and extra firepower) from a lovable cast of quirky companions. With each death, Von Wanst is transported back to the top of the randomly generated Tower to start again, ensuring that no two journeys are ever the same.

CHAOS, COMEDY, MYSTERY
Lucky Tower encourages improvisation, mastery, and learning as you play. Experiment with puzzles and enemies, and take your time to learn the twists and tricks of the Tower if you want to survive.

Lucky Tower Ultimate is infused with slapstick humor and a hand-drawn aesthetic, making each run feel like an immersive cartoon. As a continuation of the cult classic Flash game series about choosing between three mysterious doors, the Lucky Tower beckons seasoned fans and new players alike to experience the unique pleasure of getting all geared up... just to slip on a banana peel and die.

Features:
• From broccoli to dead enemies, everything in the game can be used as a weapon
• A village for commerce, meta-progression, and a customizable home awaits you after you escape the tower
• Companions and enemies react to the way you treat them - friends turn to foes if you step on their toes, and villains can open doors for you if you help them out along the way
• Journey through the tower to find 200+ items, ranging from Golden Armor to a honk horn, and 40+ traps, like barrels of dynamite and bee hives
• Randomly generated levels and haircuts keeps every playthrough fresh
• Hand-drawn 2D graphics that feel like an immersive cartoon
• Full voice acting makes for kickin’ times and smashing punchlines
• Multiple ways to exit the tower, including a dark and atmospheric Cave
• Learn and experiment without limitations (or hand holding)
• Unlock companion quests by escaping the tower with them by your side
70010000116648.intro: Escape from an incredibly dangerous, randomly generated tower in a slapstick, roguelite adventure that looks like a cartoon and feels like a joke. Slashy slashy!
70010000116648.name: Lucky Tower Ultimate

70010000116660.description:
Just like in the first game, you’ll find very simple puzzles and pleasant music. Relax as you assemble beautiful images.
Fierce barbarians, wise mages, brave paladins, and many other heroines are waiting for you!
70010000116660.intro: The second installment of the fantasy puzzle series.
70010000116660.name: Anime: Fantasy Uni 2

70010000116667.description:
Become the caretaker of an island full of silliness, drama, love and other surprises in Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream for Nintendo Switch!

Create all sorts of Mii characters based on your family and friends, someone you admire, or someone completely original! From their appearance to their personality traits and even little quirks, there are all sorts of ways to customise your Mii characters – including face parts that are unique to this game.

By picking up and placing Mii characters next to each other, they’ll start hanging out together. Watch as they forge unlikely friendships, get into fights, fall in (and out of) love unexpectedly, and so much more.

Expand and design your island as you see fit. Place homes, shops, restaurants, and more to give your island residents new hang out spots to visit. Want to make your Mii characters feel at home? Decorate their rooms with different interior sets, including furniture, wallpaper and floors to match their vibe.
70010000116667.intro: Your Mii characters, their wacky world!
70010000116667.name: Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream

70010000116673.description:
Fight for survival while exploring the vast expanses of an alien world in Xenoblade Chronicles X: Definitive Edition. This visually enhanced version of the epic sci-fi RPG features additional content – including new story elements.

The year is 2054. Earth has been destroyed by an intergalactic war between two alien races, and humanity is on the brink of annihilation. A small number of survivors, aboard the USS White Whale, crash land on the vast and untamed planet Mira – and now it falls to you, as a member of BLADE, to help bring humanity back from the edge of extinction.

With smoother frame rates and up to 4K resolution in TV mode, the sprawling alien landscapes of planet Mira have never looked better.
70010000116673.intro: Your epic adventure is now enhanced for Nintendo Switch 2
70010000116673.name: Xenoblade Chronicles X: Definitive Edition – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000116681.description:
The Boba Teashop is a cozy horror game where you own and manage a boba tea shop.

Prepare boba teas, serve customers, and expand your menu to attract more patrons.

You play as Risa, a woman who is tired of corporate life and has decided to chase her dream of opening a boba tea shop.

This is a psychological horror game that builds tension through an eerie atmosphere, unsettling events, and moments of intense scare when you least expect them.
70010000116681.intro: A cozy horror game where you own and manage a boba tea shop.
70010000116681.name: The Boba Teashop

70010000116682.description:
Race to victory through a mayhem-filled obstacle course of deadly traps you’ve built with friends while pulling off sick tricks!

Ultimate Sheep Raccoon is a bike-racing party game where you and your friends build a course of ramps, obstacles, and traps! Dodge hazards, do crazy tricks, and use power-ups to get ahead of the competition. Pedal to victory with up to 8 players locally, online, and cross-platform.

Bike to victory
Race to the finish on your bikes! With easy-to-pick-up and intuitive controls, everyone can play.

Power-ups
Stay ahead of the competition with power-ups! Lift off with the jetpack, glide safely over threats with the parachute, scatter opponents with bouncy mines or stop them in their tracks with honey traps.

Blocks and traps
Build the level together by adding rails, ramps, bouncy pads, speed zones, and other obstacles. Then amp up the difficulty with pendulums, spinning machinery, spikes, and laser-emitting TVs!

Sick tricks
Pull off tricks and do backflips and wheelies to rack up extra points!

Classic characters
Chicken, Horse, Sheep, and Raccoon return from Ultimate Chicken Horse! Plus a brand-new cast of barnyard buddies.

8-player support
Because 4 players weren’t enough!

Local, online and cross-platform multiplayer
Play together on all supported platforms.

Custom level editor & playlists
Build and share your own level designs. Create challenge levels where players compete for the best times, and put together level playlists for a campaign-like experience.
70010000116682.intro: Ultimate Sheep Raccoon is a bike-racing party game where you and your friends build the course together. Add obstacles and dangerous traps, and race to the finish!
70010000116682.name: Ultimate Sheep Raccoon

70010000116693.description:
Digimon Story Time Stranger is an RPG with monster-taming elements that explores the deep bond between humans and Digimon in an epic story that unravels the mystery of the world’s collapse.

Embark on an adventure that spans across the human world and Digital World, collecting and raising a diverse array of Digimon to fight in turn-based battles.

An Epic Story of Connection
Tokyo, Japan – An agent of a secret organization encounters an unknown creature shortly before a city-leveling explosion. They then reawaken eight years in the past...
Take on a mission to uncover the mystery of the world’s collapse, where chance encounters with unique characters will shape your journey across time and parallel worlds - and change fate itself.

Adventure Between Worlds and Time
Journey between the parallel human world and the Digital World: Iliad where Digimon reside. See the Digital World and its intricately detailed realms like never before, with interactive elements and special quests to explore.

Strategic Turn-Based Battles
Enjoy dynamic turn-based combat that combines strategic elements with evolved battle components. More than 450 Digimon and deep customization options provide limitless ways to approach the challenges of battle and reveal the strength of the bonds formed with your Digimon.
70010000116693.name: Digimon Story Time Stranger

70010000116699.description:
Who says ships are only for the water? Why not take a voyage across a sea of clouds instead?

On a little island, floating in the sky, your adventure begins...
Hop on board your shining new airship and see what lies beyond the horizon! Gather your crew and explore regions of the sky where no one has ever been!

You'll discover all kinds of floating islands, from bustling tourist destinations to perilous monster-filled dungeons.
Develop your island, fend off monster attacks, and help your crew with their problems to earn fabulous rewards!

Use the resources you've earned to install new facilities on your ship and help your crew expand their know-how. With a stronger ship, and a more knowledgeable crew, you'll be able to explore islands from even further afield.

What new adventures and encounters await you in the vast blue sky? There's only one way to find out.
It's time to take off!
70010000116699.intro: Customize your airship and explore the world above the clouds in this sim RPG
70010000116699.name: Skyship Quest Story

70010000116705.description:
Fowl Damage is an atmospheric puzzle platformer where your default jump provides enough fall damage to destroy you. Carefully manage your jumps and falls as you adventure through this chilling, beautiful, and occasionally cute world!

Your adventure will have you escape from the factory, splash through the riverbed, climb the giant trees of the ancient forest, slip your way through the slimy cave and hunt for secret warp zones in each area in an attempt to find a new home for your fragile friend. And all that by only using one button!

KEY FEATURES:
- Atmospheric gameplay.
- Unique, challenging mechanics, such as ramps that convert your falls into incredible speed boosts or bubbles that can catch (or launch!) you.
- Intense boss fights that will put your platforming and puzzle-solving skills to the test.
- Many secrets to discover!
70010000116705.name: Fowl Damage

70010000116725.description:
Choose your spaceship and defeat the alien threat coming from the Moon. Fight your way through by crushing, smashing, and blowing up hostile aliens that are taking control of powerful Earth weapons and military technology. Find the entity controlling the threat and make it explode in blood.

Space Dragons is a classic horizontal shoot ’em up game where you can choose different ships with unique characteristics and abilities to destroy tons of invading aliens. Throughout the adventure, you will face powerful bosses and explosive enemies. Get upgrades for your ship, weapons, and more to carve your way through the fleshy and bloody path that awaits you in Space Dragons.

Features:

Local multiplayer

11 fun and complete stages

A large arsenal of weapons awaits you in vast scenarios

Cumulative upgrades each time you finish a stage, allowing different combinations

11 epic and frantic boss encounters

Beautiful hand-drawn and animated pixel art characters and environments

Various enemies with different attacks and transformations

Execute enemies and bosses to gain upgrades and score points

Extremely frantic and explosive gameplay

Each boss has a transformation
70010000116725.intro: Choose your spaceship and defeat the alien threat from the Moon
70010000116725.name: Space Dragons

70010000116731.description:
RED TITANS is a single-player vertical shoot ’em up. You must put an end to the threat by creating a strategy with the available resources. You will need great skill since there are no continues, although you will be able to recover lives at certain moments.

You are the best pilot, a survivor. This is your last mission and everything will be decided. But in the middle of the mission, strange ships appear. A greater threat has arrived and the conflict begins to change course. You are no longer fighting for a nation; this is the beginning of something much bigger, and you are the first line of defense without even knowing it.

FEATURES:

6 frantic stages

5 epic bosses at the end of each stage

Beautiful hand-drawn pixel art environments

Retro 3:4 resolution (vertical shoot ’em up)

A challenging path with no continues
70010000116731.intro: Face the ultimate threat in a ruthless vertical shoot ’em up
70010000116731.name: Red Titans

70010000116741.description:
Collect puzzles with photorealistic images of girls in spectacular outfits, enjoy convenient touch controls and feel the process at your fingertips.

Relaxing music creates the right mood, and gradually increasing difficulty turns each level into an exciting challenge. After assembly, you can carefully examine each image and appreciate all the details.

Features:

• Photorealistic images.

• Realistic assembly process.

• Gradually increasing difficulty.

• Relaxing music.

• Detailed image viewing.
70010000116741.name: Call of Beauty

70010000116748.description:
Who said the underworld cannot have a cute side?

In Goat Out of Hell: Lost Pets, you take on the role of the hardest-working infernal goat in the underworld, tasked with a very unusual mission: guiding the glowing souls of lost pets to their portals of eternal rest. One push at a time, you must lead each soul through tight corridors, ancient ruins, and lava-lit passages without blocking the path or getting stuck in a dead end.

With 30 short and clever stages divided across three personality-filled biomes, each level is a new puzzle at the heart of the afterlife. From the misty shores of the Styx Riverbank to the reddish depths of Tartarus, and the fiery gates of the Outer Gate of Hell, every setting brings fresh challenges and layouts that demand careful planning and solid reasoning.

There is no ticking timer, no attacking enemies, and no draining health bars here. The only danger is logical: push a soul into the wrong place and the perfect solution becomes a small infernal mess. Fortunately, you can use Undo and Restart whenever you like, testing different routes until you find the ideal path.

Cute, challenging, and surprisingly cozy, Goat Out of Hell: Lost Pets is perfect for players who love strategic puzzles, clever challenges, and that delicious satisfaction of seeing every little soul resting peacefully on its portal at the end of the stage.
70010000116748.intro: Push the Souls, Save the Little Pets
70010000116748.name: Goat Out Of Hell: Lost Pets

70010000116773.description:
Explore a secret-filled land in this 3D Action-Adventure, where every level is hidden in plain sight! Travel and fight through a vast, unmarked overworld. The next surprise is only a single search away!

The Angel's mothership, Throne, lays dormant behind a fierce storm. To reach it, unlock its secrets, and usher in the future, you must explore the land of Era and survive its trap-filled ruins, primordial forests, treacherous mountains, mines, towns, and more!

Follow wandering ex-soldier, Tets Kinoshta, as he overcomes intense battles and hilarious hazards in this tale of betrayal, haunting lore, and fruitless yearning.

Features

"Bump the World!" with intuitive Bumpslash Combat. Walk into enemies to attack - no button needed! Fast-paced action levels AND exploration-and-lore focused levels will test your skills.

A vast world map you can search to find levels and zones. Follow your instincts to chart a flexible path. Go at your own pace — follow your spirit!

Fierce and uniquely designed bosses and enemies that will test your Bumpslash skills. Face vicious and hilarious tricks guarding the Fae's ancient secrets!

Plenty of levels, each offering glimpses into the Fae, Angels and Humans living together in the country of Era.

Haunting lore, woven from Irish mythology, early Christian philosophy, and Japanese American history.

Mix up combat with subweapons and a gun, and visit towns to shop for items. Beat levels to get Scales and level up!

On average, a first playthrough takes 15-30 hours, depending on how much of the world you want to explore and how fast you play.

Low-difficulty setting for Beginner Bumpslashers, and nightmarish settings for the deranged!

Created by Analgesic Productions
70010000116773.intro: Explore a secret-filled land in this 3D Action-Adventure, where every surprising level is hidden in plain sight! Travel and fight through a vast, unmarked overworld!
70010000116773.name: Angeline Era

70010000116779.description:
That legendary "Arm Tank Volley" is coming to Nintendo Switch™!

The rules are simple: just spike the ball into your opponent's court!
...but in practice, physics-driven chaos turns every match into total pandemonium.

■ Arm Tanks play volleyball
Take control of an Arm Tank and dive into volleyball-style battles.
The controls are simple - jump, move left/right, and swing your arm to hit the ball - but nothing ever goes as planned, and that's what makes it hilarious.
Smash too hard and fly out of bounds, punch the net and go flying, invade the opponent's court... you've never seen volleyball like this.

■ Five game modes to master
Versus, Time Attack, Endless, Rally, and Custom - five modes in one package.
Choose from 3 CPU difficulty levels and dive in whether you've got five minutes or five hours to spare.

■ Team battles for up to 4 players
2-on-2 team matches are supported too. Grab your controllers and get up to 4 players hyped.
Commentary, streaming, and clips are all welcome!

Now, swing that arm! Spike that ball!
70010000116779.intro:
Punch the net and rocket-jump! Arm Tank volleyball
Physics chaos makes every match totally unpredictable
2-4 player local play wrecks friendships
70010000116779.name: You All Know! Arm Tank Volley

70010000116795.description:
The head of a charitable foundation is discovered dead in a local auto shop.
As journalist Lana Whitt and police officer Bill Mates dig into the case, they must answer one crucial question: was it a simple accident,
or a calculated kill by someone desperate to steal the foundation's money?

No clue is too small in this tangled web of deceit.

- Colorful and intuitive solitaire challenges
- Finish compelling quests
- Solve hundreds of solitaire levels
- Crack the case and catch the killer
70010000116795.intro: The peaceful town of Springdale is rocked by murder.
70010000116795.name: Solitaire Crime Stories Chapter 2

70010000116801.description:
Build a team
Recruit heroes with unique skills and place them strategically on the field. Merge the same heroes to level them up and get access to more powerful skills. Optimize your team and create strong synergies.

Fight against other players
When the battle starts, your heroes will fight automatically and use their skills. Where they are on the battlefield determines the order of attacks and skills. Status effects like armor, poison, or freezing make the combat even deeper.

Customize your decks
Win battles to earn Unlock Tokens! Use these tokens to get new heroes and add them to your custom deck. Find unexpected combinations and perfect your strategy. Share your decks with the community and friends ‒ and try out their creations.

Choose relics
Get these passive bonuses to complement your team. Relics can make every run into a unique experience.

Level up rewards
Pick a reward whenever you level up one of your heroes. With a bit of luck, you will be able to boost your team's strength by a lot.

Leaderboards
Play ranked games to climb the leaderboard among all players globally or compete with your friends.

Detailed player stats
You can always have a look at this comprehensive list of all your in game actions and results.

Features:
- Play against teams of other players: Discover and learn new strategies
- No turn timer: Take as much time as you want
- Ranked and Casual mode: Play competitive or have a relaxing time
- Compete in weekly challenges: Find the strongest build from a curated deck
- Find relics: Get passive bonuses to complement your team
- Create custom decks: Choose from dozens of unique heroes
70010000116801.intro: A chill PvP auto battler where you build your team on a 3x3 grid. Recruit and upgrade unique heroes, strategically place them on the battlefield and find the best synergies.
70010000116801.name: Tiny Auto Knights

70010000116802.description:
*This product can be upgraded to the Nintendo Switch™ 2 version after purchase at no additional cost.
To upgrade, download the upgrade pack available from the Nintendo eShop onto your Nintendo Switch 2.

- Story
Ivalice—a kingdom blessed by the light of the gods and ruled by the Two-headed Lion. A year after her defeat to Ordallia in the Fifty Years' War, the king succumbed to malady, leaving a mere boy of two to ascend the throne.

Whoever was named regent would rule in truth, and thus emerged two rival candidates: dukes Goltanna and Larg, whose deeds during the war had earned them great renown. Goltanna the Black Lion and Larg the White Lion were destined to clash, and the resulting conflict would come to be known as the War of the Lions.

Against this backdrop appear Ramza, third son of House Beoulve, one of Ivalice's leading military families, and his childhood companion Delita, a commoner raised amongst nobles. As they endeavor to chart a course through this tumultuous age, a mighty current draws them ever closer to the abyss.

- Combat
Lead your party in exhilarating encounters where strategic positioning and forward planning determine the outcome. Use the varied terrain of 3D battlefields to your advantage, skillfully manipulate the turn order, and victory will be yours for the taking.

- Character Growth and Customization
Combine a wide variety of jobs and abilities to craft your very own strategies.

As your party members grow, they will gain access to more jobs, each with its own unique abilities. Once learned, abilities can be used even after changing to another job. With over 20 jobs to master—including white mage, black mage, dragoon, and many others from the FINAL FANTASY series—and hundreds of abilities to learn, you have the freedom to experiment and discover the combinations that best suit your party. Chocobos and other creatures can also be tamed and led into battle.

- Two Versions: Enhanced and Classic
With improved graphics, fully voiced dialogue, and refined gameplay, the enhanced version provides the perfect way to immerse yourself in the world of Ivalice. Along with the fine-tuning of several features and battle mechanics, the inclusion of the more accessible "Squire" difficulty setting makes the enhanced version an excellent starting point for first-time players.

The classic version unites the graphics and gameplay of the original 1997 version with the renowned War of the Lions translation for a unique way to experience this beloved title.
70010000116802.intro: The groundbreaking tactical RPG makes its long-awaited return.
70010000116802.name: FINAL FANTASY TACTICS - The Ivalice Chronicles

70010000116822.description:
Face the horrors lurking around the house and discover who the No-Skin Man truly is.
What started as a normal night with your friends quickly turned into something far more twisted. Fight, talk, trade and pray for one more turn as you delve deeper into each room, trying to survive this madness.

FEATURES:
▪ UNIQUE ART STYLE - hand-drawn pixel art characters and items meet photographic backgrounds, giving the game a distinctive look,
▪ HIGH REPLAYABILITY - choose from different characters, unlock new content between runs and experience unique outcomes with each playthrough,
▪ YOUR PROGRESS MATTERS - collect lunar fragments to buy permanent upgrades that carry over between runs,
▪ HORROR ATMOSPHERE - immerse yourself in the game's unsettling, surreal world, where every corner hides something uncanny,
▪ CAN YOU DISCOVER THE TRUTH? - talk with your friends and piece together fragments of the story hidden within the conversations.
70010000116822.intro: NO-SKIN is a horror roguelike where experimental art style and storytelling meet strategic gameplay.
70010000116822.name: NO-SKIN

70010000116828.description:
A World Ruled by Machines
Humanity has lost the war. The wastelands are now crawling with rogue AI and scavenging war machines. You and your mercenary crew fight to survive, taking on contracts from the last remaining cities built high above the wasteland.

Explore the Wasteland
Fly across a massive open world filled with settlements, machine lairs, quests, and unexpected events.
Take on contracts, recruit new pilots, and shape your crew’s legend one battle at a time.

Cinematic Turn-Based Battles
Plan your moves during the Planning Phase, then watch your strategy unfold in fully animated, anime-inspired combat sequences.
Injuries, panic, and breakdowns can strike at any moment—but so can heroism.

Create and Command Your Crew
Create and recruit your crew. Command a four-pilot squad, each controlling a different Mech subsystem.
Dodge, fire, deploy coolant, or unleash special tactics using the game’s unique Timeline System, where every second counts and every action shapes the flow of battle.

Life Aboard the Airship
Between missions, your airship becomes home.
Cook, train, or relax as your pilots bond, form rivalries, and grow through their experiences.
Each relationship influences how they fight—and how they survive.

Customize and Evolve
Collect and assemble Mech parts to build your perfect war machine.
Balance protection, heat, and ammo to match your playstyle, and unlock new Mech frames with unique strengths and loadouts.

Every Decision Matters
Your Mech can be rebuilt—your pilots cannot.
Manage morale and fatigue, face the consequences of your choices, and discover who you and your crew truly are in a world on the brink.
70010000116828.intro: A sandbox tactical RPG of steel, fire, friendship, and shonen anime.
70010000116828.name: NITRO GEN OMEGA

70010000116829.description:
Step into the boots of a frontline hero with Firefighters Simulator 2026, the ultimate firefighting experience. Take command of realistic emergency operations, where every second counts, and every decision can save lives. In this simulator, you are not just putting out fires—you are protecting communities under extreme conditions.

Key Features:
• Authentic Firefighting Mechanics – Operate hoses, axes, and vehicles with realistic controls and physics.
• Character and Gear Upgrades – Customize your firefighter and enhance suits, tools, and fire trucks.
• Diverse Missions – Tackle incidents from house fires and vehicle accidents to forest fires.
• Resource Management – Keep track of oxygen, water, and equipment to survive dangerous situations.
• Immersive Environments – Navigate detailed urban, rural, and natural locations with realistic challenges.

Firefighters Simulator 2026 offers deep immersion, realistic firefighting mechanics, and varied missions that test precision, timing, and tactical planning. Explore richly detailed locations and experience the adrenaline and responsibility of real-life firefighting.
70010000116829.intro: Every fire is a new challenge, every second a life saved.
70010000116829.name: Firefighters Simulator 2026

70010000116849.description:
Engage in legendary tank battles and dominate the global war zone! In this intense real-time strategy game, build your base, fortify defenses, and unleash a strategic warfare frenzy. Lead your army of powerful tanks, to conquer enemy forces. Prepare for adrenaline-pumping clashes, execute lightning-fast rushes, and strategically position turrets for an unyielding defense. It's time to prove your tactical prowess and become the ultimate legend in the Armageddon of tank battles!

Features:
- Three campaigns with 28 missions.  (One free campaign)
- Unlimited multiplayer PvP and PvE. Choose between 9 playable countries: USA, UK, France, Russia, Japan, Germany, Hungary, Romania, and Czechoslovakia.
- 20 unit types per nation upgradeable for all infantry and vehicles (200 usable upgrades) Tanks, Trucks, Commander Vehicles, stationary guns, and much more.
- Special extra units: Maus, IS2, Churchill, T29, Katyusha, Gepard, Sturmtiger.
- Defensive tactics include minefield planting, stationary turrets, and anti-tank assault.
- Action camera, powerups, boosters, and airstrike capabilities for offensive special attacks.
- Learning AI that adjusts to the player's skill level.
- Elevated terrains allowing for multiple strategic tactics.

Audio Engine: FMOD Studio by Firelight Technologies Pty Ltd.
70010000116849.intro: Command Tanks in a World War II RTS
70010000116849.name: US Conflict - Tank Battles

70010000116856.description:
Medieval Paris, Where the Tolling Bells Herald the End
1499. Paris is engulfed in flames as monstrous creatures suddenly emerge from the shadows.
Trevor Belmont, the hero who defeated Dracula, ventures into the burning streets with his daughter, Rose Belmont. Armed with the legendary holy whip, the Vampire Killer, they hunt down the beasts bleeding from the looming castle.

Rose is soon swept up in the dark conspiracy that lurks beneath. Will she succeed in saving Paris from devastation?

Satisfying Whip Action
Castlevania's iconic whip action is more satisfying than ever!
Crack your whip to move around freely like a trapeze artist!
Master the whip mechanics and be creative to pounce on your prey like a wolf in fast-paced combat!

Diverse Bosses and the Arcana System
Face-off against legendary bosses including Death, Medusa and Carmilla in addition to enigmatic new bosses such as Joan of Arc.
Once defeated, bosses are sealed into Rose's tarot cards, turning them into Arcana - use their skills to cast spells and obtain unique special actions

Customize Your Battle Style with Weapons and Relics
Customize Rose’s battle style by using a variety of equipment, including weapons spanning seven distinct categories and Relics that trigger powerful effects through both offense and defense.
Combine equipment you discover through exploration to create your own playstyle!

Iconic Castlevania Atmosphere, Reimagined in New Stages
From iconic Gothic aesthetics to vivid, refined visuals, the game presents a fresh take on the world of Castlevania.
Explore maps filled with both new features and familiar elements inspired by classic Castlevania titles.
70010000116856.intro: Crimson Curse —Will Your Fate Bloom in Despair or Salvation
70010000116856.name: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse

70010000116875.description:
- Story
Ivalice—a kingdom blessed by the light of the gods and ruled by the Two-headed Lion. A year after her defeat to Ordallia in the Fifty Years' War, the king succumbed to malady, leaving a mere boy of two to ascend the throne.

Whoever was named regent would rule in truth, and thus emerged two rival candidates: dukes Goltanna and Larg, whose deeds during the war had earned them great renown. Goltanna the Black Lion and Larg the White Lion were destined to clash, and the resulting conflict would come to be known as the War of the Lions.

Against this backdrop appear Ramza, third son of House Beoulve, one of Ivalice's leading military families, and his childhood companion Delita, a commoner raised amongst nobles. As they endeavor to chart a course through this tumultuous age, a mighty current draws them ever closer to the abyss.

- Combat
Lead your party in exhilarating encounters where strategic positioning and forward planning determine the outcome. Use the varied terrain of 3D battlefields to your advantage, skillfully manipulate the turn order, and victory will be yours for the taking.

- Character Growth and Customization
Combine a wide variety of jobs and abilities to craft your very own strategies.

As your party members grow, they will gain access to more jobs, each with its own unique abilities. Once learned, abilities can be used even after changing to another job. With over 20 jobs to master—including white mage, black mage, dragoon, and many others from the FINAL FANTASY series—and hundreds of abilities to learn, you have the freedom to experiment and discover the combinations that best suit your party. Chocobos and other creatures can also be tamed and led into battle.

- Two Versions: Enhanced and Classic
With improved graphics, fully voiced dialogue, and refined gameplay, the enhanced version provides the perfect way to immerse yourself in the world of Ivalice. Along with the fine-tuning of several features and battle mechanics, the inclusion of the more accessible "Squire" difficulty setting makes the enhanced version an excellent starting point for first-time players.

The classic version unites the graphics and gameplay of the original 1997 version with the renowned War of the Lions translation for a unique way to experience this beloved title.
70010000116875.intro: The groundbreaking tactical RPG makes its long-awaited return.
70010000116875.name: FINAL FANTASY TACTICS - The Ivalice Chronicles Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition

70010000116881.description:
Get ready for a journey through snowy America, from bustling cities to cozy little towns, the spirit of the holiday is in the air.
Garland lights sparkle, Christmas carols sound, and the smell of hot cocoa with marshmallows fills the air.

In Christmas Across America, you’ll find two intertwining stories:
— Santa and his cheerful elves go on a festive tour across the U.S. to deliver gifts and magic to children from California to New York.
— And little Lily and her family prepare for Christmas the way millions of Americans do: decorating the house, visiting friends, taking part in charity events, and creating family traditions that will stay in the heart forever.

Take a walk through Christmas markets, go ice skating in Central Park, visit Santa’s house in Alaska, hop on a holiday train, and feel the atmosphere of those heartwarming classic holiday movies we all love as a family.

Game features:
- A journey across the U.S. on Christmas Eve — 38 locations, each capturing the spirit of the region and the holiday
- An American family story — Lily, her parents, neighbors and friends come together to create a Christmas filled with care, warmth and traditions
- Holiday hidden-object scenes — decorations, letters to Santa, Christmas toys, treats, greeting cards, angels
- Dozens of mini-games — decorate the house, help pack gifts, launch the Christmas train, create a snow angel
- Collections and meta-progression — collect souvenirs from every state, decorate Lily’s house, unlock family recipes and stories

This game is like a warm letter from the past and a gift for the whole family.
Wrap yourself in a blanket, pour some cocoa, and start your journey through Christmas America.
70010000116881.intro: Experience the magic of a true American Christmas!
70010000116881.name: Christmas Across America Collector's Edition

70010000116928.description:
What does the fog hide?
Monsters? Darkness? Forgotten secrets?
While others fear to take a step, one frog leaps upward.
Each jump cuts through the mist,
each breath echoes in the silence.
The fog thickens…
but fear is unknown to her.

Forward. Higher. Into the unknown.
70010000116928.name: Frog in the Fog

70010000116944.description:
Sandbox Doodle Playground, a creative physics sandbox where your imagination becomes reality! Craft, build, experiment, and create endless scenarios using a huge collection of characters, weapons, vehicles, tools, and interactive objects.
Design your own worlds, build incredible machines, or unleash total chaos with realistic ragdoll physics. Every object reacts naturally, allowing you to create funny experiments, epic battles, crazy chain reactions, or peaceful constructions. There are no rules or missions—only unlimited freedom to play your way.
Whether you enjoy engineering complex contraptions, testing physics, or simply creating hilarious moments, Sandbox Doodle Playground gives you all the tools you need.

Features:
Creative physics sandbox with realistic interactions.
Draw and build your own unique playground.
Hundreds of objects, weapons, vehicles, and tools.
Realistic ragdoll physics and destructible environments.
Create machines, traps, battles, and chain reactions.
Endless possibilities with no limits or objectives.
Easy-to-use controls for players of all ages.

Create. Experiment. Destroy. Build your own world in Sandbox Doodle Playground!
70010000116944.intro:
Build. Craft. Destroy.
Create Your Own Playground.
Experiment Without Limits.
70010000116944.name: Sandbox Doodle Playground

70010000116974.description: It is a physics based car driving game. Where you ride alongside many levels, collect coins, so you can upgrade your car.  Over 40 challenging levels in a few different environments. You can customize your car.
70010000116974.intro: Race through challenging levels as you collect coins, jump obstacles, and perform flips to reach the finish line.
70010000116974.name: Climb Driver

70010000117008.description:
A brand new PARANORMASIGHT tale begins in Ise-Shima, Japan - a region rich in mermaid legends.
Join a cast of fascinating characters investigating the mysteries of the Mermaids of Ise. Unravel their different perspectives on the case and guide the story to its thrilling conclusion.

Story:
The remote island of Kameshima sits nestled in Ise bay.
Yuza Minakuchi is a young pearl diver who lives on the island and spends his days underwater gathering, together with his best friend Azami Kumoi. After he has a bewildering supernatural experience encountering another version of himself on the ocean floor, a series of curses start to befall the island...
A girl of unknown origins, a treasure hunter from a foreign land and a mysterious housewife investigating a drowning. Paths cross and destinies collide as they come closer to the secret of the Mermaids of Ise, a legend that has been obscured by the fog of history for so long.

Features:
- A brand-new story that starts with a new location, new supernatural legends and a new cast of characters.
- Faithful reproductions of real locations and vistas in collaboration with Mie prefecture. Investigate stunning 360 degree backgrounds for clues.
- Numerous new gameplay systems and mechanics, including a new Diving mini game.
- Multiple characters, each dealing with their own mysteries to unravel.
- Unearth the truth by your own hand!

*Once you have downloaded the game, no further monetary transactions are required and the whole story can be enjoyed to the ending.
70010000117008.intro: Will you survive the curse together this summer?
70010000117008.name: PARANORMASIGHT: The Mermaid's Curse

70010000117025.description:
For centuries, the dwarves lived in peace and harmony, but dark magic has driven them from their ancestral lands.
Help the dwarves build a new city where they can be safe from the threats of the past!

- Four types of gameplay to collect different resource types!
- Build a new town for Dwarves!
- beautiful and relaxing soundtrack!
70010000117025.intro: Help the dwarves carve out a new city!
70010000117025.name: Destiny Powers: Dwarven Town

70010000117030.description:
Peaceful goblins were driven out of their homeland by Dark Magic, and now they are seeking refuge in the Great Forest.
Use your magic to help them in four different game modes, and give them a new town to settle!

- Four types of gameplay to collect different resource types!
- Build a new town for goblins!
- beautiful and relaxing soundtrack!
70010000117030.intro: Not all goblins are evil and dangerous.
70010000117030.name: Destiny Powers: Goblins Realms

70010000117035.description:
Forget airports, hotel bookings, and strict schedules. It’s time to hit the road in your cozy motorhome, where every day brings a new adventure.

In Motorhome: Traveling North America 3, your favorite family is back behind the wheel.
This time, they’re traveling from Portland to Key West, exploring America’s most breathtaking places, from snowy mountains to sunny coastlines.

- Wake up in the mountains, have lunch by the lake, fall asleep under the stars — all in the comfort of your home on wheels.
- Dive into colorful hidden object scenes filled with nature, cozy charm, and the spirit of the open road.
- Play relaxing mini-games and brain-teasing puzzles that help you unwind.
- Collect unique baseball caps — each location offers a new design, a fun memory, and a piece of American culture.
- Take Polaroid-style photos throughout your journey — every snapshot becomes part of your family’s road trip album.

Collector’s Edition Includes:
- 10 extra hidden object scenes — with more items to find and a mischievous raccoon to spot.
- 8 all-new mini-games + 12 bonus puzzles from previous games.
- A full collection of rare baseball caps — become the ultimate road trip collector!
- A Polaroid photo album to save your favorite memories.
70010000117035.intro: Ever dreamed of the ultimate American road trip?
70010000117035.name: Motorhome: Traveling North America 3 Collector's Edition

70010000117046.description:
Welcome to WHY ME, a brutal rage-platformer where survival is earned one agonizing jump at a time. You’ve been thrown into a dungeon filled with shifting platforms, deadly traps, and relentless chaos. The question is simple: will you escape, or will the dungeon break you first?

Every room is a new test of patience and precision. Spikes, fire, collapsing floors, and tricks designed to catch you off guard will punish even the smallest mistake. But with every failure comes another chance to learn, improve, and push just a little bit further.

WHY ME is not just about surviving—it’s about enduring the rage. Designed for players who crave challenge, it rewards quick thinking, sharp reflexes, and stubborn determination. Lose yourself in the cycle of frustration and triumph as you climb higher, escape further, and uncover the mystery behind your imprisonment.

Play "Why Me?" today and face the dungeon’s wrath. One wrong step could end it all—but one perfect run might just prove you’ve got what it takes.
70010000117046.intro:
A brutal platformer full of traps and bad luck.
Mistakes are instant. Restarts are constant.
70010000117046.name: Why Me?

70010000117054.description:
Enter the thrilling world of high-stakes storage auctions where every box could hold riches—or worthless junk. In Storage Hunter Bid War Simulator, you play as a bold treasure hunter competing to outbid rivals and uncover forgotten fortune.

Glance into locked units for just seconds before the bidding begins. Will you trust your gut, play it safe, or go all-in?
Outsmart competitors with real-time tactics—bluff, bait, and strike when the moment’s right.

Win the unit, then dig through the chaos. Some finds are trash, others are gold: vintage collectibles, rare gadgets, or secret stashes. Sell smart, reinvest, and climb the ranks from rookie bidder to auction legend.

Key Features:
• Real Auction Tension – Face unique AI opponents in dynamic, fast-paced bidding wars.
• Instinct & Strategy – Make snap decisions based on limited clues and big risks.
• Buy, Sell, Profit – Flip your finds through shops, collectors, and markets.
• Progressive Gameplay – Unlock new locations, rare items, and build your legacy.
• Diverse Environments – Bid in garages, urban lockers, and luxury vaults.

Big risks, bigger rewards.
Will you strike it rich—or walk away broke?
70010000117054.intro: Win auctions, uncover secrets, and become an auction legend.
70010000117054.name: Storage Hunter Bid War Simulator

70010000117062.description:
Dive into a world of stunning, realistic puzzles that captivate your eyes and mind. Piece by piece, reveal breathtaking images of beautiful women — each completed puzzle unlocks a new masterpiece, keeping you motivated to discover what’s next.

Smooth and intuitive touch controls make gameplay effortless and deeply satisfying — you’ll feel like you’re truly shaping every picture with your own hands. Gentle, soothing music sets the perfect mood, helping you unwind while your curiosity pulls you to complete the next challenge.

Relax, enjoy, and let yourself get lost in the details.

Features:
• Addictive, easy-to-play puzzle mechanics.
• Gorgeous, realistic artwork of women.
• Satisfying touch interaction — every move feels natural.
• Unlock new, even more stunning images as you progress.
• Perfect balance of challenge and relaxation.
• Soothing soundtrack that enhances your focus and mood.
• Admire each completed image in full detail.
70010000117062.intro: Every piece brings you closer to perfection!
70010000117062.name: Hentai House: Lost Rooms

70010000117063.description:
#DRIVE Rally is an arcade-inspired rally racing game set in the golden racing era of the 1990s. Grab your co-driver and burn rubber in iconic, race-winning cars across varied rally stages and terrains in some of the most recognizable rallying locations in the world—perfect for fans of retro racing games and newcomers alike.

From the sunny landscapes of Dry Crumbs, through the whispering woods of Holzberg, to the chilly wilderness of Revontuli; take a journey through a diverse world you haven’t experienced in racing games before. Each destination delivers distinctive stage design and visual flair that celebrate classic ’90s rally vibes.

Jump behind the wheel of legendary rally cars, including Das Holzwagen, The Doggo, The Bobond, and many more. Build and customize your cars from the ground up to match your driving style and rally your way. Personalize the body, paintwork, and decals, then add that cherry on top with custom decorations - create a ride that feels truly your own.

Don’t forget the co-driver! Your co-driver can be your biggest cheerleader and toughest judge. It’s a partnership that thrives on performance and emotion. Their goal is to assist your runs with helpful navigation and tips to improve your stage times - making every run feel dynamic and replayable.

Features
• The spirit of ’90s rally for players of all ages and generations

• Exciting driving mechanics, simple to start but demanding in depth

• Stunning rally tracks and locations inspired by the world

• Retro-inspired cars with awesome personalization and car customization options

• Compete on online leaderboards to be the best and prove your rally skills
70010000117063.intro: Put your foot down and redefine speed in #DRIVE Rally!
70010000117063.name: #DRIVE Rally

70010000117069.description:
Travel from a city house through a series of interconnected worlds where time behaves strangely, searching for an elusive Princess. Along the way you'll explore memories and regrets that still haunt you. This Anniversary Edition remaster of the award-winning platformer contains fully repainted high-resolution graphics, new sound effects and extensive audio commentary.

MANIPULATE TIME TO MOVE FORWARD
Rewind, pause and use the strange properties of time in each world to run and jump through beautifully painted environments. Avoid hazards, unlock doors and collect jigsaw puzzle pieces to assemble. If you get hung up on a particular puzzle, feel free to move on and return later.

A FRESH COAT OF PAINT
This is the game you remember, with all the original challenges and the same haunting, evocative score — but repainted pixel by pixel so that each carefully rendered world comes to life in high resolution. New visual details, animated brushstroke effects and revamped sounds add to the immersive experience.

GO (DEEP) BEHIND THE SCENES
Explore the most extensive developer commentary ever put into a game, with over 12 hours of recorded insight and conversation from developer Jonathan Blow, artist David Hellman and more members of the "Braid" creative team. Navigate it by visiting a new in-game world, which also contains new puzzles and redesigns of classic puzzles.  - Created by Thekla, Inc.
70010000117069.intro: Control the flow of time to solve puzzles in this new version of the indie classic, featuring fully repainted artwork, a new world of puzzles, and seriously in-depth commentary.
70010000117069.name: Braid, Anniversary – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000117091.description:
Hollow Knight is a classically styled 2D action adventure across a vast interconnected world. Explore twisting caverns, ancient cities and deadly wastes; battle tainted creatures and befriend bizarre bugs; and solve ancient mysteries at the kingdom's heart.

Includes free content packs! All new quests, boss battles and secrets!
• Hidden Dreams: Mighty new foes emerge! New Boss fights. New Upgrades. New Music.
• The Grimm Troupe: Light the Nightmare Lantern. Summon the Troupe. New Major Quest. New Boss Fights. New Charms. New Enemies. New Friends.
• Lifeblood: New mapping tools. New Boss fight. Upgraded Bosses. New Music. Hidden Extras!
• Godmaster: Take your place amongst the Gods. New Characters and Quests. New Boss Fights. Hidden Surprises!

Game Features
• Classic side-scrolling action, with all the modern trimmings.
• Forge your own path! The world of Hallownest is expansive and open. Choose which paths you take, which enemies you face and find your own way forward.
• Evolve with powerful new skills and abilities! Gain spells, strength and speed. Leap to new heights on ethereal wings. Dash forward in a blazing flash. Blast foes with fiery Soul!
• Equip Charms! Ancient relics that offer bizarre new powers and abilities. Choose your favourites and make your journey unique!
• An enormous cast of cute and creepy characters all brought to life with traditional 2D frame-by-frame animation.
• Over 140 enemies! 30 epic bosses! Face ferocious beasts and vanquish ancient knights on your quest through the kingdom.
• Chart your journey with extensive mapping tools. Buy compasses, quills, maps and pins to enhance your understanding of Hollow Knight’s many twisting landscapes.
• A haunting, intimate score accompanies the player on their journey, composed by Christopher Larkin.
70010000117091.intro: Brave the depths of a forgotten kingdom, enhanced for Nintendo Switch™ 2.
70010000117091.name: Hollow Knight – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000117096.description:
Return to the pixel‑art world of FINAL FANTASY, evolved from its classic roots. Travel with companions bound by fate and call on Visions to aid you in battle to uncover the truth behind a force that threatens to bring everything to ruin.

◆ Cinematic pixel art
What if FINAL FANTASY had continued to push the limits of pixel art? The first FINAL FANTASY to join the HD‑2D lineup, FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE delivers a visually striking experience that feels both nostalgic and new, enhanced by dynamic camera angles and pixelized 3D models that make every moment more dramatic and immersive.

◆ A return to the familiar
A classic RPG adventure unfolds in a world filled with beloved FINAL FANTASY elements—airships, crystals, espers and moogles woven into the fabric of the story, and so much more.

◆ Strategic turn-based battles
Exploit enemy weaknesses to stagger them—breaking their defenses to seize extra turns and gain the upper hand with powerful Resonance attacks in cinematic battles shaped by smart choices.

◆ FINAL FANTASY legends
Bolster your team with Visions, echoes of beloved FINAL FANTASY characters, who fight alongside you with unique skills and abilities for deep party customization.

◆ Hours of side content to discover
The world is full of secrets, including the wandering swordmaster Gilgamesh, a Colosseum with deadly monsters and rewards to match, the Chamber of Arms with formidable foes sealed within legendary weapons, and a showdown with Ultima Weapon.
70010000117096.name: FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE

70010000117116.description:
Prison Run is a game about escape, risk, and cleverness.
You are a prisoner desperately trying to break out of a grim high-security prison. The only path to freedom is using your wits, patience, and anything you can dig up from beneath the ground.

Dig. Find. Trade. Escape.
Explore the area, dig up hidden items, upgrade your gear, and sell your loot to a shady guard who looks the other way for money. But be careful every item you uncover can bring you closer to freedom… or to solitary confinement.
70010000117116.name: Prison Run

70010000117118.description:
Projected Dreams is a charming, cosy puzzle game emphasising a casual, stress-free gaming experience.

Delve into the room, drag toys from the shelves, and handle them on the table to create a shadow play. As the shadows you cast uncover past family relationships and the environment around you changes and evolves, the lines between reality and fantasy blur.

Experience a heartfelt story:
Join Senka on her journey and experience a heartwarming, wordless story about buzzing summer nights, the importance of friendship, and bittersweet goodbyes.

Solve puzzles in multiple ways:
Rotate, place, and stack objects on a table to recreate a given shadow silhouette on the wall through shadow play. Get creative – there are unlimited solutions to solve puzzles, as long the outline of the shadow matches, and various achievements to be discovered.

Explore atmospheric settings:
Experience an ever-changing room and bring back memories from your own childhood thanks to the toys you will find. Discover new peculiarities while listening to relaxing soundtracks composed by Floris Demandt.
70010000117118.intro: A cozy, nostalgic puzzle game about projected dreams
70010000117118.name: Projected Dreams

70010000117137.description:
Under the big top, a festive atmosphere reigns: music, bright lights, and the scent of popcorn.
But the morning is shattered when an acrobat's safety rope mysteriously snaps.

Was it a tragic accident, or a carefully staged murder?

As the killer hides among the clowns and performers, Lana and Bill step into the ring to ensure this is one act that ends with the culprit behind bars.

- Colorful and intuitive solitaire challenges
- Finish compelling quests
- Solve hundreds of solitaire levels
- Crack the case and catch the killer
70010000117137.intro: New Circus is in town and fun is about to start, only to be ruined by the murder. Can you catch the killer?
70010000117137.name: Solitaire Crime Stories Chapter 3

70010000117143.description:
Frogging Up is a punishing yet rewarding physics platformer about a small frog in a yellow raincoat who dreams of escaping his muddy village life. Guided only by determination (and a very questionable sense of balance), he begins an impossible climb through a surreal world of floating pipes, platforms, and mechanical ruins. Each jump is a step closer to the top and a better life.

• Unique jump mechanic: The direction is controlled by the camera, while the strength depends on how long you hold the jump button. Mastering this precision system sets Frogging Up apart from other rage platformers.
• Rage-platformer challenge: No checkpoints by default, one slip can erase everything, but victory feels truly earned.
• Narrator commentary: A mysterious voice cheers, mocks, and reflects on your climb, turning failure into story.
• A story of struggle and ambition: Climb from the swamps of a forgotten village toward the shimmering towers above, a metaphorical journey from poverty to success.

Will you rage quit or rise from the mud and prove that even a small frog can reach the sky?
70010000117143.intro: Every leap brings you closer to glory… or back to the beginning.
70010000117143.name: Frogging Up

70010000117149.description:
Civilization has collapsed. The infection is out of control.
In OUTBREAK FALL: BIOHAZARD, you become a heavily armed survivor fighting to endure a city consumed by chaos.

This fast-paced first-person shooter throws you into a ruined urban battlefield filled with aggressive infected creatures and constant danger. Explore devastated streets, abandoned buildings, and burning districts as you search for resources and battle relentless enemies.

Armed with modern and futuristic weapons, you must rely on precision, awareness, and fast reactions to survive. The infected are unpredictable, relentless, and always advancing. Every encounter pushes your combat skills to the limit.

Key Features:
• Intense first-person shooter combat
• Dark post-apocalyptic city environments
• Immersive lighting and atmospheric sound design
• Escalating enemy encounters and constant tension

The city has fallen.
Escape is uncertain.

How long can you survive the outbreak?
70010000117149.intro: When the outbreak begins, survival is the only law.
70010000117149.name: OUTBREAK FALL: BIOHAZARD

70010000117173.description:
"KONAMI GT" is a racing game released by KONAMI in 1985.
Keep a close eye on your fuel gauge as you race through checkpoints, aiming to conquer all 6 grueling stages.
With beautiful, shifting scenery—from coastal highways and arid wastelands to plains bathed in the sunset—push the pedal to the metal and blast toward the finish line in a shower of glory!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.
70010000117173.intro: THE SPIRIT OF CHAMPIONS RACES ON!!
70010000117173.name: Arcade Archives KONAMI GT

70010000117175.description:
Explore the depths of this massive dungeon with your adorable companion Una in this exciting  ROGUE-like deck-building adventure!
Game feature:
• Dynamic Dungeon Layout
Fight through randomly-generated monster-filled dungeons and encounter merchants, treasures and story events. You can only see three levels down, so choose wisely as you push deeper into the dungeon.

• Titillating Card Battles
Build the most powerful deck out of over 50 different cards and 20 different runes and use it to overwhelm your enemies!

• Random Treasure
Obtain random treasures to upgrade Una's abilities. Put together the strongest combination and synergize it with your deck to deal ungodly amounts of damage!

• An Exciting Story with Multiple Endings
Make choices and experience different endings in this exciting adventure story! Unlock different side stories to trigger various card enchantments. Some enchantments might come in handy, while others might hurt you!
70010000117175.intro: Build your deck and take Una on an epic dungeon adventure!
70010000117175.name: Take Me To The Dungeon!!

70010000117184.description: On the 30 levels your agility will be tested. Enemies constantly spawn, but to pass level you have to shoot all of the targets. Shooting strategy is essential to survive the waves and complete the level!
70010000117184.intro: Test your agility and archery skills. Use bow to shoot targets, survive enemy waves.
70010000117184.name: Pocket Archery Master

70010000117185.description:
As purchase bonuses for the collection edition, it includes Metal Gear: Ghost Babel—the series first title for handheld consoles, released in 2000—and Metal Gear Solid: Digital Soundtrack Vol.2, featuring numerous iconic tracks that enhanced Snake's missions, ranging from BGM used in the games to vocal songs.

[Game List]
Metal Gear: Ghost Babel

[Soundtrack]
Metal Gear Solid: Digital Soundtrack Vol.2
*The soundtrack can be enjoyed using the dedicated sound player included within the game.
70010000117185.name: METAL GEAR SOLID: MASTER COLLECTION Vol.2 BONUS CONTENT

70010000117197.description:
• Multi-Character Team Battles
 Each character has unique skills and attributes, allowing flexible combinations based on combat needs. Whether you prefer powerful melee warriors or spell-casting mages, you’ll always find a role that suits your playstyle.

• Flexible Formation Switching
 Choose to gather your team into a circular formation to boost attack power, or spread them out in a line to increase speed. With simple switching controls, you can react quickly to the ever-changing battlefield and unleash your team’s full potential.

• Diverse Build Paths
 Different playstyles complement each other, enabling a wide variety of combat strategies. Explore countless possibilities, discover hidden combos and optimal builds, and let your heroes unleash their unique power and style in battle.

• Fast-Paced Combat
 A quick and rhythmic combat system makes every strike feel impactful. Combined with smooth animations and dazzling skill effects, it delivers an addictive fast-paced fighting experience.
70010000117197.intro: Unlock more classes, recruit more allies, and build your survivor legion!
70010000117197.name: Survivor Legion

70010000117203.description:
When the world is coming to an end, who would you want to speak to one last time?
In that final moment, if you could accompany souls wandering between life and death, what words would you choose to share with them?

Schrödinger’s Call gently unfolds a picture-book-like world.
It speaks softly to your heart, helping you notice what truly matters, once more.
Through the lingering regrets of others, we hope this story quietly shines a light on you too.


Story Overview
Twenty-one nanoseconds separate life from death.
The moon is about to fall, and only a moment remains before everything ends.

Mary wakes up in a strange room, her memories gone.
Guided by a mysterious cat named Hamlet, she becomes the “World’s Last Confidant.”

With a single phone by her side, Mary listens to the voices on the other end.
To the lives they lived, and the moments they left behind, just before the moon fell.

Phone calls left unfinished by the falling moon. Voices of those still trapped between life and death, waiting for someone to pick up the phone again.

Words left unsaid, feelings never realized, and the people they wished they could see one last time.
As Mary notes down these lingering regrets, chapter by chapter, she walks alongside the voices on the other end—and perhaps, you begin to see what truly matters as well.

How will Mary listen to the words of souls still wandering between life and death?
How will she walk alongside them?

And with only twenty-one nanoseconds left before the world ends, what words would you choose to share with them?
70010000117203.intro: Schrödinger’s Call is a visual novel that lets you experience the pain and salvation of human connection, as if you were turning the pages of a picture book.
70010000117203.name: Schrödinger's Call

70010000117218.description:
The ship has been looted. The crew is gone. You are the only one who survived.

During the night, pirates attacked the vessel. They took everything of value, destroyed the equipment, and captured the crew. You survived only because you managed to hide in the ship’s dark compartments.

When the silence returned, it became clear — there was no one to call for help.

Your first objective is to repair the emergency radio and send a distress signal. The first days of survival will be spent searching for intact parts, restoring power, and making risky trips into damaged sections of the ship.

But the signal is only the beginning.

Rescuers are on their way…
You just don’t know when they will arrive.

While you wait, the ship slowly dies along with you.
Supplies are limited, systems continue to fail, and at any moment a fire may break out or another авария may occur. The pirates may return — to check the ship or finish off the one who was left behind.

You will have to:

- survive by managing hunger and thirst

- extinguish fires and deal with emergencies

- defend yourself against repeated attacks

Every day is a trial.

You don’t know how long you must endure.
You know only one thing — if you give up too soon, rescue will never come.
70010000117218.intro: Hunger, fire, chaos — survive it all
70010000117218.name: Last Day On The Ship

70010000117224.description:
A hidden classic that fuses board and card games, Culdcept features a unique, innovative system that has captivated fans since its debut. Players become Cepters, wielding cards in intense battles where luck and strategy collide. After ten years, a brand-new story begins once again.

●What is Culdcept?
It is a game where you move across the board, claim territories, and build strategies using cards.
Use summons and magic to fight your way to victory.

●Story
Bavrashka, a continent created by the gods.
At its center lies the Royal Cept Academy, an insitute where Cepters are trained to wield the power of stone tablets known as "Culds," fragments of the Culdcept.
Kamur, who transferred to the Cept Academy, has his abilities recognized and is selected for the Royal Cepter Guard Regiment.
Amid battles that threaten the continent, the power of a Cepter begins to awaken.

●Game System
Move with dice and battle with cards—
This is a board game where victory hangs on a mix of luck and strategy.
Experience a more accessible evolution of Culdcept that stays true to the series’ charm.

●Cards
Over 400 cards with all-new visuals.
Combine all kinds of cards to win through the power of your own tactics.

・Creature Cards
These are cards that allow you to summon creatures.
They can help you gain more domains, or take over enemy domains.
There are five elements, and each card has different abilities.

・Item Cards
Item cards support your creatures in battle.
And that's not to say they simply help creatures attack and defend better.
Using the special abilities of items can help you snatch victory from the jaws of defeat!

・Spell Cards
Spell cards can help you build momentum, or put your opponents in a difficult position.
Use them right and you can even turn the tides of the game in the blink of an eye.
Suffice to say, these cards are essential to winning.
70010000117224.intro: Led by dice. Ruled by cards
70010000117224.name: Culdcept BEGINS

70010000117230.description:
"DEVASTATORS" is a shooting game released by KONAMI in 1988.
In this game, a group of elite mercenaries known as the "DEVASTATORS" are hired to save a developing nation from the invasion of a superpower.
This edition includes both the English version and the Japanese version, which features some differences in gameplay content.

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.
70010000117230.intro: For the GLORY, the MONEY... and to feed the BEAST inside their body!!
70010000117230.name: Arcade Archives DEVASTATORS

70010000117257.description:
Collect pieces of stylish and adorable female police officers and complete the puzzle!
There are 15 stages in total.
As you clear each stage, the difficulty increases!
Stages 1–10: 30 pieces
Stages 11–15: 50 pieces
The final stage is a tough one with no background watermark!
Take your time and examine each piece to complete the puzzle!
Once completed, high‑resolution images will be added to your gallery ♪
=====================
We support game streamers!
No permission is required to stream this game.
70010000117257.intro: A puzzle game featuring cool and cute female police officers is here!
70010000117257.name: Police Girls

70010000117259.description:
Where did gorillas come from? What are gorillas? Where are gorillas going? A single-player game of gorillas— That is GORITAIRE! Fill the jungle with gorillas!

Expand the gorilla habitat by growing the troop while ensuring a steady supply of bananas. To achieve victory, seven or more gorillas must be aligned on the ground. However, if any gorilla is left without food, defeat follows—marking the total collapse of the troop.
70010000117259.intro:
Growing the gorilla troop.
A single-player card game.
No more bananas—the end.
70010000117259.name: Goritaire

70010000117265.description:
Fast-paced Arena Shooter
Dive into a fast-paced arena shooter where the controls are simple but the battles test your strategy!

Explore dungeons filled with summoners who unleash waves of enemies, relentless attackers,
and the fearsome “Phantom” that hunts you down without mercy.

Level up to boost your stats and grab equipment from treasure chests to strengthen your character.
With each upgrade offering random sets of three options, your character grows differently every time you play.

Choose three party members before entering the dungeon.
Each combination changes your active and passive skills, dramatically altering your tactics.

Clear all the challenges in each stage and defeat the mighty boss lurking in the depths of the dungeon!

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
A Game-Exclusive Story
Experience a brand-new, fully voiced adventure that branches off from the early events of The Strongest Job Is Apparently Not a Hero or a Sage, but an Appraiser (Provisional)!.

After parting ways with Emalia, Hibiki takes on jobs to earn money together with Lillian, Claude, and Vene.
The group sets out into a forest to collect materials for a quest—a forest where people have been mysteriously disappearing.
Suddenly, they fall into a magical trap that whisks them away to a strange dungeon…

Will Hibiki and the others be able to escape from the dungeon?
And who is the mysterious girl they encounter within its depths?
70010000117265.intro: A fast-paced arena shooter game with simple controls and strategic battles.Experience a story original to the game, starring the characters of Appraiser (Provisional).
70010000117265.name: GAME The Strongest Job Is Apparently Not a Hero or a Sage, but an Appraiser (Provisional)!~Dungeon and Mystery Girl~

70010000117271.description:
Dive into a world of stunning, realistic puzzles that captivate your eyes and mind. Piece by piece, reveal breathtaking images of beautiful women — each completed puzzle unlocks a new masterpiece, keeping you motivated to discover what’s next.

Smooth and intuitive touch controls make gameplay effortless and deeply satisfying — you’ll feel like you’re truly shaping every picture with your own hands. Gentle, soothing music sets the perfect mood, helping you unwind while your curiosity pulls you to complete the next challenge.

Relax, enjoy, and let yourself get lost in the details.

Features:
• Addictive, easy-to-play puzzle mechanics.
• Gorgeous, realistic artwork of women.
• Satisfying touch interaction — every move feels natural.
• Unlock new, even more stunning images as you progress.
• Perfect balance of challenge and relaxation.
• Soothing soundtrack that enhances your focus and mood.
• Admire each completed image in full detail.
70010000117271.intro: Every piece brings you closer to perfection!
70010000117271.name: Photo Girls: First Session

70010000117277.intro: Every piece brings you closer to perfection!
70010000117277.name: Good Girls: Angels With Dirty Intentions

70010000117291.name: Bad Girls: Naughty Hands

70010000117318.description:
Enter A Good Place To Die, where survival depends on skill and quick decisions. Face relentless zombie hordes inside a confined arena where danger never stops. Build your strength as you fight—every successful attack rewards you with points that can be instantly used to improve your weapons. Shape your playstyle on the go, reinforce your defenses with combat turrets, and turn the battlefield in your favor.

Key Features:
- Dynamic third-person combat with roguelite progression
- Arena-based survival against constantly increasing threats
- Instant weapon upgrades driven by combat performance
- Tactical turret placement and upgrades during battles
- Environmental healing mechanics for strategic survival
- Periodic boss encounters that escalate the challenge

Stay focused, adapt your tactics, and push your limits. How long can you hold your ground?
70010000117318.intro: Survive endless zombie waves and grow stronger with every fight.
70010000117318.name: A Good Place To Die

70010000117324.description:
Toro 2 is a third-person 3D bullfighting simulator that lets you, in its Career Mode, step into the shoes of a bullfighter on his rise to stardom. Travel the world facing the fiercest fighting bulls, avoid getting caught by them, and you’ll become a star in the world of bullfighting.

BECOME A STAR

From the pasture where you made your first cape passes to the world’s largest bullrings. Learn new passes and moves as you prove your worth at the Maestranza in Seville, Las Ventas in Madrid, or La Macarena in Medellín. Thrill the crowd with your elegance and panache, evade the fury of the fiercest bulls, and you’ll become the most famous bullfighter of all time.

YOUR GAME, YOUR BULLFIGHTER

Customize your character to your liking, choose the outfit you’ll wear when entering the ring, and build your arsenal of moves to tailor your style to your gameplay. Inside the bullring, you’re the master of ceremonies, so choose from a wide variety of moves, outfits, and more to make the crowd cheer for your courage.

EVERY BULLFIGHT IS A NEW CHALLENGE

Try to score as many points as possible through your bullfighting, while completing various challenges that will push your skills to the limit. Push your abilities to the max and make the most of the tools at your disposal to reach the pinnacle of bullfighting and become a Master.

TAKE ON YOUR FRIENDS

In the new Versus Mode, you can choose to be either the bull or the matador. Duel with your friends in fast-paced local one-on-one matches, where you’ll decide who controls the matador and who controls the bull. Battle in bullrings around the world and try to outdo your friends. The cunning and finesse of a well-executed pass versus the fury and momentum of a beast weighing hundreds of kilos charging toward you. Who will win?
70010000117324.name: TORO 2

70010000117330.description:
Step into the wild as a mighty lion in Lion Simulator RPG: Animal Battle Survival. Roam vast savannahs, hunt prey, and defend your territory against rival animals and fierce predators. Build your pride by recruiting and protecting lionesses, and lead them to dominance in a dangerous ecosystem.

Experience realistic survival mechanics—manage hunger, stamina, and health while navigating dynamic weather and challenging environments. Engage in epic battles with other animals, sharpen your skills, and rise through the ranks to become the ultimate alpha lion.

Key Features:
• Realistic lion behavior and survival dynamics.
• Explore diverse landscapes—from open plains to dense forests.
• Form and lead a pride to conquer rivals.
• Hunt a variety of prey using stealth and power.
• Dynamic day-night cycles and weather impact gameplay.

Are you ready to rule the animal kingdom and survive the wild?
70010000117330.intro: Build your pride, defend your territory, and conquer the animal kingdom.
70010000117330.name: Lion Simulator RPG: Animal Battle Survival

70010000117336.description:
Step into a prehistoric world where danger is everywhere. Towering cliffs, dense jungles, and ancient predators surround you. You are a lone hunter — and survival is your only goal.

Your small metal base is your only safe place. Here you restore health and stamina, upgrade your medical injector, and improve your weapons and gear. Each new level unlocks stronger tools and deadly upgrades that help you face bigger threats.

Dinosaurs are both enemies and resources. Hunt them for skins, bones, and teeth, or go after the rare dinosaur eggs — high-risk, high-reward treasures guarded by the fiercest creatures.

Choose your challenge. In Arena Mode, face endless waves of predators where speed, accuracy, and movement are your best friends. In Mission Mode, infiltrate nests, grab eggs, and escape alive — sneak past enemies or fight your way through.

Every hunt makes you stronger. Earn skill points to boost health, endurance, or healing, and shape your hunter into a true apex predator.

Key Features:
