- Survive a deadly prehistoric world filled with aggressive dinosaurs.
- Upgrade your base, weapons, and hunter skills to stay alive.
- Hunt dinosaurs for skins, bones, teeth, and rare eggs.
- Two intense modes: Arena (endless waves) and Missions (dangerous nests).
- Customize your hunter with skill points: tougher, faster, or faster healing.
- Collect resources, enhance your gear, and turn simple weapons into deadly tools.

Primal Dinosaur Shooter – Dino Killer — survive the wild, collect rare loot, and become the hunter dinosaurs fear.
70010000117336.intro: Hunt or be hunted in a world where every step could be your last.
70010000117336.name: Primal Dinosaur Shooter - Dino Killer

70010000117339.description:
Summer holidays? Adventure time!
No sooner has Bibi returned to Martin's Farm than the next big adventure awaits: the Summer Cup is starting at Falkenstein Castle. Together with Tina and Alex, you compete in exciting riding disciplines – and show what friendship, fairness and a little bit of witchcraft can make possible.

New: carriage driving!
This has never been seen in a Bibi & Tina game before: Bibi, Tina and Alex have their very own vehicle ready for the Summer Cup. Steer a carriage along country tracks, through flower gates and around tight slalom courses! After all, champions do not only prove themselves in the saddle.

Stephanie wants the cup. At any cost.
Good thing you are not on your own. Stephanie von Schotterburg has her very own ideas about how to win – and the closer the final gets, the clearer her intentions become. Now it is time to show what really matters: friendship and sticking together. And, of course, Bibi’s witch power!

Ride, drive and fight your way to the final
Checkpoint courses, show jumps, flag collecting, ring jousting – every discipline brings you closer to the final, and every mistake costs points. Timing, skill and a good sense of direction decide who ends up on the winners’ podium.

You and your horse – a strong team!
A good competition does not begin at the starting line. Brush your horse, pick out its hooves, feed it and decorate it for the big performance. After tough races, cool it down with water.

What awaits you:
• Experience an exciting Bibi & Tina adventure – with lots of great tasks and horse-filled moments!
• Play as Bibi, Tina or Alex – together with Sabrina, Amadeus, Maharaja and seven more horses that you can unlock.
• Discover the special highlight: carriage driving with races and slalom courses.
• Train for different tournament disciplines and collect points for the final.
• Ride checkpoint races, show jumping, slalom, flag races, ring jousting and trail races.
• Care for your horse by brushing it, feeding it, picking out its hooves, decorating it and cooling it down.
• Explore familiar places such as Martin's Farm, Falkenstein Castle, the Old Mill, Wolf's Gorge, the forest and Redwell Castle.
70010000117339.intro: A summer full of friendship, tournament excitement and horse-filled happiness!
70010000117339.name: Bibi & Tina – Ready, Set, Ride!

70010000117351.description:
Step into the world of used car trading where every deal can turn into big profit — or a costly mistake. Buy cheap vehicles from owners, negotiate for the best prices, restore damaged cars, and resell them to grow your business from a small garage into a successful reseller empire.

Explore different parts of the city in search of valuable deals, hidden bargains, and rare vehicles. From private sellers to competitive auctions, every opportunity depends on your negotiation skills, smart investments, and ability to spot profitable cars before anyone else.

As your business expands, you’ll restore more valuable vehicles, improve your workshop, and build a reputation as one of the city’s top car resellers. Every car has potential — if you can turn it into profit.

Key Features:
• Car Restoration: Clean, polish, and repair used vehicles to increase their market value before selling.
• Owner Negotiations: Bargain with car owners and lower prices to maximize your profit on every deal.
• Competitive Car Auctions: Join exciting auctions, outbid rivals, and win valuable or rare vehicles.
• Business Progression: Start small, grow your reputation, expand your workshop, and build a successful reseller career.
• Vehicle Variety: Buy and trade different types of used cars with unique conditions and values.

Turn cheap used cars into valuable profits and build your career as the city’s top car reseller. Every deal is a new opportunity to grow your business and expand your reputation.
70010000117351.intro: Grow from a small dealer into a successful automotive tycoon.
70010000117351.name: Car Sales Simulator

70010000117357.description:
Run the plant shop of your dreams in Leafy Corner, a cozy shop management game where you grow, sell, and care for real-life houseplants!

Step into the role of a plant shop owner. Grow plants, serve your customers, and create a warm, inviting space filled with greenery and charm.

Watch your plants grow over time, unfolding leaf by leaf as you care for them.

Not everyone knows what they’re looking for. Sometimes customers bring unusual or tricky requests. Finding just the right plant to fit their needs adds a fun challenge.

Decorate your shop with a variety of unlockable items, from shelves to plant pots. Pick colors that fit your mood and create a space that reflects your unique style.

KEY FEATURES
- Grow, care for, and sell 100+ unique plants.
- Discover plant variegations.
- Build and decorate your shop with a variety of pots, furniture, and decoration options.
- Fulfill orders and help customers.
- Complete tasks to progress your shop.
- Increase your shop’s reputation to unlock new content.
- Customize your character.

What Leafy Corner does NOT offer:
- Hardcore management (deep economy, hiring staff).
- Advanced plant care.
- Storyline.
70010000117357.intro: Run a cute little plant shop in this cozy and relaxing game.
70010000117357.name: Leafy Corner

70010000117365.description:
In Quarantine Lockdown Simulator: Zombie Border, you take on the role of a border guard in a world overwhelmed by a zombie outbreak. You must manage the arrival of survivors and prevent the spread of infection beyond the quarantine zone, making quick and responsible decisions.
Every person crossing the border can pose a risk, and every choice can change the fate of your area. As the situation grows increasingly tense, you will learn to prioritize and act under constant pressure.

Key Features:
	•	Access control: Carefully inspect people arriving at the border for signs of infection.
	•	Health assessment: Analyze suspicious symptoms to protect the safe zone.
	•	Critical decisions: Allow passage, quarantine, or eliminate threats depending on the situation.
	•	Quarantine management: Monitor and cleanse the isolation area when zombies appear.
	•	Rapid defense: Use tactical methods to neutralize threats.
	•	Resource recovery: Rest between shifts to maintain alertness.

Prepare to be the last line of defense in a world devastated by zombies, where only vigilance and correct decisions can save lives.
70010000117365.intro: Seal the border. Stop the outbreak. Survive the chaos.
70010000117365.name: Quarantine Lockdown Simulator: Zombie Border

70010000117366.description:
If you're ready to run and play a deadly game of hide-and-seek, then come on in and make yourself at home. Behind the door, endless oppressive corridors, filthy walls, deadly traps, and a ravenous creature eagerly waiting to get up close and personal with you await.

There are doors that should remain locked. There are places that no one should ever visit. Secrets hidden in the shadows should not come to light.

But if you do wander into one of these places, know this: your enemy is strong and dangerous. He plays with your emotions and feelings as he pleases. Run away from there as fast as you can and don't look back. After all, there is no enemy more cruel and insidious than your own past.

Plot:
For several months now, Alex has been having the same nightmare.
He tries to solve the problem on his own, but it leads to nothing. So, the boy decides to ask for help from a professional. But psychologist Dr. Amanda Silk is not Alex's only ally on the thorny path of his hostile consciousness.
A meeting with an old friend is also ahead. Together, they will have to go through many traps and fight monsters to reveal the secrets of the dark past.

Features:
- A grim atmosphere that immerses you in a world of horror and suffering
- Unpredictable events will keep you on edge from the first scene to the last
- Unusual character and monster design
- An original soundtrack and realistic sound effects that create a sense of presence, helping you experience the protagonist's emotions
70010000117366.intro: Are you ready to run and play a deadly game of hide-and-seek?
70010000117366.name: Scarlet Wolf

70010000117372.description:
Angel Rhapsody is a 2D shooting game.
Demons have possessed all kinds of things—hamburgers, sushi, Mount Rushmore, Mona Lisa, and more! Drive them back with an angel’s bow.

Defeat enemies to earn experience points and power up your angel! You can also strengthen mini angels that support your attacks.
Characters inspired by various countries such as the United States, Japan, the United Kingdom, and Germany make an appearance.
Conquer a variety of stages filled with famous classical music and traditional children’s songs.
70010000117372.intro: A comical shooter where angels battle demons!
70010000117372.name: Angel Rhapsody

70010000117384.description:
[Story]

"That night… did we just clink our glasses?"

You were living the life of an ordinary delivery man, and one day you get scammed by your only friend and end up taking over a failing, debt-ridden Pocha.

Wait... but why are there so many pretty girls at this Pocha?!


[About]

A story shaped entirely by your choices, 'Love Too Easily 2: Summer Pocha' is an FMV simulation game where the story unfolds in a Pocha with five attractive girls.

Become the owner of a Pocha and win over the affection of the girls you like to find your true love!

Pick the right choices to raise affection levels, and show your feelings with thoughtful gifts!

[Characters]

Five girls, each with her own charm and personality!

Who will you choose?

●Adorable Pocha part-timer: Choi Sol (Lee Heeru)

Overflowing with cuteness—the bright and bubbly mascot of the Pocha!

“Good morning, boss!”

●Pocha regular/writer: Anna (Shin Jiwon/Johyun)

Professional and elegant… yet secretly a goofy heavy drinker!

“Can you be the main character of my story?”


●Heartwarming first love classmate: Sarang (Yang Seul)

A first love with its secret innocence..!
“How.. have you been? Finally, we meet again..”


●Famous streamer: Gain (Oh Yeonha)

Bright, bubbly, and impossible to ignore on camera!
“Then let’s drop the formalities—call me your girl, oppa~”


●Proud indie band singer: Nana (Eun Daha)

Cool, sharp, and fiercely independent—like a desert fox.
“What..? So?”
70010000117384.intro: Real-life dating simulation game "Love Too Easily 2: Summer Pocha."
70010000117384.name: Love Too Easily 2: Summer Pocha

70010000117385.description:
One could say POOLS is like an art gallery where you look around and listen to the sounds. There are very few things to solve apart from a few mazes. Sometimes the game can challenge your navigation skills. But mostly you're just... there.

POOLS has no user interface and no dialogue. No background music. Instead, it uses sounds to make you feel like you're really there. The sounds and echo change depending on the room you're in. Walking in water is slower. All of these things make the game feel more real and create a tense atmosphere.

There's no typical story, no characters to meet, and you won't find any notes in-game. But as you explore and advance further, you start to notice that the game's world changes around you. Rooms look and feel different. Each chapter contains something unique. You're constantly exploring new places, each with its own kind of mystery.


Note: There are no monsters chasing you or jumping suddenly towards you, but the atmosphere can feel oppressive. POOLS plays on the fears of getting lost, the dark, and tight spaces.

Note: POOLS consists of six unique chapters, each taking between 10 and 30 minutes to play through.


POOLS is inspired by the internet phenomena "liminal spaces", "found footage" and "The Backrooms" - specifically "Backrooms Pools" or "Poolrooms".
70010000117385.intro: Walking simulator. Explore, admire and listen.
70010000117385.name: POOLS

70010000117411.description:
■ Unique battle system
Enter commands in rhythm to activate skills. Play clever beats based on the cards in your hand and your opponent's attacks.

■ A variety of stages
Fight on stages with different background music, from city streets to ancient ruins. The gameplay experience changes with the tempo and beat of each track.

■ Customize your deck
Build your own deck by freely combining skills and gifts received from the characters you've befriended. Find the strongest combination!

■ Endurance mode
Battle through consecutive fights while strengthening your skills and collecting gifts. Unleash powerful attacks with your newly acquired skills.
70010000117411.intro:
Feel the rhythm, enter commands, unleash your skills!
Cento, a turn-based rhythm battle for two.
Build your deck and clash across countless songs!
70010000117411.name: Cento

70010000117436.description:
* Download the Nintendo Switch™ 2 version and get a Battlegrounds Costume you can use in-game!

G'Day! Grab your tools, gather resources, and build your town while hanging out with friends and enjoying the charm of Dinkum.

■ A Survival Life Sim with Endless Possibilities
Plant crops, raise animals, and build your dream farm, or roam the island catching fish and bugs at your own pace.
With changing seasons and weather affecting how your crops grow, every day brings a new challenge. Slip on your flip-flops to hunt for rare fish, bugs, or ores. Every moment becomes a special adventure.

■ Explore and Survive the Wild
From red deserts and lush forests to hidden mines, Dinkum is full of wild places to explore. Hunt wild animals, gather resources, and learn how to survive in the great outdoors.
The creatures might look cute, but don't let your guard down! You'll need tools, weapons, and a solid strategy to make it out in one piece. Will you go head-to-head, or set traps and play it smart? The choice is yours.

■ Build Your Town Your Way
What starts as a simple campfire and a sleeping bag can grow into a thriving town with shops, fountains, flower beds, and windmills.
Craft furniture and decorations to personalize your home, reshape the island to design your ideal town layout, and customize your character's look from head to toe. Invite friends over to show off your one-of-a-kind creation!

■ The Joy of Growing Together
Sell your harvest and foraged goods to earn Dinks, and reinvest them to help your town flourish.
As your town grows, new shops will open, visitors will stop by—and some might even decide to stay for good. Celebrate with festivals and build a vibrant, lively town, whether you're playing solo or with friends.
70010000117436.name: Dinkum Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000117441.description:
A surprise sports day at world-famous landmarks?!
Pororo and his friends are getting into wonderfully silly fun!

It’s fun on your own!
It’s even more fun with friends!

Wacky! Funny! You just can’t stop!
Everyone can join the fun at Pororo Sports Day!
70010000117441.intro:
The Grand Canyon! The Pyramids! Hawaii!
A wacky sports day in amazing places around the world with Pororo!
70010000117441.name: Pororo Sports Day: Sports Party Game

70010000117447.description:
Murders on the Yangtze River is a Chinese-style side-scrolling detective adventure game developed by OMEGAMES STUDIO.
There is no such thing as a perfect crime — only clues that have yet to be discovered.

- Every Trace Leaves a Mark -

Set in the turbulent era of the late Qing Dynasty and early Republic of China, where ancient and modern, Eastern and Western cultures collided and intertwined, you will step into the role of the protagonist and become entangled in an unavoidable conspiracy.

Seemingly unrelated events gradually lead you toward a massive mystery and the secrets hidden behind your own identity.

A lie is simply a fact disguised in another form. Can you uncover the truth hidden beneath layers of deception and piece together the final answer from a series of intertwined cases?

- A Meticulously Crafted Logic-Based Mystery -

During your journey, you will encounter a series of bizarre and perplexing cases. To uncover the truth behind each incident and identify the culprit, you will need to:

Explore different locations as the story unfolds, searching for every hidden clue and subtle detail.

Investigate crime scenes, collect evidence, and question witnesses.

Even uncover contradictions and loopholes hidden within the testimonies you have gathered...

- Intricate Cases with Twists and Turns -

The seemingly unrelated cases that occur across different locations are, in fact, connected by countless threads to the greater mystery surrounding the protagonist.

Behind every case lies an ingenious method of crime and a deeply moving motive.

Every ordinary person carries their own complicated past, with countless hidden conflicts and entangled relationships.

Can you unravel every layer of the mystery, discover the ultimate truth behind the grand case, and complete your journey of revenge?

- A Breathtaking Chinese Ink Painting World -

Follow a beautifully unfolding ink-wash scroll as you travel through the landscapes of China during the late Qing Dynasty and early Republic of China period.

Sail across Dongting Lake and encounter the historic Yueyang Tower once again;

Travel along the Yangtze River and explore the steampunk-inspired Hanyang Iron Works;

Wander through the misty waterways and elegant scenery of Jiangnan in Yangzhou;

Step into the dazzling streets of Shanghai’s foreign concessions and experience the city's early 20th-century retro modernity...

Every scene is carefully crafted like a living painting, inviting you to experience local cultures, explore historical landscapes, and solve mysteries across different regions.

- Meticulously Researched Historical and Cultural Design -

The game's world, art style, and environments are based on extensive research from museum archives, historical photographs, and discussions with experts in history and culture.

The story is built upon real historical backgrounds, recreating the architecture, landscapes, and social atmosphere of China during the late Qing Dynasty and early Republic of China period.

From carefully researched character costumes to authentic everyday objects, every detail is designed to immerse you in the rich historical and cultural atmosphere of the late Qing Dynasty and early Republic of China.
70010000117447.name: Murders on the Yangtze River

70010000117483.description:
Step into a chaotic, fast-paced escape where you control a fragile yet determined egg with arms, fighting through dangerous attic-filled levels in a desperate attempt to break free. Every stage is packed with unstable platforms, shifting hazards, and unpredictable physics that constantly threaten to crack your shell. Survival depends on precision, timing, and staying one piece under pressure.

Across each level, you’ll swing, climb, and launch your egg through increasingly complex environments where no two runs feel the same.
Multiple paths and hidden routes encourage experimentation, speed, and smarter movement, rewarding those who master both control and creativity.

As you progress, the challenge escalates with faster sections, tighter spaces, and more demanding obstacles, pushing your skills to the limit. Along the way, you’ll unlock a wide variety of egg costumes, giving your fragile hero personality while you fight through chaos toward freedom.

Key Features
• Throw yourself into freedom through dangerous egg-filled stages
• Discover multiple routes for optimal speed and better runs
• Unlock a variety of costumes for your egg and customize your look
• Survive physics-based chaos where every move can crack or save you
• Master increasingly difficult levels packed with traps and hazards

Stay steady, avoid cracking, and guide your egg to freedom in this unpredictable escape.
70010000117483.intro: Keep climbing, keep swinging, and never lose your grip.
70010000117483.name: YOLKED

70010000117489.description:
Step into the electrifying world of nightlife and prove you have what it takes to run the city’s hottest club. In Night Club Manager Simulator, you play as a bold young entrepreneur chasing one dream — to turn an abandoned, forgotten venue into the ultimate party destination.

Start from nothing but debts and determination. Renovate your rundown space, hire your crew, and make every night unforgettable. The music, the lights, the crowd — every detail is in your hands.

Game Features:
• Club Development: Monitor the atmosphere, reputation, and income — do everything to keep your club in the spotlight.
• Staff Management: Hire security, cleaners, bartenders, and DJs. Each employee affects your club’s success and guest satisfaction.
• Technical Challenges: Fix the sound system, set up equipment, and ensure perfect music quality for unforgettable parties.
• Interior and Atmosphere: Redesign the club’s interior, add lighting, furniture, and décor to attract more visitors and create a unique vibe.
• Events and Unpredictability: Be ready for fights, messes, and equipment breakdowns. React quickly and keep order by calling security, cleaners, or a DJ.

Night Club Manager Simulator is more than just a management game — it’s a story about how passion and persistence turn dreams into success. Create an atmosphere people will remember. Manage, grow, and become an icon of the nightlife scene.
70010000117489.intro: Build hype, manage the flow, and keep the party in motion.
70010000117489.name: Night Club Manager Simulator

70010000117527.description:
Now, guided by a mysterious voice, you must explore these broken realms, piece together the past, and confront those responsible for this cataclysmic event.

Deliberate, Precision-Based Combat
Each weapon has its own weight, speed and moveset. From two handed maces with slow staggering attacks, to nimble spears perfect for crowd controlling enemies and magic wands controlling the flow of Aether - everything plays and feels different. The classless progression system allows for multiple respecs so it’s easy to try a little bit of everything or adjust your character to a particularly powerful Legendary item you find.

Encounter Other Players
Reality's distortion means that the worlds of other players might briefly overlap with yours. You can choose to interact with them, or simply continue on your own path. You can invade and assist, support and deceive, share a profitable loot pile or lure other players into a particularly deadly mob of enemies and collect the spoils once they are dealt with.

Explore Diverse, Broken Realms
Journey through unique procedural environments that are fragments of former worlds. Navigate medieval Dungeons, the mystical enchanted Forests, volcanic landscapes, and future industrial Cities. Find memory fragments that reveal the stories of those affected by the cataclysm, helping you understand what happened and mend the broken world.

Share a Piece of Your World
Map Shards are powerful artifacts that allow players to share a piece of their world with others. Map Shards create a co-operative instance with random modifiers that unpredictably alters the monsters that inhabit the area and boost the loot they are guarding. When sharing the area with others, players can comment on it letting everyone know about what to expect in the area: vast riches or especially challenging encounters.

Face Challenging Bosses
Confront powerful bosses that stand in your way. Battle the Treasure Golem, the mind-altering Rorsch, the imposing Ghostly Knight, and many more. Each boss encounter is a tough and deadly challenge where a single mistake can cost you a significant chunk of your health if played poorly. But every action in these fights is thoughtfully designed and well-telegraphed, so with practice, you can conquer even the greatest foe.

Fractured Worlds offers a journey through a broken reality, focusing on direct action and the task of restoring what was lost.
70010000117527.intro: Fractured Worlds is a Dark Fantasy Action RPG set in a reality that has been broken into pieces by the ambition of its inhabitants.
70010000117527.name: Fractured Worlds

70010000117575.description:
A hidden classic that fuses board and card games, Culdcept features a unique, innovative system that has captivated fans since its debut. Players become Cepters, wielding cards in intense battles where luck and strategy collide. After ten years, a brand-new story begins once again.

●What is Culdcept?
It is a game where you move across the board, claim territories, and build strategies using cards.
Use summons and magic to fight your way to victory.

●Story
Bavrashka, a continent created by the gods.
At its center lies the Royal Cept Academy, an insitute where Cepters are trained to wield the power of stone tablets known as "Culds," fragments of the Culdcept.
Kamur, who transferred to the Cept Academy, has his abilities recognized and is selected for the Royal Cepter Guard Regiment.
Amid battles that threaten the continent, the power of a Cepter begins to awaken.

●Game System
Move with dice and battle with cards—
This is a board game where victory hangs on a mix of luck and strategy.
Experience a more accessible evolution of Culdcept that stays true to the series’ charm.

●Cards
Over 400 cards with all-new visuals.
Combine all kinds of cards to win through the power of your own tactics.

・Creature Cards
These are cards that allow you to summon creatures.
They can help you gain more domains, or take over enemy domains.
There are five elements, and each card has different abilities.

・Item Cards
Item cards support your creatures in battle.
And that's not to say they simply help creatures attack and defend better.
Using the special abilities of items can help you snatch victory from the jaws of defeat!

・Spell Cards
Spell cards can help you build momentum, or put your opponents in a difficult position.
Use them right and you can even turn the tides of the game in the blink of an eye.
Suffice to say, these cards are essential to winning.
70010000117575.intro: Led by dice. Ruled by cards
70010000117575.name: Culdcept BEGINS Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000117581.description:
Originally released only in Japan, the first entry in the Mystery Dungeon series and prequel to Torneko: The Last Hope is finally making its international debut!

Packed with the challenge, tension, and rewarding gameplay of a classic roguelike adventure, this is a journey we're excited for a new generation of players take on!

"He's Not a Hero. He's a Merchant. And He's Here to Close the Deal."

Set after the events of DRAGON QUEST IV, this is the story of Torneko, a man who dreams of becoming the world's greatest weapons merchant. One day, he hears rumors of a mysterious dungeon said to contain incredible treasures. In search of a legendary treasure that no one has ever managed to bring back, Torneko sets out for the Mystery Dungeon.

■ Gameplay
Every decision matters. No safety nets.

Every time you enter, the Mystery Dungeon takes on a new form. That's the essence of the Mystery Dungeon series. Items and monsters change with every expedition, and each new journey begins from Level 1.

In this turn-based adventure, every step Torneko takes counts as a turn. Whenever he moves, the monsters move too, making every decision a matter of survival. Defeat enemies to gain experience and level up, gather equipment and items to grow stronger, and venture ever deeper in search of treasure. The deeper you go, the more powerful the monsters become.

If you are defeated in the dungeon, all the items you have collected will be lost, and your next attempt will begin again from Level 1 on the first floor. It's a dungeon-crawling RPG worthy of the claim to offer "a thousand adventures in one"!

■ Expand Your Shop with the Items You Collect!
If you can safely bring items back from the dungeon, you can gradually expand Torneko's shop. As the shop grows, you will be able to store more equipment and items between adventures, creating a lasting sense of progress even as each journey begins from Level 1.

■ Difficulty Options
Customize the challenge of the Mystery Dungeon to suit your playstyle! Whether you're entering the Mystery Dungeon for the first time or returning as a seasoned dungeon crawler seeking the ultimate challenge, adjustable difficulty settings let you enjoy the adventure your way—and keep you coming back for more.

—Experience is your only weapon.
Return to the roots of the Mystery Dungeon genre and take on the very first adventure—one that continues to captivate fans to this day!
70010000117581.intro: A thousand adventures in one! — Discover the roots of the Mystery Dungeon series
70010000117581.name: Dragon Quest Heroes: Torneko‘s Mystery Dungeon -Classic HD-

70010000117594.description:
Schoolgirl Card Pull Simulator is a fast, feel-good draw simulator built around one satisfying loop:
Earn → Draw → Duplicate → Sell → Draw More.

No money? Head to a part-time job.
Saved up? Time to draw.
Got duplicates? Talk to the clerk, sell them, and go again.

But it’s not just endless drawing.
Sell prices change at random, so deciding whether to sell now or wait for the next day can make a big difference to your budget.
Play smart and you’ll unlock 10-pulls for a faster pace—and if you push further, you’ll reach the Ultimate Draw, where your chance of pulling an SSR increases the more you use it.
SSRs are rare, so when one finally appears, the payoff is huge.

Outside of the part-time jobs and the draw screen, the game is presented in 3D.
Display your cards in a showroom case, chat with the clerk, and enjoy the growing satisfaction of building a real collection.

The goal is simple:
Complete all 50 illustrated schoolgirl cards and fill the showcase.
Run out of money…? Then it’s back to work.

Highlights

All-in on draw excitement: Flashy animations make big pulls feel great

Rarities: N / R / SR / SSR (SSR is extremely rare—so it feels special)

Two “it’s coming” tells: Telltale animations you can spot instantly

Random market shifts: Sell values change by day—timing becomes your strategy

Duplicates become assets: Sell individual cards and reinvest to increase your draw count

3 part-time job mini-games: Dishwashing / Construction site / Card sorting

3D shop for display & conversation: Arrange cards in a showcase and collect in style

Made to be completed: 50 cards total, no additional cards planned (complete buy-to-play experience)

Progression

Collect enough cards to unlock 10-pulls (the 10th card has a higher SSR chance)

Collect more to unlock the Ultimate Draw (SSR chance increases the more you use it)

Example: 5th 10-pull = SSR 40% / 7th = 50% / 10th = 90%

Daily SSR rotation: Available SSRs change each day, updated in sets of five

Want a different SSR? Use the Change Date button to reroll the lineup
70010000117594.intro:
Work, draw, sell, draw again.
Until you complete the Schoolgirl Card Collection, your money management is a roguelike.
70010000117594.name: Schoolgirl Card Pull Simulator

70010000117601.description:
The objective is to use jumps and dashes to obtain crystals on the stage.
The stage is a 3D space with vertical, horizontal, and depth. Gravity is present, and players control the player by moving forward, backward, left, right, and vertically with jumps to reach the crystal.

Features
・Clear the stage once you obtain a crystal!
・30 stages in total!
・Choose your difficulty level: Normal mode is relatively easy to clear. Hard mode is extremely challenging.
・Crystals will appear as you collect coins!
・Support split-screen play for up to four players!
・Use items to improve your abilities!
・Defend enemies.
・Swords are available as weapons.
・Use evasive actions to move.
・Defend with a shield.

Multiplayer
・Work together to collect coins!
・Work together to defeat enemies!
・Be the first to obtain a crystal!
・Player attacks are also possible!
70010000117601.intro:
Get the crystals!!
Play in split-screen multiplayer with 1-4 players!
30 stages! Normal and Hard difficulty!
70010000117601.name: CRYZON part4

70010000117607.description:
"MASTER OF SYOUGI" is a shogi game released by SNK in 1995.
It stands as the only authentic shogi (Japanese chess) title for the NEOGEO system, offering both standard shogi and the simplified "hasami shogi."
With adjustable settings to display beginner guides or play with handicaps (piece drops), the game is designed to be enjoyed by everyone from novices to true masters!

The "ACA NEOGEO" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.
70010000117607.name: ACA NEOGEO MASTER OF SYOUGI

70010000117608.description:
ABOUT THIS GAME
The daily-life horror series Tsugunohi, known for its simple “move left” gameplay, arrives on Nintendo Switch™ as
Tsugunohi -The Chamber of Phantom Name-!
The core gameplay remains the same: simply press the left key "←" to move the protagonist.
With no complex controls, you can fully immerse yourself in the eerie, realistic story crafted by ImCyan.
In this installment, you will wander between reality and illusion in a world both beautiful and bizarre.
Can you endure an even more refined level of horror?
Experience the evolved terror of Tsugunohi, brought to you by ImCyan.

STORY
A young office worker, Kana Sakuragi, begins her new life in the renovated old house Akembara House.
At first glance, it seems like a perfect home, but each night, strange phenomena begin to occur.
A suspicious manager, mysterious phantom character, and eerie origami—
Is this reality… or something else?

PROFILE
■ Tsugunohi Series
ImCyan is an indie game creator who has continuously developed numerous horror titles.
His most notable work is the Tsugunohi series.
The defining feature of the Tsugunohi series is its unique horror experience.
As you repeatedly walk “to the left” along familiar routes such as your way home or workplace, everyday life gradually distorts, and a deep sense of fear begins to envelop you—
Please enjoy the unsettling horror of everyday life slowly turning ominous.
70010000117608.intro: The "Tsugunohi" series — a creeping everyday horror game with over 150M gameplay views! A sparkling new grad's fresh start is slowly consumed by terror―
70010000117608.name: Tsugunohi -The Chamber of Phantom Name-

70010000117614.description:
"99% sweetness × 1% surprise"!?
"Hey, do you know the meaning of the four-leaf clover?"
A fully-voiced, youthful yuri visual novel you'll fall in love with at first sight is coming to Nintendo Switch™!

【Synopsis】
The wheels of fate begin to turn.
The girls meet, fall in love, and deepen their bonds.
"Hey, do you know the meaning of the four-leaf clover?"
Set at "Shonan Saika Academy," a prestigious school in Shonan, Kanagawa Prefecture, this is a youthful story of girls wavering between friendship and love.
Shonan Saika Academy, a high-achieving all-girls school in Kanagawa Prefecture.

One day, Marin Tachibana, along with her best friends Mashiro Saotome and Kiyoka Jinguji, experiences a special day.
It begins with meeting an unusual new transfer student, Shizuku Kujyo.
A beautiful girl with a calm and dignified demeanor.
Meeting her feels like déjà vu...
While showing her around the school, they stop by an observation deck, where Marin finds a four-leaf clover.
There is a tradition at this school:
If you press a four-leaf clover found on the observation deck into your student notebook, your wish will come true.
(I want to get closer to her. To spend more time with her...)
With this wish, Marin gives Shizuku the "coincidental" four-leaf clover she found.
This act becomes a turning point, bringing Marin and Shizuku closer together with the help of Mashiro and Kiyoka. However...
"Please, stop worrying about me. I don't want to just be protected..."
"Shizuku, we're friends, right?"
A storm threatens to tear them apart.
It is deeply tied to a "secret" Shizuku is hiding and a "trauma" from Marin's past.
The story follows the growth, mutual support, and cherished memories of the four girls.
Will Marin and the others find their personal "clover" (happiness)?

【Localization】
In addition to Japanese, supports English and Chinese (Traditional and Simplified)!

【Main Character】
Gentle and healing girl-----Marin Tachibana (立花 茉鈴)
CV: Saho Shirasuna

Cool and beautiful girl-----Shizuku Kujyo (九条 しずく)
CV: Yuki Takada

Bright and cheerful mood-maker-----Mashiro Saotome (早乙女 真白)
CV: Yuki Kuwahara

Caring older-sister type-----Kiyoka Jinguji (神宮寺 清香)
CV: Noriko Shibasaki

【Special】
Dynamic Character Expressions System.
Express characters' emotions in greater variety!
Enhance immersion!

【Theme Song】
"Clover Reset"
Music, Lyrics, Arrangement: Shoichiro Toko
Vocals: Saho Shirasuna (as Marin Tachibana)
70010000117614.intro: A yuri novel game that you'll fall in love with at first sight. this is a youthful story of girls wavering between friendship and love.
70010000117614.name: Clover Reset

70010000117623.description:
You wake up in a dangerous zone where survival is the only rule. Waves of armed enemies attack without mercy, and one wrong move can end your run. Fight smart, use the environment, and prove you have what it takes to escape. Each run is a test of skill and awareness. One mistake can end everything. Learn enemy patterns, control the battlefield, and prove you have what it takes to escape.

Key Features:
• Wave-based combat with relentless enemies
• Fast-paced firefights on an optimized, action-focused map
• Ranged enemies with custom AI and tactical shooting behavior
• Loot pickups (armor, health, grenades) to keep you in the fight
• Responsive movement and shooting mechanics for precise control

Escape is never guaranteed. Learn the battlefield, adapt to every wave, and fight until the last moment. Only skill keeps you alive.
70010000117623.intro: Master the battlefield or fall in the chaos.
70010000117623.name: Escape From Duck

70010000117629.description:
The extreme tension of infiltrating without being detected.
Metal Gear series, the pinnacle of “stealth action” Immerse yourself in the Metal Gear series, the pinnacle of “stealth action” where you can infiltrate and elude your enemies to complete missions.

The game takes place five years after the Big Shell incident in METAL GEAR SOLID 2: Sons of Liberty, in a world where war has become a business.
To stop Liquid Ocelot's uprising, Solid Snake throws himself into his final battle.
The battle against Liquid and the Patriots draws to a close, and the mysteries woven throughout the series are now revealed!

【STORY】
THE TRANSFORMATION OF WAR INTO BUSINESS.
In an era where PMCs (private military companies) have risen to the top, war has become a business and the driving force behind the world economy.

Controlling the top five PMCs from behind the scenes is Liquid Ocelot, who fanning the flames of war even further, plans an insurrection with the goal of creating a world where warriors can lead fulfilling lives—a goal shared by none other than Big Boss.

Under the theme of “Sense” watch as the final battle of the man with Big Boss’s genes, Solid Snake, unfolds.

----------
The Screenplay Book containing in-game text from Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots and the Master Book detailing the story and characters are also included within the game.

[Game]
Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots
*Versions for other regions can be downloaded separately from the store.

[Digital Contents]
Metal Gear Solid 4 Database
Metal Gear Solid 4: Screenplay Book
Metal Gear Solid 4: Master Book
*Accessible via the in-game Start Menu.

----------
【METAL GEAR SOLID: MASTER COLLECTION Vol.1 Save-Data Bonus】
If you have save data from titles included in METAL GEAR SOLID MASTER COLLECTION Vol.1, you can receive in-game items usable in the game as a bonus.

・Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots Bonus: Gold Camouflage

*Bonus content can be obtained by playing this game respectively.
*This requires that save data for titles included in METAL GEAR SOLID: MASTER COLLECTION Vol.1, created using the same account, be present on the console used to play this game.
*Playing this game first, then starting to play titles included in METAL GEAR SOLID: MASTER COLLECTION Vol.1, still qualifies you for this bonus.
70010000117629.name: METAL GEAR SOLID 4: Guns of the Patriots - Master Collection Version

70010000117651.description: Get ready for a relaxing and charming journey in Habitat Shapes: The Tropical Journey, a delightful puzzle where every piece finds its place in nature. Arrange adorable creatures and complete unique environments as you transform each board into a vibrant, living habitat. With intuitive and fluid gameplay, you can place pieces freely without complicated rules, creating natural and satisfying solutions. Just pick, rotate, and fit pieces together while enjoying a calm pace that rewards creativity and spatial thinking. Explore 30 levels across three enchanting biomes, including colorful tropical settings full of personality. Each stage brings new shapes, gentle challenges, and that rewarding sense of progress with every perfect fit. With cozy visuals, a light atmosphere, and puzzles designed to relax without pressure, Habitat Shapes: The Tropical Journey is perfect for players who love organizing, completing, and seeing everything come together beautifully. Observe, experiment, and fill every space to create the perfect habitat.
70010000117651.intro: Build, Discover, and Bring Nature to Life
70010000117651.name: Habitat Shapes: The Tropical Journey

70010000117657.description:
Conrad wakes up in a hotel room with no memory of who he is or how he got there. What he does know: a deadly virus is tearing through cyberspace, Ankh Industries is behind it, and the clock is already ticking.

Navigate the cyberpunk streets of the City as Conrad, a rogue Courier piecing together the truth. Take on jobs from shady employers, pickpocket and loot to earn credits, and spend them on better guns, stronger armour, and high-tech upgrades. Hack your way through security systems using an intricate beam puzzle minigame, and dig deeper into the conspiracy threatening to bring the whole city down.

- Explore a richly detailed cyberpunk city in a brand new 8-bit adventure
- Earn and spend credits on weapons, armour, and tech upgrades
- Hack security systems with an intricate beam puzzle minigame
- Unravel the mystery behind Ankh Industries and the Courier virus
70010000117657.intro: He woke up with nothing. The city is about to have the same problem.
70010000117657.name: Courier

70010000117662.description:
Shuri, the people of the sky, became a messenger of the golden dragon of the king of the sky and headed for HestiaFort.

In HestiaFort, there is a Red Bird.

Together with Shuri, run through HestiaFort to meet the Red Bird.

In this game, you will avoid the red ball and aim for the blue circle.

Run and fly through stages to reach the goal.
70010000117662.intro: At the end of the blue sky that spreads out like the sea, HestiaFort
70010000117662.name: HestiaFort

70010000117682.description:
The Story:

On your way home from work, a sudden bolt of lightning changes everything. You wake up to find yourself in a strange new land... a world reminiscent of medieval Europe?!

Before you can even get your bearings, you are falsely accused of being the reincarnation of the Evil Witch Queen and dragged off to the royal castle.

Your pleas of innocence fall on deaf ears. With suspicion hanging over you, you are forced to make a choice: select one of five enchanting heroes - who look as if they stepped straight out of a fairy tale - to be your warden and keep watch over you...

Why were you summoned to this world? As you unravel the mysteries binding you here, where will this unexpected love lead?

Characters:

August (The Knight)
Iseul (The Elf Prince)
Saerys (The Demon)
Altea (The Wizard)
Reiner (The Lord)
Helena (The Sorceress)
Alain (The Knight General)

Contents: Main Stories from the app "Lovestruck: Choose Your Romance" up until Season 5.
70010000117682.intro: In a heartbeat, the ordinary becomes legendary. In a world of fantasy, where will your destiny and love lead?
70010000117682.name: Love and Legends

70010000117691.description:
Your friends are scattered across the city, and the rail network is in pieces! Draw colored tracks, reconnect the railroads, and guide trains back to their stations to find your lost buddies and bring everyone home.

With each rescue, your hometown slowly recovers, but the puzzles get trickier. Tunnels, crossroads, and clever obstacles will test your logic and creativity as you invent new routes, solve mind-bending challenges, and restore order to the railways.

Features:
- 1000+ handcrafted logic puzzles!
- Tricky mechanics like gates, crossroads, and obstacles.
- Multiple solutions that reward creative thinking!
- Optional hints to help you through tougher levels.
- A beautiful city full of life waiting to be restored!

Choo Choo! Next station is never-ending fun!
70010000117691.intro: Your train crashed! Find your friends and rebuild your home!
70010000117691.name: Rail Rescue: Puzzle Lines

70010000117715.description:
Get ready for an irresistibly cute adventure in Snack and Quack: Ducklings Steps, a charming puzzle where you help a mother duck take care of her hungry ducklings. In peaceful, water-inspired environments, every move matters as you guide the little ones toward delicious pieces of bread scattered across the path.

With clever and charming challenges, each level invites you to think calmly, plan your moves, and find the perfect solution. It’s the kind of relaxing and satisfying experience where every success brings a smile and every solved puzzle warms your heart.

Colorful, cozy, and full of personality, Snack and Quack: Ducklings Steps is perfect for players who love light puzzles, cute themes, and that delightful “just one more level” feeling.
70010000117715.intro: Quack, Push, and Feed the Ducklings
70010000117715.name: Snack and Quack: Duckling Steps

70010000117727.description:
Step into the forest and enjoy a relaxing moment in Claim the Forest: Shape of Wolves. This is a cozy puzzle game where you must perfectly fill the board with adorable wolf-shaped tiles. Pick up pieces that gently drift along the river, rotate them, test their positions, and find the best combination to fill every space.

The game features 30 charming levels that offer a gentle challenge within a calm atmosphere. Boards vary in size and shape, requiring careful observation and logical thinking to ensure no gaps remain.

With no time pressure and no penalties, Claim the Forest: Shape of Wolves is perfect for players who enjoy relaxing puzzles, cute animals, and the satisfying moment of perfect completion. Follow the rhythm of the river as you adjust each piece and build the ideal forest home for your wolf pack.
70010000117727.name: Claim the forest: Shape of Wolves

70010000117728.description:
Tale of Dark Lands - a magical fantasy action RPG with an elegant low-poly style and the charm of a timeless fairy tale. Immerse yourself in a world of mysteries, perils, and glorious adventures!

A story full of secrets and challenges.
The main hero is a brave mercenary hired by the residents of a small village to defend them against fierce goblin raids. But what begins as a simple job turns into something far greater. Soon, the hero becomes entwined in an ancient dark tale that threatens the entire land, and only he can stop the encroaching darkness.

Create the hero of your dreams.
A flexible character editor lets you craft a hero with a unique appearance.
Develop your character: earn experience, acquire new skills, and grow stronger with every battle!

Immerse yourself in thrilling gameplay.
Gear and customization: Find or buy unique items – from shining swords to sturdy armor, bows, and magical helmets.
Crafting and upgrades: Gather resources, forge powerful equipment at the village blacksmith, and enhance your gear using runes in the Runic Forge.
Unique skill system: Learn new abilities from the experienced skill trader.
A variety of items: Equipment, artifacts for trade, runes, crafting materials – just make sure everything fits in your grid-based inventory.

Game features:
- Story-driven adventure: A rich yet concise gameplay experience.
- Visual style: Beautiful low-poly design that creates a magical fantasy atmosphere.
- Thoughtful inventory system: A convenient grid-based item storage system.
- Crafting and upgrades: Collect resources and craft gear at the blacksmith.
- Trading and economy: Buy equipment, sell unwanted items, and discover rare finds.
- Hero equipment: A vast selection of gear for your character.
- Character customization: Use the editor to create your unique hero.

Tale of Dark Lands is an epic journey filled with secrets, dangerous foes, and incredible rewards. Become the hero who will face the ancient evil and etch your name into legend!
70010000117728.intro: Magical fantasy action RPG with an elegant low-poly style and the charm of a timeless fairy tale.
70010000117728.name: Tale of Dark Lands

70010000117736.description:
Get ready for GluMe, a sliding puzzle game where you control a slime, and any friends you pick up along the way. Move through top-down grid stages, collecting gems across 80 unique puzzles of growing size and complexity.

New challenges keep appearing: sleeping gray slimes wake when touched, turning blue and sticking to you. Use them to cross pitfalls, but don’t grow too big to fit into tight spots. Find the right order to collect gems and uncover secrets. Reset anytime if you get stuck. Enjoy chiptune tunes and retro vibes!

• Move around puzzling stages and collect gems to advance.
• Run into other slimes to wake them up and stick together.
• Use your slimes’ changing shape to get around obstacles.
• Master 80 unique levels presented in retro pixel art style.
• Revisit cleared stages to find secrets you’ve missed.
70010000117736.intro: Stick together to solve brainteasing stages in retro sliding puzzle style!
70010000117736.name: GluMe

70010000117788.description:
Blackspot is a fast paced pirate card duel where every decision could make you a legend or send you to the bottom of the sea.

Draw your card. Read your enemy. Then choose to play it straight, run a bluff, or throw down a taunt. One wrong read and your streak is gone, but walk away too early and you will never know what you left on the table.

Quick, tense duels resolve in seconds with a single bold choice. Face dangerous opponents with distinct personalities, from the sloppy Drunkard to the ruthless Captain.

Endless Arcade mode lets you build your streak, spend your gold, and survive as long as you dare. Challenge Mode offers progressive trials that teach the ropes and push your limits. Local multiplayer brings pass and play duels for two pirates on one Nintendo Switch™.

Deep meta progression allows you to earn Notoriety, unlock relics, cosmetics, and permanent advantages across every run. The Black Spot raises the stakes. Draw the Ace of Spades and you cannot run. You must win or die trying.

Easy to learn. Hard to master. Impossible to put down.
70010000117788.intro: One card. One choice. Dead men don't fold.
70010000117788.name: Blackspot: The Card Game

70010000117789.description:
A World After the Machines Came
On Lana and Mui’s home planet, new technology brings progress but also stirs greed and imbalance. As different tribes adopt it in their own ways, tensions grow and the world’s harmony begins to shift. When those seeking power push too far, Lana and her little companion are pulled into a journey that reveals long-buried truths about their planet and about themselves.

A World That Tells Its Story
Journey across frozen peaks, deep oceans, and forgotten ruins in a hand-painted world where nature meets technology. With no spoken dialogue, characters express themselves through an alien language, letting the world, music, and your choices carry the story and inviting you to find its meaning for yourself.

A Bond at the Center of the Journey
Planet of Lana II is a cinematic puzzle-adventure built around companionship and trust. Guide an older, more agile Lana and her loyal companion Mui as their bond becomes the key to moving forward in a world where beauty and danger live side by side.

Thoughtful Puzzles & Fluid Movement
Puzzles are woven naturally into the world, rewarding awareness, timing, and cooperation instead of complex logic. Turn Lana’s expanded agility, from wall jumps to smooth movement and momentum, into your path through danger.

An Emotional, Carefully Paced Adventure
As Lana and Mui travel, new discoveries unravel the history of their planet and the truth behind Mui’s origins. Their journey grows into an intimate tale of coexistence, responsibility, and the cost of progress, carried forward by a moving orchestral score that gives weight to quiet moments, bold discoveries, and every emotional turn across its 6 to 8 hour adventure.

A Standalone Experience
Planet of Lana II welcomes new players while offering a deeper journey for those returning, an intimate story about connection, resilience, and protecting what still matters in a changing world.

Key Features

A Cinematic Puzzle-Platformer Adventure
A story-driven experience blending exploration, environmental puzzles and cinematic atmosphere.

A Companion-Driven Journey
A heartfelt adventure built around the bond between Lana and her loyal companion, Mui.

A Hand-Painted World in Transition
Explore a beautifully crafted planet where nature and technology collide, and different tribes respond to progress in their own ways.

Fluid Exploration & Movement
Guide an older, more agile Lana with wall jumps, smooth traversal, and dynamic movement across diverse environments.

Thoughtful & Varied Puzzles
Puzzles are woven naturally into the world, focusing on observation, timing, and cooperation rather than complex logic.

Storytelling Without Words
No spoken dialogue. Meaning emerges through visuals, music, and your interactions with the world.

An Emotional, Carefully Paced Sci-Fi Tale
Uncover new truths about the planet and Mui’s past in a 6-8 hour cinematic journey, accompanied by a moving orchestral score.
70010000117789.name: Planet of Lana II

70010000117806.description:
Step into a new chapter of calm and clever challenges in Legends Align Land of Order, a puzzle where every piece has its place and every decision brings you closer to the perfect solution. Set in refreshed environments full of personality, the goal is simple and satisfying: fit different shapes together until the entire board is complete.

With 30 carefully crafted levels, the game invites you to observe, test, and reorganize ideas without rush or pressure. Each layout offers new possibilities, encouraging creative strategies and that clear moment when everything finally aligns.

Easy to understand and pleasant to play, Legends Align Land of Order offers a relaxing experience for players who enjoy visual puzzles, steady progression, and the rewarding feeling of seeing every piece find its place. It is the kind of challenge that calms the mind while keeping your thinking active.
70010000117806.name: Legends Aligned: Land of Order

70010000117812.description:
Welcome to Pie Pie Cafeteria, an irresistible puzzle where round little desserts meet, collide, and transform into increasingly delicious treats. Dive into a charming café where combining identical sweets is the key to fulfilling orders, earning extra time, and keeping everything under control before the mess overflows.

Each stage features a different container, such as boxes, cups, mugs, and even coffee machines, completely changing how sweets fall, roll, and merge. Planning every drop makes all the difference. A well thought out combination can free space, create chain reactions, and save your run at the very last second.

With light physics, a relaxing pace, and clear goals driven by customer orders, Pie Pie Cafeteria offers the perfect balance between strategy and delightful chaos. It is the kind of game that invites you to play just one more level, always discovering a new sweet, a new fusion, or an unexpected solution.

Cozy, addictive, and full of personality, Pie Pie Cafeteria is the ideal puzzle for players who love accessible challenges, cute visuals, and the delicious satisfaction of seeing everything fall into place at the right moment.
70010000117812.name: Pie Pie Cafeteria

70010000117837.description:
▼Work Out with Miku!
Miku will join you as your exercise partner.
As you follow the instructors' actions, they will pump you up with motivational phrases to support you in your daily exercise regimen.
Lin and Evan from Fitness Boxing return as your instructors.
They will assist you in all 99 training menus, so beginners can exercise easily at their own pace.
▼Enjoy "Miku Exercise" for the first time ever in Fitness Boxing!
With this latest entry into the Fitness Boxing series, you can box along to original hits from fan-favorite Piapro Characters like Hatsune Miku, Kagamine Rin, Kagamine Len, and Megurine Luka!
Enjoy not only the fun of exercising to your favorite music, but also the challenging workout provided by the varying beats of the songs.
Challenge yourself to ultra-fast tempos that are sure to get your heart racing!
There are 24 songs in all, including popular hits like "Melt" and "God-ish."
What's more, you can also treat your ears to a brand-new main theme song that was specially written by creators such as cosMo@Bousou-P.
Add in the more than 30 songs that are already part of the Fitness Boxing series, and you'll never run out of ways to enjoy exercising!
▼Dive into the colorful world of Hatsune Miku with new clothes and performances!
Get a sweat going while enjoying countless new outfits designed exclusively for this game.
Players who are new to Fitness Boxing can enjoy all the best that the series has to offer, including its renowned system which helps you monitor your workouts, and its feature allowing you to mark stamps to showcase your progress. Experienced players, too, can enjoy a brand-new and exciting boxing experience through the bright and colorful world of Hatsune Miku.
70010000117837.intro: Get healthier and fitter with Hatsune Miku!
70010000117837.name: Fitness Boxing feat. HATSUNE MIKU Exercise with Miku

70010000117842.description:
But when the gunsmoke clears, one actor isn't getting back up, he's been shot with a live round.
As Lana and Bill investigate, they realize this wasn't an on-stage accident, but a perfectly staged murder.

Now they must track down the killer who turned a performance into an execution.

- Colorful and intuitive solitaire challenges
- Finish compelling quests
- Solve hundreds of solitaire levels
- Crack the case and catch the killer
70010000117842.intro: The stage is set for a classic Wild West shootout at the theme park.
70010000117842.name: Solitaire Crime Stories Chapter 4

70010000117850.description:
Embark Speed Dates, where you control first dates with 18 attractive women in this interactive FMV game. Shape your story with charm and humor for a personalized romantic journey.

Our main character Murat attends the Speed Date event and has only a few minutes to get to know the women and make him love himself. Try to impress the girls in this adventure where you can experience today's male-female relationships in the most realistic way.

Features:
•Stunning 4K visuals
•Over 54 unique paths and 36 distinct endings
•500+ meticulously crafted scenes
•8 hours of immersive storytelling
70010000117850.intro: Shape your story with charm and humor for a personalized romantic journey
70010000117850.name: Speed Dates

70010000117859.description:
*This product is released for the Nintendo Switch. It can also be played on Nintendo Switch 2. However, please note that a separate product, "Dear me, I was...", is available for Nintendo Switch 2.
*Save data and Additional Contents are not compatible between the two versions. Please be careful to avoid duplicate or mistaken purchases.
*Nintendo Switch 2 Edition and Upgrade Pack are not available for this product.

With a beautiful watercolor touch, it depicts the life of a woman.

In her ordinary and modest life...experience her joys, her sorrows, her growth.
Witness the story she spins in a life woven by those around her.

♦A short and simple interactive adventure
♦Vivid visuals captured with watercolor and rotoscoping
♦Memorable theme music and soothing sounds
70010000117859.intro: A short tale, a long journey.
70010000117859.name: Dear me, I was...

70010000117861.description:
"TOP SPEED" is a racing game released by TAITO in 1987.
Enter high-stakes street races where speed is everything, and aim for the finish line while dodging obstacles and avoiding collisions with rival cars.
Using Nitro grants you explosive acceleration. Blow past the competition, leave everyone in your dust, and show them what it means to be the best!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.
70010000117861.name: Arcade Archives TOP SPEED

70010000117866.description:
Play as Blueberry and live through key memories from childhood to old age, piecing together fragments of her past in a deeply emotional story about trauma, resilience, and forgiveness.
Climb the Tower of Life. Go on a journey from childhood to twilight years.

MAKE MEANINGFUL DECISIONS
Guide Blueberry’s journey by making choices that shape her emotional growth. Help her find peace by managing her “blues” and making decisions that support her healing. Each choice impacts her story, leading to different outcomes in her story.

KEY FEATURES
Climb the Tower of Life: Journey through Blueberry’s life stages in an interactive platformer that combines exploration, mystery-solving, and memory reconstruction.

Choices Matter: Face moments of choice that impact Blueberry’s emotional journey, leading to multiple endings based on how you choose to guide her through her past.

Pivotal Life Moments: Steal cookies and cause kitchen chaos as a child, engage in spirited word battles with your mom as a teenager, and embrace the joys and challenges of motherhood as an adult.

Emotional and Philosophical Depth: Experience a moving story that explores themes of trauma, motherhood, forgiveness, and the impact of memory on identity.

Surreal Art and Atmosphere: A colorful yet introspective world that shifts with Blueberry’s emotions and memories, creating a visual journey that mirrors her mental landscape."
70010000117866.intro: Blueberry is a story-driven puzzle platformer that takes you deep into a woman’s mind as she faces her trauma.
70010000117866.name: Blueberry

70010000117867.description:
Farming Camp is a cozy, single-player farm management game that follows the journey of an ambitious teenager competing to become the best farmer in the camp. Manage your farm alongside your companions, complete chores for points, and deal with the dynamics of a colorful cast in their teenage years.

Your path to farming greatness begins!
Step into the boots of young Alessandra, before she became the renowned Evertree Farmer. Experience her life at the Evertree Farming Camp where it all began. Learn the ropes and face the fun and chaos of camp life.

Team up with a lively farming crew
You're not alone on the farm. You’ll have the company of two budding young farmers, each with their own vibe. Assign chores, solve problems, and build friendships as you figure out how to run the farm together.

Heart, humor, and harvests!
Farming’s only half the fun at Evertree Farming Camp. From delightful dramas to silly surprises, and even a few messy moments, there's never a dull day at the camp!

Work hard to take care of the camp
Use the tools at your disposal and climb your way to the top as the camp’s best farming team. Coordinate with your companions and earn points by completing chores, maintaining the camp, attending classes, and tackling missions.

Have fun and win the competition
Jump into quick and fun minigames that keep things exciting—whether it’s racing against the clock to eliminate pests, chopping wood, cooking delicious meals, and more!

Key Features:
- Embark on a cozy single-player farming adventure and follow a unique, captivating story.
- Explore a beautifully hand-drawn 2D top-down world full of charming details.
- Meet a diverse and lovable cast of characters, each with their own quirks, stories, and farming talents.
- Grow a variety of crops, care for animals, fish, and make your team win the competition.
- Keep your farm thriving with fun and engaging mini-games.
70010000117867.intro: Follow the journey of Alessandra competing to become the best farmer in the camp.
70010000117867.name: Farming Camp

70010000117909.description:
Twins or Tens is a fun and relaxing number puzzle game.

Your goal is simple — connect numbers in one line to match identical numbers or create combinations with a total sum of 10. The rules are easy to learn, but the game becomes more challenging as you play.

Think carefully, plan your moves, and clear the board to get the highest score possible. The game is perfect for quick sessions or longer relaxing play.

Game Features:
Easy to learn gameplay
Fun and challenging puzzles
Clean and pleasant visuals
Suitable for all ages
Great way to relax and train your brain

Can you find the best combinations and clear the board?
70010000117909.intro: Twins or Tens — It’s not about the numbers, it’s about your strategy.
70010000117909.name: Twins or Tens

70010000117915.description: Move the Nintendo Switch™ to guide balls through handcrafted mazes.
70010000117915.intro: Move the Nintendo Switch™ to guide balls through handcrafted mazes.
70010000117915.name: Game With Balls

70010000117921.description:
Hoof & Seek is a relaxed hidden-object game set on a charming farm.

Each level takes place on a single screen filled with barns, trees, fences, and other farm scenery. Somewhere in each scene, farm animals are carefully hidden. Your goal is to observe the environment, search every corner, and find them all.

With 40 handcrafted levels, the challenge gradually increases as scenes become more detailed and animals are hidden more cleverly. There are no timers or penalties, allowing you to play at your own pace and enjoy a calm, focused experience.

Simple controls, clear visuals, and short levels make Hoof & Seek easy to pick up and enjoyable for players of all ages. Look closely, stay observant, and uncover every hidden farm animal.
70010000117921.intro: Find all the hidden farm animals.
70010000117921.name: Hoof & Seek

70010000117927.description:
The Story:

Long ago, the kingdom thrived—ringed by vast forests, towering mountains, and tranquil seas. From its high walls, the great castle watched over a peaceful people… until the night Death rode through the gates on a black horse.

It passed silently through the streets, and ruin followed in its wake. Fire spread, plague consumed the weak, and despair swallowed the living. By dawn, the cries had faded, the streets were filled with the fallen, and a terrible curse had taken hold.

Since that day, the kingdom has lived under a broken pact. Every ten years, a chosen soul must descend into the darkness in the hope of ending the curse.

A secret council now prepares the ritual once more, forging a magical six-sided die—an artifact said to shape fate itself. The newly chosen knight rides toward the ten forbidden dungeons, where shadows cling to ancient stone… and deep within, the monsters wait.

The Game:

DecaDungeons™ is a first-person, turn-based dungeon crawler that blends classic DRPG mechanics with a minimalistic, atmospheric 3D pixel-art style.

Descend through ten deadly dungeons, battle powerful foes, and uncover the secrets needed to save the kingdom. Exploration is just as important as survival—hidden throughout the labyrinths are 50 Red Coins, waiting for those who search carefully.

Rare Monsters:

Some encounters carry a 1 in 100 chance to spawn a rare, rainbow-colored monster. These elusive foes grant massive rewards in EXP and gold. Few have seen them—will you be one of the lucky few?

Events:

While exploring, you’ll encounter special events—short scenarios that present three possible choices. Each decision carries risk or reward. Choose wisely… luck does not always favor the bold.

The Council Has Spoken:

The fate of the realm now rests in the hands of the dice-wielding knight.
Will you break the curse… or watch the kingdom fall into darkness?

Key Features:

10 unique, trap-filled dungeons

First-person, turn-based combat

50 hidden Red Coins to discover

Rare monsters with massive EXP and gold rewards

Random events with branching outcomes

Atmospheric 3D pixel-art environments
70010000117927.intro: DecaDungeons™ is a first-person, turn-based dungeon crawler where fate is decided by a magical six-sided dice. Explore 10 deadly dungeons, battle fierce foes, hunt monsters, and survive!
70010000117927.name: DecaDungeons™

70010000117934.description:
Overview

Rei, the main character, is a human spirit bound with the challenging duty of defeating mystical entities of nature, the Kami, to obtain their power.

You are free to pick your fights against the Kami in any order. The game features a dynamic difficulty system where each enemy strength is defined by the player’s chosen path. This means that the very same Kami fought at the very beginning could also be the final boss in a different route. Hope to never leave the one you struggle most to fight last!

Combat Features

Besides sword attacks, dodges, head stomps and other basic abilities, Rei will learn a completely new skill for each defeated Kami. Those will provide further depth to your combat arsenal, be it a stronger dash, a weapon that can execute enemies, the ability to heal and many more!

Player choice is the ultimate power. Taking into account the vastly distinct enemies’ patterns and unique skills granted upon each victory, you will be able to decide how to approach every challenge. It won’t be easy either way, but you can always go back and try something different.

Beyond the Brawl

Gurei is a game about fighting strong enemies, but that’s not all. The Kami inhabit a surreal castle located between the human and spirit worlds. After each victory, Rei comes closer to the realm of spirits, starting to encounter peculiar characters from Japanese mythology. These creatures will add novelty and strangeness to your journey, providing commentary, unique animations, side objectives and obscure secrets.

Unlikely “Friends”

You will get to know the different Kami quite well. When Rei defeats them, she absorbs their power – and their personality. The defeated Kami will be carried around wherever Rei goes, and they’ll surely have stuff to talk about. Sometimes their remarks will be useful information that builds the player’s understanding of the lore and the game mechanics, but sometimes they will be... not so helpful, to put it briefly. Good luck!
70010000117934.intro: An unforgiving game with precise combat. Fight challenging bosses in any order, acquire their unique powers and succeed in your own terms.
70010000117934.name: Gurei

70010000117946.description:
Whisper of the House is a cozy game about organizing and decorating. You'll take on various tasks from the townspeople—helping them move, organize, and clean their spaces. In the process, your gentle touch might make a difference in their lives, and perhaps uncover some hidden stories...

- Take on charming, quirky tasks: moving into new homes, tidying cluttered rooms, preparing new shops, sorting through treasured keepsakes… even tracking down cats!
- Piece together the smallest clues to uncover their unspoken memories, weaving a story where mystery and love intertwine.
- Decorate your own home freely! Over 2,000 pieces of furniture and more than 10 unique home layouts—every space is yours to design.
- Dozens of items also feature custom sound effects—tap the drums, snap a photo, run the tap. In this home, you don't just see it—you hear it.
- But beneath these warm, everyday moments, the town hides something. Perhaps the one destined to uncover the truth… is you.
70010000117946.intro: Help the townspeople move, organize, and clean, perhaps making a difference in their lives and uncovering some hidden stories...
70010000117946.name: Whisper of the House

70010000117951.description:
The city has fallen into chaos. Zombies flood the streets, and only a few people have managed to survive. Among them is a fearless cheerleader who unexpectedly rises as a symbol of hope in the middle of the apocalypse. Her mission is clear: protect what remains of humanity. As she navigates the shattered city, she meets survivors in desperate need of help. By completing their requests, players earn rewards and uncover pieces of the world’s lost story.

Key Features:
• Survival Challenge: Stay alive in a city consumed by zombies.
• Melee Combat: Wield light or heavy katanas, each with a unique fighting style.
• Weapon Upgrades: Customize your blades with powerful enhancements and special effects.
• Character Progression: Boost your attack, increase health, and unlock new abilities.
• Survivor Missions: Assist stranded survivors and gain valuable rewards.
• In-Game Economy: Gather currency and invest in faster upgrades and improvements.
• Apocalyptic Atmosphere: Explore dark streets and ruined districts filled with constant danger.

In this unforgiving world, every decision, every strike, and every step matters. Hold your ground, rise above the chaos, and prove that even in the darkest moments, hope can endure.
70010000117951.intro: Rise in the middle of chaos and defend the last of humanity.
70010000117951.name: Cherry Girls vs Zombie Carnage: Brutal Anime Kawaii

70010000117959.description:
Unlock new weapons and abilities as you battle. Upgrade your characters’ stats with Constellation Ability Trees, equip yourself with powerful relics and slay your enemies before they surround you, or it may be too late…
During Ragnarok, Yggdrasil, the Tree of Life, lost almost all of its energy to sustain the Nine Realms. Only a few heroes will be able to survive the End of the World. Play as Axeldör, a Viking warrior; Thyra, a fierce ranger; or Hafgrim, master of the elements, among many other charismatic survivors.
70010000117959.intro: Nordic Ashes is a challenging Norse inspired roguelite-survivor game, where you’ll have to survive hordes of creatures that come your way.
70010000117959.name: Nordic Ashes: The Complete Saga

70010000117965.description:
In My Winter Drive, every detail counts. You start with nothing but an empty chassis, and piece by piece, you’ll craft it into a fully functional vehicle. But building your car is only half the challenge — the frozen countryside is unforgiving. One wrong move, and your journey could end before it begins. Every decision matters, from managing resources to maintaining your own health, as you push forward through snow, ice, and harsh winds.

Key Features
• Assemble Your Car, Part by Part
Install the engine, mount the wheels, adjust the carburetor, and fine-tune every component. Precision is crucial — even a small mistake can lead to breakdowns.
• Automotive Quests and Practical Tasks
Take on a variety of car-related jobs, from repairs and repainting to more unexpected challenges, earning rewards and improving your skills.
• Survival in the Winter Wilderness
Hunger, fatigue, hygiene, and stress all impact your performance. Manage your supplies wisely and find creative solutions to survive the harsh environment.

Step into a world where car building meets survival. Every journey is a test of skill, patience, and resilience. Are you ready to face the winter and drive your creation to life?
70010000117965.intro: Craft your vehicle and endure the harsh grip of winter.
70010000117965.name: My Winter Drive

70010000117975.description:
The battlefield is set — how you fight decides everything.
Engage in fast-paced encounters where you face enemy forces in score-based missions that reward skill and efficiency.

Every elimination brings you closer to victory, but every mistake gives your opponents the advantage. Staying focused and reacting quickly is the key to controlling the battlefield.

Navigate through a variety of combat zones designed to challenge your positioning and movement. Each environment offers different layouts and tactical opportunities, pushing you to adapt your strategy and approach every encounter differently.

Choose from a wide range of weapons and adjust your playstyle depending on the situation. Whether you prefer aggressive engagements or a more controlled approach, your decisions in combat define your success.
Every mission is built around action, timing, and control — pushing you to improve with every match and dominate every encounter.

Key Features:
-Fast-paced combat focused on skill and reaction
-Score-based gameplay that rewards performance
-Multiple combat environments with different layouts
-Weapon variety for flexible playstyles
-Tactical gameplay based on positioning and timing

Stay sharp, react fast, and take control of every encounter.
In Call of Warfront, victory depends on how you fight.
70010000117975.name: Call of Warfront

70010000117981.description:
Take control of a sleek rolling sphere and blast down a constantly shifting track packed with spinning platforms, deadly hazards, and glowing collectibles. Every second pushes you faster, every decision matters, and one mistake ends the run.

This is instant-action gameplay at its most addictive. Controls are simple, but survival demands focus, precision, and nerves of steel.

Collect dots to rack up points and trigger Frenzy Mode mid-run. In this short burst of unstoppable power, smash through obstacles, shatter barriers, and tear the track apart.
70010000117981.name: Spin Path 2

70010000117991.description:
The objective is quite simple: each level contains numerous uncolored pixels, and it is your job to color them in. Each pixel is numbered; this number corresponds to a color in your palette. Select a color from the palette and paint each corresponding pixel. Correctly color all pixels in a level to finish it!

Coloring Pixels is a great way to wind down; you can just sit back and relax. With 180 levels, you can have hours of fun. This collection contains 8 themed books:
