Candy Book - Candies and sweet treats from around the world in one book, guaranteed to make your mouth water!

Fantasy Maps Book - Maps from mythology, fantasy and everything imaginary!

Pastels Book - Dive into Spring with this calming, cute, pastel book!

Zodiac Book - All 12 signs and various meanings are shown in this book!

Gothic Book - A look back in time to a beloved European culture!

Alchemy Book - Images portray chemistry, alchemy, and even a hint of magic!

Playing Cards Book - An image for each card in a standard deck of playing cards, in the New Deck Order!

Celebration XL Book - Revisit new levels based on some of your favourite books from the past, celebrating the best of Coloring Pixels so far!
70010000117991.intro: A relaxing coloring-by-numbers game. Enjoy completing a variety of images with different themes, levels of complexity, and sizes.
70010000117991.name: Coloring Pixels: Collection 7

70010000117997.description:
You wake up in an enormous, shadow-drenched room filled with the forgotten playthings. Seated across from you at a small wooden table is the Dollmaker – a mysterious, stitched-together doll who is missing an eye. She is your adversary, and you have been chosen to play her macabre game.

To survive, you must prove your skills as a master builder. Analyze the eerie photographs she presents to you and race against the ticking clock to replicate them perfectly. From the drawer of discarded parts, you must select the correct eyes, hats, clothing, and accessories to assemble the requested toy.

But this isn't just about making dolls. You're playing to recover a missing part of yourself. With your opponent's watchful button eyes on you, you must demonstrate focus and precision. One wrong piece or one second too late, and you may remain in the dark forever.
70010000117997.name: Dollmaker

70010000118005.description:
Pro Jank Footy is an absurd and over-the-top arcade sports game.

Score a goal? Your opponent picks a game-changing power-up.

Hinder your opponents, increase your footy abilities with powers that give your team strong legs, or turn the gameplay completely on its head by transforming everyone into footballs – the choice is yours!

Outplay, out-kick, and out-jank your mates in local multiplayer. Or, if you’re shy, conquer single-player season mode.

AUSTRALIAN RULES FOOTBALL LIKE YOU'VE NEVER SEEN IT

Australian Footy is the most attended domestic sports league in the world! 36 players on a field, an obscenely large oval, and a ball that looks like a sunburnt lemon...

For those outside the loop, “Aussie Rules” could mean anything. Pro Jank Footy takes this confusion and runs with it—a fast-paced, comedic sports game where you're constantly changing the rules.

WORLD-CLASS COMEDY

With commentating from Aunty Donna's Broden Kelly and the creative minds of David Ashby and Dario Russo behind cult TV series Danger 5 and Italian Spiderman driving the humor, Pro Jank Footy is jam-packed with comedy, charm and Australianisms.

FEATURES

ROGUELITE GAMEPLAY – Every goal scored lets your opponent choose from over 150+ ridiculous power-ups that completely alter the match. Or, play classic mode for simple, arcade footy with no power-ups.

VERSUS MODES – Face off against AI or challenge your mates.

SEASON MODE – Lead your team through a full season with deck-building mechanics to unlock and customize power-ups as you progress.

RETRO ARCADE NOSTALGIA – Inspired by classic 90s sports games, blending pixel-perfect action with buttery-smooth modern gameplay.

UNIQUELY AUSTRALIAN – Aussie Rules meets Aussie humor. It’s chaotic, unpredictable, and proudly embraces Australian culture.

MULTIPLE TEAMS & STADIUMS – Play as 11 unique teams across 4 iconic stadiums, each with their own quirks, hazards, and surprises.
70010000118005.intro: Score goals to unleash powers in this over-the-top arcade comedy-sports game.
70010000118005.name: Pro Jank Footy

70010000118017.description:
"POLARIS" is a shooting game released by TAITO in 1980.
Take command of a submarine and battle advancing enemy forces using missiles that can only be fired directly upward.
Navigate through a relentless onslaught from all directions—bombers in the sky, frigates patrolling the surface, and mines lurking on the seabed!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.
70010000118017.intro: A glimmer of hope lurking in the deep blue.
70010000118017.name: Arcade Archives POLARIS

70010000118018.description:
In this town, strange incidents never cease.
The cause? Beings born from the darkness of the human heart: Demon Spirits.

Join Satoree Mizuki, a girl who can read others’ minds, and uncover the truth behind these supernatural cases.


■Story

...I can’t remember anything.

Through the haze of my fading consciousness, a girl’s voice faintly echoes in my ears.
When I open my eyes, I find her staring at me, her face filled with uncertainty.

According to her, this town is plagued by Demon Spirits, creatures that lurk in the shadows, bringing disaster to those who cross their path.
And one of them... stole my memories.

With the guidance of this girl, I step into a world of exorcism and supernatural battles without a single clue about my identity.
70010000118018.intro:
I am here, in this world...
A Japanese-style fantasy adventure by Kogado Studio.
70010000118018.name: Dear Mirror Flower

70010000118020.description:
“SHIKA-Q” is an ultra-fast competitive puzzle game where players connect “Links” on a 10×10 board, and victory or defeat is decided in an instant.

The board evolves in real time as attacks, interference, recovery, and special moves unfold simultaneously. With barely a moment to think, players must constantly decide their next move, creating intense tension and speed.

Unlike traditional falling-block puzzle games, blocks do not drop from above. The board begins reacting the moment you place a piece. Because it is a real-time competitive system, players must not only connect Links but also read their opponent’s intentions—creating mind games similar to those found in fighting games.

Every decision directly impacts the outcome. Both strategic thinking and reflexes are essential. Momentum shifts rapidly, and the game state is visually clear, making it exciting not only to play but also to watch—an ideal fit for esports.

The game’s defining feature is its Music.

Vocal tracks and high-energy songs amplify the intensity of battle. Rather than serving as simple background music, the vocal tracks integrate with gameplay flow, directly enhancing tension and momentum. Music, play, and emotion synchronize to create an unprecedented level of immersion.

Game Features
■ Strategy ×Super Speed × Showdown (1–2 Players)

Connect Links on a 10×10 board as offense and defense unfold in real time. Instant decisions determine victory.

Custom settings allow players to adjust the balance between speed and strategy—from slower, thought-focused matches to ultra-high-speed battles.

In addition to Offline Versus, the game also supports Online Battles and Ranked Matches, where split-second judgment determines the winner against players worldwide.

■ Challenge Mode (Single-Player)

A world-ranking-supported solo mode fully synchronized with music.

As stages progress, both the music and gameplay evolve. Manage your health, balance offense and defense, clear all 99 stages, and aim for a high score.

Unlike Versus Mode, this mode emphasizes discovering the optimal solution for each situation.

■ Characters, Worldbuilding & Customization

A diverse cast of characters enhances the competitive experience through unique themes and presentation.

Customize UI design, music, emotes, loading screens, wallpapers, icons, and more to personalize your matches.

Each theme includes dedicated character songs, deepening both musical and narrative immersion.

Tailor the atmosphere to your playstyle and express yourself through battle presentation.

■ DLC Battle Pass – Expanding the Online Experience

The DLC Battle Pass unlocks rewards progressively through mission completion.

It includes premium customization content such as UI designs, music, emotes, loading screens, wallpapers, and icons—enhancing the competitive experience.

The more you play, the more your presentation evolves. Your progress remains visible, supporting a long-term online experience built on growth and achievement.
70010000118020.intro: Strategy × Super Speed × Showdown! Every split second counts.
70010000118020.name: SHIKA-Q

70010000118052.description:
They disturbed a sealed temple. Now, an ancient evil has followed them to Springdale.
When the archaeologists start dying in seemingly "accidental" ways, the town whispers of a curse.

Skeptical but determined, Lana and Bill enter a shadowy world where logic fails, and they must fight an enemy that can't be touched by handcuffs or bullets.

- Colorful and intuitive solitaire challenges
- Finish compelling quests
- Solve hundreds of solitaire levels
- Crack the case and catch the killer
70010000118052.name: Solitaire Crime Stories Chapter 5

70010000118059.description:
A mysterious vigilante is cleaning up Springdale's streets.
The townsfolk cheer, but Detective Bill Mates sees a criminal, and journalist Lana Whitt smells a great story.

To uncover the truth, the duo must track down a hero who doesn't want to be found, and decide where true justice lies in a city dazzled by a cape.

- Colorful and intuitive solitaire challenges
- Finish compelling quests
- Solve hundreds of solitaire levels
- Crack the case and catch the killer
70010000118059.name: Solitaire Crime Stories Chapter 6

70010000118069.description:
A 2D pixel art roguelike space shooter with plugged resource management, procedural levels and challenging bosses!

Hold the controls tight and do not get stranded in the void!

- PLUG "N" SHOOT -
• Plug in to recharge your energy and manage your resources.
• Be Careful! Once plugged, you'll only be able to move within the range of your cable!
• Space is plunged into darkness, activate the spacesockets to clear a level and travel to the next sector.

- FIGHT -
• Choose between 10+ different ships with different gameplay modes!
• Blast your mega-laser!
• Form an army of rescued stranded ships that will fight alongside you!
• Destroy the stages and defeat a large variety of enemies!
• Encounter dangerous and challenging BOSSES after each galaxy in your quest.

- SLOW DOWN TIME -
• Holding the breach, dodging enemy bullets, and piloting through narrow hallways shouldn't be a problem, BUT just in case...
• Your ship is equipped with a futuristic Slow-Mo System that you can use almost whenever you want!
• Luckily for you, it recharges by collecting energy from dead enemies!

- UPGRADE -
• Pick up BATTERIES and discover +250 combinations of bullet modifiers!
• Get CHIPS of temporary upgrades by destroying enemies!
• Choose between more than 40 upgrades for your ship.
• Optimize charge times, improve your firepower, get more cable length...
• Become invisible to enemies.
• And more!
70010000118069.intro: Hyperwired is a classic top-down action shooter, where your spaceship has a plug hanging from it.
70010000118069.name: HYPERWIRED

70010000118107.description:
Archerio is a run-based action roguelike where every room is a new test of aim, movement, and quick decisions. Dash, strafe, and thread your shots through chaotic battles as you fight for “one more room.”

Each run lets you craft a new build with powerful abilities and upgrades — stack elemental arrows, boost crits, summon helpers, or trade safety for damage. Learn enemy patterns, adapt on the fly, and bring down relentless bosses waiting at the end of each push.

Features:
- Fast, responsive 3D archery combat with dodge-and-shoot movement
- Room/wave-based stages that keep the pace high
- A wide pool of upgrades for fresh builds every run
- Varied enemies and intense boss encounters
- Replayable progression that rewards repeated attempts
70010000118107.intro:
A fast-paced 3D archery roguelike.
Clear deadly rooms, stack wild powers, defeat bosses.
70010000118107.name: Archerio

70010000118116.description:
Take control of a brave carrot on a mission to protect its territory in this exciting pixel art platformer. Face challenging enemies and obstacles, using powerful punches, double jumps, and the Dash to overcome action-packed, precise levels.

With fast-paced gameplay, responsive controls, and appealing retro visuals, Carrot Smash delivers a fun and addictive platforming experience from start to finish.

Features:
- Precision platforming with intense action
- Use punches, double jumps, and the Dash to defeat enemies
- Challenging levels full of traps and obstacles
- Charming Pixel Art visual style
- Engaging and energetic soundtrack
70010000118116.intro: A fun and addictive platforming experience from start to finish!
70010000118116.name: Carrot Smash

70010000118122.description:
Follow the courageous explorer Calyssa on her quest to find the entrance to ancient ruins, where a legendary treasure lies hidden. In this intense precision platformer, players will face deadly traps, dark creatures, and a forgotten curse — testing their reflexes and skills to uncover the secrets of the place and survive the dangerous journey.

With a mysterious atmosphere, fast-paced action, and tight controls, Calyssa delivers an engaging experience from start to finish.

Features:
- Challenging platforming focused on precision
- Climb walls, use your Dash ability, and defeat enemies with your sword
- Dark, trap-filled environments
- Unique Pixel Art visual style
- Intense and immersive soundtrack
70010000118122.intro: Follow Calyssa on her quest to find the entrance to ancient ruins!
70010000118122.name: Calyssa

70010000118129.description:
You do not have to worry about the people around you as you consider the situation.
The new diagnostic game about reading a room, ""Consider It"",
has a new subtitle and is now coming to the Nintendo Switch.

The basic rule of reading the situation and moving the red item on the screen remains the same as the old game, but with all-new situations to consider.
Join us in this updated world of being considerate, with a more diverse set of situations
and a much more refined evaluation system.

Play through 100 situations and improve your consideration level in the ""Consider It"" mode.
Test your abilities with a friend or family member in the ""Consider It Together"" mode.
Or see how fast your reaction time is in the ""Quick Consider It"" mode. There are plenty of situations to explore.

Play by yourself, with a friend, or with everyone.
You'll be sure to consider it all here.
70010000118129.intro:
New situations added.
A game that determines whether you have the skills to be considerate in this new world.
70010000118129.name: KUUKIYOMI 2: Consider It More! - New Era

70010000118130.description:
Be considerate without worrying about what others think.
The 3rd installment of Consider It, the game that tests
your social awareness, makes its way to Nintendo Switch™.

The protagonist of this game is the first female ""YOU"" in the series.
The basic rule of deciding what to do in situations by moving the red object on the screen is the same.
But this time around, the sweet air of romance and drama envelope you more than in previous entries.

An all new 100-question Consider It evaluation mode.
A Consider It Together co-op evaluation mode.
The basic modes of the series are all accounted for, such as Quick Consider It mode, which allows you to get a feel of the game.
No matter who you are, you'll be sure to enjoy this game!

Whether alone, with a friend, or with someone you fancy...
You're sure to find things you'll want to consider.
70010000118130.intro:
Third time's a charm.
This is a game that checks your ability to be considerate to attain happiness.
70010000118130.name: KUUKIYOMI 3: Consider It More and More!! - Father to Son

70010000118150.description:
Join the party at Party Land and team up with beloved Sanrio characters to play together in a variety of exciting mini games.

• Immerse Yourself in the Sanrio Universe
Meet over 145 beloved characters and collect their stickers! Team up with one of 16 playable Sanrio characters and play as your own avatar or your favorite teammate.

• Partner Up and Enjoy Exciting Mini Games
Jump into 45+ mini games with friends, either offline or online. Take on Board Game Mode and keep the action going by playing quick Petit Games while you wait for your turn.

• Customize Your Avatar
Design a character that's uniquely yours. Adjust everything from hairstyle to outfits. Unlock even more items as you progress through the game!


*A separate Nintendo Switch™ 2 version is available for purchase. There is no Nintendo Switch 2 Edition upgrade pack for the Nintendo Switch™ version.
*Save data cannot be shared between the Nintendo Switch version and the Nintendo Switch 2 version.
70010000118150.name: Hello Kitty Party Land

70010000118156.description:
Brought to life by director Hu Yaohui and a team of film industry veterans. In this entirely fictional story, step into the role of a hunter of hearts and infiltrate a shadowy organization deep in emotional deceit.

The game features 472 minutes of cinematic footage. Comes with both Standard and Master modes. One purchase gives you the full experience.

You play as Wu Yulun, a man once shattered by betrayal, who deliberately turns himself into bait to strike back at a ruthless gold-digger ring. Step into the murky depths of love and deceit, navigating a perilous game against dazzling women, each one a force to be reckoned with.

A kind yet vulnerable rookie streamer. A model wrapped in candy-coated charm. A popular influencer who bends public opinion to her will. A cold-blooded fixer lurking in the shadows. And above them all, the unseen mastermind orchestrating it all.

This is no lighthearted romance sim. It’s a test of wit, will, and emotional endurance. Will you emerge as the hunter, or become the prey?

With over 200 decisions to make, your choices don’t just shape the story. They quietly tilt the scales of obsession, drawing you toward one of 38 endings.

Will you stand as avenger or redeemer? Yield to temptation, or seal an unholy pact with your sworn enemy? The die of destiny rattles, and your path lies open before you.
70010000118156.intro: The first interactive film game focused on emotional fraud prevention
70010000118156.name: Revenge On Gold Diggers

70010000118177.description:
Only Kitty Cat Up is a cute but brutally addictive climbing adventure where you play as a tiny, fearless cat chasing one simple dream — reach the very top.

Jump from object to object, climb higher and higher, and test your patience, timing, and focus in a journey where every move matters. One small mistake can send you falling back down… but a true kitty never gives up.

This is a game about determination, precision, and that unstoppable “just one more try” feeling.
Soft paws, hard jumps, and a long way to the top.

Cute on the outside.
Challenging on the inside.
70010000118177.intro: A fearless cat and a very long way up!
70010000118177.name: Only Kitty Cat Up

70010000118189.description:
In Hotel Renovator Simulator, you take on the role of a master renovator and manager.
Your task is to restore an old, neglected hotel, transforming it from a pile of rubble into a five-star establishment.
Progress from your very first room to managing a massive hotel complex with 24 unique rooms across multiple floors.

Key Features:

- Complete Restoration: Every project begins with clearing the space. Use the trash bin to get rid of clutter and make room for your future masterpiece.

- Total Transformation: You control every aspect of the finish. Use the hammer to replace old flooring with new tiles, put up fresh wallpaper, repaint walls with a roller, and upgrade ceiling panels.

- Design and Furnishing: After the renovation comes the beautification stage. Choose furniture   from an extensive catalog — from classic Majesty beds to modern Chelsea sofas and Orbit tables. Arrange items in designated zones to create a cozy atmosphere for your future guests.

- A Living Hotel: Your job isn’t limited to just repairs. Greet guests at the reception, hand out keys, and manage their check-ins. Happy guests are the key to your success and your main source of income.

- Economy and Development: Complete restoration tasks to earn money for new materials and furniture. Invest your profits to unlock new floors and expand your business.

- Professional Growth: Master your craft! Upgrade your tools (roller, hammer, spatula) to work faster and more efficiently.
70010000118189.intro: Your hotel. Your design. Your rules.
70010000118189.name: Hotel Renovator Simulator

70010000118214.description:
A psychological horror roguelike where your financial decisions are somehow even scarier than the monster watching you. Six nights. Infinite debt. One cursed slot machine. And something in the darkness that really wants to see how this ends. Good luck. You're going to need it.

- The Gilded Trap. Step into a lavish, one-room royal hall where opulence meets terror. Surrounded by marble columns and flickering crystal chandeliers, you are trapped in a high-stakes gambling nightmare.

- Spin to Survive. Your life depends on the whims of a cursed slot machine. Pull the lever to align lemons, cherries, and crowns to clear an ever-growing debt. Every spin counts when the deadline is breathing down your neck.

- Artifacts and Amulets. Purchase permanent upgrades from a gilded vending machine using hard-earned tokens. From Silver Cherry Rings to the Cursed Diadem, these mystical items manipulate luck and multiply your winnings - if you can afford the price.

- The Entity in the Wall. You are not alone. Glowing eyes watch you from a dark window, offering powerful temporary buffs and risky pacts. Will you accept the creature's aid to cheat fate, or will you succumb to your own greed?

- Risk the Abyss. The "Darkness" Crown (666) lurks within the reels, ready to reset your round's earnings to zero and trigger haunting horror events. Manage your Luck points carefully to guarantee a "Triumph" Jackpot before the darkness claims you.
70010000118214.intro: Spin for your life, pay with your soul.
70010000118214.name: Royal Pit

70010000118220.description:
Welcome to a horror experience set during a long, lonely night inside an empty office building.
What begins as a normal overtime shift quickly turns unsettling. The building grows quiet and the silence becomes almost unbearable. Something about the place feels wrong — as if the office has changed.
As the night continues, reality starts to feel unstable. While moving through the office, the harder it becomes to trust what you see.
You came here to finish your work and go home.
But now it feels like you might not be the only one left in the building.
The office looks the same, yet something here definitely isn’t.
70010000118220.name: Not Human Nightmare

70010000118226.description:
Dive into a world of stunning, realistic puzzles that captivate your eyes and mind. Piece by piece, reveal breathtaking images of beautiful women — each completed puzzle unlocks a new masterpiece, keeping you motivated to discover what’s next.

Smooth and intuitive touch controls make gameplay effortless and deeply satisfying — you’ll feel like you’re truly shaping every picture with your own hands. Gentle, soothing music sets the perfect mood, helping you unwind while your curiosity pulls you to complete the next challenge.

Relax, enjoy, and let yourself get lost in the details.

Features:
• Addictive, easy-to-play puzzle mechanics.
• Gorgeous, realistic artwork of women.
• Satisfying touch interaction — every move feels natural.
• Unlock new, even more stunning images as you progress.
• Perfect balance of challenge and relaxation.
• Soothing soundtrack that enhances your focus and mood.
• Admire each completed image in full detail.
70010000118226.intro: Every piece brings you closer to perfection!
70010000118226.name: Photo Girls: Secret Footage

70010000118231.description:
The Witch's Bakery is a cozy Adventure RPG about a joyful witch who opens her bakery in modern Paris. She has one special power: she can see into people's heart and heal emotions through magic!

YOUR DAILY LIFE AS A WITCH-BAKER IN PARIS!
You play as Lunne, who has just arrived in the city! Each day is split into three phases:

-Daytime, where Lunne manages her bakery and serves clients with her team of friends.
-Evening, where Lunne explores Paris, builds relationships, discovers the city's secrets and goes inside her friends' troubled heart.
- Night, where Lunne rests, improves her magic, decorates her bakery and spends time in her cosy atelier.

The story progresses through the days as you earn experience, money, and fame, meet new friends and heal their heart.

A COLORFUL PARIS IN A JOYFUL ADVENTURE!
Once your work day is done, you can visit several districts of Paris to meet with main characters, engage in activities to learn new skills, buy books for new recipes, etc.
From typical streets of famous districts like Montmartre and the Grands Boulevards, to more intimate promenades known only by locals, Paris has many wonders to discover.Each district has its own characters, activities and shops!

A STORY ABOUT EMOTIONS AND VULNERABILITY
For some people, their emotion is locked away so strongly than Lunne needs to go inside their heart to help them. She enters their "Heart Palace", a magical space where emotions and thoughts take shape. Lunne needs to guide the personified Emotion back to the heart.

Inside the Heart Palace, Lunne discovers the person's deepest struggles and finds the key ingredient she needs to make a bread that will heal them!


This product is released for the Nintendo Switch™. It can also be played on Nintendo Switch™ 2. However, please note that a separate product, "The Witch's Bakery", is available exclusively for Nintendo Switch 2.
Save data and Additional Contents are not compatible between the two versions. Please be careful to avoid duplicate or mistaken purchases.
Nintendo Switch 2 Edition and Upgrade Pack are not available for this product.
70010000118231.intro: The Witch's Bakery is a cozy Adventure RPG about a joyful witch who opens her bakery in modern Paris!
70010000118231.name: The Witch's Bakery

70010000118274.description:
Prepare your mind and take a deep breath… the ancient monks have left a challenge waiting for you.

In Cipher Monk: Ancient Calculus, numbers are not just numbers — they are mysterious symbols from an ancestral system that you must decipher. Drag, rotate, and position the pieces correctly to reveal the hidden answer in each puzzle.

With 35 carefully crafted levels, the game blends numerical logic with a calm, minimalist atmosphere. Each stage feels like a small ritual of focus: observe the symbols, test combinations, adjust positions… until everything aligns perfectly.

No pressure, no complications — just you, the ancient numbers, and that delightful feeling of understanding something that seemed impossible just moments before.

If you enjoy smart challenges, relaxing puzzles, and the quiet satisfaction of solving a mystery, Cipher Monk: Ancient Calculus is your next moment of enlightenment.
70010000118274.intro: The Secret of the Sacred Numbers
70010000118274.name: Cipher Monk: Ancient Calculus

70010000118284.description:
Plungeez is an exploration-focused puzzle-adventure that puts your mind to the test. Dive deep into a complex underground sewer system in the historic city of Salvador, Brazil, where progress isn’t measured by brute force, but by perception and logic.

Run, push, activate, and explore. Like a Metroidvania, Plungeez’s map is vast and full of hidden connections that require you to go back and forth to solve the central mysteries. With no combat distractions, you can fully focus on the mechanics of each puzzle and the unique atmosphere of this pixel-art world.
70010000118284.intro: Explore the underground labyrinth of a historic city’s sewers and uncover secrets in an interconnected world.
70010000118284.name: Plungeez

70010000118290.description:
Take mass destruction anywhere with Mechaconda! In this frantic arcade experience, you control a bio-mechanical weapon that grows in real-time. Maneuver your long body through dangerous arenas, collecting upgrade cards to install destructive weapons on every new segment.

With optimized controls for handheld mode, Mechaconda demands quick reflexes: the larger you get, the greater your firepower, but also the bigger the target for enemies. Choose your strategy from over 30 ability cards, defeat Dr. EVIL’s colossal bosses, and dominate the arena in this addictive blend of action and evolutionary survival!
70010000118290.intro: The classic “eat-and-grow” is now a weapon of mass destruction!
70010000118290.name: Mechaconda

70010000118321.description:
Fantasy Maiden Wars is a classic tactical RPG with a diverse cast of iconic Touhou Project heroines. Explore the expansive world of Gensokyo, a fantastical realm where humans, yokai, and gods exist side-by-side. Seek out the source of supernational incidents disturbing the peace across the land.

◆Classic Tactical RPG Gameplay
Deploy your units across grid-based maps, take down enemies with strategic positioning and turn-based tactics, and clear stages to progress the story.
Multiple difficulty levels and a full-featured tutorial system make this a perfect entry point for players new to the genre—while offering plenty of depth for veterans.

◆Dynamic Combat Animations
Engage in beautifully animated battles whenever characters clash. From sword slashes and gunfire to devastating Spell Card finishers, every attack is brought to life with flair.
Watch your favorite characters unleash flashy moves in the rich, vibrant world of Gensokyo.

◆70+ Playabele Characters and Deep Customization
Customize your squad between missions in the Intermission screen—equip gear, assign skills, and build the dream team your way.
Each character has unique traits and signature abilities, opening the door to countless team compositions and strategies. Go all-in on your favorites or hunt down the most broken combos—how you play is up to you.

◆A Massive Story Blending the Touhou Universe
Choose between shrine maiden Reimu Hakurei or magician Marisa Kirisame as your protagonist—your choice will impact parts of the story.
The game weaves together reinterpretations of storylines from across the Touhou Project series, uniting them into a single, epic narrative arc for both newcomers and longtime fans.

◆More Than Just a Game - Dive into the World of Touhou
Beyond the gameplay, enjoy a rich selection of bonus content:
- A detailed character and terminology encyclopedia that introduces the world of Touhou
- A massive music room with over 200 tracks from the game
- Perfect for both Touhou veterans and those just beginning their journey into Gensokyo.
70010000118321.intro:
A tactical RPG with over 70 Touhou characters!
Enjoy diverse skills and flashy Spell Cards.
Fun for everyone, from beginners to veterans!
70010000118321.name: Fantasy Maiden Wars - DREAM OF THE STRAY DREAMER -

70010000118328.description: Enter a captivating realm steeped in the exotic and bizarre tapestry of Japanese mythology with Talespinner, a deck-building roguelike adventure. As the storyteller, you will guide your chosen hero through an ever-changing narrative shaped by your decisions and deck construction.
70010000118328.intro: A roguelike deckbuilder where you control the narrative.
70010000118328.name: Talespinner

70010000118334.description:
Mr. Stackman is a simple arcade survival game where blocks keep falling from above.

Move your character, stack the blocks, and try not to get crushed. Build your way up, stay in safe spots, and survive as long as you can while the game gets faster and harder.

Easy to understand and quick to play, Mr. Stackman is perfect for short sessions and high-score challenges.

Features:
 • Simple and easy controls
 • Endless falling blocks
 • Survival gameplay — last as long as you can
 • Increasing difficulty
 • Great for quick play anytime

How long can you survive?
70010000118334.name: Mr. Stackman

70010000118355.description:
Don’t Mess With Bober is an atmospheric first-person horror game inspired by 1980s classics, where a seemingly innocent vacation turns into a nightmare. A small mistake during your holiday can unleash the wrath of an enraged Beaver seeking revenge. Immerse yourself in a chilling experience filled with tension, suspense, and classic horror elements.

FEATURES
> River fishing
> Hide-and-seek and chase mechanics
> Good graphics
> A beaver
> A walk in the fresh air (at least in the game)
70010000118355.intro: An 80s-inspired horror thriller where a careless vacation turns into a nightmare
70010000118355.name: Don't Mess With Bober

70010000118382.description:
Throw logic to the wind and embrace your instincts! The legendary zombie hunter Juliet is finally back!

 Lollipop Chainsaw, which sold 1.24 million copies worldwide, is back with the latest graphics!
 The cheerleader Juliet, born into a family of zombie hunters, uses her trusty chainsaw to rip and tear through the undead! But now that RePOP adds speedier chainsaw action and auto-fire for her chainsaw blaster, the action never slows down till the very end! And it's not just the gameplay that's been improved, the visuals and soundtrack have been powered up too! Don't miss out on this unparalleled zombie hunting adventure!

 ＜STORY＞
 The story starts in San Romero High School, the largest high school in the district, somewhere on the west coast of the US of A. Protagonist Juliet Starling, is an exemplary student of San Romero who passionately loves cheerleading. Unbeknownst to most, however, her family, the Starlings, has been a lineage of zombie hunters, guiding the undead to beyond since ancient times…
 The incident unfolds on Juliet's birthday. She heads to school to meet her boyfriend, but as she pedals her bicycle into the school grounds, she is greeted by the sight of her former schoolmates, who have all been turned into zombies!
70010000118382.intro: The legendary zombie hunter Juliet is back in full HD!
70010000118382.name: LOLLIPOP CHAINSAW RePOP

70010000118384.description:
Worlds are colliding in Sonic the Hedgehog’s high-speed adventure! In search of the missing Chaos emeralds, Sonic becomes stranded on an ancient island teeming with unusual creatures. Battle hordes of powerful enemies as you explore a breathtaking world of action, adventure, and mystery. Accelerate to new heights and experience the thrill of high-velocity, open-zone platforming freedom as you race across the five massive Starfall Islands. Jump into adventure, wield the power of the Ancients, and fight to stop these new mysterious foes. Welcome to the evolution of Sonic games!

Experience All-New Open Zone Platforming
Race across five massive overworld islands brimming with dense forests, overflowing waterfalls, and sizzling desert landscapes, each with their own unique action-platforming challenges and hidden secrets to uncover.

Unparalleled High-Speed Freedom
Adventure across the Starfall Islands and see what each has to offer at the speed that only Sonic can deliver. Blaze a trail as you see fit and discover side quests, solve puzzles, scale enormous structures, go fishing, and encounter a friendly face or two along the way…

Challenge Yourself In Cyber Space
Discover portals scattered across the island and venture into Cyber Space levels through portals scattered across the islands featuring signature 3D platforming at Sonic speeds, packed with challenges to put your skills to the test.

Cyber-Powered Combat
The Starfall Islands are home to strange creatures Sonic has never encountered before. Use the all-new battle system and skill tree upgrades to fight strategically, combining moves such as dodges, parries, counters, combos, and the new Cyloop ability to take down mysterious foes and colossal titans.

A New Adventure Full of Mystery and Intrigue
Become Sonic and journey to uncover the mysteries of the remains of an ancient civilization plagued by robotic hordes. With nothing but a handful of questions and a disembodied voice to guide you, set out to save your friends and the enigmatic inhabitants of the Starfall Islands from a colossal, mechanized threat.
70010000118384.name: Sonic Frontiers

70010000118394.description:
A side-scrolling shooter sensation returns, bigger and bolder than ever before! Blending traditional arcade gameplay with scorching HD visuals and rocking audio presentation, Söldner-X 2: Final Prototype Definitive Edition is laser-focused on bringing everything the genre is known for into the current generation, from its sophisticated sci-fi narrative to strategic weapon juggling and rewarding power-up mechanics inspired by genre classics.

Dynamic score-linked difficulty, a challenge mode that rewards skillful performance with bonus features, devastating limit attacks and a pumping soundtrack with 30 original music pieces are just the beginning. Online scoreboards, stunning weapon and boss effects, rebalanced difficulty and a new gallery mode are now included. This is the ultimate realization of Söldner-X 2, fully revised and reborn!

• Master 10 stages of blistering shoot’em up action!
• Choose from 3 ships, each tuned for a unique play style.
• Take down fierce and gigantic bosses!
• Unlock a variety of bonuses, some useful and others purely prestigious.
• Discover the brand new gallery mode.
• Enjoy HD presentation in 60 fps with almost no load times!
70010000118394.intro: Experience the complete version of a modern shoot’em up classic packed with intense side-scrolling bullet hell action!
70010000118394.name: Söldner-X 2: Final Prototype Definitive Edition

70010000118427.description:
Dive into the depths of a massive underground military facility in Deep Combat, a high-intensity 2D action platformer packed with danger and futuristic warfare. Play as an elite soldier sent far below the surface to eliminate advanced threats, survive brutal ambushes, and push through increasingly hostile sectors.

With fluid combat, tight controls, and a tense sci-fi atmosphere, Deep Combat delivers an intense and immersive action experience from beginning to end.

Features:
- Fast-paced 2D action platforming
- Fluid combat with responsive controls
- Futuristic enemies, traps, and high-tech hazards
- Constant tension with ambushes and dynamic encounters
70010000118427.intro: Survive brutal ambushes, and push through increasingly hostile sectors!
70010000118427.name: Deep Combat

70010000118433.description:
By day, they are untouchable icons.
By night… they are men with secrets.

The city sees fearless superheroes: symbols of strength, protectors of justice, living legends.
But when the masks come off, you discover the truth hidden beneath power and perfection.

Desire.
Tension.
Control.
Vulnerability.

Dangerous Superheroes After Dark: Heroes Behind the Mask is a narrative-driven gay dating visual novel where your choices shape your relationship with powerful anime superheroes living double lives.

Each hero hides more than his identity.
Behind the public image lies pressure, expectation… and a connection he can’t risk.

You’re not just another civilian.

You’re the one man who sees him, not the symbol, but the person.

Will you break through his walls?
Will you protect his secret?
Or will passion blur the line between hero and something far more dangerous?


FEATURES:

● POWERFUL HERO CAST: Meet anime superheroes with unique abilities, strong personalities, and hidden weaknesses.

● SECRET IDENTITIES: Discover who they really are when the mask comes off.

● CHOICE-DRIVEN ROMANCE: Your decisions influence trust, intimacy, and destiny.

● MULTIPLE STORY ROUTES: Each hero has branching paths and exclusive scenes.

● DIFFERENT ENDINGS: Romance, betrayal, obsession, redemption… or heartbreak.

● HIGH REPLAY VALUE: Unlock new dialogue, hidden moments, and alternate outcomes.


He fights villains in the shadows.
Will you be the one he lets in… after dark?
70010000118433.intro:
When the city sleeps, their control begins to slip.
Behind every mask… there’s a man who could ruin you.
Will you earn his trust or surrender to the danger?
70010000118433.name: Dangerous Superheroes After Dark: Heroes Behind the Mask

70010000118439.description:
Dive into a world of stunning, realistic puzzles that captivate your eyes and mind. Piece by piece, reveal breathtaking images of beautiful women — each completed puzzle unlocks a new masterpiece, keeping you motivated to discover what’s next.

Smooth and intuitive touch controls make gameplay effortless and deeply satisfying — you’ll feel like you’re truly shaping every picture with your own hands. Gentle, soothing music sets the perfect mood, helping you unwind while your curiosity pulls you to complete the next challenge.

Relax, enjoy, and let yourself get lost in the details.

Features:
• Addictive, easy-to-play puzzle mechanics.
• Gorgeous, realistic artwork of women.
• Satisfying touch interaction — every move feels natural.
• Unlock new, even more stunning images as you progress.
• Perfect balance of challenge and relaxation.
• Soothing soundtrack that enhances your focus and mood.
• Admire each completed image in full detail.
70010000118439.intro: Every piece brings you closer to perfection!
70010000118439.name: Hentai House: Puzzle Nights

70010000118445.description:
Dive into a world of stunning, realistic puzzles that captivate your eyes and mind. Piece by piece, reveal breathtaking images of beautiful women — each completed puzzle unlocks a new masterpiece, keeping you motivated to discover what’s next.

Smooth and intuitive touch controls make gameplay effortless and deeply satisfying — you’ll feel like you’re truly shaping every picture with your own hands. Gentle, soothing music sets the perfect mood, helping you unwind while your curiosity pulls you to complete the next challenge.

Relax, enjoy, and let yourself get lost in the details.

Features:
• Addictive, easy-to-play puzzle mechanics.
• Gorgeous, realistic artwork of women.
• Satisfying touch interaction — every move feels natural.
• Unlock new, even more stunning images as you progress.
• Perfect balance of challenge and relaxation.
• Soothing soundtrack that enhances your focus and mood.
• Admire each completed image in full detail.
70010000118445.intro: Every piece brings you closer to perfection!
70010000118445.name: Photo Girls: Raw Photo

70010000118458.description:
By day, they are symbols.

By night… they are something else.

The city worships them as fearless heroines: guardians of justice, icons of power, untouchable legends.
But when the lights fade and the masks come off, you discover a side no one else is allowed to see.

Strength. Doubt. Desire. Vulnerability.

Dangerous Superheroes After Dark: Heroines Behind the Mask is a narrative-driven dating visual novel where your choices shape your relationship with powerful anime superheroines hiding more than just their identities.

Each heroine carries a double life.
A public symbol of perfection… and a private world filled with secrets, pressure, and temptation.

You’re not just another civilian.

You’re the one person who sees the woman behind the legend.

Will you earn her trust?
Will you protect her secret?
Or will passion blur the line between hero and something far more dangerous?


Features:

● POWERFUL HEROINE CAST: Meet anime superheroines with unique powers, personalities, and hidden weaknesses.

● SECRET IDENTITIES: Discover who they really are when the mask comes off.

● CHOICE-DRIVEN ROMANCE: Your decisions influence trust, intimacy, and destiny.

● MULTIPLE STORY ROUTES: Each heroine has branching paths and exclusive scenes.

● DIFFERENT ENDINGS: Romance, betrayal, obsession, redemption… or heartbreak.

● HIGH REPLAY VALUE: Unlock new dialogue, hidden moments, and alternate outcomes.


She fights villains in the shadows.

Will you be the one she lets in… after dark?
70010000118458.intro:
When the city sleeps, their secrets awaken.
Behind every mask… there’s a woman who could break you.
Will you uncover the truth or fall for the danger?
70010000118458.name: Dangerous Superheroes After Dark: Heroines Behind the Mask

70010000118473.description:
The Island is an Escape Room where you have to make your way through intelligence and lateral thinking. You will solve a huge number of puzzles while discovering an interesting story and moving through the corners of an island full of challenges. Search for clues, find objects and secrets and keep a cool head, because only then you will be able to get out alive from The Island.


Features
- Dozens of puzzles that will challenge your mind
- Large island with different atmospheres
- A story that will keep you hooked
- From escape room lovers to escape room lovers
70010000118473.intro: You wake up on an unknown island, alone and without help. Will you be able to solve the mysteries it contains? Will you find out how you got there? Could you escape from The Island?
70010000118473.name: The Island - Escape Room

70010000118557.description:
HERE’S THE PLAN!
Get famous or die trying! Content Warning is a co-op horror game where you film spooky stuff with your friends to try and go viral.

Step One: Go Down to the Old World
Squad up, customize your face with the ASCII face customizer, buy some gear and use the diving bell to go down to the Old World!

Down there you’ll encounter scary physics-animated monsters, cursed relics and other artefacts!

Step Two: Film something scary
Film as many scary things as possible before you run out of oxygen, or friends…

Step Three: Upload to SpöökTube
If you survive, you need to get back in the diving bell to transport you and the remaining members of your team to the surface.

Upload your chaotic footage to SpöökTube, settle in for a watch party, and wait for the views to tick up!

And… Profit!!
Every run goes on for 3 days, the more scary stuff you film, the more you go viral. The ad revenue from your SpöökTube videos enables you to upgrade your gear to film better videos and survive more easily in the Old World.

If your team accumulates enough views in three days - you get to keep going with your SpöökTube Career and live a life of fame and fortune!

You can also sign up for sponsorship deals to earn MC to purchase island upgrades and hats!

WHAT COULD POSSIBLY GO WRONG!

Game Features
In-game handheld working video camera
2-4 player online coop
Voice chat
ASCII face customisation
Make and save in-game recordings
Your friends looking and acting silly
Scary animated physics monsters
Cursed artefacts
Flashlights (many)
Fame (maybe)

Store: Use your Ad revenue to buy fun and useful stuff
For every video you upload to SpöökTube you get ad revenue to spend on fun and useful items in the store, like upgraded gear, emotes, props and medical equipment!
Have fun!

This product is released for the Nintendo Switch. It can also be played on Nintendo Switch 2. However, please note that a separate product is available exclusively for Nintendo Switch 2.
Save data and Additional Contents are not compatible between the two versions. Please be careful to avoid duplicate or mistaken purchases.
Nintendo Switch 2 Edition and Upgrade Pack are not available for this product.
70010000118557.intro: Film your friends do scary things to become SpöökTube famous! (strongly advised to not go alone)
70010000118557.name: Content Warning

70010000118570.description:
Jump into a party game for up to 4 players, starring characters from
The Legend of Dark Witch Episode 4!

Play locally and compete in 6 fast-paced mini-games,
where magic isn’t just for winning — it’s for messing with your friends.

-Magic Changes Everything
Each character can use unique magic to interrupt, trap, or turn the tide at the worst possible moment.

Winning isn’t just about skill —
it’s about timing your magic and causing chaos.

-Familiar Faces, New Battles
Fan-favorite characters return in a completely new party game format.
Easy to pick up, hard to master — and always unpredictable.

-6 Different Mini-Games
Every game has its own rules, pace, and strategy.
Short rounds, quick rematches, and nonstop laughs.
70010000118570.intro: Chaotic Party Action with Dark Witch Characters!
70010000118570.name: Versus One

70010000118604.description:
No need for expensive lessons or a bulky piano!
Joy Piano is an "Edutainment" game designed to help children build a solid musical foundation and feel the thrill of performing world-famous songs.

■ Master the Basics: 23-Step Curriculum
From rhythm and note reading to two-handed play and chords! Following our 23 structured lessons makes mastering piano basics natural and fun. Achieve the grand finale—playing "Canon"!

■ 20 Beloved Global Classics & Nursery Rhymes
Featuring 20 hits like "Twinkle Twinkle Little Star," "Chopsticks," and "Old MacDonald Had a Farm." Playing familiar tunes boosts confidence and focus.

■ 2 Guided Learning Modes

Note Mode: A visual, intuitive way to learn rhythm by following falling notes.

Sheet Music Mode: A practical mode to learn key positions by reading real notes.

Speed Control: Adjust the tempo to match your child's pace so they can finish every song with a smile.
70010000118604.intro:
The Perfect Start to Your Child's Musical Journey.
From basic notes to Canon, learn to play like magic through fun gameplay!
70010000118604.name: Joy Piano

70010000118610.description:
◆Live in the Japanese countryside surrounded by nature

Fix up an old house, make the yard nice, grow your own crops, and become self-sufficient.
View the cherry blossoms in the spring;
attend the festival in the summer;
eat roasted sweet potatoes in the fall;
hear the temple bell ring in winter, and then it's time for the first shrine visit of the New Year.

◆Self-Sufficiency: Hard Work, Deep Flavor

Rice --- the essential source of energy for the people in Japan.
Salt, soy sauce, miso ---- seasonings no Japanese kitchen can do without.
In this countryside, many things city dwellers take for granted must be made by hand.
By standing in the kitchen or cooking around the traditional irori hearth of your heritage home,
you can simulate preparing a wide variety of dishes and seasonings.
Food made through your own effort tastes extra special.
Don't be surprised if the game makes you hungry!

◆Bring back life to the village through various events

Many events unfold depending on the season, location, and time of day.
A villager might ask you to repair an old waterwheel,
or to help reopen a shuttered candy shop.
Strengthen your relationships with the locals and restore the liveliness the village once had.
As you complete requests and interact with the villagers, you may earn useful items or unlock new areas to explore.


■Game Features

- Grow crops, gather materials, and produce goods to gradually improve your heritage home.
- Enjoy a wide variety of activities, including fishing and bug catching.
- Meet many villagers in your new hometown, help them with their troubles, and complete missions to open up new areas.
- Over 100 hours of total playtime packed with numerous in-game missions.


■Game System

Your journey begins as the protagonist, a newcomer from the city, starts a solitary life in an old countryside house.
Start by clearing the overgrown weeds, cleaning the floors, and repairing the "shoji" paper screens.
By the time you've completed the tutorial, you'll have learned the basics of village life.
Each morning, an elderly woman visits to sell daily necessities, and each afternoon, a man arrives to buy items you no longer need. Buy and sell goods as you steadily gather everything required to thrive in the village and complete your missions.
70010000118610.intro: A relaxing slow-life simulation game where you can experience the charm of traditional Japanese countryside living, all in a beautifully crafted pixel-art world.
70010000118610.name: Japanese Rural Life Adventure

70010000118617.description:
Celebrate 30 years of Pokémon™ with this Nintendo Switch™ version of the Pokémon FireRed Version game originally released on the Game Boy™ Advance system! Explore the Kanto region, discover wild Pokémon around every corner, and aim to complete your Pokédex as you battle your way to success. Earn badges as you develop winning strategies to use against each experienced Gym Leader, and uncover amazing secrets in your quest to be the best Trainer.

These digital exclusives contain the Sevii islands, where even more Pokémon await. You can also visit the Pokémon Wireless Club to trade, battle, and chat with other players via local wireless!
70010000118617.intro: Set off on a grand adventure to become the Pokémon League Champion—now on Nintendo Switch™!
70010000118617.name: Pokémon FireRed Version

70010000118622.description:
Celebrate 30 years of Pokémon™ with this Nintendo Switch™ version of the Pokémon LeafGreen Version game originally released on the Game Boy™ Advance system! Explore the Kanto region, discover wild Pokémon around every corner, and aim to complete your Pokédex as you battle your way to success. Earn badges as you develop winning strategies to use against each experienced Gym Leader, and uncover amazing secrets in your quest to be the best Trainer.

These digital exclusives contain the Sevii islands, where even more Pokémon await. You can also visit the Pokémon Wireless Club to trade, battle, and chat with other players via local wireless!
70010000118622.intro: Set off on a grand adventure to become the Pokémon League Champion—now on Nintendo Switch™!
70010000118622.name: Pokémon LeafGreen Version

70010000118648.description:
The world needs you!
AereA is a music-themed Action RPG in which you play as one of Great Maestro Guido’s disciples and explore Aezir; a floating island that was broken into pieces. Your mission is to find and return the nine primordial instruments to restore balance and peace to the world. You have to find your way through all parts of the scattered islands; complete quests, solve puzzles, defeat bosses and discover the truth behind the islands. Will you be able to return the nine primordial instruments?

Features
Enjoy the beautifully hand-drawn music themed graphic style
Play as 4 different characters, each with their own unique set of abilities
Fight 9 unique bosses, inspired by a specific musical instruments
Switch to local co-op to form a team with up to 4 friends at any time
70010000118648.intro: AereA is a music-themed Action RPG in which you play as one of Great Maestro Guido’s disciples and explore Aezir
70010000118648.name: AereA

70010000118660.description:
A chill world of puzzling challenges awaits in Pengilo, a physics-driven platformer where you fling a bouncy penguin through charming winter landscapes. Across 50 levels, collect stars and grab the key to unlock the exit, mastering precision launches to escape every frosty challenge!

Bounce your penguin at least once and you’ll even be able to change directions midair, slowing down time and re-aiming to hit your target or avoid pitfalls and spike traps. Enjoy cozy and casual brainteasing gameplay at your own pace, all accompanied by a mellow soundtrack.

• Enjoy physics-based platforming across 50 puzzling stages.
• Fling your penguin with precision to reach the exit.
• Grab the key and collect stars along the way.
• Slow down time and change direction midair.
• Replay cleared stages to improve your skills.
70010000118660.intro: Bounce your penguin with precision as you master brainteasing stages in chill wintry style!
70010000118660.name: Pengilo

70010000118665.description:
Take the role of a young man named Nahuel as he travels to his mother’s hometown of San Adraín, a quiet and remote village that he’s never visited before… or so he believes. What Nahuel finds in San Adraín feels oddly familiar, perhaps too familiar to simply be because of the stories his mom told him. The family home almost seems haunted, the townspeople are cautious and distant, everything smells of firewood and neighbors he’s never met act as if they recognize him.

The Fissure is a mature and atmospheric visual novel adventure, a narrative mystery about memory and buried secrets. Guide Nahuel as he explores San Adraín, making key decisions for him along the way. Your choices will determine how the tale unfolds, leading to multiple possible endings and adding new scenes to your gallery. Consider the clues you gather to use in subsequent playthroughs in hopes of uncovering the truth of San Adraín and how Nahuel is connected to its many mysteries!

• Guide a young man as he travels to a remote family home shrouded in old secrets!
• Make key decisions to uncover clues and directly impact the story.
• Explore mature themes across multiple narrative paths and endings!
• Meet memorable characters and investigate hauntingly atmospheric locales.
• Discover the truth of San Adrain and your own past!
70010000118665.intro: Investigate the mystery of an old family home in atmospheric visual novel style!
70010000118665.name: The Fissure

70010000118694.description:
Momento is a cozy room decorator with a twist: the objects you choose will alter the course of the story! Decorate your room, choose which items are important to you, and discover how these choices play out over the course of a lifetime.

Begin in childhood, picking out toys that represent your dreams for the future. Follow those dreams into adulthood, exploring wildly different settings and themes. Uncover stories of heartbreak, wonder and love, and learn the significance behind the sentimental treasures that follow you throughout. Pay close attention - some objects may be more than they seem at first glance.

Click your way through a delightfully tactile world, switching on lights, leafing through books, petting adorable animals, and more! Collect items and furniture in story mode to play with in the endless creative mode. At the end of it all you return to the very beginning, to discover new endings, fresh twists in the path, and explore an evolving story of love and loss.

Embark on a journey where the objects you choose to keep influence the life you lead.

Features:
• Decorative freedom: There’s no right or wrong way to arrange your space!
• Choices matter: Watch small decisions ripple over a lifetime!
• Explore freely: Search every nook and cranny of the level. There’s surprises behind every corner!
• Creative mode: Unlock items and furniture to decorate your own room in creative mode!
• Easter eggs: Solve puzzles to uncover special rewards.
• Gorgeous vibes: Immerse yourself in relaxing scenery and lovely music!


This product is released for the Nintendo Switch. It can also be played on Nintendo Switch 2. However, please note that a separate product, "Momento", is available exclusively for Nintendo Switch 2.
Save data and Additional Contents are not compatible between the two versions. Please be careful to avoid duplicate or mistaken purchases.
Nintendo Switch 2 Edition and Upgrade Pack are not available for this product.
70010000118694.intro: Momento is a cozy room decorator with a twist: the objects you choose will alter the course of the story!
70010000118694.name: Momento

70010000118700.description: Dash through a frozen world as a brave seal in this dynamic endless runner! Avoid cracking ice floes, leap over obstacles, and escape predators while collecting fish and unlocking new abilities. Simple gameplay, increasing challenge, and a stunning icy landscape will keep you running for more!
70010000118700.intro: Help the seal overcome the obstacles!
70010000118700.name: Seals from the frosty Bay

70010000118703.description:
Take to the stars as the commander of the space station Alexandria IV, a place full of danger and strife, be it caused by mercenary aliens or power-hungry corporations. When an ancient secret is revealed on system Groombridge 34, the commander must act with strategy and diplomacy to avoid rupture between factions. In the future, we are not alone.

Experience the multi-media spanning series Veil of Truth, by award-winning author J.M. Beraldo.

Immerse yourself in a story-rich space opera as the commander of an entire space station. How will you deal with the myriad of problems life in space has to offer?

Fall in love with a diverse cast of characters, ranging from fellow humans to the strangest alien species. But beware! Romance between crew members is prohibited and has consequences...

Intergalactic trouble never ends: Prove yourself worthy of command by solving conflicts strategically in this five act episodic visual novel inspired by classics such as Deep Space 9 and Babylon 5.
70010000118703.intro: Tasked with commanding of one of the most challenging sectors of the galaxy, the future of the Alexandria IV space station depends on your diplomatic and strategic capabilities.
70010000118703.name: Alexandria IV

70010000118706.description:
Embark on a lifetime of adventure in a beautiful world of creativity and intrigue. Raise a family, customise your farm, run a business, craft items, and battle monsters!

Your actions and decisions matter in our adventurous story filled with purpose and promise. Lend a helping hand to villagers in need and discover the unique blend of creativity and choice that sets Kynseed apart. Come and join us - your legacy awaits!

• Story-driven RPG set in beautiful regions, where you’ll battle dark faery tale creatures.
• Customise your farm and farmhouse using Kynseed's customisation mode with hundreds of items and limitless design possibilities.
• Take on the role of shopkeeper and run your own blacksmith, potion shop, tavern, or bustling goods store.
• Develop relationships with villagers who will remember your deeds, actions, and pranks!
• Combat the evil Hob army as they construct powerful totems and cause the destruction of crops and buildings.
• Rebuild broken houses and buildings for your neighbours and new NPCs.
• Gather materials to create items, forge weapons or mix cures for bizarre maladies.
• Buy strange artifacts from the mysterious Mr. Fairweather — items that ease your chores, boost your combat skills, or simply let you bend the rules of the world. But beware his life tax: each one costs years from your life.
• A world where everyone ages -  raise a family then step into your children's shoes and continue your legacy.

In Kynseed, live your life the way you choose in a lovingly handcrafted 2D open world.
70010000118706.intro: A beautiful life sim sandbox RPG full of family, farming, friendship, and folklore.
70010000118706.name: Kynseed

70010000118717.description:
Buckle up for the most destructive driving experience! Hyper Cars Ramp Crash combines high-speed racing with extreme, physics-based chaos. Whether you're launching off massive ramps, dodging crushing hammers, or falling from the sky, every dent and scratch is rendered with realistic crash physics.

Take control of seven distinct super sports cars that are fully customizable to match your style. Push them to the limit in a massive open world or test your precision in the challenging stunt and fall modes.

Key Features:
• Realistic Destruction Physics: Watch your car crumble, smash, and deform in real time when you hit obstacles or land massive jumps.
• Seven Super-Sport Cars: Unlock and drive a garage full of high-performance vehicles. Customize them and view the action from a realistic interior cockpit camera.
• Multiple Adrenaline Modes: Free Style, Stunt Mode, Fall Break Mode, Time Trial.
• Diverse Environments: Master your driving skills on Road, Forest, Ocean, and Desert maps.
70010000118717.name: Hyper Cars Ramp Crash

70010000118718.description:
A squad of mutant kids from the hood is humanity’s last hope in this colorful, humor-packed zombie apocalypse. Blast freaky zombies with ridiculous guns, spray wild graffiti across the city, and face a monstrous Zombie Boss at the end of every mission.

Each hero in the squad offers a unique playstyle: choose yours, dig the weirdest guns out of dumpsters, and enjoy the insane headshot animations.

THE SQUAD

Four young mutants, each with their own powers and playstyle, ready to blast some zombies! Pick your favorite (or the one with the collest look) and go wild!

FIND CRAZY GUNS

A Ketchup Blaster, a Gumball Shooter, a Shark-Head Shotgun, and even a Witch’s Broom, you’ll find all sorts of crazy guns to make zombies deeply regret their life (and death) choices.

KILL FREAK ZOMBIES

The writer definitely went off the rails here. Expect cute puppy zombies, tentacle-armed chonks, jacked-up cop zombies, and even an  Frankenstein with underwear. It doesn’t make much sense, but hey, it’s hilarious.

GRAFFITI THE WALLS

Painting graffiti in a zombie apocalypse isn’t easy. Every time you try to tag a wall, you might just summon an entire horde of the undead. Art has never been so dangerous (or colorful)!

DEFEAT THE ZOMBIE BOSS

This zombie clearly had a different breakfast. It’s stronger, meaner, and keeps coming back stronger each time. Beat the Boss Zombie and show it who’s the real monster here!
70010000118718.intro: Turn freaky zombies into a green goo explosion with a bunch of crazy guns and graffiti the walls while you try to save the city!
70010000118718.name: Ghetto Zombies: Graffiti Squad

70010000118724.description:
Highway Roads Racer brings the heat of arcade racing to your console. This isn't just about speed; it's about mastering the physics of curved highways while weaving through dense traffic.

Push your skills to the limit, earn cash for risky maneuvers, and build a garage of 15 high-performance cars—from agile sports cars to heavy muscle.

4 High-Octane Modes
-One Way: Tear through traffic at max speed.
-Two Ways: Double the risk. Dodge oncoming cars for massive multipliers.
-Time Attack: Race the clock. Hitting checkpoints is the only way to survive.
-Speed Bomb: Pure adrenaline. A bomb is rigged to your chassis—drop below the speed limit, and you explode!

3 Racing Conditions
-Sunny: Perfect visibility for setting new records.
-Rainy: Slick asphalt that challenges your traction.
-Night: Rely on your headlights and reflexes in the dark.

Experience the Rush
-Dynamic Curved Roads: Feel the G-force as you navigate realistic highway bends, unlike standard straight-line racers.
-Tight Gamepad Controls: Optimized analog steering gives you the precision needed to thread the needle between cars at high speeds.
-Progression Loop: Use your hard-earned race cash to upgrade your fleet and unlock the fastest machines on the road.

Start your engine. The highway awaits.
70010000118724.intro: Master the Curves. Own the Road.
70010000118724.name: Highway Roads Racer

70010000118736.description:
『BLOKES on BLOCKS!』 is a fast-paced action party game for up to 6 players that anyone can jump into with simple controls!
Choose your favorite bloke and knock the other blokes flying!

【Game Features】
▼ Simple Controls
Movement is all you need—up, down, left, and right.
Crash into other players to knock them down,
then crash into them again to send them flying.
It’s a simple, straight-up competitive game built entirely around moving and crashing into your opponents.

▼ Chaotic Multiplayer Fun
Pick up items to crank up the chaos in battle—press the A button to use them!
Bombs, missiles, beams, and more send matches into total mayhem.
Fast, chaotic matches make it easy to jump in anytime—even if you only have a few minutes to play.

【Game Modes】
▼ Last Stand
Survive to the very end!
A life-based battle mode where you respawn quickly, even after getting knocked out.
Lose all your lives, and you can still attack from outside to mess with the action.
a loud, chaotic mode that stays exciting until the very last moment.

▼ Chip Rush
Collect chips and claim victory!
Gather chips scattered across the stage or steal them from other players to compete for the win.
Near the end of the match, the Piggy Bank appears, opening up a huge chance for a last-second comeback!

▼ Sudden Smash
Get knocked down, and it’s instant KO!?
A high-risk, round-based battle where every smash is a one-hit finisher.
Send your opponents flying, rack up points, and aim for first place!

▼ Hot Zone
Step into the Hot Zone and claim victory!
Gain points by standing in the active zone.
Reach 100% to start securing your victory!
Stay in the zone for a bit longer to win!

▼ Crown Hold
Grab the crown and claim victory!
Gain points while you hold the crown.
Reach 100% to win!
Wrestle for control of the crown to win!

▼ Color Domination
Color the stage by moving around!
Use items wisely to spread your color faster!
The player who covers the most area wins!
70010000118736.name: BLOKES on BLOCKS!

70010000118742.description:
Design your store layout, keep shelves stocked, set competitive prices, and deliver fast, reliable service to keep customers coming back. Step behind the counter, manage daily operations, and watch your store evolve as you expand, upgrade, and optimize every detail.
Start small, think big, and build your own retail success story.

In Supermarket Simulator 2026, you take control of a humble local shop and turn it into a bustling supermarket. With only basic equipment and ambition on your side, every decision you make shapes the future of your business.

Build your ultimate supermarket with deep and detailed customization. From store layout and product placement to pricing strategies and staffing, every choice affects how your business performs and stands out.

Key Features:
● Immersive retail experience where you manage every aspect of your own supermarket
● Full store customization system with flexible layout design and efficient space organization
● Product ordering and inventory management with dynamic stocking and pricing control
● Interactive checkout system with scanning, payments, and real-time customer service
● Store expansion and upgrades that transform a small shop into a modern supermarket
● Staff hiring and management system to automate tasks and improve daily operations
● Progression system that rewards smart decisions, efficiency, and business growth

Build from the ground up, master the flow of business, and become the ultimate supermarket owner.
70010000118742.intro: Design, organize, and perfect the flow of your supermarket.
70010000118742.name: Supermarket Simulator 2026

70010000118775.description:
Climb the branches of knowledge in Nature’s Question, an engaging quiz that turns curiosity about the natural world into a journey of growth and challenge. Guided by Sylvaran, the forest’s guardian spirit, you must answer questions to restore the strength of the Ancient Tree and reach the top of its majestic living tower.

Each correct answer strengthens the tree and lets you advance through its floors, while mistakes end the journey and invite you to try again. As you climb higher, questions become more challenging and time becomes more precious, demanding focus, quick thinking, and strategic decisions.

Use your points to activate powerful aids at the right moment, overcoming obstacles and keeping your ascent alive. With shuffled questions in every run and dynamic progression, each playthrough offers a new opportunity to prove your knowledge.

Relax in nature-inspired environments, challenge your mind, and discover how far your knowledge can take you. In Nature’s Question, every answer brings you one step closer to the top of the Ancient Tree.
70010000118775.intro: Climb the Ancient Tree and test your knowledge of nature
70010000118775.name: Nature's Question

70010000118781.description:
In Zoo Orbs, adorable animals gently fall into containers full of personality, waiting for the perfect fusion. Combine two identical little creatures to create bigger and even more charming versions, advancing step by step until you reach the impressive Whale.

With relaxing physics-based gameplay, each level invites you to slow down, plan every drop, and discover delightful combinations. Containers change shape, challenges become more engaging, and every decision influences the final outcome.

With no rush, no pressure, and plenty of charm, Zoo Orbs is the perfect puzzle for players who enjoy cozy games, pleasant visuals, and that wonderful feeling of making the perfect move. Drop, combine, and enjoy every fusion at your own pace.
70010000118781.name: Zoo Orbs

70010000118787.description:
Get ready to relax in Claim the Forest: Settling Peace, a cozy puzzle where your mission is to fill each board with adorable capybara-shaped pieces. They arrive peacefully on little boats along the river, and it’s up to you to pick them up, rotate them, and find the perfect fit to complete every space.

Across 30 handcrafted levels, boards vary in size and shape, offering gentle challenges that unfold at a calm and pleasant pace. It’s the perfect experience for puzzle fans, casual players, and anyone who enjoys quiet moments alongside the forest’s cutest capybaras.

Observe the pieces, plan each move, and watch harmony take shape as the forest comes to life, piece by piece.
70010000118787.intro: Capybaras in Harmony in the Forest
70010000118787.name: Claim the Forest: Settling Peace

70010000118793.description:
Get ready for a challenge full of excitement, trivia, and passion for the world’s most beloved sport. In Do You Really Know About Soccer?, every correct answer takes you one step closer to the top of the legendary Football Tower, where only true football masters can reach.

Starting with lighter and more accessible questions, you will quickly realize the journey becomes increasingly intense. With every floor, the challenges grow tougher, testing your memory, knowledge, and love for the game. Do you really know everything about soccer?

But climbing the tower is not only about confidence. By answering correctly, you earn points that can be exchanged for special power-ups capable of saving your run during the hardest moments. Choosing the perfect time to use each advantage can make the difference between continuing upward or falling back to the beginning.

With cute visuals, a relaxed atmosphere, and addictive progression, the game transforms every round into the perfect mix of competition, learning, and fun. It is the kind of experience that makes you think “just one more try” while chasing the final floor of the tower.

Perfect for football fans, quiz lovers, and players who enjoy fast and clever challenges, Do You Really Know About Soccer? delivers dynamic matches, exciting tension, and that amazing feeling of getting a difficult answer right at the last second.

Take a deep breath, choose your answer, and prove your football knowledge deserves a place at the top.
70010000118793.intro: Climb the Tower and Prove You Know Soccer
70010000118793.name: Do You Really Know About Soccer?

70010000118805.description:
Get ready to return to the farm in a relaxing puzzle that will win your heart. In To Farm Lands : Sowing Fields, adorable animals in unique shapes await your strategic touch to perfectly fill each grid.

Explore 30 new levels across 3 charming biomes, where every stage brings a gentle and clever challenge. With no time limits and no pressure, you can play at your own pace, testing combinations, rotating pieces and finding the perfect fit in total calm.

With cozy visuals, a peaceful atmosphere and irresistible nostalgic charm, To Farm Lands : Sowing Fields is the ideal choice for fans of cute puzzles that stimulate the mind while delivering pure relaxation.

Observe, plan and complete each board to watch your farm take shape piece by piece.
70010000118805.intro: Plant, Fit and Relax on the Farm
70010000118805.name: To Farm Lands: Sowing Fields

70010000118806.description:
Step into the role of a zoo owner and manager tasked with transforming a small, neglected park into a bustling wildlife attraction. Your goal is to create comfortable homes for animals, enjoyable experiences for visitors, and a successful, high-rated zoo. Every decision—from repairing enclosures to caring for exotic animals—shapes the future of your park.

Key Features:
• Build and Expand: Repair damaged enclosures, clean up debris, and restore old buildings. Expand your zoo by unlocking new areas and facilities through your office computer.
• Animal Management Purchase a variety of animals, from common species to rare, exotic creatures. Feed them, monitor their health, and maintain proper living conditions to keep them happy and stress-free.
• Visitor Experience: Improve comfort and enjoyment by building and upgrading cafes, restrooms, and decorative areas. The better the facilities, the longer guests will stay and the more they’ll spend.
• Maintenance and Staff: Keep your zoo running smoothly by repairing gates, water systems, and other equipment. Hire staff to assist with cleaning, repairs, and animal care.
• Progress and Reputation: Increase your zoo’s rating by balancing animal welfare, visitor satisfaction, and efficient management.

Transform a rundown zoo into a thriving wildlife sanctuary in Zoo Manager Simulator. Your creativity, strategy, and dedication will determine whether your park becomes a top-rated destination or remains just another forgotten zoo.
70010000118806.intro: Build, care, and grow your ultimate zoo empire.
70010000118806.name: ZOO MANAGER SIMULATOR

70010000118807.description:
Rearrange the world. Reunite the twins. Rediscover wonder.
Abi and Ben are lost but not alone. In Lost Twins 2, you'll shift entire pieces of the world to guide them through a beautifully handcrafted puzzle adventure full of cozy charm and clever surprises.

How it plays:
- Slide and swap tiles to reshape levels
- Solve puzzles using switches, platforms, water gates, and more
- Explore magical environments like enchanted forests and toy castles
- Play solo or team up in delightful local co-op
- Discover secrets, collectibles, and heartwarming surprises
With no enemies, no time limits, and no stress, Lost Twins 2 is a peaceful puzzle journey perfect for players of all ages.

 Key Features:
Inventive Puzzle Mechanics – Slide, swap, and shift tiles to unlock new paths and reveal clever solutions

Solo or Co-Op Play – Play alone or team up with a friend in couch co-op mode

Whimsical World – Gorgeous visuals inspired by Studio Ghibli bring every corner of the world to life

Atmospheric Soundtrack – Original music that adapts to your journey’s emotional beats

Secrets & Collectibles – Find hidden paths, unlock concept art, and gather charming curios

No Two Puzzles Alike – Every level introduces fresh ideas with zero filler

Stress-Free Play – No deaths, timers, or enemies just pure puzzling joy
70010000118807.intro: Shift the world, solve puzzles, and help Abi & Ben find their way back home.
70010000118807.name: Lost Twins 2

70010000118813.description:
ABOUT
PEPPERED is an existential platformer where you have ONE SHOT at everything.

Every choice, every boss battle, and every failure impact the branching plotline and determine how the story will go and how it will end. Will you save the world - or fail miserably?

SYNOPSIS
