Seeing apathy in the face of doomsday, an office intern decides to save the world by themselves. But the world responds by summoning the police, angry mobs, and the media, branding them as a terrorist.

KEY FEATURES
■ BRANCHING NARRATIVE
Multiple endings. Multiple story routes. Your failures and choices affect the story, which branches out heavily — sometimes taking you to completely unique locations with unique scenes, characters, or gameplay mechanics.

■ PLATFORMING ACTION
Run. Jump. Die. Scream at the screen.

■ ONE-SHOT BOSS FIGHTS
Challenging boss fights! If you lose, the game will not reset or give you a second chance — it will go on, incorporating your loss and changing the story accordingly.

■ CHOICES
Make story choices, ranging from dialogue responses to actions. These will either affect the characters, the scene's outcome, or the ending you get.

■ STEALTH SECTIONS
Get caught, sneak past, or find a secret solution. Every section features a unique character, permanent outcomes, and dumb gags.


■ EXPLORATION
Immerse yourself in a bizarre world full of weirdos and sad people! Talk with colorful NPCs, poke around the environment, or ignore it all.

■ COMPLETELY RANDOM CR*P
Maybe you'll have to use a shopping cart to run away from thugs? Perhaps you'll have to write a presentation or gamble with a street corner lunatic? Who knows? (I do.)

■ AN OFFICE CHAIR
You can spin in it.
70010000118813.intro: An existential platformer where Doomsday is just around the corner.
70010000118813.name: PEPPERED: An Existential Platformer

70010000118832.description:
"STREET SMART" is an action game released by SNK in 1989.
In an era where a man's true worth was measured solely by his strength, a lone karate master and a professional wrestler travel across America to prove who is the ultimate street brawler.
After teaming up in 2-player co-op, you'll face off in a 1P vs. 2P showdown! Victory earns you the blessings of the GALS!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.
70010000118832.intro: Fight on! For the crown! For the glory of victory!
70010000118832.name: Arcade Archives STREET SMART

70010000118839.description:
Dustland Delivery is a post-apocalyptic survival business simulator, featuring over 40 hours of gameplay content. Scour the wastes for profit, complete missions to grow your trading empire, and assemble a rag-tag band of adventurers to turn your city into the capital of the Dustlands. Danger lurks around every corner—but no risk, no reward!

Marshal Resources to Build Your Dustland Empire
 •  A vast game world with a rich narrative to explore
 • Establish trade routes across unique settlements to become a kingpin of the wastes
 • Control resource flows to build magnificent cities

Transform Your Truck for Apocalyptic Adventures
 • Create your own mobile base to cruise through the Dustlands
 • Install mods to turn your truck into a deadly weapon against infected swarms

A Cast of Unique Companions
 • Recruit a rag-tag group of adventurers with distinctive traits
 • Assign different roles to help build your city
 • Tool up and train animal companions to boost your team's stats
 • Undead? No excuse not to show up for work...

Random Events, Freedom to Choose
 • Countless random events: armored motorcades, undead raids, unknown signals from mysterious locations...
 • Your Dustland, your way: become a warrior for justice, a money-grubbing merchant, or an infamous bandit

Struggle for Power, Rebuild the Wastes
 • 6 major factions with a web of complex relations
 • Exploit power struggles and trading rivalries to come out on top
 • Form alliances, stir up trouble, and build your own power base

Complex Weather System
 • Forge a path through the Dustlands while fighting storms and hidden dangers
 • Set up camp to shelter from the elements, then ride out at daybreak
70010000118839.intro: Grow your trading empire in a post-apocalyptic wasteland.
70010000118839.name: Dustland Delivery

70010000118845.description:
Meet your child's first dinosaur friend, 'Crayon Little Dino'! The latest installment of the hit 'Crayon' series is finally here. Let’s travel back to the mysterious age of dinosaurs! From T-Rex to Triceratops, adorable baby dinosaurs are waiting for your colorful touch.

Animated Dino Encyclopedia: Decorate over 16 species of dinosaurs. Once finished, they react with lively animations!

Creative Art Tools: Unleash infinite imagination with various crayon colors.

Stress-Free Play: No rules, no time limits. Designed for kids to explore and feel achievement at their own pace.
70010000118845.intro:
Wake up the cute baby dinosaur with your own colors.
Create your own dinosaur playground with the Crayon Series!
70010000118845.name: CRAYON LITTLE DINO

70010000118854.description:
Drop straight into a high-intensity battle royale set in a dense, unpredictable forest. Leap from the plane, hit the ground running, and arm yourself fast—because danger is already closing in. Weapons are scattered everywhere, from long-range sniper rifles to explosive launchers and close-combat options, giving you the freedom to play your way.

The map keeps you on edge. A deadly shrinking zone forces constant movement, while supply crates crash down from the sky, packed with powerful gear—but reaching them could cost you everything. With 25 aggressive, armed opponents hunting across the terrain, every moment is a fight to stay alive.

Key Features:
• Adrenaline-fueled battle royale in a dynamic forest
• Parachute in and start looting instantly
• 8 weapon types with 50+ pickups to discover
• 25 relentless enemies actively hunting you
• Shrinking danger zone that ramps up the pressure
• High-risk supply drops with weapons, ammo, and health
• Smooth core mechanics: movement, shooting, weapon switching, grenades, and combat

Be the last one standing.
Gear up, stay ahead of the zone, and outfight everyone in your path. Only the fastest and smartest will survive.
70010000118854.intro: Every step could be your last—move or be hunted.
70010000118854.name: Bubu Battle Royale

70010000118859.description:
Ragdoll Playground Sandbox is a 2D physics sandbox built for experimentation, creativity, and pure chaos. Test explosions, run vehicle crash scenarios, or simply observe how objects behave under realistic physical forces.

You are completely free in your actions. Create scenes, place objects, remove them at any time, and experiment with physics without limits. Weapons, explosives, vehicles, human and robot models interact dynamically, creating unpredictable and often spectacular results.

Features:
• Full sandbox with no objectives, rules, or restrictions
• Realistic 2D physics with dynamic collisions and forces
• Ragdoll-based human and robot models reacting to impacts, falls, and explosions
• Destructible objects affected by weight, speed, and impulse
• Vehicles, weapons, explosives, props, and machinery to combine freely
• Unpredictable outcomes that make every experiment unique
• Suitable for both chaotic action and calm physics observation

Ragdoll Playground Sandbox is a space without limits, where physics drives every outcome. Whether you enjoy experimenting, observing, or creating chaotic scenarios, the game lets you explore interactions freely and enjoy the process at your own pace.
70010000118859.intro: Enjoy a playground where ragdolls, robots, and physics collide spectacularly.
70010000118859.name: Ragdoll Playground Sandbox
70010000118859.publisher: Lu Ming trading as Shane Game

70010000118872.description:
Doll Defenders is a tower defense action game set in the “Male Doll” multiverse where you’re tasked with protecting a sacred statue from invading monsters, all while meeting heroes and unlocking special scenes and animations on your way to the final showdown

Master a dozen weapon types or stick to the ones that fit your playstyle. Fight it out against enemy waves across 3 different worlds and 15 unique levels with 8 hunky characters to rescue!

• Journey to a mysterious dimension where characters from the “Male Doll” multiverse of visual novels converge!
• Protect a sacred statue from waves of monsters in top-down tower defense style.
• Choose from 12 different weapon types to suit your preferred playstyle!
• Survive 15 different levels set across 3 uniquely themed worlds.
• Meet and rescue 8 handsome characters and win their affections!
70010000118872.intro: Protect the statue and meet hunky heroes!
70010000118872.name: Doll Defenders

70010000118878.description:
Take aim and smash your way through a fast, colourful action shooter where every shot counts.
Blast apart destructible cover piece by piece to flush enemies into the open, timing each hit with care. Trigger the bonus power-up to enter Infinite Mode and unleash a devastating barrage that turns the arena into a storm of flying debris.
But not everything should be shot. Bombs are mixed into the chaos—and hitting one instantly ends the run.
Unlock stylish new ball skins to customise your shots and show off your progress as the challenge ramps up. Easy to pick up, endlessly replayable, and packed with crunchy destruction, this is hyper-casual shooting at its most explosive.
70010000118878.name: Smash Balls 2

70010000118883.description:
After breaking up with Erika, Bianca's life unravels once more when a second magic camera appears and a new girl, Lúcia, enters the scene. Will she reconnect with Erika or explore a new path with the mysterious student council president?

Magic Exposure 2 is a cute yuri-themed visual novel adventure with a supernatural twist! Take the role of Bianca in a story spanning 15,000 words and featuring 2 romance options to date. Make critical choices for Bianca to affect the narrative and explore multiple endings, unlocking special CG scenes along the way!

• Follow the tale of unlikely companions in a world of anthropomorphic characters!
• Enjoy cute and romantic dialogue spanning a story of 15,000 words.
• Use convenient features to auto-advance, save, load or skip!
• Make key choices for the protagonist and unlock special CG scenes.
• Explore themes of girls’ love with 2 different characters to date!
70010000118883.intro: Find new love or mend a broken relationship as you make key choices in a yuri-themed visual novel adventure!
70010000118883.name: Magic Exposure 2

70010000118893.description:
Step into the world of high-speed formula racing and push your driving skills to the limit.

In Formula 2026: Rise of Legends, you’ll race powerful open-wheel cars across a variety of circuits, competing against skilled AI opponents. Every race is a chance to improve, react faster, and climb your way to the top.

Whether you jump into quick races or build your career from the ground up, the road to victory is yours to define.

Features:

Smooth and responsive driving controls
Multiple tracks with fast-paced racing action
Career Mode and Quick Race options
Challenging AI opponents
Immersive cockpit view and dynamic cameras

Win races, sharpen your skills, and become a true racing legend.
70010000118893.intro:
Enter the world of high-speed racing
Master every corner
Become a legend
70010000118893.name: Formula 2026: Rise of Legends

70010000118935.description:
London: Echoes of The Past is a short yuri mystery visual novel.

A mysterious woman returns back from the dead, and the dusty past surfaces. Between a gloomy school girl and a glamorous ex-girlfriend,  every clue interwines. Who is the mastermind behind the scene? Play as a detective heroine in 1935 London, embark on a journey of love and growth.

Characters
He Yaqiong
Calm, intelligent private detective
An agent with a secret mission
"Could it be that every reunions is just another deadly gamble elaborated by the fate?"

Xin Rui
Stubborn, lively young girl with a strange obsession with He Yaqiong
A student client who awaked the dusty memory
“It's hard to say, things are unpredictable, some things always change. Don't you think so?”

Kun Ni
Gentle, elegant, glamorous and mysterious ex-girlfriend

Unidentified international businesswoman

“I've often wondered what kind of person you would become, Ya. Thank you for giving me the answer.”



Story
Bizarre Commissions
Lost and Found
Tangible riddles
Ghosts of the past
A foreign land, an old friend, a strange case.
What's the connection among them?
It's a time for justice
When the bullet takes flight
Can you pierce through the fog
To uncover the truth?

Features
Yuri Mystery Visual Novel
90,000 Words
3 Endings
Cel Shading Backgrounds
25+ CGs
70010000118935.intro: In 1935 London, investigate a woman’s mysterious return from the dead and uncover a tangled story of love, secrets, and betrayal.
70010000118935.name: London: Echoes of the Past

70010000118947.description:
After successfully leading her friends through a one-shot TTRPG campaign, part-time barista and full-time gamer Flora now faces a new challenge… How can she possibly muster up the courage to tell her DM that she likes him?!

In this sequel to the comedy/otome visual novel Fetch Quest, Flora gives herself a one-week deadline to raise her stats high enough to ask her crush out on a date. Is it silly and arbitrary? Yes! Will it work? Who knows!

Features:
- ~50k word story, and ~8k words of extras.
- Light stat-raising.
- 4 different "Date" endings depending on Flora's stats.
- An otome game within an otome game.

Each day, choose one of four games for Flora to play with her friends and level up her stats. But be careful–Flora has been known to get a little too into her hobbies. If she doesn't strike the right balance, she might completely forget what her original goal was in the first place.

Acumen: If Flora chooses to play the 4X board game Techno-opolis, she'll increase her Acumen stat. This is a measure of her strategic thinking and problem-solving skills.

Charm: If Flora chooses to play the social deduction game Of Fiends and Fangs, She'll increase her Charm. This indicates her ability to control and manipulate others with the power of her words.

Gud: In the action role-playing video game Clockwork Mercenaries, Flora will increase her Gud stat. This is not only a measure of her skill, but her grit and perseverance as well.

Moxie: If Flora plays the indie ghost hunting videogame Ghost Factory 2, her Moxie will increase. This determines how brave she is.
70010000118947.intro: Flora gives herself a one-week deadline to raise her stats high enough to ask her crush out on a date.
70010000118947.name: Fetch Re:Quest

70010000118963.description:
Do you believe in the existence of an afterlife?

■About
Jukai Maze is a sci-fi suspense visual novel where every choice sends the story down a completely different path. Branching routes twist and diverge with each decision you make. Explore multiple endings, piece together scattered clues, and uncover the deeper truth that lies beneath them all.

■Story
“They say there’s a research institute at the foot of Mount Fuji studying the afterlife.”
Intrigued by the half-believable rumor, Shiu invites the protagonist, Haryu Ryoushi, to explore the depths of Aokigahara. What was supposed to be a simple vlog shoot shifts the moment they step into the forest.
As night falls and the mist thickens, they lose their sense of direction. Shiu vanishes without a trace, and Ryoushi is pulled into another “reality,” awakening inside a strange psychiatric hospital.

Everyone inside mutters things that border on madness:
“This place is a dream.”
“This place is another planet.”
“This place is the afterlife.”

As the boundary between truth and illusion collapses, Ryoushi sinks deeper into the maze, and is soon entangled in a baffling murder case……

■Features
- Fully voiced in Japanese
- Clear, elegantly structured storytelling
- Expressive and nuanced character portraits
- Retro filters & pixel fonts included.
- Immersive HD Rumble integration.
70010000118963.intro: Beneath a volcano, a facility probes the afterlife. As the world ends, enter the spectral forest maze to find your missing loved one.
70010000118963.name: Jukai Maze

70010000118969.description:
Rooster Saga is a fast-paced arcade game built around timing, reflexes, and precision.

Tap to keep the rooster airborne, dodge endless obstacles, and survive for as long as possible. Every tap matters, and each mistake costs one of your limited lives.

Designed for quick play sessions and constant retries, the game features simple controls paired with an unforgiving challenge. There are no upgrades or shortcuts — success depends entirely on skill, focus, and consistency.

Compete on the global all-time leaderboard to prove your mastery, or take part in weekly challenge leaderboards to test yourself against other players under fresh conditions.

Chase higher scores, sharpen your reflexes, and see how far you can fly.
70010000118969.intro:
Tap to fly.
Dodge obstacles.
Chase high scores.
70010000118969.name: Rooster Saga: I Believe I Can Fly

70010000118983.description:
Kiko the bear has one goal: to bake the biggest apple pie ever for the annual Apple Festival! To do that, Kiko needs lots of apples.

Curious and excited, Kiko sets off on a wooden raft to explore fun and colorful islands, discovering new surprises and collecting apples along the way.

Some naughty creatures are trying to stop Kiko… But Kiko is clever and always one step ahead!

Features:
- About 2-4 hours playtime
- 50+ puzzles, on a gentle difficulty curve, ranging from easy to challenging
- Every puzzle can be freely skipped to return to later
- Enemies with fun and surprising behaviors
- Cartoony graphics
- Relaxing music and playful sounds
70010000118983.intro: Push apples, move the rafts, and outsmart silly enemies in this adorable puzzle adventure!
70010000118983.name: Kiko's Apple Adventure

70010000118989.description:
Dive into an action-packed wilderness in PLANET WOW!
Choose your favorite animal: Creep through the jungle like a chameleon, slither swiftly as a snake, or rule over rivers and swamps as a crocodile.
Will you be the hunter or the hunted? Only the strongest will survive!

• Play as powerful animals with cool special abilities
• Explore dangerous habitats - deserts, rainforests, swamps and more
• Dodge attacks and get stronger, level by level
• Collect exotic animals and unlock new powers
• Discover exciting facts and become a real expert on animals
70010000118989.name: PLANET WOW Wildlife Adventure

70010000118993.description:
A table tennis legend meets a rhythm game! Hit every ball precisely in time, keep to the beat and let the rhythm guide your shots. Master Timo Boll's legendary techniques, challenge charismatic rivals in urban locations and create perfect combos. Every shot counts – your sense of rhythm will be crucial!

• 77 songs, 7 genres – pop, hip-hop/RnB, rock, electro, chill-out, country and kids' music
• Professional moves from Timo Boll – train with a world-class player
• Reflexes and timing – focus and stay sharp
• Combos and hiscores – play a perfect series of shots
• Stylish arenas – industrial areas, train stations and many more
70010000118993.intro: Feel the beat. Hit the ball.
70010000118993.name: Timo Boll Beats

70010000119001.description:
Legacy of Kain: Ascendance is a fast, 2D action platformer built around vertical movement, fluid combat, and skill-driven play.

Nosgoth’s dark fantasy world is brought to life through animated cut scenes and beautifully crafted pixel art gameplay. Each level filled with environmental challenges and puzzles that flow seamlessly into combat. Fly, fight, and unravel the past in a world of collapsing kingdoms, haunted ruins, and shattered timelines.

2D Action Platformer
Chain melee strikes, evasive dashes, and supernatural attacks in fluid, vicious combat.

Multiple Protagonists
Overwhelm the battlefield with Kain’s vampiric powers. Play Raziel before his fall as a human Sarafan knight, then take flight for the first time in his vampiric form. The Vampire Elaleth introduces an aggressive playstyle focused on fast relentless offense.

Original Score
Ascendance delivers a powerful original score by Celldweller.

Returning Voice Talent
Reunites iconic Legacy of Kain voice actors – Michael Bell, Simon Templeman, Richard Doyle and Anna Gunn.
70010000119001.intro: Enter the dark word of Nosgoth to harness vampiric powers in this fast 2D action platformer.
70010000119001.name: Legacy of Kain: Ascendance

70010000119020.description:
Grab your Joy-Con™ controllers, and get your body moving to the beat!
Learn popular hip-hop dance moves from basic to complex.
But you won't be alone on your dancing journey. Four instructors help along the way!

- Start off with the basics - Lesson Mode will take you through 30 lessons that will have you moving and grooving in no time!

- In Free Mode, put your dancing skills to the test, and follow your instructor through six original choreographed dances!

- Turn on Camera Mode and rotate the angle during lessons to see steps in detail!
70010000119020.intro: Become a Dance Hero from Zero!
70010000119020.name: Zero to Dance Hero

70010000119026.description:
+ Idle Gameplay: Enjoy a relaxing idle experience designed to help you unwind. Even while you are away, your sect keeps battling, growing stronger, and moving closer to ascension.

+ Squad Building: Recruit from 16 playable characters. Each character has unique talents, classes, and skills. Bring in the disciples you need and freely build your own squad.

+ Character Growth: Each character can choose one of six different cultivation paths. They can also practice different cultivation techniques to gain unique bonuses. Even characters of the same class can grow into completely different builds.

+ Explore the World: Journey across the land, discover other sects and factions, and advance the story. Gather resources for personal cultivation and sect development. Encounter random events and uncover unexpected treasures.

+ Sect Management: While exploring the world, you will also manage your own sect. Earn reputation and sect resources to upgrade and expand your home base. Build different sect facilities to continuously produce useful items. A powerful sect will help you go further on the path to immortality.
70010000119026.intro: Build a Chinese fantasy sect, recruit disciples, and forge the ultimate squad for ascension! Are you ready to walk the path to immortality as a true Sect Master?
70010000119026.name: Idle Immortal

70010000119033.description:
Disney Music Parade -Encore- is a rhythm action game in which players ride along to Disney songs through famous scenes from Disney animations that have been recreated on a glittering stage.

The game features an impressive lineup of 60 Disney songs including iconic tracks such as "A Whole New World" and "Under the Sea". Each have their own unique stages that players will traverse on a magical train ride for an immersive experience that feels just like a real amusement park ride.

The game also features Collections consisting of different "Music Rides" that depict well-known Disney characters in a brilliant, vibrant art style and "Memory Crystals" that feature famous scenes from beloved Disney animated titles.
Players will have tons of fun collecting their favorite characters and scenes from memorable titles.

Up to 4 players can enjoy playing together on local multiplayer.
The game also features a control method that doesn't require any button input and can be played by "just shaking" the Joy-Con™, so children can join in the fun too.
70010000119033.intro: Step into a Dazzling Parade of Beloved Tracks!
70010000119033.name: Disney Music Parade -Encore-

70010000119039.description:
Start your engines and get ready to climb your way to the top of the motorsports world! Super Woden Rally Edge is a spin-off of the critically acclaimed Super Woden saga of racing games, blending classic arcade essence with technical depth and a genuine love of car culture. Inspired by genre classics but sporting a personality all its own, Super Woden Rally Edge takes you back to an era where fun goes beyond strict realism.

Navigate using an intuitive overworld map interface and collect a vast variety of vehicles, from the smallest and humblest to unstoppable hill-climb machines. Buy, sell, upgrade and customize cars in your garage, show off your photography skills in photo mode, record your times and try to beat other players’ records. Enjoy a multitude of environments with different terrain and weather conditions to negotiate, all set to an original soundtrack and presented with unique stylized visuals!

• Climb the ranks of the motorsports world in arcade-style rally events!
• Race the clock to claim podium positions.
• Use your winnings to buy new cars, customize and upgrade!
• Explore using an old-school world map interface.
• Check stats, take photos of your cars, listen to music and more between races!

This game and the content contained therein is not authorized by car manufacturers or motor racing competitions and there is no association thereof.
70010000119039.intro: Race for the top in a rally-focused arcade spin-off to the popular Super Woden series!
70010000119039.name: Super Woden Rally Edge

70010000119048.description:
Step into the cab of a massive garbage truck in Garbage Truck Sim Driver Simulator 26, where everyday city streets become your ultimate playground. Experience the thrill of driving a heavy vehicle, navigating busy urban roads, and completing challenging waste collection missions.

From tight corners to traffic-packed avenues, every route tests your skill, precision, and strategy — proving that even cleaning the city can be an exciting adventure.

 Key Features
 • Realistic Garbage Truck Driving — Handle a large vehicle with authentic physics, engine sounds, and precise controls.
• City Waste Collection Missions — Navigate streets, alleys, and busy zones to collect and deliver garbage efficiently.
• Fuel & Resource Management — Plan routes and fuel stops to keep your truck running smoothly.
• Immersive Urban Environments — Explore detailed cityscapes with realistic traffic, obstacles, and ambient sounds.
• Challenging Driving Tasks — Master careful driving, tight turns, and precise parking to succeed in every mission.

Clean the streets, master the roads, and take full control of your garbage truck. Garbage Truck Sim Driver Simulator 26 turns everyday city work into a skill-based driving adventure that’s as challenging as it is satisfying.
70010000119048.intro: Drive the city. Clean every street. Master the route.
70010000119048.name: Garbage Truck Sim Driver Simulator 26

70010000119134.description:
You find yourself somewhere you don’t remember entering. The air feels still, the lights flicker without rhythm, and the endless yellow corridors stretch in every direction with no clear origin or end. In Inside The Backrooms, each step forward deepens the uncertainty, as the environment subtly shifts and the sense of direction fades away.

Key Features:
 • Unpredictable Environments: Move through interconnected spaces that change and evolve, making navigation a constant challenge.
 • Constant Danger: Unknown entities roam the area, forcing you to rely on stealth, awareness, and quick decisions to survive.
 • Immersive Atmosphere: Minimalist visuals combined with ambient audio create a persistent sense of tension and unease.
 • Progression Through Discovery: Search for clues, interpret your surroundings, and uncover paths that may lead you further—or deeper into danger.
 • Persistent Suspense: Every step forward increases the risk, as the unknown becomes increasingly present and unpredictable.

Stay focused, trust your instincts, and attempt to navigate your way out before the maze takes hold of you completely.
70010000119134.intro: Lost in the Backrooms, you must stay alert to survive and find a way out.
70010000119134.name: Inside The Backrooms

70010000119140.description:
Step inside a charming maid cafe where every day is full of energy, cute outfits, and cheerful anime girls ready to serve.

In Maid-Sama Cafe: Anime Girls Services in Cute Outfits, you’ll help a team of adorable maids keep the cafe running through a collection of fun and fast paced minigames.

Each successful challenge unlocks new illustrations and reveals more of the cafe’s lovable staff.

Every maid has her own personality, uniform, and special charm. As you improve your scores, you’ll discover new characters, unlock gallery images, and experience the lively atmosphere of the cafe.

Relax, play, and enjoy the sweetest service in town.


FEATURES:

● FUN MINIGAMES: Play multiple minigames that test speed, timing, and precision.

● ADORABLE MAID CAST: Meet anime maid girls with cute outfits and charming personalities.

● UNLOCKABLE GALLERY: Progress through the game to unlock collectible illustrations.

● COLORFUL ANIME STYLE: Bright visuals and expressive characters bring the cafe to life.

● EASY TO PLAY: Simple controls designed for quick and enjoyable sessions.

● REPLAYABLE CHALLENGES: Improve your scores and unlock all the cafe’s secrets.


The cafe is open.
Your favorite maid is waiting.
70010000119140.intro:
Welcome to the cutest cafe in town.
Adorable maids, sweet smiles, and playful challenges await.
Can you keep every customer happy?
70010000119140.name: Maid-Sama Cafe: Anime Girls Services in Cute Outfits

70010000119146.description:
Welcome to a maid cafe where the service is as charming as it is unexpected.

In Maid-Sama Cafe: Anime Boys Services in Cute Outfits, a team of handsome anime boys is ready to serve customers in adorable maid outfits. Behind the smiles, playful teasing, and stylish uniforms lies a cafe full of energy, fun, and irresistible charm.

Help the boys keep the cafe running through a series of fast and entertaining minigames. Serve drinks, prepare desserts, and assist the staff as they entertain guests with confidence and personality.

Each boy has his own unique style, attitude, and playful charm. As you improve your scores, you’ll unlock new illustrations and discover more about the cafe’s most charismatic staff members.

Relax, enjoy the atmosphere, and spend time with the cutest maids you never expected.


FEATURES:

● CHARMING MAID BOYS: Meet anime boys in cute maid outfits with unique personalities and playful attitudes.

● FUN MINIGAMES: Complete a variety of fast-paced cafe minigames based on timing and reflexes.

● UNLOCKABLE GALLERY: Progress through the game to unlock collectible illustrations.

● COLORFUL ANIME STYLE: Expressive characters and vibrant visuals bring the cafe to life.

● EASY TO PLAY: Simple controls designed for quick and enjoyable sessions.

● HIGH REPLAY VALUE: Improve your scores and unlock all the cafe’s secrets.


The cafe is open.
Your favorite maid might be a boy.
70010000119146.intro:
The cutest cafe just got a little more dangerous.
Charming anime boys serving with style.
Are you ready for the sweetest service in town?
70010000119146.name: Maid-Sama Cafe: Anime Boys Services in Cute Outfits

70010000119152.description:
In every fairy tale, the princess waits in the castle.

But what if she’s waiting for someone who sees her for who she truly is?

Behind the crown lies expectation, responsibility, and a life planned long before she could choose her own path. Admired by the kingdom, yet rarely understood, every princess carries her own dreams hidden beneath royal grace.

Princess Date Diaries: A Fairy Tale Love is a narrative-driven dating visual novel where your choices shape your romance with beautiful anime princesses from rival kingdoms.

As you grow closer, you’ll discover secret hopes, private doubts, and emotions that could change more than just a royal heart… they could change the future of an entire kingdom.

You’re not just another face in the court.

You’re the one person who sees the woman beneath the crown.

Will you respect royal tradition… or follow your heart and create a new fairy tale?


FEATURES:

● ENCHANTING PRINCESS CAST: Meet anime princesses with unique personalities, royal roles, and hidden dreams.

● FAIRY TALE ROMANCE: Explore castles, royal balls, moonlit gardens, and intimate moments with the princesses.

● CHOICE-DRIVEN STORY: Your decisions influence trust, affection, and the princess’s future.

● MULTIPLE STORY ROUTES: Each princess has branching paths and exclusive romantic scenes.

● DIFFERENT ENDINGS: True love, royal duty, sacrifice, or bittersweet farewell.

● HIGH REPLAY VALUE: Unlock hidden dialogues, special events, and alternate endings.


A crown may define her duty.
But your love could change her destiny.
70010000119152.intro:
A kingdom ruled by tradition.
A princess longing to be truly seen.
Will your love change her destiny?
70010000119152.name: Princess Date Diaries: A Fairy Tale Love

70010000119158.description:
In every fairy tale, the prince saves the kingdom.

But who saves the prince?

Behind the crown lies pressure, expectation, and a life chosen for him long before he could choose for himself. Admired by all, yet rarely understood, each prince carries a different burden beneath royal perfection.

Prince Date Diaries: A Fairy Tale Love is a narrative-driven dating visual novel where your choices shape your romance with charming anime princes from rival kingdoms.

As you grow closer, you’ll uncover hidden doubts, private fears, and feelings that could change more than just a heart, they could change the future of a kingdom.

You’re not just part of his story.

You’re the one who sees the man beneath the crown.

Will you follow tradition… or create your own fairy tale ending?


FEATURES:

● CHARMING PRINCE CAST: Meet anime princes with unique personalities, royal roles, and emotional depth.

● FAIRY TALE ROMANCE: Experience palace settings, royal balls, secret gardens, and intimate moments.

● CHOICE-DRIVEN STORY: Your decisions influence trust, affection, and the prince’s future.

● MULTIPLE STORY ROUTES: Each prince has branching paths and exclusive romantic scenes.

● DIFFERENT ENDINGS: True love, political alliance, sacrifice, or heartbreak.

● HIGH REPLAY VALUE: Unlock hidden dialogues, special events, and alternative endings.


A crown may shape his destiny.
But your love could change his story.
70010000119158.intro:
A kingdom bound by duty.
A prince longing for something real.
Will your love rewrite his destiny?
70010000119158.name: Prince Date Diaries: A Fairy Tale Love

70010000119182.description:
Your forest is dying.

Poisonous creatures crawl beneath ancient roots,
corrupt the air, and hunt your friends.
But they forgot one thing — this forest has a fairy protector.

You are the last spark of light in the darkness.
Each wave of enemies grows faster, deadlier, and more overwhelming.
The screen fills with monsters, and there is nowhere left to run.

Draw power from nature.
Level up.
Unlock devastating spells, magical auras, and new abilities.
With every minute, you transform from a fragile fairy
into a storm of magic that wipes out everything in its path.

This isn’t just survival —
it’s the fury of the forest unleashed.

Easy to start. Impossible to stop.
70010000119182.intro: Fairywood Survivors — play as a fairy guardian, unleash powerful magic, grow stronger, and survive endless waves of poisonous creatures invading your forest.
70010000119182.name: Fairywood Survivors

70010000119188.description:
VoidFront: Galactic Warfare is an intense team-based FPS
inspired by classic tactical shooters, set
in the heart of an interstellar war.

Two combat cyborg factions clash in battles
across diverse space locations:
lunar bases, scorching desert planets,
and orbital space stations.

Players gain access to a massive arsenal of futuristic plasma weapons —
from devastating shotguns
to precise sniper rifles.

Victory depends not only on accuracy,
but also on tactics, positioning,
and team coordination.
70010000119188.intro: VoidFront: Galactic Warfare — a fast-paced sci-fi FPS where cyborg factions battle across the galaxy, wielding devastating space weaponry and relying on tactical team superiority.
70010000119188.name: VoidFront: Galactic Warfare

70010000119216.description:
Get ready for the most important mission in the zoo: making sure the laziest and most adorable panda in the world reaches its favorite bamboo!

In Panda Keeper, you take on the role of the keeper and must use logic, patience, and a bit of strategy to push the big fluffy buddy around the enclosure without getting him stuck in tight corners. Each level is a new habitat filled with rocks, fences, and corridors that turn a simple “little push” into a delightful brain teaser.

With 30 short and clever stages, the game is perfect for relaxing while keeping your mind active. There’s no ticking clock, no pressure — just you, the panda, and that magical moment when everything lines up perfectly… and he finally sits down happily to munch on bamboo.

Made a wrong move? No problem! Use Undo to test new ideas or Restart to begin fresh. Here, experimenting is part of the fun.

Cute, clear, and satisfying, Panda Keeper is perfect for anyone who loves calm puzzles, strategic challenges, and the simple joy of seeing a well-fed panda at the end of each level.
70010000119216.name: Panda Keeper

70010000119228.description:
Balls vs. Tombs is a dark fantasy action-survival game built around a single, haunting purpose: to reclaim stolen souls and restore peace to a desecrated graveyard.

Once, the cemetery was a place of rest. A sacred ground where spirits slept quietly beneath stone and soil. That balance was shattered when four colossal abominations emerged from the depths, corrupting the land and absorbing every soul bound to the graves. As the spirits were torn from their resting places, the monsters grew stronger, warping the cemetery into a battlefield of rage, decay, and despair.

You are one of the few who can fight back.

CORE GAMEPLAY

At its heart, Balls vs. Tombs is a fast-paced combat experience where precision, positioning, and elemental mastery matter. You fight by launching powerful orbs—your primary weapons against waves of enraged spirits and corrupted entities.

The core loop is simple but deep:

Defeat corrupted enemies

Recover their trapped souls

Return souls to restored graves

Expand and cleanse the cemetery

Unlock new characters, powers, and combinations

Each reclaimed grave brings the world closer to balance—and brings you closer to confronting the true source of the corruption.

ELEMENTAL CHARACTERS & ORBS

Beyond the basic orb, the game features four unlockable characters, each bound to a unique elemental sphere:

Water Orb – fluid control, slowing enemies and shaping the battlefield

Air Orb – speed, mobility, and precision strikes

Poison Orb – damage over time, area corruption, and attrition

Fire Orb – raw power, explosive impact, and aggressive play

Each character fundamentally changes how the game feels, encouraging experimentation and mastery.

FUSION SYSTEM – THE HEART OF POWER

What truly sets Balls vs. Tombs apart is its Orb Fusion System.

Every elemental orb can be fused with every other orb.

Water + Fire
Air + Poison
Fire + Air
Poison + Water
…and every possible combination in between.

Each fusion creates a new, more powerful hybrid orb with unique behaviors, visuals, and combat effects. Some fusions focus on crowd control, others on burst damage, chain reactions, or battlefield dominance.

This system turns combat into a strategic sandbox, rewarding creativity and experimentation. The more you understand the elements, the more devastating your builds become.

THE CEMETERY AS PROGRESSION

There is no traditional level select.

The graveyard itself is your progression system.

As you rescue souls and rebuild graves:

New cemetery zones unlock

Stronger enemy types begin to appear

New characters and orb types become available

The world visually transforms from corruption to sanctified ground

What feels like an open, evolving environment is actually a carefully structured progression arc—a living level system disguised as world restoration.

BOSSES & NARRATIVE

The four great monsters are not random enemies. Each represents a twisted force that feeds on unrest and unfinished souls. As they absorb spirits, they grow in size, power, and presence—something reflected both in gameplay and cinematic moments.

THE GOAL

This is not just about surviving waves.

It’s about bringing peace back to the dead.

Every soul you recover matters.
Every grave you restore reshapes the world.
Every fusion you master brings you closer to ending the corruption.

Welcome to Balls vs. Tombs.
The dead are waiting.
70010000119228.intro: Restore lost souls, master elemental orbs, and cleanse a corrupted graveyard.
70010000119228.name: Balls vs. Tombs

70010000119252.description:
Jonas wake up in the middle of the night to the sound of gunfire on the neighboring farm.

Worried, you decide to investigate and discover your nightmare has come true.

Dead Arise is a tribute to zombie FPS games, a retro experience from the 1990s.

Roam through various environments, killing zombies and collecting resources.

Follow the radio call and escape this hell called the zombie apocalypse!
70010000119252.intro: A retro zombie FPS paying tribute to classic console games from the 1990s
70010000119252.name: Zombie Arise

70010000119266.description:
"CYBER COMMANDO" is an action game released by NAMCO LIMITED (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1994.
Board your vehicle and fight to stop a security computer malfunction that has broken out in a space colony.
The thrill of locking on and slamming missiles into a split-second opening—combined with diverse strategies unique to each vehicle—accelerates this ultimate one-on-one battle!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.
70010000119266.intro: Emergency orders from the UGSF! Cyber Commando Unit, suppress the AI rebellion!
70010000119266.name: Arcade Archives CYBER COMMANDO

70010000119309.description:
BLOCKBOUND — Swap, Warp, and Conquer!

Are you ready to defy the laws of space? Step into the world of BLOCKBOUND, an engaging pixel-art puzzle platformer where your wits are your only weapon.

In BLOCKBOUND, you don’t just walk through levels—you rewrite them. Master the unique swapping mechanic that allows you to instantly trade places with blocks. Outsmart deadly traps, navigate through complex structures, and find the path to the exit in this stylish retro-inspired challenge. It’s a perfect blend of old-school aesthetics and innovative puzzle design.

Key Features:

Swap & Solve Mechanics: Use your unique ability to swap places with objects to navigate obstacles and solve intricate environmental puzzles.

Vibrant Pixel Art: Immerse yourself in a beautifully crafted 2D world that pays homage to the classic 8-bit era.

Challenging Level Design: Tackle dozens of unique stages that will test both your reflexes and your logic.

Perfect for Nintendo Switch™: Fully optimized for Joy-Con™ controllers, offering a seamless experience in both Handheld and TV modes.

Retro Chiptune Soundtrack: Stay focused and motivated with an atmospheric soundtrack inspired by gaming history.

Master the art of the swap in BLOCKBOUND!
70010000119309.intro: One swap away from the exit
70010000119309.name: BLOCKBOUND

70010000119320.description:
The Prince of Tennis Sweet School Festival ~♡-40 and more...~ is a globally remastered edition of a legendary otome game that has been beloved in Japan for more than 20 years.

<Story>
During a joint school festival hosted by the tennis clubs of seven academies, you are chosen to serve as a member of the festival’s management committee.
Guide and support the players of your assigned school, strengthen your bonds, and strive for first place in the stall competition!

<Features>
- Experience a school life filled with romance, surrounded by many charming Princes.
- Enjoy sweet and bittersweet date events unique to each Prince!
- Experience elegant, beautifully illustrated event CGs, with some artwork enhanced by animation.

70010000119358.description:
The game is very simple!
First, watch the dance performed by the Fox Shrine Maiden carefully and memorize it well.
Be sure not to get distracted by her sexy allure and miss any part of the dance.

How to Play
To return to your original world, you must witness all the rituals performed by the Fox Shrine Maiden.
Sometimes, apparitions called "mononoke" will try to deceive you by taking on a form very similar to the Fox Shrine Maiden and tempt you.

Stay strong, watch the rituals carefully, and don’t get enchanted by the seductive fox dance, so you can spot the "mononoke"!

"One! If you believe it is my real self, call upon my name!"
"Two! If you think it to be an impostor, see through the deception at once!"
"Know that if you err in either, the ritual fails immediately!"

If you find a difference from the initial dance, press the "Fake".
If you don't find anything suspicious, watch the dance untill the end or press the "Real".
Light all 8 lanterns to return to the world you came from!

Apparition Encyclopedia
The various forms of the "mononoke" you have exposed can be recorded in an encyclopedia.
Repeat the rituals and create your very own captivating "Apparition Encyclopedia"!


<Cast>
The Fox Shrine Maiden (CV: Maaya Uchida)
70010000119358.intro:
Dancing fox shrine maiden!
A slightly sexy Apparition Find game
70010000119358.name: The Fox's Way Home – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000119367.description:
Perform Rayman’s signature punch and helicopter hair glide through colorful worlds, from the Dream Forest and its unforgettable mosquito ride to Band Land’s musical chaos. Rescue the Electoons and save the world from Mr. Dark in a classic platforming adventure with a unique art style that remains as magical today as it was in the '90s.

THE DEFINITIVE EDITION
Play the classic adventure now enhanced with an immersive, reimagined soundtrack, plus more than 120 additional levels from Rayman’s New Levels, Rayman 60 Levels, and Rayman By His Fans. And for the first time ever, offering a rare glimpse into how Rayman’s innovative gameplay first took shape.

EXCLUSIVE DOCUMENTARY
Uncover the untold story behind Rayman’s creation in an interactive documentary featuring over 50 minutes of brand-new interviews with the original developers. Dive into rare concept art, early sketches, and design documents that offer exclusive insights into the making of the limbless hero.

A CLASSIC FOR EVERYONE
Rediscover the cult-classic gameplay or take on the challenge with new features designed to keep you in the action, including a rewind, multiple save slots, and accessibility options like infinite lives and instant level unlocks.
70010000119367.intro: THE ADVENTURE THAT STARTED IT ALL
70010000119367.name: Rayman: 30th Anniversary Edition

70010000119372.description:
Enter a controlled nightmare where every challenge is designed to push you to your limits. You are one of many contestants trapped inside a secret survival facility, forced to take part in a chain of deadly trials. Under constant surveillance and surrounded by unpredictable opponents, you must stay alert, act carefully, and avoid even the smallest mistake.

Go through a series of intense stages, each with its own rules, mechanics, and hidden threats. Complete precision-based tasks, endure dangerous environments, and adjust quickly to shifting conditions. Whether it’s timing challenges or strategic group encounters, every stage becomes harder and demands faster thinking and smarter choices.

Key Features:
- Hardcore Survival Minigames — A collection of intense challenges inspired by deadly trials, each with unique mechanics and rules.
- Iconic Game Modes — Red Light – Green Light, Honeycomb, Tug of War, Glass Bridge, Cookie Stage, Glass Squares, and more.
 - Advanced NPC & Guard System — NPC contestants run, panic, and die in real time, while guards detect, chase, and eliminate players.
 - Progression & Missions — Unlock new stages, routes, and tasks through a branching mission system.
 - Realistic Physics & Death System — Detailed animations, ragdoll physics, and impactful reactions to every mistake.
 - Interactive Mechanics — Cut shapes freely, balance across dangerous paths, and face physics-based challenges.
 - Dark Atmosphere — Bright arenas combined with cold lighting, sharp shadows, and brutal, bloody outcomes.

Survive each trial, master every stage, and fight your way out of the facility alive.
70010000119372.intro: Win the game or lose everything.
70010000119372.name: Squid Survival Simulator

70010000119392.description:
Micro Mages Maker is a level editor of Micro Mages, a platform game developed for the original 8-bit console.

Including:
New level editor to build and share your own towers.
20 new levels to play!
Micro Mages, the original 8-bit game.
Micro Mages: Second Quest, the extra levels DLC.

Become the evil mastermind behind new traps and challenges. Build and design your own deadly tower with your crew of goblins. Choose from a range of enemies, including new ones, such as the Tele Bubble Goats and Jumpy Goblins.

Build, share and play new levels!
The maker also comes with 20 premade levels waiting to take you on new platforming adventures :)

Play solo or join forces with your friends. This game supports up to 4 players. Shoot and wall jump your way up the fortress' towers.
Battle the evil bosses lurking  in Micro Mages and Micro Mages: Second Quest.

No downtime: If you die while at least one other player is still alive, you will turn into a ghost and can help by freezing enemies. Try to open crates and treasure chests to find a Fairy or Feather that will bring you back to life.

Will you help each other to overcome the dangerous traps built to stop nosy adventurers or will you turn on your comrades to snatch the high score?
70010000119392.intro: Create your own levels, share them with everyone! Play solo or with up to 4 players simultaneously!
70010000119392.name: Micro Mages Maker

70010000119396.description:
The Culdcept series has captivated players worldwide. Now, the original masterpiece returns, enhanced with convenient new features.
Build your deck from over 300 types of cards and witness the dawn of a new battle among Cepter.

◆The "Book" of the Gods moves the world.
On the continent of Bablashca, where the chief god Culdra once clashed with the neutral god Baltias, humanity—Culdra’s final creation—had long flourished.
However, the world fell into chaos when stone tablets discovered across the land were revealed to be fragments of "Culdcept"—the Book of Creation and Destruction.
Driven by the mythical prophecy that "he who commands the Culdcept shall gain infinite power," Cepter began to fight one another over the scattered fragments.
As the ravages of war spread, a lone youth finally rises and sets out on a long, epic journey.

◆A Battle of Offense and Defense for Territory
Players become "Cepter" who wield cards, heading into battle with a self-constructed 50-card "Book" (deck).
Move across the map guided by the roll of the dice and summon creatures using cards on the spaces where you land. Any land where you place a creature becomes your territory.
By using Spell Cards, you can manipulate dice rolls, support your creatures, or sabotage your rivals.
The first Cepter to collect the target amount of Magic Power and return to the Castle (the starting point) is declared the winner.
After a match, you will receive a random set of cards based on your ranking. Incorporate these new cards into your Book and refine your tactics for the next battle.

◆Incandescent Battles Featuring 180 Types of Creatures
When you land on another player's territory, you must pay Magic Power as a toll. However, by summoning a creature and winning a battle, you can claim that territory as your own.
In battle, the key to victory lies not only in a creature's stats and special abilities but also in Item Card effects and support bonuses from the land or allies.
Seize territories and increase your Magic Power to gain the upper hand in the game.

◆Equipped with New Features for a Smoother Gameplay Experience
【Rewind】Rewind the game to any point someone passed a Checkpoint at a Fort or the Castle.
【Quick Save & Load】Enables you to save and load at any time, independent of the main game's standard save function.
【Bonus Pack】Increases the number of reward cards received at the end of a match. This can be toggled ON/OFF in the options menu.
【Reveal Hands】This feature allows you to constantly display both your own and your opponent's hand on-screen—information that was only visible at specific times in the original version. It can be toggled ON/OFF, and the display size adjusts automatically according to the game's screen layout.
70010000119396.intro: The pinnacle of board game and card game fusion is back.
70010000119396.name: Culdcept The First

70010000119417.description:
- This is a Nintendo Switch™ version product.
There is also a version of this game for the Nintendo Switch™ 2. Please take care not to buy the wrong version by mistake.

DRAGON QUEST I & II HD-2D Remake is a stunning reimagining of the first two legendary adventures in the Erdrick trilogy, brought together in one package.

(Players can play either DRAGON QUEST I or II whenever they want by selecting their preferred title on the game's start screen.)

DRAGON QUEST I Story:
Thanks to the heroic efforts of the legendary Erdrick, the Lord of the Underworld was defeated and peace returned to the land of Alefgard. Yet this peace was not to last, as the diabolical Dragonlord has risen and unleashed hordes of monsters on the realm once more. Now, descendant of Erdrick, it is your destiny to defeat this new evil and rescue the world from its plight!

The Setting:
This tale takes place in the land of Alefgard, a realm given shape by a goddess known as Rubiss. The hero travels the land hoping to slay the mighty Dragonlord once and for all. Along the way he meets plenty of charming characters and faces numerous fearsome foes.

DRAGON QUEST II Story:
Many years have passed since Alefgard was saved at the hero's hand, earning him the same title as his storied forebear. The descendants of this Erdrick and his scions founded three kingdoms that thrived in peacetime. Yet, darkness stirs once more and a sudden invasion of malicious monsters plunges the world into shadow again. All that stands between the forces of evil and their wicked ambitions is a band of young princes and princesses of Erdrick's lineage. The time has come for them to venture forth and honor their ancestor's legacy!

The Setting:
Explore a world filled with locales visited by the legendary hero as well as a host of new towns, castles, caves, and dungeons.
As the story progresses, you'll obtain a ship, which will allow you to traverse the seas and rivers, and broaden your horizons ever further.

The Party:
The Prince of Midenhall, the game's protagonist, is joined on his quest by his cousins the Prince of Cannock, the Princess of Moonbrooke and, entirely new to this version of the game, the Princess of Cannock. These four descendants of the legendary hero, Erdrick, band together to protect the world from evil forces.

Turn-based Battles:
Enjoy the traditional turn-based battles the series is known for. Attack with an assembly of weapons and let loose all kinds of spells and abilities to slay the many menacing monsters.
70010000119417.name: DRAGON QUEST I & II HD-2D Remake

70010000119427.description:
Join Ringo, a young martial artist looking for her brother, and Wolfe, a mysterious scoundrel running from his past, as they join forces in an unlikely partnership to collect the pieces of the fabled Wanderstar Map. Across 10 “episodes” of anime-inspired adventure, Ringo and Wolfe will have to work together to find answers, make up for past mistakes, and travel across the universe in search of their goal. And who knows, maybe they’ll learn how to get along at some point!

Trained in the ways of Kiai, a magical form of martial art and also the universe’s most exciting form of televised entertainment, Ringo can combine words to create customized attacks in intense turn-based battles. During her race across the universe you’ll expand Ringo’s vocabulary, equip Pep Up bonuses earned through honorable victories and level up her spirit power. Defeat or befriend a cast of fearsome space pirates, mysterious scoundrels, cute witches, high school delinquents, talking crows, and skilled martial artists on your way to becoming a Kiai master.

USE YOUR WORDS
Create custom attacks by combining words up to the limit of your spirit level. The more spirit you have, the more slots you have to place words into and the more powerful and complex actions you can take.

All words have cool downs and opponents might be weak or strong against specific attacks or specific elements. You won’t know which until you engage them in battle so you need to be prepared to improvise.

COLLECT THEM ALL
With over 200 words to collect across the game there is a near infinite number of possible unique attacks to make. Things start off easy but as you expand Ringo’s vocabulary you’ll need to carefully select which words you take into battle, building strategies around your mix of categories, blend of offensive and defensive words, giving yourself options to manage your opponents weaknesses and strengths, consider optimizing the juggling of cool downs and, of course, which attacks sound the coolest.

The result is an accessible, immediately fun but deep combat system.

STEP UP WITH PEP UPS
The core ethos of the Kiai martial art is to fight with honor. Defeating an opponent with honor can turn the most heated of rivals into the fastest of friends! Befriend your rivals to earn their words of encouragement in the form of useful Pep Ups which can be equipped to give you special bonuses in combat.

THE STARS CALL
Travel the universe on a rollercoaster adventure as you seek the pieces of the Wanderstar map, Ringo’s lost brother and the answers to Wolfe’s mysterious past.

UNLIKELY ALLIES
Along the way you’ll build a found family of colorful characters, each with their own thing going on. They might not all get along at first, but that’s nothing a thrilling space adventure can’t fix! And even with the trail gone cold, take heart, for these wandering stars are bound to find each other...

AN ANIME YOU CAN PLAY
Inspired by anime the developers grew up watching, Wander Stars plays out across 10 “episodes”, each one taking between 60-90 minutes to complete. Each episode features a map to explore with procedurally generated battles, special events and other secrets to find along with the main story events.

Play an episode at a time, or binge the whole thing in one go! You can even replay episodes to find all the side adventures, NPCs, and party member banter you might have missed! Try new paths as you explore ever-changing maps with randomized special events, lurking rivals, and tantalizing treasures. The experience is never quite the same!
70010000119427.intro: Unleash custom attacks by combining words in this Super! Anime! Turn-Based! RPG!
70010000119427.name: Wander Stars

70010000119460.description:
Kamikaze Strike: FPV Drone pushes the boundaries of modern combat simulation, putting your piloting skills to the ultimate test in high-stakes, first-person kamikaze missions. This isn't just a game; it’s a high-octane descent into the future of electronic warfare, where your precision determines the outcome of the frontline.

Experience ultra-smooth, responsive drone controls engineered to mimic professional racing rigs. From the immersive FPV cockpit, you’ll navigate hostile, high-threat environments where every second counts. You aren't just flying—you are the weapon.
Master the Art of the Strike

Become a ghost in the machine as you weave through "dead zones." To reach your objective, you must:

    -Dodge Enemy Fire: Evade rapid-fire anti-air guns and small arms fire.

    -Neutralize Electronic Warfare: Navigate around signal jammers and radar arrays that threaten to kill your feed.

    -Precision Impact: Deliver devastating payloads by crashing directly into high-value military assets, including heavy tanks, mobile artillery units, and fortified enemy command centers.

Realistic Military Training & Progression

Before heading into the heat of battle, hone your craft in the Dedicated Training Grounds. This expansive training map is designed for pilots to master:

    -High-Speed Technical Flight: Push your motors to the limit through gate races and tight gaps.

    -Acrobatic Maneuvers: Practice power loops, dives, and sharp snaps to become unpredictable to enemy sensors.

    -Tactical Drills: Simulate approach runs on static targets to perfect your terminal velocity and impact angles.

The True Pilot Experience

With cutting-edge flight physics and a simulated analog/digital video feed, you will feel the weight, inertia, and adrenaline of a real-world drone operator. Every vibration and signal flicker pulls you deeper into the role of a modern elite pilot.

Kamikaze Strike delivers an authentic, gritty, and explosive blend of pilot skill and military strategy. The sky is no longer a limit—it’s your playground of destruction.
70010000119460.intro: Fly a kamikaze drone through fast-paced FPV missions. Dodge bullets, sneak past jammers and radars, and crash into tanks, troops, and enemy bases.
70010000119460.name: Kamikaze Strike:FPV Drone

70010000119466.description:
Six Seven Nights is a compact first-person survival horror focused on investigation, atmosphere, and escalating tension.

You are sent to a school locals openly call cursed. It has been closed for months after a chain of unexplained incidents and growing panic in the surrounding area. Strange sightings, nightly disturbances, and psychological breakdowns are all tied to the building — or so people believe.

With fear spreading and pressure mounting, authorities decide on a simple solution: demolish the school. Your employer disagrees.

According to the Bureau, destroying the building won't end the phenomenon — it may make it far worse. You are sent in to prevent a disaster before it's too late.

The game unfolds across six playable nights. Each night:
• expands the accessible areas of the school
• introduces new paranormal behavior
• increases pressure and unpredictability

You explore a damaged, partially collapsed building, clearing debris, opening sealed rooms, and uncovering clues through environmental storytelling, notes, and strange markings scattered throughout the school. There is no combat — survival depends on observation, timing, and understanding how the environment responds to your actions.

A persistent hostile presence roams the school and reacts dynamically. Some actions draw attention. Others reduce it. Learning the difference is part of surviving.

Between nights, you receive calls from a Bureau specialist who helps contextualize what you're dealing with — offering guidance without direct answers. The truth is never handed to you.

You have six nights because the seventh day is irreversible.
If you fail, demolition won't erase what's here — it will unleash it.

Features:
• First-person survival horror with a unique combat system
• Six-night structure with escalating tension
• One evolving location that changes with progress
• Environmental puzzles inspired by classic horror
• A reactive entity that responds to player behavior
• Heavy focus on atmosphere, sound, and observation

The school is not just a location.
It's a problem that's running out of time.
70010000119466.intro: You have six nights. The seventh day changes everything.
70010000119466.name: Six Seven Nights

70010000119548.description:
In Trusted Hands is a narrative-driven repair shop simulator where fixing phones turns dealing with people’s private lives. Messages, photos, and hidden files can surface during repairs, placing you in the middle of secrets you were never meant to see.

As the story unfolds, customers with complicated pasts cross your path, and strangers with unclear motives begin asking for information in exchange for money. Every decision matters — what you share, what you hide, and who you choose to help can change lives, shape the city, and affect your own future.

You run a small phone repair shop under constant pressure: exhaustion, stress, rent, and inspections are part of daily life. The repair process is intentionally simple, keeping the focus on moral choices, relationships, and long-term consequences rather than technical complexity.
70010000119548.intro: Dive into the daily work of a cozy workshop in a big city, manage client data, balance energy and stress, and make choices that shape the story and its outcome.

70010000119583.description:
In Amanda the Adventurer 3, continue Riley Park’s journey, immediately following the events of the previous game, as they discover the truth behind the ongoing mysteries surrounding Amanda and Hameln.

After being left a mysterious tape by their Aunt Kate that set into motion a series of events surrounding the children’s show Amanda the Adventurer, Riley Park survived their Aunt’s attic only to find more mysteries and danger awaiting at the Kensdale Public Library. With the help of a mysterious masked woman, Riley barely escaped the library with their life, and now must explore the abandoned Hameln facilities.

In the final game, play through a return to form taking the best elements of both previous games to create an experience that is bound to thrill both returning and new players alike.

FEATURES

- Challenging, escape room style puzzles using clues hidden within the tapes
- Interact with Amanda, and friends in an all new series of 90’s style CGI adventures!
- New Area: You’re not at the Kensdale Public Library anymore! Explore an abandoned Hameln Facility with decades of secrets to uncover.
- Bring closure to the story of Amanda, Riley, Aunt Kate, and everyone affected by the sinister production of Amanda the Adventurer and the Hameln Corporation’s mysterious motivations.
70010000119583.intro: Get ready for one last adventure!
70010000119583.name: Amanda the Adventurer 3

- 9 levels with changing differences to find (we didn't really count all the combinations, sorry!)
