- hints
70010000119595.intro: Ready to test your detective skills? Find the differences between two similar dragon-themed scenes!
70010000119595.name: There's No Differences: Dragons

70010000119607.description:
Gunvolt Chronicles: Luminous Avenger iX 1+2 Dual Collection brings together and updates the apeX of 2D action for new and old players alike.
The Dual Collection includes both Luminous Avenger iX 1 and 2, with all all DLC included, as well as balance adjustments.
It also features a new mode, Endless Battle.

●Revised balance "Director's Cut"
Luminous Avenger iX's Darkness Trigger "berserk" mode has been powered up.
Luminous Avenger iX 2 receives a new "Spike Smash" system, powering up Copen's main weapon, the Razor Wheel.
A number of other adjustments also improve gameplay balance.

●All DLC included
Every item is built in, including content that was previously limited availability.

●New "Endless Battle" mode
Luminous Avenger iX and Luminous Avenger iX 2 each receive a special mode, "Endless Battle". Configure the settings to your liking before facing off against an endless onslaught of random bosses.
How many will you be able to defeat? Take on the apeX challenge!

●Two sci-fi action stories filled with character
Copen is a hard-boiled fighter in a grim future distopia.
Can he save the powerless people he meets? And can they save him?

[Voice Cast]
Copen: Yuma Uchida (Japanese)
           Alejandro Saab (English, iX 2)
Lola: Mayu Mineda (Japanese)
        Cassandra Lee Morris (English, iX 2)
Kohaku: Yumiri Hanamori (Japanese)
            Kira Buckland (English, iX 2)
Blade: Yui Ishikawa (Japanese)
Null: Sumire Morohoshi (Japanese)
       Natalie Rose Hoover (English)
70010000119607.intro: The complete iX series, refined. The apeX of 2D action reaches a new peak!
70010000119607.name: Gunvolt Chronicles: Luminous Avenger iX 1+2 Dual Collection

70010000119645.description:
Plane Flight Simulator lets you experience the thrill of flying like never before. Step into the pilot’s seat with a single goal: master the skies and grow your aviation career from humble beginnings to global recognition. Every flight challenges your skills, strategy, and courage as you explore the world from above.

Key Features:
• Fleet Management: Purchase and upgrade aircraft — from light private planes to powerful passenger jets — improving speed, maneuverability, and reliability.
• Infrastructure Development: Expand hangars, improve your airbase, and optimize conditions for maintaining your fleet.
• Realistic Weather Conditions: Navigate wind, rain, fog, and thunderstorms, adapting to every challenge with precision.
• Day and Night Cycle: Fly at sunrise, bright daylight, sunset, or under the stars for truly immersive experiences.
• Freedom of Exploration: Unlock dozens of airports worldwide, discover new routes, and test your reflexes, endurance, and piloting skills.

Plane Flight Simulator is more than just flying — it’s a journey of ambition, courage, and discipline. Fly, upgrade, explore, and become a true king of the skies.
70010000119645.intro: Discover new horizons and build your aviation empire.
70010000119645.name: Plane Flight Simulator

70010000119651.description:
"There is a saying that when you depart from this world, the dog who went ahead will warmly welcome you."

Bong-gu the Welsh Corgi was once an abandoned dog. Judging by his docked tail, someone had once cared for him, but for some reason, he became unwanted. As an 8-year-old senior dog with various illnesses, it was hard for him to find a new family. Trapped in a cage at an animal shelter, each day passed gloomily for Bong-gu. Then one day, a miracle happened. Bong-gu met a new family. The man who took Bong-gu had a somewhat scruffy appearance and seemed slightly awkward, but Bong-gu loved his scent. From that day on, Bong-gu lived out his remaining days just like any other dog would: playing tug-of-war, running around, eating, and sleeping. In the end, he crossed the rainbow bridge, having lived out a simple yet joyful life.

Sniff sniff… this scent… One day in dog heaven, Bong-gu wakes from his nap to a very familiar scent. Sniff sniff… it's dad!. Though faint, surely it is dad's scent he has been waiting for. Jubilant, Bong-gu escapes dog heaven and embarks on a journey to meet his dad - a journey that may hold unexpected dangers. Just as his dad once found him by some miracle, it is now Bong-gu’s turn to find his dad.

Will Bong-gu be able to see his dad again?

[An adventure in a beautiful world filled with stories of dogs and people]

Teetering on the border between life and death, a world outside of dog heaven feels both familiar and strange. Embark on an adventure through beautifully crafted landscapes including deserts, snowy mountains, and beaches. Experience diverse gameplay across adventure, action, racing genres. And remember, Bong-gu is a dog! Actions like sniffing, barking, running, and jumping come with limitations. To overcome his limitations and reunite with his dad, he must meet, give, and receive help from people and other dogs, each with unique stories to share. Unlike cats, there is only so much a dog can do alone!

[In the end, this is a story for all of us]

At the end of his journey, Bong-gu finally reunites with his dad. The journey is filled with joy and excitement, but also moments of hardship and sadness. Yet, the ending has always been written: those destined to meet again will find their way back together. My Little Puppy may be a story about a dog, but it is also a story of relationships, farewells, and reunions that speaks to us all. For those waiting to see their once-in-a-lifetime friend or family member again, or those preparing for an inevitable parting that may come, we hope this story brings warm comfort. One day, we will meet again.
70010000119651.intro: "They say a dog who went ahead waits to welcome you in the end."
70010000119651.name: My Little Puppy

70010000119652.description:
"R-Type" is a milestone in sci-fi shooter games.
A simulation game themed on space fleet battles with the R-Type worldview- that's "R-Type Tactics".

■ Diverse Missions, Overwhelming Scale
Battle across a wide range of environments—from outer space to eerie creature lairs and the inner depths of Space Fortresses.
Your enemies include unknown vicious lifeforms, rampaging machines gone out of control, and rebel factions driven by conflicting ideologies. More than 100 missions await you.

■ A Turn-Based System That Lets You Think Through Every Move
Turn-based gameplay lets you take your time to plan each move with care.

■ You Are the Space Fleet Commander
As the commander of the space fleet, you take command of your forces.
Develop new fighters and spacecraft, organize your fleet, and prepare for the battles ahead.

■ Outsmart the Enemy with Tactical Ingenuity
On the battlefield, enemy forces lie in wait for your fleet.
Stay on top of scouting and resupply, and maneuver your units into positions where they can effectively engage the enemy.
Send squads into the enemy’s blind spots or leverage electronic warfare systems to turn the tide of battle in your favor.

■ A Chronicle of a Journey to Save Humanity from Extinction
As the protagonist and the commander, you push through mission after mission against formidable enemies, leaving the Solar System behind and traveling across unfathomable distances to reach the source of the lifeforms driving humanity toward extinction.
The story unfolds through a logbook written by you.
When you finally defeat the unknown lifeforms and return home, the people of Earth will surely welcome you and your fleet with open arms.
Now, the time has come. Your journey begins—let’s go.

■Story — Humanity places the fate of Earth in the hands of a young fleet commander.

Humanity was on the brink of extinction,
— threatened by a ferocious, unknown lifeform that had emerged from the depths of space.

People came to call this dreadful swarm of creatures “Bydo,” and they feared it above all else.
In response to this unprecedented crisis, a unified government was formed, and a space fleet was assembled to fight back. But their efforts proved powerless against the Bydo.

But amid the struggle, humanity gained the technology to control and weaponize the Bydo.
With the creation of the Bydo-based weapon, the Force System, humanity gradually gained enough power to resist the Bydo, at least in localized engagements.

Humanity took a gamble.
They entrusted the bulk of their available forces to a young commander and sent him deep into the heart of the star system where the Bydo originated— to eradicate them once and for all.

■ Additional Content
Multiple new missions and units are planned for release after launch.
70010000119652.intro: Cosmos – The Ultimate Sci-Fi Simulation Game.
70010000119652.name: R-TYPE TACTICS I･II COSMOS

70010000119658.description: Defeat the crazy robots and save the city! Obtain a variety of weapons and props to tackle various challenges.
70010000119658.name: Quantum Beast

70010000119679.description: Battle ferocious Lions, Devils, Witches, Dragons, and more. Collect gold and meat, upgrade weapons, and don a powerful cape to become unstoppable!
70010000119679.intro: Embark on a thrilling adventure across 18 immersive 3D levels!
70010000119679.name: Zawisza The Black

70010000119687.description:
Gems of Egypt is an exciting match-3 puzzle where gems of different shapes fall from above, and your goal is to line up three or more stones to clear them from the board.

Plan your moves, react quickly to the falling pieces, and create powerful matches to score higher and keep the board under control. With simple rules, smooth gameplay, and an authentic ancient Egypt atmosphere, the game is perfect for both quick sessions and long relaxing play.
70010000119687.intro: Treasures of Egypt await your match!
70010000119687.name: Gems of Egypt

70010000119709.description:
Players earn money, draw cards, and sell duplicates as they work toward completing a full collection of all 50 maid cards.
The game loop follows a simple, intuitive cycle — Earn → Draw → Sell → Collect More — making it easy to pick up and play even in short sessions.
Cards are divided into four rarity tiers: N / R / SR / SSR.
SSR cards are rare and harder to obtain, so the thrill of chasing them only grows as your collection expands.
Unlock 10-Roll Gacha and Ultimate Gacha by meeting certain conditions, letting you build your collection even more efficiently.
Duplicate cards can be sold, and since sell prices fluctuate randomly, timing your sales becomes part of the strategy.
Beyond collecting, the game rewards smart resource management and well-timed decisions.
Cards you've obtained can also be displayed in a 3D Showcase.
Arrange your favorites to build your very own collection space and savor the satisfaction of completing your set.
Gather funds through minigames, pull the gacha, put cards on display, and aim for full completion.
Simple, accessible, and deeply satisfying for any collector.
【Features】
・Only maid character cards — a focused, themed collection
・Full 50-card collection to complete
・Four rarity tiers: N / R / SR / SSR
・Sell duplicate cards to fund more draws
・Fluctuating sell prices add strategic depth
・10-Roll Gacha and Ultimate Gacha included
・Display cards in a 3D Showcase
・Minigames included for earning funds
・One-time purchase — no subscriptions, play at your own pace
70010000119709.intro: MAID CARD GACHA: COLLECT, DISPLAY, COMPLETE is a collection-focused gacha simulator featuring exclusively maid character cards.
70010000119709.name: MAID CARD GACHA : COLLECT, DISPLAY, COMPLETE

70010000119733.description:
Burn rubber, fire rockets, and survive the arena in this explosive combat racing experience.

RACE: Rocket Arena Car Extreme throws you into a post-apocalyptic world of armored cars, deadly tracks, and all-out vehicular warfare. Every race is a battle where speed, firepower, and survival decide who rules the arena.

Play solo or challenge friends in local split-screen mode and prove who dominates the battlefield.

Pick from 21 unique cars, each with its own ultimate ability, upgrade path, and special body kits. Choose your class - SPEEDSTER, GUNNER, or CRUSHER - and master a wide arsenal of abilities, from rocket salvos and mini-missiles to teleport swaps, laser drones, flamethrowers, ghost summons, freezing blasts, and electric traps.

Race through 7 locations, face 5 unique bosses, and test your skills across Career, Event, Season, and Split-Screen modes. Every boss features distinct mechanics and attack patterns, from rocket barrages and enemy summons to teleport strikes, poison shots, and ice crystal traps.

With a variety of mission types and deep upgrade systems, every run offers a new way to dominate the road.

Event mode features tournaments built around specific cars, where you build your run by choosing skill cards between stages and survive with a single shared HP bar.

Season mode introduces daily challenges and leaderboards - complete missions, set records, and earn rewards.

Features:
• 20+ hours of combat racing in Career mode
• 21 unique cars with ultimate abilities
• 3 car classes: SPEEDSTER, GUNNER, CRUSHER
• 4 game modes: Career, Event, Season, Split-Screen
• 7 distinct locations and 5 unique bosses
• Wide range of weapons, abilities, and upgrades
• Local split-screen multiplayer on one console
70010000119733.intro: Jump into explosive combat racing where every track is a battlefield and every rival is a target.
70010000119733.name: RACE: Rocket Arena Car Extreme

70010000119744.description:
Urban Jungle is a charming and relaxing simulation game that invites you to transform ordinary apartments into a lush, green haven by placing delightful plants with savvy. But no worries, you won’t have to deal with watering or pest control – the plants just need a good spot, and that's enough to create to comfiest and coziest home of them all. Oh, and don’t forget to pet your cat!

Features:

- Decorate with Plants: The core gameplay revolves around arranging a diverse selection of plants in your apartment. Each plant can be placed in different spots, challenging you to find the optimal placement to enhance the room’s coziness and aesthetics.
- Puzzle Elements: While the game is primarily about decoration, it includes puzzle-like aspects. You’ll need to think strategically about where to place each plant to maximize the comfort and visual appeal of your home, ultimately unlocking new plants.
- Relaxing Atmosphere: Urban Jungle is designed to be a stress-free experience. There are no time limits or high-pressure scenarios. You can move plants around freely and adjust your setup at your own pace.
- Environmental Storytelling: The game’s narrative is subtly woven into the environment. As you progress, you’ll uncover pieces of a heartwarming story that unfolds across the different stages of the protagonist's life.
- Interactive Elements: In addition to plants, you can interact with other items like lamps and humidifiers to alter the ambiance of your apartment, further enhancing the cozy feeling.

Immerse yourself in the serene joy of plant decoration, where every decision brings your apartment closer to becoming a perfect green sanctuary.
70010000119744.intro: Use luscious plants to turn your home into a green haven in Urban Jungle.
70010000119744.name: Urban Jungle

70010000119751.description:
Drive Thru Fast Food Simulator throws you into the fast-paced world of a high-poly, first-person drive-thru restaurant, where you are both a worker and the manager. From prepping ingredients to handing out orders through the service window, every task is in your hands. Can you serve every customer quickly, keep the kitchen running smoothly, and turn your restaurant into the city’s favorite spot?

Key Features:
• Order & Cook with Precision: Grill burgers, slice vegetables, fry perfect fries, fill sodas, and serve ice cream — all in real-time, with attention to detail.
• Supply & Logistics Management: Order everything from meat and vegetables to branded packaging. Receive deliveries at the back door and unload manually to keep your kitchen stocked.
• Cleanliness & Maintenance: Greasy stoves and messy floors demand constant attention. Use cleaning tools regularly to maintain hygiene and avoid penalties.
• Drive-Thru Service: Take orders from cars, prepare meals efficiently, and hand them out through the service window to keep drivers satisfied and your reputation high.
• Reputation & Time Management: Each on-time order boosts your rating, unlocking new features and attracting more customers. Prepare for busy rush hours, manage opening and closing times, and balance kitchen duties with supply and cleaning tasks.

In Drive Thru Fast Food Simulator, every day is a race against time. Strategic planning, quick hands, and careful multitasking are key to running a successful drive-thru. Step behind the counter, master the kitchen, and transform your small restaurant into the city’s ultimate fast-food hotspot. Are you ready to serve the perfect order under pressure?
70010000119751.intro: Build your fast-food empire from the ground up.
70010000119751.name: Drive Thru Fast Food Simulator

70010000119757.description:
A physics-driven 3D rolling platformer built around control, balance, and deliberate movement. Navigate hazard-filled stages where narrow paths, collapsing tiles, enemies, and instant-death traps demand careful planning and precise execution.

More than fifty handcrafted stages offer multiple routes and constant risk–reward decisions, encouraging experimentation without forcing a single solution. Progress is measured through mastery, with star ratings awarded for collecting every coin in a stage.

Optional red coin challenges push skilled players into dangerous territory for pure completion prestige, while collected coins can be spent on cosmetic ball skins that never affect gameplay. With clear, readable visuals, consistent physics, and a gradual difficulty curve, the experience is suited to both short play sessions and long-term mastery.
70010000119757.name: Roll Mad

70010000119758.description:
Become Paint
Utilize paint-based mechanics to experience a constant state of flow—dive into the ground and walls, slice through the air and enemies!

Wield Your Brush
Become stronger by unlocking new techniques with your brush that aid you in defeating threatening foes, overcoming platform challenges, solving complex puzzles, and advancing your progress.

Discover Yourself
Explore Constance's non-linear interconnected world and discover countless secrets, abilities, upgrades, characters, side quests, and inspiring moments.

Strive for Balance
Using your brush techniques will corrupt your Paint. If you become fully corrupted, negative effects await you, so be wary!

Get Inspired
Use inspirations that you find on your travels to sketch in your journal. Your sketches enhance and customize Constance's capabilities. By gathering materials, you can upgrade your sketches into even stronger artworks.

Choice in Death
Upon death, choose how to continue your journey. Do you want to persevere through the challenge, at a price? Or do you return to a safe point and explore other unbeaten paths?

Rich Imagined World
The inner world is strongly connected to Constance's mental health journey, with each colorful biome and its unique set of enemies and characters representing different aspects of her psyche and personal history.

Interactive Backstory
Experience playable flashbacks about personal struggle, creativity, work-life-balance, and inner purpose. Step into Constance's socks to uncover her past!
70010000119758.intro: Presented by PARCO GAMES and Blue Backpack, Constance is a 2D hand-drawn action-adventure about an artist escaping a decaying inner world shaped by her own mind.
70010000119758.name: Constance

70010000119775.description:
In this unique survival horror game, classical music intertwines with psychological terror to create an oppressive, chilling atmosphere. You play Alice, an ordinary girl who wakes up to find herself trapped in a bizarre, ever-changing world. A snowbound orphanage, monsters lurking in the shadows, and intricate puzzles—every step is fraught with danger and uncertainty.

To survive, you must gather supplies, evade pursuit, and uncover the secrets hidden in the darkness. But as the truth gradually comes to light, can you bear the cruel reality behind it all?

Gameplay features:
Action Shooting
Use a variety of firearms to defeat enemies

Map Exploration
Explore the eerie orphanage step by step, collecting items to unlock new areas while confronting unexplained changes that may occur without warning

Resource Management
Gather and make prudent use of limited resources, and do whatever it takes to survive

Puzzle Solving
Gather clues, solve a wide range of puzzles, and uncover the final truth
70010000119775.intro: A nightmare you cannot wake from, a pain that refuses to fade.
70010000119775.name: SEEK

70010000119823.description:
Join Bubsy on a new, intergalactic, platforming adventure! Yeah, we couldn’t believe it either. The world’s most infamous, wise-cracking bobcat has returned to 3D with new challenges, new moves, and even more personality – in space! Run, jump, glide, and roll across alien planets, battle robotic sheep, and collect tons and tons of yarn. What could possibly go wrong?

Bubsy’s longstanding enemies, the fleece-obsessed Woolies, have stolen all of the Earth’s sheep. Oh well, that ain’t Bubsy’s problem. Until the sheep overthrow their captors and return as deadly BaaBots, empowered by Woolie technology, determined to steal Bubsy’s most prized possession, The Golden Fleece.

With the help of his motley crew of acquaintances, Bubsy must journey through space to defeat the BaaBots and take back the Golden Fleece. Luckily, he’s acquired some new skills to navigate the expansive, craft-themed levels. Bubsy can leap, glide, claw his way up walls, and pounce off enemies. He can also puff up into a new hairball form to roll at blistering speeds.

The team at Fabraz crafted this expressive new moveset to cater to beginners and speedrun enthusiasts alike. Once you’ve mastered Bubsy’s awesome new moves, show off your skills by uploading your best level times to the online leaderboards for other players to race against!

Features
- Explore intergalactic, craft-themed worlds, each ending in a BaaBot boss battle
- New hairball form allows you to roll, bounce, and launch your way around
- An expressive platforming moveset supports both beginner and advanced levels of play
- Spend yarn to purchase stylish new outfits, or collect a hidden blueprint in each level to unlock new moves and upgrades
- Tackle each level’s time trial, upload your best run, and race against other players’ ghost data
- Chat with a cast of familiar friends including Terri, Terry, Virgil, and Oblivia
- Positively funky soundtrack by Fat Bard, incorporating elements of jazz, big band, electro-swing and more
70010000119823.intro: Bubsy is back in a new 3D platforming adventure! What could possibly go wrong?
70010000119823.name: Bubsy 4D

70010000119869.description:
Carom Billiards - The Ultimate Carambole Experience

Experience the most authentic carom billiards simulation available on console. Step up to the table and master the elegant art of carambole, where precision and finesse meet strategic play.

In carom billiards, two players compete using cue balls—one white, one yellow. Your objective: strike your cue ball so it contacts both other balls in a single shot. Pure, skillful billiards at its finest.

Features:

-Hyper-Realistic Physics Engine
Every shot behaves exactly as it would on a real carom table. Execute advanced techniques including jump shots, topspin, backspin, screw shots, and massé. Watch as balls respond to spin, speed, and angle with stunning accuracy.

-Precision Controls & Targeting
Intuitive controls put professional-level shot-making at your fingertips. Apply English, adjust power, and fine-tune your aim with responsive controls designed for both newcomers and seasoned players.

-Challenging AI Opponent
Face off against a formidable computer opponent that plays smart, tactical carom billiards. Beatable with skill and practice, but never a pushover—prepare for a genuine challenge.

-Local Multiplayer
Challenge friends to head-to-head matches on the same device. Perfect for settling disputes about who's the true carom champion.

Discover why carom billiards is considered the purest form of cue sports—no pockets, just skill.
70010000119869.name: Carom Billiards

70010000119901.description:
Car Simulator : Driving School puts you behind the wheel and lets you become a true master of the road! Explore vast open regions inspired by real-world locations, drive an impressive collection of cars across multiple categories, and take on a wide variety of driving challenges — all powered by realistic handling and immersive driving conditions.

Choose from 48 detailed vehicles, including hatchbacks, sedans, coupes, SUVs, supercars, and hypercars. Complete 75 unique missions, race on 3 dedicated tracks, or enjoy Free Ride mode across all maps. Customize your car inside and out with paint options, bodykits, interior trims, and more.

Features:

• 48 cars to choose from, including 11 hatchbacks, 7 sedans, 9 coupes, 7 SUVs, 9 supercars, and 5 hypercars
• 8 open regions inspired by real locations: Washington, Chicago, Madrid, Montreal, Arizona Countryside, Texas Highway, European Countryside, and Europe Highway
• 75 missions ranging from beginner driving lessons to advanced challenges
• 3 Race Tracks plus Free Ride mode available on all maps
• Extensive vehicle customization, including exterior paint, bodykits, wheels, interior trims, and more
• 4 selectable driving conditions: Daytime, Nighttime, Dusk, and Rain
• Realistic driving physics and detailed vehicle interiors
• Explore, practice, race, or simply cruise — the choice is yours

Become the ultimate driver with Car Simulator : Driving School!
70010000119901.intro:
Feel the engine. Hear the world.
Every road becomes a story —
and you’re the one behind the wheel.
70010000119901.name: Car Simulator : Driving School

70010000119910.description:
LeMrosh in the Lazy Kingdom is a funny point-and-click adventure game set in a medieval kingdom where nothing is as it seems. What starts out as a simple quest quickly turns into a tangle of puzzles, strange items and quirky characters. Explore, experiment, and talk along the way through a kingdom where even the wrong choices can lead to unexpected (and often hilarious) results - whether you mean to or not.

FEATURES
■ Classic point-and-click adventure game inspired by 90’s legends
■ Over 12 hours of story-driven gameplay with multiple twists
■ Solve clever and unconventional puzzles
■ Explore over 200 unique locations across a strange medieval kingdom
■ Meet a large cast of quirky and memorable characters
■ Full English voiceover across the entire game
■ Unique interactions: most actions trigger custom, often humorous responses
■ Experiment freely - even wrong choices can lead to funny outcomes
■ Clean interface with intuitive actions (examine, use, talk, collect)
■ A lighthearted story with a touch of romance

As LeMrosh says: "Spin it like never before."

If you enjoy classic adventure games, witty humor, and discovering unexpected solutions, LeMrosh in the Lazy Kingdom is waiting.
70010000119910.intro: A humorous point-and-click adventure game, full of clever puzzles, quirky characters, and unexpected twists. Get ready for hours of fun, a long journey, a few fairies... and a little love story.
70010000119910.name: LeMrosh in the Lazy Kingdom

70010000119927.description:
Collect pieces of the pajama girls and complete the puzzle!
There are 15 stages in total.
As you clear each stage, the difficulty increases!
Stages 1–10: 30 pieces
Stages 11–15: 50 pieces
The final stage is a tough one with no background watermark!
Take your time and examine each piece to complete the puzzle!
Once completed, high‑resolution images will be added to your gallery ♪
=====================
We support game streamers!
No permission is required to stream this game.
70010000119927.intro: A puzzle game featuring cute girls in pajamas is here!
70010000119927.name: GoodNightGirls

70010000119935.description:
Clock Rogue is a roguelike action game that tests your sense of time.
Moves are set to specific times on a 12-second clock and must be activated by sharp timing using your internal clock.

Will you trust your sense of time and take risks for strong moves, or play it safe and advance cautiously? It's up to you!

◆A unique "time structure" combat system
- When you defeat an enemy, you'll get to choose from three moves to add to the clock.
- The stronger the move, the smaller its activation window.
- Consider each move's position carefully and build a clock that fits your playstyle.

◆Battling inside a hedgehog?!
- The game takes place within the body of a hedgehog.
- As Hari Cells, your goal is to protect the hedgehog from marauding viruses.

Build your own clock and protect the hedgehog!
70010000119935.intro: Are you confident in your internal clock?
70010000119935.name: Clock Rogue

70010000119941.description:
This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone.
There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed.
You can also change the drone's flight mode from Normal, Sport, and Eco to any of the 3.

Enjoy the beautiful scenery of Anmyeon-eup, Korea with "Real" footage!
There are a total of 2 flight courses in 1 areas.
 high-definition footage faithfully reproduces the atmosphere of real nature, providing a strong sense of immersion in the game.
Smooth and realistic video playback makes you feel like you are a real drone pilot.
Large capacity! You can fly to locations that show the beautiful scenery of Korea!
Two play modes are supported: course-specific flying mode and view mode automatic flight. There is also an achievement system.
Visit Korea from home at any time!
Enjoy the drone flight control experience and the beautiful natural scenery. MasCon for Nintendo Switch™ made by Zuiki of Japan is also supported.
70010000119941.intro: A simulation game where you directly operate a drone based on actual drone flight footage! You can enjoy the actual beautiful natural scenery in high definition!
70010000119941.name: Korean Drone Flying Tour Anmyeon-eup

Enjoy the beautiful scenery of Baekje Military Museum, Korea with "Real" footage!

 high-definition footage faithfully reproduces the atmosphere of real nature, providing a strong sense of immersion in the game.

70010000119981.description:
Assemble your team, build your roster of iconic Star Wars™ characters, and battle with your friends and family for control of the galaxy as you move across storied planets and locations.
Choose from a wide array of Star Wars heroes and villains, each with their own unique abilities. Whether you're teaming up with Luke Skywalker or unleashing Darth Vader, every match is packed with team strategy, surprises, and classic Star Wars moments. No two battles unfold the same way, the fate of your team is yours to shape!

STAR WARS MEETS MONOPOLY®
Step into the Star Wars galaxy with a bold new twist on MONOPOLY. Experience iconic cinematic moments while competing with family and friends across iconic locations from every era of the saga.

PLAY AS A TEAM, WIN AS A TEAM
Team up with your friends and family through online play or couch co-op and experience MONOPOLY like never before with 2v2 and 3v3 competitive game modes. With endless team compositions, the game transforms classic competition into a fun strategic showdown.

ASSEMBLE YOUR ICONIC STAR WARS TEAM
Each character brings distinct hero abilities, allowing you to shape your team’s composition and lead your team to victory. Command legends like Darth Maul and Princess Leia, each with game-changing skills that turn the tide in your favor.

COMMAND THE DICE, CONTROL THE BOARD
The game can change with every roll as properties change hands in an instant. Dynamic GO events unleash game-altering twists and shift momentum rapidly, making each turn critical and victory uncertain until the final turn.

A NEW ADVENTURE EVERY MATCH
With action-packed matches, evolving team strategies, and tons of unlockable cosmetics, no two games are exactly the same. Experiment with different heroes to assemble the perfect team. There's always a reason to jump back in for one more round.
70010000119981.intro: Get ready for a dynamic, team-based twist on MONOPOLY® set in the Star Wars™ galaxy!
70010000119981.name: Monopoly: Star Wars™ Heroes vs. Villains

70010000119995.description:
ROUTE16R is a remake of the ROUTE16 series, originally released in the 1980s.

Avoid enemy vehicles and monsters as you race through the stage, collecting every item scattered across the maze.
Switch dynamically between Maze Mode, where you navigate intricate labyrinths filled with traps and gimmicks, and Radar Mode, which reveals the entire stage made up of 16 mazes-delivering a high-speed chase experience that surpasses the original games.

Not Just Escape - Fight Back with the Evolved MAD X-R :
Unlike previous ROUTE16 titles, colliding with enemies triggers a transformation: MAD X-R shifts into a combat robot, initiating battle.
Use your upgraded MAD X-R’s attacks along with SP items collected throughout the stage to deal damage and defeat your enemies.

Customization :
Before entering a stage, use the money you’ve recovered to customize your MAD X-R.
Enhance core attributes like fuel and speed, as well as combat performance, to suit your playstyle.

Boss Battles :
The Kanharoo Gang won’t go down without a fight.
Collecting all items won’t end the stage-doing so will trigger a boss encounter.
Bosses unleash intense attacks to corner MAD X-R.
Dodge their assaults, find openings in their defenses, and strike back by transforming into robot form to deal decisive damage!

Multiplayer:
For the first time in the series, multiplayer mode is included.
Compete in a mini-game where players battle to capture the flag.
Enjoy fast-paced, arcade-style chase action with friends and family!
* Local multiplayer only. Online multiplayer is not supported.
70010000119995.intro: The ROUTE16 remake. Beat the revived Kanharoo Gang with your car MAD X-R!
70010000119995.name: ROUTE16R

70010000120005.description:
Turn broken spaces into something worth living in.
Step into the role of a renovation specialist and take on jobs that transform messy, damaged, and abandoned spaces into clean, functional, and beautiful homes. From simple cleaning tasks to full-scale renovations, every project challenges your attention to detail, planning, and creativity.

Start with basic jobs like removing trash, cleaning surfaces, and organizing spaces. As you progress, take on more complex tasks such as painting walls, placing furniture, and redesigning interiors. Every action brings visible results, turning neglected environments into comfortable and inviting places.

Earn money, gain experience, and build your reputation as you complete orders for clients across the city. With better results come bigger opportunities — allowing you to upgrade tools, unlock new features, and take on larger, more demanding projects.

Eventually, you can buy old houses, fully renovate them, and sell them for profit. Choose how to restore each property, improve its value, and grow your own renovation business step by step.

Key Features:
	•	Renovation Gameplay: Clean, repair, paint, and restore different properties
	•	Interactive Environment: Move objects, organize spaces, and work with detailed interiors
	•	Tool Variety: Use brushes, cleaning tools, and renovation equipment
	•	Progression System: Earn money, gain experience, and improve your skills
	•	Property Flipping: Buy, renovate, and sell houses for profit
	•	Diverse Locations: Work in apartments, houses, offices, and more

From small cleanups to complete transformations, every project brings visible progress and satisfaction.

House Fixer Simulator delivers a relaxing yet engaging experience where creativity, organization, and smart decisions turn every space into something better.
70010000120005.name: House Fixer Simulator

70010000120032.description:
Sink into a calm, satisfying experience where control is simple and the reward is purely sensory. You guide a growing hole across a peaceful island, absorbing carefully arranged patterns of fruit that disappear with smooth, soothing sounds. Every bite feels deliberate and relaxing, designed to trigger that unmistakable ASMR pleasure as colors vanish and space opens beneath you.

As you consume more fruit, you steadily increase in size, unlocking the ability to swallow larger and more complex shapes. What begins as delicate, bite-sized snacks evolves into a deeply satisfying flow of growth and momentum. Clear the entire island to move forward, then continue endlessly as new layouts invite you to relax, focus, and repeat the cycle.

A gentle, atmospheric soundtrack blends with soft absorption effects to create a meditative rhythm. There is no pressure, no rush, and no harsh distractions—just smooth motion, calming audio, and the quiet joy of watching order dissolve into tranquility. Perfect for unwinding, zoning out, or enjoying a peaceful moment whenever you need it.
70010000120032.intro: Absorb fruit and grow your hole
70010000120032.name: Hole ASMR

70010000120056.description:
Explore a colorful world and build your own cozy home on wheels. Craft workstations, and source energy from the sun, wind, or water. Upgrade and customize your vehicle, grow crops, and live sustainably off-grid with up to 4 players.

Outbound is a cozy open-world exploration game set in a utopian near future. Start with an empty camper van and turn it into the home of your dreams - alone or together with your friends. Build and explore at your own pace. Collect materials, craft, and build in and on top of your vehicle with modular parts. Advance in technology and efficiently use energy to power your home.

Explore
Explore a colorful world in your electric camper van, powered by the sun, wind, or water. Discover iconic landmarks across diverse biomes.

Build & Craft
Build your moving base with a modular building system. Customize your vehicle with paint, decorations, and furniture to create your own perfect cozy place.

Grow
Create gardens to grow a variety of plants and mushrooms. Enjoy them fresh or cook delicious meals to stay healthy on the road.

Best friends forever
Adopt a new friend at the Paws & Whiskers Lodge who you can feed, pet, and train to help you.

Play together
Go on a road trip across diverse biomes and build your home on wheels solo or in co-op with up to 4 players online.



This product is released for the Nintendo Switch. It can also be played on Nintendo Switch 2. However, please note that a separate product, Outbound, is available exclusively for Nintendo Switch 2.
Save data and Additional Contents are not compatible between the two versions. Please be careful to avoid duplicate or mistaken purchases.
Nintendo Switch 2 Edition and Upgrade Pack are not available for this product.
70010000120056.intro: The Great outdoors on four wheels!
70010000120056.name: Outbound

70010000120134.description:
Step into a vibrant city park as a clever raccoon driven by curiosity and instinct. Explore a lively environment filled with secrets, challenges, and opportunities, where every corner hides something new to discover. Take on the role of a small but resourceful animal navigating a world full of surprises and interactions.

Progress through a variety of tasks and evolving challenges that gradually unlock new abilities.  As your raccoon grows stronger and more capable, new paths and hidden possibilities begin to open.
Dive into a dynamic world that blends exploration, light puzzles, and playful adventures. Meet other animals, complete their requests, and uncover hidden items scattered across the park.

Key Features
	•	Varied Tasks: Complete missions that test your agility and thinking.
	•	Park Exploration: Explore interactive areas and uncover hidden secrets.
	•	Raccoon Abilities: Run, climb, and dig to overcome obstacles.
	•	Animal Interactions: Help others to unlock new paths and tasks.
	•	Dynamic World: Enjoy a lively park full of constant activity.

Follow your raccoon instincts and turn every corner into a new adventure.
70010000120134.intro: Be clever, be quick, and think like a raccoon!
70010000120134.name: Raccoon Survival Simulator

70010000120161.description:
Tie those sneakers and ready your camera, it’s time to set off on a new photo adventure in TOEM 2! Head off on a relaxing journey, spurred on by your newly-awakened passion for discovering and photographing mysterious “events” known as TOEMs. TOEM 2 was crafted to be welcoming for both returning fans of TOEM and those who want to jump in for the first time.

Explore: Run, jump, and climb your way through all-new cozy environments, uncovering hidden paths, scenic viewpoints, and small details waiting to be discovered. The world is built to reward curiosity, so take your time and wander wherever your camera leads you.

Meet: Encounter a cast of new quirky characters and adorable critters along your journey. Lend a hand to new faces, create lasting friendships, and catalogue your memories as you go along.

Snap: Your camera has gotten an upgrade! Not only can you snap pictures to solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and document your discoveries, you can also use them in more unconventional ways, with new attachments letting you overcome various problems in each region.

Stamp: Fill your journal with stamps as you complete quests, document discoveries, and expand your critter compendium. Each stamp is not only a reminder of the little wonders you’ve uncovered along the way — they’re also your ticket to unlocking the next region.

Set Your Pace: TOEM 2 is built to be experienced at your own pace with no time limits or tricky requirements for full completion. Listen to music on a bench, smell the flowers, admire the sights and enjoy.
70010000120161.intro: Ready your camera and set off on a new photo adventure in TOEM 2!
70010000120161.name: TOEM 2

70010000120195.description:
"SPACE CYCLONE" is a shooting game released by TAITO in 1980.
Shoot down the BEMs (insect cyborgs) as they appear in the sky and invade by warping from meteor to meteor. Don't let the BEMs land! They will construct rockets to launch into the sky and blast you with their deadly Cyclone Shots!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.
70010000120195.intro: Stop the BEMs from building enemy rockets!
70010000120195.name: Arcade Archives SPACE CYCLONE

70010000120240.description:
Fly around as Doug, an overworked duck astronaut looking for a new homeworld. Crashed on a strange side of the galaxy, maybe this break is exactly what he needs! Whether you’re exploring or just soaking in the stars, this galaxy is yours to enjoy at your own pace.

Explore & Discover
Dive into a world filled with secrets! Find rare minerals in glowing caves, win outfits at the funfair, or see what’s bubbling inside the volcano... Whether it’s the highest stars or the deepest mines, every path has something to discover!

Meet & Help
Lucky for you, this side of the galaxy is filled with curious creatures who welcome you. Build a party, solve the town's mysteries, win an ice cream, and much more! In this world doing a little good goes a long way.

Collect & Craft
Make your spaceship a home among the stars! Build a comfy couch, a gardening room, or maybe even a basketball hoop. Fill your backpack with rare materials and return home to craft gadgets and stylish outfits! No rush, your ship isn’t going anywhere without you!
70010000120240.intro: Waddle and fly as a duck in space! Explore the galaxy and find curious creatures and materials along the way. Craft gadgets, upgrade your spaceship, and get cozy in this relaxing adventure.
70010000120240.name: Duck Side of the Moon

70010000120246.description:
Solitaire is a classic single-player card game based on the traditional Klondike rule set. The objective is to sort a standard 52-card deck into four foundation piles, one for each suit, arranged in ascending order from Ace to King.

Cards are dealt into seven tableau columns with alternating colors and descending rank sequences. Players move cards between columns to uncover hidden cards and strategically build complete suit stacks. Only Kings can occupy empty tableau spaces. The stock pile allows additional cards to be drawn when no other moves are available.

The game features simple, consistent gameplay with intuitive controls, supporting either touch screen interaction or an in-game cursor. Drag-and-drop mechanics make card movement fluid and precise, preserving the traditional Klondike experience in a clean and accessible digital format.
70010000120246.name: Solitaire

70010000120251.description:
Welcome to the wonderful country of Emerland!

A stunning new game with classic rules. Hundreds of fun levels, dangerous opponents and heroic companions await in an adventure full of mysteries and secrets.

Dive deep into the world of magical tale where great mages battle for the Source of the ancient magic of the Cards.
Explore mysterious lands accompanied by heroes that include a noble Knight, an Elven Archeress and a mystical Sorceress to defeat the malevolent Dark Master.

Solve puzzles and collect combinations to complete difficult and varied levels.
Get rewards and find new assistants! Prove that you have learned all of the mysteries of the magic of Solitaire and challenge the most difficult trials at the card table.
This game is easy to learn, but are you brave enough to master it?

- Fabulous adventure.
- Legendary heroes!
- Fascinating levels!
- Amazing solitaire in the fairy world.
70010000120251.intro: An exciting adventure in Emerland, the magical country of Solitaire!
70010000120251.name: Emerland Solitaire 2 Collector's Edition

70010000120270.description:
Streetdog BMX is an action sports game where you ride through expansive maps sending extreme tricks, getting technical on the rails, and feeling the flow.

Customize your bike and rider before hitting the streets to explore six maps packed with wallrides, gaps, bowls, ramps and rails. Uncover new spots, complete handcrafted challenges, and link up your combos!


Your Bike, Your Rules

Focus on high scores and big air, or flow through levels at your own pace. Streetdog BMX accommodates all kinds of riders and play styles. Your lines can be as complex or as simple as you want them to be. Just keep in mind, the bigger the combo... the harder you fall.


Own the Streets

Unleash your creativity. Fakie, manual, icepick or wallride your way through over 270 sick challenges. From barspin to backflip, to crooked grind to crankflip - you’ll have a huge selection of tricks and stunts to use when you send it.


Customization Galore

With dozens of color and outfit options, you can customize your bike and rider the way you want. Play around with options for clothes, shoes, hair, tattoos and more. Build the BMX bike of your dreams with plenty of customizable options ranging from the frame down to the chainring.


BMX for Life

As a longtime BMX rider, I've been pouring my passion for the sport into games like Trail Boss BMX and the Pumped BMX series for years. Streetdog BMX is the action sports game I've always wanted to make and is the next step in combining my love of making games and getting on the bike.
70010000120270.intro: Massive tricks, high scores, and gnarly slams.
70010000120270.name: Streetdog BMX

70010000120291.description:
Travel through Time! In this cozy hidden-object adventure, cats and friends explore the contrast between a magical past and a high-tech future. Every detail invites you to discover that whether in a castle or a skyscraper, friendship and fun are timeless.

Start your journey in The Old Kingdom, a peaceful medieval citadel where everyday life unfolds with gentle humor. Watch clumsy trainees, wandering performers, and eccentric adventurers in a world inspired by classic RPGs, full of warm encounters and legendary charm.

Then, warp into The New Frontier to visit Neo-Cat Metropolis. Explore a bustling city of glass towers and floating platforms where robots get confused and flying cars break down. Amidst the neon lights, discover that friends helping friends is what truly keeps the future moving.

Features:

- Cats and Friends: Find delightful characters in two detailed scenes—one from a mythic past and one from a comic future.
- Balloon-Popping Fun: Enjoy relaxing gameplay as you pop balloons across the scenes—a bit of fun with every search!
- Rich Details: Explore beautifully illustrated settings that blend fantasy and sci-fi with visual storytelling in every corner.
- Over 600 Items to Find! Search for 202 cats, 202 unique characters, and colorful balloons hidden throughout the ages.
- Atmospheric Soundtrack: Set the tone with immersive music tailored to match each era—from cozy medieval tunes to chill futuristic beats.
- Family-Friendly Fun: With cozy, pressure-free gameplay and intuitive controls, it’s an experience for all ages. Perfect for relaxing together or playing solo.

Celebrate the connection between myth and machine in this heartwarming journey—where every moment is worth remembering.
70010000120291.intro: Join cute cats in a time-travel adventure! Find feline friends and pop balloons as you explore a magical medieval kingdom and a chaotic sci-fi metropolis.
70010000120291.name: Meow Moments: Celebrating Myth & Machine

70010000120297.description:
Survive the Night. Escape the Dead.

Darkness descends and the undead rise. Armed with only a handful of weapons and the shelter of an abandoned house, you must fight to see the sunrise. Can you hold out, or be overwhelmed?

Features

Retro arcade thrills with modern polish

Gorgeous 16-bit pixel art bursting with personality

Spooky, toe-tapping chiptune soundtrack

Play solo or team up in local co-op

Arcade and Survival modes for endless action

Compete on leaderboards for 1 or 2 players

20 pulse pounding stages of undead mayhem

6 unique weapons and items to aid your survival

Collect hidden letters to unlock a devastating super weapon

Black & White and CRT filters for an authentic horror atmosphere
70010000120297.intro: Living Dead House delivers a pulse pounding, classic arcade experience. Battle through waves of the undead solo or team up with a friend.
70010000120297.name: Living Dead House

70010000120301.description:
Indoor Baseball Features:
-Each indoor field has its own wild ways to crush home runs and cause chaos
-Choose from 16 unique characters, each with their own stats and playstyle
-12+ indoor fields packed with hazards, obstacles, and gameplay twists
-Jump into Story Mode and see if you’ve got what it takes to make the school's baseball team
-Take a break with 7 crazy Mini Games like Keepy Uppy, Cutting the Grass, and Toddler Tag
-Play a 12 game Season Mode with playoffs and a Championship Game
-Compete in Moonshot Mayhem—rack up points with home runs and destruction
-Challenge a friend and play 1v1 local multiplayer
70010000120301.intro: Play fast-paced 1v1 baseball where your parents wouldn’t let you. Smash windows, wreck the house, and dodge the chaos in this arcade-style baseball game.
70010000120301.name: Indoor Baseball

70010000120308.description:
Shipwrecked Survival 2 returns with a bigger world, more freedom, and new adventures beyond simple survival.

After a catastrophic flood swallowed the Earth, endless oceans stretch where cities once stood. Stranded on a small makeshift raft with nothing but a hook and your instincts, you must gather floating debris, catch fish, purify water, and craft the tools needed to survive.

Build, expand, and transform your raft into your own floating home. Cook meals, manage resources, and turn scraps into everything from survival gear to powerful upgrades.

But the ocean is no longer just empty water. Set sail and explore distant islands, uncover hidden secrets, and discover abandoned cities left behind by the old world. Search for treasures, face new dangers, and uncover what really happened to civilization.

Choose your own path. Become a fearless pirate, a lone explorer, a master builder, or simply survive day by day. The world is yours to shape, and every journey across the sea tells a new story.

Every wave brings danger. Every horizon holds possibility.

Will you survive… or create your own legend?
70010000120308.intro: Survive the flood. Explore the unknown. Create your own legend.
70010000120308.name: Shipwrecked Survival 2

70010000120324.description:
Experience the ultimate racing challenge across every terrain and weather condition imaginable. From sun-drenched circuits to snow-covered mountain passes and rain-slicked city streets, test your skills behind the wheel of 37 meticulously crafted vehicles.

-Master Every Machine
Choose your weapon from an extensive garage featuring 23 high-performance sports cars, 6 precision-engineered Formula Cars, 5 rugged Offroad vehicles, and 3 powerful trucks. Each vehicle offers unique handling characteristics and racing dynamics that will keep you coming back for more.

-Earn, Upgrade, Dominate
Victory means more than glory—cash prizes from each win let you expand and upgrade your collection. Build the garage of your dreams as you progress through increasingly challenging races and championships.

-Race in Any Condition
Adapt your driving style to dynamic weather systems including blazing sunshine, torrential rain, and treacherous snow. Every weather condition changes the track, demanding different strategies and split-second decisions.

-Diverse Tracks and Terrains
From professional racing circuits to dirt trails, urban streets to off-road wilderness, each environment presents unique challenges that will push you and your vehicle to the limit.

-Optimized for Your Setup
Fine-tune your experience with comprehensive graphics options including adjustable quality settings, customizable target framerates, level of detail controls, and optional motion blur—ensuring smooth performance tailored to your preferences.

Are you ready to become the ultimate all-terrain racing champion?
70010000120324.intro: All Roads. All Motors. All Out.
70010000120324.name: All Motors Racing Simulator

70010000120339.description:
Features:

Immersive Gameplay: Enjoy 3v3 and 4v4 matches.
Competitive Cup Mode: Engage in tournament-style gameplay.
Customizable Soccer Balls: Choose from 6 unique designs.
Unique Environments: Play on 5 distinct courts.
Flexible Flooring: Customize with 4 different floor styles.
70010000120339.intro: Jump into casual street soccer and relive the joy of playing on the neighborhood playground.
70010000120339.name: Street Soccer

70010000120351.description:
Step into the scorching sands of the Persian Gulf, 1991. Coalition forces are pushing deep into Iraqi-held territory, and every dune, every bombed-out building, every oil-choked horizon is a potential kill zone. Desert Storm War drops you into the heart of Operation Desert Storm as a special operations soldier fighting alongside a squad of AI teammates across brutal, tactically demanding frontlines.

Lead Your Squad. Hold the Line.
You never fight alone. Your team of combat-hardened bot soldiers reacts to the battlefield in real time — laying down suppressive fire, flanking enemy positions, and calling out threats. But the enemy is just as organized. Opposing bot teams move with coordination and aggression, adapting to your tactics across every engagement. No two firefights play out the same way.

A War That Feels Real
Desert Storm War is built around one goal: authenticity. Powered by a full IK (Inverse Kinematics) character system, every soldier on the battlefield moves like a human being, not a puppet.

Full Foot IK — Boots plant naturally on uneven terrain, rocky embankments, and rubble-strewn streets. No more floating soldiers or clipping feet.
Arm IK — Weapons are gripped and braced dynamically. Lean against cover, climb obstacles, or crouch behind a wall and watch your soldier's arms adjust in real time.
Head-Look — Characters track threats, teammates, and movement with natural head turns and gaze direction, making every NPC feel aware, alive, and dangerous.

The result is a squad of soldiers that look and move like they actually belong in a warzone.

Fight through a series of distinct operational levels drawn from the Gulf War conflict — desert highway ambushes, urban clearing operations in occupied Kuwait, fortified bunker assaults, and open-terrain armored pushes under the blazing Middle Eastern sun. Each level presents a different tactical challenge, forcing you to adapt your approach, manage your squad, and outgun a well-organized enemy force.
70010000120351.intro: The desert doesn't forgive. Neither do you.
70010000120351.name: Desert Storm War

70010000120357.description:
Blocky Blast is an original puzzle game by Webnetic s.r.o.. Stack, match, and blast your way through endless puzzles in Blocky Blast!

Master the art of fitting colorful block shapes, clear rows, and collect precious gems in an explosive puzzle adventure. Whether you're chasing high scores in Infinite Mode or solving creative challenges in Adventure Mode, every move counts. Easy to pick up, hard to put down — can you become the ultimate Blocky Master?

Key Highlights:
- Adventure Mode with progressively harder gem-collecting missions
- Infinite Mode for endless strategic play and score-chasing
- Combo bonuses and explosive clears for skilled players
- Colorful visuals and satisfying block placements
- Relaxing yet challenging — perfect for a quick game or a marathon session

Ready to blast some blocks? Let's go!
70010000120357.intro: Stack, match, and blast your way through endless colorful puzzles. Master two exciting modes - Adventure and Infinite - and become the ultimate Blocky Master.
70010000120357.name: Blocky Blast

70010000120380.description:
In the city of Friendly, where the story takes place, many residents who are shaped like ancient terracotta clay figures belong to the Haniwa Clan.
Amid them lives a curious boy who is neither human nor Haniwa, but something entirely different… a child shaped like a tiny burial mound.
This boy is Kofun, the protagonist of this adventure.

Kofun has always dreamed of becoming a proper burial mound and one day meeting the body that will rest inside of him.
But despite his dream, he never quite had the courage to go out and search.
That all changed when one day, a spirited boy named Haniwa calls out to him and says, "Come play with me!"
And so...their story begins.

Will Kofun ever find the "perfect body" he's been hoping for?
Come to think of it...if he's neither human nor Haniwa...what even is he?
As you explore the world and meet its many residents, all the questions you and Kofun have will begin to unravel.
Through these encounters, he gradually discovers the truth about his origins.
Enjoy a story full of surprises, following Kofun and his friends through a heartfelt tale of friendship and growth.

■GAME CONCEPT
In The Little Tomb, you will control the protagonist Kofun. The story begins when you explore the town he lives in.
Wander through the town, examine objects, interact with the residents, and uncover the story bit by bit.
Every person you meet and every item you interact with helps move the narrative forward.
If something catches your eye, don't hesitate to take a closer look and see what you can reveal.

You can easily navigate through the main story using the handy dandy "To-Do List".
But the adventure doesn't stop there, feel free to stray off the path, hunt for hidden treasures, or explore areas unrelated to the main story as every detour is an opportunity for discovery.
Go through the story with Kofun at your own pace.

Kofun grows and develops by earning Action Points.
You gain Action Points every time Kofun interacts with the world through actions such as examining objects, playing on playground equipment, and other activities.
Once you've gotten some Action Points, you can use them to get new skills or hints to help you solve puzzles you encounter along the way. Kofun is always learning!

Give Kofun the experiences he needs to become a great burial mound!
70010000120380.intro:
"Is there a dead body who'd like to be buried in me?"
A Coming-of-Age Adventure of a Boy who Believes He's an Ancient Tomb.
70010000120380.name: The Little Tomb: The Maholova Club and the Search for a Dead Body

70010000120386.description:
Your final year at Duel Academy is officially underway!  Select your partner from over 100 visually upgraded characters and conquer your opponents as a Dueling duo! Strengthen your affinity with your classmates and build memories as you study the art of Tag Dueling and prepare for a Graduation Duel to remember!

Get Your Game On! Classic Dueling is back and rebuilt with over 3,800 cards, including additional fan-favorite cards beyond those featured in the original Yu-Gi-Oh! GX TAG FORCE 3. Build your Deck, develop unique strategies, and enjoy student life at Duel Academy as you Duel your way to victory.

《New Features》
・Unleash your inner HERO! Over 3,800 cards, including additional cards supporting GX-era Decks.
・Class is in Session Explore, investigate and expand your extracurricular activities with new and renewed mini-games.
・Duel the World Enter a Casual Duel or Room Match to enjoy both Tag and 1v1 Duels with Online Multiplayer!
・Gallery Mode Reminisce with story scenes from Yu-Gi-Oh! GX TAG FORCE and Yu-Gi-Oh! GX TAG FORCE2.

[About "Yu-Gi-Oh!"]
"Yu-Gi-Oh!" is a popular manga created by Kazuki Takahashi that was serialized in SHUEISHA Inc.'s "WEEKLY SHONEN JUMP" since 1996. Konami Digital Entertainment Co., Ltd. provides a Trading Card Game (TCG) and console games, based on "Yu-Gi-Oh!" created from the original manga, that has been enjoyed around the world.
70010000120386.intro: Duel Alongside Your Partner and Forge Your Own Future!
70010000120386.name: Yu-Gi-Oh! TAG FORCE GX

70010000120410.description:
Forget about sitting, staying, or rolling over. In Angry Dog, you trade the obedience school diploma for a license to cause absolute mayhem. Granny just wants a peaceful afternoon, but you have a bad case of the zoomies and a house full of breakable objects waiting to be smashed. Step into the fur of the neighborhood’s naughtiest canine and turn every room into your personal playground.

Unlike your sneaky feline rivals, you are a wrecking ball of energy. Dash through hallways, knock over expensive vases with your clumsy paws, chew up the furniture, and bark until the windows rattle. The game drops you into a fully interactive 3D environment where almost everything can be destroyed, dragged, or messed with. Your goal is simple: cause enough chaos to fill the meter and drive Granny crazy before she catches you with her broom.
70010000120410.name: Angry Dog

70010000120416.description:
This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone.
There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed.
You can also change the drone's flight mode from Normal, Sport, and Eco to any of the 3.

Enjoy the beautiful scenery of Tapjeong Lake, Korea with "Real" footage!
There are a total of 2 flight courses in 1 areas.
 high-definition footage faithfully reproduces the atmosphere of real nature, providing a strong sense of immersion in the game.
Smooth and realistic video playback makes you feel like you are a real drone pilot.
Large capacity! You can fly to locations that show the beautiful scenery of Korea!
Two play modes are supported: course-specific flying mode and view mode automatic flight. There is also an achievement system.
Visit Korea from home at any time!
Enjoy the drone flight control experience and the beautiful natural scenery. MasCon for Nintendo Switch™ made by Zuiki of Japan is also supported.
70010000120416.intro: A simulation game where you directly operate a drone based on actual drone flight footage! You can enjoy the actual beautiful natural scenery in high definition!
70010000120416.name: Korean Drone Flying Tour Tapjeong Lake

70010000120422.description:
Mathify turns math into a fun and satisfying puzzle challenge! Connect numbers and operations in the right order to build the target value and solve each level.

Easy to learn and rewarding to master, the game mixes logic, quick thinking, and creative problem-solving. With clean visuals, smooth gameplay, and gradually more challenging puzzles, Mathify is perfect for both short sessions and brain-training fun.
70010000120422.name: Mathify

70010000120428.description:
Dive into a world of stunning, realistic puzzles that captivate your eyes and mind. Piece by piece, reveal breathtaking images of beautiful women — each completed puzzle unlocks a new masterpiece, keeping you motivated to discover what’s next.

Smooth and intuitive touch controls make gameplay effortless and deeply satisfying — you’ll feel like you’re truly shaping every picture with your own hands. Gentle, soothing music sets the perfect mood, helping you unwind while your curiosity pulls you to complete the next challenge.

Relax, enjoy, and let yourself get lost in the details.

Features:
• Addictive, easy-to-play puzzle mechanics.
• Gorgeous, realistic artwork of women.
• Satisfying touch interaction — every move feels natural.
• Unlock new, even more stunning images as you progress.
• Perfect balance of challenge and relaxation.
• Soothing soundtrack that enhances your focus and mood.
• Admire each completed image in full detail.
70010000120428.intro: Every piece brings you closer to perfection!
70010000120428.name: Bad Girls: Wild Desire

70010000120440.description:
Wake up Garfield from this nightmarish veggie filled 3D Platformer! The laziest cat is about to work hard in Garfield - Escape from Monday!

When you’re a lazy cat spending most of his time sleeping, having a nightmare can happen. But a nightmare full of vegetables and sugar-free candies, no way!

After Jon fed him spinach lasagnas inspired by Chef Monday’s recipe, Garfield falls into a deep sleep...

To wake up and reactivate his taste buds, the laziest cat in the world will have to explore worlds filled with enemies and eat a gigantic deal of lasagnas!

Fortunately Garfield can rely on Jon and his friends Odie, Arlene and Pookie. But also on his turkey, surfer and cowboy suits that will give him amazing skills!

- Move like a cat
Jump, climb the walls, curl up into a ball… you will always land on your feet!

- Embody Garfield in every form
Go airborne dressed as a turkey, slide on the water like a surfer and swing with your cowboy lasso!

- All the Garfield cast is here
Jon will be here to help you in your quest, along with Odie and Pookie. But beware Garfield's archenemies, Nermal and Squeak!

- Explore lively worlds
3 worlds and dozens of levels filled with enemies to fight and lasagnas to devour to regain the taste.

- The more you eat, the more rooms you edit!
Gather tons of delicious collectibles to keep your morale and help refurbish Jon's house with all kinds of surprising items.
70010000120440.intro: Garfield may be right not to trust vegetables…
70010000120440.name: Garfield - Escape From Monday

70010000120461.description:
The princess is dead... or so the Empire believes.Assassinated by her own father, the Emperor, and mysteriously brought back to life, Princess Celestina hides her identity and travels the land as "Tiene." Her goal is the legendary Sword of Sixteen Nights, and she must claim it before the Emperor seizes its power for himself.

Meanwhile, a young swordsman named Alya walks his own path toward the same blade. Whose story will you live?Play as Alya or Tiene, each with their own unique scenario. Decipher ancient grimoires to unlock and master forgotten magic.

Journey alongside unforgettable companions: a self-proclaimed Superhero, a hard-drinking bishop, a runaway mayor's daughter, and more. And unravel the mystery of the "WIND," the calamity scouring the land, said to be the scream of the Earth.
Story scenes are fully voiced in Japanese.
70010000120461.intro: Two heroes. One sword. A world on the brink.
70010000120461.name: AMEL BROAT

70010000120495.description:
Speed Boom: Last Delivery is a high-speed arcade experience built around one thing — momentum.

Dash across a vibrant neon city, wall-run between skyscrapers, chain jumps across rooftops, and deliver packages as fast as humanly possible. Every second counts. Every shortcut matters. Every mistake costs you time.

Take on 40 time-based deliveries and push for the ultimate S+ rank. The faster you move, the better the reward. Master the routes, optimize your path, and chase your personal best.

Earn coins through perfect runs and exploration. Upgrade your runner’s speed, acceleration, and movement to break your limits. Unlock a variety of skins and express your style while dominating the streets.

The city is fully explorable and packed with hidden graffiti waiting to be discovered. Find them, repaint them with your own mark, and turn the streets into your playground.

Designed for replayability and built with flow in mind, Speed Boom: Last Delivery is speedrun-friendly and rewards skill, precision, and mastery.

No brakes. No limits. Just speed.
70010000120495.intro:
Built for Speed.
Designed for Records.
Speedrun Friendly.
70010000120495.name: Speed Boom: Last Delivery

70010000120501.description:
Welcome to Limbot, the ultimate physics-based city stomping experience where up to 4 players must attempt to pilot a person dressed as a giant cardboard robot! Embrace the chaos in a paper-craft metropolis designed to be crushed, smashed, and destroyed!

Stomp, kick, and punch your way to completing wacky objectives set in a fully destructible cardboard world, where every building, obstacle, and enemy can be bashed to pieces or flattened into pulp! Smash down skyscrapers, face-off against paper foes, and take down the biggest (and silliest) crafted bosses this world has ever seen…

Go full DIY and unlock upgrades to customise your robot such as strapping a soda can to your leg for a handy speed boost, wooden spoons to give your Karate chops some added range, or slap on some stickers to add some extra style. Mix and match upgrades to make your perfect robot!

Intuitive controls make moving limbs simple and accessible to players of all ages and abilities. All you need to do is figure out how to work together... good luck with that! Oh, one more thing, if the robot trips, it's definitely your teammate’s fault!
70010000120501.intro: Limbot is a super silly, 3D platformer where you individually control the limbs of a giant cardboard robot! Master all four limbs in solo or embrace the chaos and camaraderie in co-op.
70010000120501.name: Limbot

70010000120507.description:
In the 1980s, Defender of the Crown helped define a new kind of cinematic strategy game. Now it returns, rebuilt for modern platforms and remastered with an entirely new way to play.


Conquer territories, raise armies, storm castles, and shift the balance of power. It's the Defender of the Crown you remember - just sharper, cleaner, and built for today.

Three Ways to Play

Retro Mode. The original Amiga classic, preserved with near-perfect authenticity and quality-of-life enhancements.

Classic Mode. Amiga classic reimagined for today. A completely new visual identity, refined mechanics, and smoother systems.

Kingdom Mode. An entirely new challenge. Procedurally generated maps, special dice mechanics, unlockable abilities, and multiple difficulty levels to keep every run unpredictable.

Faithful to Its Roots, Built for Today

Everything that made the original special is intact: the ruleset, the pacing, the atmosphere. What's changed is everything around it - cleaner systems, improved balance, a modernized interface, and quality-of-life updates throughout.
70010000120507.intro: The crown is stolen. England burns. Conquer territories, siege castles, and unite a fractured kingdom before the Normans close in.
70010000120507.name: Defender of the Crown: The Legend Returns

70010000120533.description:
Your peaceful journey has turned into a nightmare. You wake up in a cold, locked cell inside an old, abandoned psychiatric clinic. But you are not alone. The facility is the playground of Dr. Psycho, a madman obsessed with horrific experiments, and you are his next guinea pig.

Dr. Psycho: Hospital Escape is a tense survival horror game where stealth is your only weapon. To survive, you must explore the dark corridors of the asylum, searching for keys, tools, and items needed to unlock the path to freedom. But be warned: the Doctor and his psychotic patients are roaming the halls.

You have exactly three days to plan your escape. If you don't find an exit before time runs out, you'll become a permanent resident of this house of horrors.

They can hear you. They are hunting you. And time is running out.
70010000120533.name: Dr. Psycho: Hospital Escape

70010000120559.description:
A Creature-Collector Roguelike Deckbuilding Game.

Assemble your team of Montabi to outsmart the bad guys and save the city!

Build your Montabi team!

If you're going to be the big hero and save the city, you've gotta get some Montabi! Each Montabi has a unique set of skills, giving you endless combinations for team synergies. Collect equipment and charms and utilize them to chart the path to victory!

Evolve and draft new skills!

Train your Montabi to grow stronger, unlocking new moves to enhance your team's strategy. As they level up, your Montabi evolve into more powerful forms, gaining new card abilities and expanding your tactical options. If you work together, there's nothing you and your Montabi can't achieve!

Outsmart your opponents!

Deploy your best strategies to beat up the bad guys in a unique 3x3 grid-based system. With every Montabi's unique abilities, you'll have endless options to outthink the competition and win the day. Just make sure you rest up at a cafe every now and then to recover those hit points!

Choose your Trainer!

Select from diverse trainers, each with a unique playstyle. Do you wanna put your team in the perfect position, get right up in their faces and duke it out, or buff up your Montabi with a hearty meal? When the city's at stake, everyone pitches in! Just make sure to stay safe! Like the king in chess, if your trainer is defeated, the game ends.

*
This product is released for the Nintendo Switch. It can also be played on Nintendo Switch 2. However, please note that a separate product, "Montabi",
is available exclusively for Nintendo Switch 2.
Save data and Additional Contents are not compatible between the two versions. Please be careful to avoid duplicate or mistaken purchases.
Nintendo Switch 2 Edition and Upgrade Pack are not available for this product.
70010000120559.intro: Tame, collect, fight! Assemble an unstoppable team of unique Montabi in this Creature-Collector Roguelike Deckbuilder.
70010000120559.name: MONTABI

70010000120589.description:
Key Features

1. Link System – The Closer, the Stronger
SP charging speed increases as you keep two ships close
Unique gameplay where distance control is the strategy

2. Powerful Blast Attack
A super-powerful attack triggered when ships are linked
A single blow that turns the battlefield with timing and cooperation

3. 2-Player Local Co-op
A shooting game that requires true cooperation
Play where position, timing, and coordination are all crucial

4. SP Management-Based Strategy
The closer you get, the stronger you become, but the higher the risk
Play that balances risk and reward

5. Roguelike Upgrade System
Select upgrades after clearing a boss
Combat style that changes with every playthrough

6. Story Mode with Twist upon Twist
Short but intensely immersive
Unexpected plot twists and a clean ending
70010000120589.intro: Blast Linkers is a strategic 2-player local cooperative shooter.
70010000120589.name: Blast Linkers

70010000120601.description:
Five Trials, Five Thrills

Kaguya’s Picture-Matching Puzzle
Fragments of yokai illustrations have been shattered. Rearrange the pieces correctly and restore them to their true forms.

Okiku’s Sorting Game
Bombs keep appearing one after another—sort them quickly before they explode! A moment of hesitation can be fatal.

Kaede’s Riding Training
Control a gently floating character and slip through narrow gaps between obstacles. Push your limits and see how far you can go.

Alice’s Orb Fusion Experiment
Stack identical characters together to evolve them, aiming for the highest score before the box overflows.

Setsuna’s Wish-Binding
Connect adorable yokai filling the screen in a single continuous stroke and wipe them out all at once. At the end of a massive chain awaits pure, exhilarating catharsis.

Collect the Truth of the World

Earn “Magic Stones” as rewards for clearing challenges, each one a fragment of the world itself. Spend the stones to unlock pieces of stories spanning time and space: Sengoku battlefields, distant galaxies, and mysterious yokai realms…

A Depth of Replayability

Quick and easy to jump into yet irresistibly addictive for those determined to collect every last Magic Stone. Conquer every mini-game and uncover all the intertwined destinies recorded in this “Chronicle of Illusions.”

Jump into the world of Hyakki today!
70010000120601.intro: A compact yet richly packed anthology of bite-sized games you can enjoy anytime.
70010000120601.name: Hyakki Fantasia Mini Game Selection VOL.1

70010000120607.description:
The captivating clicker game in which you join space expansion!
Take on the role of an autonomous orbital station in this space adventure! Your goal is to prepare planets for the landing of a team of explorers. There’s just one problem: the planets are inhabited by many hostile creatures who are not very happy about the arrival of uninvited guests...
Destroy the mutants, get coins and buy improvements that will make you even more effective in combat: increase the damage dealt by each shot, slow down enemies when hit or reduce the reloading time.

Game features:
- Many progression options: upgrade weapons and abilities to fight more effectively.
- Intuitive gameplay: this simple and entertaining clicker doesn’t require you to have masterful skills, but still keeps you on your toes.
- Destroying mutants: every click is a step towards victory over alien creatures inhabiting dangerous planets.

Every click brings you closer to getting a planet ready for a successful landing. Use the full potential of the orbital station to clear the planets of any threat! The squad of heroes will not get here soon, but the future of their mission depends on your work.
