70010000120607.intro: Mutants are flooding the planets! Destroy them all! Improve your technology, upgrade weapons and turn dangerous worlds into safe havens.
70010000120607.name: Kickback Clicker

70010000120637.description:
A World After the Machines Came
On Lana and Mui’s home planet, new technology brings progress but also stirs greed and imbalance. As different tribes adopt it in their own ways, tensions grow and the world’s harmony begins to shift. When those seeking power push too far, Lana and her little companion are pulled into a journey that reveals long-buried truths about their planet and about themselves.

A World That Tells Its Story
Journey across frozen peaks, deep oceans, and forgotten ruins in a hand-painted world where nature meets technology. With no spoken dialogue, characters express themselves through an alien language, letting the world, music, and your choices carry the story and inviting you to find its meaning for yourself.

A Bond at the Center of the Journey
Planet of Lana II is a cinematic puzzle-adventure built around companionship and trust. Guide an older, more agile Lana and her loyal companion Mui as their bond becomes the key to moving forward in a world where beauty and danger live side by side.

Thoughtful Puzzles & Fluid Movement
Puzzles are woven naturally into the world, rewarding awareness, timing, and cooperation instead of complex logic. Turn Lana’s expanded agility, from wall jumps to smooth movement and momentum, into your path through danger.

An Emotional, Carefully Paced Adventure
As Lana and Mui travel, new discoveries unravel the history of their planet and the truth behind Mui’s origins. Their journey grows into an intimate tale of coexistence, responsibility, and the cost of progress, carried forward by a moving orchestral score that gives weight to quiet moments, bold discoveries, and every emotional turn across its 6 to 8 hour adventure.

A Standalone Experience
Planet of Lana II welcomes new players while offering a deeper journey for those returning, an intimate story about connection, resilience, and protecting what still matters in a changing world.

Key Features

A Cinematic Puzzle-Platformer Adventure
A story-driven experience blending exploration, environmental puzzles and cinematic atmosphere.

A Companion-Driven Journey
A heartfelt adventure built around the bond between Lana and her loyal companion, Mui.

A Hand-Painted World in Transition
Explore a beautifully crafted planet where nature and technology collide, and different tribes respond to progress in their own ways.

Fluid Exploration & Movement
Guide an older, more agile Lana with wall jumps, smooth traversal, and dynamic movement across diverse environments.

Thoughtful & Varied Puzzles
Puzzles are woven naturally into the world, focusing on observation, timing, and cooperation rather than complex logic.

Storytelling Without Words
No spoken dialogue. Meaning emerges through visuals, music, and your interactions with the world.

An Emotional, Carefully Paced Sci-Fi Tale
Uncover new truths about the planet and Mui’s past in a 6-8 hour cinematic journey, accompanied by a moving orchestral score.
70010000120637.name: Planet of Lana II: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000120658.description:
The story follows Ignat, a lonely young man surviving in a dark, dangerous post-apocalyptic cyberpunk world. After a tragic military conflict, the few remaining survivors had to adapt to a harsh new reality. Having lost his parents, Ignat has learned to live alone and build his life in this unforgiving environment.

However, his once-stable existence changes dramatically when he receives an unexpected email message…

“Hail to the Rainbow” is a first-person, story-driven adventure with horror and shooter elements. Set in a richly detailed world, the game challenges you to survive in a new reality, uncover the secrets behind the surrounding chaos, and experience the protagonist’s memories and inner struggles.

Explore the environment, examine electronic records, solve technical puzzles, collect items, and upgrade your inventory - all of which will be essential for your journey.

Features:
- A new game from famous solo developer Sergey Noskov
- A deep story and immersive world
- Spectacular cyberpunk set in a post-apocalyptic Russia
- Logical technical challenges and intense combat encounters with enemies
- Bonus content after completing the game
- Photo mode
- Atmospheric soundtrack by Nobody's Nail Machine
70010000120658.intro: Survive the trials in a new apocalyptic cyberpunk reality
70010000120658.name: Hail to the Rainbow

70010000120659.description:
"POP'N BOUNCE" is a brick breaker released by VIDEO SYSTEM in 1997.
Enemy characters serving as blocks fuse into a single unit when adjacent enemies are the same color.
Connect as many as possible to make them grow, then take them down to score massive points and earn power-up items!

The "ACA NEOGEO" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.
70010000120659.intro: Grow them big and BLAST THEM TO PIECES!
70010000120659.name: ACA NEOGEO POP'N BOUNCE

70010000120714.description:
You are hired as a mini-golf level tester by the french company ROGOLF. Management will always expect big quality scores from your golfing skills...
Thanks to the help of the Smuggler, cheat your way through the floors of this strange office building, or get fired trying to !
Bonuses you buy will grant you access to secret rooms, rule-breaking cards and make your score explode !
In need of a day off ? Try the "Team Building" multiplayer game mode, and play locally with up to 4 players.
70010000120714.intro: Play mini-golf, buy equipment and score enough points to reach the top. Each level has it’s own rules and each game is different.
70010000120714.name: ROGOLF

70010000120718.description:
The Official 2026 Championship
Experience the full intensity of the 2026 MotoGP™ Championship with all the official riders, teams, bikes and tracks in a more authentic way: for the first time, the real-world results dynamically update Riders Ratings, directly influencing in-game performance throughout the season. Step into the spotlight and track your journey with dazzling Collectible Cards celebrating your progress.

Renewed Physics for Total Control
Jump straight into action with the Arcade Experience or dive into pure simulation with the Pro Experience, both supported by tutorials, adaptive difficulty and Neural Aids. Enjoy a renewed physics system built around a new rider-based handling model: your body movement on the bike matters more than ever, delivering greater control and a more authentic riding feel.

A Deeper Career
Build your legacy from Rookie to Legend with a custom rider or relive and reshape the career of an official MotoGP™ star. Your journey evolves season after season through contract negotiations, rider market dynamics and press conferences that shape your future. Your words to the media influence upcoming challenges, while your collaboration with teams drives bike development. Every decision becomes part of your story.

Train and Experiment
Step away from the paddock and explore new ways to ride. Train with the Motard, Flat Track and Minibike disciplines, or hit the circuit with Production Bikes, models featured in single-brand events with dedicated physics.
70010000120718.intro: Live the real MotoGP™ experience with all the thrills of the Official 2026 Season.
70010000120718.name: MotoGP™26

70010000120720.description:
Outerloop Games delivers Dosa Divas - a spicy narrative turn-based RPG. After years apart, sisters Samara and Amani journey with their ancient spirit-mech on a mission to defeat a rotten fast food empire and reconnect communities with their traditions. Platform through vibrant villages, battle corporate goons, reconcile with loved ones, and eat one last meal together before saying goodbye.

TASTE VICTORY
Engage in a flavorful turn-based combat system where every attack packs some heat, especially when you time it right. Hitting the action button as the hit lands amplifies your attack damage and strengthens your blocks against enemy attacks.  Use boost points at the start of your turn to multiply damage on attacks and skills. Each character harnesses their Spirit Power to use a unique set of class-based abilities associated with one of five flavor profiles. Match enemy flavour cravings to break down their defenses and leave them stuffed. With each round, build up your Ultimate meter to use special group Ultimates and serve up some devastating damage.

MECH-SPLORATION
Traverse unique villages in a customizable and upgradable ancient spirit-mech named Goddess. Double-jump, drill, and grapple your way through the world to discover local ingredients, hidden paths, memories, and new friends.

ORDER UP
Cook up made-to-order food to wake the people from a processed food-induced haze using the expressive cooking system. Forage, fish, and barter to collect ingredients and fire up orders for hungry villagers. Delivering delicious, hearty meals reconnects communities with their culture, history, and shared memories and increases your reputation. Developing a strong reputation comes with major perks and progression.

FIST FOOD
Fuel yourself in battle by having a quick bite to eat. Leverage the effects of ingredients to adjust recipes and create extra fragrant dishes that restore health, enhance damage, fortify defense, and replenish your Spirit Power.

MECH IT YOUR OWN
Serve up looks by customizing your spirit-mech, Goddess. Mix and match your mech’s body, arms, and legs. Create your own spicy style with custom wraps and accessories.

*There is no upgrade pack available.
*A separate title for Nintendo Switch 2 is available.
*Save data is not compatible with the Nintendo Switch 2 version.
70010000120720.intro: Two sisters and a mech cook, bond, and fight corpos in a spicy turn-based RPG.
70010000120720.name: Dosa Divas

70010000120726.description:
The mega-hit 3D puzzle game “Fruit Mountain” — where you merge fruits to make them bigger — is now a party battle game for everyone!
This time, it’s a fruit battle!? Jump into versus mode with up to 4 players!
With items and wild surprises, it’s a chaotic battle full of laughs!
Keep stacking those fruits!

[Easy to Play!]
Just toss fruits onto the plate and stack them up.
Merge two of the same fruit to create a bigger one!
The bigger the fruit you make, the higher your score climbs!
Be careful not to let fruits fall off the plate — merge them skillfully!
Master your stacking technique and take on your rivals!

[Battle Together!]
・Compete against rivals worldwide online!
Create a Room and invite friends to battle anytime, anywhere!
・Local versus play offline too!
Up to 4 players can play locally on a single Nintendo Switch! Get everyone together for some fun!

[Tons of Game Modes!]
Multiple versus modes! Try different styles and have a blast!
・Standard Race
・Thief Frenzy
・Fruit of the Sun
・Great Harvest
・Survival

[Single Player Too!]
Hone your skills against NPCs and prepare for online battles!
In “Time Attack” mode, race to complete a watermelon as fast as you can!
Aim for the fastest time! Climb the rankings!

[Collection]
Customize your plate with the dress-up feature! Show off your style with your favorite plate!
70010000120726.intro: The long-awaited new entry in the hit 3D puzzle game “Fruit Mountain” — where you merge fruits to make them bigger — is coming to Nintendo Switch™!
70010000120726.name: Fruit Mountain Party

70010000120732.description:
Fairy Tale Fighters is a 2D fighting game.

Momotaro, Kintaro, Sun Wukong, Peter Pan, Pinocchio, Aladdin,
Puss in Boots, Red Hood, Alice, Rapunzel, Snow White,
Cinderella, the Witch, the Wolf, and many more fairy tale characters all gather in one place!

When your gauge fills up, you can unleash a powerful super special move!
Enjoy exciting battles in a magical fantasy world!
70010000120732.intro: A dream fighting game where characters from fairy tales and novels battle each other!
70010000120732.name: Fairy Tale Fighters

70010000120738.description:
ROUTE16TURBO is an action game released in 1985.

Take control of your car, MAD X, and evade relentless enemy cars as you infiltrate the secret base of the evil Kanharoo Gang to recover all the stolen money.

Switch dynamically between Maze Mode, where you navigate complex labyrinths, and Radar Mode, which displays the entire stage made up of 16 mazes-delivering a constantly thrilling car chase experience.

This version also includes stages that were unreachable in the original 1985 release.
Now’s your chance to beat the high scores you set back then!
70010000120738.intro: Control MAD X and take back the stolen money!
70010000120738.name: ROUTE16TURBO

70010000120744.description:
Help Kuky, a curious character who gets lost in the Candy World and must travel through colorful environments to find the way back home. Along the journey, collect candies and face strange sugar-made enemies such as marshmallows, cookies, and other living, dangerous sweets.

Use precise jumps and a double jump to overcome obstacles, avoid traps, and progress through challenging stages full of action and rhythm.

With fast-paced gameplay, responsive controls, and a charming visual style, Kuky Adventure delivers a fun and addictive platforming experience from start to finish.

Features:
- Precision platforming with dynamic action
- Double jump to explore and overcome challenges
- A variety of candy-themed enemies
- Levels filled with obstacles and traps
- Colorful and charming visuals
- Cheerful and engaging soundtrack
70010000120744.intro: Lost in the Candy World you must find the way back home!
70010000120744.name: Kuky Adventure

70010000120774.description:
Meet charming girls, each dreaming of completing their own collection of the most stylish and vibrant swimsuits! Your task is to help them find the missing pieces by matching threes of identical swimsuits in cozy puzzles. Instead of the usual fruit or candy, you'll find elegant summer swimsuits in a wide variety of colors, cuts, textures, and styles: from glamorous bikinis to elegant one-pieces.
Match threes, solve increasingly complex puzzles, and gradually unlock full, realistic images of the girls in these swimsuits. With each completed round, you gain access to new fragments, and then to complete portraits that you can not only store but also creatively decorate.
In the interactive gallery, you can move, zoom, and choose the perfect angle, combining open images with different backgrounds—from sunny beaches to tropical sunsets—to create your own unique composition. All this is accompanied by gentle, relaxing music, turning the game into a meditative ritual of beauty, summer mood, and attention to detail.

Features:
• Realistic images of girls in stylish swimsuits.
• Collect swimsuits in dozens of colors, styles, and designs—from minimalist to glamorous.
• Numerous backgrounds to personalize your favorite looks.
• Interactive gallery with zoom and layout options.
• Helpful bonuses and boosters for solving puzzles.
• Relaxing music creates an atmosphere of summer comfort and aesthetic pleasure.
• Gradually increasing puzzle difficulty—from simple combinations to real logical challenges.
70010000120774.intro: Your summer starts with the perfect bikini.
70010000120774.name: Bikini Match Girls

70010000120782.description:
Step into a brutal, post-apocalyptic world where every second is a fight for your life. Flee the Fallen is a thrilling 2D zombie survival game that blends fast-paced arcade combat, strategic resource management, and atmospheric exploration.

The infected are evolving, the ruined streets are crawling with danger, and your only goal is simple: survive, fight, and escape.

Will you succumb to the horde, or will you carve a bloody path to freedom?

Key Features:
- Unforgiving 2D Combat: Engage in intense, fast-paced side-scrolling action. Master stamina-based melee strikes, tactical dodge-rolls, and precise gunplay to survive against overwhelming odds.
- Arsenal of Survival: From knives and blunt weapons to firearms and explosive grenades—choose the right tool for the job. Resources and ammunition are scarce, meaning you must carefully balance offense with smart positioning.
- Evolving Threats and Epic Bosses: The undead aren't just mindless; face enemies with deadly, unpredictable attack patterns and survive grueling, screen-filling boss encounters that will test your reflexes to their absolute limits.
- Classic Survival-Horror Puzzles: Catch your breath between blood-soaked battles by solving environmental puzzles, finding passcodes, and unlocking hidden paths to secure your escape route.
- Atmospheric Pixel Art: Immerse yourself in a beautifully bleak, retro-inspired post-apocalyptic world, brought to life with detailed pixel graphics, dynamic lighting, and visceral gore effects.
70010000120782.intro: Survive the Undead Menace in a Relentless 2D Action-Adventure!
70010000120782.name: Flee The Fallen

70010000120794.description:
"Sprunki Hell Towers is a dynamic platformer with horror elements, where every jump matters.
You play as one of the Sprunki and climb sinister towers to save friends captured by the villain Black. Each tower is a separate trial with its own atmosphere, mechanics, and mood: from bright and almost cheerful levels to anxious, oppressive sections with horror elements.

The game is built on fair but demanding gameplay. Mistakes are punished, but always fairly — no randomness or injustice. Difficulty grows gradually, forcing you to learn, adapt, and feel real progress.

You'll experience:
• unique towers of varying height and difficulty
• diverse game mechanics that change from level to level
• stylish music and recognizable Sprunki characters
• vibrant environments that gradually become darker
• tense but captivating atmosphere

Sprunki Hell Towers is a game about overcoming, rhythm, and concentration. Climb higher, don't look back, and don't let Black keep your friends trapped.
70010000120794.intro: Vibrant platformer: conquer horror towers and save Sprunki from Black
70010000120794.name: Sprunki Hell Towers

70010000120800.description:
Take the wheel and launch into the sky in STUNT RACE — an adrenaline-fueled driving experience where gravity is just a suggestion.

DEFY THE LAWS OF PHYSICS
Race through impossible tracks suspended high above a sprawling city. Loop through aerial rings, dodge obstacles in the clouds, and prove your skills on death-defying courses designed to push your reflexes to the limit.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY
• STUNT RACE — Navigate twisted loops, floating platforms, and mid-air hazards in heart-pounding timed runs
• STRAIGHT ROAD — Hit top speed on an endless highway and launch off a massive ramp into the unknown
• PLAYGROUND — Your personal stunt arena with ramps, jumps, and room to experiment with insane tricks

POINTS FOR STYLE
Every second in the air counts. Flip, spin, and rotate your car to rack up points. The bigger the rotation, the bigger the reward. Land it clean or crash spectacularly — either way, it's a show.

FEEL THE IMPACT
Real damage physics mean every collision leaves its mark. Watch your car crumble, dent, and shatter as you push it beyond limits. Four unique vehicles, each ready to be destroyed in spectacular fashion.

CINEMATIC PRESENTATION
Stunning visuals with realistic lighting bring the city skyline to life beneath your wheels. An energetic soundtrack keeps your pulse racing from start to finish.

Strap in. Floor it. Fly.
70010000120800.intro: Fly through loops, smash cars & pull insane stunts above a stunning city skyline.
70010000120800.name: Stunt Race

70010000120804.description:
Speed across anti-gravity tracks filled with jumps, shortcuts, hazards, and explosive pickups on your way to victory! Get revved up for local multiplayer, challenging Event Races, a powerful Course Editor, and more.

Create your own tracks, discover new community creations, master every shortcut, and leave your rivals behind. Whether you're chasing the perfect lap or battling for first place, there's always another race waiting in Star Racer.
70010000120804.intro: Race through futuristic cities where gravity is just another obstacle!
70010000120804.name: Star Racer

70010000120821.description:
• In this future, MAN and INTERNET have merged into a new being. This being needs DOPAMINE every 10 SECONDS, or else it will DIE!

• ARCADE FUN! You are MULLET MAD JACK, and you must kill enemies to refill your 10 SECONDS OF LIFE!

• Beat handcraft stages at random full of exciting new obstacles at each chapter!

• Memorize each room and compete for better times!

• Cleverly build your character every FLOOR, in a fully-fledge NARRATIVE with small roguelite elements.

• Defeat the mysterious masterminds and experience the ultimate OLD SCHOOL ANIME plot!
70010000120821.intro: MULLET MADJACK is a HIGH-OCTANE-ACTION SHOOTER that put you directly inside a CLASSIC ANIME.
70010000120821.name: MULLET MADJACK

70010000120829.description:
An adventure to find the ultimate legendary card hidden in the Wind Forest!

The mysterious 'Wind Forest' where external cards do not work at all.
Start with basic monster cards alongside your guide, 'Kumira', and build your ultimate deck!
Collect and enhance monsters across four elemental attributes (Water, Fire, Wood, Iron) with unique character abilities, and overcome the trials of villains and guardian deities threatening the Wind Forest.

Key Features
Intuitive one-button timing battles played with just a single finger!
Tap the matching elemental icon according to the rotating circular gauge!
Claim the initiative with precise timing and deliver fatal strikes utilizing elemental matchups.

4 Elements and Deep Elemental Matchup Strategy
Clear matchup relationships among the four elements: Water, Fire, Wood, and Iron!
Strategic fun in analyzing enemy attributes to build decks with advantageous element monsters.

Fun of Collection and Growth (From Rank C to Rank S!)
Monster card crafting, card rank upgrades, level enhancement, and transcendence!
Equip Hole Stones (Enhancement Stones) to grant unique skills (Rage, Crazy, Reflect, Absorb, Heal, etc.) and train them to be stronger.
Uncapped cumulative stat boosts upon acquiring duplicates!

Unique Character Stat Development
Each character possesses diverse trait stats such as Critical Chance, Evasion Rate, and EXP Boost!
Enhance character stats in your preferred direction to match your playstyle.

Rich Content and Complete Index
20 basic monsters per element and golden 'Legendary Hidden Monsters' with special abilities!
Mining system, various achievement rewards, plus Guardian Battles and showdowns against character doppelgangers that test your limits!
70010000120829.intro:
Thrilling timing battles with just one finger!
An adventure to find the ultimate legendary card!
70010000120829.name: Tap Monster Duel

70010000120835.description:
Design the space of your dreams in a world filled with cozy emotions. In <Lovely Deco House>, gather materials from nature, such as plants and rocks, to create unique furniture and props, offering creative joy. Just like dyeing old cloth with cherry blossoms to make pretty pink fabric, your ideas will soon become wonderful interiors.

Decorate the homes of your cute doll friends with carefully crafted furniture. From charming rabbit cafes to emotionally rich chick camping sites, new stories bloom wherever your touch reaches. But simple decoration isn't everything. Explore regions with their own mysterious characteristics and bravely overcome the obstacles you encounter. The rare materials you discover after hard work will make your space even more special. Start your heartwarming deco journey right now!
70010000120835.intro: Create your own healing space through collecting and crafting, a deco adventure with cute friends!
70010000120835.name: Lovely Deco House

70010000120841.description:
Embark on an exciting coloring journey with adorable bee friends! <Crayon Farm Animals> is an easy and fun creativity education game featuring farm animals that our children love most.

It provides an intuitive interface that anyone can easily enjoy without complicated controls, and it implements a smooth and warm texture as if coloring with real crayons. Over 15 different farm animal friends are waiting for your colors.

Check out what your completed animal friends look like, and complete your own animal collection painted in various colors! It will be the most perfect and safe sketchbook that allows children to freely unleash their imagination and provide emotional stability. Give the gift of creative time that the whole family can enjoy together.
70010000120841.intro: My child's first digital sketchbook, color in the colorful farm animals! Complete cute cow, horse, and sheep friends with my fingertips, and fill your own animal picture book.
70010000120841.name: CRAYON FARM ANIMALS

70010000120847.description:
The 'Crayon' series, beloved by children and creative adults worldwide, now dives into a mysterious underwater world!

 'Crayon Sea Friends' is a creativity game where you fill adorable whales, playful turtles, sparkling fish, and other diverse marine creatures with your own colors.

It offers an intuitive interface that anyone can easily enjoy without complicated controls, and it recreates the texture of coloring with real crayons through precise touch controls. Watch your completed sea friends come to life with vivid animation. It will be the most perfect digital sketchbook, offering both educational fun and emotional stability.
70010000120847.intro:
A small ocean in my hands, dyed in vibrant colors!
I invite you to a healing drawing world where you can enjoy creating your own sea friends with your imagination.
70010000120847.name: CRAYON SEA FRIENDS

70010000120853.description:
The 'Crayon' series, responsible for children's creativity worldwide, finally arrives in the most mysterious world, <Crayon Magic World>! In this series, you can meet friends from the Magic World that only existed in imagination, including legendary unicorns, beautiful mermaids, brave dragons, and mysterious nine-tailed foxes.

Unleash your children's imagination with an intuitive interface that anyone can easily enjoy without complicated rules, and a variety of colors that perfectly capture the texture of real crayons. The sight of the fantastic characters you carefully colored coming to life will give children a special sense of accomplishment and a magical experience. Open the door to the Magic World now, the most beautiful digital sketchbook that offers both educational fun and emotional stability!
70010000120853.intro: Mystical friends met in dreams awaken in vibrant colors at my fingertips!
70010000120853.name: CRAYON MAGIC WORLD

70010000120859.description:
The 'Crayon' series, responsible for children's creativity worldwide, is back with a mysterious jungle theme, 'Crayon Jungle,' going beyond cars, dinosaurs, and animals! In this series, you can meet wild animals hidden throughout the jungle, including brave tigers, playful gorillas, long-necked giraffes, and cute sloths hanging from trees.

Unleash your children's imagination with an intuitive interface that anyone can easily enjoy without complicated controls, and a variety of colors that perfectly capture the smooth texture of real crayons. Feel the animals you carefully colored come to life, experiencing a sense of accomplishment and emotional stability at the same time. Start your exciting wildlife adventure right now with 'Crayon Jungle,' a safe and creative digital sketchbook that you can unfold anytime, anywhere!
70010000120859.intro: Color adorable animal friends in a lush jungle with your own colors!
70010000120859.name: CRAYON JUNGLE

70010000120865.description:
A colorful fairytale world that comes to life at your fingertips!
Complete your own special sketchbook with cute friends!

<Crayon Friends> is a healing coloring simulation game where anyone can freely fill in cute characters with their own colors, without complicated rules or stress.

Rabbits, bears, birds, cool dinosaurs and even cute astronauts! A variety of illustrations and rich crayon colors are available.  Easily open your own atelier anytime, anywhere with intuitive touch operation optimized for.

■ Special fun elements unique to <Crayon Friends>

Colorful character lineup: From forest animals to imaginary monsters and dinosaurs, there are many cute characters that will catch the eyes of users.

Challenge and Medal System: You can feel a unique sense of accomplishment by earning a wonderful medal for each uniquely completed painting.

Camera function to leave memories: Take a picture of the work you worked hard to complete with a camera and store it nicely in your sketchbook album.

Equipped with fun minigames: “Who will be the character I completed?” After you finish coloring, an intuitive and exciting quiz game unfolds where you have to find the character you designed yourself!

Perfect healing play environment: Helps develop children's creativity and relieve adults' stress in warm sounds, without time limits or competition elements.
70010000120865.intro: Color your own cute animal friends with colorful crayons!
70010000120865.name: CRAYON FRIENDS

70010000120871.description:
Escape from the hustle and bustle of everyday life and find peace of mind by coloring beautiful mandala patterns!
<Crayon Mandala> goes beyond the existing Crayon series for children and is a healing coloring simulation game that the whole family, including parents and adults, can enjoy together.

A variety of elaborate mandala patterns await your touch. Relieve stress and experience inner peace by completing the mandala with your own color combination.

■ The special charm of <Crayon Mandala>
Healing for the whole family: The perfect art therapy game for kids to get creative and adults to relax.
Elaborate and beautiful patterns: From simple drawings to artistic mandalas, there are a variety of patterns available.
Intuitive operation: Without complicated tools, anyone can easily fill in beautiful colors by touching the screen.
Artwork Gallery: You can save your completed mandala in the gallery and view it again at any time.

Experience the time of filling a mandala with your own colors with quiet music.
70010000120871.intro: Enjoy healing time with your family through soothing mandala coloring!
70010000120871.name: CRAYON MANDALA

70010000120882.description:
Springbot: The Last Spark is a side-scrolling action platforming adventure. Traverse a vibrant world by running, jumping and bouncing on springy robotic legs as you try to find gems hidden in mazelike stages. Push crates to reach higher platforms, avoid spike traps, hop on the heads of roving enemies to deactivate them and touch checkpoints to safeguard your progress.

This journey will take you through forests, underground caverns, lofty cliffs and more as you collect coins and explore in colorfully cute HD style across 35 unique levels. Replay cleared stages for better times or to collect more coins, team up for co-op play or put your skills to the test in Glitch Mode!

• Take the role of Springbot as the last remaining hope to restore memory to his fellow robots!
• Enjoy retro side-scrolling adventure through colorful platforming stages.
• Run, jump and bounce on spring-like legs as you traverse mazelike environments!
• Avoid traps and hop on the heads of enemies as you master 35 unique levels.
• Collect gems to power the Great Heart and bring order to a chaotic world!
70010000120882.intro: Embark on a journey to save your fellow robots in colorful side-scrolling style!
70010000120882.name: Springbot: The Last Spark

70010000120889.description:
"TAG TEAM WRESTLING" is an action game released by Technos Japan in 1983.
Enjoy the world of professional wrestling as you control the hero wrestler and aim to become world champion.
Quick move selection and the skillful tag team work unique to tag matches are the keys to victory!
Sometimes brawls spill out of the ring, and unexpected intruders might even show up!?

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.
70010000120889.intro: The Big Excite Series finally begins!!
70010000120889.name: Arcade Archives TAG TEAM WRESTLING

70010000120906.description:
This is a pure love story between a young man and a girl who gave everything to the world.
Three separate stories begin at random, ultimately converging into a single narrative.
We embraced the strengths of the visual novel format to create a maddeningly intense tale of pure love that lingers long after the final line.
70010000120906.intro: The Girl Who Dreamed the World
70010000120906.name: Cyanotype Daydream -The Girl Who Dreamed the World-

70010000120911.description:
COORDINATE OR CRUMBLE! To survive this mission, you'll need to grab a Joy-Con™ and get ready to swing into action. Take control of the inseparable duo, Ten and Tango, as they embark on a high-stakes platforming journey to topple the villainous Chef Murgó.

Don’t let the cute art style fool you—this is a relentless test of skill where one slip-up sends both octos tumbling. Whether you’re tackling the challenge Solo (mastering the "brain-melting" art of controlling both characters at once) or syncing up in Local or Online Co-op, your coordination will be pushed to the absolute limit.

WHY YOU’LL BE TANGLED UP:

DECEPTIVELY DIFFICULT: Master the timing of two octos holding hands. It’s quirky, colourful, and punishingly hard.

TANDEM TEAMWORK: Use your physical bond to swing across massive gaps and dodge lethal traps. In this game, you literally "carry" your partner!

DIVERSE WORLDS: Navigate windy deserts, crumbling lava mountains, and intricate puzzles that demand 100% precision.

PERFECT FOR SWITCH: Play anytime, anywhere in Tabletop, Handheld, or TV mode. One Joy-Con per player is all you need for local co-op!

GLOBAL LEADERBOARDS: Think you’re the fastest on the planet? Prove it! Compete for the best times against players worldwide.

GAME MODES:
* 2-Player Online or Local Co-op: The ultimate test of friendship and physics.
* Solo Mode: A unique mental challenge where you must coordinate both octos simultaneously.
70010000120911.intro: Two octos on a precision mission! Swing through a cute but brutal world. Master the tango of teamwork solo or in local/online co-op. Can you defeat Chef Murgó?
70010000120911.name: Tentacle Tango

70010000120923.description:
Enter the world of The Fallen Kingdom, a fast-paced action RPG adventure. Fight your way through intense bullet hell-inspired battles where quick reflexes, strategic movement, and powerful abilities are the key to survival. Explore dangerous environments filled with enemies, hidden surprises, and challenging boss fights that will test your combat skills at every step.

Unlock and upgrade abilities through a deep and rewarding skill tree, allowing you to customize your playstyle and become stronger with every battle. Experience a simple yet engaging story that keeps the adventure moving forward while introducing new challenges and unexpected moments along the way.

Key Features
	•	Battle powerful bosses with challenging and dynamic attack patterns
	•	Unlock new abilities and strengthen your character through a detailed skill tree
	•	Explore atmospheric levels filled with enemies, secrets, and surprises
	•	Discover a simple but engaging story that drives the adventure forward
	•	Face increasingly difficult encounters that reward skill and strategy
	•	Fight through intense levels packed with action, danger, and progression


Every battle brings new challenges, every victory makes you stronger, and every moment pushes you closer to becoming a true legend of The Fallen Kingdom.
70010000120923.intro: Step into the fallen kingdom and fight for victory.
70010000120923.name: The Fallen Kingdom

70010000120934.description:
Dive into a world of stunning, realistic puzzles that captivate your eyes and mind. Piece by piece, reveal breathtaking images of beautiful women — each completed puzzle unlocks a new masterpiece, keeping you motivated to discover what’s next.

Smooth and intuitive touch controls make gameplay effortless and deeply satisfying — you’ll feel like you’re truly shaping every picture with your own hands. Gentle, soothing music sets the perfect mood, helping you unwind while your curiosity pulls you to complete the next challenge.

Relax, enjoy, and let yourself get lost in the details.

Features:
• Addictive, easy-to-play puzzle mechanics.
• Gorgeous, realistic artwork of women.
• Satisfying touch interaction — every move feels natural.
• Unlock new, even more stunning images as you progress.
• Perfect balance of challenge and relaxation.
• Soothing soundtrack that enhances your focus and mood.
• Admire each completed image in full detail.
70010000120934.intro: Every piece brings you closer to perfection!
70010000120934.name: Dirty Little Puzzle

70010000120959.description:
Welcome to GRIDbeat!

A rhythm-fueled cyber-dungeon crawler where every move must match the music or risk total system shutdown.

You just breached Knoss.OS, the planet’s most fortified corporate network, and made off with a payload of priceless data. Now you’re trapped inside, hunted by rogue security protocols and hostile malware. Your only way out? Sync with the system. Move to the beat. And escape before the grid locks you down for good.

FEATURES

* Beat-Based Dungeon Crawling
In GRIDbeat!, movement, combat, and interaction all happen on the beat. Every level is a tactical challenge where rhythm equals survival.
* Pulse-Pounding Maze Exploration
As you navigate the data labyrinths, keep an eye out for all manner of hazards, including Server Formats that can wipe a level clean.
* Evolving Abilities & Power-Ups
Install powerful software tools to help you overcome system threats, uncover secrets and solve challenges.
* Cyber.Mind Boss Battles
Defeat powerful AI gatekeepers in intense beat-based battles to continue your journey and reach the final exit port out of the Mainframe.
* Step into the Rhythm! 
GRIDbeat’s electrifying soundtrack pulls you into the action, where every move, ability, and attack pulses to the beat. Sync your gameplay with the music and let the soundtrack guide your every step through the grid!
70010000120959.name: GRIDBeat!

70010000120965.description:
A management simulation in which you take an old, run-down castle and turn it into a dastardly demon stronghold! Recruit unique monsters as your minions and vanquish adventurers who dare to enter your realm!

Install gargoyles, ritual altars, and other devilish decor to boost your castle's mystique and attract more monsters your way. Gift them food and other items to help them grow, and garner their support to fend off pesky adventurers.

You can also send your monster minions out to explore nearby dungeons and towns. They'll bring you back items and other loot, and maybe even some new allies!

As you progress, you can also start merging monsters together to make new ones.

And don't forget traps—essential equipment for proper castle defense! Develop a range of traps like sleep-inducing gas and heavy washbowls to thwart any who cross the threshold of your demonic haven! By placing and combining traps in imaginative ways, you can make your fortress of fiendishness virtually impregnable!

Fend off attacks from mighty adventurers and keep your minions sweet to become the biggest and baddest demon overlord of all time!
70010000120965.intro: Demon Castle Building Dungeon Management Simulation
70010000120965.name: Demon Castle Story – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000120982.description:
No cover. No limits. Just pure action.

Enter a brutal battlefield where speed, aggression, and constant movement are the only way to survive. Serious Carnage - Adrenaline Shooter throws you into intense arena-based combat where waves of enemies never stop and every second pushes your reflexes to the limit.

Fight through closed arenas filled with enemies, where portals open and unleash continuous waves of threats. You’re forced to stay in motion, switch weapons on the fly, and react instantly as the pressure builds with every encounter.

Use a wide arsenal of powerful weapons, each designed for a different combat style. From precision shots to heavy explosive damage, every choice changes how you handle the chaos around you. Enemies range from fast and aggressive units to stronger elite forces and massive bosses that require skill and timing to defeat.
Defeat enemies, collect souls, and push your limits to activate powerful abilities that turn the fight in your favor.  Aggressive gameplay is rewarded, encouraging you to stay in the action and take control of every arena.

Key Features:
	•	Non-stop arena combat with constant pressure
	•	Wave-based encounters that keep escalating
	•	Fast movement built around aggression
	•	Weapon variety for different combat styles
	•	Rage Mode that shifts the fight in your favor
	•	Boss fights that test timing and control
The pressure keeps building with every wave.
Only those who stay in control make it through.
70010000120982.name: Serious Carnage - Adrenaline Shooter

70010000120998.description:
In Unbox the Room, you’re not just moving furniture — you’re a professional life-arranger, a master of the “where does this go?” mystery, and a total (consensual) snoop. From cramped studio apartments to luxurious mansions, it’s up to you to transform a pile of cardboard boxes into a beautifully organized and lived-in home.

KEY FEATURES:
- The Ultimate Zen Zone: No timers. No "Game Over" screens. Just the rhythmic thwack of tape peeling and the pure, dopamine-hitting click of a book fitting perfectly onto a shelf.
- Environmental Storytelling: Why does this guy have four different toilets? What’s the deal with that strange book at the bottom of the box? Piece together your clients' lives through the junk they refuse to throw away.
- Total Aesthetic Control: Not feeling the beige? Use the Magic Paint Roller to overhaul the room's vibe. Make it goth. Make it neon. Make it a nightmare. We won't tell the client.
- Sandbox Shenanigans: Done with the story? Head to the Creative Sandbox where the budget is infinite and the boxes are non-existent. Build the dream gaming den you’ll never actually afford in real life!
- Tactile Satisfaction: Every item has been crafted with gorgeous pixel art and satisfying physics.
70010000120998.intro: Transform chaos into comfort in a meditative interior design simulator where every item tells a story!
70010000120998.name: Unbox the Room

70010000121004.description:
Check in to a hospital where the doctors are as intense as they are irresistible... and getting better has never felt this good.

Answer their questions, hold your ground against every interruption, and build a real connection with anime doctors who each carry something worth uncovering.

From the quiet specialist who says little but notices everything, to the confident attending who makes every visit feel personal. Every choice you make changes how they see you.

Think you can handle the pressure and win them over?


Features:

● DUAL GAMEPLAY, DOUBLE TENSION: Alternate between personality-driven Q&A sessions and reflex-based minigames where you block distractions, rival patients, and unexpected visitors to keep your connection alive.

● UNLOCK EXCLUSIVE IMAGES: Deepen your bond with each doctor to reveal special moments and unique illustrations as you progress through their route.

● DISTINCT PERSONALITIES, REAL DEPTH: Every doctor reacts differently to your answers, your timing, and your choices. Getting it right feels earned.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: How it ends depends on how well you listen, how fast you react, and how much you truly understand him.

● A HIDDEN FINAL MOMENT: Reach question 150 to unlock a very special scene that only the most dedicated patients will ever see.


This hospital runs on connection, and you are the missing piece.
Ready to find out which doctor steals your heart?
70010000121004.intro:
The doctor will see you now.
Get close, earn his trust, and unlock exclusive images!
70010000121004.name: Hospital Romance: Anime Doctor Crush

70010000121010.description:
Step into a hospital where the staff is as captivating as they are caring... and your recovery depends on how well you play your cards.

Answer their questions, defend your heart from unwanted interruptions, and earn the trust of charming anime nurses who each hide a story worth discovering.

Every right move brings you closer to their secret side. Do you have the patience and the skill to win them over?


Features:

● DUAL GAMEPLAY, DOUBLE TENSION: Alternate between personality-driven Q&A sessions and reflex-based minigames where you defend against distractions, rival patients, and unexpected visitors.

● UNLOCK EXCLUSIVE IMAGES: Build connection with each nurse to reveal special moments and unique illustrations as you progress through their route.

● DISTINCT PERSONALITIES, REAL DEPTH: From the strict head nurse to the bubbly intern, every character reacts differently to your answers, your timing, and your choices.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Your results depend on how well you listen, how fast you react, and how much you truly understand her.

● A HIDDEN FINAL MOMENT: Reach question 150 to unlock a very special scene that only the most dedicated patients will ever see.


Think you've got what it takes to charm the whole ward?

This is one hospital you won't want to leave!
70010000121010.intro:
Your heart isn't the only thing they'll check.
Fall for the nurses and unlock exclusive images!
70010000121010.name: Hospital Romance: Anime Nurse Crush

70010000121016.description:
They were lost to the apocalypse… now they’re yours to claim.

In Zombie Hearts: Turn the Undead into Anime Boys, every battle brings you closer to something dangerous, intense… and impossible to resist.

Explore infected zones crawling with the undead. Fight, weaken, and capture them… then transform them into captivating anime boys with a dark, post-apocalyptic allure.

♥ HUNT, CAPTURE AND REVIVE
Face relentless hordes of zombies and turn your enemies into something far more tempting: your ideal anime boys.

♥ FROM DECAY TO DESIRE
Each boy carries the essence of what he once was. Strong, mysterious, wild… now reborn with a seductive edge that’s hard to ignore.

♥ BUILD DESIRE AND CONNECTION
Get closer to the boys you capture. Unlock intimate moments, deepen your bond, and uncover their hidden sides.

♥ GROW STRONGER, GO FURTHER
Earn rewards, upgrade your skills, and dominate increasingly dangerous encounters. The stronger you become, the more irresistible they are.

♥ UNLOCK EXCLUSIVE MOMENTS
Progress to reveal special scenes and unique interactions. Every victory pulls you deeper into their world.


In a world overrun by the undead… will you control them, or give in to them?
70010000121016.intro: Hunt the undead… and turn them into irresistible anime boys.
70010000121016.name: Zombie Hearts: Turn the Undead into Anime Boys

70010000121022.description:
They were once lost to the apocalypse… now they’re yours to reclaim.

In Zombie Hearts: Turn the Undead into Anime Girls, every battle is a chance to bring beauty back from decay.

Explore dangerous zones overrun by zombies. Fight, weaken, and capture them… then transform them into stunning anime girls with a dark, post-apocalyptic edge.

♥ HUNT, CAPTURE AND REVIVE
Face relentless waves of the undead and turn your enemies into something completely unexpected: your ideal anime girls.

♥ FROM DECAY TO DESIRE
Each girl carries traces of her past life. Their personalities, looks, and attitude reflect the zombie they once were… now reborn in a seductive new form.

♥ BUILD BONDS BEYOND SURVIVAL
Get closer to the girls you save. Unlock scenes, deepen your connection, and discover their hidden stories.

♥ UPGRADE AND DOMINATE
Earn rewards, improve your combat skills, and survive tougher encounters. The stronger you become, the more powerful and alluring your girls will be.

♥ UNLOCK EXCLUSIVE SCENES
Progress through the game to reveal special images and moments. Every victory brings you closer to uncovering everything they have to offer.


In a world ruled by the undead… will you fight them, or fall for them?
70010000121022.intro: Hunt the undead… and turn them into irresistible anime girls.
70010000121022.name: Zombie Hearts: Turn the Undead into Anime Girls

70010000121028.description:
Step into the shoes of a station manager and take over an abandoned roadside gas station. From rusty pumps and empty shelves to a bustling hub of activity, every decision is yours. Refuel cars, clean vehicles, manage the store, and maintain the area — success depends on your skill, speed, and strategy. Experience the challenge of running a full-service station, where every role matters and every customer counts.

Key Features:
• Refuel & Serve: Keep fuel flowing and customers happy.
• Store Management: Stock shelves, sell goods, and attract more visitors.
• Car Wash & Maintenance: Clean vehicles and repair damaged equipment.
• Supply & Upgrades: Manage deliveries, monitor inventory, and improve your station.
• Hands-On Roles: Play as cashier, mechanic, cleaner, or take full control as manager.

Transform a forgotten stop into a thriving roadside empire. Gas Station Simulator is more than a game — it’s your chance to master every detail, grow your business, and build the ultimate gas station experience. Are you ready to take the wheel?
70010000121028.intro: Refuel cars, manage your store, and grow your roadside empire.
70010000121028.name: Gas Station Manager 2026

70010000121051.name: Hentai Reality 2

70010000121062.description:
Build your own automotive empire in Auto Shop Simulator — the ultimate business simulation where every deal counts. Step into the role of a car dealership owner and transform a small local garage into a thriving vehicle marketplace. Buy used and premium cars, negotiate profitable deals, manage your inventory, and satisfy customers looking for their perfect ride.

Start with a modest showroom and gradually expand your business by unlocking new vehicles, upgrading facilities, and attracting more buyers. From economy cars to luxury models, every purchase and sale influences your reputation and success. Manage finances carefully, react to changing market trends, and make strategic decisions to grow your dealership into the top auto shop in town.
Features:
	•	Buy and Sell Vehicles: Discover valuable cars, negotiate prices, and sell vehicles for maximum profit.
	•	Realistic Dealership Management: Organize inventory, monitor market value, and keep your showroom stocked with popular models.
	•	Expand Your Business: Upgrade your dealership, unlock larger spaces, and improve customer experience.
	•	Dynamic Customer System: Meet different customer needs and handle daily business challenges.
	•	Immersive Simulation Experience: Enjoy detailed vehicles, dealership customization, and rewarding progression.
Auto Shop Simulator delivers an engaging experience for car lovers and simulation fans alike. Test your entrepreneurial skills, make smart business decisions, and grow your small dealership into a successful automotive empire.
70010000121062.intro: Ready to become the ultimate car tycoon?
70010000121062.name: Auto Shop Simulator

70010000121068.description:
Counter Call - Half Escape Shooter Enter a high-intensity first-person shooter built for nonstop action and fast decision-making. Every mission throws you straight into combat, where quick reflexes, precision aiming, and smart positioning are the only way to survive. Fight through waves of enemies across compact, action-driven maps designed to keep you constantly engaged.

There’s no downtime — every route leads to new encounters, pushing you to stay alert and react instantly to threats coming from all directions. Adapt your playstyle to each situation. Choose the right weapon, switch tactics on the fly, and handle both close-range aggression and controlled, long-distance combat. Success depends on how well you read the battlefield and respond under pressure. Enjoy smooth controls and responsive mechanics that make movement, aiming, and shooting feel sharp and satisfying. Every encounter is direct, intense, and rewarding for players who think fast and act faster.

Key Features:
	•	Fast-paced FPS gameplay with continuous action
	•	Wave-based enemy encounters
	•	Compact maps designed for constant engagement
	•	Flexible combat styles: aggressive or tactical
	•	Smooth controls and responsive shooting mechanics
	•	Increasing challenge that tests reflexes and precision
Step into the zone. Eliminate the threat. Win.
70010000121068.name: Counter Call - Half Escape Shooter

70010000121070.description:
Welcome to Drill Core, where corporate greed meets strategic planet-mining! By day, lead an elite crew of miners, carriers, and guards as they carve a path through hostile alien worlds. Build advanced facilities, upgrade deadly turrets, and prepare for relentless nightly assaults from alien lifeforms. Will you chase maximum efficiency at any cost, or play it safe and fight to survive?
Drill Core is a strategy roguelike that will push your decision-making to the limit. Every run is a fresh challenge during which you will:
- Manage resources across procedurally generated maps, where no two expeditions ever play the same.
- Explore three distinct biomes, each packed with unique enemies, blocks, and bosses: Caves, Frozen Worlds, and Jungle.
- Command one of three unique platforms:
- - Humans — adaptable, well-equipped, and armed with reliable machine guns.
- - Dwarves — hardy demolition specialists who blast through rock and enemies alike with brutal efficiency.
- - Swarnids — led by a ruthless Queen who spawns endless loyal workers to devour everything in their path.
- Take on a range of contracts: drill to the planet’s core, ship huge resource hauls back to your corporate overlords, or test their latest experimental machinery.
70010000121070.intro: Corporate greed meets planet-mining in this roguelite strategy.
70010000121070.name: Drill Core

70010000121087.description:
Step into the mind of John Morley, a 1940s detective on his final case. Explore shadowed places long forgotten by time, and piece together crime scenes in a narrative adventure steeped in mystery, unexpected twists, and a truth buried for decades.

The Last Case of John Morley is a first-person narrative adventure set in the 1940s. You play as an experienced detective faced with a case long buried by time. After months in hospital, John Morley receives an unexpected visit from Lady Margarette Fordside, an aristocrat haunted by the murder of her daughter twenty years earlier. Though the police closed the case, she believes the real killer was never found.

What begins as a quiet look into an old case becomes a haunting investigation into forgotten places and long-hidden truths that refuse to stay buried.


Features
• First-person perspective – Step into the shoes of Detective John Morley.
• Atmospheric setting – A game inspired by the great tradition of detective fiction.
• Exploration and investigation – Reconstruct past scenes and search for hidden clues.
• Evocative soundtrack – Music inspired by the era enhances immersion.
• Compact, memorable story – A mystery that will stay with you.
70010000121087.intro: A forgotten crime. A hidden truth. The last case of Detective John Morley.
70010000121087.name: The Last Case of John Morley

70010000121095.description:
In Nocturne Routes, you guide a vampire through dark, puzzle-filled levels where every move must be planned in advance. Each stage challenges you to chart an efficient route, defeat lurking skeletons, and decide whether to collect optional coins along the way — or leave them behind.

Enemies aren’t avoided, they’re outplayed. Skeletons block your path, forcing you to think carefully about movement order, positioning, and strategy. A single wrong decision can leave you trapped in the darkness.

Every level contains three optional coins, rewarding mastery and smart planning. Your progress is tracked on the level select screen, letting you replay stages to perfect your solutions and claim full completion.

With its darker atmosphere, thoughtful mechanics, and focus on deliberate decision-making, Nocturne Routes offers a puzzle experience that rewards patience, logic, and careful execution.
70010000121095.intro: Plan your path. Control the night.
70010000121095.name: Nocturne Routes

70010000121100.description:
Turn into a kaiju as you destroy everything in your path in this fast-paced dice game! Roll the dice and find the best possible combinations to rule over Tokyo, whether you choose to heal yourself, attack, buy cards or win Victory Points.

Adapt your strategy to become the King of Tokyo at the right moment and attack all your opponents at the same time.

The first player to reach 20 Victory Points wins the game... and so does the last player to stay alive!

- Build your strategy
Roll the dice and choose wisely which ones to keep. Whether you decide to keep your dice or reroll, each decision is crucial to your winning strategy. Turn into a glass canon with powerful cards to reduce your opponents' hit points to 0, play it safe and quickly collect Victory Points, or build up health to become a tank: the choice is yours.

- Choose your kaiju
Unleash the kaiju within you and rule over Tokyo! The mighty Gigazaur, the cute Cyber Kitty or maybe the otherworldly Alienoid, choose the invader that suits you best.

- Battle over Tokyo against AI or against your friends
Test your strategies by competing against the AI in the solo mode, and find the strategy that matches you.
Challenge up to 5 of your friends in the couch multiplayer mode to prove who the mightiest kaiju is!

- A unique recreation
(Re)discover King of Tokyo in a dynamic recreation of the critically acclaimed board game.
Immerse yourself in the ukiyo-e inspired art style (Japanese woodblock prints and painting style).
70010000121100.intro: Become the ultimate kaiju and rule over Tokyo!
70010000121100.name: King of Tokyo - Richard Garfield

70010000121117.description:
Collect pieces of the battle girls and complete the puzzle!
There are 15 stages in total.
As you clear each stage, the difficulty increases!
Stages 1–10: 30 pieces
Stages 11–15: 50 pieces
The final stage is a tough one with no background watermark!
Take your time and examine each piece to complete the puzzle!
Once completed, high resolution images will be added to your gallery ♪

70010000121117.intro: A puzzle game featuring cool and cute battle girls is here!
70010000121117.name: Fight Girls

70010000121123.description:
Shiba Inu, Kishu Ken, Akita Inu, and many other Japanese dog breeds appear!
There are 15 stages in total!
As you clear each stage, the difficulty increases.
This game starts with 50‑piece puzzles and goes up to challenging 150‑piece stages!

The later stages are tough ones with no background watermark!
Take your time, observe each piece carefully, and complete the puzzle!
=====================

70010000121123.intro:
【Up to 150 Pieces!】
Everyone’s favorite! Collect puzzle pieces of iconic Japanese dogs and complete the puzzle!
70010000121123.name: Dog Jigsaw from Japan

70010000121133.description:
Rise to the top of the K-pop charts, become the next sensation, and earn the love of fans. Lead your group to stand out and conquer the hyper-competitive music scene. In this one-of-a-kind idol life simulator, step into the shoes of a powerful manager and shape your girl group’s destiny on their journey to the Hall of Fame.

Step into the spotlight behind the scenes! Build your dream idol group as you scout rising stars, shape their weekly schedules, and guide their journey to fame. Mix work, training, and downtime to help your idols shine their brightest, while you enjoy the thrill of creating a superstar career you can’t experience in real life.

Your decisions extend far beyond management. The relationships you build and the choices you make will define your group’s future. Whether you’re offering unconditional support, navigating rivalries, or representing your group in the public eye, every action has consequences. Randomized events mirror the unpredictable challenges of the real K-pop industry, testing your judgment at every turn.

Your ultimate goal? Debut. Along the way, your trainees will face off against rivals in thrilling, RPG-style battles that will prove whether they have what it takes to shine. Once your group is ready, you’ll choose their signature look, define their fan club identity, and produce a debut album that captures their essence.

The road to debut isn’t an easy path, but it’s where every dream begins, and every step you take becomes a story worth remembering.

- Your Dream K-pop Group: Choose from eight unique trainees, from the cheerful Minji to the shy Ai, the lineup and skillset of your group is in your hands, and it's your job to shape them as stars.
- Plan Their Schedule: As the manager, it's your job to balance stamina, finances, and workload. Push your idols too hard and risk burnout, but pamper them too much and you'll quickly run out of funds!
- Relationships Matter: The bonds you build shape every outcome. Your decisions influence how each character perceives you, unlocking new encounters, storylines and endings.
- Minigames: Scout new idols, hit the right notes during vocal practice, and master dance routines in rhythm challenges. Your performance in these mini-games determines your success as an idol manager.
- Original K-pop Soundtrack: Featuring exclusive music and special vocal tracks for your group's debut, produced just for this game. K-pop fans will be clamouring for the tracklist.
- Visual Adventure: Stunning hand-drawn artwork brings a rich world to life. Beautifully animated emotions and gestures make your idols feel truly alive, letting you connect with them like never before.
70010000121133.intro: Do you have what it takes to debut the ultimate K-pop group?
70010000121133.name: K-pop Idol Stories: Road to Debut

70010000121138.description:
Create, decorate, and transform beautiful outdoor spaces in Garden Designer Simulator — a relaxing gardening and landscaping experience where creativity and hard work go hand in hand.

Start your journey in a quiet small town with your very own house and garden. Learn the basics of outdoor maintenance by mowing lawns, trimming hedges, removing weeds, watering plants, and restoring old fences. Grow flowers and vegetables in your greenhouse while turning your backyard into a cozy and welcoming retreat.

As your reputation grows, local residents will begin asking for your help. Travel across town to restore neglected gardens, redesign outdoor spaces, and complete landscaping projects. Earn rewards, unlock new tools and decorations, and continue improving your own property.

After completing the first missions, unlock a more open experience where you can focus on gardening, landscaping, decoration, or customer requests. With repeatable contracts and randomized tasks, there is always a new garden waiting to be transformed.

Key Features:
• Mow lawns, trim hedges, and clean overgrown yards
• Plant flowers and grow vegetables in your greenhouse
• Paint fences, water plants, and restore outdoor spaces
• Decorate gardens with statues and decorative items
• Complete gardening jobs for residents around town
• Buy new seeds, tools, and outdoor decorations
• Upgrade and customize your own home garden

Garden Designer Simulator is perfect for players who enjoy cozy simulation games, relaxing outdoor activities, and creative garden customization.
70010000121138.intro: Turn forgotten gardens into cozy little paradises where every flower matters
70010000121138.name: Garden Designer Simulator

70010000121143.description:
Enter a war zone where history and modern combat collide. You are a highly trained soldier from the present, suddenly thrown into the middle of brutal medieval battles. Surrounded by knights, archers, and massive armies, you must rely on advanced weaponry, sharp instincts, and tactical thinking to survive. Outnumbered and in unfamiliar territory, every decision you make could mean the difference between victory and defeat.

Take on intense missions that push your combat skills to the limit. Secure strategic locations, withstand relentless enemy waves, and adapt your approach as the battlefield evolves. Precision, awareness, and smart positioning are just as important as the firepower in your hands.

Experience a unique blend of modern warfare and medieval chaos. Learn to control the pace of battle, use your environment to your advantage, and respond to constant threats from every direction. As challenges grow tougher, only those who think ahead and act decisively will make it through.

Key Features
● Step into the role of a modern soldier fighting in a medieval war environment
● Use advanced weapons like rifles, pistols, and grenades against traditional armies
● Complete tactical objectives by capturing and defending key areas
● Explore varied locations including castles, villages, forests, and open battlefields
● Face increasing difficulty with stronger enemies and more complex missions
● Discover a unique setting that merges modern combat with medieval warfare
● Engage in dynamic gameplay where positioning and timing are essential

Survive the impossible, dominate the battlefield, and rewrite the rules of war.
70010000121143.intro: Modern firepower. Medieval chaos. Survive the impossible.
70010000121143.name: Time Kings: Modern War in Medieval Age

70010000121152.description:
Veins of DARKNESS Horror is a first-person horror experience where you play as an ordinary shift worker sent on a routine business trip. Your company rents you a house on the outskirts of town — quiet, isolated, and seemingly perfect for a short stay. But soon it becomes clear that something about this place is deeply wrong.

The atmosphere grows heavier with every passing moment. The deeper you explore, the more unsettling secrets begin to surface.

Along the way, you will encounter a variety of challenging and unusual puzzles that must be solved to uncover the truth and move forward. Each discovery pulls you further into the mystery hidden within the house.

Prepare for an intense horror experience where every step feels uncertain and every new corner may reveal something you wish you had never found.
70010000121152.intro: The truth lives in the darkness...
70010000121152.name: Veins of DARKNESS Horror

70010000121165.description:
This is Number Match — a fast, addictive logic game where every move brings you closer to a perfect 10.

Match identical numbers or pairs that total 10. Clear the board. Rack up your score. Chase combos and set records as the pace builds and pressure rises.

It’s simple. It’s satisfying. And it’s just you versus the board… and everyone else.

With a dynamic leaderboard built into the experience, every match is a battle for the top spot. Whether you're chasing your first win or your next personal best, the race never ends. Pure puzzle gameplay meets arcade energy, designed for quick rounds and long sessions alike.
70010000121165.intro:
Match the numbers
Beat the high scores
Rule the global leaderboard
70010000121165.name: Match Quest: Numbers

70010000121181.description:
■ Real Shinkansen Photos on Every Card This game features 50 unique cards showcasing real photographs of Tokaido and Sanyo Shinkansen bullet trains. From the cutting-edge N700S to the classic 0 Series that started it all, and even the legendary Doctor Yellow Type 923 T4 — retired in 2025 — build your ultimate Shinkansen collection.

■ Pull Gacha to Collect Cards Spin the gacha to get new Shinkansen cards! Each train appears in multiple versions with different rarities and unique titles. Display your collection in your personal showcase and aim for 100% completion.

■ A Market That Moves This isn't just a gacha game. A full card trading market lets you buy and sell cards at fluctuating prices. Watch for sudden booms and crashes — sell high for a big profit, or swoop in during a crash to grab rare cards at a bargain.

■ The Gacha–Trade Loop Spend your trading profits on more gacha pulls. Some cards can only be purchased on the market after you've pulled them from the gacha at least once — so both gacha and trading are essential to complete your collection.

■ No Microtransactions There are absolutely no in-app purchases. Everything is earned through in-game currency. Buy the game and enjoy the full experience. Born from a passion to preserve these legendary trains in a game — whether you're a Shinkansen fan or a gacha enthusiast, there's something here for you.

Approved by Central Japan Railway Company / Approved by West Japan Railway Company
70010000121181.intro: Real Shinkansen bullet trains — now collectible cards! Pull gacha, trade on the market, ride the price swings. 50 cards featuring real Shinkansen photographs.
70010000121181.name: Shinkansen Card Pull Simulator

70010000121182.description:
A time-traveling RPG adventure from Masato Kato, creator of countless classic RPGs
Product Summary
Aldo embarks on an adventure beyond time and space to save his sister, Feinne, from the clutches of the beastfolk.

A richly woven tale by scenario writer and director, Masato Kato, unfolds across the ages, alongside a main theme composed by Yasunori Mitsuda, music incorporating traditional folk instruments and an orchestra by Procyon Studios, and a stellar voice cast.

The strategic command battles, which feature exhilarating actions like chain skills that trigger successive strikes, and Another Force that allows a barrage of attacks, can be fought with original parties composed from a total of 19 characters.

After clearing the main story, New Game+ offers a new adventure filled with new faces and over 10 different endings based on your actions and choices.

◆Strategic Command Battles
The lands of Another Eden are rife with monsters—run into them to initiate a command-based battle and take them down.
Create your own original parties, unleash chain skills, and create chains to trigger successive strikes!
Unleash a flurry of attacks with Another Force to beat your enemy into submission!

◆Befriend and Forge Meaningful Bonds with 18 Allies
18 allies of different races and eras await Aldo on his journey.
Allies' stories are told through various quests. Encounter quests depict their first meeting with Aldo, character quests reveal their past and purpose, and kinship quests explore their relationship with Aldo.

◆Embark on a New Adventure with New Game+
Complete the main story to unlock New Game+ and embark on a new adventure with your allies as they are!
New Game+ also introduces a brand-new character, Ramiu, and features over 10 different endings based on your actions and choices.

◆New Features to Enrich Your Time-Traveling Adventure
Enrich your adventure beyond time and space by logging the feline friends you encounter in the cat catalog, and creating weapons, armor, and food from different eras with the crafting feature.
70010000121182.intro: Now begins an RPG beyond time and space
70010000121182.name: Another Eden Begins

70010000121188.description:

Guide and support the players of your assigned school, strengthen your bonds, and strive for first place in the stall competition!

<Features>
- Experience a school life filled with romance, surrounded by many charming Princes.
- Enjoy sweet and bittersweet date events unique to each Prince!

70010000121203.description:
Start your engine and get ready to experience the thrill of street racing in over-the-top arcade style! Choose and customize your ride, navigate through traffic and push your driving skills to the limit as you compete in a wide variety of high-octane challenges. Nitro City Racing is a throwback to genre classics that puts the focus on speed, blending realistic physics with intuitive controls and accessible, endlessly replayable racing modes!

Pick a track and avoid obstacles to reach maximum velocity as you race to victory. Clear missions in Career mode, sprint from point to point in One-Way mode or enjoy the freedom of Free Ride, with additional modes to unlock as you progress. Track your mission stats and reward your skill with coins to spend on upgrades. Do you have what it takes to rule the streets?

• Put your skills to the test across a variety of racing modes!
• Choose your car and customize it.
• Navigate through traffic and dodge obstacles to maintain speed!
• Complete missions to earn coins and set new high scores.
• Enjoy high-quality 3D graphics and intuitive controls.
• Switch between in-car and external camera views!

This game and the content contained therein is not authorized by car manufacturers or motor racing competitions and there is no association thereof.
70010000121203.intro: Dodge traffic and maintain top speed on your mission to become the ultimate street racer!
70010000121203.name: Nitro City Racing

70010000121208.description:
Feeling lucky? Step into the Grand Vegas Casino and try your hand at 4 of the most popular gambling games in the world, with no need to get dressed up or risk your wallet! Grand Vegas Casino is a casual gambling simulation game for players of all skill levels, offering intuitive controls and a fluidly animated HD-2D graphic style to keep you immersed in luxurious high-rolling action.

Build your strategy, improve your skills, place daring bets and experiment to win. Featured casino games include Poker, Roulette, Blackjack and Slots, each with unique mechanics and standard rules that have made them timeless staples of the gambling scene. Play against computer-controlled opponents and unlock cool rewards as you progress! Are you ready to go all in?

• Play Poker, Blackjack, Roulette and Slots using standard casino rules!
• Experiment, strategize and easily restart if you run out of money.
• Collect rewards for defeating AI opponents!
• Enjoy crisp and colorful HD presentation in fluidly animated 2D style.
70010000121208.intro: Become a gambling master without the financial risk as you test your skills in the world's most popular casino games!
70010000121208.name: Grand Vegas Casino

70010000121223.description:
Take control of a combat helicopter and enter missions where every second matters. Support ground forces, eliminate threats, and complete objectives in fast-paced aerial operations.
Engage in intense missions across dynamic environments where threats come from every direction. Each situation pushes you to react quickly, manage resources, and adapt your strategy in real time.
Stay in constant motion while navigating compact, action-focused maps filled with enemies, hazards, and objectives. From urban conflict zones to military bases, every location tests your control and decision-making.
Use a mix of weapons and systems to handle different combat scenarios. Suppress enemies with your machine gun, launch rockets against heavy targets, and manage fuel and ammo carefully to stay operational.
A unique hook system lets you capture and transport objects, evacuate civilians, and complete mission objectives under pressure. Carrying cargo affects your maneuverability and increases risk, adding a strategic layer to every flight.

Key Features:

	•	Aerial Combat Gameplay: Fast-paced helicopter action
	•	 Mission Variety: Different types of objectives
	•	Weapon Systems: Core combat equipment
	•	Resource Management: Fuel and ammo matter
	•	 Hook Mechanic: Transport and rescue system
	•	Dynamic Maps: Designed for constant action
	•	Progressive Difficulty: Increasing challenge over time

Control the airspace, respond under pressure, and complete every mission with precision.
70010000121223.name: Helicopter Shooter - Hot Ace Heli War Borne

70010000121236.description:
Solve captivating puzzles featuring images of beautiful anime-style girls. With each image you complete, you'll unlock new ones, and the gradually increasing difficulty makes solving the puzzle a fascinating challenge. Intuitive touch controls create the feeling that you're actually touching every detail.

Soft and relaxing music will help you immerse yourself in the atmosphere, and after solving the puzzle, you can examine the image closely and admire every detail.

Features:

• Convenient one-handed play.
• Stylish anime images.
• Full immersion thanks to touch controls.
• Gradually increasing difficulty.
• Relaxing music.
70010000121236.intro: Relaxing puzzles with cute anime girls.
70010000121236.name: Triple Trouble: Midnight Club

70010000121263.description:
Set sail on a ruthless rogue-like pirate adventure where every voyage brings you closer to glory—or to the bottom of the sea. Long ago, you made a cursed deal with the legendary Davey Jones, and now he’s coming to claim your soul. With the clock ticking toward your final confrontation, you must raid ships, hunt treasure, build your crew, and become powerful enough to survive the battle waiting beyond the horizon.

Command your own pirate ship across a constantly changing ocean filled with enemy vessels, hidden treasure, mysterious encounters, and dangerous opportunities. Raid ships for resources, follow risky treasure maps, and make difficult choices that shape every voyage. No two runs are the same, with randomized events and encounters creating a fresh adventure every time you play.

Key Features
• Rogue-Like Pirate Runs: Every voyage is unique with random encounters and shifting challenges
• Ship Progression: Upgrade weapons, abilities, and crew to grow stronger over time
• Ocean Exploration: Sail through dangerous seas filled with treasure, enemies, and secrets
• Strategic Decisions: Every choice shapes your path, power, and survival chances
• Naval Combat: Fast, stylized ship battles inspired by pirate legends
• Time Pressure: Race against the clock as Davey Jones closes in on your soul

Raise the sails, gather your crew, and fight for your freedom before the sea claims you forever.
70010000121263.intro: Build a floating fortress capable of surviving the final storm.
70010000121263.name: High and Dry

70010000121269.description:
Wake up trapped inside a train with no memory of how you got there. Beyond the windows, endless darkness stretches across abandoned tracks while an unknown presence follows close behind. The fuel gauge keeps dropping, and every passing station may hold the supplies needed to survive — or something far worse.

Oni Station is a tense atmospheric horror experience set aboard a lonely moving train where fear, mystery, and survival collide. Travel through eerie stations, uncover fragments of the forgotten past, and face the constant pressure of something lurking just out of sight. The deeper you go, the more the truth begins to unravel.

Features:
	•	Dark atmospheric horror inspired by psychological tension and urban legends.
