Optimise and improvise - Chain kills, parries and get into the flow to earn Bolts and upgrade the War Hand, unlock firearms and blades and tailor loadouts to your playstyle.

Follow Jin’s missions through dynamic comic-panel cutscenes—sharp frames, cinematic pacing and a gritty tale of violence, corruption and fractured loyalties.

A rain-soaked pixel-art metropolis where Jin is ready to cross every line to save the girl.

Welcome to Kusan: City of Wolves, a brutal top-down shooter set in a neon-drenched urban jungle consumed by violence and corruption.

Kusan delivers hardcore action where one mistake means death. Master gunplay, perfect your movement, survive the streets and combat arenas ruled by furious kingpins that demand speed, precision and flawless execution. Every moment of action is intensified by Korean hip-hop heavyweight Loptimist’s adrenaline-fuelled soundtrack drenched with head-bopping loops and deep 808s pushing you forward without mercy.

You play as Jin, a skilled ex-soldier turned gun-for-hire, living in the heart of a city where the line between predator and prey has already been crossed. This isn’t just another job though, a mysterious girl with immense but uncontrollable power is linked to a violent conspiracy that threatens to shift the balance of power. As chaos erupts, Jin must save the girl, confront his past and the betrayal of a commander he once trusted without question.

Everyone in Kusan wants something and nobody plays fair.

For Jin, there is only one way forward: flawless planning, ruthless execution and saving the girl from criminals while relying only on his wit and unrelenting will to survive the battlefield.

With the whole city at stake, Jin knows it is time to not only clean-house but restore balance.

Features:

• Hardcore top-down combat with style

Brutal, precise gunplay where every move counts. Stylish play is rewarded as you dominate tightly designed arenas.

• 54 Hand-crafted Stages & Mastery

Fight through 54 intense stages across multiple chapters with skill-based puzzles, challenges and S-ranks for perfectionists—for lone wolves and high score chasers.

• Beastly Boss Battles

Face towering foes with distinctive mechanics and high-stakes patterns. Learn, adapt and execute to survive cinematic duels that push timing and tactics to the limit.

• War Hand & Arsenal

Optimise and improvise - Chain kills, parries and get into the flow to earn Bolts and upgrade the War Hand, unlock firearms and blades and tailor loadouts to your playstyle.

• Adrenaline-fuelled Soundtrack

An adrenaline-fuelled score from Korean hip-hop artist Loptimist serving heavy doses of energy.

• Graphic-Novel Storytelling

Follow Jin’s missions through dynamic comic-panel cutscenes—sharp frames, cinematic pacing and a gritty tale of violence, corruption and fractured loyalties.

• Neo-Noir Atmosphere

A rain-soaked pixel-art metropolis where Jin is ready to cross every line to save the girl.

Dive into Kusan: City of Wolves and descend into a city on the edge. It's more than just a fight, you are the last line between order and oblivion.
70010000122070.intro: Kusan: City of Wolves is a high-octane hardcore top-down shooter where players fight through a brutal urban jungle ruled by gunfire and corruption to save Haru
70010000122070.name: Kusan: City of Wolves

70010000122093.description:
An avian story of a bird and a chatty blade unfurls its feathers! Hidalgo Bladewing and his companions return to their favorite ramen spot following a perilous mission, only to be confronted by the vengeful void crow Omega Wing. Two years later, Hidalgo must rescue his fallen companions from the clutches of this ruthless old foe with the help of a chaotic, brash-talking sword.

Atomic Owl is a pixel art-based single-player, side-scrolling roguelike that combines fast-paced platforming with dynamic hack-and-slash combat and a variety of weapons, powerups and a demonic blade. Journey through 8 roguelite zones, save your friends and take up arms against Omega Wing!

This definitive version of the game includes a "NO ROGUELITE" mode to experience the game in classic side-scrolling style, plus enjoy rebalanced weapons, improved sound and more across all modes!

Features:

• Defeat hordes of menacing Tengu across 8 side-scrolling stages!
• Attempt runs, try again, get stronger and prevail in roguelike style.
• Choose from a wide variety of weapons, from swords and hammers to whips and more!
• Take flight in winged sections and enjoy the serenity of gliding through the world of Judanest.
• Enjoy dynamic dialogue with a voice-acted cast!
• Transform into the powerful Void Crow to wreak havoc on your enemies.
• Switch to non-roguelike mode to enjoy the game as a normal side-scroller!
70010000122093.intro: Take up arms against the evil Crow sorcerer who brainwashed your troupe!
70010000122093.name: Atomic Owl

70010000122094.description:
Ink Inside is a hand drawn adventure with beat-em-up meets dodgeball combat! When water seeps into a child's drawings, it warps their landscapes and turns once friendly doodles into mindless, soggy monsters. However - Play as Stick (Brian David Gilbert) an odd doodle in a kid’s notebook trying to discover who they are while fighting back against the "Sog" corrupting their world!

YOU can fight back against the invading “Sog” by hitting them in the face with dodgeball “CORES!” Hold and aim your attack before letting go at just the right time to trigger unique weapon “perks” - then get in close and knock the wet out of them with a melee
combo. Use more unique cores and combo attacks in action-packed dodgeball-meets-beat-em-up style combat that will see you dodging patterns of projectiles, using specials, and mastering a unique form of action RPG combat!
70010000122094.intro: Join the fun in a co-op action RPG with a Saturday morning cartoon vibe! Play as Stick, a doodle fighting the "Sog" corruption!
70010000122094.name: Ink Inside

70010000122143.description:
Get ready for the perfect dose of cuteness in Little Helper Cafe: Sugar Cubes. In this cozy Sokoban-style puzzle, a friendly hedgehog has a delicious mission: push sugar cubes into coffee cups on a dessert-filled tabletop.

But not everything is so simple. Holes on the board can disrupt the delivery, and that is where macarons come in, used strategically to plug paths and open new routes. Each level is a small logic challenge wrapped in a calm and cozy atmosphere.

With no time limit and no pressure, Little Helper Cafe: Sugar Cubes offers a relaxing, clear and irresistibly charming experience for players who love cute and clever puzzles. Observe, plan and help the little hero make every coffee a little sweeter.
70010000122143.name: Little Helper Cafe: Sugar Cubes

70010000122154.description:
Stranded in the middle of the endless ocean, you have nothing but a fragile raft, a rusty hook, and the determination to survive. With no land in sight and no help on the horizon, every day becomes a challenge. Gather whatever resources the sea provides, manage your supplies carefully, and find ways to stay alive in an environment where even the smallest mistake can have serious consequences.

The ocean is vast, unpredictable, and filled with both opportunities and dangers. Collect floating debris, expand your raft piece by piece, and transform it into a sturdy shelter capable of withstanding storms and defending against threats lurking beneath the waves. As you grow stronger, venture farther from your starting point to discover tropical islands, gather rare materials, and uncover secrets hidden across the endless sea.

Features:
• Build, repair, and expand your raft into a floating survival base
• Craft weapons, tools, and equipment to improve your chances of survival
• Explore tropical islands and search for valuable resources and hidden treasures
• Dive beneath the waves and discover the mysteries of the deep ocean
• Defend your raft against sharks and other dangerous sea creatures
• Gather resources, unlock upgrades, and grow stronger with every journey

Will you turn a few scattered planks into an unstoppable ocean fortress, or will the sea become your final challenge?
70010000122154.intro: Can you outsmart hungry sharks and conquer the dangers of the sea?
70010000122154.name: CASTAWAY SURVIVAL IN OCEAN - Build Your Own Raft, Craft

70010000122160.description:
Solve captivating puzzles featuring images of beautiful anime-style girls. With each image you complete, you'll unlock new ones, and the gradually increasing difficulty makes solving the puzzle a fascinating challenge. Intuitive touch controls create the feeling that you're actually touching every detail.

Soft and relaxing music will help you immerse yourself in the atmosphere, and after solving the puzzle, you can examine the image closely and admire every detail.

Features:

• Convenient one-handed play.
• Stylish anime images.
• Full immersion thanks to touch controls.
• Gradually increasing difficulty.
• Relaxing music.
70010000122160.intro: Relaxing puzzles with cute anime girls.
70010000122160.name: Hentai Panty: Intimate Album

70010000122166.description:
Create the workspace of your dreams in My Cozy Workspace - a relaxing simulator where creativity, comfort, and productivity come together. Design and customize rooms by placing furniture, organizing accessories, decorating shelves, and building a cozy atmosphere that feels uniquely yours.

Arrange desks, plants, books, lights, and dozens of decorative items while transforming small empty spaces into inspiring work, whether you prefer a minimalist office, a colorful creative studio, or a warm workspace corner.

Take your time, experiment with different layouts, and enjoy a calm and satisfying experience focused on creativity and relaxation.
70010000122166.intro: Build the workspace you’ve always dreamed of!
70010000122166.name: My Cozy Workspace

70010000122198.description:
One day, without warning, you become a ghost. You lived an honest life and committed no wrongs, so your soul should surely find peace… right? But the thought of being separated from the one you love is more terrifying than the abyss itself. If you can no longer stay by his side, then you must bring him with you before your soul passes on. Torn between love and obsession, you struggle against fate in this dark, emotional pixel-art visual novel about devotion, loss, and the desperate choices made in the afterlife.

Decollate Decoration is a pixel-style visual novel adventure with point-and-click and command selection gameplay. As a girl who has become a ghost, you must influence your beloved through conversations, poltergeist activity, dream visits, and even curses. Because he lacks spiritual awareness, direct communication is nearly impossible, requiring careful experimentation and strategic choices. The branching narrative features six different endings, with each playthrough lasting around 15 minutes. Additionally, the game features a prologue and epilogue side stories, a save function, an ending list, and unlockable bonus illustrations, encouraging replayability and full completion.
70010000122198.intro: A haunting adventure where love lingers beyond death!
70010000122198.name: Decollate Decoration

70010000122212.description:
From the hidden pages of Jurnal Risa comes a visual novel where the boundary between the living and the unseen begins to blur. Step into Jurnal Risa's world where each shadow holds a story, and every whisper leads you deeper into the unknown.

Witness the resurrection of the foretold nemesis of the Jurnal Risa crew, which was never revealed before. Unveil its dark destiny within this horror-adventure game.

This is the tale of Jurnal Risa, as recounted to me by Risa herself.

Key features

• A Paranormal Adventure Mystery

Jurnal Risa is known for exploring haunted places and sharing true ghost stories from Indonesia. Their adventures, bonds, and spiritual encounters inspire the game’s mystery and emotional depth.

• Brought to Life with Full Voice Acting

Fully voiced by the real members of the group, each scene feels authentic as it captures their unique personalities, real-life bonds, and the emotional weight behind every supernatural encounter.

• Mini games

Take a break from the tension with fun mini-games.

• Collect the Fragments of the Past

Gather collectible photos as you complete stories and challenges. Each photo unlocks a memory or reveals a hidden piece of the mystery.


Ready to turn the last page and face what lingers beyond?
70010000122212.intro: Witness the resurrection of the foretold nemesis of the Jurnal Risa family, which was never revealed before. Unveil its dark destiny within this horror-adventure game.
70010000122212.name: Jurnal Risa: Dark Destiny

70010000122240.description:
Underling Uprising is a new take on classic "brawlers". Enjoy Beat 'Em Up gameplay mixed with inspirations from those vibrant '90s cartoons. Fight across the world as the Underlings, a group of scientifically enhanced experiments, each with their own unique powers. You only have one mission at hand: Stop the mad scientist that created you!

MASTER FLUID COMBAT
Create new combos on the fly! Experiment with an open-ended combat system that offers limitless room for optimizing your attacks. Once your power bar is full, unleash devastating and flashy Supers to clear the screen!

RIDE COOL THINGS
Your fists may not be enough. Control a variety of strong mounts to pummel your foes! These will range from spacepods, mech-suits, and more!

FIGHT AS DIVERSE CHARACTERS
Learn each character's large moveset: Rose, Ángel, Deckster, and Boogie have unique playstyles and special story-related interactions. Master movements such as Super Armor, Hovering, Animation Cancels, and Double Jumping! Each playthrough will be a unique experience that can always be further perfected! And then, you can unlock secret underlings.

CHALLENGE BIG BOSSES
On your quest for vengeance, you'll have to overcome Bosses and Mini-Bosses that will challenge your skills in different ways!

FEATURES
• Up to 4-Player Local Co-Op and Versus Modes!
• Unique playstyle, moveset and specials for each character.
• Cartoon inspired designs and animations, with a killer OST.
• Explore 7 lengthy stages spanning the world (and even further)!
• Face multiple difficulties and huge bosses, for those seeking more challenge!
• Beat your high score in Arcade Mode!
• Pick up temporary weapons and vehicles to spice up combat!
70010000122240.intro: A modern Beat 'Em Up with inspirations from '90s cartoons. Take revenge on the mad scientist that created you!
70010000122240.name: Underling Uprising

70010000122319.description:
Story:
1981, Somewhere in Europe.

Eighteen-year-old Noah is haunted by the memory of his mother abandoning him as a child.
He lives with his father Leonard, a failed writer obsessed with collecting items related to “Dictator X.”
Noah wishes he would stop, but Leonard refuses to give up his strange obsession, even as they struggle financially.

One day, an auction invitation arrives, addressed to Leonard. Ignoring Noah’s protests, Leonard sets off for the old castle where the auction is to be held, promising to tell Noah everything once he returns.
But Leonard never comes home. With no way to contact him, Noah heads to the castle himself, determined to bring him home—only to witness something shocking.
Trapped inside the castle with the other guests, Noah decided to accept the Auctioneer's invitation, and take part in the auction himself.


Characters:
Noah Crawford (VA. Kengo Kawanishi)
Leonard Crawford (VA. Rikiya Koyama)
Edgar Schultz (VA. Daisuke Namikawa)
Christoph Treheim von Berg (VA. Nobunaga Shimazaki)
Otto Klein (VA. Shunsuke Takeuchi)
Karla Becker (VA. Maaya Uchida)
Lorraine Klopp (VA. Yui Ishikawa)
Hell (VA. Akira Ishida)
Auctioneer (VA. Show Hayami)

Game features:
- Explore freely within an old castle rendered in 3D
- Use reasoning and deduction to solve clues via the Word Cloud System
- Use memories to expose the truth via each Auction

In the exploration phase, you will search rooms and floors, and talk to other participants, revealing trauma and lies that will lead you to the truth each one keeps hidden.

Information you learn here will be stored in your Word Cloud, and can then be used to solve mysteries during each auction!

But in this place, the auction exhibits aren't bid on with money, but with memories.
Auction participants try to win their bids by offering their own memories, using a memory reconstruction device known as EPO.
But memories burdened by secrets or trauma can change completely, becoming distorted and incorrect.
If the participants offer incomplete memories, their auction bids will fail.

Noah must become their supporter, fixing each target's memory to ensure they are correct.
If the auction is a success, the truth will be revealed—unleashing the dramatic story behind each ill-fated auction exhibit.

Story / Script: Rika Suzuki
Character Design: KOHSKE
Music: Yuko Komiyama, Tsukasa Masuko
Director / Producer: Shinsuke Umeda

* This game is a story about young people learning about the past, and striving to protect a peaceful future. Although memories related to past wars feature in this game, it does not in any way, seek to glorify or promote the crimes of war.
70010000122319.intro:
The Auction of Dark Memories Begins Now.
What truths await beyond a bid made with your life?
70010000122319.name: Dark Auction - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000122325.description:
"RACK'EM UP" is a sports game released by KONAMI in 1987.
In this game, you can play pool (pocket billiards) with Nine-Ball or Rotation rules. A key feature of this game is the ability to check the positions of the cue ball and object balls on the 3D screen. The game appeals to a wide range of age groups.

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.
70010000122325.intro: Recreating the popular game of pool!
70010000122325.name: Arcade Archives RACK'EM UP

70010000122337.description:
Based on the popular webtoon! A special fantasy romance visual novel arrives, unfolding in a small modern city cafe with 'Kim Sam-wol,' a nine-tailed fox who has lived for 3,000 years. Why did she, who sought to become a deity by eating human livers, awaken as an ordinary human and work part-time at a cafe?

In-depth Narrative and Multiple Endings
A high-quality story where Korean mythology meets modern sensibilities. Depending on your choices, Sam-wol can become a deity, choose human love, or even disappear.

Lively Production and Voice Acting
Beyond simple images, 'Spine animation' and 'full voice' support for all characters except the protagonist provide an immersive experience as if watching an animation.

Heart-Touching Sound
The original OST, with participation from Shin Jun-ki, the bassist of the band 'BUZZ,' enriches the game's emotional depth.

Detective-Style Cafe Mini-Game
Find clues hidden in the conversations of customers and create the perfect drink. You can enjoy both cafe management and the fun of deduction at the same time.
70010000122337.intro:
Three thousand years, having consumed a thousand livers,
A nine-tailed fox awakens as a human, far from becoming a divine being.
70010000122337.name: CoffeeFox: Kim Samwol

70010000122359.description:
Explore the haunting, dreamlike fantasy world of BEFORE I GO, a punishing Metroidvania where you embody the innocence of an inner child on an allegorical odyssey towards death acceptance. The end is inevitable, but will you brave the journey?

The world is old and unwell. An ominous affliction has left every living soul weak, terrified and helpless before despair.
But this paralyzing infestation has left the innocence of a young child untainted.
Lost in limbo, an otherworldly journey awaits you. Find answers. Face your greatest fear. Confront reality.

BEFORE I GO depicts a contemplative reflection on existence and the transitory nature of life.
Lose yourself in this enigmatic tale. In adversity, find your way to deliverance and peace.

BEFORE I GO is a challenging side-scrolling action-platformer that distils the classic genre down to its most beloved aspects,
satisfying old-school platformer lovers and enthusiasts looking for fresh mechanics.

Key Features
 - Unconventional storytelling grounded in a genuine emotional tragedy.
 - Unique art style with a foreboding and melancholic atmosphere.
 - Explore a non-linear elaborate world; immerse yourself in a dreamlike universe.
 - Overcome meticulously crafted and intense platforming sections.
 - Withstand unforgiving parasitic abominations.
 - Assimilate powerful and dexterous abilities, sharpen your skills, and perfect the promptness of your actions.
 - Master intuitive, responsive, and diligently tuned controls.
70010000122359.intro: A punishing Metroidvania about death acceptance.
70010000122359.name: BEFORE I GO

70010000122365.description:
You hear scurrying in the ceiling. You hear scratching in the walls. Your house is infested with rats, and it’s your job to get rid of them. Catch rats with the help of your best friend, Lola, and uncover the supernatural mysteries behind their gatherings inside your new home.

I Hear Them is a first-person horror game where you team up with the family cat and try to clear the infestation of rats in your new home. Set in early 2008, explore an atmospheric house while unveiling supernatural secrets about the creatures running around in the walls.
70010000122365.intro: Uncover the mystery of where the rats keep coming from.
70010000122365.name: I Hear Them

70010000122406.description: Crypt Carnage is a fast-paced, wave-based retro FPS that drops you into cursed catacombs crawling with monsters, armored brutes, and nightmare bosses. Every round is a desperate scramble for ammo, upgrades, and breathing room as the horde tightens the circle and the arena turns into a killbox. Stack power-ups, swap to absurd weapons on the fly, and keep moving—because in the Crypt, standing still is a death sentence.
70010000122406.name: Crypt Carnage

70010000122412.description: Get ready for the ultimate downhill mountain biking experience in Crossbars, where speed, skill, and adventure collide. Set across four stunning, mountainous islands, Crossbars challenges you to ride through 20 thrilling tracks, each with its own unique terrain and environmental hazards. From rocky cliffs and forested trails to muddy paths and open hills, every track offers a new adventure—will you stick to the main path and race against the clock, or venture off-road and discover hidden secrets?
70010000122412.name: Crossbars

70010000122439.description:
Heaven has turned against her.

Waves of divine soldiers, mythological beasts, and rogue gods close in from every direction and they never stop coming.

You are Aphrodite, the most powerful and most hunted goddess in the Greek world, walking alone through ancient lands as the sky itself attacks you.

Pick up weapons. Evolve them. Destroy everything.

Every run is different. Weapons combine and transform into devastating divine tools. Arrows of desire become storms of golden light.

Shields of beauty become walls of destruction. The longer you survive, the stronger you become, until the screen fills with hundreds of enemies and your arsenal fills with chaos.

This is not a game you play once. This is a game you cannot stop playing.


Features:

● AUTO-ATTACK SURVIVAL GAMEPLAY: Focus on moving and positioning. Your weapons fire automatically. Your job is to survive long enough to become unstoppable.

● EVOLVE YOUR WEAPONS: Combine weapons and items to trigger powerful evolutions. Find the right synergies and watch your build go from mortal to divine.

● ENDLESS WAVES OF DIVINE ENEMIES: Gods, titans, mythological creatures, and heavenly armies. They keep coming. You keep fighting.

● GREEK MYTHOLOGY SETTING: Ancient landscapes, golden temples, divine ruins. Battle across the world of the gods as the one they could never defeat.


One more run. Just one more. That is what they all say.
Aphrodite does not die here.
70010000122439.intro:
Thousands of gods want her dead. She just wants to evolve her weapons.
Play as Aphrodite and survive the divine wrath of Olympus!
70010000122439.name: Aphrodite Evolve Weapons Survivor: Greek Gods Versus Heaven

70010000122452.description:
A woman, summoned by an eccentric man to participate in a project in an old hotel somewhere in central Europe, becomes embroiled in a game of illusions, increasingly dangerous and surreal.

Now you are invited to fall into the same rabbit hole, in a non-linear mystery with an immense amount of handcrafted puzzles, constantly presenting you with new riddles to solve, each leading you closer to deciphering the enigma of Lorelei and the Laser Eyes.
70010000122452.name: Lorelei and the Laser Eyes

70010000122464.description:
Challenge yourself in Driving Is Hard! Drive a bathtub on wheels through steep, unforgiving terrain where every mistake costs you progress. Master tough physics-based gameplay, sharpen your patience, and uncover Jeff’s journey of self-doubt, family struggles, and emotional growth as he finds strength, self-acceptance, and hope for a brighter future.


FEATURES

• Drive a Bathtub: Navigate Jeff in a physics-based bathtub on wheels

• Select Your Difficulty: Driving is Easy for a relaxing time with checkpoints, Driving is Hard - the original challenge, Driving is Insane for insane people.

• Explore 7 Worlds: Each with unique challenges and mechanics.

• Easy to Play, Hard to Master: Simple controls, challenging mechanics.

• Emotional Journey: Jeff faces his father’s expectations and finds his own path.

• Customizable Bathtub: Unlock and use different car skins.

• Collect Soaps: Find 21 soaps as you play.


WARNING!
This difficult game tests your patience - falling is part of the challenge. Will you rise or quit when it gets tough?
70010000122464.intro: Prove your skills by driving the Bathtub on Wheels! Solve puzzles, collect soap, and dive into Jeff's family drama. Drive, Fall, Learn, Repeat.
70010000122464.name: Driving is Hard

70010000122474.description:
Welcome to Death by Scrolling, an action game set in the chaotic depths of Purgatory, inc. now under new management! Choose your character—each with unique perks and abilities, and race upward through endless levels. Battle bizarre monsters, dodge death itself, and collect gems to pay the Ferryman’s exorbitant fee! With each screen inching upward, time is never on your side. Outsmart the Reaper, grab power-ups, complete quirky side quests, and shop from vendors mid-run. Stay alive, pay your dues, and maybe, just maybe, you'll cross that river.
Key Features
	- Varied Cast of Characters: Select from multiple playable characters, each offering distinct abilities and perks to suit your playstyle.
	- Vertically Scrolling Mayhem: Constant upward movement means no time to rest—let the fiery bottom of the screen catch you, and it’s game over.
	- Relentless Pursuit: The Reaper is always close by—stun, dodge, and outmaneuver, but never kill him!
	- Loot & Progression: Collect gold and precious gems to unlock upgrades, power-ups, and abilities from quirky vendors.
	- Bonus Runs & Side Quests: Discover extra challenges and side quests at the top of each level for extra rewards.
	- Monster Mash: Battle quirky underworld creatures, from hellish pests to demonic bosses, all in a wild vertical sprint.
	- Quirky Lore & Humor: A tongue-in-cheek take on afterlife bureaucracy, with cheeky dialogues and playful narration.
	- Leaderboards: See how your purgatorial performance stacks up against other trapped souls.
Choose your hero. Outsmart death. Outrun scrolling. Earn your passage. Are you ready to survive Purgatory, inc.?
70010000122474.intro: Death By Scrolling is an endless vertical arcade action game where the world won’t stop moving, the monsters won’t stop spawning, and the Reaper won’t stop chasing you.
70010000122474.name: Death by Scrolling

70010000122517.description:
[Story]
Kyuuhei Inui has never been one to take rumors as anything but that - rumors, until his best friend had died while playing the game...

Kyuuhei is driven to find out the truth behind his friend's mysterious death by any means possible.
After exhausting all ideas, he decided the only way to find out the truth is to play BAD END himself.

Will Kyuuhei risk his life to get to the bottom of the game's mystery or will he meet his demise?

[Features]
* Drastic short story that will branch according to your "choice".
* Surprising ending included!
70010000122517.intro: It's rumored that those who play 'BAD END'- a Visual Novel will die in REAL LIFE if they make the wrong decision in the game itself.
70010000122517.name: BAD END: If you play, you'll die?

70010000122518.description:
A new life begins in a village surrounded by beautiful streets and abundant nature.
The setting is a peaceful little village called “Fleune.”
In this village exists a form of “practical magic” that makes everyday living more convenient. Among its many arts is “Sewing Magic.” Inspired by her grandmother—who delighted everyone with the lovely dresses she created using this magic—the protagonist, Lilia, dreams of following in her footsteps.
One day, Lilia inherits her grandmother’s Sewing Magic and atelier, taking her first step toward becoming a dressmaker.
As she fulfills requests from the villagers, she sets her sights on becoming a legendary dressmaker.
Lilia’s journey of growth has only just begun.
‥‥‥‥
"Magical Craft - My Enchanted Dress Shop" is a simulation game where you can enjoy creating authentic and charming dresses—from gathering materials to crafting fabrics.
Players take on the role of Lilia, designing their own dresses while accepting requests to create outfits for the villagers.
Not only Lilia, but the villagers as well can be dressed up through completed requests, allowing you to color the entire village in your own unique style.
With gentle guidance and simple controls, even children can enjoy the game with confidence.
Why not spend your days in this calm and leisurely village, and tailor a one-of-a-kind dress that reflects your own personal touch?
70010000122518.intro: Blue skies, southern breezes, cats and cats—
70010000122518.name: Magical Craft - My Enchanted Dress Shop

70010000122549.description:
Step into a fun and chaotic adventure where you play as a mischievous dog exploring a lively world full of tasks, surprises, and challenges. Complete a variety of missions such as collecting items, interacting with objects, and reaching special locations to progress through exciting levels. Each stage offers new objectives and playful scenarios that test your curiosity and problem-solving skills.

Unlock new areas, overcome obstacles, and experience a lighthearted role-playing adventure designed for casual players of all ages. With clear goals, rewarding progression, and plenty of playful chaos, every level brings a new opportunity to explore, complete tasks, and become the ultimate trouble-making hero.
70010000122549.name: Dog Chaos

70010000122568.description:
Solve captivating puzzles featuring images of beautiful anime-style girls. With each image you complete, you'll unlock new ones, and the gradually increasing difficulty makes solving the puzzle a fascinating challenge. Intuitive touch controls create the feeling that you're actually touching every detail.

Soft and relaxing music will help you immerse yourself in the atmosphere, and after solving the puzzle, you can examine the image closely and admire every detail.

Features:

• Convenient one-handed play.
• Stylish anime images.
• Full immersion thanks to touch controls.
• Gradually increasing difficulty.
• Relaxing music.
70010000122568.intro: Relaxing puzzles with cute anime girls.
70010000122568.name: Hentai Protocol: Lesson One

70010000122574.description:
Solve captivating puzzles featuring images of beautiful anime-style girls. With each image you complete, you'll unlock new ones, and the gradually increasing difficulty makes solving the puzzle a fascinating challenge. Intuitive touch controls create the feeling that you're actually touching every detail.

Soft and relaxing music will help you immerse yourself in the atmosphere, and after solving the puzzle, you can examine the image closely and admire every detail.

Features:

• Convenient one-handed play.
• Stylish anime images.
• Full immersion thanks to touch controls.
• Gradually increasing difficulty.
• Relaxing music.
70010000122574.intro: Relaxing puzzles with cute anime girls.
70010000122574.name: Hentai Protocol: Lesson Two

70010000122592.description:
Solve captivating puzzles featuring images of beautiful anime-style girls. With each image you complete, you'll unlock new ones, and the gradually increasing difficulty makes solving the puzzle a fascinating challenge. Intuitive touch controls create the feeling that you're actually touching every detail.

Soft and relaxing music will help you immerse yourself in the atmosphere, and after solving the puzzle, you can examine the image closely and admire every detail.

Features:

• Convenient one-handed play.
• Stylish anime images.
• Full immersion thanks to touch controls.
• Gradually increasing difficulty.
• Relaxing music.
70010000122592.intro: Relaxing puzzles with cute anime girls.
70010000122592.name: Dirty Little Puzzle 2

70010000122621.description:
Connect Lines is a satisfying and relaxing puzzle game where your goal is to connect paths and fill the entire board to 100%.

Take your time, think ahead, and find the perfect way to complete each level. Whether you want a quick brain exercise or a longer relaxing session, Connect Lines offers the perfect balance of challenge and calm gameplay.

Game Features:

-Hundreds of engaging levels
-Clean and minimalistic design
-Smooth and intuitive controls
-Relaxing yet challenging puzzles
-Suitable for all ages

Can you connect all the lines and fill the board perfectly?
70010000122621.name: Connect Lines

70010000122644.description:
School, work, home—there are lots of places to play!
Enjoy the thrill as you try not to get caught!
Up to 6 players can join in the fun with a Joy-Con™ for each player!
Watch for the perfect timing to earn as many points as possible!

《Roles》
・Actor
  Play to earn points and try not to get caught!
  Play at a sparkling location to earn even more points!

・Watcher
  Find people playing to earn points!

[Time Attack]
Aim for the fastest clear possible and climb the rankings!
Play without getting caught and try to reduce your time!

[Battle]
Compete for the highest score against friends and CPUs!
Play skillfully to earn the most points!

[Online Mode]
Play in real time against players around the world!
Up to 4 people can play at a time!

In friendly and online matches, the roles are decided randomly!
Finding out which role you'll be is part of the fun!
70010000122644.intro:
Let's stir up some undercover chaos!
Slip past teachers, bosses, and parents, and play to your heart's content!
70010000122644.name: Sneaky Secret Mission!

70010000122656.description:
Let's go fishing on the Nintendo Switch™!
Travel to different world locations like North America, Europe, Africa, and the Amazon!
Each spot is home to lots of unique fish to discover!
Play solo, or compete with up to 4 players using one Joy-Con™ each!
Become the world's greatest angler!

[Score Attack]
Catch as many fish as you can within the time limit!
Look out for big fish to boost your score!

[Endless]
Sit back, relax, and enjoy endless fishing!
Watch the scenery shift from day to night!
Change your gear when the situation calls and search for big catches!

[Ranking]
Compete against players around the world in Score Attack and Endless modes!
Show off your skills by increasing your high score and rank!

[Battle]
Compete with up to 4 players for the highest score!
Face off against CPUs in single-player mode!

[Shop]
Spend the points you've earned from fishing to buy new lures and rods!
Discover the perfect combination for your fishing style!

[Records]
Every fish you catch will be added to your personal encyclopedia!
70010000122656.intro:
Embark on a fishing adventure around the world!
Cast your line and reel in fish from across the globe!
70010000122656.name: Reel it! World Fishing

70010000122663.description:
■ How to Play

Throw, Merge, and Grow!: Just drop the "Yukkuri" into the bowl! When two of the same kind touch, they transform into a larger Yukkuri!

Don't Let Them Fall!: It's Game Over if the Yukkuri overflow from the bowl...

Aim for the High Score!: Growing them large and triggering consecutive merges (Chains) will skyrocket your score!

■ Reimu & Marisa’s Live Commentary!

Reimu and Marisa chat away with game-style commentary based on your play!

Their lively banter and reactions make every match even more exciting!

■ Fully Customizable Features

30 Different Yukkuri!: Play the game, earn points, and head to the shop to unlock new Yukkuri.

Customize the Evolution Order!: You can swap the order of evolution! Set your favorite character as the largest size and create your very own "Yukkuri Mountain"!

■ Various Game Modes

Multiplayer: Supports local matches for up to 4 players! Enjoy a heart-pounding stacking battle together!

Rankings: Compete with players worldwide for the top score and prove you’re the ultimate Yukkuri master!
70010000122663.intro:
3D Puzzle: Take It Easy!!!
Touhou Project characters are here in their "Yukkuri" forms!
70010000122663.name: Touhou Yukkuri Mountain

70010000122669.description:
People gather memories as they live their lives, thus developing their souls. This is the story of a young woman traveling across a ruined continent to find the path toward the future.

The theme of this game is "memory." There are moments when everyone must confront the past and their own memories. All memories, including both successes and failures, become nourishment for the future and help shape people. "Atelier Yumia" tells the story of Yumia and her companions as they follow the path they believe in while being confronted by the memories they discover along the way.

Story:
In a world where alchemy is deemed "taboo," the alchemist Yumia yearns for the truth the lies hidden in a ruined continent. The time has come for her to take the first step on her grand adventure across the continent.

Main features:
- Freely traverse the vast open field in all directions
The continent is an unexplored land where the player can use a wide range of items and actions to forge their path forward.

- Game cycle
Explore the field and gather ingredients in order to synthesize items. The items you create are key to advancing the story and can be used for combat and further exploration. You can also use "Simple Synthesis" to create items while you are out in the field and construct bases using the "Building" feature.

- Create items while out in the field and customize bases however you like!
You can use Simple Synthesis to create exploration tools for opening the path forward, as well as items that will benefit you during combat and synthesis. You can also use the Building feature to construct bases and then decorate them with furniture to your liking.

Note: Please check the official "Atelier Yumia" site for details.
70010000122669.intro: Walk the forbidden path, no matter where it leads.
70010000122669.name: Atelier Yumia: The Alchemist of Memories & the Envisioned Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000122675.description: Join Shulk and his allies in this sprawling RPG classic. In the aftermath of a devastating invasion, embark on a journey that will take you beyond the horizon. Can you change the future, or is your race doomed to extinction?
70010000122675.intro: Uncover the secrets of the Monado and save the world
70010000122675.name: Xenoblade Chronicles: Definitive Edition – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000122694.description: Explore an endless ocean of clouds, where the last remnants of civilisation live on the backs of colossal beasts called Titans. Experience the story of Rex and Pyra, a mysterious being known as a Blade who grants him tremendous power.
70010000122694.intro: Journey to the birthplace of humanity
70010000122694.name: Xenoblade Chronicles 2 – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000122704.description:
A chase battle between Monsters and Humans! Round 2!
The new setting is Japan?!

You only have 3 minutes!
Run and hide. If even one person escapes, the Humans win!
If everyone is caught, the Monsters win!
Make use of the Monsters' special abilities to catch the Humans.
Up to 8 players can play together in Local or Online play.

Obakeidoro 2 is an asymmetrical multiplayer action game where players are split into Humans and Monsters to play chase and seek.
Aside from running and hiding, Humans can use their secret weapon, "Activate Lantern," to stun Monsters.
If used skillfully, you may be able to turn a crisis into an opportunity.
The key to winning for Monsters is through their powerful skills. Utilize unique Monster abilities, such as moving through walls or detecting footprints, to catch Humans.

◆ Work together with your friends using the new Human action, "Call"!
This newly added action enables you to call out to nearby allies.
When your allies respond, you can use cooperative actions such as "Solo Throw," "Two Person Jump," or "Bond Forger"!

◆ Round up everyone at once with the new Monster action, "Super Catch"!
Use this new action with improved range and visuals to capture the Humans!
70010000122704.intro:
"It's time to take on those monsters!"
Can you escape? Or will you hunt humans as a monster?
70010000122704.name: OBAKEIDORO 2: Chase & Seek

70010000122746.description:
The ultimate car dealership experience. Buy cars at auctions, restore them to their former glory, and sell them for a profit. Customize and expand your office to build the most prestigious car empire in the world!

- Build Your Showroom.
Start from a simple office and transform it into a world-class car dealership. Take full control of your office: expand its size, choose unique layouts, and customize every detail to reflect your personal style. Your office isn't just a workplace—it’s a symbol of your success.

- The Thrill of the Auction.
Travel to various auto auctions to find hidden gems and rare classics. Outbid your rivals and secure the best deals. Every car has a story, and it’s up to you to decide which ones are worth the investment.

- Restore to Perfection.
Get your hands dirty in the workshop. Repair mechanical issues and give each vehicle a fresh look. A well-restored car isn't just a machine—it’s a masterpiece that will attract the most elite buyers.

- Master the Market.
Buy low, sell high. Use your business intuition to negotiate with customers and maximize your profits. Manage your budget wisely to buy rarer cars and a grander office as you climb to the top of the industry.

- Your Empire, Your Rules.
In Car Sales Simulator 2026, you are the boss. Whether you prefer flipping quick city cars or collecting luxury exotics, the path to becoming the ultimate car mogul is entirely in your hands.
70010000122746.name: Car Sales Simulator 2026

70010000122753.description:
In a world where the undead have consumed the frontier, survival is the only law left. Step into the boots of a fearless bounty hunter and fight through waves of zombies across cursed towns, abandoned mines, and forgotten wilderness. Unlock powerful survivors, devastating weapons, and loyal companions as you carve your path through the apocalypse.

- Begin your journey as a lone gunslinger and unlock unique playable characters, each with their own abilities and playstyles.

- Create hundreds of powerful build combinations using a perk system that enhances weapons, triggers explosions, and unleashes elemental powers such as lightning, fire, and ice.

- Fight alongside loyal companions with unique abilities. Some pets strengthen your attacks and skills, while others bring powerful combat abilities of their own.

- Survive against massive zombie hordes, deadly elite enemies, and terrifying bosses that will challenge your reflexes, positioning, and strategy.

- Explore diverse locations ranging from abandoned western towns and graveyards to dark mines, cursed forests, and forgotten frontier outposts. Every location introduces new dangers, secrets, and gameplay opportunities.

- Wield a massive arsenal of weapons, from classic revolvers and lever-action rifles to experimental creations like Tesla gun and explosive heavy weaponry.

- Gather resources and experience during every run to upgrade your characters, pets, weapons, and abilities, allowing you to take on increasingly dangerous enemies.

- Immerse yourself in stylized visuals and a soundtrack inspired by the brutal atmosphere of a zombie-infested Wild West.

- Complete missions to unlock locations and gameplay modifiers.
70010000122753.intro: Survive the frontier. Hunt the undead.
70010000122753.name: Wild West Survivors

70010000122759.description:
Take the wheel and put your driving precision to the test in an engaging parking experience designed for drivers of all skill levels.

Complete a variety of parking challenges, earn rewards, and improve your skills as you tackle increasingly demanding objectives. Whether you're aiming for perfect performance, competing against the clock, or simply enjoying a relaxing drive, there's always a new challenge waiting behind the wheel.

Unlock a diverse collection of vehicles, expand your garage, and customize your favorite cars to match your personal style. From everyday vehicles to powerful machines, each car offers a unique driving experience as you work your way toward becoming a true parking master.

With different gameplay modes, rewarding progression, vehicle customization, and plenty of opportunities to earn and upgrade, every session offers a fresh reason to get back on the road.
70010000122759.name: Car Parking Simulator 2026

70010000122767.description:
Dive into an irresistible chase in Honey Sprint, where a hungry bear must escape a furious swarm while collecting as much honey as possible along the way. With simple controls and nonstop action, each run blends quick reflexes, smart decisions, and pure fun.

Dodge obstacles, slide under branches, and jump at the right moment to keep your flow while chasing ever-higher scores. The tracks change with every attempt, always bringing fresh challenges and that addictive “just one more run” feeling.

Colorful, dynamic, and full of personality, Honey Sprint is perfect for quick sessions and lighthearted moments, delivering an engaging experience that balances challenge and pure entertainment.
70010000122767.intro: Run, Jump, and Devour All the Honey
70010000122767.name: Honey Sprint

70010000122773.description:
Get ready for a radiant journey in Golem Lights, an engaging puzzle where every beam of light can change everything. Take control of the Mage Golem and use its energy to illuminate the path, awaken other golems, and create luminous connections until you reach the mysterious Crystal Portal.

With 60 levels spread across three enchanting biomes, from the cave’s edge to the crystal core, each challenge invites you to experiment, adjust, and discover new solutions. With no time limits, the experience is relaxed yet strategic, perfect for players who enjoy thinking calmly and testing different possibilities.

Watch as light gradually reveals the environment, activate golems with unique abilities, and manipulate the surroundings to expand your illumination. Each stage is a small puzzle of logic and creativity, where planning and curiosity go hand in hand.

Explore, experiment, and let your light guide the way to victory.
70010000122773.intro: Light the Path, Awaken the Golems
70010000122773.name: Golem Lights

70010000122779.description:
Get ready for an action-packed adventure in Noodlebound, a 2D pixel art platformer that combines precise movement with direct and dynamic combat. Take on the role of a ramen samurai on a journey to recover ingredients that have come to life due to a mage’s magic, facing enemies, traps, and bosses across 30 stages full of personality.

With abilities such as jumping, dashing, and close-range attacks, every challenge demands quick reflexes and sharp decisions. The levels are intense and engaging, perfect for players who enjoy fast-paced action, challenging combat, and charismatic characters.

Explore environments filled with danger, face enemies with unique behaviors, and prove your skill in epic boss battles. In every stage, you will need to observe patterns, act with precision, and master your abilities to progress.

Sharpen your blade, keep the rhythm, and fight to restore the balance of flavors.
70010000122779.intro: Slice, Dash, and Recover the Lost Flavor
70010000122779.name: Noodlebound

70010000122785.description:
The Confinement is an FP4 (First Person Paced Precision Platformer) that combines speed, precision, and reflexes in an extremely challenging parkour experience. You are trapped in a simulation created by the artificial intelligence AmokAI, where every move could be your last.

Run, dodge, jump, and dash as you navigate narrow corridors, suspended platforms, and deadly traps in a hostile, technological environment. Each level is designed to test your skill, your quick reading of the scenario, and your ability to improvise under pressure.

With around 30 to 40 short and intense stages, each stage encourages constant improvement, challenging you to beat your own times and compete with other players. The combination of fluid movement, intense challenges, and striking surroundings makes The Confinement an ideal experience for those seeking fast action, extreme precision, and high replay value.
70010000122785.intro: The Confinement is a game that puts your skills to the test. Master precise movements, strategic dashes, and challenging courses.
70010000122785.name: The Confinement

70010000122799.description:
"ARMADILLO RACING" is a racing game released by NAMCO LIMITED (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1997.
Control an armadillo that rolls as it picks up speed, and head for the finish line through obstacle courses filled with unique events, or sprint courses designed for pure racing enjoyment. Finish in 1st place and you can enjoy a fun bonus game, too!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.
70010000122799.intro: Never Seen Before?! An Active Racing Game!
70010000122799.name: Arcade Archives ARMADILLO RACING

70010000122822.description:
Get ready to use your ears! Time your button presses to the beat in this broad collection of rhythm games that are easy to learn and rewarding to master. Catch flying veggies, bounce fruit off your biceps, swing sledgehammers, and more as you focus on catchy original music—including tracks by renowned Japanese musician Tsunku♂.

Boost frogs into the air, flap umbrellas, and so much more in over 80 rhythm games—and that’s just solo mode!

Cooperate and compete in over 30 rhythm games for up to four players

Gather up to four players* around a single system to slice arrows, pluck hair from onions, and more. Whether you’re striving to see who can be first to snatch the cake, or teaming up to save the prince with the power of tennis, these games are sure to test your ability to keep the beat.

Become a magician and use the power of rhythm to beat monsters in Beatspell

As you progress in the game, you'll gradually unlock Beatspell—a mode in which you combat monsters with rhythm-based spells, like fire and healing, by tapping buttons to the beat. What spells will strike a chord when you face down your foes?
70010000122822.intro: Tune in and groove to a variety of games that will challenge your rhythm
70010000122822.name: Rhythm Heaven™ Groove

70010000122844.description:
Driftcraft drops you into a colorful, fully explorable sandbox where the only limits are your imagination and your fuel tank.

Crash through the environment to harvest resources. Use what you collect to build, expand, and customize your world the way you want it. It's part racing game, part survival, part creative playground — and it's all yours.

CHOOSE YOUR MACHINE
From drift-tuned FR legends to mud-caked off-roaders, from towering trucks to razor-sharp supercars — Driftcraft gives you a massive, ever-growing vehicle roster with near-infinite customization. Every machine can be made uniquely yours. Find your style and push it to the limit.

SMASH. COLLECT. BUILD.
Resources don't spawn in menus — you earn them by driving. Ram into objects scattered across the world, collect what falls, and put it to work. Manage your stockpile, explore hidden corners of the map, and build a world that reflects how you play.

A WORLD WORTH EXPLORING
Driftcraft's cartoon-style open world is packed with secrets, terrain variety, and places that reward curiosity. Whether you're pulling stunts on a mountain ridge or discovering hidden resource caches in forgotten valleys — there's always something new just over the horizon.

YOUR RIDE. YOUR WORLD.
No multiplayer lobbies. No waiting. Just you, a ridiculous amount of vehicles, and a sandbox that grows as you do. Driftcraft is the solo experience that gives you total creative freedom — build big, drive fast, and leave your mark on every corner of the map.

Download now and start building the world you actually want to drive through.
70010000122844.intro: Build your perfect vehicle from endless combinations, tear through a vibrant open world, smash objects to gather resources, and craft a world that's entirely your own.
70010000122844.name: DRIFTCRAFT

70010000122853.description: DEEP ROCK GALACTIC: SURVIVOR is a single player survivor-like auto-shooter. Take on hordes of lethal aliens, mine riches, and unlock powerful upgrades to survive, as you wield the full arsenal of Deep Rock Galactic. It's one dwarf against all of Planet Hoxxes!
70010000122853.name: Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor

70010000122874.description:
Step into the cinematic world of Planet of Lana with the Supporter Pack, a heartfelt collection celebrating creativity, care, and imagination and inviting fans to walk a little closer beside Lana and Mui.

Inside, you’ll discover:

Digital Art Book
Explore the evolution of the game’s painterly world, from lush forests and tropical reefs to snowy peaks and makeshift cities, alongside characters, creatures, locations, in-game scenes, and concept art.

Language Companion
Discover the game’s fictional language, learn basic phrases, gain insight into select dialogue while diving deeper into the lore of Novo.

Thank you for helping us bring this hand-painted world to life.
70010000122874.intro: Go Deeper into the World of Planet of Lana.
70010000122874.name: Planet of Lana II - Supporter Pack

70010000122880.description:
Become the ultimate ruler of the range in Archery King — a fantasy archery game where precision, focus, and timing lead to victory. Travel through beautiful forest paths, ancient ruins, and medieval-inspired training grounds as you take on increasingly challenging target layouts.

Test your aim across a variety of levels filled with moving targets, tricky angles, and rewarding bullseyes. Each shot matters, so steady your hand, draw your bow, and prove your skills in a world built for true archery masters.

With satisfying gameplay, immersive environments, and a classic medieval atmosphere, Archery King delivers a fun and addictive experience for players who love target shooting games and skill-based challenges.
70010000122880.name: Archery King

70010000122886.description:
Criminal Hearts puts you on rooftops at 3am, in back rooms where deals go sideways, and across the table from three women who should scare you.

They don't.

One of them doesn't talk. One of them talks too much. One tells you exactly what she is and dares you to stay anyway.

Every line you choose either pulls her closer or shuts the door for good. Your companion has your back and tells you the truth, but the risk is yours to take.

Say the right thing and she lets something slip she's never told anyone. Push too hard and she's gone before you can fix it.

Three women. Three ways this ends. None of them planned on you.


Features:

● ONE WRONG WORD CHANGES EVERYTHING: Trust here is earned slowly and lost instantly.

● THREE WOMEN WORTH THE RISK: Each one guards something different, and none of them hand it over.

● DARK ROMANCE VISUAL NOVEL: Cinematic, heavy, and built on choices that stick.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Redemption, ruin, or something a lot closer to obsession.

● A COMPANION IN YOUR CORNER: Reads the room, calls you out, never lies to you.


Three women nobody has ever gotten close to.
You're not here to be careful.
Get close.
70010000122886.intro:
Some women come with a warning.
You've never been good at listening.
70010000122886.name: Criminal Hearts: Obsession Bad Girls Dating Sim

70010000122892.description:
Criminal Hearts puts you on rooftops at 3am, in back rooms where deals go sideways, and across the table from three men who should scare you.

They don't.

One of them doesn't talk. One of them talks too much. One tells you exactly what he is and dares you to stay anyway.

Every line you choose either pulls him closer or shuts the door for good. Your companion has your back and tells you the truth, but the risk is yours to take.

Say the right thing and he lets something slip he's never told anyone. Push too hard and he's gone before you can fix it.

Three men. Three ways this ends. None of them planned on you.


Features:

● ONE WRONG WORD CHANGES EVERYTHING: Trust here is earned slowly and lost instantly.

● THREE MEN WORTH THE RISK: Each one guards something different, and none of them hand it over.

● DARK ROMANCE VISUAL NOVEL: Cinematic, heavy, and built on choices that stick.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Redemption, ruin, or something a lot closer to obsession.

● A COMPANION IN YOUR CORNER: Reads the room, calls you out, never lies to you.


Three men nobody has ever gotten close to.

You're not here to be careful.

Get close.
70010000122892.intro:
Some men come with a warning.
You've never been good at listening.
70010000122892.name: Criminal Hearts: Obsession Bad Boys Dating Sim

70010000122904.description:
Meet Dan. Dan has a sniper rifle. Don’t panic, he’s not here to harm anyone. Dan’s a professional and his job is fixing things. From a distance. With pinpoint accuracy and good intentions.

Sniper Dan is a hidden object game unlike any other. Objects aren't always well hidden and the solution involves shooting them. Each job follows a simple and highly respected method.

Figure out the problem. Use the clues. HMM…

Find the problem. Scope the area. AHA!

Fix the problem. Shoot. WHEE!

You’re not hunting enemies. You’re hunting problems. Fixing rusty taps, machines behaving badly and even stop a thieving Pelican. Travel far and wide across lively 3D locations packed with visual jokes and silly situations as you help those in need. Can Dan and his trusty tool get the job done?
Dan’s business takes him to villages, parks, farms, airports, cities and beyond. Special challenges keep every day fresh. Take on optional work for extra cash, tackle bigger jobs for even bigger rewards and uncover secrets that leave citizens quietly convinced something magical just happened.
It did. It was Dan!

Between contracts, upgrade your rifle, decorate your office hub and grow your entirely legitimate troubleshooting business. Unlock bonus games and extra modes like Time Attack, Ammo Hunt and Photo Mode, all under the judgmental eye of Rank Chook.

Funny, colourful and sure to leave you wanting more, Sniper Dan is about finding what’s wrong, fixing it fast and moving on to the next job.

Scope the problem. Take the shot. Make everyone happy.
70010000122904.intro: A ridiculous, family-friendly 3D Hidden Object game with a big twist.
70010000122904.name: Sniper Dan

70010000122914.description:
New stories by author Susan Shepard recount the times of the construction of the Stronghold of Five Worlds.

“Lost Lands: Stories about the Sorceress, the Prince and the Minotaur” is an adventure game in the Hidden Objects genre, with plenty of mini-games and puzzles, unforgettable characters, and complicated quests.

Susan Shepard opens the book of stories once again! This time, you will embark on a journey with three new characters. Together, you will explore a new corner of the Lost Lands, lying between the legendary tower and an ancient city that once stood nearby. In these different yet intertwined stories, the heroes confront the value of friendship, the sense of justice and injustice, the impact of their decisions, the thirst for victory, and the pursuit of freedom.
This journey reveals that the Lost Lands are endless, full of uncharted corners, fascinating events, and vivid heroes!

- Discover the new charismatic heroes of this world!
- Learn about the stories of the past that shaped the events of the earlier parts of the saga!
- Battles, thrill, and risky adventures — explore the world of the Lost Lands from a new perspective!
- Who entered the Lost Lands long before Susan? Meet the firstcomer!
- Take part in the great race for a priceless prize — your own freedom!
70010000122914.intro: The great deeds of little heroes.
70010000122914.name: Lost Lands: Stories about the Sorceress, the Prince and the Minotaur

70010000122930.description:
Features:
【Photography】
Use your old analog camera to capture the perfect shot through framing, timing, exposure, focus, and filters. Photography in this game reflects how closely you look at the world. Take in your surroundings, understand the desires of each spirit you meet, and uncover the world's secrets through your lens.

【Sacred Firebowl】
These shrines bearing aperture symbols connect different worlds and hold the secrets of the Dusklands. Figure out and capture the photos each fire demands to receive items and upgrades for your camera.

【A Mysterious Companion】
The girl you meet in the Dusklands has no memory, only a faint sense that she must reach the distant Dusk Mountain. Together you'll journey through this strange land, but why is she even here? And can you bring her home?

【Wistful Magical Realism】
This world mirrors reality yet bears no trace of humanity, only spirits in the form of animals call this place home. Through careful observation, you'll uncover the reason humans no longer exist, and the realm's true purpose.

【Dusklands Field Notes】
A mysterious journal filled with photos and stories from the Dusklands' past. Photograph clues along your journey and add them to the journal to identify spirits, piece together myths, and decode ancient runes, as you unravel the hidden mysteries of this world.

【Spiritual Bonds】
The spirits you encounter throughout the game may grow closer to you depending on your choices, quietly shaping what awaits at your destination.
70010000122930.intro: Capture the moment, then learn to let go.
70010000122930.name: OPUS: Prism Peak

70010000122961.description:
MONOWAVE is a puzzle adventure game following the journey of Mono, a newborn Guardian spirit destined to protect the four Emotions: Happiness,Sorrow,Anger and Anxiety.

Everything changed, when the Emotion Shards within the Prism suddenly vanished, scattering the Emotions across the land. It’s up to the newborn Guardian, Mono, to reunite the wayward Emotions and restore harmony to the land.

4 Unique Emotions & Powers
As the guardian spirit of Emotions, you’ll be able to harness special powers based on anxiety, anger, sorrow, and happiness.

■Happiness: Jump to reach new heights. Nothing can stop your glee!
■Sorrow: Dive underwater and flow through subterranean passageways to reach unexplored depths.
■Anger: Wall-jump with the power of your fury to pave a path forward.
■Anxiety: Evade potential threats and navigate difficult terrain with your heightened senses.
70010000122961.intro:
An adventure where no one gets hurt begins now...
Explore the world and restore lost peace!
70010000122961.name: MONOWAVE

70010000122975.description:
Seat diverse guests and serve drinks while balancing unique customer types.
Keep the peace by choosing seats wisely and surviving wild weather disasters.
Handle quirky characters and upgrade your venue to keep the party going.
Team up or go solo to master the art of hectic, high-energy management!
70010000122975.intro: Manage the chaos and build the ultimate party venue with up to 4 players!
70010000122975.name: Party Club

70010000122983.description:
[Story]
A small fire warrior with no memories goes on a journey to find the King—the only hope to save the world.

Solateria, the land of the Sun, once prospered under the Primordial Flame’s blessings.
But everything changed when the Shadow Plague—the most deadly catastrophe it ever faced—descended, pushing Solateria to the brink of ruin.
You wake up as a small fire warrior with no memories of the past. The only thing you can recall is a voice urging you to find the vanished King and save the world.

Defeat powerful bosses corrupted by the Shadow Plague through stylish, parry-focused combat, and begin your journey to find the King.
In the end, you will have to confront the truth.

[Game Features]
■ Stylish Parry-Focused Combat
Master enemy attack patterns and parry with perfect timing. Experience Solateria’s exhilarating combat flow, where parries lead straight into powerful counterattacks.

■ Tense Battles Against Formidable Enemies
Break through bosses infected by the Shadow Plague with precise parries and stylish action. They won’t go down easily—but victory brings a deep sense of accomplishment.
Absorb the King’s power at King Statues scattered throughout Solateria to grow stronger. Unlock Heat Cores with rare items to unleash the fire warrior’s true power. Acquire new skills and enjoy increasingly spectacular combat.

■ Deep Customization Through Upgrades
Enhance your Core Stones and equip various Parts to shape your own combat style. Parts can create powerful synergies when combined in specific ways.

■ Untold Stories in a Fallen World
In Solateria, brought to ruin by the Shadow Plague, countless beings fight their own battles for their own reasons—even those who have become infected bosses. Battle powerful bosses, meet new NPCs, and uncover the stories they’ve kept hidden. Complete side quests and witness their final choices.

■ Active Interaction and Information Gathering
Explore the world of Solateria and gather “information” in many ways—collect fragments of memory, talk to NPCs, and more. The more thoroughly you explore, the more helpful information you’ll uncover, and what you learn will be marked on the map. Of course, how you explore Solateria is entirely up to you.

■ A Beautiful Hand-Drawn World Map
Immerse yourself in a beautifully crafted world of hand-drawn art. Use various skills to find hidden elements and create shortcuts. Maybe you’ll recover your lost memories while exploring this shadowed world.


- Choose your build with 40 different Parts combinations
- Multiple upgrade systems, including cooking, refining, and crafting
- Over 50 beautiful story cutscenes
- Unique and powerful bosses and mini-bosses
- Hidden locations reached through skill combinations
- A vast world you can explore freely in any order
- The story of a small fire warrior setting out to find the King—the only hope to save a fallen world
70010000122983.intro: Solateria is an action Metroidvania featuring beautiful hand-drawn art and a focus on parry-based combat.
70010000122983.name: Solateria

70010000123013.description:
Explore the dark marine abysses in AquaDream, a captivating puzzle game. Take on the role of a brave anglerfish and solve complex puzzles in the heart of underwater labyrinths. Find hidden keys, activate towers to open new passages, and follow ocean currents precisely to avoid deadly traps.

But that's not all! Collect a variety of rare shells scattered throughout the levels to complete your personal collection. Each shell collected brings you one step closer to becoming the master of the depths.

Are you ready to take on the challenge and uncover the hidden secrets of the marine depths?
70010000123013.name: AquaDream

70010000123019.description: Robo Hop is a fast-paced 3D platformer where you control a brave little robot exploring vibrant worlds filled with lava pits, floating islands, and tricky obstacles. Jump, dodge, and collect glowing gears while battling hovering enemies and mastering precise platforming challenges. Every level tests your timing, reflexes, and curiosity as you hop your way to victory.
70010000123019.name: Robo Hop

70010000123026.description:
Unpack your perfect life in this cozy, hygge-inspired home simulator.
Design the apartment of your dreams in a relaxing and meditative experience focused on creativity, comfort, and personal expression.

Create a unique home with two layers, decorate each room to match your mood, and even design your garden or outdoor area. Arrange furniture, experiment with color combinations, and customize the atmosphere outside your window with changing light and weather.

Whether you’re crafting a minimalistic loft, a soft Scandinavian bedroom, or a mysterious mage’s basement, this is your space to shape freely.

Features:
	•	A calm and cozy simulator inspired by hygge living
	•	Unpack and place furniture with intuitive controls
	•	Customize walls, floors, lighting, and window views
	•	Design indoor and outdoor spaces, including gardens
	•	Create multi-layer homes with vertical layouts
	•	Complete relaxing design quests with unique themes
	•	Enjoy a peaceful and stress-free environment

In a chaotic world, your hygge room is your shelter.
70010000123026.name: Comfy Corners: Unpack and Decorate

70010000123044.description:
Dig Your Way to Freedom

Trapped behind bars, you have only one chance to escape: dig a secret tunnel beneath your prison cell and reach freedom before the guards discover your plan.

Every day is a careful balancing act. Dig deeper into the ground, hide the tunnel entrance under your cell's carpet, and keep an eye on guard patrols. One mistake is all it takes to get caught, lose progress, and start over.

As you excavate the tunnel, you'll uncover valuable items buried underground. Trade them with the prison cook for soap—the prison's underground currency—and invest in powerful upgrades. Buy better tools to dig faster, increase your carrying capacity, and expand your pockets to secretly transport more dirt.

Managing the excavated soil is just as important as digging. Sneak outside and dispose of it before anyone becomes suspicious. The deeper your tunnel grows, the more careful you'll need to be.

With every upgrade, every successful digging session, and every close call with the guards, you'll move one step closer to freedom.

Can you outsmart the prison, complete the tunnel, and make your escape?

Features:
	•	Dig a secret tunnel beneath your prison cell.
	•	Avoid guard inspections and stay hidden.
	•	Discover valuable items while excavating.
	•	Trade found items for soap, the prison currency.
	•	Upgrade tools, inventory space, and carrying capacity.
	•	Dispose of dirt without raising suspicion.
	•	Interact with prison NPCs.
	•	Take a break with a fun basketball minigame.
	•	Unlock the final escape and earn your freedom.

The tunnel won't dig itself. Start digging.
70010000123044.intro: Can you dig a secret tunnel before the guards discover your plan?
70010000123044.name: Prison Escape Simulator 2026

70010000123079.description:
Five Elements Chess is a spell-duel game that combines the Five Elements theory and match-three gameplay.

Features
• Simple rules, deep strategy
• Calm, Zen-inspired visual style
• A balance of strategy and luck that anyone can enjoy
• Local and online PvP
70010000123079.name: Five Elements Chess

70010000123085.description:
◆Synopsis
“If you do not wake up... I will play a little prank on you.”

As being the only son of a noble family in the kingdom,
the personal maid you have hired was your childhood friend Rica Hanamiya.

Having Rica by your side everyday, at every moment,
she teases you nonstop, and your heart would not stop racing!
Hoping that this life would go on forever.

But--

One remark from your father shakes both of your hearts.
Can the two with a different status share the same fate--

◆Characters
Rica Hanamiya（CV：Rica Hanamiya）
Your childhood friend who became your personal maid.
She is diligent and professional on duty, but changes when it is just the two of you.
She loves teasing you and enjoys watching you be nervous.
Maid and a master, also a childhood friend--
Caught between those position, what does she truly feel?

○Novel Game Brand "Rabbitfoot”
A novel game brand that delivers novel games casting active YouTubers and VTubers as game characters.
As well as using their names and nicknames, you can enjoy the different sides of your faves and feel a close connection through the novel game that you cannot experience in the usual streaming or video uploads.
70010000123085.intro: A visual novel with ASMR starring the VTuber Rica Hanamiya.
70010000123085.name: Rica Mode♡

70010000123106.description:
Pirate Havoc is a fast-paced action shooter set in a chaotic, sun-soaked pirate world where danger lurks around every corner. Step into the boots of a ruthless pirate and fight your way through lively ports, narrow streets, and explosive battlegrounds. Use classic flintlock weapons, outmaneuver your enemies, and unleash pure havoc in intense combat encounters.
Explore vibrant environments inspired by Caribbean towns, engage in thrilling gunfights, and dominate your foes with skill and precision. Whether you're ambushing enemies in tight alleys or battling in open plazas, every moment is packed with action, strategy, and destruction.
Do you have what it takes to rule the seas and become the most feared pirate of all?
70010000123106.intro: Unleash Chaos on the High Seas
70010000123106.name: Pirate Havoc

70010000123119.description:
Get behind the wheel and begin your journey toward becoming a skilled driver. Every road presents a new challenge as you navigate busy city streets, follow traffic laws, and complete realistic driving lessons. Stay alert at intersections, watch surrounding traffic, and reach your destination safely while avoiding accidents and respecting speed limits.

Driving School Simulator is a realistic driving experience where learning, progression, and vehicle customization come together. Complete nearly 100 unique routes across a lively city, master different driving situations, and improve your skills behind the wheel. Earn rewards for safe driving, unlock new vehicles, and build your collection as you advance through increasingly challenging lessons.

Features:
	•	Nearly 100 unique driving routes with varied objectives and road layouts.
	•	Realistic city traffic featuring intersections, road signs, and everyday driving situations.
	•	Performance ratings based on safe driving, rule compliance, and route completion.
	•	Garage and vehicle shop with multiple cars to unlock using in-game currency.
	•	Vehicle customization with colors, wheels, spoilers, vinyls, and other cosmetic options.
	•	Upgrade system that improves your cars and enhances the driving experience.


Can you master every lesson and earn the highest driving ratings? Explore the city, unlock your favorite vehicles, customize your collection, and prove your skills in Driving School Simulator.
70010000123119.intro: Can you master every road and every challenge?
70010000123119.name: Driving School Sim
70010000123119.publisher: Lu Ming trading as Shane Game

70010000123164.description:
Sayonara Wild Hearts is a dreamy arcade game about riding motorcycles, skateboarding, dance battling, shooting lasers, wielding swords, and breaking hearts at 200 mph.

As the heart of a young woman breaks, the balance of the universe is disturbed. A diamond butterfly appears in her dreams and leads her through a highway in the sky, where she finds her other self: the masked biker called The Fool.

Journey through a custom-written pop soundtrack, chase scores, and set out to find the harmony of the universe, hidden away in the hearts of Little Death and her star-crossed allies: Dancing Devils, Howling Moons, Stereo Lovers and Hermit 64.

Let’s Pop!
70010000123164.name: Sayonara Wild Hearts - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000123191.description:
The character “You” from KUUKIYOMI travels from Japan to Thailand.
By spending time together with friends met in Thailand, those friends gradually begin to learn what it means to "Consider It".
Through the unique situations they encounter, how will these Thai friends choose to "Consider It"?

■ Game Features
KUUKIYOMI: Consider It World – Thailand Ver. is an ambitious title that lets you experience "Consider It"! through Thailand’s unique culture, values, and communication styles.
This is a completely original work created by Thai creators, and all 100 problems included in the game are newly made specifically for this title.
As you play, you will consider things such as the atmosphere of the situation, other people’s feelings, and small acts of thoughtfulness  while experiencing various situations in Thailand.

■ How to Play
The way to play this game is very simple.
The basic rule is that you can move the red object on the screen.
Most of the time, you will control the protagonist known as “You,” but depending on the situation, you may control something else.By playing all 100 problems, the game will evaluate how well you were able to "Consider It".

■ Results
The familiar evaluation of whether you were able to Consider It returns in this title,this time expressed in a Thai style, inspired by Thai food and the ghosts and occult that Thai people enjoy.
After playing all 100 problems, your overall ability to Consider It will be evaluated.
※ The results change each time, depending on how you play.

■ Game Modes
・ Consider It Mode
A total of 100 problems will be presented.
After playing all problems, your ability to "Consider It" will be evaluated.

・ Chapter Mode
After clearing the game, you will be able to play each problem individually.
※ No evaluation results are shown in Chapter Mode.

・ Secrets
This game includes secret elements (titles).
Whether or not these secrets are revealed depends on how you play.

・ Past You
You can view the evaluation results from your past playthroughs.
70010000123191.intro:
This time, the stage is Thailand!
Test your ability to read the room in familiar, everyday Thai scenarios!
70010000123191.name: KUUKIYOMI: Consider It World - Thailand Ver.

70010000123205.description:
Welcome aboard the Determination Bringer!

You have been appointed senior conductor of the legendary train, which all the citizens of our vast country are happy to see in their cities.
