Your responsibilities are maintaining order in the carriage assigned to you and providing assistance to passengers along the way. Your tools are reporting, intimidation, searches and ejection. Remember: the conductor is always right.

Monitor the passengers
Carefully monitor everyone who enters the carriage and decide what to do with fare-evaders. Observe and report all suspicious, unauthorized and basically any passenger activity. Search the baggage and call the police if you find prohibited items.

Move up the train
Get access to the dining car or VIP compartments and carriages where high-ranking officials and big industrialists ride. Keep an eye on your colleagues and report their accepting bribes or transporting banned goods. The Ministry will not let your dedication go unnoticed.

Complete secret missions
Earn the trust of higher-ups in order to receive special assignments. Their level of secrecy will depend on your loyalty, and completion will be rewarded with a bonus or even a promotion. You will also encounter smugglers — transporting their packages along the route is risky, but profitable.

Visit various stations and remote corners of the country. Make difficult decisions determining the fate of passengers and your colleagues. What kind of person will you be at the end of the journey? The choice is yours!
70010000123205.name: Beholder: Conductor

70010000123212.description:
Infiltrate a luxury hotel and complete different tasks. Quiet paws and a bit of attitude are all you need for success!

- A Cat’s Eye View
See the world from just four inches off the ground. Explore the cozy hotel lobby as a curious little cat, wandering through warm lounges, reception areas, sofas, plants, luggage corners, and decorative spaces filled with charm and relaxing atmosphere.

- Cozy Hotel Atmosphere
Enjoy a calm and peaceful experience focused on exploration and cozy vibes. Soft lighting, relaxing music, and detailed interiors turn the hotel hall into a warm and comforting place perfect for quiet adventures.

- Playful Exploration
Jump onto counters, walk across furniture, rest in cozy corners, and freely explore the hotel lobby at your own pace. Every small detail of the environment helps create a relaxing and charming experience.

- A Warm Living Space
The entire game takes place inside a hotel hall designed to feel alive, stylish, and welcoming. From the reception desk to lounge areas and decorative corners, the lobby is filled with cozy visual details and relaxing ambiance.
70010000123212.intro: A charming adventure from a cat's perspective.
70010000123212.name: Strays POV Tales

70010000123219.description:
Explore a quiet and cozy office from the perspective of a curious little cat in Little Kitty Meow, a relaxing adventure focused on atmosphere, exploration, and peaceful wandering.

Walk through office rooms, meeting areas, corridors, and workspaces while discovering hidden corners, cozy spots, and small environmental details that bring the workplace to life. Enjoy calm exploration, soft visuals, and a comforting atmosphere as you freely roam through the office at your own pace.

With relaxing gameplay and charming environments, Little Kitty Meow offers a simple and wholesome experience perfect for players who enjoy cozy exploration games.
70010000123219.name: Little Kitty Meow

70010000123225.description:
You awaken in a labyrinth of interconnected rooms with no memory of how you got there - and no obvious way out. Every corridor leads to another mystery, every door hides a new challenge, and every mistake brings you closer to failure.
Solve clever environmental puzzles, avoid deadly traps, and search for the path to freedom before time runs out. The maze is constantly testing your observation, logic, and decision-making, forcing you to think quickly under pressure.
With each room you conquer, the exit feels closer... yet the labyrinth always has another surprise waiting. Stay focused, keep moving, and make every second count - because the clock never stops ticking.
70010000123225.name: Inside the Cube

70010000123234.description:
The Coma 3: Bloodlines is a 2D run-and-hide horror adventure where you must escape threatening puppets and shadow monsters while gathering clues, solving problems, and unraveling the mystery surrounding the chaos that the three main characters have been thrust into.

The game maintains a constant sense of suspense and tension, allowing players to experience the unique culture and lifestyle of South Korea, while uncovering its distinctive sorcery, curses, history, and style.



STORY

In a district of Seoul, South Korea, there was a school boasting a long history and tradition, known as ‘Sehwa Private High School’. Behind the scenes, people seeking to study the cursed underworld of history were exploring and managing this place under the name ‘Sehwa Foundation’, with their focus on the nightmare dimension, the mirror world of this reality: The Coma.

 However, there were also those who viewed this place as an object of exploration and suppressed the dangerous elements. They are the Ghost Vigilantes. The wraiths of the past, who have traversed the ages to this time period, appear...and the once-quiet Coma dimension has once again become a realm of nightmare.



KEY FEATURES

Welcome to the Coma World: In this realm of shadows, where rumors and urban legends become reality, all kinds of dangers lurk. If a living intruder dies here, their body will be severed from their spirit and never wake up again.

Exotic Region for The Mystery Horror: Experience a unique occult and mystery atmosphere in the special local area of South Korea. The mysteries and secrets that have continued since the previous work will stimulate your brain. Who should you trust, and who should you abandon?

Into New Locations: Leaving behind familiar schools and neighborhoods, you will embark on unpredictable adventures with new missions and locations. Will you struggle to survive on your own, or will someone save you from that fate?

Run and Hide: You cannot fight. The shadows are running amok, and hideous puppets will hunt you down. You must hide when you have the chance and wait for the right moment to make your move and escape.



NEW FEATURES

4 Bosses from the Cursed History: New, never-before-seen bosses are coming. They all have different attack patterns and require different approaches.

Compact area design: Run-and-Hide action in more enclosed, tight spaces.

3 playable characters: You can take turns playing as three different characters, each with different strengths and weaknesses, all of who will be familiar to fans of the series.

Closure of all previous games: This game concludes the story surrounding Sehwa High School that began in The Coma 1. Many secrets from the previous games are unravelled here, in the most intense entry of all.
70010000123234.intro: Follow the Bloodlines and break this curse.
70010000123234.name: The Coma 3: Bloodlines

70010000123260.description:
Antique Backgammon is a classic board game that is easy to learn and enjoyable at your own pace. It is suitable for both quick sessions and more thoughtful play.

The game includes two modes: short backgammon and long backgammon - choose the one you prefer. You can play against an AI with adjustable difficulty or share the device and play with someone else.

Clean visuals, intuitive controls, and smooth gameplay keep the experience simple and comfortable. Just roll the dice and play whenever you like.
70010000123260.name: Antique Backgammon

70010000123266.description:
Weird science and block-pushing puzzle mechanics combine for a brainteasing adventure in Rat Protocol!

When an experiment unexpectedly grants humanoid strength and intelligence to a lab rat, the scientists in charge decide to test the limits of their creation’s newfound abilities. Guide the lab rat through increasingly tricky chambers by pushing crates, blocking dangerous laser beams, activating switches and detonating explosives. Find the right order to clear obstacles so the lab rat can reach key cards to open doorways and proceed to the next test.

Will you make the experiment a success or lead your rodent to an untimely demise?

• Test the limits of a mutated lab rat in top-down puzzle adventure style!
• Solve increasingly complex puzzles to escape each tricky chamber.
• Avoid hazards and collect key cards to help the lab rat survive!
• Block laser beams, activate switches, push crates and more in the correct order.
• Enjoy retro pixel art aesthetics and a whimsical narrative about twisted science!
70010000123266.intro: Escape dangerous labs as a mutated rodent in a pushing puzzle adventure about twisted experiments!
70010000123266.name: Rat Protocol

70010000123287.description:
Play more than 500 levels, including the new Sliding level type,
while unlocking classic and additional solitaire variants such as Carlton, Fanny, or Daisy Garden!

Immerse yourself in Supersize and Challenge levels, as well as Mahjong and Match-2 levels.

Overcome obstacles like thorns, chains and ribbons, elevator and frozen cards, seals,
vines and more to collect the bonus gems and coins in each level.

Visit the shop for special upgrades to help you on your quest.
Choose between multiple card decks, and 4 different game modes: Normal, Hard, Relaxed, and Timed!

Search every last level for gems and coins that you can use to purchase new upgrades for each scene, plus aim for the elusive „Perfect“ in each level.

Features:
- More than 500 Solitaire levels!
- 6 classical Solitaire games such as Klondike, Spider or Freecell.
- 12 additional Solitaire variants including 32 Thieves or Deuces.
- 60 replayable bonus Mahjong levels!
- 5 stunning palaces to build.
- Play 4 different game modes: Normal, Hard, Relaxed and Timed.
- Discover the brand new sliding levels.
- Play supersize, challenge and match-2 bonus level.
- Choose between multiple card decks to play with.
70010000123287.intro: Explore a fantastical world in this new Solitaire adventure!
70010000123287.name: Jewel Match Solitaire X

70010000123298.description:
Football 26 League Superstar invites you into the heart of modern football — where ambition, strategy, and skill decide who becomes a legend.

Start your journey as a hungry newcomer with a modest squad and limited resources. Every match is a step forward, every decision matters. Train harder, think smarter, and climb from local victories to the grandest stage of world football. Your ultimate dream? Lifting the World Cup and proving you belong among the elite.

Key Features:
• Career Progression
Compete in tournaments of increasing difficulty, evolving from early matches against weaker opponents to intense professional-level battles on the road to World Cup glory.
• Rush Mode
Jump into fast-paced matches to test tactics, experiment with lineups, and sharpen individual player skills — perfect for quick sessions and rapid squad growth.
• Deep Team Management
Open player packs of varying rarities, upgrade your squad using match experience, rearrange positions, and fine-tune tactics to dominate the pitch.
• Dynamic Match Atmosphere
Experience games played across a full day and night cycle — from bright mornings to dramatic night-time kickoffs.
• Unique Player Skills
Every footballer brings their own dribbles, tricks, and signature moves, creating spectacular moments and varied gameplay.
• Squad Building System
Use in-game currency to unlock powerful players and gradually assemble your ultimate dream team.

Football 26 League Superstar is more than a football game — it’s your personal rise to greatness. Plan your strategy, train relentlessly, outplay your rivals, and write your own legacy in football history.

The pitch is ready. The crowd is waiting. Become a superstar.
70010000123298.intro: Create the ultimate football squad and write your own championship story.
70010000123298.name: Football 26 League Superstar

70010000123310.description:
Easter Coloring Book for Kids & Toddlers is the perfect coloring book full of kid-friendly Easter vacation animal illustrations. All graphics and drawings were created for creative kids who love Easter and funny animals.

The game can be played directly on the device’s touchscreen using a finger. Children simply tap, paint, and get creative!

Kids start the educational learning game by choosing an Easter animal line-art image and then enter the canvas area, where they can color the picture and freely paint in the background. The line-art can also be disabled, allowing children to draw on a blank canvas.

A wide selection of colors, brushes, and fill tool is available. The size of each drawing tool can be adjusted, and all buttons and tools can be hidden so only the drawing area remains visible.

It’s the perfect early-learning creative experience for young children to improve hand-eye coordination, explore colors, and enjoy a fun artistic journey with friendly animals and Easter decorations.
70010000123310.intro: Lovingly designed Easter animals coloring book full of child-friendly illustrations
70010000123310.name: Easter Coloring Book for Kids & Toddlers

70010000123316.description:
Smash Bullets with Your Fists!
Crush a Machine Army with Eight Buddies in This Cybernetic Punching Action Game


◆GAME OVERVIEW
The year is 2030.
Metal Command, a cyborg army bent on world domination, has launched a rebellion.

Police officer Steve Herman lost both hands in battle. Equipped with cybernetic hands powerful enough to smash metal, he rises under the code name “Shatterhand.”

Fight through dangerous areas like the Factory, Submarine, and Ravaged City with close-range punches.

Power up to double your attack power and gain the upper hand in battle.

Collect three [α] and [β] letters to summon one of eight Satellite Robots, depending on the pattern. Each robot supports you with a different weapon.

Complete the same pattern again to transform into the invincible “Heavy Armor Dynamo.”

Master your fists and Satellite Robots, and crush General Grover, leader of Metal Command!


◎SPECIAL RULES
1. RESTORE SATELLITE ROBOT LIFE
Punch enemy bullets to destroy them and restore your Satellite Robot’s Life.

2. SPECIAL POWER-UP
Complete the letter pattern shown for each area to gain special bonuses, such as fully restoring Life or doubling Power-up Durability.


◆NEW GAME INFORMATION

View information that was not shown in the original game:

★Power-up Durability
★Current Satellite Robot name and three-letter pattern
★Satellite Robot Life
★Boss name and Life gauge
★Current area name


◆NEW UI FEATURES
★PATTERN LOG
View the [α] and [β] letter combinations you have collected as three-letter patterns.

★Key VISUALIZER
See the three sound channels that make up the BGM displayed in real time on a keyboard-style interface.

◆ABOUT SATELLITE ROBOTS
View video guides showing how to control Satellite Robots and use their different attack patterns from the menu.


◆JALECOLLE FEATURES

★HELPFUL FEATURES FOR ALL PLAYERS
Use Rewind to quickly undo mistakes, or Quick Save & Load to save and resume the game anywhere.

★SUBTITLE GUIDE
iew information about each area on the stage-select screen.

★RECORD YOUR BEST TIME
Use the Simple Timer to measure and record your time from the start of the game to the defeat of the final boss.

*Special rules and other new features can be turned ON or OFF in the options. You can also play in the original classic style.


★AND EVEN MORE FEATURES!

・30 Achievements
・Extras featuring the original package design and never-before-seen development materials
　*Development materials are also available in an English-edited version.
・Screen Edge option to reduce visual distortion at the edges
・Screen size and filter options
・Wallpapers
・A bonus unlocked by clearing the game
70010000123316.intro:
A project bringing JALECO Famicom titles back-to-back!
Now comes +α Vol. 2—“Operation Steel Fist,” SHATTERHAND!
70010000123316.name: JALECOlle Famicom Ver. SHATTERHAND

70010000123340.description:
Welcome to the world’s most relaxing tidying-up simulator! Pick & Place is a vibrant, low-stress puzzle game where your only goal is to find the perfect home for everyday objects. From vintage vinyls and leafy succulents to chaotic books and mismatched clothes, every item has a story—and a specific spot where it "just fits.", and everything is hand-drawn in a vibrant retro, pixel style.

Forget timers, high scores, or "Game Over" screens. Here, the only reward is the pure, tingly satisfaction of a perfectly organized shelf and the gentle hum of lo-fi beats.

KEY FEATURES:
- Satisfying Tactile Gameplay: Feel the click! Experience the tactile joy of placing items with smooth, responsive controls designed for maximum "ahhh" moments.
- Vibrant Pixel Art: Immerse yourself in a nostalgic, colorful, handcrafted 16-bit world.
- Zero Stress, All Chill: No timers. No pressure. Just you, your collection, and a cozy atmosphere. It’s the perfect "wind-down" game before bed or during a rainy afternoon.
70010000123340.intro: Messy room? Stressful day? Not anymore! Turn chaos into calm, one pixel at a time.
70010000123340.name: Pick & Place

70010000123346.description:
Step onto vibrant islands where towering structures rise into the sky, each one a challenge waiting to be conquered. Climb winding paths that spiral around massive towers, testing your skill, timing, and courage with every step upward.

The journey is anything but simple. Treacherous hazards stand in your way, from blazing fire jets to razor-sharp spikes and crumbling floors that collapse beneath your feet. Every climb demands precision and quick thinking as the environment itself works against you.

Along the path, a variety of enemies guard the ascent. From skittering spiders and swooping bats to relentless skeletons and brutish orcs, each level introduces new threats that force you to adapt your strategy and stay alert.

At the summit of each tower, victory awaits. Raise the flag to claim your success and unlock the next destination, where a brand-new island and environment bring fresh challenges and surprises.

With its colorful, stylized world and ever-changing obstacles, every climb feels like a new adventure.
70010000123346.name: The Towers

70010000123352.description:
Welcome to Cozy Pages, a cozy/kawaii coloring game designed for those quiet, feel-good moments. Pick a page, choose a palette that matches your mood, add a few cute stickers and let everything slow down. No pressure, no timers. Just soft vibes, gentle creativity and that satisfying feeling when a scene comes to life.

Color charming 2D pages, from simple doodles and bold, easy designs to mandalas, lettering, and more detailed realistic drawings. Plus plenty of cute animals, cozy everyday moments and adorably decorated little houses.

Then switch things up with our separate 3D & Voxel mode, where you color blocky  models and unlock whiteboards for free drawing, quick doodles and cozy creativity anytime.

This free edition gives you a warm, complete starter set:
- 33 coloring pages from different themes
- 4 voxel 3D models
- 1 sticker pack (10 stickers)
- 2 palettes (32 colors)

It’s enough to relax right away and discover what style you love most.

And if you want the complete set, the full version—sold separately as the Cozy Bundle—includes: 450+ pages, 33 themed collections, 40 voxel 3D models, all sticker packs (110 stickers total), all palettes (192 colors total), plus 20 whiteboards for drawing freely.

Controls
Choose your favorite way to play:
- Motion pointer (Joy-Con™): move the pointer by tilting the controller like a magic wand.
- Touchscreen: tap and color directly for a smooth, hands-on experience.

Tools
Keep it simple or get creative: use cozy tools like brushes (with different looks), a satisfying fill bucket, an eraser, glitter and sticker stamps to decorate your pages.

Cozy Pages is your pocket of calm: cute, cozy and always ready when you need a little break.
70010000123352.intro: Your cozy corner. Cute, calming coloring for all ages.
70010000123352.name: Cozy Pages: Comfy Coloring for All Ages - Paint, Draw & Relax

70010000123372.description:
The Thunder Hoop collection brings the intense, adrenaline-fueled action of cult-classic 2D side-scrolling arcade games straight to your console. Face a dangerous bio-organic crisis in two full games.

Run, jump, and fight your way through levels infested with runaway genetic experiments. Climb ladders, avoid deadly traps, collect weapon power-ups, and defeat gigantic bosses. Play solo or pass the controller to a friend for exciting local multiplayer action. Packed with modern enhancements like Rewind, Save States, and CRT video filters, this is the best way to play these retro gems!
70010000123372.intro: Defeat Professor Genbreak's mutant army and protect your lab-created DNA! Master precise jumps, grab powerful weapons, and battle alongside a friend!
70010000123372.name: Thunder Hoop Collection

70010000123379.description:
Experience life as a vampire in a magical town full of werewolves, witches, mermaids, and more! In this heartwarming, supernatural life-sim, you will raise mystical crops, learn spell-casting and potion-making, and befriend – or even romance – the locals. And at the same time, show your skeptical father that a life of compassion is possible – even for the undead.

Settle down in your family’s abandoned homestead and make it your own. Build your farm with magic crops and livestock, customize your cottage with gothic style, and make friends with other creatures of the night. Embrace immortality and unlock ancient abilities, all in the name of a more bountiful harvest. Unravel the mysteries of the seven families that inhabit Moonlight Peaks and bring a bit of light back to this spooky settlement. Just remember to be back in your coffin before the sun comes up!

■Uncover a Sweet and Spooky Journey
Customize your perfect vampire persona and build relationships with the people of Moonlight Peaks to learn more about the town’s history. Uncover the secrets of the seven families who dwell there – and maybe even find your “tomb” love from any of the two dozen romanceable characters in the process.

■Build Your Dream Gothic Farmstead
Design your cozy gothic homestead, turning a forgotten farm into the ideal sanctuary. Obtain new tools and develop your property to grow even more enchanted crops and raise magical livestock.

■Harness Magical Powers
Embrace your supernatural lineage! Shapeshift into other forms to explore all the town has to offer, and study witchcraft to learn spells that will help you on the farm or when gathering resources.

■Delight in Dark Diversions
Beyond the farm, you’ll be able to enjoy fishing, foraging, and potion-crafting, along with activities like embroidering, flower arranging, and more. You can even collect cards for the town’s favorite game, Nokturna, to play against other residents.
70010000123379.intro: Welcome to your new vampiric life in the magical town of Moonlight Peaks!
70010000123379.name: Moonlight Peaks

70010000123399.description:
Enter a surreal platforming adventure where the world constantly changes around you. This is more than a journey through obstacles - it’s a challenge where the environment itself becomes part of the puzzle.

Using the power of a rotating, you’ll manipulate the world to find new paths, avoid dangers, and uncover hidden ways forward. Every level introduces fresh challenges that test your reflexes, timing, and ability to adapt to changing surroundings.

Collect coins, overcome mind-bending platforming sequences, and take on intense encounters where the entire arena shifts and moves beneath your feet. Some stages demand speed and precision, while others reward careful observation and creative thinking.

Blending dynamic gameplay, puzzle-solving, and fast-paced action, this adventure invites you to master a world where nothing stays still for long.
70010000123399.name: Inversion: The Single Path

70010000123421.description:
Kingdom's Return is an action RPG where you'll adventure to restore your fallen kingdom. Collect materials in 2D side-scrolling adventure stages, then use them in the strategy part to rebuild your kingdom and power up your characters!

*Story
In a world of swords, magic, and fairies, you are a lone adventurer who suddenly becomes tasked to revive the ruined kingdom of Almacia along with the Fairy of Time, Chronos.
Through adventure (action) and revival (strategy), restore the kingdom to its former glory!

*Action and Strategy
Kingdom's Return combines action with strategy for an addictive hybrid experience!
In adventure stages, you'll collect items for construction in the strategy part, all while levelling up your kingdom and characters.
You can approach each side in balance, or concentrate primarily on just one and still clear the game.

*The build of your dreams!
As you fill the land with buildings, the characters you take on adventures will also grow stronger.
Build the kingdom of your dreams and strengthen your allies!

*The playable cast is brimming with personality!
Start your adventure by choosing from "Imperial", "Wizard", "Alchemist", and "Zipangu".
Each has unique stats, skills and attacks, so choose the one that fits your action style!
You can change characters while in your kingdom, so you'll always have a variety of styles to choose from!

*Adventure in an idyllic fantasy world!
In Kingdom's Return, you'll build your cozy fantasy kingdom and bravely adventure into dungeons.
Get quests from villagers, build up your lands, and play around with powerful bosses!
This is your kingdom to rebuild how you want!
70010000123421.intro: A kingdom-rebuilding adventure filled with action and strategy!
70010000123421.name: Kingdom's Return: Time-Eating Fruit and the Ancient Monster Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000123423.description:
Frostpunk is a society survival game where heat means life and every decision comes at a price. In an entirely frozen world, people develop steam-powered technology to oppose the overwhelming cold. You face the task of building the last city on Earth and securing the means necessary for your community to survive.

Optimization and resource management often clash with empathy and thoughtful decision-making. While city and society management will consume most of the ruler’s time, at some point exploration of the outside world is necessary to understand its history and present state.

What decisions will you make to ensure the survival of your society? What will you do when pushed to the limit? And who will you become in the process?

MAKE THE LAW
Establish laws that regulate the existence of your growing society. Decide on their working routine, healthcare, food provision and other crucial aspects of everyday life. Maintain their hope and contentment – the moral condition of your society is as important as securing the basic means to keep them fed and safe.

SHAPE YOUR SOCIETY
If you reach a turning point, do not hesitate to determine the path of your people. Should you rule them with an iron fist... or show them a way of compassion and faith? Reach for extremes or try to find a fair balance. Whichever you choose, remember: there’s no turning back.

WEIGH UP YOUR CHOICES
Some of your decisions will seem small – like deciding the fate of a troubled citizen or meeting the demands of a newborn faction – but be aware that the sum of your doings can lead to unexpected results. Your people put their faith in you, but their devotion is not limitless. Leadership can be a burden.

DEVELOP NEW TECHNOLOGIES
Survival demands progress. React to current events, but don’t forget about the long term and investing in development and technological progress. Providing a highly advanced infrastructure with self-powered automatons, airships, and other technical wonders is difficult, but achievable. It all depends on your management and leadership skills.

EXPLORE THE FROSTLAND
While New London is your main focus, there is much more to the world than what lies within the limits of your city. Expeditions, while risky, can bring you valuable intel, precious supplies and grow your society’s population. There may be people out there, and their fate lies solely in your hands.
70010000123423.name: Frostpunk

70010000123429.description:
April, 1912. A calm night in the Atlantic. Laughter echoes through grand halls, chandeliers glow warmly, and the world’s most luxurious ocean liner glides confidently through the water. Then — impact.
The legendary RMS Titanic has struck an iceberg. A tremor shakes the decks, metal groans, and whispers of panic spread. Within minutes, the truth is undeniable — the ship is sinking, and there aren’t enough lifeboats for everyone. You are just a passenger caught in the chaos.
As the decks flood and the ship tilts into the icy Atlantic, every decision matters. Explore the cabins, stairways, and hallways before they vanish under water. Every second counts — will you save yourself, or risk precious time helping others?

Key Features:
• Race Against Time – Reach lifeboats before areas are flooded.
• Resource Survival – Gather food and light sources to stay alive.
• Hypothermia & Stamina – Cold water and exhaustion are real threats.
• Moral Choices – Decide between self-preservation or helping others.
• Immersive Atmosphere – Experience a realistic recreation of Titanic’s interiors, rising water, and the tension of a historic disaster.

The lifeboats are few.
The ocean is merciless.
Every choice, every second, can mean the difference between survival… and tragedy.
70010000123429.intro: Explore the legendary Titanic as history unfolds around you.
70010000123429.name: Titanic Survival Simulator

70010000123443.description:
Step into one of the most powerful stories ever told — the life of Jesus Christ. Jesus Simulator is a narrative-driven experience that brings the events of the Gospel to life with care, authenticity, and respect. Inspired by biblical texts and historically grounded sources, the game invites players to follow Jesus’ journey from His early years through His ministry, teachings, miracles, and ultimate sacrifice.

Experience a story shaped by faith, compassion, and choice as you interact with disciples, witness iconic moments, and explore meaningful encounters that have inspired generations. Through immersive storytelling and interactive elements, players discover the timeless values of love, mercy, forgiveness, and devotion.

Features:
• Immersive narrative experience presented in a visual novel style with interactive gameplay elements
• Play from multiple perspectives, including Mary, Joseph, Jesus, and His disciples
• Relive key Gospel events and miracles, recreated with respect and symbolic depth
• Explore historically inspired locations reflecting the world of the New Testament
• Thoughtful and respectful artistic direction designed to be accessible to all players

Jesus Simulator offers more than entertainment — it is a reflective journey through one of history’s most influential stories.

Live the story. Experience the message. Discover its meaning.
70010000123443.intro: Can you experience the story that changed the world?
70010000123443.name: Jesus Simulator

70010000123479.description:
Take the leap into a gravity-defying action adventure! Akita: Legends Squad brings the classic thrill of the 3D platformer genre to the Nintendo Switch™ with modern, high-speed movement mechanics and stunning environments.

Take control of Akita, a brave hero equipped with high-tech thrusters, and navigate through a series of challenging floating islands. From freezing snow-capped peaks and mysterious ancient ruins to futuristic cloud cities, every world offers a unique visual spectacle and a fresh set of deadly obstacles. Master the art of mid-air hovering, dodge giant rolling boulders, maneuver through massive spinning gears, and solve intricate platforming puzzles.

Key Features:

Dynamic Jetpack Platforming: Leap across massive gaps, hover over dangerous traps, and master precise mid-air controls to survive the sky-high courses.

Diverse 3D Worlds: Journey through beautifully crafted environments, each packed with unique physics-based challenges and platforming mechanics.

Challenging Obstacle Courses: Test your reflexes against spike traps, moving platforms, powerful wind currents, and intricate level designs that will push your skills to the limit.

Collect and Conquer: Gather hidden coins, find secret gems, and complete levels with perfect timing to prove your worth.

Perfect for All Players: A family-friendly adventure that offers accessible fun for beginners and tight, skill-based challenges for hardcore platforming fans.
70010000123479.intro: Strap on your jetpack and defy gravity! Master thrilling 3D platforming challenges, explore floating islands, and join the Legends Squad in this epic action adventure.
70010000123479.name: Akita: Legends Squad

70010000123480.description:
Set in the demon realm of Adribune, this story-driven JRPG follows Kaine, a demon who awakens with no memories after washing ashore on a remote island. With the Overlord gone, rival nations clash and heroes from the Radiant Realm invade, seeking to dominate the Shadow Realm. Joined by three demon princesses and a strange mascot, Kaine searches for fragments of his lost past while fighting to protect a world on the brink of collapse.

Featuring classic turn-based RPG gameplay, battles play out in a side-view command system that rewards strategy and timing. Equip and grow magical orbs to learn powerful skills, unlock new abilities, and customize your party. Each character also wields unique POW skills that can turn the tide of battle when used at the right moment. With deep progression, charming companions, and nostalgic JRPG flair, this fantasy RPG delivers a satisfying experience for fans of turn-based battle games.
70010000123480.intro: Adventure through the Shadow Realm with three princesses!
70010000123480.name: Akuma Rise

70010000123506.description:
ROUTE16 is an arcade action game originally released in 1981.

Avoid enemy cars as you race through a vast maze, collecting every item scattered across the stage.
If you get cornered, grab a flag and turn the tables!

Switch dynamically between Maze Mode, where you navigate intricate labyrinths, and Radar Mode, which displays the entire stage made up of 16 mazes-delivering a thrilling car chase experience.
70010000123506.intro: The original high-octane car chase action game!
70010000123506.name: ROUTE16

70010000123512.description:
"V'BALL" is an action game released by Technos Japan in 1988.
Control two young men as they enter a beach volleyball tournament and aim for the championship.
Enjoy a variety of actions, such as controlling where the ball flies during serves and spikes, or delivering a more powerful spike by tapping rapidly.
This is the story of their success. The rest of the story is up to you.

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.
70010000123512.intro: It’s Summer! It’s the Beach! It’s Beach Volleyball!!
70010000123512.name: Arcade Archives V'BALL

70010000123535.description:
The zombies keep coming, growing stronger with every wave, but so does your arsenal. Traps, fortifications, powerful weapons, and a little bit of madness will help you survive... as long as you don't run out of ammo first.

Beyond your home lie new corners of the multiverse and the answers behind mysterious portals that unleash monsters into your world. Explore new locations, gather resources, craft weapons and ammunition, upgrade your gear, and discover new ways to survive. From machetes to flamethrowers, use everything you can to stay alive.

Battle powerful bosses, uncover the secret of the portals, build a time machine, and try to stop the apocalypse before it's too late.

Your house. Your rules.
70010000123535.intro: When the world fell to the undead, humanity had one last hope. Somehow, that hope lives in your house.
70010000123535.name: Pixel Combat: Zombie Shooter

70010000123578.description:
Table Foosball lets you create a fully immersive 3D soccer experience. With single-player, local multiplayer, your players can challenge opponents in an adrenaline-pumping soccer match.

This game kit goes beyond the basics, offering additional gameplay modes like Tournament, One Player against device, Two local players, and a chaotic Crazy Mode, where all players can shoot at the same time! With a polished 3D setup, realistic physics, and customizable features, this asset ensures your audience gets hooked.

Step onto the pitch and feel the rush! Tabletop Foosball brings the thrill of the beautiful game to life with stunning 3D visuals, fluid animations, and physics that make every shot, pass, and tackle feel real.

Go head-to-head against the CPU or invite a friend for intense local multiplayer showdowns. Choose your nation, take control of your squad, and dominate the field across a variety of exciting game modes:

- Tournament – Compete through knockout rounds and lift the trophy
- 1 Player vs CPU – Sharpen your skills against a challenging AI opponent
- Local 2-Player – Challenge a friend on the same device
- Crazy Mode – All players shoot at once — pure, beautiful chaos

With various detailed stadiums, smooth controls, and fully customizable match settings, Tabletop Foosball is easy to pick up and impossible to put down.

The whistle blows. Are you ready?
70010000123578.name: Tabletop Foosball

70010000123595.description: Join Kitsune, a curious fox spirit, and the powerful deity Nyaneko on a serene quest across enchanted realms. From the rhythmic rails of the Water Train Station to the neon glow of the Mushroom Council, every map is a living illustration teeming with secrets. Solve gentle puzzles, meet quirky Yokai, and uncover the stories hidden in the details.
70010000123595.intro: Step into a hand-drawn world of whimsy in Lost Little Things, a cozy hidden object adventure for the soul.
70010000123595.name: Lost Little Things

70010000123600.description:
Welcome to Home Rescue: Clean and Restore, a brand-new, relaxing hidden object adventure that brings the satisfaction of a deep clean right to your screen!
Step into the shoes of Jane, the ambitious owner of a budding small cleaning agency.

Your mission?

To explore incredible, beautifully designed homes, clear out the clutter, and restore them to their former glory!
Whether you are finding misplaced items, tidying up gorgeous living spaces, or solving delightful mini-games,
this game offers a perfectly calm and satisfying seek-and-find experience from the comfort of your own home.

Take your cleaning business to the next level with exclusive extras!

The Collector's Edition includes:
18 Additional Bonus Locations: Keep the fun going with even more colorful rooms, unique items to find, and homes to restore.
Brain-Teasing Extras: Enjoy 3 extra Mini-Games and 18 additional puzzles designed to delight true fans of the genre!

Are you ready to grab your cleaning supplies and make these incredible homes shine?
Join Jane's agency and play Home Rescue: Clean and Restore Collector's Edition today!
70010000123600.intro: Roll Up Your Sleeves and Get Ready to Sparkle!
70010000123600.name: Home Rescue Clean And Restore Collector's Edition

70010000123609.description: In the game, players take on the role of an adorable spirit fox, using firearms, magical artifacts, and spells to battle various monsters across diverse worlds. Along the way, they can meet more pet companions and search for the lost Spirit Fox Fire!
70010000123609.intro: "Protean fox" is a bullet-hell shooting game that combines relaxation and challenge.
70010000123609.name: Protean fox

70010000123618.description:
Chicken Rescue is a retro-inspired 2D pixel art platformer where a brave chicken sets out on an adventure to rescue lost chicks and recover valuable diamonds across challenging stages.

Run, jump, glide, and overcome levels filled with enemies, traps, and cleverly designed obstacles. In each stage, players can save up to three lost chicks by opening the cages at the end, rewarding exploration and precise platforming skills.

Collect diamonds scattered throughout the journey and gather eggs to use as ranged attacks against enemies. Defeat foes by jumping on them or attacking from a distance while mastering responsive controls and smooth movement. Hold the jump button to glide through the air, allowing you to avoid hazards, reach hidden paths, and explore new areas.

With detailed pixel art visuals and nostalgic 8-bit inspired music, Chicken Rescue blends classic platforming gameplay with modern level design, offering a fun and rewarding experience for both casual players and platforming fans.

Key Features:
- Classic 2D precision platforming gameplay
- Rescue lost chicks in every level
- Collect diamonds and use eggs as ranged attacks
- Glide mechanic for advanced movement and exploration
- Challenging traps, enemies, and hidden secrets
- Retro pixel art visuals with 8-bit inspired music
70010000123618.intro: Retro-inspired 2D platformer packed with traps, secrets, and challenging levels.
70010000123618.name: Chicken Rescue

70010000123621.description:
Prepare for the collapse of civilization in Dead Patrol, an intense and visceral action shooter where every shot counts. In a city consumed by chaos, you take on the role of an elite patrol officer sent into the most dangerous zones to face relentless hordes of the undead and reclaim overrun sectors.
With fast-paced, tactical combat, extremely responsive controls, and a powerful arsenal, Dead Patrol delivers a brutal and straightforward survival experience. Strategic movement, fluid weapon switching, and smart use of the environment are essential to stay alive amid the urban chaos.
70010000123621.intro: Intense and visceral action shooter where every shot counts
70010000123621.name: Dead Patrol

70010000123627.description: Party Pool captures the laid-back vibe of hanging out in a pub with friends, casually playing billiards and enjoying the moment. Whether you’re unwinding solo against AI or sharing the experience with a second player, it’s all about relaxed fun, friendly competition, and good times.
70010000123627.intro: Party Pool is a fun and fast-paced game where players compete in colorful pool matches. Challenge yourself against smart AI opponents, or go head-to-head with a second player
70010000123627.name: Party Pool

70010000123633.description:
Explore the Opaloid Kingdom and take control of a sorcerer sent on a mission to rescue the princess!

Play through fast, minimalistic, old-school arcade challenges in a medieval fantasy land! Explore dark dungeons filled with monsters, travel through new towns and meet crazy wizards while fighting through obstacles that will test your skill.

Features
- Carefully crafted retro aesthetic, including a CRT filter for old-school visual delight.
- Overwhelmed by slow games with multiple story choices at every turn? Enjoy an experience based on quick, satisfying gameplay.
- A wonderful chiptune soundtrack based on authentic medieval songs.
- Minimalist user interface, no cluttered numbers or text covering up the gameplay.
- This game is inspired by old-school RPGs but it is an action game based on skill.

Stories

Like a cozy medieval fantasy tale, Opaloid Kingdom tells the story of two mages.

The first one is the Azure Sorcerer that lives a simple life in Azure river town, growing herbs, foraging mushrooms, helping the villagers with the harvest and a little rain once in a while thanks to his water magic.

His calm lifestyle gets interrupted when the King summons him to the castle with a request that might put his life in danger.

The Crazy Wizard, a mage that lives in a fortress and used to serve the king as an advisor and ally is now the enemy of the whole crown, he lives in his secluded fortress where his monstrous pets keep him company, along with a whole company of dungeon gnomes which have built their own town inside and recognize the Crazy Wizard as his liege.
70010000123633.intro: Explore the Opaloid Kingdom and take control of a sorcerer
70010000123633.name: Opaloid Kingdom

70010000123635.description:
* Build Your Dream Farm *
Harvest Cafe is a cozy open-world farming and restaurant adventure set on a beautiful island full of charm, opportunities, and secrets to uncover. Grow a variety of crops, gather useful materials, and expand your land as you build the farm of your dreams.

* Cook and Serve Delicious Meals *
Turn your harvest into delicious meals and serve them in your very own restaurant in the village center. Unlock new recipes, expand your menu, and keep customers coming back for more as your café grows into one of the island’s favorite destinations.

* Explore and Restore the Island *
There is more to the island than farming and cooking. Explore abandoned harbors, buildings, and shops, restore forgotten places, and help bring life back to the island. As you repair and improve the world around you, more tourists begin to arrive.

* Grow Your Business *
As your business grows, so do your opportunities. Upgrade your restaurant, hire staff such as cooks and waiters, and serve more customers with greater efficiency. From humble beginnings to a bustling island hotspot, every step of your journey brings new rewards.
70010000123635.intro: Escape to a vibrant island where farming, cooking, and exploration come together. Grow crops, restore old places, and build your dream café.
70010000123635.name: Harvest Cafe

70010000123641.description:
Get ready for a cute and addictive savanna adventure. In Zoo Orbs Safari, adorable animals fall into glass containers full of personality, and it is up to you to merge them into bigger creatures. Combine two identical animals and climb the evolution chain until you reach the majestic Giraffe, the ultimate trophy of your run.

Each merge creates a small burst that nudges nearby pieces, triggering fun chain reactions and keeping the pile alive. It is easy to understand, but full of clever decisions with every drop.

Instead of short stages, the game features 5 replayable levels, each with a unique container shape and its own mission set. Three objectives are active at the same time, and whenever you complete one, a new one appears to keep the challenge fresh.

With no time pressure and no power-ups, everything depends on your ability to read the space, plan your drops, and handle the physics. Slopes, gaps, and tight spaces make each level feel different and strategic.

Complete mission sets to unlock new levels or keep playing in endless mode to chase higher scores. It is the perfect mix of light strategy, charming visuals, and that irresistible “just one more run” feeling.

Observe, merge, reorganize, and shape the savanna your way.
70010000123641.intro: Stack, Merge and Reach the Giraffe
70010000123641.name: Zoo Orbs: Safari

70010000123649.description:
Dive into a world of stunning, realistic puzzles that captivate your eyes and mind. Piece by piece, reveal breathtaking images of beautiful women — each completed puzzle unlocks a new masterpiece, keeping you motivated to discover what’s next.

Smooth and intuitive touch controls make gameplay effortless and deeply satisfying — you’ll feel like you’re truly shaping every picture with your own hands. Gentle, soothing music sets the perfect mood, helping you unwind while your curiosity pulls you to complete the next challenge.

Relax, enjoy, and let yourself get lost in the details.

Features:
• Addictive, easy-to-play puzzle mechanics.
• Gorgeous, realistic artwork of women.
• Satisfying touch interaction — every move feels natural.
• Unlock new, even more stunning images as you progress.
• Perfect balance of challenge and relaxation.
• Soothing soundtrack that enhances your focus and mood.
• Admire each completed image in full detail.
70010000123649.intro: Every piece brings you closer to perfection!
70010000123649.name: Hentai Puzzle Simulator

70010000123655.description:
Drift into the silence of space, where every run is a mix of calm exploration and split-second decisions. In Ore Klast, you’re not just collecting resources—you’re constantly balancing risk and reward as you weave through dense asteroid fields, dodge hazards, and decide how far into the unknown you’re willing to go before turning back.

Each meteorite you break apart tells a small story of progress. Iron (Fe), copper (Cu), and uranium (U) aren’t just resources—they’re your lifeline. Do you play it safe and cash out early, or push deeper for bigger rewards, knowing one mistake could cost everything you’ve gathered?

The ship evolves with you. Every upgrade changes how the game feels—faster movement, tighter control, more efficient mining, or new abilities that open up different playstyles. What starts as a fragile craft slowly becomes a finely tuned machine built for deep-space survival.
70010000123655.intro: Mine the void, destroy meteorites, and upgrade your ship.
70010000123655.name: Ore Klast

70010000123661.description:
Take control of a sleek spacecraft racing through a vibrant, ever-shifting cubic tunnel where speed is both your greatest thrill and your biggest challenge.

Starting at a manageable pace, you must weave and react quickly to incoming hazards that block your path, each requiring precise movement and sharp focus to avoid.

As you progress, the pace steadily increases, pushing your reflexes to the limit while the tunnel stretches further and the obstacles become more demanding.

The experience is endless, but structured into progressively longer and more intense stages, creating a constant sense of growth and escalation.

With simple controls and fast, addictive gameplay, it delivers a pure, high-energy test of timing and concentration that keeps you chasing just one more run.
70010000123661.name: Hyper Thruster

70010000123701.description:
CO-OP ADVENTURE
Buddy up online or locally in this two-player co-op adventure! Test your teamwork as you swing, scale, and navigate the home of an unhinged teenager. Learn to co-operate... or probably just rage quit. Has your friendship got what it takes?

CLIMB. FALL. REPEAT.
Conquer challenging, physics-based climbing where every grab, swing, and slip could be your last. Miss a jump and it’s back to the floor, but isn’t falling half the fun?

ESCAPE THE HAND-TAGONIST
What’s up with this sadistic kid with too much time on his hands? Chopped doll heads? Mutilated toys? Just when you think you’re getting somewhere, he’ll pop up and squash your hopes of escape.

THE HOME STRETCH
Explore a full-scale house. Six rooms, each packed with unique hazards, interactive objects, and increasingly unfair level design. Throwback to the 90s with retro toys, nostalgic tunes, and enough chaos to mend your childhood trauma.

P.S. If you don’t escape the attic you’re trash.
70010000123701.intro: A co-op climbing game about two stuck-together toys on an escape mission from their evil owner.
70010000123701.name: Stuck Together

70010000123719.description:
Physics-based party platformer in the disco. Your goal: get to the dance floor – faster than everyone else. Shortcuts, risky jumps, clean timing, also with friends in local coop. Editor & Community Levels provide a constant stream of new levels with online leaderboards.

Play with your friends to help each other... or push each other out at the last second. The main thing is that the room is roaring.

With the intuitive editor, you can create your own disco levels in minutes and share them immediately. Browse through community levels. New challenges every day.

Every course is a race. Use physics to your advantage. Discover shortcuts, hunt for the best online time, and climb the leaderboard.

Build chains of chaos with precise lasers, catapulting cannons, and bouncy disco balls. Combine the objects to create nasty timings or fun party traps. Perfect for trolling, tinkering, and celebrating.

Colorful scenery, glittering balls, and cute cube characters. The perfect setting for chaotic party platforming fun.
70010000123719.intro: Chaotic party platformer in the disco. Race to the dance floor, solo or coop.
70010000123719.name: The Clubies

70010000123725.description: Code Blue is a fast-paced top-down shooter set inside a ruined hospital consumed by chaos and infection. Fight your way through dark corridors, shattered wards, and emergency rooms filled with hostile enemies, limited safety, and constant pressure. Using sharp reflexes, precise shooting, and smart positioning, you must survive wave after wave of infected while pushing deeper into the facility. With its cold atmosphere, intense arcade combat, and desperate fight for survival, Code Blue throws you into a brutal emergency where every room can become your last.
70010000123725.intro: Fight the infection. Survive the ward.
70010000123725.name: Code Blue

70010000123744.description:
In Raccoon Simulator, you aren't a cute little pet; you're a mischievous, hungry scavenger on a mission. Sheriff and his dog live in a nice house full of shiny objects, tasty sausages, and breakable vases. It's time to break in and turn the house into your playground!

Take on the role of the boldest raccoon in town! What's your goal? Cause as much trouble as possible without getting caught! Sneak through the house, raid the refrigerator, knock over the TV, and drive the dog crazy!

This is a game of pure anarchy. Hide in closets to ambush the residents, steal fish from the aquarium, or simply run wild and destroy the furniture. Nowhere is safe from your tiny, grabby hands, from the backyard to the living room.
70010000123744.intro: Welcome to the life of a Suburban Bandit!
70010000123744.name: Bad Raccoon

70010000123765.description:
Jump into fast-paced racing action and take control of powerful race cars on exciting tracks.

In Apex 2026: Rise of Legends, every race is about skill, timing, and quick decisions. Learn the tracks, improve your driving, and compete against challenging AI opponents.

Whether you want quick races or a full career experience, the action never stops.

FEATURES
Easy to learn, skill-based driving
Fast and exciting races on multiple tracks
Career Mode and Quick Race
Competitive AI opponents
Dynamic camera views and smooth controls
FIX YOUR MISTAKES

Made a mistake? Keep going.

Use the Rewind system to go back in time, correct your errors, and try again — perfect for learning tracks and improving your skills.

RACE YOUR WAY

Win races, improve your performance, and climb the ranks to become a true racing legend.
70010000123765.intro:
Jump into high-speed racing
Master every corner
Become a legend
70010000123765.name: Apex 2026: Rise of Legends

70010000123771.description: Love, Internet, and Murder Magic is a Roguelike game. You will role-play an agent of a streamer who died because of a murder. You are trying to "bring her back" through AI technology on the Internet, making her the unique creation of the Internet.
70010000123771.intro:
Manage a murdered streamer brought back by AI.
Grow her online career—and uncover
the truth behind her death.
70010000123771.name: Love, Internet, and Murder Magic

70010000123774.intro: Craft Your Own Way to Victory!
70010000123774.name: Crafty Survivors

70010000123780.description:
KILL ALL ENEMIES

Arashi Gaiden is a turn-based action game with fast-paced dash and slash combat. Use the dash mechanic to quickly traverse levels and slice your enemies in half in style, combining your blade with shurikens, teleports and chains that paralyze your opponents.

BREAK THE TURN STRUCTURE

Overcome levels with mechanics that change how you play and face Bosses that redefine what a turn-based game is by using special abilities in real time.

Stop the time of your enemies, play shurikens, teleport and change the direction of your dash!
Use special skills to master the field of combat, make combos and win creatively.

Survive 7 bosses that also break the turn structure, using bombs, traps, flying cuts, flames and more! Play carefully or frantically, the choice is yours.

- Over 5 hours of fun in turn-based combat, with diverse challenges and multiple solutions.
- A new level for an innovative combat system, Dash and Slash: enjoy turn-based combat with fast moves.
- Experience a stylish turn-based action game with puzzle features (or vice versa).

WIN WITH STYLE

- Get Power-Ups as you progress through the game, but manage them well during the match.
- Achieve the perfect score in each room.
- Replay each Stage with new powers after unlocking it.
- Enjoy guts and blood flying everywhere in pixel art while cutting your enemies in beautiful stages featuring settings from different locations in Japan.
- Discover Arashi's story, his involvement with Lobo and deepen the Lore of the Bravery Universe.
70010000123780.intro: A fast-paced turn-based action game where you unleash swift, stylish attacks to defeat enemies and mechanically unique bosses.
70010000123780.name: Arashi Gaiden

70010000123781.description:
In a world where you can literally eat your feelings, you work at The Hotbox, a one-of-a-kind donut shop where every donut is infused with mood enhancers that can change your customers’ emotions. But people don’t always know what they need, so from flavors that give them courage to ones that lift their spirits, it’s up to you to choose the right mood and help each troubled customer. Listen to their stories, offer advice in the form of donuts, and help mend broken relationships.

FEATURES

♡ A Sweet Kind Of Therapy
Serve donuts that change the emotions of your customers and influence their actions.

♡ Manage Your Own Donut Shop
Cook donuts, serve the right orders, collect tips, unlock new tools, decorate your shop and discover recipes!

♡ Full English Voice Acting
Starring Nola Klop, LilyPichu, Johnny Yong Bosch, and other talented voice actors, every character is fully voiced except for the MC.

♡ Closure Simulator
Rekindle romance with the exes you've ghosted. Will you heal from the trauma of the past, and perhaps even experience the most elusive and mythical of all emotions—closure?

♡ A Cast Of Misfits
Get to know over 30 customers and 6 romanceable characters, serve their favorite donuts, and find out what makes them tick.

♡ Choices Matter & Multiple Endings
The donuts you serve and the choices you make in the story ultimately affect your relationships. Each romanceable character has 2-3 endings.

♡ Customizable Main Character
Players can customize their character's appearance—skin color, hairstyle, outfit, etc.

♡ Dynamic Comic Book-Styled Visuals
Watch the story come to life with over 70+ vibrant and animated comic book style illustrations.

♡ Original Soundtrack
Vibe during service time to a blend of originally composed rock, city pop and lo-fi music.
70010000123781.intro: Sit back & relax as you play the role of a donut therapist in this cozy cooking/dating sim. Feeling nervous? Need some cheer in your life? Here at High Times, there's a donut for every mood.
70010000123781.name: High Times

70010000123793.description: Take control of your own shop in the heart of a medieval world and turn it into a true legend. Sign profitable contracts with top suppliers, unlock licenses for rare and magical items, manage your inventory, and hire reliable workers. Expand your business, attract more customers, and never let anyone leave empty-handed. Build the richest and most renowned shop in the entire kingdom.
70010000123793.intro:
Run your medieval shop: strike deals, trade rare and magical goods, and manage your business like a true master.
Turn it into the richest store, known across the entire kingdom.
70010000123793.name: Medieval Market Simulator

70010000123799.description:
“TETRIS® THE GRAND MASTER 4 -ABSOLUTE EYE-” offers a fast-paced and highly technical Tetris experience, true to the series. Take on new challenges with modes such as ASUKA and SHIRANUI.

Beginner-friendly modes are also included, allowing players of all skill levels to learn, improve, and replay with ease.
70010000123799.intro: The new title in the “TGM” series arrives on Nintendo Switch™!
70010000123799.name: TETRIS® THE GRAND MASTER 4 -ABSOLUTE EYE-

70010000123824.description:
The curtain rises on a new Fate, presented by TYPE-MOON and KOEI TECMO GAMES.

The 4th year of the Keian Era, Edo Period. It has been several decades since the end of a turbulent, blood-soaked era. People were enjoying peace and tranquility. But, a battle between seven pairs of Masters and Servants is about to begin, as the "Waxing Moon Ritual" unfolds in the shadows. Miyamoto Iori, a young man in Asakusa, finds himself caught in the violence of a Holy Grail War.

- A brand new Fate set in Edo, mid-17th century Japan
In the Waxing Moon Ritual, seven pairs of Masters and Servants, historical Heroic Spirits that possess overwhelming power, vie for the omnipotent wish granter — the Waxing Moon. Only one can emerge victorious from the Ritual. Join the fierce battle in Edo from the perspective of Miyamoto Iori, a ronin who studied the Niten Ichiryu style of swordsmanship, and his Servant Saber who suddenly appeared before him.

- An Action RPG where you can explore the towns of Edo
Feel the bustling atmosphere of Edo where traditional houses, samurai residences, and brothels can be seen. Progress through the story centered around the Waxing Moon Ritual, meet various characters, explore different towns, and take on a wide variety of quests.

- Master and Servant fight as one
Switch between controlling a Master and a Servant to fight against enemy Servants and giant monsters. Unleash Link Strikes and Affinity Techniques to turn the tide of battle and survive the Ritual.

Supervision: Kinoko Nasu / TYPE-MOON
Character Design: Rei Wataru
Story Supervisors: Hikaru Sakurai, Yuichiro Higashide
Development: KOEI TECMO GAMES
In Cooperation with ANIPLEX
Opening Animation Production: CloverWorks
Genre: Action RPG

Other editions featuring this product are also available for purchase. Please avoid making redundant purchases.
70010000123824.intro: “Your wish shall perish...” A Holy Grail War begins in Edo Japan.
70010000123824.name: Fate/Samurai Remnant

70010000123845.description:
She has thousands of followers, a ring light, and a smile that breaks the internet.

Getting her attention is already hard.
Getting a date? Even harder.
Making her fall for you? That's the real challenge.

Each one with her own channel, her own vibe, her own reason to be impossible to forget. Work your way up, get on their radar, and earn your way into their world.

Because behind the camera, they're just girls who want someone real.

The question is whether that someone is you.


Features:

● DATE YOUTUBERS: Each girl is a star in her own right. Beauty, gaming, lifestyle, drama. Get close enough and find out who she really is when the camera's off.

● MAKE HER NOTICE YOU: She has thousands of fans. You have one shot. Go on dates around the city, say the right things, and become the one she actually thinks about.

● KEEP THE CHAT ALIVE: Text her between dates. Don't go cold. Girls who get a lot of attention drop fast the guys who don't keep up.

● UNLOCK EXCLUSIVE IMAGES: The closer she lets you in, the more she shares. Things her followers will never see.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Not every story ends the same. How far you get depends entirely on you.

A girl with millions of eyes on her.
Completely out of reach.
Or is she?

Prove you're worth her time.
70010000123845.intro:
Millions watch her.
Do you think you can make her look at you?
70010000123845.name: Youtuber Girls: Love Behind the Camera

70010000123851.description:
He has thousands of followers, a perfect setup, and a presence that stops the scroll.

Getting his attention is already hard.
Getting a date? Even harder.
Making him fall for you? That's the real challenge.

Each one with his own channel, his own vibe, his own reason to be impossible to forget. Work your way up, get on their radar, and earn your way into their world.

Because behind the camera, they're just guys who want someone real.

The question is whether that someone is you.

Features:

● DATE YOUTUBERS: Each guy is a star in his own right. Gaming, lifestyle, drama, the ones who never show their face. Get close enough and find out who he really is when the camera's off.

● MAKE HIM NOTICE YOU: He has thousands of fans. You have one shot. Go on dates around the city, say the right things, and become the one he actually thinks about.

● KEEP THE CHAT GOING: Text him between dates. Don't go cold. Guys who get a lot of attention drop fast the ones who don't keep up.

● UNLOCK EXCLUSIVE IMAGES: The closer he lets you in, the more he shares. Things his subscribers will never see.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Not every story ends the same. How far you get depends entirely on you.


A guy with millions of eyes on him.
Completely out of reach.
Or is he?

Prove you're worth his time.
70010000123851.intro:
Millions watch him.
Do you think you can make him look at you?
70010000123851.name: Youtuber Boys: Love Behind the Camera

70010000123860.description: A juicy first-person incremental game about growing berries and tossing them down an ominous hole. Earn money and upgrades. Make new friends with sentient berry pals. Grow and control the hole as you unearth why nobody leaves this accursed garden. Bury it all, Berry everything.
70010000123860.intro: Berry Bury Berry is a surreal first-person incremental game about growing berries and putting them in a hole. Lots and lots of berries.
70010000123860.name: Berry Bury Berry

70010000123878.description:
WELCOME TO LEMURIA
A world inspired by Madagascar’s folklore. Once a paradise, it now suffers under the witch Raneny’s ruthless rule. Having grown tired of exploiting its people, she decided to host a huge concert with the island’s most famous band. You’re sent on a mission to fight back by rallying legendary musicians to your cause!

THE (BOGUS) PROPHECY CHOSE YOU
Dash through diverse biomes across Lemuria, save and befriend funky locals to form your crew, and jump over industrial platforming traps to become Lemuria’s number one band and finally face Raneny!

DANCING THROUGH JOYFUL CHAOS
Defeat Raneny’s minions in fast-paced combat, using hair-based powers and improvised weapons (slippers included) to fight epic and groovy boss battles and free the island! 

HOP ON A FUN MUSICAL ROADTRIP
Assemble a band with eccentric lemur artists, manage your tour bus through mini-games, and build your band’s popularity among locals to perform on bigger stages.
70010000123878.intro: Kalanoro is an action-adventure mixing platforming, combat and light management!
70010000123878.name: Kalanoro

70010000123884.description:
It's your first day as a security officer in a mysterious building designed by an unknown architect. Within its vast stairwell, you are tasked with inspecting the floors for reported strange phenomena. Make your way through the building and carefully choose which way to go based on your findings.

How to Play
If everything is normal, proceed upstairs.
If you notice an anomaly, go downstairs, quickly.
Do not miss too many anomalies.

The Stairwell is a psychological horror game inspired by anomaly loop games, with a new vertical dimension of massive scale. There are over 50 anomalies to uncover between all difficulties. You can see how many are left to find after you win a game. Anomalies that you haven't seen will usually appear first.

Choose Your Difficulty

Customize the difficulty of your playthrough. In nightmare mode, beware: the lights are out. Can you find anomalies in total darkness with your candle?
70010000123884.intro: Your task is simple: investigate each floor for strange phenomena.
70010000123884.name: The Stairwell

70010000123906.description:
"HYPER CRASH" is a racing game released by KONAMI in 1987.
Race along courses with various landscapes and buildings from all over the world while avoiding obstacles like drums and oil as you aim for the goal across all 6 stages.
Slam into enemy cars to make them crash! Or jump into the air and land on them to crush them down! In this survival race, anything goes!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.
70010000123906.intro: A survival race where anything goes!
70010000123906.name: Arcade Archives HYPER CRASH

70010000123951.description:
You are the Exterminator on a crusade against the spider horde taking over the multiverse. Blast through the story campaign solo or with friends via online co-op for up to 4 players or jump into a frenetic Humans vs Spiders PvP mode for some laughs and screams.

GEAR UP AND EXTERMINATE
Wage war on the eight-legged monsters with an arsenal of 45 weapons and gadgets worthy of the Exterminator. Will your team smash the pests with a newspaper, burn them to a crisp, rev up the minigun, unleash a rocket launcher, or wield a laser sword?

SAVE THE MULTIVERSE
Embark on an epic spider hunt across seven distinct worlds. Exterminate the pesky arachnids in a mysterious manor, liberate a town in the Wild West, explore cyberspace, and descend into Spider Hell. Every level is a unique battle against the spiders!

COMPLETE CHALLENGES
Brew magic potions in a bubbling cauldron. Demolish a megapolis as a kaiju-sized madman. Defend a cacti-owned saloon from waves of spiders. Win a drone race in virtual reality. And more!

(ALSO) PLAY AS A SPIDER
‘Okay, all this spider-hunting sounds fun, but what if I want to play as a spider?’ you might ask. And yes, you can indeed play as a spider in an online 8-player PvP mode called Spider Hunt. It’s actual humans vs actual arachnids!
70010000123951.intro: Embark on an epic co-op spider-hunting crusade! It's time to KILL IT WITH FIRE!
70010000123951.name: KILL IT WITH FIRE! 2

70010000123978.description:
INCOMING BROADCAST
"Welcome to Rabbithole City, where all animals live a fulfilling life outside nature in this modern, neon-lit city - and it's all thanks to the mightiest species of all: bunnies! A few years ago, they brought us technological progress and a life of fun and pleasure.

And the small price for such a life? Leaving your filthy natural habitat and your instincts behind. Especially you, carnivores, should change your ways if you want to be accepted in this glorious society. "


FREE THE OPRESSED
Not everyone agrees with the bunnies and many species are suffering under this strict rabbit regime.

You are recruited by a giant Owl who needs your help to sabotage the Bunny Tyranny. He gives you control over the body of a tiger-lynx, Kiyo, and sends you on various stealth and platforming missions to uncover the bunnies’ wicked plans. To avoid the merciless rabbit police, you'll need to make clever decisions about when to be stealthy or violent, or both. Hide in the dynamic shadows, use distractions, attacks, and ninja rope acrobatics, and don't get caught!


THE NIGHTLIFE IS CALLING
Take your time and get lost in the atmosphere of Rabbithole City. Learn more about life in this world, meet colorful characters, explore different locations, and discover how evil the bunnies really are.

Feel the seductive pull of the neon lights and immersive synth-wave beats, but be careful - do not lose sight of your mission.
70010000123978.intro: Kiyo, a feline ex-predator, is trapped in a neon-lit, dystopian city dominated by smartphone-addicted bunnies. Infiltrate the bunnies' facilities and free everyone from their tyrannical grip.
70010000123978.name: KIYO - Bunny Tyranny

70010000123983.description:
Play as Kat, a brave newcomer ready to solve the town’s trickiest cases.
Find hidden objects, uncover clues, and help a bunch of cute cat friends including noble Sir Whiskers, elegant Duchess Purrcilla, and bubbly Mittens.

Each mystery you solve brings Kat closer to rising through the detective ranks and helps her fix her new office.
With easy-to-play, whimsical characters, and stories that are warm and funny, this cat detective adventure is sure to make you smile from beginning to end.

Features:
- 15 beautiful Hidden Object scenes to explore
- 15 fun Item Matching scenes to enjoy
- Help Whiskerburg’s quirky cats solve 7 cozy cases
- 15 Triple Tile levels plus 7 relaxing jigsaw puzzles
- Gorgeous hand-crafted visuals and immersive sound design
70010000123983.intro: Join Whiskerburg’s next big detective adventure!
70010000123983.name: Kat-Tastic Hidden Object

70010000123992.description:
Dive into a world of stunning, realistic puzzles that captivate your eyes and mind. Piece by piece, reveal breathtaking images of beautiful women — each completed puzzle unlocks a new masterpiece, keeping you motivated to discover what’s next.

Smooth and intuitive touch controls make gameplay effortless and deeply satisfying — you’ll feel like you’re truly shaping every picture with your own hands. Gentle, soothing music sets the perfect mood, helping you unwind while your curiosity pulls you to complete the next challenge.

Relax, enjoy, and let yourself get lost in the details.

Features:
• Addictive, easy-to-play puzzle mechanics.
• Gorgeous, realistic artwork of women.
• Satisfying touch interaction — every move feels natural.
• Unlock new, even more stunning images as you progress.
• Perfect balance of challenge and relaxation.
• Soothing soundtrack that enhances your focus and mood.
• Admire each completed image in full detail.
70010000123992.intro: Every piece brings you closer to perfection!
70010000123992.name: The Last of Touch

70010000124039.description:
Dungeon Antiqua is a dungeon crawl-type RPG with beautiful dots and nostalgic sounding chiptunes that are reminiscent of the 1980s and 1990s.

- 2D maps that expand to match the character's field of view.

- A game design that can be played over and over again thanks to a wide variety of professions, free party formation and auto-generated maps.

- Game progression focused on hacking and exploration, with no redundant scenarios or direction.

- Fast-paced, modern and comfortable controls.

Dungeon Antiqua is a portal to new adventures for players who love retro games. Enjoy new challenges while reminiscing about the good old days of gaming!
70010000124039.intro: A dungeon-exploration RPG inspired by retro RPGs.
70010000124039.name: Dungeon Antiqua

70010000124045.description:
Since then, countless moons have passed...
As people wove generations together,she quietly continued to fulfill her duty.

But at last, the time came, and the silence was broken.
Old and weary, she gathered her last strength
and spread her wings to find out the hero...

- About Dungeon Antiqua 2
Dungeon Antiqua 2 is a 2D dungeon hack-and-slash RPG featuring pixel art and sound reminiscent of 16-bit gaming consoles from the 1990s.
A retro-flavored adventure awaits you, blending strategic exploration with a highly flexible character building system.

- Exploration
Players will explore six dungeons, navigating with a unique system where visibility of corridors and enemies depends on the character’s “vision".
Dungeon Antiqua 2 uses a symbol encounter system—you can avoid battles by dodging enemies, or strike first and take the initiative. The path forward is yours to carve through skill and decision-making!

- System
In addition to the eight jobs from the previous game, two new classes—Monk and Archer—have been added, bringing the total to ten.
Earn skill points from victorious battles; once they reach the required threshold, you’ll unlock job-specific skills.
Since changing jobs does not reset level, you can freely experiment with multiple jobs to create your own ultimate party!
note: Five jobs are available at the start of the game. The remaining five types will become available as you progress through the game.

- Concept
Sometimes, why not take a step back and return to the cartridge era of gaming?
By stripping away excessive story cutscenes and focusing on short, simple dialogue and text, the world is designed to spark your imagination—inviting you to create your own personal adventure.

- Playtime
For a first playthrough, we estimate a playtime of approximately 10-12 hours.

Dungeon Antiqua
This game takes place hundreds of years after the story of Dungeon Antiqua.
You may even come across some familiar characters from the previous game…
70010000124045.intro: A retro 2D dungeon crawler bursting with 16-bit nostalgia.
70010000124045.name: Dungeon Antiqua 2

70010000124058.description:
Strategize and conquer in a brainteasing twist on a tabletop gaming classic! Mate’Morphosis is a chess-inspired puzzle game built around the concept of becoming the pieces that you capture. Outsmart each board, adapt to evolving mechanics and hunt down the rival king across every stage! Instead of commanding multiple pieces, you’ll need to navigate the board with a single player piece that transforms into the type of piece you’ve just defeated.

Step up from pawn to knight, bishop or rook in order to take out the queen and finally gain the freedom of movement necessary to checkmate the king. Your route evolves with every move. Learn as you go, even if you’re not a master at classic chess! Enjoy retro 2D pixel art presentation and tight hand-crafted challenges with quick restarts, fast strategic pacing and a gradual climb in difficulty across dozens of unique stages!

• Push your strategic thinking to the limit!
• Master 60 hand-crafted puzzles inspired by chess.
• Command a single piece and morph into the ones you defeat!
• Determine your route to victory over the queen and put the king in checkmate.
• Enjoy beginner-friendly rules and gradual increase in challenge!
70010000124058.intro: Solve puzzles by becoming the pieces you defeat in a strategic and brainteasing twist on classic chess!
70010000124058.name: Mate'Morphosis

70010000124063.description:
“FAIRY TAIL 2” is a new RPG based on the popular magical combat fantasy manga and anime series “FAIRY TAIL,” whose story is beloved by fans around the world, with the original manga selling more than 72 million copies worldwide. This sequel to the game "FAIRY TAIL," released in July 2020, depicts the “Alvarez Empire Arc,” the climax of the original manga.

- Relive the culmination of the original series through gameplay!
This RPG depicts the dramatic developments of the “Alvarez Empire Arc,” the climax of the original story. Playing as the main characters Natsu and Lucy and other members of the Fairy Tail guild, you can relive the epic battles against their greatest enemy, Emperor Spriggan (Zeref) of the Alvarez Empire, along with his elite team, called the "Spriggan 12," and the world destroyer, Black Dragon Acnologia.

- Flashy magic battles with unique characters!
The battle system has been completely redesigned from the previous game, resulting in real-time battles that are even more flashy and impactful. Use various strategic elements to your advantage and experience the thrill of exhilarating battles!

- Seamlessly explore the final battlefield of the Kingdom of Fiore!
