The world of “FAIRY TAIL” has been recreated with beautiful 3D graphics that allow you to feel immersed in the world of the original series as if you were exploring it yourself!

- An abundance of exclusive in-game content, including an original epilogue!
Explore a new original story, "Key to the Unknown," set after the events of this arc and the original series. Plus, you can get to know new sides of your favorite characters in “Character Stories” and experience a variety of other elements that can only be seen in the game!

Note:
- Please see the official site for more details.
- There are other editions that include this product. Please be careful not to make duplicate purchases.
70010000124063.intro: The final battle of FAIRY TAIL is about to begin
70010000124063.name: FAIRY TAIL 2

70010000124079.description:
Skyforge Trails is an isometric puzzle-adventure set among breathtaking floating islands high above the clouds. Players guide a brave traveler across ancient stone paths, shifting platforms, dangerous traps, and mysterious ruins scattered through magical sky realms. Each level is a handcrafted challenge that blends exploration, timing, and clever problem-solving, rewarding careful planning as much as quick movement.

Along the way, you will push blocks, activate glowing tiles, avoid hazards, collect coins, and discover new routes through increasingly complex environments. From fiery volcanic heights to frozen mountain trails and peaceful sky temples, every world introduces fresh mechanics and a distinct visual atmosphere. The journey is both relaxing and challenging, combining satisfying puzzle design with the charm of vibrant pixel-art landscapes.

With its mix of accessible gameplay, atmospheric worldbuilding, and rewarding progression, Skyforge Trails invites players to forge their own path through a magical world suspended between the heavens and the unknown.
70010000124079.intro: Forge your path above the clouds.
70010000124079.name: Skyforge Trails

70010000124090.description:
Umbra is hunting you. She has eyes lurking everywhere within the shadows, and she will not stop until she finds you and locks your soul away forever.

Trapped in a mysterious village ruled by darkness, your only tools to escape her curse are a small flashlight and a secret book of clues. Move unseen, follow the cats' hints, and solve the enigmas to find your path to freedom.

•	The Secret Book: An enigmatic journal filled with information and clues that will help you solve the various puzzles and riddles you must face to escape.

•	Exploration & Interaction: Investigate your surroundings, pick up items, examine them, and combine them. Discover how to use and manipulate the environment to escape from each area.

•	The Flashlight: More than just lighting your way in a world of near-total darkness, it serves as a crucial tool with a powerful flash function. But use it wisely and keep a close eye on your battery.

•	The Cats: When you see them, trust them. They will guide you and help you through key moments of your adventure.

•	A Village in Darkness: Inspired by mountain witch legends, this labyrinthine village is open for exploration, yet remains a world drenched in shadows and darkness.

•	The Witch: She roams the streets of the village, relentlessly hunting you. If you hear roots creaking, turn off your flashlight and hide quickly where she cannot see you.

•	The Specters: Summoned by the witch to watch every corner, they are alert to any trace of light. Avoid being seen, as they are fast and precise. But if they find you, your flashlight's flash function will give you a chance to shake them off.

•	Traces of Black Magic & Mirrors: Clouds of shadows and mirrors frozen in time. Find a way to discover what they hide.

•	Vibration Mechanics: Feel your heartbeat—light when you seem safe, but intense and rapid when danger is near.

Do you dare to face your fears and unveil the secrets of Umbra’s domain?
70010000124090.intro: Immerse yourself in a survival horror escape room experience. Trapped in a mysterious world of darkness where shadows lurk, your only help is a secret book and a flashlight.
70010000124090.name: Escape from Umbra

70010000124096.description:
Step into the role of a dedicated law enforcement officer in Tow Truck Police Simulator, where maintaining order on the streets is entirely in your hands. Patrol a living, breathing city filled with traffic violations, and take action with precision and authority. Every call is a new challenge—every decision shapes your reputation as you work to keep the roads clear and the city moving.

Features:
• Realistic towing mechanics with detailed truck physics, weight balance, and precise control systems.
• Advanced violation detection system with dynamic scenarios and decision-based outcomes.
• Multiple tow truck types, including medium and heavy-duty vehicles with unique handling characteristics.
• Interactive towing tools and equipment for complex recovery operations.
• Vehicle customization and upgrade system affecting performance and efficiency.
• Reputation and reward system tied to accuracy, speed, and professional conduct.
• Diverse urban environments with tight streets, heavy traffic, and evolving conditions.

Enforce the rules, clear the streets, and rise through the ranks in a city that depends on your skills. In Tow Truck Police Simulator, it’s not just about towing—it’s about control, responsibility, and mastering every situation. Prove you have what it takes to become the ultimate authority on the road.
70010000124096.intro: Command the fleet that keeps the city moving.
70010000124096.name: Tow Truck Police Simulator
70010000124096.publisher: Lu Ming trading as Shane Game

70010000124102.description:
Hunter Desert Simulator: Sniper Rifle challenges you to become a true hunter in the vast, endless stretches of the desert. Explore a large and demanding environment filled with wild animals adapted to harsh conditions, where precision and patience are key to success. Use your sniper skills to track and hunt prey without being detected, taking advantage of rugged terrain and natural elements to stay hidden. Every step counts in this realistic simulation that emphasizes tactical strategy and smart decision-making.

Key Features:
-Authentic desert environment: Explore a vast and varied landscape with dunes, rocks, and oases, carefully detailed.
 -Precision shooting: Control a specialized arsenal of sniper rifles designed for long-distance hunting.
-Realistic wildlife behavior: Animals have natural routines and reactions, requiring observation and careful planning.
 -Strategy and patience: Be silent, use the terrain for camouflage, and plan every move to succeed.
 -Dynamic challenges: Changing environmental conditions and difficult terrain constantly test your hunting skills.

Get ready to sharpen your senses and master the art of hunting in the heart of the desert.
70010000124102.intro: Do you have the patience to become a master hunter?
70010000124102.name: Hunter Desert Simulator: Sniper Rifle

70010000124114.description:
Horripilant is a chilling incremental dungeon crawl through the horrors of a forgotten underworld. Combining idler, puzzle and autobattler elements, you'll fight, mine, and think your way through the depths of a forsaken dungeon. With each step you'll grow stronger, but beware; every boon has its burden.

Story
You awaken. An old, battered knight, lost in the darkest corners of an abandoned dungeon, with no memory of how you got there. The stench of decay permeates the thick air. The walls seem to whisper your name.

A strange tree catches your eye. Barely a sprout, growing in defiance of the dark. The voice demands you hit it. A twig breaks off onto the ground. The first of many.

Distorted moans echo from an empty staircase. Beckoning you. You must go down. It is your purpose...

Encounter bizarre characters, solve cryptic puzzles, and survive the horrors that lurk in every shadow. Will you escape this living nightmare, or will it consume you?
70010000124114.intro: KILL YOUR GOD. BECOME WORTHY. Horripilant is a chilling idle incremental dungeon crawl through the horrors of a forgotten underworld.
70010000124114.name: Horripilant

70010000124120.description:
Gather resources to improve your chances of survival, search for supplies, build tools and a shelter to stay alive. In this harsh environment, your greatest enemy is hunger, so you'll need to hunt wild boars, gather fruit that has fallen to the ground, and catch fish from the sea to keep yourself fed and avoid starving.

Embrace the solitude as you fight to survive in Castaway.
70010000124120.intro: Survive day and night on a small island in the middle of the ocean.
70010000124120.name: Castaway

70010000124130.description:
The Prince of Tennis Doki Doki Survival ~eternal passion! Tie break ♡ game~ is a globally remastered edition of a legendary otome game that has been beloved in Japan for more than 20 years.

<Story>
While on vacation, a sudden storm leaves you and your friend stranded on a deserted island.
Join forces with the tennis club members who shared your ship and set out together to escape the island.

<Features>
- Experience a survival life surrounded by many charming Princes.
- Enjoy sweet and bittersweet date events unique to each Prince!
- Experience elegant, beautifully illustrated event CGs, with some artwork enhanced by animation.

70010000124130.intro: Stranded with a Prince—get ready to Survi-love!
70010000124130.name: The Prince of Tennis Doki Doki Survival ~eternal passion! Tie break ♡ game~ Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000124136.description:
■Story

The heroine lives with her sister in the American rural town of Havenfall.
However, one day her sister suddenly goes missing—!?
On her quest to find her sister alone, everyone the heroine meets turns out to be a monster!
A vampire town doctor, a werewolf sheriff, a djinn boss at her part-time job, and even a devil!

The heroine believes they are the culprits who kidnapped her sister.
However, the real culprits are a group antagonistic to them...
To get her sister back, the heroine decides to work with these monsters!

As they work together, the heroine gradually finds herself drawn to the very human hearts that lurk beneath their monstrous appearances...
What will become of the love between a human and a monster...?!
■Characters

Diego Escalona
The town's only doctor. He has an otherworldly aura, but is actually a vampire who has lived for over 500 years.

Mackenzie Hunt
A diligent sheriff. Her true identity, despite being serious and having a strong sense of justice, is a werewolf.


Razi Nassar
The owner of the heroine's workplace. A charming and accepting person, but actually a djinn.

Jordan "JD" Davies
A colleague working at the same workplace. They look like a delinquent youth but are actually a devil.

■Contents Included

Includes scenarios up to "Season 6" of the main story from the reading app "Lovestruck: Choose Your Romance".
70010000124136.intro: My partners, chasing after my vanished sister, were kind-hearted "monsters." At the end of our joint struggle to uncover the truth, a dangerous love transcending species
70010000124136.name: Havenfall is for Lovers

70010000124144.description:
■Story
"This is my will. No one else's."

She was once the beloved child of a wealthy family.
But those bright days were swallowed by the darkness of a tragic scheme.

Having lost everything, the girl returns to her homeland with ambition burning in her heart.
There, she meets a group of heretical men who wield the power of witches.

Bonds forged by wounded souls
Warmth flickering in frozen hearts
The miracle of love, now known by the lonesome

But in the end...

Death is but a turning point. Hope is the prelude to despair.

This is the story of saving those vanishing fates.


■Story Systems
●Banish the Darkness by Repairing

The characters' hearts are shrouded in darkness,
and depending on your choices or the story's progress, that darkness may change shades.

If the darkness maintains its control over them, you'll never be able to save them from their fated ruin.
Depending on their Repair Rate, the story will lead to multiple endings,
such as the "Sad Love Ending", "Despair Ending", and "Happy Ending".


● Unravel the Heart with Mental Appraisal

What drove him mad?
What has made him suffer?

Just as you were to appraise an artwork,
use this system to trace the characters' pasts, tour their hearts,
and study their emotions to figure out the truth.


●Reveal the Truth with Art Appraisal

The genius artist Ambrose left countless artworks behind.
But wicked witches lurk within these beautiful pieces of art,
their presence manifesting as errors from the original piece.

In this puzzle-solving system, the heroine uses writings about these artworks
to find the hidden errors and ascertain where the witch is hiding.


Features:
・Fully Voiced (excluding the heroine)
・Change the heroine's name
・Jump to story checkpoints via a flowchart
・Skip through scenes with ease
・Touch Screen controls available


■ Voice Actors
Nobuhiko Okamoto/Kohei Amasaki/Hikaru Midorikawa/Takuya Sato/Tomoaki Maeno
Syun Horie/Yuhko Kaida/Sakura Kasuga/Juri Nagatsuma/Kouichi Souma/Yasunori Masutani/Hitomi Ueda/Masaya Fukunishi/Hinako Takahashi/Takuya Masumoto/Takuya Tsuda/Isshin Chiba
70010000124144.intro: Hearts, sins, despair... Gather them all.
70010000124144.name: sins of KALEIDO

70010000124164.description:
About the Story
After humanity disappeared from Earth, the robots at the Earth Post Office continue to operate. The postwoman from the Heaven Post Office was shot down, scattering letters everywhere. Although she eventually retrieved the letters, she still needs to evade the scrutiny of the Earth Post Office… Solve puzzle to help the protagonist escape her predicament. There is no text in the game.

Game Features
1. Original Music
2. Drawn on paper with pencil
3. Short games, approximately half an hour long
4. Three Endings

Author's Note
Hello everyone, I'm HAIM. This game is once again my own, encompassing the art, music, script, and programming. With the goal of ensuring that people around the world can enjoy this game regardless of language barriers, I deliberately challenged myself to create a text-free game, relying solely on visuals to help players understand the story and levels. This proved difficult, and it prolonged the development cycle. During this time, I also came up with more ideas, ultimately creating three endings (good, normal, and bad), giving the story greater depth.
70010000124164.intro:
P.I.S.=Postal Inspection Service
This is a point-and-click puzzle game with no dialogue, actions, or combat elements.
70010000124164.name: P.I.S. File

70010000124168.description:
In the year 220X, humanity encountered a lifeform from another dimension — the Bydo.

Survival or extinction.

The R-9 fighter, equipped with the ultimate weapon known as the Force, is deployed.
Though seemingly defeated after a fierce battle, the Bydo return from beyond the dimensional rift.
The war continues from the First Bydo Mission (R-TYPE) to the Second Bydo Mission (R-TYPE II).

R-TYPE DX: Music Encore features the ultimate mode, Ultimate Challenge, allowing players to battle through both titles seamlessly.
For the first time, this mode includes a full soundtrack.
Arcade-accurate stage themes have been newly implemented — including dedicated tracks for areas that originally shared music — enabling every stage to be played with the same musical structure as the arcade versions.
Experience newly reconstructed sound created using authentic handheld hardware audio.

The original R-TYPE and R-TYPE II are also included.
In Classic mode, players can choose between monochrome and color versions, preserving the feel of the original release.

Modern support features include:
• Rewind
• Quick Save & Load
• Full Power-Up Start
• Rapid Fire

In addition, a rich collection of original packaging and manuals is included.
Relive the deadly war against the Bydo — now with newly realized sound.
70010000124168.intro: Bydo Missions in Your Pocket — Beyond Dimensions, the Melody of Two “R”s.
70010000124168.name: R-TYPE DX: Music Encore

70010000124185.description:
Step into the world of modern agriculture and build your farming legacy from the ground up. Experience the rewarding life of a farmer as you manage every stage of production, from preparing the soil to harvesting valuable crops. Start with a small piece of land and gradually transform it into a thriving agricultural enterprise through hard work, smart investments, and efficient farm management.

Drive a variety of realistic farming vehicles, including powerful tractors, trailers, and combine harvesters. Cultivate your fields, plant different crops, monitor their growth, and protect them throughout the season. Sell your harvest, earn profits, and invest in new equipment to increase productivity and expand your operations.

Grow your farm, unlock better machinery, and take on larger agricultural challenges as you build a successful farming business. Every harvest brings new opportunities to develop your land and become a true master of modern farming.

Features:
• Drive realistic tractors, harvesters, and farming vehicles.
• Cultivate fields, plant crops, and manage their growth.
• Harvest and sell produce to earn profits.
• Upgrade equipment and unlock new machinery.
• Expand your farmland and grow your agricultural business.

Turn a small farm into a thriving agricultural empire and enjoy the complete farming experience.
70010000124185.intro: Are you ready to master every step of the farming process?
70010000124185.name: Farm Pro 26 Simulator

70010000124213.description:
Silent Raid is a fast-paced stealth action game where every move matters. Slip through dangerous areas, avoid enemy vision, strike at the perfect moment, and grab the loot before the whole map turns against you.

Play as a swift knife-wielding infiltrator and outsmart armed guards in tense, close-quarters encounters. Use cover, timing, and smart positioning to stay unseen, eliminate threats, and survive high-risk raids packed with danger and reward.

With quick missions, satisfying stealth-combat gameplay, and easy-to-learn controls, Silent Raid delivers intense action in short bursts — perfect for players who love stealth, precision, and tactical decision-making.
70010000124213.intro: Sneak in. Strike fast. Escape rich.
70010000124213.name: Silent Raid

70010000124219.description:
Step into a thrilling cooperative adventure where two heroes are forever connected by an unbreakable chain. Every battle, puzzle, and obstacle must be overcome together as you explore dangerous worlds filled with deadly enemies, hidden traps, and unexpected challenges.

Success depends on teamwork, communication, and trust. Use the chain to cross impossible gaps, rescue your partner from danger, and solve creative environmental puzzles. Every decision affects both players, making cooperation the only path to survival.

Key Features:
• Local Co-Op: Play the entire adventure with a friend.
• Chain Mechanics: Swing, pull, climb, and solve puzzles together.
• Cooperative Combat: Defeat enemies through teamwork.
• Deadly Challenges: Survive traps and dangerous environments.
• Shared Journey: Every victory depends on both players.

Only players who work together can conquer every challenge. Master the chain, overcome every obstacle, and prove that true teamwork is the greatest strength of all.
70010000124219.intro: Every battle is easier when you fight together.
70010000124219.name: Chained Up Together: Co-Op Duo

70010000124225.description: Cook the Word is a fun and addictive word puzzle game with a delicious cooking twist. Players swipe and combine letters to form words, complete levels, and unlock new kitchen-inspired challenges along the way. With charming visuals, satisfying gameplay, and a fresh culinary theme, the game blends classic word-solving fun with the warmth and creativity of cooking. It’s easy to pick up, relaxing to play, and perfect for anyone who enjoys casual puzzle games and tasty brain teasers.
70010000124225.name: Cook the Word

70010000124248.description:
A woman, summoned by an eccentric man to participate in a project in an old hotel somewhere in central Europe, becomes embroiled in a game of illusions, increasingly dangerous and surreal.

Now you are invited to fall into the same rabbit hole, in a non-linear mystery with an immense amount of handcrafted puzzles, constantly presenting you with new riddles to solve, each leading you closer to deciphering the enigma of Lorelei and the Laser Eyes.
70010000124248.name: Lorelei and the Laser Eyes - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000124249.description:
Coffee Talk Tokyo is an instalment of the beloved coffee brewing and heart-to-heart talking simulator. It brings the warmth, heart, and delicious drinks from the previous games to an all-new café in Tokyo where humans and yokai alike share their stories.

In a city of paper and steel, as large as a country, a small café gives humans and fantasy people a cosy place to be. Brew the right order for your customers as they seek refuge from the sweltering Tokyo summer heat and share heartfelt stories to chill lo-fi beats.

Set in Tokyo, a city where old and new coexist, this instalment in the Coffee Talk franchise brings back familiar elements with fresh twists.

New Cafe, New Customers
Coffee Talk Tokyo once again places you behind the counter of a chill coffee shop. But while the feeling is familiar, the customers and their stories are new. They include:

 Kenji, the traditional kappa salaryman, striving to find meaning and a way forward after retirement.
 Vin, the Barista's assistant coping with a fractured past and the daily consequences of a previous disaster.
 Ayame, a happy-go-lucky but recently deceased It girl, struggling to make sense of her new (after)life.

Lo-fi Beats Soundtrack by Andrew "AJ" Jeremy
The composer for Coffee Talk and Coffee Talk Episode 2, AJ, returns once again with new tracks to set the lo-fi soundscape and chill atmosphere.

Say it with Stencils
Elevate your latte art with sprinkle stencils. Easily create beautiful latte art by sprinkling a powdery design on a customer's drink, then make it your own by adding milk and etching.

Master of Tomodachill
Engage with your customers on the social network Tomodachill. Learn more about their stories and help them discover the truth they're seeking or make life-changing connections.

This product is released for the Nintendo Switch. It can also be played on Nintendo Switch 2. However, please note that a separate product, "Coffee Talk Tokyo",
is available exclusively for Nintendo Switch 2.
Save data and Additional Contents are not compatible between the two versions. Please be careful to avoid duplicate or mistaken purchases.
Nintendo Switch 2 Edition and Upgrade Pack are not available for this product.
70010000124249.intro: Brew drinks, meet humans and yokai, and experience heartfelt stories in a cozy, story-rich world.
70010000124249.name: Coffee Talk Tokyo

70010000124250.description:
*Please note that a Nintendo Switch™ 2 version of KINGDOM HEARTS -HD 1.5+2.5 ReMIX is also available. To avoid duplicate purchases, please check your platform before buying.
*There are currently no plans to offer an upgrade from this Nintendo Switch™ version to the Nintendo Switch™ 2 version.
*Save data from this Nintendo Switch™ version CAN be transferred to the Nintendo Switch™ 2 version; HOWEVER, save data from the Nintendo Switch™ 2 version CANNOT be transferred to this Nintendo Switch™ version.


KINGDOM HEARTS -HD 1.5+2.5 ReMIX- is an essential collection of the first six stories in the KINGDOM HEARTS series, a collaboration between Disney and SQUARE ENIX. Wield the legendary Keyblade and unlock the true power of friendship as you explore Disney worlds and defend them from darkness.

<Featured Titles>
・KINGDOM HEARTS FINAL MIX
・KINGDOM HEARTS Re:Chain of Memories
・KINGDOM HEARTS II FINAL MIX
・KINGDOM HEARTS 358/2 Days (HD cutscene compilation)
・KINGDOM HEARTS Birth by Sleep FINAL MIX
・KINGDOM HEARTS Re:coded (HD cutscene compilation)
70010000124250.intro: Explore six KINGDOM HEARTS titles starting with the very first adventure.
70010000124250.name: KINGDOM HEARTS -HD 1.5+2.5 ReMIX-

70010000124270.description:
Something is wrong with time… and you are trapped inside it.
In A Little Horror Story, you follow a young boy who wakes up in a broken world where reality no longer behaves as it should. Shadows move on their own, environments shift without warning, and fragments of the past repeat in strange and unsettling ways.

Explore a series of dark and atmospheric locations, from silent forests frozen in time to ruined structures caught in endless loops. Each area presents new puzzles and dangers, forcing you to observe carefully and think before every move.
Use unique time-based mechanics to interact with the world around you. Slow down moving objects, restore broken paths, and manipulate unstable environments to progress through each challenge. Every puzzle is connected to how you understand and control time.

Some dangers cannot be fought — only avoided. Timing, awareness, and patience are your only tools.
As you move forward, fragments of the story begin to reveal the truth behind the world and your connection to it. Nothing is explained directly — everything must be discovered.

Key Features:
- Atmospheric 2D platformer with puzzle elements
- Time manipulation mechanics that shape gameplay
- Exploration across multiple unique environments
- Environmental puzzles based on logic and timing
- Dark narrative told through discovery

Move carefully, observe everything, and trust nothing.
In A Little Horror Story, time is not your ally.
70010000124270.intro: A world frozen in fear and shadows
70010000124270.name: A Little Horror Story

70010000124282.description:
Something is haunting these streets, and it's not what you'd expect.

Graveyards, abandoned mansions, empty roads lit by something that shouldn't exist... and somewhere in the dark, they're waiting for you to find them.

Battle the spirits lurking in every shadow. Weaken them. Capture them. And watch as something dangerous and beautiful takes their place.

Every spirit you catch transforms into a dark anime girl with a personality pulled straight from the other side.

Build affinity, unlock dates, and discover what these girls are hiding beneath the darkness. The stronger the spirit, the more intense the girl waiting on the other side.


Features:

● HUNT & CAPTURE: Explore haunted locations and battle spirits in light combat encounters. Weaken them, catch them, add them to your collection.

● DARK TRANSFORMATION: Every captured spirit reveals a unique dark anime girl form, each with her own look, personality, and secrets.

● DATING & AFFINITY SYSTEM: Go on dates, make choices in visual novel style, and build your bond to unlock exclusive scenes and illustrations.

● CHARACTER COLLECTION: Yanderes, cold beauties, seductresses, the mysterious... each spirit becomes someone completely different and completely unforgettable.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Your choices and affinity levels shape the outcome. Who gets close enough to unlock everything?


The dark ones are waiting.
Are you brave enough to go looking?
70010000124282.intro:
They were terrifying once. Now they're irresistible.
Hunt the spirits, unlock their dark side, and make one your girlfriend.
70010000124282.name: Ghost Dating: Hunt Spirits to Create Dark Anime Girls

70010000124294.description:
Something is haunting these streets, and it's not what you'd expect.

Graveyards, abandoned mansions, empty roads lit by something that shouldn't exist... and somewhere in the dark, they're waiting for you to find them.

Battle the spirits lurking in every shadow. Weaken them. Capture them. And watch as something dangerous and beautiful takes their place.

Every spirit you catch transforms into a dark anime boy with a personality pulled straight from the other side.

Build affinity, unlock dates, and discover what these guys are hiding beneath the darkness. The stronger the spirit, the more intense the guy waiting on the other side.


Features:

● HUNT & CAPTURE: Explore haunted locations and battle spirits in light combat encounters. Weaken them, catch them, add them to your collection.

● DARK TRANSFORMATION: Every captured spirit reveals a unique dark anime boy form, each with his own look, personality, and secrets.

● DATING & AFFINITY SYSTEM: Go on dates, make choices in visual novel style, and build your bond to unlock exclusive scenes and illustrations.

● CHARACTER COLLECTION: Yanderes, ice-cold heartthrobs, seductive charmers, the mysterious... each spirit becomes someone completely different and completely unforgettable.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Your choices and affinity levels shape the outcome. Who gets close enough to unlock everything?


The dark ones are waiting.
Are you brave enough to go looking?
70010000124294.intro:
They used to terrify you. Now they're irresistible.
Hunt the spirits, unlock their dark side, and make one your boyfriend.
70010000124294.name: Ghost Dating: Hunt Spirits to Create Dark Anime Boys

70010000124306.description:
Embark on a playful journey where every jump can lead to a new challenge. You take control of a curious cat and travel through a variety of levels and unique locations, each filled with obstacles, traps, and tricky situations to overcome.

Jump, dodge, explore, and carefully navigate through each stage as you make your way toward the finish. Every level puts your timing and reflexes to the test, with new challenges waiting around every corner. Make your feline hero your own by customizing your cat with different colors and jump effects.

Explore colorful locations, overcome dangerous obstacles, master your jumps, and create your own unique cat as you make your way through a charming adventure full of surprises.
70010000124306.intro: Jump into a world of adventures.
70010000124306.name: Cat Adventure

70010000124314.description:
Park with precision and complete a wide range of driving challenges in tight and controlled environments. In Parking Simulator: Retro Car Driving, your main objective is to move your car carefully and park it correctly within the marked zone while avoiding collisions and staying within the level conditions.

Each level presents a different parking scenario where you must control your speed, adjust your steering, and use both forward and reverse to align your vehicle perfectly. You’ll need to pay attention to distance, angle, and positioning, especially in narrow spaces where even a small mistake can fail the attempt.

The game gradually increases in difficulty, starting with simple parking tasks and moving toward more complex challenges. As you progress, you’ll face tighter layouts, limited visibility, sharper turns, and obstacles placed in critical positions. Some levels require precise timing and multiple adjustments before reaching the final position.
You will drive through various environments such as open parking areas and underground garages. Each location introduces new challenges and forces you to adapt your driving approach.

The gameplay is built around smooth and responsive controls, allowing you to focus on accuracy and control rather than speed. Camera positioning helps you better understand the space around your car, making it easier to plan your moves and avoid obstacles.

Success depends on patience, precision, and the ability to stay focused in every situation.
Take your time, make every move count, and master the art of parking.
70010000124314.name: Parking Simulator: Retro Car Driving

70010000124320.description:
Get behind the wheel and dive into fast-paced top-down arcade racing where speed, precision, and control are the keys to victory. Choose your car, master challenging tracks, and push your driving skills to the limit as you race for the fastest times.

Pick from a variety of cars available from the very beginning, giving you the freedom to jump into any vehicle and discover which one best fits your racing style. Take on sharp corners, tricky layouts, fast sections, and obstacles as you learn each track and search for the perfect racing line.
KEY FEATURES
	•	Choose Your Ride – Start with access to a variety of cars and find the vehicle that matches your racing style.
	•	Master Challenging Tracks – Race across circuits packed with tight corners, obstacles, fast sections, and tricky layouts.
	•	Race for Better Times – Complete events, earn rewards, improve your results, and challenge yourself to go faster.
	•	Master Speed & Precision – Control your speed, nail every corner, and perfect your racing line to gain the advantage.
	•	Top-Down Arcade Racing – Enjoy fast, accessible racing action focused on skill, control, and quick decisions.

Choose your car, hit the track, and race for the perfect run. Master every corner, improve your times, and prove you have what it takes to become the fastest racer!
70010000124320.name: Art Rally Simulator

70010000124327.description:
Featuring hand-drawn 2D animation faithful to the series’ roots, Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game lets you experience the world of Avatar like never before. Choose from 12 playable characters and go head-to-head across a variety of modes, including Offline & Online Versus, Story, Arcade, Training, Spectator, and an Art Gallery.

Standard Edition:

•  Hand-Drawn 2D Animation
Hand-drawn 2D animation faithfully brings characters and their unique fighting styles from Avatar: The Last Airbender, The Legend of Korra, and the expanded universe to life.

• A Wealth of Game Modes
Includes Story Mode, Arcade Mode, Offline & Online Play, Training Mode, Spectator Mode, an Art Gallery featuring never-before-seen concept art.

•  Story and Arcade Mode
Experience an all-new original story outlined by show creators Michael Dante DiMartino and Tim Hedrick. Shape the fate of time and space in the main story mode, then dive into arcade runs featuring storylines for every playable character.

• Robust Training Mode
A Training Mode equips players of all skill levels with advanced tools, including hitboxes, frame data, save states, and more.

• Art Gallery
Explore never-before-seen original artwork from the show, honoring the history, characters, and world of Avatar.

• Easy to Pick Up, Impossible to Put Down
Anyone can start bending with simple, intuitive controls, perfect for quick matches with friends and family. Beneath the surface lies a deep fighting system rewarding technical prowess and creativity.

• Seamless Online Play
Battle players worldwide with rollback netcode and crossplay across multiple platforms. Ranked and Casual matches, lobbies, spectator mode, replays, and more ensure a competitive experience no matter where you are or who you’re fighting.

Gameplay Features

• Master Flow and Energy Points
Control the fight by using Flow to dash, evade, and outmaneuver opponents with high-speed mobility, then build Energy Points through skilled play to unleash enhanced special moves and powerful cinematic Super Arts that can turn the tide of battle.

• Support Characters
Choose from three support characters to accompany your fighter, each providing unique abilities that enhance different strengths and open up new strategic possibilities. Experiment with combinations and discover the partnership that best fits your style.
70010000124327.intro:
Water. Earth. Fire. Air.
Master the elements and clash as legendary characters in Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game.
70010000124327.name: Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game

70010000124366.description:
The pizza girl Kat is already late to a party, but she has one more pizza to deliver late at night. The town is quiet, but this neighborhood seems to be sinister and creepy. Kat finds weird signs in the street warning about pizza, and to never deliver any pizza here. Kat decides that she has to do her job anyway and ignores the warnings, but soon she realizes that they are there for a reason as she knocks on the door of the last house on the street, where the Clown lives.

The game tells a comedic and terrifying story - playing as Kat, the player must deliver the pizza to the scary Clown, but she keeps dropping it on the ground and has to make a new one before the Clown hunts her. Find pizza ingredients, food or other items, put them into a pizza and pray that you don't drop it on your next step. The Clown's world is full of dangers and surprises: traps, minigames, challenges, weird characters, monsters, puzzles and scares - all in a surreal and funhouse/circus aesthetic.

Fun and scary features:
- Pizza box inventory that allows you to turn every item into a slice of pizza
- Mini games! Cheese basketball, tomato cannons, balloons popping, clown-like character challenges...
- Survival horror with the Clown on your tail
- Charming characters you'll meet along the way
- Many various environments to explore
- Terrifying horror parts as well as hilarious jokes, not overstepping on each other to bring you a great experience
70010000124366.intro: Clown Is Hungry is a comedy horror game about delivering a pizza to a hungry clown.
70010000124366.name: Clown Is Hungry

70010000124372.description:
"SATAN OF SATURN" is a shooting game released by SNK in 1981.
Fire your missiles and laser beams to take down the UFOs and rockets coming to invade Earth. Clear the Earth stages and blast off for Saturn! Win the decisive battle against Satan of Saturn!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.
70010000124372.intro: Fight a decisive battle with Satan! Only you can save Earth!
70010000124372.name: Arcade Archives SATAN OF SATURN

70010000124384.description:
■Play as powerful mages from different guilds
A total of 16 playable characters!
Various characters from guilds other than "Fairy Tail" appear!
Also, the game includes an original episode.

■Magic battles, Fairy Tail style
Familiar moves from the source material such as Unison Raid and Extreme Magic can be performed!
There are also Unison Raids that are original to the game.

■Aim to become the No. 1 guild
The town of Magnolia and inside of the guild are fully depicted.
Complete missions that appear on the request board, raise your guild's rank with your comrades, and aim to become the No. 1 guild!
70010000124384.intro: A game based on the popular "FAIRY TAIL" is available on Nintendo Switch™ for the first time!
70010000124384.name: FAIRY TAIL

70010000124393.description:
Game Features:

30 exciting levels to conquer
10 customizable characters with unique styles
Upgradable weapons to enhance your power
Powerful abilities for dynamic combat
Strategic 3v3 battles
Command a group of 3 warriors in battle
70010000124393.intro: Adventure where you command a trio of legendary warriors, each with unique abilities and combat styles. Journey through magical realms, master teamwork and strategy to save a world.
70010000124393.name: Fantasy Voyagers

70010000124401.description:
The world of legendary arcade games returns as a 3D puzzle!

■ How to Play

Simple controls. Just toss the Voxel-filled capsules into the field!
When two Voxels of the same kind collide, they transform into a larger one.
Keep them on the field—don't let them overflow!


■ Immerse Yourself in Classic Titles with Dedicated Stages & Sounds

Alongside a main stage that blends elements from multiple titles, you can enjoy dedicated stages for these all-time classics:
"PAC-MAN", "DIG DUG", "XEVIOUS", "MAPPY", and "THE TOWER OF DRUAGA"!

Beyond just the visuals, the iconic music will take your gameplay to the next level!


■ Collect Over 100 Unique Voxels

Clear various challenges to keep unlocking new ones!
Build your favorite lineup and enjoy a fully customized experience!


■ Build Your Own Gallery

Showcase your collection in the "Collection Room."
Arrange them freely to recreate your favorite memories or build the ultimate crossover universe!


■ Aim for the Top in Score Attack!

Relive the thrill of carving your name into the arcade high score board.
Compete in online rankings against players worldwide to claim the top spot!


* This product is software for Nintendo Switch™.
* There is also a Nintendo Switch™ 2 version of this product. Please be careful to avoid duplicate purchases.
70010000124401.intro: Classic pixel art meets 3D! Namco’s iconic characters are reborn as "voxels."
70010000124401.name: NAMCO LEGENDARY Mountains

70010000124407.description:
Through Nintendo Switch™, a girl living in another world keeps you company while you work at your desk.

Memory of Memorie : A Chill Story is a work adventure where the story progresses together with the time you spend working, as you share your desk time with Memorie, an apprentice witch.

In a quiet room filled with gentle Celtic music, whenever you sit down to work, Memorie studies magic by your side.

What used to be solitary work time slowly becomes something warmer: time shared with someone.

■ The more you focus, the more the story unfolds

The game features a Pomodoro-based focus timer. As you accumulate focused work sessions, conversations with Memorie and events in her world gradually unlock.

Everyday chats.
Small changes creeping into the village.
And the secret she keeps hidden.

Beyond your work, a new piece of the story awaits.

■ Your focus changes her world

As the story progresses, Memorie's room gradually begins to change.

Her favorite cup.
The glow of magic.
A space growing warmer and richer.

The more you keep going, the more her world moves forward too.

■ Features

・A cozy fantasy workspace with Celtic music and ambient sounds
・A Pomodoro-technique-based focus timer
・Story and world mysteries unlocked through your focus time
・A room that changes as the story progresses
・A calendar system to track your daily focus
・A companion for studying, working, creative projects, and all kinds of desk work

■ The World

The story takes place in Elmana Village, a small settlement not far from the Imperial Capital. It is a peaceful place protected by the sacred Lightroot Tree.

But little by little, a dark presence begins to creep into the world.

Using a spell that connects distant people, Memorie found you. Was it coincidence, or...?

Stay focused, and see the story through to its ending together.
70010000124407.intro:
The more you focus, the more the story unfolds.
A chill work adventure with a girl from another world.
Focus time no longer spent alone, for you.
70010000124407.name: Memory of Memorie : A Chill Story

70010000124410.description:
The King's watchful gaze.

Peasants toil, miners dig, and knights train... but only when I look at them! Wherever my eyes fall, progress follows. But the moment I glance elsewhere?
Laziness! Chaos! I must choose wisely between the fields, the mines, or the barracks, expanding my gaze so no one slacks off!

Command the kingdom's lifeblood
Water, wheat, stone, coal, silver, every resource fuels my empire! Farms feed my people, mines fund my ambitions, and workshops forge mighty defenses. Every decision shapes my reign, and only a well-managed kingdom will survive the storm.

A roguelite kingdom
Each land presents new trials, from cursed cemeteries to infernal depths. Enemies are led by unexpected Generals, demanding unique tactics to defeat. As a true roguelite, my efforts grant permanent upgrades for my next reign. With my royal council of cavalry masters, arcane sages, and cunning strategists, victory is inevitable!

Ever-Expanding Kingdom!
Regularly updated with new free content, the console version comes packed from day one with the Volcano update, adding a fiery new biome, new bosses, and new ways to expand your realm.
70010000124410.intro: Build, defend, and rule your kingdom by your gaze. A hit on PC, now on Nintendo Switch™
70010000124410.name: The King is Watching

70010000124422.description:
The carnival has closed, but the real horror is just beginning. In Death Attraction, you awaken trapped inside a labyrinthine funhouse controlled by a terrifying, maniacal clown. What was supposed to be a thrilling amusement park ride has morphed into a spine-chilling fight for survival. The neon lights flicker, the eerie carnival music plays on a twisted loop, and somewhere in the shadows, a relentless killer is hunting you down.

To survive this house of horrors, you must rely entirely on your wits and observational skills. Explore the dark and eerie premises to find essential clues, uncover hidden secrets, and solve puzzles that unlock new areas of this deadly attraction. But always watch your back and tread carefully. The evil clown is cunning and will set treacherous traps and appear when you least expect it to stop you in your tracks.

As you make your way through confusing mazes and locked rooms, every corner you turn hides a new threat. Your only hope is to outsmart your painted tormentor and survive long enough to make a final, heart-stopping dash for freedom. Dive into this gripping, atmospheric survival horror experience. Face your deepest fears and prove that you have what it takes to escape the deadliest show on Earth.
70010000124422.name: Death Attraction

70010000124434.description:
Discover a Gothic world in this 2D top-down action-adventure, blending fast-paced combat, exploration, and pixel art inspired by retro classics. Fight monstrous foes, unlock new abilities, and explore a non-linear map filled with hidden secrets and dangerous challenges.

COMBAT

Master precise combat, where every strike and dodge matters. Manage your stamina  as you face off against grotesque enemies. You have a limited number of healing flasks so use them wisely. Upgrade your character's stats to remain effective in combat.

TOOLS

Discover powerful new tools hidden in the dungeons that enhance both combat and exploration. Unlock new abilities to defeat enemies more effectively and access hidden paths, uncovering deeper secrets within the world.

DUNGEONS

Uncover hidden dungeons throughout Tearscape's dark, interconnected world. Each dungeon holds unique challenges, powerful items, and deadly enemies, pushing your combat and exploration skills to the limit.

BOSS FIGHTS

Face off against  challenging bosses: massive, grotesque creatures born from dark experiments. Each encounter demands precise timing, strategy, and mastery of your abilities to emerge victorious.

EXPLORATION

Explore the vast, interconnected map filled with branching paths, hidden shortcuts, and secret areas. The non-linear design encourages exploration, rewarding you with powerful items and new abilities.

NPCs

Encounter a diverse cast of NPCs, some offering guidance, others seeking your help, and a few with their own hidden agendas. Every interaction adds depth to the story.
70010000124434.name: Tearscape

70010000124440.description:
BACKROOMS: ESCAPE THE BRAINROT

The internet has lost its mind. And you're trapped inside.

Enter a mental maze where every room is a rotten meme, every corridor an anxiety attack, and every entity a nightmare laughing at you. A blend of fear, absurdity, and disturbing brilliance that will make you scream, then laugh at how loud you're screaming.

Locations you'll want to forget

Faded poolrooms drowning in dead silence. Endless backrooms heavy with oppressive déjà vu. Brainrot-rooms born from the most feverish corners of the web. Every space is a visual trap.

Entities that laugh at you

Deformed living memes, original nightmare creatures, and brainrot icons reimagined as horror abominations. They want you dead — but first, they want to break your mind.

Gameplay on the edge of panic

Survive, explore, find the brainrot objects, and search for a way out. Dynamic jumpscares, eerie collectibles, cryptic notes, and secret events that change everything.

Free mode

When the story ends, unlock exploration mode: revisit every location, tweak the rules, add more monsters and more brainrot with a single click. Every run is different.

You've seen the backrooms. But you've never escaped them like this.
70010000124440.intro: A grotesque horror born from a rotten internet. Decayed memes, laughing entities, rooms where everything feels wrong. Scream, laugh, and escape the backrooms.
70010000124440.name: Backrooms: Escape The Brainrot

70010000124482.description:
Birds Watching is a single-player psychological horror game about solitude, survival, and bird watching at the end of the world.

An endless global fire has consumed the planet. You are the last human alive, stranded on a mountain peak untouched by the flames below.

Your days are spent exploring the mountain, watching wild birds through your binoculars, and cataloging the species that escaped there with you. It is quiet. Peaceful. Isolated.

Until something changes.

You are no longer alone, and the only ones who may be able to help you are the birds themselves. But their help does not come freely. Observe them. Understand them. Satisfy them.

Be honest. Be ruthless. Be careful.

Because the birds are watching.

Features
- A focused psychological horror experience
- Explore a handcrafted mountain reserve filled with secrets and hidden locations
- Observe, identify, and catalog every bird you can find
- Use your binoculars to study the world from a distance
- Follow your animal companion as you uncover the mountain’s mysteries
- Experience a quiet, unsettling story of survival, guilt, and observation
- Remember: not everything on the mountain is a bird
70010000124482.name: Birds Watching

70010000124509.description:
Welcome to the yard！
In this game, you inherit an long-abandoned villa burdened with dark debts. You’ll manage a hotel and hire diverse employees including Death, a dragon, a Spirit Hunter, and a bioroid maid.Strange guests will arrive, each bearing their own mysterious events. Build your wealth through various methods like mining, adventuring, alchemy, and restaurant management, while adjusting your strategies based on the predictions of Oracles.
*Caution: Consulting Oracles may decrease your sanity level!
The fate of the world will be shaped by your decisions, and your staff may fall for you based on your choices. This game offers up to 23 different endings.

The Hotel
Making money is great!! Making money is joyful
What’s that, lose some sanity for the sake of earning money?

The Building
This dilapidated villa can be transformed into a luxurious hotel with multiple rooms
As a boss who’s heartless to customers but kind to your employees, you’ll customize exclusive rooms just for your core team.
The Beautiful Yard

Putting aside the facts, this yard is still quite visually appealing
Please hasten to dig through the mine cave and clear the forest.
Kindly expedite the excavation of the mine and forest.
Pay attention to every guest visiting the courtyard and listen to their Oracles to gain extraordinary powers, but be sure to keep your SAN in check to avoid confronting the truth too soon.
If you see a giant cat covered in eyes, please ask the front desk for a sick leave note.

Forest Developmen
Beyond the hotel lies an expansive forest.
With proper development, it can provide a variety of ingredients for your hotel's restaurant.

Food and Alchemy
Place some indescribable animals and plants in specific containers.
Chop finely.
Add some magical spices from foreign lands.
Incorporate some special minerals.
Maintain the proper flame temperature.
"Are you talking about alchemy or Eastern mystical culinary arts?"
"Both."

Food
The hotel welcomes a variety of business strategies. There’s more than one way to complete the game.
Managing food, for instance, helps you swiftly utilize materials and amass wealth.
Assist the guests in the yard, and in return you’ll receive diverse recipes from around the world.

The auto-listing feature frees up your hands. With just one lovely chef Haa Lou Ling, you can enjoy the capitalist joy of earning money while lying flat. However, your cat form must diligently explore the forest to supply her with abundant ingredients.

Alchemy
Stay on good terms with Yevna the Dragon Alchemist, and she will work diligently in the alchemy workshop to provide you with alchemical products.
As you gradually gain more knowledge, you can level up your alchemy skill to help the workshop produce more alchemical items.
As you gradually gain more wisdom, you can increase your alchemy level and help the workshop produce even more alchemical creations.
Be sure to collect alchemy formulas — they will provide you with key items that help preserve your sanity.
When your alchemy reaches godlike mastery, you can even craft transcendent items, such as the legendary Philosopher's Stone.

Recruit Employees
Bioroid Maid
One day, you discovered she was once human (???)

Trainee Death
After confessing, "I need to repay 9999 ounces of high-purity souls to the Death Tower," she brandished her scythe.
The "Slaughter" option — turn it on or off?

The Dragon Alchemist
Even though your alchemy skills surpassed hers by the fifth month — yep! — don't tell her. That proud and conceited Dragon Alchemist will turn on you in a heartbeat.

The Spirit Hunter (Chef)
Although her swordsmanship is impressive, she prefers being a chef.
— Regardless, her knife skills are excellent.
In addition, there is a variety of unique NPCs with a wide range of different races, appearances, and personalities. Every character has their own story to discover.
A rich game experience and a fantastical dark world await your exploration
70010000124509.intro: Spend a whole year at an abandoned hotel with four beautiful girls: Death, a Dragon, a Spirit Hunter, and a bioroid maid!
70010000124509.name: Yog-Sothoth’s Yard

70010000124521.description:
Street Racing Simulator EVO : Car & Moto
Are you ready to take the wheel and experience the most realistic and exhilarating driving simulation on handheld? Street Racing EVO, developed by Ovilex, is here to redefine your expectations of car and motorcycle racing games. With its stunning visuals, immersive gameplay, and endless customization options, this game is a must-play for any driving enthusiast.

What Makes Street Racing Simulator EVO Stand Out?
Unmatched Realism and Highly Detailed Vehicles
Every car and motorcycle is crafted with precision, featuring intricate interiors and exteriors that bring your ride to life.
Interior POV
Step into the driver’s seat with a first-person interior view that offers an unparalleled level of immersion. Feel like you’re truly behind the wheel as you navigate through diverse environments.
Handcrafted Details
From the roar of the engine to the sound of tires gripping the road, every detail is designed to enhance your driving experience.
Dual Thrills: Cars & Motorcycles
Whether you’re a fan of high-performance sports cars or the agility of motorcycles, Street Racing EVO has it all. Race through challenging terrains on two wheels or dominate the streets in your customized dream car.
Endless Customization
Make your vehicle truly yours with a wide range of customization options. From paint jobs to engine upgrades, you can fine-tune every aspect of your ride to match your style and performance preferences.
Open-World Exploration
Explore a vast, detailed open world filled with diverse environments. Cruise through bustling city streets, race down highways, or tackle off-road trails—the choice is yours.

Thrilling Challenges
Engage in high-speed races, evade police chases, and complete adrenaline-pumping challenges. Test your driving skills and prove you’re the best on the road.
Multiple Race Types to Choose From
Compete in Sprint, Time Attack, Speed Camera, Average Speed, Drag, and Top Speed races. Take your skills to the track for endless racing excitement.
Stunning Graphics
Experience breathtaking visuals that bring the game world to life. From scenic rural roads to vibrant cityscapes, every environment is designed to immerse you in the ultimate driving adventure.

Why You’ll Love Street Racing EVO
Immersive Gameplay
The combination of realistic vehicle dynamics, first-person POV, and dynamic environments creates an experience that feels truly authentic.
Something for Everyone
Whether you’re into street racing, police pursuits, or simply cruising through an open world, this game caters to all types of players.
70010000124521.name: Street Racing Simulator EVO : Car & Moto

70010000124527.description:
Dive into a world of stunning, realistic puzzles that captivate your eyes and mind. Piece by piece, reveal breathtaking images of beautiful women — each completed puzzle unlocks a new masterpiece, keeping you motivated to discover what’s next.

Smooth and intuitive touch controls make gameplay effortless and deeply satisfying — you’ll feel like you’re truly shaping every picture with your own hands. Gentle, soothing music sets the perfect mood, helping you unwind while your curiosity pulls you to complete the next challenge.

Relax, enjoy, and let yourself get lost in the details.

Features:
• Addictive, easy-to-play puzzle mechanics.
• Gorgeous, realistic artwork of women.
• Satisfying touch interaction — every move feels natural.
• Unlock new, even more stunning images as you progress.
• Perfect balance of challenge and relaxation.
• Soothing soundtrack that enhances your focus and mood.
• Admire each completed image in full detail.
70010000124527.intro: Every piece brings you closer to perfection!
70010000124527.name: Hentai Puzzle Simulator 2

70010000124549.description:
Lead a small group of survivors and build the ultimate legion in a world where every battle makes your army stronger. Defeat enemies, recruit new warriors, and expand your forces as you fight to become the strongest commander on the battlefield.

*Build Your Legion
Start with only a handful of fighters and grow into an unstoppable army. Recruit survivors after every victory, strengthen your squad, and unlock powerful new units to dominate the battlefield.
*Survive Intense Battles
Face relentless waves of enemies and dangerous rival legions. Every encounter requires quick decisions, smart movement, and tactical positioning. Only the strongest commanders will survive.
*Customize Your Fighters
Unlock a variety of skins and visual upgrades to create a unique-looking legion. Personalize your army and stand out while leading your warriors into battle.

Build your army, survive against overwhelming odds, and become the legendary commander of Survival Legion.
70010000124549.intro:
Recruit Warriors.
Build Your Legion.
Survive Every Battle.
70010000124549.name: Survival Legion

70010000124561.description:
Welcome to Block Shop!
You are one of the final candidates in our search for the new Block Shop Operator. Do you have the problem-solving skills, resourcefulness, and intellect to fill this important role? Only one way to find out...

Key features:
- Multiple worlds to unlock.
- 10 distinct block-transforming machines.
- Over 100 increasingly complex puzzles.
70010000124561.intro: Block shop is an automation puzzle game in which basic blocks are transformed and combined to create increasingly complex blocks.
70010000124561.name: Block Shop

70010000124585.description:
*This is the Nintendo Switch™ version. There is also a Nintendo Switch™ 2 version of this game. Please select the version you require carefully.


In this RPG, you befriend monsters from the DRAGON QUEST series, raise them up, synthesize new creatures, and pit them against other monsters in battle.

Join fledgling monster wranglers Bianca and Nera as they set off on the adventure of a lifetime.

[About the Game]
Befriend a Medley of Monsters
- There's a whole host of monsters to befriend, including many familiar favorites from across the DRAGON QUEST series.
- While each monster has its own traits and attributes, they can also learn a variety of talents, allowing you to fine tune your party to match your playstyle.
- Combine two monsters via synthesis to create an even stronger creature, maybe even one you've never seen before.
- Create a party of your favorite monsters that fights exactly the way you want. The possibilities are mind-boggling!

A World Full of Wonder
- With the game's unique visual style, you never quite know what lies beyond the curve of the horizon.
- Each step forward reveals more about your surroundings, where new discoveries and fresh surprises await.

Monsters by Your Side
- Your monsters will follow you as you explore the world so you can enjoy every adventure together.
- You can take any monster along with you, regardless of its type or size.

Stay Competitive with Extra Content
- Online features allow you to battle with monster wranglers the world over.
- With a variety of modes to enjoy, from serious tournaments to friendly matches, there's plenty to try.
- Send your strongest party into battle and be in with a shot at earning fantastic prizes!
70010000124585.name: DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World

70010000124596.description:
Welcome to Sports Camp Deluxe, the ultimate party game packed with over 35 unique and unexpected
activities. Forget traditional sports—jump into sheep roping, walking roll ball, hovercraft, and more in
a vibrant summer camp adventure.

Explore a lively open-world camp full of activities, treasures, and secrets in Story Mode, or
gather friends and family for instant multiplayer fun on one console. Compete, cooperate, or just
enjoy the adventure together, as every game is a new experience.

With easy-to-learn gameplay, nonstop variety, and activities you won’t find anywhere else,
there’s something for everyone.

Sports Camp is the perfect way to share unforgettable moments with your loved ones.

This bundle also contains Sports Camp's Artbook - 30 pages of concept art, artwork, avatars, animals, and environment.
70010000124596.intro: Welcome to Sports Camp, the ultimate party game packed with over 35 unexpected activities.
70010000124596.name: Sports Camp: A 35-Game Adventure Deluxe

70010000124602.description:
Step into the heart of high-risk tactical operations in this intense first-person shooter where every move can mean the difference between success and failure. As an elite tactical operator, you are deployed into hostile environments overrun by dangerous terrorists, where innocent lives depend entirely on your actions. Every mission demands careful planning, accurate shooting, and the ability to stay calm under relentless pressure as you fight through fortified enemy positions and rescue hostages before it's too late.

Face unpredictable combat across detailed locations where every room, hallway, and corner could hide a deadly threat. Build your perfect loadout, customize your weapons and equipment, and adapt your tactics to every situation. Success isn't determined by speed alone—it belongs to those who think ahead, use every advantage, and complete every objective without leaving anyone behind.

Key Features:
• Complete Tactical Missions: Finish two challenging operations across two detailed maps.
• Rescue Every Hostage: Save innocent civilians and eliminate every terrorist.
• Strategic Combat: Use tactics, precision, and smart positioning to survive.
• Weapon Customization: Add suppressors, change colors, and equip attachments.
• Customize Your Operator: Personalize your outfit with tactical clothing and gear.



Save every hostage, eliminate every hostile, and complete every objective to prove yourself as an elite operator capable of succeeding where others fail.
70010000124602.intro: Can you survive the mission without making a single mistake?
70010000124602.name: Ready or Nowhere

70010000124639.description: Outbreak Compound is a fast-paced top-down zombie survival shooter where every second counts. Trapped inside a devastated compound overrun by the undead, you must fight through relentless waves of infected, scavenge powerful weapons, and use explosives wisely to stay alive. From tight defensive holds to chaotic last stands, survival depends on quick reflexes, smart positioning, and ruthless firepower.
70010000124639.intro: Survive the siege. Burn the dead.
70010000124639.name: Outbreak Compound

70010000124645.description:
Capybaras are famous for their Zen-like patience, but even they have a breaking point! Welcome to Angry Capybara, a hilarious physics simulator in which nature's most relaxed mammal finally resorts to violence. When denied access to your favorite outdoor hot spring, it’s time to take out your frustrations on Granny’s pristine living space. This isn't about sneaking, it's about embracing your inner wrecking ball!

Take control of this bulky, furry menace and embark on a rampage of indoor destruction. Waddle through the hallways, use your size to knock over fragile decorations, and raid the kitchen for all the fresh vegetables you can find. Each shattered plate and stolen snack will fuel your chaos meter, earning you high scores and triggering laugh-out-loud reactions from an increasingly panicked Granny.

As you master the art of the rodent rampage, you'll discover secret passageways, unlock new rooms, and customize your capybara with absurd outfits and colorful skins. Slip into a silly costume, bare those giant incisors, and show Granny that the era of the well-behaved pet is officially over!
70010000124645.intro: The world's chillest animal just exploded!
70010000124645.name: Angry Capybara

70010000124650.description:
Relaxing in the backyard with a cozy blanket and a glass of lemonade, gathering around a campfire in a national park, enjoying a picnic with friends, or simply unwinding in the peacefulness of nature.
Every scene in the game tells a little story about warmth, comfort, and friendship.

Find hidden objects, solve mini-games, earn coins, and design your own relaxation zone!

Decorate it with furniture, string lights, charming decorations, and all the little touches that make it truly yours.

The perfect weekend vibe – from cozy evenings by the fire to lively backyard parties.
Beautiful locations – parks, campsites, festive decorations, and natural hideaways you’ll love exploring.
Updated and improved hidden object gameplay – detailed scenes, sharp visuals, and fun new items to find.


Collector’s Edition Includes:
- 12 bonus levels with unique hidden object scenes and mini-games.
- 12 exclusive mini-games from previous titles.
- 2 customizable relaxation areas – decorate and personalize them to your liking.
- Souvenir shop – collect unique trophies as rewards for your achievements.
70010000124650.intro: This is your chance to escape the hustle and bustle of city life and spend your weekend exactly the way you want.
70010000124650.name: Hidden Weekend: The American Getaway Collector's Edition

70010000124658.description:
You don’t remember how you got to this islands, but now you’re stranded in the wild.
Surviving here will be no simple task.
First you’ll need to find food, craft some primitive tools, and build a shelter. Think you have what it takes?
Your survival adventure is about to begin… In order to survive and escape the deserted lost islands, the hero will have to explore desert islands and dungeons, become a forager expert and gather items, craft multiple new ones and fight monsters in this fantasy adventure.
70010000124658.intro: Explore this survival and exploration RPG game that combines adventure, escape, fantasy. All in one game!
70010000124658.name: Lost Islands

70010000124664.description: Dive into a fast-paced top-down action game where every second is a fight for survival. Hordes of unholy creatures close in from all sides, and only your magic can hold back the onslaught. Gather crystals, level up rapidly in the middle of battle, and combine and empower devastating spells to create a unique build that matches your playstyle. Fight against dozens of enemy types, survive encounters with powerful bosses, and transform from a vulnerable apprentice into the embodiment of arcane power. The longer you survive, the more insane the battle becomes. How long can you last?
70010000124664.intro: Become the mage feared by darkness itself.
70010000124664.name: Sapphire Tempest

70010000124699.description:
No roads. No limits. Only the path you choose.

Take control of powerful 4x4 vehicles and explore wild, unpredictable environments where every decision matters. In Offroad Craft Runner 4x4 Simulator, the focus is not speed — it’s control, planning, and the ability to overcome challenging terrain.

Drive through mud, snow, sand, and rocky landscapes where each surface affects your movement and forces you to adapt. Choosing the right path becomes essential as you navigate through difficult conditions, avoid hazards, and complete missions in remote locations.

Every mission is an expedition. You deliver cargo, locate objectives, rescue targets, and explore unknown areas while managing your vehicle’s performance. Damage, terrain resistance, and route selection all impact your progress, making each journey a test of skill and patience.

There are no fixed roads — you decide how to reach your destination. Explore different routes, discover hidden areas, and uncover pieces of a larger story as you move through diverse environments inspired by real-world locations

Key Features:
	•	Drive through terrain that constantly pushes your control
	•	Plan your route instead of following fixed roads
	•	Complete missions built around exploration and precision
	•	Manage your vehicle and overcome natural obstacles
	•	Progress through increasingly demanding environments
Take your time, choose your path, and push your limits.
In Offroad Craft Runner 4x4 Simulator, every journey is about control, strategy, and exploration.
70010000124699.name: Offroad Craft Runner 4x4 Simulator

70010000124706.description:
A colorful world. A competitive fight. Survival with a twist.
In Cozy Battle Royale 2026, you enter a vibrant battlefield set across floating islands where every match is dynamic, fast, and unpredictable. Drop into the arena, explore your surroundings, and adapt quickly as the world changes around you.

Instead of relying only on weapons, you evolve during the match. Collect special cores and choose upgrades that transform your abilities, movement, and combat style. Every decision shapes how you play — whether you focus on mobility, offense, or defense.

Move freely across vertical environments using jumps, glides, and fast traversal mechanics. As the match progresses, parts of the map collapse, forcing players closer together and creating intense final encounters high above the void.
Face both players and environmental threats while managing your build and positioning. Combine different upgrades with your equipment to create unique strategies and outplay your opponents.

Each match is a mix of exploration, adaptation, and survival — where staying flexible is the key to victory .

Key Features:
* Evolution system with upgrade choices during matches
* Vertical movement with dynamic traversal mechanics
* Map collapse system that changes the battlefield
* Variety of weapons and build combinations
* Fast-paced matches with strategic depth

Stay light, move fast, and adapt to every moment.

In Cozy Battle Royale 2026, survival is about how you evolve.
70010000124706.intro: A cozy world with a competitive edge!
70010000124706.name: Cozy Battle Royale 2026

70010000124712.description:
Exstetra follows Ryoma, a high school student chosen to become a Prisma, the savior destined to protect Amejia, a Tokyo fused with another world and doomed to destruction.

During his journey, Ryoma meets future Prisma Knights who share his mission. By awakening their powers with a kiss, he joins them on an adventure to save two worlds.

◆ STORY ◆

Kiss her...

It is the only way to save two worlds from ruin.

Amejia was born from the fusion of Tokyo and another realm. As the chosen Prisma, Ryoma fights to prevent the extinction of both worlds.

Find the friends drawn into Amejia and awaken their hidden powers as Prisma Knights through the power of a kiss.

◆ WORLD ◆

Amejia is a transformed version of Tokyo that has merged with another world.

Featuring artwork inspired by Tokyo Fantasy, it offers a beautiful yet haunting world unlike any other.

Explore reimagined locations such as Shibuya and Akihabara.

◆ DUNGEON ◆

Mysterious labyrinths stretch across Amejia.

Battle monsters, solve puzzles, discover treasure, gather materials, and explore dangerous dungeons as you venture ever deeper.

◆ BATTLE ◆

The only way to save the world is a kiss!

Fight alongside the Prisma Knights in strategic turn-based battles.

Form a party of up to four characters, choose formations and skills, and adapt your tactics to every encounter.

An Auto-Battle feature is also available.

• Ex Skills

As a Prisma, Ryoma can absorb Ex, the energy that powers this world, by defeating enemies.

Share Ex with Prisma Knights through a kiss to awaken their strength and unleash powerful Ex Skills.

• Party Formation and Affinity

Up to four characters can participate in battle.

Team composition and relationships with allies both play important roles, so strengthen your bonds with a variety of companions.

• Enchant System

Combine skills attached to weapons, armor, and accessories to create customized battle strategies.

Gather materials, enhance your equipment, and prepare for powerful enemies.

*This product is based on Exstetra, originally released in 2013. Some features and specifications may differ from the original version.
70010000124712.intro: A fantasy RPG where a kiss can save the world.
70010000124712.name: EXSTETRA

70010000124718.description:
Protocol: Annihilation is a high-intensity sci-fi shooter where your only directive is total destruction. Take control of a powerful combat robot built for one purpose—eliminate every hostile machine in your path. Navigate through dangerous, futuristic environments filled with relentless enemy fire, shifting hazards, and increasingly complex robotic threats designed to test your reflexes and strategy.

As you progress, collect and upgrade an arsenal of devastating weapons, each offering unique ways to dismantle your enemies. Adapt your playstyle on the fly as you face diverse enemy types, from fast-moving drones to heavily armored war machines, all with distinct attack patterns and behaviors. Precision, timing, and quick decision-making are key to survival.

Each level intensifies the chaos, pushing you deeper into enemy territory under the strict protocol: annihilation. Master your movement, outmaneuver overwhelming forces, and prepare for climactic encounters that demand everything you’ve learned. At the end of your mission awaits a massive, formidable final boss—an ultimate test of your firepower and skill in a battle where only one will remain.
70010000124718.intro: Assume control of a combat robot in a relentless sci-fi shooter where total destruction is the only directive.
70010000124718.name: Protocol: Annihilation

70010000124723.description:
About BLUE REFLECTION
The BLUE REFLECTION series depicts the emotions and bonds of female students across a variety of mediums, with character design and series supervision by famed illustrator Mel Kishida. BLUE REFLECTION Quartet contains all four of these emotional stories in a single collection.

New features make the series more accessible than ever before, with a more detailed look at the setting that will help newcomers understand events and provide a deeper look for returning fans.

BLUE REFLECTION
A console game which told the story of an injured former ballerina as she used her powers as a magical Reflector to form bonds with others and fight off the looming threat to the world. Textures have been updated to high resolution versions, and new visual effects such as glistening water add to the world's atmosphere. New features such as autosave have been included, offering a more enjoyable experience than ever before.

BLUE REFLECTION: RAY
An anime that tells the story of magical Reflectors clashing with each other over their conflicting beliefs and emotions.
This game tells a condensed version of the story, with the major characters rendered in 3D.
Follow Hiori and Ruka as they explore the Common while re-experiencing their memories on their way to confront a student from another academy who is trying to recreate the world. New short stories expand on the anime's story, and a new prologue and epilogue connect this entry to the other works in the series.

BLUE REFLECTION: SUN
A mobile game that told the story of a team of students living in a dying world as they hold on to hope for the future.
SUN's story has been remade as a console game using the systems of BLUE REFLECTION: Second Light to recreate the memorable battles of the original game. 24 new character events have been added alongside the main story, and the prologue and epilogue from the original release connect this entry to the other works in the series.

BLUE REFLECTION: Second Light
A console game that tells the story of a group of students with no memories who find themselves in a strange world. Through their adventures, they must look deep inside their hearts, regain their memories, and discover the truth about the world they are living in.
This entry in the BLUE REFLECTION project first came out in October of 2021. This release for BLUE REFLECTION Quartet features eight additional characters from RAY and SUN who can join you in battle. These new characters also join Yuzuki and Lime as new additions to the Photo Mode! New features such as increased battle speed, faster movement speed while exploring, and event fast-forwarding have been included, offering a more enjoyable experience than ever before.

Reference
A database that gives deeper understanding of the world of the BLUE REFLECTION series. Here you can check chronological flowcharts of major events in the stories, as well as character relationship charts across the entire series. This in-depth overview of the characters and the series's setting will make the games even more enjoyable!

There is also a gallery where official artwork created by Mel Kishida can be viewed.
70010000124723.intro: Our tears turned the world ever so slightly blue.
70010000124723.name: BLUE REFLECTION Quartet

70010000124736.description:
Collect pieces of the big‑eater girls and complete the puzzle!
There are 15 stages in total.
As you clear each stage, the difficulty increases!
Stages 1–10: 30 pieces
Stages 11–15: 50 pieces
The final stage is a tough one with no background watermark!
Take your time and examine each piece to complete the puzzle!
Once completed, high‑resolution images will be added to your gallery ♪
=====================
We support game streamers!
No permission is required to stream this game.
70010000124736.intro: Love to eat! A puzzle game featuring big‑eating girls is here!
70010000124736.name: Mega Eater Girls

70010000124746.description:
YOU STEP INTO YARIV...ACCURSED LAND FROM WHICH THE CURSE THAT RAVAGED THE WORLD ORIGINATED....

The Curse of Faces - where revealing one's face means instant death – has befallen the world. Humanity was brought close to the brink. After 264 years of "the Era of Solitude", a symbol of safety appeared – Masks.
