While the origins of the curse are still shrouded in mystery, many travelers still venture to the source of this curse in an attempt to reveal its secrets. Will you strive to lift the curse from the world, or will you harness its power for your own ends?

- Throughout your journeys in Yariv, you will encounter many unique characters whose fates will hinge on your decisions.

- Face numerous dangerous creatures and engage in challenging battles.

- Discover mysterious locations and acquire artifacts and ancient weaponry.

Don your chosen mask. Fight. Explore. And unveil the secrets of Yariv...
70010000124746.intro: Verho is a Dark RPG in which you Travel to the land of Yariv, find the source of the Curse of Faces, and fight the dangers of this scourge.
70010000124746.name: Verho - Curse of Faces

70010000124774.description:
Under the fluttering cherry blossoms on the streets of Japan, your cross-cultural romance adventure begins now! The game authentically recreates famous Japanese landmarks, where four distinctively charming Japanese girls await to meet you. Amid sweet dates, a life-or-death chase suddenly erupts on Tokyo’s late-night streets, and you accidentally stumble upon the underworld’s dark dealings of power and lust – beneath the romantic surface, a surging undercurrent of life-and-death choices lies hidden. Scenes you never dared to imagine come at you one after another! Tear through the crisis with courage, lock onto true feelings with perfect chemistry.

Deadly Charm・Japanese Heroine Gallery
An energetic anime-style cosplayer, a cool goddess who practices kendo and rides a motorcycle, a millionaire female CEO, a Japanese idol with no control over her own fate… Loli girls, graceful onee-sama, pure first loves — sweet, spicy, or dark, fierce, dashing, or gentle! All the most iconic personality types from Japanese anime and dramas are gathered here. Each is a full-fledged Japanese heroine with powerful presence. At least one of them will make your heart race uncontrollably.

Desperate Run・Tokyo Survival Files
A Tokyo adventure! In a second, you’re pulled into a real J-drama world. The story twists and turns, making your emotions surge out of control. Unpredictable plot developments, challenges full of surprise and fun — skill battles, chases, kidnappings, one wrong step and you lose your life. Go head-to-head with classic J-drama villains. All the excitement from a first-person perspective. Did you really think you were just here for a date?

Real-shot Impact・Immersive Japan Pilgrimage
Over 20 real-life shots of popular Japanese photo spots — real sunlight, real nightscapes come right at you. Akihabara, Kamakura, Tokyo Tower, Yokohama Cosmoclock… famous locations from numerous anime and manga, plus spectacular Japanese festivals and cultural scenes you’ve never seen before! Without leaving home, you can feel the streets of Japan across the ocean, immerse yourself, experience firsthand just how wonderful Japanese life can be, and witness the mind-blowing collision that breaks through the dimensional wall.
70010000124774.intro:
Cherry blossoms fall, hearts race wild.
Fall in love – or fight for your life.
Real Japan, real danger, real romance.
70010000124774.name: Blossom Voyage

70010000124784.description:
Touhou Koumakyou from the Touhou makes its debut on Nintendo Switch™ and Nintendo Switch 2 .
Take control of Reimu the shrine maiden or Marisa the magician as you set out to resolve an incident threatening Gensokyo.

The New Classic version features upgraded high-resolution visuals, with every BGM track arranged by ZUN. It also introduces a new mode, where you can take on the game with unlimited lives.

You can also play the Classic version, which perfectly preserves the original 2002 gameplay.
*All text in the Classic version is in Japanese.

This product is for the Nintendo Switch™. It can also be played on the Nintendo Switch 2 , but a separate Nintendo Switch 2 -exclusive version, “Touhou Koumakyou: New Classic - the Embodiment of Scarlet Devil,” is also available.
Save data and downloadable content are not compatible between the two versions. Please check carefully to avoid duplicate or mistaken purchases.
Please note that there is no Nintendo Switch 2 Edition or Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade Pack for this title.
70010000124784.intro: Dodge bullets, defeat the enemy, and face the incident of the Scarlet Mist
70010000124784.name: Touhou Koumakyou: New Classic - the Embodiment of Scarlet Devil

70010000124790.description:
Enjoy an authentic crane game experience on Nintendo Switch™!
Take on realistic physics and a wide variety of stages!
In addition to standard crane claws, special machines featuring suction cups, hooks, chains, and water-based stages also appear!
Collect every prize and become a true crane game master!

【Free Play】
Challenge all 36 stages!
Clear a stage by collecting every prize!
Aim for a 3-star rating with the fastest clear times!

【Challenge】
Take on 6 stages in a row!
Compete for the fastest times and climb the global rankings!

【Collection Room】
Display and admire the prizes you've collected!
Create your very own original room!
70010000124790.intro:
The hugely popular crane game series is back and better than ever!
Aim, grab, and hook your prizes!
70010000124790.name: Let's Aim! Crane Game

70010000124823.description:
"10 Seconds Dash!" is a 2D platform action game with a twist: an extremely short time limit of just 10 seconds per stage, delivering a whole new kind of tension and satisfaction.

You play as Elisil, a knight who must conquer a castle full of tricks and traps to bring back Princess Terena, who ran away in a sulk. Use your athletic abilities, skills, and items to reach the innermost depths of the castle. But remember—you only have 10 seconds per room! Retry again and again, and gradually carve out your path to the goal. That tension and sense of achievement is the heart of this game.

[Story Mode]
100 stages in total, from tutorials to fiendish challenges. Clear stages one by one while enjoying the quirky story of the knight and the princess. Make use of skills that unlock as you progress to slip past enemies and traps. Trial and error is the key to uncovering each stage's secrets—though sometimes you may need a bit of luck, too.

[Edit Mode]
Create your own original stages using every gimmick and effect that appears in the game. Record a Stage ID to share your creations! What tricks will you pack into those 10 seconds?

[RTA Mode / Stage Select]
RTA Mode offers handy features for time attack play, such as skipping story scenes and toggling the 3-second countdown. In Stage Select, replay any stage you've cleared as many times as you like. Keep practicing and become a true 10-second master!

Enjoy the ultimate time limit, brought to life with adorable pixel-art characters and upbeat music.
70010000124823.intro:
Clear each stage in just 10 seconds!
Jump, dash, and master your skills!
The ultimate speed-focused 2D action game!
70010000124823.name: 10 Seconds Dash!

70010000124839.description:
Pocket Ludo captures the charm of the classic tabletop experience and brings it into a convenient digital format. Just like gathering around a board at home, rolling dice, and teasing your friends over lucky moves, the game recreates that same lighthearted competition—only now on a shared screen. The familiar rules remain intact, making it instantly accessible whether you’re a longtime fan or new to the game.

Playing locally with up to four players mirrors the traditional at-home experience, where every turn sparks reactions—cheers, groans, and playful rivalries. The difference is in the ease: no setup, no lost pieces, and no need to clear the table. Keeps the spirit of sitting together in one room, passing turns and reacting in real time, while adding smooth visuals and faster pacing.

While nothing fully replaces the tactile feel of a physical board and dice, Pocket Ludo offers a modern alternative that fits anywhere. Whether on the couch, during travel, or at a small gathering, it preserves the social fun of the original game while making it more accessible and portable for today’s players.
70010000124839.intro: Classic board game, bringing simple dice-based strategy to your screen. Designed for up to four players, it offers quick, turn-based gameplay that’s easy to learn and fun for all ages.
70010000124839.name: Pocket Ludo

70010000124845.description:
This roguelike card game, themed around the world of the Chinese zodiac, is accessible to everyone. It features a plethora of cute, fun, and even quirky illustrated cards! Each of the twelve zodiac characters has their own unique characteristics, so you can start with your own zodiac sign or your favorite character. The maps, cards, and enemy characters change randomly each time you play.

There are over 150 different cards! Victory is achieved by reducing the enemy leader's HP to zero using the attack power written on each card! Besides battle spaces, the map features shop spaces where you can buy your favorite cards, gacha spaces where you can randomly obtain cards, and event spaces where good and bad events occur, leading to various encounters and new adventures. Enjoy different gameplay and strategies using decks that vary depending on your zodiac sign and difficulty level!
70010000124845.intro:
A roguelike card game themed around the world of the Chinese zodiac
Simple rules and controls make it enjoyable for everyone
70010000124845.name: YURU-ETO Card Battle

70010000124860.description:
"CYBER CYCLES" is a racing game released by NAMCO LIMITED (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1995.
This game featured a large bike-style cabinet design that stood out at arcades at the time.
Set against the backdrop of near-future motorcycle racing, choose from a lineup of unique machines with different performance features, and cross the finish line ahead of all your rivals!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.
70010000124860.intro: It all comes down to cornering! Know the track, and attack!
70010000124860.name: Arcade Archives CYBER CYCLES

70010000124901.description:
This is a classic tale of rescuing maidens from dangerous villains such as goblins, trolls, werewolves, harpies, and other dark creatures. You will encounter them across a variety of locations throughout the game world.

Your choices directly influence the story and the progression of the main character. Certain paladin abilities depend on your moral path and personal discipline. Multiple endings await, shaped by the decisions you make along the way.

Game features:

- Meaningful moral choices that affect both survival and story progression

- High-stakes decisions where every choice matters

- A familiar fantasy storyline with a humorous twist

- Play as an unconventional paladin hero

- Player decisions influence character development and the final outcome

- Rescue maidens and become their hero

- Japanese voice-over

- Dynamic battles and engaging QTE-based activities

- Optional caravan raids

- Beautifully animated scenes
70010000124901.intro: An interactive adventure about a paladin torn between duty and desire.
70010000124901.name: Damsels in Distress

70010000124907.description:
Step into the chaos of ZOMBIE CAM: Bodycam Shooter, where every heartbeat counts and the undead are closing in. Feel the tension as you navigate dark corridors, dimly lit streets, and abandoned buildings, every step bringing danger closer.
Arm yourself with a mix of weapons and gear, from rifles and pistols to flashlights and grenades, and adapt on the fly to survive relentless waves of zombies. Each map offers a new challenge, each wave a test of courage—and every second matters.

Features:
• Immerse yourself in a gritty bodycam perspective
• Fight through waves of slow, fast, and cunning zombies
• Explore three unique, atmospheric maps
• Tense, time-limited action that keeps you on edge
• Strategic combat with weapons and tactical gear

Do you have what it takes to survive the night? Every shot, every move, every decision could be your last.
70010000124907.intro: Can you escape before the undead surround you?
70010000124907.name: ZOMBIE CAM BODY CAM SHOOTER

70010000124913.description:
Defend the gates. Survive the siege.
Step into a medieval battlefield where your strategy and skill decide the fate of the kingdom. Build defenses, fight back, and hold your fortress against relentless waves of invaders.
Prepare your defenses, place towers, and get ready for incoming waves of enemies. Each enemy type requires a different approach — from fast attackers to heavily armored units and powerful siege weapons that threaten to break your gates.
You are not just a commander — you fight alongside your defenses. Use your crossbow and repair structures during battle to keep your fortress standing. Every decision matters as the pressure increases with each wave.
Earn resources by defeating enemies and use them wisely to build new defenses or upgrade existing ones. Balance your strategy between offense and defense to handle growing threats and survive until the final wave.
With every attack, the battlefield becomes more intense, forcing you to adapt, reposition, and react quickly to protect your base at all costs.
Key Features:
	•	Combine FPS combat with tower defense gameplay
	•	Build and upgrade defensive structures
	•	Survive waves of increasingly powerful enemies
	•	Fight actively using weapons
	•	Manage resources to strengthen your defense
	•	Face diverse enemy types and strategic challenges
Stand your ground, defend your kingdom, and survive every wave.
70010000124913.intro: Stand between chaos and the kingdom!
70010000124913.name: Medieval Castle Siege Defense vs Invaders

70010000124931.description:
TAMASHIKA is a fast-paced arcade-style corridor shooter focused on flow, precision, and survival.

Move through shifting environments, react quickly, and stay locked in. Each run is about control, timing, and keeping your mind in one place.

Patterns in the world create a sense of continuity, but everything is in motion. Focus is what keeps you alive.

Features:
TAMASHIKA is a fast-paced arcade-style corridor shooter with hand-drawn animations, precision sound effects, and upbeat background music.

You get:
One weapon: a semi-automatic pistol
One side-arm: a tanto blade
70010000124931.name: Tamashika

70010000124955.description:
Prepare for a delightful mission in a romantic landscape. Every corner hides a fluffy surprise just waiting to be petted!

Enter a charming black-and-white world filled with adorable cats, romance, and specially themed locations. In 100 Romantic Hidden Cats, you embark on a journey where your task is to bring this wonderful world to life by finding all the hidden furry friends. Each location is designed in the style of a detailed coloring book, but within this simplicity lies a true challenge! Explore every corner, look closely, and discover cats hiding in unexpected places.

Game Features:
• Unique visual style: each level looks like a coloring book.
• Unique locations to explore.
• 100 adorable cats, masterfully hidden on each map.
• Real meow sounds!
• Color magic: tap a cat and it instantly turns vibrant.
• Cozy gameplay experience: search, explore, and make the world a little brighter!

Explore. Search. Discover. Bring the world to life, one cat at a time!
70010000124955.intro: Can you find every cat hiding in this romantic world?
70010000124955.name: 100 Romantic Hidden Cats

70010000124962.description:
The world around you is frozen in black and white, awaiting your touch to bring it to life. In 100 Korean Hidden Cats, you embark on a journey where your task is to bring this real world to life by finding all the hidden furry friends. Each location is designed in the style of an elegant coloring book, but within this tranquility lies a true challenge. Explore every corner, pay attention, and bring color back to this wonderful world.

Game Features:
	•	Unique visual style: each game looks like a detailed coloring book.
	•	4 unique locations to explore.
	•	100 adorable cats, masterfully hidden on each map.
	•	Color magic: tap a cat and it instantly turns vibrant.
	•	Entertaining gameplay: search, explore, and bring life to the world.
	•	Perfect for relaxation and wellness.


100 Korean Hidden Cats is a meditative adventure where every cat you find makes the world a little brighter. Look closely, notice the elusive, and become a master of the search in this cozy black-and-white universe. The world is waiting for you to add color—will you find them all?
70010000124962.intro: Will you discover all 100 adorable hidden cats?
70010000124962.name: 100 Korean Hidden Cats

70010000124968.description:
Welcome to a colorful world of candy, adventure, and survival. You play as a brave little gummy bear stranded on a mysterious sweet island, where escaping will require more than just finding the way home.

Explore the island, gather valuable resources, and visit different workshops to craft and improve the tools you need for your journey. At your campsite, develop your character's abilities and become stronger, faster, and better prepared for the challenges ahead.

You won't have to face the island alone. Along the way, you'll meet friendly companions who can join you and help gather resources, making your journey a little easier.

Discover the secrets of the sweet island, upgrade your abilities, collect resources, and find a way to escape.
70010000124968.intro: Your adventure may be sweet, but survival won't be easy.
70010000124968.name: Sweet Land Survival

70010000124999.description:
For the first time, your favorite characters are traveling without the kids and enjoying time together.
Exploring new places, and soaking up the atmosphere of true romance.
This is more than just a hidden object game. It’s a heartfelt story about love, discovery, and the beauty of the world around us.

What's new in Trip to Europe 12 Romantic Tour:
- Even more locations and details — every place is crafted with love and care for atmosphere.
- All-new scenes and puzzles — vibrant, varied, and full of charm.
- Enhanced search mechanics — more interactivity, diversity, and gameplay satisfaction.
- A cozy love story — romantic strolls, warm moments, and true closeness in scenic European settings.
- Updated design and interface — everything is smoother, more stylish, and easier to enjoy.
- Expanded souvenir collection — gather memorable items that capture the spirit of each country you visit.

Collector’s Edition includes:
- 18 extra locations
- 12 mini-games + 18 new puzzles
- A broader collection of unique souvenirs
70010000124999.intro: Set off on an unforgettable journey through the most picturesque corners of Europe. This time, just the two of you!
70010000124999.name: Trip to Europe 12 Romantic Tour Collector's Edition

70010000125068.description:
Lamp Clicker is a simple and addictive incremental / idle clicker game where your goal is to build your own… lamp empire.

You click the lamp.
The lamp starts to glow.
Your earnings increase.
You feel satisfaction.

You can unlock new lamps — from ordinary candles and oil lamps… to increasingly bizarre creations you’d rather not question (yes, we’re looking at you, Toilet Lamp).

You start to wonder… does this make any sense? You keep clicking…
70010000125068.intro: Build your lamp empire, one click at a time!
70010000125068.name: Lamp Clicker

70010000125096.description:
Step into the chaotic world of card trading, where hype and luck rule everything. Run your own shop, buy low, sell high, and hunt for rare collectibles. Deal with unpredictable customers and wild market swings as you try to stay ahead. Upgrade your store, expand your stock, and chase every profitable opportunity. Only sharp instincts and quick decisions will keep your business growing.

Key Features
• Fast-moving market with sudden price spikes and crashes
• Buy, sell, and trade a wide range of collectible cards
• Haggle with quirky customers and unpredictable buyers
• Find rare cards in flea markets, drops, and secret trades
• Upgrade your shop to attract bigger crowds
• High-risk, high-reward decisions that shape your empire

Do you have what it takes?
70010000125096.intro: Can you become the king of card trading?
70010000125096.name: Brainrot Card Market Simulator
70010000125096.publisher: Lu Ming trading as Shane Game

70010000125100.description: Minecraft Dungeons II is here with more action, more loot, and more adventure. Step through the rift and fight where no hero has been before: the Sift, an uncharted dimension teeming with threats, mysteries, and breathtaking beauty. Gear up and customize your playstyle to face your toughest enemies yet in explosive battles. Brave the unknown as a lone hero, team up with friends in couch, online and mixed co-op, or find allies through matchmaking. The illagers’ plot is already underway, and their cruelty is only matched by their power. Stop them – or lose the Overworld to their corruption.
70010000125100.intro: A new threat descends upon the Overworld...
70010000125100.name: Minecraft Dungeons II

70010000125115.description:
Feel the adrenaline of Wheelie Life Simulator, the ultimate motorcycle skill game where balance is everything. Ride on one wheel, push your limits, and prove your mastery in a world built for precision and thrills. Every ride is a test of control, focus, and daring — from quiet city streets to wide open countryside, this game is all about perfecting the art of the wheelie. Stylish, immersive, and endlessly challenging, it’s not just a ride — it’s your journey to becoming a wheelie legend.

Key Features
• Master the Wheelie — Control throttle, brakes, and bike angle to stay perfectly balanced.
• Realistic Physics — Every surface and movement affects your ride, making precision essential.
• Upgrade & Customize — Improve engine, brakes, weight, and speed; unlock new bikes and skins.
• Career & Free Mode — Complete challenges or ride freely to perfect your skills.
• Explore New Locations — Unlock city streets, countryside roads, and night routes as you progress.

Balance, skill, and patience — that’s what it takes to dominate Wheelie Life Simulator. Stay on one wheel, chase your limits, and become the ultimate wheelie pro.
70010000125115.intro: Master the art of the perfect wheelie and become a true riding legend.
70010000125115.name: Wheelie Life Simulator

70010000125164.description: Monster Slingshot Smash is a fast-paced arcade puzzle game where players launch quirky monsters from a slingshot and smash enemy towers in bright, colorful worlds. Aim carefully, trigger satisfying chain reactions, destroy crazy structures, and defeat hilarious blue monsters across fun and challenging levels. Easy to pick up and hard to put down, the game combines simple controls, explosive action, and playful visuals into a highly addictive mobile experience.
70010000125164.intro: Launch, smash, and conquer in a colorful slingshot adventure packed with action, destruction, and fun.
70010000125164.name: Monster Slingshot Smash

70010000125170.description:
Drifting in the silence of space, you awaken aboard a damaged orbital station. Systems are failing, oxygen is running low, and every sound echoes through cold metal corridors. This isn’t a story about conquering space—it’s about surviving it.

Explore the station in zero gravity, restore critical systems, and keep yourself alive against the odds. Repair broken modules, manage life support, and craft essential tools using limited resources. Every action matters, and every mistake brings you closer to the end.

Guided by a small AI drone, you’ll navigate through a tense and atmospheric environment where isolation, danger, and discovery go hand in hand.

Key Features:
• Monitor oxygen levels and maintain life support systems
• Repair damaged modules, pipelines, and power nodes
• Perform hands-on mini-games to restore station functionality
• Navigate and control movement in zero gravity
• Collect resources and craft essential survival tools
• Manage limited supplies while exploring the station

Stay focused, manage your resources, and fight to survive in the cold emptiness of space.
70010000125170.intro: Can you keep the station alive long enough to save yourself?
70010000125170.name: Astronaut Simulator

70010000125184.description:
Make your dream come true and become a K-Pop Star in this exciting life sim and rhythm game!

Together with your best friend Nova, you've always dreamed of making your mark in the world of K-Pop… Now it's time to shine! Throw yourself into the race for fame and let your talent sparkle, from the practice rooms to the stage!
Create a group that reflects who you are and, together, set out to conquer the world's biggest stages. Take inspiration from your idols and grow your fan community on social media!

Music is your world, and passion is your driving force: you are the future of K-Pop!

- An Adventure That Suits You
Customise your character to match your style and performances: clothes, make-up… everything is possible!

- Your Group, Your Rules!
You run the show: create your group, recruit its members and grow your fan community!

- Keep up the Pace!
Fine-tune your singing, dance routines and sense of rhythm to become a fully-fledged star!

- From Your Bedroom to the World's Biggest Stages
Start at the bottom, work your way up with your passion and talent, and become the icon you've always dreamt of being!

- Shine Solo, Triumph as a Trio!
Experience the adventure on your own or with two friends: form the group of your dreams and lead it to the very top of K-Pop!

- A 100% K-pop, 100% original soundtrack!
Enjoy every note of a soundtrack crafted especially for K-pop fans!
70010000125184.intro: Make your dream come true and become a K-Pop Star in this exciting life sim and rhythm game!
70010000125184.name: K-Pop Rising - Dream to Shine

70010000125202.description: Cloud Golf is a relaxing and visually charming mini golf game that takes players on a journey high above the clouds. Set in a bright pastel sky world, the game features floating courses, smooth curves, creative layouts, and satisfying shots designed to feel both calming and fun. Each level offers a mix of simple controls, clever course design, and light challenge, making the game easy to enjoy for casual players while still rewarding precision and skill. With its cheerful atmosphere, soft visuals, and accessible gameplay, Cloud Golf delivers a lighthearted mini golf experience that feels fresh, peaceful, and fun for players of all ages.
70010000125202.name: Cloud Golf

70010000125220.description:
The young sorceress Elvy sets off on a journey to pass her exam and become a true witch.
She will encounter all kind of wonders along the way!
Immerse yourself in hidden object scenes, use Match 3 to gather magical energy, and collect magical artifacts.

- Embark on a journey to a magical place!
- Discover new hidden objects!
- Familiar gameplay with all new features!
70010000125220.intro: Avoid dangers and help Elvy become a real sorceress!
70010000125220.name: Hiddenius: Sorceress Journey

70010000125241.description:
Step into a future where happiness is curated by artificial intelligence, in this gentle-paced puzzle adventure.

The Utopia Project was created in the interest of maximizing human happiness and comfort. As the newest residential Facilitator at D-topia, your role is to resolve issues around the residential community. Tackle fun logic-based puzzles to resolve mechanical issues and keep the facilities running smoothly and meet the many vibrant residents, each with their own unique story and personal struggle.

But what happens when problems go beyond the mechanical? How will your choices impact the wellbeing of the residents, and the future of humanity? In a world of curated happiness, what does it mean to find purpose?

Features:
* A Gentle-Paced, Reflective Adventure: Unwind in a calm, yet thought-provoking journey to discover what happiness truly means.

* Clever, Integrated Puzzles: Tackle satisfying logic puzzles that connect to the heart of this gentle-paced adventure.

* Meet D-topia’s Residents: Gain their trust, discover their stories, and shape their futures in unexpected ways.

* Your Choices Matter: Guide this artificial intelligence-managed utopia toward joy or despair through your decisions.

* Step Into Two Worlds: Move between the bright, public reality and the hidden “Block Side” to fix glitches and uncover secrets.
70010000125241.name: D-topia

70010000125295.description:
Step into a world where magic is real and the girls are irresistibly adorable. Pastel skies, glowing stars, and kawaii anime girls with powers that match their charm, this is the cutest place you've ever been.

Play through the minigames and watch your score open up the gallery, one stunning image at a time. The higher you climb, the more they reveal.

From bubbly and bright magical girls to mysteriously enchanting magical girls, each one has her own personality and her own way of rooting for you mid-game. They notice when you're winning.

Think you've got what it takes to unlock every single one?


Features:

● EVERY MODE, A REASON TO KEEP GOING: Test your mind and your reflexes while climbing the scoreboard. Every point counts toward unlocking more.

● UNLOCK EXCLUSIVE IMAGES: Score higher, unlock more. The gallery fills up as you get better, and every image is worth it.

● KAWAII CHARACTER PERSONALITIES: Every girl reacts, cheers, and teases you throughout the game. No two feel the same.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: How the story closes depends on you. Some endings are sweeter than others.

● HIDDEN FINAL MOMENT: Reach question 150 and discover the secret that's been waiting for you the whole time.


These magical girls are waiting to be found. The gallery won't fill itself.
Start playing and see how far your score takes you.

Are you ready?
70010000125295.intro:
Spells, sparkles, and the cutest girls you've ever seen.
Play, score, and unlock them all.
70010000125295.name: Kawaii Anime: Cute Girls Magic World

70010000125301.description:
Welcome to a world that's equal parts glittery and gorgeous, where kawaii anime boys with magical powers are waiting to be discovered.

Bright colors, soft pastels, and boys so cute they make the whole world feel a little warmer.

Play through the minigames, rack up your score, and watch the gallery unlock one boy at a time. The better you play, the closer you get.

From sweet and shy magical boys to confidently magical ones, each boy has a personality all his own, and yes, they cheer you on while you play.

Ready to find your favorite?


Features:

● EVERY MODE, A REASON TO KEEP GOING: Test your mind and your reflexes while climbing the scoreboard. Every point counts toward unlocking more.

● UNLOCK EXCLUSIVE IMAGES: Your score unlocks the gallery. Every new image is a reward worth earning.

● KAWAII CHARACTER PERSONALITIES: Each boy reacts to your gameplay in his own way. Some are encouraging, some are playfully competitive.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: The ending you get depends on how you play. Some paths lead somewhere special.

● HIDDEN FINAL MOMENT: Hit question 150 and unlock the secret scene that only the most dedicated players ever reach.


The magic world is full of magical boys worth discovering. Your gallery is waiting. Start playing and see who you find.

Are you ready?
70010000125301.intro:
Magic, minigames, and boys cute enough to cast a spell on you.
Play more, unlock more, fall harder.
70010000125301.name: Kawaii Anime: Cute Boys Magic World

70010000125323.description:
In Waterpark Manager Simulator, you take control of a small, local pool and transform it into a massive, bustling aqua park. Manage the rides, expand the facilities, and keep the guests happy as you develop a thriving entertainment empire.

Take charge of every aspect of your water park, from the slides and wave pools to the splash zones and relaxing rivers. Make quick decisions, solve unexpected issues, and maintain the fun even when the crowds become demanding. As your park grows, hire staff to maintain the rides, clean the areas, and handle the rising number of visitors.

Upgrade attractions, unlock new zones, and design your park’s layout to create the perfect summer destination. Every choice you make, whether improving flow, building new slides, or managing busy days, brings your water park closer to becoming the top spot for guests of all ages.

Build, manage, and expand your water park to make it the number one place to cool off!
70010000125323.intro: Build your summer water park adventure!
70010000125323.name: Waterpark Manager Simulator

70010000125333.description:
'The Game of LIFE' is a board game where you can experience a rollercoaster life.
Spin the roulette and move your piece the number of spaces you land on—then enjoy a variety of events triggered by the space you stop on.
Whether you live for work or for love—your way of living is up to you!

The game ends when everyone reaches the finish point, and your rank is determined by your total assets.
70010000125333.intro:
Create your own avatar, spin the roulette, and grow your character!
Whether you live for work or for love—your way of living i
70010000125333.name: the Game of LIFE for Nintendo Switch

70010000125384.description:
Escape Tsunami for Brainrots is a fast-paced survival runner where a massive wave crashes behind you while dozens of bizarre brainrot characters wait ahead, ready to earn you millions of coins per second. Grab as many as you can carry and sprint back to base before the tsunami swallows the corridor.

The deeper you push into the corridor, the rarer and more valuable the brainrots become. Common ones bring in thousands of coins, while Legendary, Cosmic and Celestial brainrots generate millions. But the reward grows with the risk, and one mistake or a single second of hesitation lets the wave take everything you have collected.

Spend your hard-earned coins upgrading your base. Boost brainrot income, running speed, carry speed and base size to unlock new collection slots. Use the rebirth system to reset your progress in exchange for a permanent income multiplier and reach the rarest creatures.

Open lucky blocks and alien lucky blocks for random rewards, sacrifice common brainrots to the machine for a chance at upgraded versions, and hunt the divine characters that appear at the very end of the corridor.

Dozens of unique brainrots, constant base upgrades and a leaderboard where you can climb to the top in coins earned and top speed. Fully single-player, play at your own pace with no online connection required.
70010000125384.intro: Sprint down the corridor, grab brainrots and escape a massive tsunami. Upgrade your base, unlock rare characters and climb the leaderboard.
70010000125384.name: Escape Tsunami For Brainrots

70010000125390.intro: Build incredible creations brick by brick in a relaxing 3D construction puzzle adventure. Complete detailed models, unlock new sets, and become the ultimate tiny builder.
70010000125390.name: Legolast Tiny Builder

70010000125399.description:
Alone in a frozen wilderness, every decision could be the difference between survival and a cold, silent end.

Explore a vast winter forest from a first-person perspective. Gather wood, stone, iron, berries, and other essential resources before hunger, freezing temperatures, or wild predators catch up with you. Craft the tools, weapons, clothing, and supplies you need to stay alive.

Turn an empty patch of wilderness into a secure survival base. Build a shelter, furnish it with a workbench, bed, and furnace, light a campfire, and prepare for the dangers waiting beyond its walls.

Hunt wolves, deer, hares, and birds using a bow, rifle, or shotgun. Cook food, monitor your health, hunger, and body temperature, and adapt as day gives way to night.

Your struggle is not only about survival. Explore the forest, complete story quests, uncover its secrets, and discover what happened to your missing father.

KEY FEATURES

• Explore an open winter wilderness
• Gather resources and craft essential equipment
• Build and furnish your own shelter
• Hunt wildlife and defend yourself from predators
• Survive cold, hunger, injuries, and changing conditions
• Experience a full day-and-night cycle
• Follow story quests and search for your missing father

Can you master the frozen forest and survive another day?
70010000125399.intro: Brave the frozen wilderness, build a shelter, and survive one more night.
70010000125399.name: WinterCraft: Survival in the Forest

70010000125420.description:
Step into the boots of a lone warrior in a relentless fight against overwhelming enemy forces. In this intense one-man army experience, you’ll face wave after wave of opponents, each more dangerous than the last. Armed with skill, precision, and an evolving arsenal, you must adapt quickly, using smart tactics and lightning-fast reflexes to survive the chaos.

As the battle rages on, unlock powerful upgrades, devastating weapons, and unique abilities that transform your fighting style. Every encounter pushes you to the limit, demanding careful positioning, perfect timing, and strategic decision-making. Whether you prefer aggressive assaults or calculated defense, the game rewards creativity and mastery in combat.

With fast-paced action, escalating difficulty, and nonstop adrenaline, this is a true test of endurance and skill. Stand alone, fight without backup, and prove that one soldier is all it takes to conquer impossible odds.
70010000125420.intro:
A lone warrior stands against overwhelming odds, battling relentless waves of enemies with skill and grit.
Master fast-paced combat and survive intense encounters.
70010000125420.name: One Man Army

70010000125469.description:
Set forth on your quest to [INSERT GOAL HERE] with one of the worthy yet quirky heroes in solo or cooperative play, local and online. Hack, slash, and dodge through hordes of enemies and deadly traps in procedurally generated runs of hand-crafted rooms and levels using each hero's unique attacks and abilities to your advantage.

Sharp reflexes and split-second decisions are crucial to survival as the intensity ratchets up as each run delivers new surprises, branching paths, and unrelenting bosses to conquer. Gobble up coins to spend at Bruce & Goose's Shoppe as you take a breath from the action to gain new perks, devastating attacks and summoned allies. Stack them right, and you'll unleash screen-filling destruction of arcade legend.

Keep an eye out for secrets among the chaos as this land holds many mysteries with new paths and locations, new heroes to rescue and add to your roster, and more…

Double Trouble
Charge forth alone or bring a co-op buddy to tackle dungeons together, combine powerful attacks and revive one another if you fall in battle.

Choose Your Own Adventure
Each run offers hand-crafted screens, unique bosses, and evolving routes shaped by player choices and quests.

Rogue's Gallery
Unlock nine distinctive heroes with unique skills, side objectives, and customizable trinkets that alter gameplay.

Arcade Alchemy
Chain perks and elemental powers through combat performance for explosive, high-reward playstyles.
70010000125469.intro: Dark Scrolls is a fantasy-themed action platformer that fuses shmup-style chaos with roguelite progression and is packed with charm, challenge, and secrets.
70010000125469.name: Dark Scrolls

70010000125473.description:
Step into the role of a truly hands-on mayor and shape your town from the ground up.

Plan neighbourhoods, optimise logistics networks, and help your community grow - all while juggling workers, infrastructure, suspiciously large tools, visiting robots, aliens & dinosaurs, and the general day-to-day chaos of building your dream town.

And when mayoral duties get a little much, take a break with a spot of fishing, have a spin on the Go-Kart track, or even high-five a cow.

Play solo for perfect control, or bring friends for co-op mayhem.

Grow Your Town

Lay down your streets, then place businesses, homes, and services where they’ll thrive. Welcome tourists, keep them happy, and give them plenty of reasons to stick around and make your town their home. Hire workers, keep shops stocked, and make sure the money keeps flowing, then upgrade, expand, and unlock new ways to help your town flourish.

Optimise, Automate, Prosper

Tailor each business, industry zone and building configuration to suit your wants and needs. Assign workers, optimise supply chains, set-up logistics networks and watch your systems flourish. Will you let automation do the heavy lifting, or will you be the Mayor of Micromanagement?

Bring The Style

As mayor, style starts at home, but it doesn't stop there. Dive into immersive house customisation with full 360° placement and a handy colour picker, then take that creative control across your town with recoloured buildings, and plenty of ways to make every street, shop, and neighbourhood feel uniquely yours. Need a new look while you work? Step into the Change-O-Tron and emerge as the mayor you were always meant to be. Your town. Your mayor. Your style.

Chaotic Co-Op

Team-up with up with another mayor, in either local and online play for just the right amount of teamwork and chaos. Build together, manage together, panic together, and discover how quickly a carefully planned town can go sideways when everyone has a different idea of ‘helping’.
70010000125473.intro: Time to roll up your sleeves, Mayor!
70010000125473.name: Go-Go Town!

70010000125479.description:
Tiny Crown is a fast-paced pixel-art platformer where you guide a brave little king through a castle full of traps, spikes, and dangerous jumps. Run, leap, and survive your way across handcrafted levels that test your timing, precision, and patience.
Don’t let the charming retro visuals fool you — every room is a challenge. One wrong move, and the castle will punish you. But with skill, persistence, and sharp reflexes, even the smallest ruler can conquer the deadliest dungeon.
70010000125479.intro: A tiny king. A huge challenge.
70010000125479.name: Tiny Crown

70010000125485.description: Witchfall is a dark fantasy platformer where precision, timing, and courage are the only way forward. Leap through haunted forests, deadly traps, and floating ruins as a mysterious witch drifts deeper into a cursed world filled with spikes, shadows, and ancient magic. Every level is a test of reflexes, patience, and survival.
70010000125485.intro: A cursed leap through shadow and thorn.
70010000125485.name: Witchfall

70010000125503.description:
Get ready for a microscopic battle full of strategy in Immunuzzle, an engaging pixel art puzzle where every move can change everything. Use pieces inspired by the immune system to contain a spreading infection, turning each decision into a true test of planning and intelligence.

Choose your pieces carefully, place each one with precision, and watch the infection react immediately to every move. Here, no action comes without consequences. Every placement shapes the future of the board, blocks paths, and completely redefines the threat.

With constantly evolving challenges, you will face increasingly complex layouts, tight chokepoints, and infection patterns that demand quick thinking and strategic vision. This is not just about filling spaces, it is about mastering the field, controlling the spread, and turning chaos into order.

With retro visuals full of personality, smart mechanics, and that satisfying feeling of solving something tough, Immunuzzle delivers a unique experience. Perfect for players who love challenging puzzles, impactful decisions, and hard-earned victories.

Observe, plan, and fight the infection until you take full control.
70010000125503.intro: Defend the Body, Control the Chaos
70010000125503.name: Immunuzzle

70010000125509.description:
Prepare yourself to challenge your logic in an adventure deep in the heart of the desert, where every movement could be your last. In Sands and Relics, walking is just as dangerous as it is necessary, and every step changes the world beneath your feet.

Cross ancient ruins, explore fragile pathways, and uncover hidden relics in clever puzzles that blend strategy, planning, and that satisfying feeling of discovering the perfect solution. Here, the ground waits for no one. Sand tiles crack, collapse, and disappear as you move forward, turning the environment into a living puzzle.

Each level is a compact logic challenge where you must think before acting, calculate routes, and carefully decide where to step. Some surfaces can withstand more than one step, while others collapse immediately, and a single mistake can leave you trapped in the void.

As the journey continues, new mechanics make the puzzles even more creative, including teleporters, narrow paths, and combinations that demand full awareness of the environment. All of this comes wrapped in charming pixel art visuals that create a cozy atmosphere while keeping your mind engaged.

With 30 carefully crafted levels, simple controls, and the freedom to undo moves or restart whenever you want, Sands and Relics delivers an accessible, smart, and deeply satisfying experience for players who love strategic puzzles without time pressure.

Observe the terrain, plan your route, and discover whether your footsteps will be enough to reach the lost relic.
70010000125509.name: Sands and Relics

70010000125515.description:
Get ready for an adventure full of discovery, strategy, and tropical charm. In The Pirate Keko, you take control of a charismatic pirate monkey in search of hidden treasures across mysterious islands, where each level is much more than it first appears.

Here, every level is a clever puzzle divided into two connected parts. First, you must explore the environment, manipulate blocks, activate mechanisms, and find the Treasure Map. But that is only the beginning. Once you collect it, the game reveals a new layer of the challenge: the Treasure Chest appears, and the same scenario must be reinterpreted using everything you have already changed.

Color-coded platforms, pressure buttons, breakable crates, hazards, and enemies create dynamic situations that demand planning and creativity. Every action matters, as what you do in the first half directly impacts the solution of the second.

With a fixed camera that lets you see the entire scene, the experience is clear, strategic, and focused on spatial reasoning. You are not just moving forward, you are transforming the environment step by step until you find the perfect path.

With short, clever, and highly satisfying challenges, The Pirate Keko delivers that unique "now I get it" feeling with every completed level.

Observe, experiment, adapt, and discover. Because here, finding the map is only half of the adventure.
70010000125515.intro: The Treasure Is Only the Beginning
70010000125515.name: The Pirate Keko

70010000125523.description:
Cosmic Mirage is an exciting side-scrolling shooter that takes the player on an exciting space adventure. Sinister forces have taken over peaceful planets in the galaxy, turning them into empty space mirages. Your mission is to become the last reliable pilot  and free them from the sinister invader.

An epic journey awaits you through varied landscapes and battles with different types of enemies. Planets that were once sources of life and prosperity have now become places of darkness and strife. Each world presents unique challenges, and the trapped inhabitants need your liberating intervention.
70010000125523.name: Cosmic Mirage

70010000125529.description:
Welcome to your new culinary adventure! With smart choices, a tasty menu, and a flair for interior design, you can transform this humble spot into the most popular restaurant in town. However, a great cafe is nothing without its regulars, and your customers are some of the most eccentric, hilarious, and quirky folks you will ever meet!

Get ready to put on your apron and take charge of every aspect of the restaurant business. Seat your hungry customers, take their orders, cook delicious meals, and serve them with a smile. Each satisfied customer will leave you with money and tips that you can reinvest in your growing business.

As your cafe's popularity skyrockets, so will its success. Use your profits to upgrade your kitchen equipment, expand your dining area, and decorate to your liking. You can even hire a team of quirky staff members to help you keep up with the steady stream of customers. Every visitor has their own unique personality and favorite dishes, from fussy foodies to eccentric neighbors. Do you have the time management skills to keep the whole town fed and happy? Will they keep coming back for more?
70010000125529.name: Funny Folks Cafe

70010000125562.description:
Enter the Vault of Power, where every battle is a test of strategy, preparation, and the build you create. Assemble your forces, combine powerful abilities, and face unpredictable dungeon encounters in an autobattler roguelike where no two runs are the same.

Build Your Perfect Strategy:

- Combine over 50 unique spells to create powerful and unpredictable builds.
- Strategically position your units and prepare for every battle.
- Watch your strategy unfold as battles play out automatically.
- Explore randomized encounters where every run brings new challenges.
- Harness unique class bonuses with powerful abilities from the Necromancer, Druid, Mage.

Experiment with different combinations, adapt your strategy, and push deeper into dangerous dungeons. Every decision shapes your build, and every run offers a new opportunity to become stronger.

Build. Adapt. Conquer.
70010000125562.intro: Build your power and conquer the challenging dungeons!
70010000125562.name: Vault of Power

70010000125570.description:
Discover and record 90+ plants, creatures, and fish at various locations around Shimmerbrook, and contribute your findings to the Archive.

Features
- Tame and raise 32 unique creatures
- Observe wild plants and grow them as crops based on different requirements
- Meet over 20 townsfolk, attend town festivals, go on hangout events
- Date and marry one of the 10 romanceable candidates
- Dig deep into the mines, fish, solve puzzles and uncover the mystery behind Shimmerbrook
- Cook, craft, build, and more!

Your life as a researcher starts today!
70010000125570.intro: Tame creatures, grow crops, and record your findings!
70010000125570.name: Research Story

70010000125576.description:
Such a Guy is a first-person narrative game that blends live-action interactive storytelling with light management gameplay. You play as Zane Zheng, a young man who leaves his city job in search of meaning and, together with two close friends, renovates a lakeside guesthouse by the sea. Featuring cinematic-grade filming, real actors, and on-location shooting, the game offers a deeply immersive experience. It combines branching narratives, relationship development, and exploration to create a lifelike yet open-ended interactive journey.

With nearly 1,000 minutes of 4K HD footage at its core, the game incorporates a relationship system and branching events. Players face hundreds of decision points, each influencing the characters' fates and the progression of the story. Over 20 different endings are available, along with side mini-games, hidden surprises, memorable scenes, and an achievement system to encourage exploration and replayability.

Key Features

• 4K cinematic visuals with real actors, natural lighting, and film-style editing—blurring the line between games and film.
• Dual storylines of relationships and guesthouse management, with hundreds of choices for a branching narrative.
• Side plots, mini-games, and events add rhythm and depth to the story.
• Romance six unique heroines—your. Your bond depends on choices and interaction.
• Achievements and hidden scenes support replays and unlock a whole life experience.
70010000125576.intro: One choice, one journey; a moment in time, all possibilities.
70010000125576.name: Such a Guy

70010000125585.description:
Open a new chapter of the beloved series and immerse yourself once again in an atmosphere of warmth, comfort, and peaceful hidden object searching.
Sweet Home: Look and Find 6 is a true soulful retreat, filled with attention to detail and the quiet joy of every found item.

What awaits you in the new game?

Even more hidden object scenes
You’ll explore 18 main hidden object locations and 18 bonus scenes—cozy homes, gardens, verandas, and vivid interiors brimming with detail and mood. Every scene is handcrafted to bring you the feeling of genuine homey warmth.

Your favorite gameplay—perfected
Classic hidden object searching has become even more comfortable and diverse. Relax, explore, and enjoy the process—no rush, no stress.

Mini-games for relaxation and focus
The game includes 11 mini-games and 11 bonus mini-games that gently train your attention and logic. The perfect balance between calm and engaging challenge.

An atmosphere you’ll want to return to
Sweet Home 6 isn’t just a set of levels. It’s a feeling of home, care, and quiet joy. Every moment matters: morning light in the room, carefully arranged objects, and a sense of harmony.

Collector’s Edition includes:
- 18 bonus hidden object scenes
- 11 additional mini-games
- Exclusive content for deeper immersion
- Delightful bonuses for true fans of the series
70010000125585.name: Sweet Home 6: Look and Find Collector's Edition

70010000125593.description:
Join Dog Man and his Supa Buddies for a supa-new adventure! A comic-book style game packed with action, humor, boss fights, and ability-granting gadgets. Play as 10 different characters from the comics, each with unique powers.

A hero is needed! Dr. Scum has set up Hypno Screens around the city, mind-controlling the innocent townsfolk. Now it’s up to Dog Man - part Dog, part Man- to fight back against Dr. Scum and all his minions. Defeat Dr. Scum, save your friends, and rescue the city!
A game based on the wonderful Dog Man comic books by artist Dav Pilkey, also known for Captain Underpants.

Bark in Action Features:
Work Together with the Supa Buddies
Switch between Dog Man and his Supa Buddies: Dog Man, Li'l Petey, 80HD. Each has their own special abilities, to overcome obstacles and defeat Dr. Scum.  Phone in Friends to help you, like Commander Cupcake or Chief, for a total of 10 playable characters!

Explore 60 Action Packed Levels
Explore iconic locations from the Dog Man universe, such as the Cat Jail and Robo-Time Industries. Beat the clock in the Time Challenges, and discover the Mystery Levels full of surprises!

Play Solo or with a Friend
Double the action by having a second player join with unique special abilities. Couch co-op the whole family can enjoy!

Discover Unlockable Outfits and Supa Gadgets
Collect sprockets to unlock crazy Gadgets. Collect yarn to craft cool new outfits like the Scarlet Shedder, Cat Kid and much more!

Stand up to Villains
Use each character's signature fighting move to take down Dr. Scum's minions and the Supa-Bad-Guy himself. Use clever teamwork to beat bosses!
70010000125593.intro: Join Dog Man and his Supa Buddies for a supa-new adventure! Packed with boss fights, awesome gadgets and up to 10 playable characters, each with unique abilities.
70010000125593.name: Dog Man: Bark in Action

70010000125620.description: Cage an angel. Ransack Heaven. In a far-flung dystopian future, the Angel Engine Initiative carries on as the last hope for humanity. Seal yourself in your operating room, perform surgery on comatose test subjects, and pray you make it out alive.
70010000125620.intro: A horror surgery sim based on the Angel Engine web series
70010000125620.name: Angel Engine

70010000125632.description:
Get ready for an explosion of jazz, cuteness, and organized chaos in To Bee Jazz, an irresistibly addictive puzzle where every drop can create the next big star of the band. Merge tiny musician bees, discover new evolutions, and transform a crowded stage into a spectacular show full of rhythm and personality.

Inspired by the most satisfying merge puzzles, the game blends light physics, strategic planning, and the perfect feeling of watching chain reactions unfold. Every bee bounces, slides, and finds its place while you try to stop the stage from becoming completely overcrowded.

Combine two identical bees to create increasingly sophisticated musicians and build a complete jazz band filled with instruments, style, and charm. But be careful: the more the board grows, the smarter your decisions need to be.

In Campaign Mode, missions and challenges test your creativity as you work to create specific bees for increasingly elaborate performances. In Endless Mode, the experience becomes even more strategic with special Power-Ups capable of shaking the stage, removing pieces, and reorganizing the chaos to keep the music alive for much longer.

With cozy visuals, a relaxing atmosphere, and a soundtrack full of personality, To Bee Jazz delivers the perfect combination of calm and strategy that makes you think “just one more run.”

Watch the stage, plan every drop, and let the jazz take over the hive.
70010000125632.intro: Drop the Beat, Merge the Bees, and Build the Perfect Band
70010000125632.name: To Bee Jazz

70010000125638.description:
Get ready for a sweet, clever and surprising puzzle where numbers and jellies come together in the most fun way possible. In Jelly Math, each colorful piece has a unique value and shape, and it is up to you to combine them strategically to form the perfect equation.

Nothing here is just about placing pieces. Every move influences the final result, and small changes can completely transform your solution. Choose, rotate and place your jellies while testing combinations, adjusting operators and finding the exact balance to reach the goal.

With challenges that grow in a smooth and creative way, you will deal with new elements that make everything even more interesting, such as modifiers that multiply values and spaces that require careful planning. All of this in light and cozy picnic-themed environments.

Colorful, relaxing and at the same time challenging, Jelly Math is perfect for players who love puzzles that stimulate thinking and reward each discovery with that delicious feeling of getting it right.

Experiment, adjust and find the perfect result in every level.
70010000125638.intro: Mix, Combine and Hit the Perfect Result
70010000125638.name: Jelly Math

70010000125674.description:
Flamecraft is a cozy, turn-based strategy board game for 1 to 5 players. Become a Flamekeeper and help artisan dragons and shopkeepers delight the townspeople with their craft. Gather and manage resources, enhance the shops by casting enchantments, and become the Master of Flamecraft.

Enter a cozy, vibrant world inhabited by dragons

Flamecraft is set in a fantasy world, in which dragons and magic are part of the ordinary. Here, you’ll meet the adorable artisan dragons, who will use their extraordinary flamecraft to help the town’s shopkeepers with their seemingly mundane tasks.
The sweets are just waiting to be baked in Guilty Treasures, and Scale Mail Post is ready to send enchanted letters all across the town!

Master the art of resource management and create powerful combos to increase your reputation

You’ll have to strategize and outsmart other Flamekeepers if you want to come out on top. There are countless ways to victory, and it’s up to you to make the most of your skills. Your main task is to thoughtfully place dragon artisans in the town’s bustling shopping district. They will help you gather various resources from the shops, which you can later use to cast enchantments, triggering powerful ability combos. You’ll also befriend the extraordinary Fancy Dragons, with abilities allowing you to boost your reputation.
This, along with the Companion cards, which offer powerful additional scoring opportunities, will let you get the reputation points needed to win the game.

Play in a variety of gameplay modes, both single and multiplayer

Whether you prefer playing solo, with friends, or people from around the world, Flamecraft has something in store for you. Test your skills against AI of varying difficulty or set up a relaxing custom game for your family to enjoy together.

Meet over 70 beautiful animated dragons and visit 30 unique shops while listening to a whimsical score

In Flamecraft, we’ve brought the enchanting world created by Sandara Tang to life. The beautifully illustrated dragons come to life as they use their craft in the vibrant, hand-painted town, full of animated 3D shops, booths, and laboratories.
Paweł Górniak, the composer behind Wingspan and Quilts and Cats of Calico, is also back, with another spellbinding score.

Will you be able to claim the Master of Flamecraft title with the help of your creative little crafter friends?
70010000125674.intro: Flamecraft is a 1-5 player cozy strategy game filled with magic.
70010000125674.name: Flamecraft

70010000125692.description:
Who says ships are only for the water? Why not take a voyage across a sea of clouds instead?

On a little island, floating in the sky, your adventure begins...
Hop on board your shining new airship and see what lies beyond the horizon! Gather your crew and explore regions of the sky where no one has ever been!

You'll discover all kinds of floating islands, from bustling tourist destinations to perilous monster-filled dungeons.
Develop your island, fend off monster attacks, and help your crew with their problems to earn fabulous rewards!

Use the resources you've earned to install new facilities on your ship and help your crew expand their know-how. With a stronger ship, and a more knowledgeable crew, you'll be able to explore islands from even further afield.

What new adventures and encounters await you in the vast blue sky? There's only one way to find out.
It's time to take off!
70010000125692.intro: Customize your airship and explore the world above the clouds in this sim RPG
70010000125692.name: Skyship Quest Story – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000125706.description:
◇What is “Syr and The Stars' Revival”?◇

Spica became a legendary Nextuber.
But her era of fame ended abruptly when she suddenly disappeared.
Fans mourned her and longed for her return—but no matter how long they waited, she never came back. Over time, the residents of the Cyber World where she once shined began to leave, one by one.
Now, several years after Spica vanished…

A new girl has appeared in the Cyber World, which is on the brink of collapse after losing its brightest star. She is ready to debut as a Nextuber.
Her name is Syr.
This is the story of her journey to restore the Cyber World's lost star.

◇3 Key Points to Enjoy the Game◇

[Point 1: Start Streaming to Gain Fans!]
The core cycle of the game is simple: earn Vitality → stream → gain fans.
You can earn Vitality through activities like doing part-time jobs and visiting arcades.
Spend the Vitality you earn to stream and grow your fanbase while also earning funds.
As your fan count increases, new story scenarios will unlock, the Cyber World will gradually be restored, and new part-time jobs and facilities will become available.
But be careful—it is crucial to not overwork Syr, or her mental state may collapse.

[Point 2: Develop Syr's Stats!]
Simply streaming won't earn you fans very efficiently.
In this game, you can hone Syr's stats by arranging various furniture and equipment in her agency's office. As her stats improve, your streams perform better, and the rewards you earn increase.
Some equipment even come with “Equipment Skills” that activate during streams. By combining these skills, you can make your broadcasts even more exciting!
Keep livening up the office and boost Syr's stats to make her stronger!

[Point 3: Experience a Rich Story with Unique Characters!]
While this is primarily a raising simulation game, the story is also a major focus, offering a heartwarming and emotionally touching experience.
Join Syr and help weave her story as it unfolds!
70010000125706.intro:
Streamer Raising SLG × Gentle & Heartwarming Story
A brand-new streamer raising simulation where building your room is the key to streaming success!
70010000125706.name: Syr and The Stars' Revival

70010000125729.description:
Bus, train and toilet friendly puzzle game created to test your power of logic.

Complete each level by turning all the tiles to a single colour.
All levels can be completed in 4 moves or less if you are skilled enough.

Good luck!!!

Features:
- 70 challenges to start, with more coming soon.
- Complete each level casually for a bronze or silver medal, or try and beat the game with all golds!
- Minimalistic visual and audio style.
- A Zen puzzling experience.
- Appropriate for all ages.
70010000125729.name: Full Colour Tiles

70010000125747.description:
Experience the Beauty of the Seasons! In this cozy hidden-object adventure, cats and friends explore the contrast between a frosty winter wonderland and a serene blooming garden. Every detail invites you to discover that whether in the snow or under falling petals, friendship and fun are always in season.

Start your journey in The Winter Resort, a bustling snow-covered village where everyday life unfolds with gentle humor. Watch playful kittens ice skating, enjoying snowball fun, and sipping hot cocoa in a frosty wonderland full of warm encounters and cozy winter joy.

Then, step into The Cherry Blossom Park to visit a tranquil Japanese-inspired setting. Explore a peaceful garden with elegant red bridges and lively street food stalls where cats celebrate the Hanami festival. Amidst the falling pink petals, discover that sharing quiet moments together is what truly makes spring magical.

Features:
- Cats and Friends: Find delightful characters in two detailed scenes -one from a snowy winter retreat and one from a relaxing floral park.
- Balloon-Popping Fun: Enjoy relaxing gameplay as you pop balloons across the scenes—a bit of fun with every search!
- Rich Details: Explore beautifully illustrated settings that blend festive winter elements and blooming nature with visual storytelling in every corner.
- Over 600 Items to Find! Search for 202 cats, 202 unique characters, and colorful balloons hidden throughout the seasons.
- Atmospheric Soundtrack: Set the tone with immersive music tailored to match each getaway—from cozy winter tunes to relaxing spring melodies.
- Family-Friendly Fun: With cozy, pressure-free gameplay and intuitive controls, it’s an experience for all ages. Perfect for relaxing together or playing solo.

Celebrate the comforting beauty of frost and flora in this heartwarming journey—where every moment is worth remembering.
70010000125747.intro: Join cute cats in a cozy getaway! Find feline friends and pop balloons as you explore a snowy winter village and a peaceful Japanese cherry blossom park.
70010000125747.name: Meow Moments: Celebrating Frost & Flora

70010000125753.description:
Collect puzzles with photorealistic images of girls in spectacular outfits, enjoy convenient touch controls and feel the process at your fingertips.

Relaxing music creates the right mood, and gradually increasing difficulty turns each level into an exciting challenge. After assembly, you can carefully examine each image and appreciate all the details.

Features:

• Photorealistic images.

• Realistic assembly process.

• Gradually increasing difficulty.

• Relaxing music.

• Detailed image viewing.
70010000125753.name: Hidden Pleasure: Closer and Closer

70010000125763.description:
Hexara is a puzzle game where strategy meets satisfying combo-building. Rotate clusters of hexagons to match colors, create powerful formations, and climb to higher levels.

Simple to learn, but difficult to master, every move matters as the grid evolves and new challenges appear. Chain combos, create rare formations, and push your score further with each run.

Featuring multiple game modes, increasing difficulty, and endless replayability, Hexara is perfect for quick sessions or long high-score chases.

How far can you go before the grid fills up?
70010000125763.intro:
Build combos, outsmart the grid, chase the perfect run. Perfect for fans of classic puzzle games.
Easy to pick up, hard to put down.
70010000125763.name: Hexara

70010000125769.description:
When the walls themselves seem to be alive, there is nowhere to hide. In Cornfield, you find yourself in the middle of a massive, suffocating maze of towering stalks. It is pitch black at night, the dirt paths twist into endless dead ends, and the only warning that you are being hunted is the chilling sound of rustling leaves. A relentless, terrifying monster tracks your every move through the shadows. This is not a combat game; it is a desperate test of navigation and survival.

Finding the exit is only half the battle. A series of complex puzzles and environmental challenges block your path to freedom and demand your full concentration. You must decipher clues and unlock new areas of the maze quickly yet carefully. The true terror of Cornfield lies in striking the right balance between logic and panic. Every second you spend standing still to crack a code gives the beast another second to close the distance.

Test your strategy and nerves in this heart-pounding escape adventure, where one wrong turn could be your last. Keep moving and think fast under pressure to conquer the maze before the terrifying creature catches up to you.

Will you outsmart the nightmare lurking in the fields, or will you be consumed by the harvest?
70010000125769.name: Cornfield

70010000125834.description:
Jump into a wildly unpredictable action adventure where a hot-headed rabbit leaves nothing but chaos in its wake. Battle through swarms of enemies, discover power-ups, and unleash ridiculous attacks as you carve a path through colorful comic-inspired arenas.

Gameplay features:

- Fast-Paced Arcade Brawling: Take on relentless waves of enemies in energetic battles filled with action and satisfying combat.

- Ever-Changing Runs: Choose from a variety of random enhancements and build a unique set of powers every time you play.

- Escalating Challenges: Survive increasingly dangerous enemy encounters that demand constant adaptation.

- Colorful Comic-Inspired Visuals: Explore vibrant arenas bursting with personality, humor, and stylized cartoon action.

Each battle offers opportunities to combine upgrades, experiment with unexpected abilities, and create powerful combinations that can completely change your playstyle. Whether you're charging headfirst into danger or overwhelming opponents with bizarre attacks, every encounter delivers fast-paced action.
70010000125834.name: Bob The Mad Rabbit

70010000125840.description:
A brutally frustrating co-op boat adventure you probably won’t survive. But hey—at least you’ll look ridiculous trying.

Grab your paddles (and your patience) and set out on a stupidly long, lava-surrounded parkour adventure. In Paddle Paddle Paddle, you and/or a deeply regretting friend must paddle your way through swinging axes, weird wind, evil slopes, and that one jump you’ll miss at least 27 times in a row ... maybe more.

At the end of the journey? A legendary, mysterious, possibly pointless prize awaits. Maybe. If you ever get there. Probably not.

WARNING
This game will test your coordination, your sanity, and your friendships. You can either:
- Play solo and control both paddles like some kind of multitasking god
- Or play in local/online co-op, where each of you controls a paddle. Coordination is key. So is not yelling. Too much.

FEATURES
- Physics-based paddling like in real life (sort of. not really.)
- High Frustration™ factor (rage-quitting is a feature, not a bug)
- Local & Online Co-op — destroy friendships from anywhere!
- Speedrun Timer — for those who hate themselves
- One giant handcrafted level with wacky biomes and checkpoint options (toggle them in Settings!)
- Settings with mercy — toggle checkpoints, fix controls, or just cry a little
70010000125840.intro: Paddle through pain. Solo or co-op. One paddle each. Lava everywhere. You’ll fall. You’ll scream. You might cry. Good luck and embrace the salt.
70010000125840.name: Paddle Paddle Paddle

70010000125869.description:
Enter a high-speed combat arena where every second matters and every move decides your survival.

Set in a futuristic cyberpunk world, you fight as an elite operator inside advanced simulation arenas controlled by powerful corporations. Move constantly and use speed and positioning to stay in control during intense combat encounters.

Dash, jump, and react instantly while collecting resources and adapting to fast-changing combat situations. Each arena offers vertical gameplay, interactive elements, and multiple ways to approach every fight.

Key Features:
	•	Arena Shooter Gameplay: Fast-paced combat in dynamic arenas
	•	Cyberpunk Setting: Neon environments and futuristic locations
	•	Dynamic Movement: Dash, double jump, and vertical gameplay
	•	Interactive Arenas: Power-ups, destructible elements, and multi-level design
	•	Challenging Encounters: Test your reflexes and reaction speed
Fight, adapt, and stay one step ahead in a world built for combat.

Star Troopers – Combat Force delivers an intense, fast-paced shooter experience where reflexes, movement, and precision define every battle.
70010000125869.name: Star Troopers – Combat Force

70010000125875.description:
Thornkin is a dark fantasy pixel-art platformer set in a cursed forest filled with thorns, ruins, and hidden dangers. Take control of a small mysterious creature and journey through a haunting world where every path leads deeper into shadow. Leap across deadly traps, avoid ruthless enemies, uncover secrets, and survive the twisted wilderness that surrounds you.

With atmospheric environments, handcrafted levels, and a fragile hero facing an unforgiving world, Thornkin blends exploration, precision platforming, and eerie adventure into a compact but memorable experience.
70010000125875.intro: Into the thorns, through the dark.
70010000125875.name: Thornkin

70010000125881.description:
Take on dangerous solo contracts across distant planets in this first-person survival horror experience. Explore abandoned bases, search dark corridors, and collect valuable scrap to meet your assigned quota.

Each planet features different locations, hazards, and hostile creatures. Manage your limited inventory, avoid deadly traps, and decide when it is time to escape with your haul. Staying too long may cost you everything.

Every expedition is a separate challenge. If you die, all collected scrap is lost and the mission begins again. Explore carefully, complete the quota, and survive the horrors waiting inside.
70010000125881.intro: A solo survival horror experience where every contract could be your last.
70010000125881.name: Lethal Corporation

70010000125908.description: Protect the core! Don't let the demons eat it! Welcome to this addictive incremental tower defense challenge. Build and upgrade your army in real-time to get stronger and stronger. Create your invincible legion—All units move out!
70010000125908.name: Aether Keepers

70010000125914.description:
"Exodus: Creepy Time" is an exciting casual style game with elements of a simplified roguelike. An ominous journey through dark and gloomy locations awaits you, where every action you take has serious consequences. Survive in a world where darkness and horror lurk at every turn. Collect resources, upgrade your character and develop new skills to survive in this horror world.

Trapped in a world steeped in darkness and horror, where sinister forces rule every corner. The main character discovers that the world he is in has turned out to be cursed. People and animals have turned into mutants and monsters under the influence of dark forces. He is left alone with this horror, and his only goal is to find a way out of this nightmarish reality, but keep in mind time is inexorably ticking, and the curse is getting stronger by the hour. Will the hero be able to find the strength and wisdom to overcome the horrors of this "Creepy Time" and free himself from this dark web?
Immerse yourself in "Exodus: Creepy Time", where your every decision

Features:
- Simple and Addictive Gameplay
- Constant Threat
- Improvements and New Skills
- Bright cartoon graphics
- Cool characters
- An invigorating soundtrack
70010000125914.intro:
Survive the hordes
Upgrade your character
Unlock new stages
70010000125914.name: Exodus : Creepy Time

70010000125924.description:
Craft the perfect onigiri with fluffy, warm rice and savory fillings, and serve your hungry customers with a smile.

Your menu also features delicious side dishes, like crispy croquettes and golden fried fish.

With a constant stream of orders, you'll need to think on your feet and keep your hands moving!

You're not just the owner—you're the chef and the cashier, too. With limited time and space, your success depends on smart decisions. Which ingredients do you stock up on? What do you cook first? Mastering inventory and perfecting your workflow is the secret to becoming the best onigiri shop in town.
70010000125924.intro: Welcome to your cozy onigiri (rice ball) shop on a street corner in Japan. From today, you're running the whole show yourself.
70010000125924.name: Onigiri Shop Simulator

70010000125938.description:
Precision is everything when every move counts.

Take control of a heavy truck and prove your skills in precise parking challenges that require focus and accuracy. What starts as a simple task — locating and attaching the trailer — quickly becomes a true test of coordination, timing, and control.

Once connected, the real challenge begins. Maneuver your truck with a trailer through tight spaces, avoid obstacles, and carefully position it in the designated parking zone. Every movement matters, especially when reversing, turning, or aligning your vehicle in limited areas.

As you progress, levels become more complex, introducing narrower paths, longer trailers, moving obstacles, and more demanding parking situations. You’ll need to plan your route, adjust your angles, and stay in control to complete each challenge successfully.

Switch between multiple camera views to better understand your surroundings and improve your accuracy. Learn how trailer physics behave, avoid mistakes, and refine your technique to achieve the best results.

Key Features:
- Realistic Parking Challenges: Attach trailers and park with precision
- Trailer Physics: Master reversing, angles, and control
- Multiple Camera Views: Third person, top-down, and trailer view
- Progressive Difficulty: From simple tasks to expert-level challenges
-Varied Locations: Industrial zones, warehouses, ports, and city areas
- Skill-Based Gameplay: Accuracy, timing, and control define success

From basic maneuvers to advanced parking situations, every level pushes your skills further.
Truck Parking Simulator 2026 delivers a focused driving experience where precision, patience, and control make the difference between success and failure.
70010000125938.name: Truck Parking Simulator 2026

70010000125963.description:
