A roguelike shooter in a bizarre radioactive world full of humanoid animals. In a radioactive wastelands and mutated biomes, animals are fighting for their existence and you are one of them!
Choose a hero and make your way through the hordes of enemies. Collect various artifacts, explore secrets and defeat bosses. Destroy all enemies and get to the top of food chain! (alone or with your friend!)
70010000125963.intro:
Survive stages
Destroy environment
unlock characters
70010000125963.name: Bestial Reception

70010000125981.description:
THE CLIENT IS THE VICTIM
Master the Time Loop: You have one day to solve the crime. Learn the schedules of 14 unique characters, spot their contradictions, and manipulate their routines. Keep your knowledge when the day resets and stay one step ahead of the killer.

MASTER THE LOOP
No hand-holding. Use your "Thinking Board" to link evidence, reconstruct the timeline, and accuse the culprit. Only pure logic will free you from the loop.

LITERARY NOIR
A Living Literary World: Experience a satirical, witty, and dark adaptation of Brazil's legendary author, Machado de Assis. Your investigation takes you through a hand-drawn 1937 Rio de Janeiro that drips with style, sarcasm, and atmosphere. There is no single correct answer: every accusation has its logic, and the truth is yours to define.
70010000125981.intro: A dead man hired you to solve his own murder. You have one day. Fourteen suspects. And as many attempts as it takes.
70010000125981.name: The Posthumous Investigation

70010000126010.description:
You wake up in your apartment, surrounded by the stark, minimalist geometry of a black-and-white world. Your everyday tasks, such as making the bed, washing the dishes, and taking out the trash, appear ordinary. However, in this bizarre setting, completing these everyday chores is the key to accessing the outside world.

It's a unique first-person escape room experience that mixes everyday chores with mind-bending puzzles. As you navigate the quiet rooms of your home, observe your surroundings carefully. Trust your instincts as you collect useful objects, decipher cryptic symbols painted on the walls, and manipulate strange mechanisms hidden among your furniture. The answers to your escape are buried in the television static and the wall gears.

The striking low-poly art style, paired with subtle chromatic glitch effects and a haunting sense of isolation, transforms an ordinary apartment into an intriguing puzzle box. Complete your tasks, unlock the secrets of your home, and escape the monotony of everyday life to earn your freedom.
70010000126010.intro: Break the Routine. Escape the Room.
70010000126010.name: Another Day?

70010000126046.description:
KESU-JI is a game featuring 6 modes centered around various "merge" mechanics.
(Puzzle Mode、Action Mode 、Shooting Mode)

Aim for the top of the World Rankings in each mode! Your scores are accumulated into a Total Score to compete in the overall rankings.
Use your Total Score to unlock rewards: perks that give you an edge, or new skins and music for a change of pace.
Enjoy a satisfying merging experience set in a chill, relaxing atmosphere!

【Mode Gravity】
Gravity pulls toward the center! Keep merging to stay inside the blue circle!

【Mode Shooter】
Blocks close in from all 360 degrees! Merge matching number to score points!

【Mode MewMew】
Race against the clock! See how high you can stack your blocks for a massive high score!

【Mode 65536】
Go for the ultimate size! Merge identical numbers to double their value and reach 65536!

【Mode Climbing】
A grueling race to the peak! Beat the clock in this intense mountain-climbing time attack!

【Mode Drone】
Defend the DNA (Eyeball) ! Pilot your drone, blast enemies, and gather EXP to upgrade your skills!

Use Smashes, Nudges, and Bombs in select modes to gain the upper hand.

Master them all and claim your spot at the top of the world!
70010000126046.intro:
KESU-JI is a game featuring 6 modes centered around various "merge" mechanics.
(Puzzle Mode、Action Mode 、Shooting Mode)
70010000126046.name: KESU-JI

70010000126057.description:
HOW LONG CAN YOU SURVIVE?

Memebonk is a roguelike survival where six great scientists battle endless waves of brainrot monsters. Pick a hero with a unique power, step onto the infinite battlefield, and prove that brains beat chaos.

THREE LOCATIONS — THREE WORLDS
The Great Library, where knowledge becomes a weapon. The Garden of Eden, where danger hides behind every flower. The Synthwave Desert, where neon and sand merge into madness. Every map is randomly generated — no two runs are ever the same.

BECOME ABSURDLY POWERFUL
Destroy enemies, collect XP, and level up on the fly. Every upgrade is random with varying rarity — craft insane builds and break the game in your favor. 40+ items with unique synergies give you endless room to experiment.

6 SCIENTISTS — 6 STYLES
Each character has their own core power and changes how you play. Find your favorite, unlock new ones, and try unexpected combinations.

BOSSES AND 130+ QUESTS
Waves of small foes are just the warm-up. Mighty bosses will put your build to the test. And a system of over 130 quests keeps things fresh even after hundreds of runs.

Stylish characters, gorgeous animations, addictive gameplay. One run — and you won't be able to stop.
70010000126057.intro: Smash endless hordes of meme monsters as genius scientists! Roguelike survival with insane builds and infinite chaos!
70010000126057.name: Memebonk

70010000126064.description:
Put your brain to the test with this slide-puzzler blending roguelite strategy, the satisfying feel of a match-3, and the freedom of a deck-builder!

In solo play, enjoy a focused experience and choose from a cast of unique characters!
Items available change each run. Adapt and advance from one stage to the next!

In online mode, compete with up to 8 players from around the world in lively multiplayer competition!
Chain those combos, and hype it up with your rivals!

After boss matches (yes there are those too!), "gruesome" fatalities await...!?
70010000126064.intro: An exciting roguelite puzzler where every playthrough is unique, now on Nintendo Switch™!
70010000126064.name: Dialoop -Roguelite Puzzle-

70010000126070.description:
Welcome to a colorful farm coloring adventure for kids!

In this creative coloring book, children can discover many adorable farm animal pictures and bring them to life with their favorite colors. Sheep, cows, pigs, horses, and more are waiting to be colored in bright and playful ways.

Choose from a wide variety of colors and enjoy two simple and intuitive coloring modes. Use the pen mode to draw and color freely, or use the paint bucket mode to fill larger areas quickly and easily. The pen size can be adjusted freely, making it easy to color both small details and bigger spaces.

For even more creative freedom, the line art can be hidden. This turns the page into a clean white canvas where children can create their very own drawings and let their imagination run free.

Thanks to the touchscreen controls of Nintendo Switch™, the game is simple, direct, and child-friendly. It is ideal for young children who love animals, drawing, and creative play. The game encourages creativity, fine motor skills, color recognition, and imagination in a calm and playful way.

Visit the farm, choose your favorite animal, and start coloring! A relaxing and creative coloring game for kids and the whole family.
70010000126070.intro: Color cute farm animals with many colors, an adjustable pen, and a paint bucket. A creative touchscreen coloring game for kids.
70010000126070.name: Animal Farm Coloring Book for Kids & Toddlers

70010000126076.description:
Welcome to a colorful construction coloring adventure for kids!

In Tiny Builders Coloring Book for Kids, children can discover many fun construction-themed pictures and bring them to life with their favorite colors. Excavators, trucks, cranes, builders, bulldozers, and other construction machines are waiting to be colored in bright and creative ways.

Choose from a wide variety of colors and enjoy two simple and intuitive coloring modes. Use the pen mode to draw and color freely, or use the paint bucket mode to fill larger areas quickly and easily. The pen size can be adjusted freely, making it easy to color both small details and bigger spaces.

For even more creative freedom, the line art can be hidden. This turns the page into a clean white canvas where children can create their very own drawings and let their imagination run free.

Thanks to the touchscreen controls of Nintendo Switch™, the game is simple, direct, and child-friendly. It is ideal for young children who love construction sites, vehicles, machines, drawing, and creative play. The game encourages creativity, fine motor skills, color recognition, and imagination in a calm and playful way.

Visit the construction site, choose your favorite vehicle or machine, and start coloring! A relaxing and creative coloring game for kids and the whole family.
70010000126076.intro: Color excavators, trucks, cranes, and builders. A creative touchscreen coloring game for kids.
70010000126076.name: Tiny Builders Coloring Book for Kids

70010000126082.description:
Welcome to a magical coloring adventure full of unicorns, fantasy animals, and imagination!

In Animal Coloring Book for Kids & Toddlers: Unicorns, children can discover many adorable unicorn pictures and bring them to life with their favorite colors. Cute unicorns, magical horses, rainbows, stars, clouds, enchanted scenes, and fantasy creatures invite kids to dream, create, and explore their imagination.

Choose from a wide variety of colors and enjoy two simple and intuitive coloring modes. Use the pen mode to draw and color freely, or use the paint bucket mode to fill larger areas quickly and easily. The pen size can be adjusted freely, making it easy to color both small details and bigger spaces.

For even more creative freedom, the line art can be hidden. This turns the page into a clean white canvas where children can create their very own drawings, magical worlds, and fantasy animals.

Thanks to the touchscreen controls of Nintendo Switch™, the game is simple, direct, and child-friendly. It is ideal for young children who love unicorns, horses, magical animals, drawing, fairy-tale worlds, and creative play. The game encourages imagination, creativity, fine motor skills, color recognition, and calm artistic expression in a playful way.

Enter a colorful fantasy world, choose your favorite unicorn, and start coloring! A relaxing and creative coloring game for kids and the whole family.
70010000126082.intro: Color magical unicorns, cute fantasy animals, rainbows, and enchanted scenes. A creative touchscreen coloring game for kids.
70010000126082.name: Animal Coloring Book for Kids & Toddlers: Unicorns

70010000126096.description:
Fight your way through a city ravaged by dangerous mutants, rescue hostages, find secrets, and rack up points. Locate the secret lab behind this attack and prevent Dr. Mangle from taking over the world!

This remaster features widescreen, 60 FPS, redrawn VGA-style graphics, mid-level saving, weapon switching, and many other quality of life improvements.

Explore the original 3 episodes (36+ levels) plus a brand new 4th episode (15+ levels), spanning a range of diverse environments including cities, forests, underground caves, and secret high-tech labs. Rescue hostages and encounter a variety of dangerous enemies and hazards, putting your fighting and platforming skills to the test.
Find grenades and special weapons to gain an advantage. Battle it out with 9 unique bosses, find and collect all the score items and discover well-hidden secrets - including various secret levels! Compete for the highest score or best time on the game's leaderboards and discover a growing collection of user-made levels.
70010000126096.intro: The classic 2D action platformer BioMenace returns with enhanced graphics and refined gameplay.
70010000126096.name: BioMenace Remastered

70010000126105.description:
■ How to Play

Throw, Merge, and Grow!: Just drop the "Yukkuri" into the bowl! When two of the same kind touch, they transform into a larger Yukkuri!

Don't Let Them Fall!: It's Game Over if the Yukkuri overflow from the bowl...

Aim for the High Score!: Growing them large and triggering consecutive merges (Chains) will skyrocket your score!

■ Reimu & Marisa’s Live Commentary!

Reimu and Marisa chat away with game-style commentary based on your play!

Their lively banter and reactions make every match even more exciting!

■ Fully Customizable Features

30 Different Yukkuri!: Play the game, earn points, and head to the shop to unlock new Yukkuri.

Customize the Evolution Order!: You can swap the order of evolution! Set your favorite character as the largest size and create your very own "Yukkuri Mountain"!

■ Various Game Modes

Multiplayer: Supports local matches for up to 4 players! Enjoy a heart-pounding stacking battle together!

Rankings: Compete with players worldwide for the top score and prove you’re the ultimate Yukkuri master!
70010000126105.intro:
3D Puzzle: Take It Easy!!!
Touhou Project characters are here in their "Yukkuri" forms!
70010000126105.name: Touhou Yukkuri Mountain – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000126111.description:
Summer’s here, and hearts are skipping beats!
Speed Dates Summer Edition is your chance to meet five beautiful women, flirt, and dive headfirst into a summer full of fun, connection, and maybe even something real.
Each woman has her own vibe, her own story. Who’ll catch your eye? That’s totally up to you.

 walk on the beach, or a deep late-night talk under the stars?
Every date is different, and every moment holds a surprise. Sometimes it’s a laugh, sometimes it’s a silence that says it all.
The more you open up, the more the story pulls you in.

Features:
• Five Different Women – Each with her own energy. Some wild, some shy, some straight-up irresistible. Who’ll you click with?
• Real Places, Real People – Shot with real actors in real summer locations. Feels like a movie, but you're in it.
• Your Choices Shape It All – What you say and how you act change everything. This isn’t a fixed path — it’s your story.
• Natural Conversations, Real Chemistry – Everything flows. The scenes feel alive, and nothing’s fake or stiff.
•Multiple Endings – Every playthrough brings something new. Five women, tons of paths, and endless “what ifs.”
70010000126111.intro: Summer's here and hearts are heating up! Meet five different beauties, hang out, flirt a little... and maybe even find your summer romance. Your choices matter —
70010000126111.name: Speed Dates Summer Edition

70010000126127.description: To denounce the evils of truth and love, the lovely charming germ agents, Gummy Invaders, blasting through the veins at the speed of light! In this incremental game, you’ll lead your germ agents through constant evolution. Upgrade skill tree, multiply  forces, and teach those troublemakers a lesson!
70010000126127.intro:
I'm fighting the Demon Fungi?! ... I'll win, won't I?
Tiny Mushroom Agent vs. Endless Enemies!
Relax in this cozy world and watch your stats go crazy!
70010000126127.name: Gummy Invaders

70010000126135.description:
Kogado Studio, recognized for its simulation games in the early days of PC gaming, has taken on the challenge of simplicity in this title.
Beneath the game's simple design lies a deep, strategic complexity.

Immerse yourself in the unparalleled enjoyment of strategy.

【 POINTS 】
◆ [Gameplay] Intuitive, simple, and smooth operation.

◆ [Visuals] Featuring a stylized 3D playing field that resembles a board game, creating a relaxed, casual tabletop gaming atmosphere.

◆ [Battlefields] A wide variety of missions including mountains, urban areas, and fortresses. Deploy with the right equipment tailored to each situation.

◆ [Tactics] "Line of Sight" and "Line of Fire" come into play around cover, hills, and cliffs. Carefully scout, spot enemies, and turn the tide of battle in your favor.

◆ [Units] Pilots with unique strengths and weaknesses. Building the right squad to leverage their traits is key to victory.
70010000126135.intro: Turn the tide of the war with nuanced strategies in One-inch Tactics.
70010000126135.name: One-inch Tactics

70010000126147.description:
“Hey, kids! I'm a site supervisor who hates green peas.”

Your job is to operate heavy machinery to pick green peas off the top of shumai.

All you need to operate the heavy machinery are the L and R sticks.
Be bold yet cautious—use precise stick controls to save the site supervisor’s lunch!

Excavators, wheel loaders, forklifts, and cranes.
There are over 40 special moves available for these four types of heavy machinery.
Unlock all the special moves and become a heavy machinery master!
70010000126147.intro: Please use the heavy machinery to remove the green peas from the top of the shumai.
70010000126147.name: Heavy machinery vs Shumai

70010000126157.description:
Wantama☆Life is a fully voiced visual novel starring Tamaki Inuyama.
As the teacher, lead the school trip while protecting the secrets your student carry.
Enjoy a comedy story filled with trouble at tourist spots and inns, brought to life by a cast of unique characters.

◆Synopsis
「Hey sensei... I am actually an otokonoko.」
You have discovered the secret of Tamaki Inuyama.
And at the worst timing the school trip begins!

Tourist spots, yukata, hot springs――
One wrong step, leads to an instant disaster.

Dragged around by Tamaki's best friend Mea Kagura,
and with senior teacher Norio Tsukudani getting pulled into the chaos too!?

Can you keep Tamaki’s secret
hidden until the very end――!?

School trip where the truth must never come out begins!

◆Characters
・Tamaki Inuyama (VA:Tamaki Inuyama)
A student in the class where you serve as assistant homeroom teacher.
He is an Otokonoko who hides that fact from those around, while also having a soft spot for cute girls.
An extreme unicorn fan of Mea Kagura.

・Mea Kagura (VA:Mea Kagura)
A student in the class where you serve as assistant homeroom teacher. Tamaki's best friend.
She knows Tamaki's secret and helps keep it hidden from everyone else.
She loves handsome guys and plans to find the perfect boyfriend during the school trip.

・Norio Tsukudani  (VA:Norio Tsukudani)
The homeroom teacher of the class where you serve as assistant teacher, and your former mentor from your own school days.
She gives you plenty of support as you struggle to keep up with her free-spirited students.
There seems to be something going on between her and Tamaki...?
70010000126157.intro: Starring the Vtuber Tamaki Inuyama! Exposure means over. The secret school trip begins...
70010000126157.name: Wantama☆Life

70010000126192.description:
Solve captivating puzzles featuring images of beautiful anime-style girls. With each image you complete, you'll unlock new ones, and the gradually increasing difficulty makes solving the puzzle a fascinating challenge. Intuitive touch controls create the feeling that you're actually touching every detail.

Soft and relaxing music will help you immerse yourself in the atmosphere, and after solving the puzzle, you can examine the image closely and admire every detail.

Features:

• Convenient one-handed play.
• Stylish anime images.
• Full immersion thanks to touch controls.
• Gradually increasing difficulty.
• Relaxing music.
70010000126192.intro: Relaxing puzzles with cute anime girls.
70010000126192.name: Hentai Puzzle Simulator 3

70010000126198.description:
Hidden Legends 2 is a sequel that takes you on an even deeper and more immersive fantasy adventure. This time, the search is truly interactive: items aren't just scattered throughout the level; many are carefully hidden inside the houses of fairytale characters and other environmental objects. Each level is handcrafted, and every discovery requires attention, giving you the feeling of a true detective. You'll explore familiar locations as well as completely new ones. Immerse yourself in the fairytale atmosphere thanks to colorful graphics, a magical soundtrack, and intuitive touch controls.

Game Features:

• Hundreds of unique objects to find.
• Unique handcrafted levels filled with detail.
• Colorful fantasy graphics and charming characters.
• Atmospheric music creates a completely immersive experience.
• Convenient controls with touchscreen support.
• Ideal for those who enjoy hidden object games and quiet exploration.
70010000126198.intro: Find the invisible, discover the impossible!
70010000126198.name: Hidden Legends 2

70010000126205.description:
All is not well at Miskatonic University. Professor Harry Everhart tries to ignore the shadows flitting at the corners of his vision, while student Evangeline Drayton is haunted with impossible dreams of an artifact uncovered a decade ago. In their search for answers, the pair will uncover revelations more ancient than anyone could have imagined.

Shocking Secrets
Call of the Sea’s object and observation-based puzzles return with new depth. Scour richly-rendered environments for clues. Swap between Harry and Evangeline to solve complex, multi-part problems across time and space. Choose your own difficulty level with toggle-able hints, icons, and journal entries.

Dizzying Marvels
Harry and Evangeline’s journey takes them from the firelit libraries of a New England mansion to the red sands of the Australian outback, through frozen wastelands and otherworldly cities out of time, all stunningly rendered in Unreal Engine 5 and featuring a soundtrack by multi-award-winning returning composer Eduardo De La Iglesia.

A Shadow Out of Time
Follow Harry Everhart and Evangeline Drayton as they search for the truth about their missing loved ones and come face-to-face with beings beyond their understanding. Inspired by H P Lovecraft's 'The Shadow out of Time', Call of the Elder Gods features a fully voice-acted story of grief, family, and sanity, starring returning talents Yuri Lowenthal and Cissy Jones.
70010000126205.intro: Unearth ancient horrors in this Lovecraftian narrative puzzle adventure
70010000126205.name: Call of the Elder Gods

70010000126211.description:
Spit water to move as a round fish in this cute minigolf puzzle adventure! Use clever movement, smart timing, and the help of adorable sea creatures to overcome obstacles and explore a charming world full of personality.

Sea Creatures That Lend a Fin!
Bounce on jellyfish, get carried by crabs, and let mighty whales blast you across the water. These adorable marine animals are not just part of the world, they are part of the puzzle. Learn how each creature works and use them to reach new places!

Over 100 Levels of Watery Challenges!
Take on a growing journey of handcrafted puzzles testing your problem-solving ability. Earn stars for optimal playthroughs, just watch out for the water not to run out!

Customize Your Fishy Hero!
Unlock different looks and make your little fish truly your own with 25 unique skins and 8 effects to choose from! Whether you want your fish to look cute, silly or stylish, we have that in stock!

Convenient gameplay
Enjoy dynamic camera support and a wide range of gameplay settings!
70010000126211.intro: Golfish is a cute single-player puzzle adventure where you roll, flop, and splash your way from ice hole to ice hole as a little fish on a big journey!
70010000126211.name: Golfish

70010000126214.description:
Join KUBO in a new adventure that will take you to the four corners of the world in search of the sacred crystals to free the inhabitants kidnapped by the infamous Moglar!

Journey through the underworld, the graveyard, the underwater world, and the skies. Collect the items — there will be many monsters and bosses on your way before the final battle in your enemy's castle!

- Explore four unique worlds: the underworld, the graveyard, the underwater realm, and the skies
- Battle monsters and bosses on the road to Moglar's castle
- Also includes KUBO and KUBO 2
70010000126214.intro: Four worlds. One hero. And the two adventures that started it all.
70010000126214.name: KUBO 3

70010000126226.description:
Give free reign to your creativity in this inventive town sim!

Unlock new stores and facilities, help your residents find love, or cash in on the stock market!

If you founded a new town on an uninhabited island, what would you build there? Restaurants? Convenience Stores? Movie theaters? Make your choices and create a town that everyone will want to move to!

As you develop your town further, you'll unlock new stores and facilities, helping you attract new citizens.

Residents of your town can spend their whole lives there - they can find jobs, get married, and even have kids. How many generations can you support?

Walking isn't the only way to get around town - residents can travel in style using cars, bikes, and even UFOs!

There's also a wide variety of pets available, including staples like cats and dogs as well as more out-there options. Ever wanted an elephant in your backyard? We've got you covered.

No space to build more stuff? No problem! Reclaim land off the coast, then customize the terrain's height and design it to create a region that perfectly fits your tastes!

Get started building the city of your dreams today!
70010000126226.intro: A town sim where you raise generations of residents.
70010000126226.name: Dream Town Island – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000126232.description:
Gunvolt Chronicles: Luminous Avenger iX 1+2 Dual Collection brings together and updates the apeX of 2D action for new and old players alike.
The Dual Collection includes both Luminous Avenger iX 1 and 2, with all all DLC included, as well as balance adjustments.
It also features a new mode, Endless Battle.

●Revised balance "Director's Cut"
Luminous Avenger iX's Darkness Trigger "berserk" mode has been powered up.
Luminous Avenger iX 2 receives a new "Spike Smash" system, powering up Copen's main weapon, the Razor Wheel.
A number of other adjustments also improve gameplay balance.

●All DLC included
Every item is built in, including content that was previously limited availability.

●New "Endless Battle" mode
Luminous Avenger iX and Luminous Avenger iX 2 each receive a special mode, "Endless Battle". Configure the settings to your liking before facing off against an endless onslaught of random bosses.
How many will you be able to defeat? Take on the apeX challenge!

●Two sci-fi action stories filled with character
Copen is a hard-boiled fighter in a grim future distopia.
Can he save the powerless people he meets? And can they save him?

[Voice Cast]
Copen: Yuma Uchida (Japanese)
           Alejandro Saab (English, iX 2)
Lola: Mayu Mineda (Japanese)
        Cassandra Lee Morris (English, iX 2)
Kohaku: Yumiri Hanamori (Japanese)
            Kira Buckland (English, iX 2)
Blade: Yui Ishikawa (Japanese)
Null: Sumire Morohoshi (Japanese)
       Natalie Rose Hoover (English)
70010000126232.intro: The complete iX series, refined. The apeX of 2D action reaches a new peak!
70010000126232.name: Gunvolt Chronicles: Luminous Avenger iX 1+2 Dual Collection Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition

70010000126243.description:
Welcome to the most enchanting workshop in the kingdom! Are you ready to turn a humble garden into a bustling, bubbling business? In this cozy management adventure, you’ll step into the paws (or ears!) of a talented alchemist determined to brew the best elixirs in the land.

Meet Your Furry Founders
Choose your hero! Play as a clever Cat or a spunky Rabbit. While you’re busy in the lab, your partner handles the local Bazaar, stocking up on seeds and essentials. Together, you’ll manage three vibrant locations: the bustling Bazaar, the tranquil Farmlands, and your high-tech Alchemy Laboratory.

Are you ready to become the ultimate Alchemist? Grab your apron—it’s time to get brewing!

Features to Enchant You:
- 50 Levels of Progression: Watch your empire grow from a small shed to a massive production line.
- Cozy Vibes: Start your day at your own pace. Prep your shop in the morning sun before the doors open and the rush begins.
- Deep Customization: Choose which upgrades to prioritize to fit your playstyle.
- Endless Fun: Even after hitting level 50, the challenge continues as orders get more complex and your factory reaches peak efficiency.
70010000126243.intro: Stir Up Some Magic in Your Very Own Potion Empire!
70010000126243.name: Cat&Rabbit Magic Farming

70010000126254.description:
Get ready for an amazing adventure on an alien planet, full of dangers, puzzles and unexpected allies. Only you can help the cat fix his ship and leave this dangerous world.

The main character is a cat, a pilot of a small flying ship. After an accident, he finds himself on an unknown planet, where his goal is to collect fuses to fix the ship and return home.
On the way, the cat encounters various enemies, difficult levels and puzzles, as well as allies. The game is in the style of a 2D platformer, where the hero moves through the levels, jumps, fights enemies and collects the necessary items to repair the ship. The controls are simple and intuitive, which makes the game accessible to both beginners and experienced players.
Top-view puzzles: In some levels, the view switches to "from above", and you must solve puzzles to open access to the next stage.
Ship Repair Between levels, the hero returns to his ship, where he uses the collected diodes to repair it. With each new diode, the cat gets one step closer to fixing the ship and returning home.
Conclusion Get ready for an amazing adventure on an alien planet, full of dangers, puzzles and unexpected allies. Only you can help the cat fix his ship and leave this dangerous world.
70010000126254.intro:
Resolve puzzle
Repair spaceship
Precise movement
70010000126254.name: Alien Cat Story

70010000126261.description:
In our game, you’ll enjoy simple and engaging puzzles set to relaxing music.
Unwind and enjoy assembling vibrant images inspired by a tropical resort getaway.
Surfer girls, party lovers, mermaids, and many other heroines are waiting for you!
70010000126261.intro: Relax with tropical puzzles and colorful heroines!
70010000126261.name: Anime Uni 3D: Hot Vacay

70010000126306.description:
RollerCoaster Tycoon® Classic™ is a new RCT experience, remastered in 2017 by franchise creator Chris Sawyer to combine the best features from two of the most successful and beloved RCT games in the series’ history – RollerCoaster Tycoon® and RollerCoaster Tycoon® 2. Roller Coaster Tycoon Classic also comes complete with the Toolkit, Wacky Worlds, and Time Twister expansion packs!  Create and run amazing parks filled with the most outrageous rides imaginable.  RCT Classic includes a mixture of authentic playability, depth of gameplay and unique graphical style of Chris Sawyer’s original best-selling RollerCoaster Tycoon® Games. Packed with content, players can enjoy designing and building roller coasters and rides, landscaping parks and managing the staff and finances to keep their guests happy and the money flowing in. Can you become the next RollerCoaster Tycoon?

Key Features:

The Original RollerCoaster Sim: Experience all the fun from the original RollerCoaster Tycoon® and RollerCoaster Tycoon® 2 games, with a new sim that combines the best elements of both classic titles.

Coaster Construction: Create incredible roller coasters – Quickly build a pre-made design or use the intuitive piece-by-piece building tools to design and theme your own unique rides.

Park Designer: Keep your guests happy by building gentle or wild rides, food and drink stalls, water rides, and even transport rides to take them around the park; Customize your park by building scenery, fine-tuning the landscape, and routing the footpaths.

Park Management: Run your park’s marketing and finances to make a profit while attracting more guests; Organize your staff to keep the park running well and looking its best.

Exciting Environments: Build the ultimate theme park in a variety of challenging environments, from the tranquility of Forest Frontiers to the bustling commerce of Megaworld Park.

Park Scenarios: Progress through 95 classic park scenarios from RollerCoaster Tycoon® and RollerCoaster Tycoon® 2.

Authentic Gameplay: Classic-style isometric graphics and original amusement park music and sound effects.

Packed with Content: Includes hundreds of types of roller coasters and rides, and dozens of different shops, stalls, and facilities.
70010000126306.intro: Create incredible parks in the original rollercoaster sim from Chris Sawyer.
70010000126306.name: RollerCoaster Tycoon Classic

70010000126312.description:
Having moved away from her friends and family to attend community college, Allison Merlo is a fresh student struggling with the day to day challenges of life.

Faced not only with living independently for the first time, but also having to get past her nerves to find new friends in an unfamiliar environment, she finds herself falling in with a group of eccentric writers and artists.

As she pushes through this new stage in her life, the art of the cold and enigmatic Eileen Turner takes her attention, setting her on a course she never expected.

Twofold: First Snow is a prequel spinoff of the visual novel Twofold, focused on Allison and Eileen's first months in community college in the leadup to Christmas, and the many varied people who surround them.
70010000126312.intro: A warm-hearted prequel from the cold of winter.
70010000126312.name: Twofold: First Snow

70010000126329.description:
[STORY]
3,000 years in the future, the Earth has lost all semblance of its former self...Human greed has brought about irreparable devastation.
In harsh conditions, people survived under the control of a runaway AI, but there were also organizations that resisted that control.
Play as Akane, a new agent of the resistance organization called "Lith," and uncover the hidden secrets of the devastated, post-apocalyptic world together with a small AI companion robot named "Bot".

[Features]
■ A post-apocalyptic RPG that took 4 years to develop and is made up of over 4,000 dot frames and hand-drawn pixels!
A beautifully yet decadently depicted post-apocalyptic world, with charming characters who move smoothly and with a wide variety of patterns. A delicate and dynamic adventure RPG created by Malaysian game creator Mas over a period of four years!

■ A strange, heartwarming and dramatic story
The story follows Akane, a new agent of the organization known as "Lith" that resists the runaway AI. Along with her partner, a small AI robot called "Bot," Akane helps people all over the country and discovers fragments of memories related to the apocalyptic world. The dramatic developments in the main story and side quests, plus the serious and comical expressions of the main character Akane between the stories, all create an exciting adventure you won't want to miss!

■ Classic turn-based battles with tons of depth. A one-of-a-kind RPG!
The combat in this RPG takes place in turn-based battles with a nostalgic yet tactical feel. On the surface it looks like a 90s-style JRPG, but the smooth actions of main character Akane and the various enemy characters makes this a one-of-a-kind RPG.
70010000126329.name: Artis Impact

70010000126335.description:
Half Billion: Love Choice is a surreal simulation management interactive video work. Inspired by real-world prices and events, it transforms authentic entrepreneurial investment into a simple yet engaging simulation experience. Among countless investment opportunities, how will you make the wisest decisions? As the protagonist, you will embark on a entrepreneurial journey with a starting capital of 500 million. In this adventure revolving around money and love, six beautiful women—each with their own goals, identities, and personalities—will join your career. When emotions and business intertwine, how will you balance your relationships with them? And how will you choose when you're busy building your empire?

Key Features

Dual Main Storylines: Career & Love, Authentic Entrepreneurial Experience
Players begin with 500 million in startup capital and explore two parallel paths—entrepreneurship and romance. Your investment decisions generate different wealth outcomes, which in turn affect the emotional endings with the heroines. Note: The business world is treacherous; carefully discern whether they truly love you or just your fortune.

Top-Tier Internet Celebrities & Acclaimed Actors Join Forces for a High-Quality Entrepreneurial Thrill Ride
Starring powerhouse actors such as Mei Baolai, Wen Xin, Chen Siche, Li Xin'ai, and Liu Mengru, alongside popular online personalities including Hua Suihua, DJ Jiang Xiaobai, Milk Princess Xiaozhang, It's Still You, Jenny Jenny, Liu Yilin, Xiaoyueyue, Banban Sauce, Swan, and Car Model Potato Strings. They portray a dazzling array of characters—some alluring, some gentle, some innocent, some willful, others fiery and seductive, or noble and aloof—accompanying you on your entrepreneurial path. Spending money not only unlocks exclusive storylines with them but can even... sign them as streamers under your company to work for you.

Over 100 Story Branches, Unexpected Hidden Plots & Easter Eggs
More than a hundred narrative branches and numerous hidden plotlines and Easter eggs await exploration. Both "wealth" and "emotional intelligence" matter—only by accumulating fortune through sound investment decisions can you better collect achievements and uncover their secrets. Note: Draw on your real-world knowledge and make choices true to your heart—they may bring unexpected rewards.

"Get Rich" or "Fall in Love"? An Ultra-Realistic Rich Second-Generation Entrepreneur Simulator
As your wealth and career evolve, the game gradually reveals the actors' nuanced portrayals of each character's inner journey at different stages. Changes in the heroines' attitudes and demands toward the male lead influence your romantic experience. Faced with the temptations of six strikingly different beauties, what choices will you make?
70010000126335.intro:
Half a billion in hand—the heir simulator begins now.
Six love stories—are they true hearts or just a bet?
In this duel of wealth and love, you call the shots.
70010000126335.name: Half Billion: Love Choice

70010000126341.description:
Neko Odyssey: A Game for Cat Lovers You Can't Miss!

Here’s a slightly unusual Casual Adventure game where the main gameplay centers around taking pictures of cats. The pixel art graphics in a 3D setting create a charming atmosphere reminiscent of Japanese animation.

In the game, you'll have to search for cats in various locations throughout the town and take pictures to upload to social media (in game). Each photo you upload will earn likes from netizens. As you receive more likes, you'll become better known, and your followers may offer tips on finding new and different cat poses.

During the cat photography sessions, some cats may require you to establish a connection with them before allowing you to photograph them. You'll also encounter certain events that will lead you to discover new photo opportunities.

Apart from taking cat photos and sharing them on social media, the game features a main storyline where you'll unravel the mysteries of the town based on the information you capture in your cat photos. You'll experience excitement, cuteness, and inspiration along with the adventure in this game.
70010000126341.intro: A Game for Cat Lovers You Can't Miss!
70010000126341.name: Neko Odyssey

70010000126353.description: Minigolf Rush is a fast-paced arcade minigolf game where skill, speed, and smart shot selection decide the winner. Take on creative courses packed with obstacles, tight corners, bounces, and tricky routes designed to test both precision and strategy. Every hole offers new opportunities to discover shortcuts, set up trick shots, and gain an edge over the competition. With simple controls and satisfying gameplay, Minigolf Rush is easy for anyone to jump into, but mastering each course takes focus, timing, and practice. Challenge your friends, improve your aim, and learn how to turn every obstacle into an advantage. In Minigolf Rush, every stroke matters, every round moves quickly, and every match is a chance to pull off your best shot yet.
70010000126353.name: Minigolf Rush

70010000126361.description:
With stunning graphics, a modernized interface, new object search modes, and more content than ever, it’s the ultimate European adventure, no passport required!

Discover iconic landmarks, hidden corners, and the unique charm of Europe, all from the comfort of your home.

Game features:
- 30 unique locations – Explore scenic cities, natural wonders, and cultural landmarks across Europe. Each level is a beautifully illustrated masterpiece full of hidden objects.
- New search features – Enjoy enhanced gameplay with new object types and interactive mechanics that keep the experience fresh and engaging.
- Redesigned interface – A clean, user friendly UI makes navigation and play smoother and more enjoyable.
- Mini-Games and puzzles – Take on a variety of logic, memory, and observation challenges between hidden object levels.
- Souvenir collection – Collect meaningful items that reflect the spirit and culture of every country you visit.

Collector’s Edition Includes:
- 13 Bonus Locations – Unlock even more colorful scenes and hidden object challenges.
- 7 Extra Mini-Games + 12 Bonus Puzzles – Nearly 20 additional brain-teasing challenges for true hidden object fans.
- Expanded Souvenir Collection – Discover even more collectibles as you explore Europe in depth.
70010000126361.intro: Pack your bags! Start your journey today, no luggage or visa required!
70010000126361.name: Big Adventure: Trip To Europe 11 Collector's Edition

70010000126395.description: Traffic Survivor is a fast-paced endless runner where every second on the highway can be your last. Sprint through dense traffic, dodge trucks and cars, avoid roadblocks, and react instantly to an ever-changing stream of hazards. Master running, jumping, sliding, and boosting as the road grows faster, tougher, and more chaotic. How long can you survive?
70010000126395.name: Traffic Survivor

70010000126457.description:
Welcome to Fish In — a relaxing yet addictive fishing adventure built for everyone who loves the thrill of a perfect catch.

Explore beautifully crafted worlds, each brimming with unique fish, hidden secrets, and breathtaking scenery. From tranquil forest ponds to mysterious deep-sea trenches, every location offers new species to discover and new challenges to master.

Cast your line and feel the excitement as rare and legendary fish tug at your rod. Build a massive collection of beautifully designed fish — each one hand-crafted with vibrant colours and charming detail. Track your progress, unlock new species, and chase the rarest catches in the game.

Upgrade your fishing gear to reach deeper waters and distant shores. Better rods, stronger lines, and specialised lures open up a world of possibilities. Trade with other anglers, sell your prized catches, and invest in the equipment you need to become the ultimate angler.

With charming character designs, gorgeous environments, and dozens of unique fish to collect, Fish In is a fishing experience unlike any other. Whether you have five minutes or five hours, every session rewards you with something new.

Pick up your rod. The water is calling.
70010000126457.intro: Cast your line across stunning worlds. Catch rare fish, upgrade your gear, and build the ultimate collection. Your fishing adventure awaits!
70010000126457.name: Fish In

70010000126463.description:
Embark on a captivating 2D puzzle-platforming adventure where every step challenges your mind and reflexes. Guide a determined hero through 30 handcrafted levels, each filled with intricate puzzles, hidden routes, and cleverly designed obstacles waiting to be uncovered. Explore atmospheric environments, discover secret paths tucked away off the beaten trail, and use timing, logic, and creativity to progress.

As the journey unfolds, new mechanics and surprises keep each stage feeling fresh and rewarding. Whether you’re carefully planning your next move or reacting quickly to hazards, every level offers a satisfying blend of exploration and problem-solving. Perfect for players who enjoy thoughtful challenges and the thrill of uncovering secrets, this adventure invites you to master each path and reveal everything it has to offer.
70010000126463.intro: Guide a brave hero through handcrafted levels filled with clever puzzles, hidden paths, and tricky platforming challenges in this immersive adventure.
70010000126463.name: Puzztrail

70010000126481.description:
Betrayed by his first mate, former gangster Quad returns years later as a space bounty hunter, setting his sights on the mafia’s 7 generals so he can finally exact his revenge against their now infamous leader! Blast’N Bounty is a vertical scrolling shoot’em up presented in a mix of retro pixel art and low poly 3D.

Inspired by genre classics, Blast’N Bounty offers modernized widescreen visuals, slick animations and intuitive controls that are easy to pick up but require a deft hand to really push Quad’s limits. Secure upgrade flasks to increase ship defenses and  acquire a variety of drones, each with unique behavior that works in tandem with your main shot. Master 8 challenging levels! Blast through the 7 generals’ stages in any order before the final showdown!

• Blast off for vertical scrolling shoot’em up action!
• Enjoy retro pixel art and low poly 3D in modernized widescreen style.
• Grab upgrade flasks to power up your ship!
• Acquire various drone types and choose the ones that work best with your playstyle.
• Take down the mafia’s 7 generals and get revenge on those who betrayed you!
70010000126481.intro: Engage in retro vertical scrolling shoot’em up mayhem as Quad the frog bounty hunter!
70010000126481.name: Blast'N Bounty

70010000126488.description:
"ACE DRIVER" is a racing game released by NAMCO LIMITED (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1994.
Experience the essence of racing with breathtaking race tracks and authentic handling.
Choose a class based on your player level and charge through the game! Who is the true ACE DRIVER!?

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.
70010000126488.intro: The high-speed battle is about to begin!
70010000126488.name: Arcade Archives ACE DRIVER

70010000126497.description:
Dive into the ruthless world beneath the waves in Shark Simulator: Ocean RPG Survival. In the endless blue of the ocean, only the strongest predator survives. Begin your journey as a hungry hunter and carve your path through a living underwater world filled with danger, prey, and powerful rivals. Every hunt makes you stronger, every battle pushes you closer to the top of the food chain. The ocean is vast, beautiful, and unforgiving — and it’s time to prove that you are its true ruler.

Key Features:
• Explore a Living Ocean – Swim through vibrant coral reefs, mysterious underwater caves, sunlit lagoons, and dark abyssal depths filled with life and hidden dangers.
• Hunt to Survive – Track down fish, sea creatures, and rival sharks while fighting for food and territory in intense underwater encounters.
• Evolve Your Predator – Upgrade your shark’s speed, bite power, and endurance to become faster, stronger, and deadlier with every evolution.
• Multiple Shark Species – Play as different types of sharks, each offering a unique style of hunting and survival.
• Rise to the Top of the Food Chain – Grow from a lone hunter into the ultimate ocean predator feared by everything beneath the waves.
• Easy and Intuitive Controls – Swim, strike, and tear through prey with fluid controls designed for smooth underwater action.

The ocean is a battlefield where only the strongest endure. Hunt, evolve, and dominate the deep as you become a legend of the seas in Shark Simulator: Ocean RPG Survival.
70010000126497.intro: Will your shark become an unstoppable hunter?
70010000126497.name: Shark Simulator: Ocean RPG Survival

70010000126498.description:
Two young friends, lost in a frightening world not made for children. If they cannot find a way out of this Nowhere place, they’ll be condemned to a fate worse than death.

FACE YOUR CHILDHOOD FEARS TOGETHER

You play as Low and Alone, best friends ever since they found each other in this lonely nightmare. They each possess their own iconic item: a bow for Low and a wrench for Alone. Working together, they’ve become adept at sneaking through hidden passages, hoisting each other over massive obstacles, and watching each other’s backs.

Whether you’re playing with a friend or an A.I. companion, you’ll depend on each other's iconic items to create opportunities and to progress. The environment is full of clues and possibilities for imaginative children to exploit. Low’s arrows can reach high targets, cut through ropes, or down flying enemies, and Alone’s wrench is just the thing for crushing stunned enemies, smashing through barriers, or manipulating the workings of massive machines.

EMBARK ON AN IMMERSIVE AND DISTURBING ADVENTURE

No matter where you go, the Nowhere is home to horrific monsters. These Residents won't hesitate to go out of their way to capture any intrusive little Visitors that draw their attention. You might find yourself playing a terrifying game of hide and seek with Monster Baby in the sandy ruins of the Necropolis, struggling to avoid swarms of voracious Candy Weevils in an unsettling Candy Factory, or dodging heavy feet while running along the rain-soaked promenade of a filthy funfair.

You'll need to be ready to run, hide, or even defend yourself at a moment's notice to stay in one piece.

SINK INTO THE SPIRAL

Don’t be too distracted by the desolate beauty of the Nowhere. There are dark mysteries waiting for you as Low and Alone follow their mirror path across the Spiral. As each new location will become more dangerous and disturbing than the last, traumatic flashes from the past will begin to emerge. Will Low and Alone finally escape from this unending nightmare? Only you can help them, little ones...
70010000126498.name: Little Nightmares III

70010000126499.description:
Step into the Spiral with the Free Trial & Friend’s Pass of Little Nightmares III.

This special offer lets you experience the beginning of the adventure at no cost - solo or with a friend in online co-op on the same platform. It also allows you to play the full adventure for free in online co-op if your partner owns a copy of the game on the same platform as yours.

- One or two players can experience the beginning of Little Nightmares III for free, even without owning the game. Each player simply needs to download the Free Trial & Friend’s Pass. If they choose to play together, both must be on the same platform and invite each other online. Should one player purchase the full game, progress made during the Free Trial will carry over, allowing both to continue seamlessly. With one unlocked copy, the entire campaign can be completed in online co-op on the same platform.

- The Free Trial & Friend’s Pass also lets you play the full game together online on the same platform: one player owns the full version, while the other just needs to download the Free Trial & Friend’s Pass to join.


Take on the roles of Low and Alone, two best friends trapped in the eerie lands of the Spiral. Work side by side to solve puzzles, survive terrifying encounters, and uncover the secrets hidden in the shadows.

Try it today, invite a friend, and discover how far you can go together.
70010000126499.name: Little Nightmares III - Free Trial & Friend's Pass

70010000126508.description:
Ink Splash is a 2D action game.
Ride your skateboard and cover the ground with ink while creating graffiti on walls.
In Time Battle mode, the player with the higher score wins.
As you progress through stages, new tricks will be unlocked. Use a variety of moves to win graffiti battles.
70010000126508.name: Ink Splash

70010000126516.description:
Silly physics-based forklift game inspired by Ghibli and Japanese car culture! Use your forklift skills in logic puzzles with many unexpected outcomes!

When all you have is a Forklift, everything looks like a palette.
Take a flight to Ghibli stylized JAPAN!
Let your forklift loose on a peaceful prefecture.

- Travel through the whole island and solve more than 30 puzzles to learn your story.
- Some truck takes your parking place? No problem, you can forklift them!
- Place Kei Cars in the right parking spots,
- They can have alarms,
- And might be Wired,
- Be smart about parking gates,
- Use illegal moves when no one sees,
- But sometimes you can help others.

Maybe they will show you how to cook Ramen? Of course, using a forklift!

Featuring:
- An elegant forklift straight from Japan (that's you)
- A lot of kei cars to stick on the fork,
- A dedicated beep button (!!!)
70010000126516.intro: Silly physics-based forklift game inspired by Japanese car culture!
70010000126516.name: Do You even Forklift?

70010000126518.description:
Descend into a frightful world of action-adventure in Mina the Hollower. Take control of Mina, a renowned Hollower hurtled into a desperate mission to rescue a cursed island. Burrow beneath hazards and monsters, whip foes into oblivion, and gear up with an arsenal of sidearms and trinkets. Explore a vast world filled with pixel-perfect graphics, masterful gameplay, beastly bosses, and infectious music. Encounter a cast of bizarre characters, search out secrets in an array of exotic locales, and illuminate the omnipresent darkness in Mina the Hollower, a brand new game from the developers who brought you Shovel Knight!

Features:
- Hauntingly authentic 8-bit visuals, refined for the modern era.

- Modern touches abound: detailed animation, widescreen visuals, and rock-solid controls!

- Leap, dodge, and burrow through the ground to battle monsters or navigate the world.

- Lash at foes with your trusty whip, Nightstar- or choose from an arsenal of weapons, each with a totally different move set.

- Discover and utilize a reliquary's worth of unusual Sidearms to gain the advantage in combat.

- Collect and equip Trinkets to acquire a variety of exotic effects. Level Mina up to suit your unique playstyle.

- Electrifying 8-bit inspired soundtrack by chiptune virtuoso, Jake Kaufman.

- Descend into the depths of madness with a bone-chilling, yet heartwarming tale inspired by Victorian Gothic horror.

- Explore a huge, dark world brimming with secrets, challenging battles, and interconnected level design.
70010000126518.intro: A bone-chilling 8-bit action adventure, refined for the modern era.
70010000126518.name: Mina the Hollower

70010000126531.description:
Play as Father Mathias Marton, a revered priest trapped in a web of forbidden desires and sinister events. Uncover the mysteries of a corrupt rectory, confront your own demons, and walk the blurred line between sin and salvation.

• AN ENTHRALLING MYSTERY
Who was she? Why does her presence still linger? How did it all come to this? Why did you taste the forbidden fruit? And above all: WHAT HAVE YOU DONE, FATHER?

• AN IMMERSIVE EXPERIENCE
Embark on a brief but deeply captivating narrative journey that blends exploration, cinematics, light puzzles, and gripping dialogue.

• EXPLORE THE ENIGMATIC RECTORY
Uncover the layers of a disturbing story as you roam the shadowed halls. Will you leave a stain, or redeem its corrupted legacy?

• MEET QUESTIONABLE CHARACTERS AND UNCOVER THEIR SECRETS
Speak with the mysterious residents of the rectory and delve into their pasts through diary entries and hidden notes.

• FACE UNHOLY MANIFESTATIONS
Brace yourself as you grapple with the tangible and the supernatural in equal measure.

• DISCOVER OPTIONAL CONTENT
Hidden throughout the rectory are titillating magazines — you'll be surprised by the secrets they hold! Uncover the turbulent history of the rectory by finding old photographs of former priests along with the stories of their lives.
Will you emerge purified, or succumb to the shadows lurking within? Explore this atmospheric tale and uncover the truth hidden beneath the collar. Your path to redemption awaits.

Purchase Notices:

This product is released for the Nintendo Switch. It can also be played on Nintendo Switch 2. However, please note that a separate product, "What have you done, father?", is available exclusively for Nintendo Switch 2.
Save data and Additional Contents are not compatible between the two versions. Please be careful to avoid duplicate or mistaken purchases.
Nintendo Switch 2 Edition and Upgrade Pack are not available for this product.
70010000126531.intro: A dark narrative thriller set in the 1940s. Sin, secrets, and shadows lurk in the halls of the rectory.
70010000126531.name: What have you done, father?

70010000126537.description:
Is a fast-paced clicker game with strategic elements where you build and expand your financial empire by optimizing money production lines. Start with a simple setup and gradually grow by upgrading equipment, unlocking new production areas, and enhancing efficiency to skyrocket your profits.

Upgrade Production Lines – Boost profit output with each upgrade.
Enhance Machines – Improve equipment to maximize efficiency.
Unlock New Sections – Expand your factory to increase production capacity.
Collect Profits – Gather money faster and trigger bonuses.

Carefully balance upgrades and expansion to create a massive financial powerhouse.
70010000126537.intro: Build, upgrade, and expand your own money-making factory.
70010000126537.name: Money Factory Tycoon

70010000126547.description:
The classic bubble shooter gets a pirate makeover! Pop, chain and clear your way through 60 coloUrful levels of pure puzzle fun set across the high seas.

Take on 30 progressively challenging beginner levels to find your aim, then tackle 30 demanding stages that will put your strategy and reflexes to the true test. Every level brings new bubble formations, tricky layouts and fresh obstacles to keep you hooked from start to finish.

Collect power-ups, trigger chain reactions and hunt for hidden bonuses to boost your score. Earn up to 3 stars on every level and chase the perfect run for the most dedicated players.

Simple to pick up, endlessly replayable — the ideal arcade puzzle for players of all ages.

Features
- 60 levels across 2 chapters — 30 Easy, 30 Hard
- Collectible power-ups and special bubbles
- Hidden bonuses and up to 3 stars per level
- Chain reaction combos for massive score multipliers
- Classic bubble shooter mechanics with a pirate theme
- Suitable for all ages and skill levels
70010000126547.intro: Pop your way to pirate glory.
70010000126547.name: Bubble Shooter Piratery

70010000126553.description:
A fast-paced arcade experience focused on precision and timing, this game challenges players to defend a central core using rotating color-coded shields. Projectiles arrive from all directions, and success depends on quickly aligning the correct color while multiple shield layers spin at different speeds, often in opposite directions.

Each round builds to a final phase where a neutral projectile must be guided through the rotating defenses. Players create a precise opening, shifting from reactive play to careful control and spatial awareness.

With minimalist neon visuals and smooth, responsive animations, the experience is easy to pick up yet difficult to master. A structured set of levels and an endless mode introduce increasing speed, complexity, and patterns, encouraging players to improve, adapt, and chase higher scores through skill and focus.
70010000126553.name: Color Attack!

70010000126560.description:
• COMING OF AGE IN THE AFTERLIFE

Grim Trials is a heavy metal action roguelite where you craft and customize your own weapons and equipment to embrace Death your own way.

Play as Avelin, a young woman who has met an untimely end, and found herself recruited as one of Death’s many Reapers. Tasked to hunt down impure souls, face her demons, and fight her way through an underworld of her own making, Avelin must endure these trials to become a full-fledged Reaper and see her still-living love once again.

• REAP THEIR SOULS

Endless hex-grid arenas filled with monsters, traps, sinful souls, and 7 sacrilegious bosses await. Slay them all with a variety of customizable scythes, crossbows, and powerful Blessings from the Gods of Death around the world. Master the scythe and crossbow to maximize damage to your foes with a unique combat system that rewards clever use of your dual-wielded weapons.

• GATHER MATERIALS & CRAFT EQUIPMENT

The spoils of battle are the tools of your trade. Gather materials from the battlefield and work with your mentors in the arcane arts to craft new and ever more powerful weapons, armor, and consumables.

• CUSTOMIZE GEARS & CREATE PERSONALIZED BUILD


Every reaper carves their own path! Mix and match your crafted equipment with skills gained from investing in an expansive skill tree at the start of every run, then choose carefully from the randomized Blessings you obtain mid-run to create powerful builds!

• A NEW LIFE AFTER DEATH

Explore The Academy, built for the training and arming of Death’s various Reapers. Seek enlightenment from mentors, take on quests to build your relationships, and unlock sage advice, knowledge, and powerful support from your peers. Learn the stories of the dead by interacting with the Academy’s denizens.

• LOVE CONQUERS DEATH

Coming of age in the afterlife was certainly not the plan, but dying means little to the already-dead, and love unyielding wields power no god can rival. Every time Avelin falls in battle, the experience and materials you’ve earned stay with her. Live, fight, die, then live again, over and over until the promise is kept.

★This product is released for the Nintendo Switch. It can also be played on Nintendo Switch 2. However, please note that a separate product, "Grim Trials",
is available exclusively for Nintendo Switch 2.

Save data and Additional Contents are not compatible between the two versions. Please be careful to avoid duplicate or mistaken purchases.

Nintendo Switch 2 Edition and Upgrade Pack are not available for this product.
70010000126560.intro: Prove your worth. Hack and blast your way through the Grim Trials.
70010000126560.name: Grim Trials

70010000126568.description:
Build your ultimate spaceship and dive into a thrilling arcade-style space adventure. Customize every part of your ship—from body and wings to engine and weapons—then launch into fast-paced battles across the galaxy. Speed through dense asteroid fields, unleash powerful rockets, and take down enemy ships while skillfully avoiding deadly mines and hazards.

Explore two distinct planets, each offering unique environments and challenges, from vast open space to dangerous planetary surfaces. Stay sharp as rival pilots try to outgun and outmaneuver you in intense combat encounters. With responsive controls, upgradeable abilities, and nonstop action, every mission pushes your reflexes and strategy to the limit.

Outfly, outfight, and outlast your enemies to conquer the galaxy and prove you’re the ultimate pilot.
70010000126568.intro: Customize your spaceship and set off on a fast-paced galactic adventure. Race through unique planets, blast enemies, dodge dangerous mines, and outmaneuver rivals.
70010000126568.name: Planetfall Conquerors

70010000126574.description:
What if your mathematical reasoning were your only chance to escape?
In a colorful world made up of shapes and numbers, mathematics becomes a playground where experimentation, learning, and observation are the keys to moving forward, whether on your own or in co-op.

・Learn by playing
Néro & Sci ∫ Integral Edition has been designed to provide a real improvement to mathematical logic, while keeping all the entertainment a challenging platformer has to bring.
Observe, experiment, try, and learn until the logic of each puzzle clicks into place
The game concept and mechanics have been tested and are recommended by the Institute for Research on Mathematics Education (IREM Lyon)
No need to be good at math to move forward: the progressive difficulty curve and clue system are designed to engage all players aged 13 and up

・The Story of Néro & Sci
Néro is a young Synapsian who lives on the streets of Curiosita, the capital of the world of Heméide, home to a people wallowing in their achievements. He has taken refuge in the library of Psyga, whom he considers like his father.

While cleaning out the basement of the library, Néro drops a jar containing Sci and knocks over a book that unleashes the Chaos theories and plunges them into the caves of Heméide, from which they will have to escape!

" Mathematics is a gymnastics of the mind and a preparation for philosophy." Isocrates .
70010000126574.intro: Néro & Sci are departing for an adventure in the world of Heméide, made of colorful shapes, numbers, and mathematical logic.
70010000126574.name: Néro & Sci ∫ Integral Edition

70010000126607.description:
Beyond the walls, faint whispers echo through the darkness, drawing you deeper into a strange and unsettling world.

Explore eerie corridors, discover hidden chambers, and reveal secrets concealed behind magical riddles. Every clue uncovers more of the story and brings you closer to discovering the source of the whispers.

Master powers of ice, fire, transformation, and true vision. Meet mysterious creatures, face powerful demons, and encounter a strange Buffoon whose motives remain unclear. Your choices and conversations may influence what awaits ahead.

Will you escape… or become another soul in his collection?

Features:
• Explore mysterious corridors and hidden chambers
• Solve magical riddles and uncover secrets
• Discover powers of ice, fire, transformation, and true vision
• Encounter unusual characters and dangerous creatures
• Make choices that shape your journey
• Uncover the truth behind the whispers and ancient contracts
70010000126607.intro: Uncover forbidden secrets and escape the Sorcerer's realm.
70010000126607.name: Sorcerer's Refuge

70010000126613.description:
Discover the truth hidden behind a famous vlogger's online fame. What begins as curiosity quickly turns into a nightmare when the doors lock behind you and escape becomes your only goal.

Explore dark rooms, search for useful items, unlock new areas, and solve escape-room style puzzles. Hidden passages, secret compartments, strange mechanisms, and mysterious clues reveal the story of the house and its owner.

Stay out of sight and avoid the vlogger at all costs. He reacts to noise, patrols the house, and can appear when you least expect it. Hide, move carefully, and use your surroundings to survive.

Experience a mix of exploration, stealth, puzzles, and tense chase sequences. Every item may help you solve a challenge or open a path forward.

Features:

• Survival horror with stealth gameplay
• Escape-room inspired puzzles and challenges
• Explore a mysterious house filled with secrets
• Search for items and unlock new areas
• Hide from a dangerous and unpredictable pursuer
• Atmospheric horror with touches of humor and satire
• Story-driven adventure with unusual characters
• Multiple ways to approach survival and escape

Can you uncover the vlogger's secrets and find a way out?
70010000126613.intro: Sneak into a famous vlogger's house, uncover his secrets, solve puzzles, and escape before he finds you.
70010000126613.name: Escape from Vlogger: Runaway

70010000126619.description: Mori Carta is a handless deckbuilding roguelike. Choose left or right on every card to adventure through stories. Simple decisions lead to rich and rewarding gameplay. Four dramatically different characters with their own unique card sets, more than 1000 playable cards, over 185 unique enemies.
70010000126619.intro: Decide fast. Build smart. Survive longer.
70010000126619.name: Mori Carta

70010000126622.description:
After having a normal day at the office, Terrence while traveling home inexplicably falls down to The Backrooms. A journey chronicling 7 days... Can Terrence escape this liminar horror phenomenon? Or will he be trapped within this place forever?

Backrooms is a horror adventure game where you explore the liminal space of the Backrooms while you interact with strange and creepy characters. Explore the Backrooms, find the unexpected as you go into impossible spaces and see things you shouldn't have seen.

Backrooms brings the liminal horror phenomenon from obscure corners of the internet to console players looking for exploration based atmospheric horror from Puppet Combo.

Features:

-Encounter strange and creepy characters with nefarious motives
-Low poly retro graphics
-Inspired by Japanese 1990s visual novels
-A big liminal space to explore.
70010000126622.intro: A journey chronicling 7 days... Can Terrence escape this liminar horror phenomenon? Or will he be trapped within this place forever?
70010000126622.name: The Backrooms

70010000126631.description:
From the creators of Nidhogg comes a game about 2D platforming survival. You'll have to parkour your way around treacherous dungeons to kite monsters while gathering blood and powerups.

Survive a run, take the bones you’ve earned to the Bone Shop, and get stronger.

Complete quests to unlock upgrades, arenas, skins, and more.

Features:
- 9 unlockable playable characters with different traits and weapons
- 6 unlockable unique survival arenas
- Over 100 enemy types
- Over 100 quests to complete
- Over 100 unlockable weapons and upgrades
- Dynamic “dungeon dnb” soundtrack by Thomas Hooey
70010000126631.intro: These dungeons are full of monsters. The blood is there. Take it!
70010000126631.name: Blood Dungeon

70010000126637.description:
Every delivery counts!

Jump on your bike and experience the life of a city courier in a vibrant open-world delivery adventure. Pick up food, drinks, and packages from local businesses and race through busy streets to deliver orders on time while building your reputation as the city's most trusted rider.

Explore a large city filled with unique districts, from bustling residential neighborhoods and lively parks to industrial zones packed with shortcuts and hidden routes. Watch the city come alive through a dynamic day-and-night cycle and changing weather conditions that make every delivery feel different.

Manage your stamina during long rides and collect energy sodas scattered throughout the city to keep moving when the pressure is on. Earn money from successful deliveries and unlock up to 12 unique bicycles, each offering its own riding style, speed, handling, and performance.

Looking for extra challenges? Practice wheelies and show off your bike-handling skills while exploring every corner of the city.

Whether you prefer relaxing rides through the streets or racing against the clock to complete deliveries, Bike Food Delivery Simulator offers a fun and rewarding courier experience for players of all ages.

Features
Explore a large open-world city
Deliver food, drinks, and packages across multiple districts
Dynamic day-and-night cycle and weather system
City traffic that creates new challenges for every route
Unlock and ride 12 unique bicycles
Earn money and expand your delivery career
Stamina system with collectible energy boosts
Perform wheelies and improve your riding skills
Discover residential areas, parks, industrial zones, and hidden shortcuts
Relaxing and accessible simulation gameplay

Grab your bike, hit the streets, and become the ultimate city delivery rider!
70010000126637.intro: Pick up orders, ride through the city, and become the ultimate bike courier.
70010000126637.name: Bike Food Delivery Simulator

70010000126679.description:
Give yourself over to the ultimate relaxation! Clay&Cats will make you feel good in a way you didn't know you needed.

Your task is simple - assemble adorable, cat-themed pottery to its full glory. Put back together pawesome vases, purrfect plates, and kittiful bowls. Don't worry about the timers and sweating to pass the challenge - take all the time getting the pieces together and enjoy the satisfying way they click into the right places. Can't get cozier than that!

KEY FEATURES:
- 9 categories with 14 levels of pure joy in each
- Lo-fi music providing good vibes for the hours of playing
- Satisfying gameplay that soothes your nervous system
- Tons of adorable, furry troublemakers to admire
70010000126679.intro: You'll forget about the rest of the world with the most satisfying hobby - repairing cute cat pots!
70010000126679.name: Clay&Cats

70010000126714.description:
Unrailed 2: Back on Track brings chaotic local and online multiplayer track-building action to the next level – band together with friends to collaborate and build your track across new procedurally generated worlds - WHILST the train is running! So think fast, with more freedom than ever before, and conquer new obstacles in your way - before your trains becomes… a trainwreck!

CHOOSE YOUR TRACK
Now featuring a story spread across new environments, on branching paths for you to choose, so no two runs will feel the same. In these biomes you’ll now be able encounter new points of interests, side quests, daunting bosses and as well as other random encounters, so adapt quickly on your feet! New unlockable cosmetics also let you add your personal touch to your characters’ story.

YOUR JOURNEY GETS BETTER AND BETTER
Every excursion your crew undertakes feels increasingly meaningful, with new rewards and permanent upgrades granting you character with gameplay-modifying abilities, as well as new train engines, wagons and extensions to unlock, giving you the tools to build a multitude of train configurations to play and experiment with. Each locomotive loss is an opportunity to rebuild and get… back on track!

CREATE, SHARE AND PLAY WITH THE COMMUNITY
The all-new Terrain Conductor mode allows you unleash your imagination to create your very own custom maps and share these with the Unrailed community – with highlights being featured by the developers. Or if creating isn’t your thing, browse the limitless creations other players have built, so the frantic fun never ends!

CO-OPERATE TO COMPETE
Fulfill your burning competitive urge – manically duke it out in against another team in the new 8-player Vs Mode. Test your team’s prowess in online leaderboards with action replays and see who can achieve the highest scores.
70010000126714.intro: Unrailed is back on track with more co-op railroad construction chaos than ever!
70010000126714.name: Unrailed 2: Back on Track – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000126721.description:
A strange melody has swept across Palombia… and all the animals have suddenly started dancing, leaving chaos in their wake! The creature behind this crazy beat is none other than the Mummy Queen, back from the Land of the Dead with her minions to play a cursed concert with a calamitous crescendo.

Help the Marsupilamis save Palombia from the Mummy Queen and her minions!

A Fast-Paced 2D Platformer
Journey through four vibrant worlds in this high-energy platformer!
From the colourful jungle to the bustling city, find the clues to the Mummy Queen's hideout. Take on increasingly more intense challenges leading to the ultimate showdown against the Mummy Queen.

3 Marsupilamis, 3 Abilities
Master the unique abilities of each Marsupilami. Switch characters to soar through the air, punch enemies, or leap across obstacles, and explore the different levels' secrets. Choose your Marsupilami wisely, and you might uncover a hidden level!

Experience the Adventure Together in Local Co-Op
Play the adventure with a friend or on your own and take on the Battle Dojos' challenges and the competitive minigames designed for friendly rivalries.

Dive Into a Vibrant, Colourful Universe Faithful to the Marsupilami Licence
Explore unforgettable environments, face memorable bosses, and uncover hidden levels, all set within a fast-paced, fun atmosphere for the whole family.
70010000126721.intro: Will you be able to follow the rhythm… or fall victim to the cursed dance?
70010000126721.name: Marsupilami 2 - Salsa Palombia

70010000126746.description:
Become the neighborhood handyman and transform rundown houses into beautiful homes!
Take on renovation jobs, travel to different locations, and restore homes room by room. Clean up trash, replace damaged flooring, paint walls, install ceiling panels, and furnish interiors to satisfy your clients.
Complete contracts to earn money and invest in better tools and equipment. Upgrade your gear to work faster, take on bigger projects, and become the most trusted handyman in town.
Every house is a new challenge, and every renovation brings you one step closer to building your dream handyman business.
70010000126746.intro: From Broken Rooms to Dream Homes.
70010000126746.name: Handyman Flipper: House Stories

70010000126754.description:
In Motel Renovator Simulator, take control of a neglected motel and turn it into a comfortable destination for travelers. Start with dusty, forgotten rooms and gradually restore the entire property, bringing it back to life one renovation at a time.

Clear away clutter, replace old flooring and walls, and give each room a complete makeover. Choose furniture and decorations from a variety of options to create welcoming spaces that guests will enjoy. Your renovation work is also the key to growing the business. Welcome guests, earn money from successful stays, and reinvest your profits into new furniture, materials, tools, and additional rooms.

Upgrade your equipment to work faster and more efficiently, while experimenting with different designs to give your motel its own unique character.
From a forgotten roadside property to a thriving place for travelers, every improvement brings you closer to creating the motel of your dreams.
70010000126754.name: Motel Renovator Simulator

70010000126763.description:
Get ready for a wild ride in Back Driver Simulator, where you’re not behind the wheel—but your decisions still control the chaos. Sit in the back seat of a speeding taxi, direct the driver, and navigate unpredictable roads from a first-person perspective. Every choice matters, and one wrong command can turn a smooth run into total disaster. Fast, absurd, and full of surprises, this is a driving experience unlike any other.

Features:
• Indirect Driving Gameplay: Command the driver instead of steering yourself, creating tense, unpredictable racing scenarios.
• Challenging Routes: Master focus, timing, and nerves across multiple routes and environments.
• Stylized Chaotic World: Navigate vibrant, exaggerated streets filled with hazards, humor, and visual gags.
• First-Person Passenger View: Experience every near-miss, crash, and triumph up close.
• Multiple Maps & Tracks: Fifteen unique tracks across five distinct maps, each with its own challenges.
• Varied Drivers & Vehicles: Interact with different taxi drivers, each with unique personalities, dialogue, and reactions.
