• Playful Level Design: Discover hidden easter eggs, clever blockages, and surprises on every road.

Take control from the back seat, survive the madness, and master indirect driving in Back Driver Simulator. It’s a fast-paced, hilarious, and unpredictable journey where every decision can make or break the ride. Are you ready to direct the chaos?
70010000126763.intro: Can you stay calm while every second brings a new surprise?
70010000126763.name: Back Driver Simulator

70010000126766.description:
Pixel Blaster DX is a fast-paced hybrid-casual color shooter and sorting puzzle game built for quick, satisfying gameplay sessions.
Tap, shoot, match colors, manage the conveyor belt, and clear pixel cube formations before your holders are full.
The rules are simple and easy to learn. Tap the color-coded sphere on the left side of the screen to launch them onto the rotating circular conveyor belt.
Each sphere shoots cubes that match its own color, for example:
• Pink spheres shoot pink cubes
• Cyan spheres shoot cyan cubes
More colors appear as the challenge and complexity increases

Your objective is to clear all pixel cubes from the board. Each level features different cube formations, including fun shapes, items, icons, and emoji-style designs. But there is a twist. Every sphere has limited ammo. If a sphere still has remaining ammo after all matching targets are cleared, it drops into one of the waiting holder slots below. If all holder slots become occupied with unused spheres, the game is over. Plan carefully, shoot at the right time, and manage your queue before the board fills up.

Special Bonuses - Use special bonuses to overcome tricky stages:
• Shuffle - Re-shuffles all waiting spheres on the board.
• Holder - Adds one extra holder slot.
• Turtle - Slows down the movement speed of spheres on the conveyor belt.
• Skip - Skips the current level and moves you to the next stage.
• Spin -Drops bonus coins from the spin wheel.

Features
★ Marathon gameplay with more then 2000 unique levels
★ Fast-paced color shooter and sorting puzzle mechanics
★ Simple touch controls that are easy to learn
★ Handheld and Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller support
★ Increasing difficulty with strategic challenges
★ Satisfying conveyor belt gameplay
★ Special power-ups and bonuses for difficult stages
★ Hand crafted fun pixel cube formations and colorful level designs
★ Global social leaderboards
★ Professional sound effects and background music
★ Rumble support
70010000126766.intro: Tap, shoot, sort, and clear colorful pixel cubes in this fast-paced conveyor belt puzzle game!
70010000126766.name: Pixel Blaster DX

70010000126801.description: Become a cheerful delivery bird and explore a colorful archipelago filled with charming villages, friendly characters, and countless deliveries waiting to be completed. Fly freely between beautiful islands, collect letters, parcels, and special cargo, then deliver them safely to homes across the world. Every successful delivery rewards you with coins that can be used to upgrade your equipment and unlock new possibilities. Customize your delivery cart with stronger wheels that allow you to transport heavier packages, then enhance them with powerful badges that provide unique bonuses such as increased delivery rewards, faster progression, and improved earnings. Master dynamic delivery challenges by flying through speed boost rings to maintain momentum, improve your routes, and complete deliveries as quickly as possible. Discover new islands, meet memorable villagers, improve your delivery business, and become the greatest courier the skies have ever known. Features • Explore a colorful open world made of beautiful floating islands. • Deliver letters, parcels, and valuable cargo. • Upgrade your cart with stronger wheels to carry heavier deliveries. • Equip special badges that provide unique gameplay bonuses. • Master boost ring challenges for faster deliveries. • Earn coins, unlock upgrades, and expand your delivery business. • Relaxing gameplay with charming cartoon-inspired visuals. • Easy to learn, satisfying to master.
70010000126801.intro: Take to the skies, deliver with care, and connect a peaceful world one package at a time.
70010000126801.name: Aerialia: Wings of Delivery

70010000126813.description:
"CAMELTRY" is an action game released by TAITO in 1990.
Rotate the maze to roll the ball and reach the goal before the timer hits zero. A variety of obstacles stand in your way, including traps that reduce your time and bumpers that bounce the ball away. It's a unique ball-action game with a whole new sensation.

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.
70010000126813.intro: Spin the Maze, Roll the Ball!
70010000126813.name: Arcade Archives CAMELTRY

70010000126831.description:
When a boy’s father is suddenly slain by a terrifying lightning demon, he courageously sets out on a quest of vengeance. Take the role of this young hero as he learns to gather and wield powerful demon magic known as Clarity. Run, jump, air dash and swing your sword as you traverse 7 worlds in side-scrolling style, slaying lesser demon spawn and avoiding treacherous traps to reach the boss of each unique stage!

Clarity: The Seven Demons of Vanguardia is an action platforming adventure with a focus on thoughtful reward, all presented in hand-drawn HD style. Customize the experience with multiple difficulty settings. Choose whichever stage you want to tackle first but be mindful to collect demon swords from defeated bosses in an order that grants a strategic advantage against the next. Each demon has an elemental weakness to exploit! Use melee slashes from your swords or execute spells with your staff by consuming the Clarity you’ve claimed from fallen foes. Will you be prepared for the final showdown?

• Hunt menacing demons in the quest to avenge your father!
• Run, jump, slash and air dash as you traverse 7 worlds in side-scrolling style.
• Gather magical Clarity to wield special spells and skills!
• Tackle stages in any order to acquire powerful demon swords.
• Strategically exploit enemies’ elemental weaknesses!
70010000126831.intro: Slay demons to avenge your fallen father in side-scrolling action platforming style!
70010000126831.name: Clarity: The Seven Demons of Vanguardia

70010000126848.description:
A simple paper airplane becomes the start of a quiet and meaningful journey.

Lifted by the wind, you guide a fragile creation across a world that feels alive, changing with every new area you reach. What begins as an easy glide slowly turns into a path that asks for attention, control, and a sense of direction.

Movement is smooth and natural, built around momentum and balance. You rise, fall, and adjust your angle to stay in the air, learning how to use the wind instead of fighting against it. Invisible currents carry you forward, while obstacles and narrow passages test your ability to react and stay focused.

Each environment tells its own story through space and atmosphere. Open, warm areas give you freedom to explore and understand the flow of flight, while more complex zones introduce tighter paths, shifting air, and moments where precision becomes essential. The pace evolves naturally, allowing you to grow more confident without breaking the calm rhythm of the experience.

As you progress, your journey becomes longer and more controlled. You begin to reach places that once felt distant, adapting your movement and improving your ability to stay airborne. Every section feels like a step forward — not just in distance, but in understanding how to move with intention.

This is not about speed or competition. It’s about flow, direction, and the feeling of carrying something forward through space and time. A quiet experience where every movement matters, and every flight brings you closer to where you’re meant to arrive.
70010000126848.intro: A small flight. A big journey.
70010000126848.name: Paper Airplane Flying Game

70010000126855.description:
Take control of Kyra, a skilled hunter with golden hair and a blue cape, on an epic journey to reclaim lands overrun by dark creatures. Armed with her trusty sword, Kyra must traverse devastated regions, facing hordes of monsters and deadly challenges to restore peace to the world.

With dynamic combat, fluid movement, and intense exploration, Kyra The Hunter delivers an engaging experience filled with strategic action and constant progression.

Features:
- Fast-paced and strategic top-down combat
- Face a variety of monsters across unique areas
- Challenging regions to explore and conquer
- Use sword-based abilities to defeat enemies with precision
- Intense exploration with continuous progression
- Stylized visuals with an immersive atmosphere
70010000126855.intro:
Fight the creatures
Achieve victory
Dynamic combat
70010000126855.name: Kyra The Hunter

70010000126862.description:
The Fountain of Youth was hidden away. Nonetheless, it is fated that a Usurper will slay the Ageless and unearth it once more.

FOUNTAINS is a soulslike action-RPG built around fighting your way through a maze-like interconnected, seamless world. You'll take the role of a hooded stranger, recently imprisoned by a tyrannical regime. Will you escape and uncover the mysteries of this war-torn empire?

Demanding, but fair combat
Tight, responsive combat puts every tool and tactic in your arsenal to the test, rewarding precision and quick thinking. Your enemies will hit hard and punish hesitation, turning each fight into an intense back-and-forth where the tide of battle can shift in an instant. Adjustable difficulty settings let you feel that thrill at exactly the intensity you crave, no matter your experience.

Exploration that rewards curiosity
The world of FOUNTAINS is one, seamless, giant dungeon. It is a tightly packed labyrinth which twists and loops back on itself. You'll always discover something new:  items, powers and upgrades to unlock new parts of the world.

Leave Your Mark
FOUNTAINS features an online message system. Leave hints throughout the world to help out your fellow players, or trick them into doing something foolish!

- Souls-like action combat set in a metroidvania-style interconnected world.
- Find new abilities and tools to help you to defend yourself and to traverse the world.
- Rich dark fantasy lore told through exploration and environmental storytelling.
- Online message system for community interaction.
- Secrets are everywhere, so always keep an eye out!
70010000126862.intro: Master high-skilled combat and explore a vast, interconnected world.
70010000126862.name: FOUNTAINS

70010000126961.description:
What if this dream never ended? What if we could dream it together?

Reverie in the Moonlight is an action game where, with the help of your stuffed animals, you try to defend yourself from the monsters attacking you night after night.

Nightly Visits

Little Tete’s nights are restless. His dreams are full of horrible monsters attacking him. But then, one night, he meets Luna, and she teaches him how to use his plushies to defend himself.

Cute but Strong

When faced with a monster, Tete can only do one thing: run away. His plushies, however, can actually fight and defeat monsters. Different animals play different roles, with some focusing on short-range attacks, some on long-range shots, and some on supporting their allies. There are 40 types to choose from, so find your favorites and help them protect Tete from the monsters.

Collect and Strategize

After the monsters’ attack is over, you can shop with the gold you found. You can get new plushies and even buy special items that can make you stronger. Some of them will also give you new weaknesses, so it’s up to you to strategize and prepare for the next attack in the best way possible. There are more than 100 items in the game... Will you be able to collect them all?

Change Clothes to Change Strategies

So, you’ve played the game’s story to the end. Well done. But this is just the start!

You can change Tete’s clothes, choosing from more than 20 costumes. Each one makes him stronger in some ways and weaker in others. If you want to help Tete defeat his nightmares, you’ll have to find the right plushies and items to go with each costume!
70010000126961.intro: In Reverie in the Moonlight, scary monsters are chasing you, and you can’t fight them...but your plushies can.
70010000126961.name: Reverie in the Moonlight - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000126985.description:
Max Speed is a high-speed arcade racing game for Nintendo Switch™ where every race is a fight for first place. Take on AI rivals across winding, hilly tracks where mastering speed is only half the challenge. Use the terrain to your advantage — perform flips, jumps, and aerial tricks to gain nitro boosts and push your car beyond its limits. But be careful: one mistake can cost you the race.

Each track is packed with danger. Dodge obstacles, survive environmental hazards, and watch out for aggressive opponents trying to push you off the road. From prehistoric creatures to deadly track traps, every race is unpredictable and intense.

Choose from 14 unique cars and customise them to match your style. Upgrade your vehicles to improve performance and unlock visual changes that transform your ride. Personalise your car with different colours, wheels, and nitro effects to stand out on the track.

Race across 9 diverse locations and 29 handcrafted tracks, each offering its own challenges and driving conditions. Test your skills in multiple game modes, including Career, Events, Season, Time Trial, and Split-Screen.

Play solo or compete with friends in local multiplayer. With up to 4 players on one console, split-screen mode lets you challenge others and prove who is the fastest racer.

Whether you're chasing the perfect run in Time Trial or battling for first place in chaotic races, Max Speed delivers fast-paced action, skill-based driving, and non-stop adrenaline.

Features

• Arcade racing focused on speed, physics, and skill
• 14 unique cars with upgrades and visual progression
• Deep customisation: colours, wheels, and nitro effects
• 9 locations and 29 unique tracks
• 5 game modes: Career, Events, Season, Time Trial, Split-Screen
• Dynamic tracks with jumps, tricks, and nitro boosting
• Hazard-filled environments with obstacles and creatures
• Local split-screen multiplayer for up to 4 players on one console

The application does not communicate with an independent server.
70010000126985.intro: Race to the finish on wild, winding tracks where every jump is a boost and every rival is a threat.
70010000126985.name: Max Speed

70010000126992.description: A narrative simulation game where you experience the world from the perspective of a park bench. Observe the lives of those who sit beside you, listen to their stories, and subtly influence their conversations through physical reactions — a gentle sway, a creak, a shift in weight. You don't speak. You don't move. But your presence shapes everything.
70010000126992.intro: You are not the hero. You are not the villain. You are the bench.
70010000126992.name: Bench Simulator A Story Told From a Bench

70010000127031.description:
Bacterium is an artificial life simulation where you design microscopic organisms and watch them evolve, fight, eat, and reproduce in a petri dish. Each creature has a neural network brain that mutates across generations, learning to hunt, flee, and mate on its own.

Build your organism from components - spikes for attack, flagella for speed, receptors for awareness, membranes for defense. Choose your look, drop them into the dish, and see if your lineage can outlast the competition.

Features:
- Design custom organisms with pixel art editor
 -Neural networks that evolve through natural selection
- Multiple levels with unique challenges
- 9 visual styles plus custom cell designs
- Track lifetime stats across all your experiments
- Watch ecosystems emerge from simple rules
70010000127031.intro: Design organisms. Evolve brains. Survive the dish.
70010000127031.name: Bacterium

70010000127037.description:
A dynamic physics-based puzzle platformer where every movement matters and creativity is key. Players navigate a series of vibrant environments—from floating island landscapes to high-tech laboratory chambers—filled with interactive objects, moving platforms, and hazardous obstacles. Using simple controls like jumping, throwing, and activating mechanisms, you must manipulate the environment to solve increasingly complex challenges.

Momentum and timing play a crucial role as you launch objects, trigger switches, and chain reactions to unlock new paths. Each level introduces new mechanics that test your problem-solving skills and spatial awareness, encouraging experimentation and multiple approaches to success. With a blend of precision platforming and clever physics puzzles, the game offers an engaging experience that rewards both logic and skill.
70010000127037.intro: A fast-paced physics puzzle platformer where you jump, throw, and interact with objects to solve challenges across floating islands and futuristic labs.
70010000127037.name: PuzzleCore

70010000127043.description:
Drifting isn’t about speed — it’s about control, flow, and style.

Step into a relaxed yet skill-based drifting experience where every corner is an opportunity to build momentum and score. Set across snowy tracks with a clean low-poly aesthetic, the game focuses on smooth driving, precision, and maintaining long, controlled drifts.

Chain together turns, control your angle, and keep your speed to build higher scores. The closer you get to obstacles and the longer you hold your drift, the more rewarding each run becomes. Every mistake breaks your flow, so staying focused is key.

Use handbrake turns to initiate drifts and nitro boosts to maintain speed through long curves. As you progress, unlock new cars with different handling styles and explore new locations designed to challenge your control and creativity behind the wheel.

Key Features:
	•	Drift System: Earn points through angle, speed, and control
	•	Smooth Arcade Handling: Easy to learn, challenging to master
	•	Nitro & Handbrake Mechanics: Extend drifts and maintain flow
	•	Multiple Cars: Unlock vehicles with unique driving feel
	•	Snowy Environments: Clean low-poly tracks with atmospheric design
	•	Progression System: Earn rewards, unlock locations, and improve performance
Art of Drift – Cozy Drift Simulator delivers a satisfying drifting experience where precision, timing, and style define every ride.
70010000127043.intro: Feel the drift, not the rush
70010000127043.name: Art of Drift – Cozy Drift Simulator

70010000127049.description:
Players take on the role of an alien monster, devouring and fighting against human armed forces with various transformations, and annihilating the world. By continuously devouring humans to obtain energy, numerous weapons and abilities can be added to combat human armed forces and eliminate the world. When encountering different extraterrestrial crystals, one can acquire different superpowers. And it can have different transformations in different situations, experiencing super destructive power.

This is a Roguelike game where players operate an alien monster to devour humans, obtaining dozens of weapons, shields, and more through the energy gained Buff、 Follow the ball, fire different energy bullets, and merge these bullets for firing. Different follower balls can also attack in different ways.

In the game, there are randomly encountered alien crystals that can acquire different superpowers, providing abilities such as freezing, fire breathing, and protective shields, making the game process more interesting.

In the game, you can also have different transformations and experience super destructive power. If it can transform into a super ape with invincible power, it can directly destroy houses and police cars in the city.

Players can choose different characters to play the game, and multiple maps are set up to confront humans in different environments. And designed a 6-level difficulty level, constantly challenging one's own abilities. The game features nearly a hundred achievements, requiring constant achievement in intense battles.

Players can continuously enhance their abilities, including health, health recovery, damage, attack speed, critical hit rate, etc., through the game's outsider cultivation function.
70010000127049.intro:
Devour, and destroy the world..
Fighting against armed forces with various transformations.
Obtain energy, numerous weapons and abilities.
70010000127049.name: Monst

70010000127055.description:
Sun, water, and a group of anime girls cheering you on from the pool's edge. Every point you score, every combo you land, gets their eyes on you a little more. One summer party, zero excuses to stop playing.

Stack, match, and hold the line while they react to every move you make.

Each girl has her own energy, whether she's screaming "YOU GOT THIS" from the diving board or blushing every time you pull off something impressive.

Think you can unlock every girls before summer ends?


FEATURES:

● MINIGAMES WITH SPARK: Play through different challenges while they cheer, tease, and react to your every move.

● UNLOCK EXCLUSIVE GALLERY IMAGES: Better scores mean more images, more looks, more moments with each girl.

● ANIME CHARACTERS WITH TONS OF PERSONALITY: From the one who never stops cheering to the one who can't hide her surprise, every reaction is part of the experience.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: How the summer closes depends on how well you play.

● HIDDEN FINAL MOMENT: Push far enough and discover what they've been keeping from you.


Play harder. Score more. Make them wish they'd cheered for someone else.
The pool's waiting.
Jump in!
70010000127055.intro:
The pool's heating up and they're all watching you play.
Nail the minigames, win their attention, unlock exclusive images.
70010000127055.name: Pool Party Girls: Splash Babes

70010000127063.description:
It's the hottest party of the summer and the guys are watching every move you make. Score big across the minigames and watch the gallery fill up with exclusive images of each character in his full pool party look.

Play hard, react fast, and hold your ground when things get intense. The boys notice everything, whether you're crushing it or just barely hanging on.

Some of them can't stop hyping you up. Others turn red every time you do something unexpected. All of them are worth getting to know better.

How deep into the gallery can you get before the sun goes down?


FEATURES:

● MINIGAMES WITH SPARK: Play through different challenges while they cheer, tease, and react to your every move.

● UNLOCK EXCLUSIVE GALLERY IMAGES: Higher scores open up more images, more looks, more sides of each character.

● ANIME CHARACTERS WITH TONS OF PERSONALITY: From the one who never stops cheering to the one who can't hide his surprise, every reaction is part of the experience.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: The summer ends differently depending on how far you push it.

● HIDDEN FINAL MOMENT: Score high enough and find out what they've been hiding all along.


Push your score. Make them regret underestimating you.
The pool party's already started.
Get in!
70010000127063.intro:
Sun's out, the pool's packed, and they're all rooting for you.
Play the minigames, earn their attention and unlock exclusive images!
70010000127063.name: Pool Party Boys: Splash Guys

70010000127077.description:
The summer roster has one spot left, and everyone on the sand is just as determined to take it as you are. Somewhere between the drills and the downtime, it stopped being just about volleyball.

One reads every play before it happens. One stays guarded until you've actually earned a place in his world. Another is warm and easy until the score gets close, then turns sharp and unreadable. And the captain isn't letting anyone in who hasn't proven he's worth the risk.

Say the right thing and something shifts. Say the wrong thing and you're back on the bench. Thirty days until the season opener, and every day you wait is a day someone else gets closer.


Features:

● A ROSTER FULL OF UNFORGETTABLE GUYS: A deep bench, and every player is a completely different reason to fall. None of them easy. All of them worth the effort.

● DIALOGUE CHOICES THAT MATTER: Every response shifts the relationship. Say the wrong thing and you lose ground. Get it right and something real starts to open up.

● CHARACTER AFFINITY SYSTEM: Build genuine connection through practices, late nights, and moments away from the crowd. The harder the pursuit, the more it means when he finally lets you close.

● EXCLUSIVE GALLERY IMAGES: Unlock beautiful illustrations as each bond deepens. Every guy is hiding a story he's not ready to hand you for free.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Your path through the season is yours to shape. Not every route ends in romance, but every one of them is worth playing out.

● 30 DAYS TO MAKE THE TEAM: The season opener is locked in and the countdown has already started. Waste a day, and someone else closes the distance instead of you.


One roster. One summer. Only one spot opens up, and it might cost you more than you think.

Which one are you chasing?
70010000127077.intro:
The roster's stacked. One spot open. Every match could change everything.
Think you can win them over before the season starts?
70010000127077.name: Beach Volleyball Boys: Hot Spike

70010000127083.description:
Incredible new challenges, amazing graphics and improved mechanics. As a great monarch, you will fight many new and dangerous enemies using your clicker skills. Every click on your screen summons powerful warriors, deals crushing blows to enemies and directs the magic of nature into battle. But be careful — each level will bring even more powerful and treacherous bosses, who will have to be defeated to advance further.

While orcs, goblins and other sinister creatures are getting closer, you will have to improve your castle and develop your army to meet new challenges. For defeating enemies, you will receive coins that can be spent on improving your troops and defensive structures.

Get ready for exciting battles, strategic decisions and unforgettable adventures! The future of the kingdom depends only on your skill and determination. Are you ready to become a real hero and save the world?
70010000127083.intro:
choose your strategy
improve your allies
defeat enemy castle
70010000127083.name: Lord of the Click 4

70010000127089.description:
Step into a calming yet deeply satisfying experience in House Cleaner Simulator, where every mess is a chance to create something beautiful. Take on the role of a professional cleaner and transform cluttered, dirty spaces into spotless, cozy homes. From small apartments to large houses, each job brings new challenges and visible results you can truly enjoy.

Features:
	•	Detailed cleaning mechanics including trash removal, surface scrubbing, floor washing, and object organization.
	•	Variety of jobs with unique conditions and different levels of dirt and complexity.
	•	Wide selection of tools and equipment with upgrade options to improve efficiency.
	•	Progression system with new contracts, larger locations, and more demanding tasks.
	•	Equipment customization and upgrades that enhance speed and cleaning performance.
	•	Client satisfaction system based on precision, completeness, and overall results.
	•	Relaxing gameplay focused on attention to detail and satisfying visual transformations.

Turn chaos into cleanliness and restore every space to perfection. In House Cleaner Simulator, your precision and dedication define your success. Build your reputation, take on bigger challenges, and become the ultimate cleaning professional.
70010000127089.intro: Build your reputation with every perfectly cleaned home.
70010000127089.name: House Cleaner Simulator

70010000127100.description:
Pixel Art Coloring Book 2 is back—bigger, bolder, and more colorful than ever! Get ready to relax, unwind, and create breathtaking pixel masterpieces with just a few taps. Whether you're a fan of anime, cute pets, dazzling mandalas, or holiday magic like Halloween and Xmas, there's a perfect pixel canvas waiting for you.
Lose yourself in a world of color with hundreds of stunning images (as a matter of fact, try thousands) spanning categories like fashion, sports, emojis, unicorns, and retro art. Every pixel tells a story—just tap, color, and watch your artwork come to life!

WHY YOU’LL LOVE IT:

-  HUGE COLLECTION – Anime, dogs, flowers, pop art, and more—find your perfect match!
-  MAGIC TOOLS – Use the wand to paint matching pixels or fill entire sections instantly.
-  ZOOM & LONG PRESS – Easily color even the tiniest details.
-  SPECIAL EFFECTS – Add textures and filters for a unique touch.
-  PIXELIZE YOUR PHOTOS – Turn your own pictures into pixel art!
-  COLOR ANYWHERE – No WiFi? No problem! Play offline and color anytime.
-  COLOR SPLASH MODE – Fill matching pixels with a single tap!

From soothing patterns to quirky characters, this is more than just a game—it’s a creative escape! Dive in, tap away, and enjoy these beautiful colors!
70010000127100.intro: Unleash your creativity with Pixel Art Coloring Book 2! Relax, de-stress, and paint your way through hundreds of dazzling designs. Tap, color, and let the magic happen!
70010000127100.name: Pixel Art Coloring Book 2

70010000127115.description:
Minesweeper Pro takes the legendary puzzle experience to the next level with advanced difficulty customization, competitive progression, and global leaderboards. Use logic, precision, and strategy to uncover safe tiles, avoid hidden mines, and clear the board faster than ever.

Fine-tune your challenge with fully customizable board settings, from relaxed beginner layouts to intense expert-level minefields built exactly the way you like. Earn experience, increase your player level, and prove your skills against other players on the leaderboard.

With smooth controls, clean visuals, and endlessly replayable gameplay, Minesweeper Pro keeps the timeless formula intact while adding modern competitive features for both casual players and true masters.

Train your brain, beat your best times, and rise through the ranks in the ultimate Minesweeper experience.
70010000127115.intro: The classic challenge lives on in a whole new form.
70010000127115.name: Minesweeper Pro

70010000127116.description:
A strange night falls on the village...

This werewolf game features 30 roles.
Some protect the innocent... others hunt in the shadows.
And a few play for themselves, without any side or faith.

Each role has a secret power, a unique mission... That of winning the game by winning the village, their pack, as a couple, or sometimes even alone.
So, welcome to the spellbook of roles...

• THE VILLAGE PROTECTORS
Their mission: to unmask the wolves and the villains, and survive until the end.

The Seer – Every night, she can spy on a player's role and discover their true identity.

Witch – She has in her possession a potion of life and a potion of death.

Savior – They protect one player each night against any attack. But be careful, he can't protect the same player two turns in a row!

The Trapper – Every other night, he sets a trap on a player. If the player is attacked, it will be protected and kill the attacker. The trap is deactivated if the player isn't attacked.

The Fox – He can sniff out a player to find out if they or one of their neighbors is part of the wolf camp. If they are, he retains his power for the following night. However, if the sniffed-out player or their neighbors are not part of the wolf camp, he loses his power.
Be careful... not being a wolf doesn't necessarily mean you're a villager...

The Bear Trainer – At dawn, he will growl if a wolf is near him.

The Raven – Each night, he can choose to designate a player who will end up with two votes against him the next day.

The Medium – When night falls, he is the only one who can listen to the dead.

The Dictator – Only once per game, he can seize the village's voting power over a player.

The Hunter – Upon his death, he can eliminate one remaining player by using his last bullet. He is Little Red Riding Hood's guardian angel, without knowing her identity.

Little Red Riding Hood – While she has no powers, she benefits from the hunter's protection because as long as he is alive, she will be protected from werewolf attacks at night.

The Cupid – He has the power to form a pair of two players whose goal is to survive and win the game together.
Because if one of them dies… the other will die of grief.

• CREATURES OF THE NIGHT
Their mission: eliminate all the villagers without being spotted.

Werewolf – Every night, he meets with his fellow wolves to decide on a victim to devour.

The Infectious Father of Wolves – Once per game, he can decide whether the werewolf's victim will transform into a werewolf and join the pack. His infection can be crucial: the infected person retains his innocent powers.

The Big Bad Wolf – As long as no other wolf is dead, he has the power to devour an additional victim each night.

• LONELY SOULS
They are not necessarily wolves, nor part of the village... they only obey their own rules.

The White Werewolf – He is part of the pack... until he decides to betray. Every other night, he has the power to assassinate a wolf in his pack. His wish: to be the sole survivor.

The Assassin – His goal is to finish and win the game alone. Each night, he can assassinate one player, and he cannot die from the wolf attack.

The Chemist – His goal is to win alone. Every other night, he can infect a player with his potion. At dawn, each infected player has a 50% chance of transmitting it to their neighbor, a 33% chance of dying,
and a 10% chance of recovering.

The Pyromaniac – Each night, he can cover two players in gasoline, or set fire to everyone he's already doused in order to win the game alone.

So... Will you prefer to be a hero... or a silent menace?
70010000127116.name: Werewolf Online

70010000127134.description:
Game Features
Intense Combat: Fight your way through hostile territory using precision and speed to eliminate threats before they pin you down.

8 Handcrafted Levels: Navigate through diverse, meticulously designed environments—from urban ruins to fortified jungle outposts.

The Final Push: Fight toward the extraction zone and hold your ground until the rescue helicopter arrives.

Action-Oriented Gameplay: Optimized for quick sessions and relentless momentum.

Lock, load, and reach the chopper. Your mission starts now.
70010000127134.intro: Strap in for a high-octane rescue operation where every second counts. In this combat experience, you are dropped behind enemy lines with one objective: survive long enough to escape.
70010000127134.name: Military Extraction

70010000127141.description:
The ocean was supposed to be dangerous.

Nobody warned you it would be this complicated.

One second you're out on the water minding your business...
The next you're locked in combat with a creature that has terrorized sailors for a thousand years.

You win. You capture her. And then...
She transforms into a stunning anime girl who is now, inexplicably, interested in you.

And yes. You are going on a date with her. An actual date. With a former siren. Who tried to kill you twenty minutes ago.

Every siren you catch reveals a different girl. Every girl has her own personality forged from centuries in the deep: fierce, mysterious, proud, or dangerously sweet.

Take her out, make the right choices, and watch something impossible start to feel very real.

Unlock scenes, images, and moments that prove you were never just fishing.

Go deeper. Hunt harder. The stronger the siren, the more unforgettable the girl waiting on the other side.

Your choices decide who falls for you.
The real question is whether you are ready to fall too.


Features:

♥ CAPTURE & TRANSFORM: You beat her in combat. Now she's an anime girl and somehow that's your problem.

♥ LEVEL UP & HUNT HARDER: The strongest sirens don't go down easy. Upgrade your skills, sharpen your gear, and go after the ones that were laughing at you five minutes ago.

♥ TURN-BASED COMBAT: Strategy, timing, and the audacity to think you can handle what comes next.

♥ ROMANCE & VISUAL NOVEL CHOICES: She's not easy to impress. Every date, every word, every decision counts.

♥ CHARACTER COLLECTION: Each girl is shaped by what she was. Ancient, wild, powerful... and now yours to figure out.

♥ MULTIPLE ENDINGS: What you unlock depends entirely on how far you're willing to go.


Strange. Addictive. Surprisingly romantic.
Are you ready to find out what the ocean has been hiding?
70010000127141.intro:
Catch sirens. Transform them. Date them.
The ocean has no rules anymore.
70010000127141.name: Mermaid Catch: Transform Sirens into Anime Girls

70010000127147.description:
Hamstory is a heartfelt 2D pixel platformer where every fall is part of the journey forward.

Join Hamcho on a touching adventure to reach Haessi Star. Along the way, you will leap across challenging paths, sometimes miss your jump, and try again. Each attempt helps you grow stronger, teaching you how to go a little further than before. The way forward is not always clear, but with patience and a bit of courage, you will find your own path.

As you travel, you will meet kind animal friends who share their stories and cheer you on. By helping them, you can learn new techniques and discover small moments that make the journey feel meaningful. Even when things do not go as planned, you are never alone.

The world of Hamstory is brought to life with carefully crafted pixel art and gentle animations. Changing seasons shape the atmosphere as you progress, making each step of the adventure feel fresh and alive.

Keep leaping, keep trying, and create your own story as you make your way toward Haessi Star.
70010000127147.intro: Where heartfelt moments meet thrilling challenges
70010000127147.name: Hamstory

70010000127153.description:
The ocean was supposed to be dangerous.

Nobody warned you it would be this complicated.

One second you're out on the water minding your business...
The next you're locked in combat with a creature that has ruled the deep since before anyone alive can remember.

You win. You capture him. And then...
He transforms into a stunning anime boy who is, against all logic, now part of your life.

And yes. You are going on a date with him. An actual date. With a former siren. Who was trying to destroy you twenty minutes ago.

Every siren you catch reveals a different guy. Every guy carries a personality built from centuries beneath the surface: intense, guarded, chaotic, or quietly impossible to ignore.

Take him out, make the right choices, and watch something that should not exist start to feel like the most natural thing in the world.

Unlock scenes, images, and moments that prove this was never just a fishing trip.

Go deeper. Hunt harder. The stronger the siren, the more unforgettable the story waiting on the other side.

Your choices decide who lets you in.
The real question is whether you are ready for what that means.


Features:

● CAPTURE & TRANSFORM: You won the fight. Now he's an anime boy and neither of you saw this coming.

● LEVEL UP & HUNT HARDER: The rarest sirens are the most dangerous ones. Get stronger, upgrade your arsenal, and prove you deserve to even be in the same water as them.

● TURN-BASED COMBAT: These creatures ruled the deep for centuries. They don't go down without a fight.

● ROMANCE & VISUAL NOVEL CHOICES: He remembers what you did to catch him. Make the next moves count.

● CHARACTER COLLECTION: Every boy carries something ancient in him. Getting past it is the real game.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Some doors only open if you earn the trust to reach them.

70010000127159.description:
You landed on this island with a relationship back home and zero intention of complicating things. Then the girls showed up.

Beautiful, bold, and completely unaware that you're supposed to be off limits. The problem is, so are they.

Work the island, build your reputation, and find yourself in situations you didn't plan for. Dates that start innocent and don't stay that way. Late night chats that go further than they should.

Every girl here pulls at something different, and the more time you spend with them, the harder it gets to remember why you're supposed to say no. The in-game chat keeps you close even when you're apart. And distance, on an island this small, doesn't last long.

A girl who goes after what she wants without apology, one who pretends she feels nothing until she does, a wild one who makes terrible ideas sound perfect... None of them are asking you to choose. Not yet.

Someone is waiting for you. The island doesn't care.


Features:

● ISLAND JOBS & SKILL PROGRESSION: Build your life on the island and open doors you weren't supposed to open.

● DATES YOU WEREN'T SUPPOSED TO GO ON: Hidden coves, rooftop bars, late nights by the water. Every date is a line you're crossing.

● IN-GAME CHAT SYSTEM: Keep the conversations going. The ones back home, and the ones that are getting complicated.

● EXCLUSIVE GALLERY IMAGES: The further you go, the more unlocks. Some things can't be unseen.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: You can stay faithful. You can fall. You can burn everything down. The choice is yours.

● 30 DAYS ON THE ISLAND: The summer has an expiration date. Every day you waste is a door that closes forever.


Someone at home is waiting for you.
The girls on this island are not waiting for anyone.
How long can you hold out?
70010000127159.intro:
You have someone waiting at home.
But the island doesn't know that, and neither do they.
70010000127159.name: Love Island: Forbidden Girls Temptation

70010000127165.description:

Every guy here pulls at something you didn't know was there, and the more time you spend with them, the harder it gets to look away. The in-game chat keeps you close even when you're apart. And on an island this small, distance doesn't fix anything.

70010000127191.description:
Somewhere between the attic and the flea market, retro consoles have started fighting back. Old machines, blinking cursors, cartridges with a mind of their own. Something's alive in there.

Battle them turn by turn, wear them down, then catch them.

That's when the real surprise hits: every console you capture transforms into an anime girl carrying pieces of its old hardware personality.

Take her on dates, make the right choices, and watch the bond grow.

• The stubborn beige box that never wanted to boot up? Meet the girl who takes forever to warm up to you, but is worth every second.
• The tiny handheld that fit in your pocket? She's quick, playful, and always one step ahead.
• The chunky console with the flashing red light? Turns out she runs hot and burns just as fast for you.


Features:

♥ CAPTURE & TRANSFORM: Battle retro machines, capture them, and watch them become anime girls with personalities pulled straight from their old hardware quirks.

♥ TURN-BASED COMBAT: Outsmart every console before it powers down on you. Strategy meets seduction.

♥ ROMANCE & VISUAL NOVEL CHOICES: Take her on dates, say the right thing, unlock secret memories and scenes.

♥ CHARACTER COLLECTION: Every console has its own anime form and its own personality. Collect them all.

♥ MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Not every route ends the same way. Choose wisely.


Yes, you read that right. You're about to date your old game console.
Ready to hit start?
70010000127191.intro:
Your dusty old console just blinked.
Catch it before it runs and it might just become your girlfriend.
70010000127191.name: Pixel Hunters: Turn Retro Consoles into your Girlfriend

70010000127203.description:
Have you ever wanted to escape from the stress of urban life? Nom Nom: Cozy Forest Café is a cozy and relaxing decoration and rhythm game where you manage a café and befriend cute animals.

Low stress, non confrontational, relaxing experience.

Manage your own cafeteria! Customize your place with furniture, decorations, lamps, wallpaper, and flooring. Take pictures of your favourite corners, dishes, and customers and share them on the café's website.

Adorable customers! Forge friendships and learn about their favourite recipes and decorations.

Learn new recipes... To the beat! Prepare snacks and drinks, from waffles to sodas, to the rhythm of upbeat tunes and colourful animations.

Unleash your creativity! Practice your skills whenever you like. Experiment with new ingredient combinations and sell them in your own vending machine to earn rewards!

Use your own custom designs! You can customize different objects, as well as your dishes! Paint signs, posters and even T-shirts for your customers.
70010000127203.intro: A decoration-focused café game where you bake and brew... TO THE BEAT!
70010000127203.name: Nom Nom: Cozy Forest Café

70010000127214.description:
continue the legendary clicker series, offering unique challenges, deep strategy and exciting gameplay. As a wise king, you once again enter the battle to save the kingdom, which is plunging into darkness.

The game is a 2D autobattler with an isometric view. Place your troops, press "Play" and watch the majestic battles full of surprises. But now everything is in your hands - collect crystals and use powerful spells: call tornadoes or strike enemies with lightning to turn the tide of battle!

Each new level brings more dangerous enemies and insidious bosses. For victories, you will receive stars that can be used to strengthen your army and unlock new combat abilities. Your strategy and instant decisions on the battlefield will be the key to victory.

Get ready for a world where the fate of kingdoms is determined by clicks. Take up the challenge, prove your skills and become a true legend!
70010000127214.intro:
choose your strategy
improve your allies
defeat enemy castle
70010000127214.name: Lord of the Click 5

70010000127215.description:
Dive into a world of stunning, realistic puzzles that captivate your eyes and mind. Piece by piece, reveal breathtaking images of beautiful women — each completed puzzle unlocks a new masterpiece, keeping you motivated to discover what’s next.

Smooth and intuitive touch controls make gameplay effortless and deeply satisfying — you’ll feel like you’re truly shaping every picture with your own hands. Gentle, soothing music sets the perfect mood, helping you unwind while your curiosity pulls you to complete the next challenge.

Relax, enjoy, and let yourself get lost in the details.

Features:
• Addictive, easy-to-play puzzle mechanics.
• Gorgeous, realistic artwork of women.
• Satisfying touch interaction — every move feels natural.
• Unlock new, even more stunning images as you progress.
• Perfect balance of challenge and relaxation.
• Soothing soundtrack that enhances your focus and mood.
• Admire each completed image in full detail.
70010000127215.intro: Every piece brings you closer to perfection!
70010000127215.name: Anime Codex: Whispered Lips

70010000127269.description:
You noclipped out of reality. Now you are standing in a yellow corridor that stretches further than it should. The lights buzz. The carpet is damp. There is no way back.

BACKROOMS PHASES takes you deeper into the Backrooms than you have ever been. Each phase warps the world around you — familiar halls fracture into something darker, stranger, and far more hostile. Something here has gone through phases of its own. The entities that roam these corridors were not always what they are now. They shifted. They changed. And what they became is worse.

HAND-CRAFTED ENTITIES
Every creature in the game was designed and modeled from scratch. No templates, no recycled assets. Each entity has a distinct silhouette, behavior pattern, and reason to terrify you.

ATMOSPHERIC SOUND DESIGN
Footsteps echo wrong. Doors creak behind you. Sometimes the fluorescent hum stops — and the silence is worse. Sound is your only warning system. Use headphones.

PUZZLES UNDER PRESSURE
Locked passages, hidden tools, multi-step objectives. You will need to search, think, and act while something is hunting you. The Backrooms do not wait.

PHASE-BASED PROGRESSION
Each phase changes the rules. New environments, new threats, new ways to die. The deeper you go, the less this place resembles anything real.

From the creators of BACKROOMS INSIDE THE ESCAPE. The next descent is here.
70010000127269.intro: Wander through the shifting phases of the Backrooms. Solve puzzles, avoid twisted entities, and find a way out before the corridors close in on you forever.
70010000127269.name: Backrooms Phases

70010000127283.description:
A peaceful picnic turns into a big adventure when Judy wakes up to find her house key gone!

Run, jump, slip, and explore through colorful forests, golden cities, metallic sewers, and secret filled areas in this charming retro platforming adventure.

Features:
• Over 140 levels in 8 colorful areas!
• 4 challenges for skilled players
• Many charming NPCs
• Hidden Game Girls to find
• Unlockable art, music, and more
70010000127283.intro: Judy’s house key has been stolen by a mysterious hand, and now she needs your help to get it back!
70010000127283.name: Judy's Adventure DX

70010000127290.description:
As in the previous entries, you can enjoy very simple puzzles and pleasant music.
Relax while assembling beautiful images.
Bloodthirsty vampires, wild nomads, daring pirates, and many other heroines are waiting for you!
70010000127290.intro: The third installment in the fantasy puzzle series.
70010000127290.name: Anime: Fantasy Uni 3

70010000127387.description:
Golftacular! is mini-golf... barely. Mix party game chaos and dumb fun with precision and strategy.

Up to 4 players take turns as Tortillo, Chuck, Fin, Poop, Papa, Mama, Claude, and Frend, each one aiming for the hole while unleashing chaos on anyone foolish enough to stand in the way.

Enjoy endless replayability with dozens of handcrafted courses and thousands of possible item combos. Items shake up everything: turn the course into your personal parkour playground or an obstacle-filled nightmare for your opponents. Call in airstrikes, play rock-paper-scissors, give your ball wings, place portals... and that’s just the tip of the iceberg.


FEATURES

- Items, Items, Items - Use items for game breaking abilities and combos
- Ear Candy Radio - Bumping original sound track
- Express yourself - Pick from a cast of whackos... which one are you?
- Play it your way - Play with keyboard & mouse or controllers
- Not enough controllers? No Problem! - Pass and play mode lets you share
- No friends? No problem! - Tackle challenging courses alone in single player puzzles
70010000127387.intro: Mini-golf turned upside down! Abuse wild items on a variety of challenging golf tours. Shoot, fly, explode, and whatever else you can to get in the hole! It’s golf... barely.
70010000127387.name: Golftacular!

70010000127426.description:
◆ Welcome to Mousebusters!
You just moved into your new place, and are excited to settle in…when all of a sudden, you get turned into a mouse! Thankfully, you soon meet a fellow rodent who knows how to help.
He asks you to call him “Chief,” and explains that there’s only one way to break the curse: by ridding the whole apartment building of the ghosts that haunt its inhabitants!

◆ Get to Know Your New Neighbors
In each apartment, you'll find a different ghost—but it won't be that easy to track them down. It seems they prey on negative emotions, so in order to smoke them out, you'll have to do some major recon to figure out each resident's biggest insecurities. Just don't get caught!

◆ A Partner You Can Count On
Luckily, you won't have to go it alone, because you'll be in frequent contact with the Chief throughout each mission. From his comfy desk at HQ, he'll offer plenty of guidance and comedic commentary as you scour the building and solve puzzles to find each ghost.

◆ Engage in Ghost-Zapping Action!
Once you've tracked down the source of each resident's woes, you'll have to whip out your trusty ray gun and perform a good ol' fashioned exorcism. Protect yourself from projectiles while targeting their weak points to expose their spectral cores!

◆ Venture Down the Rabbit Hole
Over the course of your investigations, you'll slowly uncover more and more evidence that suggests something far more ominous is going on with this building...and it seems the Chief knows more about the curse than he's letting on. Just how deep does this conspiracy go?
70010000127426.intro: Explore a haunted apartment building to save its cute and quirky residents from their inner demons in this pint-sized pixel adventure!
70010000127426.name: Mousebusters

70010000127431.description:
Explore a Fallen Kingdom
Venture through a mythic land marked by the ruins of fallen kingdom slowly being reclaimed by an enduring and untamed nature. 

Guide an Unlikely Hero 
Form a powerful bond with Quill, a small but courageous mouse who looks to you for guidance, protection, and trust at every step of her journey.

Embark on a Timeless Tale
Uncover hidden secrets, navigate puzzling places, and confront arcane forces in an intimate and epic fable inspired by classic fantasy adventures. 

Optional Local Co-Op
Play together as Quill and the Reader, each using a separate controller

Additional Features
• Explore a fallen kingdom slowly reclaimed by nature
• Guide a tiny hero through puzzling places and towering dangers
• Solve handcrafted, diorama-like environmental puzzles
• Discover hidden secrets and surprises off the beaten path
• Face arcane threats with optional “skip combat” accessibility
• Uncover the epic and heartfelt tale of a hero who needs you
• Thoughtfully designed and lovingly crafted by a small team
• Critically acclaimed with over 160 awards and nominations 
• Orchestral soundtrack by acclaimed composer Jason Graves

Moss: The Forgotten Relic brings Moss: Book I and Moss: Book II together as one complete, enhanced experience debuting and beautifully reimagined for Nintendo Switch™.
70010000127431.intro: Journey through the pages of a living fable.
70010000127431.name: Moss: The Forgotten Relic

70010000127458.description:
A brand-new Flip-Flip Jigsaw puzzle game featuring adorable girls has arrived!
In addition to traditional jigsaw puzzle gameplay, this game introduces exciting Flip and Rotate mechanics.
Flip pieces over, rotate them into place, and complete beautiful illustrations while taking on increasingly challenging stages!
15 stages in total!
As you progress, new mechanics and larger puzzles will test your puzzle-solving skills.

Stages 1–5: Rotate Puzzles
Stages 6–10: Flip Puzzles
Stages 11–15: Flip & Rotate Puzzles
Up to 81 pieces × 2 sides in the most challenging stages!

In Flip stages, you can complete either the front side or the back side first.
Choose your strategy and solve each puzzle your way♪
The final stage is an extreme challenge with no background watermark hints!
Carefully examine every piece and complete the puzzle!
The gallery also contains both front-side and back-side versions of every illustration.
Clear every stage and complete the entire gallery collection!
=====================
Our company supports content creators and streamers.
You do not need to obtain permission before uploading gameplay videos or live streaming this game.
70010000127458.intro: Clear Both Sides♪ A Cute Girl Puzzle Game Featuring the Unique "Flip-Flip" Challenge!
70010000127458.name: Flip-Flip Jigsaw Girls

70010000127463.description:
Conquer challenging card configurations and take on a big, vibrant game with several levels of varying difficulties.

Weekend Solitaire Summer Village dives into a bright world filled with vibrant gameplay, colorful animations, and hours of addictive card-solving fun!

Enjoy an exciting journey through 130 levels of various complexities, each presenting a unique challenge that will put your solitaire skills to the test.
Get ready to unwind and bask in the joys of summer with Weekend Solitaire Summer Village!
70010000127463.intro: It's time to take on Solitaire Challenge.
70010000127463.name: Weekend Solitaire Summer Village

70010000127478.description:
RollerCoaster Tycoon® Classic™ is a new RCT experience, remastered in 2017 by franchise creator Chris Sawyer to combine the best features from two of the most successful and beloved RCT games in the series’ history – RollerCoaster Tycoon® and RollerCoaster Tycoon® 2. Roller Coaster Tycoon Classic also comes complete with the Toolkit, Wacky Worlds, and Time Twister expansion packs!  Create and run amazing parks filled with the most outrageous rides imaginable.  RCT Classic includes a mixture of authentic playability, depth of gameplay and unique graphical style of Chris Sawyer’s original best-selling RollerCoaster Tycoon® Games. Packed with content, players can enjoy designing and building roller coasters and rides, landscaping parks and managing the staff and finances to keep their guests happy and the money flowing in. Can you become the next RollerCoaster Tycoon?

Key Features:

The Original RollerCoaster Sim: Experience all the fun from the original RollerCoaster Tycoon® and RollerCoaster Tycoon® 2 games, with a new sim that combines the best elements of both classic titles.

Coaster Construction: Create incredible roller coasters – Quickly build a pre-made design or use the intuitive piece-by-piece building tools to design and theme your own unique rides.

Park Designer: Keep your guests happy by building gentle or wild rides, food and drink stalls, water rides, and even transport rides to take them around the park; Customize your park by building scenery, fine-tuning the landscape, and routing the footpaths.

Park Management: Run your park’s marketing and finances to make a profit while attracting more guests; Organize your staff to keep the park running well and looking its best.

Exciting Environments: Build the ultimate theme park in a variety of challenging environments, from the tranquility of Forest Frontiers to the bustling commerce of Megaworld Park.

Park Scenarios: Progress through 95 classic park scenarios from RollerCoaster Tycoon® and RollerCoaster Tycoon® 2.

Authentic Gameplay: Classic-style isometric graphics and original amusement park music and sound effects.

Packed with Content: Includes hundreds of types of roller coasters and rides, and dozens of different shops, stalls, and facilities.
70010000127478.intro: Create incredible parks in the original rollercoaster sim from Chris Sawyer.
70010000127478.name: RollerCoaster Tycoon Classic Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000127490.description:
Prepare for a prehistoric battle where intelligence matters more than brute force. In Dino Hex Trap, every trap can completely change the course of the invasion, and every decision transforms the battlefield into a massive strategic puzzle filled with action and creativity.

Forget fixed towers and predictable strategies. Here, you control traps placed across a dynamic hexagonal field where direction, spacing, and positioning make all the difference. Rotate, reposition, and combine traps to turn seemingly safe routes into true corridors of Jurassic destruction.

Waves of dinosaur-inspired creatures keep advancing, and it is up to you to stop them before they reach your base. But resources are limited, so every choice matters: expand your defense with new traps or reorganize the ones you already have? Improvisation is part of survival.

As the campaign progresses, new trap types unlock increasingly creative possibilities. Some levels already begin with fixed structures spread throughout the map, completely changing the way you think about strategy and forcing you to constantly adapt.

With 30 levels spread across morning, afternoon, and night biomes, Dino Hex Trap combines planning, resource management, and spatial awareness in fast, smart, and deeply satisfying challenges.

With stylish visuals, engaging battles, and that perfect feeling of “now my strategy is brilliant,” Dino Hex Trap is an irresistible experience for players who love strategic defense, meaningful decisions, and defeating hordes in the most creative ways possible.

Watch the paths, prepare your traps, and prove that even dinosaurs can fall into the perfect plan.
70010000127490.name: Dino Hex Trap

70010000127496.description:
Get ready for a clever, relaxing, and strategy-filled adventure across a lake where every move matters. In Damways, you control a resourceful beaver that slides endlessly across the water, reshaping the environment with dams and creating unlikely paths toward home.

But nothing here is as simple as it seems. The beaver does not move step by step. Once it starts sliding, it only stops when it hits an obstacle, a wall, wood, or one of your own dams. This turns every direction into an important decision where predicting the trajectory matters just as much as choosing the destination.

Collect bundles of wood scattered around the lake and use them to build strategic dams capable of completely reshaping the map. Create new barriers, redirect routes, open impossible paths, and transform the environment piece by piece until the perfect solution appears.

Every piece of wood is precious. You can carry only one at a time, so deciding when to collect, where to build, and how to reorganize the lake makes all the difference. A badly placed dam can block your entire route… but with Undo and Restart features, there is always room to experiment with new ideas.

As the journey continues, the challenges become increasingly creative, bringing more complex maps, clever obstacles, and puzzles that demand observation, planning, and spatial reasoning. The result is a relaxing yet deeply satisfying experience for players who love well-crafted puzzles.

With cozy visuals, a peaceful atmosphere, and that wonderful feeling of finally understanding the solution, Damways transforms every lake into a strategic playground full of possibilities.

Observe the environment, slide through the water, and build the perfect path toward the den.
70010000127496.intro: Slide, Build, and Master the Lake
70010000127496.name: Damways

70010000127521.description:
"KARNOV" is an action game released by Data East in 1987.
Defeat the Emperor of Darkness and reclaim the stolen treasures.
KARNOV can attack by breathing fire from his mouth.
Also, by making use of 9 different weapons (options), you can perform various actions such as increasing movement speed, creating a ladder, and flying through the air.
What will happen when you defeat bosses and collect all the torn map pieces...?

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.
70010000127521.intro: Rise, brave Karnov! Defeat the Emperor of Darkness!
70010000127521.name: Arcade Archives KARNOV

70010000127560.description:
Experience Tales of Eternia, remastered for the first time ever.

• An Epic Journey with Two Worlds at Stake
Journey to Eternia, a world split into two isolated realms, Inferia and Celestia.
In the remote Inferian village of Rasheans, Reid Hershel and his childhood friend Farah Oersted meet a mysterious girl named Meredy. During their journey to discover Meredy's origins, the group discovers that a collision called the "Great Fall" threatens both Inferia and Celesita.
Harnessing the power of elemental spirits known as the Greater Craymels, Reid and his companions embark on an epic journey to save the two realms from catastrophe.

• Exhilarating Battle Action with Speed and Freedom
Featuring the Aggressive Linear Motion Battle System (A-LMBS), which enables diverse Arte usage, continued combos, and coordination with each unique party member.
Experience thrilling combat as you outmaneuver enemies and defeat them one after another with fast-paced, dynamic 2D battle action.

• The Same Moving Experience, Now Easier to Play
Gameplay is better than ever with the quality-of-life features that have been added, including destination markers, the ability to disable enemy encounters, and high-speed mode during auto-battle.
Additionally, graphics and SFX can be toggled between modes, allowing you to experience the nostalgic atmosphere of the original game.
70010000127560.intro: The strength to change. A resolve that never wavers.
70010000127560.name: Tales of Eternia Remastered

70010000127566.description:
Enjoy goldfish scooping anytime on Nintendo Switch™!
Aim for a high score in solo play, or compete with up to 4 players in exciting multiplayer battles!

Grab items and gain the upper hand!
Make your poi bigger, boost your movement speed, and catch tons of fish!
Sometimes you'll even be able to hinder your rivals and turn the tide of the match!
Chaotic action and constant surprises mean it's anyone's game until the very end!

[Classic Stage]
Enjoy the festival atmosphere in this traditional goldfish scooping experience!
Catch a variety of goldfish and rack up the highest score possible!

[Japanese Stage]
A beautiful stage inspired by traditional rock gardens!
Use the flow of the water to skillfully scoop up goldfish as they drift by!

[Colorful Stage]
Dive into a colorful toy-box world packed with surprises!
Toy goldfish and unpredictable gimmicks create nonstop chaos!

Watch out for explosive pufferfish that affect everything around them!
Beware of sharks that gobble up other fish!
Take on gigantic boss fish that require multiple scoops to catch!

Face a never-ending stream of unique challenges in the ultimate goldfish scooping experience!

[Score Attack]
Catch as many goldfish as you can before time runs out!
Chain catches together and target high-value fish to set a new personal best!

[Battle]
Battle it out with up to 4 players!
Use items strategically and scoop more goldfish than your opponents to claim victory!

[Rankings]
Compete with players from around the world for the highest score!
Can you become a true goldfish scooping master?
70010000127566.intro:
It's goldfish scooping like you've never seen it before!
Scoop up crazy goldfish one after another!
70010000127566.name: Super Goldfish Scooping

70010000127576.description:
Players control two different burglars, each with their own role, size, and strengths. The smaller character is fast, agile, and perfect for reaching tight spaces, climbing, activating switches, and sneaking through dangerous areas. The larger character is slower but stronger, able to push heavy crates, carry objects, throw items, and help solve puzzles that the smaller character cannot complete alone.

Every level is built around cooperation, timing, and clever use of the environment. Players must move through prison corridors, security rooms, industrial platforms, locked passages, traps, lasers, moving platforms, pressure buttons, sliding doors, safes, cameras, guards, and other hazards. Progress often requires using both characters together: one may need to stand on a button while the other passes through a door, push a crate into position, avoid a patrol, disable a mechanism, or create a path forward.

Expect short but carefully designed levels with increasing complexity. Early stages introduce basic movement, buttons, doors, crates, and simple platforming. Later levels add more advanced mechanics such as moving platforms, animated traps, security cameras, laser barriers, locked safes, enemy guards, timing-based obstacles, and multi-step puzzles where both characters must work together.

Key features:
- Cooperative puzzle-platform gameplay
- Two playable characters with different abilities
- Levels built around teamwork and timing
- Pushable crates, pressure buttons, sliding doors, traps, lasers, cameras, safes, and guards
- Levels that become more complex as new mechanics are introduced
- Designed for quick, satisfying puzzle-solving sessions
70010000127576.intro: Cash Movers is a 2D cooperative puzzle-platformer about two unlikely partners trying to escape a heavily guarded building collecting as much cash as possible.
70010000127576.name: Cash Movers

70010000127582.description:
MotoGP™19 celebrates passion for motorsports with many new features!

With the Historical Challenges mode you can relive the most exciting rivalries that made the history of the MotoGP™!

Compete with a faster, smarter and more accurate AI based on machine learning!

Play with your favourite 2019 Championship rider and race on 19 different tracks! Discover all the classes: MotoGP™, Moto2™, Moto3™, Red Bull MotoGP™ Rookies Cup and the new MotoE™.

Create your style and customise your helmet, lower back patch and racing number with the new graphic editors!

Improve your bike's performance working on different technical aspects during dedicated tests and plan your strategy to be the best!
70010000127582.name: MotoGP™19

70010000127586.description:
Rev up your engines for a new chapter of the MotoGP™ series!

With MotoGP™20, experience all the thrills of the more-complete-than-ever Managerial Career mode and decide whether to join a 2020 season team and race together with the official riders or join a totally brand new team.

Discover more realistic physics, improved graphics, new 3D models of riders and face scans of official MotoGP™ team managers, plus new animations. Learn to manage gasoline and tyre consumption.

Customize your bike and your suit! Find the best combination of sponsor and livery, and choose colours and materials. Coordinate everything to win in style!

Compete with legendary riders! New historic content and a new gaming mode await you to let you relive MotoGP™ history.
70010000127586.name: MotoGP™20

70010000127660.description:
[Game Details]
Celebrating the 20th anniversary of the Kiseki series,
a story-driven RPG that began in 2004, the landmark first installment, The Legend of Heroes: Sora no Kiseki FC (First Chapter), is receiving a full remake!
The Liberl Kingdom, the setting of the adventure, is brought to life in stunning 3D, with refined designs for all characters, including the vibrant Estelle and Joshua.
Enjoy seamless transitions between two battle modes: field action and command battles. The remake also features dynamic presentations of each character's special abilities (Crafts) and elemental magic (Arts), delivering exhilarating and stress-free combat.
While retaining the picturesque charm of the Liberl Kingdom, the game offers various quests and extensive side content, allowing players to immerse themselves in the journey through the kingdom from a fresh perspective.

●Prologue
Estelle and Joshua embark on a journey across the Liberl Kingdom, spurred by the mysterious disappearance of their father, Cassius. Meet new allies, experience heartfelt farewells, and uncover the fate that awaits the two at the end of their journey...
70010000127660.name: Sora no Kiseki the 1st Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000127718.description:
Sky Reach is a minimalistic, neon-drenched infinite climber set in a cyberpunk city that stretches from the darkest slums to the open sky above.

You play as a small rectangular hero with one goal: climb higher than ever before. Jump from platform to platform, react fast, and keep moving upward as the city pulses beneath you.

But Sky Reach isn’t just about precision jumping.

Shape Your Own Path

The core mechanic lets you shoot energy waves. The world itself is alive with waves of motion - and when the waves collide, they create new platforms.
Every shot matters. Every collision can change your route. You’re not just climbing the tower - you’re building it as you go.

Climb Together

Play solo or team up in local co-op for two players. Help each other recover from falls, create platforms together, and push your climb further than you ever could alone. Cooperation can mean the difference between a new high score… or a long fall down.

Grow Stronger the Higher You Go

Reach climbing milestones to unlock new power-ups that let you jump higher, move faster, and bend the rules of ascent. Master them, chain your progress, and chase ever-greater heights - and scores.

A Neon City With a Soul

Ascend through five distinct neon backdrops, each revealing a new layer of the city - from gritty street-level slums to the glowing skyline and beyond. Beneath the action lies a simple, touching narrative, quietly unfolding as you rise.
70010000127718.intro: Shape the climb. Ride the waves. Reach the sky.
70010000127718.name: Sky Reach

70010000127719.description:
Let's make shaved ice on the Nintendo Switch™!
Quickly shave ice and add the correct toppings to fill each order!
With a Joy-Con™ per player, up to 4 players can join in the fun!
Aim for a new high score!

《Rules》
Make shaved ice and fill customer orders!
Make as many as you can within the time limit!

《How to Play》
1. Shave the ice!

2. Add the syrup that matches the order!

3. Add fruit as a topping!

4. Serve the shaved ice to your customers! Match the orders exactly to earn more points!

[Score Attack]
Make lots of shaved ice and climb the leaderboards!

[Battle]
Compete in battles and put your shaved ice skills to the test!
70010000127719.intro:
Get ready for a delicious shaved ice challenge!
Make lots of shaved ice and watch your food cart prosper!
70010000127719.name: Make it! Shaved Ice

70010000127727.description:
Touhou: Lost Branch of Legend is a deck-building roguelike fan game based on Touhou Project.

One day, Kaguya Houraisan of Eientei held the Lunar Capital Exhibition, attracting visitors from far and wide.
But in the midst of the event, its centerpiece—the treasured artifact known as the “Jeweled Branch of Hourai”—was suddenly stolen.

Seeking to resolve the incident, Kaguya made an announcement:
“Find the missing Exhibit, and I shall reward you with one of my treasures.”

Upon hearing this, the residents of Gensokyo rushed to begin their investigations.
Reimu Hakurei, Marisa Kirisame, Sakuya Izayoi, Cirno, and Koishi Komeiji were no exception.

・Harness your mana and unleash powerful danmaku.

Touhou: Lost Branch of Legend is a deck-building roguelike.
Choose from cards with a wide variety of costs and effects as you advance through each stage.

・Five playable characters, each with two distinct strategies.

The five playable characters are Reimu Hakurei, Marisa Kirisame, Sakuya Izayoi, Cirno, and Koishi Komeiji.

Each character offers two core strategies.
With entirely different cards and tactics to choose from, find your favorite way to fight.

・Collect Exhibits to grow stronger.

Acquiring Exhibits from the Lunar Capital Exhibition allows you to enhance your character’s abilities.

Gather as many Exhibits as you can along the way and take on the powerful foes standing between you and the true culprit.

・Beautiful visual effects bring every journey to life.

To recreate the iconic danmaku battles of Touhou Project as a card game, Touhou: Lost Branch of Legend features more than 200 different danmaku effects.
70010000127727.intro: A Touhou Project deck-building roguelike. Unleash dazzling danmaku and hunt down the culprit who stole the treasured artifact!
70010000127727.name: Touhou: Lost Branch of Legend

70010000127739.description:
Thunder Trucks: Heavy Racers puts you behind the wheel of powerful semi trucks built for speed, impact, and pure chaos.

 FEEL THE POWER
Drive massive trucks that roar across the track with unstoppable momentum. Master acceleration, braking, and handling to control these beasts at high speed.
 INTENSE RACING ACTION
Compete in fast-paced events against skilled opponents. Overtake rivals, hold your line, and fight for first place in adrenaline-filled races.
 UPGRADE YOUR MACHINE
Improve your truck’s performance with upgrades and tune your ride to match your driving style and dominate every track.

Big trucks. Big speed. Bigger competition.
Can you handle the weight of victory?
70010000127739.intro: Race powerful semi trucks in high-speed competitions. Upgrade performance, master control, and dominate intense tracks to become the ultimate heavy racer.
70010000127739.name: Thunder Trucks: Heavy Racers

70010000127740.description:
Enter a futuristic world of light and logic in this immersive 3D puzzle adventure. Your mission is simple: guide powerful laser beams through intricate environments by rotating mirrors, redirecting energy, activating switches, and solving increasingly complex challenges. Every level introduces new mechanics and obstacles that test your precision, timing, and problem-solving skills.

Explore beautifully designed stages filled with glowing visuals, dynamic lighting effects, and satisfying chain reactions as you discover the perfect path for each beam. From relaxing early puzzles to mind-bending late-game challenges, the experience is designed to be accessible for newcomers while offering rewarding depth for puzzle fans.

With intuitive controls, smooth gameplay, and dozens of unique laser-based challenges, this game delivers a relaxing yet engaging experience perfect for players who enjoy strategy, logic, and creative thinking. Can you master the light and complete every puzzle?
70010000127740.intro: Guide laser beams through clever puzzles in this relaxing yet challenging brain teaser.
70010000127740.name: Laser Logic

70010000127742.description:
Worldly: the ultimate Countries & Geography Quiz!

Join Sir Maxwell Worldly on a grand adventure around the globe! Test your knowledge of countries, capitals, flags, maps, and more in the world geography quiz loved by explorers everywhere.

Whether you're a beginner or a seasoned traveller, Worldly makes learning geography fun, fast, and addictive. Play quick rounds to sharpen your knowledge, or dive deep into every country, capital, landmark, and currency on the planet.

Why players love Worldly:
• Guess every world capital and prove your geography skills.
• Learn every country flag in a fun, fast-paced quiz format.
• Explore currencies, landmarks, and regions across the planet.
• Challenge friends and prove you're the most seasoned traveller!
• 54 game modes spanning every corner of the globe.

With game modes covering capitals, countries, flags, maps, currencies, and geography trivia, there's always a new challenge to conquer. Earn achievements, beat your high score, and keep your mind sharp!

Stunning visuals & audio: Explore a beautiful hand-drawn globe as Sir Maxwell whisks you around the planet in his iconic hot air balloon. Enjoy gorgeous cartoon-style graphics and full animation from a BAFTA award-winning art team, plus an addictive soundtrack and sound effects.

Packed with content:
• Every country in the world, with national flags and local currencies.
• Capital cities, city locations, and detailed maps.
• Mini-games, multiple difficulty levels, and fast-paced quiz rounds.
• New quizzes and challenges added regularly — the journey never ends!

Perfect for:
• Students who want to learn world geography and capitals.
• Quiz and trivia fans who love testing their knowledge.
• Travellers curious about countries, flags, and cultures.
