• Anyone who loves fun, educational, and challenging games.

Get Worldly today and start your adventure — how well do you really know our planet?
70010000127742.intro: Guess capital cities, flags & countries in a fun geography quiz!
70010000127742.name: Worldly: Country & Maps Quiz

70010000127760.description:
Embark on an exciting adventure alongside man's best friends. Explore vibrant new worlds, face dangerous enemies, collect coins to unlock adorable new puppies, and rescue the fourth dog, who has been kidnapped by the evil giant rat.

Play as a Shih Tzu, a Corgi, or a Bulldog, each ready to take on the adventure. Jump across challenging platforms, dodge deadly spikes, defeat both ground and flying enemies, and prove that every dog can be a Super Dog
70010000127760.intro: For those of us who have a dog, every one of them is a Super Dog. A game dedicated to all the dogs in the world.
70010000127760.name: SuperDog

70010000127770.description:
Experience life as a vampire in a magical town full of werewolves, witches, mermaids, and more! In this heartwarming, supernatural life-sim, you will raise mystical crops, learn spell-casting and potion-making, and befriend – or even romance – the locals. And at the same time, show your skeptical father that a life of compassion is possible – even for the undead.

Settle down in your family’s abandoned homestead and make it your own. Build your farm with magic crops and livestock, customize your cottage with gothic style, and make friends with other creatures of the night. Embrace immortality and unlock ancient abilities, all in the name of a more bountiful harvest. Unravel the mysteries of the seven families that inhabit Moonlight Peaks and bring a bit of light back to this spooky settlement. Just remember to be back in your coffin before the sun comes up!

■Uncover a Sweet and Spooky Journey
Customize your perfect vampire persona and build relationships with the people of Moonlight Peaks to learn more about the town’s history. Uncover the secrets of the seven families who dwell there – and maybe even find your “tomb” love from any of the two dozen romanceable characters in the process.

■Build Your Dream Gothic Farmstead
Design your cozy gothic homestead, turning a forgotten farm into the ideal sanctuary. Obtain new tools and develop your property to grow even more enchanted crops and raise magical livestock.

■Harness Magical Powers
Embrace your supernatural lineage! Shapeshift into other forms to explore all the town has to offer, and study witchcraft to learn spells that will help you on the farm or when gathering resources.

■Delight in Dark Diversions
Beyond the farm, you’ll be able to enjoy fishing, foraging, and potion-crafting, along with activities like embroidering, flower arranging, and more. You can even collect cards for the town’s favorite game, Nokturna, to play against other residents.
70010000127770.intro: Welcome to your new vampiric life in the magical town of Moonlight Peaks!
70010000127770.name: Moonlight Peaks - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000127772.description:
Ten of Capcom's most popular arcade games in one epic collection!

A wide variety of titles are included from iconic series such as Street Fighter and Darkstalkers, Cyberbots, and the first home console port of Red Earth!
And of course, all titles support online play!
This is the perfect collection for both arcade veterans who remember the titles, and those who want to get into them for the first time!

■ Fully-featured online modes
Players can aim to top the global leaderboards in ranked matches, or create a lobby with friends for casual games or just spectate some exciting matches.
Supported with a robust Rollback netcode which offers a stable and smooth online experience.

■ First-timers welcome
Beginner-friendly features such as training mode and one-button special move control options are included.
You can also save and load any time for a quick do-over!

■ Additional content: The Museum
This archive features more than 500 illustrations and development materials across the 10 included titles.
It also includes concept art that has never been shown to the public before, and behind-the-scenes materials that give a glimpse into the development process.
Not only that, you can listen to over 400 music tracks recorded from the arcade versions of each title.　

Included game titles (Japanese and English versions selectable for most titles *1)
Darkstalkers: The Night Warriors
Night Warriors: Darkstalkers’ Revenge
Vampire Savior: The Lord of Vampire
Vampire Hunter 2: Darkstalkers’ Revenge
Vampire Savior 2: The Lord of Vampire
Hyper Street Fighter II: The Anniversary Edition
Super Puzzle Fighter II Turbo
Super Gem Fighter Mini Mix
Cyberbots: Full Metal Madness
Red Earth

(*1 Vampire Hunter 2: Darkstalkers’ Revenge and Vampire Savior 2: The Lord of Vampire are Japanese versions only)
70010000127772.intro:
Ten of Capcom's most popular arcade games in one epic collection!
All titles support online play!
70010000127772.name: Capcom Fighting Collection

70010000127774.description:
Choose from fan-favorite games like Capcom vs. SNK 2: Mark of the Millennium 2001 and Project Justice to 3D action games like Power Stone and Power Stone 2 in this collection of eight classic fighting games!

Each game in the collection can be played online or co-op!

Get back in the ring and duke it out in battles that everyone rumored, but no one believed!
Whether it's with a rival new or old, give it your all and strive for victory!

- Smooth Online Play!
Compete in heated ranked battles or play for fun in casual matches. Create a lobby with friends and battle head-to-head, play co-op, or spectate other matches.
However you choose to play, rollback netcode makes the experience smooth and fun!
A High Score Challenge mode is also available. Aim for the top of the global leaderboards!

- No Experience? No Problem!
This collection boasts a number of beginner-friendly features such as adjustable difficulty levels, One Button Specials, and training modes.
Plus, players can save and load their progress almost anywhere and pick up right where they left off.

- Additional Features!
Players can view more than 700 pieces of artwork from all 8 titles along with never-before-seen development documents used to make the original games.
The Music feature contains over 300 tracks from the original arcade games that players can listen to at any time!

- Included Games
Capcom vs. SNK: Millennium Fight 2000 Pro
Capcom vs. SNK 2: Mark of the Millennium 2001
Capcom Fighting Evolution
Street Fighter Alpha 3 UPPER
Power Stone
Power Stone 2
Project Justice
Plasma Sword: Nightmare of Bilstein
70010000127774.intro: Capcom's new fighting collection hits the stage!
70010000127774.name: Capcom Fighting Collection 2

70010000127798.description:
Note:
This game focuses on Japanese-style psychological horror and subtle, atmospheric fear.
It is not based on jump scares, action, or chase scenes.
Your task is to observe real-world locations in Japan and report any abnormal phenomena.
Inspired by Japanese urban legends, this experience blends horror with visual attention.
You may find the horror “quiet”—but it lingers in your mind.
If you enjoy subtle, unsettling vibes over gore or action, this game is for you.

ーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーー

To All Employees,
You are a surveillance officer of Japan Stigmatized Property
Operate the security cameras installed throughout the property and monitor for any signs of anomalies
If you discover anything unusual, report it immediately
Failure to report anomalies or repeated mistakes will result in a mission failure
Conversely, if you can maintain surveillance from midnight to 5 a.m., the mission will be considered successful

[Mission Features]
You will be assigned to real-life properties located within Japan
Anomalies will occur randomly
Be aware of phenomena that can only be observed through either the night vision camera or the regular camera

[Examples of Anomalies]
Furniture moving, objects disappearing or appearing
Intrusion by human figures or spirits
Lighting malfunctions, floating orbs
Bloodstains on walls, video distortion
And other phenomena beyond imagination

[Work Hours]
You will be in charge of 4 properties in total
Surveillance duties run from 12:00 a.m. to 5:00 a.m.
Choose between 'Nomal' or 'Special Pay' Assignment difficulty modes

[Other Notes]
Streaming and broadcasting while conducting duties is permitted.
We place no restrictions on monetization or Super Chats.
Submission of permission requests is not required for either individuals or corporate entities.

Please commence your duties.
70010000127798.intro: Can you endure until morning Monitor Japan's stigmatized properties and report any paranormal activity If you miss a report or make repeated mistakes——
70010000127798.name: Japan Stigmatized Property -日本事故物件監視協会-

70010000127802.description:
Japan Stigmatized Property2
To All Personnel:
We appreciate your dedicated efforts in the previous surveillance operation.
Please be advised that the risk level for the current assignment has significantly increased.
You are required to exercise extreme caution while performing your duties.

You are an observer for the "Japan Stigmatized Property Association" (JSP).
Your duty is to monitor surveillance cameras installed in designated properties and check for any anomalies.
Upon discovering an anomaly, you must report it immediately.
Repeated failure to report or excessive false reports will result in "Mission Failure." Conversely, maintaining successful surveillance from 00:00 to 05:00 constitutes "Mission Success."

【Operational Features】
Real-World Locations: You will be assigned to properties that actually exist in Japan.
Randomized Anomalies: Irregularities occur randomly.
Camera Modes: Be vigilant for phenomena visible only through specific equipment (Night Vision or Standard Camera).

【Examples of Anomalies】
Movement of furniture; disappearance or appearance of objects.
Intrusion by human figures or spiritual entities.
Lighting malfunctions; floating orbs.
Bloodstains on walls; video feed noise/interference.
"Something" beyond imagination.

【Shift Details】
Assignment: 4 total properties.
Hours: 00:00 – 05:00 (Midnight shift).
Difficulty: Selectable between "Normal" and "Special Pay" (Hard).

【Others】
Streaming and broadcasting while conducting duties is permitted.
We place no restrictions on monetization or Super Chats.
Submission of permission requests is not required for either individuals or corporate entities.

Please commence your duties.
70010000127802.intro:
Can you survive until dawn?
Monitor real Japanese properties and report every anomaly.
70010000127802.name: Japan Stigmatized Property2 -日本事故物件監視協会-

70010000127807.description: Punch and dodge to the beat in the latest entry of the Fitness Boxing series, now with additional content and performance enhancements for Nintendo Switch 2! Correct your form using a compatible USB-C camera (sold separately), take things up a notch with Boost Up feature, work out with up to three friends via GameShare and more!
70010000127807.intro: A workout that works for you – now enhanced for Nintendo Switch 2!
70010000127807.name: Fitness Boxing 3: Your Personal Trainer – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000127808.description:
Street Fighter II, the most iconic fighting game of all time, is back on the Nintendo Switch™!

Ultra Street Fighter II features all of the classic characters, a host of new single player and multiplayer features, as well as two new fighters: Evil Ryu and Violent Ken!

Choose between classic pixel-art graphics for a retro nostalgia trip, or enjoy a refined new modern look.

Utilize the motion controls of the Joy-Con™ in "Way of the Hado" mode, a new first-person single player experience where players attempt to defeat the Shadaloo army using signature Hadoken and Shoryuken special moves.

Team up with a friend to take on the CPU opponent in a new co-op mode. Create new two-character combos and attack the CPU on both sides! Battle it out with a friend in local multiplayer or take the fight online in Ranked and Casual matches.

Browse through a beautiful 250+ page digital art book featuring over 1,500 illustrations throughout Street Fighter's 30-year history.
70010000127808.intro: The most iconic fighting game is back!
70010000127808.name: Ultra Street Fighter® II: The Final Challengers

70010000127809.description:
This comprehensive collection includes seven classic games, each with various multiplayer options, online capabilities and detailed galleries!

Say goodbye to game overs! Adjust your difficulty settings or give yourself more lives to battle through each game in its entirety. You can also play the English or Japanese versions of each title!

Games included: Final Fight, Captain Commando, The King of Dragons, Knights of the Round and Warriors of Fate, as well as two games that were previously unavailable on consoles: Armored Warriors and Battle Circuit!

Grab some friends, stare down the bad guys and BEAT 'EM UP!
70010000127809.intro: Relive the glory days of cooperative arcade games with the Capcom Beat 'Em Up Bundle!
70010000127809.name: Capcom Beat 'Em Up Bundle

70010000127812.description:
The legendary crossover hits are back!
Jump into this collection of arcade classics from the fan-favorite Marvel and Capcom crossover games!

Dive into an action-packed lineup consisting of seven unique titles, including heavy hitters like X-MEN VS. STREET FIGHTER, and MARVEL vs. CAPCOM 2 New Age of Heroes. The collection also includes the rare beat 'em up game, THE PUNISHER.

Each game in the collection can be played online or co-op!
Whether you're new to the series or you played back in the arcades, players of all levels can enjoy these timeless classics together!

- Smooth Online Play!
Compete in heated ranked battles or play for fun in casual matches. Create a lobby with friends and battle head-to-head, play co-op, or spectate other matches.
However you choose to play, rollback netcode makes the experience smooth and fun!
A High Score Challenge mode is also available. Aim for the top of the global leaderboards!

- No Experience? No Problem!
This collection boasts a number of beginner-friendly features such as adjustable difficulty levels, One Button Specials, and training modes.
Plus, players can save and load their progress almost anywhere and pick up right where they left off.

- Additional Features!
Players can view more than 500 pieces of artwork from all 7 titles along with never-before-seen development documents used to make the original games.
The Music feature contains over 200 tracks from the original arcade games that players can listen to at any time!

- Included Games
X-MEN CHILDREN OF THE ATOM
MARVEL SUPER HEROES
X-MEN VS. STREET FIGHTER
MARVEL SUPER HEROES vs. STREET FIGHTER
MARVEL vs. CAPCOM CLASH OF SUPER HEROES
MARVEL vs. CAPCOM 2 New Age of Heroes
THE PUNISHER
70010000127812.intro: The legendary crossover hits are back!
70010000127812.name: MARVEL vs. CAPCOM Fighting Collection: Arcade Classics

70010000127819.description:
A devilishly fun party game where command RPG battles meet sugoroku-style board game action!

The Sugoroku Park has been taken over by the evil Sugoroku Demon King! Team up with up to four players, roll the dice, make your way across the board, and overcome all kinds of events and battles to reclaim the park.

Work together to defeat the mighty Four Heavenly Kings and the Sugoroku Demon King!

...But only one player can claim victory—and that's the one who brings the defeated boss home.

The moment the boss falls, your allies become your rivals.

Will you cooperate... or betray your friends?
Who will have the last laugh?

Let the betrayal party begin!
70010000127819.intro: Betray your friends?! Totally fair game!
70010000127819.name: Prinny Party: Going Overboard!

70010000127830.description:
Jump into a thrilling anti-gravity racing experience with this complete 3D bike game built for fast-paced arcade action. Ride futuristic bikes across challenging tracks filled with sharp turns, ramps, obstacles, and high-speed gameplay designed to keep players engaged from start to finish.

The game includes polished bike controls, responsive movement, smooth camera systems, and immersive visual effects that create an exciting racing atmosphere. Multiple gameplay systems are already integrated, allowing developers to quickly customize tracks, environments, bikes, UI elements, and game mechanics for their own unique project.

Designed with optimization and flexibility in mind, the project is suitable for creating sci-fi racing games, stunt challenges, endless riding modes, or competitive time-trial experiences. Clean project organization and ready-to-use assets help accelerate development while maintaining high visual quality and enjoyable gameplay performance.

Whether you're building a futuristic racing title or expanding your existing arcade game collection, this game provides a strong foundation for delivering intense speed, stylish visuals, and adrenaline-filled bike action.
70010000127830.intro: Race through futuristic tracks and defy gravity in this fast-paced 3D bike racing game.
70010000127830.name: FlipRide Rush

70010000127836.description:
OddBallers™ is a hilariously charming and totally bonkers multiplayer party game where each round is a new, absurd type of dodgeball.

• Play a new type of hard-hitting dodgeball as you dodge, block, and grab whatever you can to throw at the faces of your frenemies.
• Switch up your playing field, from rustic farms to waterfront towns to paradise islands. Each environment features more than 30 different arenas.
• Every arena comes with its own rules and features various frantic mini-games where anything can happen!
• Challenge your friends and test your skills (and friendships) online or locally! Play with up to six players in your living room, or take the matches online and compete against five other contenders.
• Customize your character from head to toe with hundreds of hilarious outfits, haircuts, and more to be the best-looking in the arena.

Play online with your friends on any platform thanks to cross-play!

Game can be played offline. Internet access required for online features. Terms apply.
70010000127836.name: OddBallers™

70010000127842.description:
Lead your troops to victory in this modern version of the classic RISK game with enhanced 3D visuals, custom rules and tactical gameplay. Play at home or on-the-go with up to four players or play solo with opponents online from around the world.

Classic rules with a twist: Play with the 2010 rules for a standard game or choose Capture the Capitals for a shorter game.

Modern battle map: Direct your troops from a high-tech control room and get tactical advice to help you reach your objectives.

Exciting rewards: Unlock epic videos of tank battles, air combat and more as you lead your troops to victory.

Challenge yourself online: Match wits with opponents from around the world or take on the best of the best in League Play.
70010000127842.name: RISK: The Game of Global Domination

70010000127847.description:
Time to break a sweat!

Sports Party takes you to the seaside where the beach meets the mountain to discover 6 outdoor sports!

Faithfully replicate real-life movements with intuitive and inclusive controls, and get off your couch to challenge your family and friends, whether at home or on the go!

Enjoy Frisbee®, Jet Ski®, Basketball, Golf, Skateboarding and Beach Tennis! Discover several ways to play each sport, making Sports Party easy to play and fun to replay!
70010000127847.name: Sports Party

70010000127860.description:
Welcome to Make it Cozy!

Create the sweetest little home and share it with the cutest animal friends imaginable!

Step into a charming world filled with soft colors, cozy corners, and adorable companions waiting to move in. Design dreamy bedrooms, sunny living rooms, peaceful reading nooks, relaxing bathrooms, and magical outdoor spaces — then watch them come to life with playful kittens, a curious fox, a cheerful penguin, a tiny hedgehog, and many other fluffy friends.

Every room is a place where memories are made. Arrange comfy furniture, decorate with lovely plants, hang cute decorations, and create warm spaces where your animal companions can feel safe, happy, and loved. Whether you prefer a pastel paradise, a cozy cottage, or something wonderfully unique, your imagination is the only limit.

Relax, decorate, and enjoy the gentle atmosphere as your tiny residents explore the home you've created just for them. Every smile, nap, and playful moment makes your cozy world feel even more magical.

KEY FEATURES:
- Design and decorate adorable cozy homes and beautiful outdoor spaces
- Meet charming animal residents including kittens, foxes, penguins, hedgehogs, bunnies, and more
- Hundreds of cute furniture pieces, plants, and decorations to personalize every room
- Warm pastel visuals and relaxing music that create a peaceful atmosphere
- Endless creative freedom to build your dream cozy retreat
- Watch your lovable animal friends enjoy and explore their new home
- Perfect for players who love cozy vibes, cute animals, creativity, and relaxing gameplay
70010000127860.intro: Unleash your creativity in a cutest possible way!
70010000127860.name: Make It Cozy!

70010000127863.description:
Trivial Pursuit Live! 2 is available in English, French, German, Spanish and Russian.

Take your place on stage to showcase your knowledge and face off against friends and family to collect as many wedges as you can to take home the win! Challenge other players from all around the world or compete against your streaming viewers on Twitch. With hundreds of new questions, adapted level of difficulties, and a diverse line-up of characters, everyone can join the party and enjoy the thrill of a fast-paced TV show experience.
70010000127863.name: TRIVIAL PURSUIT Live! 2

70010000127864.description:
Play as a contestant on Wheel of Fortune®, America's favorite TV show, anytime, anywhere! Spin the wheel and put your brain to the test against thousands of unique puzzles. Play solo or challenge players online. Enjoy an authentic TV-show experience with Wheel of Fortune®. Spin the wheel, win special wedges, and experience true-to-the-TV-show rules. Win iconic in-game prizes such as luxurious trips, cars, and up to one million dollars.

Enjoy Classic mode for the original experience, or Quick mode to solve only one puzzle when time is short. Unlock items and personalize your game by upgrading your contestant avatar and the studio set.
70010000127864.name: Wheel of Fortune®

70010000127893.description:
Weekend Solitaire: Voyage offers a colorful array of puzzles through a gentle cascade of challenges.
As you navigate through vibrant and dynamically animated levels, your strategic mind is both soothed and tested, immersing you into a relaxed, yet focused state.
With every card turned and each layout solved, the game crafts an inviting and seamless experience, designed to delicately engage and guide you through the subtle mastery of solitaire.

130 Meticulously Designed Levels Across Four Distinct Card Decks!
Weekend Solitaire: Voyage extends an invitation to explore 130 meticulously designed levels, played across four distinct card decks.
The game intertwines obstacles that keenly beckon your tactical insights with bonuses that appreciatively reward your strategic play.
The narrative unfolds where every card and each layout becomes a chapter of a story, melding tranquility and strategy into a singular, engrossing experience.
70010000127893.intro: Embark on a Serene Journey with Weekend Solitaire: Voyage!
70010000127893.name: Weekend Solitaire Voyage

70010000127907.description:
Welcome to the only taxi company where the driving is done for you, and all the action happens in the backseat. Engage the autopilot and prepare to mess with your passengers. Will you be a five-star professional or the ultimate backseat menace? The choice is yours. Each passenger in your cab is a fully interactive, physics-based rag doll that reacts dynamically to your every move. You can tap the glass, poke them, or tease them. Or, you can just sit back and watch them throw a ridiculous, cartoonish tantrum.

Expect the unexpected on every ride. What will you do if a passenger starts dancing wildly, tries to pick a fight, or demands that you pop a giant pimple on their face? Grab your tools and dive into the madness! Turn up the multimedia, blast their eardrums, spray them down, and test out wild new prank items to see how they react. In this interactive playground, you are the director of the chaos. Annoy them on purpose or try to calm them down. How you handle the ride is completely up to you.

The wilder the ride, the better the stories. Earn cash and driver ratings based on how you handle each crazy encounter. Use your hard-earned tips to unlock more ridiculous prank tools, upgrade your cab's interactive features, and purchase supplies to clean the backseat after a disastrous ride.

Jump into a non-stop comedy show where you always deliver the punchline.
70010000127907.name: Mad Taxi Simulator

70010000127915.description:
STREET UNi X is a retro-callback to the extreme sports games that took over during the cusp of the Y2K Millenium. Fuelled by a passion for this era of gaming, and an obsession with the burgeoning sport of street unicycling, daffodil & friends have crafted STREET UNi X to cater to classic video game fans and unicycling aficionados alike!

With unique controls that capture the nuanced capabilities of unicycling, and the nostalgic goal oriented gameplay rush of video games past, STREET UNI X is guaranteed to leave you at the edge of your seat and wall-tapping to your next grind!

This new release is fired up with hot-tricks, more music, and a deeper dive into the heart of street unicycling, featuring in-game texts from daffodil and other riders from around the world!

Features

• The world's first authentic street unicycling video game! Taking the sport as seriously as the pros with expressive gamepad controls, infectious energy, and tricks you didn't even know were possible!

• Join the ranks of contemporary pro unicyclists! Hop, grind, wall-tap, footplant, rail-ride, and twist your way through a full career mode with secret riders to unlock and hidden tricks to reveal!

• Fresh retro looks! Real-life inspired spots transformed into yester-console playgrounds for you to explore and combo your way to unlocking secrets and besting your high scores!

• Off the rails tracks! Featuring 20+ horn-fuelled ska bops and powered up hardcore punk bangers from your new favourite bands that will keep you humming to yourself and bobbing to the beat!

• No unicycling experience required! Learn how to ride a virtual unicycle that will have you up and rolling in no time, and unleashing hi heat combos and hot-tricks soon after, even if you question reality itself!
70010000127915.intro: Classic EXTREME sports at their best: on ONE WHEEL! Perform unicycle stunts and combos with style, smash goals, unlock new levels, characters, cheats, and more!
70010000127915.name: STREET UNi X

70010000127933.description:
The witch's cauldron is full of kittens. Drop magic eggs into the cauldron and let them merge. Match two of a kind and something bigger appears, climbing from a tiny caracal all the way up to a golden tiger. Easy to pick up, hard to put down.

Merges score points, points become stars, and stars go into the witch's album to unlock new breeds and awaken new forms. Chain your merges for glowing combos. Clear the cauldron completely for a Perfect Round. And take care with a spell that isn't ready yet - unfinished magic turns your cats to quiet stone.

Every few rounds the witch leans in with a word of advice, a bit of lore, or a small proud smile when you beat your best.

Features
• Cozy merge puzzle — easy to learn, hard to stop
• 11 elemental cat breeds and 33 forms to hatch, grow and collect
• A magical album to fill
• Stars, upgrades and combo chains for players who like to optimize
• A friendly witch companion who follows you through every round
• Storybook art in warm candlelight colors and an original cozy soundtrack
• No timers, no rush — play one round in five minutes, or stay with the kittens all evening

How many kittens can one cauldron hold?
70010000127933.intro: Merge magic eggs, hatch enchanted kittens and fill the witch's album with every form.
70010000127933.name: Magic Kittens Merge

70010000127943.description:
You were just in the wrong place at the wrong time. The justice system threw you away for life for one fatal mistake, picking up the weapon at an active crime scene. However, you refuse to rot in prison for another man's crime. It's time to take your fate into your own hands.

Your grand escape begins beneath the tattered carpet of your solitary cell. Armed with only a metal spoon, slowly carve out a tunnel to freedom. As you dig deeper, you will uncover lost valuables and raw materials buried in the dirt. Sell this contraband to corrupt guards or trade it with fellow inmates on the black market to earn upgrades, energy, and toilet paper, the ultimate prison currency.

But digging is only half the battle. Survival requires perfect timing and nerves of steel. When you hear the guard's heavy footsteps approaching, you must quickly cover your tracks. Flush the loose dirt down the toilet, kick the carpet back over the hole, and hide your spoon under the bed before cell inspections begin. Make one clumsy move and you will lose everything. Manage your stamina, hustle the underground economy, and dig your way back to your old life!

Key features:
• The Great Spoon Escape: Use a simple dining utensil to secretly dig a huge tunnel right under the warden's nose.
• Leave No Trace: Frantically flush dirt, hide your tools, and fix your carpet before the guards spot you.
• Prison Black Market: Scavenge for hidden valuables and trade with inmates or corrupt guards to upgrade your gear.
• Manage your stamina. Digging is exhausting. Spend your hard-earned cash to restore energy and sleep to survive another day.
• High Stakes Stealth: Stay completely under the radar. If you get caught, you will lose your contraband and progress!
70010000127943.name: Dig Out of Prison

70010000127970.description:
One day, you suddenly find yourself imprisoned by a clingy menhera girl.
Now trapped, you are forced to play blood-staked Chinchirorin against her.

Before you run out of blood, meet each day’s quota and keep her satisfied.
If you fail to satisfy her, then you...

・Face Menhera-chan’s oh-so-generous rules every day
Menhera-chan’s additional rules will stand in the way of reaching your quota.
Sometimes, you’ll need to predict what rules she might add and plan your build and strategy accordingly.

・Use every cheat you can to survive!
Every day, you must play Chinchirorin and overcome the ever-increasing quotas by making full use of cheats.

Amulets grant effects just by having them.
Items activate their effects when used.
You can even modify the faces of your dice. Want to make every side a "1"? Go right ahead.

Build the optimal setup for each situation and answer Menhera-chan’s impossible demands.

Survive 7 days and see how your story with Menhera-chan comes to an end.
70010000127970.intro:
"Let's play together… forever, okay?"
Survive 7 days and see how your story with the clingy menhera girl (CV: Yuko Natsuyoshi) comes to an end.
70010000127970.name: Menherarium

70010000127976.description:
Descend into a frightful world of action-adventure in Mina the Hollower. Take control of Mina, a renowned Hollower hurtled into a desperate mission to rescue a cursed island. Burrow beneath hazards and monsters, whip foes into oblivion, and gear up with an arsenal of sidearms and trinkets. Explore a vast world filled with pixel-perfect graphics, masterful gameplay, beastly bosses, and infectious music. Encounter a cast of bizarre characters, search out secrets in an array of exotic locales, and illuminate the omnipresent darkness in Mina the Hollower, a brand new game from the developers who brought you Shovel Knight!

Features:
- Hauntingly authentic 8-bit visuals, refined for the modern era.

- Modern touches abound: detailed animation, widescreen visuals, and rock-solid controls!

- Leap, dodge, and burrow through the ground to battle monsters or navigate the world.

- Lash at foes with your trusty whip, Nightstar- or choose from an arsenal of weapons, each with a totally different move set.

- Discover and utilize a reliquary's worth of unusual Sidearms to gain the advantage in combat.

- Collect and equip Trinkets to acquire a variety of exotic effects. Level Mina up to suit your unique playstyle.

- Electrifying 8-bit inspired soundtrack by chiptune virtuoso, Jake Kaufman.

- Descend into the depths of madness with a bone-chilling, yet heartwarming tale inspired by Victorian Gothic horror.

- Explore a huge, dark world brimming with secrets, challenging battles, and interconnected level design
70010000127976.intro: A bone-chilling 8-bit action-adventure, refined for the modern era and enhanced for Nintendo Switch™ 2.
70010000127976.name: Mina the Hollower - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000127991.description:
The year is 2099. The line between reality and the virtual world has disappeared.

Step into a fully immersive virtual world powered by cutting-edge Full-Dive technology. Join investigator Rapid and genius hacker Lena as they uncover the truth behind a mysterious series of incidents.

Veiled Edge is a 2D action-adventure combining fast-paced combat, detailed pixel art, and diverse gameplay styles. Master platforming and intense battles while using hacking abilities to alter the environment, reveal hidden paths, and overcome challenging stages.

Each chapter introduces unique settings and gameplay mechanics, offering fresh experiences throughout your journey. Explore cyberpunk cities, theme parks, research facilities, and more as you battle powerful enemies and bosses to expose a massive conspiracy.

Features
Beautiful pixel-art cyberpunk world
Fast-paced 2D action and platforming
Hack the environment to solve puzzles and progress
Unique gameplay in every chapter
Story-driven sci-fi mystery
Hidden routes and optional challenges to discover
70010000127991.intro: A 2D action-adventure set in a stunning pixel-art cyberpunk world.
70010000127991.name: Veiled Edge

70010000128028.description:
Classic literature meets classic gaming in Jane Austen's 8-bit Adventure! This 2D platformer stars Jane Austen herself, the beloved English novelist, who finds herself transported into an 8-bit video game.

Explore 8-bit England, battle characters ripped straight from Austen's novels, and defeat enemies the only way a proper author knows how — with a quill. Collect the scattered pages and restore Miss Austen's books to the 8-bit library before it's too late!

- Battle characters from Jane Austen's novels
- Explore 8-bit England
- Defeat enemies with a quill
- Restore Miss Austen's books to the 8-bit library
70010000128028.intro: She wrote the rules. Now she's breaking them — with a quill.
70010000128028.name: Jane Austen's 8-bit Adventure

70010000128040.description:
In the far-off future of 20XX, the brilliant roboticist Dr. Otto Matton builds the two most advanced humanoid robots ever created: Zed and Zee. But when they learn that their purpose is to lead Matton's army of super bots to world domination, they rebel against their creator and his sinister ambitions. Now it's up to them to put a stop to Dr. Matton's schemes and prevent the world from falling into his hands!

Run, jump, and stomp through six colorful worlds of fast-paced, arcade-style action! Passwords allow you to pick up where you left off last time! Play solo or cooperatively with a friend, or settle your differences in the two-player Battle Mode!

• Play solo or team up! You can take on Dr. Matton's robotic hordes alone, but teaming up with a friend is even better!
• Six unique worlds! Save the city of Mechtropolis, dodge flying buzzsaws in the Wired Woods, and brave the heat of the Infernal Factory!
• A colorful cast of enemies! Relentless plasma tanks, flying luchador masks, and unpredictable robo-frogs are just some of the threats you'll encounter on your mission!
• Challenging boss encounters! You may be able to defeat Dr. Matton's army of grunts, but can you survive the massive Super Robots waiting for you at the end of each world?
• 2-Player Battle Mode! When you need a break from saving the world, challenge your friend to a match in Battle Mode and determine who the real robot master is!
• Genuine 8-bit action! Zed and Zee isn't just retro-"styled"—it's a real 8-bit game designed for 8-bit console hardware!
70010000128040.name: Zed and Zee

70010000128046.description:
Introducing a quirky minigame based on the anime Girls Band Cry!

Alongside console support, the latest version of this game includes a new playable character—Iseri Muneo—and a new Truck Mode, where you need to reach the goal without falling off a moving truck!

■Game Overview
Momoka (wo) Wasshoi was developed by staff of the anime Girls Band Cry. Wacky, weird, and wonderfully goofy, it's been streamed by the anime's cast to the delight of the series' fans.

This straightforward 2D platformer has you take control of Nina Iseri and Subaru Awa as they run, jump, and carry a groggy Momoka Kawaragi past loads of obstacles, all to fling their bleary-eyed guitarist onto her couch so she can catch a few much-needed Zs. It features several unique levels, including a challenging auto-scrolling level where you'll need to balance atop a speeding truck to reach your goal!
70010000128046.intro: Carry Momoka home to her sofa!
70010000128046.name: Momoka (wo) Wasshoi

70010000128073.description:
You wake up locked in a single room with three other girls, complete strangers, forced to play a killing game none of you agreed to.

Search every corner, solve twisted puzzles, and win every macabre challenge you come across, because in this game, only one of you walks out alive.

Every girl beside you is hiding something, and figuring out who you can trust matters just as much as any puzzle.

Are you good enough to be the one who survives?


FEATURES:

● A ROOM FULL OF TWISTED PUZZLES: Every corner hides a new macabre challenge you must beat to survive.

● SHE'S ALWAYS WATCHING: The woman behind this killing game controls every rule, and she's never far.

● FOUR GIRLS, FOUR SECRETS: Tense conversations between challenges reveal who you can trust, and who's lying.

● EVERY CHALLENGE COUNTS: Losing isn't an option. Every challenge you beat keeps you in the game.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Only one girl makes it out alive. Your choices decide who it is.


Four girls. One locked room. Only one will survive.
Do you have what it takes to be her?
70010000128073.intro:
Four girls. One locked room.
Only one will survive.
Will it be you?
70010000128073.name: Death Room: A Psychological Horror Killing Game

70010000128081.description:
Step into the role of a truly hands-on mayor and shape your town from the ground up.

Plan neighbourhoods, optimise logistics networks, and help your community grow - all while juggling workers, infrastructure, suspiciously large tools, visiting robots, aliens & dinosaurs, and the general day-to-day chaos of building your dream town.

And when mayoral duties get a little much, take a break with a spot of fishing, have a spin on the Go-Kart track, or even high-five a cow.

Play solo for perfect control, or bring friends for co-op mayhem.

Grow Your Town

Lay down your streets, then place businesses, homes, and services where they’ll thrive. Welcome tourists, keep them happy, and give them plenty of reasons to stick around and make your town their home. Hire workers, keep shops stocked, and make sure the money keeps flowing, then upgrade, expand, and unlock new ways to help your town flourish.

Optimise, Automate, Prosper

Tailor each business, industry zone and building configuration to suit your wants and needs. Assign workers, optimise supply chains, set-up logistics networks and watch your systems flourish. Will you let automation do the heavy lifting, or will you be the Mayor of Micromanagement?

Bring The Style

As mayor, style starts at home, but it doesn't stop there. Dive into immersive house customisation with full 360° placement and a handy colour picker, then take that creative control across your town with recoloured buildings, and plenty of ways to make every street, shop, and neighbourhood feel uniquely yours. Need a new look while you work? Step into the Change-O-Tron and emerge as the mayor you were always meant to be. Your town. Your mayor. Your style.

Chaotic Co-Op

Team-up with up with another mayor, in either local and online play for just the right amount of teamwork and chaos. Build together, manage together, panic together, and discover how quickly a carefully planned town can go sideways when everyone has a different idea of ‘helping’.
70010000128081.intro: Time to roll up your sleeves, Mayor!
70010000128081.name: Go-Go Town! – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000128174.description:
An ordinary young man is reborn into the world of his favorite comic—only to find himself as a bit-part villain doomed to die. To escape his fate, he must rise as a true villain, gathering allies, defying heroes, and carving a new destiny in this dark fantasy isekai JRPG. Experience a story of survival, betrayal, and ambition where good and evil clash in a pixel-art world.

Fight strategic turn-based battles that blend classic RPG command systems with modern mechanics. Exploit enemy weaknesses, trigger chain attacks, and unleash powerful break attacks. Earn notoriety through misdeeds to rank up and unlock unique arts via a skill tree. Explore dungeons, gather resources, and develop your own evil base with a smithery, lab, smuggling, and more. Packed with pixel-art charm, immersive story, and tactical depth, this parallel world RPG is a must for fans of JRPGs, anime-style games, and fantasy adventures.
70010000128174.intro: Rise as a true villain and carve your own destiny in a dark fantasy RPG!
70010000128174.name: Isekai Villain

70010000128197.description:
Why do humans “read the air“?
The answer lies in this “KUUKIYOMI 4: Consider It”.

This game puts the spotlight on the childhood of the main character “You”,
Let's Consider It with innocence while looking back on various events that everyone must have experienced in their childhood.

The basic rule of deciding what to do in situations by moving the red object on the screen is the same.

Please consider the situation and read the atmosphere according to the various scenes that will be asked.


"KUUKIYOMI 4: Consider It" is equipped with the following game modes.

・"Consider It" mode
A total of 100 situations will be asked.
After playing all the questions, your "ability to read the atmosphere" will be diagnosed.

・“Consider It Together” mode.
Play together with your friends and family.
10 questions will be asked out of a total of 30 questions.
After playing, the compatibility between the two people will be diagnosed.

・“Fun Minigames” mode
Contains 3 mini games.
Aim for the highest score with Score Attack.
70010000128197.intro:
One 4 All, All 4 One,
This is a game that checks your ability to be considerate to make the world a little more peaceful.
70010000128197.name: KUUKIYOMI 4: Consider It

70010000128232.description:
Build your career as a city taxi driver. Pick up passengers, navigate through the city, and deliver them safely to their destinations while earning money from every completed trip.

Every passenger brings a new journey and another opportunity to grow. Explore the city streets, manage your time, choose your routes, and work toward earning enough to improve your vehicle or eventually get behind the wheel of a new car.

As your career develops, you can also personalize your driver and give your vehicle a look that suits you. Start with a simple taxi and work your way toward becoming a successful driver known throughout the city.
70010000128232.intro: Pick up passengers, drive, repeat. Your taxi career starts here.
70010000128232.name: Taxi Life Simulator

70010000128241.description:
An ordinary young man is reborn into the world of his favorite comic—only to find himself as a bit-part villain doomed to die. To escape his fate, he must rise as a true villain, gathering allies, defying heroes, and carving a new destiny in this dark fantasy isekai JRPG. Experience a story of survival, betrayal, and ambition where good and evil clash in a pixel-art world.

Fight strategic turn-based battles that blend classic RPG command systems with modern mechanics. Exploit enemy weaknesses, trigger chain attacks, and unleash powerful break attacks. Earn notoriety through misdeeds to rank up and unlock unique arts via a skill tree. Explore dungeons, gather resources, and develop your own evil base with a smithery, lab, smuggling, and more. Packed with pixel-art charm, immersive story, and tactical depth, this parallel world RPG is a must for fans of JRPGs, anime-style games, and fantasy adventures.
70010000128241.intro: Rise as a true villain and carve your own destiny in a dark fantasy RPG!
70010000128241.name: Isekai Villain - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000128265.description:
Enter a dark and dangerous fantasy realm where every battle tests your skill, timing, and courage. In this challenging third-person action RPG, you play as a lone warrior fighting through cursed lands filled with deadly enemies, hidden dangers, and towering bosses inspired by classic soulslike adventures.

Master responsive melee combat, dodge devastating attacks, and strike back with precision as you explore atmospheric environments packed with secrets and rewards. Gather souls from fallen foes to strengthen your character, improve your abilities, and adapt your combat style to survive increasingly difficult encounters.

Use powerful sword-throwing attacks, tactical movement, and careful resource management to overcome relentless enemies and massive boss battles. Your journey culminates in an epic final confrontation against a colossal dragon in a cinematic showdown that will push your skills to the limit.

With stylized visuals, intense combat, rewarding progression, and unforgettable encounters, this adventure delivers a thrilling action RPG experience for players who crave challenge, exploration, and legendary battles.
70010000128265.intro: Forge your legend in a brutal fantasy world inspired by classic action RPGs. Master fast-paced melee combat, dodge deadly attacks, and collect lost souls to upgrade your warrior.
70010000128265.name: Dragon Soul

70010000128281.description:
The city is full of people who need a ride - and you're the one who gets them there.

Take orders, pick up passengers, navigate through city streets, and deliver them to their destinations. Every completed trip keeps you moving and brings a new passenger, a new destination, and a new challenge.

Learn the city, discover new routes, and become more confident behind the wheel as you take on more rides. Keep an eye on your surroundings, choose your routes wisely, and make every trip count.
From your first ride to becoming a trusted driver, every journey is another step forward.
70010000128281.intro: Passengers are waiting, journeys are calling.
70010000128281.name: Taxi Crew Simulator

70010000128326.description:
Tilt The Entire Course
Mini-golf just got flipped on its head. Instead of swinging the club, you tilt the entire course to guide the ball to the hole. Master momentum, angles, and gravity as you roll through tricky hazards, dodge obstacles, and sink the perfect shot.

300 Holes Across 15 Unique Biomes
Tee off across 300 levels spread throughout 15 biomes, each introducing new mechanics, hazards, and twists. From precision putts to gravity-defying trick shots, every course challenges your ability to read the green.

Chase the Perfect Round
Quick-fire levels and instant restarts make it easy to jump back in for just one more putt. Shave seconds off your time, refine your line, and master that “motion-in-one” perfect shot.

A Budget-Friendly Birdie
Packed with hours of gameplay, replayability, and satisfying physics-based challenges, Tilt it! Golf delivers a full round of fun for about the price of a coffee. No expensive country club membership required.
70010000128326.intro: Mini-golf with a twist - tilt the whole course!
70010000128326.name: Tilt it! Golf

70010000128332.description:
Feel the tires scream, the engine roar, and the asphalt disappear beneath you as you push every corner to the limit! Enter a high-speed world of precision drifting where split-second reactions, perfect control, and fearless driving are the keys to becoming a true drift master.

Choose your favorite car from the very beginning and hit the track with nothing holding you back. Throw your car into every corner, control the slide, balance the throttle, and chase the perfect drift as you take on increasingly demanding challenges. Every turn is an opportunity to prove your skill, and every mistake can cost you the perfect run.

Key Features:
	•	5 Cars Available From the Start: Choose from 5 unique cars and start drifting immediately.
	•	20 Challenging Levels: Master 20 tracks filled with demanding corners and technical turns.
	•	Advanced Drift Physics: Control every slide with responsive handling and realistic weight transfer.
	•	Master Every Curve: Improve your lines and drifting technique across every challenging track.
	•	Immersive Racing Audio: Feel every drift with roaring engines and screeching tires.


Choose your car, fire up the engine, and put your drifting skills to the ultimate test. Hold the slide, conquer every corner, and become the driver everyone remembers!
70010000128332.intro: Choose your car and start your drifting journey.
70010000128332.name: Car Drift Simulator 2027

70010000128343.description:
Help Hazel to renovate a Living Room, Bedroom, Study and Dining Room with real world furniture!
Play lots of hidden object games and loads of mini games.
Earn money to be able to buy nice furniture to renovate the rooms.
Decorate with hundreds of furniture pieces and learn fun facts at the same time.

- Redesign fabulous living spaces
- Over 400 real world furniture items
- Play 25 different game modes
- Learn fun-facts about being a real designer!
- Fun hidden objects scenes and mini games
70010000128343.intro: Help Hazel redesign client homes in this fun Hidden Objects game, "Home Designer: Home Sweet Home".
70010000128343.name: Home Designer: Home Sweet Home

70010000128356.description:
Absorb & Transform!

Teeto’s got a talent for absorbing all sorts of objects - and turning them into wild new forms! With Nory’s Vionite-powered backpack, they unlock unique abilities to outsmart enemies, solve puzzles, and discover hidden secrets. Mix it up, get creative, and see what strange new powers you’ll unleash!

Team up Together!

Life’s better with a buddy - and so is saving the world! Grab a friend and dive into split-screen co-op, where you’ll absorb, transform, and explore together. Solve puzzles, help each other out, and take on this wild adventure side by side!

Chaos Corruption!

Chaos is spreading, and the shadow creatures are behind it! Teeto and Nory must team up, using their unique powers to stop the mayhem, restore balance, and keep the world from tipping into complete disorder!

Missing Michaels!

It started with one Michael - Nory’s first experiment. But Michael couldn’t stay simple… he split into two, then four, then eight! Now there are too many Michaels for anyone to handle. Track them down, rescue them, and bring the tiny mischief-makers home!

Lend a Hand, Get a Hand!

Teeto and Nory aren’t the only ones in need of help. Along the way, you’ll meet a colourful cast of quirky characters, each with their own oddball dilemmas. Lend them a hand, and they might just return the favour with useful items, hidden secrets, or unexpected abilities.

Dress The Part

Teeto can unlock a variety of fun and stylish costumes, from the effortlessly cool to the absolutely ridiculous. Saving the world is important - but who says you can’t look fashionable while doing it?
70010000128356.intro: Explore a world of mayhem and Michaels! Join Teeto the blob and Nory the bunny in this 3D adventure platformer to stop the shadow corruption from spreading.
70010000128356.name: Teeto

70010000128366.description:
What started as a late-night dare has turned into a desperate fight for survival. You are trapped in an abandoned school with a demonic entity that has possessed your best friend. Armed with only a flashlight, you must navigate the eerie, pitch-black hallways and classrooms to find a way out. You cannot fight back against the spirit. Your only options are to run, use stealth to stay out of sight, and listen closely for the terrifying sound of her approaching footsteps.

Your survival depends on navigating a dynamic, escalating threat system. The entity knows you are trying to leave. The closer you get to escaping, the more aggressive and enraged she becomes. The hunt intensifies, her patrols tighten, and the pressure mounts. You must time your movements perfectly to slip past her while searching for the exit.

As the spirit's anger reaches its peak, the horror spills over into reality. The environment warps, blood fills your vision, and sinister glitches attempt to trick your mind and break your focus. Maintain your composure, manage your limited visibility, and outsmart the deadly entity hunting you in the darkness. Will you survive the night, or will the school claim another victim?
70010000128366.name: Seishin

70010000128394.description:
In this classic hidden object game, Hazel wants to help her aunt with home refurbishment.
Sell off the old stuff and renovate the empty living room with real world furniture and design the room of your dreams!
Offering tons of Hidden Object modes: Picture, Word, Silhouette, Spot the Difference, and many more!

Play a variety of great minigames like Match-3, Card Memory, Jigsaw Puzzles, or skip them if you're not in the mood.

- A classic HO game with tons of objects to find
- More than 150 choices of furniture to decorate
- Hidden Objects scenes in more than 15 different ways
- 5 different mini-game typs, including Match-3
70010000128394.intro: Great home renovation adventure in cozy atmosphere.
70010000128394.name: Home Designer: Living Room

70010000128419.description:
You've already traveled with us from Portland to Florida, but the adventures don't end here!
This time, the beloved family returns behind the wheel to take part in America's grand motorhome rally.
In Motorhome: Traveling America 4, expect the same warm encounters and cozy evenings, but now the route is full of unexpected twists.
This isn't a race for speed, it's a competition of impressions, where every day brings new stories.

Why you'll love this game:
- Exciting adventures! From everyday moments at the laundromat to thrilling tales of catching thieves.
- The spirit of freedom behind the wheel: join a friendly motorhome race, discovering hidden paths and secret locations along the route.
- Collect memories: Gather unique souvenirs — instead of baseball caps, now you'll find memorable keepsakes from each state.
- Preserve the moments: Take photos for your family album, continuing your personal travel story.
70010000128419.intro: Remember that feeling of wind in your hair and the endless road?
70010000128419.name: Motorhome: Traveling North America 4 Collector's Edition

70010000128434.description:
Charge down endless action-packed tracks in a fast-paced hyper casual runner shooter where every second counts. Blast through waves of enemies using dual guns while constantly sprinting forward, moving side to side to avoid danger, jumping over obstacles, and ducking under deadly hazards.

Each run lasts around 30 to 40 seconds and delivers nonstop arcade action. Enemies block your path and fire back, forcing you to react quickly and shoot accurately to survive. Break through walls by unloading enough bullets to destroy them before impact, and stay alert for dangerous traps including spinning spikes, saw blades, and rotating obstacles designed to stop your run.

As the challenge increases, use the coins earned during gameplay to upgrade your fire rate, shooting distance, and reload timing to become stronger and push further into harder stages. Unlock new character skins and powerful weapon designs to customize your style while taking on increasingly intense runs.

Easy to pick up and hard to put down, this endless runner shooter combines fast reflex gameplay with satisfying upgrades and nonstop action.
70010000128434.name: Blast Dash

70010000128456.description:
As you investigate the mansion and its surrounding laboratories, you’ll uncover cryptic clues, interact with unusual mechanisms, and slowly piece together the story behind the doctor’s terrifying machine. Hand-crafted pixel-art visuals, moody environments, and a haunting soundtrack create an immersive gothic atmosphere that pays homage to classic adventure and horror games while delivering its own unique identity.

Designed for players who enjoy mystery, retro aesthetics, and thoughtful exploration, The machine of madness offers a suspenseful journey through secrets, experiments, and forgotten memories where every room hides another piece of the puzzle.
70010000128456.intro: A dark, atmospheric adventure inspired by classic storytelling, where you explore the eerie mansion of Dr. Jeffrey. Featuring hand-drawn visuals, gothic horror vibes.
70010000128456.name: Machine of Madness

70010000128498.description:
Guilty Gear -Strive-, the latest entry of the Guilty Gear series with more than 3 million users worldwide, finally arrives as Guilty Gear -Strive- Nintendo Switch Edition!

◆Enjoy amazing graphics and animations on Nintendo Switch!
Features stunning graphics and immersive experience, fully embracing the ability for fiery battles across the Nintendo Switch’s TV mode, tabletop mode, or handheld modes!

◆ONLINE BATTLES
With Rollback Netcode functionality installed; players can enjoy lagless online battles with other Nintendo Switch players remotely!

◆Cinematic story mode
Experience the over 6-hour GUILTY GEAR -STRIVE- main story following the conclusion of Sol Badguy’s journey. There's also "Another Story," a full-length story cinematic that follows what has been occurring in the background of the game’s main story!

◆28 PLAYABLE CHARACTERS
A diverse roster of 28 characters and the largest roster in GUILTY GEAR history!
70010000128498.intro: State of the art 2.5D fighting game is coming to Nintendo Switch™!
70010000128498.name: Guilty Gear -Strive- Nintendo Switch Edition

70010000128504.description:
■ Build Your Team with Your Favorite VTubers!
Over 350 VTubers from a wide range of genres—including game streamers, singers, ASMR creators, and illustrators—join the battle!

Every VTuber featured in the game can be used as your protagonist. Choose your favorite VTuber and take on the challenge!

■ Extensive Card Collection
Each of the 350+ VTubers has cards with different rarities!
Collect every card featuring your favorite VTubers and complete your collection!

■ Game System
Experience a unique blend of Card Game × Auto-Battle × Roguelite gameplay.
Set five cards and strengthen stats such as HP, ATK, DEF, MAG, MDEF, and SPD to defeat your rivals. Collect stronger cards as you progress and take on increasingly powerful opponents!

■ Skills & Levels — Every Card Has a Chance to Shine!
A card's strength is determined by its level and rarity, rather than the character itself.

Cards featuring the same VTuber can have different levels, while higher-rarity cards come with additional skills.

This means every card has its own potential and can play an important role in your strategy!

■ Estimated Playtime
A single run takes approximately 1–2 hours to complete.

With card and skill collection, you can enjoy 100+ hours of gameplay!

■ Live Streaming
Monetization
Monetization of live streams and videos featuring this game is permitted.

Monetization through video-sharing websites and live-streaming platforms is also permitted.

Streaming Content
You may stream all scenes and content from the game.

Other Guidelines
There are no specific restrictions on streaming the game as long as it is used within the scope of normal gameplay and content creation.

However, the game features many VTubers. Please remember to treat all featured creators with respect.
70010000128504.intro:
Choose your “oshi” from 350+ VTubers!
Battle your way through Roguelike, Card Game, and Auto-Battle gameplay!
70010000128504.name: VTBattle It’s Not About Subscribers! It’s All About Power.

70010000128511.description: Trapped within a decaying asylum consumed by darkness and despair, you must uncover the horrifying truth hidden behind its abandoned halls. In this psychological horror experience, isolation becomes your greatest enemy as disturbing echoes, twisted visions, and unseen threats blur the line between reality and madness. Explore oppressive environments, solve unsettling mysteries, and survive terrifying encounters where every sound could be your last. The deeper you descend into the asylum, the more the past refuses to stay buried.
70010000128511.intro: A psychological horror experience where isolation is your greatest enemy. Explore abandoned asylum, uncover disturbing secrets.
70010000128511.name: Retro Asylum

70010000128518.description:
POPUCOM is a multiplayer co-op platform adventure game. As an adventurer, you are summoned to an unknown planet to embark on an exoplanet adventure with your friends. You will face various enemies and use engaging items and techniques to eliminate threats and restore the world to its former glory.

[Engage in Fun-filled Co-Op Gameplay]
Work together with your friends to take on a variety of challenges. Effective cooperation and strong teamwork are the only ways forward. Whether it's facing powerful enemies or tackling complex puzzles, you'll need to work together to triumph!

[Embark on a Colorful Adventure]
Color plays a crucial role in this fantastical world. It is key to everything from puzzle solving to combat. You'll need to switch colors to activate mechanisms and solve puzzles, and shoot Pomu gel in different colors to change the surroundings and impact enemies. Master the techniques of color switching and match-3 shooting to overcome puzzles and defeat enemies!

[Use Items to Work Miracles]
During the journey, you will acquire items known as super artifacts. Examples of these wondrous artifacts include Rollo the Bomb, Captain Kitty, Barrier Bot, and Power Kid. Each of them grants you a unique ability that helps remove obstacles and solve puzzles in your adventure.

[Let Your Style Shine]
The adventure isn't just about combat; it's also about showcasing your style! Pick from a selection of gear and cosmetics in the Closet and combine them to create your unique looks. Then you can set off on the journey in your personalized style!

[Enjoy Arcade Mini-Games]
In addition to the exciting battles and engaging puzzles, the game includes a number of enjoyable mini-games. Head to the in-game arcade room for some lighthearted arcade fun during breaks from the main stages.
70010000128518.intro: Pop yourself into an adventure! Become the rainbow!
70010000128518.name: POPUCOM

70010000128529.description:
Choose your pilot and build your own custom mecha with 17+ weapons and 55+ attachments, then jump to the battlefield against hundreds of enemies to save spacetime itself in this thrilling sci-fi bullet heaven!

Features
- Surviors-like action with fast-paced, intense battles
- Six pilots, each with distinct stats and special skills
- Multiple mecha archetypes with fully customizable loadouts
- A wide variety of weapons, attachments, and items to discover
- Missions spanning exploration, defense, and total annihilation
70010000128529.name: Time Treker

70010000128551.description:
Take the controls of real JR-West trains in this authentic railway driving game.

■ The exhilaration of the Special Rapid Service
Drive the famous Special Rapid Service non-stop from the very first station of the Keishin Line all the way to the terminus. On quadruple-track sections, blast past local trains one after another for a rush of speed only this train can deliver. Direct Rapid and local services are fully drivable too.

■ Every line, every section, both directions
Three fictional lines inspired by the region — the Ohan East Line, Ohan West Line, and Keishin Line — with every section drivable in both directions. A massive amount of track that rewards every hour you put in.

■ Drivable trains
Drive the 221, 223, 207, and 321 Series, plus the 227 Series appearing as a special test-run train.

■ A series first: the driving score system
Your accuracy behind the controls — departing on time, passing stations on schedule, keeping to speed limits, stopping precisely at the mark — is rated as a score, so you can feel yourself improving with every run.

■ Boost your score with your card deck
Set cards in your deck before each run. Meet the scoring conditions to earn bonus points based on each card's multiplier.
The cards feature a spectacular lineup of 14 train series, including limited express trains: the 223, 221, 321, 207, 227, 287, 283, 289, 281, 271, 683, 225, 115, and 485 Series.
Match cards of the same type to double their values with Chemistry, collect cards of the same station for a station score bonus, and upgrade your cards to build the ultimate deck. New cards are obtained through an in-game gacha — there are no paid purchases.
Struggling with the controls? A clever deck can still carry you to victory. A master driver with a weak deck will find high scores out of reach. Driving skill and deck strategy: two ways to play, one deep experience.

■ Mascon controller support
Compatible with the ZUIKI MasCon for Nintendo Switch™ and the Densha de GO!! One Handle Controller for Nintendo Switch™ (電車でGO!!専用ワンハンドルコントローラー for Nintendo Switch™) for an even more realistic driver experience.

■ Recommended for
- Train and railway fans
- Anyone who loves Japan's Kansai region
- Deck-building and card game enthusiasts
- Owners of a mascon-style train controller
70010000128551.intro: Drive real JR-West trains! An authentic railway driving game straight from Japan.A series first: the driving score system! Every line, every section, both directions.
70010000128551.name: Train Plus Japan Drive Western Japan Trains! Rapid Service Edition

70010000128552.description:
A Collapsing Empire
During Chongzhen’s Reign (A.D. 1628-1644), land annexation reached unmitigated extremes, the country faced domestic issues and foreign invasions, coinciding with the catastrophic Little Ice Age. After many years of horrid disasters in succession one after another, the Ming court continued to impose inhumane policies resulting in widespread starvation and leading to the rise of multiple rebellions against the court.

A Travelling With Desperados
Liang the bandit, and his companion are commissioned for a job from an unsavory merchant and must escort four girls to a wealthy lord in the city of Luoyang. They must pass through Huazhou, Wenxiang, Shanzhou, and finally reach their destination of Luoyang.
Liang initially believes that the girls he is escorting will be sold to the wealthy lord as adopted daughters to begin a new life. However, one of the four girls named “Sui” reveals the hidden secret of their journey to Luoyang.
The lord is a swine demon who has practiced devouring young ladies for over a thousand years. Every year on his birthday, he dispatches human traffickers to abduct girls from Shan in celebration of his special day. Sui’s sister was among the many who have fallen victim to the demon’s appetite.
Sui is hopeful that Liang will end the escort and join her in assassinating the swine demon to avenge her sister, and those who have perished in recent years. Although Liang wants to believe Sui, there are too many inconsistencies in her story. Throughout the journey, Liang will gather information, unravel the truth, and make his decisions accordingly.
70010000128552.intro: Trek across ancient China in a dark, boundary-pushing visual novel inspired by traditional Chinese art with modern animation.
70010000128552.name: The Hungry Lamb

70010000128554.description:
This easy to pick up but hard to master
shooter masterpiece from Psikyo
is one of their most popular titles!

STRIKERS 1945 is a
vertical-scrolling shooter game that
first appeared in arcades in 1995.

Battleships and tanks transform into futuristic mechs!
Enjoy heart-stopping boss battles at every turn, the hallmark of the STRIKERS series!
The legendary Psikyo Bullets are coming for you!

Pilot your fighter plane to places beyond your wildest imagination...
STRIKERS are on the move!
Stop the secret organization CANY from taking over the world!

The game comes with options you can tweak to your liking.
Pick your preferred difficulty, max lives, max continues, key controls,
and screen orientation to make the game just right for you.

Don't forget about the new online rankings!
Do you have what it takes to become the best STRIKER in the world?

Planes:
Six World War-era fighters are at your service, each with unique abilities.
"P" items power up your unit and add sub-weapons to it.
"B" items give you bombs that deal area damage to clear out enemies or help with emergency escapes.
Store up your shot to unleash a powerful formation attack!

ARCADE Mode:
Seven difficulty tiers to cater to all levels of players—including beginners!
Those looking for a challenge should try out HARD and VERY HARD modes!
There will be local rankings for each plane in each difficulty mode.

Options:
Play in vertical screen mode for that nostalgic arcade experience!
Two additional screen filters for your enjoyment.
Lives can be set between 1 to 9, whereas continues can be set between 0 to infinity.
Freely configure your preferred keys for shots, auto-shots, or bombs.
Vertical screen mode is playable even in landscape orientation. You decide your style!

SCORE ATTACK:
This mode has a fixed difficulty and number of lives. Serious challengers only!
Submit your high scores to compete with players from around the world!
Online rankings can be viewed from the options menu.
70010000128554.name: STRIKERS1945 for Nintendo Switch

70010000128555.description:
Rapid mainstream action with a hardcore twist!
This Psikyo shooter that once took the world by storm
is back for more!

STRIKERS 1945 II is a
vertical-scrolling shooter game that
first appeared in arcades in 1997.

This highly polished second title in the STRIKERS series
is one of the most iconic arcade shooters to emerge from the 90s.
It remains immensely popular to this day.

The new "super shot" mechanic depletes the gauge
to unleash a flashy special attack that helps with strategy and
provides eye candy at the same time!

Enjoy heart-stopping boss battles at every turn, the hallmark of the STRIKERS series!
The legendary Psikyo Bullets are coming for you!

The game comes with options you can tweak to your liking.
Pick your preferred difficulty, max lives, max continues, key controls,
and screen orientation to make the game just right for you.

Don't forget about the new online rankings!
Do you have what it takes to become the best STRIKER in the world?

Planes:
Six World War-era fighters are at your service, each with unique abilities.
"P" items power up your unit and add sub-weapons to it.
"B" items give you bombs that deal area damage to clear out enemies or help with emergency escapes.
Store up your shot to unleash a powerful formation attack!

ARCADE Mode:
Seven difficulty tiers to cater to all levels of players—including beginners!
Those looking for a challenge should try out HARD and VERY HARD modes!
There will be local rankings for each plane in each difficulty mode.

Options:
Play in vertical screen mode for that nostalgic arcade experience!
Two additional screen filters for your enjoyment.
Lives can be set between 1 to 9, whereas continues can be set between 0 to infinity.
Freely configure your preferred keys for shots, auto-shots, or bombs.
Vertical screen mode is playable even in landscape orientation. You decide your style!

SCORE ATTACK:
This mode has a fixed difficulty and number of lives. Serious challengers only!
Submit your high scores to compete with players from around the world!
Online rankings can be viewed from the options menu.
70010000128555.name: STRIKERS1945 Ⅱ for Nintendo Switch

70010000128556.description:
It has been 54 years since the Strikers' last flight, but a new danger known as the 'nanites' has appeared. This swarm of evolving alien microbots has infiltrated Earth's military bases, and the Strikers must now form an unlikely alliance with their old foes, the FGR faction, in order to stop them!

This is STRIKERS in its most intense evolution yet, with vivid modern backgrounds setting the stage for blistering aerial action unlike anything seen before in the series. Harness the speed and firepower of five all-new planes, master the new chain scoring system, and exercise your tactical mettle against the most advanced enemies and bosses ever encountered in the series.
70010000128556.intro:
Enter the age of modern warfare;
for the first time in console!
70010000128556.name: STRIKERS 1945 III for Nintendo Switch

70010000128641.description:
A time-traveling RPG adventure from Masato Kato, creator of countless classic RPGs
Product Summary
Aldo embarks on an adventure beyond time and space to save his sister, Feinne, from the clutches of the beastfolk.

A richly woven tale by scenario writer and director, Masato Kato, unfolds across the ages, alongside a main theme composed by Yasunori Mitsuda, music incorporating traditional folk instruments and an orchestra by Procyon Studios, and a stellar voice cast.

The strategic command battles, which feature exhilarating actions like chain skills that trigger successive strikes, and Another Force that allows a barrage of attacks, can be fought with original parties composed from a total of 19 characters.

After clearing the main story, New Game+ offers a new adventure filled with new faces and over 10 different endings based on your actions and choices.

◆Strategic Command Battles
The lands of Another Eden are rife with monsters—run into them to initiate a command-based battle and take them down.
Create your own original parties, unleash chain skills, and create chains to trigger successive strikes!
Unleash a flurry of attacks with Another Force to beat your enemy into submission!

◆Befriend and Forge Meaningful Bonds with 18 Allies
18 allies of different races and eras await Aldo on his journey.
Allies' stories are told through various quests. Encounter quests depict their first meeting with Aldo, character quests reveal their past and purpose, and kinship quests explore their relationship with Aldo.

◆Embark on a New Adventure with New Game+
Complete the main story to unlock New Game+ and embark on a new adventure with your allies as they are!
New Game+ also introduces a brand-new character, Ramiu, and features over 10 different endings based on your actions and choices.

◆New Features to Enrich Your Time-Traveling Adventure
Enrich your adventure beyond time and space by logging the feline friends you encounter in the cat catalog, and creating weapons, armor, and food from different eras with the crafting feature.
70010000128641.intro: Now begins an RPG beyond time and space
70010000128641.name: Another Eden Begins Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000128656.description:
Story Background
The thousand-year-old Galactic Empire collapses under the attack of alien creatures. Admirals, pirates, merchant guilds, the Church, mercenaries, and colonists plunge into a chaotic struggle for dominance.

Yet humanity faces an even greater threat: the rebellious AI legions and the resurgence of the alien hive fleets begin their merciless purge of mankind. The climactic battle of Ragnarök has begun! Wield your strategy and courage to end the chaos of the galaxy!

Govern Your Nation
Build various districts on your planets—farmlands, mines, hive cities, and laboratories on the surface; shipyards, armories, and orbital fortresses in space.

Command Warfare
Produce diverse warships and mechs, appoint formidable commanders to lead your fleets, crush enemy forces, and conquer their planets.

Dynamic Events
Hundreds of story-driven events unfold over time, shaped by intricate relationships between characters.

Diplomatic Maneuvers
Navigate a galaxy filled with dozens of major factions and countless minor powers. Forge alliances, subjugate vassals, and sow discord among enemy coalitions.

Policies and Technology
Each faction has a unique policy tree to unlock five advanced unit types and dozens of military/civil bonuses. Research alien biotechnology to develop "Bio-Armor," recover lost tech from drifting arks, or seize enemy blueprints by annihilating rival factions.

Diverse Factions
Eight distinct faction archetypes, each with unique playstyles, exclusive units, and specialized planetary structures.
70010000128656.name: Chaos Galaxy 2

70010000128659.description:
49 Keys is a narrative-focused game that will test your wits and nerves. Peruse the pages of a Lovecraftian tale, interact with maps and solve the puzzles encountered along the way. Trace your master's footsteps to uncover the deepest secrets of the arcane, on a quest brimming with horror and magic.


Embark on a Disturbing Journey
Alas, I knew not of the extraordinary, bizarre, and gut-churning sights that awaited within those walls.

The year is 1520. You receive a letter from your old mentor, the first step on an unnerving journey like none before. One that shall expose you to the forbidden arcane and all its mystery in which you shall concoct mixtures both wondrous and strange, and summon forth beings of other-worldly power. You must steel yourself, for terrors buried deep within shall soon awaken within you, Dantean horrors that bleed into reality. Endure these trials and, in time, the truth shall draw near. Yet will you be brave enough to pay its price?

An Immersive Literary Feat
Its lauded writing aside, 49 Keys is an audio-visual work of art. Intricately-designed menus hark back to manuscripts of the Middle Ages through to the Renaissance, with a unique art style throughout. Pore over incredible full-colour illustrations, and feel the thrill as original themes perfectly complement each twist and turn. All this combines for a deeply immersive world.

Unique Riddles and Marvellous Mysteries
Akin to point-and-click adventures, 49 Keys has you search through a meticulously-crafted world collecting items to aid you in solving its myriad puzzles. Read every word with care, for vital clues are hidden within. Put your reasoning skills to the test, and push onward; but fear not—an array of detailed in-game tips are at hand, if ever you need them.

Directly Adapted From The Best-Seller
49 Keys was developed and adapted by the original author behind the 2022 gamebook of the same name (49 Chiavi), a best-selling puzzle adventure. Gaining overwhelming praise from critics, it also achieved a place on Italy's 2022 gamebook best-seller list, going on to win two highly-coveted awards that year.
