70010000128659.intro: In this book-based puzzler, a captivating tale unfolds before you. Its narration blends seamlessly with the conundrums and riddles you must face.
70010000128659.name: 49 Keys

70010000128665.description:
The summer roster has one spot left, and every player on the sand wants it just as bad as you do. Off the court, the real competition starts.

One reads every move you make and expects the same back. One only warms up once you've earned it. Another flirts hard until the score gets close, then turns cold and competitive without warning. And the captain trusts no one who hasn't proven they belong.

Say the right thing and the tension breaks. Say the wrong thing and you're benched.

Thirty days until the season opener, and every day you waste, someone else closes the gap.


Features:

● A ROSTER FULL OF COMPETITIVE PERSONALITIES: A deep bench, and every player is a completely different game to win. Some want a rival. Some want a partner. All of them want proof.

● DIALOGUE CHOICES THAT MATTER: Every response you give shifts the dynamic. Push too hard and you lose ground. Read the room right and the walls start coming down.

● CHARACTER AFFINITY SYSTEM: Build real trust through practices, downtime, and late-night talks after the lights go out. The harder she is to reach, the more it means when she lets you in.

● EXCLUSIVE GALLERY IMAGES: Unlock stunning illustrations as each relationship deepens. Every player has her own story waiting past the final point.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Your run through the season is yours alone. Some routes end in romance. Some end with you watching from the bench.

● 30 DAYS TO MAKE THE TEAM: The season opener is locked in and the clock doesn't wait. Every wasted day is a spot someone else claims instead of you.


One roster. One summer. Only one of you makes the team and it might not be you.

Who are you willing to fight for?
70010000128665.intro:
The roster's stacked. One spot left. Win it, and win them.
Think you've got what it takes to make the cut?
70010000128665.name: Beach Volleyball Girls: Hot Spike

70010000128666.description:
Lead four Time Walkers to torture the Dark Lord and his subordinates with more than 40 skills. Match different skill builds without class limits. Archer healer, assassin tank or wizard warrior? All up to you.

Choose four Heroes before battles, match them with different abilities to produce amazing chain reaction. Create your unique Time Walker every time you start!

Manage the resources you collect in every battle. Merge to get advanced abilities or Reforge to your luck.

Never ignore Talents. Unlock new heroes and abilities to give Dark Lord’s subordinates an impressive lesson.

Looking for more power? Try Advanced Heroes and EX Abilities! Merge three same basic hero items into an advanced one! Merge two Level III abilities into a moer powerful EX ability.

Time Walkers power will be stronger and stronger during the war against Dark Lord. Take them to the deep side and reveal Dark Lord’s plots!
70010000128666.intro: Time Walker Dark World is a roguelike auto-battler with strategic combat. Players will need to adjust their formations, plan their resources, acquire loot.
70010000128666.name: Time Walker: Dark World

70010000128674.description:
Scritchy Scratchy is a super-satisfying scratch card incremental game where luck is your weapon, and glittering riches are just a scratch away.

Dive into a growing collection of scratchers, each with its own quirks, surprises, and sometimes downsides. Rip through tickets, uncover rare symbols, tweak your own luck, and chase absurd payouts.

Unlock Scratch Bot, your tireless mechanical friend who scratches and reveals the rewards for you. Turn your run into a full-blown jackpot engine as your balance shoots through the roof while you sit back and relax.

As you prosper, you’ll unlock upgrades that twist luck in your favor:

• Boosted odds and payouts
• Faster and easier scratching
• New scratch card variants with unique rules

But power always comes with risk. Some cards tempt you with monstrous payouts at the cost of nasty penalties. Some offer steady income… others threaten your entire run. Will you play like a sensible adult or gamble like a degenerate in a neon casino?

When you’re ready for even more madness, Prestige to reset your run, gather Jack Points, and spend them on permanent upgrades that reshape your strategy. Build your own luck engine: Slow and steady, wildly explosive, or pure chaos.

Scritchy Scratchy is a dangerously satisfying progression casino, where every scratch is a little dopamine hit, and every run is one lucky break away from the big jackpot!

This product is released for the Nintendo Switch. It can also be played on Nintendo Switch 2. However, please note that a separate product, "Scritchy Scratchy", is available exclusively for Nintendo Switch 2. Save data and Additional Contents are not compatible between the two versions. Please be careful to avoid duplicate or mistaken purchases.
Nintendo Switch 2 Edition and Upgrade Pack are not available for this product.
70010000128674.intro: Scritchy Scratchy is a super-satisfying scratch card incremental game. Buy stacks of scratch-offs, unlock auto-scratching, and chase massive jackpots. Will you play it safe or go all-in?
70010000128674.name: Scritchy Scratchy

70010000128699.description:
This time, our heroes leave their beloved village for a long journey through the Parthian Empire, a faraway kingdom under threat from Roman invasion. Their mission? To save Monipehni, the King of the Parthians, who has fallen victim to a deadly poison brewed by Bahmbuhzeli, a treacherous sorcerer allied with Caesar.

Along the way, they will need to gather the ingredients for the antidote while fending off fierce Roman legionaries. They will also lend a hand to local villagers in exotic and enchanting landscapes.
Thanks to their courage, their legendary resourcefulness and plenty of well-placed slaps, Asterix and Obelix will push back the invaders and prove that the indomitable Gauls are unbeatable, no matter how far from home they may be!

- Embark on an unforgettable adventure with Asterix and Obelix, in local co-op or solo!
- Dive into a brand-new, action-packed story bursting with humour, twists and turns!
- Explore four stunning worlds, each with their own iconic settings and landmarks, including an exclusive new destination: the legendary city of Babylon.
- Relive the action across twenty replayable levels, featuring a wide variety of enemies.
- Face off against formidable bosses and give the Roman legionaries a thrashing they won’t soon forget in epic combat!
70010000128699.intro: Experience a story full of humour, epic battles and unforgettable encounters in a thrilling platform game!
70010000128699.name: Asterix & Obelix - Mission Babylon

70010000128700.description:
32 mini-games to discover across emblematic environments such as Garfield's house, the pizzeria, Liz’s veterinary clinic...

Our friends Garfield, Odie, Arlene et Nermal have taken on an enormous challenge: to participate in a gigantic lasagna party!

A wide variety of crazy games are on the menu: throw snowballs, navigate obstacle courses, slice pizzas... Anything to get ahead of your opponents: win the mini-games, roll the best dice throws... and multiply the low blows by using objects!

Garfield Lasagna Party invites you to play a party game set in the world of everyone's favorite fat orange cat. With 32 mini-games and 3 play modes, the fun never ends!

A game for the whole family, whether you like lasagna... or not!

FEATURES:

- 2 BONUS PLAY MODES:

CHALLENGE MODE: Designed for 4 players, this mode allows players to enjoy their favorite mini-games without having to pass all the squares on the game board: the perfect way to get in a quick game... or for intensive training!

COMPETITION MODE: This game mode enables players to organize a championship with a selected number of mini-games, chosen randomly and played successively at high speed!

- 32 MINI GAMES and 3 game modes offer great fun for four!

32 mini-games for up to 4 players to enjoy!
Embody one of the 4 iconic comic book characters.

3 game modes: Standard, Challenge and Competition
Tons of lasagna will be served up to the best player!
70010000128700.intro: Who will win the Lasagna Party?
70010000128700.name: GARFIELD LASAGNA PARTY

70010000128702.description:
Our little friends need you to help them spread their wings! From their hatching stage to the moment they’ll be able to fly on their own, take care of your baby Dragons and help them enter the marvelous Dragons’ school! Fly off for an enchanting adventure full of magic and become the best Dragon Warden of all time!
"Adopt and raise dragons of all elements to become the best Dragon Warden!
As the new dragon caretaker in town, it is now time for you to start your life and open your very own dragonward. Whatever their element is, each baby dragon needs a home full of love to grow and thrive properly. You’ll have to be very careful of each dragon’s needs as they will require all your attention! Help them hatch, develop their magic and shower them with love and treats until they’re finally ready to fly to Dragons’ school! Take time to play with them and understand their magic in order to earn their trust and create a forever bond together.

- Raise dragons from every element and become a certified Dragon Warden!

- Hatch mysterious eggs to raise adorable baby Dragons and become the best dragonward!

- Teach your dragon how to fly and develop its magic

- Take really good care of your dragon to have a chance to create an unwavering bond

- Collect all the achievements to become the very best Dragon Warden!
70010000128702.intro: Raise baby Dragons and teach them their elemental magic!
70010000128702.name: My Universe - My Baby Dragon

70010000128709.description:
Quiet Evidence is an immersive, story-driven investigation game for mystery and puzzle enthusiasts. Test your keen observation, logic, and deduction skills as you unravel the dark secrets behind Maddy, a young girl who has suddenly vanished without a trace.

Whether you approach the case through the emotional lens of a desperate father or the cold logic of an experienced detective, Quiet Evidence delivers a perfectly balanced, suspenseful atmosphere by letting you experience two distinct perspectives.

Navigate this dark world at your own pace, where no obvious path is laid out for you. Explore detailed environments, examine objects, and solve deep, contextual puzzles. Remember: a misplaced item or a missed inconsistency could change the entire course of the investigation.

Get ready to unlock your full potential, spot the silent evidence others miss, and bring the shocking truth to light.
70010000128709.intro: Quiet Evidence: Unravel deep mysteries, spot hidden clues, find the truth.
70010000128709.name: Quiet Evidence: A Detective Mystery Case

70010000128719.description:
Candelaria travels from one funeral to the next, weeping for the departed she has never met in life, going on long night treks that keep her insomnia at bay.

When she comes across a bus ticket she did not buy to the mysterious Eigengrau Line, she is forced to confront traumas from the past and define a new course for her life.

ITINERARY

Get aboard a short, atmospheric story by Tiago Rech, award-winning author of TELEFORUM, Dodgeball Academia, No Place for Bravery, and Galaxy of Pen & Paper.

What is your destination? Find 5+ endings created by your choices.

Experience a unique, dark art style in 4K resolution.

Interact with bizarre passengers during a surreal journey.

Go to funerals, weep for the dead.

Find yourself amidst your traumas... or run away forever.
70010000128719.intro: Weep for the dead! In this short psychological horror story, play as a professional mourner travelling between funerals. Ride a nightmarish bus whose destination depends on your choices.
70010000128719.name: I Did Not Buy This Ticket

70010000128744.description:
STORY
In the world of Valdia, legendary monsters reign supreme.
To stand against the ancient beasts that have destroyed countless kingdoms, Luna, a black cat adventurer, is granted a forbidden power by the ancient dragon Selva.
That power is Scale Change, an ancient magic that allows her to freely alter her size.
Now, this tiny adventurer sets out on a journey to surpass the legends.

FEATURES

Master the Power of Scale Change
The defining feature of Lunadra is Scale Change.
Grow into a giant to unleash overwhelming power and devastating wide-area attacks that crush hordes of enemies.
Shrink to a tiny size to gain incredible speed and weave through deadly enemy assaults.
Adapt your size to the situation and experience a unique style of action combat.

Epic Battles Against Legendary Monsters
Standing in your way are the legendary monsters that have long threatened the world.
Massive area attacks, powerful magic, relentless assault patterns, and colossal bodies await.
Prepare for intense battles against gigantic bosses.

Create Your Ultimate Build
Combine Weapon Cards, Support Cards, and Beast Cards to create your own unique combat style.
Unlock a wide variety of abilities, including:
• Teleportation for rapid movement
• Coin Toss attacks that weaponize your gold
• Suction Tornadoes that pull in items from afar
Experiment with countless combinations and discover entirely different ways to play.

Recruit New Companions
As your adventure progresses, new companions will join your party.
Each character comes with unique weapons and abilities, opening up fresh strategies and playstyles.
Choose your favorite allies and take on legendary monsters together.

Intense 10-Minute Battles
Survive relentless waves of enemies in fast-paced battles.
Level up, customize your build, and face off against gigantic bosses.
Enjoy a highly replayable roguelite experience packed with fast-paced action, endless build possibilities, and epic boss battles.

2-Player Co-op Support
Adventure together with friends and family.
Even after being defeated, players remain on the battlefield as ghosts and can be revived by collecting recovery items.
Work together, support each other, and hunt down legendary monsters as a team.

Little One, Surpass the Legends.
70010000128744.intro:
Grow Giant and Challenge Legendary Monsters!
A Survivor-Style Roguelite RPG
70010000128744.name: Lunadra: Luna Awakens the Legendary Dragon

70010000128747.description:
You are a small robot with no memory, in a world overrun by hostile machines.

Explore 4 unique worlds and cleanse each area from corruption.
Unlock elemental transformations that change the way you play.
Fight, glide, and take on spectacular boss battles. Something isn’t right… and the truth is closer than you think.

You awaken in the HUB, guided by Tixy, a mysterious robot who helps you find your way. With no memories, but a clear goal: stop the invasion and restore balance.

Venture through 4 distinct environments, each filled with enemies, platforming challenges, and secrets to uncover. Complete small missions, explore freely, and collect bolts scattered across the levels.

Throughout your journey, you’ll unlock unique elemental forms, each with its own abilities.

Face dynamic boss battles, featuring multi-phase fights and intense action sequences.

The further you go, the more you’ll realize… this world hides something much bigger.
70010000128747.intro: Explore. Transform. Fight. Switch between robotic forms with unique abilities. Each form changes how you play.
70010000128747.name: Tolem

70010000128749.description:
Doraemon meets Story of Seasons in this new, fresh take on farming!

Japan's adored Doraemon franchise comes to Nintendo Switch™ in Story of Seasons, a beloved farming simulation series lasting over 20 years.

The setting is Natura, and at the center of this land is the mystical Big Tree. Doraemon and friends will each take on a role to help out around town!

The theme of this experience is creating bonds with the town residents, and while doing so, enjoying the heart-warming interactions through each character and the part they play in the story.

But building a farm and raising horses and cattle like in other Story of Seasons games isn't the only thing to do. Explore the town of Natura, go on adventures, catch bugs and much much more! Fans of the Doraemon series will also be happy to know that Doraemon's gadgets can be used to assist you in your new, everyday life!

Enjoy the nostalgia of Doraemon and Story of Seasons while helping Noby live his farm life in this unique, lovable land!
70010000128749.name: DORAEMON  STORY OF SEASONS

70010000128758.description:
Journey into a fantastical world on a quest for revenge in DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Dark Prince.

Psaro is cursed and is unable to harm anything with monster blood. Now, he must become a Monster Wrangler to create an army for battle.

The hunt for high-ranked monsters takes Psaro through the ever-changing seasons of Nadiria and its unique environments, with rivers of bubbling lava, mysterious ancient ruins, and soaring towers of cake. Along the way, Psaro meets the kind-hearted elf, Rose, who joins his adventure to seek out ever-stronger monsters.

The key to Psaro's success lies with synthesis: the ability to combine two monsters and create a stronger offspring. Each new creation brings Psaro one step closer to his goal of becoming the Master of Monsterkind.
70010000128758.name: DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Dark Prince

70010000128793.description: It features all DLC, including the latest "NEXT GENERATIONS" DLC Update Pack. Relive the Fourth Great Ninja War that unfolded in Naruto Shippuden, and experience the story of Boruto: Naruto the Movie featuring Naruto's son, Boruto Uzumaki. Plus, choose from 124 ninja—the most in the series! Join in action-packed battles, whenever and wherever you want!
70010000128793.name: NARUTO SHIPPUDEN™: Ultimate Ninja® STORM 4 ROAD TO BORUTO

70010000128794.description:
Digimon Survive presents a hybrid visual novel and tactical RPG set in a mysterious world filled with dangerous monsters and deadly battles that will test your ability to survive.

After getting lost on a school trip, Takuma Momozuka finds himself transported to a world inhabited by ferocious foes and new allies. Join Takuma and his friends as they fight their way back home. Craft your story in this thrilling visual novel with turn-based combat.

- A Rich Visual Novel Experience
Unfold a dark tale about friendship and survival that is jam-packed with exciting drama, a unique cast of characters, and potentially grim choices.

- A Mysterious World
Explore otherworldly areas filled with hidden secrets and Digimon to recruit.

- The Power is Yours
Your choices affect gameplay: you bond with other NPCs, your Digimon's evolution, and the outcome of your adventure.

- Thrilling and Strategic Gameplay
Persuade your opponents to join your team and evolve them to fight alongside you in thrilling turn-based battles.
70010000128794.intro: We had no idea that ordinary life could be taken from us so easily...
70010000128794.name: Digimon Survive

70010000128795.description:
From the mind of Baiyon, creative director and hypnotic soundscape composer, for both the award winning Pixeljunk Eden and Eden Obscura, comes Eden 2, an exploration of life, color and collaboration as Grimps reinvigorate and revitalize the world in a swath of luminescence, painting upon a lush canvas as they play.

Return to the spectacular, ever changing gardens of psychedelic sights and sounds as you cultivate new plants and biomes, collect pollen and help seeds sprout new exotic leaves and bloom flowers, all against a dynamic and vibrant backdrop of mellow, multi-hued visuals.

Swing and spin from silk threads, in both single and cooperative play as you and a partner pirouette around one another in brush-strokes of light and color in the world on your journey to collect the all important “Spectra,” the source of all life in the world.

- New Grimps with added perks can be unlocked over time, providing new ways to play and experience these strange new worlds.

- Use a variety of different “spices” to improve pollen gathering, spend more time cultivating the gardens, as well as alter the world in mind bending ways!

- Relax to the synergetic beats and rhythms created especially for these kaleidoscopic,  wonderful worlds.

- With a multitude of gardens to choose from and many different variants to each, Eden 2 provides countless hours of continuous play.

- An expansive and eclectic mix of ambient and sensory candy for your ears.
70010000128795.intro: Jump, Spin, Swing, Explore Beautifully Organic Worlds
70010000128795.name: PixelJunk Eden 2

70010000128830.description:
With engaging storylines, classic turn-based battles, and tons of Digimon to collect, Digimon Story Cyber Sleuth: Complete Edition delivers everything fans loved about Digimon Story: Cyber Sleuth and Digimon Story: Cyber Sleuth – Hacker’s Memory.
Get the full experience with the Complete Edition which includes both titles in one!

MYSTERIOUS EVENTS
• Become a cyber detective or powerful hacker to solve diabolical digi-mysteries.

VIVID & IMMERSIVE WORLDS
• Embark on a thrilling adventure where the line between the real and digital worlds is blurred.

ENDLESSLY ADDICTING
• Featuring more than 300 Digimon to collect, raise, and Digivolve!

SOLID GAMEPLAY
• Build an all-star Digimon team to take on opponents in classic turn-based battles.
70010000128830.name: Digimon Story Cyber Sleuth: Complete Edition

70010000128831.description:
Purchase Digimon World: Next Order and get the following bonus content:
• Omegamon Ult. Digivolution Item: Summaequetrine
• Imperialdramon PM Ult. Digivolution Item: Sacrimperine
• Parameter Boost Set
- HP Chip Mini x2, MP Chip Mini x2, Strength Chip Mini x2, Stamina Chip Mini x2, Speed Chip Mini x2, Wisdom Chip Mini x2

The Digital World has run rampant with Machinedramon and is now in a state of utter chaos. As a Digidestined, it’s up to you to restore order to the world in Digimon World: Next Order, a monster-collecting RPG.

Find and recruit as many faithful Digimon companions as possible to rebuild the Digital World. Will you be able to balance both training and exploration to stop the virus-infected Digimon from causing complete destruction?

• ENDLESSLY ENGAGING FUN
Choose between a male or female protagonist and seek adventure with over 200 Digimon to collect! Explore the world with, not one but, TWO Digimon companions for the first time ever.

• TAKE CARE OF DIGIMON
Form a strong bond with your Digimon by caring for them: feed, train, discipline, and Digivolve them. The stronger the bond between you and your Digimon, as well as between the two Digimon companions, the greater the chance of victory in battles!

• BUILD A THRIVING TOWN
Expand and manage your town, Floatia. Recruit new Digimon, upgrade buildings, grow crops, and more as you grow into a sprawling Digi-metropolis.

• EVOLVED AI BATTLE SYSTEM
Train your pair of Digimon to fight cooperatively in AI battles. Issue commands and cheer them to victory!
70010000128831.intro: Welcome Back to the Digital World
70010000128831.name: Digimon World: Next Order

70010000128859.description:
Let your child discover the numbers from 1 to 20 in a colorful collection of fun learning games made especially for young children.

This lovingly crafted educational game helps kids learn numbers, counting and spoken number recognition in 14 selectable languages. Children can hear the numbers, recognize them on screen and repeat them out loud while playing a variety of cheerful mini games.

All learning games can be played in different difficulty levels, making the experience suitable for very young children, preschoolers and early elementary school kids. As your child grows and improves, the game can grow with them, offering new challenges and keeping the learning experience fun and motivating for a longer time.

Pop the correct balloons in a funny balloon popping game, solve a farm conveyor-belt peg puzzle, roll the dice, find matching number cards, count cute animals and objects, and enjoy classic memory card games with charming motifs.

In the special number memory game, children can play against a funny animal opponent. The opponent’s skill automatically adapts to the child’s performance, keeping every match fair, motivating and fun.

There is also a playful zoo sliding puzzle that encourages children to think carefully, observe the picture and move the pieces into the right place. This extra thinking game adds variety and helps train concentration, patience and logical problem-solving in a fun, child-friendly way.

The different activities help children practice number recognition, counting, memory, first math, concentration, hand-eye coordination and early logical thinking. Because every mini game teaches numbers in a different way, kids can repeat and strengthen what they learn without it feeling like homework.

Perfect for toddlers, preschoolers, kindergarten children and early elementary school kids who want to learn numbers and different languages in a playful way on Nintendo Switch™.

Features:
Learn the numbers from 1 to 20
Spoken number learning in 14 selectable languages
Different difficulty levels for long-lasting learning fun
Grows with your child from toddler age to early elementary school
Fun balloon popping game
First math lessons
Farm conveyor-belt peg puzzle
Dice game, counting game and number memory
Classic memory card game with cute motifs
Adaptive animal opponent for fair memory matches
Zoo sliding puzzle for concentration and logical thinking
Playful practice for toddlers, preschool, kindergarten and early elementary kids
Colorful, cheerful and child-friendly design

Thanks to the touchscreen controls of Nintendo Switch™, the game is simple, direct, and child-friendly.
70010000128859.intro: Numbers game, counting game, preschool game, kids math, 14 languages, balloon pop, farm puzzle, memory game, educational game, learning peg puzzle, farm game
70010000128859.name: 123 Early Learning Games for Kids, Toddlers, Babies - Language

70010000128865.description:
Enter a fast-paced hyper casual merging game where strategy and destruction combine in satisfying arcade action. Build a team of powerful monsters on a 5 by 4 grid and send them charging down lanes packed with breakable blocks. Press dash and every monster rushes forward in its lane, smashing into obstacles, bouncing back, and attacking again until the blocks are destroyed.

Each lane contains different types of blocks, with some requiring far more power to break through than others. As levels progress, the lanes become longer and tougher, challenging you to constantly improve your team and create stronger monsters capable of pushing further than ever before.

Earn coins by destroying blocks during every dash and use them to buy new monsters for your grid. Start with basic level 1 monsters and combine matching monsters together by dragging them onto each other. Every merge creates a stronger monster at the next level, allowing you to continue upgrading all the way up to powerful level 30 monsters.

To complete a stage, at least one monster must smash through every block in its lane and reach the treasure waiting at the end. Claim huge coin rewards, unlock the next challenge, and keep merging to survive increasingly difficult levels filled with stronger obstacles and longer paths.

Easy to learn and satisfying to master, this hyper casual merge game delivers nonstop progression, rewarding upgrades, and addictive destruction with every dash.
70010000128865.name: Merge Assault

70010000128868.description:
Story

In Super Farming Boy™, you play as Super, whose mom and friends have been captured by his evil nemesis, KORPO®©TM. Unlawfully hiring you to work on your own land, Korpo taxes all proceeds for himself!
Now, with your friends and mom up for sale, you must harvest your way through some wacky challenges, saving enough to rescue them back!

Gameplay Mechanics

In Super Farming Boy™, there are no tools because you are the tool. With the simple push of a button, you can transform into a shovel, a hammer, a pickaxe, a watering can, and more! Super Farming Boy can even FLY! The game's central mechanic revolves around chain reactions and combos! The magical seed creatures in this world, once harvested, trigger specific chain-reaction effects that enable you to optimize your farm in ways never seen before in a farming game. These chain reaction and combo powers also serve as your means of defense against creatures, help optimize your daily stamina usage, and facilitate various actions such as chopping down trees, demolishing boulders, removing weeds, collecting items, defeating bosses, and much more! Explore whimsical weathers and extraordinarily unusual seasons, such as Radioactive Season, Timewarp Season, and Volcanic Season.
Super Farming Boy has been meticulously designed with touch controls in mind.

Features
Superhero abilities
Super Farming Boy™ has the ability to walk, run, and even fly! Additionally, he can transform into any tool with a simple push or tap of a button—be it a shovel, pickaxe, axe, or hammer.

Chain Reaction & Combos
Optimize your farm by harvesting a single crop and witnessing the chain and combo effects efficiently harvest your entire farm at once. However, meticulous planning in your planting efforts is essential!

Lots of Supertools to Upgrade
All SuperTools and powers in Super Farming Boy™ come in the form of old-school superhero trading cards. Unlock and upgrade them all!

Wacky Seasons to Discover
Explore a plethora of seasons in Super Farming Boy™, including Spring, Winteria, Volcanic and Radioactive.

Idle helpers to collect
Rescue all your pets by purchasing them back from Korpo™®©! Each pet comes with a unique mechanic to help automate your farm.

No inventory management
Super Farming Boy™ eliminates the need for inventory management. All seeds and helpers are creatures that follow you wherever you go, avoiding the hassle of an ever-filling inventory!

Beauty Up and Customize it All
Personalize your BlobHouse with fantastic beauty items such as tables, rugs, and beds! Your home will be uniquely yours and look amazing with your creative touch.

Touch Controls that are actually good
Drag and drop every item in this game!
70010000128868.intro: Super Farming Boy is an exciting mix of ACTION, PUZZLE, and FARMING SIM, heavily relying on CHAIN REACTION and COMBOS.
70010000128868.name: Super Farming Boy

70010000128874.description:
Arrange, rotate, and link weapons, potions, and magical wands on a grid to align inputs and outputs. When a turn starts, your backpack comes alive: links fire, effects cascade, and your custom combos automatically fill the action queue. Draft new items, manage deep elemental resistances, and nudge the battlefield with tactical card plays in a charming, cozy paper-theater world.

Key Features
The Living Backpack: Your inventory is your build. Rotate and position items to connect green inputs and yellow outputs, forging automated synergies.

Chain-Reaction Combat: At the start of your turn, linked items trigger sequentially to execute actions (Attack, Block, InflictEffect) without hidden rules.

Tactical Card Play: Don't just watch. Play clutch, limited-use cards mid-turn to manipulate the queue—double a hit, purge a debuff, or force an instant trigger.

Draft & Adapt: Build around distinct hero passives and draft unique scaling or mimic items to counter shifting enemy resistance profiles.

Paper-Theater Aesthetic: Lose yourself in a warm, handmade world featuring hand-drawn cut-out characters and cozy stage lighting.
70010000128874.intro: A grid-inventory roguelike where you rotate and wire items together. Connect wands, potions, and swords to trigger automated, chain-reaction combat.
70010000128874.name: Papercraft Tactics

70010000128888.description:
Step into a world ruled by nature, where every sound, footprint, and movement can mean the difference between hunter and prey. Far Primal Survival is an atmospheric prehistoric hunting adventure set 10,000 years ago, where survival depends on patience, awareness, and skill.

Explore untamed territories, track dangerous animals, move silently through tall grass, and use primitive weapons to bring down your prey. Every hunt is a test of your instincts, preparation, and ability to adapt to the wilderness.

Key Features
	•	Track Your Prey – Follow animal tracks and locate hidden prey.
	•	Use Primitive Weapons – Hunt with bows, spears, and clubs.
	•	Complete Hunting Quests – Take on objectives across the wilderness.
	•	Explore 20 Territories – Discover diverse prehistoric environments.
	•	Master the Hunt – Stay hidden, strike carefully, and survive.


The wilderness is vast.
The prey is unpredictable.
Only the patient become the hunter.
70010000128888.intro: Can you become the ultimate hunter in a world ruled by nature?
70010000128888.name: Far Primal Survival

70010000128911.description: Developed by id Software, the studio that pioneered the first-person shooter genre and created multiplayer Deathmatch, DOOM returns as a brutally fun and challenging modern-day shooter experience. Relentless demons, impossibly destructive guns, and fast, fluid movement provide the foundation for intense, first-person combat – whether you’re obliterating demon hordes through the depths of Hell in the single-player campaign, or competing against your friends in numerous multiplayer modes. There is no taking cover or stopping to regenerate health as you beat back Hell’s raging demon hordes. Combine your arsenal of futuristic and iconic guns, upgrades, movement and an advanced melee system to knock-down, slash, stomp, crush, and blow apart demons in creative and violent ways.
70010000128911.name: DOOM

70010000128912.description:
ATTENTION: a microSD card (sold separately) with free storage space of minimum 23GB is required to download this game.

Wolfenstein II®: The New Colossus™, the Video Game Awards’ ‘Best Action Game of 2017’ winner, comes to Nintendo Switch this Summer. Fight through post-nuclear Manhattan, occupied Roswell, New Mexico, and the embattled bayous and boulevards of New Orleans as you liberate the American people from the Nazis.

As BJ Blazkowicz, experience an unforgettable action-packed story brought to life by extraordinary characters. Reunite with your friends and fellow freedom fighters as you take on the evil Frau Engel and her Nazi army. Wage the second American Revolution your way – at home or on the go. And, for the perfect blend of immersion and accuracy, utilize the Nintendo Switch’s unique motion controls to stop the Nazi threat.
70010000128912.name: Wolfenstein II®: The New Colossus™

70010000128913.description:
Owners Receive:
- DOOM
- DOOM II
- TNT: Evilution
- The Plutonia Experiment
- Master Levels for DOOM II
- No Rest for the Living
- Sigil
- Legacy of Rust (a new episode created in collaboration by id Software, Nightdive Studios and MachineGames)
- A new Deathmatch map pack featuring 25 maps

Altogether, there are a total of 187 mission maps and 43 deathmatch maps in DOOM + DOOM II.

New Enhancements

- Online, cross-platform deathmatch and co-op for up to 16 players¹

- In-game mod browser³

- Choose between the original midi DOOM and DOOM II soundtracks or the modern IDKFA versions by Andrew Hulshult (including brand-new DOOM II recordings)

- Now on the KEX engine

- BOOM source compatibility makes it possible for hundreds of community-created mods from the past 25 years to be published in-game

- Accessibility options, such as a modern font to improve legibility, high contrast mode, text-to-speech, speech-to-text multiplayer chat and more

- Translated into 8 new languages: Mexican Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Polish, Russian, Japanese, Korean, Traditional Chinese and Simplified Chinese

Existing Enhancements

- Upgraded visuals

- Modern controller support

- Weapon carousel for faster weapon switching

- Gyroscopic aiming

- Improved mouse and keyboard controls

- Local split-screen deathmatch and co-op for up to 4 players

- Featured community mods¹'²'³, including REKKR, Revolution!, Syringe, Double Impact, Arrival, and more!

- 60 FPS and native 16:9 support – up to 1080p

- Restored original in-game music using original hardware

- Quick Save/Load support

- DeHacked mod support
70010000128913.name: DOOM + DOOM II

70010000128914.description:
Celebrate DOOM's 25th anniversary  with the release of DOOM 3, available for the first time on Nintendo consoles.

In this critically acclaimed action-horror re-telling of the original DOOM, players must battle their way through a demon-infested facility before entering the abyss to battle Hell's mightiest warrior - and put an end to the invasion.

DOOM 3 includes the Resurrection of Evil and The Lost Missions expansion packs.
70010000128914.name: DOOM 3

70010000128942.description:
Enjoy the slow life in a peaceful countryside village.
Hunt for bugs in forests, bamboo groves, rivers, and more.
Meet the villagers, make new friends, and create unforgettable summer memories.

Insects from across the globe gather in the mysterious woods.
Legendary insects are even said to dwell deep within.
Fill out your Bug Records and become a master bug collector!

[Simple Bug Catching]
Bug catching controls are simple!
Approach without startling the bug, then swing your net at the right time!
Catch the bugs before they escape!

[70+ Species to Catch!]
Catch bugs native to Japan as well as from around the world!
Complete your Bug Records by collecting data on every bug you catch.
Find every species and hunt for record-breaking sizes!

[Collect Bug Nets and Items]
Save up your allowance to buy new bug nets and items for bug catching.
Use items to increase your chances of finding rare and large bugs!

[Bug Battles]
Put the bugs you've caught to the test in exciting battles!
Knock your opponent's bug out of the battle zone!
Find the strongest bug you can and become the champion!

[Interact with the Villagers]
Spend time with your friends and the local villagers.
Help them out, play minigames, and enjoy summer vacation to its fullest!

[Decorate Your Secret Base!]
Freely decorate your secret base with the furniture you collect.
Pick your favorite items to display and make the space your own!

[Online Rankings]
Compete to capture as many bugs as you can within the time limit in Score Attack!
Climb the leaderboards with your best Score Attack score and total bugs caught.
Test your skills against players from around the world!
70010000128942.intro:
Pick up your bug net and set off on a grand summer adventure.
Your bug-collecting summer vacation is about to begin!
70010000128942.name: Peaceful Bug Catching Story

70010000128975.description:
Step into the haunted frontier in Wild West Nightmare, a tense first-person western horror adventure set deep beneath a cursed mining town. Buried under crushing debt and desperate for a way out, you enter an abandoned gold mine rumored to contain enough treasure to change your fate. But the deeper you go, the clearer it becomes that the mine is hiding far more than gold.

Your goal is simple: collect 30 gold nuggets and escape alive. Explore dark cave systems, abandoned mining tunnels, and eerie underground chambers while searching for valuable treasure scattered throughout the mine. Every corner hides danger, and strange sounds echo through the darkness as a terrifying creature stalks you from the shadows.

Balance exploration, survival, and courage as you navigate the nightmare beneath the Wild West. Use your instincts to avoid the monster, survive the oppressive atmosphere, and uncover the secrets hidden deep underground. With immersive environments, constant tension, and a blend of western adventure and horror, Wild West Nightmare delivers a chilling experience where greed, fear, and survival collide.
70010000128975.intro: Enter the cursed mine of the wild west, a spooky western adventure where danger lurks in every shadow.
70010000128975.name: Wild West Nightmare

70010000128984.description:
Enter a fast-paced battlefield where every encounter can turn into a fight for control. Choose your character, arm yourself, and face the opposing team across detailed urban environments filled with buildings, obstacles, and strategic positions.

Move through the battlefield, track enemy movements, and use your surroundings to create opportunities. Whether you push forward aggressively or take time to find a better position, quick reactions and accurate shooting can determine the outcome of every confrontation.

Take part in team-based battles where individual skill and teamwork go hand in hand.
Keep an eye on the score, support your teammates, manage your ammunition, and adapt your approach as the battle develops.

Choose the character that fits your style and return to the action after each elimination. Change your route, rethink your position, and get back into the fight to help your team turn the match around.

Key Features:
• Experience fast-paced 3D third-person combat
• Choose from multiple playable characters
• Battle opposing teams across urban-themed maps
• Use buildings, obstacles, and strategic areas to your advantage
• Manage weapons, ammunition, health, and reloads during combat
• Track the score and work together with your teammates
• Use the respawn system to quickly return to the battlefield
• Rely on reflexes, accuracy, positioning, and quick decisions

Choose your character, prepare for battle, and step onto the battlefield. Your next confrontation is waiting.
70010000128984.intro: Enter the battlefield and prove your combat skills.
70010000128984.name: Squad Legends - Battle Royale

70010000128985.description:
Die in the Dungeon is a deck-building, turn-based roguelite game where your deck is not made out of cards, but DICE!

In Die in the Dungeon, each dice represents a different action, from basic ones like attacking or healing to boosting other dice or copying their abilities.

Improve the quality of your dice, combine them and acquire powerful relics to defeat the monsters that dwell in the dungeon! Find great synergies by combining dice with unique abilities to create powerful and bizarre decks!

Game Features
Craft your deck from an ever-growing collection of dice.
Every dice has its purpose, with tons of combinations to discover and exploit. On top of that, special properties and upgrades will ensure no single dice feel exactly the same.
Explore the dungeon and its unwelcoming inhabitants.
Forged by strong magic, the walls and floors of the dungeon shift continuously, creating a brand new experience in every run. Thankfully, encounters are not always hostile, but never let your guard down... it’s all a game of risk and reward down here.
Discover powerful synergies by choosing from a myriad of relics.
Stack their powers and use them to boost your dice and board slots, multiplying the power of your combinations and becoming unstoppable. But don’t get too greedy, the stronger a relic is, the bigger their drawbacks will affect you and your deck.
Trust the roll of the dice and discover the fate that awaits you within the dungeon walls!
70010000128985.intro: Fight your way in this deck-building, turn-based roguelike game
70010000128985.name: Die in the Dungeon

70010000129001.description:
The River City Girls are ready for round 2! When an old foe resurfaces, Misako, Kyoko, Kunio, and Riki - joined by newcomers Marian and Provie - hit the streets for an all-new beat-'em-up adventure packed with new abilities, enemies, environments, and more! Team up for local or online co-op, then pound punks into the dirt with brand-new guard-crush attacks, lift-off combos, double-team maneuvers, and other knuckle-busting techniques! Level-up to earn new moves, buy items and accessories in more than 30 shops, and recruit defeated foes and hired heavies to help you on your way! River City is bigger than ever, with more locations to explore, more objects to destroy, and a day-night cycle! With nonlinear gameplay, a dynamic story system, and another epic soundtrack by Megan McDuffee, River City Girls 2 will keep you brawling until all your enemies yell "BARF!"

Key Features:
-Six playable characters, each with their own fighting styles and upgradable move sets!
-Enhanced combat: guard crushes, lift-off combos, double-team maneuvers, and more!
-River City is bigger than ever! New locations with multiple routes and secret areas!
-Play solo or team up with a friend, locally or online
-New "hired heavies" aid you in battle! Have two recruits at once!
-Loads of NPCs to meet, interact with, and punch in the face - including surprise cameos!
-Awesome anime intro, comic book cutscenes, English and Japanese voiceovers, and a spectacular soundtrack featuring RCG1 composer Megan McDuffee!
70010000129001.intro: Higher stakes. Meaner streets. The River City Girls are back in action!
70010000129001.name: River City Girls 2

70010000129009.description:
[Game Overview]
A roguelite action game set in the BLAZBLUE universe, featuring striking 2D visuals, stylish, fast-paced combat, and precise, responsive controls.
Command a line-up of unique characters from the renowned BLAZBLUE franchise and dive into an unparalleled action experience.

[Story]
At a mysterious domain, known as “the Lab”,a group of elite researchers race to save a collapsing word; however, despite their efforts to date, Dr. Mercurius, head of the laboratory, still warns the world’s downfall is near.
In a last-ditch effort, the urgent *Research of Possibility* initiative seeks to collect *Shards of Possibility*—a special fragment of the world that could forestall the seemingly inevitable destruction.
These shards lie within the *Sea of Possibility*, a realm between worlds, beyond the bounds of reality.
Our protagonist, *Ace*, is the only being capable of diving into this sea.
Guided by the elite researchers at *the Lab*, Ace descends again and again in pursuit of salvation—until strange visions take hold and his body begins to change.
As Ace continues to dive, countless memories flood his mind, and the truth behind the collapsing world—and the research itself—begins to surface....

“……The Power of Azure.”
70010000129009.name: BlazBlue Entropy Effect X - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000129036.description:
Get ready for non-stop fun in Pet World! Your favorite animals are here to help you build a massive empire. Drop into colorful worlds, tap into your pets' magical powers, and watch them smash obstacles to flood your screen with shiny gold coins!

Farm Gold, Buy Pets, Repeat!
The rules are simple but super fun: use your loyal pets to farm chests and treasures, collect mountainloads of gold, and use that wealth to hatch even stronger, mythical companions!

Unlock Legendary Kingdoms!
Got enough gold? Time to expand! Spend your riches to unlock brand-new, massive locations packed with even bigger treasures and rarer pets. Every new world brings bigger rewards and crazier pets to add to your ultimate collection. Can you unlock them all and become the richest explorer?

Key Features:

Super Fun Idle Action - Easy to play, hard to stop! Watch your pets farm gold even while you relax.

Hatch 150+ Cute Pets - Spend your gold coins to collect, level up, and upgrade legendary and cosmic companions!

Unlock New Worlds - Travel to ever-changing kingdoms that offer more riches and bigger challenges.

Fun for Everyone - Colorful 3D visuals and rewarding gameplay perfect for young tycoons!
70010000129036.intro: Collect awesome pets, farm tons of gold, and discover Magical Kingdoms!
70010000129036.name: Pet World

70010000129045.description:
Choose your target and prepare to bring an entire world to a spectacular end.

Take command of devastating cosmic power and turn planets into your personal destruction experiments. Select a world, choose your weapon, and watch the catastrophe unfold. Tear through the surface, split the planet into fragments, trigger a colossal supernova, or unleash a black hole that consumes everything in its path.

Experiment with different tools and discover how each one changes the fate of your target. Clear, intuitive controls let newcomers begin destroying immediately while giving experienced players the freedom to stage their own cosmic catastrophes.

KEY FEATURES

• Choose from different planets
• Wield a variety of destructive cosmic weapons
• Tear planetary surfaces apart
• Trigger spectacular supernovas
• Unleash all-consuming black holes
• Experiment with space and physics using intuitive controls

How much destruction can one planet withstand? There is only one way to find out.
70010000129045.intro: Choose a planet. Unleash cosmic weapons. Decide how the world ends.
70010000129045.name: Destroy The Universe: Solar Mayhem

70010000129097.description:
Dive into 10 unique and easy-to-play party games filled with summer fun!
Launch rocket fireworks at your rivals, slip and slide as somen noodles, and swipe fresh-grilled BBQ before anyone else can grab it!

Challenge CPU opponents in single-player, or battle it out with family and friends in a group of up to 4 players!
All 10 games also support online multiplayer, so you can take on players from around the world in head-to-head matches!

[Free Mode]
Pick your favorite game and jump right in!

[Party Mode]
Choose a series of games and play them back-to-back!
Compete for the highest total score to become the champion!

[Online Mode]
Hop into Quick Matches to challenge players from around the world right away!
Create your own room and enjoy matches with friends, no matter the distance!

[Included Minigames]
・Fire! Rocket Fireworks
・Somen Slide
・Float Ring Battlers
・Fan Blast!
・BBQ Grab Battle
・Frozen Treat Tower
・Beetle Battle
・Trick Surfing
・Sandal Toss
・Smack the Mosquitoes!
70010000129097.intro:
Blast off and let the chaos begin!
Get ready for a red-hot, hilarious summer showdown!
70010000129097.name: Blast Off! Summer Showdown

70010000129119.description:
Defend yourself with a camera while solving death’s mysteries in a reverent evolution of 90’s survival horror, integrating both fixed cameras and over the shoulder perspectives.

Story

Sam, unable to move on from the death of her beloved grandfather, falls down an internet rabbit hole chasing the promise of reuniting with him.

Following the lead of a mysterious forum, she finds herself at a supposedly supernatural house in the mountain, hoping to make contact with the other side.

Features

•A journey through grief and loss within retro-inspired atmospheric environments.
•4-6 hours of gameplay with multiple endings
•Both pre-rendered and in-game cutscenes
•A focus on exploration with classic puzzles, and limited combat using a camera as a weapon
•A modern control scheme with 3rd person over-the-shoulder aiming and optional classic tank controls
•Optional pixelation and retro effects calling back to the first 3D console era for a more authentic experience
•A haunting original soundtrack
70010000129119.intro: Pass through the threshold and enter a world born of memories.
70010000129119.name: Heartworm

70010000129131.description: Blast. Collect. Upgrade. Repeat. Void Miner is a retro-inspired roguelite asteroid shooter where you pilot a space ship and manage an automated tower to destroy endless fields of chaos. Dodge, blast, and harvest your way through waves of asteroids in a fast-paced loop of destruction and progression.
70010000129131.intro: Void Miner is a incremental roguelite bullet hell that is about mining asteroids, collecting resources and upgrading your ship to blast through waves of asteroid belts.
70010000129131.name: Void Miner

70010000129137.description:
Pull the lever and test your luck in Fruits Slot Machine — a simple, fast-paced slot machine game right in your console.
Choose your bet, spin the reels, and match the symbols to win. Land three of a kind for big payouts, or hit the rarest combination of all to claim the ultimate jackpot. Every spin could change everything.

Features:
-Minimum bet of $500 — high stakes only
-5 fruit symbols with different payout multipliers
-Auto-spin mode to keep the reels rolling hands-free
-Triple matches pay up to 10× your bet
-Land the secret rare combo for the JACKPOT
70010000129137.intro: Spin the reels and win multiple payouts and a legendary jackpot.
70010000129137.name: Fruits Slot Machine

70010000129148.description:
Transform a dusty room into the ultimate gaming hub! In Warnet Life, you become a budding entrepreneur tasked with building the most popular cyber cafe in town. Start from scratch by assembling custom computers, upgrading your hardware, and decorating your shop to reflect your personal style. As your reputation grows, so will your profits, enabling you to transform a small, empty room into a world-class digital empire.

Running a successful business isn't just about having fast internet and comfy chairs. It's about managing pure, unpredictable chaos. You have to be ready to fix sudden power outages, call a technician when the router crashes, and shoo away kids bothering your paying customers. You may even need to hire security to protect your valuable equipment from destructive vandals! When you aren't managing the shop, step outside to explore the vibrant city, complete quirky quests for the locals, and uncover hidden secrets. Collect cash, play entertaining minigames, and demonstrate that you have what it takes to survive the daily grind of the ultimate internet cafe!

Key Features:
• Build epic rigs: assemble custom, high-performance gaming PCs from scratch.
• Control the chaos: React quickly to dynamic events. Fix blown fuses, troubleshoot internet crashes, and keep the business running smoothly.
• Customize Everything: Paint, furnish, and decorate to create the ultimate gaming space.
• Defend your turf: Hire security to protect your shop from vandals, and personally chase out loiterers who annoy your paying customers.
• Explore the city: Step outside to meet quirky locals, uncover secrets, and complete quests.
• Take a Break: Relax and enjoy the fun arcade minigames scattered around town.
70010000129148.name: Warnet Life

70010000129166.description:
Deep in the Amazon, a lone treasure hunter in search of Ultimate Power gets more than he bargains for when he's turned to goo and falls deep into the bowels of an ancient temple. As the gooey treasure hunter, you start with nothing. No powers. No weapons. Not even the ability to jump. Only by exploring the temple can you begin to understand and unleash the powers of the slime.

Keep playing to unlock new powers, own your enemies, and hopefully uncover the secret to regaining your humanity.
70010000129166.intro: He came for ultimate power. He got it — sort of.
70010000129166.name: Gelatinous: Humanity Lost

70010000129172.description:
Banana Blood is a first person comedy horror game about, well, bananas. You arrive at the banana farm that's surrounded by mystery and death and it's up to you to find out what's going on here. Weird banana creatures are creeping around, the smell of fresh banana bread is filling the air, and you can't help but feel yourself being dragged into this place.

The game is a mix of comedy and horror: the banana jokes and puns are running wild here and the cartoon-like banana creatures are too nightmarish to be in a kids' show. You get to explore the Banana Farm, the secrets inside, run from the evil creatures, solve puzzles, laugh at the jokes and jump from the scares. We have a wide selection of evil bananas chasing you and giving you nightmares, such as the violent Banana Demon, the dancing Pink Banana, creepy Banana Children, a sinister Banana Mannequin... And they're all trying to summon the Banana God.

The game also has bus customization. The game isn't about a bus. And it's not even your bus. To be honest, the bus driver is quite angry with you about it. But you can still pick some new paint colors for that bus.

Time to go bananas.
70010000129172.intro: This is the banana horror game. They call it certain death. I call it an a-peeling adventure. Time to go bananas.
70010000129172.name: Banana Blood

70010000129179.description:
Lootbag Tactics is a fantasy strategy game that brings together deep inventory management and thrilling auto-battler mechanics. Collect the right items, build your unbeatable setup, and outsmart your rivals!

Surviving the arena requires more than just raw power; it requires a sharp mind. You must efficiently manage your limited bag space and choose the right weapons, shields, and accessories from the shop. Open chests to find Epic gear, combine items to multiply your strength, and step onto the battlefield.

Discover the unique advantages of different classes! Play as a Knight to strengthen your shields or unlock new strategies with specialized perks like Shield Doctrine and Frontline Training. Once your grid is set, sit back and watch your warriors automatically battle it out in a flawless display of your tactics!


Key Features:
* Deep Inventory Management: Place your items strategically on your grid-based bag. Create powerful synergies by positioning the right items together and maximizing your space.
* Tactical Auto-Battler Combat: After the preparation phase, send your warriors into the arena. Analyze rival setups and develop the perfect counter-tactics.
* Unique Classes & Perks: Choose a hero class that fits your playstyle. Each class features unique passive abilities that interact dynamically with your items.
* Epic Loot: Start with a simple wooden sword, upgrade the shop as you win, and discover Legendary weapons, magical codexes, and rare charms.
* Battle Against Rivals: Face off against the unique builds of different competitors and climb the Master Levels.
* Play Anywhere, Anytime: Fully optimized for Nintendo Switch™! Play on the big screen in TV Mode, or strategize on the go in Tabletop and Handheld Modes.
70010000129179.intro: Pack your bag, set your strategy, and dominate the arena!
70010000129179.name: Lootbag Tactics

70010000129222.description:
A new legend begins here!

Build and manage a town in grasslands, snow fields, even in the underworld! Set up inns, weapon stores, and more to convince adventurers to come visit.

Use items and equipment to power up your adventurers and help them get more gold and experience from their quests. Be on the lookout for new dungeons to explore and new monsters to fight!

Need help attracting adventurers? Try building new facilities, selling new kinds of food, or improving the local area to earn Titles. Keep experimenting, and you might stumble on some rare awards...

As your town develops and becomes more popular, adventurers won't just visit, but move in for good!
The enemy roster from the previous game has been expanded with a host of quirky new monsters to fight.

Play your cards right, and some monsters will become friendly and join you! Give them snacks, keep them happy, and they'll become valuable allies on your quests. Explore more and more of the world map to unlock new areas.

Feel like a fresh start? Move your town to a different region to discover unseen monsters and bold new adventurers.

Rise through the ranks and create the greatest town the kingdom has ever seen!
70010000129222.intro: Recruit adventurers and monsters to create your own RRG-style town!
70010000129222.name: Dungeon Village 2 – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000129229.description:
A broken error screen. A missing file. And somehow, on the other side of that 404, a girl who shouldn't exist is looking right at you.

Take on a mix of minigames built to test you in different ways. Beat them and every one unlocks a piece of the gallery, pushing you closer to her.

Some crash the system on purpose. Some just want to be found. Each one glitches into your game with her own personality, her own rules, her own way of making you work for it.

How many errors are you willing to chase before one of them finally lets you in?


Features:

● A VARIETY OF MINIGAMES: Different challenges test you in different ways. Clear them and the gallery unlocks as you go.

● UNLOCK EXCLUSIVE IMAGES: Every win cracks the error screen open a little more.

● GLITCHY, UNFORGETTABLE PERSONALITIES: Each anime girl comes with her own attitude, quirks and reasons for showing up in your game uninvited.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: How you play decides who stays and who logs off for good.

● A HIDDEN MOMENT AT QUESTION 150: Something's buried deep in the code. Most players never see it.


The system says 404.
Your heart says otherwise.
Boot it up and prove the error wrong.
70010000129229.intro:
Somewhere between the code and the crash, she's waiting for you.
Fix the glitch and she's all yours!
70010000129229.name: Bug Error 404: Anime Girls Not Found

70010000129236.description:
Manage your own game company and try to create a million-selling game in this unique simulation.

Features the ability to develop your company's own game console, plus a system for changing your staff members' professions.

Your staff members can have a variety of game-related professions, from programmer to sound engineer.

Work hard and you may reach the top of the video game industry!
70010000129236.intro: Work hard and you may reach the top of the video game industry!
70010000129236.name: Game Dev Story – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000129242.description:
Trapped in a dark and unsettling world, you must explore abandoned locations, uncover hidden secrets, and survive the horrors lurking within the shadows. Every sound, every hallway, and every decision could lead you closer to the truth — or deeper into madness.

Experience intense first-person psychological horror with immersive environments, atmospheric sound design, challenging puzzles, and terrifying encounters that will keep you constantly on edge. Search for clues, manage your fear, and uncover the mystery behind the nightmare before it consumes you.

Can you survive the darkness and face what hides within your fear?
70010000129242.intro: Enter a nightmarish world where fear is always watching. Explore dark environments, solve disturbing mysteries, and survive terrifying encounters.
70010000129242.name: Fearbound

70010000129248.description:
The screen glitches. The error reads 404. And staring back at you through the broken code is a guy who was never supposed to load.

Take on a mix of minigames built to test you in different ways. Beat them and every one unlocks a piece of the gallery, pushing you closer to him.

Some of them crashed the system just to get your attention. Others are glitches trying to stay hidden. Each one carries his own personality into your game, and his own way of testing whether you're worth sticking around for.

How many broken screens are you willing to fix before one of them finally stays?


Features:

● A VARIETY OF MINIGAMES: Different challenges test you in different ways. Clear them and the gallery unlocks as you go.

● UNLOCK EXCLUSIVE IMAGES: Every win cracks the error open a little more.

● PERSONALITIES THAT GLITCH INTO YOUR LIFE: Each anime boy brings his own attitude, his own quirks, his own reason for breaking into your game.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Your choices decide who stays online and who logs off for good.

● A HIDDEN MOMENT AT QUESTION 150: Something's buried in the code. Most players never find it.


The bug error 404 says he doesn't exist.
Fix the glitch and find out for yourself!
70010000129248.intro:
He shouldn't be there. The error screen says so.
Track him down and see for yourself.
70010000129248.name: Bug Error 404: Anime Boys Not Found

70010000129256.description:
Nobody warns you what the job posting doesn't say.

The website shows open floor plans and smiling teams. It doesn't show what happens once the elevator doors close, or what she really means when she asks you to stay late.

In My Sexy Boss: Office Romance Girls, you step into an adult narrative about ambition, hierarchy, and the attraction that grows in the space between professional and personal.

Every email, every performance review, every minute alone in a hallway builds toward something. What you say in a meeting matters less than how you say it when no one else is listening.

She built her career on never showing her hand. Getting closer means learning to read what she doesn't say out loud, and knowing exactly when curiosity turns into risk.

One answer might earn her trust before the quarter ends. Another might get you reassigned to a different floor entirely, and out of her sight for good.

Boardrooms after hours. Coffee runs that turn into something else. An office that looks the same to everyone else, but not to you anymore.

The higher you climb, the more you have to lose.
This is a visual novel about power, patience, and whether ambition and attraction can share the same office.


FEATURES:

● A WORKPLACE ROMANCE WITH REAL STAKES: An adult narrative about ambition, hierarchy, and the pull between duty and desire.

● CHOICES THAT SHAPE YOUR CAREER AND YOUR HEART: Every conversation moves you closer or costs you standing.

● MULTIPLE PATHS, MULTIPLE OUTCOMES: Not every route leads to the corner office, or to romance.

● BOSSES WORTH WATCHING CLOSELY: Each woman guards something behind the professional facade.

● AN OFFICE THAT NEVER FEELS ROUTINE: Boardrooms, late nights, and quiet corners hold more than deadlines.

● STUNNING ANIME ART: Expressive character designs that bring every look and every silence to life.


Clock out. Stay anyway to see what happens.
Are you ready?
70010000129256.intro:
Every promotion has a price.
She's about to show you hers.
70010000129256.name: My Sexy Boss: Office Romance Girls

70010000129287.description:
Welcome to Parcel Inspection Simulator, where every package tells a story — and every detail matters. Step into the role of an inspector responsible for keeping the flow of parcels moving smoothly.

From small envelopes to large shipments, dozens of packages pass through your hands each day. Check documents, inspect deliveries, and make sure everything reaches the right destination. Stay sharp, work efficiently, and turn a small inspection point into a thriving logistics operation.

Key Features:
• Receive and Sort Parcels – Manage the full parcel workflow: accept shipments, sort them correctly, and prepare them for the next stage of processing.
• Inspect Documents Carefully – Verify sender and recipient information, identify incorrect data, and prevent costly mistakes.
• Multiple Inspection Methods – Use different tools and checking methods to ensure every parcel meets the correct requirements.
• Upgrade Your Workspace – Expand your inspection area, upgrade equipment, and improve your parcel processing system.
• Increasing Workload – Handle more packages and more complex tasks as operations grow busier and more demanding.
• Build an Efficient Operation – Start with a small inspection point and develop it into a well-organized parcel management system.

Accuracy, organization, and quick thinking are the keys to success in Parcel Inspection Simulator. Inspect, sort, and manage the flow of deliveries while building a fast and efficient inspection operation.
70010000129287.intro: Inspect every parcel and keep the deliveries moving.
70010000129287.name: PARCEL INSPECTION SIMULATOR

70010000129305.description:
A hooded figure meets you at the gate and welcomes you home.

The compound sits deep in the woods, lit by candlelight and old promises, and every woman inside has given herself to something bigger than fear.

Each one is built around a different kind of devotion, twisted just enough to be dangerous. Some will love you. Some will test you. All of them are watching to see if you belong.

Every conversation is a choice you can't take back. Comfort the wrong one and you lose ground. Push too hard and a door closes for good. A private chat line keeps their voices in your pocket between visits, so the pressure never really stops.

The High Priestess speaks softly and controls the room without raising her voice. The Fanatic would burn the whole compound down to prove her loyalty to you. The Skeptic doesn't trust outsiders, least of all one the others already adore.

And the Chosen One has thirty nights left before the ritual takes what's hers, and she's decided you're the one thing worth breaking the rules for.

Moonlit courtyards, a shrine no one is supposed to enter alone, a ceremony room that only opens once. This compound was built to keep secrets, and it's starting to let you in.

Thirty nights. A circle of women who could love you, or ruin you completely. The ritual doesn't wait for anyone.


FEATURES:

● A CIRCLE OF UNFORGETTABLE WOMEN: Every member of the cult is built around her own twisted devotion, no two the same.

● DIALOGUE CHOICES THAT MATTER: Say the wrong thing and a door closes forever. Say the right thing and she opens up completely.

● A DEVOTION SYSTEM THAT DEEPENS EVERYTHING: Grow closer through dates, private moments, and secrets no one else gets to hear.

● EXCLUSIVE GALLERY IMAGES: Every bond unlocked reveals a piece of her story, and a piece of yours.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Not every path leads to romance. Some lead somewhere much darker.

● 30 NIGHTS BEFORE THE RITUAL: The countdown is real. Every night you waste is a night one of them stops waiting for you.


The gate only opens once.
Will you belong to them, or become their next warning?
70010000129305.intro:
They already picked their favorite.
Thirty nights to escape, or fall completely in love with your captors.
70010000129305.name: Cult Seduction: Girls Horror Romance

70010000129323.description:
Somewhere off the map, the villains operate. Crime bosses, con artists, masterminds, rebels, hackers, every kind of dangerous woman you can imagine, each one has carved out her own version of power, and none of them are looking for a hero.

Each one is a different kind of dangerous. Cold-blooded strategists, manipulative charmers, chaos-loving wildcards, silent operators with soft spots they'll never admit to.

• There's the boss who rules through fear but melts under real attention.
• The trickster who tests you just to see if you'll flinch.
• The enforcer who respects strength more than sweetness.

Each one wants something different, and figuring out what could be the difference between winning her over and losing her for good.


Features:

♥ A ROSTER FULL OF UNFORGETTABLE VILLAINS: Every character brings her own brand of danger, and no two are alike.

♥ DIALOGUE CHOICES THAT MATTER: What you say decides who opens up to you and who shuts you out for good.

♥ CHARACTER AFFINITY SYSTEM: Build trust with each villain to unlock dates and intimate moments only she'll share with you.

♥ EXCLUSIVE GALLERY IMAGES: Every bond deepened means a new illustration unlocked, some hidden until you've truly earned them.

♥ MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Not every villain falls for you. Some routes end in romance, others end somewhere far more dangerous.

♥ 30 DAYS TO WIN THEIR DARK HEARTS: The clock is running. Waste a day and a path could close forever.


You've got thirty days to prove you're not afraid of the dark.
Are you villain enough for them?
70010000129323.intro:
Bad girls don't wait to be rescued.
Earn their trust, break their walls, and see how dark romance can get.
70010000129323.name: Villain Girls: Date the Dark Side

70010000129329.description:

70010000129329.intro:
Bad boys don't play by the rules.
Break down their walls and find out what's underneath the dark side.
70010000129329.name: Villain Boys: Date the Dark Side

70010000129346.description:
Step into the gritty world of Cut Corner Renovations USSR, where every crumbling wall and leaking pipe tests your creativity.

Take on the role of a handyman working with scarce resources as you repair old Soviet-era apartments and houses using whatever tools and materials you can find. Patch cracked walls, fix broken wiring, replace damaged floors, and restore rundown rooms while improvising solutions on a tight budget. In a world where nothing is ever straightforward, each repair demands clever thinking, patience, and resourcefulness. Can you keep these aging homes standing despite the odds?

Key Features:
• Repair Soviet-era houses and apartments using limited tools and scarce materials.
• Scavenge for usable parts and improvise creative solutions when resources fall short.
• Navigate unpredictable and quirky repair scenarios inspired by real USSR-era challenges.
• Manage your time and prioritize tasks to keep homes functional and safe.
• Experience a blend of humor, strategy, and realistic handyman work.
• Adapt, overcome obstacles, and prove you’re the ultimate low-budget home repair specialist.

Every cracked wall is a new test of your ingenuity.
70010000129346.intro: Repair, improvise, and make the most of what you find.
70010000129346.name: Cut Corner Renovations USSR

70010000129356.description:
FROM ONE FIREBALL TO UNSTOPPABLE POWER
Aim your shot, release the flame, and blast through anything that stands in your path! In The Legend Of Fireball, you begin as a young fireball fighter training in an ordinary room, breaking simple objects to build your strength. Home appliances, computers, motorcycles, cars, massive buildings - every target brings you closer to true fireball mastery.

BURN THROUGH BIGGER AND TOUGHER TARGETS
Grow stronger, upgrade your stats, and take on bigger, tougher, and crazier targets. Boost your Fireball Power, Stamina, Stamina Recovery, and more to turn every shot into pure destruction. When you are ready, enter special challenges with a target and a time limit. Destroy the required number of objects before the countdown ends to earn rewards and unlock the next stage!

MORE POWER WITH EVERY UPGRADE
Gather powerful fireballs, stylish costumes, ancient relics, and loyal pets. Upgrade fireballs to increase your Fireball Power, Gold Acquisition, and Exp Acquisition. Strengthen costumes to improve your Stamina and Recovery. Refine relics for mighty stat bonuses that make every blast even more devastating.

COMMAND YOUR PET COMPANIONS
Create a team of Light and Dark Family pets with active and passive skills. Bring up to 3 pets into action and let them attack alongside you while boosting your power. Their skills add another layer of strength to every stage, turning your fireball training into a true team effort.

FEATURES:
• Fireball Action - Aim, charge, and launch explosive fireball attacks!
• Destruction Progression - Start with simple targets, then work your way up to vehicles and massive buildings
• Deep Upgrades - Upgrade your character, fireballs, costumes, relics, and pets to keep growing stronger
• Stylish Costumes - Wear costumes to boost your Stamina and Stamina Recovery
• Powerful Relics - Collect relics to gain stat boosts for Fireball Power, Stamina, Gold, Exp, and others
• Pet Companions - Build a team of Light and Dark Family pets with active and passive skills
• Timed Challenges - Destroy the required number of targets before the countdown ends to unlock the next stage
• Daily Missions and Achievements - Complete tasks and claim extra rewards
• Special Events - Break the Gold Safe for coins and enter the World Championship to win gems
• Addictive Progression - Keep upgrading, unlocking, and destroying bigger targets

End as the legend who can destroy anything!
70010000129356.intro: Unleash your fireball power and destroy your way to legendary mastery!
70010000129356.name: The Legend Of Fireball

70010000129364.description:
Letter Snap: Term Challenge is a fun, engaging, and fast-paced word game designed for puzzle lovers of all ages. Challenge yourself with thousands of jumbled letter combinations to sharpen your vocabulary and quick thinking.

Play across various themed categories to test your knowledge at your own pace, or push your limits in Endless Mode—where you race against a ticking clock, build massive high-score streaks, and see how long you can keep your momentum alive!

Whether you want to expand your word bank, improve your problem-solving skills, or just enjoy a relaxing mental workout, it offers the perfect balance of brain training and satisfying arcade fun.

Get ready to snap cards into place, beat the clock, and unlock your ultimate word-solving potential!
70010000129364.intro: Letter Snap: Term Challenge – A fast, vibrant word challenge to test your speed!
70010000129364.name: Letter Snap: Term Challenge

70010000129391.description:
Collect the puzzle pieces of adorable Steam Girls and complete the puzzles!

Total of 15 stages
The difficulty increases as you clear stages!

Stages 1–10: 30 pieces
Stages 11–15: 50 pieces
The final stage is a challenging level with no background watermark to guide you!
Carefully examine each piece and lead the puzzle to completion!
When you complete a puzzle, high-quality images of the Steam Girls will be added to the gallery♪
=====================
AGE supports content creators and streamers who wish to showcase our games.
You do not need to obtain permission to create gameplay videos or stream this game.
70010000129391.intro: A puzzle game featuring many Steam Girls is here!
70010000129391.name: Steam Girls

70010000129416.description:
As a sushi chef apprentice, you'll make sushi, train it , and compete in races. Win races, use the prize money to make even faster sushi and train harder, aiming for victory in the ultimate “S1” Cup!

No matter how painstakingly crafted the sushi may be, once eaten, it's an instant defeat. It heads straight for the customer's stomach and never comes back.

Each sushi topping has different performance characteristics. How well you've mastered making that particular topping also affects its performance. Use training to perfect your ideal sushi. However, since sushi is a perishable item, its performance degrades after each race.

During the race, all you can do is “cheer on” the sushi to boost it. You can escape chopsticks by using boost, but the sushi race isn't that easy—you won't win just by doing that. Sometimes you'll need to take risks and use boost to overtake rivals.

Some sushi toppings possess unique skills. For example, Flounder can dive to dodge chopsticks in an emergency without using boost, while Sea Urchin can use its spines to knock rivals away. There are over 40 different skills, some of which can be learned through training.
70010000129416.intro: Adorable sushi race at full speed in a training × racing game!
70010000129416.name: Wabisabi SushiDerby

70010000129455.description:
Kingdom of Night is an 80s-inspired isometric action RPG where coming-of-age drama meets cosmic horror.

When a satanic cult unleashes the ancient evil Baphomet on the small town of Miami, Arizona, high school student John must fight through a night of demonic chaos to rescue his friends before the town is lost forever.

Choose from five distinct classes—Barbarian, Knight, Rogue, Necromancer, or Sorcerer—and customize your build with expansive skill trees, powerful loot, and unique equipment. Explore the town freely, battle terrifying Demon Generals in any order, uncover the stories of Miami's residents, and descend into massive demon lairs.

Face the apocalypse alone or team up with a friend in local co-op to save Miami before the night ends.

- Explore a handcrafted 1980s Arizona town consumed by demonic invasion.
- Experience a blend of coming-of-age drama, cosmic horror, and dark fantasy.
- Choose from five unique character classes with deep skill customization.
- Collect powerful weapons, armor, and rare loot to create your ideal build.
