- Challenge the Demon Generals in the order you choose.
- Play solo or in two-player local co-op.
70010000129455.intro: Friday night just became the end of the world.
70010000129455.name: Kingdom of Night

70010000129512.description:
Collect puzzles with photorealistic images of girls in spectacular outfits, enjoy convenient touch controls and feel the process at your fingertips.

Relaxing music creates the right mood, and gradually increasing difficulty turns each level into an exciting challenge. After assembly, you can carefully examine each image and appreciate all the details.

Features:

• Photorealistic images.

• Realistic assembly process.

• Gradually increasing difficulty.

• Relaxing music.

• Detailed image viewing.
70010000129512.name: Hentai Project 67

70010000129558.description:
Players can choose from a cast of quirky and adorable characters to race through item-filled, obstacle-packed courses. Local multiplayer supports up to 4 players, while online multiplayer supports up to 8 players, ensuring fun and frantic competition.

■ Story: The story unfolds differently depending on the character you choose. Defeat all opponents across 10 stages to clear the game.
※ Even if you lose, don’t be discouraged—you can always try again.

■ Battle Run: Enjoy competitive races with 2 to 4 players by splitting the screen into 1 or 4 sections. The player who reaches the finish line first wins.

■ Time Attack: A single-player mode where the goal is to reach the finish line as quickly as possible. Challenge your limits by breaking your own records. You can also race against a ghost of your previous record to motivate yourself to improve.

■ Engacho (Chasing game): The character with the "poop" on their head becomes the chaser. You win by chasing down and touching other players. Supports 1 to 4 players.

■ Online Battle: Up to 8 players can enjoy either “Battle Run” or “Pofun Battle” together. Each game room can hold up to 8 players, and stages are chosen at random.

■ Rhythm Game: Hit the corresponding inputs for each colored Pofun as they align with the judgment line. Depending on your accuracy, the text, effects, and character reactions will change. Combos and accuracy are displayed on the screen, and Fever Mode triggers special effects. Enjoy the rhythm game with colorful and exciting music!

■ High Scoreboard: A mode where you can check players’ top scores in ranking order.

■ Game Settings: Choose the language and screen mode, adjust sound volume and control style. You can also enable shadow silhouettes when objects obscure characters, or turn on vibration feedback.
70010000129558.intro: Hashire HEBEREKE: EX is a modern remake of the 1994  Hashire HEBEREKE by SUNSOFT.
70010000129558.name: Hashire HEBEREKE: EX

70010000129571.description:
SAEKO: Giantess Dating Sim is an adventure game set in 2000s Japan about the lives of Saeko, a girl with mysterious abilities, and the little people she has shrunk to the size of her thumb. Experience Saeko's and the little people's fates in the day and at night, through two separate game systems with different art styles.

You are Rin, the latest addition to the little people. Under Saeko’s protection, you spend your days in her desk drawer together with the other little people.
But don't let your guard down. Saeko has some...interesting hobbies, to say the least.

・Stunning and unique visuals drawn in two different styles of pixel art
・A world filled with brutal allure inspired by many strange tales, beginning with Fueti Shizue’s work
・An original game system which forces players to make difficult choices and live with the consequences
・A soundtrack heavily influenced by future garage and breakcore, composed by the developer himself
・The deepest journey into a developer’s proclivities in indie game history
70010000129571.intro: You opened your eyes to find a giant girl looking down at you...
70010000129571.name: SAEKO: Giantess Dating Sim

70010000129595.description:
Only a brave badger can stop the beast, but to win, he must be the first to collect the red power stones.

If the monster collects his blue power stones faster than the badger collects the red ones, the battle will be lost, and no one will be left to protect the forest!

Help the badger collect red power stones, keep the beast from obtaining the blue power stones, and save the forest!
70010000129595.intro: An evil monster has taken over the kind and cheerful forest and locked all the animals in cages, with plans to eat them all!
70010000129595.name: Clear It You Can

70010000129625.description:
Take control of an ambulance and race through dangerous highways filled with cars, trucks, buses, and obstacles. Use nitro boosts, react quickly, and survive intense traffic as you drive across desert, forest, and snowy roads.
Every run is a test of speed, timing, and reflexes. Avoid crashes, keep moving, and reach the emergency before it is too late.

Emergency Rush is a fast, simple, and exciting ambulance driving game for players who love highway action, racing, and quick reflex challenges.
70010000129625.intro: Drive fast, dodge traffic, and save lives in Emergency Rush!
70010000129625.name: Emergency Rush

70010000129661.description:
Pit Panic is a challenging rogue-like 2D platformer with fast pace, unique gameplay and environmental puzzles.

Take on the role of a curious archeologist and race through handcrafted levels, take down ancient bosses and jump up like your pants are on fire.

GET HOOKED!
Wield the mysterious hook – a powerful omnitool – that digs through blocks, swings you around and unlocks hidden treasures. Master physics-driven movement to avoid deadly traps and blast through interactive blocks. Turn sand into glass, jelly into fire and bridges into weapons, if necessary.

THINK FAST, RUN FASTER
You will have to dig deep to return to the surface. There are many ways to die, but only one way to survive: up. Get in the flow, make split-second decisions and even sacrifice your health for power-ups to escape the crumbling Aztec temple.

EVERY RUN IS DIFFERENT
Discover four distinct biomes, each with unique puzzles, enemies and art styles. Over 1,000 unique handcrafted levels mix things up every time you play. Or build your own levels to put fellow adventurers to the ultimate test.

CHALLENGE OTHER PLAYERS
The real fun starts after you climb out of the pit. Compare your skills with other players, beat their best times and complete unique daily challenges to receive precious rewards.



A Nintendo Switch™ 2 version of this product is also available.
Additional content is not compatible between versions.
Please be careful to avoid duplicate or incorrect purchases.

In addition, this product does not offer a Nintendo Switch 2 Edition or a Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade Pass.
70010000129661.intro: Escape the sinking Aztec temple in this cartoonish rogue-like arcade platformer.
70010000129661.name: Pit Panic

70010000129682.description:
Your grand adventure begins in your own backyard with just a shovel and a dream. In this simple yet addictive simulator, your mission is simple: Dig as deep as you can! Carve out your own vertical tunnel, navigate the underground world, and unearth the valuable stones and colorful gems buried deep beneath your feet.

But digging is exhausting work, and your backpack has limited capacity. Once your pockets are full or your energy is low, it's time to head back to the surface. Take your hard-earned cash to the garage to upgrade your equipment. Increase your shovel’s digging power, expand your backpack's capacity, and boost your maximum stamina so you can dig for longer periods of time. Best of all, buy and upgrade a reliable jetpack so you can easily fly right back up from the deepest, darkest holes!
70010000129682.name: Digging Simulator

70010000129690.description:
"ARKANOID REVENGE OF DOH" is a brick breaker released by TAITO in 1987.
The sequel to ARKANOID is back and more powered up than ever! While retaining the core gameplay of bouncing the Energy Ball to shatter Space Walls, it introduces brand-new systems, including branching paths into L and R versions, and an increased variety of items.
Only you can stop the dimension-controlling force DOH, which has crossed dimensions to invade our universe!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.
70010000129690.name: Arcade Archives ARKANOID REVENGE OF DOH

70010000129700.description:
Olive’s situation is dire. They're on the verge of being thrown out of college unless they can salvage their GPA, and their only chance rests on classes they know next to nothing about.

Their lifeline: two club leaders who are more than willing to help them succeed. However, no solution is that easy. Olive soon finds themself in the middle of a conflict between these two friends that threatens to undo their long-standing love for each other.

Twofold is a story about love, family, and connection. It celebrates family of all kinds, and explores the strength (and fragility) of bonds between people.

Taking place roughly a year after Twofold: First Snow, Olive’s position as an outsider to these established friend circles will be vital to fully understanding the situation threatening to undo this close-knit group.
70010000129700.intro: In a bid to avoid failing out of college, Olive Penn inadvertently finds themselves caught in the middle of a feud between two campus club leaders.
70010000129700.name: Twofold

70010000129712.description:
Create the ultimate beachfront destination!

A game all about building a beautiful boardwalk.  Start with small stands and grow into a sprawling seaside paradise full of rides, high-end shops and fancy restaurants.


Build your Boardwalk
Dozens of shops to choose from

Build rides, restaurants, and stores, selling everything from sunglasses to vintage video games to sea glass art

Boost your visit rate by building the rides and restaurants people want


Manage your Promenade
Earn rewards as customers visit your shops

Upgrade each shop to bring in more revenue and serve customers faster

Expand your boardwalk and hire entertainers

Launch marketing campaigns to spread the word about your seaside destination


Combine Shops and Rides
Not enough space to serve your customers?  Combine shops to create bigger, better ones that can handle more customers at a time and earn you more money

Dozens of combination recipes to discover - movie theaters, bumper cars and more!


Other Features:
Navigate demand-changing weather events such as smog and rain

Donate to neighboring businesses – and earn rewards in return!

Participate in themed festivals to up your income and draw in big crowds

Invite VIPs and convince them to build their top-tier attractions on your boardwalk
70010000129712.intro: Design and expand your boardwalk by building rides, shops, and restaurants to draw in crowds.
70010000129712.name: Boardwalk Builders

70010000129759.description:
Aggelos 2 is an explosive action-platformer where lightning-fast combat, precision platforming, and two opposing worlds collide. As an Aggelos, the highest order of angels, you are chosen by Balro to venture through the Kingdom of Lumen, domain of the supreme God of Light. But with Lumen under siege and the Gods facing imminent defeat at the hands of the Army of Darkness, you are forced to embrace a shadowy new form to survive the chaos of both light and dark realms.

While your angelic side favors a slower, disciplined approach, your demon form is highly agile, aggressive, and bristling with dark powers. Mastering the shift between both forms is key to survival, and only by balancing order and chaos can you hope to overcome formidable enemies, deadly obstacles, and challenging puzzles along your path.

- Parallel realms: Explore two massive, overlapping maps, each with their own unique characteristics, enemies to fight, secrets to discover, and challenges to overcome.
- Dual Combat System: Switch between Angel and Demon forms to change the world and your playstyle, from precise defenses to fast assaults, mastering timing, strategy, and reflexes.
- Emerge victorious: Take on hordes of enemies and conquer 13 massive bosses across both realms. Steel yourself for memorable encounters that build on the original game’s signature battles.
- Puzzles of Discovery: Solve challenges by mastering skills, memorising routes, manipulating mechanisms, avoiding traps, and interacting with the world to reveal secrets and new paths.
- Grow your power: Collect orbs to unlock devastating special attacks, boost your strength and increase your survivability, adding a tactical layer to your progression.
- Evolve to survive: Unlock new skills as you progress, from flight and wall grabs to dashes and powerful special attacks, offering up new ways to explore and reach previously inaccessible areas.
- Stunning 16-bit Artwork: Striking pixel art and detailed sprites designed to complement smooth, fast-paced 2D gameplay.
70010000129759.intro: Two forms. Two realms. One epic adventure awaits.
70010000129759.name: Aggelos 2

70010000129815.description:
Roll into a world full of rhythm and light! Manage a fast ball in levels, each with a unique style and music. Dodge obstacles, stay on the beat, and test your reflexes. It is easy to play, but can you master the speed? Unlike easy rhythm games, show off your skills in Rhythm Roll.

Step into a high-speed fusion of sound and colour. This is a musical journey where your reflexes are the conductor. Control a racing ball through breathtaking landscapes where every pulse of the environment is synced to the track.

Every Level is a New World
Forget repetitive backgrounds. Every stage is a handcrafted masterpiece with its own soul.
- Neon 80s: Race through glowing grids and retro futurism.
- Cyberpunk Future: Navigate gritty high-tech corridors.
- Minimalist Zen: Find your flow in clean geometric spaces.

A Symphony of Genres
Your ears will never get bored. Each level features a unique musical identity including Synthwave, Electro, Drum and Bass, and Lo-fi.

Key Features
- Fast-Paced Gameplay: Intuitive controls that are easy to learn but hard to master.
- Stunning Diversity: From colour palettes to architecture, no two levels look or feel the same.
- Rhythm-Driven Challenges: The music is your map. Use the beat to predict what is coming next.
- Pure Skill: No gimmicks or power ups. It is just you, the ball, and your ability to stay on beat.

The speed is rising. The beat is dropping. Can you keep up in Rhythm Roll?
70010000129815.intro: Roll into a universe of rhythm and light! Feel the beat, master the high-speed motion, and test your reflexes.
70010000129815.name: Rhythm Roll

70010000129821.description:
Become the last line of defense.

In Counter Protocol: Origins, you are an elite SWAT operative deployed to a city overwhelmed by armed gangs, violent criminals, and fear. Take on dangerous missions, neutralize hostile forces, clear criminal strongholds, and fight toward one critical objective: rescuing innocent hostages.

Every operation throws you into intense tactical shooter action. Search criminal hideouts, breach enemy-controlled buildings, survive fierce firefights, and restore order to streets consumed by chaos.

Choose from a variety of weapons to match your combat style and complete dangerous missions across diverse locations. Enemies can be waiting anywhere. Assess the situation quickly, react under pressure, and never let your guard down.

Can you carry out the protocol to the very end?

Key Features:
- Intense tactical shooter action as an elite SWAT operative
- High-risk missions against armed criminals and gang members
- Tense operations across a variety of locations
- Break through criminal strongholds and rescue hostages
- A varied arsenal of firearms for different combat situations
- Fast decisions and precise reactions in every firefight

Complete the mission. Rescue the hostages. Follow the Counter Protocol.
70010000129821.intro: Become an elite SWAT operative, reclaim the city, and rescue the hostages.
70010000129821.name: Counter Protocol: Origins

70010000129829.description:
Welcome to Little Number Daycare, a colorful early learning game made especially for babies, toddlers and preschool children.

In this lovingly designed educational game, young children can discover the numbers from 1 to 10 through playful mini games that are simple, cheerful and easy to understand. Children can learn numbers, practice counting and hear spoken numbers in 14 selectable languages. They can listen, recognize the numbers on screen and say them out loud while playing.

All learning games can be played in different difficulty levels, making the experience suitable for very young children, toddlers and preschoolers. As your child grows and becomes more confident, the game can grow with them, offering new challenges and keeping the learning experience fun, gentle and motivating for a longer time.

Pop the correct balloons in a funny balloon popping game, solve a farm conveyor-belt peg puzzle, roll the dice, find matching number cards, count cute animals and objects, and enjoy classic memory card games with charming motifs.

In the special number memory game, children can play against a funny animal opponent. The opponent’s skill automatically adapts to the child’s performance, keeping every match fair, friendly and fun.

There is also a playful side-scrolling truck game! Children drive a transport truck, collect numbered crates and jump over objects on the road. This turns number learning into a small action adventure that is easy to play and exciting for young children.

The different activities help children practice number recognition, counting, memory, first math, concentration, hand-eye coordination and early logical thinking. Because every mini game teaches numbers in a different way, kids can repeat and strengthen what they learn without it feeling like homework.

Perfect for babies, toddlers, preschoolers and kindergarten children who want to learn numbers and different languages in a playful way on Nintendo Switch™.

Features:
Learn the numbers from 1 to 10
Spoken number learning in 14 selectable languages
Different difficulty levels for long-lasting learning fun
Grows with your child from baby and toddler age to preschool
Fun balloon popping game
First counting and math activities
Farm conveyor-belt peg puzzle
Dice game, counting game and number memory
Classic memory card game with cute motifs
Adaptive animal opponent for friendly memory matches
Side-scrolling truck game with numbered crates
Playful practice for babies, toddlers, preschool and kindergarten children
Colorful, cheerful and child-friendly design

Thanks to the touchscreen controls of Nintendo Switch™, the game is simple, direct, and child-friendly.
70010000129829.intro: Learn numbers 1-10, counting game, toddler game, preschool math, baby learning, 14 languages, balloon pop, farm puzzle, memory, truck game, educational game
70010000129829.name: Little Number Daycare - Learn, Count, Say, Play for Toddlers

70010000129847.description:
Buckle up and get ready for the most realistic and breathtaking flight experience of your life!
Universal Flight Simulator 3 PvP lets you take the controls of legendary vintage aircraft, cutting-edge jets, and powerful modern helicopters — each with its own unique feel and challenge.

Explore 12 stunning locations across the world, from sun-drenched coastlines to stormy mountain ranges, each meticulously crafted to push your piloting skills to the limit. Master 5 incredible fixed-wing aircraft and 2 agile helicopters, each faithfully recreated with authentic aerodynamics and handling.

But this time, you're not flying alone. Challenge a friend in local 2-player PvP multiplayer — race head-to-head on circuits, dominate free-flight challenges, and settle once and for all who the ultimate pilot really is. Set the best lap times, unlock new missions, and leave your rival in your wake.

Key Features
-Optimized aerodynamic and hydrodynamic simulation
-Physics-based engine simulation with realistic propeller and transmission systems
-Custom wheels and suspension for ground handling
-Fully interactive 2D/3D gauges and control panels
-Immersive virtual cockpit system
-12 unique locations to discover and master
-5 planes and 2 helicopters, each with distinct flight characteristics
-Free flight and circuit racing modes
-Local 2-player PvP — face off against a friend on the same screen
70010000129847.intro: The sky is no longer the limit — it's the battlefield.
70010000129847.name: Universal Flight Simulator 3 PvP

70010000129856.description:
The Mysterious Library is a visual novel.
Read your way through a variety of books, including eerie tales, heartwarming stories, and strange yet humorous adventures.
You can change the background music, featuring pieces such as Nocturne, Gnossienne, and Gymnopedie.
Try to read every book and complete the entire collection.
70010000129856.intro: A visual novel containing over 50 short stories!
70010000129856.name: The Mysterious Library

70010000129911.description:
Set within a dark, atmospheric environment filled with abandoned spaces and distorted realities, the game challenges you to explore, survive, and uncover the truth behind a creeping, unknown presence.

Every location in Dead Echo is crafted to build tension through environmental storytelling, subtle audio cues, and a constant feeling of being watched. There are no clear answers or safe paths—only fragments of information scattered across eerie corridors, broken structures, and shifting spaces that seem to change when you’re not looking. The deeper you explore, the more unstable reality becomes.

Survival depends on awareness, patience, and careful decision-making. Resources are scarce, visibility is limited, and danger often reveals itself too late. The game emphasizes psychological tension over direct confrontation, forcing players to rely on their instincts as much as their tools. Every sound could be a warning, and every shadow may hide something watching you back.

As you progress, Dead Echo begins to blur the line between perception and reality. Environments subtly shift, familiar areas become unfamiliar, and the presence within the world grows more aggressive and unpredictable. What starts as exploration quickly evolves into a psychological struggle to maintain control and understanding.

Designed for fans of atmospheric horror and immersive survival gameplay, Dead Echo delivers a slow-building, tension-heavy experience focused on fear, mystery, and the unknown. It is not just about surviving what lurks in the dark—but surviving what the dark does to you.
70010000129911.intro: Explore eerie, atmospheric environments, uncover hidden secrets, and survive against an unseen presence lurking in the dark.
70010000129911.name: Dead Echo

70010000129931.description:
Top-down tactical tower defense where you don't just place your troops, you actively manage their position!

The kingdom has fallen under the onslaught of dark forces, and its defenders have been bound by magic. They can't move, but they can still fight! The only one who has escaped this curse is the main character. Now only he can change the army's position, moving swordsmen, archers and other fighters to fight off waves of enemies.

Use strategy, adapt to new threats, buy resources and upgrade your army to become the kingdom's last hope!
70010000129931.intro:
Survive the horde
Upgrade your characters
Complete Levels
70010000129931.name: Reposition Defense

70010000129947.description:
Dig your way through a world of underground puzzles in this fun and addictive adventure.

Use your shovel to carve paths through dirt and sand, guiding streams of balls toward hungry underground creatures. Each stage challenges you to think ahead, plan your routes carefully, and make the most of every ball as you work your way deeper underground.

Across 50 handcrafted levels spread over 5 unique worlds, you'll encounter a variety of enemies including carnivorous plants, dragons, giant worms, salamanders, and bats. Every stage contains three smaller enemies that must be defeated to earn stars. Feed them enough balls and they'll release a star. Collect all three stars, then take on the larger boss waiting at the bottom of the level to complete the stage.

But digging a simple path won't be enough. As you progress, new obstacles and mechanics are introduced that transform each level into a clever puzzle. Navigate around lava pits, dodge deadly lasers, avoid spinning blockers, slip past rotating laser traps, time your movements around pulsing laser beams, and work around immovable rocks. Discover special gates that multiply your balls and use them strategically to ensure you have enough resources to defeat every enemy and boss.

The early stages are easy to learn, but the challenge steadily grows as new obstacles combine in increasingly complex ways. Success requires careful planning, smart path creation, and creative problem solving.

Can you dig the perfect path and defeat every underground threat?
70010000129947.name: Feed Them

70010000130008.description:
The familiar faces of the series clash in a brand-new puzzle battle. Easy to pick up, deep to master — a truly competitive puzzle game, Dark Witch Match!

■ Deep, Competitive Match-3 Battles
Match three or more blocks to clear them, chain combos, and pile the pressure onto your opponent. Simple rules hide a world of mind games and strategy.

■ Online & Local Versus
Test your skills against players worldwide online, or go head-to-head with friends in local matches.

■ Score Attack & Global Leaderboards
Chase high scores and climb the ranks. The more you play, the hotter the climb to the top.

■ Story Mode (8 Stages)
Take on a cast of quirky rivals across 8 stages, with light, comedic banter along the way.

■ A Beloved Cast Returns
Zizou, Klinsy, Al, Sola and more — series favorites all in one place.
70010000130008.intro: A Match-3 Showdown from The Legend of Dark Witch!
70010000130008.name: Dark Witch Match!

70010000130014.description:
A noir story of a tiny bird fighting to bring color back to a dying world.

Caught in the endless war between Humans and Aliens, you are a small bird struggling to survive in the ruined, radioactive lands of Grayland. What was once a peaceful home has become a scorched, lifeless battlefield.

Fly through breathtaking hand-painted environments, dodge enemy drones, cleanse toxic hotspots, and confront colossal bosses on your journey to save your loved ones. Discover the haunting mystery behind the fall of this world—and fight to restore hope where none remains.

Key Features
• 16 handcrafted, challenging levels
• Atmospheric noir visuals and a deeply emotional story
• Varied and intense boss encounters
• A beautiful, immersive soundtrack
• Rebalanced difficulty for smoother, more rewarding progression

Even the smallest being can change the fate of a world.
Be the one who brings life back to Grayland.
70010000130014.intro: Fight to bring color back to a dying world.
70010000130014.name: Grayland Remastered

70010000130031.description:
Build your own grocery store, stock the shelves, set competitive prices, and keep your customers happy.

Manage daily operations, serve shoppers, upgrade your store, and turn a small local shop into a successful supermarket.

In Supermarket Simulator - Grocery Store, every decision shapes your business. Customize your layout, organize products, manage inventory, hire staff, and improve your store as you grow. Start with basic equipment and limited resources, then expand your supermarket and create a thriving retail business.

Key Features:

● Manage every aspect of your own supermarket
● Customize your store layout and organize products efficiently
● Order stock, manage inventory, and set competitive prices
● Operate the checkout with scanning and customer payments
● Expand and upgrade your store as your business grows
● Hire staff and automate daily tasks
● Build your business through smart decisions and efficient management

Take control of your store, keep your customers coming back, and turn your small grocery shop into a successful supermarket. Make smart investments, improve your operations, and watch your business grow from a simple local store into a thriving retail destination.
70010000130031.intro: Build your store, serve your customers, and grow your business.
70010000130031.name: Supermarket Simulator - Grocery Store
70010000130031.publisher: Lu Ming trading as Shane Game

70010000130057.description:
Welcome to the ultimate word puzzle experience designed for brain trainers and language lovers alike! Inspired by traditional Lingo-style word games, this title challenges you to guess hidden words under time pressure using strategic color-coded clues.

Green means the letter is correct and in the perfect spot; yellow means the letter is in the word but in the wrong position. Use your logic, unlock power-ups, and climb the scoreboard!

Key Features:

Thrilling Streak Mode: Put your skills to the ultimate test! Face an endless barrage of words back-to-back. With shifting word lengths and randomized themes, how many words can you solve in a row before breaking the chain?

Diverse Word Lengths: Play through dynamic modes featuring 4-letter, 5-letter, and 6-letter words to steadily increase the challenge.

Rich Category Map: Explore an interactive progression map. Test your vocabulary across dedicated categories including General Knowledge, Science, Art, Verbal, Literature, Architecture, and Psychology.

Powerful Boosters: Stuck on a tough word? Use your hard-earned coins to activate powerful power-ups like the Bomb (to eliminate wrong letters) or Time Extenders to keep the clock ticking.

Engaging Progression: Earn score multipliers, collect thousands of coins, and clear stages with a perfect 3-star rating to prove your word mastery.

Full Nintendo Switch™ Support: Play comfortably on the big screen in TV Mode, on your tabletop, or on the go with full Handheld Mode optimization.

Whether you want a quick 5-minute mental workout, a deep dive into advanced vocabulary, or a high-stakes run in Streak Mode, this game offers endless hours of educational and addictive puzzle fun. Sharpen your wits, expand your vocabulary, and become the ultimate word champion today!
70010000130057.intro: An addictive Lingo-style word puzzle! Play through the map or start a streak!
70010000130057.name: Lingix Lingo

70010000130117.description:
Race against the clock as you rewind tapes, restock shelves, manage impatient customers, and keep the Friday night rush from turning into a complete disaster. Every second counts when there's only one rewinding machine and a store full of people demanding their movies now.

Can you survive three increasingly hectic shifts and become the ultimate VHS clerk, or will your customers leave before the credits roll?

Be Kind, Rewind. The fate of movie night is in your hands.
70010000130117.intro: The fate of movie night is in your hands.
70010000130117.name: Be Kind Rewind

70010000130134.description:
Jump into a fast-paced, endlessly replayable action platformer where precision movement and quick thinking are the keys to survival. In Numerous Ninjas, you guide a growing team of agile ninjas through an ever-changing series of hazard-filled chambers designed to test your reflexes and adaptability at every turn.

Run, leap, and scale walls as your ninja squad navigates dangerous environments packed with traps, shifting obstacles, and unpredictable layouts. Each run pushes you further into increasingly difficult challenges where timing and positioning matter just as much as speed. One mistake can end your attempt—but every new run offers a fresh chance to improve.

Master fluid movement mechanics as you bounce between surfaces, avoid deadly hazards, and chain together precise maneuvers to stay alive longer. The action escalates quickly, demanding focus and rewarding players who learn to read the environment and react with confidence under pressure.

Along the way, discover helpful power-ups that can turn the tide of a run, offering temporary advantages or new survival options. Strategic use of these boosts can mean the difference between an early exit and a record-breaking run.

With its focus on replayability, Numerous Ninjas encourages players to refine their skills over time, chasing higher scores and longer survival streaks. Whether you’re playing in short bursts or committing to mastering its systems, every attempt feels dynamic and unpredictable.

Simple to pick up but challenging to master, Numerous Ninjas delivers an intense arcade-style experience built around momentum, precision, and survival. How far can your ninja team go before the chambers finally defeat them?
70010000130134.intro: Guide a team of ninjas through endless chambers packed with traps, power-ups, and surprises. How long can your clan survive?
70010000130134.name: Numerous Ninjas

70010000130156.description:
"Muchi Muchi Pork!": Ride rogue machines and turn all of humanity into pigs!
"PinkSweets ~Ibara Sorekara~": Sisters charge into battle to rescue their mother imprisoned on a remote island.
Two of the most unique titles in CAVE’s legendary shoot-'em-up lineup are back.

◆ Master various versions and game modes across both titles!

【Muchi Muchi Pork!】
Rogue machines run wild on Earth! Turn humans into pigs one after another!
Blast through enemies and use the massive "Lard Attack" to rack up a mountain of score items!

＜Included Variations & Game Modes＞
Version 1.0: The original version that debuted in arcades.
Version 1.01: A balanced mode with buffed player ships for a more accessible experience.
Arrange Mode: Trigger "Fever Mode" with Lard Attacks! Fill the entire screen with score items.
MANPUKU Mode: A high-difficulty mode featuring "Revenge Fire" (suicide bullets).
HARAHARA Mode: Start the game directly from the increased difficulty of the 2nd Loop.

【PinkSweets ~Ibara Sorekara~】
Rescue Mom from a forced marriage! The five sisters launch a massive assault on the wedding venue.
Block enemy fire with your Shield, then unleash the "Rose Cracker" after charging to wipe out both enemies and bullets!

＜Included Variations & Game Modes＞
Version 1.0: The original version that debuted in arcades.
Version 1.01: A balanced mode with buffed player ships for a more accessible experience.
Arrange Mode: The new "Hadou Cannon" weapon accelerates the score attack to new heights.
HARDER Mode: A high-difficulty mode where destroyed enemies release massive amounts of Revenge Fire.
EXTENDED Mode: An ultra-hard mode with increased 1st Loop difficulty and access to the 2nd Loop.
S･ATTACK Mode: A score attack mode where you play Stage 6 with infinite lives and a strict time limit.

◆ All-New Arrangements! "Boosted" with Rich Options
Featuring a completely new Arranged BGM soundtrack. Switch between the original and arranged tracks to create your own custom setlist!
【Featured Composers】 Daisuke Matsumoto, Yosuke Yasui, Hagane, Sean Bialo.
Also supports Online Rankings and Replay Data recording, allowing you to save and share your best.
70010000130156.intro: Hardcore yet cute Danmaku shooting makes a grand comeback!
70010000130156.name: Muchi Muchi Pork! & PinkSweets Boosted

70010000130176.description:
Welcome to Parking Problem — a puzzle game about untangling jammed car parks. Slide vehicles in the right order, open up tight lanes, and guide every last car to the exit. It's quick to learn, deeply strategic, and perfect for that "one more puzzle" rhythm.

Tackle 150 handcrafted levels that gradually turn simple jams into clever brainteasers. New twists keep the grid fresh — tight corners, long vans, blocked lanes, one-way spaces, and gates to open — so planning two moves ahead really pays off. Stuck? Take a breath, rethink the order, and savor that sweet "aha!" when the lane finally clears.

Why you'll love it:
- 150 levels of clean, logic-driven parking puzzles
- Smooth slide controls and fast restarts for rapid iteration
- Smart difficulty curve: gentle warm-ups to devious jams
- Minimal, readable visuals that keep the board crystal-clear
- Play at your own pace — no timers, just pure strategy

Beat the gridlock, master the order, and enjoy the calm of a perfectly cleared lot in Parking Problem.
70010000130176.intro:
A slick, satisfying puzzler about untangling jammed car parks.
Slide vehicles in the right order and guide every car to the exit.
70010000130176.name: Parking Problem

70010000130200.description:
Welcome to Hex Park a colorful playground of brainteasers where every move matters. Rotate and align arrow tiles to guide directions, pop obstacles, and clear the board in as few moves as possible. It’s easy to pick up, delightfully tricky to master, and impossible to put down.

Tackle handcrafted levels featuring smart mechanics: keys and locks, mystery tiles, bombs, ice counters, gears, and more. Plan routes, set up neat arrow alignments, and use handy tools like the hammer, dynamite, and drill when you need a nudge. No timers, no stress—just clean, strategic puzzle-solving with that perfect “one more level” feel.

Why you’ll love it:

Keys/locks, mystery tiles, bombs, ice counters, and other clever twists

Fair tools to get unstuck—without breaking the puzzle flow

Play at your own pace with smooth, satisfying controls

Achievements and cloud saves supported

Take a stroll, stay for a challenge—Hex Park is your new daily puzzle routine.
70010000130200.intro: A relaxing puzzle adventure where simple rules lead to surprisingly deep challenges.
70010000130200.name: Hex Park

70010000130206.description:
See the hazard. Time the jump. Reach the flag - then do it faster.

Bright colors. Deadly obstacles. One tiny hero who never gives up. Colorful Boi 2 is a fast, precise arcade platformer built on one simple loop - and 74 handcrafted levels that dare you to master it.

DIE FAST. LEARN FASTER.
Death is instant - but so is the retry. Colorful Boi 2 is built for the "one more try" itch: you fail, you learn the trap, you go again - and the moment it finally clicks feels earned. Checkpoints catch you, instant restarts erase the sting, and nothing ever stands between you and the next attempt.

EVERY LEVEL IS A FRESH PUZZLE
Spikes. Spinning and static saw blades. Conveyor belts that shove you toward the edge. Every level remixes the danger with its own color, its own layout and its own trap you haven't seen yet. Read the pattern, find the timing, thread the gap.

MASTER THE GIMMICKS
Just when you settle into a rhythm, the game changes the rules. Launcher blocks fling you across gaps you could never jump. Wall-climbing opens vertical routes and hidden lines. Each twist is introduced gently, then twisted hard - master one gimmick and the next level is already stacking it with everything you've learned.

CHASE THE PERFECT RUN
You never lose progress - only time. Chain perfect jumps, shave the milliseconds and beat your best time on every level. Anyone can clear the first levels. The best times belong to players who know every pixel.

PURE PLATFORMING - FOR EVERYONE
Colorful Boi 2 is family-friendly and simple enough for a kid to pick up, yet honestly difficult when you push for mastery. 74 levels keep the challenge coming, and every one of them is built to be replayed until it's clean.

KEY FEATURES
- 74 handcrafted levels - each with its own color, layout and hazard mix.
- Tight, reaction-based controls - every jump is on you, not luck.
- Deadly, varied hazards - spikes, spinning saw blades, conveyor belts and launcher blocks.
- Instant retries and checkpoints - fail fast, learn faster, never lose progress.
- Per-level best times - built to be raced and speedrun.
- Easy to learn, tough to master - family-friendly, honestly difficult, endlessly replayable.

One tiny hero. 74 deadly levels. Endless retries. How far can you get?
70010000130206.intro: Get ready for a pulse-pounding platformer in Colorful Boi 2! With 74 levels, vibrant worlds, deadly traps, and tight controls, test your reflexes and speed.
70010000130206.name: Colorful Boi 2

70010000130218.description:
In the year 2063 the evil Kyle Kaboom has begun kidnapping the former members of his band Chainsaw Cannonball and infecting them with deadly viruses! Strapped into the Viral Unit, Bimmy and Octo must fight these infections all while trying to track down Kyle and stop him before he destroys the moon!

- Gameplay -
Blast away at deadly viruses and mechanical hybrids as you fight for the future of mankind! Dash through bullets, lasers, and even enemies to stay alive and rack up points.

- Features -
Story Mode - Defend earth from Kyle Kaboom at your pace: retry stages, practice bosses, and watch the story unfold.

Arcade Mode - Rack up a high score and attempt to clear the game in one complete run! You'll receive extra lives and a shield power-up to help tackle the swarm of viruses. If you can do it once, can you do it 2 or even 3 times in a row?

Boss Rush Mode - Once you've beaten the Story Mode, try your hand at Boss Rush! You'll face every boss back to back in one continuous loop as they become more and more challenging to defeat.

If you're up for some competition, see if you can be the top player in the world on the Online Leaderboard!

Grab a friend and fight for the high score with Alternating V.S. Multiplayer, or carry each other through the story!

Customize your visual experience with a selection of borders, the gorgeous Lottes CRT filter, and full Tate support for your vertical monitor.

Struggling to see bullets against the backgrounds? Hand getting tired from holding down or mashing the fire button? You can customize your experience further with a selection of Accessibility features.
70010000130218.intro: Viral Reload EX is a shoot-em-up with a dash mechanic where you shrink down to fight infections at a microscopic scale! Can you defeat the evil Kyle Kaboom?
70010000130218.name: Viral Reload EX

70010000130241.description:
Get ready to enter a world of clever inventions, smart challenges, and brilliant solutions in Magnetail. In this charming puzzle adventure, you follow an ingenious inventor mouse who transforms workshops, laboratories, and storage rooms into playgrounds of experimentation and discovery.

Each level presents a new challenge where energy, magnetism, and logic work together. Push energy modules, watch them slide across the environment, and use magnets strategically to redirect trajectories, create barriers, and open unexpected paths. It may seem simple at first, but you will quickly discover that every move can completely change the outcome of the puzzle.

The key is thinking several steps ahead. Where will the module stop? Which magnet should be used first? Which route leaves the path clear for the next move? In Magnetail, every decision matters, and finding the perfect solution is as satisfying as powering up a complex machine for the very first time.

Explore 30 carefully crafted levels spread across busy workshops, experimental laboratories, and storage facilities filled with mechanical challenges. New situations constantly emerge, requiring observation, planning, and creativity to master the rules of magnetism and turn obstacles into opportunities.

With charming visuals, accessible controls, and puzzles that reward intelligence and experimentation, Magnetail delivers a relaxing, engaging, and highly rewarding experience. It is the kind of game that makes you stop, study the room for a moment, and then smile when the perfect solution finally clicks into place.

Align the modules, master the magnets, and prove that no invention is too complex for a brilliant mind.
70010000130241.intro: Think Like a Genius, Solve Like an Inventor
70010000130241.name: Magnetail

70010000130251.description:
Collect puzzles with photorealistic images of girls in spectacular outfits, enjoy convenient touch controls and feel the process at your fingertips.

Relaxing music creates the right mood, and gradually increasing difficulty turns each level into an exciting challenge. After assembly, you can carefully examine each image and appreciate all the details.

Features:

• Photorealistic images.

• Realistic assembly process.

• Gradually increasing difficulty.

• Relaxing music.

• Detailed image viewing.
70010000130251.name: Hidden Girls: Secret Puzzle

70010000130255.description:
Guide four distinct knights through 100 brain-bending puzzle levels where the real danger isn't obstacles or enemies—it's the hungry mimic waiting for them at the end. Place directional tiles, springs, and boxes to steer your hapless adventurers towards treasure (and their inevitable doom), whilst keeping hazards from derailing the path to their delicious demise.

Featuring 100 challenging levels with three coins hidden in each, four knights with different personalities to master, multiple endings to uncover, and enough puns to make you groan. Plus a killer soundtrack.

• 4 knight types with unique mechanics
• 100 levels with secret coins to find
• 3 different endings
70010000130255.intro: Guide four knights through 100 puzzles towards a very hungry mimic
70010000130255.name: Chew Chew Mimic

70010000130299.description:
In the desolate future of 2042, Earth teeters on the brink of ecological collapse due to relentless climate change. The only hope lies with a visionary who abandoned Earth to start anew on Mars, disgusted by humanity’s negativity and the financial betrayal of his ventures.

“Project Neon” is your top-secret mission to navigate the treacherous cosmos and bring this recluse back from his Martian stronghold, without harming him, to salvage our dying planet. He has fortified Mars with an impenetrable shield, anchored by defenses on four neighboring planets.

Each planet is guarded by fierce enemies and daunting bosses, integral to maintaining the shield. Your task: dismantle this interplanetary defense, planet by planet, in a high-stakes shoot ’em up adventure.

Featuring intense 16-bit action that harks back to the glory days of Japanese arcade shooters, “Project Neon” promises a thrilling challenge.

Are you ready to face the ultimate shmup challenge and save Earth?
70010000130299.name: Project Neon

70010000130312.description:
Survive by maintaining a balanced diet and eat as much as you can. If your stomach gets full, burn off calories with squats to get hungry again!



Who doesn't love yakiniku?



How much can you eat at the BBQ restaurant? How many days can you survive at the BBQ restaurant? How far can your stomach endure? Who grilled this meat anyway? Food waste is a no-go.



Stealing, being stolen from, sometimes giving, and the budding friendships... all with a tear in your eye.



Welcome to Yakiniku Party Survival.



Game Overview:

Survive by consuming a balanced mix of protein, carbohydrates, and fats.

Each ingredient affects your nutritional balance differently.

If you overeat and your calories go overboard, you won’t be able to eat anymore. Burn off those calories with squats!



Game Features:

Online Multiplayer: Play with up to 4 people. Both Quick Matches and Friend Matches are available, and you can freely enter or leave either. In Quick Matches, survivors from around the world play at their own pace. Friend Matches let you easily play with specific friends using a single keyword. Of course, you can also play solo.



Cooperative or Competitive Play: In online multiplayer, you can grill meat for other players or steal their meat instead.



Skills: Learn and upgrade survival skills, such as tableware, rice, stomach expansion, or squat efficiency.



Fever Event: During The Fever event, no matter how much you consume, it’s zero calories! It’s your chance to balance your nutrition in one go.
70010000130312.intro: This is a game where you challenge yourself to survive using only the ingredients from a yakiniku restaurant.
70010000130312.name: Yakiniku Party Survival

70010000130331.description:
Your new business is now welcoming you! You have been handed the keys to a modest, empty commercial space, and your goal is simple: turn it into a thriving, highly profitable retail empire.

The success of the store rests entirely in your hands. Begin your day by ordering inventory, unpacking heavy cardboard boxes, and meticulously organizing products on the shelves so that customers can easily find what they need. You control the economy. Analyze market trends and set dynamic prices for each item to maximize profits without losing loyal customers. When the store opens, stand behind the cash register to scan barcodes, process credit cards, and give back change quickly to keep the lines moving.

Reinvest your earnings to expand your floor space, upgrade your lighting, and unlock licenses to sell hundreds of new, diverse products. Once the daily rush becomes too much for one person to handle, hire and train a team of cashiers and stockers to keep the business running smoothly. Customize your layout, paint the walls, and design the ultimate shopping environment. Do you have what it takes to build the greatest supermarket in town?

Key Features:
• Stock the Shelves: Order goods, unpack boxes, and arrange a wide variety of products to create an organized and inviting store.
• Master the Register: Scan items, process card payments, and quickly count out cash change for waiting customers.
• Set the Market: Take control of the economy. Monitor daily market trends and adjust your pricing strategy to balance high profits with happy shoppers.
• Grow Your Empire: Use your profits to unlock new store sections, purchase additional shelving, and expand your product catalog from basic snacks to premium goods.
• Automate the grind by hiring, training, and managing a team of employees to run the registers and restock shelves while you focus on the big picture.
• Total Customization: Design your store's layout, choose color schemes, and place decorations to create a unique shopping atmosphere.
70010000130331.intro: From humble store to retail giant!
70010000130331.name: My Supermarket Simulator

70010000130466.description:
Move through 3D space to find hints, solve mysteries and escape from the room.
Anyone can play to the end because you can see hints and answers.
70010000130466.name: Escape game R00M16

70010000130472.description: You awaken alone in a deserted hospital, its halls filled with darkness, mystery, and fear. As you search for a way out, you discover that you are not alone. A relentless butcher roams the building, hunting anyone who crosses his path. Explore the hospital, solve puzzles, uncover its disturbing past, and use stealth to survive. Stay quiet, stay hidden, and escape before the butcher finds you.
70010000130472.intro: Run. Hide. Survive. A ruthless butcher stalks your every move in this tense first-person horror experience.
70010000130472.name: Hunted

70010000130526.description:
Darkstone Bay is a first-person escape room puzzle adventure where you explore a mysterious island, solve puzzles and search for a lost Spanish galleon.

In 1721, the Spanish ship El Diablo Dormido vanished without a trace. For centuries it was believed to be lost at sea. Now, a forgotten trail leads to Darkstone Bay.

Explore sandy beaches, ancient caves, abandoned mines and dense jungle as you solve puzzles, decode forgotten symbols, discover hidden objects and uncover the truth behind the lost galleon.

Features:
• First-person escape room puzzle adventure
• Solve puzzles to cross the island
• Decode ancient symbols and discover hidden objects
• Explore beaches, caves, mines and jungle environments
• Atmospheric original soundtrack
70010000130526.intro: A first-person escape room puzzle adventure. Explore a mysterious island and search for a legendary shipwreck hidden for over 300 years.
70010000130526.name: Darkstone Bay

70010000130595.description:
Forget being a peaceful pet; today, you're a destructive intruder. You are a giant rodent breaking into the sheriff's house. Your objective is simple: cause as much property damage as possible without getting caught.

Waddle through a highly interactive house and use your size to your advantage. Push over heavy TVs, break expensive vases, and smash the furniture. Open the refrigerator door to steal food, jump on kitchen tables, and drive the sheriff's guard dog crazy. When the owner walks in, quickly hide in a closet to avoid capture. Then, jump out and continue your rampage! From the backyard to the living room, make the sheriff's home your personal playground.

Key Features:
• Interactive Destruction: Shatter household objects, knock over electronics, and toss furniture with amusing physics-based movement.
• Fridge Raiding: Search the kitchen to steal snacks, sausages, and fresh vegetables directly from the cabinets and refrigerator.
• Evade the Sheriff: Dodge the homeowner and his guard dog by hiding in closets and sneaking through different rooms.
• Explore the house. Run wild from the grassy backyard to the master bedroom and leave a trail of chaos in your wake.
70010000130595.intro: The giant rodent versus the sheriff!
70010000130595.name: Bad Capybara

70010000130619.description:
Conquest: Global Domination is a turn-based grand strategy game where every decision can change the balance of power.

Choose from real-world nations or create battles between fictional countries as you compete for global supremacy. Expand your territory, strengthen your economy, develop advanced military technology, and build an army capable of defeating your rivals.

Recruit infantry, tanks, helicopters, bombers, and other military units to defend your borders or launch large-scale invasions. Research powerful technologies including drones, missile defense systems, and nuclear weapons to gain a strategic advantage over your opponents.

Victory requires more than military strength. Manage your resources carefully, plan your expansion, and decide when to attack, defend, or invest in new technologies. Every turn presents new strategic opportunities and difficult choices.

Play with different victory conditions to suit your preferred style:
• Domination Mode – Conquer countries to become the world's dominant superpower.
• Turn Limit Mode – Earn the highest score before the final turn to claim victory.

Features:

Turn-based global strategy gameplay.
Play as real or fictional nations.
Build and command a modern military.
Recruit infantry, tanks, helicopters, and bombers.
Research drones, nuclear weapons, and missile defense systems.
Capture territories and expand your empire.
Multiple victory conditions for varied gameplay.
High replay value with countless strategic possibilities.

Will your nation become the next global superpower?
70010000130619.intro: Conquer the world through strategy, diplomacy, and military power. Build your nation. Expand your empire. Dominate the globe.
70010000130619.name: Conquest: Global Domination

70010000130658.description:
Get behind the wheel and put your racing skills to the test in Ragdoll Kart Simulator 2026, a fast-paced arcade kart racing experience focused on drifting, boosting, and mastering every track.

Choose your driver, customize their appearance with different colors and accessories, select your kart, and get ready to compete across 10 challenging tracks. Each track features its own layout, turns, shortcuts, and racing challenges, giving you new opportunities to improve your control and racing technique.

KEY FEATURES
	•	Master the Drift – Drift through corners, build your boost, and release it at the perfect moment to gain speed.
	•	Race Across 10 Tracks – Take on unique track layouts featuring tight corners, shortcuts, difficult sections, and high-speed areas.
	•	Customize Your Driver – Choose colors and accessories to create your preferred driver look.
	•	Choose Your Kart – Select from a variety of karts and find one that matches your racing style.
	•	Race for Rewards – Compete against AI opponents, improve your times, complete challenges, and earn rewards for additional customization options.

Race, drift, boost, and improve with every lap. Find the perfect racing line, master every corner, and push your kart to the limit in Ragdoll Kart Simulator 2026.
70010000130658.name: Ragdoll Kart Simulator 2026

70010000130678.description:
Get out of the prison and try not to die!

Take advantage of the chaos in the prison to fight your way through 30 levels, testing your wits and reflexes as you face explosions, heavy gunfire and deadly obstacles in a bid to reclaim your freedom!

- Try on Jake's shoes from Team Hot Guns in his famous prison break.
- Solve 30 levels filled with useful items, tricky enemies and puzzles.
- Put your patience, reflexes and ambition to the test.
70010000130678.intro: Shoot your way to freedom through explosive levels and retro gunfire!
70010000130678.name: Prison Run and Gun

70010000130684.description:
You are not just the head chef, but also the manager, cashier, and driving force behind the city's most popular food truck. Bustling sidewalks are filled with hungry customers waiting for you to take their orders, prep the ingredients, and serve them mouthwatering meals that are hot, fresh, and served exactly on time.

Success in the street food business requires more than a great recipe. It demands lightning-fast reflexes and impeccable time management. During the daily lunch rush, you must multitask effortlessly with smooth, intuitive gamepad controls. Juggle multiple orders, keep a close eye on the grill, and ensure nothing burns! Each satisfied customer will leave you with hard-earned cash and a growing reputation. However, if you make them wait too long, they will walk away hungry.

Use your daily profits to transform your modest setup into a world-class culinary enterprise. As you progress, you will unlock a wide variety of new ingredients, allowing you to expand your menu and take on exciting new cooking challenges. Purchase top-tier kitchen equipment to speed up prep time and eventually unlock expanded dining spaces to accommodate larger crowds. Put on your apron, turn on the stove, and see how far you can take your street food empire!

Key Features:
• Sizzle & Serve: Master the daily rush! Cook, assemble, and deliver orders quickly before your hungry customers get impatient.
• Upgrade Your Kitchen: Use your hard-earned profits to invest in high-tech grills, faster fryers, and advanced prep stations to increase your efficiency.
• Expand your menu: Unlock a wide variety of fresh ingredients and complex, high-paying recipes to keep the crowds coming back for more.
• Grow Your Empire: Transform your modest street cart into a top-tier mobile restaurant with expanded dining spaces to host bigger crowds.
• Smooth Console Controls: Seamlessly navigate kitchen chaos with intuitive gamepad controls designed specifically for fast-paced multitasking.
70010000130684.intro: From Corner Cart to Culinary Kingpin!
70010000130684.name: Street Food Simulator

70010000130689.description:
Set in a grim and desolate world overrun by zombies, the game challenges players to fend off wave after wave of increasingly formidable enemies.
With its top-down view and fast-paced action, Zombie War offers an adrenaline-pumping experience that will keep players on the edge of their seats.
Armed with an arsenal of weapons and gear, players must fight tooth and nail to stay alive in the face of overwhelming odds.

Fight and thrive in the endless onslaught of zombies.
Upgrade your gear and weapons and keep up with stronger enemies.
Your main goal in this grim world is survival.

Upgrade your gear and weapons to progress in the game as the difficulty rises.
Pick up useful loot and use your special abilities to survive as long as possible.
70010000130689.intro: Zombie War plunges players into a relentless battle for survival against hordes of the undead.
70010000130689.name: Zombie War

70010000130708.description:
Hotel Empire - Check Inn is a charming management simulation in which you build your own hotel chain step by step. Start with a small, simple hotel and expand your empire into more and more cities – each with its own challenges.

BUILD, EXPAND, AND OPTIMIZE
- Build new hotels, buy building plots.
- Plan rooms with increasingly complex shapes and place them as efficiently as possible.
- Fulfill your guests' wishes: they want specific rooms and parking spaces.

MANAGE STAFF & SERVICE
- Hire enough maids, because every room must be cleaned after check-out.
- Build elevators, upgrade them, and keep them in good condition so guests can quickly reach their floor.
- Build service rooms such as kitchens, laundries, or saunas, and employ porters who transport food, laundry, and other items through the hotel.

EVERY CITY BRINGS NEW CHALLENGES
- Montreal: Cold, snowy weather – insulate rooms so guests don't freeze.
- Miami: Luxury hotels right by the sea with especially demanding room layouts.
- New York: Build several hotels at the same time and use managers who automate check-in.

EASY TO LEARN - HARD TO MASTER
Hotel Empire - Check Inn combines accessible gameplay with a deep management focus. Optimize processes, keep guests happy, and expand your hotel chain into a global empire.
70010000130708.intro: Build hotels, accommodate guests, and expand your hotel business worldwide!
70010000130708.name: Hotel Empire - Check Inn

70010000130748.description:
Plant crops, water your fields, harvest fresh produce, craft useful tools, trade with merchants, and shape your homestead exactly the way you want.

Start with a small piece of land and turn it into a thriving countryside home. Prepare the soil, grow different crops through realistic growth stages, gather resources, and expand your farm with buildings, fences, storage areas, and custom structures. Whether you enjoy peaceful farming, creative building, or managing resources for survival, Farming Homestead gives you the freedom to play your way.

Explore a complete farming experience with dynamic weather, a smooth day-and-night cycle, useful tools, crafting recipes, inventory management, trading, and persistent save progress. Every system works together to create a relaxing yet rewarding homestead adventure. Create the farm you have always imagined. Grow your land, build your home, and enjoy the peaceful life of Farming Homestead.

Features

Grow a wide variety of crops with planting, watering, harvesting, soil preparation, and time-based growth.

Craft tools, items, and equipment using a flexible recipe-based crafting system.

Build and customize your farm with structures, fences, storage, and decorations using free placement.

Manage your inventory and hotbar to quickly access tools, seeds, resources, and crafted items.

Buy and sell goods through merchant NPCs and build your farming economy.

Experience dynamic weather and a beautiful day-and-night cycle that brings your world to life.
70010000130748.intro: Build, grow, craft, and live your dream farm life in Farming Homestead, a cozy farming simulation game where every day brings new opportunities.
70010000130748.name: Farming Homestead

70010000130770.description:
Step into the grim world of heroic fantasy with King's Blade – a classic beat 'em up that channels the spirit of legendary arcade titles. Take command of the elite warriors of the King's Blade and fight your way through the hordes of the Barganian Empire! Crush enemies in epic brawls, traverse deadly lands, and carve a path to the heart of the enemy capital. Join forces with friends in local co-op for up to 4 players, or add AI fighters to your team!

Key features:
- Deep Combat System with various combos, environmental weapons, spells, and special attacks
- 6 Unique Heroes
- 12 Diverse Levels
- Local Co-op for up to 4 players
- Option to play Co-op with AI
70010000130770.intro: A classic beat 'em up inspired by legendary arcade titles.
70010000130770.name: King's Blade

70010000130818.description:
Jump into a vibrant world of floating platforms, tricky obstacles and fast-paced challenges in this addictive hyper-casual platformer.

Take control of a charming cube and hop your way across a variety of handcrafted levels filled with narrow pathways, moving hazards and clever routes that will put your timing and precision to the test. Every stage offers a new challenge as you leap from block to block, avoid deadly spikes, cross crumbling platforms, dodge fireballs, swing past massive hammers and overcome many more obstacles standing in your way.

Collect coins throughout your adventure and use them to unlock a growing collection of unique cube skins, allowing you to customize your character and show off your style as you progress through the game.

As your journey continues, you'll encounter the Evil Square Ones, powerful rivals that await in exciting boss battles. These action-packed encounters will challenge everything you've learned and reward skillful play.

With simple controls, satisfying gameplay and a steady stream of short, engaging levels, this is the perfect game to pick up for a quick challenge or settle in for a longer session. Easy to learn but difficult to master, every jump counts as you work your way through increasingly demanding stages.

Can you conquer every level, defeat the Evil Square Ones and become the ultimate platforming champion?
70010000130818.name: The Square Ones

70010000130823.description:
Your journey begins with a single roll of the dice.
A board game-style adventure where heroes journey through the miniature world of “Viractalia.”
Your movement depends on the roll of the dice—but the key to victory lies in your hand and how you build your deck!

Embark on your own unique adventure in a world where strategy and luck are perfectly intertwined!

＜Features＞
Explore a charming miniature world
Each time you play, the whimsical yet intricate world transforms before your eyes!
With limited time to explore, every step is full of excitement: What will happen next? What will I find?

A fusion of card battles and board game strategy
Use a wide variety of cards to defeat your enemies!
Collect countless cards and build your own custom deck and powerful combos!

Dice-based movement with the DP system
“I rolled a big number... but I only want to move one space?”
Don't worry—no roll is ever wasted!
Unused movement points are converted into DP, a special resource that can be spent to power up events or give you the edge in battle.

Dynamic events and meaningful choices
On your journey, you'll encounter unique and colorful events.
Your decisions may grant you powerful abilities... or change the course of your adventure entirely!

Play solo or with friends
Whether you're diving in solo or adventuring with others, you're in for a good time!
Online multiplayer is supported—and who knows? Something special might happen just for you when you're playing online...

<Where strategy and fate collide>
The fate you entrust to the dice, and the cards you choose with care—
Every move you make weaves your story.
A fresh adventure awaits board game lovers, card game fans, and strategy enthusiasts alike.
70010000130823.intro: A highly replayable board game RPG powered by dice and cards.
70010000130823.name: Viractal: Will You Trust Your Party?

70010000130829.description:
Welcome to SuperSharket — the supermarket where fish shop like humans!

Build and manage your very own underwater supermarket, stocked with all the everyday products you would find in a human store. From filling shelves to managing the checkout, every part of the supermarket is in your hands.

Hire a team of sharks to keep your store running, serve different types of fish, manage your money, and keep your customers happy. Expand your supermarket, build new areas, upgrade your facilities, and turn a small underwater shop into a thriving retail empire.

Every customer is different, and every fish has somewhere to be. Keep the shelves stocked, the queues moving, and the cash registers ringing while your shark employees handle the work.

Why do fish need human groceries? Nobody knows. But they clearly love shopping.

Build your store. Hire your sharks. Serve your fish. Become the ultimate underwater supermarket manager!
70010000130829.intro: Welcome to the supermarket where fish shop and sharks work!
70010000130829.name: SuperSharket

70010000130835.description:
Join the main character, Sir Brante, on a journey through the various stages of life and guide your protagonist as his personality is being forged by the cruel injustices of a society divided by class and ruled by outdated traditions. This is a story of a merciless world that punishes those who violate its laws... and the one man who dares to challenge the old order.

Born a commoner with no rights or title, you were never fated for an easy existence. Changing your destiny and becoming a true heir to the Brante family name will put you at odds with the ancient customs and foundations. Go the distance from birth until true death, writing a history of great upheavals, monumental experiences, and difficult choices.

- A narrative RPG with a vibrant, dark fantasy adventure plot
- Every event has multiple possible outcomes, and only you decide which path Sir Brante should follow
- Make any choice you want but beware the unpredictable consequences wrought on by hasty decisions
- Influence the course of history and participate in events that reshape the world around you
- Savor the dark and gritty atmosphere of the Blessed Arknian Empire, where the laws are harsh, gods know little mercy, and everyone's Lot is predetermined by their estate
- Unravel an engaging storyline and accompany your character the whole way through, from birth until his demise

Key features:

Gripping narrative
The gods once bestowed the truth of the Lots unto the realm of mortals, and the Imperial law now demands that every person's life be determined by their estate. The nobles rule, the clergy offer counsel and punish those led astray from the one true path, while the common folk suffer and toil away for the glory of the Empire. You may accept this fate, but it is also within your power to alter the existing world order forever.

Your choice is not an illusion
All of your character's deeds, acquired skills, and the consequences of his actions add up to form a plot that is unique to the current playthrough. Every decision has a price, and you will be held accountable throughout the entire journey. Protect your family and loved ones, reach out for the reins of the state, or challenge the old order – make your choice and witness the aftermath.

Fight for survival
Train your character, cultivating traits such as determination, sensitivity, or endurance. All of the hero's skills will affect his personality, worldview, and relationships, ultimately unlocking new talents and possible storylines in this dark fantasy world!


A path full of hardships
The first complete walkthrough can take you upwards of 15 hours! Numerous branching paths that affect the unfolding story will make every playthrough a unique experience: become a noble judge, learn the ways of the inquisition, plot a revolution as a member of a secret society, or embrace an entirely different purpose. Destiny itself shall bend to your will!

Strive for survival in the harsh reality of dark fantasy! Walk a path full of danger and adventure, take risks, and find your own way in the universe of The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante!
70010000130835.intro: The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante is a narrative-driven RPG that tells of the hardships of a commoner's Lot in a realm of dark fantasy.
70010000130835.name: The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante

70010000130841.description:
Sir, You Are Being Hunted is a procedurally-generated British horror in which tweed-wearing robots hunt you for sport.
Roam the landscape, scavenge for food, hide breathlessly in the undergrowth, flee in terror, and even fight back with stolen weapons.

Sir is a stealth and survival game unlike any other.

Key Features:
- First-person stealth and survival.
- Procedurally-generated British landscape.
- Five biomes to explore: castle, industrial, rural, mountainous, and fenland.
- Infinite replayability in a sandbox world.
- Powerful, brutal AI that becomes tougher as you play.
- Tea and biscuits.
- Foliage-based stealth system.
- Scavenge to survive.
- Play as Sir or Madam.
- Relentless Britishness.

Every Game Unique!
Sir, You Are Being Hunted is set on a mysterious archipelago generated procedurally by you, and therefore unique to each game you play.
You can define your own islands, each one created in moments by our rather clever British Countryside Generator.
These islands are then populated by a raving aristocracy of murderous robots, their robot hounds, and worse. You job is simply to survive, and get home.

You're not entirely alone, though: The disembodied voice of Walters, your butler, will help you and offer advice.

Ultimate AI Threat
Sir's AI is one of the toughest in stealth, and as an open-world game, it's unique in its field.
The robots are some of the most aggressive and intelligent game enemies you will ever experience, and will pursue you even after losing sight of you. Expect to be hunted!

The Most British Of Games
Sir, You Are Being Hunted is set in a parallel Britain, complete with bleak villages, rocky highlands, bramble-filled woodland, decrepit farms, and crumbling post-industrial landscapes.
Made with the remarkable power of our British Landscape Generator, these landscapes are enormously evocative and teeming with detail.
Take time to explore, and find that vital hidden flask of tea!
70010000130841.intro: Escape from these robot-infested islands with violence, trickery and stealth.
70010000130841.name: Sir, You Are Being Hunted

70010000130847.description:
Tired of the same old jigsaw puzzles?

Discover a fresh take on the puzzle genre with video puzzles!

Assemble animated scenes featuring beautiful anime girls and enjoy high-quality animation, vibrant visual effects, and an immersive atmosphere in our new game, Anime Video Puzzle!

Relax with soothing music and meditative gameplay as you solve a collection of fun and engaging puzzles!
70010000130847.intro: Assemble beautiful animated video puzzles featuring anime girls and relax with soothing music and engaging gameplay.
70010000130847.name: Anime Video Puzzle

70010000130865.description:
YOUR WORLD, BUT TWISTED
When your best friend vanishes, you must enter the Dark Reflection—a hostile, warped copy of your own reality. Here, familiar places are dangerous, and friendly faces cannot be trusted.

SURVIVE THE NIGHTMARE
The Dark Reflection is a classic side-scrolling pixel-art adventure packed with action, puzzles, and heavy metal energy.

Explore: Search creepy locations and find vital items to survive.

Solve: Use your brain and your inventory to clear obstacles.

Fight: Slash your way through hordes of demons and unique bosses.

DARK HUMOR & HEAVY METAL
Step into a world where dark humor meets a heavy rock soundtrack. Every corner hides a secret, and every choice matters.

Features
Warped World: Explore an unsettling, distorted reality.

Classic Gameplay: Solve puzzles and manage items to progress.

Brutal Battles: Fight aggressive monsters and giant bosses.

Hidden Secrets: Find secret paths and weird encounters.

Your Choice: Make decisions that lead to multiple endings.

Turn up the volume of your doom.
70010000130865.intro: A thrash metal album reveals a ritual that opens a portal to another world.
70010000130865.name: Dark Reflection

70010000130927.description:
Captain Soda takes arcade shoot'em up platforming to new heights, boasting soda flavors with unique abilities, flashy weapons, powerful upgrades, and pulse-pounding challenges. Revel in the fluid controls that let you jiggle, slosh, and clink with satisfaction as you annihilate enemies and navigate the chaos.

Throw-down wave after wave of money-abducting alien invaders with weapons like the Bubble Sub-machine Gun and Bottle Rocket Launcher. Pick your favorite carbonated beverage and shoot water guns loaded with it, all while grooving to an Arcade Orchestral synth soundtrack composed by Aleix Ramon.

SATISFY YOUR THIRST FOR VIOLENCE

Destroy the alien invaders with a variety of short-range, long-range and melee weapons. Toss exploding cans, fly with a soda-powered jetpack, or flatten them with an entire vending machine! Hone your skills to evade and defeat 18 different types of enemies.

MIX, MATCH AND UPGRADE

Play as different soda heroes to dazzle the enemy like Lieutenant Lemonade or Major Matcha Bubble Tea. Acquire over 14 accessories and upgrades like the CO2 Boost Boots and Effervescent Wings to tailor to your play style and boost your power.

INTENSE HEART-RACING CAMPAIGN

Shoot and blast your way through a vibrant campaign across three mysterious areas with diverse carbonated themes. Complete over 60 optional missions, unlock item shops, and uncover secret upgrades as you pursue the enemy.

NEVER-ENDING ENDLESS MODE

Fight never-ending waves of enemies in rogue-like Endless mode, where each level is more intense than the last one! Can you survive the alien onslaught and achieve an eye-popping high score on the global leaderboard?

SODAFIED SPIRITUAL SUCCESSOR

Captain Soda elevates the genre with a full-fledged campaign mode, enhanced visuals, new enemies, mechanics, customizable weapon loadouts, and an expanded screen-wrapping mechanic for intense and skill-based gameplay.

FUN AND ACCESSIBLE FOR ALL

With a range of difficulty options, Captain Soda caters to beginners, experts, and speedrunners alike. Adjust settings and options like aim assist, enemy movement speed, and color blind mode to your heart's content for an optimized and enjoyable gameplay experience.
70010000130927.intro: Transform into the ultimate pop bottle hero, obliterating an alien army with your sparkling soda guns!
70010000130927.name: Captain Soda

70010000130935.description:
Make money from garage sales to buy furniture and new fixtures for their old house!
Home Makeover is a hidden object game that features decoration and match 3 mini games with unlimited levels and gameplay time, all in one package!

- 12 scenes and 10 gameplay modes
- Match-3 mini-games
- Decoration and makeover
- Bonus household tips and facts
70010000130935.intro: Help Emma restore her grandparents' old house back to its former glory!
70010000130935.name: Home Makeover: Hidden Object

70010000130941.description:
Become the Nightmare of All Humanity

Tome of the Damned is a dark and gripping top-down roguelike that tells the tragic story of a mage whose reckless experiments with forbidden magic ended in disaster. Once a powerful sorcerer, you are now a living corpse doomed to endless cycles of reincarnation, inhabiting the bodies of the dead. Your lair lies deep within the castle’s dungeons, surrounded by former allies and castle guards who are determined to keep you locked away to prevent your dark magic from escaping.

Your journey begins in the deepest, darkest corners of the castle. Step by step, you fight your way toward freedom, facing increasingly powerful foes-seasoned warriors, cunning mages, and relentless guards willing to give their lives to stop you.

Along the way, you discover ancient altars that serve as sources of power.
