These altars allow you to enhance your weapons, unlock powerful spells, and improve your attributes, offering countless paths to develop your abilities and adapt to the trials ahead.

Choose one of five enchanted weapons and one of four magical grimoires, then grind your enemies to dust. But don’t worry if you happen to die.

After all, you still have plenty of bodies left-you can simply take a new one.
70010000130941.intro: Tome of the Damned - dark top-down roguelike. Cut down the castle guard, upgrade your weapons and spells, battle through dozens of locations, and face ruthless bosses.
70010000130941.name: Tome of the Damned

70010000131015.description:
Have you ever wanted to drink an entire lake through a straw? Well now you can in this cozy incremental fishing game! There's so much to sip in the lake, so upgrade your straw, drink up schools of fish, and maybe find what's at the bottom of the Lake!

Sip Fisher is an incremental fishing game about draining a lake of all its water.

Start out on an old dock surrounded by a vast and daunting lake. Sip up water from the lake, sell the fish you find, and upgrade your equipment to sip up the lake faster. Relax and explore as the lake gets lower. Progress until you have a massive dock and find out what’s at the bottom!
70010000131015.name: Sip Fisher

70010000131035.description:
Enter the arena and prove you're the apex serpent in this fast-paced snake battler. Compete against a swarm of rival snakes for every scrap of food, grow longer with every bite, and force your opponents into deadly mistakes. One wrong move means the end — crash into another snake and it's game over. Only the biggest and smartest survive.
GROW OR CRASH

Start small and chow down your way to the top. The more you eat, the longer and deadlier you become. But size cuts both ways — the bigger you grow, the harder it is to weave through the chaos. Steer clear of every other snake on the field, because a single collision ends your run. Outmaneuver your rivals, cut off their path, and watch them crash so you can feast on what's left.


FEATURES
-Snake Growth & Evolution — Every bite makes you bigger and stronger. Evolve from a tiny worm into a massive, screen-dominating beast.
-Living Food World — A constantly replenishing arena keeps the action non-stop. There's always something to eat — and always someone trying to take it first.
-Survive the Collision — Crash into another snake and you're done. Force your rivals into yours and clear the field of competition.
-Real-Time Leaderboards — Watch the rankings shift live as you and your rivals battle for the #1 spot. Can you hold the crown?
-XP & Progression — Earn experience with every match and level up your way to bigger rewards and bragging rights.
-Game-Changing Boosters — Deploy magnets, speed bursts, score multipliers, and vision boosters to turn the tide in the heat of battle.
-Cosmetic Customization — Make your snake unmistakably yours with a huge range of looks and styles at the skin Shop
-Booster Shop — Stock up on power-ups and head into each match loaded for war.
-Reward Economy — Earn coins through skillful play or Wheel of fortune and spend them on skins, boosters, and more. The grind always pays off.

THE ARENA AWAITS
No two matches play the same. Quick to learn, impossible to put down — Brawl Snakes delivers bite-sized chaos that's perfect for one more round... and then just one more.

Are you ready to become the Final Boss of the arena?
70010000131035.name: Brawl Snakes

70010000131085.description:
Welcome to the night shift! You just got a job running a small, 24-hour shawarma stand on a dark, quiet street. It seems like an easy way to earn some quick cash. Wait for a customer to approach the window, prepare their food, and collect the money. However, as the midnight crowd arrives, you'll quickly realize that this isn't an ordinary neighborhood and that not everyone on the other side of the glass is human.

To survive in this kiosk, you need to be paranoid and have a sharp eye. As each customer approaches to place an order, observe them closely and check the security cameras for anything unusual. Are their voices distorted? Are their facial features morphing into something monstrous? Is there an unsettling shadow lurking just out of sight? Learn to spot these terrifying anomalies hiding in plain sight.

When a guest checks out, treat them to a delicious shawarma and send them on their way. However, if your gut tells you something is wrong, do not hesitate. Hit the red emergency button and slam the heavy metal shutters down immediately. You cannot afford to be careless. You only have five chances to mess up. If you make too many mistakes by feeding a monster or turning away a normal person, you will summon the dreaded Inspector. If he arrives at your window, your shift is over... and your life might be, too.

Do you have the nerve to survive until morning?
70010000131085.name: Scary Shawarma Shop

70010000131102.description:
DopePie Survivors 3D is a single-player third-person shooter that combines survivor-like progression with free-roaming action in a fully 3D city.

Choose from a cast of adorable heroines, each with unique skills and talents. Defeat hordes of zombies, earn experience, and select new weapons, skills, summons, and upgrades to create your own powerful build. Every run offers new combinations and strategies.

Climb the buildings around you, glide across the city, and explore the battlefield from every angle. Drive police cars and flying motorcycles, or take control of tanks and attack helicopters to break through the enemy horde.

Face enormous corrupted female bosses in intense battles. In Giantess Mode, you can become a giantess yourself, roam freely through the city, smash buildings and streets, and experience overwhelming size and power.

Key Features
・A cast of heroines with distinct skills and talents
・A wide variety of weapons, summons, upgrades, and build combinations
・A large 3D city with climbing, gliding, and vertical exploration
・Police cars, flying motorcycles, tanks, attack helicopters, and more
・Giant boss battles and a playable Giantess Mode

Build your arsenal, survive the infected city, and lead the heroines to safety!
70010000131102.intro: Fight through a 3D city, build unstoppable loadouts, command powerful vehicles, and face giant bosses—or become a giantess yourself!
70010000131102.name: DopePie Survivors 3D

70010000131126.description:
A game that teaches you about Japan's "Blue Ticket" system!

This game allows you to learn about Japanese traffic laws and the "Traffic Infringement Notification System" (commonly known as the "Blue Ticket" system)—which came into effect in April 2026—through gameplay. In the quiz stage, you can learn the correct rules and interesting trivia via True/False questions. The action stage lets you navigate a city modeled after real Japanese streets, challenging you to reach your destination safely without committing any traffic violations.

Is it okay to ride on the sidewalk? What is the correct way to navigate a T-junction? Can children get a "Blue Ticket"? Is it permissible to hang bags on the handlebars? Find the answers to these questions and more.
Use this game to acquire accurate and proper knowledge.

The game features a bilingual display (Japanese and English), making it a great tool for language study.
It is also designed so that international visitors to Japan—or anyone interested in understanding Japanese traffic laws—can play with ease and confidence.
70010000131126.intro:
A game to learn about the Blue Ticket system
Two gameplay modes: Quiz and Action
Simultaneous Japanese and English display
70010000131126.name: Bicycle Quiz & Riding

70010000131132.description:
Speed is only the beginning. The real challenge starts in every corner.

Push your car to the limit, enter corners at high speed and control every slide with precision. Chain smooth drifts, keep your momentum and chase higher scores while competing in intense street races.

Winning takes more than raw speed. Your entry angle, drift control, racing line and exit timing all matter. Every corner is a chance to gain an advantage, improve your run and prove your driving skill.

Feel the rush of fast cars, sharp turns and perfectly controlled drifts as you fight for better results and cleaner runs. Easy to pick up but rewarding to master, every race gives you another reason to come back and improve.

Features:

High-speed drift racing
Skill-based driving and precise car control
Competitive street races where speed and style both matter
Challenging tracks and corners built for drifting
Accessible gameplay with plenty of depth to master
Chase higher scores and improve your best runs
Fast-paced racing atmosphere focused on cars, speed and drifting

Hit the road, leave your mark on the asphalt and prove you can master every corner.
70010000131132.intro: Master the streets. Own every drift.
70010000131132.name: Drift Club: Street Legends

70010000131167.description:
Move through 3D space to find hints, solve mysteries and escape from the room.
Anyone can play to the end because you can see hints and answers.
70010000131167.name: Escape game R00M17

70010000131223.description:
Take flight in your seaplane on a heartfelt adventure across the tropical Limbo archipelago. After a devastating storm, gather materials with your Swirler, and help the locals rebuild. Can you uncover the truth behind Uncle Lou’s disappearance?

A Seaplane, a Storm, and a Missing Uncle

Take to the skies in your trusty seaplane on a heartfelt adventure across the tropical Limbo archipelago. After receiving a distress call from Uncle Lou, you arrive only to find the islands in disarray and Lou nowhere to be found. Collect resources, help rebuild a community, and unravel the mystery of your uncle’s disappearance.

Collect, Craft, Restore

Harness the vacuum power of the Swirler! — a glorious multi-tool — to collect everything from scrap and native plants to materials dropped by Limbo’s unique wildlife. Use your finds to repair buildings, craft goods, and help the communities thrive again.

Claim your slice of paradise at Lou’s Lagoon. Build your dream beach hut, add your personal touch, and let the island rhythm take over.

Meet the islanders of Limbo

Discover the archipelago’s vibrant islands, each with their own spirited communities, hidden treasures, and unique problems to solve. Get a warm welcome from the Charneys in Tangle Bloom—the archipelago's liveliest town—then head to Gleam Reef to watch the Vooi move to the music of the tides. Lastly, visit Boulderia, home to the grumpy, sugar-crystal-mining Gorplins!

Key Features: 

- Explore the Limbo archipelago, home to vibrant communities and ancient secrets. 
- Pilot your very own seaplane, master ring challenges, and enjoy the freedom of open skies. 
- Upgrade your gadgets to expand your adventures. Scoop, build, glide and fish! 
- Build your island base, decorate it, and make Lou’s Lagoon feel like home. 
- A mystery to unravel. Piece together clues, follow Lou’s trail, and uncover the truth behind his disappearance! 

Whether you’re hot on the trail to solving the mystery of Uncle Lou or just kicking back and enjoying island life, Lou’s Lagoon is your ticket to an exciting adventure.

Ready for takeoff?
70010000131223.name: Lou's Lagoon – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000131256.description: A soundtrack featuring over 30 tracks, including the original music from the 2002 release of "Touhou Koumakyou" and the tracks newly arranged by ZUN for "Touhou Koumakyou: New Classic".
70010000131256.name: Touhou Koumakyou: New Classic Soundtrack Player

70010000131257.description:
Embark on an unforgettable journey through the enchanting world of Teradea, where peaceful farm life meets thrilling adventure!

Raised in the quiet comfort of Bloomfield Village, your life is about to change forever. A mysterious mist creeps from the Forest of Echoes, wild beasts roam under the cover of night, and strange disasters threaten villages across the land.

Venture across a vast, living landscape filled with hidden caves, remote islands, lively towns, and long-forgotten secrets. Between your travels, cultivate your farm, raise animals, harvest crops, and build a place to call home. Guided by the Harvest Goddess and aided by the friends you'll meet along the way, you’ll find new ways to grow, explore, and lend a hand wherever it’s needed.

As friendships deepen and the seasons pass, the truth behind the mist will slowly begin to unfold. With the support of those you’ve helped — and those who stand beside you — you may discover a way to lift the veil from the Forest of Echoes and let Teradea flourish once more!

• Romance & Relationships: Meet 10 unique romance candidates—5 bachelors and 5 bachelorettes. Build meaningful relationships, experience heartfelt events, and find your perfect partner to share your life with.

• Animal Companion System: Befriend a variety of animal companions, each with unique abilities that help you explore. Break obstacles, reach hidden locations, and uncover secrets throughout Teradea together.

• New Exploration Abilities: Jump, climb ladders, and scale vines to discover previously unreachable areas. Combine your movement skills with your animal companions to fully explore every corner of the world.

• Make Everyone Happilia: Help villagers, complete requests, and contribute to Teradea's growth to earn precious Happilia. The more Happilia you gather, the more the Harvest Goddess can help restore the land.

• Island Life: Discover remote islands by collecting nautical charts. Hunt for hidden treasures, uncover new locations, and befriend rare animals found nowhere else in Teradea.

• Untamed Wilderness: The wilderness is home to wolves, bears, tigers, and other wildlife. Stay alert and avoid being caught, or you'll lose your collected items and wake up back at your farm.
70010000131257.name: Harvest Moon®: Echoes of Teradea

70010000131284.description:
Explore a vast urban landscape in this narrative-driven, 2D top-down platforming adventure!

In Pipistrello and the Cursed Yoyo, you're a budding yoyo master facing off against enemies using the weapon you know best: your prized yoyo! As Pippit, you'll be quite literally thrown into the shocking story of your auntie's business empire, a soul-stealing mega-laser, and four dastardly crime bosses!

Each yoyo trick you learn will drastically change the way you look at the cityscape, and the battlefield! By chaining moves together, you'll be able to explore secret areas and teach those baddies a lesson! Many challenges have multiple solutions — so come up with your own novel routes in this mouth-watering adventure!

Features:
• Explore the city's 4 districts with over 1000 screens of challenges and secrets!
• Infiltrate the businesses of the 4 crime bosses! Navigate their labyrinthine buildings, take on foes, and solve action puzzles!
• Learn yoyo tricks and techniques to create your own cityscape yoyo-parkour routes, and make those mob minions pay!
• Collect over 40 ability-enhancing Badges that alter the way you play!
• Unlock over 20 passive Upgrades through a shady loan shark!
• Find over 80 other collectibles throughout town, from life upgrades to precious treasures!
70010000131284.intro: Are you ready for the first Yoyovania?!
70010000131284.name: Pipistrello and the Cursed Yoyo – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000131287.description:
In the pitch-black waters beyond a long-abandoned fishing town, the enigmatic captain of the world's strangest submarine has been murdered. Some say he was an immortal time-traveller. Others say he was a vampire, cursed to stay hidden beneath the waves forever...

Found alone in a locked room, with only an ancient stone cauldron to suggest how he might have died, it's up to Detective Grimoire and Sally to piece together what really happened. Was it a curse, released from the cauldron? One of the submarine's eccentric crew? Or does the bizarre truth run even deeper...

• Every clue is a fully realised 3D object waiting to be examined for hidden secrets
• Grimoire and Sally are back, and joined by a fully voiced* cast of mysterious suspects
• A hauntingly beautiful original soundtrack performed by the Budapest Art Orchestra
• Explore every hand-painted inch of The Mortuga Submarine, where not all is as it seems...
*Voice audio is only in English
70010000131287.intro: An impossible locked-room murder: Captain Mortuga lies dead beside an ancient cauldron aboard the world’s strangest submarine, crewed by sketchy suspects.
70010000131287.name: The Mermaid Mask

70010000131293.description:
Through Nintendo Switch™ 2, a girl living in another world keeps you company while you work at your desk.

Memory of Memorie : A Chill Story is a work adventure where the story progresses together with the time you spend working, as you share your desk time with Memorie, an apprentice witch.

In a quiet room filled with gentle Celtic music, whenever you sit down to work, Memorie studies magic by your side.

What used to be solitary work time slowly becomes something warmer: time shared with someone.

■ The more you focus, the more the story unfolds

The game features a Pomodoro-based focus timer. As you accumulate focused work sessions, conversations with Memorie and events in her world gradually unlock.

Everyday chats.
Small changes creeping into the village.
And the secret she keeps hidden.

Beyond your work, a new piece of the story awaits.

■ Your focus changes her world

As the story progresses, Memorie's room gradually begins to change.

Her favorite cup.
The glow of magic.
A space growing warmer and richer.

The more you keep going, the more her world moves forward too.

■ Features

・A cozy fantasy workspace with Celtic music and ambient sounds
・A Pomodoro-technique-based focus timer
・Story and world mysteries unlocked through your focus time
・A room that changes as the story progresses
・A calendar system to track your daily focus
・A companion for studying, working, creative projects, and all kinds of desk work

■ The World

The story takes place in Elmana Village, a small settlement not far from the Imperial Capital. It is a peaceful place protected by the sacred Lightroot Tree.

But little by little, a dark presence begins to creep into the world.

Using a spell that connects distant people, Memorie found you. Was it coincidence, or...?

Stay focused, and see the story through to its ending together.
70010000131293.intro:
The more you focus, the more the story unfolds.
A chill work adventure with a girl from another world.
Focus time no longer spent alone, for you.
70010000131293.name: Memory of Memorie : A Chill Story – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000131366.description:
Domesticated animals get wild in roguelike arena shooter combat where survival is all that matters! Pick 1 of 14 playable pets, each with unique skills and stats, as they face hordes of fantasy monsters like slimes, rock giants, oversized bugs, carnivorous plants and more in top-down retro pixel art style.

Choose wisely from a dozen starting weapons, then select a level from areas you’ve unlocked. Take down waves of enemies while strategically keeping your distance from danger. Level up and choose upgrades mid-battle, all in preparation for a big boss showdown. If you succeed, you’ll bank coins you’ve collected to spend on permanent perks, thus stacking the deck in your favor for the next fight!

• Survive waves of incoming enemies in addictive real-time arena combat!
• Choose from more than a dozen domesticated animals.
• Pick a starting weapon and upgrade on-the-fly as you level up!
• Collect coins to spend on permanent stat boosts between stages.
• Use character-specific skills to turn the tide of battle!
• Enjoy retro pixel art aesthetics and multiple difficulty options!
70010000131366.intro: Fend off waves of monsters as a dog, cat, chicken and other unlockable furry or feathered friends!
70010000131366.name: Pets Survivors

70010000131421.description:
In this world, strong and beautiful women compete in a tournament known as the Queen’s Blade. The most powerful warrior will claim the crown and rule over all.

Choose your warrior and embark on a journey to challenge the ultimate ruler, Queen Aldra.
Navigate through randomized choices, defeat your rivals, and collect new cards to strengthen your deck. Unleash devastating combos on your path to becoming the new Queen!

The card battles take place in real time, putting your skills to the test.
(*Turn-based battles can also be selected based on your preference.)

The key to victory is the Armor Break system. Every warrior’s armor is split into three zones: high, mid, and low. Shatter your opponent's armor first?once their defenses are completely stripped away, strike with a decisive blow!

As you progress, you will unlock new warriors, cards, and even tougher rivals.
For those looking to push their limits, a challenge mode called "Path to the Strongest" awaits. Will you be able to defeat the true Queen?
70010000131421.intro: A rogue-lite deck-building game featuring beautiful warriors has arrived!
70010000131421.name: Queen's Blade Re:Build

70010000131450.description:
In The Royal Writ, you don't just play cards - you command them on the battlefield. Place your loyal subjects strategically as they advance toward the enemy, dealing damage. But beware: any card that reaches the enemy base before victory is permanently destroyed and removed from your deck for the rest of your run.

Sacrifice isn't just a risk - it's an essential strategy that creates memorable sub-stories with each run. Will you honour the subjects who gave everything for your cause? Every fallen card tells a tale, and their glory lives on in the legacy you build.

Lead an army of adorable yet battle-hardened animals with abilities to shape your strategy. Your ranks may comprise a frail and wounded flamingo, a short sighted chicken bowman, or even a crafty lizard who cheats death by only losing its tail! From the renegade red ants to the sacrificial lamb, every card in your deck has a personality and purpose.

As they march toward glory or death, their individual stories become part of your kingdom's legacy, and their sacrifices will never be forgotten. You may even come across some peculiar creatures on your journey, like the crazed mantis dentist, the goat tactician or the impatient boar shopkeeper - just don’t ask them where they got their credentials.

Conquer the realm through two distinct adventures:

The First Campaign pits you against a growing rebellion as you try to maintain the king’s good and just rule (objectively). Battle your way through a challenging environment filled with deep pits and poison swamps as you try to suppress your enemies. As you progress, you may start to wonder if there are more to the kingdom’s troubles than meet the eye?

The Second Campaign introduces a new threat - gunpowder. As new experimental weapons now enter the battlefield, your strategy must change. No longer are you simply avoiding the environmental hazards - you must dodge an onslaught of bullets to ensure you and your troops are not fatally wounded as you march forth.

Each campaign features unique cards, bosses, and strategic challenges. The battlefield awaits your command!
Intuitive Yet Deep Gameplay - Easy to learn without compromising on the challenge
Roguelike Progression - Every run is different
Card Permadeath - Lost cards stay lost!
Charming Art Style - Picture-book visuals blend with medieval absurdity and dark humour
Memorable NPC Encounters - Are they friend or foe?
Special Boss Mechanics - Unique challenges that will test you
Gradual Difficulty Ladder - Climb through harder and harder difficulties as you progress
Challenge Modes - Test your skills in special modes with unique rules
Relics - Collect relics with various effects that change how you play

From an ancient royal decree:

"The art of war is simple. Send forth your subjects to die gloriously in your name. Their sacrifice ensures your legacy... and if they happen to win, all the better!"

Will you write your name in the annals of history, or become just another forgotten monarch? The balance between loss and triumph is yours to master.

All hail! May your fallen be remembered  and your victories sweet!
70010000131450.intro: Sacrifice creates stories in this medieval roguelike deckbuilder. Watch your cards march to glory or permanent death as they battle toward the enemy.
70010000131450.name: The Royal Writ

70010000131477.description:
We all know the rules of horror by heart. The maniac killer always walks slowly while you sprint for your life. There's always a suspiciously large ventilation shaft to crawl through. The walls are inevitably covered in cryptic, bloody messages, such as "REDRUM." We've seen it all a thousand times before. But what if those predictable tropes suddenly stopped working the way they were supposed to?

Welcome to Horror Cliche, a first-person meta-adventure that turns the terrifying tropes you love to hate completely upside down. This isn't a game about surviving the night; it's a game about surviving absurdity. Navigate dark, atmospheric environments where monsters monologue about genre flaws, jump scares become punchlines, and typical survival instincts lead to unexpected outcomes.

The game features 7 uniquely crafted levels, each designed to poke fun at a different horror movie or game trope. Although you can jump into any level from the beginning, playing them in order reveals a hilarious, self-aware journey that pokes fun at the movies and games we love to be scared by. Grab your flashlight, ignore the ominous bloody handprints, and prepare for a horror experience!
70010000131477.intro: The rules of horror are meant to be broken...
70010000131477.name: Horror Cliche

70010000131522.description:
Burn rubber through endless highways in the ultimate high-speed traffic racer. Weave between oncoming cars, dodge slower traffic, and push your reflexes to the limit as the road never ends.

Features:

23 Sports Cars — Unlock and tune a garage of 23 sports cars, each with its own handling and top speed. Find the ride that matches your driving style.

Infinite Roads — Our procedural road generation system means no two runs are ever the same. The highway stretches on forever, so the only finish line is the one your skills set.

Dynamic Weather & Levels — Race across multiple environments and conditions, from blazing sunshine to treacherous ice. Adapt your driving as grip and visibility shift beneath your wheels.

Multiple Camera Views — Switch between cockpit, chase, and other camera angles to race exactly the way you like it. Go first-person for the adrenaline rush or pull back for total control.

Front Crash Mode — Crave chaos? Flip on Front Crash Mode and embrace the carnage as you barrel head-on into traffic for maximum impact.

Floor it. Dodge everything. Survive the rush.
70010000131522.intro: Outrun the traffic. Outlast the chaos.
70010000131522.name: Xtreme Traffic Racing

70010000131535.description:
Take on the ultimate takoyaki challenge on Nintendo Switch™!
Add the batter and ingredients, then flip the takoyaki with a pick!
Play with up to 4 players using one Joy-Con™ controller each!

Enjoy a variety of game modes!
Cause chaos with items and random events in Party Battle, test your skills against friends in Battle, or make takoyaki to order in Score Attack!

Become a takoyaki master!

《Rules》
Make takoyaki using a takoyaki maker!
The better they turn out, the more points you earn!
Make as many as you can before time runs out!

《How to Play》
1. Fill each hole in the pan with batter and ingredients.

2. When the takoyaki starts to brown, use a pick to flip it over! Be careful not to act too quickly or too slowly! Once both sides are fully cooked, the takoyaki is done!

[Party Battle]
The feature mode of Super Takoyaki Battle is "Party Battle!"
Chaos erupts as up to 4 players compete on one giant grill!
Unique events occur to change the flow of the match!
Use items to gain the advantage over your opponents!
It's anyone's game until the very last second!

[Score Attack]
Master 3 different makers—home, food stall, and commercial—each with its own unique challenges!
Cook up as many takoyaki as you can, fill orders, and aim for a high score!

[Battle]
Compete with up to 4 players to see who's the ultimate takoyaki chef!
You can also challenge CPU opponents!

[Rankings]
Compete for high scores against players from around the world!
Become a takoyaki master!
70010000131535.intro:
Experience takoyaki-making like never before!
Make as many as you can in an all-out battle!
70010000131535.name: Super Takoyaki Battle

70010000131583.description:
You are one of the last flying drones, untouched by the virus.
You are faced with a quiet but crucial mission: penetrate the depths of the infected bunker and find what remains hidden within its sections. Something that will later play a key role in the fate of the entire complex.

With each level, the corridors become more dangerous: external mechanisms, security traps, closed blocks that are easy to crash into—all hidden in the darkness. But the drone has a special vision; it can see what is normally invisible, and sometimes there's a chance that it can protect you from range.

Along the way, you'll have to deal with epic bosses—malfunctioning security machines and twisted structures, whose virus has transformed into something unpredictable.

To the Basement: Before is a side-scrolling arcade game where flight, maneuvering, devastating humidity, traps, and boss fights intertwine in a single, grim journey through a contaminated area.
Test your resilience and willpower in these challenges!
70010000131583.intro:
Perform precise movements
Defeat the bosses
Complete the levels
70010000131583.name: To the Basement: Before

70010000131595.description:
Ready to pop some bubbles? Match colors, trigger exciting combos, and clear challenging puzzles one shot at a time.

Enjoy intuitive controls, satisfying gameplay, and hundreds of relaxing moments as each level brings new challenges and colorful fun.
70010000131595.name: Bubble Shooter: Color Splash

70010000131601.description:
Forget slow, methodical flight sims—Drone Attack unadulterated, fast-paced aerial carnage. You’re tossed into the digital cockpit of a heavily armed drone and tasked with one simple objective: absolute devastation. The controls are razor-sharp, letting you scream across the terrain, thread the needle through a storm of anti-air fire, and strike with lethal precision.

But what truly elevates the power fantasy is how incredibly heavy the destruction feels. Powered by gorgeous, impactful 3D graphics, every strafing run and missile strike lands with a satisfying, visceral crunch. It’s loud, it’s chaotic, and it’s beautifully explosive.

KEY FEATURES:

-Fast-Paced Aerial Carnage: Master the flight mechanics of an agile combat drone. The combat demands aggressive speed and precision, letting you dodge, weave, and return fire without breaking a sweat.
-Total Base Destruction: Leave nothing standing. Wipe out radar towers, SAM sites, and sprawling military compounds. Dropping a full missile payload sends stunning shockwaves through the battlefield, reducing towering bases to ash in seconds.
-Visceral 3D Graphics: Experience the heat of battle with gorgeous visual effects. Every time your rotary cannons shred enemy armor, you'll feel it through highly detailed, physics-heavy explosions.
-Deep Hangar Customization: Between white-knuckle sorties, hit the Hangar to cash in your hard-earned Command Points. Bolt on thicker armor, overclock your engines, and unlock weapon tiers that border on war crimes.
-Tactical Resource Management: Aggression is rewarded, but carelessness gets you killed. Knowing exactly when to vent your weapon heat and when to unleash a lethal barrage is the difference between victory and becoming scrap metal.
70010000131601.intro: Rain hell. Leave ash. Master the ultimate drone.
70010000131601.name: Drones Attack

70010000131688.description:
■About This Game
Hololive Fantasy, the unit featuring 〈Houshou Marine〉〈Shirogane Noel〉〈Shiranui Flare〉 and 〈Usada Pekora〉, enters the biggest free-for-all battle of the century in pursuit of the wish-granting “Queen’s Throne”!
Experience “oshi victory” by winning with your oshi in this 2.5D versus action game for up to four players!
That's ‘Hololive Fantasy Battle’

■How to Play
・[Move] → [Attack] That’s it!
・Use unique attacks to stagger opponents, knock them back, and gain the upper hand!
・Obtaining a Red Super Weapon drastically changes your attacks!
・Launch the game-changing “Solo Live,” and let your oshi dominate the stage!

■Costume Change
・Your oshi is already cute enough, but now they’ll become even cuter. Can you darlings handle it?!

■Versus Mode: "Online Battle"
・Up to 4 players clash in an all-out brawl to decide the winner!
・Expand your strategy with combinations of [Each Talent's Unique Ability] × [Field Gimmicks]!

■Solo / Co-op Mode: "Fake Hunter"
・For one reason or another, fake 3rd Gen members and fake 3rd Gen fans have appeared all over the place and are causing chaos. Time to make them reflect… ORAA!!
・Fight solo with NPC allies, or team up with friends and other players online!
・No worries if an ally goes down! With the "Rescue Totsumachi" feature, you can rescue fallen teammates—or have them rescue you.
70010000131688.intro:
【Breaking News】
-Hololive 3rd Generation Members Unleash Chaos in Battle-
70010000131688.name: Hololive Fantasy Battle

70010000131713.description:
Collect puzzles with photorealistic images of girls in spectacular outfits, enjoy convenient touch controls and feel the process at your fingertips.

Relaxing music creates the right mood, and gradually increasing difficulty turns each level into an exciting challenge. After assembly, you can carefully examine each image and appreciate all the details.

Features:

• Photorealistic images.

• Realistic assembly process.

• Gradually increasing difficulty.

• Relaxing music.

• Detailed image viewing.
70010000131713.name: Hidden Girls: Private Nights

70010000131763.description:
Word Hive is a word puzzle game where each puzzle gives you seven letters: six outer letters and one required center letter. Create as many words as possible using the letters provided, but every word must include the center letter.

Letters can be reused, and words must be at least four letters long. Longer words earn more points, while special words that use all seven letters give bonus points.

Progress through ranks as your score grows, challenge yourself to find every hidden word, and become the ultimate word master.

Challenge your mind, discover new words, sharpen your vocabulary, and enjoy a fun word puzzle experience with every game.

Word Hive uses an American English word dictionary.

Features:
• Play through more than 2,000 word puzzle levels
• Create words using seven letters, including the required center letter
• Discover pangrams by finding words that use all seven letters
• Learn and discover new English words as you play
• Compete with other players through the online leaderboard
• Resume your last played game and continue from where you left off
• Play in Handheld Mode, Tabletop Mode, or TV Mode
70010000131763.intro: Build words, score points, and master the hive.
70010000131763.name: WordHive

70010000131769.description:
Peaceful, atmospheric exploration experience set in a dense, mysterious forest. Players are invited to wander through a quiet natural world filled with subtle details, hidden routes, and environmental storytelling. Rather than focusing on action or pressure-driven objectives, the experience emphasizes curiosity, discovery, and immersion in a calm, handcrafted setting.

As you move deeper into the woods, you gradually uncover the secrets woven into the landscape. Every path can lead to something new—whether it’s a hidden clearing, an unusual landmark, or a quiet moment that adds to the sense of mystery. The game encourages slow exploration and observation, rewarding players who take their time to look closely at the world around them.

Designed with a minimalist and relaxing approach, Green Thicket aims to create a soothing experience suitable for short sessions or longer, more meditative play. Its focus on atmosphere and exploration makes it ideal for players who enjoy discovery-driven games and tranquil environments.
70010000131769.intro: Relaxing exploration game where you wander through a mysterious forest, uncover hidden paths, and interact with the world at your own pace.
70010000131769.name: Green Thicket

70010000131777.description:
Can you spot what does not belong?
Chameleon Dummy Hunt is a colorful first-person hidden-object action game where sneaky dummy characters are hiding in plain sight. They are painted to blend into walls, floors, furniture, props, shadows, patterns, and bright environments.

Your mission is simple: search the level, find every camouflaged dummy, and blast them with your paint gun before time runs out.

Look closely. A strange shape on the wall, a color that feels slightly off, a dummy sitting like a decoration, or a suspicious object in the corner could be your next target. Some dummies stand still, some sit, some crouch, some lie on the floor, and some are hidden so well that you may walk right past them.

But be careful. Shooting the wrong object can cost you time and score. Use your scanner wisely when you are stuck, stay focused, and clear each level as fast as possible.

With 20 levels, multiple dummy poses, tricky camouflage, time-based challenges, score rewards, and controller-friendly gameplay, Chameleon Dummy Hunt turns every environment into a playful test of attention, speed, and visual skill.

Find them. Paint them. Hunt them.
70010000131777.intro:
Can you spot what does not belong?
Chameleon Dummy Hunt is a colorful first-person hidden-object action game where sneaky dummy charact
70010000131777.name: Chameleon Dummy Hunt

70010000131808.description:
Tamarack Narrows is a town running out of time - fading industry, mounting resentment, and a blood-red aurora bleeding across the sky. On the night of a centennial celebration meant to save it all, an unknown visitor arrives promising salvation, and brings something far older instead.

Play through the interwoven perspectives of Sarah Walker, her sister Bree, and the townsfolk caught in the town's final, unraveling night. Blending retro-style visuals, VHS-style distortion, and fixed-camera exploration, Act 0 stands on its own - no prior knowledge of the series required.

This is the night the story begins. This is the night Tamarack Narrows changed forever.

Features:
- Multi-perspective narrative following Sarah, Bree, and the townsfolk of Tamarack Narrows
- Analog-horror visuals: CRT distortion, VHS noise, and retro-style art
- Fixed-camera exploration through a collapsing prairie town
- A standalone prequel that expands the Boreal Tenebrae universe
- Atmospheric soundtrack shifting from nostalgia to dissonance
70010000131808.intro: A prequel narrative adventure set the night a dying prairie town collapses into fire, static, and cosmic horror.
70010000131808.name: Boreal Tenebrae Act 0

70010000131814.description:
Slime Rebellion! Small and adorable slimes have started a bouncing rebellion, filling up the entire screen. Dive right into this unstoppable commotion!

◆ Unstoppable Addiction
With simple and intuitive controls, anyone can easily jump in, but once you're hooked, there's no way out.

◆ The Fun of Growing with Various Elements
Build diverse skill trees using the loot you earn from battles. Add special abilities like striking lightning with cards and relics or summoning a bouncing boomerang that deals damage off walls, and grow in your own unique way!

◆ Diverse Skills and Refreshing Impact
Experience the thrill of wiping the screen clean with mercenary skills! Freeze enemies, drop meteors to defeat them, and use special weapons that deal massive Area of Effect (AoE) damage to feel an incredibly satisfying impact.

※ Caution ※
Be careful, your time might just vanish!
70010000131814.intro: The World's Cutest Chaos, Squishy Slime Commotion!
70010000131814.name: No More Slimes!!

70010000131835.description:
By merging identical items, you create stronger versions and decide what to develop next. Your goal is to strategically combine resources and prepare your heroes for the upcoming night, where any mistake could cost them their lives.

It's not about armor or crests anymore. The hour has come for those whose power is born of the very nature of rage and magic. It's time for new heroes to take up what has become their continuation: a jagged staff that has absorbed the wrath of the earth; a taut bow singing the songs of the wind; a battered grimoire in which the souls of forgotten gods whisper. Their battle is not a battle pattern, but a ritual.

Everything happens in a tense rhythm of day and night. During the day, you can combine items on the field and collect ready-made supplies in your supplies. At night, when the world is frozen in terror, all you can do is desperately try to put the pieces together.
70010000131835.intro:
Merge cards to upgrade
Upgrade your character
Defeat all monsters
70010000131835.name: Bone Marrow 2

70010000131846.description:
Join Loree, a brave and curious penguin, on a colorful 3D platforming adventure! Wearing his signature red propeller hat and cozy green scarf, Loree waddles, jumps, and glides his way through dozens of imaginative levels packed with challenges, secrets, and surprises.

Features:
• Dozens of levels spread across vibrant, themed worlds
• Collect coins to unlock new playable characters
• Race against the clock and earn up to 3 stars per level for a perfect run
• Simple, intuitive controls — easy to pick up, fun to master
• Charming low-poly art style paired with a cute pixel-art interface
• Explore everything from frosty mountain peaks to mysterious ruins

Whether you're chasing perfect star times on every level or just looking for a relaxing hop through cute, colorful worlds, Loree 3D offers approachable, family-friendly platforming fun for players of all ages.

Grab your propeller hat and start waddling — adventure awaits!
70010000131846.intro: Waddle into adventure with Loree, a fearless penguin explorer! Race through colorful 3D worlds, dodge obstacles, and collect coins for family fun.
70010000131846.name: Loree 3D

70010000131855.description:
STORY

Five years.

Five years on the run, spent hiding from surveillance cameras, police checks ... and friends.

In an attempt to elude the cult that's been chasing him, former Miami detective Lazarus “Lars” Bundy is in Italy working incognito for a security agency when his client is murdered in cold blood by a sharpshooter. As the blood stain slowly spreads on the victim's clothes, Lars realizes there is only one way to keep his past from catching up with him: solve the case before the police and bring the perpetrator to justice as quickly and silently as possible.

A senseless murder, conflicting clues and an indistinct lead will thrust the former detective on another thrilling journey around the world, from majestic Rome to the Land of the Rising Sun by way of Jordan and India. With help from an old ally he thought he’d left behind for good, Lars finds himself swept up in a case far more complex and dangerous than he ever could have imagined, filled with international mystery and mysticism. And all the while, a much more personal danger lurks close at hand, one that Lars is determined to suppress and keep hidden from the world.

FEATURES

> A new point-and-click adventure game inspired by the golden age classics
> Compelling blend of comedy, supernatural mystery, and conspiracy-steeped intrigue
> Alternate control between Lars and his returning cohort Alice
> Challenging but logical puzzles seamlessly integrated into the story
> Explore more than 50 stylish hand-drawn HD locations across Rome, Jordan, India and Japan
> Original atmospheric soundtrack and full English voice-overs (with German and Italian subtitles)
> Sequel to the acclaimed "The Hand of Glory" (95% positive reviews online), though no prior familiarity is necessary
70010000131855.intro: After five years in hiding, detective Lazarus “Lars” Bundy is swept up in another globe-trotting supernatural mystery whose origins trace back to a legend about the creation of Earth itself.
70010000131855.name: Roots in the Sky - The Hand of Glory 2

70010000131886.description:
Project City is a top-down open-city action game inspired by the chaotic feel of classic arcade crime sandboxes. Hit the streets in a drivable city full of traffic, pedestrians, shops, police, gangs, odd jobs, and escalating trouble.

Earn cash by running taxi fares, package drops, food deliveries, and risky crew work, or push your luck with ATM hacks and weapon shop visits. Slide into drift challenges, dodge police heat, avoid spike strips and roadblocks, and keep moving when the city turns against you. Every run is about choosing how far to hustle, how much chaos to cause, and whether you can survive long enough to cash out.
With fast driving, on-foot exploration, wanted levels, city events, weapons, interiors, leaderboards, and a sharp street-comedy tone, Project City is a compact urban mayhem sandbox built around simple controls and constant trouble.
70010000131886.intro: Drive, drift, hustle, and survive a city that reacts to every bad decision.
70010000131886.name: Project City

70010000131917.description:
Step into the chaotic world of Rasterfire, a fast-paced top-down shooter inspired by the golden age of arcade action.

Fight your way through dangerous environments filled with hostile enemies, incoming projectiles and deadly obstacles. Keep moving, aim carefully and use your limited space to avoid attacks while returning fire. Every encounter tests your reactions, positioning and ability to survive under pressure.

The battlefield is viewed from above and presented in a distinctive retro pixel-art style, enhanced by CRT scanlines, vivid effects and an energetic arcade atmosphere. Enemies can attack from multiple directions, so staying alert is just as important as having a quick trigger finger.

Clear each area, survive increasingly intense battles and push forward through waves of opposition. Whether you are chasing a higher score or simply trying to reach the end, every round offers a compact dose of old-school shooting action.

Features:

Fast-paced top-down shooting gameplay
Retro pixel-art graphics with CRT-inspired effects
Multiple enemy types and dangerous attack patterns
Responsive controls designed for quick arcade action
Increasingly intense combat encounters
A dark, energetic soundtrack and classic shooter atmosphere

Load your weapon, enter the crosshairs and see how long you can survive in Rasterfire.
70010000131917.intro: Enter a fast-paced retro shooter filled with pixel-art action, dangerous enemies and relentless gunfire. Aim carefully, survive each encounter and clear your path through the battlefield.
70010000131917.name: RasterFire

70010000131942.description:
THE ARCADE CLASSICS YOU GREW UP WITH. REBUILT FOR TODAY.

The year is 2085. A runaway mega-intelligence called the Algorithm has decided humanity is obsolete, and unleashed millions of networked humanoid robots to make sure of it. You are one of the anomalies: minds the Algorithm could never map, predict, or control. Grab a controller and start fighting back.

RETROBOT: 2085 is a fast, frantic twin-stick shooter made in the style of a spiritual successor to one of your arcade favourites - a love letter to the golden age of the arcade, modernised with a fully 3D retro art style and that unmistakable 8-bit bleep-and-bloop soundtrack.

• ENDLESS ROBOTIC HORDES - Dismantle wave after wave of humanoid robots across dozens of levels, each one more relentless than the last.
• RESCUE THE LAST HUMAN FAMILY - Find every survivor scattered through the level. Reach them and they're rescued instantly for huge bonus points.
• CHASE THE HIGH SCORE - Classic arcade scoring, extra lives, and a leaderboard to settle who's the best, once and for all. Earn your spot - and your initials - at the top of the table.
• 4-PLAYER LOCAL MULTIPLAYER - Connect extra controllers and team up with up to three friends for chaotic local multiplayer action.
• TUNED FOR THE PAD - Precision twin-stick controls built around a controller, the way modern arcade action is meant to be played.
• A SECRET WORTH FINDING - Enter a classic secret code (remember these?) to unlock the hidden Service Menu, where you can switch on classic-style waves and controls for the original arcade experience.

Everything is playable from the start - no purchases required to unlock content, no forced progression systems gating your progress. Just you, an endless robot horde, and a high score table calling your name. How far can you get? Grab a friend (or three) and find out.
70010000131942.name: Retrobot: 2085

70010000131963.description:
Klondike Classic is the perfect solitaire experience for players who enjoy classic card games and relaxing puzzles.

Choose your favorite card back and enjoy a clean, elegant design focused on the classic Klondike experience.

Play at your own pace, sharpen your mind, and enjoy the timeless appeal of classic Solitaire!
70010000131963.intro: Relax and enjoy the timeless classic. Challenge yourself with the world's most beloved solitaire card game!
70010000131963.name: Klondike Classic

70010000131979.description:
When two of the same dog touch, BAM! You get a BIGGER dog. With careful placement, some clever purchases, and a can-do attitude, you can merge pups strategically and achieve the biggest dogs imaginable.

You really shouldn't adopt a dozen dogs, but now you can! Dogpile gets you to wrangle a cute collection of canines into the perfect deck, customize them, and play them expertly. Manage the clutter, upgrade and improve your cards as you go, and strive for the BIGGEST dogs.

Like in real life, dogs come with quirks and untapped potential! You’ll discover any variety of weird traits such as Barky, Sleepy, Timid, Cool and more. Take your dogs to the Dog Wash to add even more traits, and find Dog Tags that bolster and benefit from Trait synergy!

Utilize a clever array of powerful Dog Tags to modify how your dogs and their Traits function. Find interesting synergies and unique combos to aid you in all of your merging endeavors. And always remember your ultimate goal: BIGGER!

PLEASE NOTE: This product is released for the Nintendo Switch. It can also be played on Nintendo Switch 2. However, please note that a separate product, "Dogpile", is available exclusively for Nintendo Switch 2.
Save data and Additional Contents are not compatible between the two versions. Please be careful to avoid duplicate or mistaken purchases.
Nintendo Switch 2 Edition and Upgrade Pack are not available for this product.
70010000131979.intro: Dogpile is a roguelike deck builder about merging cute dogs into bigger dogs. Play dogs, get money, customize your dogs with special Traits, refine your deck, PLAY MORE DOGS! DOGS!
70010000131979.name: Dogpile

70010000131994.description:
Step into the shadows and put your stealth skills to the test in a tense game of infiltration, timing, and escape.

Explore guarded buildings filled with valuable items while police officers patrol the corridors. Observe their movements, learn their routes, and wait for the perfect moment to sneak past them. One careless step can expose your position and turn a carefully planned robbery into a desperate attempt to escape.

Stay out of sight, use corners and rooms to avoid detection, and collect as much loot as possible before making your way to safety. Every corridor presents a new risk, forcing you to decide whether to grab another valuable item or leave before the patrol returns.

Success depends on patience, awareness, and smart movement. Study your surroundings, adapt to changing situations, and avoid rushing into danger. The more confident you become, the more daring your robberies can be.

Can you take the loot, avoid every patrol, and escape without getting caught?
70010000131994.intro: Sneak through guarded corridors, avoid police patrols, and steal valuable loot without being detected. Study their routes, stay out of sight, and escape before the law catches up with you.
70010000131994.name: Loot Before the Law

70010000132002.description:
Move through 3D space to find hints, solve mysteries and escape from the room.
Anyone can play to the end because you can see hints and answers.
70010000132002.name: Escape game R00M18

70010000132020.description:
Jump into the colorful world of Aetherfall - a 3D platformer packed with precise jumps, evolving mechanics, and challenges suspended high above the abyss.

Explore a variety of levels, leap between floating platforms, collect coins, and use the environment to open new paths forward. Buttons, crates, moving obstacles, and new mechanics keep each stage fresh and introduce new ways to overcome challenges.

Each chapter brings its own set of ideas and obstacles, ending with a unique boss fight that puts everything you’ve learned along the way to the test.

In Aetherfall, you’ll find:
- Dynamic 3D platforming
- A variety of mechanics
- Secrets and coins to collect
- Environmental puzzle elements
- Diverse locations and challenges
- A boss fight at the end of every chapter
70010000132020.intro: Jump, explore, and master new mechanics as you make your way deeper into the world of Aetherfall.
70010000132020.name: Aetherfall

70010000132026.description:
A deadly outbreak has turned the city into a territory of the infected. Follow the trail of Dr. Varga and Project Lazarus — humanity's last chance to stop the infection.

Fight through a full mission-based zombie survival campaign spanning 15 chapters and 29 missions. Explore ruined hospitals, contaminated sewers, abandoned farms, industrial zones, railways, underground stations and devastated city streets while uncovering the truth behind the outbreak.

Your mission is more than simply staying alive. Restore generators, activate communication relays, defend strategic positions, escort Dr. Varga, protect the mobile laboratory and hold back increasingly dangerous waves of infected.

Build your arsenal and prepare for different threats as every new area pushes the operation closer to its final objective.

Project Lazarus may contain the key to a cure — but the data must survive long enough to be transmitted.

Features:

Mission-based first-person zombie survival action
15 chapters and 29 campaign missions
Multiple environments and combat scenarios
Escort and protection objectives
Generator and power restoration missions
Relay activation and defense objectives
Mobile laboratory escort missions
Multiple weapons and equipment
Different infected enemy types
Story-driven campaign centered on Project Lazarus
Final extraction and last-stand battles

Find Dr. Varga. Protect the Lazarus data. Fight through the outbreak and make sure humanity's last hope reaches extraction.
70010000132026.intro: Complete the mission. Protect the cure. Survive the outbreak.
70010000132026.name: Zombie Outbreak: Last Stand Survival

70010000132032.description:
"Mr.Do!'s Castle" is an action game released by UNIVERSAL in 1983.
Take control of a clown character and defeat the unicorns. Use your hammer to knock blocks down and crush the unicorns to defeat them.
Make clever use of the stage mechanics by changing ladder directions to alter your path or trapping unicorns in holes to immobilize them!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.
70010000132032.name: Arcade Archives Mr.Do!'s Castle

70010000132046.description:
You've just become the manager of the rookie idol group, "♡Melonchu♡"!
To make their debut concert a roaring success, dating any of the active idols is absolutely, 100% off-limits...!
And yet, romance flags keep popping up left and right, and the members' affection levels are already at MAX from the very start!
How on earth will you navigate this crisis?!
An otome game industry first (!?)—a slapstick rom-com where romance is strictly forbidden!

■ Story & Art (Scenario/Illustration): MikiMaki
【Game Features】
Fully voiced (excluding the protagonist)
Customizable protagonist name
8 unique endings
70010000132046.intro: Trigger a romance flag with an idol, and it’s a BAD END!
70010000132046.name: Can I Not Fall for Idols?

70010000132052.description:
Saddle up and ride back into the Wild West with the gunslinging ex-Marshal, James Anderson, and face off against the good, the bad, and the even worse this side of the Mississippi as you work to uncover a twisted plot of greed and corruption. With your trusty six-shooting .45 Revolver, Scoped .44 Rifle, 10-Gauge Shotgun, and good ol' Sawed-Off 12-Gauge Shotgun, you'll be packin' plenty of firepower to take out all manner of outlaw varmints.

Outlaws + Handful of Missions features high-resolution, uncompressed cutscenes and updated visuals for weapons, characters, and enemies, all fully recreated from archived art and stylized to match the original look with full color palettes. Outlaws + Handful of Missions also offers Cross-Play Multiplayer with game modes including Deathmatch, Team Play, Capture the Flag, and Kill The Fool With The Chicken!

It's Payback Time.

Outlaws + Handful of Missions Remastered Key Features:
- Engaging first-person ground combat featuring five weapon types.
- Modernized Joy-Con™ and Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller support, adding a new weapon wheel.
- A Vault filled with a treasure trove of behind-the-scenes gold nuggets.
70010000132052.intro: The Most Dangerous Man is the One with Nothing Left to Lose.
70010000132052.name: Outlaws + Handful of Missions: Remaster - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000132109.description:
Your worst nightmare has become your reality. You are the latest captive of a notorious, masked serial killer, imprisoned in his grim subterranean dungeon. Through the cracked walls, you can hear the horrifying screams of other victims meeting gruesome ends. Your cell door is just the first obstacle. To survive, you must navigate a house of horrors, solve twisted puzzles, and find a way out before the killer starts up his chainsaw.

Your captor is highly observant and constantly patrols his territory. Stealth and meticulous attention to detail are your only hope. If you open a drawer, pick a lock, or move an object, you must return it exactly as you found it. If he notices even a trace of your escape attempt, he will hunt you down with relentless fury. Navigate the claustrophobic brick hallways by the dim light of your lantern. Squeeze through tight vents and witness the grim machinery of his torture chamber from the shadows. Stay quiet, think logically under pressure, and cover your tracks perfectly. Can you outsmart the ultimate predator, or will you become just another voice screaming in the dark?
70010000132109.intro: Leave No Trace. He is Always Watching.
70010000132109.name: Captive

70010000132116.description:
SOMA is a horror and science fiction video game from Frictional Games. It is a haunting story about identity, consciousness and what it means to be human.

The radio doesn't work, food is scarce and machines have begun to believe they are people. The submerged PATHOS-II facility has suffered terrible isolation and difficult decisions will have to be made. What to do? What makes sense? What is left to fight for?

Enter the world of SOMA and confront the horrors submerged in the depths of the ocean. Rummage through locked terminals and secret documents to uncover the truth behind the chaos. Search for the last inhabitants and take part in the events that will ultimately shape the fate of the station. But beware, danger lurks around every corner: corrupt humans, twisted creatures, mad robots and even an inscrutable and omnipresent A.I..
You'll need to figure out how to deal with each one. Just remember there's no turning back, either you defeat your enemies or get ready to run.
70010000132116.intro: A masterpiece of psychological horror. Fight to survive in a hostile world that will make you question your own existence.
70010000132116.name: SOMA - Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition

70010000132120.description:
《Story》
Tokyo has collapsed. In a city where reality itself is eroding, grotesque entities known as 《Aberrations》 roam the ruined streets.
While working as a simple delivery boy, Souma Hoshigami is brutally attacked by an Aberration—leaving him in a fractured, 'Half-turned' state where man and monster fuse into one. He is rescued and taken into custody not as a citizen, but as 'lost property' by Rena Hizuki, a lethal investigator from the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department's Public Safety Department, Foreign Affairs Fifth Division (commonly known as the Public Safety Mutation Response Division).
Step into the shoes of Rena and Souma in a world choking on reality-shattering contamination.
Track down 'Tiny True,' the demonic narcotic flooding the streets. Uncover the truth behind 'Stigmas,' the cursed body-carved glyphs infecting the youth. Expose the mysterious cult pulling the strings from the shadows. Engage in fast-paced, hyper-stylish combat to slice through terrifying foes and unravel the mystery of a world tearing at the seams.

《Battle System》
Unleash total dominance with a refreshing, high-octane combat system. Master the flow of time itself as you stack and chain devastating skills to obliterate your enemies with massive, satisfying combos.

◆ The Timeline Innovation
Predict. React. Intercept. The combat interface features a dynamic, timeline-driven gauge that exposes the exact timing and nature of incoming enemy attacks.
Use this timeline to program your own skills, shatter enemy offensives, and take complete control of the battlefield.
Slow down time or pause the action at any moment to analyze tactical forecasts, track cooldowns, and execute precise strategies.
Whether you are delivering a punishing counter-attack or slipping buffs into the narrow gaps of an enemy’s onslaught, victory is determined by your strategic intellect.

◆ Master the Speed of Combat
While the timeline offers deep, strategic contemplation, the combat scales with your skill. As you master the mechanics, the gameplay transforms into an aggressive, adrenaline-fueled experience that rivals pure action games!
Will you play with relentless aggression, or stay cool and intellectual to dissect formidable bosses?
Choose your combat style, slash through bizarre threats with unparalleled flair, and conquer the ultimate anomalies.

《Immersive Voice Acting》
Experience a fully voiced, gripping narrative that drags you straight into the heart of the crisis.

《Cutting-Edge Visuals》
Immerse yourself in a vibrant, cel-shaded art style paired with custom, unsettling shaders designed exclusively to bring the horrific nature of the Aberrations to life in spectacular, bone-chilling detail.

《Searing Soundtracks & Themes》
Ignite your battle spirit with a pulse-pounding opening theme and an electrifying lineup of in-game insert songs that will elevate your gaming experience to new heights.
70010000132120.name: Qliphah in Providence's Shadow

70010000132121.description:
"TX-1" is a racing game released by TATSUMI in 1983.
Enjoy a powerful race, unique to the triple-screen display.
The course splits along the way, where deserts, coastlines, and city nightscapes dynamically flash past. Goals all around the world?! Cross the finish line and claim your glorious checkered flag!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.
70010000132121.intro: Now, the cockpit opens into infinity.
70010000132121.name: Arcade Archives TX-1

70010000132175.description:
BLOCKY POWERS — The Ultimate 2-Player Physics Block Party!

Grab a controller, invite a friend, and get ready for the most chaotic, fast-paced, and hilarious block-stacking duel! Blocky Powers takes the timeless excitement of falling block puzzles and combines it with unpredictable real-time physics, tricky strategies, and non-stop 1v1 local multiplayer mayhem.

Whether you are looking for the perfect couch showdown or a fierce competitive trial against a rival, Blocky Powers delivers an unforgettable head-to-head battle experience where every single block counts and no towers are ever truly safe!
REAL PHYSICS & THE MIGHTY WIND!

Forget rigid grids and predictable placements—in Blocky Powers, real physics reign supreme! Drop, rotate, and balance classic falling blocks to build the tallest, most stable towers imaginable.

Every block you place sways, shifts, and reacts to dynamic gravity. But physics isn't your only challenge—watch out for strong environmental winds that will test your tower’s stability to the absolute limit! Do you have the engineering precision and quick reflexes needed to construct epic towers and fight off the howling wind under pressure?
SABOTAGE YOUR RIVAL — PLACE BLOCKS ON THEIR TOWER!

Building a high tower is only half the battle. What makes Blocky Powers the ultimate local multiplayer experience is the unique, direct sabotage mechanic!

Instead of using distant spells, you can use tricky tactics to drop tricky blocks directly onto your opponent's screen and structure!

    Throw Off Their Balance: Send awkward, heavy, or unevenly shaped blocks straight over to your rival’s side.

    Ruined Precision: Ruin their carefully built foundation and watch their tower wobble under the sudden extra weight!

Timing is everything. Send a tricky block right when your friend is placing a critical piece and force their hard work to come tumbling down!
INTENSE 2-PLAYER LOCAL MULTIPLAYER BATTLES

Blocky Powers is built from the ground up for maximum 1v1 head-to-head action! Plug in an extra controller and jump into instant same-screen party battles with 2 players.

    Extra Controller Couch Play: Grab a second controller and battle side-by-side on a single screen! Perfect for rivalry nights, casual gaming sessions, and competitive duels on the couch.

    Custom Battle Rules: Tweak game settings, adjust wind forces, or set block drop speeds to create your own custom 2-player battle rules.

GAME MODES: RACE & SURVIVAL

Master your block-stacking skills across two thrilling game modes designed to test your reflexes, strategy, and patience:

    Race Mode (Build to the Top): Who can build the tallest towers and cross the finish line first? Speed is key, but build too fast without balance—or get sabotaged by a rival block—and watch your tower crash!

    Survival Mode (Keep It Balanced): You only have a limited number of life-hearts. Don't let your falling blocks drop into the abyss below—stack carefully, fight the wind, and survive the blocks thrown onto your tower by your opponent!

KEY FEATURES:

    Physics-Based Stacking Mechanics: Experience dynamic block physics where balance, weight, and center of gravity dictate survival.

    Direct Block Sabotage: Use tricky tactics to place extra blocks directly onto your opponent's tower to ruin their balance.

    Environmental Wind Effects: Battle unpredictable gusts of wind that push and sway your towers.

    2-Player Local Multiplayer: Seamless head-to-head play—grab an extra controller and battle your friend on the same screen!

    Race & Survival Modes: Challenge your rival in high-speed tower races or tense survival showdowns.

Put on your hard hat, master real physics, defeat the wind, throw tricky blocks onto your opponent's side, and stack your way to victory in Blocky Powers! Will your towers reach the sky, or will your friend send them tumbling down?
70010000132175.intro: Stack blocks to reach the sky and trust real physics as towers rise high! Use tricky powers, cause a big crash, and beat your friends in this party bash!
70010000132175.name: Blocky Powers

70010000132271.description:
Having gained a reputation as a man versed in the occult, Detective Woodbrey has attracted a rather peculiar clientele. Whether that is good or bad is for you to decide!

“Mystery Detective Adventure 2” is an adventure game in the Hidden Objects genre, with plenty of mini-games and puzzles, unforgettable characters, and complicated quests.

The world does not stand still—and neither does the world of crime. Thieves and murderers are becoming ever more cunning and twisted. And while others argue over who should make the streets safe and life fair, Detective John Woodbrey takes action, no matter what.
His experience played a cruel joke on him: he failed his last case after becoming too absorbed in paranormal phenomena and losing touch with reality. But his respite will not last forever—retirement is still a long way off.
With a reputation as a detective versed in the occult, he finds mystic cases drawn to him. He will have to undertake three investigations—three unique and dangerous adventures. Their unpredictable nature will force you to find solutions on the fly and quickly adapt to the situation. There will be no time to be bored!

- Close extraordinary cases that only you can handle.
- Each investigation tells its own story, with unique locations and characters.
- Complete collections by studying the world carefully and missing none of even the smallest details.
- Examine locations carefully and find every collectible
- Join the battle for freedom alongside your favorite characters
70010000132271.intro: Other people’s secrets cannot escape the detective’s attention.
70010000132271.name: Mystery Detective Adventure 2

70010000132377.description:
The Ultimate Game Night for Learning and Laughter

Play solo against AI or locally with up to 4 players on the same Nintendo Switch system. Educational Family Games is designed for people playing together in the same room and does not include online multiplayer.

From the creators of the award-winning Educational Games for Kids comes a collection of 80 quick games across 5 interactive game boards, combining educational challenges with party-game fun for the whole family.

Race, think, remember, solve, guess, react, and compete in challenges involving maths, geography, logic, memory, reflexes, science, chemistry, art, anatomy, entertaining party games, and timeless classics. Collect gems, buy crowns, and try to finish as the winner.

One moment you may be solving maths problems under pressure. The next, you may be dodging fireballs, racing bicycles, flying rockets, scoring goals, copying drawings, or competing in chaotic 2-versus-2 challenges. Every quick game offers something different.

Every instruction, word, and character is fully voiced in 19 languages. No reading is required, making the game accessible to pre-readers, grandparents, and players of different abilities.

Key Features

• Solo play against AI or local multiplayer for 1–4 players
• 80 educational and party quick games
• 5 interactive game boards
• Maths, geography, logic, memory, science, chemistry, art, anatomy, reflexes, and more
• Fully voiced in 19 languages
• AI fills empty player positions
• Short sessions or longer family tournaments
• 10 playable characters
• Colourful 2D cartoon visuals
• Family-friendly and violence-free
• No online multiplayer

Designed for children, parents, grandparents, friends, parties, holidays, and living-room game nights. Suitable for ages 5 to 100.
70010000132377.intro: 80 educational and party games for 1–4 players.
70010000132377.name: Educational Family Games

70010000132391.description:
Take to the rooftops in a fast-paced first-person parkour adventure where every jump matters. Sprint across towering city buildings, leap over massive gaps, wall-run across obstacles, and use your movement skills to reach new heights.

Navigate handcrafted levels filled with dangerous enemies, environmental hazards, and challenging platforming sections that demand quick reflexes and precise timing. Every rooftop presents a new obstacle, from collapsing structures to heavily guarded areas that stand between you and your objective.

Master fluid parkour movement, discover the best routes through the city skyline, and combine speed with precision to overcome increasingly difficult challenges. Whether you're avoiding enemy fire, making daring rooftop leaps, or climbing to impossible heights, every level tests your ability to keep moving.

Features:

Fast-paced first-person parkour gameplay.
Jump, wall-run, and climb across towering city rooftops.
Handcrafted levels with increasing difficulty.
Enemy encounters that challenge both movement and timing.
Smooth controls designed for fast traversal.
Explore a sprawling urban skyline from above.
Easy to learn, challenging to master.
70010000132391.intro: Leap across towering rooftops, wall-run over obstacles, and master fast-paced parkour as you race through a dangerous city filled with enemies and challenging platforming.
70010000132391.name: Jump Protocol

70010000132402.description:
Circuit Flow is a wire-routing puzzle game set on a compact circuit board. Draw traces to connect colored signals from the board edge to their matching components - LEDs, speakers, fans, and displays all need the right current to power up.

Start simple with single-color routes, then tackle resistors that transform signal colors, splitters that break secondaries into primaries, and mixers that combine them into new ones. Plan your paths carefully - wires can't overlap, and a wrong turn means a short circuit.

Features:
- Hand-crafted puzzle levels with progressive difficulty
- Color mixing and splitting mechanics
- Circuit designer - build and share your own levels
- Arcade mode with procedurally generated boards
- Encyclopedia of real electronic components
- Clean, readable circuit board visual style
70010000132402.intro: Route the signal. Power the board.
70010000132402.name: Circuit Flow

70010000132420.description:
Today, you aren't a peaceful forest creature; you're a masked burglar on a mission to take over Granny's house. Use your tiny, grabby hands to transform her quiet, clean home into your own personal dumpster-diving playground.

Waddle through the rooms and cause total chaos. Raid the refrigerator, turn trash cans upside down, climb on the countertops, and shatter expensive vases. Each prank earns you chaos points and triggers a furious yet funny reaction from Granny. When she comes running with her broom, quickly hide in a cupboard or squeeze behind some furniture. Earn enough points to unlock hilarious outfits and discover hidden shortcuts from the basement to the attic. Prove that no room is safe from a trash panda!
70010000132420.name: Angry Raccoon

70010000132433.description:
"FIGHTING GOLF" is a golf game released by SNK in 1988.
Choose one of four characters with unique strengths in distance and accuracy, and take on 18 varied holes filled with three types of rough, two types of bunkers, oceans, rivers, and dense trees.
Advice is displayed before starting each hole, and the optimal club is automatically picked for you based on the distance to the pin to guide your strategy!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.
70010000132433.intro: All the power and excitement of a live golf tournament!
70010000132433.name: Arcade Archives FIGHTING GOLF

70010000132455.description:
Descend into a forgotten underground vault where every room hides new dangers, valuable supplies, and terrifying enemies.

Fight your way through five increasingly difficult dungeon levels in a fast-paced, top-down pixel-art roguelike shooter. Each run features procedurally generated rooms, unpredictable encounters, and randomized loot, ensuring that no two expeditions feel exactly the same.

Choose from three playable characters with different strengths, then search the vault for weapons, ammunition, health supplies, and other useful equipment. Expand your arsenal with pistols, shotguns, lasers, rockets, and other weapons, each offering different firing patterns, magazine sizes, and combat possibilities.

Stay mobile, dodge incoming attacks, take cover behind interactive objects, and flip tables to block enemy projectiles. Break containers, open mysterious chests, explore cleared areas using the minimap, and prepare for powerful bosses waiting at the end of every level.

The deeper you travel, the more dangerous the vault becomes. Enemies grow faster, attack more frequently, and appear in greater numbers. Taking damage can also affect your sanity, briefly distorting the world around you and making every battle even more unsettling.

Manage your resources carefully, adapt to the weapons you discover, defeat each guardian, and uncover how far the darkness beneath the vault truly reaches.
70010000132455.intro: Enter a forgotten underground vault in this fast-paced pixel-art roguelike shooter. Explore procedurally generated dungeons, collect powerful weapons, battle dangerous enemies.
70010000132455.name: Forgotten Vault

70010000132461.description:
Disney Speedstorm is the ultimate hero-based combat-racing game, set on high-speed circuits inspired by Disney and Pixar worlds. It’s a thrilling arcade racing experience where players will need to master each Character’s unique Skills on the racetrack and claim victory.

DISNEY & PIXAR GO FULL BATTLE RACING
An incredible cast of characters, including Sulley, Beast, Mickey Mouse, Mulan, Baloo, Captain Jack Sparrow, and more, are suited and revving up for racing combat. Upgrade each Racer’s stats and make the most of their unique Skills that can impact the outcome of a single race and dramatically change the way you play the game!

ARCADE RACING REDEFINED
Anyone can pick up and play Disney Speedstorm, but mastering skills and techniques like timing your nitro boosts, precisely drifting around corners, and adapting to dynamic track environments are crucial to dominating each race.

RACING TOGETHER HAS NEVER BEEN EASIER
Pick your Racer and speed through action-packed tracks solo, or challenge friends in local and online multiplayer modes. You can even face off with players from around the globe to become an online legend.

DISNEY- & PIXAR-INSPIRED RACETRACKS
Start your engine in environments inspired by some of your favourite Disney and Pixar films. From the docks of Pirates of the Caribbean’s Kraken Port to the wilds of The Jungle Book’s Jungle Ruins or the Scare Floor from Monsters, Inc., you can experience these worlds from a fresh, exciting perspective geared specifically for racing!

CUSTOMISE TO YOUR OWN STYLE
