Choose your favorite Racer’s suit, a flashy kart livery, and show off stylish wheels and wings -- all of this and more is possible with the extensive customisation features in the game!

NEW CONTENT RACING YOUR WAY
The action never slows down thanks to fresh seasonal content always around the corner. New Disney and Pixar Racers will be added regularly, bringing special skills for you to master (or overcome), and unique tracks will be created often, to pump fresh strategy into the mix. Support Crew characters, environments, customisation options, and collectibles will also drop in regularly, so there’s always more to experience.
70010000132461.intro: Drift into the ultimate hero-based combat racing game, set on high-speed circuits inspired by Disney and Pixar worlds.
70010000132461.name: Disney Speedstorm – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000132480.description:
Every thousand years, a chosen one journeys to the Rift — a place where life and death converge.

In the shadow of an ancient crypt, a crystal glimmers, calling to lost souls. They do not remember their deaths and are drawn to the light, hoping to escape this grim place. But touching it only disturbs the peace of the living with their presence.

Now, you are the new Guardian. Do not let the boundary between worlds vanish.

Threshold Warden is a 2D pixel-art shooter-platformer where you control the guardian protecting the world of the living. Build towers, place turrets and traps to keep zombies from reaching the crystal and defend the boundary between worlds.

By defeating enemies, you collect soul fragments. Once a wave is complete, the crystal activates and offers you a choice of upgrades and defensive tools: light generators, turrets, flamethrowers, mines, new weapons, and much more. Combine items and strategically strengthen your defenses to stop the zombie onslaught and keep the crystal safe.
70010000132480.intro:
upgrade your character
survive hordes
defend crystal
70010000132480.name: Threshold Warden

70010000132486.description: An alien caterpillar  whose biology requires radiation for growth and survival. Luckily, your home planet is literally saturated with this dangerous yet vital resource. Your goal is to navigate challenging levels, collect radioactive elements, and grow, but be careful: the larger you get, the harder it is to maneuver!
70010000132486.intro:
upgrade your snake
manage more snakes at once
solve puzzles
70010000132486.name: Radiation Caterpillar

70010000132492.description:
A snake puzzle game where, on some levels, you control multiple snakes by switching between them while the others remain asleep.

A top-down puzzle game where you guide a snake through carefully crafted levels, collecting apples and finding the way forward.

As the game unfolds, new rules come into play. Some levels feature multiple snakes, and you can switch between them — only one moves at a time while the others remain asleep. Their positions become part of the puzzle, letting you block paths, set up moves, and solve challenges that require more than a straightforward route.
70010000132492.intro:
upgrade your snake
manage more snakes at once
solve puzzles
70010000132492.name: Eden Coil

70010000132543.description:
Rescue Mama from Maboots Tower!
Grab enemies with Magic Rods and create ladders with special shoes.
A stage-clearing action game for 1 or 2 players.

◆Game Story

Tam and Rit, two fairy siblings, lived peacefully with their Mama in Fairy Village.

But one day, a huge ghost kidnapped their mother and took her away to Maboots Tower.

To save Mama, the two set off for the tower with their magical rods and special shoes.

Their main attack is to use the rods’ magic to grab enemies and slam them into the ground.

The special shoes also let them create and climb ladders.

Cross otherwise unreachable platforms, collect items placed high above, and discover new ways through each stage!

Defeated enemies can leave behind attack items, allowing you to take them down in all kinds of ways.

Collect every flower in a stage, and the remaining enemies will transform into special EXTRA GAME enemies.

Defeat them to make EXTRA items appear!

Collect EXTRA items to earn 1UPs and high-score bonuses.

Play solo or team up in 2-player co-op!

Guide Tam and Rit to the top of Maboots Tower and rescue Mama!


◆Customize Your Game with Options!

The options menu, available from the title screen,
includes settings for 2-player play with Tam and Rit.

Choose Friendly play, share points between both players,
or compete in Rival mode, where you can interfere with your opponent.

The Jump setting can also dramatically change the way you play.
Choose from No Jump, Normal Jump, or jumps that hit overhead platforms.
(Normal Jump is selected by default.)

Customize player colors, hints, music, and sound effects.
You can also choose the title screen BGM, adjust demo speed,
register player names, and more!

Set up ROD LAND your way!


◆JALECOlle Famicom Series: New Features

★Beginner-Friendly Assist Features
Use intuitive Rewind controls to instantly retry after a mistake,
or save and resume your game from anywhere
with Quick Save & Load.

★Helpful Subtitle Guide
Supports the Japanese localization.

★Record Your Best Time
Track your time from the start of your adventure
to defeating the final boss with the Simple Timer.

Use Quick Save to chase your best time,
or take on the game without any assist features at all.
Set your personal best!

★Plus, plenty of extras and options!
・Achievements to challenge a variety of goals
・An Extra Page featuring original package art, manuals, flyers, and more
・A Screen Edge option to reduce distortion at the edges of the screen
・Screen Filter options
・Wallpaper options
・Clear bonuses featuring a little extra content after completing the main game
70010000132543.intro:
JALECOlle Famicom revives JALECO classics!
Vol. 8: ROD LAND Includes the original Japanese version in this 2-in-1 release!
70010000132543.name: JALECOlle Famicom Ver. ROD LAND

70010000132569.description:
Crayon Story: Thumbelina is a creativity-boosting game based on the classic fairy tale that children love. Beyond just playing, children can decorate scenes and complete stories in their own words, fostering a sense of accomplishment.


Key Features


Coloring: Touch the screen to fill scenes with vibrant colors. With intuitive controls, anyone can easily create their own masterpiece.


Writing: Write your own sentences to match the colored scenes. Your child's imagination brings a unique version of 'Thumbelina' to life.


Personal Gallery: Completed pages are saved in your gallery, so you can revisit and enjoy your custom storybook anytime.


Start a fun artistic journey with Crayon Story: Thumbelina by GaniTani!
70010000132569.intro: An emotional, creative children's game where you color your own storybook and write your own tales.
70010000132569.name: Crayon Story: Thumbelina

70010000132587.description:
THE NEXT GENERATION OF SPEEDRUNNERS
The original multiplayer gameplay formula of SpeedRunners is timeless. With the sequel, our goal is to carefully bring this unique ‘SpeedRunners feel’ into the new era without compromising on the depth and fluidity of the movement system while still keeping it easy to grasp. On top of that, King of Speed introduces vibrant high-definition graphics and improved netcode.

GOTTA GO FAST
SpeedRunners 2: King of Speed is a fast-paced competitive platformer and a sequel to one of the most beloved indie games of the 2010s. Pick a character of your choice from a vibrant cast of eccentric superheroes, both returning and new, and face off against your rivals in frenetic running races for up to 4 players per lobby, locally or online.

BE THE LAST ONE RUNNING
Your goal is to get ahead by any means necessary and cling to the first place as your opponents get consumed, one by one, by an ever-shrinking ring of fire. Prepare to run like your life depends on it, across multiple beautiful tracks set in a retrofuturistic world inspired by the superhero utopia of the 1960s.

FAST AND FURIOUS
Knock rivals off-screen and eliminate the competition by using powerful pick-ups like missiles, traps, freezing rays, or a golden grappling hook that allows you to pull runners in front of you.  Ruin friendships, break controllers, and make split-second decisions on your way to becoming the true King of Speed!

MASTER COMPETITIVE PLATFORMING
Learn the layout of expertly crafted maps and master the intuitive yet deep movement mechanics. Memorize the locations of booster pads, pick-ups, wall jumping sections, obstacles, blue ceilings that you can grapple to, and levers to open or close pathways. Run, jump, slide, and swing to victory!

RUN AS YOU ARE
SpeedRunners 2 is a competitive game that can be enjoyed casually but has a high skill ceiling, allowing you to hone your speedrunning prowess for hundreds of hours. Join a dedicated community to participate in tournaments, create custom challenges, and climb the leaderboards, or host a private lobby with your buddies for some laid-back PvP fun.
70010000132587.intro: The ultimate competitive platformer is back! Cutthroat online and local races.
70010000132587.name: SpeedRunners 2: King of Speed

70010000132656.description:
APIDYA SPECIAL – A very special retro shoot 'em up buzzes into view!
Take flight in Apidya Special, brought back through sheer Pixel Passion!

1992's home computer legend Apidya is making a comeback in this authentic 24-bit pixel remake, built from the ground up, but utterly faithful to the original.

Developed by the original team alongside a devoted Apidya super-fan-turned-developer, Apidya Special is based on a previously abandoned 1990s console port — combining original assets with all-new pixel art, additional authentic sound effects, and remixed music. Legendary composer Chris Hülsbeck contributes exclusive new studio versions of the iconic soundtrack, never released before.

The warmth and charm of a CRT on modern screens!

Experience Apidya Special in true widescreen with new parallax effects, or switch to the original home computer 4:3 mode that looks, plays, and sounds exactly like 1992. Optional CRT effects with simulated shadow mask, scan lines, and phosphor bloom recreate the classic display feel.

FEATURES:

Authentic Remake – Completely rebuilt from scratch; no emulation.

Two Visual Modes – Seamlessly switch between HD widescreen or original home computer 4:3 presentation.

Exclusive Chris Hülsbeck OST – Brand-new studio versions of the iconic soundtrack, never before released.

Retro Visual Effects – Optional CRT shaders, bloom, and authentic scanline simulation.

Expanded Worlds – 5 diverse themed worlds (Meadow, Pond, Sewers, Cyber, Lair), up to 5 levels each, 20 unique bosses, and hidden special stages.

Fresh Surprises – Randomized in-game events like Night Mode with new enemy sprites.

Co-op Mode – A second player controls one of the helper drones.

Accessibility Options – Modernized difficulty settings to make the game enjoyable for all generations.
70010000132656.intro: Apidya is making a comeback in this authentic 24-bit pixel remake, built from the ground up, but utterly faithful to the original.
70010000132656.name: Apidya‘ Special

70010000132682.description:
Slither across a grid, gather ingredients, and brew tea inside your snake’s body. Gather score by completing goals, brewing tea in order to pop segments and just growing longer.
Chai Glide is a cozy reimagining of the classic snakey game built for calming play sessions.
Want old-school pressure instead? Classic Mode is a fast paced core run. Pick your speed, grab pellets, race timed bonus ingredients before they vanish, and go for the high sSsSSscore!
70010000132682.intro: Slither, collect ingredients, and brew tea inside your snake. Complete cozy shifts in this modern twist on a classic. Classic score attack mode included!
70010000132682.name: Chai Glide

70010000132695.description:
Collect puzzles with photorealistic images of girls in spectacular outfits, enjoy convenient touch controls and feel the process at your fingertips.

Relaxing music creates the right mood, and gradually increasing difficulty turns each level into an exciting challenge. After assembly, you can carefully examine each image and appreciate all the details.

Features:

• Photorealistic images.

• Realistic assembly process.

• Gradually increasing difficulty.

• Relaxing music.

• Detailed image viewing.
70010000132695.name: Hidden Girls: Quiet Beauty

70010000132700.description:
Use your knowledge and wits to break her hold on the island.
Your path lays through dazzling island locations, a mystery forest, mountain, cave and lake.
On your adventure, free bewitched islanders.
You are going to discover the mystery of an ancient prophecy and figure out what made Peter betray you last time.

- Thrilling story
- Beautiful hidden object scenes
- Replayable logic mini games
- Unconventional use of hog-scenes and items
70010000132700.intro: The island really exists, and the witch has regained her power. Can you defeat her?
70010000132700.name: Legacy: Witch Island 2

70010000132706.description:

70010000132781.description:
Word Hive 2 is a word puzzle game where each puzzle gives you seven letters: six outer letters and one required center letter. Use them to create as many words as possible. Every word must include the center letter.

Letters may be used more than once, and each word must contain at least four letters. Longer words earn more points, while special words that use all seven letters, known as pangrams, award bonus points.

Put your mind to the test with every puzzle, discover new words, expand your vocabulary, and enjoy a rewarding word puzzle experience.

Increase your score to climb the ranks, uncover every hidden word, and become the ultimate word master.

Word Hive 2 uses an American English dictionary.

Features
• Play through 2,000 all-new word puzzle levels
• Discover special words called pangrams by using all seven letters
• Learn new English words and expand your vocabulary as you play
• Compete with players around the world on the online leaderboard
• Resume your last game and continue where you left off
• Play in Handheld Mode, Tabletop Mode, or TV Mode
70010000132781.intro: Build words, score points, and master the hive.
70010000132781.name: WordHive 2

70010000132791.description:
Cubic Cosmos is a thrilling fast-paced roguelike card game. Build an unstoppable army of pawns, chain together massive combos, and enjoy endless possibilities!

Mix and Match Countless Exciting Strategies
 • Create an army of unstoppable pawns and build up their attributes to beat down the strongest of bosses!
 • Chain together abilities to unleash awesome combos, take endless turns, and deal massive damage... anything is possible!
 • Team up pawns to unlock incredible synergies and clear whole battlefields in a single shot!

Build an Unbeatable Deck
 • Combine cards and Relics to build an unstoppable deck.
 • Clear runs to unlock 12 different heroes across 3 classes with unique abilities.
 • With 240+ cards, create lethal combinations that are unique to you!
 • Explore unique effect combos with 50+ equippable Relics.
 • Tons of random events make each run a new adventure.

Rise to the Challenge in Multiple Game Modes
 • Endless Adventures: With fixed and random boss fights and daily challenges, you'll find new thrills in every run!
 • Scaling Difficulty: Prove yourself in 10+ difficulty levels and emerge stronger than ever.
 • Mastery Mode: Are you a true master of the cosmos? Put your perfectly crafted deck to the test in this high-pressure game mode.
70010000132791.intro: Build lethal decks, chain massive combos, and halt the enemy march!
70010000132791.name: Cubic Cosmos

70010000132815.description:
■About This Game
2D Shoot 'em up meets Brick Breaker action!
Avoid enemy fire, bounce back bullets, and fight your way through!
Master unique skills and wave attacks to unleash powerful combos!
70010000132815.intro:
2D Shooting Game × A Brick Breaker!
Embark on an adventure with the witches Phurl, Eire, and
70010000132815.name: Manalia Notes -A memory of innocence-

70010000132824.description:
Collect puzzles with photorealistic images of girls in spectacular outfits, enjoy convenient touch controls and feel the process at your fingertips.

Relaxing music creates the right mood, and gradually increasing difficulty turns each level into an exciting challenge. After assembly, you can carefully examine each image and appreciate all the details.

70010000132824.name: Real Girls: Velvet Flame

70010000132911.description:
Rollick N' Roll combines fun physics with intuitive controls to deliver a joyful puzzle experience for all ages. Expand your collection by unlocking fun vehicles and playsets, but be prepared for a bit of chaos.

Key Features:
• Intuitive controls - Press the button. See what happens.
• Easy, medium or hard - More vehicles means more mayhem.
• Need more? - Try some formidable time trials!
• Chill tunes - Professionally composed soundtrack by Rest!
• No training necessary - We hate tutorials too.
• 25 challenging courses - 75 unique vehicles to collect.
70010000132911.intro: Marvelous marble runs, with a modern twist.
70010000132911.name: Rollick N' Roll

70010000132934.description:
Enter a world where every card can change your destiny. In this fantasy roguelike deck-building adventure, you'll battle your way through dangerous dungeons filled with fearsome monsters, powerful bosses, and magical secrets waiting to be uncovered.

Build your deck from an ever-growing collection of cards, combining spells, attacks, and special abilities to create powerful strategies. No two adventures are the same—discover new cards, collect mystical relics, and adapt your tactics as each run presents different enemies, rewards, and challenges.

Every decision matters. Choose your path carefully, strengthen your deck after each battle, and experiment with countless card combinations to overcome increasingly difficult encounters. Whether you prefer overwhelming magical attacks, powerful defensive strategies, or carefully planned combos, there are many ways to achieve victory.

Defeat formidable bosses, unlock new possibilities with every playthrough, and prove your mastery in a world where strategy is just as important as luck.

Features:

Build and customize powerful decks with a variety of unique cards.
Battle monsters and challenging bosses in strategic turn-based combat.
Explore procedurally generated adventures where every run is different.
Discover magical relics and powerful upgrades that transform your strategy.
Experiment with countless card synergies and deck combinations.
Easy to learn, challenging to master, with high replayability.
70010000132934.intro: Embark on a magical roguelike card adventure where every choice shapes your journey. Build powerful decks, discover mystical artifacts, battle dangerous foes.
70010000132934.name: Card of Arcana

70010000132953.description:
"Meiji Tokyo Renka" (also known as "Meikoi") is a historical romance fantasy game in which the main character travels back in time to the Meiji era and meets—and falls in love with—great figures from history.

This is the story of Mei, a high school girl who suddenly finds herself transported through time to a mysterious version of Meiji-era Tokyo, where supernatural beings known as mononoke roam. There, she becomes romantically involved with famous historical figures from the era.
These sweet yet dramatic stories, centered on the male leads and their relationships with Mei, pick up where the last game left off. As the characters face new incidents caused by mononoke, their bonds deepen, unfolding into richly emotional and romantic tales.

New romances with historical figures unfold in a slightly mysterious version of Meiji-era Tokyo, now brought to life in high definition.
The game also includes one of its signature features: 3D Love Voice. These immersive voice performances enhance the romantic scenes with each character.
70010000132953.name: Meiji Tokyo Renka Twilight Kiss

70010000132967.description:
Become a curious cat with a clear mission: knock over everything in sight. Navigate the house and smash 192 different household items as quickly as possible.

Explore a variety of low-poly rooms. Jump onto countertops, climb bookshelves, swipe at fragile decor, and cause absolute disaster. Keep an eye on the timer, hunt down every breakable item, and prove that nothing is safe when a cat is in the house.

Experience the world from the ground up with an immersive first-person perspective and watch your own paws swipe at targets. Search for unique breakable objects in various environments, such as a cozy study, a fully stocked bathroom, and a festive living room decorated with holiday gifts. You can even shout your triumphs on command as you race against the clock to finish your destructive spree.
70010000132967.name: Smash Cat

70010000132999.description:
Every customer who walks through your door has their own personality - the punk who wants his beats loud, the tennis star who needs the perfect gift for a teammate, the vampy goth girl, the sweet grandma who just wants something cozy. In Mystery Box, you read the room and pack the perfect box for every single one of them.

Drag, stack, and arrange items by hand until the box is filled just right - every piece carries patterns that build value in specific ways, and perks that ripple out to boost everything else inside. Get it right, and watch your customer light up. Then hit the shop between rounds to unlock new items, papers, and packaging styles to build even better combos next time.

As your reputation grows, so do customer expectations - and so do the stakes. How long can you keep everyone happy?

Features:
- A colorful cast of customers, each with their own tastes and quirks
- Hands-on 3D box-packing - arrange every item yourself
- Item patterns and perks combine for deep, replayable strategy
- Unlock new items and packaging styles between rounds
- Endless mode with rising difficulty and demands
70010000132999.intro: Pack it. Ship it. Make their day.
70010000132999.name: Mystery Box

70010000133020.description:
One day, while walking down the street, you encounter a mysterious, "neckless" giraffe?!
Upon closer inspection, it turns out to be a incredibly rare new species whose neck grows longer as time passes. And it seems to have taken a total liking to you!

Start your slow-paced, carefree life raising your very own special giraffe!

[How to Live with Your Giraffe]
■ Keep an Eye on Its Belly!
Your giraffe’s fullness meter drops over time. Keep it happy and healthy by feeding it carrots so it never goes hungry!

■ Harvest Piles of Carrots in Mini-Games!
Carrot Tower: A balancing game where you stack carrots as high as you can. The higher you stack, the bigger the reward! But watch out—drop just one, and it's game over. Stay focused and aim for a high score!

Carrot Darts: Aim carefully and throw carrots at the target. Show off your skills and go for the gold!

■ Shop Till You Drop! ♪
Exchange your collected carrots for handy items in the shop. Get your hands on useful goodies like Mini-Game Tickets or a Name Tag to give your giraffe a name, and deepen your bond together!
70010000133020.name: GIRAFFE RAISING GAME ~Reach for the sky~

70010000133043.description: A fantastic, oceanic, open world puzzle adventure. Solve innovative block puzzles while unearthing a mystifying story, gaining new friends that change the puzzle landscape, and unlocking powers that provide more options for how you choose to progress through the enigmatic Isles of Sea and Sky.
70010000133043.intro: A fantastic, oceanic, open world puzzle adventure.
70010000133043.name: Isles of Sea and Sky

70010000133124.description:
Curl up with the coziest card game on your console! Kitties Solitaire wraps the classic TriPeaks Solitaire experience in an adorable world of playful cats, warm colors, and charming feline companions.
Clear the peaks one card at a time in this relaxing yet endlessly engaging solitaire adventure. With 340 handcrafted levels, every session brings a fresh challenge — and a new reason to keep those paws tapping.
Features:

Full TriPeaks Solitaire — Master the beloved card system that's easy to learn and satisfying to perfect.
340 Levels — A massive collection designed to keep you playing for hours on end.
Unique Card Layouts — Varied and creative board designs ensure no two levels feel the same, delivering long-term engagement.
Smooth & Responsive — Enjoy fluid animations and tight controls that make every move feel great.
Undo & Rewards — Rethink your strategy with the handy undo system, and collect rewards as you climb each peak.

Whether you're a solitaire veteran or just love cute cats, Kitties Solitaire is the purr-fect way to unwind. Deal yourself in and let the good times paw-r in!
70010000133124.intro: 340 levels of cozy, cuddly card fun.
70010000133124.name: Kitties Solitaire

70010000133136.description:
Run a karaoke location solo in this frantic action game!
Dash around the venue handling tasks while customers keep pouring in!
Feel the thrill of handling one task after another!

Food orders, cleaning, and even unexpected trouble make this a busy job!
Take care of each task as it comes up before time runs out!
Complete them all, and you just might become a true solo shift master!

[The Work Never Ends!]
Work the front desk, serve food and drinks, clean the karaoke rooms and bathrooms, restock the drink bar, and more!
Work efficiently to stay on top of it all!

[Be Prepared for Trouble!]
Exchange microphones, repair karaoke machines, and answer the phone when it rings!
Be ready to handle all kinds of unexpected tasks outside your normal workload!

[Decision-Making is Key!]
Prioritize your tasks!
Assess the situation and move efficiently!

[A Different Location Every Stage]
Each stage features a karaoke venue with a different layout!
Learn the locations of the front desk, karaoke rooms, and cooking area, and plan your moves accordingly!

[Score Attack]
Your performance affects your rating!
Work quickly and accurately to achieve a high score!

[2-Player Mode]
Play co-op as a worker and support robot team!
Split up tasks and work together to take on the karaoke rush!
70010000133136.intro:
Front desk, food and drinks, cleaning—you've got to manage it all!
Take on task after task all by yourself!
70010000133136.name: Solo Shift! Karaoke

70010000133156.description:
Step into a house consumed by fear, where a sinister clown lurks in the shadows and every room hides another terrifying secret. Explore dark hallways, abandoned rooms, and hidden passages as you search for a way to survive and escape.

Stay out of sight and avoid attracting the clown's attention. Use stealth, carefully plan your movements, and search the environment for useful items that will help you progress. Solve puzzles, unlock new areas, and destroy cursed clown boxes to weaken the evil that has taken over the house.

Every encounter is a test of your nerves. Listen carefully, hide when danger approaches, and make every decision count as the relentless clown hunts you through the darkness.

Can you uncover the mystery behind the nightmare and escape before it's too late?

Features:

First-person survival horror gameplay.
Explore a mysterious house filled with secrets and hidden areas.
Evade a relentless clown using stealth and careful planning.
Solve environmental puzzles to unlock your path forward.
Search for useful items and destroy cursed clown boxes.
Immersive atmosphere with suspenseful exploration and tense encounters.
Easy to learn, challenging to survive.
70010000133156.intro: Explore a haunted house stalked by a sinister clown. Stay hidden, solve puzzles, destroy cursed objects, and escape before your pursuer catches you.
70010000133156.name: Clown's Lair

70010000133162.description:
Take to the skies in an explosive arcade helicopter shooter where every mission puts you in control of the battlefield. Fly freely across vast enemy-occupied islands, launch devastating rocket attacks, and unleash relentless machine-gun fire as you fight to liberate fifty action-packed missions across five unique environments.

Face increasingly dangerous enemies including infantry, tanks, defensive turrets, and hostile helicopters while earning coins to upgrade your weapons and improve your combat performance. Every tenth mission raises the stakes with a race against time to destroy enemy power stations before a nuclear missile launch can be triggered.

Fast-paced aerial combat, rewarding progression, and complete freedom of movement combine to deliver an intense arcade experience that keeps every mission fresh and every victory hard-earned.
70010000133162.name: Chopper Strike 2

70010000133183.description:
Sword? Check.
Horse? Of course.
Explosive barrels? You'd better believe it!

Choose your side, arm yourself with your favourite weapons and charge into large-scale medieval battles. Fight with swords, bows, spears, crossbows, shields and even magic. Capture flags to respawn closer to the front line, ride into combat on horseback and use everything at your disposal to help your team claim victory.

Battle across snowy fields, islands and mountain fortresses, experiment with different tactics and always keep an eye on your surroundings—sometimes a single well-placed explosive barrel is all it takes to change the course of the battle.
70010000133183.intro: With great explosive barrels comes great responsibility.
70010000133183.name: War the Knights

70010000133200.description:
You awaken to find yourself trapped inside an abandoned, suffocating house. The doors are sealed, the hallways are cloaked in shadow, and an ancient evil lurks in the air. You quickly realize that you are not alone in the darkness. A vengeful ghostly witch prowls the corridors, listening for your every footstep. This isn't just a prison, it's a deadly trap. Your only way out is to break the dark magic binding you to this nightmare.

In order to survive, you must master the art of stealth. Keep a low profile, hide in the shadows, and stay out of sight when the entity approaches. As you carefully navigate the haunted rooms, you will need to rely on your wits. Search your surroundings to solve challenging environmental puzzles, unlock hidden passageways, and collect items that will help you escape.

Your ultimate goal lies hidden within these cursed walls: a dark, malevolent ring that empowers the witch. To shatter the curse forever, you must locate the artifact, gather the materials to light a cleansing fire, and perform a dangerous final ritual. One wrong move will bring the witch right to you. Do you have the courage to face the supernatural, destroy the ring, and escape alive?

• Evade the Witch: Use stealth, patience, and strategy to hide from the ghostly entity that is constantly hunting you through the house.
• Shatter the Curse: Scavenge the decaying mansion for the cursed ring, then perform the final fire ritual to secure your freedom.
• Solve the Mystery: Unlock sealed doors and uncover hidden areas by solving challenging logic puzzles and riddles.
• Immersive Terror: Experience a chilling atmosphere brought to life with detailed 3D environments, intense jump scares, and eerie sound design.
70010000133200.intro: The witch is waiting. The ring is calling.
70010000133200.name: Scary Ring

70010000133201.description:
Step back into Andy’s room with Woody, Buzz Lightyear, and more classic characters in Toy Story: Retro Roundup! This five-game collection features console and handheld versions of four early Toy Story titles, as well as A Bug’s Life. All the games have been upgraded with new features, quality-of-life improvements, and an overflowing toy chest of behind-the-scenes content. Revisit the ‘90s and early 2000s hits you loved and share these titles with a new generation of Toy Story fans.

Play Toy Story (1995), Toy Story 2: Buzz Lightyear to the Rescue! (1999), Toy Story 2 (1999), Buzz Lightyear of Star Command (2000), Toy Story Racer (2001) and A Bug’s Life (1998). Includes 11 total versions of the games across console and handheld. The games have been enhanced with quality-of-life improvements, including Rewind, Rex’s Cheat Codes, and more. Use Rewind to retry mistakes when you miss a jump across Andy’s shelves or take too many hits from the angry, wind-up robot. Unlock game-specific enhancements like unlimited lives or invincibility with Rex’s Cheat Codes.

Step inside Digital Eclipse’s behind-the-scenes experience, featuring exclusive interviews withJason Katz – Head of Story, Pixar, Jim Hanks – Voice Actor, Luigi Priore – VP and GM, Disney & Pixar Games, and Jon Burton – Founder, TT Games, who helped bring these adventures to life. Explore a richly-detailed virtual museum filled with rare design documents, vintage development photos, and archival content. Listen to your favorite songs from the games in the Music Player, where we’ve rounded up the soundtracks from every game in the collection.

FEATURES

- Play five classic games, including four Toy Story games and A Bug’s Life. Includes 11 total versions of the games across console and handheld.

- Enhancements and quality-of-life improvements make the games easier to learn and understand for gamers of all ages.

- Use Rewind to fix your mistakes. Messed up a jump? Took too many hits? Simply hold a button and scrub back to before you made that mistake and try again.

- Includes a behind-the-scenes experience featuring new interviews with Jason Katz – Head of Story, Pixar, Jim Hanks – Voice Actor, Luigi Priore – VP and GM, Disney & Pixar Games, and Jon Burton – Founder, TT Games.

- Explore the virtual museum filled with rare design documents, vintage development photos, and archival content.

- Use Rex’s Cheat Codes! Get unlimited lives, invincibility, or unlock all the characters or levels.

- Learn the game with enhanced How to Play instructions, then hone your skills in Practice Mode.

- Listen to the Music Player, which includes the complete soundtrack for every game in the collection.

This product is released for the Nintendo Switch. It can also be played on Nintendo Switch 2. However, please note that a separate product, "Disney/Pixar Toy Story: Retro Roundup!",
is available exclusively for Nintendo Switch 2.
Save data and Additional Contents are not compatible between the two versions. Please be careful to avoid duplicate or mistaken purchases.
Nintendo Switch 2 Edition and Upgrade Pack are not available for this product.
70010000133201.intro: Play along with classic Toy Story characters in the ultimate 5-game collection.
70010000133201.name: Disney/Pixar Toy Story: Retro Roundup!

70010000133208.description:
Reopen the toy chest and saddle up as Woody, Buzz Lightyear, and Jessie in Toy Story 3 Complete Edition, a 3D adventure based on the hit 2010 animated film, Toy Story 3. The updated game features improved graphics and a few new surprises in store. Play through authentic moments from the movie in Story Mode, or drop into the wild west sandbox of Woody’s Roundup in Toy Box Mode.

In Story Mode, swap between Woody, Buzz, and Jessie as you play through iconic scenes from the film, including the train rescue, Operation Playtime, surviving the junkyard, and more. Harness each character's unique abilities, whether you need to swing on Woody’s pull string or use Buzz’s strength to throw the other toys long distances. You can even play in two-player co-op.

Step out of Story Mode and into the sandbox in Toy Box Mode. This fan-favorite, customizable mode drops you into the wild west of Woody’s Roundup. Like Story Mode, you play as Woody, Buzz, or Jessie, but in Toy Box Mode you can play however you want! Characters around town give you quests to complete, so you can earn gold and spend it on personalizing the town your way. Build, decorate and customize the buildings, dress up the townsfolk, and more.

Toy Story 3 Complete Edition also includes content that was previously restricted to certain versions of the game. Players can now play as the Evil Emperor Zurg in Toy Box Mode, and can access four additional Theme Packs to decorate their Toy Box. Toy Story 3 Complete Edition also features upgraded graphics, resolution, and framerate.

FEATURES

- Toy Story 3 Complete Edition brings back a fan-favorite game.

- Relive key moments from the movie in Story Mode from Andy's room to Sunnyside Daycare.

- Swap between Woody, Buzz Lightyear, and Jessie, each of with different abilities you’ll need to complete each level.

- Dive into the sandbox in Toy Box Mode. Take on missions for your fellow toys, dress up the townsfolk, decorate buildings, and much more.

- Play with a friend in local, two player co-op. Available in Story Mode or Toy Box Mode.

- All versions now include previously exclusive content, such as the ability to play as Emperor Zurg in Toy Box Mode.

This product is released for the Nintendo Switch. It can also be played on Nintendo Switch 2. However, please note that a separate product, "Disney/Pixar Toy Story 3 Complete Edition",
is available exclusively for Nintendo Switch 2.
Save data and Additional Contents are not compatible between the two versions. Please be careful to avoid duplicate or mistaken purchases.
Nintendo Switch 2 Edition and Upgrade Pack are not available for this product.
70010000133208.intro: Play as Woody, Buzz, and Jessie in the Complete Edition of the 3D adventure.
70010000133208.name: Disney/Pixar Toy Story 3 Complete Edition

70010000133221.description:
"BALLOON BOMBER" is a shooting game released by TAITO in 1980.
Control the anti-aircraft gun and destroy the balloon bombs as they gently sway through the air.
However, destroying the balloon bombs is no easy task. Aim and shoot so your bullets hit only the bomb itself.
If your shot hits the balloon instead, the bomb will fall and blow a hole in the ground. Be careful, as the anti-aircraft gun cannot pass over holes, narrowing your movement range.

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.
70010000133221.name: Arcade Archives BALLOON BOMBER

70010000133270.description:
Hockey Beasts is a colorful, casual hockey game in which the player takes on the role of a member of one of the animal teams and tries to prove which of them deserves to be called the best. Play locally with up to 4 players, or take the competition online with up to 6 players.

Pick your favourite squad: from stubborn bulls and speedy monkeys to crocodiles, elephants, giraffes, and other rink-ready beasts. Every team plays differently, so choosing a character is not just about looks. Some are quick and agile, others rely on strength, reach, or a more patient approach.

The controls are simple enough to understand from the first match, but winning consistently takes timing, positioning, and a good read of your opponent. It is easy to play, hard to master, and built around short matches that are just as enjoyable during a relaxed solo session as they are in a competitive multiplayer game.

Expect expressive cartoon characters, colorful arenas, messy rebounds, awkward collisions, and goals that sometimes feel brilliant and sometimes completely accidental.
70010000133270.intro: Choose your team, step onto the ice, and see what kind of beast you are when the puck starts moving.
70010000133270.name: Hockey Beasts

70010000133290.description:
This is an action game themed around Japanese culture and traditional children's songs, where you chase after a rolling rice ball (*omusubi*).

Mai-chan has dropped her precious rice ball. Chase after the rolling rice ball and jump into the hole where you think it fell! Catch the rice ball to clear the level!
There are various types of rice balls—such as salmon or tuna mayo—and their movements differ depending on the filling.
In addition to standard chase stages, there are pinball-style stages where you must predict where the rice ball will land and chase after it. Catch the rice ball without falling into a hole yourself!

The game also features a simultaneous Japanese and English display, making it a fun way to learn while you play.
70010000133290.intro:
Simple, easy-to-play action game.
Cute illustrations.
Great for learning Japanese and English.
70010000133290.name: THE Rolling Rolling Rolling Rice Ball

70010000133311.description:
Black Flower is a strategic roguelike about survival and growth in a fragile garden.

Guide your garden through a magical calendar, making daily choices between unpredictable weather conditions. Each day brings new risks and opportunities, forcing you to manage resources, protect your flowers, and adapt to an ever-changing world.

At the center of your journey lies a single black seed — a rare and mysterious chance to change your fate, if you can make it bloom.

Every run is different. Skill matters, but success is never guaranteed.

Features:
-Strategic roguelike gameplay where every run brings new knowledge.
-Experiment, learn, predict, and adapt your strategy to achieve your goal.
-Unlock over 80 achievements and discover new ways to influence the world.
-Combine tools, devices, enchantments, and weather effects to overcome every challenge.
-A relaxing yet challenging experience where careful planning competes with unpredictable chaos.
-Handcrafted art and a magical atmosphere.
-Learn through experimentation—knowledge is your true progression.
70010000133311.intro: In this strategic roguelike survival game, knowledge is your true progression. Grow flowers, gather resources, and use clever combinations of tools, devices, charms and weather to make the
70010000133311.name: Black Flower

70010000133325.description:
A young cleric named Verselio once devoted his life to serving the deity Treises—until the truth shattered everything he believed. When the divine is revealed to be a lie, faith turns into fury, and a journey of rebellion begins. Joined by a mysterious maiden, a disciplined vigilante chief, and a self-proclaimed deity, Verselio sets out across a vast fantasy world in search of answers. As their paths intertwine, each carries their own burdens, beliefs, and secrets, in a story of betrayal, redemption, and the meaning of faith in a deityless world.

Asdivine Knot is a classic turn-based JRPG that blends strategic command battles with modern systems and deep customization. Master the shared Nexus Gauge to control the flow of combat, unleash powerful Nexus Skills, and summon devastating entities to turn the tide. Explore a wide world with your fully customizable airship, craft and upgrade equipment using collected materials, and shape your adventure with side quests, crew recruitment, fishing, and puzzle dungeons. Packed with rich content and designed for a complete single-player experience, this is a must-play fantasy RPG for fans of traditional Japanese role-playing games.
70010000133325.intro: Tie the knot of fate in a skybound fantasy RPG!
70010000133325.name: Asdivine Knot

70010000133326.description:
A service industry apocalypse

Welcome to Roman Sands RE:Build, a shape-shifting absurdist adventure that twists two stories together, taking you from a luxury tropical resort to post-apocalyptic survival.

Two stories of escape

The Resort
Wash up on the beach of an indulgent Resort. According to the guests, you work here—AND you're slacking off. Race against time to rank up and earn equipment to stem their never-ending tide of demands. The only catch to your employment: the sun is days away from swallowing the world, and the guests couldn't care less.

Look under the surface: uncover the resort's secrets and solve puzzles in an attempt to escape.

Cling to life after the end

The Facility
One of the last people left alive, you are the caretaker of a decaying zoological research station. Your only companions are a dead cow and a voice on the radio; it sounds familiar, but ... from where?

A parasite clogs the guts of your station: will you exterminate it and preserve the station's work, even at the cost of your own survival?

Manic genre mashup

Are these worlds the same? When are they? WHAT are they!? Two distinct narratives overlap and mutate in a delirious genre apocalypse: adventure, visual novel, puzzle solving, survival simulation, and atmospheric horror collide to tell a story of escaping the inescapable.
70010000133326.intro: A service industry adventure with an apocalyptic flavor. A manic genre mashup told across two broken realities. Step through the cracks: find your Exit.
70010000133326.name: Roman Sands RE:Build

70010000133364.description:
Descend into forgotten catacombs where every room hides a new challenge. Solve intricate puzzles, avoid deadly traps, uncover ancient secrets, and survive encounters with terrifying creatures.

Explore a mysterious underground world filled with hidden passages, magical artifacts, and forgotten mechanisms. Some enemies cannot be defeated by force—you must discover their weaknesses, think creatively, and outsmart the darkness.

Every solved puzzle brings you one step closer to the legendary Secret Portal. But only those with sharp minds and unwavering courage will escape the underworld.

Features

*Atmospheric escape room adventure set in ancient catacombs
*Clever environmental puzzles and interactive mechanisms
*Hidden passages, secret chambers, and magical artifacts
*Deadly traps and terrifying supernatural creatures
*Explore a dark world full of mystery, danger, and forgotten history
*Discover the Secret Portal and find your way to freedom
70010000133364.intro: The deeper you go, the darker the truth becomes*
70010000133364.name: Escape Room: The Secret Portal Puzzle

70010000133379.description:
A nomad wanders the far reaches of an overgrown megastructure, a world built for a forgotten purpose in which countless civilizations have lived entombed for ages.

But when the mech they use to traverse its vast distances breaks, they remain stranded in its hostile wilds beneath a concrete sky.

- - -

Travel through an overgrown megastructure, and discover what lies beyond it. Metal Garden is a short, atmospheric singleplayer FPS game that can be finished in a single sitting (one to three hours).

Explore architectual relics of eras near and long gone, meet mysterious and powerful factions that have emerged inside the megastructure, and fight your way through varied encounters in this tight and compact FPS campaign.

FEATURES:
- A short, tightly designed shooter campaign.
Unique setting filled with massive industrial structures taken over by nature.
- Atmospheric visuals inspired by mid-00s games.
- Responsive movement and combat.
- A sci-fi mystery story revealed through exploration of the game's spaces.
- An injury system that asks you to manage not only your health, but also your individual body parts.
- Multiple modifiers to change up your playthrough, from health system modifiers to enemy and item randomizers.
70010000133379.intro: Travel through an overgrown megastructure, and discover what lies beyond it. Metal Garden is a short, atmospheric singleplayer FPS game.
70010000133379.name: Metal Garden

70010000133391.description:
Who knew that a successful business could start in a tomato garden? Your day begins with harvesting ripe tomatoes and carrying them directly to your shelves. But tomatoes are only the beginning. To satisfy your hungry customers, you must feed those tomatoes to your backyard hens and gather fresh eggs to stock the adjacent display.

This is a fast-paced game of supply and demand that requires perfect balance. You must constantly run between your harvesting patches, animal feeding pens, retail shelves, and the busy checkout counter. As you accumulate cash, you can expand your store, unlock new inventory types, and hire clerks and cashiers to automate the daily grind. Keep your shelves full, your chickens fed, and your checkout lines moving quickly to build the ultimate community market.

Key Features:
• Farming Meets Retail: Harvest fresh tomatoes from your garden and use them to feed your chickens, which will produce high-demand eggs.
• Hands-On Management: Move quickly between production stations, stock shelves to the brim, and process payments at the cash register.
• Expand and upgrade: Use your profits to unlock new sections of your market, increase your carrying capacity, and boost your movement speed.
• Assemble your staff. Hire and train helpful employees to stock shelves and manage the checkout line, allowing you to focus on expanding your business empire.
70010000133391.intro: Grow the goods and rule the retail market!
70010000133391.name: My Mart

70010000133392.description:
Find Eddie Velvet.

Private investigator Red Walker finds himself in Silver Pines, a place half-abandoned, half-forgotten, in the middle of nowhere on a job to track down Eddie Velvet. A musician who has vanished. As the case begins to reveal a dark past, Walker soon slips into a strange and nightmarish descent beyond his control.

The Kind of Moment that Lasts Forever
Embark on a journey filled with dread and atmosphere. Haunted by shadows of the past, Silver Pines is waiting to reveal its dark secrets.

Survival Horror Gameplay
A love letter to classic survival horror. Fight or avoid the horrors of the town as you scavenge for resources and solutions to the puzzles blocking your way.

Metroidvania Navigation
Filled with locked doors and hidden paths, every turn holds an uncovered clue, a resource, or something waiting in the dark. With better tools and weapons more and more of the town becomes accessible.

Visceral and grounded action
The horrors of the town include a large variety of challenging monsters and hulking bosses that keeps every encounter tense and dangerous.

Manage your resources
Inventory space is limited. Search everywhere for items because every bullet, bottle of medicine and upgrade matters.
70010000133392.intro: Silver Pines. The kind of moment that lasts forever.
70010000133392.name: Silver Pines

70010000133405.description:
Deep within the forest, at the bottom of a well, lives the only creature brave enough to kill the queen... 

  Play as Glimmer - a tiny bird armed with a matchstick- who must burn the wicked queen to save his family. Explore a dark fairy-tale landscape and befriend the charming characters who reside in the kingdom’s underbelly. Battle terrifying beasts and gain new abilities to expand your map. Solve puzzles, discover secrets, and unravel the mysteries that lie in this rotted kingdom.

Among the rotting ruins are a charming cast of characters just trying to get by.  Go camping with Ilda, a tiny mouse who is on the run from the queens grasp. Explore an abandoned castle with Looter, a mysterious scavenger who searches the kingdom for the best wares to steal. And find and reunite with all of your sheltered siblings who were snatched up one night by a crazed hunter.

Light up your matchstick to illuminate the world and aid in combat. Collect trinkets to upgrade your abilities, and mix-and-match them to customize your game play. Solve puzzles, defeat vicious bosses, and forge your path to the queens quarters to save your family.
70010000133405.intro: Well Dweller is a dark fairy-tale metroidvania, full of charming characters living in a wretched kingdom. Play as Glimmer, a tiny bird armed with a matchstick.
70010000133405.name: Well Dweller

70010000133418.description:
You wake up locked in a single room with three other guys, complete strangers, forced to play a killing game none of you agreed to.

Search every corner, solve twisted puzzles, and win every macabre challenge you come across, because in this game, only one of you walks out alive.

Every guy beside you is hiding something, and figuring out who you can trust matters just as much as any puzzle.

Are you good enough to be the one who survives?


FEATURES:

● A ROOM FULL OF TWISTED PUZZLES: Every corner hides a new macabre challenge you must beat to survive.

● HE'S ALWAYS WATCHING: The man behind this killing game controls every rule, and he's never far.

● FOUR GUYS, FOUR SECRETS: Tense conversations between challenges reveal who you can trust, and who's lying.

● EVERY CHALLENGE COUNTS: Losing isn't an option. Every challenge you beat keeps you in the game.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Only one guy makes it out alive. Your choices decide who it is.


Four guys. One locked room. Only one will survive.
Do you have what it takes to be him?
70010000133418.intro:
Four guys. One locked room.
Only one will survive.
Will it be you?
70010000133418.name: Death Room Boys: A Psychological Horror Killing Game

70010000133429.description:
Ducks In Disguise is a peaceful hidden-object game focused on discovering beauty within the chaos. Explore hand-drawn 2D scenes, each with its own atmosphere, and find the ducks hiding around every corner!

Hundreds of ducks have decided to play the biggest game of hide-and-seek ever! Your task is simple: carefully examine each scene, find the hidden ducks and complete your collection. But not every duck is easy to spot. Some have disguised themselves to blend into their surroundings, so you’ll need to pay close attention to the details to find them.

As you explore each scene, click on objects and interact with your surroundings. Sometimes a duck is hiding right in front of you, while other times you’ll need to interact with the environment to reveal it. Every duck you find brings you one step closer to completing your collection.

A Stress-Free Experience

In Ducks In Disguise, there are no time limits, high-score pressures or tasks that require you to rush. Play at your own pace, listen to relaxing lo-fi music, examine each scene and enjoy the satisfaction of finding all the ducks.

Hand-Drawn 2D Worlds

Explore carefully crafted, hand-drawn illustrations, each with its own atmosphere and visual details. Take a close look at the detailed scenes and discover new ducks as you spot the little details hidden throughout the environment.

Ducks in Disguise

Not every duck hides in the same way. Some special ducks disguise themselves by blending into their surroundings. Keep your eyes peeled and don’t miss even the smallest detail!

Find Them All

Complete your collection by finishing every scene and prove that you’re a true duck-finding expert. Find every hidden duck to unlock a special reward: the Quack Certificate!

Whether you have five minutes to spare or want to play for hours, Ducks In Disguise is designed to help you relax, sharpen your observation skills and discover something new in every scene.

Can you find every hidden duck? Quack! Quack!
70010000133429.intro: Discover hidden ducks, find the ones in disguise, and enjoy a peaceful hidden-object adventure across beautifully hand-drawn worlds!
70010000133429.name: Ducks In Disguise

70010000133435.description:
Shape Wars is a fast-paced local multiplayer strategy game where geometric armies clash for dominance. Build your base, spawn units, upgrade your forces, and deploy devastating EMPs or pilot a Commander to turn the tide of battle.

Play solo against cunning AI opponents or go head-to-head with up to 4 players in Free For All, Teams, or AI Teams mode. Capture resource points, upgrade damage and shields, and outmaneuver your rivals to be the last shape standing.

Features:
- 1-4 player local multiplayer
- 3 game modes: Free For All, Teams, AI Teams
- 4 unique maps with different resource layouts
- Build barracks, archery ranges, tank factories, and more
- Deploy EMPs to wipe enemy waves
- Pilot a Commander unit with rocket attacks and self-destruct EMP
- Capture resource points for income advantage
- Upgrade damage, shields, and building production
- Procedural sound effects and a neon glow aesthetic
- Quick matches - games last 3-10 minutes
70010000133435.name: Shape Wars

70010000133449.description:
== THE STORY ==

With Earth made uninhabitable to humans, mankind has spread through the universe. A century has passed since that fateful day...

You suddenly wake up in an unfamiliar room. You step through a door only to find yourself in yet another strange room. This mysterious space is a collection of interconnected rooms, coming one after the other with no exit in sight.

Inside the rooms, you run into four other people who, just like you, also have no idea who they are or how they got here. But as you keep exploring, you realize something: these rooms are built from your memories. Yours and the others'.

Through the memories you find, you will remember who you are. But some of these memories are quite unpleasant. One among you has apparently shot a girl dead. And another boarded a spaceship illegally with a fake ID.

Who are you?
Why are you here?
And carrying all these questions, how can you escape this seemingly endless collection of rooms?

== THE GAMEPLAY ==

* Restore Memories by Placing Items
As you explore, you'll find various "memory spots" that allow you to see lost memories. But in order to activate them, you need specific items that you can find throughout the rooms.
These memories are like chapters from a novel with missing pages. Read through them and try to piece together your and the other people's stories.

* Whose Memory Is This?
Not all the memories you'll find will be your own. Some will belong to the four other people trapped in this strange space.
Who is the murderer who shot the girl? Who is the stowaway?
Sort through the memories, find out whom they belong to, and the truth will finally come into focus.

* A Shifting Space, Changing Every Time You Wake Up
Every time you fall asleep and wake up, you'll find that the layout of the rooms and how they connect will change, as will the items and characters you find in them.
You can explore, find items, and uncover memories as many times as you like, but remember: no two attempts will be the same.

* The More You Do, the Sleepier You Get
Each action you take consumes your Vigor. Once this drops to zero, you'll fall asleep... and who knows where you'll wake up.
You'll also lose the items you were carrying, so you'll need to carefully plan your every step, from the rooms you explore to the items you place in them.

* The Others Trapped Within
Just like you, the others inside this space have lost their memories.
As you help them find out more about themselves, they'll surely repay the favor by giving you hints.
The real question is... should you trust them?
Everyone here has their own forgotten past and their own secrets. Uncovering those may be the key to learning the truth.
70010000133449.intro: Open the door and step into someone's memories. Platonica Space is a sci-fi exploration adventure where you search countless rooms to recover lost memories.
70010000133449.name: PLATONICA SPACE

70010000133459.description:
Word Hive 3 is a word puzzle game where each puzzle gives you eight letters: seven outer letters and one required center letter. Use them to create as many words as possible. Every word must include the center letter.

Letters may be used more than once, and each word must contain at least four letters. Longer words earn more points, while special words that use all eight letters, known as pangrams, award bonus points.

Put your mind to the test with every puzzle, discover new words, expand your vocabulary, and enjoy a rewarding word puzzle experience.

Increase your score to climb the global ranks, uncover every hidden word, and become the ultimate word master.

Word Hive 3 uses an British English dictionary.

Features
• Play through 5,000 all-new word puzzle levels
• Discover special words called pangrams by using all eight letters
• Learn new English words and expand your vocabulary as you play
• Compete with players around the world on the online leaderboard
• Resume your last game and continue where you left off
• Play in Handheld Mode, Tabletop Mode, or TV Mode
70010000133459.intro: Build words, score points, and master the hive.
70010000133459.name: WordHive 3

70010000133471.description:
Every night begins the same way—you wake up trapped inside a terrifying nightmare where fear lurks around every corner. Explore dark and unsettling environments, search for clues, and uncover the truth hidden within a world where reality and nightmares have become one.

Venture through eerie locations filled with disturbing sights, mysterious puzzles, and relentless supernatural threats. Every room may hide a valuable clue, a useful item, or a deadly creature waiting in the darkness. Stay alert, manage your resources carefully, and use your wits to survive.

As the nightmare grows more intense, you'll face increasingly dangerous encounters that test your courage and determination. Solve environmental puzzles, unlock new paths, and piece together the mystery behind the horrors haunting your sleep before it's too late.

Will you escape the nightmare, or become trapped within it forever?

Features:

First-person psychological horror gameplay.
Explore eerie locations filled with secrets and hidden paths.
Solve puzzles to unlock new areas and uncover the story.
Evade terrifying supernatural creatures and survive tense encounters.
Search for useful items and resources to aid your escape.
Immersive atmosphere with haunting visuals and chilling sound design.
A suspenseful horror experience that keeps you on edge from beginning to end.
70010000133471.intro: Awaken in the middle of the night to a terrifying nightmare. Explore a haunted house, solve puzzles, avoid sinister creatures, and fight to survive until dawn.
70010000133471.name: Awaken in Fear

70010000133487.description:
Welcome to Airport Baggage Simulator! My name is Günther Gewinn and I am the boss here! Recently, a position opened up with us because our previous baggage handler, Rolf, has changed careers.

CONTROL
Flights arrive and matching baggage is delivered for inspection. You pick it up, place it on the table, scan it green or red depending on whether the tag is correct, and then place it on the corresponding output belt. After that, you load it onto a baggage cart at the gate and move on to the next suitcase.

AUTOMATION
The goal is clear: You want to make the processes in the terminal more efficient and automate them. To do that, you can buy conveyor belts and machines on your tablet. Eventually, you leave the checking and sorting to the machines: baggage is transported through the air by a launcher module onto the next belt and sorted by a scanner machine without you having to intervene.

LOGISTICS
Our deliveries run reliably: Our employee Horst is responsible for delivering packages. Everything you order on your tablet, he delivers to you in the shortest possible time and in top quality so you can build it directly in the terminal.

PROGRESS
Through your work, you can earn promotions and take on new responsibilities. These promotions let you unlock new checks, such as weighing suitcases or using the Substance Sniffer. You can also buy expansions for your hangar on the tablet so you have more space to build.

THANK YOU!
If you've read this far, my gut tells me that you are exactly the right person for this job. Congratulations!

Ute Gutgelaunt from HR will send you all important information again by email when you start your duties.

I look forward to your first day at work. Always remember: Airport operations tolerate no negligence!

Kind regards
Günther Gewinn from management
70010000133487.intro:
Inspect, sort and automate baggage.
Build conveyor lines and unlock promotions.
Airport operations tolerate no negligence!
70010000133487.name: Airport Baggage Simulator

70010000133497.description:
"The Green Light" is a first person horror game. In The Green Light Fred is stuck in a dead-end job, trapped in a cycle of dissatisfaction. He hates his work, he hates his boss, and his life feels like one long, constant disappointment. But everything changes one late night during his shift. As he drifts through the monotony, a voice on the radio cuts through the silence, offering him something he’s longed for: freedom. The voice tells him that his escape is waiting at a distant lighthouse, a beacon calling out to him from the darkness.

With nothing left to lose, Fred embarks on a journey that forces him to confront the depths of his own mind—and the true cost of freedom.
70010000133497.intro: Follow the voice, escape the routine, and discover the true cost of freedom.
70010000133497.name: The Green Light

70010000133530.description: Condo is a quiet, short, and atmospheric first-person exploration game. You wander through an apartment complex at night, meet its residents, and uncover hidden stories. Playtime: ≈ 30 minutes. Finding all events unlocks an ending. No rush. No destination. ♥
70010000133530.intro: Unable to sleep, you navigate a quiet condo complex. There's no rush - just you, the building, its inhabitants, and the stories they hold.
70010000133530.name: Condo

70010000133559.description: Dungeons of Alethrion is a dungeon crawler roguelike game based on the animated series, Tales of Alethrion. Play as heroes from the show, each with unique abilities. Try it single-player or grab a friend to join you in the dungeons!
70010000133559.intro: Enter the infinite dungeon and see how far you can go!
70010000133559.name: Dungeons of Alethrion

70010000133582.description:
MineSweeper Galaxy brings the classic mine-clearing puzzle into a colourful space adventure.

Reveal tiles, study the numbered clues, and locate every hidden mine. Each number shows how many mines are hidden in the surrounding spaces. Mark dangerous tiles, uncover all safe areas, and clear the board without triggering a mine.

Start with smaller puzzles and unlock larger, more challenging boards as you progress through the Nova, Supernova, Galaxy, and Universe stages.

Minesweeper is more than a game of chance. Every tile you uncover, mine you mark, and numbered clue you analyse challenges your problem-solving, pattern-recognition, and deductive-reasoning skills.

With simple controls, multiple difficulty levels, and colourful space-themed graphics, MineSweeper Galaxy is suitable for both new players and experienced puzzle fans.

Experience the satisfaction of mastering Minesweeper as you progress from beginner to expert, learn new strategies, and discover smarter ways to clear each board.

Features:
• Multiple board sizes and difficulty levels: Nova (9 × 9), Supernova (15 × 15), Galaxy (80 × 30), and Universe (80 × 80)
• Resume your last game session and continue where you left off
• Use hints whenever you get stuck
• Play in Handheld Mode, Tabletop Mode, or TV Mode
• Pan across the board and zoom in or out
• Colourful space-themed graphics, professional background music, and sound effects
• Compete with players around the world through online leaderboard rankings
70010000133582.intro: Clear the mines and conquer the galaxy!
70010000133582.name: MineSweeper Galaxy

70010000133593.description:
Get ready for a race game unlike any other!
Take on courses set in a school, a temple, and a plaza, and compete against other characters in all-out floor wiping races!

Maneuver your character well and speed through each course!
Drift around corners in style and use items to get the edge over your rivals!

Customize your character's appearance and stats in Character Edit!
Take on races with your own custom characters!

[Time Attack]
Choose your favorite course and aim for your best time!
Compete for the fastest times on the online leaderboards against players worldwide!

[Free Run]
Choose your favorite course and race against friends or CPU opponents!
Use items to gain the upper hand and enjoy intense battles!

[Grand Prix]
Race through multiple courses in succession and compete for the highest total score!
Conquer each course and aim for a total victory!

Up to 4 players can play together!
Have a blast with family and friends in floor wiping races!
70010000133593.intro:
Wipe floors here, there, and everywhere?!
Race across courses while wiping floors and aim for 1st place!
70010000133593.name: Floor Wiping Race

70010000133605.description:
Enjoy a next-level shooting gallery experience on the Nintendo Switch™!
Take aim, shoot down prizes, and become the ultimate shooting gallery master!
Up to 4 players can battle together with a Joy-Con™ controller for each!

Use items wisely to turn the tide of battle!
Fire a barrage of shots, take down big prizes with powerful ammo, or even sabotage your opponents!

Play on 3 totally different stages!
Put your shooting skills to the test as prizes appear one after another!

[Festival Stage]
The classic shooting gallery experience with a festive atmosphere!
Take aim and shoot down all kinds of prizes!

[Sweetland Stage]
A lively stage filled with sweets and amusement park fun!
Aim for prizes as they move around and collect tons of treats!

[Ruins Stage]
Mysterious ruins await, packed with all kinds of mechanisms!
Time your shots carefully and collect the treasures within!

[Score Attack]
Shoot down as many prizes as you can before time runs out!
Keep playing to beat your high score!

[Battle]
Battle it out with up to 4 players!
Compete for prizes and use your items at just the right moment to win!

[Rankings]
Compete with players from around the world for the highest score!
Can you become the ultimate shooting gallery master?
70010000133605.intro:
It's a shooting gallery like you've never seen it before!
Aim, fire, and battle it out in wild shooting gallery action!
70010000133605.name: Super Shooting Gallery Battle

70010000133622.description:
Make your fledgling airport into a world-famous international landmark jam-packed with entertainment!

First build facilities such as Bistros and Bookstores to make visitors comfortable.
Satisfied customers make your airport more popular, and will attract even more visitors!

But the bigger your airport gets, the more tired visitors will be from walking around...
Still, never fear! Simply place seating like Benches and Sofas near facilities, and visitors will be able to rest up.
Oh, and don't forget Plants to soothe sore eyes!
Seeing nature is especially important in places like airports, don't you think?
So add some greenery to your airport scenery!

Keep on truckin' until you can hold fairs and make your airport even livelier!
You may even get some new visitors?!

Make enough money to buy your own airliners and devise flight plans.
Before long you'll be setting up regular flights!

Sign contracts with foreign airline companies and make your airport a global player!
Build up friendships with foreign cities and attract people from all over the world!

So what are you waiting for? Help passengers travel the world and live out their dreams today!
70010000133622.intro: Just imagine: your own world-famous airport! A game with sky-high levels of fun!
70010000133622.name: Jumbo Airport Story – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000133628.description:
Roll the dice and put your luck and strategy to the test, a colorful board game experience built around classic dice combinations and high-score challenges.

Roll up to five dice, decide which ones to keep, and use your remaining attempts to create the best possible result. Aim for pairs, straights, full houses, four of a kind, and the ultimate five-dice combination. Every decision matters as you choose where to place your score and try to complete the scorecard with the highest total possible.

With simple controls, bright visuals, and quick rounds, easy to learn but offers plenty of opportunities to improve your strategy. Play at your own pace, challenge yourself to beat your personal best, and enjoy the excitement of every roll.

Features:

• Classic dice-based board game rules
• Simple and accessible gameplay
• Strategic dice selection and score management
• Colorful board game presentation
• Fast and relaxing rounds
• High-score challenges with plenty of replay value

Pick up the dice, trust your instincts, and make every roll count.
70010000133628.intro: Roll the dice, chase high scores, and master classic combinations, a colorful and relaxing board game experience for players of all ages.
70010000133628.name: Dice Nights

70010000133722.description:
Welcome to the sento—a Japanese public bathhouse where the floors are slippery and the battles are anything but relaxing!

Slide too far, crash into your rivals, or get caught up in unexpected stage gimmicks. Anything can happen in this chaotic water-gun battle!
Master the slippery bathhouse floors, blast your rivals with water guns, and fight your way to the ultimate honor: being first into the bath!

Enjoy a full single-player campaign packed with unique stages, or gather up to four players for chaotic local multiplayer battles.

■ Take on 36 unique stages set in Japanese public bathhouses!
In the single-player campaign, travel through six areas inspired by different parts of Japan and take on a total of 36 stages. A powerful boss awaits at the end of each area!

No two stages are the same. Their size, obstacle layouts, and stage gimmicks all vary, so study your surroundings and figure out the best route to gain the upper hand.
Having trouble with a stage? Try switching characters or changing your water gun to find a combination that better suits the challenge.

Clearing a stage is only the beginning. Each stage also features three Challenges to complete for players looking to master them all.

■ Choose from four unique characters!
Four playable characters are ready to enter the bathhouse, each with their own appearance and abilities.
Asahi is a balanced all-rounder with strong offense and defense. Rei uses exceptional acceleration to chase down rivals. Teppei relies on his impressive toughness to overpower the competition, while Yuzuki uses speed and agility to keep opponents guessing.
Choose the character that best suits the stage—or simply pick your favorite!

■ Pick the right water gun for the job!
Four different water guns offer distinct playstyles.
The Aqua Shot is a reliable handgun-type weapon with balanced performance and fast reloads. The Aqua Burst is a shotgun-type weapon that fires water over a wide area. The Aqua Lancer is a powerful rifle-type weapon with excellent range, while the Aqua Storm is a submachine-gun-type weapon capable of unleashing a relentless stream of shots.
Experiment with different combinations of characters and water guns to find the setup that works best for each stage.
Complete certain conditions in the campaign to unlock new water-gun skins and customize their appearance to your liking!

■ Go wild with Special Weapons!
Powerful Special Weapons can appear during battle. Grab them before your rivals do and turn the tide in an instant!
If an opponent gets there first, you could be in serious trouble—but take them down and you can steal the weapon for yourself.
Win the fight for these powerful weapons and seize the advantage!

■ Stage gimmicks turn every match into chaos!
Jet showers bursting up from the floor, giant rubber ducks, and plenty of other bizarre gimmicks can throw your plans into disarray.
Why are things like these in a bathhouse?
Some mysteries are better left unsolved.

■ Up to 4-player local multiplayer!
In addition to the full single-player campaign, you can enjoy local multiplayer battles with up to four players.
Play solo, with friends, or with family—and embrace the chaos!

■ The Story
“At last, the time has come!”
Once every four years, the Grand Sento First Bath Festival is held!
Sento Masters from across Japan gather to prove just how deeply they treasure the sacred honor of Ichibanfuro (First Bath).
Pride is on the line, water guns are loaded, and only one can claim the glory of the first bath!
Show the world a passion for the bath hotter than the water itself!
70010000133722.intro: Master the slippery floors of a Japanese public bathhouse and blast your rivals with water guns!
70010000133722.name: SENTO SURVIVOR : Slip, Grab, and Bathe in Glory!

70010000133785.description:
Before Exit: Gas Station is anomaly-detection game with dense atmosphere and some unexpected plot-twists.

To reveal all its secrets and fully understand it, you will have to play through the campaign several times.

In Before Exit: Gas Station, you must close your workplace at night as a gas station employee. But wait, don't gas stations stay open at night? Not in this world!

Your boss is very strict and he loves to save money. When night comes, it means you have to turn off the lights, close the store, and go home. It's a gas station in the middle of nowhere, so why would anyone visit this place after dark?

 Over 40 story-rich scenarios, packed with unique content, 4 different endings, and 6 mysterious bonus episodes.

Play through the game again and again to unlock everything and uncover the true ending. Are you ready to return home?

Like its predecessor, the game combines roguelike features with logical riddles in unique anomaly-detection genre! Play day by day to find all the assignments, and finish every task before coming back... home?

It's also the first time in the franchise you can actually walk out of your workplace before going back home! Check the fuel dispensers, and the oil stains, and get rid of the customers thinking they can fuel up at the last minute.

Complete every task to make your boss pleased. Do not make any mistake, as he is very observant and you are THIS close to getting fired. Anyway, have a lovely time at your charming workplace!
70010000133785.intro: Your beloved employee is back! Before Exit: Gas Station brings you back to work. Clean up your workplace, take care of customers, and make sure everything is closed.
70010000133785.name: Before Exit: Gas Station

70010000133798.description:
Beware - this land is under dispute by the Jotun Idyl, an archrival of the ancient gods. Play through 130+ challenging solitaire levels and chase the Jotun Idyl away!

Nordic Storm Solitaire is a charming and challenging card adventure set in a frozen mythic world. Face the ancient rival Jotun Idyl as you journey through a land of winter storms, magical legends and tactical solitaire puzzles.

Play through 130+ handcrafted levels of solitaire with a progression system designed to keep every stage fresh and rewarding. Earn boosts, unlock helpful tools and use smart strategies to clear difficult layouts faster and more efficiently. Whether you enjoy relaxing card games or more demanding puzzle challenges, Nordic Storm Solitaire offers a satisfying balance of accessibility and depth.

With beautiful Nordic scenery, story-driven progression and polished solo gameplay, this is a perfect pick for players who love casual strategy games, atmospheric adventures and classic solitaire with a modern twist.

FEATURES
- A mythic solitaire adventure in a frozen Nordic world
- Guide Elof through 130+ handcrafted levels of challenging solitaire
- Story-driven progression across a land of winter storms and legends
- Earn boosts and unlock helpful tools to master tricky layouts
- Relaxing card gameplay meets a Nordic fantasy journey
70010000133798.intro: Help Northman Elof lead his people to the land promised by the god Feyr!
70010000133798.name: Nordic Storm Solitaire

70010000133804.description:
"THUNDERCADE" is a shooting game released by SETA in 1987.
