As a member of the special forces, use a high-speed motorcycle equipped with machine guns to reach the enemy stronghold.
Destroying structures such as buildings will reveal power-up items in the form of sidecars equipped with gun barrels. Sidecars come in various types some fire bullets further, while others can only shoot sideways so choose the right one for each situation!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpieces that built a generation for video games.
70010000133804.intro: Now, head out on your mission! THUNDERCADE!
70010000133804.name: Arcade Archives THUNDERCADE

70010000133816.description:
Monsters are swarming across a world consumed by darkness.

Rescue your captured allies on the battlefield and join forces to defeat your enemies.

Slash through waves of enemies with fast attacks and well-timed dodges, and grow stronger through battle. Rescued allies will fight alongside you, granting you new powers.

Use ever-changing battles and upgrades to create your own fighting style. Break through dangerous battlefields, face powerful bosses, and stand against the forces of darkness with your allies.

■Features
・Action-focused roguelite hack-and-slash
・Fast-paced combat with attacks and dodges
・Rescue allies and fight alongside them
・Various enemies and powerful bosses
・Character progression through repeated runs
・Different strategies required in every run
70010000133816.intro:
Slash enemies and save your allies!
Grow stronger and challenge powerful bosses!
70010000133816.name: Clearing Blade

70010000133823.description:
***The aroma of bread in memories... In this moment, let's start anew!***

This is a world where bread is gradually being forgotten.

Until one day, in the corner of the world, an accidental explosion triggered by the main character Chaya, who was forced to stay in a rundown town where she is unfamiliar with the little store owner Effie to rebulid her bakery.

And the good smell from the insignificant oven is - the almost lost delicious food, **BREAD**!

## Collect materials in areas with your style!

Use your weapon and skills to create a path!

There're multiple weapons to choose from,

They all have a unique skilltree to make your own playstyle!

* Multiple areas with different theme and challenges!
* The locals are cute but also dangerous!
* Rare materials! What bread can they make?

## Delicious bread for the bakery!

Sell breads in your own bakery!

* Set up the rack of breads for most outcome!
* Customers are in need! Help them or lose the opportunity!
* Make sure there're breads to sell!
* Clean up that floor, or you might lose some money!

## Develop deserted town, meet new friends!

With power of bread, new possibilities are opened!

* New friends will join the town with your progress!
* Research and upgrade the recipes to become top rated shop!
* Make deserted town great by developing new buldings!
70010000133823.intro: A bread revolution across the world now begins!
70010000133823.name: Aeruta

70010000133840.description:
Pack your bags and prepare for a peaceful journey around the world. You are invited to explore highly detailed, picturesque locations that were hand-drawn by talented artists. Each scene is a unique work of art, turning simple searching into an aesthetically pleasing, meditative experience. From the romantic streets of Paris to the icy expanses of Antarctica and majestic German castles to busy airport terminals, each backdrop holds a new collection of secrets waiting to be discovered.

The beauty of this classic puzzle game lies in the organic integration of its items into the surroundings. Rather than lying on top of the scene, the objects are cleverly tucked away within the interior architecture and natural decor, requiring careful and patient observation to spot them. While the game provides traditional hints to help you when you're stuck, the laid-back, unobtrusive soundtrack ensures your journey remains stress-free. Dive in at your own pace, enjoy the relaxing flow, and see how many well-hidden treasures you can find.

Key Features:
• Hand-Drawn Masterpieces: Search through beautifully detailed, hand-drawn locations, each one a unique visual treat.
• A Global Expedition: Travel to diverse destinations, including historic German castles, Parisian streets, chilly polar landscapes, and bustling travel hubs.
• Cleverly Concealed Items: Put your observation skills to the test with objects that are seamlessly integrated into the scenery, offering a satisfying and clever search experience.
• Laid-Back Atmosphere: Take a break with a soft, calming soundtrack and slow-paced gameplay that lets you search at your own speed.
70010000133840.intro: A Relaxing Journey of Art and Observation
70010000133840.name: Hidden Objects

70010000133899.description:
The Princess has been crowned - but her beloved garden lies in ruins. Play through 130+ challenging match 3 levels and bring the royal grounds back to life!

Queen's Garden 2 is a charming and relaxing match 3 adventure set in a hand-drawn royal kingdom. Join Jack on a journey through blooming courtyards, quiet ponds and flower beds waiting to be restored to their former glory.

Play through 130+ handcrafted match 3 levels with a progression system designed to keep every stage fresh and rewarding. Collect coins and precious jewels, then spend them on plants, trees, fountains and decorations to shape the garden exactly the way you like. Whether you enjoy relaxing puzzle games or more demanding match 3 challenges, Queen's Garden 2 offers a satisfying balance of accessibility and depth.

With beautiful hand-drawn scenery, rewarding garden customization and polished solo gameplay, this is a perfect pick for players who love casual puzzle games, cozy decoration adventures and classic match 3 with a fresh twist.

FEATURES
- A charming match 3 adventure in a blooming royal kingdom
- Guide Jack through 130+ handcrafted levels of match 3 puzzles
- Collect coins and jewels to rebuild the garden piece by piece
- Buy plants, trees, fountains and decorations and design your own garden
- Relaxing puzzle gameplay meets cozy garden restoration
70010000133899.intro: Help Jack, the Queen's loyal assistant, rebuild the royal garden from the ground up!
70010000133899.name: Queen's Garden 2

70010000133921.description:
Collect puzzles with photorealistic images of girls in spectacular outfits, enjoy convenient touch controls and feel the process at your fingertips.

Relaxing music creates the right mood, and gradually increasing difficulty turns each level into an exciting challenge. After assembly, you can carefully examine each image and appreciate all the details.

Features:

• Photorealistic images.

• Realistic assembly process.

• Gradually increasing difficulty.

• Relaxing music.

• Detailed image viewing.
70010000133921.name: Real Girls: Midnight Desire

70010000133934.description:
This is a quiz game where you can choose the correct answer "2" (example: "Ni" is the correct answer if "Ni" and "two") from the national flag and country name (example: Hinomaru and Japan).

Let's aim for "Dr. Genius" in the challenge mode where you compete for how many questions you can answer correctly within 22 seconds and challenge!
70010000133934.intro:
A beautiful girl 2-choice quiz adventure game where you can experience a little variety of languages!
Enjoy multi-end collection and Challenge
70010000133934.name: School Sweets Discovery ～granulated sugar edition～

70010000133979.description:
Feel the sea breeze and the endless horizon!
This is the beginning of a grand journey. For the first time, you step aboard a luxurious liner to spend an unforgettable honeymoon!
In Cruise Adventure: Hidden Journey, warm encounters and cozy evenings await, as your route takes you through the colorful islands of the Pacific Ocean.
This isn't just a sightseeing tour, it's a celebration of life, where every day brings new emotions.

Why you'll love this game:
-Engaging storylines! From the care and love of newlyweds to the developing relationship between a distinguished captain and a female manager.
-A carefree atmosphere: join parties, play in the casino, and enjoy diving in the Pacific waters.
-Collect memories: Gather unique souvenirs from ports of call — memorable keepsakes from every destination you visit.
-Rich bonus search content: Beyond the main item list on each location, a whole set of additional items awaits you!

This isn't just a game.
It's a lifestyle: with new friends, carefree moments, and the atmosphere of a daily celebration.
Ocean, luxury, and love are just a click away.

Collector's Edition includes:
-18 additional hidden object scenes — even more cozy locations and details to explore.
-12 new mini-games + 18 bonus games — for those who love a challenge along the way.
-A souvenir collection — gather unique mementos from every port, like true traveler's trophies.
-Beautiful desktop wallpapers and a music player with a wonderful soundtrack.
70010000133979.name: Cruise Adventure: Hidden Journey Collector's Edition

70010000133986.description:
Plan every move in this satisfying sliding puzzle adventure where combining numbers is the key to unlocking every stage. Slide numbered blocks across the board, merge matching values together and create increasingly larger numbers as you work towards opening the exit gate.

Every block moves in a straight line until it reaches a wall, collides with another block, or interacts with an obstacle. Merge matching numbers to create higher values, from 2 all the way up to 2048, and produce the target number needed to unlock the gate. Simple rules quickly evolve into rewarding puzzles that challenge your logic, planning and spatial awareness.

Dangerous obstacles keep every move interesting. Avoid holes that swallow your blocks, smash through fragile ice, and watch out for deadly lasers that destroy anything in their path. If a block is lost, it respawns at its previous position, encouraging experimentation while still demanding careful strategy.

As blocks slide across the board, they leave colourful trails across the floor, transforming each completed puzzle into a vibrant display of your solution. With 50 handcrafted levels that steadily introduce tougher layouts and new challenges, every stage offers a fresh test of your puzzle-solving skills. Easy to learn yet increasingly rewarding to master, every successful merge brings you one step closer to unlocking the next challenge.
70010000133986.name: Unlock Merge

70010000133989.description:
Out of the frying pan, into the fire…

You’ve saved the world from the Ever Peckish. Now a new threat has arisen and it’s time to get back in the kitchen to stave off the hunger of The Unbread!

ONLINE/LOCAL MULTIPLAYER MADNESS- You’ll knead to work together (or against each other) to get the highest score in chaotic local and online multiplayer. Team up with up to 3 other chefs taking a Joy-Con™ controller each or use wireless play across four Nintendo Switch™ consoles.

FEAST YOUR EYES ON THIS- Journey across a brand new overworld map by land, sea and air. Get cooking in new themes ranging from sushi restaurants, magic schools, mines and even alien planets!

WHET YOUR APPETITE! - Travel the land cooking up a range of new recipes that are sure to cater to any tastes, including sushi, cakes, burgers and pizzas.

ROMAINE CALM! - Travel through teleporters, across moving platforms and save time by throwing ingredients across dynamic kitchens that shift and evolve. Some kitchens even whisk your chefs away to new locations.
70010000133989.intro: Overcooked returns with a brand-new helping of chaotic cooking action! Journey back to the Onion Kingdom and assemble your team of chefs in classic couch co-op or online play for up to four players. Hold onto your aprons … it’s time to save the world (again!)
70010000133989.name: Overcooked! 2

70010000134000.description:
Enjoy hundreds of levels of cooperative cooking chaos across increasingly perilous and obscure kitchens.

Overcooked! Goes Online

For the first time ever, online multiplayer has been fully integrated into Overcooked! Revisit your favourite kitchens from the first game in ONLINE!

A Visual Feast!

Both games have been taken to the next level with stunning, enhanced visuals - this is the best that the Overcooked! series has ever looked.

Tasty New Content!

New levels, new chefs and new mayhem - all exclusive to Overcooked! All You Can Eat.

Multiple Modes!

Players can enjoy campaign, survival and practice modes, and new to All You Can Eat - assist mode! Assist mode offers a number of options to allow for a less frantic game including slower recipe timeout, increased round timers and the option to skip levels.

Accessible For All!

Overcooked! All You Can Eat contains a features to allow as many players as possible to join in the food frenzy! Scalable UI  and dyslexia friendly text options are all available.

Journey back to the Onion King for a feast of epic proportions in Overcooked! All You Can Eat.
70010000134000.intro: Overcooked!, Overcooked! 2 and all additional content are blended together and remastered in this delicious definitive edition!
70010000134000.name: Overcooked! All You Can Eat

70010000134031.description:
Welcome to Horse Spirit Valley

Step into a soft, sunlit fantasy where the rhythm is simple: ride, sparkle, dress up your mount, and unlock new pastures when you are ready for the next view. No rush—just you, the trail, and a pocket full of dreams.

Ride and Explore

Travel on horseback across handcrafted 3D valleys filled with grass, sunlight, and open space.

Every journey has a clear goal: collect all the diamonds hidden throughout the world. Find them all to complete the area and enjoy the satisfaction of clearing every corner of the map.

Diamonds That Work for You

Diamonds collected during your adventures remain available between play sessions, with your current balance always visible.

Spend your savings on new environments or cosmetic items for your horse. When you do not have enough diamonds, the game clearly shows how many more you need.

Make the Horse Unmistakably Yours

Create a horse that feels completely your own with a wide range of customization options:

* Size
* Coat color
* Mane style and color
* Saddle and reins
* Armor style and color
* Horn shape and color

Preview every option in the customization hub, save your favorite appearance, and use collected diamonds to unlock premium styles.

Pastures Waiting Beyond the Horizon

The world selection screen displays each environment, its name, and its unlock price.

Your first pasture is available from the beginning. Additional dreamlike landscapes can be unlocked whenever you have collected enough diamonds and are ready for a new adventure.

Play Your Way

Adjust visual settings, real-time shadows, and music to create the experience that suits you best.

A varied soundtrack keeps menus and journeys feeling fresh, while a calm fairy-tale atmosphere follows you throughout the valley.

Comfortable Controls

Simple and intuitive controls make exploring, navigating menus, and customizing your horse easy and comfortable.

Pause the game, adjust settings, or return to the main menu whenever you need a break. Your progress will remain safely saved.

Who It Is For

Horse Spirit Valley is a low-stress, satisfying pocket of magic where you can explore, collect, customize, unlock, and repeat.

If gentle fantasy worlds, sparkling collectibles, and a beautiful unicorn-inspired mount sound like your perfect relaxing adventure, saddle up and enter the valley.
70010000134031.intro: Ride peaceful 3D valleys on your horse, collect every diamond on the map, and spend your sparkle on new pastures plus deep unicorn-style looks—coats, manes, saddles, armor, and horns—
70010000134031.name: Horse Spirit Valley

70010000134075.description:
You are locked inside a cinema. Your only way to escape is to follow the instructions of your task: Watch the same film clip repeatedly and search for flaws to break free. But this may sound easier than it is, every wrong decision or death will set you back. So be careful!


On this journey, you’ll watch the clip Paper Panic a haunting tale of Jim and his paper plane. But be warned... the story behind it might be darker than it seems.

You wake up in a storage room of a strange cinema, with no memory of how you got there. On the wall, you find a board with instructions. It tells you what to do if you want to escape. Otherwise, you’ll be trapped here forever.

Your task is simple: Help sort out the flawed film reels.

Enter the cinema hall, take your seat, and watch the film clip. After watching, choose one of the two exits, one for a normal clip, the other for a flawed one. Continue this cycle until you reach Cinema Hall 0. But beware if you make the wrong choice, you’ll be sent back to the beginning.

Strange or spooky things might happen in the cinema. Ignore them. They’re just distractions, and they shouldn’t affect your judgment.
70010000134075.intro: Trapped inside a haunted cinema, you must repeatedly watch the same film and spot every hidden flaw. Choose the correct exit, survive and escape before the loop claims you.
70010000134075.name: One Last Clip

70010000134093.description:
WordBuzz 4 is a word puzzle game where each puzzle gives you eight letters: seven outer letters and one required center letter. Use them to create as many words as possible. Every word must include the center letter.

Letters may be used more than once, and each word must contain at least four letters. Longer words earn more points, while special words that use all eight letters, known as pangrams, award bonus points.

Put your mind to the test with every puzzle, discover new words, expand your vocabulary, and enjoy a rewarding word puzzle experience.

Increase your score to climb the global rankings, uncover every hidden word, and become the ultimate word master.

WordBuzz 4 uses a British English dictionary.

Features
• Play through 5,000 all-new word puzzle levels
• Discover special words called pangrams by using all eight letters
• Learn new English words and expand your vocabulary as you play
• Compete with players around the world on the online leaderboard
• Resume your last game and continue where you left off
• Skip to the next level after 24 hours
• Play in Handheld Mode, Tabletop Mode, or TV Mode
70010000134093.intro: Build words, score points, and master the hive.
70010000134093.name: WordBuzz 4

70010000134099.description:
Embark on a journey to a mysterious alien planet filled with breathtaking landscapes, abandoned research facilities, and the remnants of a forgotten civilization. Every location holds clues to the planet's past, inviting you to uncover the secrets hidden beneath its surface.

Explore vast sci-fi environments at your own pace, from towering structures and mysterious outposts to rocky valleys and futuristic complexes. Search every corner, discover hidden areas, and piece together the story of a world left behind.

Immerse yourself in an atmospheric adventure where curiosity is your greatest tool. Observe your surroundings, uncover ancient technology, and experience the wonder of exploring an unknown planet far from home.

Every discovery brings you closer to understanding the mysteries of Astrava.

Features:

First-person sci-fi exploration adventure.
Explore a mysterious alien planet filled with unique environments.
Discover abandoned facilities and futuristic structures.
Uncover hidden secrets and learn the story of a forgotten civilization.
Atmospheric exploration focused on discovery and immersion.
Beautiful science-fiction landscapes inspired by distant worlds.
Relaxing gameplay that rewards curiosity and exploration.
70010000134099.intro: Explore a mysterious alien planet filled with abandoned facilities, breathtaking landscapes, and hidden secrets waiting to be discovered.
70010000134099.name: Astrava

70010000134147.description:
Ride into the Valley

Horse Spirit Valley 2 is a peaceful open-world horse adventure. Gallop across rolling meadows, autumn woods, winter frost, lilac dusk and emerald night — five distinct worlds waiting for your next ride.

Befriend wild horses, collect sparkling gems, and build the stable of your dreams in the Horse Boutique. Soft exploration, beautiful nature, and the freedom to ride wherever the trail leads.
Explore Five Worlds

Every level has its own mood, light and terrain:

Meadow— sunlit hills, wildflowers and open trails
Autumn Forest— warm earth, birch trees and golden light
Winter Frost— snowy fields under a quiet sky
Lilac Dusk— soft evening colours and calm paths
Emerald Night— deep forest atmosphere after dark

Unlock new worlds in the shop, select your favourite, and ride straight into it.
Tame & Ride

Wild horses roam the valley. Approach gently, earn their trust, and welcome them into your stable. Switch mounts in the Horse Boutique — your friends are always waiting.
Horse Boutique

Make every horse your own:

Coats and spirit colours
Mane styles and mane colour
Saddles and reins
Horns and size option
Your collection of tamed horses

Try looks on a live preview, buy with gems, and save the style you love.

Collect, Discover, Relax
Gather gems across the valley
Follow the compass to points of interest
Capture beautiful moments with Photo Mode
70010000134147.intro: Ride free through a living valley of meadows, forests, frost and dusk. Tame wild horses, style them in the Horse Boutique, collect gems.
70010000134147.name: Horse Spirit Valley 2

70010000134178.description:
The truth about Stonehenge is buried far too deep… It’s time to dig it up! Grab your shovel, stock up on dynamite, and embark on a thrilling underground adventure. Blast through layers of rock, collect gold, upgrade your gear, and uncover the ultimate mystery. But tread carefully: deep beneath the earth sleeps something that should have never been awakened...

Game Features

    Addictive Gameplay: Dig, blast, gather gold, and head back to the surface for brand-new upgrades!

    Powerful Upgrades: Level up your shovel for faster excavation, boost your stamina for longer expeditions, and buy a jetpack to swiftly escape danger.

    Explosive Arsenal: Shatter the toughest rock layers with dynamite, carving out the quickest path into the depths.

    The Ultimate Underground Secret: Every gold vein brings you one step closer to the answer—why was Stonehenge really built?

    A Deadly Inhabitant: An ancient monster lurks in the abyss. Every detonation stirs it from its slumber… Will you uncover the truth before the beast catches up to you?
70010000134178.intro: Unearth the truth about Stonehenge: dig with your shovel, blast through rock layers with dynamite, and grab all the gold!
70010000134178.name: Deep miner

70010000134190.description:
The cooking chaos of Overcooked! 2 hits Nintendo Switch 2 with a host of new features. Tear up the kitchen with 4K, 60 FPS gameplay, enjoy Nintendo Switch 2 features like CameraPlay and GameShare, plus meet an exclusive Chef: The Platinum Platypus. Hold onto your aprons and try not to set the kitchen, and your friendships, on fire.

After saving the Onion Kingdom in the original Overcooked!, you and your team of up to four chefs are needed once more to stave off the hunger of The Unbread.

ONLINE/LOCAL MULTIPLAYER MADNESS
You’ll knead to work together (or against each other) to get the highest score in chaotic local and online multiplayer.

FEAST YOUR EYES ON THIS
Explore the Onion Kingdom’s diverse lands in your trusted food van. Get cooking in themes ranging from sushi restaurants, magic schools, mines and even alien planets!

WHET YOUR APPETITE!
Learn to cook a smorgasbord of recipes that are sure to cater to any tastes, including sushi, cakes, burgers and pizzas.

ROMAINE CALM!
Travel through teleporters, across moving platforms and save time by throwing ingredients across dynamic kitchens that shift and evolve. Some kitchens even whisk your chefs away to new locations.
70010000134190.intro: Kitchen chaos comes to Nintendo Switch™ 2
70010000134190.name: Overcooked! 2 – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition

70010000134225.description:
Build a peaceful farm by day and defend everything you have created when night falls!

Farming and tower defense come together in a charming strategy experience. Plant crops, feed your animals, collect coins and expand your homestead with new structures. Every decision matters, so carefully plan where to place your crop fields, animal pens, storage buildings, defensive walls and barracks.

Your farm animals are more than just friendly residents—they can also become brave defenders! Recruit chickens, pigs, cows and goats, each offering different levels of speed, health and attack power. Position your animal army, strengthen vulnerable areas and prepare for the next enemy invasion.

Different crops are needed to care for different animals. Grow sunflowers for chickens, wheat for cows and sheep, and carrots for pigs and goats. Place structures close together to unlock useful bonuses, improve harvests, reduce feeding requirements and lower the cost of recruiting defenders.

As the seasons change, new dangers arrive. Wolves hunt your animals during spring, raccoons target valuable resources in summer, boars smash through defenses in fall and powerful bears attack your buildings in winter. Construct hay bales, wooden fences and stone barriers to slow them down before they reach the heart of your farm.

Balance expansion with preparation, improve your farm’s layout and survive through every season. A beautiful homestead can quickly become a battlefield, so grow wisely, build carefully and keep your animal defenders ready.

Can your cozy little farm survive an entire year?
70010000134225.intro: Build your farm by day and defend it by night! Grow crops, raise animals, recruit farmyard defenders and build walls to stop hungry enemies.
70010000134225.name: Cozy Farm Defense

70010000134256.description:
Help the Queen and her loyal assistant Jack decorate the palace garden in time for the Halloween celebrations.
Customize your garden, and unlock delightfully eerie new items to place within it.

Play over 130 levels, collect special jewels and purchase plants and decorations to design the spookiest Halloween garden ever!

Night fell, sending shivers down your spine. Will you persist? The Queen counts on your Match 3 bravery!

- Fully customizable gardens
- Many Halloween decorations to choose
- Visit your garden at night!
70010000134256.intro: All Hallow’s Eve is upon us, and the royal court is eager to celebrate!
70010000134256.name: Queen's Garden: Halloween

70010000134277.description:
Join Bingo the dog, Scott the cat, Fidget the duck, Papo the frog and Tucker the racoon in a perilous multi-dimensional adventure! Dimensional Animals is a side-scrolling precision platformer about cute animal friends with crazy abilities. Swap between protagonists on the fly as you master each animal’s unique abilities to overcome obstacles and explore a massive interconnected map in retro pixel art style.

Run, jump, interact with the environment, use portals to discover new areas and uncover more skills! Find up to 50 hidden diamonds and 25 health orbs as you search every nook and cranny across beaches, over mountains and through waterworks. Can you help Bingo find and recover his play ball so he can return it to his human companion?

• Take control of 5 animal friends, each with unique abilities!
• Switch between playable characters on-the-fly.
• Run, jump, use portals, avoid traps and pounce on enemies!
• Discover loads of special secrets.
• Traverse mountains, beaches and other landscapes.
70010000134277.intro: Guide 5 animal friends through a pixelated retro adventure using their unique abilities to overcome precision platforming challenges!
70010000134277.name: Dimensional Animals

70010000134288.description:
Embark on an unforgettable journey through the enchanting world of Teradea, where peaceful farm life meets thrilling adventure!

Raised in the quiet comfort of Bloomfield Village, your life is about to change forever. A mysterious mist creeps from the Forest of Echoes, wild beasts roam under the cover of night, and strange disasters threaten villages across the land.

Venture across a vast, living landscape filled with hidden caves, remote islands, lively towns, and long-forgotten secrets. Between your travels, cultivate your farm, raise animals, harvest crops, and build a place to call home. Guided by the Harvest Goddess and aided by the friends you'll meet along the way, you’ll find new ways to grow, explore, and lend a hand wherever it’s needed.

As friendships deepen and the seasons pass, the truth behind the mist will slowly begin to unfold. With the support of those you’ve helped — and those who stand beside you — you may discover a way to lift the veil from the Forest of Echoes and let Teradea flourish once more!

• Romance & Relationships: Meet 10 unique romance candidates—5 bachelors and 5 bachelorettes. Build meaningful relationships, experience heartfelt events, and find your perfect partner to share your life with.

• Animal Companion System: Befriend a variety of animal companions, each with unique abilities that help you explore. Break obstacles, reach hidden locations, and uncover secrets throughout Teradea together.

• New Exploration Abilities: Jump, climb ladders, and scale vines to discover previously unreachable areas. Combine your movement skills with your animal companions to fully explore every corner of the world.

• Make Everyone Happilia: Help villagers, complete requests, and contribute to Teradea's growth to earn precious Happilia. The more Happilia you gather, the more the Harvest Goddess can help restore the land.

• Island Life: Discover remote islands by collecting nautical charts. Hunt for hidden treasures, uncover new locations, and befriend rare animals found nowhere else in Teradea.

• Untamed Wilderness: The wilderness is home to wolves, bears, tigers, and other wildlife. Stay alert and avoid being caught, or you'll lose your collected items and wake up back at your farm.
70010000134288.name: Harvest Moon®: Echoes of Teradea - Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition

70010000134322.description:
Ever wish you were a wall-jumping, arrow-dodging, trap-setting horse, besting your animal pals in a race through a peril-laden obstacle course that you all built together?

Wish Granted!

Ultimate Chicken Horse is a party platformer where you and your friends build the level as you play, placing deadly traps before trying to reach the end of the level. If you can make it but your friends can't, you score points! Play online or locally with your animal buddies and experiment with a wide variety of platforms to find new ways to mess with your friends.

- Online and local play for up to 4 players
- PC & Switch cross-play
- Unique game flow, from strategic block placement to twitch control platforming
- A wide variety of levels with unique gameplay features
- Build and share custom levels
- Compete for global best times on Challenge levels across all platforms
- Huge library of blocks to create an infinite variety of levels
- Customizable rule sets and game modes
- Shared controller mode to play multiplayer with one controller
- Sweet funky soundtrack
70010000134322.name: Ultimate Chicken Horse

70010000134350.description:
WordBuzz 5 is a word puzzle game where each puzzle gives you eight letters: seven outer letters and one required center letter. Use them to create as many words as possible. Every word must include the center letter.

Letters may be used more than once, and each word must contain at least four letters. Longer words earn more points, while special words that use all eight letters, known as pangrams, award bonus points.

Put your mind to the test with every puzzle, discover new words, expand your vocabulary, and enjoy a rewarding word puzzle experience.

Increase your score to climb the global rankings, uncover every hidden word, and become the ultimate word master.

WordBuzz 5 uses a British English dictionary.

Features
• Play through 5,000 all-new word puzzle levels
• Discover special words called pangrams by using all eight letters
• Learn new English words and expand your vocabulary as you play
• Compete with players around the world on the online leaderboard
• Resume your last game and continue where you left off
• Skip to the next level after 24 hours
• Play in Handheld Mode, Tabletop Mode, or TV Mode
70010000134350.intro: Build words, score points, and master the hive.
70010000134350.name: WordBuzz 5

70010000134360.description:
WordBuzz 6 is a word puzzle game where each puzzle gives you eight letters: seven outer letters and one required center letter. Use them to create as many words as possible. Every word must include the center letter.

Letters may be used more than once, and each word must contain at least four letters. Longer words earn more points, while special words that use all eight letters, known as pangrams, award bonus points.

Put your mind to the test with every puzzle, discover new words, expand your vocabulary, and enjoy a rewarding word puzzle experience.

Increase your score to climb the global rankings, uncover every hidden word, and become the ultimate word master.

WordBuzz 6 uses modern Oxford English dictionary.

Features
• Play through 5,000 all-new word puzzle levels
• Discover special words called pangrams by using all eight letters
• Learn new English words and expand your vocabulary as you play
• Compete with players around the world on the online leaderboard
• Resume your last game and continue where you left off
• Skip to the next level after 24 hours
• Play in Handheld Mode, Tabletop Mode, or TV Mode
70010000134360.intro: Build words, score points, and master the hive.
70010000134360.name: WordBuzz 6

70010000134374.description:
Your journey begins with a single roll of the dice.
A board game-style adventure where heroes journey through the miniature world of “Viractalia.”
Your movement depends on the roll of the dice—but the key to victory lies in your hand and how you build your deck!

Embark on your own unique adventure in a world where strategy and luck are perfectly intertwined!

＜Features＞
Explore a charming miniature world
Each time you play, the whimsical yet intricate world transforms before your eyes!
With limited time to explore, every step is full of excitement: What will happen next? What will I find?

A fusion of card battles and board game strategy
Use a wide variety of cards to defeat your enemies!
Collect countless cards and build your own custom deck and powerful combos!

Dice-based movement with the DP system
“I rolled a big number... but I only want to move one space?”
Don't worry—no roll is ever wasted!
Unused movement points are converted into DP, a special resource that can be spent to power up events or give you the edge in battle.

Dynamic events and meaningful choices
On your journey, you'll encounter unique and colorful events.
Your decisions may grant you powerful abilities... or change the course of your adventure entirely!

Play solo or with friends
Whether you're diving in solo or adventuring with others, you're in for a good time!
Online multiplayer is supported—and who knows? Something special might happen just for you when you're playing online...

<Where strategy and fate collide>
The fate you entrust to the dice, and the cards you choose with care—
Every move you make weaves your story.
A fresh adventure awaits board game lovers, card game fans, and strategy enthusiasts alike.
70010000134374.intro: A highly replayable board game RPG powered by dice and cards.
70010000134374.name: Viractal: Will You Trust Your Party? Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000134383.description:
Build your ramen rep by fashioning the ultimate bowl from a vast assortment of noodles, soup, and toppings. From roast pork to miso, mackerel, and more--the only limit is your imagination, meaning you'll need to use your noodle to nail the right recipes and bring hungry customers in by the crowd!

Enter contests and see how you size up against rivals, thus cementing your standing as superlative sensei of the savory! Succeed--and one day you might even have your own ramen theme park!
70010000134383.intro:
Build the ultimate bowl to leap past your
ramen rivals and achieve greatness!
70010000134383.name: The Ramen Sensei – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000134389.description:
hololive members transform into adorable treasures!
Stack the 3D hololive members without letting them overflow to create your very own mountain in this must-play 3D puzzle game for hololive fans!


How to Play
Just toss the treasures and stack them on the island!
Combine identical treasures to transform them into larger ones!
The game ends when a treasure falls off the island!

Create bigger treasures and make consecutive combinations to boost your score through chain reactions!
And when you create the largest treasure, something amazing happens…!?


Treasure Exchange
The treasures that appear in the game can be swapped with other members!
Customize to your liking and create your own unique mountain of favorite members!


Rankings
Compete with players from around the world and test your skills.
Aim for the high score and keep challenging yourself!


New Features for the Nintendo Switch™ Version
This version includes all three DLC packs previously released for the PC version!
By completing newly added in-game missions, you can unlock a total of four commentators and music tracks by talents!

Additionally, a new BGM customization feature has been added!
Combine your favorite BGM with your favorite commentator to create your very own Treasure Mountain and enjoy the game even more!
70010000134389.intro: Stack the Love of Captain Marine!
70010000134389.name: hololive Treasure Mountain MegaPack – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000134428.description:
Humanity had a good run, Now it’s time to take back what’s yours. Dive into a dice-based roguelike deckbuilder where your tactical decisions, not luck, determine the fate of the planet.

Build your own Invasion

Build a growing alien force on a turn-based grid where every placement matters. Each turn you can acquire different units, artifacts, budges and chrono. Place your invaders strategically in the grid to enhance your scoring potential.

Manipulate the Dice

Dice aren’t a game of chance here, they’re your most powerful tool. With ‘Chrono’ you can strategically reroll your dice and restock the shop to draft your most vital units.  You can transform a bad roll into an unstoppable chain reaction. Use ‘budge’ to  manipulate your dice throw to build the exact combo you want. Even, align your dice in pairs, triples or quadruple to ignite devastating combos.

Be the Commander

Each commander brings a distinct strategic approach, specialized synergies and XP scaling possibilities unlocking new ways to dominate. Each equipped with unique perks and artifacts so each run gives you new ways to send your attack score into the stratosphere.

Earth won’t be destroyed without a fight. Beware, the legendary Pilots from StarVaders will show up to protect the planet, each armed with unique abilities designed to disrupt your invasion.

Break the game

Experiment with absurd synergies and push the game’s systems to their absolute limit. Discover a broken combo that launches your score into orbit and out smarts the pilots.
70010000134428.intro: Lead the Invasion. Master the Dice. Break the Game.
70010000134428.name: Dicevaders

70010000134452.description:
Quiz Challenge Multiplayer is the quiz game that turns your couch into a game show stage.

Answer questions across two great fields of knowledge — History and Science — each split into a wide range of themes. From ancient civilizations to modern events, from astronomy to chemistry, every session mixes things up so no two games feel the same.

GRAB A CONTROLLER, GRAB YOUR FRIENDS
Play solo to train at your own pace, or gather up to 4 players in local multiplayer. No account, no connection, no waiting — just pass the pad or take a controller each and start.

TWO WAYS TO PLAY

STANDARD — Classic quiz rules. Take your time, think it through, and answer correctly to score.
BATTLE — Speed is everything. The faster you lock in the right answer, the more points you take. Hesitate, and your opponents leave you behind.

LEARN WHILE YOU PLAY
Every question is a chance to pick something new up. History and Science are only half of it: the game is fully playable in English, French, German and Spanish, so you can switch to the language you're learning and train your vocabulary while you play. It's a quiz night and a language lesson in one.

FEATURES

Hundreds of questions across History and Science
Multiple themes within each category
1 to 4 players, local multiplayer
Standard and Battle modes
4 fully localized languages: English, French, German, Spanish
Pick up and play — perfect for family evenings and party sessions

How much do you really know? Time to find out.
70010000134452.intro: History & Science quiz, 1 to 4 players, in English, French, German, Spanish.
70010000134452.name: Quiz Challenge Multiplayer

70010000134472.description: This set contains the original mini soundtrack “CRISIS CORE –FINAL FANTASY VII– REUNION MINI SOUNDTRACK” and the original art book “HEROES Past and Present The Art of CRISIS CORE –FINAL FANTASY VII–“.
70010000134472.name: CRISIS CORE –FINAL FANTASY VII– REUNION Digital Contents

70010000134512.description:
CRISIS CORE –FINAL FANTASY VII– REUNION is the HD remaster version of the smash hit prequel to FINAL FANTASY VII.

In addition to all graphics being remastered in HD, fully voiced dialogue and new soundtrack arrangements make for a dynamic new retelling of a beloved classic.

CRISIS CORE –FINAL FANTASY VII– REUNION follows the story of Zack Fair, a young warrior admired by the boy destined to save the world, trusted by men renowned as heroes of legend, and loved by the girl who holds the fate of the planet in her hands. The tale of Zack's dreams and honor—the legacy that connects him to Cloud—is revealed in full in this grand saga that has broken the limits of an HD remaster.

<New Features>
- All graphics fully remastered in HD
- Renewed 3D models, including characters and backgrounds, enriching the visual experience
- Improved battle system providing a vastly smoother gameplay experience
- Fully voiced dialogue in both English and Japanese
- A newly arranged soundtrack from the original composer, Takeharu Ishimoto

<CRISIS CORE –FINAL FANTASY VII– REUNION>
In the mako-powered metropolis of Midgar stands the headquarters of Shinra, a powerful company with a formidable private army. Zack Fair is a promising young operative in the Shinra military's elite unit, SOLDIER. Together with his mentor, SOLDIER 1st Class Angeal, and the SOLDIER hero Sephiroth, Zack begins an investigation into the recent mass disappearance of SOLDIER operatives.
70010000134512.intro: CRISIS CORE –FINAL FANTASY VII– REUNION has broken the limits of an HD remaster. Witness the evolution of the beloved FFVII prequel.
70010000134512.name: CRISIS CORE –FINAL FANTASY VII– REUNION

70010000134525.description:
TCG Card Shop Simulator is a trading card shop simulation where you sell card booster packs to earn money and build your card shop business.

Manage Your Shop:
Design your own TCG shop. Organize shelves and card packs to make the customer shopping experience smooth and easy. "

Card Collection:
Open the booster packs yourself and collect the cards. Find rare cards and sell them to make a fortune, or keep them to complete your card collection.

Host Game:
Set your card game format and fee, invite players to play card games in your shop. Be sure to keep your store clean and hygienic for the players or they might leave!"

Order Products:
Stock up on different booster card packs and card game products. Keep track of popular trends and adjust your inventory to cater to the ever-changing demands of your customers.

Expand Your Business:
Earn profits to reinvest in your shop. Expand your space, unlock new card sets, and upgrade your facilities to attract even more customers and increase revenue.

This product is released for the Nintendo Switch™. It can also be played on Nintendo Switch 2. However, please note that a separate product, "TCG Card Shop Simulator", is available exclusively for Nintendo Switch 2.
Save data and Additional Contents are not compatible between the two versions. Please be careful to avoid duplicate or mistaken purchases.
Nintendo Switch 2 Edition and Upgrade Pack are not available for this product.
70010000134525.intro: Sell cards, build your collection, run tournaments and earn money and build your card shop business.
70010000134525.name: TCG Card Shop Simulator

70010000134567.description:
A familiar word can feel surprisingly tricky when one kanji is missing. Does the right answer spring to mind?

Use illustrations and words as clues in a friendly kanji quiz for beginners.

Fill in the blank by choosing the correct kanji from four options. Everyday words become a fun way to get comfortable with Japanese characters.

How to play:
・Look at the illustration and the displayed word
・Think about which kanji completes the blank
・Choose the correct answer from four kanji

There are no complicated controls to learn. Simply pick an answer and enjoy one question at a time, even if you are just starting to study kanji.

With 120 stages to play through, you can make steady progress at your own pace. It is ideal for a little daily practice, a quick review or a short break.

Recommended for:
・Anyone who wants to get familiar with kanji
・Players who want to review kanji and words in a fun way
・Learners looking for an easy quiz for primary-school level
・Families who want to think through questions together
・Anyone looking for a learning game that fits into a few spare minutes

Use the illustrations as clues and work out which kanji belongs in the blank. Take on all 120 stages and discover a range of useful kanji and words.
70010000134567.intro: Match the picture with the right kanji!
70010000134567.name: Play & Learn My First KANJI

70010000134651.description:
The island is empty, but not abandoned. Someone worked here, and left behind their notes, their machines and their questions.

Quern - Undying Thoughts is a first-person puzzle adventure about exploring a place and slowly coming to understand it. The puzzles are not isolated boxes to tick off. A mechanism you learn in one building turns up again somewhere else, and the island rewards you for thinking about it as a whole rather than one room at a time.

Explore at your own pace, keep your own notes, and work out why you were brought here.

- Hand crafted environments and environmental storytelling
- Puzzle mechanics that reappear and build on each other
- English voice over, with text in nine further languages
- Single player
70010000134651.intro: You step through the portal onto the island of Quern. It closes behind you.
70010000134651.name: Quern - Undying Thoughts

70010000134663.description:
Eight unique characters face off
in an exciting card-flipping showdown!

Flipi Rivals!

Follow the story through the eyes of Panda
in Story Mode.

Discover the stories of all eight characters
and take on a series of battles in Arcade Mode.

Challenge a friend right beside you
in Local Battle Mode.

Enjoy the game's beautiful music anytime
in the Music Room.

Plus, discover a variety of game-changing items
and unique battle arenas!

Simple controls, intense competition!
Test your reflexes and memory!

Use quick thinking and strategy
to become the ultimate Card Master!

An exciting card battle with adorable rivals!

Flipi Rivals!

Flip the cards. Turn the tide!
70010000134663.intro:
Flip the cards. Turn the tide!
An exciting card battle with adorable rivals!
70010000134663.name: Flipi Rivals

70010000134709.description:
Enter the ruins of a long-fallen kingdom and uncover the dangers hidden within its forgotten dungeon.

You take control of a mysterious masked adventurer on a journey through an interconnected world filled with hazardous passages, challenging platforming sections and hostile creatures. Explore the dungeon in your chosen order, discover new paths and prepare for an inevitable confrontation with the nameless king.

Master a responsive set of movement abilities, including double jumps, rapid dashes and wall-climbing. Combine these skills to cross dangerous gaps, climb towering chambers and reach areas hidden throughout the kingdom.

When enemies stand in your way, fight back using quick combo attacks or charge a powerful special move that unleashes explosive damage across the surrounding area. Choose the right moment to strike, avoid incoming attacks and survive each encounter.

Rest at bonfires to restore your strength and establish new checkpoints as you descend deeper into the ruins. Every chamber brings you closer to the ruler waiting at the end of your journey.

Features:

• Explore an interconnected 2D dungeon
• Run, double-jump, dash and climb walls
• Battle enemies using combos and special attacks
• Rest at bonfires to heal and save your progress
• Discover multiple routes through the fallen kingdom
• Face the nameless king in a final boss battle

The kingdom has fallen, but its ruler remains. Will you survive the descent?
70010000134709.intro: Explore a fallen kingdom as a masked adventurer. Master jumps, dashes, wall-climbing and powerful attacks as you battle through the dungeon and confront the Nameless King.
70010000134709.name: King's Descent

70010000134759.description:
Strap on your jet pack and prepare for a high-speed journey through twisting tunnels and dangerous caves!

Each level starts at a manageable pace, but the longer you survive, the faster you go. Dodge the tunnel walls, react quickly and keep your flight under control as the speed continues to increase.

Take on 50 increasingly challenging levels across 5 unique worlds. Early levels are short and simple, but the tunnels become longer, faster and more difficult as you progress.

Complete levels to earn coins, then spend them to unlock new characters and take them along for the ride.

Master your jet pack, survive the speed and make it through every tunnel!
70010000134759.name: Dodge Mayhem

70010000134802.description:
There are no rescue teams. There is no medicine. Your only goal is to survive an endless wave of ruthless zombies. Starting with only the bare essentials, you’ll have to think fast and act even faster as the daily hordes gather. Every second on the battlefield is a test of your reflexes, where the rational use of ammunition, maintaining distance, and keeping your weapon ready at all times are the only keys to survival.

The struggle is simple yet intense: survive the day to make it to the next. At the end of each day, the environment changes, transporting you to new locations. This constantly forces you to adapt your actions and strategies to entirely new conditions and challenges. To help you face the increasingly faster, stronger, and more aggressive mutants the next morning, after each day you successfully survive, you’re rewarded with a set of random upgrades. Boost your weapon’s power, improve your stats, and see how many days you can hold out against the relentless horde.
70010000134802.name: Dead Seek

70010000134808.description:
Step into the action with MotionPlay™ Sports, featuring two easy to play games -Bowling and Table Tennis - using your body movements to control the action.
Using the free MotionPlay™ app on your compatible smartphone, your phone camera tracks your movements in real time and turns them into game controls. No wearable controllers, no extra accessories just position your phone, stand in front, and play.
BOWLING
Move and bowl naturally.
Move your bowling hand left or right to line up your shot, then swing your arm forward just like bowling a real ball. Play solo against the AI or go head-to-head with a friend or family member in 2 player local play as you chase strikes, spares and the high score.
TABLE TENNIS
Take on the AI across 3 difficulty levels, from an easy-going rally partner to a serious challenge.
Move your hand left and right to position your bat and line up with the ball. With automatic hit and serve, it’s simple to pick up and play, while the higher AI levels bring the heat.
No gear. Just move.

MotionPlay Sports requires a compatible smartphone and the free MotionPlay app.
70010000134808.intro: YOU ARE THE CONTROLLER. JUST MOVE.
70010000134808.name: MotionPlay Sports

70010000134815.description:
Step into a colourful woodland filled with animals, hidden discoveries and mysterious creatures.

Mathias has ventured deep into the forest, where every path offers something new to investigate. Guide him through peaceful meadows, dense woodland trails, flowing rivers and dark caves as you search for interesting objects and uncover the secrets of the wilderness.

Pay close attention to your surroundings. Follow scattered feathers, inspect abandoned campsites, examine unusual plants and mushrooms, and interact with the animals you meet along the way. Some creatures may need your help, while other encounters will test whether Mathias is brave enough to continue.

Every discovery shapes Mathias’s personality. Exploring unfamiliar places increases his curiosity, facing frightening creatures develops his bravery, and experiencing the peaceful side of nature brings him happiness. The qualities you develop during your journey will influence how Mathias handles the greatest mystery hiding within the woods.

Deep inside the forest lives a legendary Yeti. Will Mathias frighten the creature away, become trapped in its cave or discover that the mysterious beast may not be an enemy after all? His final fate depends on the experiences collected throughout the adventure.

Explore at your own pace, enjoy the charming low-poly environments and see where your journey through the forest will lead.

Features:

• Explore a colourful 3D woodland environment
• Discover hidden locations and mysterious caves
• Interact with animals, plants and unusual objects
• Develop bravery, curiosity and happiness
• Help creatures you encounter during your journey
• Uncover the mystery of the legendary Yeti
• Experience multiple endings based on your actions

The forest is waiting. Follow the trail, embrace the unknown and discover what lies deep within the woods.
70010000134815.intro: Explore a mysterious forest, uncover hidden paths, discover forgotten secrets and survive the dangers lurking among the trees.
70010000134815.name: Evergreen Quest

70010000134856.description:
Discover iconic landmarks, hidden courtyards, and the unique charm of European cities, all from the comfort of your home.

What's new in Trip to Europe 13:
- Every scene is crafted with meticulous attention to architectural authenticity and cultural context. Dozens of carefully hidden objects await your sharp eye.
- Enhanced search modes — Expanded task types, dynamic hints, and interactive elements breathe life into every image and keep gameplay engaging.
- Mini games and puzzles — Logic, observation, and memory challenges are seamlessly woven into your journey for a satisfying change of pace.
- Souvenir collection — Purchase memorable keepsakes that reflect the traditions, crafts, and spirit of each country you visit.
- Postage stamps — A commemorative stamp awaits you on every location. Fill your album to unlock exclusive bonuses.
70010000134856.intro: Pack your bags, it's time to travel!
70010000134856.name: Big Adventure: Trip to Europe 13 Collector's Edition

70010000134874.description:
In 2001, development began on an ambitious game that would have shown the full potential of handheld consoles with its unique 3d voxel engine. Based on a hugely popular science fiction franchise, the game was unfortunately cancelled before it could be fully completed. Now, experience this enhanced revival of this forgotten game.

Elland, a harsh desert world on the outskirts of the Galaxy. With nothing but scant indigenous life, the planet is controlled by the cooperative Elland Inc., which mines the abundant minerals and crystals used in the construction of galactic star cruisers. The mining operations and the abundance of Brem-Nar crystals have transformed Elland from a dusty wasteland into a glittering and much envied prize. Notorious for its precipitation, the neighboring world of Mank is home to the headquarters of the Trafford Corporation, the largest constructor of space cruisers and weapons in the Galaxy. Trafford is infamously aggressive, using its financial muscle and military power to always get what it wants. At this moment in time it wants to control Elland and it will use all and any resources to get what it wants.

You are Ethan Lancashire, one of the finest of Elland Inc.’s fighter pilots. Across more than 20 dangerous missions you will pilot advanced flying machines that can move, turn and hover, and come equipped with a variety of weapons and utilities, fitted as the mission requires. Weapons can be set to lock-on or aimed manually. Earn commendations and trophies, displayed in your personal room, and climb the ranks from lowly Cadet all the way up to Air Force General.

This enhanced version introduces a number of modern features to this emulated game, including:
• An LCD filter option for an authentic retro experience
• Rewind live gameplay at any time
• A virtual interactive instruction booklet
70010000134874.intro: Experience a unique revived 3D flight game. Become an ace pilot on a harsh, unforgiving desert planet.
70010000134874.name: Elland: The Crystal Wars

70010000134957.description:
Collect puzzles with photorealistic images of girls in spectacular outfits, enjoy convenient touch controls and feel the process at your fingertips.

Relaxing music creates the right mood, and gradually increasing difficulty turns each level into an exciting challenge. After assembly, you can carefully examine each image and appreciate all the details.

Features:

• Photorealistic images.

• Realistic assembly process.

• Gradually increasing difficulty.

• Relaxing music.

• Detailed image viewing.
70010000134957.name: Real Girls: Forbidden Glow

70010000134978.description:
In a strange parallel galaxy, every fruit shares the same dream — to become a Big Watermelon.
Drop fruits onto a 360-degree planet and combine matching fruits to evolve them into bigger and bigger forms. Two cherries become a strawberry, two strawberries become grapes, and the evolution continues until you finally create a giant watermelon.
But be careful — the planet can only hold so much.
As more fruits pile up, they may begin to push beyond the planet’s safe boundary. A red warning ring appears when fruit move too far outside the planet. You still have a chance to knock them back into orbit, but if they drift completely beyond the boundary, they will fly off into the vacuum of space.
Plan every drop, create chain reactions, and aim for the highest score possible.

Fruit Evolution:
Combine two matching fruits to evolve them into the next fruit.
Cherry → Strawberry → Grapes → Orange → ... → Big Watermelon
Keep merging to create larger fruits, free up space, and increase your score.

Game Modes:
• Time Mode
You have 5 minutes to score as many points as possible.
Create a Big Watermelon and a bonus pickup will appear, giving you extra time. The more watermelons you create, the more chances you have to extend the match.
Merge two Big Watermelons to trigger a Super Big Bang and earn a huge score bonus.
Each game session is recorded so you can review your results after the match.

• Infinity Mode
Play without a time limit and see how long you can survive.
There is no clock. Your skill, strategy, and ability to keep the planet under control will determine how long you can keep playing and how high you can score.

• Versus Mode
Challenge another player in local split-screen multiplayer, or compete against an AI opponent.
A second player can join using an additional paired controller. If no human player joins within 5 seconds, the AI automatically takes control of Player 2.
Build bigger fruits, manage your planet, and try to outscore your opponent.

How to Play ?
Use the Left Stick, D-Pad, or L/R Buttons to move your small spaceship around the planet.
The spaceship carries the next fruit. Press the A Button to release it.
Each fruit is pulled toward the centre of the planet, where it can collide and merge with matching fruits.
For Versus Mode, pair an additional controller for a second human player to join the match.

Features
• Three game modes: Time, Infinity, and Versus
• Single-player gameplay
• Two-player local split-screen multiplayer
• Play against another human player or an AI opponent
• Unique 360-degree planetary fruit-merging gameplay
• Evolve fruits all the way into a Big Watermelon
• Trigger the Super Big Bang for huge bonus scores
• Review your recorded post-game results
• Compete with players around the world through online leaderboards
• Play in Handheld Mode, Tabletop Mode, or TV Mode
• Colourful space-themed graphics
• Professional background music and sound effects

How big can your watermelon become before everything flies into space?
70010000134978.intro: Merge fruits, grow giant watermelons, and conquer the galaxy!
70010000134978.name: Big Watermelon Galaxy
