70010000135016.description:
Walk The Frog is a cozy, heartwarming point-and-click adventure with simple, unique drag-and-drop puzzle mechanics. Your task is to correctly assemble Froggo’s world on sticky notes. You can solve the puzzles at your own pace and enjoy a gentle narrative journey with no stress or pressure.

Head home for the Froggapalooza festival
Froggo only wants one thing: to be back home at his pond so he can celebrate the start of spring with his friend Buddy. But along his path, he will encounter a lot of funny, sassy, and quirky characters who want his time and attention. Maybe they’ll help him, too? Will he make it to the festival on time?

Sort the world out
Each level consists of an assortment of hand-drawn sticky notes. Your task is to piece them together correctly to create a path so Froggo can continue his journey and set his world to rights.
Every puzzle you solve is like a little moment of clarity; the mechanics are intuitive and accessible.

Get cozy
The lovingly hand-drawn 2D style and ambient soundtrack create a heartwarming world where you can immerse yourself and relax.

Friendship and hope
Snuggle up in your coziest blanket, brew a cup of your favorite tea, and get to know Froggo and his quirky new friends. Talk to each other, help one another, and work together to overcome an array of obstacles.
Walk The Frog invites you into a hopeful, emotional story of homecoming, friendship, and connection.

No timer, no stress
You can take your time solving the puzzles on Froggo’s journey home. Some encounters are optional, and some dialogues change nuances of the story.

A narrative game that helps you unwind
Take a break from your day-to-day and immerse yourself in a cozy puzzle adventure that doesn’t push you; it gently takes you along on a journey.

Froggo is here to cheer you up when things get tough.

FEATURES:
- Enjoy a touching story and humorous dialogue.
- Assemble a world out of sticky notes and create the right path for Froggo and his friends.
- Unique, hand-drawn 2D visual style.
- A story for young and old alike; the whole family can play together.
- Join Froggo as he meets funny, quirky friends, and work together to overcome obstacles.
- Finally, a fun use for sticky notes! No more boring to-do lists.
- Three different chapters: 1. The Forest, 2. The Insect City, 3. Fields and Meadows.
- A total of 18 levels made up of lots of lovingly illustrated sticky notes.
- Intuitive drag-and-drop and point-and-click controls.
70010000135016.intro: Help Froggo solve cozy sticky note puzzles and find his best friend Buddy!
70010000135016.name: Walk The Frog

70010000135026.description:
Dice A Million is a roguelike deckbuilder about rolling dice to try and get to a million points. That's the whole point. (get it?!)

You're trapped in this dice rolling facility, so let's get rolling and try to escape. Combine the effects of more than 120 different dice and discover powerful synergies. Get through ever-increasing debts and challenging bosses that will require perfect symbiosis in your bag in order to be beaten.

Will you be able to push luck to your side?
70010000135026.intro: Have you ever tried to roll 1,000,000 on a set of dice? No? Build the right bag of die, and you might just pull it off.
70010000135026.name: Dice A Million

70010000135041.description:
KEEP YOUR CAT EYES SHARP
Step into a cozy world of colorful rooms, adorable cats, and little details waiting to fool your eyes. Compare rooms carefully and find everything that has changed. Objects may move, disappear, rotate, change color, or hide somewhere you least expect!

TRUST YOUR MEOWMORY
Think you can remember every little detail? Study a room carefully, keep its layout in mind and then find what has changed without a side-by-side comparison. If things get tricky, use helpful boosters such as Highlight, Peek and Freeze to give yourself a little extra help.

CREATE YOUR PURR-FECT ROOM
Take a break from puzzling and become an interior designer! Build your own cozy rooms from scratch and make them truly yours with over 870 customization items, including furniture, decorations, plants, floors, walls and more! Arrange everything just the way you like, experiment with colors and create a cozy space for your feline friends. Collect 2 adorable kitties and watch them wander around the room as you enjoy your creation.

TWO PLAYERS, TWICE THE PURR
Challenge a friend in local multiplayer and see who can spot the differences faster! Play together on one screen, put your observation skills to the test and turn every cozy room into a little friendly competition.

FEATURES:
• Spot the Difference - Compare 2 rooms and find objects that have moved, disappeared, rotated, changed color or been replaced
• Memory Rooms - Study a room carefully, remember every detail and then find what has changed
• Cozy Room Editor - Build and decorate your own cozy rooms from scratch!
• Over 870 Customization Items - Choose from furniture, decorations, plants, floors, walls and more to create your perfect cozy space
• Local Multiplayer - Challenge a friend and see who can spot the differences faster
• Cute Kitties - Collect 2 adorable feline friends that wander around the room
• Custom Memory Challenges - Choose the number of differences, Time to Look, Time to Spot and Allowed Mistakes
• Helpful Boosters - Use Highlight, Peek and Freeze when you need a little help

Spot the little things, create cozy spaces and enjoy every meow-ment!
70010000135041.intro: Build the purr-fect room and spot what’s out of place!
70010000135041.name: Cozy Meowmory

70010000135042.description:
Deck of Haunts invites you to step into the eerie role of a malevolent Haunted House, where the walls whisper secrets and terror lurks around every corner. As the master of this cursed domain, your goal is to ensnare daring humans, play on their fears, and drain their very essence to expand your dark influence.

By day, meticulously design the labyrinthine layout of your mansion, transforming it into a death trap that no human can escape. As night falls, lure unwitting explorers into your home, where you'll use a deck of terrifying cards to summon spirits, shift hallways, and unleash spine-chilling horrors. Build tension and drive your guests toward madness, all while protecting your Heart room—the core of your malevolent power.

Once their sanity crumbles, harvest their essence to strengthen your mansion, increasing your infamy and attracting even more daring foes, from law enforcement to priests. But beware, the Stone Masons are coming, ready to challenge your reign of terror…

Craft Your Deck of Haunts
Unlock and collect new cards as you progress. Expand your deck to include tools of terror like bone-chilling screams, phantoms, creaking floors, and shifting walls. Use your cards to scare – or kill – your victims, then extract their essence.

Build Your Mansion
Strategically design your haunted house by placing rooms that serve to protect your Heart room, where your power is concentrated. Construct a maze filled with traps, scares, and unique twists, all tailored to frighten and confuse your visitors. Utilize special rooms with unique powers to aid in your hauntings.

Sow Tension and Fear
As humans navigate your mansion, increase the tension by playing haunt cards directly on them and within different rooms. Slowly drive them to insanity. Once their fear reaches critical levels, use the right haunts to push them to the brink of madness. Will you let them escape?

Harvest Essence
Once you've driven the explorers mad with fear, extract their essence to grow your mansion. Use it to unlock new rooms, expand your haunting powers, and attract more dangerous—and rewarding—targets. Grow your haunted domain into a nightmare that consumes all who enter.

Note: This is the Nintendo Switch version:

This product is released for the Nintendo Switch. It can also be played on Nintendo Switch 2. However, please note that a separate product, also named "Deck Of Haunts" is available for Nintendo Switch 2.

Save data and Additional Contents are not compatible between the two versions. Please be careful to avoid duplicate or mistaken purchases.

Nintendo Switch 2 Edition and Upgrade Pack are not available for this product.
70010000135042.name: Deck Of Haunts

70010000135063.description:
Meet Pikmin, small, plantlike creatures you can grow, pluck, guide, and send into battle with enemies multiple times their size! These loyal, curious helpers come in different types, including fire-resistant Red Pikmin and brand-new Ice Pikmin. The fate of your Pikmin is yours to decide—will you carefully avoid danger or rush into situations despite potential...losses?

- Dandori Academy.
Give Oatchi commands using your voice and put your Dandori skills to the test in Pikmin 4 – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy.

Take on challenges to see how quickly you can collect treasure within the stage. Exams are held each week on Friday, Saturday, and Sunday. You can practise each stage as much as you want, but you can only attempt the exam once per week.
70010000135063.intro: Raise a crop of plantlike Pikmin and guide them on an endearing expedition!
70010000135063.name: Pikmin 4 – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy

70010000135120.description:
In RESONANT BLADE, sound itself becomes your weapon. The Dark Synths have overrun a world once protected by domed cities, turning them into cages for an ever-growing army of hostile machines.

You play as Atlas, a scientist forced to become a fighter after his home is destroyed. Armed with the Resonant Blade, he channels sonic energy into devastating attacks - and uses that same resonance to uncover hidden paths, solve environmental puzzles, and expose secrets buried in the ruins.

Dash, parry, and tune your blade's frequency to break through enemy defenses in fast, precise 2D combat that combines intense action, exploration, and environmental puzzles. As the Synths adapt and grow stronger, only careful timing and clever use of sound will keep Atlas - and what's left of Terra - alive.

Features:
- Sonic-powered combat: slash, dash, and modulate frequencies to break enemy defenses
- Explore the ruins of Terra and uncover secrets through sound-based puzzles
- Fast, precise 2D action combining combat, exploration, and environmental challenges
- Face an ever-evolving army of Dark Synth machines and challenging bosses
- Single-player sci-fi adventure in a dystopian, atmospheric world
70010000135120.intro: Wield sonic power to slash through an army of machines in a fallen world.
70010000135120.name: Resonant Blade

70010000135133.description:
A young cleric named Verselio once devoted his life to serving the deity Treises—until the truth shattered everything he believed. When the divine is revealed to be a lie, faith turns into fury, and a journey of rebellion begins. Joined by a mysterious maiden, a disciplined vigilante chief, and a self-proclaimed deity, Verselio sets out across a vast fantasy world in search of answers. As their paths intertwine, each carries their own burdens, beliefs, and secrets, in a story of betrayal, redemption, and the meaning of faith in a deityless world.

Asdivine Knot is a classic turn-based JRPG that blends strategic command battles with modern systems and deep customization. Master the shared Nexus Gauge to control the flow of combat, unleash powerful Nexus Skills, and summon devastating entities to turn the tide. Explore a wide world with your fully customizable airship, craft and upgrade equipment using collected materials, and shape your adventure with side quests, crew recruitment, fishing, and puzzle dungeons. Packed with rich content and designed for a complete single-player experience, this is a must-play fantasy RPG for fans of traditional Japanese role-playing games.
70010000135133.intro: Tie the knot of fate in a skybound fantasy RPG!
70010000135133.name: Asdivine Knot - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000135243.description:
Opening your own clothing boutique means managing more than just racks of fabric. In this simulation game, you oversee all aspects of a retail space, transforming a modest shop into the city’s premier fashion destination. Every detail depends on your business decisions. Take your place at the helm. Browse seasonal catalogs to order trendy casual wear and elegant garments. Then, unpack and display your merchandise to catch the eyes of passersby.

Curating the perfect inventory is only the first step. You must also manage your prices strategically to keep your stock moving while ensuring your profit margins allow for future expansion. When the doors open, interact directly with your customers at the register while scanning clothes and processing physical cash and digital cards. Keep a close eye on the store for potential shoplifters and reinvest your profits in high-tech security systems, fresh paint, modern lighting fixtures, and decorative displays that enhance the shopping experience. As your customer list grows, unlock new apparel licenses, expand your store’s physical footprint, and hire cashiers to automate the daily routine.

Key Features:
★ Shop Management: Order diverse styles directly from wholesale catalogs, coordinate seasonal displays, and set prices to balance customer satisfaction with profit.
★ Interactive Checkout: Ring up shoppers at the register by scanning barcodes, handling cash, and processing card transactions, all while keeping wait times low.
★ Loss Prevention: Monitor the sales floor closely to deter shoplifting and install robust security measures to protect your stock.
★ Bespoke Customization: Personalize your interior with fresh wall paint, tailored lighting setups, and elegant clothing racks to create an inviting space.
★ Business Growth: Expand your physical storefront to unlock new garment licenses, add high-fashion sections, and hire cashiers to handle the increased customer volume.
70010000135243.intro: Set the trends and grow your boutique!
70010000135243.name: My Clothing Store Simulator

70010000135294.description:
A wild new "RABBIT AND TURTLE HARSH JUMP RACE" has begun!

Rabbits can move quickly, but they can only jump. On the other hand, turtles move slowly, but they take the safest and shortest route towards their goal. As a rabbit, can you skillfully jump over the various challenging and difficult courses and reach the finish line before the turtle?

There are all sorts of stages, from turtles pulling out strange machines to crows suddenly becoming allies, to races taking place during heavy snow with frozen platforms—it's a truly chaotic race!

While the simultaneous display of Japanese and English can be educational, it might be more suitable for mental training.
70010000135294.intro:
The World of Japanese Fairy Tales
Simple Jumping and harsh Races
The appeal of simultaneous Japanese and English display
70010000135294.name: RABBIT AND TURTLE HARSH JUMP RACE

70010000135300.description:
Valkyrie Saga is an indie, retro platformer styled after 1994 3D platformer classics, giving you a chance to embark on an epic odyssey! Play as Roll the Valkyrie, a divine warrior tasked by the gods with one mission: Stopping a floating island from crashing into the earth. Ascend the ancient skyborne land, explore ancient ruins, unlock their secrets - and stop the cataclysm!

* PLAY A TRUE RETRO GAME

Valkyrie Saga captures the original 1994 3D platformer gamefeel with era-authentic visuals, a deeply immersive soundtrack, and gameplay that recreates the magic that defined a generation.

* EXPERIENCE A VALKYRIE'S LIFE

As the divine warrior, you'll have to master both the art of soaring across the skies across the plummeting island, and the way of the spear, confronting otherworldly foes!

* DISCOVER COMPLEX LORE

Hidden among the ruins, cryptic scribblings, and odd twists of the world is a complex story to piece together, detailing what happened to the civilization that once occupied the island. Can you find out the truth before it is too late?
70010000135300.intro: Join Roll the Valkyrie as she subverts fate. Climb, dash, jump, and glide your way up a falling sky island, to stop it from destroying the world below.
70010000135300.name: Valkyrie Saga

70010000135321.description:
<How to Play>
◆ Turn your drawings into puzzles!
Draw freely using pens, watercolours, crayons, stamps and more. Once your picture is finished, transform it into a one-of-a-kind jigsaw puzzle.
◆ Enjoy beautiful 3D puzzles!
Alongside your own drawings, you’ll find a variety of pictures featuring scenery, animals, food and more. Choose from 12 to 84 pieces, turn piece rotation on or off, and play at your preferred difficulty.
◆ Play alone or with up to four players!
Take your time playing solo, or enjoy drawing and solving puzzles together with family and friends.
◆ Play and collect new items!
Complete puzzles to earn coins. Exchange them for new pictures, stamps and tables.
70010000135321.intro: Turn your drawings into puzzles! Enjoy beautiful graphics and local multiplayer in this feature-packed puzzle game.
70010000135321.name: Canvas Puzzle

70010000135356.description:
Feel the rhythm and let the music guide every move in this exciting rhythm game where precision, timing, and quick reflexes are the keys to success. Follow the beat, hit every note with perfect accuracy, and challenge yourself across a variety of energetic tracks.

Each song offers a unique rhythm pattern designed to test your coordination and sense of timing. As the music becomes faster and more complex, you'll need to stay focused, maintain your combo, and strive for the highest score.

Whether you're a newcomer to rhythm games or a seasoned music game fan, intuitive controls and progressively challenging songs make every performance both fun and rewarding.

Master every track, improve your accuracy, and become the ultimate rhythm champion.

Features:

Fast-paced rhythm gameplay focused on timing and precision.
A variety of energetic music tracks to master.
Challenging note patterns that test your reflexes.
Build combos and achieve high scores with perfect performances.
Easy-to-learn controls suitable for players of all skill levels.
Replay your favorite songs to improve your timing and beat your best scores.
70010000135356.intro: Feel the rhythm and hit every beat as you test your timing across a variety of energetic songs in this fast-paced music game.
70010000135356.name: Rhythm Flow

70010000135366.description:
If it's a multiple of 3 or 4,
YES!

If it's not a multiple of 3 or 4,
NO!

Count to 100 to
CLEAR THE GAME!
Let's get started!
70010000135366.intro:
Let's play with multiples of 3 or 4
together with Shuri!
70010000135366.name: 3OR4

70010000135416.description:
You are a curious child with a house full of interactive objects and a list of simple missions to complete. This level-based simulator is designed for straightforward, relaxed gameplay from a child's perspective on the floor. You have complete freedom to crawl, walk, and climb through cozy indoor rooms and sunny backyard gardens, transforming everyday domestic spaces into your personal playground.

This puzzle adventure offers unique and lighthearted challenges at each level. Some missions have you hunting down hidden toys, while others require you to use your wits to reach high places. Use smooth controls to navigate the stylized 3D environment and complete objectives such as finding hidden toys, solving simple puzzles, and setting up harmless, funny pranks to surprise your mom.
70010000135416.name: Naughty Baby

70010000135451.description:
Very Scary Game is a horror game where your decisions determine the story's development and ending.

Explore mysterious locations, solve puzzles, talk to strange characters, and make choices in the most unexpected situations. Don't trust everything you see, and pay close attention to details—sometimes the most obvious solution isn't the right one.

The game offers a variety of story paths and endings, from the truly terrifying to the downright crazy and humorous. Some are easy to find, while others will require you to make far more unobvious decisions.

Game Features:

• Multiple choices and unique endings
• Non-linear story progression
• Psychological horror atmosphere
• Puzzles, riddles, and hidden clues
• Unexpected plot twists
• Secret and humorous endings
• Dark humor and absurd situations

Can you find the real exit?
70010000135451.intro: Your choice. Your fear. Your ending.
70010000135451.name: Very Scary Game

70010000135463.description:
Grab your biggest gun and help one fearless squirrel collect every nut! Shoot, jump, use weapon recoil to launch yourself through obstacles, and blast enemies with nut-shaped heads.

Every level brings new traps, crazy situations, and fresh challenges. Unlock even bigger weapons, master chaotic physics, and turn every firefight into explosive fun.

Features

- Fast-paced 2D action with ragdoll physics
- A crazy arsenal of powerful weapons
- Use weapon recoil to reach new places
- Nut-headed enemies and deadly traps
- Dozens of action-packed levels
- Easy to learn, endlessly fun to master
70010000135463.name: Nutty Gunner: 2D Squirrel Shooter

70010000135519.description:
Discover a fresh take on mini golf where the course is just as important as the ball. Instead of swinging a club, you'll tilt the entire level to guide your golf ball through creative courses filled with ramps, moving platforms, narrow pathways, and clever obstacles.

Use gravity to your advantage as you carefully control the ball's movement, avoid dangerous hazards, and find the perfect route to the hole. Every level introduces new challenges that require precision, timing, and strategic thinking to master.

Easy to pick up but difficult to perfect, each course rewards careful control and experimentation. Learn how every tilt affects the ball's momentum and overcome increasingly complex layouts as your skills improve.

Can you conquer every course and become the ultimate master of gravity-driven mini golf?

Features:

Unique gameplay where you tilt the entire course instead of hitting the ball.
Creative levels filled with ramps, moving platforms, and challenging obstacles.
Physics-based gameplay that rewards precision and careful timing.
Increasingly difficult courses that test your skill and strategy.
Simple controls that are easy to learn and satisfying to master.
Relaxing mini golf experience with a fresh and original twist.
70010000135519.intro: Tilt the entire course to guide your golf ball through creative obstacles, avoid hazards, and sink the perfect shot across challenging levels.
70010000135519.name: Roll Golf

70010000135603.description:
A Wholesomevania game

The Merlies, a community of tiny birds, got scattered across the land by a huge storm! Explore a colorful charming 2D universe and unlock new hidden passages as your Merlies squad grows and learns new skills, in a metroidvania-like gameplay. Use each Merlies’ specific abilities during your exploration in this poetic adventure game.

While being beautiful, the world of The Merlies isn’t the most welcoming one. Your Merlies remain fragile little fellows exposed to the dangers of Nature. No creature or fight will be on your way but every thorn, every rock, every tree becomes an obstacle to overcome. Sometimes, the path will be hard to find, hidden in this wild and bucolic maze. And be careful not to lose one of your Merlies on the way!

Throughout your exploration, you’ll encounter remains of a long gone civilization. Lucky you! For one man’s junk is a Merlies’ treasure! Collect scraps to create and decorate your village, accommodate your Merlies and train them to get ready for exploration!

A great adventure in a small universe

Visually inspired by graphic novels and children’s image books, The Merlies is a bright and cozy tale. Befriend cute expressive birds and go out with your new friends to discover the many biomes and uncover their passageways and secrets.

Climb electric cables and fallen billboards, send your Merlies up in the sky by jumping on mushrooms or explore empty pipes. For your small Merlies, everyday objects take on gigantic proportions and get a new purpose for your community: make a cozy house out of a lamp, a huge map out of a slate or a store room out of an ice cube tray!
But their little size isn’t going to stop their adventurous and creative minds to create a new and better community for their kind.

A tale of resilience

Human civilization is gone and Nature is healing. Discover a calm and comforting adventure and help your community grow through recycling and upcycling human junk. Wacky constructions and clever upcycling are the key to bringing comfort and happiness to your tribe. The Merlies’ way of life is to do a lot, with a little.

The Merlies is a Solarpunk game: post-apocalyptic, sure, but not like you would expect. It’s a bright tale promoting a hopeful future, where your Merlies are brought together by cooperation and solidarity. Community spirit and a clever (re)use of scraps are key features that take the game far from dystopic Cyberpunk often associated with post-apocalypse.

Features

- An exploration-based poetic adventure
- A “wholesomevania” gameplay: explore a 2D map at your own pace
- Exploit the many abilities of a squad of Merlies
- Stunning and refined visuals with hand-made drawings
- A solarpunk optimistic take on post-apocalypse games
70010000135603.intro: Meet the Merlies, adorable little birds scattered by the wind. Gather them together and recycle the trash to make a cozy nest.
70010000135603.name: The Merlies

70010000135624.description:
MERGE, BUILD, AND DEFEND
Your fortress is under attack! Choose and place buildings, merge matching ones to make them stronger, and prepare for waves of monsters. Build structures that train knights, horsemen, archers, and mages, while all kinds of turrets and barricades attack or slow down enemies as they approach. Face skeletons, slimes, dragons, giants, and even stronger foes that appear as you progress. Adapt your setup to each threat and prepare for mighty bosses that can quickly break through a weak defense.

MAKE EVERY TILE COUNT
Space is limited, so plan your fortress carefully. Clear trees to open new tiles, decide where to place buildings that train different units, and find the best spots for barricades and turrets. Use every tile wisely, leave enough room to place and merge buildings, and create a layout that balances attack and defense.

LEAD HEROES INTO BATTLE
Place a hero on the battlefield to fight alongside your army. Each hero has unique stats, a combat skill, and a permanent boost. Upgrade your heroes, equip gear with useful bonuses, and prepare them for regular battles and special challenges.

EARN GOLD AND GROW STRONGER
Build gold mines to earn extra gold during each wave, but protect them from enemy attacks to collect the full reward. Spend your gold on rerolls to search for better buildings, gain experience by merging structures, and choose a new upgrade each time you level up. Strengthen your units, improve your defenses, or pick bonuses that fit your current strategy.

FEATURES:
• Units and Defenses - Build structures that produce different units or protect your fortress
• Strategic Placement - Clear trees, manage limited space, and balance offense with defense
• Merge and Upgrade - Combine matching buildings to create stronger structures
• Powerful Enemies - Face skeletons, slimes, dragons, giants, bosses, and unexpected threats
• Lead Your Heroes - Choose from 3 unique heroes, equip powerful gear, and use their combat skills
• Battle Upgrades - Gain experience and choose new bonuses during each battle
• Gold Management - Protect gold mines and spend your earnings on building rerolls
• 3 Challenge Modes - Test your strategy in Grand Battle, Boss Fight, and Hero Battle
• Varied Battlefields - Adapt your fortress to different environments, obstacles, and layouts

Lead your forces, prove your strategic skills, and build a kingdom no enemy can conquer!
70010000135624.intro: Merge your defenses, defeat relentless monsters and protect your fortress!
70010000135624.name: Fortress Merge

70010000135630.description:
Welcome to the ultimate playground of cute chaos. You step into the soft paws of a mischievous little kitten with one clear objective: turn every room into your personal playground of total destruction. From sprawling suburban houses to sunny yards across three unique locations, you have complete freedom to jump, explore, and knock over every fragile object in sight just for the fun of it.

Being a cat is a busy job. To complete your daily missions, you will need to hunt down sneaky mice, scratch up the carpets, and pull off funny, harmless pranks to keep your humans on their toes. As you explore, you will collect hidden stars and earn coins to unlock new, highly detailed rooms to expand your territory. To make the adventure even more playful, you can unlock and play as a variety of other adorable animal companions, and customize them all with a wardrobe of silly, stylish hats. Grab your controller, ignore the house rules, and show the world how much trouble one little kitten can make!
70010000135630.name: Cat Simulator

70010000135655.description:
In Spirit Valor, you play as a spirit caught in a struggle between magic and fate. After a magic outburst binds him to a human warrior Richard's body, the two embark on a perilous quest to stop the rise of demonic forces. With the world’s laws shattered, and the Overlord vanished, they must track down this elusive enemy before it is too late. Armed with the powerful Spellstones and magic, the spirit warrior sets out on an epic journey to restore balance to the world and prevent the transformation into a demon.

The game offers a rich RPG experience where adventure meets strategy. Make contracts with spirits, each granting unique magical abilities to aid you in your quest. As you journey through a beautifully crafted pixel art world, you will level up your spirits, evolve them, and unlock powerful magic. The dynamic combat system allows you to absorb enemy skills using the Empty Spellstone, giving you the ability to turn your foes' strengths against them. With strategic battles, a deep magic system, and a world filled with quests and exploration, Spirit Valor delivers an engaging fantasy experience that will keep you immersed till the end.
70010000135655.intro: An exciting spirit-collection RPG where you get stronger with each contract!
70010000135655.name: Spirit Valor

70010000135664.description:
Chart your fortune across a living galaxy. In 4096 Space Traders Era, you are a trader-pilot working your way from star to star, hunting the best deals the universe has to offer.

Explore a fully 3D galaxy: scroll through star systems, dive into each system to inspect its planets, and pick your next destination from a sprawling map where distance and reachability matter. On every world, the trading and stock screen puts a live market at your fingertips — buy commodities cheap on one planet, haul them across space, and sell them dear. Track your cargo, your positions, and your profit and loss in real time, because your one true goal is to grow the combined value of your cash and stock to the very top.

But the void is not empty. Every journey to a planet can drop you into a dogfight against alien fighters — dodge, out-fly and out-shoot them with guns and missiles while your Quantum Energy and ammo drain away. Whether you're winning or losing the battle, you can open comms and negotiate with the aliens to settle the fight and finish your journey on your own terms.

Trade, fly, fight, and deal your way to the richest hold in the galaxy.
- Deep 3D exploration — Scroll a detailed, navigable star map, jump between systems within your hyperdrive's range, and drop into any system to survey its planets before choosing where to trade next.
- Living market & stock screen — Buy low, sell high across thousands of worlds. A real-time trading board and inventory screen track your cargo, average cost, current market value and profit/loss, with prices that drift and evolve as the galactic economy simulates day by day (complete with price history and sparklines).
- One goal: build your fortune — Your net worth is the combined value of your cash + stock. Grow it as high as you can, chase the top "Stock and Cash Value," and beat your own peak.
- Alien dogfights — Every trip to a planet can erupt into combat. Pilot your fighter, manage Quantum Energy and ammo, and fight off alien waves with guns and missiles.
- Negotiate your way out — Win or lose, open comms with the aliens to settle any battle and continue your journey on your terms.
- Risk & permanence — Manage fuel, hull damage and cargo weight between trips, repair at station, and play with optional permadeath for a true high-stakes run.
70010000135664.intro: Trade the galaxy. Fight for it. Rule it.
70010000135664.name: 4096 Space Traders Era

70010000135670.description:
DOTI GOLF turns classic mini golf into a playground of chaos. Every hole hides its own trick - sand traps to slow you down, boost pads to send your ball flying, buttons and rotating bars that shift the course mid-swing, swamps that swallow a bad shot, and even pinball-style bumpers that send you ricocheting toward (or away from) the cup.

Rack up stars on every hole, chase the best par, and work your way through World after World of increasingly devious course design. Whether you're lining up a careful three-putt or gambling on a boost-pad bank shot, DOTI GOLF keeps every hole unpredictable.

Features:
- 5 Worlds featuring 15 holes each - 75 mini golf courses in total
- Wildly varied obstacles: sand, boost pads, buttons, portals, swamps, spikes, and pinball bumpers
- Star rating and par system on every hole
- Solo play, at your own pace
- Sleek, minimalist course design
70010000135670.intro: Putt, bounce, and boost your way through a wildly inventive mini golf adventure!
70010000135670.name: Doti Golf

70010000135696.description:
Color Lines is a classic and addictive puzzle game where every move matters. Arrange colorful balls on the board, create lines of 5 or more matching colors, and clear them to keep the board from filling up.

Think ahead, plan your moves, and build clever combinations. New balls appear as you play, making every turn a new challenge. Easy to learn but hard to master, Color Lines is perfect for both quick puzzle sessions and longer strategic play.

Game Features:

-Classic Color Lines gameplay
-Simple and intuitive controls
-Strategic and rewarding puzzles
-Clean and colorful design
-Relaxing gameplay with a real challenge
-Easy to learn, hard to master
-Suitable for all ages

How long can you keep the board clear and beat your best score?
70010000135696.intro: Plan your moves, line up the colors.
70010000135696.name: Color Lines

70010000135702.description:
A first-person game about tending a graveyard with a hole in the middle that eats.

What you do. Plant beds. They grow gourds on their own and level up as they grow. Pick a gourd up, carry it to the pit in the middle of the yard, and throw it in. Every one pays coins, and a long throw pays a bonus.

What is pushing you. The day runs on a timer. When it ends, night falls and you sleep in the bed to bank your coins. Fall in the pit yourself and the day ends there. You keep half of what you were carrying.

What you spend it on. The shop opens at nightfall. Money buys more ground to plant on. Sigils buy the upgrade tree: a vacuum that pulls gourds to you, a broom that blasts loose the heavy props lying around the yard, which the pit eats too, and eventually the pit itself, which you can drive across the yard instead of carrying everything to it.

What you are working towards. Everything you feed it makes it bigger. At rank eight the pit is full, and you climb in yourself to end the run. Or restart before that and keep your companions and a permanent growing-speed bonus.
70010000135702.intro: Grow gourds in a graveyard, carry them to the pit in the middle, and throw them in for coins before the day runs out.
70010000135702.name: The Pit Is Hungry

70010000135731.description:
From the creators of Nidhogg comes a game about 2D platforming survival. You'll have to parkour your way around treacherous dungeons to kite monsters while gathering blood and powerups.

Survive a run, take the bones you’ve earned to the Bone Shop, and get stronger.

Complete quests to unlock upgrades, arenas, skins, and more.

Features:
- 9 unlockable playable characters with different traits and weapons
- 6 unlockable unique survival arenas
- Over 100 enemy types
- Over 100 quests to complete
- Over 100 unlockable weapons and upgrades
- Dynamic “dungeon dnb” soundtrack by Thomas Hooey
70010000135731.intro: These dungeons are full of monsters. The blood is there. Take it!
70010000135731.name: Blood Dungeon - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000135778.description:
A normal morning heading to work at the high school...until you wake up surrounded by fog, the school deserted, and your dog missing. Something happened in the bathrooms, and now you're going in. Collect enough coins to buy your exit ticket, or risk it all to rescue your pet Shiba.

Welcome to The Bathrooms, a place you've probably seen in your dreams.

Things have been weird for a while at the high school. And now, after a kid performed a ritual in the school bathrooms for Halloween, they lead somewhere they shouldn't...

Your way out isn't a door. It's a price.
Coins are scattered throughout the tiled labyrinth. Collect enough and you can buy an exit ticket. That's the deal: no coins, no leaving.

Your vacuum is your lifeline. Upgrade it at the shop and gather faster.


You are not alone in here.
Beware of The Custodian. No one knows where he comes from. It's his realm and his rules. He learns, he adapts.

Hide in a stall if he spots you.


Rescue your Shiba, if you can.
Your pet dog is locked in a cage and you need the keys hidden around to unlock it. Will you risk everything to find them?


Features:
Use your vacuum to suck up as many coins as possible

Inhale copium to make every coin worth more

Ponder your orb to find keys and check for danger

Defend yourself against The Custodian with the clown gun if you have the skills

Gamble your coins at the slot machines if you like taking chances

Lose yourself in a maze of tiles that is never the same twice
70010000135778.intro: Use your vacuum to suck up as many coins as possible.
70010000135778.name: THE BATHROOMS

70010000135789.description:
Where It All Began
Before smartphones. Before app stores.
ZENONIA set the foundation for mobile RPGs.

Now, this iconic action RPG returns in its original form.

A Classic, Reimagined
Bringing back the original charm
while adapting seamlessly to today’s platforms.
Whether you're here for nostalgia
or a brand-new adventure—
ZENONIA is ready.

Classic RPG, Timeless Depth
Choose your path from three distinct classes:
Warrior – Balanced and resilient
Paladin – Defensive and reliable
Assassin – Fast and lethal
Customize your stats and gear
to build a playstyle that’s truly yours.

A Journey Driven by Choice
In a world where light and darkness collide,
every decision matters.
Unfold a rich story filled with unexpected events,
and shape your path between good and evil.

Endless Progression
- Hundreds of items across multiple tiers
- Deep systems combining skills, gear, and character growth
There is always more to discover.
70010000135789.intro:
Remember the RPG that defined a generation?
ZENONIA is back—faithfully restored.
Relive the adventure that kept you playing for hours.
70010000135789.name: ZENONIA

70010000135889.description:
THE SEQUEL TO THE REBOOT
Cotton Reboot! High Tension! is the latest game in the long-running Cotton series. These classic cute ’em ups have existed ever since 1991, when the first game was released in the Japanese arcades. Then as now, you play as the young witch Cotton and her faithful (?!) fairy friend Silk. The original game has a modern remake called Cotton Reboot!, and Cotton Reboot! High Tension! is the natural sequel and evolution of that very remake. Magical!

A HORIZONTAL ACTION FEST
There are two schools of shoot ’em ups: either they scroll vertically or they scroll horizontally. Cotton Reboot! High Tension! is an example of the latter. You control the witch Cotton as she flies on her broom, firing forward or using bomb attacks on ground targets. The enemies you face are as tough as they are numerous, but Cotton’s firepower is nothing to scoff at. Fight hard and you will prevail.

CRYSTAL POWER
When you defeat enemies in Cotton Reboot! High Tension!, they drop yellow crystals. If you shoot the crystals before picking them up, they will change color. Colored crystals help you level up your different elemental spells. But that's not all! By shooting your shots straight through the crystals and into enemies, you'll fill up a special bar and can eventually activate a mode called Willow Fever.

OVER TENSION!
Where does the game’s subtitle High Tension come from, you wonder? Well, it’s tied to the game’s signature mechanic! When you’re in Willow Fever mode, collect Willow candy to enter Over Tension. When Over Tension is active, enemy attacks become more extreme, but in return you can use powerful hidden magic to boost your score. If you want the highest possible points, it’s important to learn how to use Over Tension correctly. Good luck!
70010000135889.intro: The Willow candy is rebelling! Help the witch Cotton defeat these murderous sweets for good!
70010000135889.name: Cotton Reboot! High Tension!

70010000135951.description:
Meet our little friend Sputnik. Help its journey to become the greatest star in the solar system - the Sun!

Cosmic gravity is applied to the planet, which makes it different from the classic physics-based merge game.
The ability to target the other side of the planets adds much more strategy and depth to the game!
70010000135951.intro: A Cosmic twist on a physics-based merge game with space gravity. Help our little friend Sputnik on his journey to become the Sun.
70010000135951.name: Sputnika Game

70010000135961.description:
Enter a dangerous world where every room brings a new challenge. Fight your way through waves of enemies, avoid deadly traps, and survive intense encounters as you explore a fast-paced 2D roguelike adventure.

Use a variety of weapons and abilities to defeat increasingly powerful foes. Stay on the move, dodge incoming attacks, and learn enemy patterns as the action becomes more demanding with every battle. Each room tests your reflexes and your ability to adapt to constantly changing situations.

Your journey eventually leads to a powerful multi-stage boss encounter that will push everything you have learned to the limit. Dodge relentless attacks, find openings, and survive long enough to claim victory.

Game Features:

• Fast-paced 2D roguelike combat
• Rooms filled with enemies, hazards, and traps
• Different weapons and combat options
• Intense bullet-hell-inspired encounters
• Increasingly challenging enemy waves
• Multi-stage boss battle
• Simple controls with action-focused gameplay
• Test your reflexes, timing, and survival skills

Enter the Rogue Vault, survive its dangers, and see if you have what it takes to reach the end.
70010000135961.intro: Fight your way through dangerous rooms filled with relentless enemies, deadly traps, and intense bullet-hell action.
70010000135961.name: Rogue Vault

70010000135971.description:
Ethan Parker arrives in New York with little money, too much ambition, and an opportunity that could change his life: an internship at Monroe Advertising Group, one of Manhattan's most prestigious agencies.
But surviving the job will only be the beginning.
A brilliant boss, demanding and dangerously hard to ignore. A coworker who gets a little too close between jokes and late nights at work. A sophisticated executive who turns every conversation into a power game. And another intern whose friendship might stop being innocent much sooner than expected.
Between endless meetings, corporate parties, glances that linger too long, and nights when professional boundaries start to blur, Ethan will have to decide how much he's willing to risk.
Make choices, solve visual puzzles, discover unlockables, and get swept up in a story of ambition, temptation, chemistry, and romance in the competitive heart of Manhattan.
At Monroe, one bad decision can cost you your career.
But resisting certain temptations can be even harder.
How far would you cross the line to get everything you want?
70010000135971.name: The Intern: Temptation at Work

70010000135974.description:
How far would you go for a second chance?

Clara Reyes has left her old life behind with no destination in mind. When her car breaks down near an isolated farm, Lucas Navarro offers her help and a place to stay for a few days.

What should have been a temporary stop soon becomes something far more complicated.

Surrounded by endless fields, quiet nights, and moments that linger a little too long, Clara finds an unexpected connection with Lucas. But he already has a life of his own, a wife who notices more than she says, and feelings neither of them should allow to grow.

The farm that once felt like a refuge slowly becomes a place filled with uneasy glances, secrets, desire, and difficult choices.

Experience a romantic drama visual novel where every conversation pulls you deeper into a relationship as intense as it is dangerous. Make choices, discover alternative scenes, find unlockables, and reconstruct key moments through visual puzzles as you follow Clara through a story about freedom, guilt, desire, and the consequences of staying when perhaps you should run.

Will you choose to protect yourself and start over? Will you surrender to what you feel? Or will you remain trapped in a relationship no one has the courage to end?

Your choices can lead to different endings.

Sometimes running away is easier than staying.

And sometimes staying changes everything.
70010000135974.name: Broken Fields: Stay or Run?

70010000136041.description:
The city is under siege, and an unstoppable horde of zombies is closing in. Build your defenses, upgrade your firepower, and hold the line in Zombie Siege, a fast-paced tower defense game where every round brings a greater threat.

Strategically place turrets around the city to stop waves of undead before they overwhelm your defenses. Every zombie you eliminate earns valuable coins that can be used to strengthen your position and prepare for increasingly dangerous attacks.

Surviving is about more than simply destroying the horde. The infection is spreading through the city, putting innocent civilians at risk. Choose your defenses carefully, manage your resources, and prevent the outbreak from taking over.

Battle through 10 escalating rounds as stronger enemies push your defenses to their limits. Upgrade your turrets, adapt your strategy, and prepare for the ultimate challenge waiting in the final wave—a powerful boss that will require everything you have built to defeat.

Game Features:

• Defend the city against 10 waves of zombie attacks
• Strategically place and upgrade defensive turrets
• Earn coins by eliminating enemies
• Manage your resources and strengthen your defenses
• Protect civilians from the spreading infection
• Face increasingly dangerous waves of undead
• Battle a powerful boss during the final round
• Easy to understand tower defense gameplay with strategic choices

The undead are coming. Build your defenses, protect the city, and survive the Zombie Siege.
70010000136041.intro: Defend the city from relentless zombie waves!
70010000136041.name: Zombie Siege

70010000136110.description:
Experience the ultimate fixed-route tower defense game! Summon a wide variety of units to defend and conquer the battlefield. Where and when you deploy, upgrade or replace your units is up to you. Discover synergies and hone your strategy.

◆ Master your units!
Unlock over 60 different types of units as you progress through the game. Use specialized units to inflict status ailments, stall multiple enemies, and heal and buff your team. Assess the battlefield and deploy the right units in the right place.

◆ Surging enemies, mighty bosses
Take down hordes of enemy units surging forth over the battlefield. Brace yourself and prepare your army to encounter giant bosses with overwhelming power.

◆ Carefully crafted pixel art that colors the world
Step into a pixel world, and unleash your pixel army! Nostalgic and endearing, the beautiful backgrounds, fiercely battling units and user interface will be sure to charm you.

◆ ""EX Skills"" where timing determines your fate
Unleash the power of EX Skills at crucial moments to turn the tide. Crush waves of enemies with meteorites, use barriers to keep them at bay, and more. Getting the timing right is your key to victory.

◆ Reliable ""Items"" to save you in a pinch
When you're about to fall short of clearing a stage, you can use a single use ""Item"" to sway the battle. Unleash a powerful attack on all enemies or heal your team. Even tower defense beginners can experience the satisfaction of strategic gameplay without frustration.

◆ Diverse Locations × Difficulty Selection
Battle enemies in city streets, lush grasslands, harsh deserts and more. Stage difficulty is available in three levels: ""Normal"", ""Hard"", and ""Challenge"". Face special restrictions in ""Challenge"" mode, where even experienced players will be put to the test.

◆ Reclaim invaded territory with specialized units!
Whether you're a beginner or a veteran, immerse yourself in the pixel world, and feel the rush of defeating enemies.
70010000136110.intro: Intercept the surging waves of pixels with a variety of units!
70010000136110.name: PixelHeroScramble Plus

70010000136170.description:
Millions have played the previous games in the "Croc's World" series – now it's time for "Croc's World 5"!

Run, jump and swim your way through swamps, ancient Greece, Egypt and the world of the Maya. Whole sections of the levels are constantly on the move, so you have to time your jumps carefully – and in the gravity zones Croc simply carries on running along the ceiling.

Features:
– 60 varied levels across 4 islands
– NEW: Gravity zones – walk on the ceiling in certain sections
– NEW: Constantly moving sections of the level – time your jumps
– Vastly improved graphics
– 4 different worlds: swamp, Greece, Egypt and Maya
– 4 wicked boss enemies
– Collect up to 3 stars in every level
– Retro mode with CRT screen effect for a true 80s feeling
– Lots of challenging enemies
70010000136170.intro: Croc is back for his fifth adventure! 60 hand-crafted levels across 4 islands, packed with new enemies, huge boss fights and two brand new mechanics.
70010000136170.name: Croc's World 5

70010000136191.description:
You cannot move. You cannot speak. You can only choose.

You are a stone wishing well in a small seaside town. People lean over your edge, toss a coin, and whisper what they want most. Granting is your only voice — and your water is not endless.

Eight townspeople return to you, day after day, for eight days. The merchant asks for a horse; days later he buys the field that fed the girl who greets you every morning. The game never blames you. It only shows you what you did — in the same faces, in the same square, one day later.

Across those eight days you will witness 119 handwritten events, each one someone's wish or its consequence. Eight characters' fates intertwine: what you give one, you quietly take from another. The town remembers — choices persist and come back as props, lines and faces. Four endings wait at the bottom, decided by the kind of well you chose to be.

The whole game fits in two buttons: grant or refuse. (And one more, to skip.) Around you, the square lives from dawn to dusk, and visitors arrive with the sun. One run lasts 70 to 80 minutes; seeing everything takes about four runs. Full controller support, playable in 22 languages.

Who is the well when the water runs low? Some wishes feed your depths; some drain them. If you hold everything back, you are forgotten. If you give everything away, the town devours itself. Four ends of the same rope — and none of them is called "right".
70010000136191.intro:
You are the wishing well.
Eight days. Eight people. Not enough water for everyone.
Every wish has a price.
70010000136191.name: Wishing Well Simulator

70010000136299.description:
Inherit your grandma's beloved recipe book and rediscover all her favorite dishes - one delicious page at a time. Pick your favorite animal chef, from a curious rabbit to a cheerful bear, and step into a cozy kitchen full of charm.

Mix ingredients by hand, time your baking just right in the oven mini-game, and level up to unlock new recipes, ingredients, and upgrades. From pizza and bread to cakes and cinnamon rolls, every recipe adds another page to your own cooking story.

Features:
- Choose your favorite animal chef, each with their own personality
- Cook and bake a variety of recipes: pizza, bread, cake, and pastries
- Hands-on mixing and baking mini-games
- Level up to unlock new recipes, ingredient slots, and kitchen upgrades
- Relaxing solo gameplay
70010000136299.intro: Bake, mix, and level up in this cozy kitchen adventure inspired by grandma's recipe book!
70010000136299.name: Yummy Yummy Cook Book

70010000136343.description:
In Spirit Valor, you play as a spirit caught in a struggle between magic and fate. After a magic outburst binds him to a human warrior Richard's body, the two embark on a perilous quest to stop the rise of demonic forces. With the world’s laws shattered, and the Overlord vanished, they must track down this elusive enemy before it is too late. Armed with the powerful Spellstones and magic, the spirit warrior sets out on an epic journey to restore balance to the world and prevent the transformation into a demon.

The game offers a rich RPG experience where adventure meets strategy. Make contracts with spirits, each granting unique magical abilities to aid you in your quest. As you journey through a beautifully crafted pixel art world, you will level up your spirits, evolve them, and unlock powerful magic. The dynamic combat system allows you to absorb enemy skills using the Empty Spellstone, giving you the ability to turn your foes' strengths against them. With strategic battles, a deep magic system, and a world filled with quests and exploration, Spirit Valor delivers an engaging fantasy experience that will keep you immersed till the end.
70010000136343.intro: An exciting spirit-collection RPG where you get stronger with each contract!
70010000136343.name: Spirit Valor - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000136355.description:
Woodo is a cozy diorama puzzle game where you assemble wooden scenes piece by piece. As you place objects in their correct spots, each scene slowly fills with color and comes to life, revealing charming animations and small surprises. Follow the story of Foxy and Ben the frog through a series of interconnected dioramas, each capturing a unique moment from their shared adventure.

Tactile Satisfaction
Feel like you’re assembling a real toy, with each piece clicking into place with a satisfying, tactile sensation, as if it’s right in your hands.
Assembling objects isn’t linear—you have to turn and explore the 3D space to reveal hidden pieces. Watch as each piece transforms the world around you, with playful animations that react to your placements, bringing the diorama to life.

A Warm Companion
With a friendly narrator's voice, immerse yourself in a world when time was plentiful and much of it was spent outdoors, when the simplest things surprised and when every day promised great adventure. Feelings that were more present in childhood and are often missed or even forgotten with time passing.

Feed Your Inner Child
The game features funny and charming characters that create an atmosphere of carefree joy and humor, reminding you that happiness is what your inner child needs.

-Assemble beautiful dioramas piece by piece with a unique puzzle mechanic
-The game adapts to your pace, providing assistance when you need it
-Gameplay changes to adapt the narration
-Simple but deeply meaningful story
-The comforting voice of the narrator keeps you company
-Get carried away by nostalgic feelings of when things were simple
-Plenty of funny characters and silly animations make you smile
70010000136355.intro: Woodo is a cozy 3D puzzle matching game
70010000136355.name: Woodo - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000136367.description:
Ever dreamed of running the coziest cat shop in town?

Welcome to Cozy Cat Shop, where adorable cats, happy customers, and endless possibilities come together! Build your dream store, discover a variety of charming cat breeds, and create a cozy place where every customer can find their perfect furry companion.

Start small and grow your shop into a bustling cat paradise. Expand your space, customize the interior, build up your business, and surround yourself with more and more adorable cats along the way!

Key features:
- Discover a variety of cat breeds
- Grow your cozy cat shop
- Customize your store
- Expand your business

Meet lots of adorable cats!
70010000136367.name: Cozy Cat Shop

70010000136399.description: As a sorcerer's servant, you'll strategically use weapons and items to gain the upper hand in battle. Featuring deck-building mechanics, the items you acquire appear on the slot reels and power up through chain combos. You can experiment with a variety of strategies—like healing endlessly with herbs, or maxing out your attack power to one-shot your enemies. Plus, it features a highly unique gameplay system where getting a "Game Over" actually progresses the story.
70010000136399.intro: Spin the slots to battle monsters in this roguelike spinning RPG!
70010000136399.name: Sorcerer's Servant SweetWitch

70010000136410.description:
Dream Hike is a relaxing walking simulator where you explore a beautiful, colorful world in search of hidden melons. Wander through forests, valleys, mountains, and mysterious paths as you discover new places and see what the world has to offer.

There’s no rush and no danger. Just put on your hiking boots, enjoy the scenery, and keep your eyes open.

How many melons can you find?
70010000136410.intro: A peaceful adventure through a beautiful world.
70010000136410.name: Dream Hike

70010000136444.description:
Step into a warm and welcoming teahouse where every customer is waiting for the perfect cup. Take orders, prepare delicious teas, and serve your guests as you experience the relaxing routine of running a cozy tea shop.

Pay attention to what each customer wants and carefully prepare their order. Keep up with incoming guests, serve the right drinks, and make sure everyone leaves satisfied. As the day continues, you'll need to balance speed and accuracy while maintaining the peaceful atmosphere of your teahouse.

With simple and accessible gameplay, Cozy Tea House offers a relaxing experience centered around preparing drinks, serving customers, and enjoying the everyday life of a charming little teahouse.

Take your time, brew the perfect cup, and enjoy another cozy day behind the counter.

Features:

Prepare and serve tea to your customers.
Take orders and make the correct drinks.
Manage multiple customers as your teahouse gets busy.
Simple and accessible tea-serving gameplay.
Relaxing and cozy atmosphere.
Charming casual experience focused on serving customers.
Enjoy the peaceful routine of working in your own teahouse.
70010000136444.intro: Run a cozy teahouse and serve delicious tea to your customers. Prepare each order carefully, keep everyone happy, and enjoy a relaxing tea-serving experience.
70010000136444.name: Cozy Tea House

70010000136464.description:
Eight travelers. Eight adventures. Eight roles to play in a new world brought to life by Square Enix. Explore each traveler’s story and use their abilities in and out of battle. Will you expand your horizons as the Merchant or track down a traitor as the Warrior? Where will you go? Who will join you? You alone can choose your path.

Step into the shoes of a traveler to inherit their struggles and strengths. Use each character’s special abilities to interact with the world and enhance your tactics in turn-based battles. The Dancer’s alluring charm leads followers into battle, whereas the Apothecary can mix items to heal allies or unleash explosive attacks. Discover enemy weaknesses and target them to break through their defenses. Store Boost Points with each turn and then spend them at strategic times to strengthen abilities, chain attacks, or provide aid. Choose the path you wish to walk and discover what lies beyond the horizon.
70010000136464.intro: Choose your fate. Eight stories await.
70010000136464.name: Octopath Traveler™

70010000136495.description:
Things are everywhere. The bathroom is a disaster, the desk has disappeared under a mountain of stuff, and the kitchen? Let's not even talk about it.

The mission is simple: pick it up, figure out where it belongs, and make the chaos disappear!

Sort toiletries, stationery, plants, kitchenware, toys, and all kinds of wonderfully weird household items across a variety of colorful rooms. Find the right spot for every object and watch each messy space transform into a perfectly organized one.

With bold cartoon visuals, playful details, and a lighthearted sense of humor, every room is packed with little surprises to discover. No timers. No pressure. Just pure organizing satisfaction.

Whether you love cozy games, satisfying puzzles, or simply enjoy turning complete chaos into glorious order, Neatly Organized is ready to make a mess of your day - and then help you clean it up.

Features:
- A variety of colorful, delightfully chaotic scenes to tidy and organize
- Relaxing, no-pressure organizing gameplay
- A wide variety of household items across different rooms
- Bold, charming cartoon art style with playful little surprises
- Simple, satisfying mechanics - perfect for quick sessions or long relaxing play
70010000136495.intro: A colorful, chaotic, and ridiculously satisfying organizing puzzle!
70010000136495.name: Neatly Organized

70010000136540.description:
Step into the enchanting world of Alphadia, a revitalized epic fantasy RPG series that merges the first two titles, 'Alphadia I' and 'Alphadia II', into a single, captivating adventure.

Immerse yourself in a beautifully reimagined world, where attractive characters and their enthralling journey come to life through updated graphics. Experience a richer narrative with the inclusion of cross events, bridging the stories of I and II. Choices made in one game influence the unfolding drama in the other. Unveil the elusive true ending of Alphadia II by conquering both titles and meeting specific conditions. Moreover, delve into a treasure trove of rewards, including enemy catalog, and various other exciting extras.

Alphadia I: Embark on a compelling journey centered around 'energi', a mystical power harnessed from life energy. After a tumultuous conflict known as the Energi War leaves humanity reeling, peace seems restored following a century of reconstruction. However, the Schwarzschild Empire's declaration of war plunges the world into chaos once more. From the frontier city of Heiland, a new story of resilience and hope unfolds.

Alphadia II: Two centuries have passed since the Energi Crisis thwarted the empire's ambitions and saved the world from destruction. Yet, the world's life energy wanes, threatening its very existence. Enah, a heroic figure, establishes the Energi Guild to combat this ominous decline. Although the Guild's efforts initially bring stability, a resurgence of energi-related ambitions looms in the shadows, signaling a new wave of challenges and adventures.
70010000136540.intro: The legends of energi once again in a new edition!
70010000136540.name: Alphadia I & II

70010000136591.description:
Build, upgrade, and evolve your defenses as endless waves of enemies close in.

Create a powerful network of futuristic defensive structures and use advanced technology to keep your base standing. Every wave brings new pressure, forcing you to improve your towers, manage your resources, and decide where your upgrades will have the greatest impact.

Generate Energy and Science as you fight, then invest them into permanent improvements that make your defensive system stronger and more efficient. Increase resource production, improve your towers, unlock powerful skills, and unleash abilities such as Overcharge and EMP Shockwave when your defenses need an extra boost.

Balance your resources carefully and develop your own strategy as the enemy forces become increasingly difficult to stop.

**Features:**

* Futuristic tower defense gameplay
* Increasingly challenging enemy waves
* Multiple defensive structures with different capabilities
* Energy and Science resource systems
* Extensive tower and resource upgrades
* Powerful unlockable combat skills
* Active abilities including EMP and Overcharge
* Idle-inspired progression and resource generation
* Strategic decisions that become more important with every wave

Upgrade your technology, strengthen your defenses, and see how long your base can survive.
70010000136591.intro: Defend your base against relentless waves in a futuristic tower defense game.
70010000136591.name: Quantum Defense

70010000136627.description:
Lordcraft is a medieval fantasy kingdom-building RPG where you begin with a small settlement and grow it into a mighty realm. Gather resources, construct and upgrade buildings, expand your territory, and strengthen your castle.

Train settlers to become skilled warriors and build an army capable of defending your lands from orcs, skeletons, giants, dragons, and other dangerous enemies. Upgrade your heroes, craft powerful weapons and equipment, and shape the development of your kingdom as it grows.

Build your realm, lead your army into battle, conquer new lands, and become the most powerful lord in the kingdom!
70010000136627.intro: Build your kingdom, raise an army, and conquer the realm.
70010000136627.name: Lordcraft

70010000136647.description:
Obby Sword Master — from rookie with a stick to legendary blade master.

You step onto the arena holding the weakest sword in the game. Ahead of you: crowds of enemies, piles of rewards and one goal — become the strongest swordsman in this world.

Every hit earns experience. Every enemy drops resources. Every upgrade makes the difference you can actually feel. This is that addictive loop: swing, get stronger, swing harder, get stronger still. The progress never stops.

Endless sword upgrades
Build an arsenal of legendary blades and pour everything into raw power. The gap between your first sword and your tenth is the gap between a scratch and a lightning strike.

Loyal pets
Recruit companions that fight at your side. Each one has its own upgrade path and adds real weight to your total damage.

Strength training
Level up your character between fights. The more you invest, the bigger the damage numbers flying off the screen.

Varied enemies
From easy fodder to genuinely dangerous bosses. Every new tier tests whether you have upgraded enough to keep up.

Daily quests and events
Complete missions for rare resources, join special events and claim exclusive weapons and pets.

Adventure atmosphere
Detailed locations, epic music and a busy arena full of other swordsmen going about their business.

Simple controls, instant pick-up-and-play and progress that always moves forward. Grab your sword — the legend will not write itself.
70010000136647.intro: Upgrade your blade, cut down endless enemies and collect loyal pets. An incremental action game where every swing makes you stronger. Become the Sword Master!
70010000136647.name: Obby Sword Master

70010000136674.description: You are Eli — Tether on the radio — and the only person in the city who can be on any roof in ninety seconds. Ride a line that catches anything above you, run up sheer glass, and get to the people the city has already crossed off a list. Thirteen missions carry you from eight runaway goods wagons over a market street to the top floor of the company bringing the houses down, past six people who each believe they are the one doing the right thing. Twenty more jobs wait on street corners for whoever has the time: a cat up a water tower, a locker key, a name nobody wants said out loud. Speed is the whole fight. Arrive fast and it hurts. Arrive slowly and it hurts you. A city of rooftops, viaducts, alleys and a harbour, in the low-poly look of a 1998 disc Web swinging, wall climbing, and a straight pull to any anchor 13 story missions across four acts 20 side jobs, each with its own person and its own turn 6 boss fights, three phases apiece An upgrade tree paid for with the city's trust
70010000136674.intro: New Haven City is losing a building a week. The paperwork says they were empty. They weren't.
70010000136674.name: Swing Shift

70010000136698.description: Explore ancient pyramids with Mel in this cute and challenging 2D platformer! Conquer 40 handcrafted levels, dodge deadly traps, escape the mummy Theo, and uncover hidden treasures.
70010000136698.intro:
Complete Levels
Survive Traps
Stategic moves
70010000136698.name: Mel The Pyramid Cat

70010000136704.description: Help Mel survive her cosmic journey in this cute and challenging 2D platformer! Explore 40 handcrafted space levels, dodge alien traps, escape Theo, and overcome dangerous planets.
70010000136704.intro:
Complete Levels
Survive Traps
Stategic moves
70010000136704.name: Mel The Space Cat

70010000136710.description: Help Mel find her way home in this cute and challenging 2D platformer! Run, jump, dodge deadly traps, escape Theo, and conquer 40 handcrafted levels across colorful and dangerous worlds.
70010000136710.intro:
Complete Levels
Survive Traps
Stategic moves
70010000136710.name: Mel The Cat

70010000136776.description:
Get ready for an all-new sequel to the party game that anyone can enjoy on Nintendo Switch™ 2!
Up to six players can join the fun with one Joy-Con™ per person!

Enjoy a collection of 30 intuitive and easy-to-play minigames!
Spend quality time with friends and family and have a blast!

The Nintendo Switch 2 Edition features 2 exclusive new minigames!
Enjoy new party games, "Cave Race" and "Stealth Hunter," along with improved frame rates and faster loading times for a smoother gaming experience!

[Free Mode]
Pick a game freely and play!
With both competitive and cooperative games, there are lots of ways to play!
In single-player mode, record your high scores and compete against players from around the world!

[Party Mode]
Choose a selection of games to play in order, and compete to become the champion!
You can select the option to double the points in the last game!

[Online Mode]
Play together with players from around the world!
Hop in a Quick Match to start the fun right away!

<Character Edit>
Make your own special character with further enhanced customization features, and watch as they join the party!
70010000136776.intro:
It's time for a new and improved party time!
Compete or cooperate—there's no limit on the fun when everyone's together!
70010000136776.name: Party Party Time 3 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000136838.description:
BIRDCAGE is an arcade-style vertical scrolling shoot’em up inspired by genre classics, blending gritty pixel art sprites with 2.5D backdrops and a pumping retro soundtrack! Blast through 6 unique stages of bullet hell mayhem, facing off against enemy swarms using multiple shot types and rechargeable specials.

Chase high scores by maintaining chains and kill rate. Strategically activate Hyperblade mode in tense situations, and take down screen-filling bosses! Can you break free of your cage and redeem humanity?

• Blast through 6 unique stages of bullet hell mayhem!
• Enjoy retro aesthetics with 2D pixel art sprites and 2.5D environments.
• Strategically switch between spread shots and focused attacks.
• Charge homing specials and deploy Hyperblade mode!
• Aim for higher scores with attack chains and precise kill rates.
• Engage in a thought-provoking narrative and review memories as you progress.
70010000136838.intro: Break free of your cage and protect humanity from certain destruction in old-school shoot’em up style!
70010000136838.name: BIRDCAGE

70010000136883.description:
After a shipwreck, you find yourself on a strange island ruled by the mysterious ChungaChanga.

Explore jungles, beaches, and abandoned structures. Gather resources, craft useful items, solve puzzles, and search for a way to escape the island.

Use your wits to outsmart ChungaChanga, avoid his tricks, uncover hidden locations, and experiment with the world around you. You never know what will happen next or what surprise this crazy island has in store.

The first rule of survival: never trust ChungaChanga. Ever.
70010000136883.intro: Don't let ChungaChanga convince you that living on this island is a good idea.
70010000136883.name: Escape from ChungaChanga: Island Survival

70010000136895.description:
Two cats sit side by side. One is correct. The other has been stretched, swollen, twisted, flattened, or bent in ways that should not be possible.

Your job is simple: make them match.

Use twelve different lenses to reshape the specimen in real time. Magnify, shrink, widen, flatten, swirl, bulge, pinch, shear, ripple, or erase distortions completely. Move, rotate, and resize each lens until the two cats line up perfectly.

FIFTY CATS

Across fifty handcrafted puzzles, the distortions become stranger and more complex. Later levels may even reverse the rules—the cat you thought was correct may be the distorted one.

Twenty different cat breeds appear along the way, from tabbies and ragdolls to sphynxes, chonks, and something the files simply call “eldritch.”

There is no fail state and no pressure. Take your time, study the cats, and solve each puzzle in as few moves as possible to earn up to three stars.

CREATE YOUR OWN

Build your own distorted cats using the same lenses as the main game. Bend them, test whether the puzzle can be solved, choose the difficulty, and create your own collection of strange feline experiments.

Fifty cats. Twelve lenses. One question:

What happened to this cat?
70010000136895.intro: Fix distorted cats with the right lenses. Fifty specimens, twelve lenses—and some “correct” cats may be lying.
70010000136895.name: Cat Magnifier

70010000136925.description:
When a young game developer is unexpectedly pulled into one of his own creations, he must survive a dangerous game-inspired world filled with traps, enemies, and challenging obstacles.

Use your agility and platforming skills to explore vibrant levels, defeat enemies by jumping on their heads, and collect enough coins to unlock portals to the next stage. Master advanced movement abilities like Wall Jump and Wall Slide to overcome difficult obstacles and reach new areas.

With fast-paced gameplay, colorful environments, and smooth, responsive controls, **Super Dev Quest** delivers a fun and rewarding platforming experience for fans of classic 2D adventures.

Features:
- Fast-paced and fun 2D platforming gameplay
- Master Wall Jump and Wall Slide abilities
- Defeat enemies by jumping on their heads
- Collect coins to unlock portals and progress through stages
- Explore colorful worlds filled with challenging obstacles
- Enjoy smooth, responsive controls
- Play through multiple levels with progressive difficulty
- Experience an adventure inspired by classic platform games
70010000136925.intro:
Complete Levels
Survive Traps
Stategic moves
70010000136925.name: Super Dev Quest

70010000136959.description:
Pick up retro game cartridges spanning three generations—8-bit, 16-bit, and 32-bit—stacked high on the floor, one by one, and place them manually onto the shelves of the correct genre.

No flashy effects, no time pressure. Just a quiet tidying-up game where you can organize at your own pace inside a small store.

As you quietly keep working, you might pick up a few oddly specific, slightly useless skills along the way—think of them as small rewards for a job well done.

● Basic Rules
Put all the game software onto the correct shelves. That’s literally it.

● Save Slots
You can create up to 9 save files for each stage.

● Skills
You can acquire somewhat subtle skills that might not be very useful.

● BGM
You can choose a playlist, but there are only 3 tracks available.
70010000136959.intro: You are just a store clerk. No magic, no skills, no cooldowns. The only thing that can clean up this messy store is your own two hands.
70010000136959.name: Game Shop Panic

70010000137060.description:
Have you ever had an experience where a door looked just like a face? Perhaps it was a "The Face Door."

To clear the game and advance the story, you must find the key, identify the correct The Face Door, and open it to proceed. But where is the key? Which is the right door? The game tests not only your role-playing skills in searching for these elements but also your powers of deduction—and, above all, your memory.

With its light horror elements, the game is accessible even to those who aren't fans of the genre. It supports both Japanese and English for text and audio, offering a chance to learn interesting turns of phrase along the way.

But what exactly *is* a The Face Door?
70010000137060.intro:
A strange and mysterious story.
Light horror and eerie presentation.
Japanese and English display and audio.
70010000137060.name: The Face Door

70010000137109.description:
An explosive mix of action and mystery, seasoned with black humor and a sinister atmosphere. Journey into Hell alongside a brave boy named Blizzy and defeat Evil itself. Save the world and become a hero. But at what cost?

PUZZLES, MYSTERIES, AND ACTION

Step into the twisted, magical universe of Creepy Tale—a world packed with eerie secrets, original brainteasers, and minigames that'll test your wits, agility, and stealth. To survive, you'll need to leap over deadly traps, dodge sinister foes, and crack puzzles like they're no big deal.

Meet the mysterious—and downright dangerous—inhabitants of the otherworldly realm in this thrilling adventure where questing collides with action, and a gripping story ensures boredom stays far, far away.

INTERACTIVE ANIMATION

Creepy Tale isn't just a game; it's a haunting story for everyone. Lovingly crafted graphics summon memories of childhood tales—only darker, stranger, and far more twisted. Whether you dive deep into the narrative or just want a creepy little diversion, this game's designed to be enjoyed by the whole family.

A TWISTED TALE YOU WON'T FORGET

Blizzy has always craved adventure—the more dangerous, the better. Becoming a hero and saving the kingdom? That's the stuff of dreams. But a trip to Hell? Now that's a real opportunity to stretch his legs and prove his mettle. An ancient evil trying to break free? Child's play! The young and fearless Blizzy can handle anything!

Your guide through Hell will be Molek, a tiny imp whose greatest joys in life are candy and children. If you're lucky enough to become one of his favorites, you'll get more than just cruel jokes—you might even get some genuinely helpful advice. After all, watching a child sow chaos is the most entertaining pastime Hell has to offer.

FEATURES:
