- Befriend hellish denizens of the underworld—and slip away just before they decide you're dinner.
- Tame enchanted butterflies to bring pictures to life.
- Uncover loads of eerie nods to classic fairy tales... and much, much stranger things.
- Take control of Furry: fight off a monstrous spider and escape a poisonous tower.
- Shatter an ancient seal, unleash the darkness within, and try desperately to set things right.
- Play with Adele—a girl with bipolar personality disorder.
- Lose yourself in the handcrafted animation for dozens of bizarre characters.
- And all of this is wrapped up in a haunting soundtrack and professional voice acting that'll creep under your skin.

Creepy Tale is the brainchild of a small but obsessed trio, pouring every ounce of passion and dark creativity into this chilling project. Prepare yourself for a tale as unsettling as it is unforgettable.

Playing the previous Creepy Tale games is not necessary to understand the story of Snow Child.
70010000137109.intro: Save the world and become a hero. But at what cost?
70010000137109.name: Creepy Tale: Snow Child

70010000137164.description:
Build, manage, and defend your settlement against relentless waves of enemies. Every successful defense begins long before the next attack arrives, so gather valuable resources, construct essential buildings, and carefully prepare your defenses.

Develop your settlement by creating structures that provide the materials you need to survive. Balance your available resources between expanding production and strengthening your defensive positions. Every decision matters as the countdown to the next enemy wave continues.

Adapt your strategy as the challenge grows. Improve your economy, expand your settlement, and create stronger defenses capable of surviving increasingly dangerous attacks. Careful planning and efficient resource management can make the difference between building a thriving stronghold and watching everything fall.

How long can your settlement survive?

Features:

Strategic tower defense gameplay combined with resource management.
Gather different resources to support your settlement.
Construct production buildings and defensive structures.
Prepare your defenses before each incoming enemy wave.
Balance economic development with the need for protection.
Expand and strengthen your settlement as you progress.
Face increasingly challenging waves that test your strategy.
Build your own approach to surviving each attack.
70010000137164.intro: Turn a small settlement into a fortified stronghold. Collect resources, construct buildings, and strategically prepare for relentless waves of enemies.
70010000137164.name: Settlement Defense

70010000137181.description:
How far can your memory really take you?

A detailed scene packed with items awaits. Study the layout, colours, shapes and tiny details, then commit as much as possible to memory.

Once the viewing time is over, you can rely only on what you remember. Which item was there? What colour was it? What detail did you notice? Challenging questions will put your memory to the test.

The rules are simple.
・Study the illustration carefully
・Memorise as much information as you can
・Answer the four-choice quiz using your memory alone

Explore a range of unusual settings, from mysterious rooms and strange research facilities to floating worlds and snowy mountain bases. Can you accurately remember a picture filled with information?

Remembering only the most obvious things may not be enough. Keep an eye on the finer details and take on every challenge.

Are you ready to push your memory beyond its limits?
70010000137181.intro: Can you master the ultimate memory test?
70010000137181.name: Break Your Limits! Ultimate Memory Quiz

70010000137184.description:
Join Bella and her cat Neko on an enchanting journey through a mysterious Japanese garden full of puzzles, hidden paths and unexpected discoveries.

When Neko slips through a small opening into the garden, Bella follows him without meaning to – a sudden gust of wind catches her umbrella and carries it over the high walls. What at first seems like an ordinary garden soon turns out to be full of secrets.

Explore 300 meticulously designed levels across 30 unique regions, which together create an atmospheric journey through the garden. Discover blossoming cherry trees, tranquil ponds, winding stone paths, ancient pagodas, peaceful temples and much more. With each new region, the garden reveals new facets of its beauty. Yet at the same time, you get the impression that there is something even greater concealed behind it all.

Two characters, two different puzzles in each level

Start by playing as Neko and find your way to his beloved fish. Use his special jumps, plan each move carefully and reach the finish in a set number of moves. Explore carefully – you might even discover some hidden secrets along the way.

You will then take control of Bella. With the help of her umbrella, she lets the wind carry her through the garden. Making clever use of the wind strength and direction, fly from flower to flower and find your way to your destination. Each challenge requires logical thinking and careful planning.

On your journey, you can find and collect lots of hidden puzzle pieces. The more you discover, the more special content you’ll unlock. For curious explorers, every peek into the garden’s hidden corners is well worth it.

Enjoy the whole adventure together

In the local two-player multiplayer mode, you can either control your favourite character throughout, or swap roles after each level. Additional stats at the end of each level encourage friendly competition and invite players to compare their best solutions.

Features
•	Explore a beautiful Japanese garden full of puzzles and secrets.
•	Journey through 30 atmospheric regions that tell a complete story.
•	Solve 300 handcrafted puzzle challenges.
•	Play as the curious cat Neko and the brave Bella, who move through the garden in completely different ways.
•	Keep an eye out for hidden puzzle pieces and reveal additional secrets.
•	Unlock special rewards through skilful exploring.
•	Play on your own or experience the whole adventure together in local multiplayer mode.
•	Perfect for players of all ages: easy to learn and full of clever challenges.
70010000137184.intro: Follow the scent, trust the wind and discover what secret awaits Bella and Neko in the heart of the garden.
70010000137184.name: Bella Umbrella and the mysterious garden

70010000137289.description:
Take command of the frontline and defend your territory against relentless enemy assaults in this military-themed tower defense strategy game. Deploy defensive units, secure key positions, and build a powerful defense capable of stopping increasingly dangerous waves of attackers.

Every battlefield presents new tactical challenges. Carefully choose where to place your units, strengthen vulnerable areas, and adapt your strategy as enemy forces grow larger, faster, and more resilient. Efficient planning and smart deployment are essential for survival.

Progress through multiple battlefields and face an endless stream of enemies designed to test your tactical skills. Whether you prefer building an impenetrable defensive line or adapting to threats as they appear, every decision can determine the outcome of the battle.

Hold the line, protect your defenses, and prove your strategic abilities against overwhelming odds.

Features:

Military-themed tower defense gameplay.
Deploy defensive units to stop advancing enemies.
Defend strategic routes across multiple battlefields.
Face increasingly challenging waves with stronger enemy forces.
Plan unit placement and adapt your tactics to changing threats.
Multiple maps with unique defensive opportunities.
Endless scaling waves for long-term strategic challenges.
Easy to learn, challenging to master.
70010000137289.intro: Hold the line against an advancing enemy force! Place defensive units, plan your strategy, and survive escalating waves across multiple battlefields.
70010000137289.name: Battlefront Defense

70010000137300.description:
FIGHT THE DEAD. SURVIVE THE STREETS.

The Walking Dead: Streets of Survival challenges you to intense arcade brawling in the unforgiving world of AMC’s The Walking Dead.

Play as iconic survivors Rick Grimes, Daryl Dixon, Michonne, and unlockable Negan while fighting through walker-infested tunnels, devastated settlements, and hostile strongholds packed with explosive encounters. Face Alexandria’s most ruthless foes, the Saviors led by Negan, along with overwhelming waves of Walkers as you unleash crushing combos, signature weapon attacks, and devastating finishers in a relentless battle for survival.

INSPIRED BY THE STORY YOU KNOW.
Based on the events of the All Out War storyline, fight through a campaign that reimagines the Saviors conflict that features walkers, threats, and surprises pulled from across the world of AMC’s The Walking Dead. You’ll explore familiar environments from the show - including the Sanctuary, Hilltop, Alexandria – enhanced by dynamic set pieces, environmental hazards, and intense, story-driven moments.

ICONIC SURVIVORS. ICONIC WEAPONS.
Step into the boots of legendary characters from The Walking Dead, each with a unique fighting style, stats, and signature abilities inspired by the series. Rick’s magnum, Michonne’s katana, and Daryl’s trusty crossbow are all ready for battle - with Negan's Lucille waiting to be unlocked.

FEATURES:
•        Hard-Hitting Arcade Beat ’Em Up Combat
Use brutal melee abilities, crowd-clearing ranged attacks, or a mix of the two in fast-paced skirmishes. Enjoy responsive, crisp, and satisfying fighting gameplay while exploring the apocalypse.

•        Overwhelming Walker Swarms & Ruthless Enemies
Battle through creeping armies of the undead and dangerous members of The Saviors that force you to adapt, assess threats, and fight for every inch of ground.

•        Face Iconic Bosses
Take on powerful, fan-favorite walkers like Winslow, the Well Walker, and more. The Saviors provide their own challenges as you throw down with Negan and Simon in intense, multi-phase boss battles that test your skill, strategy, and survival instincts.

•        Replayable Arcade Challenge
Master each character’s moveset and tackle multiple difficulty levels in an experience built for repeat runs and escalating challenges. Or jump in with an optional Easy Mode for casual play.
70010000137300.intro: Arcade Beat 'Em Up Action in the World of AMC's The Walking Dead
70010000137300.name: The Walking Dead: Streets of Survival

70010000137303.description:
Begin your adventure in a tavern that is home to a unique, corrupted version of blackjack you have never played before. You will need to pick up the rules and adapt to them as you progress through the tavern, challenging a colourful cast of blackjack-addicted townspeople. Discover the mystery of who runs this twisted casino as you progress through the tavern to take them down!

Pick a suit: hearts for healing, spades to offer you some protection, diamonds for more currency for shop purchases, or clubs for extra damage. Remove cards from your deck as you progress. Pick up more aces and face cards, or fill your deck with tarot cards, business cards, birthday cards, hall passes and more!

Make your way through the tavern challenging patrons, purchasing additional cards for your deck, resting up when your health gets low, opening boosters packs, participating in minigames and much more! Take on the run-based deckbuilding roguelike challenge, with endless possibilities for unique and interesting decks!

Features

Unique play styles based around card suits
Ascend or descend through the tavern over and over by unlocking new starter decks when you complete runs for entirely new ways to play
Discover incredible rule-breaking synergies in order to defeat the house edge.
Over 300 unique cards!
60 characters to defeat
Use unique chips to gain advantage and activate special cards
Minigames and events to gain more chips or enhance your deck
Unique grimy pixel art aesthetic
All the degeneracy from a seedy casino but with no risk to your finances, mental health, or your loved ones
70010000137303.intro: Dungeons & Degenerate Gamblers - A Blackjack Roguelike Adventure
70010000137303.name: Dungeons & Degenerate Gamblers

70010000137316.description:
Wield your sword and get ready for battle in a visceral action beat 'em up that pays homage to the great arcade classics.

As Arthur or Lancelot, you must face hordes of enemies in a fantasy world. 3D combat in a 2.5D perspective with a stunning pixel art filter that brings nostalgia to the modern era. Master the blade and write your own legend!

Key Features:
Skill-Based Combat: Use devastating combos and special attacks to win.
Distinct Heroes: Play as Arthur (strength) or Lancelot (agility), each with their own unique moveset.
Local Co-op: The perfect experience for playing with a friend.
Challenging Bosses: Test your reflexes against colossal guardians.
70010000137316.intro: Fight like a legendary hero!  Master sword combos in epic battles.
70010000137316.name: Blades & Battles

70010000137341.description:
“I’m a maid… but keep it a secret!”

Follow the everyday adventures of a slightly clumsy lad in a maid outfit as he works hard at his secret serving job.

Each charming illustration hides one difference in the right-hand image.

How to play:
・Compare the illustrations carefully
・Find the one place where the right image differs
・Tap the difference to clear the scene

From little mishaps to determined efforts, every scene makes you want to cheer him on. Enjoy a sweet, heart-warming spot-the-difference game at your own pace.

Perfect for fans of unusual cute characters, gentle maid-themed illustrations, spot-the-difference puzzles, and short casual games. Take your time admiring every little movement, or challenge yourself to find the difference quickly. It is also great for sharing a cosy gaming session with viewers.
70010000137341.intro: Cheer on a clumsy maid lad!
70010000137341.name: Me in a Dress!? Femboy Maid: Spot the Difference

70010000137370.description:
Salcy and Cockapoo are trading their chaotic rescue mission for a much calmer pastime. Grab a puzzle box, pick a themed pack, and start snapping pieces into place.

Choose from a growing lineup of themed puzzle packs - Pool, Fall, Winter, Camp, Garden, Space and more - each filled with hand-drawn scenes pulled straight from the Freaky Trip world, from building snowmen in the snow to floating around on pool rings under the palm trees. Pick your difficulty - Easy, Medium, or Hard - and enjoy the same oddball humor and cartoon charm fans know from the original game, now in a slower, cozier format. Completed puzzles are rated with stars, so you can track your progress pack by pack.

Features:
- Relaxing jigsaw puzzles starring Salcy and Cockapoo from the Freaky Trip universe
- Multiple themed puzzle packs (Pool, Fall, Winter, Camp, Garden, Space, and more)
- Three difficulty levels (Easy, Medium, Hard) for casual and dedicated puzzlers
- Star-rated completion tracking for every puzzle
- Charming, colorful art style true to the Freaky Trip world
70010000137370.intro: A cozy jigsaw puzzle game set in the world of Freaky Trip - piece together colorful, hand-drawn scenes starring Salcy and Cockapoo.
70010000137370.name: Freaky Trip: Puzzled

70010000137475.description:
An unexpected encounter can make an ordinary day feel a little more exciting.

From the walk home after school to the bustle of the office district, meet a variety of characters in distinctive uniforms and workwear.

This is a charming, heart-pounding montage puzzle where you piece together the right outfit.

How to play:
・Take a close look at the character
・Compare the separated horizontal outfit pieces
・Choose the matching combination to complete the montage

Could that be the right piece? Or perhaps the one beside it? Compare the details carefully and enjoy the satisfying moment when everything comes together.

Easy to pick up and quick to play, it is ideal for a short break or a bit of casual puzzling.

Who will call out to you next? Complete every montage and enjoy each unexpected encounter.
70010000137475.name: Heart-Pounding! Uniform Montage Puzzle ~From After School to the Office~

70010000137487.description:
Just starting to learn English? Build your confidence with an easy, friendly learning game made for beginners.

Discover how to say familiar things and everyday words in English as you work through simple questions at your own pace.

Getting started is easy!
• Look carefully at the question
• Think of the right English word
• Choose your answer and take on the challenge

There is no need to begin with difficult vocabulary. Start with basic English words and enjoy a relaxed introduction to learning English.

Ever thought, “I’ve seen that word before, but what was it in English?” Check each word one at a time and get used to English through play.

Ideal for a quick session, a little daily practice, or revising words before and after studying.

A great choice if you want to:
• Start learning English
• Build up basic vocabulary
• Find a gentle introduction to English study
• Learn in a fun, game-like way
• Make progress in short sessions

Take your first steps with English words in a simple, enjoyable way. Give it a go!
70010000137487.name: Slot & Learn Easy English Words

70010000137493.description:
Solve captivating puzzles featuring images of beautiful anime-style girls. With each image you complete, you'll unlock new ones, and the gradually increasing difficulty makes solving the puzzle a fascinating challenge. Intuitive touch controls create the feeling that you're actually touching every detail.

Soft and relaxing music will help you immerse yourself in the atmosphere, and after solving the puzzle, you can examine the image closely and admire every detail.

Features:

• Convenient one-handed play.
• Stylish anime images.
• Full immersion thanks to touch controls.
• Gradually increasing difficulty.
• Relaxing music.
70010000137493.intro: Relaxing puzzles with cute anime girls.
70010000137493.name: Yummy Girl: Cherry Glow

70010000137542.description:
How long can you stare before the ordinary starts to feel wrong?

A familiar photograph can hide a tiny unease. At first, spotting the change brings a satisfying flash of insight. Then the meaning sinks in—and a shiver follows.

This Aha-style spot-the-difference game begins with everyday scenes: a bedroom, a convenience shop, a railway crossing and a school. As the stages continue, the settings become abandoned places and strange spaces far removed from reality. You may even begin to sense that something has been watching you all along.

There are no complicated controls. Simply observe each photograph and notice the detail that is slowly changing.

・Study the photograph carefully
・Notice the place that gradually changes
・Touch the spot where the change occurred

A quick thrill for fans of eerie puzzles, unsettling horror and games that are hard to put down. Perfect for a short scare whenever you have a spare moment.

Will you really be able to stop after just one more? Test your powers of observation—and discover what you may wish you had never noticed.
70010000137542.name: Aha... Oh No.

70010000137550.description:
Can you uncover the right route through a tangled network of pipes?

Rotate each panel and connect the broken sections to complete the flow in this simple yet satisfying logic puzzle.

The rules are easy to pick up!
・Check the panels showing the pipes
・Rotate each panel to adjust its direction
・Create a complete route and check your solution

The early stages are straightforward, but more pipes and branching routes appear as you progress. “If I turn this one, where will it lead next?” Read the whole board carefully and plan each move to find the correct arrangement.

Stuck on a tricky stage? A hint function makes it easier for beginners to get started. Play a few stages in a spare moment, or take your time and tackle the more challenging layouts.

Perfect for players who enjoy:
・Rotation and pipe puzzles
・Logic games that reward careful thought
・Testing their intuition and problem-solving skills
・Quick puzzles for a spare moment
・Stages that gradually become more challenging

Read the tangled routes, find the solution and connect every part of the flow!
70010000137550.intro: Rotate, connect and master the flow!
70010000137550.name: FLOW PIPE CODE 〜Connect the Pipes Logic Puzzle〜

70010000137663.description:
Parkour Obby: Food Escape is a fast-paced obstacle course where every level is made out of delicious food. Jump across giant burgers and parkour your way to the finish!

FEATURES:
>Food-themed parkour levels
>Checkpoints to help you keep progressing
>Hardcore Mode with all checkpoints disabled
>Challenging obstacles and levels
70010000137663.name: Parkour Obby: Food Escape

70010000137669.description:
Stock Cars Racing is pure adrenaline from the first corner to the finish line.
Race across a range of tracks set in different environments and weather conditions — dusty dirt roads, green forest trails and snow-covered circuits, each with its own grip and challenges.
Choose from a varied line-up of vehicles: old classic cars, fast and agile buggies, and heavy vans. Every one handles differently, so pick the ride that fits your style.
The AI opponents race hard and won't let you through. Save your boost for the right moment, hit it on the straights, and take the position.

Features
-Multiple tracks across dirt, forest and snow environments
-Varied vehicles: classic cars, buggies, vans
-Boost system for overtaking
-Fierce AI opponents
70010000137669.intro: Boost. Overtake. Win. Pure adrenaline racing.
70010000137669.name: Stock Cars Racing

70010000137724.description:
Prepare your defenses and protect the realm from relentless waves of enemies in this strategic tower defense adventure. Every battle challenges you to think carefully, position your towers effectively, and stop the advancing forces before they reach their destination.

Build a strong defensive line by placing towers at strategic locations across the battlefield. Consider the paths your enemies will take and use your available defenses wisely to create an effective strategy capable of handling each incoming wave.

As the battle continues, the challenge grows and your defenses will be put to the test. Adapt your strategy, strengthen your defensive positions, and prepare for increasingly dangerous assaults.

Can you hold the line and protect the realm from the invading forces?

Features:

Classic strategic tower defense gameplay.
Place towers to stop waves of advancing enemies.
Plan your defenses and choose effective tower positions.
Face increasingly challenging enemy waves.
Adapt your strategy as new threats arrive.
Defend your territory and prevent enemies from reaching their destination.
Accessible gameplay that's easy to learn and challenging to master.
Test your strategy and become the ultimate defender.
70010000137724.intro: Defend your realm against relentless waves of enemies! Place powerful towers, plan your strategy, and stop every threat before it reaches your defenses.
70010000137724.name: Realm Under Siege

70010000137749.description:
Step into the enchanting world of Alphadia, a revitalized epic fantasy RPG series that merges the first two titles, 'Alphadia I' and 'Alphadia II', into a single, captivating adventure.

Immerse yourself in a beautifully reimagined world, where attractive characters and their enthralling journey come to life through updated graphics. Experience a richer narrative with the inclusion of cross events, bridging the stories of I and II. Choices made in one game influence the unfolding drama in the other. Unveil the elusive true ending of Alphadia II by conquering both titles and meeting specific conditions. Moreover, delve into a treasure trove of rewards, including enemy catalog, and various other exciting extras.

Alphadia I: Embark on a compelling journey centered around 'energi', a mystical power harnessed from life energy. After a tumultuous conflict known as the Energi War leaves humanity reeling, peace seems restored following a century of reconstruction. However, the Schwarzschild Empire's declaration of war plunges the world into chaos once more. From the frontier city of Heiland, a new story of resilience and hope unfolds.

Alphadia II: Two centuries have passed since the Energi Crisis thwarted the empire's ambitions and saved the world from destruction. Yet, the world's life energy wanes, threatening its very existence. Enah, a heroic figure, establishes the Energi Guild to combat this ominous decline. Although the Guild's efforts initially bring stability, a resurgence of energi-related ambitions looms in the shadows, signaling a new wave of challenges and adventures.
70010000137749.intro: The legends of energi once again in a new edition!
70010000137749.name: Alphadia I & II - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000137762.description:
A girlfriend’s quiet day off has been split into pieces!

Restore each photo by rotating and placing the pieces in their proper positions. It’s a simple picture puzzle made for taking your time.

Relax with cosy moments at home, from lounging in a room to taking it easy on the bed or enjoying a quiet drink. Watch the picture gradually come together as you complete each scene.

How to play:
・Study the scattered pieces carefully
・Rotate and arrange each piece in the right position
・Put everything back together to clear the stage

The early stages use only a few pieces, making them easy to pick up and play. As you progress, the photos are divided into more pieces, putting your powers of observation to the test.

With no complicated rules to learn, it’s a friendly puzzle for beginners. Enjoy a quick session when you have a spare moment, or take your time admiring each photo as you work towards the finished picture.

Perfect for anyone who enjoys picture puzzles, simple games, observation challenges or a laid-back holiday atmosphere. Can you restore every quiet day-off moment?
70010000137762.intro: Can you piece together a lazy day?
70010000137762.name: Lazy Day Girlfriend Observation Puzzle

70010000137768.description:
Olive’s situation is dire. They're on the verge of being thrown out of college unless they can salvage their GPA, and their only chance rests on classes they know next to nothing about.

Their lifeline: two club leaders who are more than willing to help them succeed. However, no solution is that easy. Olive soon finds themself in the middle of a conflict between these two friends that threatens to undo their long-standing love for each other.

Twofold is a story about love, family, and connection. It celebrates family of all kinds, and explores the strength (and fragility) of bonds between people.
70010000137768.intro: In a bid to avoid failing out of college, Olive Penn inadvertently finds themselves caught in the middle of a feud between two campus club leaders.
70010000137768.name: Twofold – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000137835.description:
Let's make karaage on Nintendo Switch™!
Marinate the meat in sauce, coat it in batter, and fry it until crispy!
Pack up the finished karaage and add toppings to match each order!
Share Joy-Con™, and up to 4 players can play together!
Reach for the ultimate high score!

《Rules》
Make karaage to order!
Keep cooking until time runs out!

《How to Play》
1. Marinate the meat in sauce

2. Coat it in batter, then fry until crispy!

3. Pack the right number of karaage and choose the correct topping!

4. Serve the order to the customer! The more closely you match the order, the more points you get!

[Score Attack]
Fill orders one after another and aim for a high score!
Make as much karaage as you can and climb the leaderboards!

[Battle]
Compete in karaage-making battles with up to 4 players!
Aim for the highest score and put your skills to the test!
70010000137835.intro:
Get ready for a delicious karaage-making challenge!
Make tons of karaage and watch your food cart prosper!
70010000137835.name: Make it! Karaage

70010000137852.description:
Travel through beautiful environments, explore unfamiliar places, and follow the light as it guides you along your path. Pay attention to your surroundings, overcome the obstacles that stand in your way, and discover what lies beyond each new area.

As your journey continues, uncover the secrets hidden throughout the world and experience an adventure where exploration and atmosphere are at the heart of the experience.

Follow the light, continue your journey, and discover what awaits at the end of the path.

Features:

Atmospheric adventure focused on exploration and discovery.
Journey through a mysterious world guided by light.
Explore a variety of environments and hidden areas.
Overcome obstacles and challenges along your path.
Discover secrets scattered throughout the world.
Immersive atmosphere designed around light and darkness.
Accessible adventure gameplay focused on the journey.
70010000137852.intro: Embark on a mysterious journey through a world shaped by light.
70010000137852.name: Lightbringer's Journey

70010000137874.description:
Ready for a puzzle with a wild side?

Meet fierce, charismatic male furry characters inspired by wolves, tigers, lions, bears, and more. Rotate the panels until each illustration comes together in this easy-to-pick-up puzzle game.

How to play:
・Check the panels, which are turned in different directions
・Rotate each panel with a quick swipe of your finger
・Line everything up to complete the full illustration

As you advance, the images are divided into more panels, gradually raising the challenge. Take your time to study each shape, or trust your instincts and make quick rotations.

Fans of bold furry artwork, rugged charm, and short, satisfying puzzle sessions will find plenty to enjoy. Focus on a stage by yourself, or share the excitement with viewers during a stream.

Can you bring every wild scene back into perfect alignment?
70010000137874.intro:
Feel the primal thrill!
Rotate your way to the perfect picture!
70010000137874.name: Spin & Howl! Wild Furry Puzzle

70010000137934.description:
When Moomintroll unexpectedly wakes up early from his winter hibernation, he finds himself completely alone for the first time, in a world he barely recognizes. The familiar landscape of Moominvalley is now cloaked in the frosty veil of the Lady of the Cold. Initially seeking someone to care for him and longing to banish winter, young Moomintroll reluctantly embarks on a journey into the unknown, learning to forge new friendships and help those in greater need than himself.

- Wander through the beautiful landscape inspired by Nordic nature, exploring Moominvalley and the nearby forests and mountains.
- Meet many of Moomintroll’s old and new friends, and help them out by solving quests and puzzles.
- Re-imagine Tove Jansson’s Moominland Midwinter. A trove of nostalgia for fans of Moomin, and an approachable starting point for those experiencing this wonderful world for the first time.
70010000137934.intro: Experience a heartwarming new adventure inspired by the beloved Moomin stories by Tove Jansson.
70010000137934.name: Moomintroll: Winter's Warmth – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition

70010000138011.description:
From waking up in the morning to work and winding down at night, how much can you remember from a single day?

Take a close look at photographs following a beautiful office worker through her everyday routine, then put your memory to the test after just one minute.

The rules are simple!

・Study each photograph carefully for one minute
・Remember the person, her belongings and the surrounding details
・Answer the questions using your memory and choose from four options

You may think you noticed everything, only to wonder, “What was that like again?” when the question appears.

Enjoy scenes from the daily commute, moments at the office, lunchtime and a relaxing evening at home while testing your powers of recall.

Each challenge is short and easy to fit into a break or spare moment. Take a careful look at every corner of the photographs and see how accurately you can remember her day!
70010000138011.intro: How much of her day can you remember?
70010000138011.name: A Day in the Life of a Beautiful Office Lady Follow Her from Morning to Night

70010000138064.description:
“I’ve seen it before, but which letter was it?”
Turn the words you come across while supporting your favourites into a fun way to learn!

This fill-in-the-blank Korean quiz uses illustrations to help you complete Hangul words. Choose the character that belongs in the empty space and build the word one piece at a time.

【Just choose and place!】
Look at the illustration and the partly completed word.
・Work out which character belongs in the gap
・Choose the correct Hangul character from four options
・Place it in the empty space to complete the word

Compare similar-looking characters and find the one that fits perfectly. Scenes from live shows, fan events and dance routines bring Korean vocabulary to life, helping familiar words feel fresh when you see them in Hangul.

Whether you love K-pop or are just starting to take an interest in Korean, each question is easy to tackle one at a time. It’s ideal for fitting a little learning into your day.

Turn “I’ve seen that!” into “Now I get it!”. Add a little Hangul learning to your fan time and enjoy discovering Korean through the things you love.
70010000138064.intro: Can you place the right Hangul?
70010000138064.name: Slot & Learn My Faves Hangul

70010000138076.description:
Ready for a relaxing walk through town with an adorable Shiba Inu?

Piece together charming scenes and enjoy a brain-teasing puzzle at your own pace. Each picture is split into pieces that must be returned to their correct positions to complete the whole scene.

Explore a variety of seasonal views, from traditional streets and waterside towns to lively lanes at night, snowy landscapes and valleys filled with autumn leaves. Somewhere in every scene, a Shiba Inu is waiting for you!

Getting started is easy!
・Study the scattered pieces carefully
・Work out how buildings, paths and skies connect
・Place every piece correctly to complete the picture

Where does that rooftop lead? Which piece continues the Shiba Inu's body? Look closely at each detail and let your intuition guide you.

If you get stuck, hints are available, so even puzzle beginners can enjoy the game at their own pace.

From spring blossoms and summer skies to autumn colours and winter snow, follow the Shiba Inu on a little journey and complete one lovely scene after another with careful observation and clever thinking.

Perfect for anyone who loves Shiba Inus and cute animals, picture puzzles, townscapes, Japanese scenery or relaxing short play sessions. Take a gentle stroll with your canine companion and see if you can complete every view!
70010000138076.intro: A gentle stroll with a Shiba!
70010000138076.name: Shiba Stroll: Brain Puzzles Around Town

70010000138113.description:
Become a fabulous supermom in this funny 3D family life and farming game! Can you manage a busy home, run a backyard farm, and stay stylish daily?

Balance the ultimate daily routine! From dressing yourself and your three energetic kids to babysitting a lazy husband who refuses to get off the couch, your hands are always full. Cook meals, clean messes, soothe crying babies, and then head outside to milk the cows and tend your farm animals. Can you survive the daily rush?

Key Features:
• Hilarious 3D Family Simulator: Experience a fast-paced, comedic life sim. Juggle non-stop chores, cook family meals, change dirty diapers, and keep your home in order.
• Manage Your Lazy Husband: He needs constant supervision! Turn on his favorite TV shows, hand-deliver his snacks, and clean up his messes before chaos breaks out.
• Backyard Homestead & Farming: Step outside to run your personal mini-farm. Feed the animals, milk the cows, and manage your outdoor chores to keep supplies stocked.
• Fashion, Makeup & Dress-Up: Looking fabulous is half the battle! Customize your supermom with a huge wardrobe of chic dresses, trendy hairstyles, and stylish accessories.
• Addictive Time Management: Upgrade your tools, unlock new rooms, and challenge your multitasking skills. Face an endless, unpredictable daily schedule.
70010000138113.intro: Rule the house and become Super Mom!
70010000138113.name: Mother Simulator

70010000138154.description:
Sharpen your eye for detail across 60 beautifully crafted hidden object scenes, each inspired by real-world cities and iconic landmarks.
Take a break from searching with 12 delightful mini games and brain teasing puzzles that the whole family can enjoy together.
This Collector's Edition is packed with exclusive extras, enjoy bonus levels, a music player and achievements to keep the adventure alive.
Personalize your experience in a special interior scene where you can buy furniture, and test your skills to unlock 10 unique achievements.

Family Journey is the cozy world tour you have been waiting for.
Ready to explore?

The collector's edition includes:
- 60 stunning hidden object scenes across the globe!
- 12 creative mini-games and brain-teasing puzzles.
- A heartwarming family story of world travel.
- Collector's Edition with exclusive bonus chapter.
- Cozy gameplay the whole family will love.
70010000138154.intro: Pack your bags and join a loving family on a heartwarming journey around the world!
70010000138154.name: Family Journey: Hidden Across the World Collector's Edition

70010000138259.description:
Bring the world around you to life with the power of color in Colorbound, a vibrant palette-platformer. Join Anku on a heartfelt journey to reunite his late grandfather’s band by using color to shape the world around you. As you journey, you’ll solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and help a family of musicians come together one last time.

A Farewell Tour For Your Grandfather
Anku’s grandfather was a beloved musician to his people, but his band has long since scattered/  Now, with only memories and a special gift, Anku must journey across diverse landscapes to find the missing musicians, reignite their passions, and give his grandfather the farewell he deserves. Along the way, you’ll use color to brighten the canvas, turning obstacles into opportunities, and puzzles into music!

Change Colors to Change The World
In Colorbound, you will collect colors onto your palette which can be used to overcome logic and light platforming puzzles. From lush forests to forgotten cities, Colorbound’s overworld offers a variety of mind-bending puzzles that span a variety of locations and aesthetics.

Finding Balance
Not all colors behave the same way. Some may be lighter, allowing objects to float away once painted, while other colors are heavier and may drop down. Using this to your advantage can help Anku cross the treacherous terrain to reach his destination.

Rooted in Culture
Colorbound draws inspiration from the Aymara culture of the Andes, blending traditional music and art styles with an indie-gem-inspired puzzle platformer experience. Informed by Panpipe Studio’s Chilean culture and heritage, Colorbound celebrates the rich culture of South America while delivering a universal story of love, loss, and the power of art.
70010000138259.intro: In Colorbound, color is more than just hue.
70010000138259.name: Colorbound – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition

70010000138278.description:
Enter a dangerous pixel-art world where survival depends on how far you are willing to transform. Take control of a strange creature and fight through relentless waves of enemies in a fast-paced 2D roguelite where every run brings new dangers, new choices, and new opportunities to evolve.

Collect experience, discover powerful mutations, and reshape your creature with every decision you make. Combine passive effects, active abilities, and physical mutations to create unique builds that can completely change the way you fight and survive. Experiment with different combinations, adapt to unexpected challenges, and find the mutations that turn your creature into an unstoppable force.

Key Features:
	•	Powerful Mutations: Combine 60+ passive, 30+ active, and 30+ physical mutations to create unique builds.
	•	Transform Your Creature: Physical mutations change your character's appearance and shape the way you play.
	•	Fast-Paced Roguelite Action: Fight through intense enemy waves in challenging 2D survival runs.
	•	4 Unique Maps: Explore dangerous pixel-art environments filled with different enemies and challenging encounters.
	•	Every Run Is Different: Adapt to random mutation choices and experiment with new builds every run.


Evolve with every battle, discover powerful combinations, and push your mutant beyond its limits. Adapt to the chaos, embrace the mutations, and survive long enough to become the ultimate creature.
70010000138278.intro: Can you build the perfect mutant and survive every dangerous stage?
70010000138278.name: Crab Evolution Roguelite

70010000138362.description:
Guide a clever snail through a series of challenging puzzles where careful planning and smart decisions are the keys to success. Find the correct path through each level and overcome increasingly tricky obstacles as you put your problem-solving skills to the test.

Every puzzle presents a new challenge. Think ahead, study your surroundings, and choose your moves carefully to help the snail reach its destination. What begins as a simple journey soon becomes a demanding test of logic and patience.

Take your time, experiment with different approaches, and discover the solution to every puzzle. Can you master every challenge and complete the journey?

Features:

Challenging puzzle gameplay focused on logic and planning.
Guide a snail through a variety of tricky levels.
Overcome obstacles and discover the correct path.
Puzzles that become increasingly challenging as you progress.
Simple gameplay that's easy to understand but difficult to master.
Test your patience, strategy, and problem-solving skills.
Replay levels and search for the perfect solution.
70010000138362.intro: Guide a clever snail through challenging puzzles where every move matters. Find the right path, overcome tricky obstacles, and put your problem-solving skills to the test!
70010000138362.name: Snail Puzzle Quest

70010000138417.description:
Can you bring every club girl together?

Remember those school days when everyone threw themselves into an activity? This charming montage puzzle brings that youthful energy to life with colourful illustrations of girls dedicated to their school clubs.

Each picture is split into three horizontal panels. Slide them into place and build the complete illustration.

How to play:
• Check the prompt
• Slide the three panels horizontally
• Line up the picture to complete the club girl

The simple controls are easy to pick up, even if you are new to puzzles. Matching the scattered panels and seeing the picture click into place is wonderfully satisfying.

Take on a few stages by yourself, or share the fun with viewers during a gameplay stream. It is also ideal for a quick break or a bit of relaxed brain training.

Can you assemble every club girl?
70010000138417.name: Youth Assemble! High School Girl Montage

70010000138423.description:
Fancy a gentle puzzle break with charming glasses girls?

From reading quietly to relaxing in a café or enjoying a nap, these easy-going characters look lovely in their glasses. Compare two illustrations and uncover the differences hiding among the details.

How to play:
・Look closely at the two illustrations side by side
・Find one detail on the right that differs from the left
・Select the spot you have found to clear the puzzle

The simple rules make it easy to enjoy, even if you are new to puzzles. It is a lovely choice for a short break or whenever you want to give your mind a little rest.

Perfect for:
・Fans of cute glasses-wearing characters
・Anyone who enjoys gentle, relaxing illustrations
・Spot-the-difference puzzle fans
・Players looking for a quick game
・Anyone keen to test their powers of observation

Take your time admiring the characters’ expressions and poses, or race to find each answer. Enjoy a relaxing solo session, or share the fun with viewers during a stream.
70010000138423.intro: Fancy a cosy break with charming glasses girls?
70010000138423.name: Glasses Waifu: Cozy Spot the Difference

70010000138429.description:
You were once a dedicated toycrafter,
spending hours working alone in your workshop.
But recently you lost your passion for your trade.
Working on small toys no longer satisfies you.
You shifted your focus towards something more grand, more robust.

Grab a doll, grab your tools, and get to work.
Cut doll parts, paint them and attach them to build unique and unsettling sculptures.

In your workshop, you are alone, you are safe.
No need to look over your shoulder.
Any anomalies you see or hear are just your imagination.
Also: Lock the door before leaving.

There are no abominations chasing you.
No monsters screaming in your ears.
Nothing can even hurt you.
This is simply... an experience. A study of isolation.
What does it feel like to be an artist so consumed by your craft that you lose your grip on reality.

While working, you will:
Interact with the environment.
Pick up, drop, move things around.
Use tools to cut, paint and attach doll parts.
Build a collection of unique and unsettling sculptures.
Keep your workshop tidy and organized.
Not engage with any anomalies.
Lock the door before leaving.
70010000138429.intro: You lost your passion for crafting small toys. You shifted your focus to working on larger dolls.
70010000138429.name: TOYCRAFTER

70010000138478.description:
Embark on a colorful pixel-art adventure where platforming, exploration, and puzzles come together. Make your way through challenging levels, collect the fruits you need, activate levers, and open the doors blocking your path.

Every level is filled with obstacles that will put your timing and precision to the test. Jump across platforms, avoid sharp spikes, escape deadly saws and fire traps, and watch out for enemies as you search for a safe route to the finish.

Use trampolines and moving platforms to reach new areas, collect the required items, and figure out how to progress through each stage. As you advance, the challenges become more demanding and require increasingly careful movement.

Features:

Colorful 2D pixel-art platforming.
Explore levels filled with puzzles and obstacles.
Collect fruits to activate mechanisms and progress.
Use levers to unlock doors and discover the path forward.
Avoid spikes, saws, fire traps, enemies, and other hazards.
Navigate moving platforms and use trampolines to reach new areas.
Test your timing, precision, and problem-solving skills.
Complete each level by finding your way to the endpoint.
70010000138478.intro: Embark on a colorful pixel-art adventure filled with puzzles and platforming challenges!
70010000138478.name: Pixel Path Quest

70010000138484.description:
The Fountain of Youth was hidden away. Nonetheless, it is fated that a Usurper will slay the Ageless and unearth it once more.

FOUNTAINS is a soulslike action-RPG built around fighting your way through a maze-like interconnected, seamless world. You'll take the role of a hooded stranger, recently imprisoned by a tyrannical regime. Will you escape and uncover the mysteries of this war-torn empire?

Demanding, but fair combat
Tight, responsive combat puts every tool and tactic in your arsenal to the test, rewarding precision and quick thinking. Your enemies will hit hard and punish hesitation, turning each fight into an intense back-and-forth where the tide of battle can shift in an instant. Adjustable difficulty settings let you feel that thrill at exactly the intensity you crave, no matter your experience.

Exploration that rewards curiosity
The world of FOUNTAINS is one, seamless, giant dungeon. It is a tightly packed labyrinth which twists and loops back on itself. You'll always discover something new:  items, powers and upgrades to unlock new parts of the world.

Leave Your Mark
FOUNTAINS features an online message system. Leave hints throughout the world to help out your fellow players, or trick them into doing something foolish!

- Souls-like action combat set in a metroidvania-style interconnected world.
- Find new abilities and tools to help you to defend yourself and to traverse the world.
- Rich dark fantasy lore told through exploration and environmental storytelling.
- Online message system for community interaction.
- Secrets are everywhere, so always keep an eye out!
70010000138484.intro: Master high-skilled combat and explore a vast, interconnected world.
70010000138484.name: FOUNTAINS - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000138522.description:
Could you tell what nature is hiding? Even familiar-looking creatures, plants and fungi may hold a surprising secret.

This lively two-choice quiz challenges you to judge whether something is poisonous or safe. Trust your knowledge, sharpen your instincts and aim to become a true poison expert.

• Look closely at the image
• Choose between poisonous and safe
• Test your knowledge with one question after another

Cute, strange or downright unsettling, appearances can be deceptive. Every choice is a chance to discover an unexpected fact and give your instincts a workout.

Perfect for a quick brain break, a laugh with friends or a lively quiz session with viewers. Are you ready to make the call?
70010000138522.name: Toxic or Safe? Dr. Poison's Dangerous Quiz

70010000138603.description:
Cargo Rail Tycoon is a trading and train-driving game set on the railways of Michigan. You are a freight entrepreneur with one simple goal: turn a small convoy and a modest bankroll into a rail empire. Buy goods where they are cheap, load your wagons, and haul them across the map to the towns that need them most — profit is made on the journey, not on the spot.

But this isn't a game you play from a spreadsheet. Every trip puts you in the cab. You drive the train yourself: open the throttle on the straights, ease off through the curves — brake too late and you derail — and read the signs at each switch to reach the right town. Bandits may block the tracks; stop and haggle the ransom down, or pay the price. Arrive fast for a bonus, but arrive at the right destination or lose out.

Between journeys you negotiate face-to-face with each town's station master. Haggle their margin down before you trade — offer low, and watch them squirm — then choose your next destination wisely and roll out again. Twenty-six towns are waiting, and the farther north you push, the bigger the rewards for those willing to travel.

Turn cargo into cash, cash into a bigger convoy, and a bigger convoy into a fortune — just don't go bankrupt on the way.

Key features

-Trade across 26 towns — a living supply-and-demand economy where prices rise and fall. Find the routes, corner the goods, grow your cash.
-Drive every train — first-person rail journeys where speed, curves, braking and route choices are all yours. Go too fast and you derail; take the wrong turn and you arrive at the wrong town.
-Haggle every deal — negotiate the station master's margin down with a multi-round back-and-forth. Push too hard and he'll dig in.
-Bandit roadblocks — stop and negotiate the ransom, or plough through and pay for it.
-Build your convoy — buy wagons matched to your cargo and expand your train as your business grows.
-A fresh route every trip — procedurally generated railways with curves, bridges, rivers and scenery, and a destination that can lie straight ahead, left or right — follow the signs.
-Explore the whole map — the far-north towns pay the best prices, rewarding the boldest hauls.
70010000138603.intro: Drive the train. Build the empire.
70010000138603.name: Cargo Rail Tycoon

70010000138858.description: DEEP ROCK GALACTIC: SURVIVOR is a single player survivor-like auto-shooter. Take on hordes of lethal aliens, mine riches, and unlock powerful upgrades to survive, as you wield the full arsenal of Deep Rock Galactic. It's one dwarf against all of Planet Hoxxes!
70010000138858.name: Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor - Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition

70010000138974.description:
Dive into a colorful and relaxing puzzle game where every move counts! Pour colorful liquids between bottles until each bottle contains just one color. Plan your moves carefully, think ahead, and enjoy the satisfaction of solving each puzzle.
With charming hand-drawn backgrounds, vibrant colors, and increasingly challenging levels, Bottle Logic Puzzle offers a delightful way to unwind while putting your logical thinking to the test.
Game Features:
- Colorful liquid-sorting puzzles that are easy to learn but challenging to master.
- Increasingly challenging levels that test your logic and planning skills.
- Beautiful hand-drawn backgrounds and charming visual themes.
- Simple, intuitive controls for a smooth puzzle-solving experience.
- Helpful hints when you need a little guidance.
- Relaxing gameplay with no rush — solve puzzles at your own pace.
Whether you have a few minutes to spare or want to enjoy a longer puzzle session, Bottle Logic Puzzle is a colorful little challenge for your brain!
70010000138974.intro: Pour, sort, and solve in Bottle Logic Puzzle!
70010000138974.name: Bottle Logic Puzzle

70010000139113.description:
Get ready to experience a new fast food sensation! Create your own diner and grill your way to success. Create different recipes and offer your patrons a truly customized experience!

Think outside the box and experiment in the kitchen. Replace your meat patty with a fish fillet and tartare sauce, or a bacon, lettuce, and egg combo. You're limited only by your imagination!

And the fun doesn't stop with burgers. Create menus for side dishes, drinks, and desserts to really capture the hearts of your customers!

Just don't let your popularity go to your head. You'll need to manage your staff and train them to improve their skills. Before you know it, you'll be offering world-class customer service even during the lunchtime rush!

Keep the cash flowing, and you'll be able to open extra branches of your restaurant. Can you handle running several stores at once? Will you crush your rivals and take their territory for yourself?

Open your restaurant today and take the food industry by storm!
70010000139113.intro: Open your own diner and create custom burgers in this management sim game.
70010000139113.name: Burger Bistro Story – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000139141.description:

Unlock the shuffle gaming mode and generate your own levels with random calculated difficulty, marble waves, length and number of colors.

70050000062851.description:

You can understand why a person would like to live here endlessly. However, life doesn't stop for anybody. The wind of change is blowing through Rynoka. A new, cryptic Portal appeared out of nowhere. Does it bring a new threat? Or is it a new way to make an easy profit? And most importantly... are you prepared to enter the unknown?

Between Dimensions is the biggest Moonlighter expansion. The DLC enlarges the main experience by filling current dungeons with new creatures, populating all-new Interdimensional Dungeon with mini-bosses, swarming the adventure with new weapons, armory, shop items, and rings.

Features:

- A brand-new Interdimensional Dungeon (and a chance for it to appear as a Corrupted Dungeon in the original dungeons
- 10 original enemies and 5 minibosses
- Full set of weapons with a new short sword, big sword, bow, gloves, and spear
- Set of armor with a new helmet, chest, and boots
- Trick Weapons – 10 unique weapons – both powerful… and punishing!
- New Rings – which are boosting Will’s passive abilities
- New Shop upgrade – allowing Will to showcase his new Interdimensional Items
- New Customers asking to trade and an unfamiliar NPC: The Trader
- Additional story and lore

70050000062871.name: Rift of the NecroDancer: Hatsune Miku Music Pack

70050000062872.description:
You can now play “SCOUT” in “Let’s Play! Oink Games”

● SCOUT
You have suddenly been appointed as the leader of a circus. Using the members of your circus you must put together a show that will beat out your rivals.
Everyone on your team has a specific role. To fill in the gaps on your team, try to scout members away from other circus groups! With the addition of just one extra person you may set off an incredible chain reaction that helps you create a show that no other circus will be able to surpass. Will you battle with your current members? Or will you wait it out and try to recruit different ones? When things go the way you planned, you'll feel amazing in this speedy card game! You can even play with a "SCOUT!" card theme.

- Supported Players: Offline 1 Player, Online 1-5 Players (Playable with CPU opponents)
70050000062872.name: SCOUT

70050000062873.description:
You can now play “NINE TILES” in “Let’s Play! Oink Games”

When playing with friends, as long as 1 person owns the game, the other players do not need to own it to play.

● NINE TILES
Move or flip over your 9 tiles as much as you want and try to be the fastest to rearrange your tiles according to the theme. The rules are simple enough, but if you don't pay attention to the pattern on the backside of your tiles too, you won't be able to complete you set smoothly. This is a speedy-party-puzzle game that is fun for all ages, from kids to adults!

- Supported Players: Offline 1-4 Players, Online/Local 1-8 Players (Playable with CPU opponents)
70050000062873.name: NINE TILES

70050000062874.description:
You can now play “Make the Difference” in “Let’s Play! Oink Games”

When playing with friends, as long as 1 person owns the game, the other players do not need to own it to play.

● Make the Difference
Hey, newbie! Welcome! The main role of the DDD, "The Department of Difference Development", is making Spot the Difference puzzles!
We want YOU to take some of our premade illustrations and draw in some differences.
But hold on! We don't need to tell you that making it too easy isn't fun, but on the other hand, making it too hard can be a bummer too. You gotta find that sweet spot and make it just difficult enough to spot the differences.
If you spot the differences within the time limit, you score! For everyone that has ever wanted to make their own Spot the Difference puzzle, this is the board game for you!
There's even a solo create and capture mode too!

- Supported Players: Offline 2-8 Players, Online/Local 2-8 Players
70050000062874.name: Make the Difference

70050000062875.description:
You can now play “Kobayakawa” in “Let’s Play! Oink Games”

When playing with friends, as long as 1 person owns the game, the other players do not need to own it to play.

● Kobayakawa
Kobayakawa is a simple, casino-style gambling card game.
After you play your turn, bet your coins and try to predict whether or not the last card in your hand has the biggest number among all of the players.
However, watch out for the tricky "Kobayakawa" card. This card is added to the lowest card's value, so even if you're holding the biggest number, a win is not guaranteed. Full of bluffing and bravery, this is a game exploding with excitement.

- Supported Players: Offline 1 Player, Online/Local 1-8 Players (Playable with CPU opponents)
70050000062875.name: Kobayakawa

70050000062876.description:
You can now play “Rafter Five” in “Let’s Play! Oink Games”

When playing with friends, as long as 1 person owns the game, the other players do not need to own it to play.

● Rafter Five
5 rafters are collecting planks of wood to make their raft bigger. Try your best to instruct them to load the cargo into the raft. But be careful, the balance of the raft extensions is very important!
If a person that is supporting the raft is moved, the raft will collapse all at once.
Will you be able to skillfully build the raft and make it difficult for others to expand while also making sure you aren't the one to let it all fall apart?
Will it collapse!? Will it hold!? Enjoy the strange balancing act in this brainy, balance game!

- Supported Players: Offline 1-8 Players, Online/Local 1-8 Players (Playable with CPU opponents)
70050000062876.name: Rafter Five

70050000062931.description:
Nicknamed the Demon Star, “Balzarr” is a new Titan that crashed into Earth as a meteor from outer space. Use its massive blade tail and agility to dart around the battlefield while cleaving through enemies with great ease. It can also enter its signature Predator Stance, perching on its own tail or on the side of a building to prepare more follow-up attacks against its prey.

5 minds in 1 body; “R.O.J.A.K.” is a super battle mech piloted by the Mighty Warriors. This ragtag team of heroes stands as mankind’s last line of defense against the terrifying “Balzarr.” Chomp down your foes with your T-Rex torso, kick enemies into the sky with your cannon-powered boots, snipe foes from afar with your Dragon arm, launch Durian bombs at your enemies, and more. Landing an attack with each body part will allow the pilots to synergize and activate the mech’s full potential.

So will you help the “R.O.J.A.K.” team protect humanity from this celestial invader, or will you play as “Balzarr” and unleash hell on Earth?
70050000062931.name: GigaBash - Mighty DLC: R.O.J.A.K & Balzarr

70050000062932.description:
The GigaBash | Godzilla: Nemesis DLC adds King Ghidorah and Hedorah from the Godzilla universe to the playable roster, Each character features a unique skillset and playstyle inspired by iconic moments seen in their respective films.

So will you sow terror in the GigaBash world as the Nemeses of Godzilla? Or will you band together with old adversaries out of sheer survival instinct to fight off these formidable new foes?
70050000062932.name: GigaBash | Godzilla: Nemesis DLC

70050000062933.description: This free DLC adds “MechaJURAS”, an original character from GigaBash to the game. This hulking mech boasts a massive Rocket Drill to decimate Titans, and a Grapple Claw to grab foes from afar. Get in the pilot seat, and protect mankind with the might of MechaJURAS!
70050000062933.name: GigaBash - MechaJURAS Free DLC

70050000062934.description:
This DLC adds “Ultraman & Emi” from Ultraman: Rising to the game, featuring iconic abilities from the animated feature film and a unique skill set that combines Ultraman and the newborn kaiju, Emi, as one character.

As Ultraman, you are star athlete Ken Sato, who reluctantly returns home to take over his father's duties as Ultraman. But, he quickly finds more than he bargained for when heʼs forced to raise a newborn Kaiju he later named Emi. Like all infants, she’s curious yet temperamental, sweet yet demanding; even her cries are like weaponized tantrums.

Enter the GigaBash arena as this dynamic duo as they pull of powerful (and sometimes accidental) combos to defeat their enemies; sweep the battlefield clean as you converge Ultraman and Emi’s ultimate to form one powerful beam attack and more!

So, will you rise up and discover what it truly means to be a hero?
70050000062934.name: GigaBash | Ultraman: Rising DLC

70050000062935.description:
The Ultraman DLC adds 4 new playable characters from the Ultraman universe: Ultraman, Ultraman Tiga, Alien Baltan and Camearra! Each of them features unique movesets and iconic abilities as seen on screen.

Will you become an Ultra-Hero or join the galactic villains to destroy our world? Or will you play as your favorite GigaBash Titan and team up with the legends that inspired the Tokusatsu genre?
70050000062935.name: GigaBash - Ultraman 4 Characters Pack

70050000062936.description:
The Godzilla DLC adds 4 new playable characters from the Godzilla universe: Godzilla, Gigan, Mechagodzilla, and Destoroyah!

Reenact the Godzilla vs. Destoroyah final battle, or play as your favorite GigaBash character and test your mettle against the OGs of the Tokusatsu genre. Each of these new characters has its own unique abilities and movesets, featuring iconic attacks as seen in the films, along with various easter eggs to invoke your long-lost nostalgia.

1. Upon completion of "Trial of a Hundred Demons - Formation" you will receive a "Book of Lucky Capote".
2. Upon completion of "Trial of a Hundred Demons - Existence" you will receive a "Book of Mage's Craft".

4. Upon completion of "Trial of a Hundred Demons - Nothingness" you will receive a "Book of Destructive Joy".

70050000063126.description:
DISCOVER THE WORLD OF THE SAVANNA, JUNGLE, AND FOREST
Explore a world full of simple puzzles and coloring activities that encourage creativity and coordination in a fun and safe way. Young children can play with adorable animals from the savanna, jungle, and forest, discovering their unique traits while developing logic and fine motor skills.

JOY-CON™ MODE
With motion-sensing technology, tilt the Joy-Con like a magic wand to move the pointer! This innovative system makes the gameplay even more interactive and engaging.

PLAY WITH THE TOUCHSCREEN
Kids can interact directly with the touchscreen, tapping and coloring in an easy and intuitive way.

53 FUN PUZZLES
Children can enjoy easy and intuitive puzzles. Drag and drop the pieces into place to complete the picture, and at the end, discover delightful background animations.

53 COLORING PAGES TO SPARK CREATIVITY
Different drawing modes offer a variety of fun. Magic Border mode is ideal for little ones, as colors stay inside the lines automatically for a relaxing experience. Free Creativity mode lets kids use pencils, spray, and bucket tools to create colorful masterpieces inspired by the animals of the savanna, jungle, and forest.

A SAFE AND EDUCATIONAL GAME
Encourages creativity, logic, and coordination with bright visuals and intuitive interactions. Designed for young children with no frustrating challenges.

Discover the magic of nature with a game that makes learning fun, perfect for kids ages 0 to 7.
70050000063126.name: Savanna Animals Painting for Kids Coloring Fun Games 3+ 4+

PLAY WITH THE TOUCHSCREEN
Children can interact directly with the touchscreen, tapping and coloring in a simple and natural way for an easy and enjoyable play experience.

36 PREHISTORIC PUZZLES FOR EVERYONE
Kids can have fun with simple and intuitive puzzles. Drag and drop the pieces to complete scenes of giant dinosaurs, baby dinos exploring their world, and prehistoric sea creatures. At the end, discover animated surprises in the background!

36 COLORING PAGES
Multiple drawing modes are included. Magic Border mode is perfect for little ones, keeping colors neatly within the lines for a frustration-free experience. With pencils, sprays, and paint buckets, kids can create colourful dinosaur masterpieces.

A SAFE AND EDUCATIONAL GAME
Encourages creativity, logical thinking, and coordination with bright graphics and easy controls. Designed especially for young children—no difficulty, just lots of dinosaur fun!

Discover the magic of dinosaurs with a game that makes learning fun—perfect for children ages 0 to 7.

70050000063139.description:
Colonize Galaxies

This DLC offers whole galaxies with up to 20 planets to explore and populate. They can be played both in a free endless mode or in a competitive game mode against AI corporations.

The Space Station

It serves as our headquarters and central hub for planetary colonies. It also enables interplanetary research and allows us to unlock extensions for city centers.

Orbital Space Lift

With this new high-tech construct we can move our resources and items quickly and free of charge between the planetary colonies and the space station.

Extensions

Extensions provide special abilities for our city centers. A maximum of 3 of them can be installed per city center.
Introductory Story Campaign

The DLC features a Story Campaign centered around the Genesis Seed Initiative, starring our new USN Advisor Ixas. It spans accross four planets.

Space Capsule Delivery

City Center capsules can now pack items from the space station. We can redefine the extensions to be installed before landing.

Galaxy-Wide Competition

Each planet will generate continuous income to be used for subsequent colonies. The party that has earned the most victory points at the end of the pioneer phase is announced main administrator of the galaxy.

70050000063259.description:
Rayman makes his great comeback to team up with Rabbid Mario and Rabbid Peach! They have been invited by the dramatic Phantom himself, former nemesis from Mario + Rabbids® Kingdom Battle; and he is a changed, er, phantom. In need of help, he invited this unlikely all-star cast to engage in tactical turn-based battles to create the greatest show ever!

• Rayman is finally back! Control him and his team as he joins forces with Rabbid Mario, Rabbid Peach, and their brand-new Sparks for an extraordinary adventure.
• Discover a whole new cinematic universe full of surprises, including three hilarious giant movie sets: Western, Pirate, and Medieval.
• Leverage Rayman’s unique abilities to rise into this showbiz world. Jump with your haircopter and use your iconic punch to uncover everything lying behind the curtains. Leap into battle to unleash the full power of Rayman’s legendary costumes and wacky weapons!
• Triumph over new enemies and exotic challenges in action-packed tactical battles.
• Get ready to shine, as it's the "Grand Premiere" and the Phantom will rate your performance at the end of each battle. Be stylish and efficient to make a good impression and get the highest score.
70050000063259.name: Mario + Rabbids® Sparks of Hope DLC 3: Rayman in the Phantom Show

70050000063260.description:
Land in the Melodic Gardens, an enchanting new planet that was once harmoniously pulsing with the sweetest music. Meet its wild inhabitants, explore its musical jungle and mysterious ruins, and sail through the vast sea and sparkling lakes. But tread carefully, as Kanya and other new powerful enemies await Mario, Rabbid Peach, and their friends.

- Explore a brand-new exotic planet filled with mysteries and new characters that will lead the team toward exciting quests.
- Face new tactical challenges, including new combat mechanisms and new enemies.
- Recruit up to five new Sparks, discover and develop their powers, and build the strongest team ever.
- Embark on a boat to sail through the Melodic Garden sea and lakes.
- Face Kanya, the last Spark Hunter, and her Mecha King Bob-Omb in epic boss fights.
70050000063260.name: Mario + Rabbids® Sparks of Hope DLC 2: The Last Spark Hunter

70050000063261.description:
Mask of Darkness is a story DLC that adds a thrilling new chapter to Sargon’s saga.
Experience a new story around Radjen, the assassin of the Immortals, as she traps Sargon in her Mind Palace, a nightmarish dimension created with her dark magic.

Dive into a new world born from the shadow assassin’s dark past and soul. Discover four surprising and surreal new biomes with more than ten totally new types of platforming elements, including deadly traps and merciless mechanisms. In between platforming sequences, face six otherworldly new enemy archetypes inspired by Radjen’s surreal dreams, as well as three epic bosses. Use newly acquired combat abilities to overcome them.

• Experience Sargon's darkest quest yet: step away from Mount Qaf to dive into a brand-new story of loss and danger.
• Uncover Radjen's fate in a story that resolves hanging questions from The Lost Crown's main story.
• Use Sargon’s abilities and Time Powers to navigate this intricate and interconnected new dimension.
• Experience an improved combat experience with new Amulets to complement Sargon’s arsenal.
• Gain a new outfit for Sargon, inspired by the Immortals’ best.

Uncover the secrets that lie behind the Mask of Darkness, buried deep within Radjen’s mind!
70050000063261.name: Prince of Persia™: The Lost Crown - Mask of Darkness

70050000063262.description:
Enter the Tower of Doooom and meet its mysterious landlady, Madame Bwahstrella! Ascend the challenging tower to free your old friend Spawny in a new game mode focused on combat. Even if you can climb to the top, the end is only the beginning as you unlock new difficulty levels for infinite replayability! Build and upgrade your team throughout the expedition, plan strategically and triumph against all odds!

• Choose and plan strategically: At each of the 10 floors, you have a choice between different gates presenting various levels of challenge. The greater the risk, the greater the reward, as they say! Start with only a handful of Heroes and Sparks and gather rewards at each floor to build a team strong enough to face the dangers of the Tower of Doooom.

• After finishing the first expedition and saving Spawny, it’s not over: gain access to the new, increasingly difficult Challenge levels that Madame Bwahstrella has up her sleeve. Venture on harder expeditions and prove your tactical skills in a highly replayable experience. Can you make it all the way to the end?


• There are nine exclusive weapon skins, useable in the main game, for you to unlock throughout your journey. Are you brave enough to collect them all?
70050000063262.name: Mario + Rabbids® Sparks of Hope - DLC 1: The Tower of Doooom

70050000063315.description:
A multiple-chapter story separate from the main game, featuring all-new additional characters, locations and battlefields.

You can start Cindered Shadows from Side Story on the title screen, regardless of your progress in the main game. You can choose from Normal or Hard difficulty (Maddening difficulty is not available). There are three save slots available for the side story, independent from those of the main game. There's also a separate autosave for the side story.
If you want to pick up from where you left off, select Continue from the title screen as normal. You can then use the ZL and ZR Buttons to toggle between the main game and side story data.

In addition, the following content will be unlocked in the main game as you progress in the side story:
-	A new area of the Monastery to explore
*Talk to the Shifty Merchant near your personal quarters.
-	New recruitable characters in the Monastery
*These characters can only be recruited during the first part of the game.
-	Quests, activities, character classes, Paralogues involving the new characters, new support conversations, and more!
-	A new costume for Anna (the Tricky Merchant outfit) for Expansion Pass holders

Depending on your progress, one auxiliary battle map will be displayed on the battle-selection screen.

70050000063378.description:
Defeating the corrupt tyrants entrenched there will require not only strength, but leadership, as Ezio commands an entire Brotherhood who will rally to his side. Only by working together can the Assassins defeat their mortal enemies.

It’s time to join the Brotherhood.

BE A LEGEND
Take Ezio, now a legendary Assassin, on a new adventure with 15+ hours of story-driven single-player gameplay.

LEAD AND CONTROL A LEGENDARY BROTHERHOOD
Recruit and customize your own guild. Train and level up assassins and command them to aid you in your quest.

DEPLOY SECRET WEAPONS
Swiftly eliminate your enemies using tools such as poison darts, parachutes, double hidden blades, hidden guns, and an advanced flying machine at your disposal.

WIN THE HEART OF A CITY
Use your hard-won currency to revitalize the crumbling capitol city. Rally the citizens to your cause and unlock extra factions and missions.
70050000063378.name: Assassin's Creed Brotherhood

70050000063379.description:
In Assassin’s Creed Revelations, master assassin Ezio Auditore walks in the footsteps of the legendary mentor Altair, on a journey of discovery and revelation. It is a perilous path – one that will take Ezio to Constantinople, the heart of the Ottoman Empire, where a growing army of Templars threatens to destabilize the region.

BECOME DEADLIER THAN EVER
Wield the lethal skills of a wiser, more efficient and deadlier Ezio. Swiftly eliminate your adversaries by deploying a new arsenal of weapons and abilities, such as enhanced free-running and hook blade combat. Experience new levels of gameplay customization with bomb crafting, and use heightened Eagle Vision to overcome your enemies and the environment.

EXPERIENCE REVOLUTIONARY GAMEPLAY
Explore the farthest reaches of the Animus as you uncover the mysteries of Desmond’s past while gaining insight into what the future might hold.
70050000063379.name: Assassin's Creed Revelations

70050000063380.description: Explore the events that revolve around Ezio’s father, Giovanni Auditore da Firenze, and gain insight on the Assassin’s Creed story and universe.

70050000063383.description: Embers is Ezio Auditore’s final chapter in a story that has spanned more than four decades. Now living in a cozy Tuscan villa with his wife, Sofia, and their two children, Ezio spends his time enjoying the company of family and old friends, and cultivating his vineyards. These are day of quiet comfort. But the life of this former Assassin Mentor will not stay quiet for long. One day a mysterious Assassin shows up at Ezio’s door quiet unexpectedly, bearing terrible news from the East and begging for Ezio’s aid. Ezio refuses at first, but when the lives of his family are threatened by the men following his guest, he has no choice but to act. Will this old assassin’s fire die out before he can save the ones he love, or will it burn brightly one last time, and spark a flame in a new generation of Assassins?
70050000063383.name: Assassin’s Creed Embers

70050000063468.description:
In Don’t Starve: Hamlet Nintendo Switch Edition, Wilson discovers a lost town of aristocratic Pigmen nestled within a foreboding tropical jungle.

Can you readjust to society as an outsider? Can you earn fame and riches recovering lost relics? Will you weather the Aporkalypse?

Key Features
-Reacquaint to city life: Visit shops and trade with the pig society. Purchase and renovate your own home.
-Delve into ancient ruins: Explore the lost world of an ancient pig civilization filled with traps and try your hand at treasure hunting.
-Explore new lands: Discover the secrets of new wild life and seasons.
-Craft and experiment with new items: Find new ingredients and recipes to solve new problems.

Three new characters
-Wilba: Daughter to Queen Malfalfa, Princess Wilba has the love of her people. If only she wanted the job.
-Wormwood: Who knows where this creature of nature came from, but he'll likely grow on you.
-Wheeler: A gutsy aeronaut whose latest adventure has blown off course.
70050000063468.name: Don't Starve: Hamlet Nintendo Switch Edition
