70050000064468.description:
In this new story mode, uncover the full history of Jin and the fall of his homeland that took place 500 years before the events of Xenoblade Chronicles 2. The newly refined combat system lets you take control of both Driver and Blades as you explore a new Titan, the Kingdom of Torna.

The year was 3564…

The 107th Indoline Praetor, Rhadallis, had sent an armed expedition against the country of Coeia. Its capital, Omrantha, fell overnight and sank beneath the clouds, along with the rest of the Titan.

This cataclysm shook the whole of Alrest. As the dust settled, Indol and the newly-risen land of Empire of Mor Ardain claimed the credit for this devastation.

In fact, it had been the work of one Blade. The Aegis, a man known as Malos.

Discover how the fates of Jin and his Driver, Lora, intertwined with that formidable individual...
70050000064468.name: Xenoblade Chronicles 2: Torna - The Golden Country

70050000064469.description: Play Xenoblade Chronicles™ 2 with fully localized Japanese VO. Voice pack only available via digital download.
70050000064469.name: Japanese-Voice Pack

70050000064472.description:
Meet Corvin, an Uchigatana-toting Light-element cool dude with a positive attitude! He comes in a Core Crystal with a 100% resonance rate, and can't wait to find a place in your party.

Elma, the Full Metal Jaguar BLADE colonel from Xenoblade Chronicles X, has arrived in Xenoblade Chronicles 2 as part of the Expansion Pass! Starting now, you can face her in the Challenge Battle Mode.

Crossette is bursting with excitement to finally meet you all! This Bitball-wielding Fire-element girl comes in a Core Crystal with a 100% resonance rate, and is very eager to prove herself!

The Poppibuster is ready to serve! To access him, finish the quest "Shiny New Power".
70050000064472.name: New Rare Blades

70050000064496.description: The Anniversary Upgrade includes new content like quests, dungeons, bosses, weapons, spells, and more to discover. You must own The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim to access this content.
70050000064496.name: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Anniversary Upgrade

70050000064499.description: This pack includes more than 40 recipes to design and decorate structures that look similar to the Hotto Steppe – a popular resting area in a distant land where visitors can take a break from their travels. Players will also get access to an additional island to gather the materials they’ll need to build these recipes.
70050000064499.name: Hotto Stuff Pack

70050000064500.description: Check the mailbox on the Isle of Awakening to discover a fishing island with a net full of quests and characters to meet. Learn how to catch 40 different fish that can be added to a DIY aquarium. Unlock the fishing rod as well as customisation options, including swimwear, straw hats and a ponytail hairstyle.
70050000064500.name: Aquarium Pack

70050000064501.description: This pack includes more than 70 different recipes to construct modern-looking structures, as well as additional hairstyles and clothing. Players can take their architectural skills to the next level by building a fashionable luxury hotel.
70050000064501.name: Modernist Pack

70050000064502.description: This pack includes 3 recipes to create a Pretty Paddle, Celebratory Soup, and Ornate Adornment so that you can celebrate every New Year with some Hotto flair!
70050000064502.name: Knickknack Pack

70050000064505.description:
Meow! (A Mii Fighter hat based on me, the charming Judd from the Splatoon series, is now available.)
Mrowr! (Hone your Smash skills while giving your best Judd-style judgement of how the battle's going. I'm expecting greatness from you!)

Contents

Mii Fighter Costume
・ Judd Hat

Usable after purchase by going to Games & More → Mii Fighter.
70050000064505.name: Judd Hat

70050000064506.description:
A Mii Fighter wig based on the Octolings from the Splatoon series is now available. This wig combines the squishy appeal of octopus tentacles with a suspicious visor to really up your villain vibes and complete your transformation into an elite Octarian fighter!

Contents

Mii Fighter Costume
・ Octoling Wig

Usable after purchase by going to Games & More → Mii Fighter.
70050000064506.name: Octoling Wig

70050000064507.description:
The Doom Slayer's armor is now available for Mii Gunners! Join the battle and rock the iconic green armor and UAC pistol from the DOOM series!

Contents

Mii Fighter Costume
・ Doom Slayer Helmet
・ Doom Slayer Armor (for Gunners)

Usable after purchase by going to Games & More → Mii Fighter.
70050000064507.name: Doom Slayer Helmet + Armor

70050000064508.description:
A Mii Fighter costume of Dante from the Devil May Cry series is now available. With his silver hair and long red coat, Dante's look is a perfect fit for Mii Swordfighters. Wield Alastor, Dante's magical sword, to slash your way to stylish victory!

Contents

Mii Fighter Costume
・ Dante Wig
・ Dante Outfit (for Swordfighters)

Usable after purchase by going to Games & More → Mii Fighter.
70050000064508.name: Dante Wig + Outfit

70050000064510.description:
A Mii Fighter costume of Shantae from the Shantae series is now available. Don Shantae's purple ponytail and genie garb and dance your way to victory with all the charms of this beloved character! The costume also comes with a popular song from the series.

Contents

Mii Fighter Costume
・ Shantae Wig
・ Shantae Outfit (for Brawlers)

Usable after purchase by going to Games & More → Mii Fighter.

Music
・ Burning Town
Usable after purchase by going to Vault → Sounds or by setting it in My Music.
70050000064510.name: Shantae Wig + Outfit

70050000064511.description:
A Mii Fighter costume of the Dragonborn from The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim is now available. Heft your iron armour and wield your blade with all the proud strength of a Mii Swordfighter to show the world of Smash the true power of the Dragonborn!

Contents

Mii Fighter Costume
・ Dragonborn Helm
・ Dragonborn Outfit (for Swordfighters)

Usable after purchase by going to Games & More → Mii Fighter.
70050000064511.name: Dragonborn Helm + Outfit

70050000064512.description:
A Mii Fighter costume of Lloyd from Tales of Symphonia is now available. Grab an extra sword-type item to wield two blades for twice the power! You could even try to replicate attacks from the series with Smash moves. Here's a tip: Use the Mii Swordfighter's Blurring Blade attack to feel like you're using Lloyd's move Sword Rain instead!

Contents

Mii Fighter Costume
・ Lloyd Wig
・ Lloyd Outfit (for Swordfighters)

Usable after purchase by going to Games & More → Mii Fighter.
70050000064512.name: Lloyd Wig + Outfit

70050000064664.description:
Pokémon Sword: The Crown Tundra

The Crown Tundra contains the following:
1. New areas (The Crown Tundra)
2. New Pokémon
3. New characters
4. A new form of co-op play
5. A wide range of clothing items
6. The Galarian Star Tournament

1. New areas
Your journey takes you to the Crown Tundra, where the falling snow carpets the land in silver-white. In this realm of extreme cold and towering snowy peaks, small communities endure by clinging together. Lead an expedition across these snow-swept plains, delve into Pokémon Dens only ever glimpsed in Max Raid Battles, and more!

2. New Pokémon
Legendary Pokémon never before seen in Pokémon Sword and Pokémon Shield make an appearance, including Calyrex, Regieleki, Regidrago, Galarian Articuno, Galarian Zapdos and Galarian Moltres. The Crown Tundra is host to many Pokémon, both regional forms with a special appearance unique to Galar as well as Pokémon known from other regions.

3. New characters
Upon arriving you'll encounter Peony, who came to the Crown Tundra to verify the rumours of Legendary Pokémon he's heard and tasks you with leading the expedition. Many more unique and colourful characters await!

4. A new form co-op play
Features a new gameplay mode called a Dynamax Adventure that enables you to explore Pokémon Dens in the Crown Tundra with other players. Legendary Pokémon featured in past Pokémon titles are lurking in the shadows deep within, so it's time to team up with your friends and get exploring!

5. A wide range of clothing items
You can enjoy an expanded selection of clothing items to brighten up your adventure, with more than 100 new items available across The Isle of Armor and The Crown Tundra.

6. The Galarian Star Tournament
Here you can have fun battling with or against Trainers who've appeared in Pokémon Sword and Pokémon Shield.

Note: For more details about the DLC, check out the official Expansion Pass site.
70050000064664.name: The Crown Tundra

70050000064670.description:
Pokémon Sword: The Isle of Armor

The Isle of Armor contains the following:
1. New areas (The Isle of Armor)
2. New Pokémon
3. New characters
4. A wide range of clothing items
5. Useful items
6. A new type of battle: Restricted Sparring
7. New moves

1. A new area: The Isle of Armor
Welcome to the brand-new Isle of Armor, a vast, lone island located off the shores of the Galar region that's brimming with nature: wave-battered beaches, forests, bogs, caves and dunes are just a few of its natural features. There's also a dojo further inland where you can take up an apprenticeship under a Pokémon Trainer and train alongside your Pokémon.

2. New Pokémon
All sorts of Legendary Pokémon not featured in Pokémon Sword and Pokémon Shield will make their appearance, including Kubfu and Urshifu! You'll encounter new Gigantamax forms for Rillaboom, Cinderace, Inteleon, Venusaur and Blastoise. Additionally, you'll encounter regional forms of Slowpoke and Slowbro, as well as familiar Pokémon known from other regions.

3. New characters
Featuring a vibrant cast of characters such as dojo master Mustard, who'll be showing you the ropes, and your rival-in-training, Klara!

4. A wide range of clothing items
You can enjoy an expanded selection of clothing items to brighten up your adventure, with more than 100 new items available across The Isle of Armor and The Crown Tundra.

5. Useful items
You'll be able to get your hands on an assortment of new and useful items, including an Exp. Charm that can help you raise your Pokémon.

6. A new type of battle: Restricted Sparring
Introducing Restricted Sparring, a type of battle where you must fight under specific conditions using specific Pokémon types. This could be the big moment for Pokémon you wouldn't normally choose!

7. New moves
You'll have the chance to teach your Pokémon all-new moves like Burning Jealousy and Grassy Slide!

Note: For more details about the DLC, check out the official Expansion Pass site.
70050000064670.name: The Isle of Armor

70050000064676.description:
Pokémon Shield: The Isle of Armor

The Isle of Armor contains the following:
1. New areas (The Isle of Armor)
2. New Pokémon
3. New characters
4. A wide range of clothing items
5. Useful items
6. A new type of battle: Restricted Sparring
7. New moves

1. New areas (The Isle of Armor)
Welcome to the brand-new Isle of Armor, a vast, lone island located off the shores of the Galar region that's brimming with nature: wave-battered beaches, forests, bogs, caves and dunes are just a few of its natural features. There's also a dojo further inland where you can take up an apprenticeship under a Pokémon Trainer and train alongside your Pokémon.

2. New Pokémon
All sorts of Legendary Pokémon not featured in Pokémon Sword and Pokémon Shield will make their appearance, including Kubfu and Urshifu! You'll encounter new Gigantamax forms for Rillaboom, Cinderace, Inteleon, Venusaur and Blastoise. Additionally, you'll encounter regional forms of Slowpoke and Slowbro, as well as familiar Pokémon known from other regions.

3. New characters
Featuring a vibrant cast of characters such as dojo master Mustard, who'll be showing you the ropes, and your rival-in-training, Avery!

4. A wide range of clothing items
You can enjoy an expanded selection of clothing items to brighten up your adventure, with more than 100 new items available across The Isle of Armor and The Crown Tundra.

5. Useful items
You'll be able to get your hands on an assortment of new and useful items, including an Exp. Charm that can help you raise your Pokémon.

6. A new type of battle: Restricted Sparring
Introducing Restricted Sparring, a type of battle where you must fight under specific conditions using specific Pokémon types. This could be the big moment for Pokémon you wouldn't normally choose!

7. New moves
You'll have the chance to teach your Pokémon all-new moves like Burning Jealousy and Grassy Slide!

Note: For more details about the DLC, check out the official Expansion Pass site.

70050000065094.description:
A boundless Three Kingdoms experience.

To celebrate the series' 40th anniversary, we have improved the quality of and added new content to the "Play as All Officers" feature of ROMANCE OF THE THREE KINGDOMS 8 REMAKE, which allows you to play as any officer in the world of the Three Kingdoms. Enjoy the game to the fullest with new elements like Turning Points and Gems, new events, and a new Chinese voice option.

• Turmoil and tension abound in the new Turning Point system.
Experience new gameplay through various Turning Points, each with their own far-reaching effects. You will need to predict which Turning Points are likely to occur and employ appropriate strategies to work alongside or counter them.

• Gems based on status and reputation result in a variety of play styles.
Enable a range of possible actions through different Gem types based on your current status. You will have to consider each Gem's effects to decide which to unlock and use for your officer's development.

• New features and data make it easier to customize your play experience.
We have added the highly requested Chinese voice option and made all cutscenes fully voiced. We have also enhanced the data for Traits, historical events, and Official Titles, and have implemented in-game editing and Registered Specialties features.

70050000065988.description:
The Deluxe Edition delves even deeper into the lore of Legacy of Kain.
Includes:

-        Dark Prophecy Demo: A playable demo of the canceled sequel to Defiance: Dark Prophecy, offering insight into an unreleased chapter of the franchise.

70050000065988.name: Legacy of Kain: Defiance Remastered – Deluxe Edition Upgrade

70050000066002.description:
Echoes from a world that never was, these skins draw inspiration from Project Shifter, a Crystal Dynamics game concept that was developed into Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver.
Includes:
-        Shifter Reborn – Skin for Raziel
-        Forsaken Master – Skin for Kain
70050000066002.name: Legacy of Kain: Defiance Remastered – Shifter Skin Pack

70050000066052.description:
This DLC adds "Gamera" and "Guiron" from the iconic Gamera series in their modern, fully animated incarnations into GigaBash, featuring their own unique skillsets.

As seen in "GAMERA -Rebirth-", Gamera emerges to protect those it was made to destroy. Gamera shows that defense and offense go hand-in-hand, with plasma jets to close the distance and flaming projectiles to engage at range. Its thick armored shell ensures no attack gets through. The guardian kaiju is devastating and dangerous at any distance.

Slicing through at lightning speed, Guiron launches into the fray in its "GAMERA -Rebirth-" incarnation. With unmatched agility, Guiron wields its iconic bladed head to drive destruction into any who stand in the way. Its razor-sharp Scale Shots threaten those who try to escape. This kaiju is a living weapon in name and purpose.

Will you embody the cutting edge of Guiron and strike terror upon the world? Or will you don the shell of Gamera to purify and protect your allies?
70050000066052.name: GigaBash - GAMERA -Rebirth- DLC

70050000066176.description:
DISCOVER THE WORLD OF BUGS
Step into a tiny, colourful world of puzzles and colouring fun that inspires creativity and curiosity in young children. Children can meet butterflies, ladybirds, bees, ants and snails while learning about shapes, colours and logic.

JOY-CON™ MODE
Tilt the Joy-Con like a magic wand to move the pointer. Simple and fun motion controls make every activity more engaging.

TOUCHSCREEN PLAY
Tap, drag and colour directly on the screen to bring your favourite bugs to life. An intuitive experience perfect for little hands.

16 FUN PUZZLES
Enjoy easy and intuitive puzzles. Drag the pieces into place to complete each image and watch cheerful animations appear when you finish.

16 COLOURING PAGES
Two colouring modes for every age.
Magic Border keeps colours neatly inside the lines for a relaxing experience. Free Creativity lets kids use pencils, sprays and paint buckets to create bright, cheerful masterpieces.

A SAFE AND EDUCATIONAL GAME
Encourages creativity, logic and coordination with colourful visuals and simple controls. Designed for young children with no pressure, only pure fun.

Discover the magic of bugs with 32 cheerful activities including puzzles and colouring pages. A creative world where learning is fun for children aged 2 to 7.
70050000066176.name: Bugs Colouring Book & Puzzles: Creative Games for Kids 3+

70050000066395.description:
It's time for an eXtreme challenge!

A new mission has been added that pits you against an incredibly powerful Blade.
You may even get a small reward if you're victorious...
70050000066395.name: Extra Mission: "VS ???"

70050000066396.description:
Lola's got a new song & outfit!

Rack up over 1000 Kudos to hear Lola's new single "Raison d'être" and see her new Idol Mode outfit by using the "Outfit Changer" ability.
The song has also been added to the jukebox.
70050000066396.name: Extra Song: "Raison d'être"

70050000066436.description:
Get the Onimusha 2: Orchestra Album Selection Pack. It includes five tracks selected from Onimusha 2 Orchestra Album Taro Iwashiro Selection by the lead music composer for the game, Taro Iwashiro. Immerse yourself in the world of Onimusha 2 in this beautiful orchestral arrangement.

Track List:
- Truth Of Brave ~Warring mix~
- Truth Of Resolution ~Oyu's Theme~
- Truth Of Edge ~Magoichi's Theme~
- Truth Of Loyalty ~Ekei's Theme~
- Truth Of Desire ~Kotaro's Theme~
*Select Special Features  →  Gallery → Original Soundtrack to access these tracks from the title-screen menu.

Also, get this pack of items to use in-game:
- Herb x3
- Medicine x2
- Secret Medicine x1
- Special Magic Liquid x2
- Perfect Medicine x1
- Talisman x1
- Red Soul x10,000

Please note that the content will appear after meeting Takajo when you select "New Game". If you have already met Takajo, the content will appear when you select "Load Game". You can only receive this item pack once.
70050000066436.name: Onimusha 2: Orchestra Album Selection Pack

70050000066482.description:
Hell rises once more in Reign of the Warlock, a transformative DLC for Diablo II: Resurrected. Rediscover the iconic story, gameplay, and challenge that defined the original, now enhanced with additional content and an expanded endgame.

Wield forbidden magic as the Warlock, a new class forged from demonic pacts and Hell itself. Discover new builds with brand new items, sets, and runewords. Explore dynamic Terror Zones, face the Colossal Ancients in a ultimate endgame encounter, and experience modernized quality-of-life upgrades.



The age of the Warlock has begun; will you master the darkness or be consumed by it?
70050000066482.name: Diablo II: Resurrected – Reign of the Warlock

70050000066653.description:
Explore a relaxing Arboretum, wade through a noxious Swamp and take on a new boss in this early game content designed to expand the Dead Cells universe.

So you’ll be able to play through:
· The Dilapidated Arboretum: a relaxing and peaceful greenhouse inhabited by a peaceful clan of mushrooms, with an understandable desire to murder The Beheaded.
· The Morass of The Banished: a noxious environment ruled by a band of tree dwelling mutants with pointy sticks, sneaky dart shooting frogmen and a bunch of deadly bloodsuckers.
· The Nest: Domain of Mama Tick, if you’ve seen Starship Troopers, you get the idea...

The two new levels and their monsters are alternatives to Promenade of the Condemned/Toxic Sewers and Ramparts/Ossuary/Ancient Sewers, with the boss designed to be on par with The Concierge, so hopefully it’ll spice up your early game runs once you’ve played through the base game.
70050000066653.name: Dead Cells: The Bad Seed

70050000066655.description:
Try not to fall as you wind your way along the sheer cliffs of the island’s coast. Explore floating shrines, infiltrate the lair of an outlawed secret society and learn the tells of a new boss. This is new mid game content for people looking for alternatives to the Stilt Village, Clock Tower and Time Keeper areas and their parallels.

· The Fractured Shrines: Breathtaking views, kamikaze crows, spear-wielding snakes, sadistic new traps and an endless fall if you slip. What more could you ask for?

· The Undying Shores: Not the beach you had in mind for your time off… Creepy lantern wielding wizards and their shovel brandishing minions. Not at all the holiday you planned...

· The Mausoleum: A new humanoid boss with his own story to tell, tough pattern based combat and a magnificent setting for a showdown.

On top of the new areas, enemies and pet sword, you’ll of course need new tools for killing and what we’ve provided here should be particularly effective.
70050000066655.name: Dead Cells: Fatal Falls

70050000066656.description:
The inspiration behind it all returns to its 2D action roots! Castlevania’s unforgettable characters & gothic setting meet the fast-paced combat of the award-winning roguelite Dead Cells in this unprecedented collaboration.

A gateway to a striking castle has suddenly appeared, and an imposing warrior called Richter asks you to help him vanquish the great evil within.
Enticed by the promise of new loot rather than a sense of moral duty, you strike out through the grounds and corridors of the gothic castle to find and kill this mysterious Dracula...

Slay hordes of his supernatural minions as you progress through our biggest DLC yet, including two levels, three bosses and a new storyline!


WIELD CLASSIC CASTLEVANIA WEAPONS

Unlock 14 iconic weapons such as the Vampire Killer, Throwing Axe & Holy Water to decimate Dracula's bestiary of monsters and finally the dark lord himself. Each item has been translated into the fast-paced combat of Dead Cells while keeping their original essence.


EXPLORE EVERY CORNER OF DRACULA'S CASTLE

Secret rooms. Flame-lit corridors. Gloomy tombs. Beautiful paintings. Food hidden in the walls. Full of original monsters from the series, such as harpies, werewolves & haunted armors, the character of the iconic castle will transport you into the realms of gothic fantasy.


ENJOY CLASSIC & REIMAGINED MUSIC

We're giving you access to an alternative soundtrack made of 51 of the original Castlevania tunes, that can be heard across the entire game. Yes, 51!

On top of this, we've taken the 12  most iconic tracks, such as Vampire Killer, Bloody Tears and Simon Belmont's Theme, and reimagined them in the style of Dead Cells as a soundtrack for this DLC, while preserving the Castlevania ambiance of course.


DISCOVER A NEW STORYLINE

Richter Belmont and Alucard will be by your side throughout your quest to vanquish Dracula, helping you to navigate the maze of Dracula’s Castle  and providing you with strong weapons (sometimes willingly, sometimes not). However, where there is good there is evil, so watch out for powerful foes who will try everything in their power to stop you from reaching the throne room.


MASTER THREE EPIC BOSS FIGHTS

Fight against the very essence of evil in two intense duels versus Death and Dracula, both set against a majestic backdrop. If you can survive these gauntlets, prepare yourself for our most ambitious boss showdown yet...


UNLOCK CASTLEVANIA CHARACTER OUTFITS

Unlock 20 outfits as you progress through the castle, letting you roleplay as all your favourite characters like Alucard, Richter Belmont, Simon Belmont, Maria Renard, Trevor Belmont, Sypha Belnades or even Dracula himself
70050000066656.name: Dead Cells: Return to Castlevania

70050000066657.description:
Battle your way through sunken shipwrecks, scale a burning lighthouse and confront your deadliest foe yet. If you manage to make it through all that, maybe you’ll finally get off this god-forsaken island...

This late-game content gives you an alternative to the High Peak Castle, Derelict Distillery and Throne Room biomes.

What’s waiting in these new levels?

Infested Shipwreck: Crawl through the claustrophobic corridors of crumbling wrecks, while seething eldritch abominations hunt you from the shadows.

Lighthouse: Ascend this soaring tower while fending off the relentless attacks of the Servants and outrunning the hungry flames rising from below.

The Crown: Try to get off this cursed island by lighting the beacon at the lighthouse summit. However, your past won’t let you go without a fight...


This DLC also gives you the usual extras:

- 9 new weapons, including a throwable shark, a trident and a pirate hook hand (eyepatch not included).
- A not-so-cute pet.
- Loads of new outfits.
- New enemies to bash.
70050000066657.name: Dead Cells: The Queen and the Sea

70050000066660.description:
TIME TO ROCK!

A powerhouse duo teams up with the Turtles for another bodacious ride!

In this final content update for Shredder’s Revenge, your favorite ninja squad are joined by two fan-favorite characters from the classic 1987 TV show, Mondo Gecko and Mona Lisa! The radical reptiles are finally ready for their playable debut in a beat-em-up video game and a long-awaited reunion with the gang.


●GONNA KICKFLIP SOME BADDIES!

The coolest reptile on wheels, Mondo Gecko, joins the fight: use his skateboard tricks to shred through Foot soldiers and rack up extreme scores! Mondo can perform mid-air dodges with his board, making him the only character with this unique skill.

Easy Steezy! Get ready for the Gecko Grind, Shred-head!


●READY FOR A SCIENCE LESSON?

The fearless lizard lady Mona Lisa also leaps into action! Whether it’s ballet, or beakers, she’s using it all to support the Turtles in their quest! Perform her backflip moves in close combat or throw chemical solutions to keep enemies at bay. Her special dodge unleashes a massive blowfish mace, adding a smashing twist to the battlefield. Prepare to smash through obstacles with these brilliant and bold maneuvers!

Let's catch these flying legs!

Together, these fan-favorite characters bring fresh, exciting abilities to the roster for a great new level of fun and action.
Time to rock!
70050000066660.name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Shredder's Revenge - Radical Reptiles

70050000066669.description:
After the development of Dead Cells, we were completely blown away by the amazing reaction of the community. Without your support and feedback we wouldn’t be where we are today. Rise of the Giant is our way of saying thank you. Here’s a free DLC with a bunch of new content, mostly aimed at the people who have been hanging around since day 1, it’s high level and should offer more challenge than most sane people would think reasonable.

Features:
· New levels: You’ve got a new level that’s connected to the main level structure and immediately available to anyone who’s finished the game at least once. You’ve got another (poorly) hidden level, for the masochists who know that there is a Boss Cell 5
· New Bosses: Mirroring the above, you’ve got a new completely different type of boss available in the main level structure, with another INSANELY difficult boss hidden behind even more ridiculously difficult content.
· New content: There are 10 new enemies, 13 new weapons/skills and a bunch of other upgrades to core game systems. There are additions to the story/lore of the game, new secrets, new blueprints and…
· Skins: People have been requesting this for ages and we’ve finally found the time to make the necessary changes to accommodate the request. You’ve now got access to female skins, fluo skins and a Christmas tree skin, cos why the hell not.

The difficulty has been rebalanced so that the entry level of the game, while extremely challenging is now in line with the 5 extra difficulty levels available to those who like to suffer.

We hope that you like Rise of the Giant!
70050000066669.name: Dead Cells: Rise of the Giant

70050000066690.description:

Choose the look that best fits your journey and explore the city from a slightly different perspective. The world may be quiet and worn, but every stray still carries its own story.

70050000067212.description:
A special mission that gives you a weapon useful in the early part of the main game. Additionally, if you complete it, you will also get Edy from the original Valkyria Chronicles as a playable character!

This mission can be played after unlocking the Headquarters in Chapter 2 of the main story. To access this mission, go to Book Mode > Menu > Extra Stories.
70050000067212.name: Edy's Advance Ops

70050000067213.description:
This story features an encounter with Squad 7, the heroes of the original Valkyria Chronicles. After playing through this extra story, you will get the characters Welkin (in the tank Edelweiss), Alicia, Isara, Largo, and Rosie for use in the main game.

This story can be played after unlocking the Headquarters in Chapter 2 of the main story. To access this story, go to Book Mode > Menu > Extra Stories.
70050000067213.name: A United Front with Squad 7

70050000067214.description:
September, 1935 EC. After a narrow victory, Squad E is given a special assignment: Cut off one of the Empire's critical supply lines.

But when Claude's squadron storms the enemy's base, they unexpectedly find themselves standing on a pristine sandy beach...

This story can be played after completing Chapter 10 of the main story. Complete this extra story to unlock swimsuit uniforms for Claude, Riley, Raz, Kai, and Minerva. To access this story, go to Book Mode > Menu > Extra Stories.
70050000067214.name: Squad E, to the Beach!

70050000067215.description:
Winter, 1935 EC. Squad E, traveling now aboard the snow cruiser Centurion, notices one day that rescue dog Ragnarok has gone missing. Feeling guilty for neglecting him, members of Squad E sneak out to find the lost pup.

Before long, though, they find themselves embroiled in a "picnic" of a decidedly unpastoral nature...

This story can be played after completing Chapter 10 of the main story. To access this story, go to Book Mode > Menu > Extra Stories.
70050000067215.name: A Captainless Squad

70050000067216.description:
A desperate plea for help has come from the war-ravaged front lines, and Squad E has answered the call for reinforcements. Six different battlefields, each one a bleak struggle for survival—could it be that the elite Squad E has finally met its match?

This mission can be played after completing Chapter 18 of the main story. To access this mission, go to Book Mode > Menu > Extra Stories.
70050000067216.name: Expert Level Skirmishes

70050000067217.description:
1933 EC. Behind the Empire's towering facade, Crymaria awaits a crucial test with Lieutenant Colonel Selvaria Bles.

This cataclysmic reunion of the two Valkyria will determine Crymaria's fate.

This story can be played after completing Chapter 18 of the main story. Complete this extra story to unlock Crymaria, Nikola, Chiara, and Selvaria for use in the main game, along with swimsuit uniforms for each. To access this story, go to Book Mode > Menu > Extra Stories.
70050000067217.name: The Two Valkyria

70050000067807.description:
Enjoy four game modes: "Original," "Time Limit," "Attack," and "Item."

"Original" is the usual Suika Game, and the player with the highest score wins. Once the box is full, play ends at that point. If the other side's score is higher, you win at that point. If you are losing, continue playing. Can you catch up to your opponent?!

"Time Limit" is a 5-minute intense competition, and the player with the highest score wins. When the rainbow gauge runs out, Poppy will drop fruits on her own, so you'll need to make decisions faster than usual!

In "Attack," the winner is the one who ends the opponent's game. On every 5th attempt, you can send an evolved fruit to your opponent's box. Sending a big fruit could turn the tables!

In "Item," the player with the higher score wins. Evolve fruits to get items, and use them strategically to gain an advantage. Timing your item use well could be the key to victory!

※ Online play mode requires a subscription to "Nintendo Switch Online" (paid).
70050000067807.name: Suika Game Multi-Player Mode Expansion Pack

70050000068355.description:
NOTE: The content of this expansion is only accessible near completion of the base game.

Winter descends, and a long-silenced deity stirs beneath the snow.

Yngya, the forgotten God of the lambs, summons you to restore the flock and reclaim what time has erased. But as you breathe life into what long passed, a creeping Rot awakens, spreading corruption through the sacred mountain the lambs once called home…

Not all who tread this peak come seeking redemption. Upon the frozen summit, a wolf prowls — his pack hungers for war with the covetous Gods. Deep within the hidden caverns, a shadowy figure waits, blade honed and patience fraying. Restless spirits drift along the ridges, each bound by former sins. The past was buried for good reason — will you unearth it, or will it consume you?

That which was sacred now rots, and nothing is as it seems. Last of the lambs, Woolhaven’s fate rests in your hooves.

Discover Woolhaven
Return the lost souls of Woolhaven to their spiritual home and learn the long-forgotten history of lambkind. Rebuild the fallen town to its former glory and reclaim the mountain to restore Yngya’s depleted power, but beware; there is always a price to be paid.

Survive the Winter
Endure harsh blizzards and freezing temperatures that threaten your Cult’s survival. Build new structures to keep your Cult warm and protect your Followers from frostbite and famine.

Explore The Mountain
Venture into a new realm battered by bitter storms, crawling with creatures corrupted with the Rot lurking beneath the snow. Battle through two vast new dungeons, where the echoes of the past refuse to rest. Every soul redeemed on the mountain defiles it further, threatening all of The Lands of the Old Faith. Can you undo the sins of the past?

Take up Ranching
Unlock ranching and breed rare animals that provide wool, warmth and when desperate, precious meat. Tame, ride and let your Followers care for these majestic creatures.
70050000068355.name: Cult of the Lamb - Woolhaven

70050000069450.description:
In Little Strays 2: The Silent Hospital, a new journey leads you into an abandoned hospital where the military continued their secret research after the fall of the old laboratory. A scout team has gone missing, strange insects have infested the halls, and guard dogs still patrol the area.

Slip through vents, explore sealed corridors, and follow faint cries for help echoing through the building. As you search for missing cats and a long-lost vaccine, you’ll uncover disturbing machines, locked cages, and the consequences of human experiments gone wrong.

Rescue trapped strays, avoid lurking dangers, and race against time to escape the hospital before it’s too late. What happened here was meant to stay hidden — but now, the truth waits in the silence.
70050000069450.name: The Silent Hospital

70050000069460.description:
New music now accompanies your journey through the city. As you explore familiar locations, fresh ambient tracks subtly shift the mood of each rooftop run, quiet alleyway, and hidden passage.

The updated soundscape deepens the atmosphere of the abandoned world, making every return feel a little different — more intimate, more alive. Sometimes, all it takes is a new sound to change how a place feels.
70050000069460.name: Echoes of the City

70050000069576.description:
This exciting new expansion for Monster Train 2 adds a new clan, new artifacts and enemies, and a brand new game mode!

The Railforged Clan
Once, they built the rail and the train itself, now they have taken up their hammers to join the fight! Lead the clan as Herzal, the blacksmith that built the Rail and the Boneshaker. Or lead as Heph, the blacksmith behind the Skullcrusher and the Covenant Outpost!

With their extensive engineering knowledge, utilize their unique Forge mechanic to build up units and equipment. Deploy an army of newly built train stewards, turrets, machines, and assemble equipment and units during combat to add to your army and fend off the enemy!

Soul Savior
Introducing a new type of run! Free powerful Souls from the clutches of the Lifemother and her twisted children who have been trapped within the Soulstream for untold ages. Souls are upgrades that can be equipped to cards and have a huge array of effects. The Lifemother is an unstoppable force of nature so you will need to level up your Souls to gain enough power to take on the challenges found in the Soulstream.
70050000069576.name: Monster Train 2: Destiny of the Railforged

70050000069958.description:
This is a large-scale DLC, with content far exceeding the base game and offering nearly 80 hours of gameplay. This DLC brings you the Dustlands like you've never experienced them before. With a new underground realm, exciting ruin exploration gameplay, and gripping storylines, you'll be immersed in the dangerous and opportunity-filled world of Dustland Delivery. Fix up your truck, call up your crew, and get ready for a brand new adventure!

※New Underground World: Sheol

Enter subway stations to travel between the darkness of the underground and the all-pervading danger of the surface. Explore and survive in two different worlds where your every decision could determine the future of the Dustlands.

• Volcanos and Glaciers: New terrain types bring whole new experiences. Change your strategy to fit the terrain, carefully shepherding resources to survive in the Dustlands.
 • Underground Cities and Factions: The cities of the underground are denser than the surface, each one with its own unique cultures and factions who could be potential allies—or potential enemies. Your choices will determine the balance of power in world of the underground.

※Ruins Exploration: No Risk, No Reward

Mysterious ruins lie scattered across the underground, symbols of the glories of the old world fraught with danger—and opportunity.

• Explore Ruins: Pull your crew out of your truck and send them to explore ruins filled with deadly traps, powerful enemies, and priceless loot. They'll need all their cunning to survive.
 • Incredible Rewards: Ruins are filled with rare equipment, road-building survey data, and other priceless resources. Every successful exploration will grant you huge rewards, helping you to stay alive in the underground.

※New Storyline: The Dustlands' Final Chapter

Deep in the underground lurks a secret that could shake the Dustlands to their foundations. The decision is yours: will you bring the truth to light?

• Experience a vast main storyline, with over 20 brand new side stories.
• Uncover mysteries, choose your own path, and witness the end of the Dustlands as we know it.
70050000069958.name: Sheol

70050000069965.description:
Follow Alba as she chases a trail of white butterflies deep into the corrupted swamps, only to discover a frightened wolf cub, lost and alone. Determined to save her, Alba must earn the young wolf's trust and guide her through the blighted wilderness. Together, they will face new enemies, endure perilous trials, and confront a monstrous force that threatens to tear them apart.

Designed to be experienced after completing the main game, Neva: Prologue offers a deeper challenge and rich narrative for returning players. The expansion introduces three new locations, each featuring unique gameplay mechanics, alongside new challenges, enemies, and intense boss encounters.
70050000069965.name: Neva: Prologue

70050000069970.description: This is a language pack that allows you to play The Prince of Tennis Doki Doki Survival ~eternal passion! Tie break ♡ game~ on Nintendo Switch™ in English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese.
70050000069970.name: The Prince of Tennis Doki Doki Survival - Language Pack

70050000070027.description: Welcome to Ocean Avenue, a new level for Ghost Master Resurrection. The mortals living in this modest suburban abode are an easy-going family with little to worry about, or so they think! A new mode comes to Ghost Master Resurrection - Defence. Those dastardly Ghostbreakers have mounted an all-out assault. Avoid their traps, adapt, and get rid of the Ghostbreakers!
70050000070027.name: Ghostly Defence

70050000070083.description:
Ashes & Abyss
A small gas station sits just on the edge of town. Mortals gather around a campfire in the campground just across the street. Make this trip to new level - Gas Station - be a night the mortals will never forget. Meanwhile, across town, there's horror brewing beneath the waves. The ocean takes far more than it yields in the new level - Marine.   Two new characters also join your roster. Release Pyro and Bathys from their chains!
70050000070083.name: Ashes & Abyss

The Expansion Pack includes the following content:
• 8 Playable Units*
- Ideon
- Hi-Nu Gundam
- Nightingale
- Imber
- Tauburn Compartment
- Villkiss
- Urs Ragnar
- Nirvash Z
*Rewarded upon completion of Area Missions

- 26 Area Missions
- 15 On-board Missions

-Sugata & Wako
• 1 Special Mission
•  [MASTER] Difficulty Mode
- Grants access to the MASTER difficulty. Designed to heighten the challenge of SUPER ROBOT WARS Y, this mode features strengthened enemies while allies will face increased upgrade costs and reduced experience gained. Additionally, repairing or resupplying units will no longer grant experience points.
During battles, you will be unable to use Spirit Commands during the enemy phase, and the option to retry after a game over will be disabled.
- This mode can be applied by selecting MASTER at the start of the game or by switching to MASTER in the Game Mode settings on the System screen.

70050000070393.description:
Customize your combat experience with a fresh military-inspired visual upgrade. This DLC changes the appearance of the player’s hands and gloves, transforming them into a camouflage green style built for modern warfare.

Perfect for intense firefights and tactical missions, this cosmetic upgrade adds a more authentic soldier look to every battle and helps immerse you deeper into the frontline action.

Stay sharp, stay hidden, and step onto the battlefield looking like a true elite operative.
70050000070393.name: Call of Warfare - FPS MODERN SHOOTER: Tactical Hands

70050000070394.description:
Enhance your combat awareness with the new Green Armour HUD, designed to give you clearer, faster visual feedback in the heat of battle.

This DLC introduces a fresh green-colored armour interface that improves visibility and readability during intense firefights, helping you track your protection status at a glance.

Strengthen your awareness. Dominate the battlefield!
70050000070394.name: Call of Warfare - FPS MODERN SHOOTER: Green Armour

70050000070521.description:
Get ready to hit the road with the School Bus Adventures DLC, where the trusty Schoolie becomes your new playable vehicle! Explore the wilderness in style and transform this iconic school bus into a fully customized camper van. Outfit and personalize every corner as you venture off the beaten path, turning the Schoolie into your perfect home on wheels.

Designed for big adventures, the Schoolie offers generous interior space for building and creativity. It features a large sliding door, a smaller passenger-side entry, and a rear door that lets you move through the entire vehicle with ease. A ladder-accessible rooftop rack opens up new possibilities for expanding your base above the bus. Please note that you select your vehicle at the start of your adventure.

This DLC includes:
- A fully customizable school bus available as a playable vehicle.
70050000070521.name: Outbound - Schoolbus Adventures DLC

70050000070533.description:
Tiny Auto Knights Supporter Pack: Show off with style

A pack for those who want to support Mumpitz Games. You will significantly contribute to the further development of Tiny Auto Knights.

To express our sincere gratitude, you will receive the following set of prestigious items:

Player Profile Customizations
Show others that you support us by pimping your profile with these accessories:
- Picture frame
- Tiny Auto Knights Avatar
- Banner background effect
- Rainbow colored profile name

Arena Background
Fight your greatest battles in this special dungeon arena.
70050000070533.name: Tiny Auto Knights - Supporter Pack

70050000070544.description:
Walls of Judgment
Some places are built to confine the body. Other places are built to attract strange, otherworldly spirits. The Walls of Judgment introduces two grim new locations:
A prison where no one can hear you scream. The church where you may hide from your nightmares.
Behind the iron bars and the locked doors, mortals wait, pace, and pray.
Mortals are unaware they are prey. In the prison, isolation and routine can drive you mad.
If you doubt this truth, ask inmate Kyle, who has been in prison serving a sentence extending into the afterlife.
In the church, faith is tested. Most win, most of the time. Others are less fortunate.
Justice may be blind… and fear can stare straight through you

Releasing in Spring 2026
70050000070544.name: Walls of Judgment

70050000070550.description:
Between Worlds
Not all places are meant to be destinations. The Train Station is a place of arrivals, departures, and fleeting encounters. Mortals pass through, never feeling safe, as though they are being watched. Platforms fade into the darkness. The tunnels echo with distant sounds from the past and the present. Panic spreads faster than the Phantom Train Conductor can operate his locomotive.

Introducing a new Train Station level built upon crowds, open spaces, and relentless motion. No place ever feels secure.

Introducing a new game mode: Second Side of the Coin.

For the first time, step into the role of a Ghost-breaker who hunts ghosts, sets traps, and experiences fear from the other side—where control is fleeting and fragile, resources are limited, and every mistake means punishment.

Releasing mid-2026
70050000070550.name: Between Worlds

70050000070559.description:
Frightful Night
The holidays arrive in Ghost Master Resurrection with a new Christmas Market level, draped in lights, decorations, and false cheer. Mortals gather to celebrate, laugh, and shop—blissfully unaware that terror awaits just beneath the tinsel.

Carols echo. Shadows linger.

Every smile hides a scream.

The most wonderful time of the year is here—for you to scare!

Releasing December 2026
70050000070559.name: Frightful Night

70050000070722.description:
Cat Girl Survivor – Extra Episode DLC

A major story expansion that deepens the world of Cat Girl Survivor.

Featuring full-voice performances by a renowned Japanese voice cast including Yui Ogura, Kana Ueda, and Marie Miyake, this DLC introduces brand-new story episodes that expand the narrative beyond the main game.
Discover hidden sides of the protagonists and uncover untold stories that add new depth to their relationships.

■ Voice Cast & Roles

Yui Ogura – Yuri

Kana Ueda – Akane

Marie Miyake – Koro

Nozomi Yamane – Chloe

Chirin Sakura – Shiro

Kenta Kiyozumi – Leo

All new story content is fully voiced to enhance immersion and character development.

■ DLC Features

New fully voiced story episodes

5 newly designed stages

More challenging new boss battles

New playable character: Mio

Mio is a bard-style character who uses sound waves to slow enemy movement.
Her unique crowd-control abilities introduce new strategic options and fresh build possibilities for advanced players.

This DLC delivers both narrative expansion and intensified combat content for players who want to experience the world of Cat Girl Survivor in greater depth.

Base game required to play.
70050000070722.name: Cat Girl Survivor – Extra Episode DLC

70050000070774.description:
This DLC adds “Gaya Gigaman" and "Zargorah", 2 of GigaBash's characters given new forms, new abilities, and a whole new story mode chapter for Gigaman.

When the situation is most dire, humanity's hero Gigaman taps deep into his source of power and becomes Gaya Gigaman to deliver hope. Faster, stronger, and 100% more Giga! His moves are stellar, and his rise meteoric! Enhance his attacks with the power of the stars, and don't forget to pose for the camera.

Tremble before the ascension of Zargorah, the Devourer of Stars! This new threat combines the speed of the Demon Star and the might of the Extinction Dragon into one devastating Titan. When he roars, pandemonium ensues!

Gigaman, the Champion of Justice, takes new form as Gaya Gigaman! But his nemesis Zargorah threatens everything he holds dear. What happens when the two clash? Can Gigaman find the strength to stop the end of all things? Find out in the brand new Story Mode for Gigaman!

Will you deliver hope on wings of azure flame as Gaya Gigaman? Or will you take what is yours as Zargorah and shatter the world?
70050000070774.name: GigaBash - Final Ascension DLC

70050000070790.description:
Solid Ice and Terror

Escape the bitter cold outside. Screams echo across the ice, celebrating victories and championships of years past.

A massive industrial hockey arena has been abandoned for years. The lights flicker over empty stands and scarred ice. Mortals enter believing their greatest enemy is the polar vortex, however outside something far worse stalks the rink tonight. What looks cute can be just as terrifying. The officials are watching from beyond.

In Canada, hockey is life—even in the afterlife. Something far worse than the cold stalks the rink on this winter evening. The rules of the natural and the supernatural can change without warning. Some will cry for decades. Others are haunted forever.

Introducing a new level set in an industrial Canadian hockey arena somewhere in Canada. We’ll give you 514 guesses where. Every whistle cuts through the darkness, and every decision feels final.

Beware the supernatural official, Jacques Rougeau, who’s on the job.
“Justice isn’t fair. I don’t care if you get screwed over…!

Releasing in mid-2026
70050000070790.name: Solid Ice and Terror

70050000070791.description:
Step inside the rigid world of bureaucracy with two new locations: a Government Bank and a Town Hall. Designed for security and control, these buildings quickly become pressure cookers when mortals realize the rules no longer protect them.

Tight corridors, public spaces, and fragile authority create the perfect environment for paranoia to spread. Watch calm routines collapse as whispers turn into panic and trust evaporates.

The system is failing.
Make sure they feel every second of it. "
70050000070791.name: DLC 8 State of Panic

70050000070792.description:
The mansion has been waiting.

Beyond rusted gates and tangled vines lies a Gothic Mansion, steeped in sorrow and shadow. Its towering halls and hidden chambers tell stories of obsession, ritual, and souls that never left.

This atmospheric new level focuses on slow-burning dread and looming presence. Every creak carries intent. Every shadow feels alive. Mortals may enter seeking answers — but the house has its own designs.

Some places are haunted.
This one hungers.
70050000070792.name: Blood and Stone

70050000070793.description:
Relics of the Past

Releasing Fall-2026
70050000070793.name: Relics of the Past

As the season progresses, players will explore new environments, face new combat encounters, and expand their roster with powerful new heroes, keeping the experience evolving for returning players.

Fly, race, and roll with Snoopy like never before — The Joe Cool Fun Pack celebrates 75 years of Peanuts with flair, fun, and four fresh challenges, featuring:

• EXCLUSIVE "JOE COOL" OUTFIT – Suit up in Snoopy’s persona and most legendary look. Beagle swagger has never looked cooler!

• 2 RED BARON MINI GAMES – Take flight in the Sopwith Camel as Snoopy with high-flying challenges that will test your reflexes:
- Frozen Cave: Carefully navigate ice trenches, avoid falling icicles and a multitude of icy obstacles!
- Scorching Desert: Put your flying ace skills to the test as you fly through canyons, and even inside a pyramid, avoiding sand tornadoes and numerous obstacles!

• 2 PEANUTS SOAPBOX RACING MINI GAMES – Strap in, start your engines, and 3, 2, 1, GO!:
- The Great Pumpkin Patch: Race through The Great Pumpkin Patch, avoiding pumpkins & tangly vines, to claim victory!
- Off-Road Challenge: Race through a forest filled with jumps and obstacles as you try to avoid tree trunks, mud pits and even falling trees.

• The 75th ANNIVERSARY COMIC COLLECTION: 75 full-color comics readable via an in-game viewer, celebrating our favorite gang!

A new playable character, “Leah”, joins Cat Girl Survivor.

Leah is the younger sister of Leo and the second cat of a mysterious family of genius exorcists. She joins the adventure as a powerful new ally.

Leah fights by scattering special spirit-hunting paint around her and detonating it to damage enemies across the battlefield.

Although she is even stronger than her brother Leo, Leah is still young and loves to sleep, so she doesn’t easily set out on adventures.

Give Leah a little allowance so she can buy her favorite dango and convince her to join your journey.

She will become a powerful ally well worth the dango.

*This content requires the base game “Cat Girl Survivor” to play.*

70050000071540.description:
ABOUT THE EXPANSIONS

THE LAST AUTUMN
The Last Autumn is a turning point in the Frostpunk universe. Revealing the restless events of Site 113 and its struggle to construct the generator before the freezing veil shrouds the Earth, this prequel expansion broadens the Frostpunk universe by introducing a new environment, new Books of Laws and unique technologies, and presents a range of new buildings — all of which let you shape society and the city in unconventional ways. Leading a group of engineers working on one of the world’s greatest technological marvels - a Generator - will require adapting your strategy to extraordinary situations. As the leader of Site 113, hope for the best, but be prepared for the worst. For Queen and Country!
•	experience a prequel story taking place before the freezing cataclysm
•	master a totally new Book of Laws allowing you to shape your society in previously unknown ways
•	construct new buildings
•	discover uncommon, steam-powered technologies
•	apply more advanced strategies to survive
•	delve into a beautiful new environment not yet covered by snow

ON THE EDGE
On The Edge expansion tells a story of citizens of New London sent for a special assignment after the Great Storm. It not only opens a brand new chapter set in the Frostpunk universe but also pits you against new challenges and offers unique mechanics, both in the city and on the Frostland map - further enriching the core experience. A brand new, frozen board is set and the pieces are moving. What destiny lies ahead for your people? What will this mean for you, as their leader? Shape the future of humanity in Frostpunk's final chapter - On The Edge.
•	brand new story scenario, set after the Great Storm
•	an array of challenges to overcome on a new, desolate map
•	unique mechanics to utilize on the Frostland view

THE RIFTS
Experience a new level of challenge on a brand new Endless Mode map, where the land itself threatens your survival. Using a new gameplay mechanic, bridge the rifts to access new areas. Expand the city to save your people from the inevitable doom!
•	unique new Endless Mode map
•	new constructible building
•	new gameplay mechanics
70050000071540.name: Frostpunk: All Expansions Pack

70050000071564.description:

Explore the pixel arena under the new pink light, collect the glowing crystals, and use your evolved abilities to survive waves of enemies and face the brutal boss.

Survive. Evolve. Smash everything… now under the pink mist of chaos!
70050000071564.name: Megabonk Smash: Misty Madness

70050000071659.description:
The boss of Babyloni-ya summons Masters and Servants to a mysterious arena, where he suddenly announces the commencement of Keian Command Championship without giving much explanation.

Whether true or not, the winner is rewarded with a wish granter that outshines even the moon. As the Divine Spirit Ibuki-Douji smiles bewitchingly behind the scenes, the contestants fight in this extraordinary tournament, each with their own motives, be it to fulfil their wish or to challenge worthy opponents.

- Game Overview
1. A dream match-up where you can choose which team to play as!
There are seven different teams in the Waxing Moon Ritual, allowing you to play through seven different routes. You will be able to control characters other than Iori and Saber in the tournament, including the newly playable Rider. Enjoy the tournament from multiple perspectives that were not depicted in the main story!

2. New character dialogues and endings unique to each team!
In between the matches, you will view new cutscenes and learn more about the characters. If you manage to win the tournament, you will unlock an ending sequence unique to each team.

3. A new Servant Ibuki-Douji joins the battle, and the boss can now accompany you!
The Divine Spirit Ibuki-Douji, the Divided Spirit of Yamata-no-Orochi, will appear in the game. Witness her tremendous might in the tournament. Depending on which team you choose to play as, you may also control Ibuki-Douji and fight through the matches. Once you meet a certain condition, you can have Ibuki-Douji and the boss accompany you as Rogue Servants in the main story.

Note:
This item is included in the Season Pass. Please avoid making redundant purchases.
- How to Play
In order to play the "Record's Fragment: Keian Command Championship" DLC, you need to play the base game until reaching the point to leave Akasaka in "An Exchange of Vows" (Chapter 2).
Once you are able to move freely on the Edo Map, please select "Record's Fragment: Keian Command Championship" on the map to begin playing.
70050000071659.name: Additional Episode 1 "Record's Fragment: Keian Command Championship"

70050000071660.description:
The magic power of the Ritual swirling around Edo attracts many oddities.
Tsujigiri of tremendous skill. A mysterious deadly blade.

Miyamoto Iori and Saber, who are investigating the situation at the behest of Sukenoshin, are confronted by a swordsman of a much higher skill. A Servant.
Is this the rumored Tsujigiri?
Just as they wonder, the Servant suddenly lowers his sword to introduce himself.

“...I am Yagyu Munenori.
A figment of human history, and now a swordsman with no master.”

A newly arrived Rogue Saber, a master of swordsmanship, whose True Name is Yagyu Tajima-no-Kami Munenori.
What is his purpose here? And what is his connection to Tsujigiri?
Accompanied by a new Servant, Iori and Saber traverse the blood-soaked streets of Edo.

- How to Play
In order to play the “Record's Fragment: Yagyu Sword Chronicles” DLC, you need to play the base game until reaching “My Mind Bides on the Battlefield” (Chapter 3).
Once you are able to move freely on the Edo Map, please select “Record's Fragment: Yagyu Sword Chronicles” on the map to begin playing.

Note:
This item is included in the Season Pass. Please avoid making redundant purchases.
70050000071660.name: Additional Episode 2 "Record's Fragment: Yagyu Sword Chronicles"

70050000071661.description:
Mysteriously disappearing children. Rumors of evil spirits in Yoshiwara.
A strange voice calling out to Miyamoto Iori. A suddenly attacking bird monster.

In the midst of all these strange incidents, Yui Shousetsu appears in the form of a child and tells them that if nothing is done, Edo will be destroyed.

With Spirit Font in turmoil, aspirants of the Waxing Moon join together to face a new anomaly.
Among them, is a newly arrived Servant.
Astride a white horse is an unrivaled spear-wielder, Rogue Rider Zhao Yun.

“Feel the sting of Zhao Zilong's spear!”

- How to Play
In order to play the "Record's Fragment: Bailong and the Crimson Demon" DLC, you need to play the base game until reaching the point to talk to the boss in "Seek the Heroes That Survive" (Chapter 3).
Once you are able to move freely on the Edo Map, please select "Record's Fragment: Bailong and the Crimson Demon" on the map to begin playing.

Note:
This item is included in the Season Pass. Please avoid making redundant purchases.
70050000071661.name: Additional Episode 3 "Record's Fragment: Bailong and the Crimson Demon"

70050000072190.description:
Downloadable content for DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World.

Delve into the special dungeons of the Mega Mole Hole where you'll only encounter monsters you've befriended before. You select the ranks and families of the monsters that appear in the dungeon to increase your chances of meeting the exact ones you want.

If you need a monster that only shows itself at a certain location at a specific time, or is otherwise only obtainable through synthesis, you can use the Mega Mole Hole to make an easier time of befriending it.

- This content does not include the main game of DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World.
- This content and other bonuses are available as part of the DIGITAL DELUXE EDITION and the DLC 4-ITEM SET. Please bear this in mind to avoid making duplicate purchases.
- You can claim this content by selecting "Check for Downloadable Content" from the in-game menu screen.
- The content will be available to use only after the main characters have obtained the Zoom spell during the main story.
70050000072190.name: The Mega Mole Hole

70050000072191.description:
Downloadable content for DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World.

In Monster Marathons, you send out a party on an expedition mini game, instructing your monsters when to run and jump as you guide them to their destination. The farther your monsters travel, the more experience points and gold coins they'll earn, and the more crafting items they'll be able to pick up.

Along the way, your party will run into enemy monsters. The only way to avoid them, and go as far as you can, is with perfectly timed jumps and expertly controlled speed.

- This content does not include the main game of DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World.
- This content and other bonuses are available as part of the DIGITAL DELUXE EDITION and the DLC 4-ITEM SET. Please bear this in mind to avoid making duplicate purchases.
- You can claim this content by selecting "Check for Downloadable Content" from the in-game menu screen.
- The content will be available to use only after the main characters have obtained the Zoom spell during the main story.
70050000072191.name: Monster Marathons

70050000072192.description:
Downloadable content for DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World.

The metallic ring is a special item you can use while out exploring to turn all the enemies in the area into metal monsters* or hunter mechs. You can use the metallic ring as many times as you like, but you'll have to wait 30 in-game minutes between uses.

The effects of the metallic ring wear off after some time has passed or if you leave your current area.

Depending on when you use the metallic ring, you may encounter monsters that provide far more experience points than otherwise available at that stage in the story. So whether you're just starting out or have already completed the main story, you can use the metallic ring to quickly and effectively boost your monsters' experience points.

*The metal monsters are metal slimes, liquid metal slimes and metal king slimes.

- This content does not include the main game of DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World.
- This content and other bonuses are available as part of the DIGITAL DELUXE EDITION and the DLC 4-ITEM SET. Please bear this in mind to avoid making duplicate purchases.
- You can claim this content by selecting "Check for Downloadable Content" from the in-game menu screen.
- The content will be available to use only after the second main area of story has been completed.
70050000072192.name: Metallic Ring

70050000072193.description:
Downloadable content for DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World.

The Scout Run VIP card is an exclusive item that makes using the Scout Run* even more rewarding. While the Scout Run is available in the base game, this item provides a range of extra benefits, including a bigger allowance of scouty snacks, more monsters appearing at one time, and a reduced wait time between uses.

*With the Scout Run feature, you use special items called "scouty snacks" to befriend monsters without having to enter battle. You can use this feature as many times as you like, but you have to wait a short while between uses.

- This content does not include the main game of DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World.
- This content and other bonuses are available as part of the DIGITAL DELUXE EDITION and the DLC 4-ITEM SET. Please bear this in mind to avoid making duplicate purchases.
- You can claim this content by selecting "Check for Downloadable Content" from the in-game menu screen.
- The content will be available to use only after the Scout Run has been unlocked during the main story.
70050000072193.name: Scout Run VIP Card

70050000073149.description:
Turn mischief up a level with a new interactive paint can that transforms every prank into a colorful burst of chaos. When used, it increases Granny’s stress level while leaving playful colored paw prints behind you for a short time, making every escape, chase, and prank even more chaotic and visually fun.

The house becomes even more unpredictable as your actions now leave a visible trail of trouble, giving Granny more reason to react—and you more ways to stir up adorable mayhem.

Sneak, prank, and paint your way through Granny’s house — because mischief just got messier.
70050000073149.name: Evil Cat Simulator vs Granny: Chaos Splash

Don’t just survive the storm—thrive in it.

70050000073278.description:
The quarantine zone continues to evolve as new visual refinements bring additional depth and variety to its environment.

The appearance of soldiers and scientists has been updated, giving a fresh and more immersive visual identity while maintaining the tense atmosphere of the outbreak.Subtle environmental and character updates enhance the sense of realism, making every checkpoint and interaction feel more grounded and dynamic.

Equip your team with the look of a true elite force. The border is changing—make sure you are ready to lead it.
70050000073278.name: Quarantine Lockdown Simulator: Zombie Border – Elite Skins

70050000073311.description:
THE ROCK'EM & BLAST'EM CONNECTION!
Two new Super Heroes join the fight against Annihilus!
Play as The Fantastic Four’s The Thing and X-Men’s Cyclops alongside the 15 playables Super Hero from the base game.

TO ME, MY X-MEN!
You asked for it, and here he is: the no-nonsense leader of the X-Men blasts into battle!
Cyclops' signature kinetic energy beams will pierce through the Annihilation Wave. As they can also be shot diagonally, Cyclops will be a perfect pick to counter aerial enemies – and catch opponents off guard.

IT'S CLOBBERIN' TIME!
The Fantastic Four’s heaviest hitter brings his cosmic radiation-induced might to the fray, excelling as a grappling-focused powerhouse.
With surprising mobility allowing him to bounce across environments to get the jump on enemies, this former ace pilot embraces his new role as a tanklike protector of family and allies alike, arriving as an incredible asset to any team.

Together, Cyclops and Thing are a perfect match to handle on the ground action and aerial foes.


This is an Additional Content for “MARVEL Cosmic Invasion”, which is a product released for Nintendo Switch.
It can also be played on Nintendo Switch 2.

However, please note that a separate product, "MARVEL Cosmic Invasion Nintendo Switch 2 version", is available exclusively for Nintendo Switch 2.

This Additional Content is not compatible with the Nintendo Switch 2 version. Please be careful to avoid duplicate or mistaken purchases.

70050000073561.description:

This DLC grants you 1500 in-game currency, giving you the freedom to upgrade your equipment, unlock new gear, and prepare for high-risk missions without limitations. Strengthen your loadout with better weapons, advanced gadgets, and improved customization options.

Make smarter decisions, upgrade earlier, and face every challenge fully equipped.
70050000073561.name: Critical Strike Modern - SWAT Shooter Ops: Tactical Funds

70050000073574.description:
The workplace dress code has been revised.*

Download this free HR Violations Pack to customize your censorship settings for Dispatch.

Choose from one of three visual styles:

- Mosaic Mode (Default) Pixelated blur
- Chaotic Mode - Covers up with whatever’s lying around
- Blackout Mode - Classic bar censorship (original game mode)

*does not apply to Artbook or Comics
70050000073574.name: HR Violations Pack

70050000073652.description: The hidden world is much like an RPG game. There are enemies you can strike down at any moment, items to collect, and occasionally quest missions to undertake! Having grown accustomed to this thrill, Young-ho dons his self-made cloak and armour, and today too, he swings his sword for the peace of this fantasy world. But as expected, it seems he's found himself in the wrong universe.
70050000073652.name: The Coma 3: Bloodlines - Nightmare Slayer Skin

70050000073714.description: Our Youngho is one of a kind; the more splendid the vigilante, the more shabbily he dresses, and he thought it utterly uncool to live in filth just to scrape by. So Youngho went to a tailor in the Coma, picked out a splendid suit, donned a tie, and hid his piercing gaze behind sunglasses. 'Huh—now I must save people with this secret agent vibe.'
70050000073714.name: The Coma 3: Bloodlines - Ghost Agent No. 3 Skin

70050000073720.description: Wider eyes and a gaping mouth! Young-ho has honed his acting skills through self-taught methods. His exaggerated gestures and expressions make his very character seem altered, rendering horrific and terrifying situations all the more grotesque... or absurdly ridiculous.
70050000073720.name: The Coma 3: Bloodlines - Overaction Skin

70050000073736.description:
You’re ready to dive into the world of Tavern Talk: Dreamwalker, but you wish it was just a little more green? That the view is nice, but one more potted plant wouldn’t hurt?
With this decoration pack, you’ll unlock nine new trinkets featuring Asteria’s fantastical flora and fauna to decorate the Drowsy Dragon with. And let's be real—who wouldn’t want an adorable little mandrakebun hanging from their ceiling?
70050000073736.name: Tavern Talk Stories: Dreamwalker - Drowsy Druid (Decoration Pack)

70050000073738.description:
Do you sometimes feel like your cozy, nautical tavern is lacking just a little bit of magic? And you just can’t help but crave that magical spark, infused with science and whimsy? Well, then we have good news for you!
With this decoration pack you’ll unlock nine new trinkets to spice up the Drowsy Dragon with. Magical artifacts, dangerous potions... What more could you want? Ah, adorable frogs, mayhaps? We got you!
70050000073738.name: Tavern Talk Stories: Dreamwalker - Wondrous Wizard (Decoration Pack)

70050000073747.description:
Expand your experience with an additional 500 added directly to your in-game balance. Unlock more customization options, access new content faster, and shape your streaming journey with greater flexibility and freedom.

Build your dream setup, explore new opportunities, and take your creator career to the next level with extra resources ready to use from the start.

Step into the spotlight, grow your audience, and create the ultimate streaming experience your way.
70050000073747.name: STREAMER SIMULATOR 2026: Balance Rise

70050000073766.description: The crisp Korean autumn. The melancholic atmosphere, intertwined with vibrant autumn foliage, feels like a fashion week for Korea's youth. To keep pace with the dazzling fashionistas roaming the streets, Mina adorns herself to the fullest today.
70050000073766.name: The Coma 3: Bloodlines - Autumn Girl Skin

70050000073772.description: Korea's renowned private high schools are financially more affluent than state schools and enjoy greater freedom in external activities. To enhance their value, brand image is also crucial, and the sophisticated design of their school uniforms plays a part in this. Sehwa Arts High School, specialising in the “arts” field, wished to provide its students with more sophisticated and vibrant uniforms.
70050000073772.name: The Coma 3: Bloodlines - Sehwa Arts High School Skin

70050000073775.description:
Expand your garage with the RACE - Razor Pack!

Razor is a fast Speedster-class combat car built for high-speed arena racing. With a sharp futuristic body, cutting-edge combat gear, and a lightweight design, it is made to strike fast and outmaneuver rivals on post-apocalyptic tracks.

Its ultimate ability, Blade Storm, surrounds the car with a storm of blades, damaging enemies on collision.

This DLC includes:
- Razor car
- 6 vinyls
- 6 flags
- 4 avatars

Vinyls and flags can be used on any unlocked car.
70050000073775.name: RACE: Rocket Arena Car Extreme - Razor Pack

70050000073782.description:
Get an instant boost of 500 added to your in-game balance, giving you more flexibility from the very beginning of your café journey.

Use this advantage to refine your setup, explore new upgrades, and unlock additional possibilities as you build and manage your coffee business step by step.

Make every decision count as you shape your café into a thriving success.
70050000073782.name: Barista Life Simulator 2026: Capital Boost

70050000073803.description:
Embark on an epic journey across Talea with the Deluxe DLC, a special bonus pack featuring items, supplies, and companion rewards for adventurers beginning their journey across Talea.

Deluxe DLC includes:

- 	Exclusive furniture for the Anispace
-	Lost variant Lampecko
-	50 standard Bilia
-	10 Lost Bilia
-	20 Velox Bilia
-	10 Memostones
-	25 Balance Buddies
-	25 Magicharms
-	25 pieces of Thick Fur
-	5 Mewaii Holo Cards
-	5 Vortail Holo Cards
-	5 Ozelash Holo Cards
-	5 Salabel Holo Cards
-	5 Queccha Holo Cards
-	1 Katamos Holo Cards
-	1 Arct-Rex Holo Card
70050000073803.name: LumenTale - Deluxe DLC

70050000073934.description: Upon discovering the shocking dimension known as the Otherworld, Mina became profoundly stressed by the shaman's fate and began to go off the rails. She started wearing black clothes adorned with coarse jewellery and grew increasingly gloomy. And now, rather than fleeing from the darkness out of fear, she has become a sorcerer who controls and utilises it.
70050000073934.name: The Coma 3: Bloodlines - Gangster Shaman Girl Skin

70050000073939.description: Sehwa Private High School was thrown into utter chaos by her appearance. In fact, the entire school in Songreung District suffered the consequences. Not only was she a teacher with an impressive CV, having studied abroad, but her looks were celebrity-grade, and her attire was excessive... to the point of being bewildering. The principal, who valued decorum and refinement above all, was so shocked he nearly collapsed, foaming at the mouth. 'Buttons must be fastened right up to the neck! Underwear showing is unacceptable!' But Jihyun found Korea's summer unbearably hot.
70050000073939.name: The Coma 3: Bloodlines - Overly Attractive Teacher Skin

70050000073946.description: The Sehwa Foundation proved far more formidable than anticipated, and its wealth was beyond imagination! Jihyun, already destined to inherit immense riches, resolved to abandon frugality and indulge herself to the fullest. No one would ever look down on or treat her with contempt.
70050000073946.name: The Coma 3: Bloodlines - Daughter of a Millionaire Skin

70050000073992.description:
Elevate your battlefield experience with a complete atmospheric overhaul that transforms the visual tone of every combat environment.

This DLC enhances immersion by updating the skybox across all maps, creating a more dynamic and visually striking war zone that reacts to the intensity of modern combat. From clear tactical skies to dramatic, tension-filled horizons, every location now feels more alive and atmospheric.

Step back onto the battlefield with a refreshed, more immersive sky that makes every mission feel even more epic.
