70050000074186.description:
STEP INTO THE BACKSTAGE

While exploring The Spiral, Low and Alone are torn apart. To find his friend, Low must venture into the darkest part of The Carnavale, behind the curtains, into The Backstage. Some secrets should stay buried... In The Backstage lies The Puppeteer hunting the living canvas for her next masterpiece. The show must go on in The mighty Carnavale.

HOLD ON TO THE LIGHT

To stay out of the shadow, Low will have to rely on Dime, a companion in despair. With her Torch Hat, Dime seems to be the only one who can guide him through The Backstage. She is the sole light he can trust, but will that be enough to snatch Alone from the clutches of The Puppeteer?

*This product is also included in the Secrets of The Spiral Season Pass. Please take care to avoid duplicate purchases.

*Kindly note that the Klonoa Costumes Set is not available in Little Nightmares III - The Backstage.
70050000074186.name: Little Nightmares III - The Backstage

70050000074187.description:
The Klonoa Costumes Set introduces two iconic figures from the KLONOA series into the eerie world of Little Nightmares III. Klonoa’s adventurous spirit and Ghadius’ menacing presence collide in a pair of distinctive outfits that capture both charm and unease.

Wear these costumes to stand out as you explore unsettling environments and face the horrors of the Spiral. A nostalgic nod for long-time fans, and a fresh, haunting look for new adventurers.

Costumes are suited for both characters: Klonoa for Alone and Ghadius for Low.
70050000074187.name: Little Nightmares III - Klonoa Costumes Set

70050000074188.description:
The Nomes Costumes Set lets you embody one of the most iconic figures from the world of Little Nightmares. Inspired by the small, secretive Nomes that hide in the darkest corners, this costume set gives your character a distinctive look, both unsettling and charming.

The costume is suited for both characters Low and Alone.
70050000074188.name: Little Nightmares III - Nomes Costumes Set

70050000074189.description:
ANCHOR AT THE SHORES

Low and Alone, reunited, traveled through the mirror. Without Dime, it's once again just the two of them. The filthy stones, the fishy smell, the damp wind, there is no doubt they have reached The Shores. The overwhelming fog is regularly pierced by the lighthouse beacon. From up there, they will find their way. Low’s map says so. It must be true.

RUN AWAY FROM THE LEECHES

Along their path, houses stand empty and streets are flooded. The hungry sea reigns as master here. These are perfect conditions for leeches to thrive, especially under the looming presence of The Leech Monster, who seems to care for them. Anyone who strays too close is unlikely to escape. They prey on anything within their reach.

TAKE ONE LAST BREATH

The lighthouse is not far, but reaching it will require taking risks. Low and Alone must dive into the sewers, where water still rushes through open pipes. Cracking valves, sharp propellers, and submerged rooms stand in their way, demanding every second of breath and every ounce of strength.

*This product is also included in Little Nightmares III - Secrets of The Spiral - Expansion Pass. Please take care to avoid duplicate purchases.
70050000074189.name: Little Nightmares III - The Shores

70050000074190.description:
This costume set is exclusive to the Secrets of The Spiral - Expansion Pass. It is available in a set of two, suited for both characters Low and Alone.

Embody a mysterious figure, familiar to all children in The Nowhere…
70050000074190.name: Little Nightmares III - Ferryman Costumes Set

70050000074191.description:
Prepare to enter a world where fear wears many faces.

Conceal your identity in The Nowhere and embrace your dark side by wearing the costumes of some of The Residents of the two previous games: The Janitor, The Twin-Chefs, The Lady, The Hunter. Each costume goes in a set of two, suited for both characters Low and Alone.

The Janitor Costume: Step into the shadows - perfect for those who prefer lurking in the quiet corners, ready to sweep away any trace of their presence.

The Twin Chefs Costume: Double the terror, double the chaos - the Twin Chefs costume brings a twisted culinary duo that’s as unsettling as it is unforgettable.

The Lady Costume: Elegance with a dark twist, the Lady costume channels a haunting grace, blending beauty and dread in a way only the truly unsettling can.

The Hunter Costume: Embrace the hunt - fierce, relentless, and ever-watchful, a true predator lurking in the dark.
70050000074191.name: Little Nightmares III - Residents Costumes Pack

70050000074192.description:
Discover the Dark Six Costumes Set suited for both characters Low and Alone - a twisted reflection of the girl who escaped The Maw.

Many questions remain about the identity of Dark Six. Is she an alternate reflection of Six, a haunted, corrupted reflection? Is she the same person, but darker, shaped by her fears and the horrors she’s witnessed? Or is she something completely different?

Her silhouette remains unchanged, but something is different… The yellow is gone.
What’s left is a cold echo - quiet, watching, waiting.

Wearing this costume is more than a disguise.
It’s a question: What happens when you stop running… and become what you feared?
70050000074192.name: Little Nightmares III - Dark Six Costumes Set

70050000074250.description:
This new prisoner has a bold personality and harbors many mysteries. Her motivations and personal goals will unfold with each escape attempt.

WEAPONS
Yamat can use 4 different weapons types for different playstyles:
- Dark Energy Fists: Close-range quick attacks of dark matter, unleashing flaming magical creatures.
- Two-Handed Dark Sword: Long-range powerful slashes that can hit multiple enemies at once.
- Dark Bow: Long-range attacks that shower enemies with arrows.
- Symmetrical Lance: A weapon from a far island that has been devastated by an infectious disease. Legend says it was used to bring down the king that ruled that place.

SPELLS, PERKS AND PASSIVES
- 21 unique spells: Summon powerful wild creatures, unleash spinning giant blades, and more!
- Forbidden Power: With this Signature Spell, Yamat transforms into her flying draconic form, allowing her to move freely while shooting magic missiles at nearby enemies.
- 37 associated perks: Modify her Signature Spell to suit your playstyle.
- 12 weapon passives: Each weapon comes with 3 unique passives, making Yamat an even deadlier fighter.

OTHER CONTENT
- New Papa Yalee stories: 4 new stories that delve deeper into the mysterious Yamat.
- 1000+ new lines of dialogue: Interact with Yamat and all the other characters in the Garden, including heroes, fully voiced in English and Japanese.
- Cinematics and ending screens: New cinematics and a new ending screen has been added for Yamat!

HOW TO ACCESS YAMAT
If you have not yet met Yamat in the Garden, she will appear after a couple of escape attempts.

ADDITIONS TO THE BASE GAME
Even without owning this add-on content, you will still be able to:

- See Yamat hanging out in the Garden.
- Collect and use 2 Yamat Echoes during runs.
- Fight Yamat's Shadow Clone.
70050000074250.name: Yamat - The Breach Traveler

70050000074257.description:
These four worlds form the most direct path to The Master, but alternative routes exist. These are known as The Outer Reaches.

ANDROMEDA
Even the mighty Zodiacs fear Andromeda. If she accepts a fight with you, she won't kill you, but she won't go easy on you either. If you beat her, she will become available as a summon and you might unlock her ending!

DLC FEATURES
- 4 new worlds, each with their own soundtrack.
- 16 new traps/elements.
- 32 additional enemy types.
- Andromeda boss fight, summon and ending.
- 2 new secret rooms.

HOW TO UNLOCK THE OUTER REACHES
Defeat the Master at least once and start a Destiny Level 1 run. You will have access to the Shattered Rises, and you will be able to battle Andromeda.
70050000074257.name: The Outer Reaches

70050000074309.description:
This DLC adds ""Ultraman Zero"" and ""Ultraman Belial"", two iconic Ultras who are each other's antithesis, as seen in their 2009 classic ""Mega Monster Battle Ultra Galaxy: The Movie"" debut forms. Each legendary character comes with their unique skills and devastating moves in a loving homage to their enduring legacy.

A warrior who has made missteps and overcome them, Ultraman Zero is a proficient fighter from the Land of Light, an Ultra! Using the Zero Sluggers to keep enemies at bay, Emerium Slashes to pummel them at range, and a storied experience with space martial arts, Ultraman Zero is a master of combat. This is a hero who understands that power without justice is dangerous!

Once destined for greatness, Ultraman Belial gave it all up for power and pride. Wielding the powerful Giga Battlenizer, Ultraman Belial stands at the spearpoint of revenge against the Land of Light and all its people. The alien genes infused within this fallen Ultra give it fearsome abilities and strength to match the fury within. Claws, fireballs, lightning, and darkness: Ultraman Belial is ferocity itself!

One craved power and paid for it, the other overcame that craving to grow more powerful. Which one will you manifest in the arena? The hot-headed hero, Ultraman Zero? Or the vengeful Ultraman Belial, all rage and roiling fury?
70050000074309.name: GigaBash - Ultraman Zero DLC

70050000074342.description:
In Brother's Wedding Story, the newest chapter of Urban Jungle, step into the shoes of Nurgun as he prepares for one of the most important moments of his life: proposing to his boyfriend Rachata, Pharita’s brother.

Surrounded by vibrant greenery and the warmth of the Thai sun, you’ll help Nurgun design and decorate their new home, making every detail perfect for the big day. But even the most beautiful homes can’t hide uncertainty — will Rachata say yes after all?

This romantic chapter blends heartfelt storytelling with Urban Jungle’s signature charm of design, creativity, and cozy expression.
70050000074342.name: Urban Jungle: Brother's Wedding Story

70050000074659.description:
A DLC game mode for DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Dark Prince.

Coach Joe's Dungeon Gym features randomly generated maps that change each time you enter. These magical dungeons also come with restrictions on the monsters you can include in your party, such as those exclusively from the slime family or material family. You are also not allowed to take items with you, and must scavenge the things you need from within the dungeons.

These dungeons are designed to provide an additional challenge and, as such, are harder than anything you'll encounter in the main game. Fittingly, a boss awaits in the final section of each dungeon—those who defeat it will be rewarded with a valuable item.

(Includes the 'Gothic Vestment' outfit.)

*Content and specifications may be altered without prior warning.
70050000074659.name: Coach Joe's Dungeon Gym

70050000074660.description:
A DLC game mode for DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Dark Prince.

Treasure Trunks features a mystical chest that contains a selection of items, but it can only be opened once every hour.

The chest contains 10 items in total, which are obtained one at a time in order. Once all the items have been obtained, the chest is replenished with an identical set of items that are acquired in the same order. You can use these items to strengthen your party in a number of ways.

The available items are:
Meaty Treat x5
Super Seed of Life x3
Sage's Elixir x5
Bonus Ball x3
Super Seed of Skill x3
Metal Slimecard x1
Seasoning x5
Beastie Bites x3
Super Seed of Magic x1
Bumper Bonus Ball x1

(Includes the 'Monstrous Mail' outfit.)

*Content and specifications may be altered without prior warning.
70050000074660.name: Treasure Trunks

70050000074667.description:
A DLC game mode for DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Dark Prince.

The Mole Hole is a special dungeon that allows you to scout monsters that you've already befriended once before. The dungeon is divided up so that only monsters of a specific rank will appear. For example, the Rank F Level features only Rank F monsters, and the Rank B Level contains only monsters from Rank B. Furthermore, the Large Level and Small Level have only large- and small-sized monsters respectively.

The Mole Hole provides ample opportunity to reunite easily with monsters that only appear during specific seasons or weather conditions, and even those that can only otherwise be obtained via synthesis. So use your show of force to full effect, or hope monsters join you of their own volition after battle, and grow your roster.

(Includes the 'Cake-Maker's Clobber' outfit.)

*Content and specifications may be altered without prior warning.
70050000074667.name: The Mole Hole

70050000074691.description:
Accelerate your prehistoric journey and secure your place at the top of the food chain. This DLC injects 500 coins into your active in-game balance, giving you immediate access to essential evolutionary upgrades.

In a brutal world where only the strongest giants and swiftest predators survive, having extra resources allows you to adapt instantly to unpredictable environmental dangers, unlock vital survival traits, and upgrade your creature’s primary abilities without delay.

Establish your territorial dominance across the volcanic zones and ancient forests with this crucial survival boost.
70050000074691.name: Dinosaur Survival Simulator - Prehistoric RPG: Hunter Balance

70050000074780.description:
For those light, feel-good sessions where you just want to pick a page and enjoy the moment, Happy Pack is the cozy go-to. Expect simple doodle-style drawings, bigger shapes, and thicker lines, made to feel friendly for little hands and calming for everyone.

You’ll color cheerful scenes filled with farm friends, friendly dinosaurs and adorable animals from around the world. Expect plenty of chibi-style cuties, happy foods and simple  mandalas, all made for quick, feel-good coloring without stress.

What’s included
- 11 collections (132 drawings total)
- 2 sticker packs (20 stickers total)
- 2 palettes (32 colors total)

And if you want the complete set, the full version—sold separately as the Cozy Bundle—includes: 450+ pages, 33 themed collections, 40 voxel 3D models, all sticker packs (110 stickers total), all palettes (192 colors total), plus 20 whiteboards for drawing freely.


Controls
Choose your favorite way to play:
- Motion pointer (Joy-Con™): move the pointer by tilting the controller like a magic wand.
- Touchscreen: tap and color directly for a smooth, hands-on experience.

Tools
Keep it simple or get creative: use cozy tools like brushes (with different looks), a satisfying fill bucket, an eraser, glitter and sticker stamps to decorate your pages.

Cozy Pages is your pocket of calm: cute, cozy and always ready when you need a little break.
70050000074780.name: Happy Pack: Easy Coloring - 100+ Pages for Kids & Family

Inside you’ll find a mix of mandalas, ornamental patterns and mosaic-inspired designs, plus relaxing pages with lettering you can color like tiny reminders to slow down.

You’ll step into little worlds filled with cute animal scenes and sweet everyday cozy moments, meet fantasy characters with a playful twist, and explore the gentle magic of Japanese and Korean folklore.

These twin brothers jump into battle as distinctive fighters, ready to throw down with bone-shattering punches, kicks, slams, and special attacks - including trademark moves such as the Hurricane Kick and Rising Knee! Arven is a character from Fallen Fates, the upcoming action RPG by Hibernian Workshop.

※ DLC CONTENT
- Brand new mechanic - Arven never travels without Kat. Traverse the astral prisons in good company with this wolf who will follow you throughout your escape attempts. Compatible with the Celestial Heaven DLC: your pet and Kat will follow you side by side.
- 25 new unique spells - Use the greatsword to create powerful slashes, move nimbly while setting up explosive traps, and more.
- Signature Spell - Throw a hook onto an enemy and dash towards them, while summoning Kat to assist you in battle and follow you around the battlefield.
- 30 Associated Perks - Adapt Arven's Signature Spell to your playstyle.
- 2 Weapon types for different playstyles:
    - Alpha Sword - Medium-range attacks, swinging and slashing enemies.
    - Ethereal Missiles - Use magic to shoot powerful blasts of energy from long range.
- 6 Weapon Passives - Each weapon comes with 3 unique passives, making Arven and Kat an even deadlier duo.
- Stellar Voice Acting - Arven is fully voiced in Japanese and English by the incredibly talented Tagui Omi and Ben Starr, respectively.
- New Papa Yalee Stories - 4 new stories to learn about Arven and Kat's mysterious origins.
- Cinematics and ending screens - Brand new cinematics and a new ending screen have been added for Arven.

※ HOW TO ACCESS ARVEN
If you own this DLC and have not yet met Arven in the Garden, he will appear after a couple of escape attempts.

※ ADDITIONS TO THE BASE GAME
Even if you do not own the DLC, you will still be able to:

- See Arven hanging out in the Garden.
- Collect and use 2 Arven Echoes during runs.
- Fight Arven's Shadow Clone.

70050000076367.description:
There are many rumors about why the ethereal Xuan Nü appeared. Some say she came by Heaven’s mandate to save the Great Fire; others say she drifted here because of a conflict between divine beliefs; or perhaps she carries an even greater, unspeakable secret. Whatever the truth may be, she seems to share some common goals with the Heir of Formlessness. If you can earn Xuan Nü’s trust and aid, you will surely gain an unmatched and powerful ally on your path to immortality!

Skill Introduction:
Voidbreaker
Deals self-element damage based on Attack to a single enemy character.
On Lucky Hit: Deals additional self-element damage based on the target’s lost HP.

Heaven-Earth Rectification
Deals self-element damage based on Attack to the single enemy character with the lowest HP.

Primordial Revelation
When dealing hit damage: Has a chance equal to a certain percentage of her Crit Rate to double the damage.

Mandate to Slay Evil
When landing a kill: Deals non-elemental damage to all enemy characters equal to a certain percentage of the overflow damage.
70050000076367.name: Daughter of Fate

70050000076368.description:
Seven Stars Pavilion is an ancient sect deeply versed in the stars and the movements of heaven and earth. In an ancient age beyond record, Seven Stars Pavilion was founded in the northern part of the continent—a place better suited for observing the heavens. The Seven-Star Diviners are the core members of Seven Stars Pavilion. Their study of the starry heavens has reached perfection, allowing them to command the great power of the stars for their own use.

Skill Introduction:
Star Essence
Deals self-element damage based on Attack to a single enemy character.
On Lucky Hit: additionally restores a certain amount of Mana.

Seven-Star Soul Suppression
Summons 7 Star Pieces. Each Star Piece deals self-element damage based on Attack to a random single enemy character.

Starry Array
When triggering Lucky Hit:
Applies 10 stacks of 【Starry Array】 to the target, lasting until the end of the wave.

Astral Divination
After casting Ultimate:
Applies 10 stacks of 【Astral Divination】 to self, lasting until the end of the wave.
70050000076368.name: Seven-Star Strategist

70050000077080.description:
Strengthen your arsenal with the DKS-501, a precision weapon built for long-range engagements and tactical missions. This DLC adds the rifle directly to your inventory, giving you another reliable option for taking on challenging assignments.

In addition to the weapon itself, you’ll also receive six locked weapon skins, allowing you to unlock and customize the rifle’s appearance as you progress.

Gear up, complete your missions, and master every shot with a weapon designed for elite marksmen.
70050000077080.name: SNIPER WARRIOR ELITE: Ready to Fire

70050000077154.description:
Growing your fleet is an important step toward building a successful transportation network.

Features:
- Adds the Martopolo double-decker bus to your vehicle collection.
- If the Martopolo bus has already been purchased, 290,000 in-game currency is awarded instead.

Expand your fleet, optimize your routes, and keep your passengers moving with confidence.
70050000077154.name: City Bus Simulator: New Wheels

70050000077177.description:
Every successful supermarket begins with smart investments. This DLC instantly adds 2,000 to your in-game balance, giving you additional funds to stock your shelves, expand your inventory, upgrade equipment, and improve your store from the very beginning. Make strategic decisions, invest where it matters most, and accelerate your journey toward becoming a successful supermarket owner.

Grow your supermarket with confidence, make every investment count, and turn your local shop into a thriving retail destination.
70050000077177.name: Supermarket Simulator 2026: Success Fund

70050000077309.description:
A new playable character, “Emer”, joins Cat Girl Survivor.

Emer, a guardian cat who has protected the forest for ages, joins your adventure as a new ally.

Blessed by the forest, Emer can transform into a mighty guardian,
using powerful slashing attacks and deadly bites to overwhelm nearby enemies with incredible strength.

In her spare time, she carefully trims her claws to keep her favorite stockings from getting torn.

But the moment she encounters demons,
those carefully maintained claws become merciless weapons.

Experience thrilling battles with Emer, the Guardian of the Forest who transforms into a powerful cat (?) and unleashes overwhelming power!

*This content requires the base game “Cat Girl Survivor” to play.*
70050000077309.name: Cat Girl Survivor – Additional Character "Emer"

70050000077320.description:
Ready to level up your park-perfect planning? Hex Park: Master DLC adds 75 brand-new, handcrafted challenges that push your arrow-guiding skills to the limit. Every puzzle is built on Hex Park’s clean, intuitive logic—rotate and align arrow tiles, chain satisfying moves, and clear the board in as few steps as possible.
No timers, no pressure—just pure, strategic puzzle-solving with that “one more level” pull. Expect clever remixes of familiar mechanics (keys/locks, mystery tiles, bombs, ice counters, gears, and more) plus trickier layouts that reward planning, patience, and smart tool usage. When a board won’t budge, fair helpers like the hammer, dynamite, and drill keep your flow going—without breaking the puzzle.
70050000077320.name: Hex Park - Master DLC

70050000077407.description:
Give your firefighter a refreshed and upgraded appearance while continuing to face life-threatening emergencies.

This DLC changes the character’s default appearance by replacing the standard outfit with a new, improved firefighter suit designed for a more modern and professional look. The updated uniform enhances the visual identity of your hero while maintaining full immersion in intense rescue missions across the city.

Step into burning buildings, respond to critical emergencies, and continue saving lives—now with a brand-new firefighting suit that reflects the courage and dedication of your role.
70050000077407.name: Firefighting Rescue Simulator: Duty Outfit

70050000077467.description: Tilt It! Golf – Sandy Roll DLC adds a desert biome with shifting sands that change ball speed. Remaster tilting the map while avoiding ominous sand vortices that can help or hinder your shots.
70050000077467.name: Tilt it! Golf - Sandy Roll DLC

70050000077499.description: Dark Song. The most threatening puppet monster the protagonists know.
70050000077499.name: The Coma 3: Bloodlines - Dark Song Skin

70050000077599.description: There’s no such thing as too much cute tableware! From sleepy kittens to mellow meadows - add more variety to your game with 14 brand new cozy tray patterns and relax assembling them piece by piece.
70050000077599.name: Tray

70050000077742.description:
Shattered Shape is an expansion to FOUNTAINS. You will continue your journey across the mysterious and dangerous One Kingdom and uncover the truth of the Usurper’s prophecy through a brand new twisted adventure.

Delve into the depths of an uncharted land:
The southern Vainlands have long been forsaken and left to rot by the One Kingdom. Though too treacherous for most, the hooded stranger is called to this mystifying region. Explore new dungeons, discover secrets, and face new challenges that await in these accursed lands.

Face mystical and fearsome foes:
Harsh and dangerous new enemies are found in the southern Vainlands. From monsters to misshapen beings, the uncanny roam the open areas in their twisted forms while beasts prowl for their next victim. Many who venture there do not survive, and those who do are never quite the same.

Wield a new, powerful arsenal:
You will find many new powers to help you in your adventure through the south. Use new magical swords to hack your foes, utilise mystical tools to confuse your enemies, and collect unique armour sets to fight with style.

Uncover the truth of the Usurper’s Prophecy:
Throughout your journey across the One Kingdom, a voice calls out and brings you to the harsh lands of the south. While pursuing this call, new faces and personalities will guide you through the Vainlands with mysterious quests and novel insights into the Usurper’s prophecy. Expect the unexpected as you go deeper into the story of these lands.
70050000077742.name: FOUNTAINS - Shattered Shape

70050000077800.description:
Gasha, a monster born from countless grudges, and Ponkichi (Ninja), wearing a hood to seem like a ninja, have arrived!

・Gasha
・Ponkichi (Ninja)

70050000077815.description:

With new tasks and new customers, your convenience store will be busier than ever!
A female clerk also joins the team, so enjoy playing as the clerk of your choice!
Take on the challenge of the night shift and aim to become a 3-star convenience store!

The "Late Night Solo Shift Pack" includes the following content:
・Adds a new area
・Adds new tasks
・Adds new customer types
・Adds a female clerk

*To access all content in this DLC,
 you must clear all stages up to Area 5.

70050000078159.description: Turn your home into a summer paradise! Cool down in a pastel pool, build a sandcastle, read under a rainbow umbrella, and taste seasonal treats! Expand your design options with 20 brand new items of the Summer Collection DLC, including furniture, outdoor decor, animals, and more!
70050000078159.name: Summer Collection

70050000078270.description:
Enhance your adventure with a distinctive cosmetic upgrade.

Bring a fresh visual style to your journey through the abandoned ruins of Pripyat with a redesigned pair of gloves. This cosmetic DLC replaces the standard glove appearance with a brand-new design, adding a distinctive look to every exploration, firefight, and investigation.

Step into the exclusion zone with renewed style as you uncover Chernobyl’s darkest secrets and fight to survive every encounter.
70050000078270.name: Chernobyl: Escape from Pripyat – Hands Style

Contents

-3D models, ready to print, for you to print your very own figurines of Foxy and Ben
-2D print templates for a poster of the in-game village map and a set of stickers
-Extra outfit colors for Foxy and Ben
-Two extra colors for your in-game cursor-hand: "Foxy Orange" and "Ben Green"
-A sticker on the in-game map expressing our gratitude
70050000078301.name: Woodo - Supporter Pack

70050000078303.description: The Original Soundtrack contains 39 songs from the colorful world of Woodo.
70050000078303.name: Woodo - Soundtrack Pack

70050000078647.description: Take it back to the early 2000s and railgrind in style with your own pair of iconic shoes from Sonic Adventure 2!

70050000078652.description:
Customize your officer experience with a new character appearance that adds a fresh visual style to your journey on the streets. This DLC changes the look of your character, giving your rookie cop a redesigned appearance while you continue to handle missions, protect citizens, and maintain order.

This DLC includes a collection of special stones known as "Runes," which grant abilities when equipped, helping you gain an advantage in battles in Exstetra.

70050000078871.description:
Includes all six episodes of the TV drama broadcast on Nippon TV, one of Japan's leading nationwide television networks!
Experience the world of AKIBA LOST through a unique live-action experience that offers a different perspective from the game.

Story
Thirteen years ago, six girls mysteriously disappeared in Akihabara — a series of unsolved cases known as "The Akiba Vanishing".

At the annual Tokyo Game Expo, Daiki Shinjo (played by Hiromitsu Kitayama), once hailed as a "genius creator," boldly announces the development of a new game inspired by this very incident: AKIBA LOST.
But soon thereafter, the strange disappearances begin again.

The cast of the game includes his sister Aoi Shinjo, who works at a maid cafe, underground idol Kokone Nagato, food writer Moe Kurosu, shrine maiden Chihiro Jimbo, cosplayer Wakana Yusa, and game streamer Yukimi Kurahashi — each a colorful icon of Akihabara’s vibrant subculture.

The story they were supposed to perform soon begins to bleed into reality.
It all starts with a threatening phone call — and the sudden disappearance of Aoi.

"Stop developing the game now. Or else...the tragedy will repeat again."

Can Shinjo finish developing the game? Can he protect everyone? Who is behind it all? And what really happened 13 years ago?
70050000078871.name: AKIBA LOST - Drama Movie

70050000079324.description:
Give your construction company a stronger financial foundation with an additional 5,000 in-game currency.

This DLC instantly adds 5,000 in-game currency to your account, allowing you to purchase equipment sooner, expand your fleet, and take on larger construction contracts with greater confidence.

Invest in better machinery, grow your business faster, and build your path toward becoming the ultimate construction tycoon.
70050000079324.name: Construction Sim: City and Road Builder - Business Boost

70050000079347.description:
Experience the prehistoric wilderness with a fresh visual update that brings even more variety to your adventures. Every journey across ancient landscapes feels more dynamic as familiar creatures appear with redesigned looks.

This DLC changes the appearance of three dinosaurs, giving them brand-new skins that add more visual diversity to the world around you while you explore, hunt, survive, and complete challenging missions.

Discover a refreshed prehistoric world and continue your survival adventure alongside dinosaurs with striking new appearances.
70050000079347.name: Dinosaur Survival Simulator - Prehistoric RPG: Jurassic Style

70050000079651.description:
Welcome to “Miracle Circus,” a wondrous dream stage where fruits and magic sparkle!
Your smiles and applause are precious energy that makes the circus shine.
Use the power you collect to unleash a variety of performances, merge fruits, and aim for an even higher score!
【Highlights of This Mode】
■ A spectacularly reimagined circus experience
Brand-new visuals and an exciting exclusive BGM transform the familiar stage into a special circus.
■ Boost your score with a variety of gimmicks!
From the “Spotlight” and “Fire Ring” to random magic bursting from the “Magic Hat,” a variety of performances bring the game to life.
Make clever use of each gimmick and aim for a high score!
■ Special merge effects
Merge fruits to create a watermelon in a brand-new form!
And when you complete the dream “Double Watermelon,” something unexpected might happen…?
Be sure to witness the surprising effects that can only be experienced in Miracle Circus!
Harness the power of magical energy and make Miracle Circus shine more spectacularly than ever!
70050000079651.name: Miracle Circus

70050000079664.description:
During our journey so many fans reached out to ask how they could further support our little Veewo team - and so the Supporter Pack was born! Your support has been so incredible, and we genuinely couldn't thank you enough!

This is a cosmetic-only pack, full to the brim with costumes for our Agents, including:
- A unique, flowing outfit for Saya
- A record player in the bar to listen to the OST
- An exclusive badge for Supporters to highlight your support in game
- A glittering ghost skin for if you die in multiplayer
- ALL holiday-exclusive items
- Our heartfelt and ETERNAL gratitude (but the bosses still won’t go easy on you)

Your passion and support has been an incredible, inspiring motivation. Thank you for standing with us and may your luck be endless!
70050000079664.name: Neon Abyss 2 - Supporter Pack

70050000079665.description:
This DLC is BOSS! We know how much our Agents loved the bosses within the first Neon Abyss, so we’ve brought them right up to date with a huge refresh project for Neon Abyss 2!

All 35 bosses from the original Neon Abyss have returned, and they’re not too happy to see you. After numerous passes of skill optimizations, visual effects upgrades and complete reworks for some manager bosses, we’ve made sure they’re fully evolved to match the upgraded Abyss.
70050000079665.name: Neon Abyss 2 - Archenemy Returns

70050000080016.description:
Make a splash in Lou's Lagoon with the bubbly Deluxe Pack! This pack includes:

- Bubblefan Engine: Add some whimsical flair to your flights with an engine that trails a beautiful stream of bubbles across the sky!

- Lifeguard Skin: Keep the islanders safe in style while sporting this vibrant lifeguard outfit (complete with its own bubble accessory).

- Beachside Decor Pack: Dive into decorating with 8 exclusive, bubble-themed furniture pieces—the perfect additions to your ultimate beachside hangout.
70050000080016.name: Lou's Lagoon Deluxe Pack

70050000080150.description:
Over 40 story-rich scenarios, packed with unique content, 4 different endings, and 6 mysterious bonus episodes.
Play through the game again and again to unlock everything and uncover the true ending. Are you ready to return home?
Play through 9 new scenarios beyond the classic workweek and descend into deeper darkness with each passing night
Face unique challenges and don't let the new weather conditions at the station get the better of you
 Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of horror and tremble with fear as your boss appears when you least expect it
Discover the true nature of the station and learn the secrets of its owner
70050000080150.name: Before Exit: Gas Station - Midnight DLC

70050000080151.description:
In the Daylight DLC, it's finally time for all the station's secrets to come to light in the rays of the sun. Take on the role of the employee's wife and conduct your own investigation every day in search of your missing husband, documenting all unusual events in photographs.

Photograph anomalies every day to advance your investigation in the new game mode
Survive 7 days of investigation, but miss even one detail and you'll lose the trail and have to start over
 Face supernatural events and try to make sense of what defies logic
See the story from the other side and discover what really happened to your husband
70050000080151.name: Before Exit: Gas Station - Daylight DLC

70050000080464.description: Unlock the Nordex Pack and add Nordex to your garage — one of the quickest Class D cars, built for fast starts, smooth handling, and confident high-speed racing. With its agile feel and strong performance, Nordex is a perfect choice for players who want to push every race to the limit.

70050000080518.description:
Take command of a massive orchestra as the walls tremble and humanity’s fate hangs in the balance!

Step into the world of the Japanese anime masterpiece Attack on Titan and conduct one of its most iconic musical pieces. Feel the tension build from haunting melodies to explosive orchestral moments as you unleash the full power of the orchestra.

70050000080527.description:
Hoist the canvas and take the helm, for a booty-laden Content Update is rumored to be buried somewhere in Maestro!

Hear hear, the cannon-blastin’ Pirates of the Caribbean themes from the quill of Hans Zimmer himself, sea shanties sung by the drunkest of mates and authentic symphonies of the most classical orrrderrrrr…

 • Zimmer & Badelt – “He’s a Pirate” (from Pirates of the Caribbean)
 • Zimmer – “Jack Sparrow” (from Pirates of the Caribbean)

Seize command of La Cultivée, summon your mighty Buccaneers crew, grab yer Kraken’s foot and set sail to find the hidden pirate culture. And remember Capt’n: an X sharp always marks the spot!

70050000080601.description:
With this DLC, you'll unlock:
- Permanent x2 Game Speed!
- A new playable hero: Claire

Turn up the pace and fight through waves of monsters twice as fast! Switch x2 Game Speed On or Off at any time, giving you full control over the pace of every battle.

Upgrade Claire, equip powerful gear, and use her abilities to bring new strength to your defense!

Packed with 18 trendy gamer-themed cosmetic items, the Hotshot DLC lets you customise both Dan and his office, creating the ultimate gaming setup while you tackle the strange and satisfying jobs of Clumsy County.

Refresh your workspace with new walls, flooring and lighting, decorate your office with colourful furniture and accessories, customise Dan’s appearance and equip stylish new rifle charms before showing off your Deluxe Super Guy! Gachapon collectable.

Whether you’re chasing S Ranks, hunting for every secret or simply building the coolest office in Clumsy County, the Hotshot DLC lets you solve problems in style.

【What is Makaism: Frenzy of the Netherworld?】
A brand-new 3D action RPG where you can unleash flashy, overpowered attacks with simple controls! Build up your characters with absurdly inflated stats, deal billions of points of damage, and revel in the sheer satisfaction of crushing your enemies with overwhelming force.

【STORY】
Welcome to the vast world of the Netherrealm: a chaotic land ruled by countless demons.
In one such realm, the “Transcendent Netherworld,” a battle-hardened mercenary named N.A. is summoned by the demon lord Ticiel and given a shocking mission:
“Someone ate my pudding from the fridge!”
“Wait... your what, now?”
The Primordial Pudding of Dawn, a legendary dessert created by Ticiel’s late father, the previous Transcendent Overlord, was stolen by a treacherous subordinate—and now N.A. must get it back!
Thus begins the battle to reclaim the Primordial Pudding, waged by a lonely mercenary and an inexperienced demon lord!

【Seven Weapons, Endless Playstyles!】
N.A. can equip seven types of weapons: Fist, Sword, Spear, Axe, Bow, Gun, and Staff, each with unique ranges and attack styles. For example: the Sword offers balanced, easy-to-use techniques, the Bow allows long-range and multi-target attacks at the cost of power, and the Staff unlocks the use of magic. By mastering and switching between multiple weapons, you can dramatically expand your combat possibilities!

【Crush Your Foes with... Extreme Character Growth?!】
Even action game newbies will be kicking butt in no time!
Characters can level up to Lv. 9999, and using Reincarnation, you can reset to Lv. 1 while keeping bonus stats to grow even stronger. Enhance your power further through systems like Evilities, which grant passive boosts, and Character World, where you can strengthen your stats from within.
And that’s not all—the game includes Item World, Innocents, and many other customization systems that fans of Nippon Ichi Software will instantly recognize!

【What is Makaism: Frenzy of the Netherworld?】
A brand-new 3D action RPG where you can unleash flashy, overpowered attacks with simple controls! Build up your characters with absurdly inflated stats, deal billions of points of damage, and revel in the sheer satisfaction of crushing your enemies with overwhelming force.

【STORY】
Welcome to the vast world of the Netherrealm: a chaotic land ruled by countless demons.
In one such realm, the “Transcendent Netherworld,” a battle-hardened mercenary named N.A. is summoned by the demon lord Ticiel and given a shocking mission:
“Someone ate my pudding from the fridge!”
“Wait... your what, now?”
The Primordial Pudding of Dawn, a legendary dessert created by Ticiel’s late father, the previous Transcendent Overlord, was stolen by a treacherous subordinate—and now N.A. must get it back!
Thus begins the battle to reclaim the Primordial Pudding, waged by a lonely mercenary and an inexperienced demon lord!

【Seven Weapons, Endless Playstyles!】
N.A. can equip seven types of weapons: Fist, Sword, Spear, Axe, Bow, Gun, and Staff, each with unique ranges and attack styles. For example: the Sword offers balanced, easy-to-use techniques, the Bow allows long-range and multi-target attacks at the cost of power, and the Staff unlocks the use of magic. By mastering and switching between multiple weapons, you can dramatically expand your combat possibilities!

【Crush Your Foes with... Extreme Character Growth?!】
Even action game newbies will be kicking butt in no time!
Characters can level up to Lv. 9999, and using Reincarnation, you can reset to Lv. 1 while keeping bonus stats to grow even stronger. Enhance your power further through systems like Evilities, which grant passive boosts, and Character World, where you can strengthen your stats from within.
And that’s not all—the game includes Item World, Innocents, and many other customization systems that fans of Nippon Ichi Software will instantly recognize!

70070000033575.description:
Worlds are colliding in Sonic the Hedgehog’s newest high-speed adventure! In search of the missing Chaos emeralds, Sonic becomes stranded on an ancient island teeming with unusual creatures. Battle hordes of powerful enemies as you explore a breathtaking world of action, adventure, and mystery. Accelerate to new heights and experience the thrill of high-velocity, open-zone platforming freedom as you race across the five massive Starfall Islands. Jump into adventure, wield the power of the Ancients, and fight to stop these new mysterious foes. Welcome to the evolution of Sonic games!

The Digital Deluxe Edition comes with the Explorer's Treasure Box, which contains useful items for your adventure: Amy's Memory Tokens, a Portal Gear, Chaos Emerald Vault Keys, Additional Gloves & Shoes for Sonic, and a Digital Art Book with a 25-track Digital Mini Soundtrack.

Experience All-New Open Zone Platforming
Race across five massive overworld islands brimming with dense forests, overflowing waterfalls, and sizzling desert landscapes, each with their own unique action-platforming challenges and hidden secrets to uncover.

Unparalleled High-Speed Freedom
Adventure across the Starfall Islands and see what each has to offer at the speed that only Sonic can deliver. Blaze a trail as you see fit and discover side quests, solve puzzles, scale enormous structures, go fishing, and encounter a friendly face or two along the way…

Challenge Yourself In Cyber Space
Discover portals scattered across the island and venture into Cyber Space levels through portals scattered across the islands featuring signature 3D platforming at Sonic speeds, packed with challenges to put your skills to the test.

Cyber-Powered Combat
The Starfall Islands are home to strange creatures Sonic has never encountered before. Use the all-new battle system and skill tree upgrades to fight strategically, combining moves such as dodges, parries, counters, combos, and the new Cyloop ability to take down mysterious foes and colossal titans.

A New Adventure Full of Mystery and Intrigue
Become Sonic and journey to uncover the mysteries of the remains of an ancient civilization plagued by robotic hordes. With nothing but a handful of questions and a disembodied voice to guide you, set out to save your friends and the enigmatic inhabitants of the Starfall Islands from a colossal, mechanized threat.

The next episode of Tsubasa’s riveting adventure is here! Enjoy the thrill of spectacular soccer actions with 110 playable characters and new sensational super moves. Challenge a friend in the field or support Tsubasa on his Journey, the ball is yours.

• New and Improved Gameplay
Action on the field has been enhanced with powerful new super moves that intensify every action, from passing to blocking. The updated system adds more strategy, especially in goalkeeper versus shooter duels featuring spectacular super shots and blocks from the original series characters.

• A Soccer World That is Bigger Than Before!
Featuring 22 national teams, over 110 playable characters, and more than 150 cutscenes highlighting moves on the pitch! Previously unseen teams from the manga and original teams and characters clash in glorious, meticulous animation. The excitement of these once-in-a-lifetime moments has never been higher!

Pick up where the first game left off and follow Tsubasa as he takes on formidable new rivals in the thrilling story based on the World Youth arc.
Discover expanded storylines overseen by the original creator, Yoichi Takahashi, and witness powerhouse nations clash as they chase international glory.
Step onto the pitch in the NEW STARS ROUTE, create your own custom player, join the Japanese national team, and fight alongside Tsubasa on the road to world victory.

• Powerful and Inspiring Music
Tadayoshi Makino (SpinSolfa), praised for his moving BGM tracks from the previous title, brings over 100 energized tracks to this iteration. Dare to compete with this exhilarating compilation of melodies perfectly suited to the high-octane action of Captain Tsubasa, the king of sports of anime, as Tsubasa and his teammates give their all on the pitch for the ultimate victory.

70070000036204.description:
Frostpunk is a society survival game where heat means life and every decision comes at a price. In an entirely frozen world, people develop steam-powered technology to oppose the overwhelming cold. You face the task of building the last city on Earth and securing the means necessary for your community to survive.

THE LAST AUTUMN
The Last Autumn is a turning point in the Frostpunk universe. Revealing the restless events of Site 113 and its struggle to construct the generator before the freezing veil shrouds the Earth, this prequel expansion broadens the Frostpunk universe by introducing a new environment, new Books of Laws and unique technologies, and presents a range of new buildings — all of which let you shape society and the city in unconventional ways. Leading a group of engineers working on one of the world’s greatest technological marvels - a Generator - will require adapting your strategy to extraordinary situations. As the leader of Site 113, hope for the best, but be prepared for the worst. For Queen and Country!
•	experience a prequel story taking place before the freezing cataclysm
•	master a totally new Book of Laws allowing you to shape your society in previously unknown ways
•	construct new buildings
•	discover uncommon, steam-powered technologies
•	apply more advanced strategies to survive
•	delve into a beautiful new environment not yet covered by snow

ON THE EDGE
On The Edge expansion tells a story of citizens of New London sent for a special assignment after the Great Storm. It not only opens a brand new chapter set in the Frostpunk universe but also pits you against new challenges and offers unique mechanics, both in the city and on the Frostland map - further enriching the core experience. A brand new, frozen board is set and the pieces are moving. What destiny lies ahead for your people? What will this mean for you, as their leader? Shape the future of humanity in Frostpunk's final chapter - On The Edge.
•	brand new story scenario, set after the Great Storm
•	an array of challenges to overcome on a new, desolate map
•	unique mechanics to utilize on the Frostland view

THE RIFTS
Experience a new level of challenge on a brand new Endless Mode map, where the land itself threatens your survival. Using a new gameplay mechanic, bridge the rifts to access new areas. Expand the city to save your people from the inevitable doom!
•	unique new Endless Mode map
•	new constructible building
•	new gameplay mechanics

Persona 5 Royal
The definite version of the 5th game in the Persona series, offering a wealth of additional content.
In this title, you'll step into the role of a teenager forced to transfer to a high school in Tokyo.
By day, you're a regular student. After class, you're a phantom thief, working in the shadows to steal the distorted desires of corrupt adults.
As you and your comrades set out to reform society, danger closes in.

The first action RPG in the Persona series.

Now, you must don your mask once more and face a crisis unfolding across Japan!

A tactical RPG set in Persona 5's iconic universe and incorporates its signature mechanics, including the One More feature and All-Out Attacks.
As the Phantom Thieves of Hearts prepare for graduation, their chill hangout session at Café Leblanc is disrupted when the café begins to shake and an eerie light envelops the door.
Lost in a bizarre realm, they are saved by a mysterious revolutionary named Erina and must join forces in a massive uprising.

Minecraft Dungeons II is here with more action, more loot, and more adventure. Step through the rift and fight where no hero has been before: the Sift, an uncharted dimension teeming with threats, mysteries, and breathtaking beauty. Gear up and customize your playstyle to face your toughest enemies yet in explosive battles. Brave the unknown as a lone hero, team up with friends and take on the crisis together. The illagers’ plot is already underway, and their cruelty is only matched by their power. Stop them – or lose the Overworld to their corruption.

Get the Deluxe Edition for even more battles ahead! Includes 4 hero skins, the Soul cape, the Blub pet, and DLC 1 & 2.*

DLC 1: Expected release - Winter 2026
DLC 2: Expected release - Spring 2027

There is a separate title for Nintendo Switch™ 2

There will be no upgrade pass (Nintendo Switch 2 Edition) for Switch version to be upgraded into Nintendo Switch 2 version

Save data is stored in the game's backend and is compatible across both Nintendo Switch™ and Nintendo Switch 2, provided the player is using the same Nintendo Account. If the console does not have access to an internet connection, save data created on Nintendo Switch cannot be transferred to Nintendo Switch 2 while running the game.
70070000036410.intro: A new threat descends upon the Overworld...
70070000036410.name: Minecraft Dungeons II Deluxe Edition

70070000036825.description:
With this bundle you get our visual novel "Tavern Talk Stories: Dreamwalker" and the two decoration packs  "Drowsy Druid" and "Wondrous Wizard".

Dive into the role of the Tavernkeep, the owner of The Drowsy Dragon, a small quayside bar in a little, bleary portside town on the coast of Borkam. Meet adventurers, gather rumours and mix fate-altering drinks to stop dreams from twisting into nightmares.

With all decoration packs you can decorate your inn, the Drowsy Dragon, to your heart’s content: Whether you desire a few more potted plants or you’re desperately craving an orb to ponder—it’s yours to decide.
70070000036825.intro: This bundle comes with our visual novel and every decoration pack we have to offer, so you can decorate your inn, the Drowsy Dragon, to your heart’s content.
70070000036825.name: Tavern Talk Stories: Dreamwalker - Decorator's Dream Edition

[Game Details]
Celebrating the 20th anniversary of the Kiseki series, a story-driven RPG that began in 2004, the landmark first installment, The Legend of Heroes: Sora no Kiseki FC (First Chapter), is receiving a full remake!

The Liberl Kingdom, the setting of the adventure, is brought to life in stunning 3D, with refined designs for all characters, including the vibrant Estelle and Joshua.

Enjoy seamless transitions between two battle modes: field action and command battles. The remake also features dynamic presentations of each character's special abilities (Crafts) and elemental magic (Arts), delivering exhilarating and stress-free combat.
While retaining the picturesque charm of the Liberl Kingdom, the game offers various quests and extensive side content, allowing players to immerse themselves in the journey through the kingdom from a fresh perspective.

Estelle and Joshua embark on a journey across the Liberl Kingdom, spurred by the mysterious disappearance of their father, Cassius.

Meet new allies, experience heartfelt farewells, and uncover the fate that awaits the two at the end of their journey...

70070000036924.description:
This bundle includes Heave Ho and Heave Ho 2.

Heave Ho
Heave Ho is a riotous multiplayer party game for up to four players in couch co-op and versus play. Reach out, get a grip, and swing to victory — or meet your messy end!

Heave Ho 2
The bedlam is back, and now it's online too. Grab and swing through all-new weird and wonderful worlds with up to four players in online and local co-op and versus play.

Take your partners by the hand (or head) and swing your ungainly chain from platform to pillar and beyond. Let go at the wrong moment and meet your splattery end, but a solid grip and pro swinging will take you over the finish line in sweet harmony!
70070000036924.name: Heave Ho + Heave Ho 2 Bundle

70070000037023.description:
Winner of more than 200 Game of the Year Awards, The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim celebrates 10 years of adventuring in stunning detail.  The Anniversary Edition includes a decade worth of content: the critically acclaimed core game and add-ons of Skyrim Special Edition, plus pre-existing and new content from Creation Club including quests, dungeons, bosses, weapons, spells, and more.

EPIC FANTASY REBORN
Skyrim reimagines and revolutionizes the open-world fantasy epic, bringing to life a complete virtual world open for you to explore any way you choose.

LIVE ANOTHER LIFE, IN ANOTHER WORLD
Play any type of character you can imagine, and do whatever you want; the legendary freedom of choice, storytelling, and adventure of The Elder Scrolls is realized like never before.

YOU ARE WHAT YOU PLAY
Choose from hundreds of weapons, spells, and abilities. The new character system allows you to play any way you want and define yourself through your actions.

BATTLE DRAGONS
Battle ancient dragons like you’ve never seen. As Dragonborn, learn their secrets and harness their power for yourself.

INCLUDED CONTENT
The Anniversary Edition includes the core game, pre-existing and new Creation Club content, plus all three official add-ons: Dawnguard, Hearthfire, and Dragonborn.
70070000037023.name: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Anniversary Edition

70070000037092.description:
Play the award-winning action roguelite Dead Cells and its 4 original DLCs, plus unlock Castlevania content with the Return to Castlevania DLC!

Dead Cells is a roguelite , metroidvania inspired, action-platformer. You'll explore a sprawling, ever-changing castle... assuming you’re able to fight your way past its keepers in 2D souls-lite combat. No checkpoints. Kill, die, learn, repeat. We release free content updates every few months to keep the game fresh too!
17 Levels - Each one with its own atmosphere, foes and secrets to discover.
5 Bosses - Made by the most sadistic of the devs, raised on the salt of the testers.
150 or so weapons and skills - Spears, swords, bows, magic spells, shields, pets, frying pans etc.You name it, we got it.
4 special powers, unlocking new areas and paths (metroidvania gear lock items).
Continuous development – We are still adding regular free content to the game every 2-3 months to keep the game fresh for you!

Original DLCs:
Unlock the four original Dead Cells DLCs, giving you late-game content plus an entire new pathway to follow, with an alternative ending and tons of new enemies, weapons & outfits.
8 new levels – six of which make up an entire new pathway through greenhouses, across floating islands and into shipwreck graveyards, culminating in a final battle on the top of a soaring lighthouse, including a unique chase/mini-boss level! The two other levels add more late-game variety, with one level only accessible at the highest difficulty.
5 new bosses, with one only accessible at the highest difficulty. That's right, these DLCs double the number of available bosses in the game!
21 new enemies, including living mushrooms, giant ticks, snake cultists, spooky necromancers and multi-legged spiky abominations.
34 new weapons/skills - double-handed scythes, lightning shields, a flying talking sword and a throwable shark?!
52 new outfits – loads of options to freshen up your look if you're tired of the 70 others...

Return to Castlevania:
Team up with Richter Belmont & Alucard to battle through the ancient corridors of Dracula’s Castle . Wield iconic Castlevania weapons against hordes of monsters to reach the throne room of the Dark Lord  himself...
14  iconic weapons such as the Vampire Killer, Throwing Axe  & Holy Water. Each item has been translated into the fast-paced combat of Dead Cells while keeping  their original essence.
2 levels - Dracula's Castle and the Castle’s Outskirts . Secret rooms. Flame-lit corridors. Gloomy tombs. Beautiful paintings. Food hidden in the walls. Full of original monsters from the series, such as harpies, werewolves & haunted armors , the character of the iconic Castle  will transport you into the realms of gothic fantasy.
51  original Castlevania tunes in a soundtrack that can be heard across the entire game. On top of this, we've taken the 12  most iconic tracks, such as Vampire Killer, Bloody Tears and Simon Belmont's Theme, and reimagined them in the style of Dead Cells as a soundtrack for the DLC.
New storyline - Richter Belmont and Alucard will be by your side throughout your quest to vanquish Dracula, helping you to navigate the maze of Dracula’s castle and providing you with strong weapons (sometimes willingly, sometimes not).
3 epic boss fights - Combat the very essence of evil in two intense duels versus Death  and Dracula, both set against a majestic backdrop. If you can survive these gauntlets, prepare yourself for our most ambitious boss showdown yet...
20  Castlevania outfits -  roleplay as all your favourite characters like Alucard, Richter Belmont , Simon Belmont, Maria Renard, Trevor Belmont, Sypha Belnades, or even Dracula himself!
70070000037092.intro: The award-winning Dead Cells, its 4 original DLCs, and Return to Castlevania DLC
70070000037092.name: Dead Cells: Medley of Pain Bundle

70070000037096.description:
Slay countless foes in fast-paced combat with action roguelite Dead Cells and storm Dracula's Castle  with classic weapons in the Return to Castlevania DLC!

Dead Cells:
Explore a sprawling, ever-changing island, challenging hordes of enemies in fast-paced, buttery smooth 2D combat.
17 Levels - Each one with its own atmosphere, foes and secrets to discover.
5 Bosses - Made by the most sadistic of the devs, raised on the salt of the testers.
150 or so weapons and skills - Spears, swords, bows, magic spells, shields, pets, frying pans etc.
1 panic roll to get you out of trouble!
4 special powers, unlocking new areas and paths (metroidvania gear lock items).
1 epic responsive, fluid and fun to play combat system.
1 Boss Rush Mode – Fight against 3 or 5 bosses back-to-back. Featuring enhanced (i.e. harder) bosses!
Regular free updates - we are still adding content to the game every 2-3 months to keep the game fresh for you!

Return to Castlevania:
Team up with Richter Belmont & Alucard to battle through the ancient corridors of Dracula’s Castle. Wield iconic Castlevania weapons against hordes of monsters to reach the throne room of the Dark Lord  himself...
14  iconic weapons such as the Vampire Killer, Throwing Axe  & Holy Water. Each item has been translated into the fast-paced combat of Dead Cells while keeping as much of their original spirit as possible.
2 levels - Dracula's Castle and the Castle’s  Outskirts. Secret rooms. Flame-lit corridors. Gloomy tombs. Beautiful paintings. Food hidden in the walls. Full of original monsters from the series, such as harpies, werewolves & haunted armors , the character of the iconic castle will transport you into the realms of gothic fantasy.
51  original Castlevania tunes in a soundtrack that can be heard across the entire game. On top of this, we've taken the 12  most iconic tracks, such as Vampire Killer, Bloody Tears and Simon Belmont's Theme, and reimagined them in the style of Dead Cells as a soundtrack for the DLC.
New storyline - Richter Belmont and Alucard will be by your side throughout your quest to vanquish Dracula, helping you to navigate the maze of Dracula’s Castle  and providing you with strong weapons (sometimes willingly, sometimes not). However, where there is good there is evil, so watch out for powerful foes who will try everything in their power to stop you from reaching the throne room.
3 epic boss fights - Combat the very essence of evil in two intense duels versus Death  and Dracula, both set against a majestic backdrop. If you can survive these gauntlets, prepare yourself for our most ambitious boss showdown yet...
20  Castlevania outfits -  roleplay as all your favourite characters like Alucard, Richter Belmont , Simon Belmont, Maria Renard, Trevor Belmont, Sypha Belnades, or even Dracula himself!
70070000037096.intro: Play the award-winning roguelite Dead Cells and its Return to Castlevania DLC!
70070000037096.name: Dead Cells: Return to Castlevania Bundle

70070000037155.description:
Journey into a fantastical world on a quest for revenge in DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Dark Prince. Join Psaro, a cursed prince, as he scouts, combines, and creates legions of monsters to take into battle on his path to becoming the Master of Monsterkind.

The Digital Deluxe Edition includes DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Dark Prince, all three DLC, outfits and some consumable items for your journey:

- Main Game "DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Dark Prince"
- The Mole Hole (Includes the 'Gothic Vestment' outfit)

- Beastie Bites x10
70070000037155.name: DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Dark Prince Digital Deluxe Edition

70070000037365.description:
This product contains the full game, Digital Sound & Art Gallery, as well as 3 bonus in-game items.

[Overview]
・Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse
・Digital Sound & Art Gallery
・Bonuses (In-game items) x3
└ Trevor Style Costume
└ Sypha Style Costume
└ Family's Grace（Relic）

Medieval Paris, Where the Tolling Bells Herald the End
1499. Paris is engulfed in flames as monstrous creatures suddenly emerge from the shadows.
Trevor Belmont, the hero who defeated Dracula, ventures into the burning streets with his daughter, Rose Belmont. Armed with the legendary holy whip, the Vampire Killer, they hunt down the beasts bleeding from the looming castle.

Rose is soon swept up in the dark conspiracy that lurks beneath. Will she succeed in saving Paris from devastation?

Satisfying Whip Action
Castlevania's iconic whip action is more satisfying than ever!
Crack your whip to move around freely like a trapeze artist!
Master the whip mechanics and be creative to pounce on your prey like a wolf in fast-paced combat!

Diverse Bosses and the Arcana System
Face-off against legendary bosses including Death, Medusa and Carmilla in addition to enigmatic new bosses such as Joan of Arc.
Once defeated, bosses are sealed into Rose's tarot cards, turning them into Arcana - use their skills to cast spells and obtain unique special actions

Customize Your Battle Style with Weapons and Relics
Customize Rose’s battle style by using a variety of equipment, including weapons spanning seven distinct categories and Relics that trigger powerful effects through both offense and defense.
Combine equipment you discover through exploration to create your own playstyle!

Iconic Castlevania Atmosphere, Reimagined in New Stages
From iconic Gothic aesthetics to vivid, refined visuals, the game presents a fresh take on the world of Castlevania.
Explore maps filled with both new features and familiar elements inspired by classic Castlevania titles.
70070000037365.intro: Crimson Curse —Will Your Fate Bloom in Despair or Salvation
70070000037365.name: Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse Midnight Edition

70070000037427.description:
ROUTE16 COLLECTION includes ROUTE16R in addition to two classic titles from the 1980s ROUTE16 series.

The ROUTE16 series is a thrilling car chase action experience where you control your beloved car, MAD X, collecting all items while evading relentless enemy cars and monsters.

ROUTE16R:
The legendary ROUTE16 returns as a brand-new title!
This time, MAD X-R isn’t just about escaping—fight back with customization and transformation to defeat incoming enemies in high-speed chase action.

- Customize and transform into a robot! Intense battle system
Use the money collected in stages to freely customize MAD X-R. Upgrade fuel, speed, and combat performance before heading into battle.
Collide with enemies to transform into a powerful robot form and use enhanced stats and SP items to defeat both minor enemies and powerful bosses.

- Series-first! Up to 4-player local multiplayer
Enjoy multiplayer for the first time in the series. Compete to capture flags in a high-speed chase action experience with friends and family.
*Local multiplayer only.

ROUTE16:
ROUTE16 is the original title in the series, first released as an arcade game in 1981.
Its defining feature is the seamless switching between two modes:
Maze Mode, which displays a zoomed-in view of the labyrinth, and Radar Mode, which shows the entire stage composed of 16 mazes.
As the foundation of the series, this title captures the core gameplay that made ROUTE16 so unique.

ROUTE16TURBO:
ROUTE16TURBO is the sequel to ROUTE16, released in 1985.
Take control of your beloved machine, MAD X, and recover the stolen money from the evil Kanharoo Gang.
Building on the original system, the game features enhanced visuals and a variety of unique maze layouts.
The turbo system allows you to accelerate using fuel, adding a new layer of strategy to the high-speed chase action.
This version also includes stages that were unreachable in the original 1985 release.
70070000037427.intro:
The classic car-chase maze series returns!
3 high-octane action games in one.
70070000037427.name: ROUTE16 COLLECTION

70070000037468.description:
Immerse yourself in the ultimate sub-zero challenge with the definitive winter survival experience. Every step through the deep drifts is a calculated risk, driven forward by the desperate search for a missing friend.

Bundle Includes:
• Frost Survival - Winter
Experience the complete story-driven progression across a beautiful but deadly snowy mountain and forest world. Track dangerous wildlife, gather vital resources, and discover scattered notes to unlock new survival recipes.

• Frost Survival – Winter: Energy Surge
Enjoy a permanent fifty percent reduction in energy drain for all running, jumping, sprinting, and attacking. This DLC allows you to navigate the deepest snow drifts and scale steep mountain peaks with twice the physical efficiency.

Do not just struggle to survive the winter—dominate it.
70070000037468.intro: Adapt to the freezing mountain climate and outlast the most dangerous predators.
70070000037468.name: Frost Survival – Winter: Deep Frost

70070000037481.description:
You opened your eyes to find a giant girl looking down at you...

SAEKO: Giantess Dating Sim is an adventure game set in 2000s Japan about the lives of Saeko, a girl with mysterious abilities, and the little people she has shrunk to the size of her thumb.
Experience Saeko's and the little people's fates in the day and at night, through two separate game systems with different art styles.

You are Rin, the latest addition to the little people. Under Saeko’s protection, you spend your days in her desk drawer together with the other little people.
But don't let your guard down. Saeko has some...interesting hobbies, to say the least.

・Stunning and unique visuals drawn in two different styles of pixel art
・A world filled with brutal allure inspired by many strange tales, beginning with Fueti Shizue’s work
・An original game system which forces players to make difficult choices and live with the consequences
・A soundtrack heavily influenced by future garage and breakcore, composed by the developer himself
・The deepest journey into a developer’s proclivities in indie game history

[The Digital Deluxe Edition includes the Original Soundtrack]
Original soundtrack by developer kyp.
A collection of tracks that bring back to life the everyday world inside that drawer.
70070000037481.intro: Get the Digital Deluxe Edition bundled with the Original Soundtrack!
70070000037481.name: SAEKO: Giantess Dating Sim Digital Deluxe Edition

70070000037630.description:
Dive into a gritty, adrenaline-fueled military experience where squad coordination and lightning-fast reflexes mean the difference between victory and defeat. Modern warfare requires absolute precision, tactical awareness, and the right gear.

Bundle Features:
1. Call of Warfare - FPS MODERN SHOOTER – Engage in intense, points-based military combat across dynamic maps with a massive arsenal of over 20 weapons.

2. Call of Warfare - FPS MODERN SHOOTER: Green Armour – A specialized HUD overlay that brings clearer, faster visual feedback to your protection status in the heat of battle.

3. Call of Warfare - FPS MODERN SHOOTER: Tactical Hands – Complete your soldier look with camouflage green hands and gloves built for modern warfare.

Outsmart your rivals, outlast the enemy, and step onto the battlefield looking like a true elite operative. Will you answer the call?
70070000037630.intro: Breathe the combat. Mask your movement. Take command.
70070000037630.name: Call of Warfare - FPS MODERN SHOOTER: Tactical Combat

70070000037683.description:
All aboard! Collector’s Cove is a cozy farming adventure on the high seas. Sail with your animal friend to uncharted waters, cultivate your floating farm, and discover new islands, crops and fish on your quest to become a Named Collector!

Get ready for the beach with the Collector's Cove Summer Pack!
This outfit collection will let you enjoy the tropical sun in style.
This pack features five breezy cosmetics for your animal companion and five sun-kissed additions for your character.
70070000037683.intro: Collector’s Cove is a cozy farming adventure on the high seas. Sail with your animal friend to uncharted waters, cultivate your floating farm, and discover new islands, crops and fish.
70070000037683.name: Collector's Cove Summer Pack Edition

70070000037709.description:
Dive into the dangerous world of extreme meteorology, where every split-second decision determines your survival. Confront unpredictable storm cells, devastating gale-force winds, and rapid atmospheric shifts designed to test both your reflexes and your tactical planning.

What’s Included:
1. Storm Chasing Sim 2025 - Tornado Hunter
Take control of powerful chase vehicles, deploy advanced tracking sensors, and intercept terrifying tornadoes across vast, dynamic landscapes.

2. Storm Chasing Sim 2025 - Tornado Hunter: Budget Boost
An instant injection of 2,000 coins credited directly to the in-game wallet, giving full creative freedom in the garage.

Maximize your vehicle’s performance, secure elite meteorological tech, and conquer the storm. Are you ready to outrun the chaos?
70070000037709.intro: Where the sky turns black, the hunt begins.
70070000037709.name: Storm Chasing Sim 2025 - Tornado Hunter: Frontline Survivor

70070000037727.description:
Base Game:
Dustland Delivery is a post-apocalyptic survival business simulator, featuring over 40 hours of gameplay content. Scour the wastes for profit, complete missions to grow your trading empire, and assemble a rag-tag band of adventurers to turn your city into the capital of the Dustlands. Danger lurks around every corner—but no risk, no reward!

Marshal Resources to Build Your Dustland Empire
 •  A vast game world with a rich narrative to explore
 • Establish trade routes across unique settlements to become a kingpin of the wastes
 • Control resource flows to build magnificent cities

Transform Your Truck for Apocalyptic Adventures
 • Create your own mobile base to cruise through the Dustlands
 • Install mods to turn your truck into a deadly weapon against infected swarms

A Cast of Unique Companions
 • Recruit a rag-tag group of adventurers with distinctive traits
 • Assign different roles to help build your city
 • Tool up and train animal companions to boost your team's stats
 • Undead? No excuse not to show up for work...

Random Events, Freedom to Choose
 • Countless random events: armored motorcades, undead raids, unknown signals from mysterious locations...
 • Your Dustland, your way: become a warrior for justice, a money-grubbing merchant, or an infamous bandit

Struggle for Power, Rebuild the Wastes
 • 6 major factions with a web of complex relations
 • Exploit power struggles and trading rivalries to come out on top
 • Form alliances, stir up trouble, and build your own power base

Complex Weather System
 • Forge a path through the Dustlands while fighting storms and hidden dangers
 • Set up camp to shelter from the elements, then ride out at daybreak

Sheol DLC：
This is a large-scale DLC, with content far exceeding the base game and offering nearly 80 hours of gameplay. This DLC brings you the Dustlands like you've never experienced them before. With a new underground realm, exciting ruin exploration gameplay, and gripping storylines, you'll be immersed in the dangerous and opportunity-filled world of Dustland Delivery. Fix up your truck, call up your crew, and get ready for a brand new adventure!

※New Underground World: Sheol

Enter subway stations to travel between the darkness of the underground and the all-pervading danger of the surface. Explore and survive in two different worlds where your every decision could determine the future of the Dustlands.

• Volcanos and Glaciers: New terrain types bring whole new experiences. Change your strategy to fit the terrain, carefully shepherding resources to survive in the Dustlands.
 • Underground Cities and Factions: The cities of the underground are denser than the surface, each one with its own unique cultures and factions who could be potential allies—or potential enemies. Your choices will determine the balance of power in world of the underground.

※Ruins Exploration: No Risk, No Reward

Mysterious ruins lie scattered across the underground, symbols of the glories of the old world fraught with danger—and opportunity.

• Explore Ruins: Pull your crew out of your truck and send them to explore ruins filled with deadly traps, powerful enemies, and priceless loot. They'll need all their cunning to survive.
 • Incredible Rewards: Ruins are filled with rare equipment, road-building survey data, and other priceless resources. Every successful exploration will grant you huge rewards, helping you to stay alive in the underground.

※New Storyline: The Dustlands' Final Chapter

Deep in the underground lurks a secret that could shake the Dustlands to their foundations. The decision is yours: will you bring the truth to light?

• Experience a vast main storyline, with over 20 brand new side stories.
• Uncover mysteries, choose your own path, and witness the end of the Dustlands as we know it.
70070000037727.intro: This edition includes the Dustland Delivery base game and Dustland Delivery: Sheol DLC, featuring over 120 hours of gameplay content.
70070000037727.name: Dustland Delivery(Wildmax Edition)

70070000037778.description:
Deploy into a relentless combat environment where every corner holds a new threat and strategy is your greatest weapon. Adapt to unpredictable battlefield conditions, coordinates your movements, and experience a hardcore simulation designed for fans of pure tactical action.

1. Gray War Conflict — Dive into the core tactical experience. Infiltrate hostile territories, engage in intense firefights, and adapt to harsh environments in a brutal struggle for control. Every mission demands strategy, precise movement, and absolute focus as you face complex tactical challenges.

2. Gray War Conflict: Hostile Gear — Personalize your infantry loadout with a premium visual design. This DLC provides a distinct aesthetic finish for your Assault Rifle, allowing you to showcase your elite status while operating in the field.

With no backup and no second chances, make sure you are ready for the raw action ahead. Step into the conflict zone and dominate every encounter.
70070000037778.intro: Isolation becomes a lethal weapon when you are unprepared.
70070000037778.name: Gray War Conflict: Warfare Strategy

70070000037854.description:
Each decade features its own visual identity and carefully curated tracklist, letting you jump between musical eras or build the ultimate throwback-to-modern playlist in one seamless experience. Discover it all through the all-new Adventure Mode, a cheerful story-driven journey that has you dancing your way through the decades.

DANCE TO SONGS EVERYONE KNOWS
Celebrate iconic intergenerational hits brought to life with unique choreography, including fan-favorites like:

- "NUEVAYoL" by Bad Bunny
- "Manchild" by Sabrina Carpenter
- "Danza Kuduro" by Lucenzo & Don Omar
- "Turn Down for What" by DJ Snake & Lil Jon
- "Feel Good Inc." by Gorillaz
- "Bye Bye Bye" by *NSYNC
- "Wannabe" by Spice Girls
- "No Scrubs" by TLC
- "It's Tricky" by Run DMC
- "Uptown Girl" by Billy Joel
- "Mamma Mia" by ABBA
AND MORE!

From easy-to-follow to satisfyingly challenging, this year's track list is made to get players of all ages and styles dancing together!

DISCOVER A FUN ADVENTURE FOR ALL GENERATIONS
Explore the decades together in the new Adventure Mode. Discover 6 themed worlds, dance to iconic songs, enjoy fun mini-activities, and unlock exclusive rewards. Only available with Just Dance: Decades of Hits!

ENDLESS WAYS TO PARTY
Dance with up to 6 players locally, jump into Party Mode or get moving with Workout Mode. Grab your friends and family, choose your mode or dance, and let the party begin!
