70070000037856.description:
Each decade features its own visual identity and carefully curated tracklist, letting you jump between musical eras or build the ultimate throwback-to-modern playlist in one seamless experience. Discover it all through the all-new Adventure Mode, a cheerful story-driven journey that has you dancing your way through the decades.

DANCE TO SONGS EVERYONE KNOWS
Celebrate iconic intergenerational hits brought to life with unique choreography, including fan favorites like:

- "NUEVAYoL" by Bad Bunny
- "Manchild" by Sabrina Carpenter
- "Danza Kuduro" by Lucenzo Ft. Don Omar
- "Turn Down for What" by DJ Snake & Lil Jon
- "Feel Good Inc." by Gorillaz
- "Bye Bye Bye" by *NSYNC
- "Wannabe" by Spice Girls
- "No Scrubs" by TLC
- "It's Tricky" by Run-D.M.C
- "Uptown Girl" by Billy Joel
- "Mamma Mia" by ABBA
AND MORE!

From easy-to-follow to satisfyingly challenging, this year's tracklist is made to get players of all ages and styles dancing together!

DISCOVER A FUN ADVENTURE FOR ALL GENERATIONS
Explore the decades together in the new Adventure Mode. Discover 6 themed worlds, dance to iconic songs, enjoy fun mini-activities, and unlock exclusive rewards. Only available with Just Dance: Decades of Hits!

ENDLESS WAYS TO PARTY
Dance with up to 6 players locally, jump into Party Mode, or get moving with Workout Mode. Grab your friends and family, choose your mode or dance, and let the party begin!
70070000037856.name: Just Dance: Decades of Hits - Deluxe Edition

70070000038128.description:
Step into the role of a border guard, where every decision can determine the fate of the quarantine zone. Inspect incoming survivors, detect signs of infection, and manage critical situations under constant pressure as the outbreak spreads beyond control. Monitor behavior, analyze symptoms, and act quickly to prevent any breach that could endanger the entire region.

What this bundle contains:
1. Quarantine Lockdown Simulator: Zombie Border
Take control of a critical border checkpoint during a global zombie outbreak. Inspect individuals, identify infection risks, and make fast decisions to protect the safe zone from contamination. Balance caution and speed as you decide who may pass, who must be isolated, and who poses an immediate threat.

2. Quarantine Lockdown Simulator: Zombie Border – Security Gear
Enhances the appearance of your clothing scanner and temperature scanner with a new visual design, improving the look of your inspection tools without changing their functionality.

Stay alert, stay accurate, and hold the line against the outbreak.
70070000038128.intro: Master the checkpoint, enforce the law, and survive the pressure.
70070000038128.name: Quarantine Lockdown Simulator: Zombie Border – Biohazard Defense

70070000038203.description:
Experience the complete story of Twofold with The Perfect Circle Collection, featuring both Twofold: First Snow and Twofold. Follow two interconnected stories about love, friendship, and self-discovery as its cast navigates college life, personal struggles, and the bonds that connect them.

Twofold: The Perfect Circle Collection includes:

•	Twofold: First Snow: Follow college student Allison Merlo through a linear story detailing her first year of school away from her family. Isolated and directionless, she finds her way forward with help from Eileen Turner, an art student who, while otherwise cold and distant, extends a warm hand to her.

•	Twofold: Taking place a year after Twofold: First Snow, Twofold follows the story of Olive Penn, a college student at risk of failing out of college due to numerous outside factors. The leaders of the campus art and writing clubs, Caprice Shiften and Millie Clarke, offer to help them to the best of their abilities, but accepting either offer will undoubtedly put Olive in the middle of a conflict between the two women. Still, it's the only option Olive has. Twofold features two core paths to travel down, focusing on Caprice, Millie and their respective clubs. There are also side paths to explore, focusing on building friendships with the various club members.
70070000038203.intro: The complete Twofold story, following two journeys through college life.
70070000038203.name: Twofold: The Perfect Circle Collection

70070000038286.description:
Slip into the paws of a mischievous little cat and turn the cozy seaside town of Pawbay upside down. Climb rooftops, sneak through alleyways, and pounce your way through a charming world where curiosity always leads to chaos. Play solo or team up with a friend in local co-op and become the town’s most unforgettable troublemaker.

Give your playful feline a fresh new look with fashionable sunglasses, then head back into town to spread smiles, stir up a little trouble, and unleash chaos in true cat fashion.

Features:
• Play as a nimble cat who loves causing trouble
• Enjoy the adventure solo or in local 2-player co-op
• Explore every street, rooftop, and hidden corner
• Create hilarious chaos with pranks and mischief
• Wear silly sunglasses and shake up Pawbay
70070000038286.intro: A tiny cat, a sunny town, and a whole lot of playful trouble!
70070000038286.name: Pawbay: Cat Chaos

70070000038343.description:
Build a Chinese fantasy sect, recruit disciples, and forge the ultimate squad for ascension! Are you ready to walk the path to immortality as a true Sect Master?

Base Game:
+ Idle Gameplay: Enjoy a relaxing idle experience designed to help you unwind. Even while you are away, your sect keeps battling, growing stronger, and moving closer to ascension.

+ Squad Building: Recruit from 16 playable characters. Each character has unique talents, classes, and skills. Bring in the disciples you need and freely build your own squad.

+ Character Growth: Each character can choose one of six different cultivation paths. They can also practice different cultivation techniques to gain unique bonuses. Even characters of the same class can grow into completely different builds.

+ Explore the World: Journey across the land, discover other sects and factions, and advance the story. Gather resources for personal cultivation and sect development. Encounter random events and uncover unexpected treasures.

+ Sect Management: While exploring the world, you will also manage your own sect. Earn reputation and sect resources to upgrade and expand your home base. Build different sect facilities to continuously produce useful items. A powerful sect will help you go further on the path to immortality.


DLC 1：
There are many rumors about why the ethereal Xuan Nü appeared. Some say she came by Heaven’s mandate to save the Great Fire; others say she drifted here because of a conflict between divine beliefs; or perhaps she carries an even greater, unspeakable secret. Whatever the truth may be, she seems to share some common goals with the Heir of Formlessness. If you can earn Xuan Nü’s trust and aid, you will surely gain an unmatched and powerful ally on your path to immortality!

Skill Introduction:
Voidbreaker
Deals self-element damage based on Attack to a single enemy character.
On Lucky Hit: Deals additional self-element damage based on the target’s lost HP.

Heaven-Earth Rectification
Deals self-element damage based on Attack to the single enemy character with the lowest HP.

Primordial Revelation
When dealing hit damage: Has a chance equal to a certain percentage of her Crit Rate to double the damage.

Mandate to Slay Evil
When landing a kill: Deals non-elemental damage to all enemy characters equal to a certain percentage of the overflow damage.


DLC 2：
Seven Stars Pavilion is an ancient sect deeply versed in the stars and the movements of heaven and earth. In an ancient age beyond record, Seven Stars Pavilion was founded in the northern part of the continent—a place better suited for observing the heavens. The Seven-Star Diviners are the core members of Seven Stars Pavilion. Their study of the starry heavens has reached perfection, allowing them to command the great power of the stars for their own use.

Skill Introduction:
Star Essence
Deals self-element damage based on Attack to a single enemy character.
On Lucky Hit: additionally restores a certain amount of Mana.

Seven-Star Soul Suppression
Summons 7 Star Pieces. Each Star Piece deals self-element damage based on Attack to a random single enemy character.

Starry Array
When triggering Lucky Hit:
Applies 10 stacks of 【Starry Array】 to the target, lasting until the end of the wave.

Astral Divination
After casting Ultimate:
Applies 10 stacks of 【Astral Divination】 to self, lasting until the end of the wave.
70070000038343.intro: This edition includes the base game and two DLCs.
70070000038343.name: Idle Immortal(Deluxe Edition)

70070000038353.description:
Give yourself over to the ultimate relaxation! Clay&Cats will make you feel good in a way you didn't know you needed.

Your task is simple - assemble adorable, cat-themed pottery to its full glory. Put back together pawesome vases, purrfect plates, and kittiful bowls. Don't worry about the timers and sweating to pass the challenge - take all the time getting the pieces together and enjoy the satisfying way they click into the right places. Can't get cozier than that!

This bundle includes the Watering Can DLC.

KEY FEATURES:
- 9 categories with 14 levels of pure joy in each
- Lo-fi music providing good vibes for the hours of playing
- Satisfying gameplay that soothes your nervous system
- Tons of adorable, furry troublemakers to admire
70070000038353.intro: You'll forget about the rest of the world with the most satisfying hobby - repairing cute cat pots!
70070000038353.name: Clay&Cats Watering Can Pack

70070000038385.description:
Welcome to Make it Cozy!

Create the sweetest little home and share it with the cutest animal friends imaginable!

Step into a charming world filled with soft colors, cozy corners, and adorable companions waiting to move in. Design dreamy bedrooms, sunny living rooms, peaceful reading nooks, relaxing bathrooms, and magical outdoor spaces — then watch them come to life with playful kittens, a curious fox, a cheerful penguin, a tiny hedgehog, and many other fluffy friends.

Every room is a place where memories are made. Arrange comfy furniture, decorate with lovely plants, hang cute decorations, and create warm spaces where your animal companions can feel safe, happy, and loved. Whether you prefer a pastel paradise, a cozy cottage, or something wonderfully unique, your imagination is the only limit.

Relax, decorate, and enjoy the gentle atmosphere as your tiny residents explore the home you've created just for them. Every smile, nap, and playful moment makes your cozy world feel even more magical.

This bundle includes the Cats DLC.

KEY FEATURES:
- Design and decorate adorable cozy homes and beautiful outdoor spaces
- Meet charming animal residents including kittens, foxes, penguins, hedgehogs, bunnies, and more
- Hundreds of cute furniture pieces, plants, and decorations to personalize every room
- Warm pastel visuals and relaxing music that create a peaceful atmosphere
- Endless creative freedom to build your dream cozy retreat
- Watch your lovable animal friends enjoy and explore their new home
- Perfect for players who love cozy vibes, cute animals, creativity, and relaxing gameplay
70070000038385.intro: Unleash your creativity in a cutest possible way!
70070000038385.name: Make It Cozy! Cats Pack

70070000038398.description:
Lock and load for the definitive tactical shooter experience. Gain complete visual clarity in the heat of battle, adapt to changing combat zones, and secure everything you need to lead your team to victory.

Bundle Features:
1. Call of Warfare - FPS MODERN SHOOTER – Step into the heart of intense, fast-paced combat. Lead your elite squad through tactical 5v5 battles, utilize a massive arsenal of over 20 weapons, and protect your team’s 1000-point pool to claim victory.

2. Call of Warfare - FPS MODERN SHOOTER: Green Armour – Enhance your combat awareness with a fresh green-colored armour interface. Designed for better visibility and readability during intense firefights, it helps you track your protection status at a glance.

3. Call of Warfare - FPS MODERN SHOOTER: Battlefield Sky – Elevate your immersion with upgraded, dynamic skyboxes across all maps. This complete atmospheric overhaul brings a new visual tone and tension to every combat environment, making every mission feel even more epic.

Answer the call, perfect your strategy, and lead your squad to victory with unmatched tactical style!
70070000038398.intro: Outsmart, outgun, and outlast every single opponent in your way.
70070000038398.name: Call of Warfare - FPS MODERN SHOOTER: Killzone

70070000038594.description:
Become the ultimate long-range marksman in a realistic modern warfare experience where patience, precision, and tactical planning are the keys to survival. Complete dangerous missions across vast environments, eliminate high-value targets, and customize your equipment to match every operation.

Bundle Includes:
1. SNIPER WARRIOR ELITE – Experience realistic sniping across expansive battlefields, complete challenging missions, customize your equipment, and rely on skill, stealth, and precision to accomplish every objective.

2. SNIPER WARRIOR ELITE: Ready to Fire – A powerful precision rifle together with six exclusive weapon skins, allowing you to expand your arsenal and customize your weapon’s appearance throughout your missions.

Take your position, steady your aim, and complete every mission with the equipment of an elite marksman.
70070000038594.intro: Become the sniper every operation depends on.
70070000038594.name: SNIPER WARRIOR ELITE: Shadow Operation

70070000038636.description:
Build and manage your own transportation company while taking on realistic city driving challenges. Complete routes, expand your fleet, and keep your operations running smoothly across a living urban environment.

This bundle includes:
1. City Bus Simulator – Experience realistic bus driving with mission-based routes, Free Ride mode, fleet management, and vehicle upgrades as you build your transport company.
2. City Bus Simulator: New Wheels – Adds the Martopolo Double-Decker Bus to your fleet. If you already own this bus, you will instead receive 290,000 in-game currency as compensation.

Grow your fleet and shape the future of your transportation company.
70070000038636.intro: Deliver passengers on time and maintain order across a growing transport network.
70070000038636.name: City Bus Simulator: Transport Manager

70070000038677.description:
Step into the world of retail management and transform a small local shop into a thriving modern supermarket. Handle daily operations, design your store layout, manage stock, set prices, and serve customers efficiently while expanding your business step by step. Every decision shapes your growth, from product selection to store upgrades and long-term strategy.

This bundle includes:
1. Supermarket Simulator 2026
Manage every aspect of your store, from stocking shelves and pricing goods to expanding your supermarket and optimizing customer service. Build and grow your retail business into a successful operation.

2. Supermarket Simulator 2026: Success Fund
Instantly adds 2,000 to your in-game balance, providing extra resources to upgrade your store, purchase inventory, and support early business growth.

Grow your supermarket, make smart decisions, and build a retail business that keeps customers coming back every day.
70070000038677.intro: Manage the chaos of retail and turn it into profit.
70070000038677.name: Supermarket Simulator 2026: Retail Story

70070000038751.description:
Space Dragons

Choose your spaceship and defeat the alien threat coming from the Moon. Fight your way through by crushing, smashing, and blowing up hostile aliens that are taking control of powerful Earth weapons and military technology. Find the entity controlling the threat and make it explode in blood.

Space Dragons is a classic horizontal shoot ’em up game where you can choose different ships with unique characteristics and abilities to destroy tons of invading aliens. Throughout the adventure, you will face powerful bosses and explosive enemies. Get upgrades for your ship, weapons, and more to carve your way through the fleshy and bloody path that awaits you in Space Dragons.

Features:

Local multiplayer
11 fun and complete stages
A large arsenal of weapons awaits you in vast scenarios
Cumulative upgrades each time you finish a stage, allowing different combinations
11 epic and frantic boss encounters
Beautiful hand-drawn and animated pixel art characters and environments
Various enemies with different attacks and transformations
Execute enemies and bosses to gain upgrades and score points
Extremely frantic and explosive gameplay
Each boss has a transformation

Red Titans

RED TITANS is a single-player vertical shoot ’em up. You must put an end to the threat by creating a strategy with the available resources. You will need great skill since there are no continues, although you will be able to recover lives at certain moments.

You are the best pilot, a survivor. This is your last mission and everything will be decided. But in the middle of the mission, strange ships appear. A greater threat has arrived and the conflict begins to change course. You are no longer fighting for a nation; this is the beginning of something much bigger, and you are the first line of defense without even knowing it.

FEATURES:

6 frantic stages
5 epic bosses at the end of each stage
Beautiful hand-drawn pixel art environments
Retro 3:4 resolution (vertical shoot ’em up)
A challenging path with no continues
70070000038751.intro: Face the ultimate threat in a ruthless shoot ’em up
70070000038751.name: Galactic Warfare Collection

70070000038768.description:
Welcome to Hex Park – Master Bundle, the complete puzzle experience that includes both the Hex Park base game and Hex Park: Master DLC.

Rotate and align arrow tiles to guide directions, trigger satisfying chain reactions, clear obstacles, and solve each board in as few moves as possible. Easy to learn yet delightfully challenging to master, Hex Park offers relaxing, strategic gameplay that's impossible to put down.

The base game introduces a colorful world of handcrafted puzzles featuring clever mechanics like keys and locks, mystery tiles, bombs, ice counters, gears, and more. Once you've mastered those challenges, continue your journey with Hex Park: Master DLC, adding 75 brand-new handcrafted levels designed to test your planning, precision, and puzzle-solving skills with even more intricate layouts and clever combinations of mechanics.

Need a little help? Handy tools like the hammer, dynamite, and drill can get you unstuck without taking away the satisfaction of solving each puzzle. With no timers and no pressure, you can enjoy every challenge at your own pace.

Why you'll love Hex Park – Master Bundle:

• Includes the complete Hex Park base game and Hex Park: Master DLC
• 75 additional handcrafted Master DLC levels
• Clever mechanics including keys, locks, mystery tiles, bombs, ice counters, gears, and more
• Strategic gameplay that's easy to learn and rewarding to master
• Helpful tools that keep the challenge fair and fun
• Relaxing gameplay with no timers or pressure
• Achievements and cloud save support

Whether you're discovering Hex Park for the first time or looking to conquer every challenge, Hex Park – Master Bundle is the definitive way to experience the complete Hex Park adventure.
70070000038768.intro:
One bundle. Endless brainteasers.
Master every puzzle in Hex Park
with the complete game and DLC.
70070000038768.name: Hex Park - Master Bundle

70070000038813.description:
Step into the role of a frontline firefighter and face extreme emergencies where every second counts. Respond to dangerous fires, rescue civilians, and prove your skills across a city filled with unpredictable crises.

Bundle Includes:
1. Firefighting Rescue Simulator - Take control of elite firefighters as you drive powerful fire trucks, respond to emergency calls, and battle intense blazes across multiple cities. Complete missions, unlock new vehicles, and adapt to day and night conditions while saving lives in high-pressure scenarios.

2. Firefighting Rescue Simulator: Duty Outfit - Enhances your firefighter’s appearance with a new and improved protective suit. This upgraded uniform replaces the standard outfit, offering a more modern and professional look while maintaining full immersion in every rescue mission.

Gear up, stay focused, and become the hero your city depends on.
70070000038813.intro: Become the hero every emergency needs.
70070000038813.name: Firefighting Rescue Simulator: Rescue Operations

70070000038886.description:
*This is the Nintendo Switch™ version. There is also a Nintendo Switch™ 2 version of this game. Please select the version you require carefully.

Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United base game

Original Version Outfit Swap Pack for the Eight Protagonists

Give yourself over to the ultimate relaxation! Clay&Cats will make you feel good in a way you didn't know you needed.

Your task is simple - assemble adorable, cat-themed pottery to its full glory. Put back together pawesome vases, purrfect plates, and kittiful bowls. Don't worry about the timers and sweating to pass the challenge - take all the time getting the pieces together and enjoy the satisfying way they click into the right places. Can't get cozier than that!

This bundle includes the Tray DLC.

KEY FEATURES:
- 9 categories with 14 levels of pure joy in each
- Lo-fi music providing good vibes for the hours of playing
- Satisfying gameplay that soothes your nervous system
- Tons of adorable, furry troublemakers to admire
70070000039056.intro: You'll forget about the rest of the world with the most satisfying hobby - repairing cute cat pots!
70070000039056.name: Clay&Cats Tray Pack

70070000039165.description:
Get all the toys in the toy chest with this double pack, featuring both Toy Story: Retro Roundup! and Toy Story 3 Complete Edition. Play as classic characters as you navigate familiar worlds and take on challenges inspired by the films. Toy Story: Retro Roundup! includes 11 classic games, with both console and handheld versions of four Toy Story games, along with A Bug’s Life. Toy Story 3 Complete Edition brings back the fan-favorite 3D adventure for modern consoles.

Toy Story: Retro Roundup!

Step back into Andy’s room with Woody, Buzz Lightyear, and more classic characters in Toy Story: Retro Roundup! This five-game collection features console and handheld versions of four early Toy Story titles, as well as A Bug’s Life. All the games have been upgraded with new features, quality-of-life improvements, and an overflowing toy chest of behind-the-scenes content. Revisit the ‘90s and early 2000s hits you loved and share these titles with a new generation of Toy Story fans.

Toy Story 3 Complete Edition

Reopen the toy chest and saddle up as Woody, Buzz Lightyear, and Jessie in Toy Story 3 Complete Edition, a 3D adventure based on the hit 2010 animated film, Toy Story 3. The updated game features improved graphics and a few new surprises in store. Play through authentic moments from the movie in Story Mode, or drop into the wild west sandbox of Woody’s Roundup in Toy Box Mode.

This bundle includes “Disney/Pixar Toy Story: Retro Roundup!” and “Disney/Pixar Toy Story 3 Complete Edition”, which are released for Nintendo Switch. They can also be played on Nintendo Switch 2. However, please note that a separate product, "Disney/Pixar Toy Story: Retro Roundup! + Toy Story 3 Complete Edition Double Pack", is available exclusively for Nintendo Switch 2.

Save data and Additional Contents are not compatible between the two versions. Please be careful to avoid duplicate or mistaken purchases.
70070000039165.name: Disney/Pixar Toy Story: Retro Roundup! + Toy Story 3 Complete Edition Double Pack

70070000039170.description:
A cat's life
Explore Pawbay by taking on important feline duties, from mail delivery to catching pigeons, as you impress (or infuriate!) the town's citizens. Dress up your cat, explore the town and adventure alone or in local co-op.

Cat parkour!
Climb onto rooftops, jump between clotheslines and find hidden shortcuts using simple controls and forgiving movement that keeps the adventure accessible for everyone.

Now dressed for the job
Dress up by combining fur patterns with unlockable hats and face accessories. Whether you put on a police cap or a chef's hat, the town will get to see you're a mature cat!

A busy schedule!
How much work is in a cat's day? Steal fish, find the most luxurious furniture to scratch, and show off in cat races, as you discover ways to impress the locals and keep up with a feline's busy life!
• Explore a lively town, getting in the way of or assisting its citizens
• Dress up by combining fur patterns with unlockable hats and face accessories
• Work alone or add an extra set of paws in local co-op
• Explore the town freely or try to complete the challenge list for each area!
70070000039170.intro: Be the cat your parents hoped for!
70070000039170.name: Pawbay: Proud Parents

70070000039194.description:
"Here Come the Grannies" bonus digital content
Janet and Rita are back -- and this time they've got wheels. Watch out, young'uns, the grannies are on the move!

More Dress-Ups!
New outfits for Bluey and Bingo to try on.

Digital Art Book:
A behind-the-scenes look at the art and ideas behind the adventure

Play, explore, and capture moments with Bluey and Bingo in this photo-powered adventure across familiar spots from the show. Snap memories solo or side-by-side with a second player, discover Australian wildlife, and turn in-game moments into real fun for Real Life.

Say Cheese!
Bluey and Bingo have found Dad's old camera (back from when he was cool). Travel around Bluey's hometown of Brisbane as you snap photos of the games you play, chase bin chickens and uncover hidden surprises. Each snapshot is saved to your own scrapbook, where you can keep your best moments.

Fun for Everyone
A second player can join in to explore and strike a pose, while the main player leads the adventure behind the camera. Hang out with Muffin, Chloe, Winton and more of Bluey's friends wherever you go, play with loads of toys and jump into games from the show, like Shadowlands and Magic Cauldron.

Play for Real Life
Packed with tips that turn game time into play for Real Life time! Find new ways to play with everyday things in the world around you, turning cushion forts and cardboard boxes into the next big adventure. Explore, play and discover in the game, then take it off the screen and keep the fun going.
70070000039194.intro: Explore Bluey's world like never before!
70070000039194.name: Bluey's Happy Snaps: Deluxe Edition

70070000039228.description:
Enter a world consumed by a dangerous outbreak, where every decision at the quarantine border can determine the survival of an entire region. As the last line of defense, inspect survivors, identify infected individuals, manage quarantine zones, and respond to sudden zombie threats while working under constant pressure.

What this bundle contains:
1. Quarantine Lockdown Simulator: Zombie Border
Control the quarantine zone, inspect incoming survivors, make critical decisions, and defend humanity against the spread of infection.

2. Quarantine Lockdown Simulator: Zombie Border – Elite Skins
Give soldiers and scientists a renewed visual identity with upgraded appearances that enhance the atmosphere of the outbreak.

3. Quarantine Lockdown Simulator: Zombie Border – Frontline Gear
Customize your guard’s equipment and refresh your view with a new hand and gear skin for every mission.

Protect the border, manage the crisis, and face the outbreak with enhanced style as you fight to keep the last safe zone alive.
70070000039228.intro: Survival depends on every choice you make.
70070000039228.name: Quarantine Lockdown Simulator: Zombie Border – Infection Control

70070000039252.description:
The best way to enjoy the Cozy Pages library. The Cozy Bundle unlocks the Comfy, Relax, Happy, 3D and Draw packs — so you can move from quick, easy doodle pages to mindful mandalas, from cute everyday scenes to blocky 3D voxel models, whenever the mood strikes.

What’s inside
* 450+ coloring pages
* 33 themed collections
* 40 voxel 3D models to color
* All sticker packs (110 stickers total)
* All palettes (192 colors total)
* 20 whiteboards for drawing freely (quick doodles, sketches, and calm creative play)

Controls
Choose your favorite way to play:
* Motion pointer (Joy-Con™): move the pointer by tilting the controller like a magic wand.
* Touchscreen: tap and color directly for a smooth, hands-on experience.

Tools
Keep it simple or get creative: use cozy tools like brushes (with different looks), a satisfying fill bucket, an eraser, glitter and sticker stamps to decorate your pages.

Cozy Pages is your pocket of calm: cute, cozy and always ready when you need a little break.
70070000039252.name: Cozy Bundle: 450+ Coloring Pages & Goodies + All Stickers, Palettes & Whiteboards

70070000039308.description:
Welcome to Make It Cozy!

Create the sweetest little home and share it with the cutest animal friends imaginable!

Step into a charming world filled with soft colors, cozy corners, and adorable companions waiting to move in. Design dreamy bedrooms, sunny living rooms, peaceful reading nooks, relaxing bathrooms, and magical outdoor spaces — then watch them come to life with playful kittens, a curious fox, a cheerful penguin, a tiny hedgehog, and many other fluffy friends.

Every room is a place where memories are made. Arrange comfy furniture, decorate with lovely plants, hang cute decorations, and create warm spaces where your animal companions can feel safe, happy, and loved. Whether you prefer a pastel paradise, a cozy cottage, or something wonderfully unique, your imagination is the only limit.

Relax, decorate, and enjoy the gentle atmosphere as your tiny residents explore the home you've created just for them. Every smile, nap, and playful moment makes your cozy world feel even more magical.

This bundle includes the Summer Collection DLC.

KEY FEATURES:
- Design and decorate adorable cozy homes and beautiful outdoor spaces
- Meet charming animal residents including kittens, foxes, penguins, hedgehogs, bunnies, and more
- Hundreds of cute furniture pieces, plants, and decorations to personalize every room
- Warm pastel visuals and relaxing music that create a peaceful atmosphere
- Endless creative freedom to build your dream cozy retreat
- Watch your lovable animal friends enjoy and explore their new home
- Perfect for players who love cozy vibes, cute animals, creativity, and relaxing gameplay
70070000039308.intro: Unleash your creativity in a cutest possible way!
70070000039308.name: Make It Cozy! Summer Pack

70070000039317.description:
Run a convenience store solo in this frantic action game!
Dash around the store handling tasks while customers keep pouring in!

Play co-op as a worker and support robot team!
Split up tasks and work together strategically!

"Solo Shift!" and the "Late Night Solo Shift Pack" are now available as a downloadable content bundle!
70070000039317.intro:
From cash register to fryer—you've got to manage it all!
Take on waves of customers all by yourself!
70070000039317.name: Solo Shift! + Late Night Pack Set

70070000039320.description:
《 CRISIS CORE –FINAL FANTASY VII– REUNION –DIGITAL DELUXE EDITION– 》
In addition to the game, you will also receive a mini soundtrack showcasing the game’s powerful music and an art book filled with gorgeous illustrations. Immerse yourself in the rich universe of CRISIS CORE –FINAL FANTASY VII– REUNION!

- “CRISIS CORE –FINAL FANTASY VII– REUNION” game
- Original mini soundtrack “CRISIS CORE –FINAL FANTASY VII– REUNION MINI SOUNDTRACK”
- Original art book “HEROES Past and Present The Art of CRISIS CORE –FINAL FANTASY VII–“

CRISIS CORE –FINAL FANTASY VII– REUNION is the HD remaster version of the smash hit prequel to FINAL FANTASY VII.

In addition to all graphics being remastered in HD, fully voiced dialogue and new soundtrack arrangements make for a dynamic new retelling of a beloved classic.

CRISIS CORE –FINAL FANTASY VII– REUNION follows the story of Zack Fair, a young warrior admired by the boy destined to save the world, trusted by men renowned as heroes of legend, and loved by the girl who holds the fate of the planet in her hands. The tale of Zack's dreams and honor—the legacy that connects him to Cloud—is revealed in full in this grand saga that has broken the limits of an HD remaster.

<New Features>
- All graphics fully remastered in HD, bringing the game to the latest console generation
- Renewed 3D models, including characters and backgrounds, enriching the visual experience
- Improved battle system providing a vastly smoother gameplay experience
- Fully voiced dialogue in both English and Japanese
- A newly arranged soundtrack from the original composer, Takeharu Ishimoto

<CRISIS CORE –FINAL FANTASY VII– REUNION>
In the mako-powered metropolis of Midgar stands the headquarters of Shinra, a powerful company with a formidable private army. Zack Fair is a promising young operative in the Shinra military's elite unit, SOLDIER. Together with his mentor, SOLDIER 1st Class Angeal, and the SOLDIER hero Sephiroth, Zack begins an investigation into the recent mass disappearance of SOLDIER operatives.

This is the Digital Deluxe edition of the game. A standard edition is also available as a purchase option, so please be careful not to make redundant purchases.
70070000039320.intro: CRISIS CORE –FINAL FANTASY VII– REUNION has broken the limits of an HD remaster. Witness the evolution of the beloved FFVII prequel.
70070000039320.name: CRISIS CORE –FINAL FANTASY VII– REUNION –DIGITAL DELUXE EDITION–

70070000039346.description:
Enter the abandoned city of Pripyat as an investigative reporter determined to uncover the truth behind the horrors hidden within the exclusion zone. Search for supplies, battle terrifying mutants, survive deadly encounters, and explore abandoned locations.

This Bundle Includes:
  Chernobyl: Escape from Pripyat
Investigate the mysteries of Chernobyl, manage your survival, fight terrifying enemies, and uncover the secrets buried beneath the ruins of Pripyat.

  Chernobyl: Escape from Pripyat – Hands Style
Refresh your first-person experience with a redesigned pair of gloves, bringing a distinctive new visual style to every exploration, investigation, and combat encounter.

Survive the unknown, reveal the truth behind the exclusion zone, and experience every step of your investigation with a renewed tactical appearance.
70070000039346.intro: Survive terrifying encounters and reveal forgotten secrets.
70070000039346.name: Chernobyl: Escape from Pripyat – Survivor

70070000039374.description:
Take on the challenge of breathing new life into forgotten homes through renovation, design, and creativity, then climb behind the wheel to tackle engaging parking challenges, unlock new vehicles, and sharpen your driving precision.
Both games reward steady progression, thoughtful decisions, and the satisfaction of watching your hard work pay off. Whether you're creating stylish interiors or perfecting every maneuver, every session brings new goals to achieve and new milestones to reach.
Discover two relaxing yet rewarding simulation adventures where every project, every upgrade, and every success is another step toward mastery.
70070000039374.name: Flipper & Parking Dream

70070000039375.description:
Test your instincts across three unique adventures where every decision can mean the difference between survival and failure.

This bundle includes three games, each delivering a different challenge. Escape from a heavily guarded prison using patience and clever planning, survive aboard a crippled ship abandoned after a brutal pirate attack, and investigate a mysterious hospital where reality itself cannot be trusted.

Every experience places you under constant pressure. Search for vital resources, solve environmental challenges, uncover hidden secrets, and make difficult decisions while facing unpredictable dangers. Whether you're managing scarce supplies, plotting the perfect escape, or carefully observing your surroundings for subtle anomalies, success depends on your ability to stay calm, think ahead, and adapt to changing situations.

Blending survival, stealth, exploration, and psychological horror, this collection offers three distinct stories united by one common theme: overcoming impossible odds. Every location presents new threats, every objective demands careful planning, and every victory feels earned.

Do you have what it takes to survive, escape, and uncover the truth?
70070000039375.intro: Face the unknown, escape the impossible.
70070000039375.name: Big Survival Collection 3-in-1

70070000039543.description:
Step into the role of a police officer, where every decision shapes your career and every mission tests your skills. Train at the shooting range, patrol the city, respond to dangerous situations, and maintain order while building your reputation as a trusted officer.

Bundle Includes:
POLICE OFFICERS SIMULATOR – Experience the life of a police officer, complete various missions, develop your skills, unlock new equipment, and make choices that influence the city around you.

POLICE OFFICERS SIMULATOR: Patrol Style – Change your character’s appearance with a new visual style, giving your officer a refreshed look as you continue your patrols and protect the city.

Take on new challenges, uphold justice, and experience your police career with an updated appearance.
70070000039543.intro: Make your officer truly stand out during every mission.
70070000039543.name: POLICE OFFICERS SIMULATOR: City Patrol

70070000039552.description:
Take on two hands-on business adventures where restoration, management, and smart investments are the keys to success.
Restore a neglected hotel from the ground up. Clear out damaged rooms, renovate floors, walls, and ceilings, choose furniture and decorations, welcome guests, and expand your property as your business grows. Improve your tools, unlock new rooms, and transform an abandoned building into a successful hotel.
Then enter the world of car dealing. Search auctions for promising vehicles, compete for the best deals, repair and restore your purchases, and sell them for profit. Customize and expand your showroom, manage your budget, negotiate with customers, and build your reputation as your collection of vehicles and your dealership continue to grow.
With two distinct management experiences, this bundle lets you renovate, customize, trade, expand, and build your way toward success - whether you're creating the perfect hotel or running your own car empire.
70070000039552.intro: Build your empire from the ground up.
70070000039552.name: Business Simulator Collection

70070000039567.description: Pokémon Legends: Z-A + Mega Dimension includes the main game plus the Mega Dimension DLC
70070000039567.intro: An adventure in a thriving Pokémon metropolis!
70070000039567.name: Pokémon Legends: Z-A + Mega Dimension

70070000039713.description:
This special bundle includes the main game Exstetra together with the following content:
• Exstetra - Item Set
• Exstetra - Rune Set
----------------------------
Exstetra follows the story of Ryoma, a high school student chosen to become a Prisma, the savior destined to protect Amejia, a Tokyo fused with another world and doomed to destruction.
During his journey, Ryoma meets future Prisma Knights who share the same mission. By awakening their powers with a kiss, he joins them on an adventure to save two worlds.

◆ STORY ◆
Kiss her...
It is the only way to save two worlds from ruin.
Amejia was born from the fusion of Tokyo and another realm. As the chosen Prisma, Ryoma fights to prevent the extinction of both worlds.
Find the friends who were drawn into Amejia and awaken their hidden powers as Prisma Knights through the power of a kiss.
The only way to save the world is a kiss.

◆ WORLD ◆
Amejia is a transformed version of Tokyo that has merged with another world.
Featuring artwork inspired by Tokyo Fantasy, it offers a beautiful yet haunting world unlike any other.
Explore reimagined locations such as Shibuya and Akihabara.

◆ DUNGEON ◆
Mysterious labyrinths stretch across Amejia.
Battle monsters, solve puzzles, discover treasure, gather materials, and explore dangerous dungeons as you venture ever deeper.
Collect equipment and resources, strengthen your party, and press onward toward the deepest reaches of each labyrinth.

◆ BATTLE ◆
The only way to save the world is a kiss!
Fight alongside the Prisma Knights in strategic turn-based battles.
Form a party of up to four characters, choose formations and skills, and adapt your tactics to every encounter.
An Auto-Battle feature is also available.

• Ex Skills
As a Prisma, Ryoma can absorb Ex, the energy that powers this world, by defeating enemies.
Share Ex with Prisma Knights through a kiss to awaken their strength and unleash powerful Ex Skills.

• Party Formation and Affinity
Up to four characters can participate in battle.
Team composition and relationships with allies both play important roles, so strengthen your bonds with a variety of companions.

• Enchant System
Combine skills attached to weapons, armor, and accessories to create customized battle strategies.
Gather materials, enhance your equipment, and prepare for powerful enemies.

*This product is based on Exstetra, originally released in 2013. Some features and specifications may differ from the original version.*
70070000039713.intro: A fantasy RPG where a kiss can save the world.
70070000039713.name: EXSTETRA - Digital Deluxe Edition

70070000039765.description:
This Digital Deluxe Edition includes the full game, soundtrack, drama movie, costumes, and more!

Contents
- AKIBA LOST (Full Game)
- AKIBA LOST - Original Soundtrack
- AKIBA LOST - Drama Movie
- Pixel Character Costume Set A (Shinjo, Wakana, Aoi, Moe)
- Pixel Character Costume Set B (Shinjo, Kokone, Chihiro, Yukimi)


Game
Thirteen years ago, six girls vanished in Akihabara in the unsolved case “The Akiba Vanishing”.
Daiki Shinjo announces a live-action game based on the incident, gathering six women who embody Akihabara’s subculture.
But their story begins to seep into reality. Can AKIBA LOST be finished?
AKIBA LOST is a live-action multi-perspective suspense game of fate and choice.

Cast:
Hiromitsu Kitayama / Game Creator: Daiki Shinjo
Sayuri Matsumura / Maid: Aoi Shinjo
Momoko Tanabe / Game Streamer: Yukimi Kurahashi
Misato Ugaki / Food Writer: Moe Kurosu
Yui Oguri (AKB48) / Underground Idol: Kokone Nagato
Azusa Ohara / Shrine Maiden: Chihiro Jimbo
MINA (East Of Eden) / Cosplayer: Wakana Yusa

Original Soundtrack
The AKIBA LOST Original Soundtrack features 31 in-game background music tracks.
In addition to the 22 tracks featured in the television drama, this soundtrack also includes original compositions for the game by Tsukasa Masuko.
*Please note that the theme song and insert songs are not included.

Drama Movie
Includes all six episodes of the television drama broadcast on Nippon TV, one of Japan's leading nationwide television networks.
Experience another side of the world of AKIBA LOST through the TV drama.

Pixel Character Costume Set
You can change costumes from the Options menu.


This bundle includes “AKIBA LOST” and its Additional Contents, which are released for Nintendo Switch. They can also be played on Nintendo Switch 2. However, please note that a separate product, "AKIBA LOST", is available exclusively for Nintendo Switch 2.

Save data and Additional Contents are not compatible between the two versions. Please be careful to avoid duplicate or mistaken purchases.
70070000039765.intro: A live-action multi-perspective suspense game of fate and choice in Akihabara
70070000039765.name: AKIBA LOST: Digital Deluxe Edition

70070000039811.description:
Deluxe Edition includes the following content:
- Base Game
- Ink & Gold Elegance Outfit Collection
- Mistveil Detective Outfit Collection

Murders on the Yangtze River is a Chinese-style side-scrolling detective adventure game developed by OMEGAMES STUDIO.
There is no such thing as a perfect crime — only clues that have yet to be discovered.

- Every Trace Leaves a Mark -

Set in the turbulent era of the late Qing Dynasty and early Republic of China, where ancient and modern, Eastern and Western cultures collided and intertwined, you will step into the role of the protagonist and become entangled in an unavoidable conspiracy.

Seemingly unrelated events gradually lead you toward a massive mystery and the secrets hidden behind your own identity.

A lie is simply a fact disguised in another form. Can you uncover the truth hidden beneath layers of deception and piece together the final answer from a series of intertwined cases?

- A Meticulously Crafted Logic-Based Mystery -

During your journey, you will encounter a series of bizarre and perplexing cases. To uncover the truth behind each incident and identify the culprit, you will need to:

Explore different locations as the story unfolds, searching for every hidden clue and subtle detail.

Investigate crime scenes, collect evidence, and question witnesses.

Even uncover contradictions and loopholes hidden within the testimonies you have gathered...

- Intricate Cases with Twists and Turns -

The seemingly unrelated cases that occur across different locations are, in fact, connected by countless threads to the greater mystery surrounding the protagonist.

Behind every case lies an ingenious method of crime and a deeply moving motive.

Every ordinary person carries their own complicated past, with countless hidden conflicts and entangled relationships.

Can you unravel every layer of the mystery, discover the ultimate truth behind the grand case, and complete your journey of revenge?

- A Breathtaking Chinese Ink Painting World -

Follow a beautifully unfolding ink-wash scroll as you travel through the landscapes of China during the late Qing Dynasty and early Republic of China period.

Sail across Dongting Lake and encounter the historic Yueyang Tower once again;

Travel along the Yangtze River and explore the steampunk-inspired Hanyang Iron Works;

Wander through the misty waterways and elegant scenery of Jiangnan in Yangzhou;

Step into the dazzling streets of Shanghai’s foreign concessions and experience the city's early 20th-century retro modernity...

Every scene is carefully crafted like a living painting, inviting you to experience local cultures, explore historical landscapes, and solve mysteries across different regions.

- Meticulously Researched Historical and Cultural Design -

The game's world, art style, and environments are based on extensive research from museum archives, historical photographs, and discussions with experts in history and culture.

The story is built upon real historical backgrounds, recreating the architecture, landscapes, and social atmosphere of China during the late Qing Dynasty and early Republic of China period.

From carefully researched character costumes to authentic everyday objects, every detail is designed to immerse you in the rich historical and cultural atmosphere of the late Qing Dynasty and early Republic of China.
70070000039811.name: Murders on the Yangtze River Deluxe Edition

70070000039866.description:
Create your own construction empire experience. Manage construction projects across the city, operate a wide range of heavy machinery, complete challenging contracts, and expand your company from a small contractor into an industry leader.

Bundle Includes:
Construction Sim: City and Road Builder
Build roads, bridges, and large-scale infrastructure, operate realistic construction machinery, complete diverse contracts, and develop a successful construction company.

Construction Sim: City and Road Builder - Business Boost
This DLC adds 5,00 in-game currency to invest in equipment, expand your fleet, and take on larger construction projects sooner.

Lay the foundation for success, grow your business with confidence, and build the future one project at a time.
70070000039866.intro: Build the city while expanding your construction empire.
70070000039866.name: Construction Sim: City and Road Builder - Grand Construction

70070000039931.description:
Welcome to Hex Park – Ultra Bundle, the puzzle experience that includes both the Hex Park base game and Hex Park: Ultra DLC.

Rotate and align arrow tiles to guide directions, trigger satisfying chain reactions, clear obstacles, and solve each board in as few moves as possible. Easy to learn yet delightfully challenging to master, Hex Park offers relaxing, strategic gameplay that's impossible to put down.

The base game introduces a colorful world of handcrafted puzzles featuring clever mechanics like keys and locks, mystery tiles, bombs, ice counters, gears, and more. Once you've mastered those challenges, continue your journey with Hex Park: Ultra DLC, adding 75 brand-new handcrafted levels designed to test your planning, precision, and puzzle-solving skills with even more intricate layouts and clever combinations of mechanics.

Need a little help? Handy tools like the hammer, dynamite, and drill can get you unstuck without taking away the satisfaction of solving each puzzle. With no timers and no pressure, you can enjoy every challenge at your own pace.

Why you'll love Hex Park – Ultra Bundle:

• Includes the Hex Park base game and Hex Park: Ultra DLC
• 75 additional handcrafted Ultra DLC levels
• Clever mechanics including keys, locks, mystery tiles, bombs, ice counters, gears, and more
• Strategic gameplay that's easy to learn and rewarding to master
• Helpful tools that keep the challenge fair and fun
• Relaxing gameplay with no timers or pressure
• Achievements and cloud save support

Whether you're discovering Hex Park for the first time or looking to conquer every challenge, Hex Park – Ultra Bundle is the definitive way to experience the Hex Park adventure.
70070000039931.intro:
One bundle. Endless brainteasers.
Master every puzzle in Hex Park.
70070000039931.name: Hex Park - Ultra Bundle

70070000039938.description:
Enter a dangerous ancient world where survival depends on adaptation, strength, and instinct. Experience the adventure as you explore hostile environments, face powerful creatures, complete challenging missions, and evolve through the prehistoric era.

Bundle Includes:
1. Dinosaur Survival Simulator - Prehistoric RPG (Base Game): Explore forests, plains, waterfalls, and volcanic regions while controlling legendary dinosaurs, improving your abilities, completing survival challenges, and fighting to become the strongest creature of the prehistoric age.

2. Dinosaur Survival Simulator - Prehistoric RPG: Jurassic Style (DLC): Refresh the appearance of three AI-controlled dinosaurs with redesigned skins, adding more visual variety to your prehistoric encounters.

Adapt, survive, and explore a world of ancient dangers with new creature appearances and an enhanced prehistoric experience.
70070000039938.intro: Evolve, adapt, and dominate the prehistoric wilderness.
70070000039938.name: Dinosaur Survival Simulator - Prehistoric RPG: Ancient Survival

70070000039958.description:
Enter a world of intense military combat , where every battle demands precision, teamwork, and strategy. Fight alongside your squad in high-stakes 5v5 encounters, explore dynamic combat zones, and use a powerful arsenal to overcome enemy forces.

Bundle Features:
1. Call of Warfare - FPS MODERN SHOOTER – Engage in tactical team battles, master a wide selection of weapons, and lead your squad through challenging firefights across diverse environments. Every decision matters as you fight to secure victory.

2. Call of Warfare - FPS MODERN SHOOTER: Tactical Hands – Customize your operator’s appearance with military-inspired camouflage green hands and gloves. Add a realistic soldier style to your character and bring a fresh tactical look to every encounter.

3. Call of Warfare - FPS Modern Shooter: Battlefield Sky – Upgrade the visual atmosphere of every map with a redesigned skybox. Experience more dynamic combat environments with refreshed skies and a more immersive war zone.

Prepare for battle, refine your tactics, and experience modern warfare with enhanced customization and visuals.
70070000039958.intro: Master every weapon and overcome every enemy force.
70070000039958.name: Call of Warfare - FPS MODERN SHOOTER: Battlefield Heroes

70070000039963.description:
Dive deeper into the chaotic, beautifully pixelated Abyss with Neon Abyss 2! The action is faster, the stakes are higher, and the possibilities are endless in this cybermyth roguelike. With explosive run 'n' gun gameplay, diverse combat styles, and unlimited item synergies, Neon Abyss 2 delivers a dramatic, thrill-packed experience every time you enter.

This Deluxe Edition includes the Archenemy Returns DLC and our Supporter Pack! 

Every God from the original Neon Abyss makes an appearance in Neon Abyss 2 with Archenemy Returns - with 35 bosses upgraded, balanced and visually enhanced to fit with the evolving Abyss.

If Agents would like to support a little further, the Supporter Pack provides a cosmetic-only enhancement with a new Saya outfit, in-game representation, an in-game record player with the OST and all holiday-exclusive cosmetics!

NEW 4 PLAYER CO-OP!
Team Work makes the Dream Work!
Neon Abyss 2 introduces exhilarating online 4-player co-op, allowing you and up to three friends to dive into the roguelike chaos together. Band together to multiply each of your unique synergies and combos, creating powerful forces of destruction. Coordinate your builds and conquer the Abyss as a team, even exploring different
rooms within the same map to maximize efficiency and uncover hidden secrets and treasures.

UNIMAGINABLE WEAPONRY
A Revolutionary Weapon System
What's your combat style? Smash enemies up close with a bat or saber, unleash attacks with deadly plants, or command fierce dragon-like creatures to fight for you—the choice is yours! With limitless options and an inventive arsenal, every run lets you experiment with unique, wild ways to conquer the Abyss.

UNLIMTED  ITEM SYNERGIES
Even More Monstrous!
Random item drops in the Abyss grant you powers that combine in surprising and powerful ways. Stack as many as you can to create wild, unstoppable synergies that make every run feel unique. Show the Abyss who’s really in charge—there’s no limit to how many items you can wield!

HATCH THEM ALL!
Hatchmon! I choose you!
Your favourite Abyss companions, now in even brighter colours! Hatch and collect these cute creatures, then evolve them into powerful and unique allies to spice up your runs. With a wide variety of Hatchmon to discover, each run brings new possibilities!

THE POWER OF FAITH
Turn the Tides!
Introducing the all-new Faith System, designed to turn the tides when the Abyss gets tough. How will you wield this power? Spend it in a shop stocked with powerful items, recruit more Hatchmon to fight by your side, or... risk it all in a game of chance? Either way, we have faith in you!

...AND MORE!
Discover as You Explore
Uncover a host of new features and surprises in this dynamic second instalment. From new enemies and powerful gods, to updated loot and hidden secrets, there’s always something fresh to discover. The Abyss awaits—dive deeper and uncover secrets you may not face alone!
70070000039963.name: Neon Abyss 2 - Deluxe Edition

70070000039987.description:
Play as a courageous stray cat and explore a ruined city filled with danger. Rescue lost kittens, find food for other strays, uncover hidden paths, and avoid swarms of insects and hostile dogs. Use stealth, speed, and teamwork to survive.

Team up with a friend in two-player local co-op. Share supplies, protect each other, and rely on stealth and speed through the expanded set of eight story-driven levels, filled with quests and secret areas. The world may be overrun… but courage still meows in the dark.

Features
• Includes Little Strays 2 and The Silent Hospital expansion
• Two-player local co-op
• Explore ruined streets, sewers, laboratories, and an abandoned hospital
• Rescue kittens and help other strays survive
• Solve puzzles, discover secrets, and avoid dangerous enemies
• Atmospheric visuals and an evolving ambient soundtrack
70070000039987.intro: The City is Silent. The Strays Still Need You.
70070000039987.name: Little Strays 2: Cat Rescue

70070000040019.description:
The Fountain of Youth is unearthed - but the One Kingdom hides far more than one secret. Face brutal, precise soulslike combat across a sprawling, interconnected world, then descend into the forsaken Vainlands with Shattered Shape, where new foes, weapons, skills and a new land await.

This bundle contains everything you need to conquer the One Kingdom.

- Full soulslike action-RPG + Shattered Shape expansion
- A seamless, labyrinthine world - now even more sprawling with the uncharted southern Vainlands
- New enemies, weapons, and armor to master alongside the base arsenal
- Uncover the entire truth of the Usurper's Prophecy, start to finish
70070000040019.intro: This is a bundle containing the base game FOUNTAINS and the DLC Shattered Shape
70070000040019.name: FOUNTAINS: Extended Edition

70070000040072.description:
In addition to the main Touhou Koumakyou game, this edition includes "Touhou Koumakyou: New Classic Soundtrack Player," which lets you listen to over 30 tracks in total from the New Classic and Classic versions of Touhou Koumakyou.

"Touhou Koumakyou: New Classic Soundtrack Player" is an application for Nintendo Switch™. Launch the application to view and listen to the content.

A standard edition containing only the main game is also available. Please take care not to purchase the same content twice.

・About This Game
Touhou Koumakyou from the Touhou makes its debut on Nintendo Switch™ and Nintendo Switch 2 .
Take control of Reimu the shrine maiden or Marisa the magician as you set out to resolve an incident threatening Gensokyo.

The New Classic version features upgraded high-resolution visuals, with every BGM track arranged by ZUN. It also introduces a new mode, where you can take on the game with unlimited lives.

You can also play the Classic version, which perfectly preserves the original 2002 gameplay.
*All text in the Classic version is in Japanese.

This product is for the Nintendo Switch™. It can also be played on the Nintendo Switch 2 , but a separate Nintendo Switch 2 -exclusive version, “Touhou Koumakyou: New Classic - the Embodiment of Scarlet Devil,” is also available.
Save data and downloadable content are not compatible between the two versions. Please check carefully to avoid duplicate or mistaken purchases.
Please note that there is no Nintendo Switch 2 Edition or Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade Pack for this title.
70070000040072.intro: A deluxe edition of the Touhou Koumakyou shooting game, bundled with an app featuring over 30 tracks in total composed and arranged by ZUN
70070000040072.name: Touhou Koumakyou: New Classic - the Embodiment of Scarlet Devil Deluxe Edition

70070000040133.description:
Two HD-2D RPGs from SQUARE ENIX’s Team Asano,
OCTOPATH TRAVELER and OCTOPATH TRAVELER II are now available as a bundle!

This series features distinctive HD-2D graphics that combine pixel art with 3D.
Embark on your own unique journey through a magical world that feels both familiar and new.

■ Bundle content:
• OCTOPATH TRAVELER full game
• OCTOPATH TRAVELER II full game

■ OCTOPATH TRAVELER
Set in the continent of Orsterra, OCTOPATH TRAVELER
follows the adventures of eight travellers from different walks of life.
Choose your traveller,
and take control of them as they journey across the world.
Eight travellers, born in different parts of the world,
travelling to different destinations, and each with their own special set of skills.
Where will your journey take you?

Embark upon a story all your own.

■ OCTOPATH TRAVELER II
This story takes place in Solistia, a region of two continents,
one to the East and another to the West, divided by the Sundering Sea.
The opening of shipping routes has paved the way for huge vessels to take to the seas,
and newly invented technologies that use steam power are coming to the fore.
Many in this world are delighted at the prospect of establishing thriving industries and cultures,
but there are also those who suffer the oppression of war, disease and poverty.
That’s where you come in. Take control of one of eight travellers, born in different parts
of the world, travelling to different destinations, and each with their own special set
of skills, and journey across the world.

Embark upon a story all your own.

For more details, please see each title’s individual product page.
The products included in this bundle can be purchased on an individual basis as well.
70070000040133.name: OCTOPATH TRAVELER + OCTOPATH TRAVELER II Bundle

70070000040192.description:
MERGE, BUILD, AND DEFEND
Your fortress is under attack! Choose and place buildings, merge matching ones to make them stronger, and prepare for waves of monsters. Build structures that train knights, horsemen, archers, and mages, while all kinds of turrets and barricades attack or slow down enemies as they approach. Face skeletons, slimes, dragons, giants, and even stronger foes that appear as you progress. Adapt your setup to each threat and prepare for mighty bosses that can quickly break through a weak defense.

MAKE EVERY TILE COUNT
Space is limited, so plan your fortress carefully. Clear trees to open new tiles, decide where to place buildings that train different units, and find the best spots for barricades and turrets. Use every tile wisely, leave enough room to place and merge buildings, and create a layout that balances attack and defense.

CONTROL THE BATTLE SPEED
Activate permanent x2 Game Speed to face enemy waves twice as fast. Switch x2 Game Speed On or Off at any time and control how quickly the action unfolds.

LEAD HEROES INTO ACTION
Deploy one of four unique heroes to support your army. Upgrade their stats, equip powerful gear, and make use of their combat skills and permanent boosts.

UNLEASH THE STORM
Claire joins the roster with a permanent Mighty boost that increases the damage of all units by 10%. Her Thunder Storm damages and slows every enemy within its range, helping your defenses regain control when a wave becomes overwhelming.

FEATURES:
• Permanent x2 Game Speed - Speed up enemy waves and switch the feature On or Off at any time
• Units and Defenses - Build structures that produce different units or protect your fortress
• Strategic Placement - Clear trees, manage limited space, and balance offense with defense
• Merge and Upgrade - Combine matching buildings to create stronger structures
• Lead Your Heroes - Choose from 4 unique heroes, equip powerful gear, and use their combat skills
• Powerful Enemies - Face skeletons, slimes, dragons, giants, bosses, and unexpected threats
• Upgrade Choices - Gain experience and choose new bonuses as you progress
• Gold Management - Protect gold mines and spend your earnings on building rerolls
• 3 Challenge Modes - Test your strategy in Grand Battle, Boss Fight, and Hero Battle
• Varied Battlefields - Adapt your fortress to different environments, obstacles, and layouts

Explore the original set of levels of your favourite pocket mini-golf, and then go a few holes further with Sandy Rolls DLC, bringing shifting sands and volatile vortices to the board! All for the price of a large cup of coffee.

70070000040391.description:
FIGHT THE DEAD. SURVIVE THE STREETS.

The Walking Dead: Streets of Survival challenges you to intense arcade brawling in the unforgiving world of AMC’s The Walking Dead.

Play as iconic survivors Rick Grimes, Daryl Dixon, Michonne, and unlockable Negan while fighting through walker-infested tunnels, devastated settlements, and hostile strongholds packed with explosive encounters. Face Alexandria’s most ruthless foes, the Saviors led by Negan, along with overwhelming waves of Walkers as you unleash crushing combos, signature weapon attacks, and devastating finishers in a relentless battle for survival.

INSPIRED BY THE STORY YOU KNOW.
Based on the events of the All Out War storyline, fight through a campaign that reimagines the Saviors conflict that features walkers, threats, and surprises pulled from across the world of AMC’s The Walking Dead. You’ll explore familiar environments from the show - including the Sanctuary, Hilltop, Alexandria – enhanced by dynamic set pieces, environmental hazards, and intense, story-driven moments.

ICONIC SURVIVORS. ICONIC WEAPONS.
Step into the boots of legendary characters from The Walking Dead, each with a unique fighting style, stats, and signature abilities inspired by the series. Rick’s magnum, Michonne’s katana, and Daryl’s trusty crossbow are all ready for battle.

The Deluxe Edition includes The Arcade Apocalypse Pack:
•        2 Weapon Skins - Bloody Lucille, Tactical Magnum
•        1 Character Skin - Civic Republic Military Rick
•        The Walker Pit - Endless Survival Combat Mode
•        HELL ON EARTH Difficulty mode - Hardcore Mode without Checkpoints
•        Digital Soundtrack

GAME FEATURES:
•        Hard-Hitting Arcade Beat ’Em Up Combat
Use brutal melee abilities, crowd-clearing ranged attacks, or a mix of the two in fast-paced skirmishes. Enjoy responsive, crisp, and satisfying fighting gameplay while exploring the apocalypse.

•        Overwhelming Walker Swarms & Ruthless Enemies
Battle through creeping armies of the undead and dangerous members of The Saviors that force you to adapt, assess threats, and fight for every inch of ground.

•        Face Iconic Bosses
Take on powerful, fan-favorite walkers like Winslow, the Well Walker, and more. The Saviors provide their own challenges as you throw down with Negan and Simon in intense, multi-phase boss battles that test your skill, strategy, and survival instincts.

•        Replayable Arcade Challenge
Master each character’s moveset and tackle multiple difficulty levels in an experience built for repeat runs and escalating challenges. Or jump in with an optional Easy Mode for casual play.

Experience Tales of Eternia, remastered for the first time ever.

• An Epic Journey with Two Worlds at Stake
Journey to Eternia, a world split into two isolated realms, Inferia and Celestia.
In the remote Inferian village of Rasheans, Reid Hershel and his childhood friend Farah Oersted meet a mysterious girl named Meredy. During their journey to discover Meredy's origins, the group discovers that a collision called the "Great Fall" threatens both Inferia and Celesita.
Harnessing the power of elemental spirits known as the Greater Craymels, Reid and his companions embark on an epic journey to save the two realms from catastrophe.

• Exhilarating Battle Action with Speed and Freedom
Featuring the Aggressive Linear Motion Battle System (A-LMBS), which enables diverse Arte usage, continued combos, and coordination with each unique party member.
Experience thrilling combat as you outmaneuver enemies and defeat them one after another with fast-paced, dynamic 2D battle action.

• The Same Moving Experience, Now Easier to Play
Gameplay is better than ever with the quality-of-life features that have been added, including destination markers, the ability to disable enemy encounters, and high-speed mode during auto-battle.
Additionally, graphics and SFX can be toggled between modes, allowing you to experience the nostalgic atmosphere of the original game.

*A Standard Edition is also available. Be careful of duplicate purchases.
